entries.translation_source: The foe is dropped into a fissure. The foe faints if it hits.
entries.translated:
Lawan dijatuhkan ke
dalam celah. Lawan
pingsan jika mengenai.

entries.original:
"An attack that hits
on the 2nd turn.
Can also be used
to exit dungeons."
entries.translation_source: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang mengenai
pada giliran kedua. Juga
dapat digunakan untuk
keluar dari gua.

entries.original:
"A move that badly
poisons the foe.
Its poison damage
worsens every turn."
entries.translation_source: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang meracuni
lawan secara parah.
Kerusakan racunnya
bertambah parah setiap
giliran.

entries.original:
"A weak telekinetic
attack that may
also leave the foe
confused."
entries.translation_source: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.
entries.translated:
Serangan telekinetik
lemah yang juga dapat
membuat lawan bingung.

entries.original:
"A strong telekinetic
attack. It may also
lower the foe’s
Sp. Def stat."
entries.translation_source: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
entries.translated:
Serangan telekinetik
kuat. Juga dapat
menurunkan stat Sp. Def
lawan.

entries.original:
"Hypnotic suggestion
is used to make the
foe fall into a
deep sleep."
entries.translation_source: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.
entries.translated:
Sugesti hipnotis
digunakan untuk membuat
lawan tertidur lelap.

entries.original:
"The user meditates
to awaken its power
and raise its
Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The user meditates to awaken its power and raise its Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna bermeditasi
untuk membangkitkan
kekuatannya dan
meningkatkan stat
Serangan.

entries.original:
"The user relaxes
and lightens its
body to sharply
boost its Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user relaxes and lightens its body to sharply boost its Speed.
entries.translated:
Pengguna bersantai dan
meringankan tubuhnya
untuk meningkatkan
Kecepatan secara
drastis.

entries.original:
"An almost invisibly
fast attack that
is certain to strike
first."
entries.translation_source: An almost invisibly fast attack that is certain to strike first.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang hampir tak
terlihat cepat yang
pasti menyerang lebih
dulu.

entries.original:
"An attack that
becomes stronger
each time the user
is hit in battle."
entries.translation_source: An attack that becomes stronger each time the user is hit in battle.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang menjadi
lebih kuat setiap kali
pengguna terkena
serangan dalam
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"Use it to flee from
any wild Pokémon.
Also warps to the
last Poké Centre."
entries.translation_source: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. Also warps to the last Poké Centre.
entries.translated:
Gunakan untuk melarikan
diri dari Pokémon liar.
Juga memindahkan ke
Pusat Pokémon terakhir.

entries.original:
"An attack with a
mirage that inflicts
damage matching
the user’s level."
entries.translation_source: An attack with a mirage that inflicts damage matching the user’s level.
entries.translated:
Serangan dengan ilusi
yang memberikan damage
sesuai level pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user copies the
move last used by
the foe for the
rest of the battle."
entries.translation_source: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meniru gerakan
terakhir yang digunakan
lawan untuk sisa
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"An ear-splitting
screech is emitted
to sharply reduce
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Jeritan memekakkan
telinga dikeluarkan
untuk mengurangi
Pertahanan lawan secara
drastis.

entries.original:
"The user creates
illusory copies of
itself to raise its
evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membuat salinan
ilusi dari dirinya
sendiri untuk
meningkatkan
evasiveness.

entries.original:
"A self-healing move
that restores HP by
up to half of the
user’s maximum HP."
entries.translation_source: A self-healing move that restores HP by up to half of the user’s maximum HP.
entries.translated:
Gerakan penyembuhan diri
yang memulihkan HP
hingga setengah dari HP
maksimum pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user stiffens
all the muscles in
its body to raise
its Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengeraskan
semua otot di tubuhnya
untuk meningkatkan stat
Pertahanan.

entries.original:
"The user compresses
all the cells in its
body to raise its
evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: The user compresses all the cells in its body to raise its evasiveness.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memampatkan
semua sel di tubuhnya
untuk meningkatkan
evasiveness.

entries.original:
"An obscuring cloud
of smoke or ink
reduces the foe’s
accuracy."
entries.translation_source: An obscuring cloud of smoke or ink reduces the foe’s accuracy.
entries.translated:
Awan asap atau tinta
yang mengaburkan
mengurangi akurasi
lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is exposed
to a sinister ray
that triggers
confusion."
entries.translation_source: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.
entries.translated:
Lawan terkena sinar
jahat yang menyebabkan
kebingungan.

entries.original:
"The user withdraws
its body in its hard
shell, raising its
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user withdraws its body in its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menarik
tubuhnya ke dalam
cangkang keras,
meningkatkan stat
Pertahanan.

entries.original:
"The user curls up
to conceal weak
spots and raise its
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggulung diri
untuk menyembunyikan
titik lemah dan
meningkatkan stat
Pertahanan.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
sturdy wall that
sharply raises its
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menciptakan
dinding kokoh yang
meningkatkan stat
Pertahanan secara
drastis.

entries.original:
"A wall of light
cuts damage from
Sp. Atk attacks
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: A wall of light cuts damage from Sp. Atk attacks for five turns.
entries.translated:
Dinding cahaya
mengurangi damage dari
serangan Sp. Atk selama
lima giliran.

entries.original:
"Eliminates all stat
changes among all
Pokémon engaged in
battle."
entries.translation_source: Eliminates all stat changes among all Pokémon engaged in battle.
entries.translated:
Menghilangkan semua
perubahan stat di antara
semua Pokémon yang
terlibat dalam
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"A wall of light
cuts damage from
physical attacks
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.
entries.translated:
Dinding cahaya
mengurangi damage dari
serangan fisik selama
lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user takes a
deep breath and
focuses to raise its
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to raise its critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengambil napas
dalam-dalam dan
berkonsentrasi untuk
meningkatkan rasio
pukulan kritisnya.

entries.original:
"The user endures
attacks for two
turns, then strikes
back double."
entries.translation_source: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back double.
entries.translated:
Pengguna bertahan dari
serangan selama dua
giliran, lalu menyerang
balik dua kali lipat.

entries.original:
"Waggles a finger
and stimulates the
brain into using any
move at random."
entries.translation_source: Waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into using any move at random.
entries.translated:
Menggerak-gerakkan jari
dan merangsang otak
untuk menggunakan jurus
apa pun secara acak.

entries.original:
"The user counters
the move last used
by the foe with the
same move."
entries.translation_source: The user counters the move last used by the foe with the same move.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membalas jurus
terakhir yang digunakan
lawan dengan jurus yang
sama.

entries.original:
"The user blows up
to inflict severe
damage, even
making itself faint."
entries.translation_source: The user blows up to inflict severe damage, even making itself faint.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meledak untuk
menimbulkan kerusakan
parah, bahkan membuat
dirinya sendiri pingsan.

entries.original:
"A large egg is
hurled with great
force at the foe to
inflict damage."
entries.translation_source: A large egg is hurled with great force at the foe to inflict damage.
entries.translated:
Sebuah telur besar
dilemparkan dengan
kekuatan besar ke arah
lawan untuk menimbulkan
kerusakan.

entries.original:
"The foe is licked
and hit with a long
tongue. It may
also paralyze."
entries.translation_source: The foe is licked and hit with a long tongue. It may also paralyze.
entries.translated:
Lawan dijilat dan
dipukul dengan lidah
panjang. Ini juga dapat
melumpuhkan.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with exhaust gases.
It may also poison
the foe."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with exhaust gases. It may also poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
gas buang. Ini juga
dapat meracuni lawan.

entries.original:
"Toxic sludge is
hurled at the foe.
It may poison the
target."
entries.translation_source: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.
entries.translated:
Lumpur beracun
dilemparkan ke lawan.
Ini dapat meracuni
target.

entries.original:
"The foe is clubbed
with a bone held in
hand. It may make
the foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The foe is clubbed with a bone held in hand. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Lawan dipukul dengan
tulang yang dipegang di
tangan. Ini dapat
membuat lawan gentar.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
an intense flame.
It may leave the
target with a burn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.
entries.translated:
Lawan dipukul dengan api
yang hebat. Ini dapat
membuat target mengalami
luka bakar.

entries.original:
"A powerful charge
attack. It can also
be used to climb
a waterfall."
entries.translation_source: A powerful charge attack. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.
entries.translated:
Serangan charge yang
kuat. Ini juga dapat
digunakan untuk memanjat
air terjun.

entries.original:
"The foe is clamped
and squeezed by
the user’s shell for
two to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The foe is clamped and squeezed by the user’s shell for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Lawan dijepit dan
diperas oleh cangkang
pengguna selama dua
hingga lima giliran.

entries.original:
"Star-shaped rays
that never miss are
fired at all foes in
battle."
entries.translation_source: Star-shaped rays that never miss are fired at all foes in battle.
entries.translated:
Sinar berbentuk bintang
yang tidak pernah
meleset ditembakkan ke
semua lawan dalam
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"The user raises its
Defense in the 1st
turn, then attacks
in the 2nd turn."
entries.translation_source: The user raises its Defense in the 1st turn, then attacks in the 2nd turn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menaikkan
Pertahanannya pada
giliran pertama, lalu
menyerang pada giliran
kedua.

entries.original:
"Sharp spikes are
fired at the foe to
strike two to five
times."
entries.translation_source: Sharp spikes are fired at the foe to strike two to five times.
entries.translated:
Paku tajam ditembakkan
ke lawan untuk menyerang
dua hingga lima kali.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with long tentacles
or vines. It may
lower Speed."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with long tentacles or vines. It may lower Speed.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
tentakel atau sulur
panjang. Ini dapat
menurunkan Kecepatan.

entries.original:
"Forgets about
something and
sharply raises
Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: Forgets about something and sharply raises Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Melupakan sesuatu dan
menaikkan Sp. Def secara
drastis.

entries.original:
"The user distracts
the foe by bending
a spoon. It may
lower accuracy."
entries.translation_source: The user distracts the foe by bending a spoon. It may lower accuracy.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengalihkan
perhatian lawan dengan
membengkokkan sendok.
Ini dapat menurunkan
akurasi.

entries.original:
"Heals the user by
up to half its full
HP. It can be used
to heal an ally."
entries.translation_source: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.
entries.translated:
Menyembuhkan pengguna
hingga setengah HP
maksimalnya. Ini dapat
digunakan untuk
menyembuhkan sekutu.

entries.original:
"A strong jumping
knee kick. If it
misses, the user is
hurt."
entries.translation_source: A strong jumping knee kick. If it misses, the user is hurt.
entries.translated:
Lompatan lutut yang
kuat. Jika meleset,
pengguna akan terluka.

entries.original:
"The user intimidates
the foe with the
design on its belly
to cause paralysis."
entries.translation_source: The user intimidates the foe with the design on its belly to cause paralysis.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengintimidasi
musuh dengan pola di
perutnya untuk
menyebabkan kelumpuhan.

entries.original:
"Absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
on a sleeping foe
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Menyerap setengah dari
kerusakan yang
ditimbulkan pada musuh
yang tidur untuk
memulihkan HP.

entries.original:
"The foe is sprayed
with a cloud of
toxic gas that may
poison the foe."
entries.translation_source: The foe is sprayed with a cloud of toxic gas that may poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Musuh disemprot dengan
awan gas beracun yang
mungkin meracuni musuh.

entries.original:
"Round objects are
hurled at the foe
to strike two to
five times."
entries.translation_source: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times.
entries.translated:
Benda-benda bulat
dilemparkan ke musuh
untuk memukul dua hingga
lima kali.

entries.original:
"An attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang menyerap
setengah kerusakan yang
ditimbulkan untuk
memulihkan HP.

entries.original:
"The user forces a
kiss on the foe
with a scary face
that induces sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user forces a kiss on the foe with a scary face that induces sleep.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memaksakan
ciuman pada musuh dengan
wajah menakutkan yang
menyebabkan tidur.

entries.original:
"A 2nd-turn attack
move with a high
critical-hit ratio.
The foe may flinch."
entries.translation_source: A 2nd-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. The foe may flinch.
entries.translated:
Serangan giliran kedua
dengan rasio serangan
kritis tinggi. Musuh
mungkin gentar.

entries.original:
"The user transforms
into a copy of the
foe with even the
same move set."
entries.translation_source: The user transforms into a copy of the foe with even the same move set.
entries.translated:
Pengguna berubah menjadi
salinan musuh dengan set
gerakan yang sama.

entries.original:
"A spray of bubbles
hits the foe.
It may lower the
foe’s Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: A spray of bubbles hits the foe. It may lower the foe’s Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Semprotan gelembung
mengenai musuh. Ini
dapat menurunkan stat
Speed musuh.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a rhythmic punch
that may leave it
confused."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a rhythmic punch that may leave it confused.
entries.translated:
Musuh dipukul dengan
pukulan berirama yang
dapat membuatnya
bingung.

entries.original:
"The user scatters
bursts of fine
spores that induce
sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user scatters bursts of fine spores that induce sleep.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyebarkan
semburan spora halus
yang menyebabkan tidur.

entries.original:
"A blast of light
that cuts the foe’s
accuracy. It also
illuminates caves."
entries.translation_source: A blast of light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It also illuminates caves.
entries.translated:
Ledakan cahaya yang
mengurangi akurasi
musuh. Ini juga
menerangi gua.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with an odd, hot
energy wave that
varies in intensity."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with an odd, hot energy wave that varies in intensity.
entries.translated:
Musuh diserang dengan
gelombang energi panas
aneh yang bervariasi
intensitasnya.

entries.original:
"The user just flops
and splashes around
without having any
effect."
entries.translation_source: The user just flops and splashes around without having any effect.
entries.translated:
Pengguna hanya
tergelepar dan memercik
tanpa efek apa pun.

entries.original:
"The user alters its
cells to liquefy
itself and sharply
raise Defense."
entries.translation_source: The user alters its cells to liquefy itself and sharply raise Defense.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengubah selnya
untuk mencairkan dirinya
dan meningkatkan Defense
secara drastis.

entries.original:
"A large pincer is
used to hammer the
foe. It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: A large pincer is used to hammer the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Penjepit besar digunakan
untuk memukul musuh. Ini
memiliki rasio serangan
kritis tinggi.

entries.original:
"The user explodes
to inflict terrible
damage even while
fainting itself."
entries.translation_source: The user explodes to inflict terrible damage even while fainting itself.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meledak untuk
memberikan kerusakan
mengerikan bahkan saat
pingsan sendiri.

entries.original:
"The foe is raked
with sharp claws or
scythes two to five
times."
entries.translation_source: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes two to five times.
entries.translated:
Musuh diseret dengan
cakar tajam atau sabit
dua hingga lima kali.

entries.original:
"The user throws a
bone that hits the
foe once, then once
again on return."
entries.translation_source: The user throws a bone that hits the foe once, then once again on return.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melempar tulang
yang mengenai musuh
sekali, lalu sekali lagi
saat kembali.

entries.original:
"The user sleeps for
two turns to fully
restore HP and heal
any status problem."
entries.translation_source: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.
entries.translated:
Pengguna tidur selama
dua giliran untuk
memulihkan HP sepenuhnya
dan menyembuhkan masalah
status apa pun.

entries.original:
"Large boulders are
hurled at the foe.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: Large boulders are hurled at the foe. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Batu besar dilemparkan
ke lawan. Ini dapat
membuat lawan menggigil.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with sharp fangs.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with sharp fangs. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
taring tajam. Ini dapat
membuat lawan menggigil.

entries.original:
"The user reduces
its polygon count
to sharpen edges
and raise Attack."
entries.translation_source: The user reduces its polygon count to sharpen edges and raise Attack.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengurangi
jumlah poligonnya untuk
mengasah ujung dan
meningkatkan Serangan.

entries.original:
"The user changes
its type to match
the type of one of
its moves."
entries.translation_source: The user changes its type to match the type of one of its moves.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengubah
tipenya agar sesuai
dengan tipe salah satu
gerakannya.

entries.original:
"A simultaneous
3-beam attack that
may paralyze, burn,
or frostbite the foe."
entries.translation_source: A simultaneous 3-beam attack that may paralyze, burn, or frostbite the foe.
entries.translated:
Serangan 3 sinar
serentak yang dapat
melumpuhkan, membakar,
atau menyebabkan radang
dingin pada lawan.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with sharp fangs
and halves the
foe’s HP."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with sharp fangs and halves the foe’s HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan taring tajam dan
membagi dua HP lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is slashed
with claws, etc.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slashed with claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Lawan dicakar dengan
cakar, dll. Ini memiliki
rasio serangan kritis
yang tinggi.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
decoy using one-
quarter of its full
HP."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menciptakan
pengganti menggunakan
seperempat dari HP
penuhnya.

entries.original:
"An attack that is
used only if there
is no PP. It also
hurts the user."
entries.translation_source: An attack that is used only if there is no PP. It also hurts the user.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang hanya
digunakan jika tidak ada
PP. Ini juga melukai
pengguna.

entries.original:
"This move copies
the move last used
by the foe, then
disappears."
entries.translation_source: This move copies the move last used by the foe, then disappears.
entries.translated:
Gerakan ini meniru
gerakan terakhir yang
digunakan lawan, lalu
menghilang.

entries.original:
"A 3-kick attack
that becomes more
powerful with each
successive hit."
entries.translation_source: A 3-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
entries.translated:
Serangan 3 tendangan
yang menjadi lebih kuat
setiap pukulan
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"An attack that may
take the foe’s held
item if the user
isn’t holding one."
entries.translation_source: An attack that may take the foe’s held item if the user isn’t holding one.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang dapat
mengambil item yang
dipegang lawan jika
pengguna tidak memegang
satu.

entries.original:
"Ensnares the foe 
with sticky string
so it doesn’t flee
or switch out."
entries.translation_source: Ensnares the foe with sticky string so it doesn’t flee or switch out.
entries.translated:
Menjerat lawan dengan
tali lengket sehingga
tidak bisa kabur atau
berganti.

entries.original:
"The user predicts
the foe’s action to
ensure its next
attack hits."
entries.translation_source: The user predicts the foe’s action to ensure its next attack hits.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memprediksi
tindakan lawan untuk
memastikan serangan
berikutnya mengenai.

entries.original:
"A sleeping foe is
shown a nightmare
that inflicts some
damage every turn."
entries.translation_source: A sleeping foe is shown a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
entries.translated:
Lawan yang tidur
ditunjukkan mimpi buruk
yang menimbulkan
kerusakan setiap
giliran.

entries.original:
"The user makes a
fiery charge at the
foe. It may cause
a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user makes a fiery charge at the foe. It may cause a burn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melakukan
serangan berapi ke
lawan. Ini dapat
menyebabkan luka bakar.

entries.original:
"An attack that can
be used only while
asleep. It may
cause flinching."
entries.translation_source: An attack that can be used only while asleep. It may cause flinching.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang hanya
dapat digunakan saat
tidur. Ini dapat
menyebabkan menggigil.

entries.original:
"A move that works
differently for the
Ghost-type and all
the other types."
entries.translation_source: A move that works differently for the Ghost-type and all the other types.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang bekerja
berbeda untuk tipe Hantu
dan semua tipe lainnya.

entries.original:
"A desperate attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has."
entries.translation_source: A desperate attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
entries.translated:
Serangan putus asa yang
menjadi lebih kuat
semakin sedikit HP yang
dimiliki pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user changes
type to make itself
resistant to the
last attack it took."
entries.translation_source: The user changes type to make itself resistant to the last attack it took.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengubah tipe
untuk membuat dirinya
tahan terhadap serangan
terakhir yang
diterimanya.

entries.original:
"A vortex of air is
shot at the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: A vortex of air is shot at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Sebuah pusaran udara
ditembakkan ke lawan.
Rasio serangan kritisnya
tinggi.

entries.original:
"Cotton-like spores
cling to the foe,
sharply reducing
its Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: Cotton-like spores cling to the foe, sharply reducing its Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Spora seperti kapas
menempel pada lawan,
sangat mengurangi
Kecepatannya.

entries.original:
"An all-out attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has."
entries.translation_source: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
entries.translated:
Serangan total yang
menjadi lebih kuat
semakin sedikit HP yang
dimiliki pengguna.

entries.original:
"A move that cuts
2 to 5 PP from the
move last used by
the foe."
entries.translation_source: A move that cuts 2 to 5 PP from the move last used by the foe.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang memotong 2
hingga 5 PP dari gerakan
terakhir yang digunakan
lawan.

entries.original:
"The opposing team is
hit with powdery snow
that may leave them
with frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The opposing team is hit with powdery snow that may leave them with frostbite.
entries.translated:
Tim lawan terkena salju
bubuk yang dapat
menyebabkan mereka
terkena radang dingin.

entries.original:
"Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession."
entries.translation_source: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Memungkinkan pengguna
untuk menghindari semua
serangan. Mungkin gagal
jika digunakan
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"A punch thrown at
blinding speed.
It is certain to
strike first."
entries.translation_source: A punch thrown at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.
entries.translated:
Pukulan yang dilemparkan
dengan kecepatan
membutakan. Pasti
menyerang lebih dulu.

entries.original:
"Frightens the foe
with a scary face
to sharply reduce
its Speed."
entries.translation_source: Frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its Speed.
entries.translated:
Menakuti lawan dengan
wajah menakutkan untuk
sangat mengurangi
Kecepatannya.

entries.original:
"The user draws up
close to the foe
disarmingly, then
hits without fail."
entries.translation_source: The user draws up close to the foe disarmingly, then hits without fail.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mendekat ke
lawan dengan sikap tidak
mengancam, lalu memukul
tanpa gagal.

entries.original:
"The user kisses
the foe with sweet
cuteness that
causes confusion."
entries.translation_source: The user kisses the foe with sweet cuteness that causes confusion.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mencium lawan
dengan kelucuan manis
yang menyebabkan
kebingungan.

entries.original:
"The user maximizes
its Attack stat at
the cost of half
its full HP."
entries.translation_source: The user maximizes its Attack stat at the cost of half its full HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memaksimalkan
Stat Serangannya dengan
mengorbankan setengah
dari HP penuhnya.

entries.original:
"Filthy sludge is
hurled at the foe.
It may poison the
target."
entries.translation_source: Filthy sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.
entries.translated:
Lumpur kotor dilemparkan
ke lawan. Dapat meracuni
target.

entries.original:
"Mud is hurled in
the foe’s face to
inflict damage and
lower its accuracy."
entries.translation_source: Mud is hurled in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
entries.translated:
Lumpur dilemparkan ke
wajah lawan untuk
memberikan kerusakan dan
menurunkan akurasinya.

entries.original:
"Ink is blasted in
the foe’s face or
eyes to damage and
lower accuracy."
entries.translation_source: Ink is blasted in the foe’s face or eyes to damage and lower accuracy.
entries.translated:
Tinta diledakkan ke
wajah atau mata lawan
untuk merusak dan
menurunkan akurasi.

entries.original:
"A trap of spikes is
laid around the
foe’s party to hurt
foes switching in."
entries.translation_source: A trap of spikes is laid around the foe’s party to hurt foes switching in.
entries.translated:
Perangkap paku
diletakkan di sekitar
tim lawan untuk melukai
lawan yang masuk ke
pertarungan.

entries.original:
"An electric blast is
fired like a cannon
to inflict damage
and paralyze."
entries.translation_source: An electric blast is fired like a cannon to inflict damage and paralyze.
entries.translated:
Ledakan listrik
ditembakkan seperti
meriam untuk memberikan
kerusakan dan
melumpuhkan.

entries.original:
"Completely negates
the foe’s efforts to
heighten its ability
to evade."
entries.translation_source: Completely negates the foe’s efforts to heighten its ability to evade.
entries.translated:
Sepenuhnya meniadakan
upaya lawan untuk
meningkatkan
kemampuannya menghindar.

entries.original:
"If the user faints,
the foe delivering
the final hit also
faints."
entries.translation_source: If the user faints, the foe delivering the final hit also faints.
entries.translated:
Jika pengguna pingsan,
lawan yang memberikan
pukulan terakhir juga
pingsan.

entries.original:
"Any battler that
hears this faints
in three turns
unless it switches."
entries.translation_source: Any battler that hears this faints in three turns unless it switches.
entries.translated:
Petarung mana pun yang
mendengar ini akan
pingsan dalam tiga
giliran kecuali jika
bertukar.

entries.original:
"A chilling wind is
used to attack.
It also lowers the
Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: A chilling wind is used to attack. It also lowers the Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Angin dingin digunakan
untuk menyerang. Ini
juga menurunkan stat
Kecepatan.

entries.original:
"Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession."
entries.translation_source: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Memungkinkan pengguna
untuk menghindari semua
serangan. Mungkin gagal
jika digunakan
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"The user strikes
the foe with a bone
in hand two to five
times."
entries.translation_source: The user strikes the foe with a bone in hand two to five times.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memukul lawan
dengan tulang di tangan
dua hingga lima kali.

entries.original:
"The user locks on
to the foe, making
the next move sure
to hit."
entries.translation_source: The user locks on to the foe, making the next move sure to hit.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengunci lawan,
membuat gerakan
berikutnya pasti
mengenai.

entries.original:
"The user thrashes
about for two to
three turns, then
becomes confused."
entries.translation_source: The user thrashes about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengamuk selama
dua hingga tiga giliran,
lalu menjadi bingung.

entries.original:
"A 5-turn sandstorm
that damages all
types except Rock,
Ground, and Steel."
entries.translation_source: A 5-turn sandstorm that damages all types except Rock, Ground, and Steel.
entries.translated:
Badai pasir 5 giliran
yang merusak semua tipe
kecuali Batu, Tanah, dan
Baja.

entries.original:
"A harsh attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: A harsh attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Serangan keras yang
menyerap setengah dari
kerusakan yang
ditimbulkan untuk
memulihkan HP.

entries.original:
"The user endures
any hit with 1 HP
left. It may fail if
used in succession."
entries.translation_source: The user endures any hit with 1 HP left. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Pengguna bertahan dari
serangan apa pun dengan
sisa 1 HP. Mungkin gagal
jika digunakan
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"The foe is charmed
by the user’s cute
appeals, sharply
cutting its Attack."
entries.translation_source: The foe is charmed by the user’s cute appeals, sharply cutting its Attack.
entries.translated:
Lawan terpesona oleh
daya tarik imut
pengguna, sangat
menurunkan Serangannya.

entries.original:
"A 5-turn rolling
attack that becomes
stronger each time
it hits."
entries.translation_source: A 5-turn rolling attack that becomes stronger each time it hits.
entries.translated:
Serangan bergulir 5
giliran yang menjadi
lebih kuat setiap kali
mengenai.

entries.original:
"A restrained attack
that always leaves
the foe with at
least 1 HP."
entries.translation_source: A restrained attack that always leaves the foe with at least 1 HP.
entries.translated:
Serangan terkendali yang
selalu membuat lawan
dengan setidaknya 1 HP.

entries.original:
"A move that makes
the foe confused,
but also sharply
raises its Attack."
entries.translation_source: A move that makes the foe confused, but also sharply raises its Attack.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang membuat
lawan bingung, tetapi
juga sangat meningkatkan
Serangannya.

entries.original:
"Heals the user by
up to half its full
HP. It can be used
to heal an ally."
entries.translation_source: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.
entries.translated:
Menyembuhkan pengguna
hingga setengah dari HP
penuhnya. Dapat
digunakan untuk
menyembuhkan sekutu.

entries.original:
"An electrically
charged tackle that
may also paralyze
the foe."
entries.translation_source: An electrically charged tackle that may also paralyze the foe.
entries.translated:
Tackle bermuatan listrik
yang juga dapat
melumpuhkan lawan.

entries.original:
"An attack that
grows stronger on
each successive
hit."
entries.translation_source: An attack that grows stronger on each successive hit.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang menjadi
lebih kuat pada setiap
pukulan berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
wings of steel.
It may also raise
the user’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Lawan dipukul dengan
sayap baja. Ini juga
dapat meningkatkan
Pertahanan pengguna.

entries.original:
"The foe is fixed
with a mean look
that prevents it
from escaping."
entries.translation_source: The foe is fixed with a mean look that prevents it from escaping.
entries.translated:
Lawan ditatap dengan
tatapan jahat yang
mencegahnya melarikan
diri.

entries.original:
"If it is the other
gender, the foe is
made infatuated and
unlikely to attack."
entries.translation_source: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.
entries.translated:
Jika lawan berjenis
kelamin berbeda, lawan
menjadi tergila-gila dan
tidak mungkin menyerang.

entries.original:
"While asleep, the
user randomly uses
one of the moves it
knows."
entries.translation_source: While asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
entries.translated:
Saat tertidur, pengguna
secara acak menggunakan
salah satu gerakan yang
diketahuinya.

entries.original:
"A soothing bell
chimes to heal the
status problems of
all allies."
entries.translation_source: A soothing bell chimes to heal the status problems of all allies.
entries.translated:
Lonceng yang menenangkan
berbunyi untuk
menyembuhkan masalah
status semua sekutu.

entries.original:
"This attack move
grows more powerful
the more the user
likes its Trainer."
entries.translation_source: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
entries.translated:
Serangan ini menjadi
semakin kuat semakin
pengguna menyukai
Pelatihnya.

entries.original:
"The foe is given a
booby-trapped gift.
It restores HP
sometimes, however."
entries.translation_source: The foe is given a booby-trapped gift. It restores HP sometimes, however.
entries.translated:
Lawan diberikan hadiah
berisi jebakan. Namun,
kadang-kadang memulihkan
HP.

entries.original:
"This attack move
grows more powerful
the less the user
likes its Trainer."
entries.translation_source: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
entries.translated:
Serangan ini menjadi
semakin kuat semakin
tidak menyukai
Pelatihnya.

entries.original:
"It protects the
user’s party from
all status problems
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: It protects the user’s party from all status problems for five turns.
entries.translated:
Melindungi tim pengguna
dari semua masalah
status selama lima
giliran.

entries.original:
"The user adds its
HP to the foe’s HP,
then equally shares
the total HP."
entries.translation_source: The user adds its HP to the foe’s HP, then equally shares the total HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menambahkan
HP-nya ke HP lawan, lalu
membagi total HP secara
merata.

entries.original:
"A mystical and
powerful fire
attack that may
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: A mystical and powerful fire attack that may inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
Serangan api mistis dan
kuat yang dapat
menyebabkan luka bakar.

entries.original:
"A ground-shaking
attack against all
standing Pokémon.
Its power varies."
entries.translation_source: A ground-shaking attack against all standing Pokémon. Its power varies.
entries.translated:
Serangan mengguncang
tanah terhadap semua
Pokémon yang berdiri.
Kekuatannya bervariasi.

entries.original:
"The foe is punched
with the user’s full
power. It confuses
the foe if it hits."
entries.translation_source: The foe is punched with the user’s full power. It confuses the foe if it hits.
entries.translated:
Lawan dipukul dengan
kekuatan penuh pengguna.
Jika mengenai,
membingungkan lawan.

entries.original:
"A brutal ramming
attack delivered
with a tough and
impressive horn."
entries.translation_source: A brutal ramming attack delivered with a tough and impressive horn.
entries.translated:
Serangan tabrak brutal
yang dilancarkan dengan
tanduk yang keras dan
mengesankan.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
an incredible blast
of breath that may
also paralyze."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with an incredible blast of breath that may also paralyze.
entries.translated:
Lawan terkena ledakan
napas luar biasa yang
juga dapat melumpuhkan.

entries.original:
"The user switches
out, passing along
any stat changes
to the new battler."
entries.translation_source: The user switches out, passing along any stat changes to the new battler.
entries.translated:
Pengguna berganti,
mewariskan perubahan
statistik apa pun kepada
petarung baru.

entries.original:
"Makes the foe use
the move it last
used repeatedly for
two to six turns."
entries.translation_source: Makes the foe use the move it last used repeatedly for two to six turns.
entries.translated:
Membuat lawan
menggunakan gerakan yang
terakhir digunakan
berulang kali selama dua
hingga enam giliran.

entries.original:
"An attack move that
works especially
well on a foe that
is switching out."
entries.translation_source: An attack move that works especially well on a foe that is switching out.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang bekerja
sangat baik pada lawan
yang sedang berganti.

entries.original:
"An attack that frees
the user from traps
and hazards. Also
raises Speed."
entries.translation_source: An attack that frees the user from traps and hazards. Also raises Speed.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang
membebaskan pengguna
dari jebakan dan
rintangan. Juga
meningkatkan Kecepatan.

entries.original:
"Allures the foe to
reduce evasiveness.
It also attracts
wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Allures the foe to reduce evasiveness. It also attracts wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Memikat lawan untuk
mengurangi kemampuan
menghindar. Juga menarik
Pokémon liar.

entries.original:
"An attack with a
steel-hard tail.
It may lower the
foe’s Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: An attack with a steel-hard tail. It may lower the foe’s Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Serangan dengan ekor
keras baja. Dapat
menurunkan statistik
Pertahanan lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with steel claws.
It may also raise
the user’s Attack."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
cakar baja. Juga dapat
meningkatkan Serangan
pengguna.

entries.original:
"Makes the user
attack after the
foe. In return,
it will not miss."
entries.translation_source: Makes the user attack after the foe. In return, it will not miss.
entries.translated:
Membuat pengguna
menyerang setelah lawan.
Sebagai imbalan, tidak
akan meleset.

entries.original:
"Restores the user’s
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather."
entries.translation_source: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
entries.translated:
Memulihkan HP pengguna.
Jumlah HP yang
dipulihkan bervariasi
tergantung cuaca.

entries.original:
"Restores the user’s
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather."
entries.translation_source: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
entries.translated:
Memulihkan HP pengguna.
Jumlah HP yang
dipulihkan bervariasi
tergantung cuaca.

entries.original:
"Restores the user’s
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather."
entries.translation_source: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
entries.translated:
Memulihkan HP pengguna.
Jumlah HP yang
dipulihkan bervariasi
tergantung cuaca.

entries.original:
"A unique attack 
that varies in type
depending on the
user.       "
entries.translation_source: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the user.
entries.translated:
Serangan unik yang
tipe-nya bervariasi
tergantung pengguna.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
double chops.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with double chops. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Lawan terkena pukulan
ganda. Rasio
critical-hit tinggi.

entries.original:
"A vicious twister
attacks the foe.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: A vicious twister attacks the foe. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Angin puyuh ganas
menyerang lawan. Dapat
membuat lawan gempar.

entries.original:
"A heavy rain falls
for five turns,
powering up Water-
type moves."
entries.translation_source: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.
entries.translated:
Hujan deras turun selama
lima giliran, memperkuat
gerakan tipe Air.

entries.original:
"The sun blazes for
five turns, powering
up Fire-type
moves."
entries.translation_source: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.
entries.translated:
Matahari bersinar terik
selama lima giliran,
memperkuat gerakan tipe
Api.

entries.original:
"The foe is crunched
with sharp fangs.
It may lower the
foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is crunched with sharp fangs. It may lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Lawan digigit dengan
taring tajam. Dapat
menurunkan Pertahanan
lawan.

entries.original:
"A retaliation move
that pays back the
foe’s special attack
double."
entries.translation_source: A retaliation move that pays back the foe’s special attack double.
entries.translated:
Gerakan balas dendam
yang membalas serangan
spesial lawan dua kali
lipat.

entries.original:
"The user hypnotizes
itself into copying
any stat change
made by the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menghipnotis
dirinya sendiri untuk
meniru perubahan stat
yang dilakukan lawan.

entries.original:
"A blindingly speedy
charge attack that
always goes before
any other."
entries.translation_source: A blindingly speedy charge attack that always goes before any other.
entries.translated:
Serangan charge yang
sangat cepat dan selalu
berjalan sebelum yang
lain.

entries.original:
"An ancient power is
used to attack. It
may also raise all
the user’s stats."
entries.translation_source: An ancient power is used to attack. It may also raise all the user’s stats.
entries.translated:
Kekuatan kuno digunakan
untuk menyerang. Dapat
juga meningkatkan semua
stat pengguna.

entries.original:
"A shadowy blob is
hurled at the foe.
May also lower the
foe’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: A shadowy blob is hurled at the foe. May also lower the foe’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Gumpalan bayangan
dilemparkan ke lawan.
Dapat juga menurunkan
Sp. Def lawan.

entries.original:
"Two turns after
this move is used,
the foe is attacked
psychically."
entries.translation_source: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked psychically.
entries.translated:
Dua giliran setelah
gerakan ini digunakan,
lawan diserang secara
psikis.

entries.original:
"An attack that
lowers Defense.
It can also smash
cracked boulders.      "
entries.translation_source: An attack that lowers Defense. It can also smash cracked boulders.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang menurunkan
Pertahanan. Juga dapat
menghancurkan batu besar
yang retak.

entries.original:
"The foe is trapped
in a fast, vicious
whirlpool for two
to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The foe is trapped in a fast, vicious whirlpool for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Lawan terperangkap di
pusaran air yang cepat
dan ganas selama dua
hingga lima giliran.

entries.original:
"All party Pokémon
join in the attack.
The more allies,
the more damage."
entries.translation_source: All party Pokémon join in the attack. The more allies, the more damage.
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon dalam tim
ikut menyerang. Semakin
banyak sekutu, semakin
besar kerusakan.

entries.original:
"An attack that hits
first and causes
flinching. Usable
only on 1st turn."
entries.translation_source: An attack that hits first and causes flinching. Usable only on 1st turn.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang mengenai
pertama dan menyebabkan
gempar. Hanya dapat
digunakan pada giliran
pertama.

entries.original:
"The user attacks in
an uproar that
prevents sleep for
two to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks in an uproar that prevents sleep for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan keributan yang
mencegah tidur selama
dua hingga lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user charges
up power for use
later. It can be
used three times."
entries.translation_source: The user charges up power for use later. It can be used three times.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengisi daya
untuk digunakan nanti.
Dapat digunakan tiga
kali.

entries.original:
"The power built
using Stockpile is
released at once
for attack."
entries.translation_source: The power built using Stockpile is released at once for attack.
entries.translated:
Kekuatan yang dibangun
menggunakan Stockpile
dilepaskan sekaligus
untuk menyerang.

entries.original:
"The energy it built
using Stockpile is
absorbed to restore
HP."
entries.translation_source: The energy it built using Stockpile is absorbed to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Energi yang dikumpulkan
menggunakan Stockpile
diserap untuk memulihkan
HP.

entries.original:
"The user exhales a
heated breath to
attack. It may also
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user exhales a heated breath to attack. It may also inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menghembuskan
napas panas untuk
menyerang. Ini juga
dapat menyebabkan luka
bakar.

entries.original:
"A hailstorm lasting
five turns damages
all Pokémon except
the Ice-type."
entries.translation_source: A hailstorm lasting five turns damages all Pokémon except the Ice-type.
entries.translated:
Badai es yang
berlangsung lima giliran
merusak semua Pokémon
kecuali tipe Es.

entries.original:
"It enrages the foe,
making it incapable
of using the same
move successively."
entries.translation_source: It enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move successively.
entries.translated:
Ini membuat lawan marah,
sehingga tidak bisa
menggunakan jurus yang
sama secara
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"Flattery is used to
confuse the foe,
but its Sp. Atk
also rises."
entries.translation_source: Flattery is used to confuse the foe, but its Sp. Atk also rises.
entries.translated:
Sanjungan digunakan
untuk membuat lawan
bingung, tetapi Sp.
Atk-nya juga naik.

entries.original:
"A sinister, bluish
white flame is shot
at the foe to
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: A sinister, bluish white flame is shot at the foe to inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
Api kebiruan dan putih
yang menyeramkan
ditembakkan ke lawan
untuk menyebabkan luka
bakar.

entries.original:
"The user faints,
but sharply lowers
the foe’s Attack
and Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: The user faints, but sharply lowers the foe’s Attack and Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Pengguna pingsan, tetapi
sangat menurunkan
Serangan dan Sp. Atk
lawan.

entries.original:
"An attack that is
boosted if user is
burned, poisoned,
or paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang diperkuat
jika pengguna mengalami
luka bakar, racun, atau
lumpuh.

entries.original:
"An attack that is
executed last.
The user flinches
if hit beforehand."
entries.translation_source: An attack that is executed last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang dilakukan
paling akhir. Pengguna
akan gemetar jika
terkena serangan
sebelumnya.

entries.original:
"Doubly effective on
a paralyzed foe,
but it also cures
the foe’s paralysis."
entries.translation_source: Doubly effective on a paralyzed foe, but it also cures the foe’s paralysis.
entries.translated:
Efektif dua kali lipat
pada lawan yang lumpuh,
tetapi juga menyembuhkan
kelumpuhan lawan.

entries.original:
"The user draws
attention to itself,
making foes attack
only the user."
entries.translation_source: The user draws attention to itself, making foes attack only the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menarik
perhatian pada dirinya
sendiri, membuat lawan
hanya menyerang
pengguna.

entries.original:
"An attack that
changes type
depending on the
user’s location."
entries.translation_source: An attack that changes type depending on the user’s location.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang berubah
tipe tergantung pada
lokasi pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user charges
power to boost the
Electric move it
uses next."
entries.translation_source: The user charges power to boost the Electric move it uses next.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengisi daya
untuk memperkuat jurus
Listrik yang digunakan
selanjutnya.

entries.original:
"The foe is taunted
into a rage that
allows it to use
only attack moves."
entries.translation_source: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves.
entries.translated:
Lawan diejek hingga
marah sehingga hanya
bisa menggunakan jurus
serangan.

entries.original:
"A move that boosts
the power of the
ally’s attack in a
battle."
entries.translation_source: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a battle.
entries.translated:
Jurus yang meningkatkan
kekuatan serangan sekutu
dalam pertarungan.

entries.original:
"A move that tricks
the foe into
trading held items
with the user."
entries.translation_source: A move that tricks the foe into trading held items with the user.
entries.translated:
Jurus yang mengelabui
lawan untuk menukar item
yang dibawa dengan
pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user mimics the
foe completely and
copies the foe’s
ability."
entries.translation_source: The user mimics the foe completely and copies the foe’s ability.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meniru lawan
sepenuhnya dan menyalin
kemampuan lawan.

entries.original:
"A self-healing move
that restores half
the full HP on the
next turn."
entries.translation_source: A self-healing move that restores half the full HP on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Jurus penyembuhan diri
yang memulihkan setengah
dari HP penuh pada
giliran berikutnya.

entries.original:
"The user randomly
picks and uses a
move of an allied
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The user randomly picks and uses a move of an allied Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Pengguna secara acak
memilih dan menggunakan
jurus dari Pokémon
sekutu.

entries.original:
"The user lays roots
that restore HP on
every turn.
It can’t switch out."
entries.translation_source: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. It can’t switch out.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menanam akar
yang memulihkan HP
setiap giliran. Pengguna
tidak bisa bertukar.

entries.original:
"A powerful attack,
but it also lowers
the user’s Attack
and Defense stats."
entries.translation_source: A powerful attack, but it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.
entries.translated:
Serangan kuat, tetapi
juga menurunkan stat
Attack dan Defense
pengguna.

entries.original:
"Reflects back the
foe’s Leech Seed
and any status-
damaging move."
entries.translation_source: Reflects back the foe’s Leech Seed and any status- damaging move.
entries.translated:
Memantulkan kembali
Leech Seed lawan dan
gerakan status yang
merusak.

entries.original:
"A move that
recycles a used
item for use once
more."
entries.translation_source: A move that recycles a used item for use once more.
entries.translated:
Gerakan yang mendaur
ulang item bekas untuk
digunakan sekali lagi.

entries.original:
"An attack move that
gains in intensity
if the target has
hurt the user."
entries.translation_source: An attack move that gains in intensity if the target has hurt the user.
entries.translated:
Gerakan serangan yang
bertambah kuat jika
target telah melukai
pengguna.

entries.original:
"An attack that also
breaks any barrier
like Light Screen
and Reflect."
entries.translation_source: An attack that also breaks any barrier like Light Screen and Reflect.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang juga
menghancurkan penghalang
seperti Light Screen dan
Reflect.

entries.original:
"A huge yawn lulls
the foe into falling
asleep on the next
turn."
entries.translation_source: A huge yawn lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Menguap besar membuat
lawan tertidur pada
giliran berikutnya.

entries.original:
"Knocks down the
foe’s held item to
prevent its use
during the battle."
entries.translation_source: Knocks down the foe’s held item to prevent its use during the battle.
entries.translated:
Menjatuhkan item yang
dibawa lawan untuk
mencegah penggunaannya
selama pertempuran.

entries.original:
"Gains power the
fewer HP the user
has compared with
the foe."
entries.translation_source: Gains power the fewer HP the user has compared with the foe.
entries.translated:
Mendapat kekuatan
semakin sedikit HP
pengguna dibandingkan
dengan lawan.

entries.original:
"The higher the
user’s HP, the more
powerful this
attack becomes."
entries.translation_source: The higher the user’s HP, the more powerful this attack becomes.
entries.translated:
Semakin tinggi HP
pengguna, semakin kuat
serangan ini.

entries.original:
"The user employs
its psychic power
to swap abilities
with the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to swap abilities with the foe.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
kekuatan psikisnya untuk
bertukar ability dengan
lawan.

entries.original:
"Prevents foes from
using any move
that is also known
by the user."
entries.translation_source: Prevents foes from using any move that is also known by the user.
entries.translated:
Mencegah lawan
menggunakan gerakan yang
juga diketahui oleh
pengguna.

entries.original:
"A self-healing move
that cures the user
of a poisoning,
burn, or paralysis."
entries.translation_source: A self-healing move that cures the user of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.
entries.translated:
Gerakan penyembuhan diri
yang menyembuhkan
pengguna dari racun,
luka bakar, atau
kelumpuhan.

entries.original:
"If the user faints,
this move deletes
the PP of the move
that finished it."
entries.translation_source: If the user faints, this move deletes the PP of the move that finished it.
entries.translated:
Jika pengguna pingsan,
gerakan ini menghapus PP
dari gerakan yang
mengalahkannya.

entries.original:
"Steals the effects
of the foe’s
healing or status-
changing move."
entries.translation_source: Steals the effects of the foe’s healing or status- changing move.
entries.translated:
Mencuri efek dari
gerakan penyembuhan atau
pengubah status lawan.

entries.original:
"An attack that may
have an additional
effect that varies
with the terrain."
entries.translation_source: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang mungkin
memiliki efek tambahan
yang bervariasi
tergantung medan.

entries.original:
"The user dives
underwater on the
first turn and
strikes next turn."
entries.translation_source: The user dives underwater on the first turn and strikes next turn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyelam di
bawah air pada giliran
pertama dan menyerang
pada giliran berikutnya.

entries.original:
"A quick flurry of
straight-arm
punches that hit
two to five times."
entries.translation_source: A quick flurry of straight-arm punches that hit two to five times.
entries.translated:
Serangan cepat pukulan
lengan lurus yang
mengenai dua hingga lima
kali.

entries.original:
"Alters the user’s
type depending on
the location’s
terrain."
entries.translation_source: Alters the user’s type depending on the location’s terrain.
entries.translated:
Mengubah tipe pengguna
tergantung pada medan
lokasi.

entries.original:
"The user flashes a
light that sharply
raises its Sp. Atk
stat."
entries.translation_source: The user flashes a light that sharply raises its Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memancarkan
cahaya yang meningkatkan
drastis stat Sp.
Atk-nya.

entries.original:
"A burst of light
injures the foe. It
may also lower the
foe’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: A burst of light injures the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Semburan cahaya melukai
lawan. Mungkin juga
menurunkan Sp. Def
lawan.

entries.original:
"A flurry of down
hits the foe. It
may also lower the
foe’s Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: A flurry of down hits the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Serbuan bulu halus
mengenai lawan. Mungkin
juga menurunkan Sp. Atk
lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is covered
with a mass of down
that sharply cuts
the Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The foe is covered with a mass of down that sharply cuts the Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Lawan diselimuti
gumpalan bulu halus yang
sangat menurunkan stat
Attack.

entries.original:
"A wobbly dance
that confuses all
the Pokémon in
battle."
entries.translation_source: A wobbly dance that confuses all the Pokémon in battle.
entries.translated:
Tarian goyah yang
membingungkan semua
Pokémon dalam
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"A fiery kick with a
high critical-hit
ratio. It may also
burn the foe."
entries.translation_source: A fiery kick with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also burn the foe.
entries.translated:
Tendangan berapi dengan
rasio serangan kritis
tinggi. Mungkin juga
membakar lawan.

entries.original:
"Weakens Electric-
type attacks while
the user is in the
battle."
entries.translation_source: Weakens Electric- type attacks while the user is in the battle.
entries.translated:
Melemahkan serangan tipe
Listrik selama pengguna
berada dalam
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"A 5-turn rolling
attack that becomes
stronger each time
it rolls."
entries.translation_source: A 5-turn rolling attack that becomes stronger each time it rolls.
entries.translated:
Serangan bergulung
selama 5 giliran yang
semakin kuat setiap kali
bergulung.

entries.original:
"An attack using
thorny arms.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: An attack using thorny arms. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Serangan menggunakan
lengan berduri. Mungkin
membuat lawan mundur.

entries.original:
"The user slacks off
and restores its HP
by half its full
HP."
entries.translation_source: The user slacks off and restores its HP by half its full HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna bersantai dan
memulihkan HP setengah
dari HP maksimalnya.

entries.original:
"The user lets loose
a horribly loud
shout with the
power to damage."
entries.translation_source: The user lets loose a horribly loud shout with the power to damage.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melepaskan
teriakan yang sangat
keras dengan kekuatan
untuk merusak.

entries.original:
"The foe is bitten
with toxic fangs.
It may also badly
poison the foe."
entries.translation_source: The foe is bitten with toxic fangs. It may also badly poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Lawan digigit dengan
taring beracun. Mungkin
juga membuat lawan
keracunan parah.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with sharp claws.
It may also lower
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with sharp claws. It may also lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
cakar tajam. Mungkin
juga menurunkan
Pertahanan lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a huge explosion.
The user can’t move
on the next turn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a huge explosion. The user can’t move on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Lawan terkena ledakan
besar. Pengguna tidak
bisa bergerak pada
giliran berikutnya.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a watery cannon.
The user can’t move
on the next turn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a watery cannon. The user can’t move on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Lawan terkena meriam
air. Pengguna tidak bisa
bergerak pada giliran
berikutnya.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a hard, fast punch.
It may also raise
the user’s Attack."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a hard, fast punch. It may also raise the user’s Attack.
entries.translated:
Lawan terkena pukulan
keras dan cepat. Mungkin
juga meningkatkan Attack
pengguna.

entries.original:
"An attack using a
startling shout.
It also may make
the foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: An attack using a startling shout. It also may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Serangan menggunakan
teriakan mengejutkan.
Ini juga bisa membuat
lawan mundur.

entries.original:
"An attack that
varies in power and
type depending on
the weather."
entries.translation_source: An attack that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang kekuatan
dan tipenya bervariasi
tergantung cuaca.

entries.original:
"A soothing scent is
released to heal
all status problems
in the user’s party."
entries.translation_source: A soothing scent is released to heal all status problems in the user’s party.
entries.translated:
Aroma menenangkan
dilepaskan untuk
menyembuhkan semua
masalah status di tim
pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user feigns
crying to sharply
lower the foe’s
Sp. Def stat."
entries.translation_source: The user feigns crying to sharply lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna berpura-pura
menangis untuk sangat
menurunkan stat Sp. Def
lawan.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
razor-like wind.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with razor-like wind. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Lawan terkena angin
seperti silet. Memiliki
rasio serangan kritis
tinggi.

entries.original:
"An intense attack
that also sharply
reduces the user’s
Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: An intense attack that also sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Serangan intens yang
juga sangat mengurangi
stat Sp. Atk pengguna.

entries.original:
"Completely negates
the foe’s efforts to
heighten its ability
to evade."
entries.translation_source: Completely negates the foe’s efforts to heighten its ability to evade.
entries.translated:
Meniadakan sepenuhnya
upaya lawan untuk
meningkatkan kemampuan
mengelaknya.

entries.original:
"Boulders are hurled
at the foe. It also
lowers the foe’s
Speed if it hits."
entries.translation_source: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed if it hits.
entries.translated:
Batu besar dilemparkan
ke lawan. Juga
menurunkan Kecepatan
lawan jika mengenai.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with a silver dust.
It may raise all
the user’s stats."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with a silver dust. It may raise all the user’s stats.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
debu perak. Mungkin
meningkatkan semua stat
pengguna.

entries.original:
"A horrible metallic
screech is used to
sharply lower the
foe’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: A horrible metallic screech is used to sharply lower the foe’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Suara berdecit logam
yang mengerikan
digunakan untuk
menurunkan drastis Sp.
Def lawan.

entries.original:
"A pleasant melody
is played to lull
the foe into a deep
sleep."
entries.translation_source: A pleasant melody is played to lull the foe into a deep sleep.
entries.translated:
Melodi yang menyenangkan
dimainkan untuk
menidurkan lawan dengan
nyenyak.

entries.original:
"The foe is made to
laugh, reducing its
Attack and Defense
stats."
entries.translation_source: The foe is made to laugh, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.
entries.translated:
Lawan dibuat tertawa,
mengurangi stat Serangan
dan Pertahanannya.

entries.original:
"The user absorbs a
mystic power to
raise its Defense
and Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: The user absorbs a mystic power to raise its Defense and Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerap
kekuatan mistis untuk
meningkatkan Pertahanan
dan Sp. Def-nya.

entries.original:
"The higher the
user’s HP, the more
powerful this
attack becomes."
entries.translation_source: The higher the user’s HP, the more powerful this attack becomes.
entries.translated:
Semakin tinggi HP
pengguna, semakin kuat
serangan ini.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a flashing beam
that may also
cause confusion."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a flashing beam that may also cause confusion.
entries.translated:
Lawan terkena sinar
berkilau yang mungkin
juga menyebabkan
kebingungan.

entries.original:
"The user throws a
punch from the
shadows. It cannot
be evaded."
entries.translation_source: The user throws a punch from the shadows. It cannot be evaded.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melayangkan
pukulan dari bayangan.
Tidak bisa dihindari.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with an odd power
that may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with an odd power that may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan kekuatan aneh
yang mungkin membuat
lawan menggentarkan.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with an uppercut
thrown skywards
with force."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with an uppercut thrown skywards with force.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan pukulan ke atas
yang dilayangkan dengan
kekuatan.

entries.original:
"The foe is trapped
inside a painful
sandstorm for two
to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The foe is trapped inside a painful sandstorm for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Lawan terjebak dalam
badai pasir yang
menyakitkan selama dua
hingga lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with ultimate cold
that causes fainting
if it hits."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with ultimate cold that causes fainting if it hits.
entries.translated:
Lawan diserang dengan
hawa dingin pamungkas
yang menyebabkan pingsan
jika mengenai.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with muddy water.
It may also lower
the foe’s accuracy."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with muddy water. It may also lower the foe’s accuracy.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan air berlumpur.
Mungkin juga menurunkan
Akurasi lawan.

entries.original:
"The user shoots
seeds at the foe.
Two to five seeds
are shot at once."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot at once.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menembakkan
biji ke lawan. Dua
hingga lima biji
ditembakkan sekaligus.

entries.original:
"An extremely fast
attack against one
target. It can’t be
evaded."
entries.translation_source: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can’t be evaded.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang sangat
cepat terhadap satu
target. Tidak bisa
dihindari.

entries.original:
"Sharp icicles are
fired at the foe.
It strikes two to
five times."
entries.translation_source: Sharp icicles are fired at the foe. It strikes two to five times.
entries.translated:
Es batu tajam
ditembakkan ke lawan.
Mengenai dua hingga lima
kali.

entries.original:
"The user hardens
its body’s surface
to sharply raise its
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user hardens its body’s surface to sharply raise its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengeraskan
permukaan tubuhnya untuk
meningkatkan drastis
stat Pertahanannya.

entries.original:
"The user blocks the
foe’s way with arms
spread wide to
prevent escape."
entries.translation_source: The user blocks the foe’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menghalangi
jalan lawan dengan
lengan terbuka lebar
untuk mencegah kabur.

entries.original:
"The user howls to
raise its team’s
spirit and boost
their Attack stats."
entries.translation_source: The user howls to raise its team’s spirit and boost their Attack stats.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melolong untuk
membangkitkan semangat
timnya dan meningkatkan
stat Attack mereka.

entries.original:
"Sharp, huge claws
hook and slash the
foe quickly and
with great power."
entries.translation_source: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.
entries.translated:
Cakar tajam dan besar
mengait dan menyayat
lawan dengan cepat dan
kekuatan besar.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with

"An odd psychic wave
attacks the target.
This attack does
physical damage."
entries.translation_source: An odd psychic wave attacks the target. This attack does physical damage.
entries.translated:
Gelombang psikis aneh
menyerang target.
Serangan ini memberikan
kerusakan fisik.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with a song. Others
can join in, doing
more damage."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with a song. Others can join in, doing more damage.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan sebuah lagu.
Pokémon lain dapat ikut
serta, menyebabkan lebih
banyak kerusakan.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
hitting the target
with its hard tail.
It hits two to five
times in a row."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by hitting the target with its hard tail. It hits two to five times in a row.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan memukul target
menggunakan ekor
kerasnya. Serangan ini
mengenai dua hingga lima
kali berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
throwing two steel
gears at it target.
This attack hits
twice in a row."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at it target. This attack hits twice in a row.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan melemparkan dua
gigi baja ke target.
Serangan ini mengenai
dua kali berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"The type and base
power of this move
is determined by
the user’s Berry."
entries.translation_source: The type and base power of this move is determined by the user’s Berry.
entries.translated:
Tipe dan kekuatan dasar
serangan ini ditentukan
oleh Berry yang dimiliki
pengguna.

entries.original:
"An attack which is
not affected by the
target’s stat
changes."
entries.translation_source: An attack which is not affected by the target’s stat changes.
entries.translated:
Serangan yang tidak
terpengaruh oleh
perubahan statistik
target.

entries.original:
"A projectile is
thrown at the
opponent. A flying
Pokémon will fall
to the ground."
entries.translation_source: A projectile is thrown at the opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground.
entries.translated:
Sebuah proyektil
dilemparkan ke lawan.
Pokémon terbang akan
jatuh ke tanah.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
from a hyperspace
hole, hitting even
protected targets."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks from a hyperspace hole, hitting even protected targets.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang dari
lubang hiperruang,
mengenai bahkan target
yang dilindungi.

entries.original:
"A high-speed spin.
The slower the user
is than the foe, the
greater the damage."
entries.translation_source: A high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the foe, the greater the damage.
entries.translated:
Putaran berkecepatan
tinggi. Semakin lambat
pengguna dibandingkan
lawan, semakin besar
kerusakannya.

entries.original:
"The target is hit
with many arms.
This hits protected
foes, and lowers
the user’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The target is hit with many arms. This hits protected foes, and lowers the user’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Target dipukul dengan
banyak lengan. Serangan
ini mengenai lawan yang
dilindungi, dan
menurunkan Pertahanan
pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user calls out
its underlings to
pummel the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memanggil
bawahannya untuk
memukuli lawan. Serangan
ini memiliki rasio
pukulan kritis yang
tinggi.

entries.original:
"The user calls out
its underlings to
shield its body,
raising its Defense
and Sp. Def stats."
entries.translation_source: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memanggil
bawahannya untuk
melindungi tubuhnya,
meningkatkan statistik
Pertahanan dan
Pertahanan Spesialnya.

entries.original:
"The user calls out
its underlings to
heal it. The user
regains up to half
of its max HP."
entries.translation_source: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memanggil
bawahannya untuk
menyembuhkannya.
Pengguna mendapatkan
kembali hingga setengah
dari HP maksimalnya.

entries.original:
"If the foe is the
opposite gender of
the user, the foe’s
Special Attack is
harshly lowered."
entries.translation_source: If the foe is the opposite gender of the user, the foe’s Special Attack is harshly lowered.
entries.translated:
Jika lawan berjenis
kelamin berlawanan
dengan pengguna,
Serangan Khusus lawan
diturunkan drastis.

entries.original:
"A strong wind blows
away the target’s
obstacles. It also
lowers the target’s
evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: A strong wind blows away the target’s obstacles. It also lowers the target’s evasiveness.
entries.translated:
Angin kencang meniup
rintangan target. Ini
juga menurunkan
kemampuan menghindar
target.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
opposing Pokémon
with countless
beams of light that
glow a deep blue."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep blue.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
Pokémon lawan dengan
pancaran cahaya tak
terhitung yang bersinar
biru pekat.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
opposing Pokémon by
manifesting the
power of the land
in blades of stone."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in blades of stone.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
Pokémon lawan dengan
mewujudkan kekuatan
tanah dalam bilah batu.

entries.original:
"The user uses its
psychic power to
switch changes to
its Defense and Sp.
Def with the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user uses its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the foe.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
kekuatan psikisnya untuk
menukar perubahan
Pertahanan dan
Pertahanan Spesialnya
dengan lawan.

entries.original:
"The user immerses
the target in
superheated steam.
This may also burn
the target."
entries.translation_source: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also burn the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna merendam target
dalam uap panas super.
Ini juga dapat
memberikan Luka Bakar
pada target.

entries.original:
"The user retaliates
with much greater
force against the
opponent that last
did damage to it."
entries.translation_source: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last did damage to it.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membalas dengan
kekuatan yang jauh lebih
besar terhadap lawan
yang terakhir memberikan
kerusakan padanya.

entries.original:
"The user tries to
cut ahead of the
target to steal and
use its intended
move with more power."
entries.translation_source: The user tries to cut ahead of the target to steal and use its intended move with more power.
entries.translated:
Pengguna berusaha
mendahului target untuk
mencuri dan menggunakan
gerakan yang dituju
dengan kekuatan lebih.

entries.original:
"The user uses its
psychic power to
switch changes to
its Attack and Sp.
Attack with the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user uses its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Attack with the foe.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
kekuatan psikisnya untuk
menukar perubahan
Serangan dan Serangan
Spesialnya dengan lawan.

entries.original:
"The user employs
its psychic power
to switch its
Attack stat with
its Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
kekuatan psikisnya untuk
menukar stat Serangan
dengan stat
Pertahanannya.

entries.original:
"Using its psychic
power of suggestion,
the user transfers
its status problems
to the target."
entries.translation_source: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.
entries.translated:
Dengan kekuatan sugesti
psikisnya, pengguna
mentransfer masalah
statusnya kepada target.

entries.original:
"The user powerfully
wrings the target.
The more HP the
target has, the
greater the power."
entries.translation_source: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater the power.
entries.translated:
Pengguna dengan kuat
memeras target. Semakin
banyak HP target,
semakin besar
kekuatannya.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself from damage,
and harshly lowers
the foe’s Attack if
it makes contact."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself from damage, and harshly lowers the foe’s Attack if it makes contact.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melindungi
dirinya dari kerusakan,
dan menurunkan drastis
Serangan lawan jika
melakukan kontak.

entries.original:
"An odd psychic wave
attacks the target.
This attack does
physical damage."
entries.translation_source: An odd psychic wave attacks the target. This attack does physical damage.
entries.translated:
Gelombang psikis aneh
menyerang target.
Serangan ini memberikan
kerusakan fisik.

entries.original:
