"The user sheds part
of its body to make
itself lighter and
sharply raise its
Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melepaskan
sebagian tubuhnya untuk
membuat dirinya lebih
ringan dan meningkatkan
drastis stat
Kecepatannya.

entries.original:
"The user whips up a
storm of diamonds
to damage the foes.
This may also raise
the user’s Defense. "
entries.translation_source: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage the foes. This may also raise the user’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengaduk badai
berlian untuk merusak
lawan. Ini juga dapat
meningkatkan Pertahanan
pengguna.

entries.original:
"The area around the
user is swamped by
a giant sludge wave.
It may also poison
those hit."
entries.translation_source: The area around the user is swamped by a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.
entries.translated:
Area di sekitar pengguna
dibanjiri oleh gelombang
lumpur raksasa. Ini juga
dapat meracuni yang
terkena.

entries.original:
"The user slams into
the target. The
greater the weight
difference, the
greater the damage."
entries.translation_source: The user slams into the target. The greater the weight difference, the greater the damage.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membanting ke
target. Semakin besar
perbedaan berat, semakin
besar kerusakan.

entries.original:
"Using an odd shock
wave, the user
damages same-type
Pokémon in the
surrounding area."
entries.translation_source: Using an odd shock wave, the user damages same-type Pokémon in the surrounding area.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan gelombang
kejut aneh, pengguna
merusak Pokémon dengan
tipe yang sama di area
sekitarnya.

entries.original:
"The user hurls an
electric orb. The
faster the user is
than the foe, the
greater the damage."
entries.translation_source: The user hurls an electric orb. The faster the user is than the foe, the greater the damage.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melempar bola
listrik. Semakin cepat
pengguna dibanding
lawan, semakin besar
kerusakan.

entries.original:
"The user turns the
foe’s power against
it. This uses the
foe’s Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The user turns the foe’s power against it. This uses the foe’s Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membalikkan
kekuatan lawan
melawannya. Ini
menggunakan stat
Serangan lawan.

entries.original:
"The user dances
with an odd rhythm,
making the target’s
Ability the same as
the user’s Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user dances with an odd rhythm, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s Ability.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menari dengan
ritme aneh, membuat
Ability target sama
dengan Ability pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user releases a
pitch-black blast
at its target. May
also lower target’s
accuracy."
entries.translation_source: The user releases a pitch-black blast at its target. May also lower target’s accuracy.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melepaskan
ledakan hitam pekat ke
target. Mungkin juga
menurunkan akurasi
target.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
the target with a
harsh echo.
If used every turn,
power increases."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the target with a harsh echo. If used every turn, power increases.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
target dengan gema yang
keras. Jika digunakan
setiap giliran, kekuatan
meningkat.

entries.original:
"The user gathers
energy from the
land and damages
the opposing Pokémon
with its power."
entries.translation_source: The user gathers energy from the land and damages the opposing Pokémon with its power.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengumpulkan
energi dari tanah dan
merusak Pokémon lawan
dengan kekuatannya.

entries.original:
"The user absorbs its
target’s HP. The
user’s HP is restored
by over half the
damage."
entries.translation_source: The user absorbs its target’s HP. The user’s HP is restored by over half the damage.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerap HP
target. HP pengguna
dipulihkan lebih dari
setengah dari kerusakan
yang ditimbulkan.

entries.original:
"The user employs its
psychic power to
switch stat changes
with the target."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
kekuatan psikisnya untuk
menukar perubahan stat
dengan target.

entries.original:
"The foe’s crushed
with great force. The
more HP the foe has,
the stronger the
power."
entries.translation_source: The foe’s crushed with great force. The more HP the foe has, the stronger the power.
entries.translated:
Lawan dihancurkan dengan
kekuatan besar. Semakin
banyak HP lawan, semakin
kuat serangannya.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
slicing with a long
horn. The target’s
stat changes are
ignored."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by slicing with a long horn. The target’s stat changes are ignored.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan memotong
menggunakan tanduk
panjang. Perubahan stat
target diabaikan.

entries.original:
"The user slams down
with fire. The more
the user outweighs
the foe, the greater
the damage."
entries.translation_source: The user slams down with fire. The more the user outweighs the foe, the greater the damage.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menghantam
dengan api. Semakin
berat pengguna
dibandingkan lawan,
semakin besar
kerusakannya.

entries.original:
"The user charges its
head into its foe,
using its guard hair.
It slightly damages
the user."
entries.translation_source: The user charges its head into its foe, using its guard hair. It slightly damages the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyeruduk
lawan dengan kepalanya
menggunakan rambut
pelindung. Sedikit
melukai pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user fires a beam
of light at its foe.
The type changes
depending on the
Drive held."
entries.translation_source: The user fires a beam of light at its foe. The type changes depending on the Drive held.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menembakkan
sinar cahaya ke lawan.
Tipe berubah tergantung
Drive yang dibawa.

entries.original:
"The user sings an
ancient song and
attacks the hearts of
the listeners. It
may induce sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user sings an ancient song and attacks the hearts of the listeners. It may induce sleep.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyanyikan
lagu kuno dan menyerang
hati pendengarnya. Dapat
menyebabkan tidur.

entries.original:
"The user cuts with
its long horn. The
odd power in the
horn does physical
damage to the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power in the horn does physical damage to the foe.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memotong dengan
tanduk panjangnya.
Kekuatan aneh di tanduk
tersebut memberikan
kerusakan fisik pada
lawan.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
blowing freezing cold
air at opposing
Pokémon. This lowers
their Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This lowers their Speed.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan meniupkan udara
dingin membeku ke
Pokémon lawan. Ini
menurunkan Kecepatan
mereka.

entries.original:
"The user surrounds
itself with abundant
electricity that can
paralyze and charges
its target."
entries.translation_source: The user surrounds itself with abundant electricity that can paralyze and charges its target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengelilingi
dirinya dengan listrik
berlimpah yang dapat
melumpuhkan dan
menyerang target.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
engulfing the foe in
a severe, beautiful,
blue flame. It may
burn the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by engulfing the foe in a severe, beautiful, blue flame. It may burn the foe.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan menyelimuti lawan
dalam api biru yang
indah dan dahsyat. Dapat
membakar lawan.

entries.original:
"A two-turn attack
that hits the foe
with electrically
charged ice. It may
paralyze the foe."
entries.translation_source: A two-turn attack that hits the foe with electrically charged ice. It may paralyze the foe.
entries.translated:
Serangan dua giliran
yang mengenai lawan
dengan es bermuatan
listrik. Dapat
melumpuhkan lawan.

entries.original:
"A two-turn attack
that surrounds the
foe with ultracold,
freezing wind. It
may burn the foe."
entries.translation_source: A two-turn attack that surrounds the foe with ultracold, freezing wind. It may burn the foe.
entries.translated:
Serangan dua giliran
yang menyelubungi lawan
dengan angin sangat
dingin yang membekukan.
Dapat membakar lawan.

entries.original:
"The user hurls the
hot flame on its
forehead. It lowers
the user’s Def, Sp.
Def, and Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user hurls the hot flame on its forehead. It lowers the user’s Def, Sp. Def, and Speed.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melemparkan api
panas dari dahinya. Ini
menurunkan Pertahanan,
Pertahanan Khusus, dan
Kecepatan pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user brings down
a huge flame. It does
more damage when
influenced by an
enormous bolt."
entries.translation_source: The user brings down a huge flame. It does more damage when influenced by an enormous bolt.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menurunkan api
besar. Ini memberikan
lebih banyak kerusakan
ketika dipengaruhi oleh
petir raksasa.

entries.original:
"The user throws down
a giant bolt. It does
more damage when
influenced by an
enormous flame."
entries.translation_source: The user throws down a giant bolt. It does more damage when influenced by an enormous flame.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melemparkan
petir raksasa. Ini
memberikan lebih banyak
kerusakan saat
dipengaruhi oleh api
yang sangat besar.

entries.original:
"When the user knocks
out a target with
this move, the user’s
Attack stat rises
drastically."
entries.translation_source: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user’s Attack stat rises drastically.
entries.translated:
Saat pengguna
mengalahkan target
dengan jurus ini, stat
Attack pengguna naik
drastis.

entries.original:
"Letting out a noble
roar, the user
intimidates the
target and lowers its
Attack and Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Dengan mengeluarkan
auman mulia, pengguna
mengintimidasi target
dan menurunkan Attack
dan Sp. Atk miliknya.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
dropping off from
the sky at high speed.
This cuts the user’s
Defense and Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by dropping off from the sky at high speed. This cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan jatuh dari langit
dengan kecepatan tinggi.
Ini memotong Defense dan
Sp. Def pengguna.

entries.original:
"With a parting threat,
the user lowers the
foe’s Attack and Sp.
Atk stats then
switches out."
entries.translation_source: With a parting threat, the user lowers the foe’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats then switches out.
entries.translated:
Dengan ancaman
perpisahan, pengguna
menurunkan stat Attack
dan Sp. Atk lawan lalu
berganti.

entries.original:
"All stat changes
affecting the target
turn topsy-turvy and
become the opposite
of them."
entries.translation_source: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of them.
entries.translated:
Semua perubahan stat
yang mempengaruhi target
menjadi terbalik dan
menjadi kebalikannya.

entries.original:
"If the target has
already used its
move this turn, it
nullifies the effect
of its Ability."
entries.translation_source: If the target has already used its move this turn, it nullifies the effect of its Ability.
entries.translated:
Jika target sudah
menggunakan jurusnya
pada giliran ini, itu
meniadakan efek
Ability-nya.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
target with sound
waves of deafening
chatter. This
confuses the target."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This confuses the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
target dengan gelombang
suara obrolan yang
memekakkan telinga. Ini
membingungkan target.

entries.original:
"The user tells the
foe a secret and it
loses concentration.
This lowers Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: The user tells the foe a secret and it loses concentration. This lowers Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memberitahu
lawan sebuah rahasia dan
lawan kehilangan
konsentrasi. Ini
menurunkan Sp. Atk.

entries.original:
"The user throws stars
at the foe 2 to 5
times in a row. This
always strikes first."
entries.translation_source: The user throws stars at the foe 2 to 5 times in a row. This always strikes first.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melemparkan
bintang ke lawan 2
hingga 5 kali
berturut-turut. Ini
selalu menyerang lebih
dulu.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
breathing a special,
hot fire. This also
lowers the target’s
Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan menghembuskan api
panas khusus. Ini juga
menurunkan stat Sp. Atk
target.

entries.original:
"Aside from protecting
the user from attacks,
this also damages
attackers who make
contact."
entries.translation_source: Aside from protecting the user from attacks, this also damages attackers who make contact.
entries.translated:
Selain melindungi
pengguna dari serangan,
ini juga merusak
penyerang yang melakukan
kontak.

entries.original:
"The user’s body
generates an impulse.
Exposing the foe to
it harshly lowers
its Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: The user’s body generates an impulse. Exposing the foe to it harshly lowers its Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Tubuh pengguna
menghasilkan impuls.
Mengekspos lawan ke
impuls tersebut sangat
menurunkan stat Sp. Atk
lawan.

entries.original:
"The user holds back
when it attacks, and
the target is left
with at least 1 HP."
entries.translation_source: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menahan diri
saat menyerang, dan
target tersisa
setidaknya 1 HP.

entries.original:
"The foe is infested
and attacked for four
to five turns. The
target can’t flee
during this."
entries.translation_source: The foe is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can’t flee during this.
entries.translated:
Lawan terinfestasi dan
diserang selama empat
hingga lima giliran.
Target tidak bisa
melarikan diri selama
ini.

entries.original:
"Striking over and
over hardens the
user’s fists.
Hitting a target
raises Attack."
entries.translation_source: Striking over and over hardens the user’s fists. Hitting a target raises Attack.
entries.translated:
Memukul berulang kali
mengeraskan tinju
pengguna. Mengenai
target meningkatkan
Attack.

entries.original:
"This move also hits
opposing Pokémon in
the air. They are
knocked down to the
ground."
entries.translation_source: This move also hits opposing Pokémon in the air. They are knocked down to the ground.
entries.translated:
Jurus ini juga mengenai
Pokémon lawan yang di
udara. Mereka dijatuhkan
ke tanah.

entries.original:
"The user attacks with
a wave that crawls
along the ground.
Those hit can’t flee
from battle."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those hit can’t flee from battle.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan gelombang yang
merayap di tanah. Yang
terkena tidak bisa
melarikan diri dari
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
everything around it.
The user’s HP is
restored by half the
damage."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks everything around it. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
segala sesuatu di
sekitarnya. HP pengguna
dipulihkan setengah dari
kerusakan.

entries.original:
"The user torches
everything around it
in an inferno of
scarlet flames.
It may cause burns."
entries.translation_source: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. It may cause burns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membakar segala
sesuatu di sekitarnya
dalam kobaran api merah.
Ini dapat menyebabkan
luka bakar.

entries.original:
"The user emits a
shock wave from its
body. This may also
harshly lower the
target’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: The user emits a shock wave from its body. This may also harshly lower the target’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengeluarkan
gelombang kejut dari
tubuhnya. Ini juga dapat
menurunkan Sp. Def
target dengan keras.

entries.original:
"The user smashes into
the target at high
speed. This move
always goes first."
entries.translation_source: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menabrak target
dengan kecepatan tinggi.
Gerakan ini selalu
menyerang terlebih
dahulu.

entries.original:
"The user entangles
the target with its
anchor chain while
attacking. The target
cannot flee."
entries.translation_source: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target cannot flee.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menjerat target
dengan rantai jangkarnya
sambil menyerang. Target
tidak bisa melarikan
diri.

entries.original:
"This move reduces
damage from physical
and special moves for
five turns during a
hailstorm."
entries.translation_source: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns during a hailstorm.
entries.translated:
Gerakan ini mengurangi
kerusakan dari serangan
fisik dan khusus selama
lima giliran saat Badai
Es.

entries.original:
"Aside from protecting
the user from attacks,
this also poisons
attackers who make
contact."
entries.translation_source: Aside from protecting the user from attacks, this also poisons attackers who make contact.
entries.translated:
Selain melindungi
pengguna dari serangan,
ini juga meracuni
penyerang yang melakukan
kontak.

entries.original:
"The user heats up its
beak and attacks.
Contact during heating
causes a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user heats up its beak and attacks. Contact during heating causes a burn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memanaskan
paruhnya dan menyerang.
Kontak saat pemanasan
menyebabkan luka bakar.

entries.original:
"The user swings its
body around violently
to inflict damage on
everything in its
vicinity."
entries.translation_source: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengayunkan
tubuhnya dengan keras
untuk memberikan
kerusakan pada semua
yang ada di sekitarnya.

entries.original:
"The user burns
itself out. After
using this move,
the user will no
longer be Fire type."
entries.translation_source: The user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membakar
dirinya sendiri. Setelah
menggunakan gerakan ini,
pengguna tidak lagi
menjadi tipe Api.

entries.original:
"The user rubs its
scales and makes a
huge noise to
attack. The user’s
Def stat goes down."
entries.translation_source: The user rubs its scales and makes a huge noise to attack. The user’s Def stat goes down.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggesekkan
sisiknya dan membuat
suara keras untuk
menyerang. Stat Def
pengguna menurun.

entries.original:
"The user swings both
arms and hits the
target. The target’s
stat changes are
ignored."
entries.translation_source: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target’s stat changes are ignored.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengayunkan
kedua lengannya dan
memukul target.
Perubahan stat target
diabaikan.

entries.original:
"The user uses its
body like a hammer
to attack the target
and inflict damage."
entries.translation_source: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
tubuhnya seperti palu
untuk menyerang target
dan memberikan
kerusakan.

entries.original:
"The user strikes the
target with a burning
lash. This also
lowers the target’s
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memukul target
dengan cambuk yang
membara. Ini juga
menurunkan stat
Pertahanan target.

entries.original:
"Although this move
has great power, it
only works the first
turn the user is in
battle."
entries.translation_source: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn the user is in battle.
entries.translated:
Meskipun gerakan ini
memiliki kekuatan besar,
gerakan ini hanya
bekerja pada giliran
pertama pengguna berada
dalam pertempuran.

entries.original:
"The user unleashes a
strong beam. The
attack’s recoil
harshly lowers the
user’s Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melepaskan
sinar yang kuat.
Dorongan balik serangan
dengan keras menurunkan
stat Sp. Atk pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user restores up
to half the max HP
of the target. It
restores more HP
on Grassy Terrain."
entries.translation_source: The user restores up to half the max HP of the target. It restores more HP on Grassy Terrain.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memulihkan
hingga setengah HP
maksimum target. Ini
memulihkan lebih banyak
HP di Medan Rumput.

entries.original:
"The user engages its
gears to raise the
Attack and Sp. Atk
of allies with the
Plus or Minus Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk of allies with the Plus or Minus Ability.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengaktifkan
rodanya untuk
meningkatkan Serangan
dan Sp. Atk sekutu yang
memiliki Ability Plus
atau Minus.

entries.original:
"The user fiercely
attacks the target
using its entire
body."
entries.translation_source: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
target dengan ganas
menggunakan seluruh
tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"The user swings
its heavy fist.
It also lowers the
user’s Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user swings its heavy fist. It also lowers the user’s Speed.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengayunkan
tinjunya yang berat. Ini
juga menurunkan
Kecepatan pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user concentrates
intensely. The
attack on the next
turn always results
in a critical hit."
entries.translation_source: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
entries.translated:
Pengguna berkonsentrasi
dengan intens. Serangan
pada giliran berikutnya
selalu menghasilkan
serangan kritis.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
pelting the target
with leaves."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan melemparkan daun
ke target.

entries.original:
"The user slams into
the foe using a
full-force water
blast. This may lower
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The user slams into the foe using a full-force water blast. This may lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menabrak lawan
dengan semburan air
berkekuatan penuh. Ini
mungkin menurunkan
Pertahanan lawan.

entries.original:
"The user makes a
lunge at the foe,
attacking with full
force. This lowers
the foe’s Attack."
entries.translation_source: The user makes a lunge at the foe, attacking with full force. This lowers the foe’s Attack.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menerjang
lawan, menyerang dengan
kekuatan penuh. Ini
menurunkan Serangan
lawan.

entries.original:
"The user emits a
sinister ray. This
can be used on the
target regardless
of its Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user emits a sinister ray. This can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memancarkan
sinar jahat. Ini dapat
digunakan pada target
terlepas dari
Ability-nya.

entries.original:
"Cloaking itself in
high energy, the user
slams into the foe.
Its type depends on
the memory."
entries.translation_source: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the foe. Its type depends on the memory.
entries.translated:
Menyelimuti dirinya
dengan energi tinggi,
pengguna menabrak lawan.
Tipe-nya tergantung pada
memori.

entries.original:
"The user hits the
target with the
force of nature. It
halves the target’s
HP."
entries.translation_source: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target’s HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memukul target
dengan kekuatan alam.
Ini mengurangi setengah
HP target.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
foe with exploding
pollen puff. If
target is an ally, it
heals instead."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the foe with exploding pollen puff. If target is an ally, it heals instead.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang lawan
dengan gumpalan serbuk
sari yang meledak. Jika
target adalah sekutu,
malah menyembuhkan.

entries.original:
"The user boasts its
strength. The more
the user’s stats are
raised, the greater
the power."
entries.translation_source: The user boasts its strength. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the power.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membanggakan
kekuatannya. Semakin
banyak stat pengguna
dinaikkan, semakin besar
kekuatan.

entries.original:
"The user shoots
powerful lasers using
prism power. The
user can’t move on
the next turn."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots powerful lasers using prism power. The user can’t move on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menembakkan
laser kuat menggunakan
kekuatan prisma.
Pengguna tidak bisa
bergerak pada giliran
berikutnya.

entries.original:
"The user bites the
target with psychic
capabilities. This
destroys Light
Screen and Reflect."
entries.translation_source: The user bites the target with psychic capabilities. This destroys Light Screen and Reflect.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggigit
target dengan kemampuan
psikis. Ini
menghancurkan Light
Screen dan Reflect.

entries.original:
"The user heals the
target’s status
condition. If this
succeeds, it also
heals the user’s HP."
entries.translation_source: The user heals the target’s status condition. If this succeeds, it also heals the user’s HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyembuhkan
kondisi status target.
Jika berhasil, ini juga
menyembuhkan HP
pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
target by dancing
very hard. The user’s
type determines this
move’s type."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user’s type determines this move’s type.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
target dengan menari
dengan sangat keras.
Tipe pengguna menentukan
tipe gerakan ini.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
foe with a bone of
spirit. It may lower
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the foe with a bone of spirit. It may lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang lawan
dengan tulang roh. Ini
mungkin menurunkan
Pertahanan lawan.

entries.original:
"The user sets a
shell trap. If the
user is hit by a
physical move, the
trap will explode."
entries.translation_source: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memasang
jebakan cangkang. Jika
pengguna terkena
serangan fisik, jebakan
akan meledak.

entries.original:
"The user regains up
to half of its max
HP. It restores
more HP in a
sandstorm."
entries.translation_source: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memulihkan
hingga setengah dari HP
maksimalnya. Ini
memulihkan lebih banyak
HP saat badai pasir.

entries.original:
"The user stabs the
target with a sharp
horn. This attack
never misses."
entries.translation_source: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menusuk target
dengan tanduk tajam.
Serangan ini tidak
pernah meleset.

entries.original:
"In this two-turn move,
the user gathers
light and fills a
blade with light’s
energy to attack."
entries.translation_source: In this two-turn move, the user gathers light and fills a blade with light’s energy to attack.
entries.translated:
Dalam serangan dua
giliran ini, pengguna
mengumpulkan cahaya dan
mengisi pedang dengan
energi cahaya untuk
menyerang.

entries.original:
"The user bursts into
song, emitting
bubbles. Any burnt
Pokémon will be
healed."
entries.translation_source: The user bursts into song, emitting bubbles. Any burnt Pokémon will be healed.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mulai
bernyanyi, mengeluarkan
gelembung. Pokémon yang
terbakar akan
disembuhkan.

entries.original:
"The user hides in
the target’s shadow,
steals the target’s
stat boosts, and
then attacks."
entries.translation_source: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.
entries.translated:
Pengguna bersembunyi di
bayangan target, mencuri
peningkatan stat target,
lalu menyerang.

entries.original:
"The user exchanges
Speed stats with
the target."
entries.translation_source: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menukar stat
Kecepatan dengan target.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
while stitching the
target’s shadow to
the ground to
prevent escape."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks while stitching the target’s shadow to the ground to prevent escape.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
sambil menjahit bayangan
target ke tanah untuk
mencegah melarikan diri.

entries.original:
"The user shines a
spotlight on the
target so that only
the target will be
attacked."
entries.translation_source: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyorotkan
sorotan pada target
sehingga hanya target
yang akan diserang.

entries.original:
"If the previous move
failed, frustration
doubles the power of
this move."
entries.translation_source: If the previous move failed, frustration doubles the power of this move.
entries.translated:
Jika gerakan sebelumnya
gagal, frustrasi
menggandakan kekuatan
gerakan ini.

entries.original:
"The user drains HP
equal to the foe’s
Attack stat. It
also lowers the
foe’s Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The user drains HP equal to the foe’s Attack stat. It also lowers the foe’s Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menguras HP
sebesar stat Serangan
lawan. Ini juga
menurunkan stat Serangan
lawan.

entries.original:
"The user slams the
target with a meteor
force. This move
disregards the
target’s Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user slams the target with a meteor force. This move disregards the target’s Ability.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menghantam
target dengan kekuatan
meteor. Gerakan ini
mengabaikan Kemampuan
target.

entries.original:
"The user gets teary
eyed to look pitiful.
This lowers the
target’s Attack and
Sp. Atk stats."
entries.translation_source: The user gets teary eyed to look pitiful. This lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membuat mata
berkaca-kaca agar
terlihat menyedihkan.
Ini menurunkan stat
Serangan dan Sp. Atk
target.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
foe’s throat to
prevent it from
using moves that emit
sound for two turns."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the foe’s throat to prevent it from using moves that emit sound for two turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
tenggorokan lawan untuk
mencegahnya menggunakan
gerakan yang
mengeluarkan suara
selama dua giliran.

entries.original:
"The user shoots
poisonous threads to
poison the target
and lower the
target’s Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target’s Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menembakkan
benang beracun untuk
meracuni target dan
menurunkan stat
Kecepatan target.

entries.original:
"The user lands a
tropical kick on the
foe. It also lowers
the foe’s Attack."
entries.translation_source: The user lands a tropical kick on the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Attack.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mendaratkan
tendangan tropis pada
lawan. Ini juga
menurunkan Serangan
lawan.

entries.original:
"A strong electric
blast crashes down
on the target. This
may make the target
flinch."
entries.translation_source: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may make the target flinch.
entries.translated:
Ledakan listrik kuat
menghantam target. Ini
dapat membuat target
mundur.

entries.original:
"The user electrifies
the ground for five
turns, powering up
Electric moves and
eluding sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user electrifies the ground for five turns, powering up Electric moves and eluding sleep.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengaliri
listrik tanah selama
lima giliran,
meningkatkan kekuatan
gerakan Listrik dan
menghindari tidur.

entries.original:
"The user turns the
ground to grass for
five turns, powering
up Grass moves and
restoring HP."
entries.translation_source: The user turns the ground to grass for five turns, powering up Grass moves and restoring HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengubah tanah
menjadi rumput selama
lima giliran,
meningkatkan kekuatan
gerakan Rumput dan
memulihkan HP.

entries.original:
"The user covers the
ground in mist for
five turns, halving
Dragon moves and
preventing status."
entries.translation_source: The user covers the ground in mist for five turns, halving Dragon moves and preventing status.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menutupi tanah
dengan kabut selama lima
giliran, membagi dua
gerakan Naga dan
mencegah status.

entries.original:
"The user makes the
ground weird for
five turns, boosting
Psychic moves and
blocking priority."
entries.translation_source: The user makes the ground weird for five turns, boosting Psychic moves and blocking priority.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membuat tanah
menjadi aneh selama lima
giliran, meningkatkan
gerakan Psikis dan
memblokir prioritas.

entries.original:
"When combined with
Water Pledge, its
power increases and
a vast swamp appears."
entries.translation_source: When combined with Water Pledge, its power increases and a vast swamp appears.
entries.translated:
Jika dikombinasikan
dengan Ikrar Air,
kekuatannya meningkat
dan rawa luas muncul.

entries.original:
"When combined with
Grass Pledge, its
power increases and a
sea of fire appears."
entries.translation_source: When combined with Grass Pledge, its power increases and a sea of fire appears.
entries.translated:
Jika dikombinasikan
dengan Ikrar Rumput,
kekuatannya meningkat
dan lautan api muncul.

entries.original:
"When combined with
Fire Pledge, its
power increases and
a rainbow appears."
entries.translation_source: When combined with Fire Pledge, its power increases and a rainbow appears.
entries.translated:
Jika dikombinasikan
dengan Ikrar Api,
kekuatannya meningkat
dan pelangi muncul.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
bizarre area in
which slower Pokémon
get to move first
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menciptakan
area aneh di mana
Pokémon yang lebih
lambat bergerak lebih
dulu selama lima
giliran.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
bizarre area in
which Pokémon’s held
items lose effect
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose effect for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menciptakan
area aneh di mana item
yang dibawa Pokémon
kehilangan efeknya
selama lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
bizarre area where
Pokémon’s Defense
and Sp. Def swap
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a bizarre area where Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def swap for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menciptakan
area aneh di mana
Pertahanan dan Sp. Def
Pokémon bertukar selama
lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself and its
allies from status
moves with a
mysterious power."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melindungi
dirinya dan sekutunya
dari gerakan status
dengan kekuatan
misterius.

entries.original:
"Using a pulled-up
mat as a shield,
the user protects
itself and its allies
from damaging moves."
entries.translation_source: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan tikar yang
ditarik ke atas sebagai
perisai, pengguna
melindungi dirinya
sendiri dan sekutunya
dari serangan yang
merusak.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself and its
allies from priority
moves."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melindungi
dirinya sendiri dan
sekutunya dari serangan
prioritas.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself and its
allies from wide-
ranged attacks."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself and its allies from wide- ranged attacks.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melindungi
dirinya sendiri dan
sekutunya dari serangan
jarak luas.

entries.original:
"The user envelops
itself in a veil
made of water. It
regains some HP
every turn."
entries.translation_source: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyelimuti
dirinya dengan selubung
air. Ia memulihkan
beberapa HP setiap
giliran.

entries.original:
"The user raises the
Sp. Def stat of an
ally Pokémon by
using a mysterious
aroma."
entries.translation_source: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meningkatkan
stat Sp. Def Pokémon
sekutu dengan
menggunakan aroma
misterius.

entries.original:
"The user lets out a
damaging belch at
the target. The user
must eat a held
Berry to use this."
entries.translation_source: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengeluarkan
sendawa yang merusak
pada target. Pengguna
harus memakan Berry yang
dibawanya untuk
menggunakan ini.

entries.original:
"The user passes its
held item to the
target when the
target isn’t
holding an item."
entries.translation_source: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memberikan item
yang dibawanya kepada
target ketika target
tidak membawa item.

entries.original:
"The user flings its
held item at the
target to attack.
Its power and effect
depend on the item."
entries.translation_source: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effect depend on the item.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melemparkan
item yang dibawanya ke
target untuk menyerang.
Kekuatan dan efeknya
tergantung pada item
tersebut.

entries.original:
"The user dives down
onto the target from
the sky. This move
is both Fighting
and Flying type."
entries.translation_source: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is both Fighting and Flying type.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyelam ke
bawah menuju target dari
langit. Serangan ini
bertipe Fighting dan
Flying.

entries.original:
"Gravity intensifies
for five turns,
preventing moves
that use flight and
negating Levitate."
entries.translation_source: Gravity intensifies for five turns, preventing moves that use flight and negating Levitate.
entries.translated:
Gravitasi meningkat
selama lima giliran,
mencegah serangan yang
menggunakan terbang dan
meniadakan Levitate.

entries.original:
"The user employs its
psychic power to
average its Defense
and Sp. Def stats
with the target."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
kekuatan psikisnya untuk
meratakan stat Defense
dan Sp. Def-nya dengan
target.

entries.original:
"The user prevents
the opposing team
from using any HP
recovery for five
turns."
entries.translation_source: The user prevents the opposing team from using any HP recovery for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mencegah tim
lawan menggunakan
pemulihan HP apa pun
selama lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user disperses
electrically charged
particles, changing
Normal- to Electric-
type moves."
entries.translation_source: The user disperses electrically charged particles, changing Normal- to Electric- type moves.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyebarkan
partikel bermuatan
listrik, mengubah
serangan tipe Normal
menjadi tipe Electric.

entries.original:
"The user chants an
incantation that
prevents foes from
landing critical
hits for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user chants an incantation that prevents foes from landing critical hits for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melantunkan
mantra yang mencegah
lawan memberikan
serangan kritis selama
lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user levitates
using electrically
generated magnetism
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melayang
menggunakan magnetisme
yang dihasilkan listrik
selama lima giliran.

entries.original:
"The user manipulates
magnets to up Def
and Sp. Def stats of
allies with Plus or
Minus Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user manipulates magnets to up Def and Sp. Def stats of allies with Plus or Minus Ability.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memanipulasi
magnet untuk
meningkatkan stat Def
dan Sp. Def sekutu
dengan Ability Plus atau
Minus.

entries.original:
"The user covers the
target in a powder
that explodes if it
uses a Fire-type
move."
entries.translation_source: The user covers the target in a powder that explodes if it uses a Fire-type move.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menutupi target
dengan bubuk yang
meledak jika ia
menggunakan serangan
tipe Fire.

entries.original:
"The user employs its
psychic power to
average its Attack
and Sp. Atk stats
with the target."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggunakan
kekuatan psikisnya untuk
meratakan stat Attack
dan Sp. Atk-nya dengan
target.

entries.original:
"The user reflects
the target’s type,
making it the same
type as the target."
entries.translation_source: The user reflects the target’s type, making it the same type as the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memantulkan
tipe target,
menjadikannya tipe yang
sama dengan target.

entries.original:
"The user’s
mysterious psychic
wave changes the
target’s Ability to
Simple."
entries.translation_source: The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the target’s Ability to Simple.
entries.translated:
Gelombang psikis
misterius pengguna
mengubah Ability target
menjadi Simple.

entries.original:
"The user shoots a
torrent of water at
the target and
changes the target’s
type to Water."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target’s type to Water.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menembakkan
semburan air ke target
dan mengubah tipe target
menjadi Air.

entries.original:
"The user makes the
target float with
psychic power. The
target is easier to
hit for three turns."
entries.translation_source: The user makes the target float with psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membuat target
melayang dengan kekuatan
psikis. Target lebih
mudah dipukul selama
tiga giliran.

entries.original:
"The foe is brought
trick-or-treating.
This adds Ghost type
to the target’s type."
entries.translation_source: The foe is brought trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.
entries.translated:
Musuh diajak
trick-or-treat. Ini
menambahkan tipe Hantu
ke tipe target.

entries.original:
"The user sprays a
poisonous liquid
that lowers Attack,
Sp. Atk, and Speed
of poisoned foes."
entries.translation_source: The user sprays a poisonous liquid that lowers Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed of poisoned foes.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyemprotkan
cairan beracun yang
menurunkan Attack, Sp.
Atk, dan Speed musuh
yang diracuni.

entries.original:
"The user puts a
forest curse on the
target. The target
is now Grass type
as well."
entries.translation_source: The user puts a forest curse on the target. The target is now Grass type as well.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memberikan
kutukan hutan pada
target. Target sekarang
juga menjadi tipe
Rumput.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
everything around it
by making its head
explode. This also
damages the user."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks everything around it by making its head explode. This also damages the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
segala sesuatu di
sekitarnya dengan
membuat kepalanya
meledak. Ini juga
melukai pengguna.

entries.original:
"A pillar of light
that deals physical
or special damage
based on the user’s
better stat."
entries.translation_source: A pillar of light that deals physical or special damage based on the user’s better stat.
entries.translated:
Pilar cahaya yang
memberikan damage fisik
atau spesial berdasarkan
stat terbaik pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with electrically
charged fists. This
makes Normal-type
moves Electric-type."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This makes Normal-type moves Electric-type.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan tinju bermuatan
listrik. Ini membuat
jurus bertipe Normal
menjadi bertipe Listrik.

entries.original:
"If the target is
electrified before
its move in the turn,
the target’s move
becomes Electric."
entries.translation_source: If the target is electrified before its move in the turn, the target’s move becomes Electric.
entries.translated:
Jika target diberi
listrik sebelum jurusnya
pada giliran tersebut,
jurus target menjadi
bertipe Listrik.

entries.original:
"It prevents the
target from using
items. Its Trainer
also can’t use
items on it."
entries.translation_source: It prevents the target from using items. Its Trainer also can’t use items on it.
entries.translated:
Ini mencegah target
menggunakan item.
Trainernya juga tidak
bisa menggunakan item
padanya.

entries.original:
"By locking down the
battlefield, the
user keeps all
Pokémon from fleeing
during the next turn."
entries.translation_source: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
entries.translated:
Dengan mengunci medan
pertempuran, pengguna
mencegah semua Pokémon
melarikan diri selama
giliran berikutnya.

entries.original:
"The user fires a
powerful beam of
light from the
Eternal Flower. This
damages the user."
entries.translation_source: The user fires a powerful beam of light from the Eternal Flower. This damages the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menembakkan
sinar cahaya yang kuat
dari Eternal Flower. Ini
melukai pengguna.

entries.original:
"The fewer PP this
move has, the
greater its power."
entries.translation_source: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its power.
entries.translated:
Semakin sedikit PP jurus
ini, semakin besar
kekuatannya.

entries.original:
"The user helps the
target and makes it
use its move right
after the user."
entries.translation_source: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membantu target
dan membuatnya
menggunakan jurusnya
tepat setelah pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user instructs
the target to use
the target’s last
move again."
entries.translation_source: The user instructs the target to use the target’s last move again.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memerintahkan
target untuk menggunakan
jurus terakhir target
lagi.

entries.original:
"The user suppresses
the target and makes
its move go last."
entries.translation_source: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menekan target
dan membuat jurusnya
menjadi yang terakhir.

entries.original:
"Using Happy Hour
doubles the amount
of prize money
received after
battle."
entries.translation_source: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan Happy Hour
menggandakan jumlah uang
hadiah yang diterima
setelah pertempuran.

entries.original:
"The user centers
its hex nut and
strikes twice with
its arms. It may
cause flinching."
entries.translation_source: The user centers its hex nut and strikes twice with its arms. It may cause flinching.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memusatkan mur
heksagonalnya dan
menyerang dua kali
dengan lengannya. Ini
dapat menyebabkan
gemetar.

entries.original:
"It can only be
used after the
user has exhausted
all other moves it
knows in battle."
entries.translation_source: It can only be used after the user has exhausted all other moves it knows in battle.
entries.translated:
Ini hanya bisa digunakan
setelah pengguna telah
menggunakan semua jurus
lain yang diketahui
dalam pertempuran.

entries.original:
"It takes the enemy
into the sky,
where it can’t
attack. It is
dropped next turn."
entries.translation_source: It takes the enemy into the sky, where it can’t attack. It is dropped next turn.
entries.translated:
Ini membawa musuh ke
langit, di mana ia tidak
bisa menyerang. Ia
dijatuhkan pada giliran
berikutnya.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon
congratulates you
on your special
day!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!
entries.translated:
Pokémon mengucapkan
selamat atas hari
spesialmu!

entries.original:
"The user and an
ally hold hands.
This makes them
very happy."
entries.translation_source: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.
entries.translated:
Pengguna dan sekutu
berpegangan tangan. Ini
membuat mereka sangat
bahagia.

entries.original:
"The user unleashes
a strong beam that
deals double damage
to Dynamaxed targets."
entries.translation_source: The user unleashes a strong beam that deals double damage to Dynamaxed targets.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melepaskan
sinar kuat yang
memberikan damage ganda
pada target Dynamax.

entries.original:
"The user ignores
the effects of moves
and Abilities that
draw in moves."
entries.translation_source: The user ignores the effects of moves and Abilities that draw in moves.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengabaikan
efek dari gerakan dan
Ability yang menarik
gerakan.

entries.original:
"The user bites down,
preventing itself
and the target from
switching out."
entries.translation_source: The user bites down, preventing itself and the target from switching out.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menggigit,
mencegah dirinya dan
target untuk berganti.

entries.original:
"The user consumes
its held Berry,
then raises its
Defense sharply."
entries.translation_source: The user consumes its held Berry, then raises its Defense sharply.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memakan Berry
yang dipegangnya, lalu
meningkatkan Defense-nya
tajam.

entries.original:
"All of the user’s
stats are raised,
but it can no longer
switch out or flee."
entries.translation_source: All of the user’s stats are raised, but it can no longer switch out or flee.
entries.translated:
Semua stat pengguna
meningkat, tetapi tidak
bisa lagi berganti atau
melarikan diri.

entries.original:
"Sticky tar lowers
the target’s Speed,
and makes it weaker
to Fire-type moves."
entries.translation_source: Sticky tar lowers the target’s Speed, and makes it weaker to Fire-type moves.
entries.translated:
Tar lengket menurunkan
Speed target, dan
membuatnya lebih lemah
terhadap gerakan tipe
Fire.

entries.original:
"The user scatters
magic powder that
changes the target
into a Psychic-type."
entries.translation_source: The user scatters magic powder that changes the target into a Psychic-type.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menebarkan
bubuk ajaib yang
mengubah target menjadi
tipe Psychic.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
twice. If there
are two targets,
each is hit once."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks twice. If there are two targets, each is hit once.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang dua
kali. Jika ada dua
target, masing-masing
terkena sekali.

entries.original:
"All Pokémon on the
field have teatime.
Each Pokémon eats
its held Berry."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon on the field have teatime. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon di
lapangan minum teh.
Setiap Pokémon memakan
Berry yang dipegangnya.

entries.original:
"The user traps the
foe and makes its
Defense and Sp. Def
fall each turn."
entries.translation_source: The user traps the foe and makes its Defense and Sp. Def fall each turn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menjebak musuh
dan membuat Defense dan
Sp. Def-nya turun setiap
giliran.

entries.original:
"If the user moves
before the target,
the power of this
move is doubled."
entries.translation_source: If the user moves before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
entries.translated:
Jika pengguna bergerak
sebelum target, kekuatan
gerakan ini menjadi dua
kali lipat.

entries.original:
"If the user moves
before the target,
the power of this
move is doubled."
entries.translation_source: If the user moves before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
entries.translated:
Jika pengguna bergerak
sebelum target, kekuatan
gerakan ini menjadi dua
kali lipat.

entries.original:
"The user swaps
the effects on
either side of
the field."
entries.translation_source: The user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menukar efek di
kedua sisi lapangan.

entries.original:
"The user raises
all of its stats
by using some of
its HP."
entries.translation_source: The user raises all of its stats by using some of its HP.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meningkatkan
semua statnya dengan
menggunakan sebagian
HP-nya.

entries.original:
"The higher the
user’s Defense,
the more damage
it will inflict."
entries.translation_source: The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it will inflict.
entries.translated:
Semakin tinggi Defense
pengguna, semakin besar
damage yang akan
diberikan.

entries.original:
"The user sharply
raises the target’s
Attack and Sp. Atk
by decorating it."
entries.translation_source: The user sharply raises the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk by decorating it.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meningkatkan
Attack dan Sp. Atk
target secara tajam
dengan menghiasinya.

entries.original:
"The user plays its
drum to attack.
The target’s Speed
stat is lowered."
entries.translation_source: The user plays its drum to attack. The target’s Speed stat is lowered.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memainkan
drumnya untuk menyerang.
Stat Speed target
diturunkan.

entries.original:
"The user snares
the target in a
snap trap for four
to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menjebak target
dalam perangkap jepret
selama empat hingga lima
giliran.

entries.original:
"The user launches
a fiery ball at
the target. It may
also cause a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user launches a fiery ball at the target. It may also cause a burn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meluncurkan
bola api ke target.
Gerakan ini juga dapat
menyebabkan luka bakar.

entries.original:
"The user becomes a
sword and strikes.
Double damage on
Dynamaxed targets."
entries.translation_source: The user becomes a sword and strikes. Double damage on Dynamaxed targets.
entries.translated:
Pengguna berubah menjadi
pedang dan menyerang.
Kerusakan ganda pada
target yang Dynamax.

entries.original:
"The user becomes a
shield and strikes.
Double damage on
Dynamaxed targets."
entries.translation_source: The user becomes a shield and strikes. Double damage on Dynamaxed targets.
entries.translated:
Pengguna berubah menjadi
perisai dan menyerang.
Kerusakan ganda pada
target yang Dynamax.

entries.original:
"Morpeko raises its
Speed and attacks.
The move’s type is
based on its form."
entries.translation_source: Morpeko raises its Speed and attacks. The move’s type is based on its form.
entries.translated:
Morpeko meningkatkan
Kecepatannya dan
menyerang. Tipe gerakan
ini berdasarkan
bentuknya.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
foes by swinging its
tail wildly, lowering
their Attack."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the foes by swinging its tail wildly, lowering their Attack.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang lawan
dengan mengayunkan
ekornya dengan liar,
menurunkan Serangan
mereka.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
the target by
poking it with a
pointed branch."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the target by poking it with a pointed branch.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
target dengan menusuknya
menggunakan cabang
runcing.

entries.original:
"The user twangs
its guitar, which
causes an echo and
strong vibrations."
entries.translation_source: The user twangs its guitar, which causes an echo and strong vibrations.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memetik
gitarnya, yang
menyebabkan gema dan
getaran kuat.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with acid made from
tart apples. Lowers
the foe’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with acid made from tart apples. Lowers the foe’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan asam yang terbuat
dari apel asam.
Menurunkan Sp. Def
lawan.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
dropping an apple
from above. Lowers
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by dropping an apple from above. Lowers the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan menjatuhkan apel
dari atas. Menurunkan
Pertahanan lawan.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with spirit-breaking
force, lowering the
target’s Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with spirit-breaking force, lowering the target’s Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan kekuatan pemecah
semangat, menurunkan Sp.
Atk target.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
by emitting steam.
The steam may also
confuse the target."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by emitting steam. The steam may also confuse the target.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan mengeluarkan uap.
Uap tersebut juga dapat
membingungkan target.

entries.original:
"The user scatters
water that restores
the HP of itself
and its allies."
entries.translation_source: The user scatters water that restores the HP of itself and its allies.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyebarkan air
yang memulihkan HP
dirinya sendiri dan
sekutunya.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself, and harshly
lowers the foe’s
Defense on contact."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself, and harshly lowers the foe’s Defense on contact.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melindungi
dirinya sendiri, dan
sangat menurunkan
Pertahanan lawan saat
kontak.

entries.original:
"The user bows,
then uses its hair
to stab the foe.
It never misses."
entries.translation_source: The user bows, then uses its hair to stab the foe. It never misses.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membungkuk,
lalu menggunakan
rambutnya untuk menusuk
lawan. Gerakan ini tidak
pernah meleset.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with its thick leek.
The user must rest
on the next turn."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with its thick leek. The user must rest on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan daun bawang
tebalnya. Pengguna harus
istirahat pada giliran
berikutnya.

entries.original:
"Eternatus’s most
powerful attack.
The user must rest
on the next turn."
entries.translation_source: Eternatus’s most powerful attack. The user must rest on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Serangan terkuat
Eternatus. Pengguna
harus istirahat pada
giliran berikutnya.

entries.original:
"It fires a beam
of steel from its
body, which also
hurts the user."
entries.translation_source: It fires a beam of steel from its body, which also hurts the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menembakkan
sinar baja dari
tubuhnya, yang juga
melukai pengguna.

entries.original:
"The move’s power
increases and damages
all opposing targets
in Psychic Terrain."
entries.translation_source: The move’s power increases and damages all opposing targets in Psychic Terrain.
entries.translated:
Kekuatan gerakan ini
meningkat dan merusak
semua target lawan di
Psychic Terrain.

entries.original:
"The user attacks and
destroys the terrain.
The move fails if
there is no terrain."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks and destroys the terrain. The move fails if there is no terrain.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang dan
menghancurkan medan.
Gerakan ini gagal jika
tidak ada medan.

entries.original:
"It hits two to five
times in a row.
Raises Speed, but
lowers Defense."
entries.translation_source: It hits two to five times in a row. Raises Speed, but lowers Defense.
entries.translated:
Serangan ini mengenai
dua hingga lima kali
berturut-turut.
Meningkatkan Kecepatan,
tetapi menurunkan
Pertahanan.

entries.original:
"In this two-turn move,
the user gathers
space power and
increases Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: In this two-turn move, the user gathers space power and increases Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Dalam gerakan dua
giliran ini, pengguna
mengumpulkan kekuatan
luar angkasa dan
meningkatkan Sp. Atk.

entries.original:
"Inflicts the more
effective of physical
or special damage.
May poison the foe."
entries.translation_source: Inflicts the more effective of physical or special damage. May poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Memberikan kerusakan
yang lebih efektif
antara fisik atau
khusus. Dapat meracuni
lawan.

entries.original:
"The user explodes
and faints itself.
Its power increases
on Misty Terrain."
entries.translation_source: The user explodes and faints itself. Its power increases on Misty Terrain.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meledak dan
pingsan sendiri.
Kekuatannya meningkat di
Medan Berkabut.

entries.original:
"The user glides
on the ground to
attack. Hits first
on Grassy Terrain."
entries.translation_source: The user glides on the ground to attack. Hits first on Grassy Terrain.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meluncur di
tanah untuk menyerang.
Menyerang lebih dulu di
Medan Rumput.

entries.original:
"The user attacks with
earthly voltage. It
doubles in power on
Electric Terrain."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with earthly voltage. It doubles in power on Electric Terrain.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan tegangan bumi.
Kekuatannya berlipat
ganda di Medan Listrik.

entries.original:
"The move’s type
and power depends on
the terrain currently
used in battle."
entries.translation_source: The move’s type and power depends on the terrain currently used in battle.
entries.translated:
Tipe dan kekuatan
gerakan tergantung pada
medan yang digunakan
dalam pertarungan.

entries.original:
"The user skitters
behind the target to
attack. It lowers the
foe’s Sp.Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: The user skitters behind the target to attack. It lowers the foe’s Sp.Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna merayap di
belakang target untuk
menyerang. Ini
menurunkan stat Sp.Atk
lawan.

entries.original:
"Inflicts a burn on
targets that had
their stats boosted
during the turn used."
entries.translation_source: Inflicts a burn on targets that had their stats boosted during the turn used.
entries.translated:
Memberikan luka bakar
pada target yang statnya
dinaikkan selama giliran
yang digunakan.

entries.original:
"The move’s power
doubles if the user’s
stats have fallen
during the turn."
entries.translation_source: The move’s power doubles if the user’s stats have fallen during the turn.
entries.translated:
Kekuatan gerakan
berlipat ganda jika stat
pengguna telah turun
selama giliran.

entries.original:
"The user controls
the target’s item to
attack. Fails if the
target has no item."
entries.translation_source: The user controls the target’s item to attack. Fails if the target has no item.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengendalikan
item target untuk
menyerang. Gagal jika
target tidak memiliki
item.

entries.original:
"The user cloaks
itself in acidic gas.
It melts away the
target’s held item."
entries.translation_source: The user cloaks itself in acidic gas. It melts away the target’s held item.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyelubungi
dirinya dengan gas asam.
Ini melelehkan item yang
dibawa target.

entries.original:
"The user coaches
its ally, raising
the ally’s Attack
and Defense stats."
entries.translation_source: The user coaches its ally, raising the ally’s Attack and Defense stats.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melatih
sekutunya, meningkatkan
stat Serangan dan
Pertahanan sekutu.

entries.original:
"After attacking,
the user switches
places with a
party Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: After attacking, the user switches places with a party Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Setelah menyerang,
pengguna bertukar tempat
dengan Pokémon dalam
tim.

entries.original:
"A 3-kick attack
that becomes more
powerful with each
successive hit."
entries.translation_source: A 3-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
entries.translated:
Serangan 3 tendangan
yang menjadi lebih kuat
dengan setiap pukulan
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"The user slams
the target with its
wings. The target is
hit twice in a row."
entries.translation_source: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memukul target
dengan sayapnya. Target
terkena dua kali
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"The user throws
scorching sand at the
target. It may also
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user throws scorching sand at the target. It may also inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melempar pasir
panas ke target. Ini
juga dapat menyebabkan
luka bakar.

entries.original:
"The user restores
HP and the status
of itself and its
ally in battle."
entries.translation_source: The user restores HP and the status of itself and its ally in battle.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memulihkan HP
dan status dirinya
sendiri dan sekutunya
dalam pertarungan.

entries.original:
"The user strikes
the foe fiercely.
It always results in
a critical hit."
entries.translation_source: The user strikes the foe fiercely. It always results in a critical hit.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang lawan
dengan ganas. Ini selalu
menghasilkan serangan
kritis.

entries.original:
"The user strikes
three times in a row.
It always results in
a critical hit."
entries.translation_source: The user strikes three times in a row. It always results in a critical hit.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang tiga
kali berturut-turut. Ini
selalu menghasilkan
serangan kritis.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with psychic power.
It may leave the
target with frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with psychic power. It may leave the target with frostbite.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan kekuatan psikis.
Ini dapat membuat target
mengalami radang dingin.

entries.original:
"The user delivers
a fierce kick that
lowers the target’s
defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user delivers a fierce kick that lowers the target’s defense stat.
entries.translated:
Pengguna memberikan
tendangan ganas yang
menurunkan stat
Pertahanan target.

entries.original:
"The user attacks with
intense, dark flames.
It may also make
the foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with intense, dark flames. It may also make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan api gelap yang
intens. Ini juga dapat
membuat lawan gemetar.

entries.original:
"The user attacks with
psychic power that
removes 3 PP from
the foe’s last move."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with psychic power that removes 3 PP from the foe’s last move.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan kekuatan psikis
yang menghilangkan 3 PP
dari jurus terakhir
lawan.

entries.original:
"A cage made of
electricity that traps
the target for four
to five turns."
entries.translation_source: A cage made of electricity that traps the target for four to five turns.
entries.translated:
Kandang yang terbuat
dari listrik yang
menjebak target selama
empat hingga lima
giliran.

entries.original:
"The higher the
user’s HP, the
more powerful this
attack becomes."
entries.translation_source: The higher the user’s HP, the more powerful this attack becomes.
entries.translated:
Semakin tinggi HP
pengguna, semakin kuat
serangan ini.

entries.original:
"A frightful amount of
small ghosts are sent
to attack opposing
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: A frightful amount of small ghosts are sent to attack opposing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sejumlah besar hantu
kecil dikirim untuk
menyerang Pokémon lawan.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
hurling a blizzard-
cloaked icicle lance
at opposing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard- cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan melemparkan
tombak es yang
diselimuti badai salju
ke Pokémon lawan.

entries.original:
"A slash that may
poison, paralyze, or
sleep the foe. It
has a high crit ratio."
entries.translation_source: A slash that may poison, paralyze, or sleep the foe. It has a high crit ratio.
entries.translated:
Tebasan yang dapat
meracuni, melumpuhkan,
atau menidurkan lawan.
Rasio kritisnya tinggi.

entries.original:
"The user slams into
the foe with psychic
energy. It raises the
user’s Defense too."
entries.translation_source: The user slams into the foe with psychic energy. It raises the user’s Defense too.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menabrak lawan
dengan energi psikis.
Ini juga meningkatkan
Pertahanan pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user swaps its
offensive and
defensive stats."
entries.translation_source: The user swaps its offensive and defensive stats.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menukar stat
ofensif dan defensifnya.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
an axe that leaves
behind splinters. It
has a high crit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with an axe that leaves behind splinters. It has a high crit ratio.
entries.translated:
Lawan dipukul dengan
kapak yang meninggalkan
serpihan. Ini memiliki
rasio kritis yang
tinggi.

entries.original:
"After dealing damage,
the user raises the
higher stats of its
offenses or defenses."
entries.translation_source: After dealing damage, the user raises the higher stats of its offenses or defenses.
entries.translated:
Setelah memberikan
kerusakan, pengguna
meningkatkan stat yang
lebih tinggi dari
ofensif atau
defensifnya.

entries.original:
"The user rampages
and spews vicious
flames for two to
three turns."
entries.translation_source: The user rampages and spews vicious flames for two to three turns.
entries.translated:
Pengguna mengamuk dan
memuntahkan api ganas
selama dua hingga tiga
giliran.

entries.original:
"The user slams into
the target, hurting
itself a little. This
move strikes first."
entries.translation_source: The user slams into the target, hurting itself a little. This move strikes first.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menabrak
target, melukai dirinya
sendiri sedikit. Jurus
ini menyerang lebih
dulu.

entries.original:
"The user launches its
amassed chlorophyll
at the foe. This also
hurts the user."
entries.translation_source: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll at the foe. This also hurts the user.
entries.translated:
Pengguna meluncurkan
klorofil yang terkumpul
ke lawan. Ini juga
melukai pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user hurls giant
chunks of ice at
the foe that may
cause it to flinch."
entries.translation_source: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the foe that may cause it to flinch.
entries.translated:
Pengguna melemparkan
bongkahan es raksasa ke
lawan yang dapat
menyebabkan lawan
gemetar.

entries.original:
"The user dances to
usher in victory.
This raises Attack,
Defense, and Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user dances to usher in victory. This raises Attack, Defense, and Speed.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menari untuk
menyambut kemenangan.
Ini meningkatkan
Serangan, Pertahanan,
dan Kecepatan.

entries.original:
"The user smashes into
the foe. This cuts
the user’s Defense
and Sp. Def stats."
entries.translation_source: The user smashes into the foe. This cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menghantam
lawan. Ini memotong stat
Pertahanan dan
Pertahanan Khusus
pengguna.

entries.original:
"Barbs that may poison
are shot at the foe.
Its power doubles if
the foe is poisoned."
entries.translation_source: Barbs that may poison are shot at the foe. Its power doubles if the foe is poisoned.
entries.translated:
Duri yang dapat meracuni
ditembakkan ke lawan.
Kekuatannya berlipat
ganda jika lawan sudah
diracuni.

entries.original:
"The foe is slashed
with wings of light.
This goes first and
has a high crit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slashed with wings of light. This goes first and has a high crit ratio.
entries.translated:
Lawan ditebas dengan
sayap cahaya. Ini
bergerak lebih dulu dan
memiliki rasio kritis
yang tinggi.

entries.original:
"The user attacks and
may inflict the foe
with frostbite. Its
power doubles if the
foe has frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks and may inflict the foe with frostbite. Its power doubles if the foe has frostbite.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang dan
dapat membuat lawan
terkena radang dingin.
Kekuatannya menjadi dua
kali lipat jika lawan
terkena radang dingin.

entries.original:
"The user makes its
skin iron-hard to
raise its Defense
and its Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user makes its skin iron-hard to raise its Defense and its Speed.
entries.translated:
Pengguna membuat
kulitnya keras seperti
besi untuk meningkatkan
Pertahanan dan
Kecepatannya.

entries.original:
"The foe is shot with
arrows that raise the
crit ratio and lower
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is shot with arrows that raise the crit ratio and lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Lawan ditembak dengan
panah yang meningkatkan
rasio kritis dan
menurunkan Pertahanan
lawan.

entries.original:
"Myriad fireballs that
may burn hit the foe.
Its power doubles if
the foe is burned."
entries.translation_source: Myriad fireballs that may burn hit the foe. Its power doubles if the foe is burned.
entries.translated:
Banyak bola api yang
dapat menyebabkan luka
bakar mengenai lawan.
Kekuatannya menjadi dua
kali lipat jika lawan
terkena luka bakar.

entries.original:
"The foe is slashed.
This leaves behind
splinters. It has a
high crit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slashed. This leaves behind splinters. It has a high crit ratio.
entries.translated:
Lawan ditebas. Ini
meninggalkan serpihan.
Rasio kritisnya tinggi.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with savagely cold
winds. This may
cause a frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with savagely cold winds. This may cause a frostbite.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan angin dingin yang
ganas. Ini dapat
menyebabkan radang
dingin.

entries.original:
"The user savagely
attacks with wind
and lightning. This
may cause paralysis."
entries.translation_source: The user savagely attacks with wind and lightning. This may cause paralysis.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan ganas menggunakan
angin dan petir. Ini
dapat menyebabkan
kelumpuhan.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with fierce winds
and hot sand. This
may cause a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with fierce winds and hot sand. This may cause a burn.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan angin kencang dan
pasir panas. Ini dapat
menyebabkan luka bakar.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with love and hate.
The effects depend
on the user’s form."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with love and hate. The effects depend on the user’s form.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyerang
dengan cinta dan benci.
Efeknya tergantung pada
bentuk pengguna.

entries.original:
"The user heals its
own statuses and
restores HP. It also
raises evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: The user heals its own statuses and restores HP. It also raises evasiveness.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyembuhkan
statusnya sendiri dan
memulihkan HP. Ini juga
meningkatkan
evasiveness.

entries.original:
"The user heals its
own statuses and
raises its Sp. Atk
and Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: The user heals its own statuses and raises its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Pengguna menyembuhkan
statusnya sendiri dan
meningkatkan Sp. Atk dan
Sp. Def-nya.

entries.original:
"Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession."
entries.translation_source: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Memungkinkan pengguna
untuk menghindari semua
serangan. Mungkin gagal
jika digunakan
berturut-turut.

entries.original:
"Normal-Type Dynamax
move. It lowers
the target’s Speed
stat."
entries.translation_source: Normal-Type Dynamax move. It lowers the target’s Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Gerakan Dynamax Tipe
Normal. Menurunkan stat
Kecepatan target.

entries.original:
"Fighting Dynamax
move. It raises
ally Pokémon’s
Attack stats."
entries.translation_source: Fighting Dynamax move. It raises ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.
entries.translated:
Gerakan Dynamax Tipe
Petarung. Meningkatkan
stat Serangan Pokémon
sekutu.

entries.original:
"Flying-Type Dynamax
move. It raises
ally Pokémon’s
Speed stats."
entries.translation_source: Flying-Type Dynamax move. It raises ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.
entries.translated:
Gerakan Dynamax Tipe
Terbang. Meningkatkan
stat Kecepatan Pokémon
sekutu.

entries.original:
"Poison-Type Dynamax
move. It raises
ally Pokémon’s
Sp. Atk stats."
entries.translation_source: Poison-Type Dynamax move. It raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.
entries.translated:
Gerakan Dynamax Tipe
Racun. Meningkatkan stat
Sp. Atk Pokémon sekutu.

entries.original:
"Ground-Type Dynamax
move. It raises
ally Pokémon’s
Sp. Def stats."
entries.translation_source: Ground-Type Dynamax move. It raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Def stats.
entries.translated:
Gerakan Dynamax Tipe
Tanah. Meningkatkan stat
Sp. Def Pokémon sekutu.

entries.original:
"Rock-Type Dynamax
move. It summons
a sandstorm that
lasts five turns."
entries.translation_source: Rock-Type Dynamax move. It summons a sandstorm that lasts five turns.
entries.translated:
Gerakan Dynamax Tipe
Batu. Memanggil badai
pasir yang berlangsung
selama lima giliran.

entries.original:
"Bug-Type Dynamax
move. It lowers
the target’s
Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: Bug-Type Dynamax move. It lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Gerakan Dynamax Tipe
Serangga. Menurunkan
stat Sp. Atk target.

entries.original:
"Ghost-Type Dynamax
move. It lowers
the target’s
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: Ghost-Type Dynamax move. It lowers the target’s Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe
Hantu. Menurunkan stat
Pertahanan target.

entries.original:
"Steel-Type Dynamax
move. It raises
ally Pokémon’s
Defense stats."
entries.translation_source: Steel-Type Dynamax move. It raises ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe
Baja. Meningkatkan stat
Pertahanan Pokémon
sekutu.

entries.original:
"Fire-Type Dynamax
move. It causes the
sun to intensify
for five turns."
