entries.translation_source: Fire-Type Dynamax move. It causes the sun to intensify for five turns.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe
Api. Menyebabkan
matahari terik selama
lima giliran.

entries.original:
"Water-Type Dynamax
move. It summons
rain that falls
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: Water-Type Dynamax move. It summons rain that falls for five turns.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe
Air. Memanggil hujan
yang turun selama lima
giliran.

entries.original:
"Grass-Type Dynamax
move. It activates
Grassy Terrain for
five turns."
entries.translation_source: Grass-Type Dynamax move. It activates Grassy Terrain for five turns.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe
Rumput. Mengaktifkan
Grassy Terrain selama
lima giliran.

entries.original:
"Electric Dynamax
move. It activates
Electric Terrain
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: Electric Dynamax move. It activates Electric Terrain for five turns.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe
Listrik. Mengaktifkan
Electric Terrain selama
lima giliran.

entries.original:
"Psychic Dynamax
move. It activates
Psychic Terrain
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: Psychic Dynamax move. It activates Psychic Terrain for five turns.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe
Psikis. Mengaktifkan
Psychic Terrain selama
lima giliran.

entries.original:
"Ice-Type Dynamax
move. It summons
a hailstorm for
five turns."
entries.translation_source: Ice-Type Dynamax move. It summons a hailstorm for five turns.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe Es.
Memanggil badai es
selama lima giliran.

entries.original:
"Dragon-Type Dynamax
move. It lowers
the target’s Attack
stat."
entries.translation_source: Dragon-Type Dynamax move. It lowers the target’s Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe
Naga. Menurunkan stat
Serangan target.

entries.original:
"Dark-Type Dynamax
move. It lowers
the target’s
Sp. Def stat."
entries.translation_source: Dark-Type Dynamax move. It lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe
Kegelapan. Menurunkan
stat Sp. Def target.

entries.original:
"Fairy-Type Dynamax
move. It activates
Misty Terrain for
five turns."
entries.translation_source: Fairy-Type Dynamax move. It activates Misty Terrain for five turns.
entries.translated:
Jurusan Dynamax Tipe
Peri. Jurusan ini
mengaktifkan Medan
Berkabut selama lima
giliran.

entries.original:
"G-Max Venusaur’s
signature move. It
deals damage for
four turns."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Venusaur’s signature move. It deals damage for four turns.
entries.translated:
Jurusan khas G-Max
Venusaur. Jurusan ini
memberikan kerusakan
selama empat giliran.

entries.original:
"G-Max Charizard’s
signature move. It
deals damage for
four turns."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Charizard’s signature move. It deals damage for four turns.
entries.translated:
Jurusan khas G-Max
Charizard. Jurusan ini
memberikan kerusakan
selama empat giliran.

entries.original:
"G-Max Blastoise’s
signature move. It
deals damage for
four turns."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Blastoise’s signature move. It deals damage for four turns.
entries.translated:
Jurusan khas G-Max
Blastoise. Jurusan ini
memberikan kerusakan
selama empat giliran.

entries.original:
"G-Max Butterfree’s
signature move. It
causes paralysis,
sleep, or poison."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Butterfree’s signature move. It causes paralysis, sleep, or poison.
entries.translated:
Jurusan khas G-Max
Butterfree. Jurusan ini
menyebabkan lumpuh,
tidur, atau racun.

entries.original:
"G-Max Pikachu’s
signature move.
It paralyzes the
target."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Pikachu’s signature move. It paralyzes the target.
entries.translated:
Jurusan khas G-Max
Pikachu. Jurusan ini
melumpuhkan target.

entries.original:
"G-Max Meowth’s
signature move. It
confuses the foe
and creates money."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Meowth’s signature move. It confuses the foe and creates money.
entries.translated:
Jurusan khas G-Max
Meowth. Jurusan ini
membingungkan lawan dan
menghasilkan uang.

entries.original:
"G-Max Machamp’s
signature move. It
raises the chance
of critical hits."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Machamp’s signature move. It raises the chance of critical hits.
entries.translated:
Jurusan khas G-Max
Machamp. Jurusan ini
meningkatkan peluang
serangan kritis.

entries.original:
"G-Max Gengar’s
signature move. It
prevents the foe
from escaping."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Gengar’s signature move. It prevents the foe from escaping.
entries.translated:
Jurusan khas G-Max
Gengar. Jurusan ini
mencegah lawan melarikan
diri.

entries.original:
"G-Max Kingler’s
signature move. It
harshly lowers the
target’s Speed."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Kingler’s signature move. It harshly lowers the target’s Speed.
entries.translated:
Jurusan khas G-Max
Kingler. Jurusan ini
sangat menurunkan
Kecepatan target.

entries.original:
"G-Max Lapras’s
signature move. It
reduces damage
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Lapras’s signature move. It reduces damage for five turns.
entries.translated:
Serangan khas G-Max
Lapras. Mengurangi
kerusakan selama lima
giliran.

entries.original:
"G-Max Eevee’s
signature move.
It infatuates
the target."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Eevee’s signature move. It infatuates the target.
entries.translated:
Serangan khas G-Max
Eevee. Membuat target
jatuh cinta.

entries.original:
"G-Max Snorlax’s
signature move. It
restores Berries
that were eaten."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Snorlax’s signature move. It restores Berries that were eaten.
entries.translated:
Serangan khas G-Max
Snorlax. Memulihkan
Berry yang telah
dimakan.

entries.original:
"G-Max Garbodor’s
signature move.
It poisons the
target."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Garbodor’s signature move. It poisons the target.
entries.translated:
Serangan khas G-Max
Garbodor. Meracuni
target.

entries.original:
"G-Max Melmetal’s
signature move. It
prevents the foe
from repeating moves."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Melmetal’s signature move. It prevents the foe from repeating moves.
entries.translated:
Serangan khas G-Max
Melmetal. Mencegah lawan
mengulangi gerakan.

entries.original:
"G-Max Rillaboom’s
signature move. It
strikes regardless of
the target’s ability."

rasa sakit yang mengerikan pada musuh.

entries.original:
"The shell, which hardens soon after
it is born, is resilient. If you poke it,
it will bounce back out."
entries.translation_source: The shell, which hardens soon after it is born, is resilient. If you poke it, it will bounce back out.
entries.translated:
Cangkangnya, yang mengeras segera setelah
lahir, sangat tangguh. Jika Anda
menusuknya, ia akan memantul kembali.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon is very popular among
older people as its fur-covered tail is
a symbol of its longevity."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon is very popular among older people as its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini sangat populer di kalangan
orang tua karena ekornya yang ditutupi bulu
adalah simbol umur panjang.

entries.original:
"The rocket cannons on its shell fire
jets of water capable of punching holes
through thick steel."
entries.translation_source: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.
entries.translated:
Meriam roket di cangkangnya menembakkan
semburan air yang mampu menembus baja
tebal.

entries.original:
"Its feet have suction cups designed
to stick to any surface. It tenaciously
climbs trees to forage."
entries.translation_source: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.
entries.translated:
Kakinya memiliki alat pengisap yang ...
menempel di permukaan apa pun. Ia dengan
gigih memanjat pohon untuk mencari makanan.

entries.original:
"It prepares for evolution by hardening
its shell as much as possible to protect
its soft body."
entries.translation_source: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.
entries.translated:
Ia bersiap untuk evolusi dengan mengeraskan
cangkangnya sebanyak mungkin untuk
melindungi tubuhnya yang lunak.

entries.original:
"Water-repellent powder on its wings
enables it to collect honey, even in
the heaviest of rains."
entries.translation_source: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.
entries.translated:
Bubuk anti air di sayapnya memungkinkannya
mengumpulkan madu, bahkan di tengah hujan
terderas sekalipun.

entries.original:
"Its poison stinger is very powerful.
Its bright-colored body is intended
to warn off its enemies."
entries.translation_source: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.
entries.translated:
Sengatan racunnya sangat kuat. Tubuhnya
yang berwarna cerah dimaksudkan untuk
memperingatkan musuh-musuhnya.

entries.original:
"Although it is a cocoon, it can move
a little. It can extend its poison barb
if it is attacked."
entries.translation_source: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.
entries.translated:
Meskipun berupa kepompong, ia bisa bergerak
sedikit. Ia dapat menjulurkan duri racunnya
jika diserang.

entries.original:
"It can take down any opponent with
its powerful poison stingers.
It sometimes attacks in swarms."
entries.translation_source: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat menjatuhkan lawan mana pun dengan
sengatan racunnya yang kuat. Ia kadang
menyerang dalam kawanan.

entries.original:
"Common in grassy areas and forests,
it is very docile and will chase off
enemies by flapping up sand."
entries.translation_source: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.
entries.translated:
Umum ditemukan di area berumput dan hutan,
ia sangat jinak dan akan mengusir musuh
dengan mengepakkan pasir.

entries.original:
"It flies over its wide territory in
search of prey, downing it with its
highly developed claws."
entries.translation_source: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
entries.translated:
Ia terbang melintasi wilayahnya yang luas
untuk mencari mangsa, menjatuhkannya dengan
cakarnya yang sangat berkembang.

entries.original:
"By flapping its wings with all its might,
Pidgeot can make a gust of wind
capable of bending tall trees."
entries.translation_source: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
entries.translated:
Dengan mengepakkan sayapnya sekuat tenaga,
Pidgeot dapat menghasilkan hembusan angin
yang mampu menekuk pohon-pohon tinggi.

entries.original:
"Living wherever there is food available,
it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles
the entire day."
entries.translation_source: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.
entries.translated:
Hidup di mana pun ada makanan tersedia, ia
tanpa henti mencari makanan sepanjang hari.

entries.original:
"Its rear feet have three toes each.
They are webbed, enabling it to swim
across rivers."
entries.translation_source: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.
entries.translated:
Kaki belakangnya masing-masing memiliki
tiga ... Mereka berselaput, memungkinkannya
berenang menyeberangi sungai.

entries.original:
"It flaps its short wings to flush out
insects from tall grass. It then plucks
them with its stubby beak."
entries.translation_source: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.
entries.translated:
Ia mengepakkan sayap pendeknya untuk
mengusir serangga dari rumput tinggi. Ia
kemudian ... dengan paruhnya yang tumpul.

entries.original:
"It shoots itself suddenly high into the
sky, then plummets down in one fell
swoop to strike its prey."
entries.translation_source: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.
entries.translated:
Ia melesat tiba-tiba tinggi ke langit, lalu
menjatuhkan diri dalam satu gerakan cepat
untuk menyerang mangsanya.

entries.original:
"It can freely detach its jaw to swallow
large prey whole. It can become too
heavy to move, however."
entries.translation_source: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat dengan bebas melepaskan rahangnya
untuk ... mangsa besar utuh. Namun, ia bisa
menjadi terlalu berat untuk bergerak.

entries.original:
"To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest
wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling
air from its mouth."
entries.translation_source: To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.
entries.translated:
Untuk mengintimidasi musuh, ia melebarkan
dadanya dan ... suara menyeramkan dengan
mengeluarkan udara dari mulutnya.

entries.original:
"It has small electric sacs on both its
cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric
charges from the sacs."
entries.translation_source: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki kantong listrik kecil di kedua
pipinya. Jika terancam, ia melepaskan
muatan listrik dari kantong tersebut.

entries.original:
"When its electricity builds, its muscles
are stimulated, and it becomes more
aggressive than usual."
entries.translation_source: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.
entries.translated:
Saat listriknya menumpuk, otot-ototnya
terstimulasi, dan ia menjadi lebih agresif
dari biasanya.

entries.original:
"It burrows and lives underground.
If threatened, it curls itself up into a
ball for protection."
entries.translation_source: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
entries.translated:
Ia menggali dan hidup di bawah tanah. Jika
terancam, ia menggulung dirinya menjadi
bola untuk perlindungan.

entries.original:
"It is adept at attacking with the spines
on its back and its sharp claws while
quickly scurrying about."
entries.translation_source: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.
entries.translated:
Ia mahir menyerang dengan duri di
punggungnya dan cakarnya yang tajam sambil
berlarian cepat.

entries.original:
"The poison hidden in its small horn is
extremely potent. Even a tiny scratch
can have fatal results."
entries.translation_source: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely potent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.
entries.translated:
Racun yang tersembunyi di tanduk kecilnya
sangat kuat. Bahkan goresan kecil pun bisa
berakibat fatal.

entries.original:
"It has a calm and caring nature.
Because its horn grows slowly, it
prefers not to fight."
entries.translation_source: It has a calm and caring nature. Because its horn grows slowly, it prefers not to fight.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki sifat tenang dan peduli. Karena
tanduknya tumbuh lambat, ia lebih memilih
untuk tidak bertarung.

entries.original:
"It uses its scaly rugged body to seal
the entrance of its nest and protect
its young from predators."
entries.translation_source: It uses its scaly rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.
entries.translated:
Ia menggunakan tubuh bersisiknya yang kasar
untuk menutup pintu masuk sarangnya dan
melindungi anak-anaknya dari pemangsa.

entries.original:
"It scans its surroundings by raising
its ears out of the grass. It will strike
first if it senses any danger."
entries.translation_source: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. It will strike first if it senses any danger.
entries.translated:
Ia memindai sekelilingnya dengan mengangkat
telinganya keluar dari ... akan menyerang
terlebih dahulu jika merasakan bahaya.

entries.original:
"Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with
its horn to inject a powerful poison
when it becomes agitated."
entries.translation_source: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with its horn to inject a powerful poison when it becomes agitated.
entries.translated:
Mudah marah, ia menusuk musuh dengan
tanduknya untuk menyuntikkan racun yang
kuat saat ia menjadi gelisah.

entries.original:
"It swings its big tail around during
battle. If its foe flinches, it will
charge with its sturdy body."
entries.translation_source: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.
entries.translated:
Ia mengayunkan ekor besarnya saat
bertarung. Jika lawannya ciut, ia akan
menyerbu dengan tubuhnya yang kokoh.

entries.original:
"Its adorable behavior and cry make it
highly popular. However, this cute
Pokémon is rarely found."
entries.translation_source: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.
entries.translated:
Perilaku dan tangisannya yang menggemaskan
membuatnya sangat populer. Namun, Pokémon
imut ini jarang ditemukan.

entries.original:
"With its acute hearing, it can pick up
sounds from far away. It usually hides
in quiet places."
entries.translation_source: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.
entries.translated:
Dengan pendengarannya yang tajam, ia dapat
menangkap suara dari jauh. Ia biasanya
bersembunyi di tempat yang sunyi.

entries.original:
"While young, it has six gorgeous tails.
When it grows, several new tails are
sprouted."
entries.translation_source: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
entries.translated:
Saat muda, ia memiliki enam ekor yang
indah. Saat tumbuh, beberapa ekor baru akan
tumbuh.

entries.original:
"Some legends claim that each of its
nine tails has its own unique type of
special mystic power."
entries.translation_source: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystic power.
entries.translated:
Beberapa legenda mengklaim bahwa
masing-masing dari sembilan ... memiliki
jenis kekuatan mistis khusus yang unik.

entries.original:
"It captivates foes with its huge, round
eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing
a soothing melody."
entries.translation_source: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
entries.translated:
Ia memikat lawan dengan matanya yang besar
dan bulat, lalu menidurkan mereka dengan
menyanyikan melodi yang menenangkan.

entries.original:
"Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and
supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur
conveys an image of luxury."
entries.translation_source: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.
entries.translated:
Bulunya sangat halus, lebat, dan lentur.
Bulu yang sangat menyenangkan ini
memberikan kesan kemewahan.

entries.original:
"It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on
its ultrasonic cries for echo location to
flit about in darkness."
entries.translation_source: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.
entries.translated:
Ia tidak memiliki mata. Sebaliknya, ia
mengandalkan teriakan ultrasoniknya untuk
ekolokasi agar dapat terbang di kegelapan.

entries.original:
"It can drink more than 10 ounces of
blood at once. If it has too much, it
gets heavy and flies clumsily."
entries.translation_source: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.
entries.translated:
Ia bisa minum lebih dari 10 ons darah
sekaligus. Jika terlalu banyak, ia menjadi
berat dan terbang dengan kikuk.

entries.original:
"Its scientific name is \qoOddium Wanderus.\qc
At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000
feet on its two roots."
entries.translation_source: Its scientific name is [quote-open-1]Oddium Wanderus.[quote-close-2] At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.
entries.translated:
Nama ilmiahnya adalah \qoOddium Wanderus.\qc
Pada malam hari, dikatakan ia berjalan
hampir 1.000 kaki dengan dua akarnya.

entries.original:
"What appears to be drool is actually
sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings
stubbornly if touched."
entries.translation_source: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
entries.translated:
Apa yang tampak seperti air liur sebenarnya
adalah madu manis. Sangat lengket dan
menempel dengan keras jika disentuh.

entries.original:
"It has the world’s largest petals.
With every step, the petals shake out
heavy clouds of toxic pollen."
entries.translation_source: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki kelopak terbesar di dunia.
Setiap ... kelopak tersebut mengeluarkan
awan tebal serbuk sari beracun.

entries.original:
"It is doused with mushroom spores when
it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms
sprout from its back."
entries.translation_source: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.
entries.translated:
Ia disiram spora jamur saat lahir. Seiring
tubuhnya tumbuh, jamur tumbuh dari
punggungnya.

entries.original:
"It stays mostly in dark, damp places.
The preference not of the bug, but of
the big mushrooms on its back."
entries.translation_source: It stays mostly in dark, damp places. The preference not of the bug, but of the big mushrooms on its back.
entries.translated:
Ia kebanyakan tinggal di tempat gelap dan
lembap. ... itu bukan dari serangganya,
melainkan dari jamur besar di punggungnya.

entries.original:
"Its eyes also function as radar units.
It catches and eats small bugs that
hide in darkness."
entries.translation_source: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.
entries.translated:
Matanya juga berfungsi sebagai unit radar.
Ia menangkap dan memakan serangga kecil
yang bersembunyi di kegelapan.

entries.original:
"The wings are covered with dustlike
scales. Every time it flaps its wings,
it looses highly toxic dust."
entries.translation_source: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.
entries.translated:
Sayapnya ditutupi sisik seperti debu.
Setiap kali mengepakkan sayapnya, ia
melepaskan debu yang sangat beracun.

entries.original:
"It burrows through the ground at a
shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in
its wake, making it easy to spot."
entries.translation_source: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
entries.translated:
Ia menggali tanah pada kedalaman dangkal.
Ia meninggalkan tanah yang meninggi di
belakangnya, sehingga mudah terlihat.

entries.original:
"Its three heads bob separately up and
down to loosen the soil nearby, making
it easier for it to burrow."
entries.translation_source: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
entries.translated:
Ketiga kepalanya bergerak naik turun secara
terpisah untuk ... tanah di sekitarnya,
sehingga memudahkannya menggali.

entries.original:
"It loves anything that shines.
It especially adores coins that it picks
up and secretly hoards."
entries.translation_source: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.
entries.translated:
Ia menyukai segala sesuatu yang berkilau.
Ia sangat mengagumi koin yang
dikumpulkannya dan diam-diam menimbunnya.

entries.original:
"Many adore it for its sophisticated air.
However, it will lash out and scratch
for little reason."
entries.translation_source: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.
entries.translated:
Banyak yang mengaguminya karena sikapnya
yang anggun. Namun, ia akan menyerang dan
mencakar dengan alasan yang sepele.

entries.original:
"It is constantly wracked by a headache.
When the headache turns intense, it
begins using mysterious powers."
entries.translation_source: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
entries.translated:
Ia terus-menerus menderita sakit kepala.
Saat sakit kepala menjadi parah, ia mulai
menggunakan kekuatan misterius.

entries.original:
"When it swims at full speed using its
long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow
begins to glow."
entries.translation_source: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.
entries.translated:
Saat berenang dengan kecepatan penuh ...
tubuhnya yang panjang dan berselaput,
dahinya entah bagaimana mulai bercahaya.

entries.original:
"Light and agile on its feet, and
ferocious in temperament. When angered,
it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy."
entries.translation_source: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.
entries.translated:
Ringan dan lincah di kakinya, serta galak
dalam temperamen. Saat marah, ia mengamuk
tak terkendali.

entries.original:
"It grows angry if you see its eyes and
gets angrier if you run. If you beat it,
it gets even madder."
entries.translation_source: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
entries.translated:
Ia menjadi marah jika kamu melihat matanya
dan semakin marah jika kamu lari. Jika kamu
mengalahkannya, ia semakin gila.

entries.original:
"It is extremely loyal, it will fearlessly
bark at any opponent to protect its
own Trainer from harm."
entries.translation_source: It is extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.
entries.translated:
Ia sangat setia, ia akan menggonggong tanpa
takut pada lawan mana pun untuk melindungi
Trainernya dari bahaya.

entries.original:
"Its magnificent bark conveys a sense
of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help
but grovel before it."
entries.translation_source: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.
entries.translated:
Gonggongannya yang megah memberikan kesan
kebesaran. Siapa pun yang mendengarnya
pasti akan sujud di depannya.

entries.original:
"Its skin is so thin, its internal organs
are visible. It has trouble walking on
its newly grown feet."
entries.translation_source: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
entries.translated:
Kulitnya sangat tipis, organ dalamnya
terlihat. Ia kesulitan berjalan dengan kaki
yang baru tumbuh.

entries.original:
"The spiral pattern on its belly subtly
undulates. Staring at it gradually
causes drowsiness."
entries.translation_source: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
entries.translated:
Pola spiral di perutnya bergerak naik turun
secara halus. Menatapnya perlahan
menyebabkan kantuk.

entries.original:
"It can use its well-developed arms and
legs to run on the surface of the water
for a split second."
entries.translation_source: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat menggunakan lengan dan kakinya
yang berkembang dengan baik untuk berlari
di permukaan air selama sekejap.

entries.original:
"It sleeps for 18 hours a day.
It uses a variety of extrasensory
powers even while asleep."
entries.translation_source: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
entries.translated:
Ia tidur selama 18 jam sehari. Ia
menggunakan berbagai kekuatan ekstrasensor
bahkan saat tidur.

entries.original:
"It stares at its silver spoon to
focus its mind. It emits more alpha
waves while doing so."
entries.translation_source: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
entries.translated:
Ia menatap sendok peraknya untuk
memfokuskan ... Ia memancarkan lebih banyak
gelombang alfa saat melakukannya.

entries.original:
"It does not like physical attacks very 
much. Instead, it freely uses extra-
sensory powers to defeat foes."
entries.translation_source: It does not like physical attacks very much. Instead, it freely uses extra- sensory powers to defeat foes.
entries.translated:
Ia tidak terlalu menyukai serangan fisik.
... ia dengan bebas menggunakan kekuatan
ekstra-sensorik untuk mengalahkan lawan.

entries.original:
"Though small in stature, it is powerful
enough to easily heft and throw a
number of Geodude at once."
entries.translation_source: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.
entries.translated:
Meskipun bertubuh kecil, ia cukup kuat
untuk dengan mudah mengangkat dan melempar
beberapa Geodude sekaligus.

entries.original:
"Its formidable body never gets tired.
It helps people by doing work such as
the moving of heavy goods."
entries.translation_source: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya yang perkasa tidak pernah lelah.
Ia ... manusia dengan melakukan pekerjaan
seperti memindahkan barang-barang berat.

entries.original:
"It quickly swings its four arms to rock
its opponents with ceaseless punches
and chops from all angles."
entries.translation_source: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
entries.translated:
Ia dengan cepat mengayunkan keempat
lengannya untuk menghantam lawan dengan ...
dan tebakan tanpa henti dari segala sudut.

entries.original:
"It plants its feet deep underground to
replenish water. It can’t escape its
enemies while it’s rooted."
entries.translation_source: It plants its feet deep underground to replenish water. It can’t escape its enemies while it’s rooted.
entries.translated:
Ia menancapkan kakinya jauh ke dalam tanah
untuk mengisi ... air. Ia tidak bisa
melarikan diri dari musuh selama tertancap.

entries.original:
"The leafy parts act as cutters for
slashing foes. It spits a fluid that
dissolves everything."
entries.translation_source: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
entries.translated:
Bagian daunnya berfungsi sebagai pemotong
untuk menebas lawan. Ia menyemburkan cairan
yang melarutkan segalanya.

entries.original:
"Acid that has dissolved many prey
becomes sweeter, making it even
more effective at attracting prey."
entries.translation_source: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
entries.translated:
Asam yang telah melarutkan banyak mangsa
menjadi lebih manis, membuatnya semakin
efektif untuk menarik mangsa.

entries.original:
"It drifts aimlessly in the ocean.
It is very difficult to see in water,
it may not be noticed until it stings."
entries.translation_source: It drifts aimlessly in the ocean. It is very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.
entries.translated:
Ia hanyut tanpa tujuan di lautan. Sangat
sulit dilihat di air, mungkin tidak akan
disadari sampai ia menyengat.

entries.original:
"It has 80 tentacles that move about
freely. They can sting, causing poisoning
and sharp, stabbing pain."
entries.translation_source: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki 80 tentakel yang bergerak
bebas. Mereka bisa menyengat, ... keracunan
dan rasa sakit yang tajam menusuk.

entries.original:
"At rest, it looks just like a rock.
Carelessly stepping on it will make it
swing its fists angrily."
entries.translation_source: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
entries.translated:
Saat istirahat, ia terlihat seperti batu.
Menginjaknya secara ... akan membuatnya
mengayunkan tinjunya dengan marah.

entries.original:
"Be careful while hiking on mountain
trails. Graveler may come rolling down
the path without slowing."
entries.translation_source: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. Graveler may come rolling down the path without slowing.
entries.translated:
Berhati-hatilah saat mendaki di jalur
gunung. Graveler mungkin datang berguling
di jalan tanpa melambat.

entries.original:
"It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as
rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin
once a year to grow larger."
entries.translation_source: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.
entries.translated:
Ia terbungkus dalam cangkang keras yang
kokoh seperti ... batu. Ia melepaskan kulit
setahun sekali untuk tumbuh lebih besar.

entries.original:
"It is a weak runner immediately after
birth. It gradually becomes faster by
chasing after its parents."
entries.translation_source: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
entries.translated:
Ia adalah pelari yang lemah segera setelah
lahir. Ia secara bertahap menjadi lebih
cepat dengan mengejar orang tuanya.

entries.original:
"At full gallop, its four hooves barely
touch the ground because it moves
so incredibly fast."
entries.translation_source: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.
entries.translated:
Saat berlari kencang, keempat kukunya
hampir tidak menyentuh tanah karena
bergerak sangat cepat.

entries.original:
"It lazes vacantly near water.
If something bites its tail, it won’t
even notice for a whole day."
entries.translation_source: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.
entries.translated:
Ia bermalas-malasan dengan kosong di dekat
air. Jika ... menggigit ekornya, ia tidak
akan menyadarinya selama sehari penuh.

entries.original:
"Though usually dim witted, it seems to
become inspired if the Shellder on its
tail bites down."
entries.translation_source: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
entries.translated:
Meskipun biasanya bodoh, ia tampaknya
menjadi terinspirasi jika Shellder di
ekornya menggigit.

entries.original:
"It moves while constantly hovering.
It discharges Thunder Wave and so on
from the units at its sides."
entries.translation_source: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.
entries.translated:
Ia bergerak sambil terus melayang. Ia
melepaskan Gelombang Petir dan sebagainya
dari unit di sisinya.

entries.original:
"A linked cluster formed of several
Magnemite. It discharges powerful
magnetic waves at high voltage."
entries.translation_source: A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
entries.translated:
Sebuah kelompok yang terhubung yang
terbentuk dari ... Ia melepaskan gelombang
magnet yang kuat pada tegangan tinggi.

entries.original:
"It always walks about with a plant stalk
clamped in its beak. The stalk is used
for building its nest."
entries.translation_source: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.
entries.translated:
Ia selalu berjalan-jalan dengan batang
tanaman di paruhnya. Batang itu digunakan
untuk membangun sarangnya.

entries.original:
"By alternately raising and lowering its
two heads, it balances itself to be more
stable while running."
entries.translation_source: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.
entries.translated:
Dengan mengangkat dan menurunkan kedua
kepalanya secara ... ia menyeimbangkan diri
agar lebih stabil saat berlari.

entries.original:
"If one of the heads gets to eat, the
others will be satisfied, too, and they
will stop squabbling."
entries.translation_source: If one of the heads gets to eat, the others will be satisfied, too, and they will stop squabbling.
entries.translated:
Jika salah satu kepalanya mendapat makanan,
yang lain juga akan puas, dan mereka akan
berhenti bertengkar.

entries.original:
"The colder it gets, the better it feels.
It joyfully swims around oceans so cold
that they are filled with floating ice."
entries.translation_source: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.
entries.translated:
Semakin dingin suhu yang ... Ia berenang
dengan gembira di lautan yang sangat dingin
hingga dipenuhi oleh es yang mengapung.

entries.original:
"Its streamlined body has little drag in
water. The colder the temperature,
the friskier it gets."
entries.translation_source: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya yang ramping memiliki hambatan
kecil di air. Semakin dingin suhunya,
semakin lineah ia.

entries.original:
"As it moves, it loses bits of its body
from which new Grimer emerge. This
worsens the stench around it."
entries.translation_source: As it moves, it loses bits of its body from which new Grimer emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
entries.translated:
Saat bergerak, ia kehilangan ... tubuhnya
dari mana Grimer baru muncul. Hal ini
memperburuk bau di sekitarnya.

entries.original:
"Its body is made of a powerful poison.
Touching it accidentally will cause a
fever that requires bed rest."
entries.translation_source: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya terbuat dari racun yang kuat.
Menyentuhnya secara tidak sengaja akan ...
yang memerlukan istirahat di tempat tidur.

entries.original:
"It is encased in a shell that is harder
than diamond. Inside, however, it is
surprisingly tender."
entries.translation_source: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.
entries.translated:
Ia terbungkus dalam cangkang yang lebih
keras dari berlian. Namun di dalamnya,
ternyata sangat lembut.

entries.original:
"Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot
be shattered, even with a bomb. The
shell opens only when it is attacking."
entries.translation_source: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.
entries.translated:
Cangkangnya sangat keras. Tidak bisa
hancur, bahkan dengan bom. Cangkang terbuka
hanya saat menyerang.

entries.original:
"With its gas-like body, it can sneak into
any place it desires. However, it can
be blown away by wind."
entries.translation_source: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
entries.translated:
Dengan tubuhnya yang seperti gas, ia dapat
... ke tempat mana pun yang diinginkannya.
Namun, ia dapat tertiup angin.

entries.original:
"In total darkness, where nothing is
visible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking
its next victim."
entries.translation_source: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking its next victim.
entries.translated:
Dalam kegelapan total, di mana tidak ada
yang terlihat, Haunter mengintai, diam-diam
mengincar korbannya yang berikutnya.

entries.original:
"It steals heat from its surroundings.
If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain
that a Gengar has appeared."
entries.translation_source: It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a Gengar has appeared.
entries.translated:
Ia mencuri panas dari sekitarnya. Jika kamu
merasakan hawa dingin mendadak, sudah pasti
ada Gengar yang muncul.

entries.original:
"It twists and squirms through the ground.
The thunderous roar of its tunneling
echoes a long way."
entries.translation_source: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.
entries.translated:
Ia berputar dan menggeliat di dalam tanah.
Gemuruh yang menggelegar dari penggaliannya
bergema jauh.

entries.original:
"It remembers every dream it eats.
It rarely eats the dreams of adults
because children’s are much tastier."
entries.translation_source: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.
entries.translated:
Ia mengingat setiap mimpi yang dimakannya.
Ia jarang memakan mimpi orang dewasa karena
mimpi anak-anak jauh lebih enak.

entries.original:
"Always holding a pendulum that it swings
at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness
in anyone nearby."
entries.translation_source: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.
entries.translated:
Selalu memegang pendulum yang diayunkan
dengan ritme tetap, ia menyebabkan kantuk
pada siapa pun yang berada di dekatnya.

entries.original:
"It can be found near the sea. The large
pincers grow back if they are torn out of
their sockets."
entries.translation_source: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat ditemukan di dekat laut. Capit
besarnya akan tumbuh kembali jika tercabut
dari soketnya.

entries.original:
"It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown
pincer. The pincers size makes it difficult
to aim properly. "
entries.translation_source: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincers size makes it difficult to aim properly.
entries.translated:
Ia hampir tidak mampu mengangkat capitnya
yang sangat besar dan ... Ukuran capit itu
membuatnya sulit membidik dengan tepat.

entries.original:
"A life-form whose identity is unknown.
It is said to Screech or suddenly
Selfdestruct."
entries.translation_source: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to Screech or suddenly Selfdestruct.
entries.translated:
Suatu bentuk kehidupan yang identitasnya
tidak ... Dikatakan dapat melakukan Jeritan
atau tiba-tiba melakukan Ledakan Diri.

entries.original:
"It explodes in response to even minor
stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname
of \qoThe Bomb Ball.\qc"
entries.translation_source: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of [quote-open-1]The Bomb Ball.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated:
Ia meledak sebagai respons terhadap
rangsangan kecil sekalipun. Ia ditakuti,
dengan julukan \qoBola Bom.\qc

entries.original:
"Even though it appears to be eggs of
some sort, it was discovered to be a
life-form more like plant seeds."
entries.translation_source: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life-form more like plant seeds.
entries.translated:
Meskipun tampak seperti semacam telur,
ditemukan bahwa itu adalah bentuk kehidupan
yang lebih mirip biji tanaman.

entries.original:
"Its three heads think independently.
However, they are friendly and never
appear to squabble."
entries.translation_source: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
entries.translated:
Ketiga kepalanya berpikir secara
independen. Namun, mereka ramah dan tidak
pernah terlihat bertengkar.

entries.original:
"If it is sad or lonely, the skull it
wears shakes, and it emits a plaintive
and mournful sound."
entries.translation_source: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes, and it emits a plaintive and mournful sound.
entries.translated:
Jika ia sedih atau kesepian, tengkorak yang
dikenakannya bergoyang, dan ia mengeluarkan
suara sedih dan pilu.

entries.original:
"It collects bones from an unknown place.
Some whisper that a Marowak graveyard
exists somewhere in the world."
entries.translation_source: It collects bones from an unknown place. Some whisper that a Marowak graveyard exists somewhere in the world.
entries.translated:
Ia mengumpulkan tulang dari tempat yang
tidak diketahui. Ada yang ... bahwa kuburan
Marowak ada di suatu tempat di dunia.

entries.original:
"If it starts kicking repeatedly, both
legs will stretch even longer to
strike a fleeing foe."
entries.translation_source: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.
entries.translated:
Jika ia mulai menendang berulang kali,
kedua kakinya akan meregang lebih panjang
untuk menyerang musuh yang melarikan diri.

entries.original:
"To increase the strength of all its
punch moves, it spins its arms just
before making contact."
entries.translation_source: To increase the strength of all its punch moves, it spins its arms just before making contact.
entries.translated:
Untuk meningkatkan kekuatan semua serangan
tinjunya, ia memutar lengannya tepat
sebelum melakukan kontak.

entries.original:
"Its tongue is twice the length of its
body. It can be moved like an arm for
grabbing food and attacking."
entries.translation_source: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.
entries.translated:
Lidahnya dua kali panjang tubuhnya. Ia bisa
digerakkan seperti lengan untuk meraih
makanan dan menyerang.

entries.original:
"The poisonous gases it contains are
a little bit lighter than air, keeping it
slightly airborne."
entries.translation_source: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air, keeping it slightly airborne.
entries.translated:
Gas beracun yang dikandungnya sedikit lebih
ringan dari udara, membuatnya sedikit
melayang.

entries.original:
"If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the
other one deflates. It constantly mixes
its poisonous gases."
entries.translation_source: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
entries.translated:
Jika salah satu dari si kembar Koffing
mengembang, yang lainnya mengempis. Ia
terus-menerus mencampur gas beracunnya.

entries.original:
"It is inept at turning because of its
four short legs. It can only charge
and run in one direction."
entries.translation_source: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.
entries.translated:
Ia tidak bisa berbelok dengan baik karena
keempat kakinya pendek. Ia hanya bisa
menyerbu dan berlari ke satu arah.

entries.original:
"Its brain developed when it began
walking on hind legs. Its thick hide
protects it even in magma."
entries.translation_source: Its brain developed when it began walking on hind legs. Its thick hide protects it even in magma.
entries.translated:
Otaknya berkembang ketika ia mulai berjalan
dengan kaki belakang. Kulitnya yang tebal
melindunginya bahkan di dalam magma.

entries.original:
"A kindly Pokémon that lays highly
nutritious eggs and shares them with
injured Pokémon or people."
entries.translation_source: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang baik hati yang bertelur dengan
nutrisi tinggi dan membaginya dengan
Pokémon atau manusia yang terluka.

entries.original:
"The vines that cloak its entire body
are always jiggling. They effectively
unnerve its foes."
entries.translation_source: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.
entries.translated:
Sulur-sulur yang menyelimuti seluruh
tubuhnya selalu bergoyang. Mereka efektif
membuat musuh gugup.

entries.original:
"If it is safe, the young gets out of the
belly pouch to play. The adult keeps
a close eye on the youngster."
entries.translation_source: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
entries.translated:
Jika aman, anaknya keluar dari kantung
perut untuk bermain. Yang dewasa mengawasi
anaknya dengan cermat.

entries.original:
"It maintains balance using its tail, which
is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink
from its mouth."
entries.translation_source: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.
entries.translated:
Ia menjaga keseimbangan menggunakan
ekornya, yang melingkar seperti kumparan.
Ia bisa menyemburkan tinta dari mulutnya.

entries.original:
"An examination of its cells revealed the
presence of a gene not found in Horsea.
It became a hot topic."
entries.translation_source: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in Horsea. It became a hot topic.
entries.translated:
Pemeriksaan sel-selnya mengungkapkan adanya
gen yang tidak ditemukan pada Horsea. Ini
menjadi topik yang hangat.

entries.original:
"During spawning season, they swim
gracefully in the water, searching for
their perfect mate."
entries.translation_source: During spawning season, they swim gracefully in the water, searching for their perfect mate.
entries.translated:
Selama musim bertelur, mereka berenang
dengan anggun di air, mencari pasangan yang
sempurna.

entries.original:
"The horn on its head is sharp like a
drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to
make its nest."
entries.translation_source: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.
entries.translated:
Tanduk di kepalanya tajam seperti bor. Ia
membuat lubang di batu besar untuk membuat
sarangnya.

entries.original:
"At night, the center of its body
slowly flickers with the same rhythm
as a human heartbeat."
entries.translation_source: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.
entries.translated:
Pada malam hari, pusat tubuhnya berkedip
perlahan dengan ritme yang sama seperti
detak jantung manusia.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon has a geometric body.
Because of its body, the locals suspect
that it is an alien creature."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini memiliki tubuh geometris.
Karena tubuhnya, penduduk setempat curiga
bahwa ia adalah makhluk alien.

entries.original:
"A skilled mime from birth, it gains the
ability to create invisible objects as
it matures."
entries.translation_source: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisible objects as it matures.
entries.translated:
Pemain pantomim yang terampil sejak lahir,
ia memperoleh kemampuan untuk menciptakan
benda tak terlihat saat ia dewasa.

entries.original:
"When it moves, it leaves only a blur.
If it hides in grass, its protective
coloration makes it invisible."
entries.translation_source: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective coloration makes it invisible.
entries.translated:
Saat bergerak, ia hanya meninggalkan jejak
kabur. Jika ... di rumput, pewarnaan
pelindungnya membuatnya tidak terlihat.

entries.original:
"It speaks a language similar to that of
humans. However, it seems to use
dancing to communicate."
entries.translation_source: It speaks a language similar to that of humans. However, it seems to use dancing to communicate.
entries.translated:
Ia berbicara dalam bahasa yang mirip dengan
bahasa manusia. Namun, tampaknya ia
menggunakan tarian untuk berkomunikasi.

entries.original:
"It loves to feed on strong electricity.
It occasionally appears around large
power plants and so on."
entries.translation_source: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.
entries.translated:
Ia suka memakan listrik yang kuat. Ia
kadang muncul di sekitar pembangkit listrik
besar dan sebagainya.

entries.original:
"The scorching fire exhaled by Magmar
forms heat waves around its body, making
it hard to see the Pokémon clearly."
entries.translation_source: The scorching fire exhaled by Magmar forms heat waves around its body, making it hard to see the Pokémon clearly.
entries.translated:
Api membara yang dihembuskan Magmar ...
panas di sekitar tubuhnya, membuat Pokémon
tersebut sulit terlihat dengan jelas.

entries.original:
"It swings its long pincer horns wildly
to attack. During cold periods, it hides
deep in forests."
entries.translation_source: It swings its long pincer horns wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.
entries.translated:
Ia mengayunkan tanduk capitnya yang panjang
dengan liar untuk ... Saat cuaca dingin, ia
bersembunyi jauh di dalam hutan.

entries.original:
"After heightening its will to fight by 
whipping itself with its three tails,
it charges at full speed."
entries.translation_source: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.
entries.translated:
Setelah meningkatkan semangat bertarungnya
dengan mencambuk dirinya ... tiga ekornya,
ia menyerbu dengan kecepatan penuh.

entries.original:
"This weak and pathetic Pokémon gets
easily pushed along rivers when there
are strong currents."
entries.translation_source: This weak and pathetic Pokémon gets easily pushed along rivers when there are strong currents.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang lemah dan menyedihkan ini
mudah terdorong di sepanjang sungai saat
ada arus yang kuat.

entries.original:
"Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados
will burn everything down, even in a
harsh storm."
entries.translation_source: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
entries.translated:
Begitu mulai mengamuk, Gyarados akan
membakar semuanya, bahkan di tengah badai
yang dahsyat.

entries.original:
"It ferries people across the sea on
its back. It may sing an enchanting
cry if it is in a good mood."
entries.translation_source: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.
entries.translated:
Ia ... di laut dengan punggungnya. Ia
mungkin menyanyikan seruan yang memesona
jika sedang dalam suasana hati yang baik.

entries.original:
"Its transformation ability is perfect.
However, if made to laugh, it can’t
maintain its disguise."
entries.translation_source: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can’t maintain its disguise.
entries.translated:
Kemampuan transformasinya sempurna. Namun,
jika dibuat tertawa, ia tidak bisa
mempertahankan penyamarannya.

entries.original:
"An extremely rare Pokémon that may
evolve in a number of different ways
depending on stimuli."
entries.translation_source: An extremely rare Pokémon that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang sangat langka yang dapat
berevolusi dalam beberapa cara berbeda
tergantung pada rangsangan.

entries.original:
"Its cell composition is similar to water
molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen
when it melts away into water."
entries.translation_source: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away into water.
entries.translated:
Komposisi selnya mirip dengan molekul air.
Akibatnya, ia tidak terlihat saat melebur
ke dalam air.

entries.original:
"Every hair on its body starts to stand
sharply on end if it becomes charged
with electricity."
entries.translation_source: Every hair on its body starts to stand sharply on end if it becomes charged with electricity.
entries.translated:
Setiap rambut di tubuhnya mulai berdiri
tegak jika terisi listrik.

entries.original:
"It fluffs out its fur collar to cool
down its body temperature, which can
reach 1,650 degrees."
entries.translation_source: It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees.
entries.translated:
Ia mengembangkan bulu kerahnya untuk
mendinginkan suhu tubuhnya, yang bisa
mencapai 1.650 derajat.

entries.original:
"Using the most advanced technologies,
scientists finally succeeded in making
the first artificial Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan teknologi paling canggih, para
ilmuwan akhirnya berhasil menciptakan
Pokémon buatan pertama.

entries.original:
"In prehistoric times, it swam on the
sea floor, eating plankton. Its fossils
are sometimes found."
entries.translation_source: In prehistoric times, it swam on the sea floor, eating plankton. Its fossils are sometimes found.
entries.translated:
Pada zaman prasejarah, ia berenang di dasar
laut, memakan plankton. Fosilnya kadang
ditemukan.

entries.original:
"Despite having strong fangs and
tentacles, it went extinct when its heavy
shell made it unable to catch prey."
entries.translation_source: Despite having strong fangs and tentacles, it went extinct when its heavy shell made it unable to catch prey.
entries.translated:
Meskipun memiliki taring dan tentakel yang
kuat, ia punah ... cangkangnya yang berat
membuatnya tidak bisa menangkap mangsa.

entries.original:
"On rare occasions, some have been
found as fossils which they became
while hiding on the ocean floor."
entries.translation_source: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.
entries.translated:
Pada kesempatan langka, beberapa ditemukan
sebagai fosil yang terbentuk saat
bersembunyi di dasar laut.

entries.original:
"In the water, it tucks in its limbs to
become more compact, then it wiggles
its shell to swim fast."
entries.translation_source: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.
entries.translated:
Di dalam air, ia ... anggota tubuhnya agar
menjadi lebih kompak, lalu menggoyangkan
cangkangnya untuk berenang cepat.

entries.original:
"A vicious Pokémon from the distant past,
it appears to have flown by spreading
its wings and gliding."
entries.translation_source: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ganas dari masa lalu, ia tampaknya
terbang dengan membentangkan sayapnya dan
meluncur.

entries.original:
"When its belly is full, it becomes too
lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is
safe to bounce on its belly."
entries.translation_source: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
entries.translated:
Saat perutnya kenyang, ia menjadi terlalu
lesu bahkan untuk mengangkat jari, jadi
aman untuk memantul di perutnya.

entries.original:
"The magnificent seemingly translucent
wings of this legendary bird Pokémon
are said to be made of ice."
entries.translation_source: The magnificent seemingly translucent wings of this legendary bird Pokémon are said to be made of ice.
entries.translated:
Sayap burung Pokémon legendaris ini yang
tampak tembus pandang dan megah dikatakan
terbuat dari es.

entries.original:
"This legendary bird Pokémon causes
savage thunderstorms by flapping its
glittering wings."
entries.translation_source: This legendary bird Pokémon causes savage thunderstorms by flapping its glittering wings.
entries.translated:
Pokémon burung legendaris ini menyebabkan
badai petir dahsyat dengan mengepakkan
sayapnya yang berkilau.

entries.original:
"This legendary Pokémon scatters
embers with every flap of its wings.
It is a thrilling sight to behold."
entries.translation_source: This legendary Pokémon scatters embers with every flap of its wings. It is a thrilling sight to behold.
entries.translated:
Pokémon legendaris ini menyebarkan bara api
dengan ... sayapnya. Itu adalah pemandangan
yang mendebarkan untuk disaksikan.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon is full of life energy.
It continually sheds its skin and grows
steadily larger."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini penuh dengan energi kehidupan.
Ia terus-menerus melepaskan kulitnya dan
tumbuh semakin besar.

entries.original:
"They say that if it emits an aura from
its whole body, the weather will begin
to change instantly."
entries.translation_source: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.
entries.translated:
Mereka mengatakan bahwa jika ia memancarkan
aura dari seluruh tubuhnya, cuaca akan
mulai berubah seketika.

entries.original:
"This marine Pokémon has an impressive
build that lets it freely fly over raging
seas without trouble."
entries.translation_source: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.
entries.translated:
Pokémon laut ini memiliki tubuh yang
mengesankan yang ... terbang bebas di atas
lautan yang bergelora tanpa kesulitan.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon whose genetic code was
repeatedly recombined for research.
It turned vicious as a result."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang kode genetiknya terus-menerus
direkombinasi untuk penelitian. Akibatnya,
ia menjadi ganas.

entries.original:
"Because it can use all kinds of moves,
many scientists believe Mew to be the
ancestor of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Karena dapat menggunakan berbagai macam
gerakan, banyak ilmuwan percaya bahwa Mew
adalah nenek moyang Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A sweet aroma gently wafts from the
leaf on its head. It is docile and loves
to soak up the sun’s rays."
entries.translation_source: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun’s rays.
entries.translated:
Aroma manis perlahan tercium dari daun di
kepalanya. Ia jinak dan suka berjemur di
bawah sinar matahari.

entries.original:
"A spicy aroma emanates from around
its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant
to restore health."
entries.translation_source: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.
entries.translated:
Aroma pedas terpancar dari sekitar
lehernya. Aroma tersebut bertindak sebagai
stimulan untuk memulihkan kesehatan.

entries.original:
"Meganium’s breath has the power to
revive dead grass and plants. It can
make them healthy again."
entries.translation_source: Meganium’s breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.
entries.translated:
Napas Meganium memiliki kekuatan untuk ...
kembali rumput dan tanaman yang mati. Ia
dapat membuat mereka sehat kembali.

entries.original:
"It is timid, and always curls itself up
in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its
back for protection."
entries.translation_source: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
entries.translated:
Ia pemalu, dan selalu menggulung dirinya
menjadi bola. Jika diserang, ia mengibaskan
punggungnya untuk perlindungan.

entries.original:
"Before battle, it turns its back on
its opponent to demonstrate how
ferociously its fire blazes."
entries.translation_source: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.
entries.translated:
Sebelum bertarung, ia membelakangi lawannya
untuk menunjukkan betapa dahsyatnya api
yang berkobar.

entries.original:
"If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot
that anything that touches it will
instantly go up in flames."
entries.translation_source: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
entries.translated:
Jika kemarahannya memuncak, ia menjadi
sangat panas sehingga apa pun yang
menyentuhnya akan langsung terbakar.

entries.original:
"This rough critter chomps at any
moving object it sees. Turning your
back on it is not recommended."
entries.translation_source: This rough critter chomps at any moving object it sees. Turning your back on it is not recommended.
entries.translated:
Makhluk kasar ini menggigit benda bergerak
apa pun yang dilihatnya. Tidak disarankan
membelakanginya.

entries.original:
"It opens its huge jaws wide when
attacking. If it loses any fangs while
biting, they grow back in."
entries.translation_source: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.
entries.translated:
Ia membuka rahang besarnya lebar-lebar saat
menyerang. Jika ... taring saat menggigit,
taring tersebut akan tumbuh kembali.

entries.original:
"Although it has a massive body, its
powerful hind legs enable it to move
quickly, even on the ground."
entries.translation_source: Although it has a massive body, its powerful hind legs enable it to move quickly, even on the ground.
entries.translated:
Meskipun memiliki tubuh yang besar, kaki
belakangnya yang kuat memungkinkannya
bergerak cepat, bahkan di darat.

entries.original:
"It stands on its tail so it can see a
long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries
loudly to warn its kind."
entries.translation_source: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.
entries.translated:
Ia berdiri di atas ekornya sehingga dapat
... jauh. Jika melihat musuh, ia berteriak
keras untuk memperingatkan sesamanya.

entries.original:
"It lives in narrow burrows that fit its
slim body. The deeper the nests go,
the more maze-like they become."
entries.translation_source: It lives in narrow burrows that fit its slim body. The deeper the nests go, the more maze-like they become.
entries.translated:
Ia tinggal di liang sempit yang sesuai
dengan tubuhnya yang ramping. Semakin dalam
sarangnya, semakin seperti labirin.

entries.original:
"It has a perfect sense of rhythm.
Whatever happens, it keeps a steady
pace by tilting its head in time."
entries.translation_source: It has a perfect sense of rhythm. Whatever happens, it keeps a steady pace by tilting its head in time.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki indera ritme yang sempurna. Apa
pun ... ia menjaga langkah yang mantap
dengan memiringkan kepalanya tepat waktu.

entries.original:
"When it needs to think, it rotates its
head 180 degrees to sharpen its
intellectual power."
entries.translation_source: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.
entries.translated:
Ketika perlu berpikir, ia memutar kepalanya
180 derajat untuk mempertajam kekuatan
intelektualnya.

entries.original:
"It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t
with a swarm of others. It conveys its
feelings with scent."
entries.translation_source: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
entries.translated:
Ia sangat pemalu, tidak bisa bergerak jika
tidak bersama dengan kawanan lainnya. Ia
menyampaikan perasaannya melalui aroma.

entries.original:
"In the daytime when it gets warm, it
curls up inside a big leaf and drifts off
into a deep slumber."
entries.translation_source: In the daytime when it gets warm, it curls up inside a big leaf and drifts off into a deep slumber.
entries.translated:
Pada siang hari saat cuaca hangat, ia
menggulung diri di dalam daun besar dan
tertidur pulas.

entries.original:
"It lies still in the same pose for days
in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting
prey to wander close."
entries.translation_source: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
entries.translated:
Ia berbaring diam dalam pose yang sama
selama berhari-hari di sarangnya, menunggu
mangsa yang tidak curiga mendekat.

entries.original:
"It spins string not only from its rear
but also from its mouth. It is hard to
tell which end is which."
entries.translation_source: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
entries.translated:
Ia memintal benang tidak hanya dari
belakang tetapi juga dari mulutnya. Sulit
untuk membedakan ujung yang mana.

entries.original:
"Having four wings allows it to fly more
quickly and quietly so it can sneak up
on prey without its noticing."
entries.translation_source: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.
entries.translated:
Memiliki empat sayap memungkinkannya
terbang lebih cepat dan tenang sehingga
bisa ... mendekati mangsa tanpa diketahui.

entries.original:
"It shoots positive and negative
electricity between the tips of its two
antennae and zaps its enemies."
entries.translation_source: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
entries.translated:
Ia menembakkan listrik positif dan negatif
di antara ujung kedua antenanya dan
menyetrum musuh-musuhnya.

entries.original:
"It blinds prey with an intense burst of
light, then swallows the immobilized prey
in a single gulp."
entries.translation_source: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.
entries.translated:
Ia membutakan mangsa dengan semburan cahaya
yang kuat, lalu menelan mangsa yang tak
bisa bergerak dalam satu tegukan.

entries.original:
"Despite its small size, it can zap even
adult humans. However, if it does so, it
also surprises itself."
entries.translation_source: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.
entries.translated:
Meskipun ukurannya kecil, ia bisa menyetrum
manusia dewasa sekalipun. Namun, jika
melakukannya, ia juga terkejut sendiri.

entries.original:
"When numerous meteors illuminate the
night sky, sightings of Cleffa strangely
increase."
entries.translation_source: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of Cleffa strangely increase.
entries.translated:
Ketika banyak meteor menerangi langit
malam, penampakan Cleffa anehnya meningkat.

entries.original:
"Its extremely flexible and elastic body
makes it bounce continuously--anytime,
anywhere."
entries.translation_source: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya yang sangat fleksibel dan elastis
membuatnya terus memantul—kapan saja, di
mana saja.

entries.original:
"A proverb claims that happiness will come
to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi
stand up."
entries.translation_source: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.
entries.translated:
Sebuah peribahasa mengatakan bahwa
kebahagiaan akan datang kepada ... pun yang
bisa membuat Togepi yang tidur berdiri.

entries.original:
"It grows dispirited if it is not with kind
people. It can float in midair without
moving its wings."
entries.translation_source: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
entries.translated:
Ia menjadi putus asa jika tidak bersama
orang-orang yang baik. Ia bisa melayang di
udara tanpa menggerakkan sayapnya.

entries.original:
"Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown,
it has to hop to get around. It is always
staring at something."
entries.translation_source: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
entries.translated:
Karena sayapnya belum sepenuhnya tumbuh, ia
harus melompat untuk bergerak. Ia selalu
menatap sesuatu.

entries.original:
"They say that it stays still and quiet
because it is seeing both the past
and future at the same time."
entries.translation_source: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
entries.translated:
Mereka mengatakan bahwa ia diam dan tenang
karena ia melihat masa lalu dan masa depan
pada saat yang bersamaan.

entries.original:
"Its fleece grows continually. In the
summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it
grows back in a week."
entries.translation_source: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.
entries.translated:
Bulu dombanya terus tumbuh. Di musim panas,
bulu tersebut rontok seluruhnya, tetapi
tumbuh kembali dalam seminggu.

entries.original:
"Not even downy wool will grow on its
rubbery, nonconductive patches of
skin that prevent electrical shock."
entries.translation_source: Not even downy wool will grow on its rubbery, nonconductive patches of skin that prevent electrical shock.
entries.translated:
Bahkan wol halus pun tidak akan tumbuh di
bagian kulitnya yang kenyal dan tidak
konduktif yang mencegah sengatan listrik.

entries.original:
"When it gets dark, the light from its
bright, shiny tail can be seen from far
away on the ocean’s surface."
entries.translation_source: When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean’s surface.
entries.translated:
Saat gelap, cahaya dari ekornya yang terang
dan berkilau dapat terlihat dari jauh di
permukaan laut.

entries.original:
"It is plentiful in tropical regions.
When it dances, its petals rub together
and make a pleasant ringing sound."
entries.translation_source: It is plentiful in tropical regions. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
entries.translated:
Ia melimpah di daerah tropis. Saat menari,
kelopak bunganya saling bergesekan dan ...
suara dering yang menyenangkan.

entries.original:
"The fur on its body naturally repels
water. It can stay dry, even when it
plays in the water."
entries.translation_source: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
entries.translated:
Bulu di tubuhnya secara alami menolak air.
Ia bisa tetap kering, bahkan saat bermain
di air.

entries.original:
"When it plays in water, it rolls up its
elongated ears to prevent their insides
from getting wet."
entries.translation_source: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.
entries.translated:
Saat bermain di air, ia menggulung
telinganya yang memanjang untuk mencegah
bagian dalamnya basah.

entries.original:
"It disguises itself as a tree to avoid
attack. It hates water, so it will
disappear if it starts raining."
entries.translation_source: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.
entries.translated:
Ia menyamar sebagai pohon untuk menghindari
serangan. Ia membenci air, jadi ia akan
menghilang jika hujan mulai turun.

entries.original:
"If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing
cry, they respond by gathering from
far and wide."
entries.translation_source: If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.
entries.translated:
Jika Poliwag dan Poliwhirl mendengar
teriakan gemanya, mereka berkumpul dari
jauh dan luas.

entries.original:
"Its body is so light, it must grip the
ground firmly with its feet to keep from
being blown away."
entries.translation_source: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya sangat ringan, ia harus
mencengkeram tanah dengan kuat dengan
kakinya agar tidak tertiup angin.

entries.original:
"It blooms when the weather warms.
It floats in the sky to soak up as much
sunlight as possible."
entries.translation_source: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
entries.translated:
Ia mekar saat cuaca menghangat. Ia melayang
di langit untuk menyerap sinar matahari
sebanyak mungkin.

entries.original:
"It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads
its cotton-like spores all over the world 
to make more offspring."
entries.translation_source: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.
entries.translated:
Ia hanyut bersama angin musiman dan ...
spora seperti kapasnya ke seluruh dunia
untuk menghasilkan lebih banyak keturunan.

entries.original:
"It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are
out of reach. Its tail is more adept
than its real hands."
entries.translation_source: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.
entries.translated:
Ia menggunakan ekornya untuk memetik buah
yang tidak terjangkau. Ekornya lebih
cekatan daripada tangan aslinya.

entries.original:
"It lives by drinking only dewdrops from
under the leaves of plants. It is said
that it eats nothing else."
entries.translation_source: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.
entries.translated:
Ia hidup hanya dengan meminum tetesan embun
dari bawah daun tanaman. Dikatakan bahwa ia
tidak makan yang lain.

entries.original:
"In the daytime, it rushes about in a
hectic manner, but it comes to a complete
stop when the sun sets."
entries.translation_source: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.
entries.translated:
Pada siang hari, ia berlarian dengan cara
yang sibuk, tetapi ia berhenti total saat
matahari terbenam.

entries.original:
"By flapping its wings at high speed,
it can fly freely through the air.
Even sudden stops are no problem."
entries.translation_source: By flapping its wings at high speed, it can fly freely through the air. Even sudden stops are no problem.
entries.translated:
Dengan mengepakkan sayapnya dengan ...
tinggi, ia dapat terbang bebas di udara.
Bahkan berhenti mendadak pun tidak masalah.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon lives in cold water.
It will leave the water to search for
food when it gets cold outside."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini hidup di air dingin. Ia akan
meninggalkan air untuk mencari makanan saat
di luar menjadi dingin.

entries.original:
"It often bangs its head on the river
bottom as it swims but seems not to
care. Its body is always slimy."
entries.translation_source: It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care. Its body is always slimy.
entries.translated:
Ia sering membenturkan kepalanya ke dasar
sungai saat berenang tetapi tampaknya tidak
peduli. Tubuhnya selalu berlendir.

entries.original:
"It uses the fine hair that covers its
body to sense air currents and predict
its enemy’s actions."
entries.translation_source: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.
entries.translated:
Ia menggunakan rambut halus yang menutupi
tubuhnya untuk merasakan arus udara dan
memprediksi tindakan musuhnya.

entries.original:
"On the night of a full moon, or when it
gets excited, the ring patterns on its
body glow yellow."
entries.translation_source: On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.
entries.translated:
Pada malam bulan purnama, atau saat ia
bersemangat, pola cincin di tubuhnya
bersinar kuning.

entries.original:
"Feared and loathed by many, it is
believed to bring misfortune to all
those who see it at night."
entries.translation_source: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
entries.translated:
Ditakuti dan dibenci oleh banyak orang, ia
diyakini membawa kesialan bagi semua yang
melihatnya di malam hari.

entries.original:
"Being bitten by Shellder gave it
intelligence comparable to that of
award-winning scientists."
entries.translation_source: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
entries.translated:
Digigit oleh Shellder memberinya kecerdasan
setara dengan ilmuwan pemenang penghargaan.

entries.original:
"It loves to bite and yank people’s hair
from behind without warning, just to see
