their shocked reactions."
entries.translation_source: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.
entries.translated:
Ia suka menggigit dan menarik rambut orang
dari belakang tanpa peringatan, hanya untuk
melihat reaksi kaget mereka.

entries.original:
"Its flat, thin body is always stuck on
walls. Its shape appears to have some
meaning."
entries.translation_source: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya yang datar dan tipis selalu
menempel di dinding. Bentuknya tampaknya
memiliki arti tertentu.

entries.original:
"To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it
lives quietly in the darkness. It is never
first to attack."
entries.translation_source: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.
entries.translated:
Untuk menyembunyikan ekornya yang hitam
pekat, ia hidup dengan tenang ... Ia tidak
pernah menjadi yang pertama menyerang.

entries.original:
"Its tail, which also contains a small
brain, may bite on its own if it notices
an alluring smell."
entries.translation_source: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.
entries.translated:
Ekornya, yang juga mengandung otak kecil,
dapat menggigit sendiri jika mencium bau
yang menarik.

entries.original:
"It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey
to come near. It does not move about
much on its own."
entries.translation_source: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.
entries.translated:
Ia bergelantungan dan menunggu mangsa
serangga terbang mendekat. Ia tidak banyak
bergerak sendiri.

entries.original:
"It remains immovably rooted to its tree.
It scatters pieces of its hard shell to
drive its enemies away."
entries.translation_source: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.
entries.translated:
Ia tetap berakar tak bergerak di pohonnya.
Ia menyebarkan potongan cangkang kerasnya
untuk mengusir musuh-musuhnya.

entries.original:
"If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with
its tail. It can hover just slightly using
its wings."
entries.translation_source: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.
entries.translated:
Jika terlihat, ia melarikan diri dengan
menggali menggunakan ekornya. Ia bisa
melayang sedikit menggunakan sayapnya.

entries.original:
"It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots
its prey, it spreads its wings and glides
down to attack."
entries.translation_source: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
entries.translated:
Ia biasanya menempel di tebing. Saat
melihat mangsa, ia membentangkan sayap dan
meluncur turun untuk menyerang.

entries.original:
"Its body has been compressed deep
under the ground. As a result, it is
even harder than a diamond."
entries.translation_source: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya telah terkompresi jauh di dalam
tanah. Akibatnya, ia lebih keras dari
berlian.

entries.original:
"Although it looks frightening, it is
actually kind and affectionate.
It is very popular among women."
entries.translation_source: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
entries.translated:
Meskipun terlihat menakutkan, ia sebenarnya
baik dan penuh kasih sayang. Ia sangat
populer di kalangan wanita.

entries.original:
"It can make most any Pokémon run
away simply by opening its mouth wide
to reveal its big fangs."
entries.translation_source: It can make most any Pokémon run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.
entries.translated:
Ia bisa membuat hampir semua Pokémon lari
hanya dengan membuka mulutnya lebar-lebar
untuk memperlihatkan taring besarnya.

entries.original:
"When faced with a larger opponent,
it swallows as much water as it can to
match the opponent’s size."
entries.translation_source: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent’s size.
entries.translated:
Saat berhadapan dengan lawan yang lebih
besar, ia menelan air sebanyak mungkin
untuk menyesuaikan ukuran lawan.

entries.original:
"It swings its eye-patterned pincers up
to scare its foes. This makes it look
like it has three heads."
entries.translation_source: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
entries.translated:
Ia mengayunkan capit bermotif matanya ke
atas untuk menakuti musuh. Ini membuatnya
terlihat seperti memiliki tiga kepala.

entries.original:
"It stores Berries inside its shell.
The Berries eventually ferment to
become delicious juices."
entries.translation_source: It stores Berries inside its shell. The Berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
entries.translated:
Ia menyimpan Berry di dalam cangkangnya.
Berry tersebut akhirnya berfermentasi
menjadi jus yang lezat.

entries.original:
"It loves sweet honey. To keep all
the honey to itself, it hurls rivals
away with its prized horn."
entries.translation_source: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.
entries.translated:
Ia menyukai madu manis. Untuk menyimpan
semua madu untuk dirinya ... ia melemparkan
saingan dengan tanduk yang berharga.

entries.original:
"Its paws conceal sharp claws.
If attacked, it suddenly extends the
claws and startles its enemy."
entries.translation_source: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
entries.translated:
Cakarnya menyembunyikan cakar tajam. Jika
diserang, ia tiba-tiba mengeluarkan cakar
dan mengejutkan musuhnya.

entries.original:
"It lets honey soak into its paws so
it can lick them all the time. Every set
of paws tastes unique."
entries.translation_source: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
entries.translated:
Ia membiarkan madu meresap ke cakarnya
sehingga bisa menjilatnya ... saat. Setiap
pasang cakar memiliki rasa yang unik.

entries.original:
"With its ability to distinguish any smell,
it unfailingly finds all food buried deep
underground."
entries.translation_source: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.
entries.translated:
Dengan kemampuannya membedakan bau apa pun,
ia selalu menemukan semua makanan yang
terkubur jauh di dalam tanah.

entries.original:
"It never sleeps. It has to keep moving
because if it stopped, its magma body
would cool and harden."
entries.translation_source: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
entries.translated:
Ia tidak pernah tidur. Ia harus terus
bergerak karena jika berhenti, tubuh
magmanya akan mendingin dan mengeras.

entries.original:
"The shell on its back is just skin that
has cooled and hardened. It breaks
easily with a slight touch."
entries.translation_source: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
entries.translated:
Cangkang di punggungnya hanyalah kulit yang
mendingin dan mengeras. Ia mudah pecah
dengan sentuhan ringan.

entries.original:
"If it smells something enticing, it dashes
off headlong to find the source of the
aroma."
entries.translation_source: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.
entries.translated:
Jika mencium sesuatu yang menggoda, ia
bergegas pergi dengan terburu-buru untuk
menemukan sumber aroma.

entries.original:
"If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on
its back stand up straight. It is very
sensitive to sound."
entries.translation_source: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.
entries.translated:
Jika menyerang musuh, bulu di punggungnya
berdiri tegak. Ia sangat sensitif terhadap
suara.

entries.original:
"In a south sea nation, the people live in
communities that are built on groups of
these Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Di sebuah negara laut selatan, orang-orang
tinggal di komunitas yang dibangun di atas
kelompok Pokémon ini.

entries.original:
"Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad,
it clings to a Mantine’s underside
to scavenge for leftovers."
entries.translation_source: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan sirip punggungnya sebagai
bantalan hisap, ia menempel di bawah
Mantine untuk mencari sisa makanan.

entries.original:
"It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes.
If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of
a fellow Octillery."
entries.translation_source: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow Octillery.
entries.translated:
Ia secara naluriah menyelinap ke lubang
berbatu. Jika mengantuk, ia mencuri sarang
Octillery lain.

entries.original:
"It always carries its food with it,
wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws
its food at the opponent."
entries.translation_source: It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.
entries.translated:
Ia selalu membawa makanannya ke mana pun ia
pergi. Jika diserang, ia melemparkan
makanannya ke lawan.

entries.original:
"Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly
out of the water and over the waves if it
builds up enough speed."
entries.translation_source: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.
entries.translated:
Berenang bebas di laut lepas, ia bisa
terbang keluar dari air dan melompati ombak
jika kecepatannya cukup.

entries.original:
"Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they
are actually hollow and light, allowing
it to fly freely in the sky."
entries.translation_source: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
entries.translated:
Sayapnya yang kokoh terlihat berat, tetapi
sebenarnya berlubang dan ringan,
memungkinkannya terbang bebas di langit.

entries.original:
"To corner prey, they check each other’s
location using barks that only they can
understand."
entries.translation_source: To corner prey, they check each other’s location using barks that only they can understand.
entries.translated:
Untuk menjebak mangsa, mereka saling
memeriksa lokasi menggunakan gonggongan
yang hanya mereka pahami.

entries.original:
"The flames it breathes when angry
contain toxins. If they cause a burn,
it will hurt forever."
entries.translation_source: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.
entries.translated:
Api yang dihembuskannya saat marah
mengandung racun. Jika ... luka bakar, rasa
sakitnya akan bertahan selamanya.

entries.original:
"It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to
build its energy. It is said to cause
tornadoes as it wakes."
entries.translation_source: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.
entries.translated:
Ia tidur di dasar laut yang dalam untuk
mengumpulkan energi. Dikatakan bahwa ia
menyebabkan tornado saat bangun.

entries.original:
"As a sign of affection, it bumps with its
snout. However, it is so strong, it may
send you flying."
entries.translation_source: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.
entries.translated:
Sebagai tanda kasih sayang, ia menyenggol
dengan moncongnya. Namun, karena sangat
kuat, ia bisa membuatmu terpental.

entries.original:
"Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard
state. An ordinary sort of attack won’t
even leave a scratch."
entries.translation_source: Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won’t even leave a scratch.
entries.translated:
Kulitnya telah mengeras hingga sekeras
batu. Serangan biasa bahkan tidak akan
meninggalkan goresan.

entries.original:
"This manmade Pokémon evolved from
the latest technology. It may have
unprogrammed reactions."
entries.translation_source: This manmade Pokémon evolved from the latest technology. It may have unprogrammed reactions.
entries.translated:
Pokémon buatan manusia ini berevolusi dari
teknologi terbaru. Ia mungkin memiliki
reaksi yang tidak terprogram.

entries.original:
"Those who stare at its antlers will
gradually lose control of their senses
and be unable to stand."
entries.translation_source: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.
entries.translated:
Mereka yang menatap tanduknya secara
bertahap akan kehilangan kendali indra dan
tidak bisa berdiri.

entries.original:
"Once it becomes an adult, it has a
tendency to let its comrades plant
footprints on its back."
entries.translation_source: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.
entries.translated:
Setelah dewasa, ia cenderung membiarkan
rekannya menjejakkan kaki di punggungnya.

entries.original:
"Even though it is small, it can’t be
ignored because it will slug any handy
target without warning."
entries.translation_source: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.
entries.translated:
Meskipun kecil, ia tidak bisa diabaikan
karena akan memukul target yang ada di
dekatnya tanpa peringatan.

entries.original:
"It launches kicks while spinning. If it
spins at high speed, it may bore its way
into the ground."
entries.translation_source: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.
entries.translated:
Ia melontarkan tendangan sambil berputar.
Jika berputar dengan kecepatan tinggi, ia
bisa mengebor tanah.

entries.original:
"It always rocks its head slowly
backwards and forwards as if it is
trying to kiss someone."
entries.translation_source: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.
entries.translated:
Ia selalu mengayunkan kepalanya perlahan ke
depan dan ke belakang seolah ingin mencium
seseorang.

entries.original:
"Even in the most vicious storm, this
Pokémon plays happily if thunder
rumbles in the sky."
entries.translation_source: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.
entries.translated:
Bahkan dalam badai paling dahsyat, Pokémon
ini bermain dengan gembira jika guntur
bergemuruh di langit.

entries.original:
"Each and every time it inhales and
exhales, hot embers dribble out of
its mouth and nostrils."
entries.translation_source: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
entries.translated:
Setiap kali ia menarik dan menghembuskan
napas, bara api panas menetes dari mulut
dan lubang hidungnya.

entries.original:
"If it has just had a baby, the milk it
produces contains much more nutrition
than usual."
entries.translation_source: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.
entries.translated:
Jika baru saja melahirkan, susu yang
dihasilkannya mengandung lebih banyak
nutrisi dari biasanya.

entries.original:
"It has a very compassionate nature.
If it sees a sick Pokémon, it will nurse
the sufferer back to health."
entries.translation_source: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick Pokémon, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki sifat yang sangat penuh kasih.
Jika melihat Pokémon yang sakit, ia akan
merawatnya hingga sembuh.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon races across the
land while barking a cry that sounds
like crashing thunder."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini berlari melintasi daratan
sambil menggonggong dengan suara seperti
gemuruh petir.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon that races across the land.
It is said that one is born every time a
new volcano appears."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang berlari melintasi daratan.
Dikatakan bahwa satu lahir setiap kali
gunung berapi baru muncul.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon races across the land.
It is said that north winds will somehow
blow whenever it appears."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini berlari melintasi daratan.
Dikatakan bahwa angin utara akan bertiup
entah bagaimana setiap kali ia muncul.

entries.original:
"It is born deep underground. It can’t
emerge until it has entirely consumed the
soil around it."
entries.translation_source: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.
entries.translated:
Ia lahir jauh di bawah tanah. Ia tidak bisa
muncul sampai ia benar-benar menghabiskan
tanah di sekitarnya.

entries.original:
"Even sealed in its shell, it can move
freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding
destructive power."
entries.translation_source: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.
entries.translated:
Bahkan saat tersegel dalam cangkangnya, ia
bisa ... Keras dan cepat, ia memiliki
kekuatan destruktif yang luar biasa.

entries.original:
"Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of
attack, so it is very eager to make
challenges against enemies."
entries.translation_source: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya tidak bisa dilukai oleh serangan
apapun, jadi ia sangat bersemangat untuk
menantang musuh-musuhnya.

entries.original:
"It is said to be the guardian of the seas.
It is rumored to have been seen on the
night of a storm."
entries.translation_source: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.
entries.translated:
Dikatakan sebagai penjaga lautan.
Dikabarkan telah terlihat pada malam badai.

entries.original:
"A legend says that its body glows in
seven colors. A rainbow is said to form
behind it when it flies."
entries.translation_source: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.
entries.translated:
Sebuah legenda mengatakan bahwa tubuhnya
bersinar dalam tujuh warna. ... dikatakan
terbentuk di belakangnya saat ia terbang.

entries.original:
"When Celebi disappears deep in a forest,
it is said to leave behind an egg it
brought from the future."
entries.translation_source: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.
entries.translated:
Saat Celebi menghilang jauh di dalam hutan,
dikatakan ia meninggalkan telur yang
dibawanya dari masa depan.

entries.original:
"The soles of its feet are covered by
countless tiny spikes, enabling it to
walk on walls and ceilings."
entries.translation_source: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
entries.translated:
Telapak kakinya ditutupi oleh duri-duri
kecil yang tak terhitung jumlahnya, ...
berjalan di dinding dan langit-langit.

entries.original:
"While closing in on its prey, it leaps
from branch to branch. It displays
astounding agility."
entries.translation_source: While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch. It displays astounding agility.
entries.translated:
Saat mendekati mangsanya, ia melompat dari
dahan ke dahan. Ia menunjukkan kelincahan
yang menakjubkan.

entries.original:
"The leaves that grow on its arms can
slice down thick trees. It is without
peer in jungle combat."
entries.translation_source: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
entries.translated:
Daun-daun yang tumbuh di lengannya bisa
menebang pohon-pohon tebal. Ia tidak ada
tandingannya dalam pertarungan hutan.

entries.original:
"It has a flame sac inside its belly
that perpetually burns. It feels warm
if it is hugged."
entries.translation_source: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki kantung api di dalam perutnya
yang terus menyala. Terasa hangat jika
dipeluk.

entries.original:
"During a battle, the hot flame in its
body grows. Its kicks have outstanding
destructive power."
entries.translation_source: During a battle, the hot flame in its body grows. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
entries.translated:
Saat bertarung, api panas di tubuhnya
membesar. Tendangannya memiliki kekuatan
destruktif yang luar biasa.

entries.original:
"Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping
its knuckles. The stronger the foes, the
more intensely they burn."
entries.translation_source: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. The stronger the foes, the more intensely they burn.
entries.translated:
Api menyembur dari pergelangan tangannya,
menyelimuti buku-buku jarinya. Semakin kuat
musuh, semakin hebat mereka terbakar.

entries.original:
"Its large tail fin propels it through
water with powerful acceleration.
It is strong in spite of its size."
entries.translation_source: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
entries.translated:
Sirip ekornya yang besar mendorongnya
melalui air dengan akselerasi yang kuat. Ia
kuat meskipun ukurannya kecil.

entries.original:
"Living on muddy ground that provides
poor footing has made its legs sturdy.
It burrows into dirt to sleep."
entries.translation_source: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
entries.translated:
Hidup di tanah berlumpur yang memberikan
pijakan buruk telah membuat kakinya kokoh.
Ia menggali ke dalam tanah untuk tidur.

entries.original:
"Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing,
they can batter down its foe. It makes
its nest on beautiful beaches."
entries.translation_source: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.
entries.translated:
Lengannya keras seperti batu. Dengan satu
ayunan, mereka bisa ... musuh. Ia membuat
sarang di pantai-pantai yang indah.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it
chases its chosen prey until the prey
becomes exhausted."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
entries.translated:
Pokémon dengan sifat gigih, ia mengejar
mangsa pilihannya sampai mangsanya
kelelahan.

entries.original:
"It will always obey the commands of a
skilled trainer. Its behavior arises from
its living in packs in ancient times."
entries.translation_source: It will always obey the commands of a skilled trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
entries.translated:
Ia akan selalu mematuhi perintah pelatih
yang terampil. Perilakunya berasal dari ...
hidup dalam kelompok di zaman kuno.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon with abundant curiosity.
It shows an interest in everything, so it
always zigs and zags."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.
entries.translated:
Pokémon dengan rasa ingin tahu yang
melimpah. Ia menunjukkan ketertarikan pada
segala hal, jadi ia selalu berbelok-belok.

entries.original:
"Linoone always runs at full speed and
only ever in straight lines. This Pokémon
is challenged by gently curving roads."
entries.translation_source: Linoone always runs at full speed and only ever in straight lines. This Pokémon is challenged by gently curving roads.
entries.translated:
Linoone selalu berlari dengan ... dan hanya
dalam garis lurus. Pokémon ini kesulitan
dengan jalan yang melengkung lembut.

entries.original:
"It lives amidst tall grass and in forests.
When attacked, it resists by pointing its
venomous spikes at the foe."
entries.translation_source: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.
entries.translated:
Ia hidup di antara rumput tinggi dan di
hutan. Saat diserang, ia melawan dengan
mengarahkan duri beracunnya ke lawan.

entries.original:
"It wraps silk around the branches of
a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk
while awaiting evolution."
entries.translation_source: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
entries.translated:
Ia membungkus sutra di sekitar cabang
pohon. Ia meminum air hujan di atas
sutranya sambil menunggu evolusi.

entries.original:
"Despite its appearance, it has an
aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing
with its long, thin mouth."
entries.translation_source: Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.
entries.translated:
Meskipun penampilannya, ia memiliki sifat
agresif. Ia ... dengan menusuk menggunakan
mulutnya yang panjang dan tipis.

entries.translation_source: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
entries.translated:
Ia tidak pernah melupakan serangan apa pun
yang dialaminya ... di dalam kepompong.
Setelah evolusi, ia mencari balas dendam.

entries.original:
"It scatters horribly toxic dust when it
senses danger. They tend to gather in the
glow of streetlamps at night."
entries.translation_source: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.
entries.translated:
Ia menyebarkan debu yang sangat beracun
saat merasakan bahaya. ... berkumpul di
bawah cahaya lampu jalan pada malam hari.

entries.original:
"It searches about for clean water. If it
does not drink water for too long, the
leaf on its head wilts."
entries.translation_source: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.
entries.translated:
Ia mencari air bersih. Jika terlalu lama
tidak minum air, daun di kepalanya layu.

entries.original:
"It lives at the water’s edge where it
is sunny. It feeds on aquatic mosses
that grow in the riverbed."
entries.translation_source: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.
entries.translated:
Ia tinggal di tepi air yang terkena sinar
matahari. Ia memakan lumut air yang tumbuh
di dasar sungai.

entries.original:
"If it hears festive music, all its muscles
fill with energy. It can’t help breaking
out into a dance."
entries.translation_source: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
entries.translated:
Jika mendengar musik meriah, semua ototnya
dipenuhi energi. Ia tidak bisa menahan diri
untuk mulai menari.

entries.original:
"If it remains still, it becomes impossible
to distinguish from real nuts. It delights
in surprising foraging Pidgey."
entries.translation_source: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging Pidgey.
entries.translated:
Jika diam, ia menjadi tidak bisa dibedakan
dari kacang asli. Ia senang mengejutkan
Pidgey yang sedang mencari makan.

entries.original:
"They live in holes bored in large trees.
The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills
listeners with dread."
entries.translation_source: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.
entries.translated:
Mereka tinggal di lubang yang dibuat di
pohon besar. Suara seruling rumput Nuzleaf
membuat pendengarnya merasa ngeri.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon that was feared as a forest
guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and
take preemptive action."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.
entries.translated:
Seekor Pokémon yang ditakuti sebagai
penjaga hutan. Ia dapat membaca pikiran
lawan dan mengambil tindakan pencegahan.

entries.original:
"Although it is small, it has a gutsy
spirit that makes it take on tough foes.
It flies in search of warm climates."
entries.translation_source: Although it is small, it has a gutsy spirit that makes it take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
entries.translated:
Meskipun kecil, ia memiliki semangat berani
yang membuatnya menghadapi lawan tangguh.
Ia terbang mencari iklim hangat.

entries.original:
"If its two tail feathers are standing at
attention, it is proof of good health.
It soars elegantly in the sky."
entries.translation_source: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.
entries.translated:
Jika dua bulu ekornya berdiri tegak, itu
adalah bukti kesehatan yang baik. Ia
melayang dengan anggun di langit.

entries.original:
"Catching sea winds with its long wings,
it soars as if it were a glider. It makes 
its nest on cliffs."
entries.translation_source: Catching sea winds with its long wings, it soars as if it were a glider. It makes its nest on cliffs.
entries.translated:
Menangkap angin laut dengan sayapnya yang
panjang, ia melayang seolah-olah pesawat
layang. Ia membuat sarang di tebing.

entries.original:
"It is a flying transporter that carries
small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the
waves to rest its wings."
entries.translation_source: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.
entries.translated:
Ia adalah pengangkut terbang yang membawa
Pokémon kecil di paruhnya. Ia mengapung di
ombak untuk mengistirahatkan sayapnya.

entries.original:
"It uses the horns on its head to sense
human emotions. It is said to appear in
front of cheerful people."
entries.translation_source: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.
entries.translated:
Ia menggunakan tanduk di kepalanya untuk
merasakan emosi manusia. Dikatakan bahwa ia
muncul di depan orang-orang yang ceria.

entries.original:
"If its Trainer becomes happy, it
overflows with energy, dancing
joyously while spinning about."
entries.translation_source: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
entries.translated:
Jika Trainernya menjadi bahagia, ia meluap
dengan energi, menari dengan gembira sambil
berputar-putar.

entries.original:
"It unleashes psychokinetic energy
at full power when protecting a
trainer it has bonded closely with."
entries.translation_source: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a trainer it has bonded closely with.
entries.translated:
Ia melepaskan energi psikokinetik dengan
kekuatan penuh saat melindungi seorang
trainer yang telah terikat erat dengannya.

entries.original:
"They usually live on ponds, but after
an evening shower, they may appear on
puddles in towns."
entries.translation_source: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.
entries.translated:
Mereka biasanya hidup di kolam, tetapi
setelah hujan sore, mereka mungkin muncul
di genangan air di kota.

entries.original:
"The antennae have distinctive patterns
that look like eyes. When it rains, they
grow heavy, making flight impossible."
entries.translation_source: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.
entries.translated:
Antena memiliki pola khas yang terlihat
seperti mata. Saat hujan, antena menjadi
berat, membuat penerbangan tidak mungkin.

entries.original:
"It prefers damp places. By day it remains
still in the forest shade. It releases
toxic powder from its head."
entries.translation_source: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
entries.translated:
Ia lebih suka tempat lembap. Pada siang
hari ia ... diam di bawah naungan hutan. Ia
melepaskan bubuk beracun dari kepalanya.

entries.original:
"The seeds on its tail are made of toxic
spores. It knocks out foes with quick,
virtually invisible punches."
entries.translation_source: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.
entries.translated:
Biji di ekornya terbuat dari spora beracun.
Ia melumpuhkan lawan dengan pukulan cepat
yang hampir tak terlihat.

entries.original:
"If it eats just three leaves in a day,
it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps
for 20 hours a day."
entries.translation_source: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.
entries.translated:
Jika ia hanya makan tiga daun dalam sehari,
ia sudah puas. Selain itu, ia tidur selama
20 jam sehari.

entries.original:
"Its stress level rises if it cannot keep
moving constantly. Too much stress
makes it feel sick."
entries.translation_source: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.
entries.translated:
Tingkat stresnya meningkat jika ia tidak
bisa terus bergerak. Terlalu banyak stres
membuatnya merasa sakit.

entries.original:
"It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon.
However, it can exert horrifying power by
releasing pent-up energy all at once."
entries.translation_source: It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah Pokémon paling pemalas di dunia.
Namun, ia ... yang mengerikan dengan
melepaskan energi yang tertahan sekaligus.

entries.original:
"It can live underground for more than
10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the
roots of trees."
entries.translation_source: It can live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.
entries.translated:
Ia bisa hidup di bawah tanah selama lebih
dari 10 tahun. Ia menyerap nutrisi dari
akar pohon.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to
be able to avoid any attack. It loves to
feed on tree sap."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini sangat cepat, dikatakan mampu
menghindari serangan apa pun. Ia suka
memakan getah pohon.

entries.original:
"A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow
appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada
evolves."
entries.translation_source: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang sangat aneh yang entah
bagaimana muncul di dalam Poké Ball saat
Nincada berevolusi.

entries.original:
"It usually murmurs, but starts crying
loudly if it senses danger. It stops when
its ear covers are shut."
entries.translation_source: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.
entries.translated:
Ia biasanya bergumam, tetapi mulai menangis
keras jika merasakan bahaya. Ia berhenti
ketika penutup telinganya ditutup.

entries.original:
"When it stamps its feet and bellows, it
generates ultrasonic waves that can blow
apart a house."
entries.translation_source: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.
entries.translated:
Saat ia menghentakkan kaki dan mengaum, ia
menghasilkan gelombang ultrasonik yang
dapat meledakkan rumah.

entries.original:
"It emits a variety of sounds from the 
holes all over its body. Its loud cries
can be heard from over six miles away."
entries.translation_source: It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.
entries.translated:
Ia mengeluarkan berbagai suara dari
lubang-lubang di seluruh ... bisa terdengar
dari jarak lebih dari sepuluh kilometer.

entries.original:
"It toughens up by slamming into thick
trees over and over. It gains a sturdy
body and dauntless spirit."
entries.translation_source: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.
entries.translated:
Ia menguatkan diri dengan membanting pohon
tebal berulang kali. Ia ... tubuh yang
kokoh dan semangat yang tak kenal takut.

entries.original:
"It loves to match power with big-bodied
Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying
with its arm thrusts."
entries.translation_source: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
entries.translated:
Ia suka mengadu kekuatan dengan Pokémon
bertubuh besar. Ia bisa melontarkan truk
dengan dorongan lengannya.

entries.original:
"It battles by flinging around its tail,
which is bigger than its body. The
tail is a flotation device in water."
entries.translation_source: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.
entries.translated:
Ia bertarung dengan mengayunkan ekornya,
yang lebih besar dari tubuhnya. Ekor itu
berfungsi sebagai alat pelampung di air.

entries.original:
"Its magnetic nose consistently faces
north. Travelers check Nosepass to
get their bearings."
entries.translation_source: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.
entries.translated:
Hidung magnetnya secara konsisten menghadap
ke utara. Pelancong memeriksa Nosepass
untuk mengetahui arah.

entries.original:
"It is said to be difficult to earn its
trust. However, it is extremely popular
for its cute looks and behavior."
entries.translation_source: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.
entries.translated:
Dikatakan sulit untuk mendapatkan
kepercayaannya. Namun, ia sangat ... karena
penampilan dan perilakunya yang imut.

entries.original:
"The favorite of trend-conscious female
trainers, they are used in competition
for their style and fur."
entries.translation_source: The favorite of trend-conscious female trainers, they are used in competition for their style and fur.
entries.translated:
Kesayangan pelatih wanita yang sadar tren,
mereka digunakan dalam kompetisi karena
gaya dan bulunya.

entries.original:
"It dwells in the darkness of caves.
It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems
to nourish itself."
entries.translation_source: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.
entries.translated:
Ia tinggal di kegelapan gua. Ia menggunakan
cakar tajamnya untuk menggali permata untuk
memberi makan dirinya sendiri.

entries.original:
"It uses its docile-looking face to lull
foes into complacency, then bites with its
huge, relentless jaws."
entries.translation_source: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
entries.translated:
Ia menggunakan wajahnya yang tampak jinak
untuk membuat lawan ... menggigit dengan
rahangnya yang besar dan tak kenal ampun.

entries.original:
"It usually lives deep in mountains.
However, hunger may drive it to eat
railroad tracks and cars."
entries.translation_source: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
entries.translated:
Ia biasanya hidup di pegunungan dalam.
Namun, rasa lapar bisa mendorongnya untuk
memakan rel kereta dan mobil.

entries.original:
"It loves iron ore. Groups of them
fight for territory by bashing one
another with their steel bodies."
entries.translation_source: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
entries.translated:
Ia menyukai bijih besi. Kelompok mereka
bertarung memperebutkan ... dengan saling
memukul menggunakan tubuh baja mereka.

entries.original:
"It claims an entire mountain as its own.
The more wounds it has, the more it has
battled, so don’t take it lightly."
entries.translation_source: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don’t take it lightly.
entries.translated:
Ia mengklaim seluruh gunung sebagai
miliknya. Semakin banyak ... semakin banyak
ia bertarung, jadi jangan anggap remeh.

entries.original:
"It meditates to heighten its inner energy
and to float in the air. It eats only one
berry each day."
entries.translation_source: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats only one berry each day.
entries.translated:
Ia bermeditasi untuk meningkatkan energi
dalamnya dan melayang di udara. Ia hanya
makan satu buah beri setiap hari.

entries.original:
"It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-
like steps, then launches a devastating
blow in the same motion."
entries.translation_source: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
entries.translated:
Ia dengan anggun menghindari serangan
dengan langkah seperti ... lalu melancarkan
pukulan dahsyat dalam gerakan yang sama.

entries.original:
"It stores static electricity in its fur
for discharging. It gives off sparks if a
storm approaches."
entries.translation_source: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.
entries.translated:
Ia menyimpan listrik statis di bulunya
untuk dilepaskan. Ia mengeluarkan percikan
api jika badai mendekat.

entries.original:
"It discharges electricity from its mane.
It creates a thundercloud overhead to
drop lightning bolts."
entries.translation_source: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
entries.translated:
Ia melepaskan listrik dari surainya. Ia
menciptakan awan petir di atas untuk
menjatuhkan sambaran petir.

entries.original:
"It cheers on friends with pom-poms
made of sparks. It shorts out its body
to create crackling noises."
entries.translation_source: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.
entries.translated:
Ia ... dengan pom-pom yang terbuat dari
percikan api. Ia membuat korsleting pada
tubuhnya untuk menghasilkan suara berderak.

entries.original:
"It likes to cheer on its friends. If they
are losing, its body lets off more and
more sparks."
entries.translation_source: It likes to cheer on its friends. If they are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
entries.translated:
Ia suka menyemangati teman-temannya. Jika
mereka kalah, tubuhnya mengeluarkan semakin
banyak percikan api.

entries.original:
"It communicates with others by lighting
up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s
sweet aroma."
entries.translation_source: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
entries.translated:
Ia berkomunikasi dengan yang lain dengan
menyalakan bagian belakangnya di malam
hari. Ia menyukai aroma manis Illumise.

entries.original:
"It guides Volbeat to draw signs in night
skies. There are scientists that study the
patterns it creates."
entries.translation_source: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.
entries.translated:
Ia memandu Volbeat untuk menggambar tanda
di langit malam. Ada ilmuwan yang
mempelajari pola yang diciptakannya.

entries.original:
"Roselia that drink nutritionally rich
springwater are said to reveal rare
coloration when they bloom."
entries.translation_source: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.
entries.translated:
Roselia yang meminum air mata air yang kaya
nutrisi dikatakan dapat menunjukkan warna
langka saat mekar.

entries.original:
"There is nothing its stomach can’t digest.
While it is digesting, vile, overpowering
gases are expelled."
entries.translation_source: There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang tidak bisa dicerna oleh
perutnya. Saat mencerna, gas-gas busuk dan
kuat dikeluarkan.

entries.original:
"It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp.
It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from
the pores on its body."
entries.translation_source: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.
entries.translated:
Ia bisa menelan ban utuh dalam sekali
teguk. Ia mengeluarkan cairan yang sangat
beracun dari pori-pori tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"They swarm any foe that invades their
territory. Their sharp fangs can tear
out boat hulls."
entries.translation_source: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
entries.translated:
Mereka mengerumuni musuh yang menyerang
wilayah mereka. Taring tajam mereka dapat
merobek lambung kapal.

entries.original:
"The vicious and sly gangster of the sea.
Its skin is specially textured to minimize
resistance in water."
entries.translation_source: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize resistance in water.
entries.translated:
Gangster laut yang ganas dan licik.
Kulitnya memiliki tekstur khusus untuk
meminimalkan hambatan di air.

entries.original:
"On sunny days, it lands on beaches
to bounce like a ball and play.
It spouts water from its nose."
entries.translation_source: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
entries.translated:
Pada hari yang cerah, ia mendarat di pantai
untuk memantul seperti bola dan bermain. Ia
menyemburkan air dari hidungnya.

entries.original:
"The biggest of all Pokémon.
It can dive to a depth of almost
10,000 feet on only one breath."
entries.translation_source: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
entries.translated:
Yang terbesar dari semua Pokémon. Ia dapat
menyelam hingga kedalaman hampir 10.000
kaki hanya dalam satu tarikan napas.

entries.original:
"Its humped back stores intensely hot
magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing
its movement."
entries.translation_source: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
entries.translated:
Punggung bungkuknya menyimpan magma yang
sangat panas. Saat hujan, magma mendingin,
memperlambat gerakannya.

entries.original:
"If angered, the humps on its back erupt
in a shower of molten lava. It lives in
the craters of volcanoes."
entries.translation_source: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.
entries.translated:
Jika marah, bungkuk di punggungnya meletus
dalam semburan lahar cair. Ia tinggal di
kawah gunung berapi.

entries.original:
"It burns coal inside its shell for energy.
It blows out black soot if it is in a
dangerous situation."
entries.translation_source: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is in a dangerous situation.
entries.translated:
Ia membakar batu bara di dalam cangkangnya
untuk energi. Ia mengeluarkan jelaga hitam
jika dalam situasi berbahaya.

entries.original:
"It bounces around on its tail to keep
its heart pumping. It carries a pearl
from Clamperl on its head."
entries.translation_source: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.
entries.translated:
Ia melompat-lompat di ekornya untuk menjaga
detak jantungnya. Ia membawa mutiara dari
Clamperl di kepalanya.

entries.original:
"It can gain control over foes by doing
odd dance steps. The black pearls on its
forehead are precious gems."
entries.translation_source: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.
entries.translated:
Ia bisa mengendalikan lawan dengan
melakukan langkah dansa yang aneh. Mutiara
hitam di dahinya adalah permata berharga.

entries.original:
"No two Spinda are said to have identical
patterns. It confuses foes with its
stumbling motions."
entries.translation_source: No two Spinda are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada dua Spinda yang memiliki pola
identik. Ia membingungkan lawan dengan
gerakan tersendat-sendatnya.

entries.original:
"It makes an inescapable conical pit and
lies in wait at the bottom for prey to
come tumbling down."
entries.translation_source: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
entries.translated:
Ia membuat lubang kerucut yang tak
terhindarkan dan menunggu di dasar untuk
mangsa yang jatuh terguling.

entries.original:
"The ultrasonic waves it generates by
rubbing its two wings together cause
severe headaches."
entries.translation_source: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
entries.translated:
Gelombang ultrasonik yang dihasilkannya
dengan menggosokkan kedua sayapnya
menyebabkan sakit kepala parah.

entries.original:
"It hides itself by kicking up desert sand
with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes
from sand."
entries.translation_source: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.
entries.translated:
Ia bersembunyi dengan menendang pasir gurun
dengan sayapnya. Penutup merah melindungi
matanya dari pasir.

entries.original:
"It prefers harsh environments such as
deserts. It can survive for 30 days on
water stored in its body."
entries.translation_source: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.
entries.translated:
Ia lebih suka lingkungan keras seperti
gurun. Ia bisa bertahan selama 30 hari
dengan air yang disimpan di tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"It becomes active at night, seeking
prey that is exhausted from the day’s
desert heat."
entries.translation_source: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
entries.translated:
Ia menjadi aktif di malam hari, mencari
mangsa yang kelelahan karena panas gurun
sepanjang hari.

entries.original:
"For some reason, it likes to land on
people’s heads softly and act like
it’s a hat."
entries.translation_source: For some reason, it likes to land on people’s heads softly and act like it’s a hat.
entries.translated:
Untuk beberapa alasan, ia suka mendarat di
kepala orang dengan lembut dan bertingkah
seperti topi.

entries.original:
"It flies gracefully through the sky.
Its melodic humming makes you feel
like you’re in a dream."
entries.translation_source: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.
entries.translated:
Ia terbang dengan anggun di langit.
Dengungan melodinya membuatmu merasa
seperti dalam mimpi.

entries.original:
"If it comes across a Seviper, its fur
bristles and it assumes its battle pose.
Its sharp claws are its best weapon."
entries.translation_source: If it comes across a Seviper, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.
entries.translated:
Jika bertemu dengan Seviper, bulunya
berdiri dan ia mengambil posisi bertarung.
Cakar tajamnya adalah senjata terbaiknya.

entries.original:
"Constant polishing makes the edge
of the blade on its tail extremely sharp.
It’s Zangoose’s archrival."
entries.translation_source: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.
entries.translated:
Penggosokan terus-menerus membuat ujung
pedang di ekornya sangat tajam. Ia adalah
musuh bebuyutan Zangoose.

entries.original:
"Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar
cycle. It brims with power when exposed
to the light of the full moon."
entries.translation_source: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar cycle. It brims with power when exposed to the light of the full moon.
entries.translated:
Kesehatannya naik turun mengikuti siklus
bulan. Ia dipenuhi kekuatan saat terkena
cahaya bulan purnama.

entries.original:
"It absorbs solar energy during the day.
Always expressionless, it can sense what
its foe is thinking."
entries.translation_source: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.
entries.translated:
Ia menyerap energi matahari di siang hari.
Selalu tanpa ekspresi, ia bisa merasakan
apa yang dipikirkan lawannya.

entries.original:
"It coats its entire body with a slimy
fluid so it can squirm and slip away
if grabbed."
entries.translation_source: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.
entries.translated:
Ia melapisi seluruh tubuhnya dengan cairan
berlendir sehingga bisa menggeliat dan
meloloskan diri jika ditangkap.

entries.original:
"It claims a large swamp to itself.
If a foe comes near it, it sets off
tremors by thrashing around."
entries.translation_source: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.
entries.translated:
Ia mengklaim rawa besar untuk dirinya
sendiri. Jika lawan mendekat, ia
menyebabkan gempa dengan meronta-ronta.

entries.original:
"No matter how dirty the water in the
river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a
strong will to survive."
entries.translation_source: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli seberapa kotor air di sungai,
ia akan ... dan berkembang. Ia memiliki
keinginan kuat untuk bertahan hidup.

entries.original:
"Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all
Pokémon that enter its territory with its
pincers and throws them out."
entries.translation_source: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.
entries.translated:
Suka bertarung, Pokémon ini mencubit semua
Pokémon yang memasuki wilayahnya dengan
capitnya dan melemparkan mereka keluar.

entries.original:
"It moves while spinning around on its
single foot. Although some Baltoy have
been seen spinning on their heads."
entries.translation_source: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Although some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.
entries.translated:
Ia bergerak sambil berputar di satu
kakinya. Meskipun beberapa Baltoy terlihat
berputar di kepala mereka.

entries.original:
"It appears to have been born from clay
dolls made by ancient people. It uses
telekinesis to float and move."
entries.translation_source: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.
entries.translated:
Ia tampaknya lahir dari boneka tanah liat
yang dibuat oleh manusia purba. Ia ...
telekinesis untuk melayang dan bergerak.

entries.original:
"It became extinct roughly 100 million
years ago. It was regenerated from a
fossil using advanced techniques."
entries.translation_source: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.
entries.translated:
Ia punah sekitar 100 juta tahun yang lalu.
Ia dihidupkan kembali dari fosil
menggunakan teknik canggih.

entries.original:
"It lives in warm seas. Its heavy
body weighs it down so it won’t
get washed away in rough weather."
entries.translation_source: It lives in warm seas. Its heavy body weighs it down so it won’t get washed away in rough weather.
entries.translated:
Ia hidup di laut hangat. Tubuhnya yang
berat membuatnya tidak hanyut saat cuaca
buruk.

entries.original:
"An ancestral Pokémon that lived in
the ocean. Over time, its eight feet
transformed into wings."
entries.translation_source: An ancestral Pokémon that lived in the ocean. Over time, its eight feet transformed into wings.
entries.translated:
Pokémon purba yang hidup di lautan. Seiring
waktu, delapan kakinya berubah menjadi
sayap.

entries.original:
"Its enormous, retractable claws can
cut through almost anything. Its entire
body is clad in sturdy plates."
entries.translation_source: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through almost anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.
entries.translated:
Cakarnya yang besar dan bisa ditarik dapat
memotong hampir apa saja. Seluruh tubuhnya
dilapisi pelat yang kokoh.

entries.original:
"Ridiculed for its shabby appearance,
it is ignored by researchers. It lives in
ponds choked with weeds."
entries.translation_source: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.
entries.translated:
Diejek karena penampilannya yang lusuh, ia
diabaikan oleh para peneliti. Ia hidup di
kolam yang penuh dengan gulma.

entries.original:
"It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and
its beauty will calm any hostile emotions
you’re feeling."
entries.translation_source: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.
entries.translated:
Dikatakan bahwa melihat sekilas Milotic dan
keindahannya akan menenangkan emosi
bermusuhan yang Anda rasakan.

entries.original:
"It has the ability to change its form into
the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, 
depending on the weather."
entries.translation_source: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki kemampuan untuk mengubah
bentuknya menjadi matahari, hujan, atau
awan salju, tergantung pada cuaca.

entries.original:
"It changes body color to blend in with
its surroundings. It also changes color if
it is happy or sad."
entries.translation_source: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.
entries.translated:
Ia mengubah warna tubuhnya untuk menyatu
dengan lingkungannya. Ia juga berubah warna
jika bahagia atau sedih.

entries.original:
"It loves to feed on feelings like envy
and malice. Its upright horn catches
the emotions of people."
entries.translation_source: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.
entries.translated:
Ia suka memakan perasaan seperti iri dan
dengki. Tanduknya yang tegak menangkap
emosi manusia.

entries.original:
"A doll that became a Pokémon over its
grudge of being thrown away.
It seeks the child who disowned it."
entries.translation_source: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge of being thrown away. It seeks the child who disowned it.
entries.translated:
Boneka yang menjadi Pokémon karena
dendamnya dibuang. Ia mencari anak yang
meninggalkannya.

entries.original:
"It loves the crying of children. It
startles bad kids by passing through
walls and making them cry."
entries.translation_source: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.
entries.translated:
Ia suka tangisan anak-anak. Ia mengejutkan
anak nakal dengan menembus dinding dan
membuat mereka menangis.

entries.original:
"Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens
its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it
were a black hole."
entries.translation_source: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya sepenuhnya berongga. Saat membuka
mulut, ia menyedot semuanya seolah-olah
lubang hitam.

entries.original:
"It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of
fruit around its neck is delicious.
The fruit grows twice a year."
entries.translation_source: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.
entries.translated:
Ia tinggal di hutan tropis. Tandan buah di
lehernya lezat. Buahnya tumbuh dua kali
setahun.

entries.original:
"Its cries echo inside its hollow body
to emerge as beautiful notes for
startling and repelling foes."
entries.translation_source: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
entries.translated:
Tangisannya bergema di dalam tubuhnya yang
berongga untuk menghasilkan nada indah yang
mengejutkan dan mengusir musuh.

entries.original:
"It appears when it senses an impending
natural disaster. As a result, it was
mistaken as a doom-bringer."
entries.translation_source: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.
entries.translated:
Ia muncul saat merasakan bencana alam yang
akan datang. Akibatnya, ia disangka sebagai
pembawa malapetaka.

entries.original:
"It tends to move in a pack. Individuals
squash against one another to toughen
their spirits."
entries.translation_source: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.
entries.translated:
Ia cenderung bergerak dalam kawanan.
Individu saling menekan untuk menguatkan
semangat mereka.

entries.original:
"In the snow country, certain folklore
says a house will prosper if a Snorunt
lives there."
entries.translation_source: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.
entries.translated:
Di negeri salju, cerita rakyat tertentu
mengatakan bahwa sebuah rumah akan makmur
jika Snorunt tinggal di sana.

entries.original:
"It has a body of ice that won’t melt,
even with fire. It can instantly freeze
moisture in the atmosphere."
entries.translation_source: It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki tubuh es yang tidak akan
meleleh, bahkan dengan api. Ia bisa
langsung membekukan kelembaban di atmosfer.

entries.original:
"They can’t swim well yet, and they move
much faster by rolling. When they’re
happy, they clap fins."
entries.translation_source: They can’t swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they’re happy, they clap fins.
entries.translated:
Mereka belum bisa berenang dengan baik, dan
mereka bergerak ... cepat dengan berguling.
Saat bahagia, mereka bertepuk sirip.

entries.original:
"It touches new things with its nose to
test for smell and feel. It plays by
spinning Spheal on its nose."
entries.translation_source: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning Spheal on its nose.
entries.translated:
Ia menyentuh benda baru dengan hidungnya
untuk menguji bau dan rasa. Ia bermain
dengan memutar Spheal di hidungnya.

entries.original:
"It shatters ice with its big tusks.
Its thick blubber repels not only the
cold, but also enemy attacks."
entries.translation_source: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
entries.translated:
Ia menghancurkan es dengan gading besarnya.
Lemak tebalnya tidak hanya menahan dingin,
tetapi juga serangan musuh.

entries.original:
"It makes a single pearl during its
lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify
psychic power."
entries.translation_source: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
entries.translated:
Ia menghasilkan satu mutiara sepanjang
hidupnya. Mutiara itu dikatakan dapat
memperkuat kekuatan psikis.

entries.original:
"It lives deep in the sea where no light
ever filters down. It lights up its small
fishlike tail to attract prey."
entries.translation_source: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.
entries.translated:
Ia hidup di dalam laut yang tidak pernah
tersentuh ... Ia menyalakan ekor kecilnya
yang seperti ikan untuk menarik mangsa.

entries.original:
"Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant.
With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed
that grows between rocks."
entries.translation_source: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.
entries.translated:
Bentuk renangnya sangat anggun. Dengan
mulutnya yang tipis, ia memakan rumput laut
yang tumbuh di antara bebatuan.

entries.original:
"A rare Pokémon discovered during a
deep-sea exploration. It has not
changed in over 100 million years."
entries.translation_source: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
entries.translated:
Pokémon langka yang ditemukan saat
eksplorasi laut dalam. Ia tidak berubah
selama lebih dari 100 juta tahun.

entries.original:
"During the spawning season, countless
Luvdisc congregate at coral reefs,
turning the waters pink."
entries.translation_source: During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.
entries.translated:
Selama musim bertelur, banyak Luvdisc
berkumpul di terumbu karang, mengubah
perairan menjadi merah muda.

entries.original:
"It longingly hopes for wings to grow
so it can fly. It practices by leaping
off cliffs every day."
entries.translation_source: It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly. It practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
entries.translated:
Ia sangat berharap sayapnya tumbuh agar
bisa terbang. Ia berlatih dengan melompat
dari tebing setiap hari.

entries.original:
"Its armored body makes all attacks bounce
off. The armor is too tough, however,
making it heavy and somewhat sluggish."
entries.translation_source: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.
entries.translated:
Tubuh lapis bajanya membuat semua serangan
memantul. Namun, armor itu terlalu keras,
membuatnya berat dan agak lamban.

entries.original:
"As a result of its long-held dream of
flying, its cellular structure changed,
and wings grew out."
entries.translation_source: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
entries.translated:
Akibat mimpinya yang telah lama terpendam
untuk terbang, struktur selnya berubah, dan
sayap pun tumbuh.

entries.original:
"It uses magnetic waves to converse
with its kind. All the cells in its body
are magnetic."
entries.translation_source: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.
entries.translated:
Ia menggunakan gelombang magnet untuk
berkomunikasi dengan sesamanya. Semua sel
di tubuhnya bersifat magnetis.

entries.original:
"When two Beldum fuse together, a
magnetic nervous system places their
brains in union."
entries.translation_source: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.
entries.translated:
Ketika dua Beldum menyatu, sistem saraf
magnetik menyatukan otak mereka.

entries.original:
"With four linked brains, it’s more
intelligent than a supercomputer.
It uses calculations to analyze foes."
entries.translation_source: With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer. It uses calculations to analyze foes.
entries.translated:
Dengan empat otak yang terhubung, ia lebih
cerdas dari superkomputer. Ia menggunakan
kalkulasi untuk menganalisis lawan.

entries.original:
"It is entirely composed of rocks with no
sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery
even to modern scientists."
entries.translation_source: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.
entries.translated:
Ia seluruhnya terbuat dari batu tanpa
tanda-tanda otak atau jantung. Ia menjadi
misteri bahkan bagi ilmuwan modern.

entries.original:
"It is said to have slept in a glacier
for thousands of years. Its body
can’t be melted, even by magma."
entries.translation_source: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.
entries.translated:
Dikatakan telah tidur di gletser selama
ribuan tahun. Tubuhnya tidak bisa
dilelehkan, bahkan oleh magma.

entries.original:
"It is sturdier than any kind of metal.
It hardened due to pressure underground
over tens of thousands of years."
entries.translation_source: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.
entries.translated:
Ia lebih kokoh dari jenis logam apa pun. Ia
mengeras karena tekanan di bawah tanah
selama puluhan ribu tahun.

entries.original:
"Its body is covered with a down that
can refract light in such a way that
it becomes invisible."
entries.translation_source: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya ditutupi bulu halus yang dapat
membiaskan cahaya sehingga menjadi tidak
terlihat.

entries.original:
"It has a docile temperament and dislikes
fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can
fly faster than a jet plane."
entries.translation_source: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki temperamen yang jinak dan tidak
suka bertarung. ... kaki depannya, ia bisa
terbang lebih cepat dari pesawat jet.

entries.original:
"A mythical Pokémon said to have
swelled the seas with rain and tidal
waves. It battled with Groudon."
entries.translation_source: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
entries.translated:
Pokémon mitos yang dikatakan telah
membesarkan lautan dengan ... dan gelombang
pasang. Ia bertarung dengan Groudon.

entries.original:
"It had been asleep in underground
magma ever since it fiercely fought
Kyogre long ago."
entries.translation_source: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.
entries.translated:
Ia telah tertidur di magma bawah tanah
sejak bertarung sengit dengan Kyogre dahulu
kala.

entries.original:
"It flies in the ozone layer, way up high
in the sky. Until recently, no one had
ever seen it."
entries.translation_source: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
entries.translated:
Ia terbang di lapisan ozon, tinggi di
langit. Sampai baru-baru ini, belum ada
yang pernah melihatnya.

entries.original:
"It is said to make any wish come true.
It is awake for only seven days out of
a thousand years."
entries.translation_source: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.
entries.translated:
Dikatakan dapat mengabulkan permintaan apa
pun. Ia hanya terjaga selama tujuh hari
dalam seribu tahun.

entries.original:
"An alien virus that fell to earth on a
meteorite underwent a DNA mutation to
become this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteorite underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sebuah virus alien yang jatuh ke bumi pada
sebuah meteorit mengalami mutasi DNA untuk
menjadi Pokémon ini.

entries.original:
"Made from soil, the shell on its back
hardens when it drinks water. It lives
along lakes."
entries.translation_source: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
entries.translated:
Terbuat dari tanah, cangkang di punggungnya
mengeras saat ia minum air. Ia hidup di
sepanjang danau.

entries.original:
"A Grotle that lives in the forest is
said to have its own secret
springwater."
entries.translation_source: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.
entries.translated:
Seekor Grotle yang hidup di hutan dikatakan
memiliki mata air rahasianya sendiri.

entries.original:
"Ancient people imagined that beneath
the ground, a gigantic Torterra
dwelled."
entries.translation_source: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang kuno membayangkan bahwa di
bawah tanah, seekor Torterra raksasa
berdiam.

entries.original:
"Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas
made in its belly. Even rain can’t
extinguish the fire."
entries.translation_source: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
entries.translated:
Bagian belakangnya yang menyala dipenuhi
oleh gas yang ... di perutnya. Bahkan hujan
pun tidak bisa memadamkan api tersebut.

entries.original:
"To intimidate attackers, it stretches
the fire on its tail to make itself
appear bigger."
entries.translation_source: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
entries.translated:
Untuk mengintimidasi penyerang, ia
membentangkan api di ekornya untuk membuat
dirinya tampak lebih besar.

entries.original:
"It tosses its enemies around with
agility. It uses all its limbs to fight
in its own unique style."
entries.translation_source: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
entries.translated:
Ia melemparkan ... dengan kelincahan. Ia
menggunakan seluruh anggota tubuhnya untuk
bertarung dengan gaya uniknya sendiri.

entries.original:
"Because it is very proud, it hates
accepting food from people. Its thick
down guards it from cold."
entries.translation_source: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
entries.translated:
Karena sangat bangga, ia benci menerima
makanan dari manusia. Bulu tebalnya
melindunginya dari dingin.

entries.original:
"Because every Prinplup considers itself
to be the most important, they can
never form a group."
entries.translation_source: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
entries.translated:
Karena setiap Prinplup menganggap dirinya
yang paling penting, mereka tidak akan
pernah bisa membentuk kelompok.

entries.original:
"It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it
will decimate anything that threatens
its pride."
entries.translation_source: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.
entries.translated:
Ia menghindari pertengkaran yang tidak
perlu, tetapi akan menghancurkan apa pun
yang mengancam harga dirinya.

entries.original:
"They flock in great numbers. Though
small, they flap their wings with great
power."
entries.translation_source: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
entries.translated:
Mereka berkumpul dalam jumlah besar.
Meskipun kecil, mereka mengepakkan sayap
mereka dengan kekuatan besar.

entries.original:
"It lives in forests and fields.
Squabbles over territory occur when
flocks collide."
entries.translation_source: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.
entries.translated:
Ia tinggal di hutan dan ladang.
Pertengkaran memperebutkan wilayah terjadi
ketika kawanan bertabrakan.

entries.original:
"It has a savage nature. It will
courageously challenge foes that are
much larger."
entries.translation_source: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki sifat ganas. Ia akan dengan
berani menantang lawan yang jauh lebih
besar.

entries.original:
"With nerves of steel, nothing can
perturb it. It is more agile and active
than it appears."
entries.translation_source: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
entries.translated:
Dengan saraf baja, tidak ada yang bisa
mengganggunya. Ia lebih lincah dan aktif
daripada yang terlihat.

entries.original:
"It makes its nest by damming streams
with bark and mud. It is known as an
industrious worker."
entries.translation_source: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
entries.translated:
Ia membuat sarangnya dengan membendung
aliran sungai ... kulit kayu dan lumpur. Ia
dikenal sebagai pekerja yang rajin.

entries.original:
"When its antennae hit each other, it
sounds like the music of a xylophone."
entries.translation_source: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
entries.translated:
Ketika antena-antenanya saling bersentuhan,
suaranya seperti musik xilofon.

entries.original:
"It signals its emotions with its
melodies. Scientists are studying these
melodic patterns."
entries.translation_source: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.
entries.translated:
Ia menunjukkan emosinya dengan
melodi-melodinya. Para ilmuwan sedang
mempelajari pola-pola melodi ini.

entries.original:
"All of its fur dazzles if danger is
sensed. It flees while the foe is
momentarily blinded."
entries.translation_source: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
entries.translated:
Semua bulunya berkilau jika merasakan
bahaya. Ia melarikan diri sementara lawan
buta sesaat.

entries.original:
"It rests its forelegs on others to
communicate with rhythmic electric
pulses from its claws."
entries.translation_source: It rests its forelegs on others to communicate with rhythmic electric pulses from its claws.
entries.translated:
Ia menyandarkan kaki depannya pada yang
lain untuk berkomunikasi dengan denyut
listrik berirama dari cakarnya.

entries.original:
"It can see clearly through walls to
track down its prey and seek its lost
young."
entries.translation_source: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
entries.translated:
Ia bisa melihat dengan jelas menembus
dinding untuk melacak mangsanya dan mencari
anak-anaknya yang hilang.

entries.original:
"It lives alongside clear ponds. It
scatters pollen that induces harsh
sneezing and runny noses."
entries.translation_source: It lives alongside clear ponds. It scatters pollen that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.
entries.translated:
Ia hidup di dekat kolam yang jernih. Ia
menebarkan serbuk sari yang menyebabkan
bersin keras dan hidung meler.

entries.original:
"It attracts prey with a sweet aroma,
then downs it with thorny whips hidden
in its arms."
entries.translation_source: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
entries.translated:
Ia menarik mangsa dengan aroma manis, lalu
menjatuhkannya dengan cambuk berduri yang
tersembunyi di lengannya.

entries.original:
"It lived in jungles around 100 million
years ago. Its skull is as hard as
iron."
entries.translation_source: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
entries.translated:
Ia hidup di hutan sekitar 100 juta tahun
yang lalu. Tengkoraknya sekeras besi.

entries.original:
"Its powerful headbutt has enough power
to shatter even the most durable things
upon impact."
entries.translation_source: Its powerful headbutt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
entries.translated:
Serangan kepalanya yang kuat memiliki
kekuatan yang cukup ... benda yang paling
tahan lama sekalipun saat terkena benturan.

entries.original:
"It is outstandingly armored. As a
result, it can eat grass and berries
without having to fight."
entries.translation_source: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki armor yang luar biasa. Alhasil,
ia bisa memakan rumput dan buah beri tanpa
harus bertarung.

entries.original:
"When attacked, they form a wall with
their shield like faces to protect their
young."
entries.translation_source: When attacked, they form a wall with their shield like faces to protect their young.
entries.translated:
Saat diserang, mereka membentuk tembok
dengan wajah seperti perisai untuk
melindungi anak-anak mereka.

entries.original:
"If its cloak is broken in battle, it
quickly remakes the cloak with materials
nearby."
