entries.translation_source: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.
entries.translated:
Jika jubahnya rusak dalam pertarungan, ia
segera membuat ulang jubah itu dengan
bahan-bahan di sekitarnya.

entries.original:
"It is said that a Wormadam that evolves
on a cold day will have a thicker
cloak."
entries.translation_source: It is said that a Wormadam that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.
entries.translated:
Konon, Wormadam yang berevolusi pada hari
yang dingin akan memiliki jubah yang lebih
tebal.

entries.original:
"It flutters around at night and steals
honey from the Combee hive."
entries.translation_source: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.
entries.translated:
Ia beterbangan di malam hari dan mencuri
madu dari sarang Combee.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon formed by three others. It
busily carries sweet floral honey to
Vespiquen."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to Vespiquen.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang terbentuk dari tiga lainnya.
Ia dengan sibuk membawa madu bunga yang
manis ke Vespiquen.

entries.original:
"It raises grubs in the holes in its
body. It secretes pheromones to control
Combee."
entries.translation_source: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.
entries.translated:
Ia memelihara belatung di lubang-lubang di
tubuhnya. Ia mengeluarkan feromon untuk
mengendalikan Combee.

entries.original:
"It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with
electric cheek pouches. It shoots
charges from its tail."
entries.translation_source: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.
entries.translated:
Ia adalah salah satu jenis Pokémon dengan
kantong pipi listrik. Ia menembakkan muatan
listrik dari ekornya.

entries.original:
"It swims by rotating its two tails like
a screw. When it dives, its flotation
sac collapses."
entries.translation_source: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
entries.translated:
Ia berenang dengan memutar kedua ekornya
seperti sekrup. Saat menyelam, kantung
apungnya mengempis.

entries.original:
"It is a common sight around fishing
ports. It is known to rescue people and
carry off prey."
entries.translation_source: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
entries.translated:
Ia adalah pemandangan umum di sekitar ...
nelayan. Ia dikenal untuk menyelamatkan
orang dan membawa pergi mangsa.

entries.original:
"The small ball is not only full of
nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try
to peck it off."
entries.translation_source: The small ball is not only full of nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.
entries.translated:
Bola kecil itu tidak hanya penuh nutrisi,
tetapi juga lezat. Starly mencoba
mematuknya.

entries.original:
"It blooms during times of strong
sunlight. It tries to make up for
everything it endured as a bud."
entries.translation_source: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
entries.translated:
Ia mekar saat sinar matahari kuat. Ia
berusaha menebus semua yang dialaminya saat
masih kuncup.

entries.original:
"Its shape and coloration vary,
depending on its habitat."
entries.translation_source: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.
entries.translated:
Bentuk dan warnanya bervariasi, tergantung
pada habitatnya.

entries.original:
"When its natural enemy attacks, it
oozes purple fluid and escapes."
entries.translation_source: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
entries.translated:
Saat musuh alaminya menyerang, ia
mengeluarkan cairan ungu dan melarikan
diri.

entries.original:
"It is very difficult to dodge the
consecutive strikes of its two tails."
entries.translation_source: It is very difficult to dodge the consecutive strikes of its two tails.
entries.translated:
Sangat sulit untuk menghindari serangan
berturut-turut dari kedua ekornya.

entries.original:
"Stories go that it grabs the hands
of small children and drags them
away to the afterlife."
entries.translation_source: Stories go that it grabs the hands of small children and drags them away to the afterlife.
entries.translated:
Cerita mengatakan bahwa ia meraih tangan
anak-anak kecil dan menyeret mereka ke alam
baka.

entries.original:
"It grabs people and Pokémon and
carries them off somewhere.
Where do they go? Nobody knows."
entries.translation_source: It grabs people and Pokémon and carries them off somewhere. Where do they go? Nobody knows.
entries.translated:
Ia menangkap manusia dan Pokémon dan
membawa mereka pergi entah ke mana. Mereka
pergi ke mana? Tidak ada yang tahu.

entries.original:
"Its ears are always rolled up. They can
be forcefully extended to shatter even
a large boulder."
entries.translation_source: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
entries.translated:
Telinganya selalu tergulung. Telinga itu
bisa dijulurkan dengan paksa hingga
menghancurkan batu besar sekalipun.

entries.original:
"It sheds its fur twice a year. Its
winter fur is soft and fluffy."
entries.translation_source: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.
entries.translated:
Ia merontokkan bulunya dua kali setahun.
Bulu musim dinginnya lembut dan halus.

entries.original:
"It chants incantations. While they
usually torment targets, some chants
bring happiness."
entries.translation_source: It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.
entries.translated:
Ia melantunkan mantra. Meskipun biasanya
mantra itu menyiksa target, beberapa mantra
membawa kebahagiaan.

entries.original:
"Becoming active at night, it is known
to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow."
entries.translation_source: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.
entries.translated:
Menjadi aktif di malam hari, ia dikenal
suka berkerumun dengan banyak Murkrow yang
mengikutinya.

entries.original:
"With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a
mild hypnotic state. It is a very
fickle Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Dengan tatapan tajamnya, ia membuat lawan
dalam keadaan hipnosis ringan. Ia adalah
Pokémon yang sangat berubah-ubah.

entries.original:
"To make itself appear intimidatingly
beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with
its twin tails."
entries.translation_source: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
entries.translated:
Untuk membuat dirinya tampak kekar dan
mengintimidasi, ia mengencangkan
pinggangnya dengan kedua ekornya.

entries.original:
"It emits cries by agitating an orb at
the back of its throat. It moves with
flouncing hops."
entries.translation_source: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
entries.translated:
Ia mengeluarkan teriakan dengan mengaduk
bola di ... tenggorokannya. Ia bergerak
dengan lompatan-lompatan yang anggun.

entries.original:
"It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid
from its rear to repel attackers."
entries.translation_source: It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers.
entries.translated:
Ia menyemprotkan cairan berbau busuk yang
membuat hidung meringis dari belakangnya
untuk mengusir penyerang.

entries.original:
"It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from
the tip of its tail to attack. Its range
is over 160 feet."
entries.translation_source: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
entries.translated:
Ia menyemprotkan cairan berbau busuk dari
ujung ekornya untuk menyerang. Jangkauannya
lebih dari 160 kaki.

entries.original:
"X-ray photos were taken to check its
body structure. Nothing appeared,
however."
entries.translation_source: X-ray photos were taken to check its body structure. Nothing appeared, however.
entries.translated:
Foto sinar-X diambil untuk memeriksa
struktur tubuhnya. Namun, tidak ada yang
muncul.

entries.original:
"Ancient people believed that
petitioning Bronzong for rain was the
way to make crops grow."
entries.translation_source: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang kuno percaya bahwa memohon
hujan kepada Bronzong adalah cara untuk
membuat tanaman tumbuh.

entries.original:
"It prefers arid environments. It leaks
water from its eyes to adjust its
body’s fluid levels."
entries.translation_source: It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.
entries.translated:
Ia lebih menyukai lingkungan yang kering.
Ia mengeluarkan air dari matanya untuk
menyesuaikan kadar cairan tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"It habitually mimics foes. Once
mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes
off this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ia secara kebiasaan meniru lawan. Setelah
ditiru, lawan tidak bisa mengalihkan
pandangan dari Pokémon ini.

entries.original:
"It loves round white things. It carries
an egg-shaped rock in imitation of
Chansey."
entries.translation_source: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of Chansey.
entries.translated:
Ia menyukai benda bulat berwarna putih. Ia
membawa batu berbentuk telur untuk meniru
Chansey.

entries.original:
"Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a
result, it can cleverly mimic human
speech."
entries.translation_source: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
entries.translated:
Lidahnya persis seperti lidah manusia.
Akibatnya, ia bisa dengan cerdik meniru
ucapan manusia.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon that was formed by 108
spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an
Odd Keystone."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone.
entries.translated:
Seekor Pokémon yang terbentuk dari 108 roh.
Ia terikat pada celah di Odd Keystone.

entries.original:
"It once lived in the tropics. To avoid
the cold, it lives in caves warmed by
geothermal heat."
entries.translation_source: It once lived in the tropics. To avoid the cold, it lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat.
entries.translated:
Ia pernah tinggal di daerah tropis. Untuk
menghindari hawa dingin, ia tinggal di gua
yang dihangatkan oleh panas geotermal.

entries.original:
"It loves sparkly things. It seeks
treasures in caves and hoards the loot
into its nest."
entries.translation_source: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot into its nest.
entries.translated:
Ia menyukai benda berkilau. Ia mencari
harta karun di gua dan menimbun jarahan di
sarangnya.

entries.original:
"It flies at speeds equal to a jet
fighter plane. It never allows its prey
to escape."
entries.translation_source: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.
entries.translated:
Ia terbang dengan kecepatan setara pesawat
jet tempur. Ia tidak pernah membiarkan
mangsanya lolos.

entries.original:
"It hides food under its long body hair.
However, it forgets it has hidden the
food."
entries.translation_source: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
entries.translated:
Ia menyembunyikan makanan di bawah bulu
panjang tubuhnya. Namun, ia lupa telah
menyembunyikan makanan itu.

entries.original:
"The aura that emanates from its body
intensifies to alert others if it is
afraid or sad."
entries.translation_source: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
entries.translated:
Aura yang terpancar dari tubuhnya semakin
kuat untuk memperingatkan yang lain jika ia
takut atau sedih.

entries.original:
"It has the ability to sense the Auras
of all things. It understands human
speech."
entries.translation_source: It has the ability to sense the Auras of all things. It understands human speech.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki kemampuan untuk merasakan Aura
dari semua makhluk. Ia mengerti ucapan
manusia.

entries.original:
"It lives in arid places. Instead of
perspiration, it expels grainy sand from
its body."
entries.translation_source: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
entries.translated:
Ia tinggal di tempat kering. Alih-alih
berkeringat, ia mengeluarkan pasir berbutir
dari tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"Surprisingly quick to anger. It holds
its mouth agape as a display of
strength."
entries.translation_source: Surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of strength.
entries.translated:
Sangat cepat marah. Ia membuka mulutnya
lebar-lebar sebagai pertunjukan kekuatan.

entries.original:
"It lives in arid lands. It buries
itself in sand and lies in wait for
unsuspecting prey."
entries.translation_source: It lives in arid lands. It buries itself in sand and lies in wait for unsuspecting prey.
entries.translated:
Ia hidup di tanah kering. Ia mengubur
dirinya di pasir dan menunggu mangsa yang
tidak curiga.

entries.original:
"Its body is encased in a sturdy shell.
Its head rotates 180 degrees,
eliminating blind spots."
entries.translation_source: Its body is encased in a sturdy shell. Its head rotates 180 degrees, eliminating blind spots.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya terbungkus dalam cangkang yang
kokoh. Kepalanya berputar 180 derajat,
menghilangkan titik buta.

entries.original:
"Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an
eerie blubbering sound for
intimidation."
entries.translation_source: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.
entries.translated:
Menggembungkan kantung racunnya, ia
mengeluarkan suara gemericik yang
menakutkan untuk intimidasi.

entries.original:
"Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so
vile that even a scratch could prove
fatal."
entries.translation_source: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
entries.translated:
Cakar buku jarinya mengeluarkan racun yang
begitu jahat sehingga goresan pun bisa
berakibat fatal.

entries.original:
"Hanging from branches using its
tentacles, it looks like a plant. It
awaits prey, mouth wide open."
entries.translation_source: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It awaits prey, mouth wide open.
entries.translated:
Bergelantungan di dahan menggunakan
tentakelnya, ia tampak seperti tanaman. Ia
menunggu mangsa dengan mulut terbuka lebar.

entries.original:
"The line running down its side can
store sunlight. It shines vividly at
night."
entries.translation_source: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
entries.translated:
Garis yang membentang di sisinya dapat
menyimpan sinar matahari. Ia bersinar
terang di malam hari.

entries.original:
"Lumineon swimming in the darkness of
the deep sea look like stars shining in
the night sky."
entries.translation_source: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.
entries.translated:
Lumineon yang berenang dalam kegelapan laut
dalam tampak seperti bintang yang bersinar
di langit malam.

entries.original:
"Scientists discovered that the
distinctive patterns on its back differ
by region."
entries.translation_source: Scientists discovered that the distinctive patterns on its back differ by region.
entries.translated:
Para ilmuwan menemukan bahwa pola khas di
punggungnya berbeda menurut wilayah.

entries.original:
"In the spring, it grows berries with
the texture of frozen treats around its
belly."
entries.translation_source: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.
entries.translated:
Pada musim semi, ia menumbuhkan buah beri
dengan tekstur seperti camilan beku di
sekitar perutnya.

entries.original:
"It blankets wide areas in snow by
whipping up blizzards. It is also known
as \qoThe Ice Monster.\qc"
entries.translation_source: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as [quote-open-1]The Ice Monster.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated:
Ia menyelimuti area luas dengan salju
dengan menciptakan badai salju. Ia juga
dikenal sebagai \qoRaksasa Es.\qc

entries.original:
"It sends signals to others by carving
odd patterns in frost-covered trees and
ice."
entries.translation_source: It sends signals to others by carving odd patterns in frost-covered trees and ice.
entries.translated:
Ia mengirimkan sinyal kepada yang lain
dengan mengukir pola aneh di pohon yang
tertutup embun beku dan es.

entries.original:
"It evolved from exposure to a special
magnetic field. Three units generate
magnetism."
entries.translation_source: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
entries.translated:
Ia berevolusi karena terpapar medan magnet
khusus. Tiga unit menghasilkan kemagnetan.

entries.original:
"The long tongue is always soggy with
slobber. The saliva contains a solvent
that causes numbness."
entries.translation_source: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.
entries.translated:
Lidah panjangnya selalu basah oleh air
liur. Air liur tersebut mengandung pelarut
yang menyebabkan mati rasa.

entries.original:
"From holes in its palms, it fires out
Geodude. Its carapace can withstand
volcanic eruptions."
entries.translation_source: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
entries.translated:
Dari lubang di telapak tangannya, ia
menembakkan Geodude. Karapasnya dapat
menahan letusan gunung berapi.

entries.original:
"Its vines grow so profusely that, in
the warm season, you can’t even see its
eyes."
entries.translation_source: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can’t even see its eyes.
entries.translated:
Sulurnya tumbuh sangat lebat sehingga pada
musim panas, Anda bahkan tidak dapat
melihat matanya.

entries.original:
"As its electric charge amplifies, blue
sparks begin to crackle between its
horns."
entries.translation_source: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
entries.translated:
Seiring muatan listriknya bertambah,
percikan biru mulai berderak di antara
tanduknya.

entries.original:
"When launching 3,600 degrees F
fireballs, its body takes on a whitish
hue from the intense heat."
entries.translation_source: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
entries.translated:
Saat meluncurkan bola api bersuhu 3.600
derajat F, tubuhnya berubah warna keputihan
karena panas yang hebat.

entries.original:
"It will never appear where there is
strife. Its sightings have become rare
recently."
entries.translation_source: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
entries.translated:
Ia tidak akan pernah muncul di tempat yang
ada perselisihan. Penampakannya menjadi
jarang akhir-akhir ini.

entries.original:
"Its jaw power is incredible. It is
adept at biting apart foes while flying
by at high speed."
entries.translation_source: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
entries.translated:
Kekuatan rahangnya luar biasa. Ia mahir
menggigit lawan saat terbang dengan
kecepatan tinggi.

entries.original:
"Just like a plant, it uses
photosynthesis. As a result, it is
always enveloped in clear air."
entries.translation_source: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
entries.translated:
Seperti tanaman, ia menggunakan
fotosintesis. Alhasil, ia selalu diselimuti
udara bersih.

entries.original:
"It causes small ice crystals to form by
lowering the temperature of the
surrounding atmosphere."
entries.translation_source: It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere.
entries.translated:
Ia menyebabkan kristal es kecil terbentuk
dengan menurunkan suhu atmosfer di
sekitarnya.

entries.original:
"It observes prey while hanging inverted
from branches. When the chance presents
itself, it swoops!"
entries.translation_source: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
entries.translated:
Ia mengamati mangsa sambil bergelantung
terbalik di dahan. Saat kesempatan tiba, ia
menyambar!

entries.original:
"A frozen one was dug up from soil
dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to
much amazement."
entries.translation_source: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.
entries.translated:
Seekor yang beku digali dari tanah yang
berusia 10.000 tahun. Ia terbangun dengan
penuh kekaguman.

entries.original:
"Its programming was modified to enable
work in alien dimensions. It did not
work as planned."
entries.translation_source: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
entries.translated:
Pemrogramannya dimodifikasi untuk
memungkinkan bekerja di dimensi asing. Itu
tidak berjalan sesuai rencana.

entries.original:
"A master of courtesy and swordsmanship,
it fights using extending swords on its
elbows."
entries.translation_source: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
entries.translated:
Seorang ahli sopan santun dan ilmu pedang,
ia bertarung menggunakan pedang memanjang
di sikunya.

entries.original:
"It freely controls three small units
called Mini-Noses using magnetic force."
entries.translation_source: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
entries.translated:
Ia dengan bebas mengendalikan tiga unit
kecil yang disebut Mini-Nose menggunakan
gaya magnet.

entries.original:
"It is said to take lost spirits into
its pliant body and guide them home."
entries.translation_source: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
entries.translated:
Dikatakan bahwa ia membawa roh yang hilang
ke dalam tubuhnya yang lentur dan
membimbing mereka pulang.

entries.original:
"Legends in snowy regions say that a
woman who was lost on an icy mountain
was reborn as Froslass."
entries.translation_source: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as Froslass.
entries.translated:
Legenda di daerah bersalju mengatakan bahwa
seorang wanita yang tersesat di gunung es
terlahir kembali sebagai Froslass.

entries.original:
"Its body is composed of plasma. It
is known to infiltrate electronic
devices and wreak havoc."
entries.translation_source: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya terdiri dari plasma. Ia dikenal
menyusup ke perangkat elektronik dan
membuat kekacauan.

entries.original:
"Known as \qoThe Being of Knowledge.\qc It
is said that it can wipe out the memory
of those who see its eyes."
entries.translation_source: Known as [quote-open-1]The Being of Knowledge.[quote-close-2] It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
entries.translated:
Dikenal sebagai \qoMakhluk Pengetahuan.\qc
Dikatakan bahwa ia dapat menghapus ingatan
mereka yang melihat matanya.

entries.original:
"Known as \qoThe Being of Emotion.\qc It
taught humans the nobility of sorrow,
pain, and joy."
entries.translation_source: Known as [quote-open-1]The Being of Emotion.[quote-close-2] It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
entries.translated:
Dikenal sebagai \qoMakhluk Emosi.\qc Ia
mengajarkan manusia tentang kemuliaan
kesedihan, rasa sakit, dan kegembiraan.

entries.original:
"Known as \qoThe Being of Willpower.\qc It
sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep
the world in balance."
entries.translation_source: Known as [quote-open-1]The Being of Willpower.[quote-close-2] It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
entries.translated:
Dikenal sebagai \qoMakhluk Kemauan.\qc Ia tidur
di dasar danau untuk menjaga keseimbangan
dunia.

entries.original:
"A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh.
It is said that time flows when Dialga’s
heart beats."
entries.translation_source: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.
entries.translated:
Pokémon legendaris dari Sinnoh. Dikatakan
bahwa waktu mengalir saat jantung Dialga
berdetak.

entries.original:
"It has the ability to distort space.
It is described as a deity in
Sinnoh-region mythology."
entries.translation_source: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki kemampuan untuk mendistorsi
ruang. Ia digambarkan sebagai dewa dalam
mitologi wilayah Sinnoh.

entries.original:
"It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in
with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on
ceilings and walls."
entries.translation_source: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
entries.translated:
Ia tinggal di gua-gua vulkanik. Ia menggali
dengan kakinya yang berbentuk salib untuk
merayap di langit-langit dan dinding.

entries.original:
"There is an enduring legend that states
this Pokémon towed continents with
ropes."
entries.translation_source: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
entries.translated:
Ada legenda abadi yang menyatakan Pokémon
ini menarik benua dengan tali.

entries.original:
"It was banished for its violence. It
silently gazed upon the old world from
the Distortion World."
entries.translation_source: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
entries.translated:
Ia diusir karena kekerasannya. Ia diam-diam
memandangi dunia lama dari Dunia Distorsi.

entries.original:
"On nights around the quarter moon, the
aurora from its tail extends and
undulates beautifully."
entries.translation_source: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
entries.translated:
Pada malam-malam sekitar bulan kuartal,
aurora dari ekornya memanjang dan
bergelombang dengan indah.

entries.original:
"It drifts in warm seas. It always
returns to where it was born, no matter
how far it may have drifted."
entries.translation_source: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
entries.translated:
Ia hanyut di laut hangat. Ia selalu kembali
ke tempat ia dilahirkan, tidak peduli
seberapa jauh ia telah hanyut.

entries.original:
"It is born with a wondrous power that
lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ia lahir dengan kekuatan luar biasa yang
memungkinkannya terikat dengan jenis
Pokémon apa pun.

entries.original:
"To protect itself, it afflicts those
around it with nightmares. However, it
means no harm."
entries.translation_source: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
entries.translated:
Untuk melindungi dirinya, ia menyebabkan
mimpi buruk pada orang-orang di sekitarnya.
Namun, ia tidak bermaksud menyakiti.

entries.original:
"The flowers all over its body burst
into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and
senses gratitude."
entries.translation_source: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
entries.translated:
Bunga-bunga di seluruh tubuhnya mekar jika
dipeluk dengan penuh kasih dan merasakan
rasa terima kasih.

entries.original:
"It is told in mythology that this
Pokémon was born before the universe
even existed."
entries.translation_source: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.
entries.translated:
Diceritakan dalam mitologi bahwa Pokémon
ini lahir sebelum alam semesta ada.

entries.original:
"It creates an unlimited supply of
energy inside its body, which it shares
with those who touch it."
entries.translation_source: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.
entries.translated:
Ia menciptakan pasokan energi tak terbatas
di dalam tubuhnya, yang dibagikannya kepada
mereka yang menyentuhnya.

entries.original:
"It is very intelligent and calm. Being
exposed to lots of sunlight makes its
movements swifter."
entries.translation_source: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
entries.translated:
Ia sangat cerdas dan tenang. Terkena banyak
sinar matahari membuat gerakannya lebih
cepat.

entries.original:
"When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be
used in photosynthesis, so it always
keeps itself clean."
entries.translation_source: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
entries.translated:
Saat kotor, daunnya tidak bisa digunakan
untuk fotosintesis, jadi ia selalu menjaga
dirinya tetap bersih.

entries.original:
"It can stop its opponents’ movements
with just a glare. It takes in solar
energy and boosts it."
entries.translation_source: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it.
entries.translated:
Ia bisa menghentikan gerakan lawan hanya
dengan tatapan. Ia menyerap energi matahari
dan meningkatkannya.

entries.original:
"It loves to eat roasted berries, but
sometimes it gets too excited and burns
them to a crisp."
entries.translation_source: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
entries.translated:
Ia suka makan buah beri panggang, tetapi
terkadang terlalu bersemangat dan
membakarnya hingga gosong.

entries.original:
"When its internal fire flares up, its
movements grow sharper and faster. When
in trouble, it emits smoke."
entries.translation_source: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
entries.translated:
Saat api internalnya berkobar, gerakannya
menjadi lebih tajam dan cepat. Saat dalam
masalah, ia mengeluarkan asap.

entries.original:
"It has mastered fast and powerful
fighting moves. It grows a beard of
fire."
entries.translation_source: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
entries.translated:
Ia telah menguasai gerakan pertarungan yang
cepat dan kuat. Ia menumbuhkan janggut api.

entries.original:
"The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just
used for battle--it is also used to
break open hard berries."
entries.translation_source: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it is also used to break open hard berries.
entries.translated:
Kerang di perutnya tidak hanya digunakan
untuk bertarung—juga digunakan untuk
memecahkan buah beri yang keras.

entries.original:
"Strict training is how it learns its
flowing double-scalchop technique."
entries.translation_source: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
entries.translated:
Latihan ketat adalah cara ia mempelajari
teknik double-scalchop yang mengalir.

entries.original:
"In the time it takes a foe to blink, it
can draw and sheathe the seamitars
attached to its front legs."
entries.translation_source: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
entries.translated:
Dalam waktu yang dibutuhkan lawan untuk
berkedip, ia ... menarik dan menyarungkan
seamitars yang terpasang di kaki depannya.

entries.original:
"Extremely cautious, one of them is
always on a lookout, but it won’t notice
a foe coming from behind."
entries.translation_source: Extremely cautious, one of them is always on a lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.
entries.translated:
Sangat hati-hati, salah satu dari mereka
selalu waspada, tetapi ia tidak akan
melihat lawan yang datang dari belakang.

entries.original:
"Using luminescent matter, it makes its
eyes and body glow and stuns attacking
opponents."
entries.translation_source: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan materi bercahaya, ia membuat
mata dan tubuhnya bersinar dan melumpuhkan
lawan yang menyerang.

entries.original:
"Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s
also smart enough to check its foe’s
strength and avoid battle."
entries.translation_source: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle.
entries.translated:
Meskipun ia adalah Pokémon yang sangat ...
juga cukup pintar untuk memeriksa kekuatan
lawannya dan menghindari pertempuran.

entries.original:
"This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers,
and it also takes care of other
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang sangat setia ini membantu para
Trainer, dan juga merawat Pokémon lain.

entries.original:
"This extremely wise Pokémon excels at
rescuing people stranded at sea or in
the mountains."
entries.translation_source: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang sangat bijaksana ini unggul
dalam menyelamatkan orang-orang yang
terdampar di laut atau di pegunungan.

entries.original:
"They trick people with cuteness, and
steal their valuables just to see the
looks on their faces."
entries.translation_source: They trick people with cuteness, and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.
entries.translated:
Mereka menipu orang dengan kelucuan, dan
mencuri barang berharga hanya untuk melihat
ekspresi wajah mereka.

entries.original:
"Their beautiful form comes from the
muscles they have developed. They run
silently in the night."
entries.translation_source: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
entries.translated:
Bentuk indah mereka berasal dari otot yang
telah mereka kembangkan. Mereka berlari
tanpa suara di malam hari.

entries.original:
"It shares the leaf on its head with
weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are
known to relieve stress."
entries.translation_source: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
entries.translated:
Ia membagikan daun di kepalanya dengan
Pokémon yang terlihat lelah. Daun-daun ini
dikenal dapat meredakan stres.

entries.original:
"It strikes its enemies with a
thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head
is bitter."
entries.translation_source: It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.
entries.translated:
Ia menyerang musuhnya dengan ekor yang
ditutupi duri. Daun di kepalanya pahit.

entries.original:
"Very intelligent, it roasts berries
before eating them. It likes to help
people."
entries.translation_source: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
entries.translated:
Sangat cerdas, ia memanggang buah beri
sebelum memakannya. Ia suka membantu orang.

entries.original:
"It loves sweets because they become
energy for the fire burning inside its
body."
entries.translation_source: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
entries.translated:
Ia menyukai makanan manis karena menjadi
energi bagi api yang membakar di dalam
tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"The water stored inside the tuft on its
head is full of nutrients. It waters
plants using its tail."
entries.translation_source: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants using its tail.
entries.translated:
Air yang disimpan di dalam jambul di
kepalanya penuh nutrisi. Ia menyiram
tanaman menggunakan ekornya.

entries.original:
"The high-pressure water expelled from
its tail is so powerful, it can destroy
a concrete wall."
entries.translation_source: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
entries.translated:
Air bertekanan tinggi yang dikeluarkan dari
ekornya sangat kuat, dapat menghancurkan
dinding beton.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon appears before people and
Pokémon who are having nightmares and
eats those dreams."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini muncul di hadapan orang dan
Pokémon yang mengalami mimpi buruk dan
memakan mimpi-mimpi tersebut.

entries.original:
"The mist emanating from their foreheads
is packed with the dreams of people and
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kabut yang keluar dari dahi mereka dipenuhi
dengan impian orang dan Pokémon.

entries.original:
"These Pokémon live in cities. They are
accustomed to people. Flocks often
gather in parks and plazas."
entries.translation_source: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini hidup di kota. Mereka terbiasa
dengan manusia. Kawanan sering berkumpul di
taman dan alun-alun.

entries.original:
"It can return to its Trainer’s location
regardless of the distance separating
them."
entries.translation_source: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat kembali ke lokasi Trainernya
terlepas dari jarak yang memisahkan mereka.

entries.original:
"Males swing the plumage on their heads
to threaten others, but females are
better at flying."
entries.translation_source: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.
entries.translated:
Jantan mengayunkan bulu di kepala mereka
untuk mengancam yang lain, tetapi betina
lebih baik dalam terbang.

entries.original:
"Its mane shines when discharging
electricity. It uses flashing manes to
communicate with others."
entries.translation_source: Its mane shines when discharging electricity. It uses flashing manes to communicate with others.
entries.translated:
Surai berkilau saat mengeluarkan listrik.
Ia menggunakan surai yang berkilau untuk
berkomunikasi dengan yang lain.

entries.original:
"When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs
wild, it shoots lightning from its mane
in all directions."
entries.translation_source: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
entries.translated:
Ketika Pokémon pemarah ini mengamuk, ia
menembakkan petir dari surainya ke segala
arah.

entries.original:
"Its ear is hexagonal in shape.
Compressed underground, its body is as
hard as steel."
entries.translation_source: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
entries.translated:
Telinganya berbentuk heksagonal. Ditekan di
bawah tanah, tubuhnya sekeras baja.

entries.original:
"Because its energy was too great to
be contained, the energy leaked and
formed orange crystals."
entries.translation_source: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
entries.translated:
Karena energinya terlalu besar untuk
ditampung, energi tersebut bocor dan
membentuk kristal oranye.

entries.original:
"The solar rays it absorbs are processed
in its energy core and fired as a ball
of light."
entries.translation_source: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
entries.translated:
Sinar matahari yang diserapnya diproses di
inti energinya dan ditembakkan sebagai bola
cahaya.

entries.original:
"It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose
to learn about its surroundings."
entries.translation_source: It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
entries.translated:
Ia mengeluarkan gelombang ultrasonik dari
hidungnya untuk mempelajari lingkungan
sekitarnya.

entries.original:
"It shakes its tail vigorously when it
emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to
reduce concrete to rubble."
entries.translation_source: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
entries.translated:
Ia menggoyangkan ekornya dengan kuat saat
... gelombang ultrasonik yang cukup kuat
untuk menghancurkan beton menjadi puing.

entries.original:
"By spinning its body, it can dig
straight through the ground at a speed
of 30 mph."
entries.translation_source: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
entries.translated:
Dengan memutar tubuhnya, ia dapat menggali
lurus ke dalam tanah dengan kecepatan 30
mph.

entries.original:
"Forming a drill with its steel claws
and head, it can cut through a steel
plate, no matter the thickness."
entries.translation_source: Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can cut through a steel plate, no matter the thickness.
entries.translated:
Membentuk bor dengan cakar baja dan
kepalanya, ia dapat memotong pelat baja,
tidak peduli seberapa tebalnya.

entries.original:
"Using the feelers on its ears, it can
tell how someone is feeling or when an
egg might hatch."
entries.translation_source: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan peraba di telinganya, ia dapat
mengetahui bagaimana perasaan seseorang
atau kapan telur akan menetas.

entries.original:
"Always carrying squared logs, they help
out with construction. As they grow,
they carry bigger logs."
entries.translation_source: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
entries.translated:
Selalu membawa balok kayu, mereka membantu
dalam konstruksi. Saat tumbuh, mereka
membawa balok yang lebih besar.

entries.original:
"With strengthened bodies, they
skillfully wield steel beams to take
down buildings."
entries.translation_source: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
entries.translated:
Dengan tubuh yang diperkuat, mereka dengan
cekatan menggunakan balok baja untuk
merobohkan gedung.

entries.original:
"It is thought that Conkeldurr taught
humans how to make concrete more than
2,000 years ago."
entries.translation_source: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
entries.translated:
Diperkirakan bahwa Conkeldurr mengajari
manusia cara membuat beton lebih dari 2.000
tahun yang lalu.

entries.original:
"They warn others of danger by vibrating
their cheeks to create a high-pitched
sound."
entries.translation_source: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
entries.translated:
Mereka memperingatkan yang lain akan bahaya
dengan menggetarkan pipi mereka untuk
menciptakan suara bernada tinggi.

entries.original:
"It lives in the water and on land. It
uses its long, sticky tongue to capture
prey."
entries.translation_source: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.
entries.translated:
Ia hidup di air dan di darat. Ia
menggunakan lidahnya yang panjang dan
lengket untuk menangkap mangsa.

entries.original:
"By putting power into its bumps, it
creates vibrations and increases the
power of its punches."
entries.translation_source: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.
entries.translated:
Dengan memasukkan kekuatan ke dalam
benjolannya, ia menciptakan getaran dan
meningkatkan kekuatan pukulannya.

entries.original:
"When it tightens its belt, it becomes
stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave
their own belts."
entries.translation_source: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
entries.translated:
Saat ia mengencangkan sabuknya, ia menjadi
lebih kuat. Throh liar menggunakan sulur
untuk menenun sabuk mereka sendiri.

entries.original:
"Desiring the strongest karate chop,
they seclude themselves in mountains and
train without sleeping."
entries.translation_source: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
entries.translated:
Menginginkan pukulan karate terkuat, mereka
mengasingkan diri di pegunungan dan
berlatih tanpa tidur.

entries.original:
"Since this Pokémon makes its own
clothes out of leaves, it is a popular
mascot for fashion designers."
entries.translation_source: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
entries.translated:
Karena Pokémon ini membuat pakaiannya
sendiri dari daun, ia menjadi maskot
populer bagi para desainer mode.

entries.original:
"Preferring dark, damp places, it spends
the entire day eating fallen leaves
that lie around it."
entries.translation_source: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.
entries.translated:
Lebih menyukai tempat gelap dan lembab, ia
menghabiskan sepanjang hari memakan
daun-daun yang jatuh di sekitarnya.

entries.original:
"It keeps its eggs warm with heat from
fermenting leaves."
entries.translation_source: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves.
entries.translated:
Ia menjaga telurnya tetap hangat dengan
panas dari daun yang difermentasi.

entries.original:
"Its bite injects a potent poison,
enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon
that try to prey on it."
entries.translation_source: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
entries.translated:
Gigitannya menyuntikkan racun yang kuat,
cukup untuk melumpuhkan Pokémon burung
besar yang mencoba memangsa.

entries.original:
"Protected by a hard shell, it spins its
body like a wheel and crashes furiously
into its enemies."
entries.translation_source: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
entries.translated:
Dilindungi oleh cangkang keras, ia memutar
tubuhnya seperti roda dan menabrak
musuh-musuhnya dengan ganas.

entries.original:
"Highly aggressive, it uses the claws
near its neck to dig into its opponents
and poison them."
entries.translation_source: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.
entries.translated:
Sangat agresif, ia menggunakan cakar di
dekat lehernya untuk menggali lawan dan
meracuni mereka.

entries.original:
"When attacked, it escapes by shooting
cotton from its body to serve as a decoy
to distract the attacker."
entries.translation_source: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body to serve as a decoy to distract the attacker.
entries.translated:
Saat diserang, ia melarikan diri dengan
menembakkan kapas dari ... untuk dijadikan
umpan pengalih perhatian penyerang.

entries.original:
"Like the wind, it can slip through any
gap, no matter how small. It leaves
balls of white fluff behind."
entries.translation_source: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
entries.translated:
Seperti angin, ia dapat menyelinap melalui
celah apa pun, ... apa pun. Ia meninggalkan
bola-bola bulu putih di belakangnya.

entries.original:
"The leaves on its head are very bitter.
Eating one of these leaves is known to
refresh a tired body."
entries.translation_source: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
entries.translated:
Daun di kepalanya sangat pahit. Memakan
salah satu daun ini diketahui dapat
menyegarkan tubuh yang lelah.

entries.original:
"The fragrance of the garland on its
head has a relaxing effect, but taking
care of it is very difficult."
entries.translation_source: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.
entries.translated:
Aroma karangan bunga di kepalanya memiliki
efek relaksasi, tetapi merawatnya sangat
sulit.

entries.original:
"Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue
Basculin are always fighting each other
over territory."
entries.translation_source: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang biadab dan ganas, Basculin
merah dan biru selalu saling bertarung
memperebutkan wilayah.

entries.original:
"They live hidden under hot desert sands
in order to keep their body temperature
from dropping."
entries.translation_source: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.
entries.translated:
Mereka hidup bersembunyi di bawah pasir
gurun yang panas untuk menjaga suhu tubuh
mereka tidak turun.

entries.original:
"It buries some of its prey in the sand
to use as emergency meals when its
hunts are unsuccessful."
entries.translation_source: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.
entries.translated:
Ia mengubur sebagian mangsanya di pasir
untuk dijadikan makanan darurat saat
perburuannya tidak berhasil.

entries.original:
"It conceals itself in sandstorms that
Flygon whip up and waits patiently for
prey to appear."
entries.translation_source: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.
entries.translated:
Ia bersembunyi di dalam badai pasir yang
dihasilkan Flygon dan menunggu dengan sabar
hingga mangsa muncul.

entries.original:
"When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into
its body and its internal fire goes
down to 1,100 degrees F."
entries.translation_source: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees F.
entries.translated:
Saat tidur, ia menarik anggota tubuhnya ke
dalam tubuhnya dan api internalnya turun
hingga 1.100 derajat Fahrenheit.

entries.original:
"When weakened in battle, it transforms
into a stone statue then sharpens its
mind and fights mentally."
entries.translation_source: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue then sharpens its mind and fights mentally.
entries.translated:
Saat melemah dalam pertempuran, ia berubah
menjadi patung batu, lalu mempertajam
pikirannya dan bertarung secara mental.

entries.original:
"Arid regions are their habitat. They
move rhythmically, making a sound
similar to maracas."
entries.translation_source: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
entries.translated:
Daerah kering adalah habitat mereka. Mereka
bergerak secara ritmis, mengeluarkan suara
yang mirip dengan marakas.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon can easily melt holes in
hard rocks with a liquid secreted from
its mouth."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini dapat dengan mudah melelehkan
lubang di batu keras dengan cairan yang
dikeluarkan dari mulutnya.

entries.original:
"When its boulder is broken in battles
for territory, it feels unsure and
begins to weaken."
entries.translation_source: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.
entries.translated:
Saat batu besarnya pecah dalam pertempuran
memperebutkan wilayah, ia merasa tidak
yakin dan mulai melemah.

entries.original:
"It immediately headbutts anyone that
makes eye contact with it. Its skull is
massively thick."
entries.translation_source: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.
entries.translated:
Ia segera menanduk siapa pun yang melakukan
kontak mata dengannya. Tengkoraknya sangat
tebal.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes
very good care of its family, its
friends, and its turf."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini mungkin kasar, tetapi ia sangat
merawat keluarganya, teman-temannya, dan
wilayahnya.

entries.original:
"The guardians of an ancient city, they
always fly the same route while keeping
watch for invaders."
entries.translation_source: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
entries.translated:
Para penjaga kota kuno, mereka selalu
terbang di rute yang sama sambil mengawasi
para penyusup.

entries.original:
"Each of them carries a mask that used
to be its face when it was human."
entries.translation_source: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human.
entries.translated:
Masing-masing dari mereka membawa topeng
yang dulunya adalah wajahnya saat masih
manusia.

entries.original:
"Grave robbers who mistake them for real
coffins and get too close end up
trapped inside their bodies."
entries.translation_source: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
entries.translated:
Perampok makam yang salah mengira mereka
sebagai peti mati sungguhan dan terlalu
dekat akan ... di dalam tubuh mereka.

entries.original:
"Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon
can dive to depths beyond half a mile."
entries.translation_source: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
entries.translated:
Dipulihkan dari fosil, Pokémon ini dapat
menyelam hingga kedalaman lebih dari
setengah mil.

entries.original:
"Incredible jaw strength enables them to
chew up steel beams and rocks along
with their prey."
entries.translation_source: Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.
entries.translated:
Kekuatan rahang yang luar biasa
memungkinkan mereka mengunyah balok baja
dan batu bersama mangsanya.

entries.original:
"Restored from a fossil, this ancient
bird Pokémon has wings but can’t yet
fly."
entries.translation_source: Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can’t yet fly.
entries.translated:
Dipulihkan dari fosil, Pokémon burung kuno
ini memiliki sayap tetapi belum bisa
terbang.

entries.original:
"It runs better than it flies. It takes
off into the sky by running at a speed
of 25 mph."
entries.translation_source: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.
entries.translated:
Ia berlari lebih baik daripada terbang. Ia
lepas landas ke langit dengan berlari
dengan kecepatan 25 mph.

entries.original:
"Wanting more garbage, they follow
people who litter. They always belch
poison gas."
entries.translation_source: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.
entries.translated:
Ingin lebih banyak sampah, mereka mengikuti
orang yang membuang sampah sembarangan.
Mereka selalu menyemburkan gas beracun.

entries.original:
"Consuming garbage makes new kinds of
poison gases and liquids inside their
bodies."
entries.translation_source: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.
entries.translated:
Mengonsumsi sampah menghasilkan jenis baru
gas dan cairan beracun di dalam tubuh
mereka.

entries.original:
"It changes so it looks just like its
foe, tricks it, and then uses that
opportunity to flee."
entries.translation_source: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
entries.translated:
Ia berubah sehingga terlihat persis seperti
lawannya, menipunya, lalu menggunakan
kesempatan itu untuk melarikan diri.

entries.original:
"Stories say those who tried to catch
Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and
punished."
entries.translation_source: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.
entries.translated:
Cerita mengatakan bahwa mereka yang mencoba
menangkap Zoroark terperangkap dalam ilusi
dan dihukum.

entries.original:
"Minccino greet each other by grooming
one another thoroughly with their
tails."
entries.translation_source: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
entries.translated:
Minccino saling menyapa dengan merawat satu
sama lain secara menyeluruh menggunakan
ekor mereka.

entries.original:
"Their white fur is coated in a special
oil that makes it easy for them to
deflect attacks."
entries.translation_source: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
entries.translated:
Bulu putih mereka dilapisi minyak khusus
yang memudahkan mereka untuk membelokkan
serangan.

entries.original:
"Their ribbonlike feelers increase their
psychic power. They are always staring
at something."
entries.translation_source: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
entries.translated:
Antena seperti pita mereka meningkatkan
kekuatan psikisnya. Mereka selalu menatap
sesuatu.

entries.original:
"According to old tales, it creates
friends for itself by controlling
sleeping children on starry nights."
entries.translation_source: According to old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.
entries.translated:
Menurut cerita kuno, ia menciptakan teman
untuk dirinya ... dengan mengendalikan
anak-anak yang tidur di malam berbintang.

entries.original:
"Starry skies thousands of light-years
away are visible in the space distorted
by their psychic power."
entries.translation_source: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their psychic power.
entries.translated:
Langit berbintang ribuan tahun cahaya
jauhnya terlihat di ruang yang terdistorsi
oleh kekuatan psikis mereka.

entries.original:
"Because their bodies are enveloped in a
special liquid, they can survive in any
environment."
entries.translation_source: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.
entries.translated:
Karena tubuh mereka diselimuti cairan
khusus, mereka dapat bertahan di lingkungan
apa pun.

entries.original:
"When their two divided brains think the
same thoughts, their psychic power is
maximized."
entries.translation_source: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.
entries.translated:
Ketika dua otak mereka yang terbagi
berpikir pikiran yang sama, kekuatan psikis
mereka dimaksimalkan.

entries.original:
"When Reuniclus shake hands, a network
forms between their brains, increasing
their psychic power."
entries.translation_source: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
entries.translated:
Saat Reuniclus berjabat tangan, sebuah
jaringan terbentuk di antara otak mereka,
meningkatkan kekuatan psikis mereka.

entries.original:
"When attacked, it uses its feathers to
splash water, escaping under cover of
the spray."
entries.translation_source: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
entries.translated:
Saat diserang, ia menggunakan bulunya untuk
memercikkan air, melarikan diri di balik
semprotan.

entries.original:
"Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one
dancing in the middle is the leader of
the flock."
entries.translation_source: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
entries.translated:
Swanna mulai menari saat senja. Yang menari
di tengah adalah pemimpin kawanan.

entries.original:
"It feels pleasantly cool when embraced.
This Pokémon is treasured by households
in warm regions."
entries.translation_source: It feels pleasantly cool when embraced. This Pokémon is treasured by households in warm regions.
entries.translated:
Terasa sejuk menyenangkan saat dipeluk.
Pokémon ini dihargai oleh rumah tangga di
daerah hangat.

entries.original:
"This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice
Age. It’s incredibly popular in very hot
regions."
entries.translation_source: This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age. It’s incredibly popular in very hot regions.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang kuat ini selamat dari Zaman
Es. Ia sangat populer di daerah yang sangat
panas.

entries.original:
"If both heads get angry simultaneously,
this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying
everything in snow."
entries.translation_source: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
entries.translated:
Jika kedua kepala marah secara bersamaan,
Pokémon ini mengeluarkan badai salju,
mengubur semuanya dalam salju.

entries.original:
"The turning of the seasons changes the
color and scent of its fur. People use
it to mark the seasons."
entries.translation_source: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of its fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
entries.translated:
Pergantian musim mengubah warna dan aroma
bulunya. Orang-orang menggunakannya untuk
menandai musim.

entries.original:
"They migrate according to seasons, so
some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers
of spring."
entries.translation_source: They migrate according to seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
entries.translated:
Mereka bermigrasi sesuai musim, jadi
beberapa orang menyebut Sawsbuck sebagai
pertanda musim semi.

entries.original:
"They live on treetops and glide using
the inside of a cape-like membrane while
discharging electricity."
entries.translation_source: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
entries.translated:
Mereka tinggal di puncak pohon dan meluncur
menggunakan bagian dalam membran seperti
jubah sambil mengeluarkan listrik.

entries.original:
"For some reason they evolve when they
receive electrical energy while they are
attacking Shelmet."
entries.translation_source: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.
entries.translated:
Untuk alasan tertentu mereka berevolusi
saat menerima energi listrik ketika
menyerang Shelmet.

entries.original:
"Wearing the shell covering they stole
from Shelmet, they defend themselves and
attack with two lances."
entries.translation_source: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
entries.translated:
Mengenakan cangkang yang mereka curi dari
Shelmet, mereka bertahan dan menyerang
dengan dua tombak.

entries.original:
"It lures Pokémon with its pattern that
looks just like a Poké Ball then
releases poison spores."
entries.translation_source: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.
entries.translated:
Ia memikat Pokémon dengan polanya yang
persis seperti Poké Ball lalu melepaskan
spora racun.

entries.original:
"It moves the caps on both arms and does
a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp
places."
entries.translation_source: It moves the caps on both arms and does a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp places.
entries.translated:
Ia menggerakkan tutup di kedua lengannya
dan menari untuk memikat mangsa. Ia lebih
suka tempat lembab.

entries.original:
"They paralyze prey with poison, then
drag them down to their lairs, five
miles below the surface."
entries.translation_source: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.
entries.translated:
Mereka melumpuhkan mangsa dengan racun,
lalu menyeretnya ke sarang mereka, lima mil
di bawah permukaan.

entries.original:
"Jellicent is always hanging around
fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping
to drag away its prey."
entries.translation_source: Jellicent is always hanging around fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping to drag away its prey.
entries.translated:
Jellicent selalu berkeliaran di sekitar
kapal pesiar mewah dan kapal tanker,
berharap dapat menyeret mangsanya.

entries.original:
"The special membrane enveloping
Alomomola has the ability to heal
wounds."
entries.translation_source: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
entries.translated:
Membran khusus yang menyelimuti Alomomola
memiliki kemampuan untuk menyembuhkan luka.

entries.original:
"Joltik that live in cities have learned
a technique for sucking electricity
from the outlets in houses."
entries.translation_source: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
entries.translated:
Joltik yang tinggal di kota telah
mempelajari teknik menyedot listrik dari
stopkontak di rumah-rumah.

entries.original:
"When attacked, they create an electric
barrier by spitting out many
electrically charged threads."
entries.translation_source: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
entries.translated:
Saat diserang, mereka membuat penghalang
listrik dengan meludahkan banyak benang
bermuatan listrik.

entries.original:
"They stick their spikes into cave walls
and absorb the minerals they find in
the rock."
entries.translation_source: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.
entries.translated:
Mereka menusukkan duri mereka ke dinding
gua dan menyerap mineral yang mereka
temukan di batu.

entries.original:
"By swinging around its three spiky
feels and shooting spikes, it can
obliterate an opponent."
entries.translation_source: By swinging around its three spiky feels and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.
entries.translated:
Dengan mengayunkan ketiga duri perasaannya
dan menembakkan duri, ia dapat
menghancurkan lawan.

entries.original:
"Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. They
spin around each other to generate
energy."
entries.translation_source: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. They spin around each other to generate energy.
entries.translated:
Dua tubuh membentuk pasangan tetap. Mereka
berputar satu sama lain untuk menghasilkan
energi.

entries.original:
"A mini and big gear comprise its body.
If the mini gear it launches at a foe
doesn’t return, it will die."
entries.translation_source: A mini and big gear comprise its body. If the mini gear it launches at a foe doesn’t return, it will die.
entries.translated:
Sebuah roda gigi mini dan besar membentuk
... Jika roda gigi mini yang diluncurkannya
ke musuh tidak kembali, ia akan mati.

entries.original:
"The gear with the red core is rotated
at high speed for a rapid energy
charge."
entries.translation_source: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
entries.translated:
Roda gigi dengan inti merah diputar dengan
kecepatan tinggi untuk pengisian energi
yang cepat.

entries.original:
"While one alone doesn’t have much
power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as
powerful as lightning."
entries.translation_source: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
entries.translated:
Meskipun satu saja tidak memiliki banyak
kekuatan, rantai dari banyak Tynamo bisa
sekuat petir.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon has a big appetite. When
it spots its prey, it attacks it and
paralyzes it with electricity."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon has a big appetite. When it spots its prey, it attacks it and paralyzes it with electricity.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini memiliki nafsu makan yang
besar. Saat melihat mangsanya, ia menyerang
dan melumpuhkannya dengan listrik.

entries.original:
"With its sucker mouth, it sucks in
prey. Then it uses its fangs to shock
the prey with electricity."
entries.translation_source: With its sucker mouth, it sucks in prey. Then it uses its fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
entries.translated:
Dengan mulut penghisapnya, ia menyedot
mangsa. Lalu ia menggunakan taringnya untuk
menyetrum mangsa dengan listrik.

entries.original:
"Rumors of its origin are linked to a
UFO crash site in the desert 50 years
ago."
entries.translation_source: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.
entries.translated:
Rumor tentang asal-usulnya terkait dengan
lokasi jatuhnya UFO di gurun 50 tahun yang
lalu.

entries.original:
"It uses psychic power to control an
opponent’s brain and tamper with its
memories."
entries.translation_source: It uses psychic power to control an opponent’s brain and tamper with its memories.
entries.translated:
Ia menggunakan kekuatan psikis untuk
mengendalikan otak lawan dan memanipulasi
ingatannya.

entries.original:
"Its flame is usually out, but it starts
shining when it absorbs life force from
people or Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Apinya biasanya padam, tetapi mulai
bersinar ketika menyerap kekuatan hidup
dari manusia atau Pokémon.

entries.original:
"It arrives near the moment of death and
steals spirit from the body."
entries.translation_source: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.
entries.translated:
Ia tiba dekat saat kematian dan mencuri roh
dari tubuh.

entries.original:
"Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame
burns up the spirit, leaving the body
behind."
entries.translation_source: Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
entries.translated:
Terbakar dalam api Chandelure membakar
habis roh, meninggalkan tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"Its large tusks have a tendency to
break, but each time they grow back,
they grow in harder and sturdier."
entries.translation_source: Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.
entries.translated:
Gading besarnya cenderung patah, tetapi
setiap kali tumbuh kembali, mereka tumbuh
lebih keras dan lebih kuat.

entries.original:
"Their tusks can shatter rocks.
Territory battles between Fraxure can be
intensely violent."
entries.translation_source: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
entries.translated:
Gading mereka dapat menghancurkan batu.
Pertempuran wilayah antara Fraxure bisa
sangat ganas.

entries.original:
"Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even
if used to cut steel beams. They are
covered in hard armor."
entries.translation_source: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. They are covered in hard armor.
entries.translated:
Taring mereka yang kokoh akan tetap tajam
bahkan jika digunakan untuk memotong balok
baja. Mereka ditutupi oleh armor keras.

entries.original:
"When it is not feeling well, its mucus
gets watery and the power of its
Ice-type moves decreases."
entries.translation_source: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
entries.translated:
Ketika tidak merasa sehat, lendirnya
menjadi encer dan kekuatan serangan tipe
Esnya berkurang.

entries.original:
"It freezes its breath to create fangs
and claws of ice. Cold northern areas
are its habitat."
entries.translation_source: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice. Cold northern areas are its habitat.
entries.translated:
Ia membekukan napasnya untuk menciptakan
taring dan cakar dari es. Daerah utara yang
dingin adalah habitatnya.

entries.original:
"They are born in snow clouds. They use
chains made of ice crystals to capture
prey."
entries.translation_source: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
entries.translated:
Mereka lahir di awan salju. Mereka
menggunakan rantai yang terbuat dari
kristal es untuk menangkap mangsa.

entries.original:
"When it and Karrablast are together,
and both receive electrical stimulation,
they both evolve."
entries.translation_source: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.
entries.translated:
Ketika ia dan Karrablast bersama, dan
keduanya menerima stimulasi listrik, mereka
berdua berevolusi.

entries.original:
"Having removed its heavy shell, it
becomes very light and can fight with
ninja-like movements."
entries.translation_source: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
entries.translated:
Setelah melepaskan cangkangnya yang berat,
ia menjadi sangat ringan dan dapat
bertarung dengan gerakan seperti ninja.

entries.original:
"When its opponent can’t be paralyzed,
it contorts itself with unexpected speed
and flops away."
entries.translation_source: When its opponent can’t be paralyzed, it contorts itself with unexpected speed and flops away.
entries.translated:
Ketika lawannya tidak bisa dilumpuhkan, ia
memelintir tubuhnya dengan kecepatan tak
terduga dan melompat menjauh.

entries.original:
"It takes pride in the speed at which it
uses moves. What it loses in power, it
makes up for in quantity."
entries.translation_source: It takes pride in the speed at which it uses moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.
entries.translated:
Ia bangga dengan kecepatan saat menggunakan
jurus. Kekurangan dalam kekuatan, ia
imbangi dengan jumlah.

entries.original:
"They use the long fur on their arms as
a whip to strike their opponents."
entries.translation_source: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.
entries.translated:
Mereka menggunakan bulu panjang di lengan
mereka sebagai cambuk untuk menyerang
lawan.

entries.original:
"It runs through the narrow tunnels
formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses
its sharp claws to catch prey."
entries.translation_source: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.
entries.translated:
Ia berlari melalui terowongan sempit yang
dibentuk oleh ... dan Onix. Ia menggunakan
cakar tajamnya untuk menangkap mangsa.

entries.original:
"Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon
from clay. It’s been active for
thousands of years."
entries.translation_source: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It’s been active for thousands of years.
entries.translated:
Ilmu pengetahuan kuno membentuk Pokémon ini
dari tanah liat. Pokémon ini telah aktif
selama ribuan tahun.

entries.original:
"Golurk were created to protect people
and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious
energy."
entries.translation_source: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.
entries.translated:
Golurk diciptakan untuk melindungi manusia
dan Pokémon. Mereka berjalan dengan energi
misterius.

entries.original:
"Ignoring their injuries, groups attack
by sinking the blades that cover their
bodies into their prey."
entries.translation_source: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.
entries.translated:
Mengabaikan luka-luka mereka, ... menyerang
dengan menusukkan bilah-bilah yang menutupi
tubuh mereka ke mangsa mereka.

entries.original:
"Bisharp pursues prey in the company of
a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp
finishes off the prey."
entries.translation_source: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.
entries.translated:
Bisharp mengejar mangsa bersama sekelompok
besar Pawniard. Kemudian Bisharp menghabisi
mangsanya.

entries.original:
"Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even
if they strike foes with a fierce
headbutt."
entries.translation_source: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
entries.translated:
Bulu mereka yang halus menyerap kerusakan,
bahkan jika mereka menyerang lawan dengan
sundulan kepala yang keras.

entries.original:
"They crush berries with their talons.
They bravely stand up to any opponent,
no matter how strong it is."
entries.translation_source: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
entries.translated:
Mereka menghancurkan buah beri dengan cakar
mereka. Mereka dengan ... lawan mana pun,
tidak peduli sekuat apa pun lawan itu.

entries.original:
"The more scars they have, the more
respect these brave soldiers of the sky
get from their peers."
entries.translation_source: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.
entries.translated:
Semakin banyak bekas luka yang mereka
miliki, semakin besar rasa hormat yang ...
yang pemberani ini dari rekan-rekan mereka.

entries.original:
"They tend to guard their posteriors
with suitable bones they have found.
They pursue weak Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Mereka cenderung melindungi bagian belakang
mereka ... yang cocok yang mereka temukan.
Mereka mengejar Pokémon yang lemah.

entries.original:
"It skillfully arranges the bones of its
prey to construct its nest. Most of the
bones are Cubone."
entries.translation_source: It skillfully arranges the bones of its prey to construct its nest. Most of the bones are Cubone.
entries.translated:
Ia dengan terampil menyusun tulang
mangsanya untuk membangun sarangnya.
Sebagian besar tulangnya adalah Cubone.

entries.original:
"It breathes through a hole in its tail
while it burns with an internal fire.
Durant is its prey."
entries.translation_source: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
entries.translated:
Ia bernapas melalui lubang di ekornya saat
terbakar dengan api internal. Durant adalah
mangsanya.

entries.original:
"Durant dig nests in mountains. They
build their complicated, interconnected
tunnels in mazes."
entries.translation_source: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels in mazes.
entries.translated:
Durant menggali sarang di pegunungan.
Mereka membangun terowongan rumit yang
saling terhubung dalam labirin.

entries.original:
"It tends to bite everything, and it is
not a picky eater. Approaching it
carelessly is dangerous."
entries.translation_source: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
entries.translated:
Ia cenderung menggigit apa pun, dan ia
bukan pemakan yang pilih-pilih.
Mendekatinya dengan sembarangan berbahaya.

entries.original:
"The two heads do not get along.
Whichever head eats more than the other
gets to be the leader."
entries.translation_source: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
entries.translated:
Kedua kepala tidak akur. Kepala mana pun
yang makan lebih banyak dari yang lain akan
menjadi pemimpin.

entries.original:
"It responds to movement by attacking.
This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours
everything in its path!"
entries.translation_source: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
entries.translated:
Ia merespons gerakan dengan menyerang.
Pokémon berkepala tiga yang menakutkan ini
melahap segala sesuatu di jalannya!

entries.original:
"It protects itself with flame. Long
years ago, people believed Larvesta had
a nest on the sun."
entries.translation_source: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.
entries.translated:
Ia melindungi dirinya dengan api.
Bertahun-tahun yang lalu, orang percaya
bahwa Larvesta memiliki sarang di matahari.

entries.original:
"When volcanic ash darkened the
atmosphere, Volcarona’s fire provided a
replacement for the sun."
entries.translation_source: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
entries.translated:
Ketika abu vulkanik menggelapkan atmosfer,
api Volcarona menjadi pengganti matahari.

entries.original:
"It has a body and heart of steel. Its
