glare is sufficient to make even an
unruly Pokémon obey it."
entries.translation_source: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki tubuh dan hati baja. Tatapannya
cukup untuk membuat Pokémon yang
memberontak pun patuh.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon came to the defense of
Pokémon that had lost their homes in a
war among humans."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini datang untuk membela Pokémon
yang kehilangan rumah mereka dalam perang
antar manusia.

entries.original:
"Legends say this Pokémon confounded
opponents with its swift movements."
entries.translation_source: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.
entries.translated:
Legenda mengatakan Pokémon ini
membingungkan lawan dengan gerakannya yang
cepat.

entries.original:
"In every direction it flies, creating
winds so powerful, they blow everything
away."
entries.translation_source: In every direction it flies, creating winds so powerful, they blow everything away.
entries.translated:
Ia terbang ke segala arah, menciptakan
angin yang begitu kuat sehingga
menerbangkan segalanya.

entries.original:
"Countless charred remains mar the
landscape of places through which
Thundurus has passed."
entries.translation_source: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
entries.translated:
Sisa-sisa hangus yang tak terhitung
jumlahnya merusak pemandangan di
tempat-tempat yang dilalui Thundurus.

entries.original:
"When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat
energy moves the atmosphere and changes
the world’s weather."
entries.translation_source: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.
entries.translated:
Ketika ekor Reshiram menyala, energi panas
menggerakkan atmosfer dan mengubah cuaca
dunia.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon appears in legends. In its
tail, it has a giant generator that
creates electricity."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini muncul dalam legenda. Di
ekornya, ia memiliki generator raksasa yang
menciptakan listrik.

entries.original:
"Lands visited by Landorus grant
bountiful crops. It has been hailed as
\qoThe Guardian of the Fields.\qc"
entries.translation_source: Lands visited by Landorus grant bountiful crops. It has been hailed as [quote-open-1]The Guardian of the Fields.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated:
Tanah yang dikunjungi Landorus memberikan
hasil panen yang melimpah. Ia telah dipuji
sebagai \qoPenjaga Ladang.\qc

entries.original:
"It can produce ultracold air. Its body
is frozen."
entries.translation_source: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat menghasilkan udara yang sangat
dingin. Tubuhnya membeku.

entries.original:
"It crosses the world, running over the
surfaces of oceans and rivers. It
appears at scenic waterfronts."
entries.translation_source: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
entries.translated:
Ia melintasi dunia, berlari di atas
permukaan samudra dan sungai. Ia muncul di
tepi perairan yang indah.

entries.original:
"Many famous songs have been inspired by
the melodies that Meloetta plays."
entries.translation_source: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.
entries.translated:
Banyak lagu terkenal yang terinspirasi oleh
melodi yang dimainkan Meloetta.

entries.original:
"This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by
Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon
on its back."
entries.translation_source: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
entries.translated:
Pokémon serangga kuno ini diubah oleh Team
Plasma. Mereka meningkatkan meriam di
punggungnya.

entries.original:
"Such a thick shell of wood covers its
head and back that even a direct hit
from a truck wouldn’t faze it."
entries.translation_source: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.
entries.translated:
Cangkang kayu yang tebal menutupi kepala
dan punggungnya ... bahkan pukulan langsung
dari truk pun tidak akan mengganggunya.

entries.original:
"It relies on its sturdy shell to
deflect predators’ attacks. It
counterattacks with its sharp quills."
entries.translation_source: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
entries.translated:
Ia mengandalkan cangkangnya yang kokoh
untuk membelokkan serangan predator. Ia
membalas dengan duri tajamnya.

entries.original:
"When it takes a defensive posture with
its fists guarding its face, it could
withstand a bomb blast."
entries.translation_source: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
entries.translated:
Saat mengambil posisi bertahan dengan tinju
melindungi wajahnya, ia dapat menahan
ledakan bom.

entries.original:
"Eating a twig fills it with energy, and
its roomy ears give vent to very hot
air."
entries.translation_source: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to very hot air.
entries.translated:
Memakan ranting mengisinya dengan energi,
dan telinganya yang luas mengeluarkan udara
yang sangat panas.

entries.original:
"With friction from its tail fur, it
sets the twig on its tail on fire and
launches into battle."
entries.translation_source: With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on its tail on fire and launches into battle.
entries.translated:
Dengan gesekan dari bulu ekornya, ia
membakar ranting di ekornya dan meluncur ke
medan pertempuran.

entries.original:
"It gazes into the flame at its branch
to achieve a focused state, allowing it
to see the future."
entries.translation_source: It gazes into the flame at its branch to achieve a focused state, allowing it to see the future.
entries.translated:
Ia menatap api di cabangnya untuk mencapai
keadaan fokus, memungkinkannya melihat masa
depan.

entries.original:
"It secretes bubbles from its chest and
back. The bubbles reduce the damage it
would take when attacked."
entries.translation_source: It secretes bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would take when attacked.
entries.translated:
Ia mengeluarkan gelembung dari dada dan
punggungnya. ... itu mengurangi kerusakan
yang akan diterimanya saat diserang.

entries.original:
"Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can
scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in
a minute’s time."
entries.translation_source: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.
entries.translated:
Kecepatannya tak tertandingi. Ia dapat
memanjat menara setinggi lebih dari 2.000
kaki dalam waktu satu menit.

entries.original:
"It creates throwing stars out of
compressed water, that can split metal
in two."
entries.translation_source: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water, that can split metal in two.
entries.translated:
Ia menciptakan bintang lempar dari air yang
dikompresi, yang dapat membelah logam
menjadi dua.

entries.original:
"They use their large ears to dig
burrows. They will dig the whole night
through."
entries.translation_source: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
entries.translated:
Mereka menggunakan telinga besar mereka
untuk menggali lubang. Mereka akan menggali
sepanjang malam.

entries.original:
"As powerful as an excavator, its ears
can reduce dense bedrock to rubble."
entries.translation_source: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble.
entries.translated:
Sekuat ekskavator, telinganya dapat
menghancurkan batuan dasar yang padat
menjadi puing-puing.

entries.original:
"When it’s excited, its temperature can
double, spiking hormone production in
its body."
entries.translation_source: When it’s excited, its temperature can double, spiking hormone production in its body.
entries.translated:
Saat bersemangat, suhunya bisa berlipat
ganda, memicu produksi hormon di tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"Its speed right after takeoff already
puts it in the top speed class of all
bird Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kecepatannya tepat setelah lepas landas
sudah menempatkannya di kelas kecepatan
tertinggi dari semua Pokémon burung.

entries.original:
"When attacking prey, it can reach
speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its
prey off with a colossal kick."
entries.translation_source: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.
entries.translated:
Saat menyerang mangsa, ia dapat mencapai
kecepatan hingga 310 mph. Ia mengakhiri
mangsanya dengan tendangan raksasa.

entries.original:
"The powder that covers its body
regulates its temperature, so it can
live in any region or climate."
entries.translation_source: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
entries.translated:
Bubuk yang menutupi tubuhnya mengatur
suhunya, sehingga ia dapat hidup di wilayah
atau iklim mana pun.

entries.original:
"The beaks of birds can’t begin to
scratch its stalwart body. To defend
itself, it spews powder."
entries.translation_source: The beaks of birds can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.
entries.translated:
Paruh burung tidak bisa mulai menggores
tubuhnya yang kokoh. Untuk membela diri, ia
menyemburkan bubuk.

entries.original:
"The colorful patterns on this Pokémon’s
wings depend on the climate and
topography of its habitat."
entries.translation_source: The colorful patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat.
entries.translated:
Pola warna-warni pada sayap Pokémon ini
tergantung pada iklim dan topografi
habitatnya.

entries.original:
"The stronger the opponent it faces, the
more heat and power flow through its
body."
entries.translation_source: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat and power flow through its body.
entries.translated:
Semakin kuat lawan yang dihadapinya,
semakin banyak panas dan kekuatan yang
mengalir melalui tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"The male with the largest mane of fire
is the leader of the pride."
entries.translation_source: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
entries.translated:
Jantan dengan surai api terbesar adalah
pemimpin kelompok.

entries.original:
"It draws and controls the hidden power
of flowers. The flower it holds is most
likely part of its body."
entries.translation_source: It draws and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower it holds is most likely part of its body.
entries.translated:
Ia menarik dan mengendalikan kekuatan
tersembunyi dari bunga. Bunga yang ...
besar adalah bagian dari tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"When the flowers of a well-tended
flower bed bloom, it appears and
celebrates with an elegant dance."
entries.translation_source: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.
entries.translated:
Saat bunga-bunga dari taman bunga yang
terawat mekar, ia muncul dan merayakan
dengan tarian yang elegan.

entries.original:
"Its life can span several hundred
years. It’s said to devote its entire
life to protecting gardens."
entries.translation_source: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
entries.translated:
Umurnya bisa mencapai beberapa ratus tahun.
Dikatakan bahwa ia mengabdikan seluruh
hidupnya untuk melindungi taman.

entries.original:
"Thought to be one of the first Pokémon
to live in harmony with humans, it has
a placid disposition."
entries.translation_source: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
entries.translated:
Dianggap sebagai salah satu Pokémon pertama
yang hidup harmonis dengan manusia, ia
memiliki watak yang tenang.

entries.original:
"They inhabit mountainous regions. The
leader of the herd is decided by a
battle of clashing horns."
entries.translation_source: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
entries.translated:
Mereka mendiami daerah pegunungan. Pemimpin
kawanan ditentukan oleh pertarungan tanduk
benturan.

entries.original:
"It grows up imitating the behavior of
Pangoro, which it looks up to as a
leader."
entries.translation_source: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.
entries.translated:
Ia tumbuh dengan meniru perilaku Pangoro,
yang ia hormati sebagai pemimpin.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon boasts great physical
strength. Many Trainers are also smitten
by its lively character."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini memiliki kekuatan fisik yang
hebat. Banyak Pelatih juga terpikat oleh
karakternya yang bersemangat.

entries.original:
"Historically, in the Kalos region,
these Pokémon were the designated
guardians of the king."
entries.translation_source: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.
entries.translated:
Secara historis, di wilayah Kalos, Pokémon
ini ditunjuk sebagai penjaga raja.

entries.original:
"The organ that emits its intense
psychic power is sheltered by its ears
to keep power from leaking out."
entries.translation_source: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
entries.translated:
Organ yang memancarkan kekuatan psikisnya
yang kuat dilindungi oleh telinganya untuk
mencegah kekuatan bocor.

entries.original:
"When in danger, it raises its ears and
releases enough psychic power to grind
a 10-ton truck to dust."
entries.translation_source: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.
entries.translated:
Saat dalam bahaya, ia mengangkat telinganya
dan ... kekuatan psikis yang cukup untuk
menghancurkan truk 10 ton menjadi debu.

entries.original:
"It is born when a departed spirit
inhabits a sword. It attaches to people
and drinks their life force."
entries.translation_source: It is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches to people and drinks their life force.
entries.translated:
Ia lahir ketika roh yang telah pergi
menghuni pedang. Ia menempel pada orang dan
meminum kekuatan hidup mereka.

entries.original:
"The complex attack patterns of its two
swords are unstoppable, even for an
accomplished opponent."
entries.translation_source: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an accomplished opponent.
entries.translated:
Pola serangan kompleks dari kedua pedangnya
tidak dapat dihentikan, bahkan bagi lawan
yang mahir.

entries.original:
"It can detect the innate qualities of
leadership. Whoever it recognizes is
destined to become king."
entries.translation_source: It can detect the innate qualities of leadership. Whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat mendeteksi kualitas kepemimpinan
bawaan. Siapa pun yang dikenalnya
ditakdirkan menjadi raja.

entries.original:
"It emits a scent that delights those
who smell it. The fragrance changes
depending on what it has eaten."
entries.translation_source: It emits a scent that delights those who smell it. The fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
entries.translated:
Ia mengeluarkan aroma yang menyenangkan
bagi yang menciumnya. Wanginya berubah
tergantung pada apa yang telah dimakannya.

entries.original:
"It devises various scents and emits
scents that its enemies dislike in order
to gain an edge in battle."
entries.translation_source: It devises various scents and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
entries.translated:
Ia merancang berbagai aroma dan ... aroma
yang tidak disukai musuhnya untuk
mendapatkan keuntungan dalam pertempuran.

entries.original:
"Because it eats nothing but sweets, its
fur is as sticky sweet as cotton
candy."
entries.translation_source: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy.
entries.translated:
Karena ia hanya makan makanan manis,
bulunya semanis lengket seperti gulali.

entries.original:
"It can distinguish the faintest of
scents. It puts its sense of smell to
use by helping pastry chefs."
entries.translation_source: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat membedakan aroma yang paling
samar. Ia menggunakan indra penciumannya
untuk membantu koki kue.

entries.original:
"It draws prey near with its blinking
lights and then wraps them up in its
long tentacles."
entries.translation_source: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles.
entries.translated:
Ia menarik mangsanya dengan lampu
berkedipnya lalu melilitnya dengan tentakel
panjangnya.

entries.original:
"It wields the most compelling hypnotic
powers of any Pokémon, and it forces
others to do anything."
entries.translation_source: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do anything.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki kekuatan hipnotis paling kuat
di antara Pokémon mana pun, dan ia memaksa
orang lain melakukan apa pun.

entries.original:
"Two Binacle live together on one rock.
When they fight, one of them will move
to a different rock."
entries.translation_source: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
entries.translated:
Dua Binacle tinggal bersama di satu batu.
Saat mereka bertengkar, salah satu dari
mereka akan pindah ke batu lain.

entries.original:
"When they evolve, two Binacle multiply
into seven. They fight with the power
of seven Binacle."
entries.translation_source: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
entries.translated:
Saat berevolusi, dua Binacle berkembang
biak menjadi tujuh. Mereka bertarung dengan
kekuatan tujuh Binacle.

entries.original:
"It looks just like rotten kelp. It
hides from foes while storing up power
for its evolution."
entries.translation_source: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.
entries.translated:
Ia tampak seperti rumput laut busuk. Ia
bersembunyi dari musuh sambil menyimpan
kekuatan untuk evolusinya.

entries.original:
"Tales are told of ships that wander
into seas where Dragalge live, never to
return."
entries.translation_source: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.
entries.translated:
Ada cerita tentang kapal yang tersesat ke
laut tempat Dragalge tinggal, yang tidak
pernah kembali.

entries.original:
"They knock down flying prey by firing
compressed water from their massive
claws like shooting a pistol."
entries.translation_source: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
entries.translated:
Mereka menjatuhkan mangsa yang terbang
dengan menembakkan air ... dari cakar besar
mereka seperti menembakkan pistol.

entries.original:
"Their enormous claws launch cannonballs
of water powerful enough to pierce
tanker hulls."
entries.translation_source: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
entries.translated:
Cakar raksasa mereka meluncurkan bola air
yang cukup kuat untuk menembus lambung
kapal tanker.

entries.original:
"The frills on either side of its head
have cells that generate electricity
when exposed to sunlight."
entries.translation_source: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.
entries.translated:
Embun di kedua sisi kepalanya memiliki sel
yang menghasilkan listrik saat terkena
sinar matahari.

entries.original:
"It flares its frill and generates
energy. It can generate sufficient
electricity to power a skyscraper."
entries.translation_source: It flares its frill and generates energy. It can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
entries.translated:
Ia mengembangkan embunnya dan menghasilkan
energi. Ia dapat ... cukup listrik untuk
menyalakan gedung pencakar langit.

entries.original:
"Its immense jaws have enough destructive
force to chew up an automobile. It lived
100 million years ago."
entries.translation_source: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force to chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.
entries.translated:
Rahangnya yang besar memiliki kekuatan
penghancur yang cukup untuk mengunyah
mobil. Ia hidup 100 juta tahun yang lalu.

entries.original:
"Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100
million years ago, so it behaved like a
king."
entries.translation_source: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang bisa menghentikan Pokémon
ini 100 juta tahun yang lalu, jadi ia
berperilaku seperti raja.

entries.original:
"This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land
where there were no violent predators
like Tyrantrum."
entries.translation_source: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang tenang ini hidup di daratan
dingin di mana tidak ada predator ganas
seperti Tyrantrum.

entries.original:
"This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon
has a surface temperature of around -240
degrees Fahrenheit."
entries.translation_source: This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon has a surface temperature of around -240 degrees Fahrenheit.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang biasanya tenang dan ramah ini
memiliki suhu permukaan sekitar -240
derajat Fahrenheit.

entries.original:
"It sends a soothing aura from its
ribbonlike feelers to calm fights."
entries.translation_source: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
entries.translated:
Ia mengirimkan aura yang menenangkan dari
peraba seperti pita untuk menenangkan
pertarungan.

entries.original:
"Although its body is small, its
proficient fighting skills enable it to
keep up with big bruisers."
entries.translation_source: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers.
entries.translated:
Meskipun tubuhnya kecil, kemampuan
bertarungnya yang mahir memungkinkannya
mengimbangi petarung besar.

entries.original:
"Its upper whiskers are sensors that
survey its surroundings. Its lower
whiskers shoot electricity."
entries.translation_source: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers shoot electricity.
entries.translated:
Kumis atasnya adalah sensor yang mengamati
sekelilingnya. Kumis bawahnya menembakkan
listrik.

entries.original:
"Born from temperatures and pressures
deep underground, it fires beams from
the stone in its head."
entries.translation_source: Born from temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
entries.translated:
Lahir dari suhu dan tekanan di bawah tanah,
ia menembakkan sinar dari batu di
kepalanya.

entries.original:
"It’s covered in a slimy membrane that
makes any punches or kicks slide off it
harmlessly."
entries.translation_source: It’s covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.
entries.translated:
Ia ditutupi membran berlendir yang membuat
pukulan atau tendangan apa pun meluncur
dengan aman.

entries.original:
"It crawls along sluggishly. The swirly
protrusion on its back is filled with
its brain and other organs."
entries.translation_source: It crawls along sluggishly. The swirly protrusion on its back is filled with its brain and other organs.
entries.translated:
Ia merangkak dengan lamban. Tonjolan
berputar di punggungnya berisi otak dan
organ-organ lainnya.

entries.original:
"An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if
left to itself, loneliness overcomes it,
and it oozes gooey tears."
entries.translation_source: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang sangat ramah, tetapi jika
dibiarkan sendiri, kesepian menguasainya,
dan ia mengeluarkan air mata lengket.

entries.original:
"These key collectors threaten any
attackers by fiercely jingling their
keys at them."
entries.translation_source: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
entries.translated:
Para pengumpul kunci ini mengancam
penyerang mana pun dengan menggetarkan
kunci mereka dengan ganas.

entries.original:
"It is created when a spirit possesses
rotten tree stumps. It prefers to live
in abandoned forests."
entries.translation_source: It is created when a spirit possesses rotten tree stumps. It prefers to live in abandoned forests.
entries.translated:
Ia diciptakan ketika roh merasuki tunggul
pohon busuk. Ia lebih suka tinggal di hutan
yang ditinggalkan.

entries.original:
"It can control trees at will. It will
trap people who harm the forest, so they
can never leave."
entries.translation_source: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat mengendalikan pohon sesuka hati.
Ia akan menjebak orang yang merusak hutan,
sehingga mereka tidak bisa pergi.

entries.original:
"It is said to carry wandering spirits
to the place where they belong so they
can move on."
entries.translation_source: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.
entries.translated:
Dikatakan bahwa ia membawa roh-roh yang
berkeliaran ke tempat mereka seharusnya
agar mereka bisa melanjutkan perjalanan.

entries.original:
"It enwraps its prey in its hairlike
arms. It sings joyfully as it observes
the suffering of its prey."
entries.translation_source: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.
entries.translated:
Ia melilitkan mangsanya dengan lengan
seperti rambutnya. Ia ... dengan gembira
saat mengamati penderitaan mangsanya.

entries.original:
"It blocks opponents’ attacks with the
ice that shields its body. It uses cold
air to repair any crack."
entries.translation_source: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any crack.
entries.translated:
Ia memblokir serangan lawan dengan es yang
melindungi tubuhnya. Ia menggunakan udara
dingin untuk memperbaiki retakan.

entries.original:
"The way several Bergmite huddle on its
back make it look like an aircraft
carrier made of ice."
entries.translation_source: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.
entries.translated:
Cara beberapa Bergmite berkerumun di
punggungnya membuatnya terlihat seperti
kapal induk yang terbuat dari es.

entries.original:
"They live in pitch black caves. Their
enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves
of 200,000 hertz."
entries.translation_source: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
entries.translated:
Mereka tinggal di gua yang gelap gulita.
Telinga besar mereka dapat memancarkan
gelombang ultrasonik 200.000 hertz.

entries.original:
"This hot-blooded Pokémon attacks
anything it sees with ultrasonic waves
that can crush boulders."
entries.translation_source: This hot-blooded Pokémon attacks anything it sees with ultrasonic waves that can crush boulders.
entries.translated:
Pokémon berdarah panas ini menyerang apa
pun yang ... dengan gelombang ultrasonik
yang dapat menghancurkan batu besar.

entries.original:
"When the horns on its head shine in
seven different colors, it is said to be
sharing everlasting life."
entries.translation_source: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
entries.translated:
Ketika tanduk di kepalanya bersinar dalam
tujuh warna berbeda, dikatakan ia sedang
membagikan kehidupan abadi.

entries.original:
"When its life comes to an end, it
absorbs the life energy of every living
thing and turns into a cocoon."
entries.translation_source: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon.
entries.translated:
Ketika hidupnya berakhir, ia menyerap
energi kehidupan dari setiap makhluk hidup
dan berubah menjadi kepompong.

entries.original:
"When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls
into disarray, it appears and reveals
its secret power."
entries.translation_source: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
entries.translated:
Ketika ekosistem wilayah Kalos kacau, ia
muncul dan mengungkapkan kekuatan
rahasianya.

entries.original:
"It can instantly create many diamonds
by compressing the carbon in the air
between its hands."
entries.translation_source: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat langsung menciptakan banyak
berlian dengan menekan karbon di udara di
antara tangannya.

entries.original:
"It gathers things it likes and passes
them through its loop to teleport them
to a secret place."
entries.translation_source: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.
entries.translated:
Ia mengumpulkan hal-hal yang disukainya dan
melewatkannya melalui lingkarannya untuk
memindahkannya ke tempat rahasia.

entries.original:
"It expels its internal steam from the
arms on its back. It has enough power to
blow away a mountain."
entries.translation_source: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
entries.translated:
Ia mengeluarkan uap internalnya dari lengan
di punggungnya. Kekuatannya cukup untuk
meledakkan gunung.

entries.original:
"It feels relaxed in tight, dark places
and has been known to use its Trainer’s
pocket or bag as a nest."
entries.translation_source: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer’s pocket or bag as a nest.
entries.translated:
Ia merasa rileks di tempat yang sempit dan
gelap, dan diketahui menggunakan saku atau
tas Pelatihnya sebagai sarang.

entries.original:
"It throws sharp feathers called blade
quills at enemies or prey. It seldom
misses."
entries.translation_source: It throws sharp feathers called blade quills at enemies or prey. It seldom misses.
entries.translated:
Ia melemparkan bulu tajam yang disebut duri
pedang ke musuh atau mangsa. Jarang
meleset.

entries.original:
"Although basically cool and cautious,
when it’s caught by surprise, it’s
seized by panic."
entries.translation_source: Although basically cool and cautious, when it’s caught by surprise, it’s seized by panic.
entries.translated:
Meskipun pada dasarnya tenang dan waspada,
ketika terkejut, ia dilanda kepanikan.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t allow its emotions to be
easily seen. Earning its trust takes
time. It prefers solitude."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.
entries.translated:
Ia tidak membiarkan emosinya terlihat
dengan mudah. Mendapatkan ... membutuhkan
waktu. Ia lebih menyukai kesendirian.

entries.original:
"It boasts powerful front legs. With a
single punch, it can bend an iron bar
right over."
entries.translation_source: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki kaki depan yang kuat. Dengan
satu pukulan, ia bisa membengkokkan batang
besi.

entries.original:
"When its fighting spirit is set alight,
the flames around its waist become
especially intense."
entries.translation_source: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.
entries.translated:
Ketika semangat bertarungnya berkobar, api
di sekitar pinggangnya menjadi sangat
hebat.

entries.original:
"The balloons it inflates with its nose
grow larger and larger as it practices
day by day."
entries.translation_source: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.
entries.translated:
Balon yang ditiup dengan hidungnya semakin
besar seiring latihan yang dilakukannya
setiap hari.

entries.original:
"It attacks by smacking its enemies with
the exploding water balloons that it
creates."
entries.translation_source: It attacks by smacking its enemies with the exploding water balloons that it creates.
entries.translated:
Ia menyerang dengan memukul musuh
menggunakan balon air meledak yang
diciptakannya.

entries.original:
"To Primarina, every battle is a stage.
It takes down its prey with beautiful
singing and dancing."
entries.translation_source: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.
entries.translated:
Bagi Primarina, setiap pertempuran adalah
panggung. Ia menjatuhkan mangsanya dengan
nyanyian dan tarian yang indah.

entries.original:
"It may look spindly, but its neck
muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a
tree 16 times per second!"
entries.translation_source: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
entries.translated:
Meski terlihat kurus, otot lehernya sangat
kuat. Ia bisa mematuk pohon 16 kali per
detik!

entries.original:
"It can bend the tip of its beak to
produce over a hundred different cries
at will."
entries.translation_source: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.
entries.translated:
Ia bisa membengkokkan ujung paruhnya untuk
menghasilkan lebih dari seratus suara
berbeda sesuka hati.

entries.original:
"Known for forming harmonious couples,
it is brought to wedding ceremonies as a
good luck charm."
entries.translation_source: Known for forming harmonious couples, it is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
entries.translated:
Dikenal karena membentuk pasangan yang
harmonis, ia dibawa ke upacara pernikahan
sebagai jimat keberuntungan.

entries.original:
"It prefers to eat fresh living things
so it marches down streets in search of
prey."
entries.translation_source: It prefers to eat fresh living things so it marches down streets in search of prey.
entries.translated:
Ia lebih suka memakan makhluk hidup segar,
jadi ia berbaris di jalanan untuk mencari
mangsa.

entries.original:
"Patient by nature, it loses control of
itself and pounces when it spots its
favorite meal-Rattata!"
entries.translation_source: Patient by nature, it loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal-Rattata!
entries.translated:
Sabar secara alami, ia kehilangan kendali
dan menerkam saat melihat makanan
favoritnya—Rattata!

entries.original:
"Its strong jaw enables it to scrape
trees and slurp out the sap. It normally
lives underground."
entries.translation_source: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
entries.translated:
Rahangnya yang kuat memungkinkannya
mengikis pohon dan menyedot getah. Ia
biasanya hidup di bawah tanah.

entries.original:
"From the food it digests, it generates
electricity, and it stores this energy
in its electric sac."
entries.translation_source: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.
entries.translated:
Dari makanan yang dicernanya, ia
menghasilkan listrik, dan menyimpan energi
ini di kantung listriknya.

entries.original:
"It flusters opponents with acrobatic
flying maneuvers. This creates an
opening for it to attack."
entries.translation_source: It flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to attack.
entries.translated:
Ia membingungkan lawan dengan manuver
terbang akrobatik. Ini menciptakan celah
baginya untuk menyerang.

entries.original:
"Its hard pincers are well suited to
both offense and defense."
entries.translation_source: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense.
entries.translated:
Capit kerasnya sangat cocok untuk menyerang
dan bertahan.

entries.original:
"It stores coldness in its pincers and
pummels its foes. It can even smash
thick walls of ice to bits!"
entries.translation_source: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!
entries.translated:
Ia menyimpan dingin di capitnya dan
memukuli musuh. Bahkan bisa menghancurkan
dinding es tebal berkeping-keping!

entries.original:
"This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its
passionate dance moves cause its enemies
to combust in both body and mind."
entries.translation_source: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.
entries.translated:
Oricorio ini telah menyesap nektar merah.
Gerakan tarian ... gairahnya menyebabkan
musuh terbakar baik tubuh maupun pikiran.

entries.original:
"Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the
heads of people who have auras
resembling those of flowers."
entries.translation_source: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.
entries.translated:
Banyak Cutiefly beterbangan di atas kepala
orang yang memiliki aura mirip bunga.

entries.original:
"Some of Ribombee’s pollen puffs are
highly nutritious. They are sometimes
sold as supplements."
entries.translation_source: Some of Ribombee’s pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.
entries.translated:
Beberapa gumpalan serbuk sari Ribombee
sangat bergizi. Kadang-kadang dijual
sebagai suplemen.

entries.original:
"When it rubs the rocks on its neck
against you, that’s proof of its love
for you."
entries.translation_source: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that’s proof of its love for you.
entries.translated:
Saat ia menggosokkan batu di lehernya
padamu, itu adalah bukti cintanya padamu.

entries.original:
"Well equipped with claws and fangs, it
uses the sharp rocks in its mane as
weapons."
entries.translation_source: Well equipped with claws and fangs, it uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
entries.translated:
Dilengkapi dengan cakar dan taring, ia
menggunakan batu tajam di surainya sebagai
senjata.

entries.original:
"They’re weak, so they move in schools.
However, they can also often be seen all
alone, having strayed from the school."
entries.translation_source: They’re weak, so they move in schools. However, they can also often be seen all alone, having strayed from the school.
entries.translated:
Mereka lemah, jadi mereka bergerak dalam
... mereka juga sering terlihat sendirian,
setelah terpisah dari kelompoknya.

entries.original:
"Aside from its head, its body parts
regenerate quickly if they’re cut off."
entries.translation_source: Aside from its head, its body parts regenerate quickly if they’re cut off.
entries.translated:
Selain kepalanya, bagian tubuhnya
beregenerasi dengan cepat jika terpotong.

entries.original:
"It crawls along the ocean floor on its
12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola
bits scattered in its wake."
entries.translation_source: It crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
entries.translated:
Ia merayap di dasar lautan dengan 12
kakinya. Ia meninggalkan jejak potongan
Corsola yang berserakan di belakangnya.

entries.original:
"The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves
enhances its grip and its powerful
running gait."
entries.translation_source: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
entries.translated:
Lumpur yang menempel di kuku Mudbray
meningkatkan cengkeramannya dan langkah
larinya yang kuat.

entries.original:
"It can trudge mountain roads without
rest for three days, all the while
dragging a 10-ton load."
entries.translation_source: It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat menempuh jalan gunung tanpa
istirahat selama tiga hari, sambil menyeret
beban seberat 10 ton.

entries.original:
"It crawls onto the land in search of
food. Its water bubble allows it to
breathe and protects its head."
entries.translation_source: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its head.
entries.translated:
Ia merayap ke daratan untuk mencari
makanan. Gelembung airnya memungkinkannya
bernapas dan melindungi kepalanya.

entries.original:
"It delivers headbutts with the bubble
on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked
into it, where they drown."
entries.translation_source: It delivers headbutts with the bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into it, where they drown.
entries.translated:
Ia menyeruduk dengan gelembung di
kepalanya. Pokémon kecil tersedot ke
dalamnya, di mana mereka tenggelam.

entries.original:
"It loves the sunshine. When it basks in
the sunlight regularly, it grows up
with vivid coloration."
entries.translation_source: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.
entries.translated:
Ia menyukai sinar matahari. Saat ia
berjemur di bawah sinar matahari secara
teratur, ia tumbuh dengan warna yang cerah.

entries.original:
"For self-protection, it pretends to be
a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear
keen-edged petals."
entries.translation_source: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.
entries.translated:
Untuk perlindungan diri, ia berpura-pura
menjadi Pokémon serangga. Kedua lengannya
memiliki kelopak bermata tajam.

entries.original:
"It scatters spores that flicker and
glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls
into a deep slumber."
entries.translation_source: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
entries.translated:
Ia menyebarkan spora yang berkelap-kelip
dan bercahaya. Siapa pun yang melihat
cahaya ini akan tertidur lelap.

entries.original:
"When it starts fighting for territory
with Parasect, the entire area gets
completely coated in spores!"
entries.translation_source: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!
entries.translated:
Saat mulai bertarung memperebutkan wilayah
dengan Parasect, seluruh area tertutup
seluruhnya oleh spora!

entries.original:
"It burns its bodily fluids to create a
poisonous gas. It weakens enemies and
sends them reeling with it."
entries.translation_source: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. It weakens enemies and sends them reeling with it.
entries.translated:
Ia membakar cairan tubuhnya untuk
menciptakan gas ... Ia melemahkan musuh dan
membuat mereka terhuyung-huyung karenanya.

entries.original:
"It punishes Salandit that couldn’t
bring it food with a fierce slap of its
flame-spewing palm."
entries.translation_source: It punishes Salandit that couldn’t bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.
entries.translated:
Ia menghukum Salandit yang tidak bisa
membawakannya makanan dengan ... keras dari
telapak tangannya yang menyemburkan api.

entries.original:
"Stufful hates to be hugged or touched
in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and
resist with amazing power."
entries.translation_source: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.
entries.translated:
Stufful benci dipeluk atau disentuh dengan
cara apa pun. Ia akan ... meronta, dan
melawan dengan kekuatan yang luar biasa.

entries.original:
"It boasts tremendous physical strength.
Many people call it the most dangerous
Pokémon in Alola region."
entries.translation_source: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in Alola region.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki kekuatan fisik yang luar biasa.
Banyak orang menyebutnya Pokémon paling
berbahaya di wilayah Alola.

entries.original:
"Because of its sweet, delicious aroma,
bird Pokémon are always after it."
entries.translation_source: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it.
entries.translated:
Karena aromanya yang manis dan lezat,
Pokémon burung selalu mengejarnya.

entries.original:
"It bounces around, swinging the sepals
on its head with abandon. It’s quite
painful when it smacks you!"
entries.translation_source: It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. It’s quite painful when it smacks you!
entries.translated:
Ia melompat-lompat, mengayunkan sepal di
kepalanya dengan sembarangan. Cukup
menyakitkan saat memukulmu!

entries.original:
"A master of grand and beautiful kicks,
it can knock out even kickboxing
champions with a single blow."
entries.translation_source: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.
entries.translated:
Seorang ahli tendangan yang megah dan
indah, ia bisa mengalahkan bahkan juara
kickboxing dengan satu pukulan.

entries.original:
"Baths prepared with the flowers from
its vine have a relaxing effect so it is
a hit to many people."
entries.translation_source: Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect so it is a hit to many people.
entries.translated:
Mandi yang disiapkan dengan bunga dari
sulurnya memiliki efek relaksasi sehingga
sangat populer di kalangan banyak orang.

entries.original:
"Known for its extreme intelligence, it
will look down on inexperienced
Trainers."
entries.translation_source: Known for its extreme intelligence, it will look down on inexperienced Trainers.
entries.translated:
Dikenal karena kecerdasannya yang ekstrem,
ia akan meremehkan Pelatih yang tidak
berpengalaman.

entries.original:
"They form groups of 20 individuals.
Their mutual bond is remarkable-they
will never let down a comrade."
entries.translation_source: They form groups of 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable-they will never let down a comrade.
entries.translated:
Mereka membentuk kelompok yang terdiri dari
20 individu. Ikatan timbal balik mereka
luar ... akan pernah mengecewakan kawan.

entries.original:
"An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, it
whirs its legs at high speed to run away
if anything comes near it."
entries.translation_source: An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, it whirs its legs at high speed to run away if anything comes near it.
entries.translated:
Seekor Pokémon yang sangat pengecut, ia ...
dengan kecepatan tinggi untuk melarikan
diri jika ada sesuatu yang mendekatinya.

entries.original:
"With a flashing slash of its giant
sharp claws, it cleaves seawater-or even
air-right in two."
entries.translation_source: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater-or even air-right in two.
entries.translated:
Dengan tebasan cakar tajamnya yang raksasa,
ia membelah air laut—atau bahkan
udara—menjadi dua.

entries.original:
"Born from a sand mound playfully built
by a child, this Pokémon embodies the
grudges of the departed."
entries.translation_source: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
entries.translated:
Lahir dari gundukan pasir yang dibangun
oleh seorang anak, Pokémon ini mewujudkan
dendam dari yang telah tiada.

entries.original:
"Buried beneath the castle are masses of
dried-up bones from those whose
vitality it has drained."
entries.translation_source: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.
entries.translated:
Terkubur di bawah kastil adalah tumpukan
tulang kering dari mereka yang vitalitasnya
telah dihisap.

entries.original:
"Its body is covered with slime. If you
accidentally step on it, you’ll slip,
and it will get mad at you!"
entries.translation_source: Its body is covered with slime. If you accidentally step on it, you’ll slip, and it will get mad at you!
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya ditutupi lendir. Jika kamu tidak
sengaja menginjaknya, kamu akan
tergelincir, dan ia akan marah padamu!

entries.original:
"There’s danger of its going on a
rampage, so its true power is sealed
away beneath its control mask."
entries.translation_source: There’s danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.
entries.translated:
Ada bahaya jika ia mengamuk, jadi kekuatan
sejatinya disegel di bawah topeng
kendalinya.

entries.original:
"It destroyed its own control mask. It
has become capable of changing type by
equipping special memories."
entries.translation_source: It destroyed its own control mask. It has become capable of changing type by equipping special memories.
entries.translated:
Ia menghancurkan topeng kendalinya sendiri.
Ia menjadi mampu mengubah tipe dengan
melengkapi kenangan khusus.

entries.original:
"It eats dust in the atmosphere. The
composition of the dust determines the
color of its core."
entries.translation_source: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.
entries.translated:
Ia memakan debu di atmosfer. Komposisi debu
menentukan warna intinya.

entries.original:
"It stays asleep from the moment it’s
born. When it falls into a deep sleep,
it stops moving altogether."
entries.translation_source: It stays asleep from the moment it’s born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.
entries.translated:
Ia tetap tertidur sejak saat ia lahir.
Ketika ia tertidur lelap, ia berhenti
bergerak sama sekali.

entries.original:
"It gushes fire and poisonous gases from
its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive
substance."
entries.translation_source: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance.
entries.translated:
Ia menyemburkan api dan gas beracun dari
lubang hidungnya. Kotorannya adalah zat
peledak.

entries.original:
"When it’s surprised or agitated, the 14
fur spikes on its back will stand up
involuntarily."
entries.translation_source: When it’s surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.
entries.translated:
Ketika ia terkejut atau gelisah, 14 duri
bulu di punggungnya akan berdiri tanpa
sadar.

entries.original:
"It conceals its terrifying appearance
beneath an old rag so it can get closer
to people and Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ia menyembunyikan penampilannya yang
menakutkan di balik kain lap tua sehingga
ia bisa mendekati manusia dan Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Its skin is thick enough to fend off
spikes. With its robust teeth, it
crunches up and eats the spikes."
entries.translation_source: Its skin is thick enough to fend off spikes. With its robust teeth, it crunches up and eats the spikes.
entries.translated:
Kulitnya cukup tebal untuk menangkis duri.
Dengan gigi yang kuat, ia mengunyah dan
memakan duri-duri tersebut.

entries.original:
"It appears in towns and plays with the
children. Drampa will protect kids when
they’re in danger."
entries.translation_source: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they’re in danger.
entries.translated:
Ia muncul di kota-kota dan bermain dengan
anak-anak. Drampa akan melindungi anak-anak
saat mereka dalam bahaya.

entries.original:
"It wraps its prey in green seaweed and
sucks away their vitality. It only
likes to go after big prey."
entries.translation_source: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey.
entries.translated:
Ia membungkus mangsanya dengan rumput laut
hijau dan menghisap vitalitas mereka. Ia
hanya suka mengejar mangsa yang besar.

entries.original:
"They live in mountains where no trace
of humans can be detected. It grows as
it battles others."
entries.translation_source: They live in mountains where no trace of humans can be detected. It grows as it battles others.
entries.translated:
Mereka tinggal di pegunungan di mana tidak
ada jejak manusia yang terdeteksi. Ia
tumbuh saat bertarung dengan yang lain.

entries.original:
"It leaps at its prey with a courageous
shout. Its scaly punches tear its
opponents to shreds."
entries.translation_source: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
entries.translated:
Ia menerkam mangsanya dengan teriakan
berani. Pukulan bersisiknya mencabik-cabik
lawannya.

entries.original:
"It battles valiantly with its fists,
which are armored in steel scales.
Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts."
entries.translation_source: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.
entries.translated:
Ia bertarung dengan gagah berani
menggunakan tinjunya, yang dilapisi sisik
baja. Kommo-o spesialis dalam pukulan atas.

entries.original:
"This guardian deity of Melemele summons
thunderclouds and stores their
lightning inside its body."
entries.translation_source: This guardian deity of Melemele summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
entries.translated:
Dewa pelindung Melemele ini memanggil awan
petir dan menyimpan petirnya di dalam
tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"This guardian deity of Akala is
guilelessly cruel. Its flowers’ fragrant
aroma is its source of energy."
entries.translation_source: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. Its flowers’ fragrant aroma is its source of energy.
entries.translated:
Dewa pelindung Akala ini kejam tanpa tipu
daya. Aroma harum bunganya adalah sumber
energinya.

entries.original:
"The guardian deity of Ula’ula is a lazy
Pokémon. It commands plants to
immobilize its foes."
entries.translation_source: The guardian deity of Ula’ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes.
entries.translated:
Dewa pelindung Ula{B4}ula adalah Pokémon yang
malas. Ia memerintahkan tanaman untuk
melumpuhkan musuhnya.

entries.original:
"The guardian deity of Poni can control
water. It can create pure water that
will wash away any impurity."
entries.translation_source: The guardian deity of Poni can control water. It can create pure water that will wash away any impurity.
entries.translated:
Dewa pelindung Poni dapat mengendalikan
air. Ia dapat menciptakan air murni yang
akan membersihkan segala kotoran.

entries.original:
"Its body is gaseous and frail. It
slowly grows as it collects dust from
the atmosphere."
entries.translation_source: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya gas dan rapuh. Ia perlahan tumbuh
saat mengumpulkan debu dari atmosfer.

entries.original:
"As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues
to grow. Its golden shell is
surprisingly solid."
entries.translation_source: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.
entries.translated:
Saat menyerap cahaya, Cosmoem terus tumbuh.
Cangkang emasnya ternyata sangat padat.

entries.original:
"In writings from the distant past, it’s
called by the name \qothe beast that
devours the sun.\qc"
entries.translation_source: In writings from the distant past, it’s called by the name [quote-open-1]the beast that devours the sun.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated:
Dalam tulisan dari masa lalu yang jauh, ia
disebut dengan nama \qobinatang yang melahap
matahari.\qc

entries.original:
"It sometimes summons unknown powers and
life-forms to this world from holes
that lead to other worlds."
entries.translation_source: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.
entries.translated:
Ia terkadang memanggil kekuatan dan bentuk
kehidupan yang tidak ... ke dunia ini dari
lubang yang menuju ke dunia lain.

entries.original:
"A life-form from another world, it was
dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a
strong neurotoxin."
entries.translation_source: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.
entries.translated:
Bentuk kehidupan dari dunia lain, ia
dijuluki UB dan dianggap menghasilkan
neurotoksin yang kuat.

entries.original:
"Buzzwole goes around showing off its
abnormally swollen muscles. It is one
kind of Ultra Beast."
entries.translation_source: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
entries.translated:
Buzzwole berkeliaran memamerkan ototnya
yang bengkak secara tidak normal. Ia adalah
salah satu jenis Ultra Beast.

entries.original:
"One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it
has been spotted running across the land
at terrific speeds."
entries.translation_source: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
entries.translated:
Salah satu Ultra Beast berbahaya, ia
terlihat berlari melintasi daratan dengan
kecepatan luar biasa.

entries.original:
"It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It
raided a power plant, so it energizes
itself with electricity."
entries.translation_source: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so it energizes itself with electricity.
entries.translated:
Ia muncul dari Ultra Wormhole. Ia merampok
pembangkit listrik, jadi ia mengisi energi
dengan listrik.

entries.original:
"It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole.
Witnesses observed it flying across the
sky at high speed."
entries.translation_source: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
entries.translated:
Ia muncul dari Ultra Wormhole. Saksi
mengamatinya terbang melintasi langit
dengan kecepatan tinggi.

entries.original:
"This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as
thin as paper, is like a sharpened
sword."
entries.translation_source: This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.
entries.translated:
Tubuh Ultra Beast ini, yang setipis kertas,
seperti pedang yang tajam.

entries.original:
"An unknown life-form called a UB. It
may be constantly hungry-it is certainly
always devouring something."
entries.translation_source: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry-it is certainly always devouring something.
entries.translated:
Bentuk kehidupan yang tidak dikenal disebut
UB. Ia mungkin selalu lapar—pasti selalu
melahap sesuatu.

entries.original:
"Light is the source of its energy. If
it isn’t devouring light, impurities
build up in it."
entries.translation_source: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn’t devouring light, impurities build up in it.
entries.translated:
Cahaya adalah sumber energinya. Jika tidak
melahap cahaya, kotoran menumpuk di
dalamnya.

entries.original:
"Its mechanized body is merely a vessel.
Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an
artificial soul."
entries.translation_source: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.
entries.translated:
Tubuh mekanisnya hanyalah wadah. Diri
sejatinya adalah Soul-Heart-nya, jiwa
buatan.

entries.original:
"It lurks in the shadows of others,
copying their movements and powers.
It is craven and cowering."
entries.translation_source: It lurks in the shadows of others, copying their movements and powers. It is craven and cowering.
entries.translated:
Ia mengintai di bayang-bayang orang lain,
meniru gerakan dan kekuatan mereka. Ia
pengecut dan ketakutan.

entries.original:
"This Ultra Beast is well enough liked
to be chosen as a first partner in its
own world."
entries.translation_source: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
entries.translated:
Ultra Beast ini cukup disukai untuk dipilih
sebagai partner pertama di dunianya
sendiri.

entries.original:
"It stores hundreds of liters of
poisonous liquid in its body. It is one
of the organisms known as UBs."
entries.translation_source: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid in its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
entries.translated:
Ia menyimpan ratusan liter cairan beracun
di tubuhnya. Ia adalah salah satu organisme
yang dikenal sebagai UB.

entries.original:
"When stone walls started moving and
attacking, the brute’s true identity was
this mysterious life-form."
entries.translation_source: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form.
entries.translated:
Ketika dinding batu mulai bergerak dan
menyerang, identitas ... dari makhluk kasar
ini adalah wujud kehidupan misterius.

entries.original:
"It causes explosions, then takes
advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob
them of their vitality."
entries.translation_source: It causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.
entries.translated:
Ia menyebabkan ledakan, lalu memanfaatkan
kejutan lawan untuk merampas vitalitas
mereka.

entries.original:
"It approaches its enemies at the speed
of lightning, then tears them limb from
limb with its sharp claws."
entries.translation_source: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
entries.translated:
Ia mendekati musuhnya dengan kecepatan
kilat, lalu mencabik-cabik mereka dengan
cakar tajamnya.

entries.original:
"It melts particles of iron and other
metals found in the subsoil, so it can
absorb them into its molten steel body."
entries.translation_source: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its molten steel body.
entries.translated:
Ia melelehkan partikel besi dan logam
lainnya yang ... dalam tanah, sehingga bisa
menyerapnya ke dalam tubuh baja cairnya.

entries.original:
"Revered long ago for its capacity
to create iron from nothing, it has
come back to life after 3000 years."
entries.translation_source: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, it has come back to life after 3000 years.
entries.translated:
Dihormati sejak lama karena kemampuannya
menciptakan besi dari ketiadaan, ia hidup
kembali setelah 3000 tahun.

entries.original:
"It attacks with rapid beats of its
stick. As it strikes with amazing speed,
it gets more and more pumped."
entries.translation_source: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.
entries.translated:
Ia menyerang dengan pukulan cepat dari
tongkatnya. Semakin cepat ia memukul,
semakin bersemangat ia.

entries.original:
"The faster a Thwackey can beat out a
rhythm with its two sticks, the more
respect it wins from its peers."
entries.translation_source: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
entries.translated:
Semakin cepat Thwackey memukul ritme dengan
dua tongkatnya, semakin banyak rasa hormat
yang ia dapatkan dari sesamanya.

entries.original:
"By drumming, it taps into the power of
its special tree stump. The roots of the
stump follow its direction in battle."
entries.translation_source: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
entries.translated:
Dengan memukul drum, ia mengakses kekuatan
dari tunggul pohon ... Akar tunggul itu
mengikuti perintahnya dalam pertempuran.

entries.original:
"It has special pads on the backs of
its feet, and one on its nose. Its
pads radiate tremendous heat."
entries.translation_source: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Its pads radiate tremendous heat.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki bantalan khusus di bagian
belakang kakinya, dan satu di hidungnya.
... itu memancarkan panas yang luar biasa.

entries.original:
"Its thick and fluffy fur protects it
from the cold and enables it to
use hotter fire moves."
entries.translation_source: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
entries.translated:
Bulu tebal dan halusnya melindunginya dari
dingin dan memungkinkannya menggunakan
gerakan api yang lebih panas.

entries.original:
"It gets pumped up when cheered on.
But if it starts showboating, it could put
itself in a tough spot."
entries.translation_source: It gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
entries.translated:
Ia menjadi bersemangat ketika didukung.
Tapi jika ia mulai pamer, itu bisa
membuatnya dalam posisi sulit.

entries.original:
"When it gets wet, its skin changes
color, and this Pokémon becomes
invisible as if it were camouflaged."
entries.translation_source: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
entries.translated:
Saat basah, kulitnya berubah warna, dan
Pokémon ini menjadi tidak terlihat
seolah-olah berkamuflase.

entries.original:
"Highly intelligent but also very lazy,
it keeps enemies out of its territory
by laying traps everywhere."
entries.translation_source: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
entries.translated:
Sangat cerdas tetapi juga sangat malas, ia
menjaga musuh keluar dari wilayahnya dengan
memasang jebakan di mana-mana.

entries.original:
"It picks out foes’ weak points so it
can precisely blast them with water
that shoots from its fingertips."
entries.translation_source: It picks out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips.
entries.translated:
Ia mengidentifikasi titik lemah lawan
sehingga bisa menembak mereka dengan tepat
... air yang menyembur dari ujung jarinya.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon becomes uneasy if its
cheeks are ever completely empty
of berries."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini menjadi gelisah jika pipinya
benar-benar kosong dari buah beri.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon has strong teeth and
can chew through the toughest of
berry shells."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini memiliki gigi yang kuat dan
bisa mengunyah kulit buah beri yang paling
keras sekalipun.

entries.original:
"It will bravely challenge any foe, no
matter how powerful. Even suffering
a defeat increases its strength a bit."
entries.translation_source: It will bravely challenge any foe, no matter how powerful. Even suffering a defeat increases its strength a bit.
entries.translated:
Ia akan dengan berani menantang musuh mana
pun, tidak peduli seberapa kuatnya. Bahkan
kekalahan pun sedikit ... kekuatannya.

entries.original:
"The lessons of many harsh battles
have taught it how to accurately judge
an opponent’s strength."
entries.translation_source: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.
entries.translated:
Pelajaran dari banyak pertempuran keras
telah mengajarinya cara menilai kekuatan
lawan secara akurat.

entries.original:
"The black luster of its steel body
could drive terror into the heart of
any foe."
entries.translation_source: The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
entries.translated:
Kilau hitam dari tubuh bajanya bisa
menanamkan teror di hati musuh mana pun.

entries.original:
"A constant collector of information,
this Pokémon is very smart. Very
strong is what it isn’t."
entries.translation_source: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.
entries.translated:
Pengumpul informasi yang konstan, Pokémon
ini sangat pintar. Yang tidak ia miliki
adalah kekuatan.

entries.original:
"As it grows inside its shell, it uses
its psychic abilities to monitor its
surroundings and wait for evolution."
entries.translation_source: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor its surroundings and wait for evolution.
entries.translated:
Saat tumbuh di dalam cangkangnya, ia
menggunakan ... psikisnya untuk memantau
sekelilingnya dan menunggu evolusi.

entries.original:
"It’s famous for its high intelligence,
and the large size of its brain is proof
that it has immense psychic power."
entries.translation_source: It’s famous for its high intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it has immense psychic power.
entries.translated:
Ia terkenal karena ... tinggi, dan ukuran
otaknya yang besar adalah bukti bahwa ia
memiliki kekuatan psikis yang luar biasa.

entries.original:
"Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it
silently raids the food stores of others.
It survives off its ill-gotten gains."
entries.translation_source: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of others. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
entries.translated:
Dibantu oleh bantalan lembut di kakinya, ia
diam-diam merampok ... milik orang lain. Ia
bertahan hidup dari hasil curiannya.

entries.original:
"With a lithe body and sharp claws, it
goes around stealing food and eggs.
It secretly marks its future targets."
entries.translation_source: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. It secretly marks its future targets.
entries.translated:
Dengan tubuh yang lentur dan cakar yang
tajam, ia berkeliling mencuri makanan dan
telur. Ia diam-diam ... masa depannya.

entries.original:
"It anchors itself in the ground and
basks in the sun. After absorbing
enough sunlight, it blooms vividly."
entries.translation_source: It anchors itself in the ground and basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, it blooms vividly.
entries.translated:
Ia menancapkan dirinya di tanah dan
berjemur di bawah sinar ... menyerap cukup
sinar matahari, ia mekar dengan indah.

entries.original:
"The seeds attached to its cotton fluff
are full of nutrients. It spreads them on
the wind so that others can benefit."
entries.translation_source: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that others can benefit.
entries.translated:
Biji-biji yang menempel pada bulu kapasnya
penuh dengan nutrisi. Ia ... ke angin agar
orang lain dapat merasakan manfaatnya.

entries.original:
"If its fleece grows too long, it won’t
be able to move. Cloth made with
its wool is surprisingly durable."
entries.translation_source: If its fleece grows too long, it won’t be able to move. Cloth made with its wool is surprisingly durable.
entries.translated:
Jika bulunya tumbuh terlalu panjang, ia
tidak akan bisa bergerak. Kain yang dibuat
dari wolnya ternyata sangat tahan lama.

entries.original:
"Its majestic horns are meant only to
impress the opposite gender. They
never see use in battle."
entries.translation_source: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
entries.translated:
Tanduknya yang megah hanya dimaksudkan
untuk menarik lawan jenis. Tanduk itu tidak
pernah digunakan dalam pertempuran.

entries.original:
"Apparently the itch of its teething
impels it to snap its jaws at anything
in front of it."
entries.translation_source: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
entries.translated:
Rupanya rasa gatal karena pertumbuhan
giginya mendorongnya untuk menggigit apa
pun yang ada di depannya.

entries.original:
"With jaws that can shear through steel
rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon
chomps down on its unfortunate prey."
entries.translation_source: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
entries.translated:
Dengan rahang yang dapat memotong batang
baja, Pokémon yang sangat agresif ini
menggigit mangsanya yang malang.

entries.original:
"This greedy Pokémon only helps people
with their work because it wants treats.
As it runs, it crackles with electricity."
entries.translation_source: This greedy Pokémon only helps people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang rakus ini hanya membantu orang
dalam pekerjaan mereka karena ia ... Saat
berlari, ia berderak dengan listrik.

entries.original:
"It sends electricity through its legs
to boost their strength. Running at
top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph."
entries.translation_source: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.
entries.translated:
Ia mengalirkan listrik melalui kakinya
untuk meningkatkan ... dengan kecepatan
maksimal, ia dengan mudah mencapai 50 mph.

entries.original:
"It can race around like a unicycle,
even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning
coal sustains it."
entries.translation_source: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
entries.translated:
Ia dapat berlari kencang seperti sepeda
roda satu, bahkan di medan berbatu yang
kasar. Batubara yang terbakar menopangnya.

entries.original:
"By rapidly rolling its legs, it can
easily travel at over 18 mph. It
forms coal inside its body."
entries.translation_source: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can easily travel at over 18 mph. It forms coal inside its body.
entries.translated:
Dengan memutar kakinya dengan cepat, ia
dapat dengan mudah ... lebih dari 18 mph.
Ia membentuk batubara di dalam tubuhnya.

entries.original:
"While engaged in battle, its mountain
of coal will burn bright red, scorching
the surrounding area with sparks."
entries.translation_source: While engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, scorching the surrounding area with sparks.
entries.translated:
Saat bertarung, gunungan batubaranya akan
terbakar merah terang, membakar area
sekitarnya dengan percikan api.

entries.original:
"As soon as it’s born, it burrows into
an apple. the flavor of the apple is
what determines its evolution."
entries.translation_source: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. the flavor of the apple is what determines its evolution.
entries.translated:
Begitu lahir, ia masuk ke dalam sebuah
apel. Rasa apel itulah yang menentukan
evolusinya.

entries.original:
"It ate a sour apple, which induced its
evolution. It stores an acid capable of
causing chemical burns in its cheeks."
entries.translation_source: It ate a sour apple, which induced its evolution. It stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns in its cheeks.
entries.translated:
Ia memakan apel asam, yang memicu
evolusinya. Ia menyimpan asam yang dapat
menyebabkan luka bakar kimia di pipinya.

entries.original:
"It ate a sweet apple, which induced
its evolution. Back in the day, children
used to have it as a snack."
entries.translation_source: It ate a sweet apple, which induced its evolution. Back in the day, children used to have it as a snack.
entries.translated:
Ia memakan apel manis, yang memicu
evolusinya. Di masa lalu, anak-anak biasa
memakannya sebagai camilan.

entries.original:
"It spews sand from its nostrils. While
the enemy is blinded, it burrows into
the ground to hide."
entries.translation_source: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
entries.translated:
Ia menyemburkan pasir dari lubang
hidungnya. Saat musuh buta, ia menggali ke
dalam tanah untuk bersembunyi.

entries.original:
"When it contracts its body, over 220
pounds of sand sprays from its nose.
It becomes disheartened if it runs out."
entries.translation_source: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. It becomes disheartened if it runs out.
entries.translated:
Saat mengerutkan tubuhnya, lebih dari 220
pon pasir menyembur dari hidungnya. Ia
menjadi sedih jika kehabisan pasir.

entries.original:
"This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda
whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake
and tries to swallow other Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow other Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Pokémon lapar ini menelan Arrokuda utuh.
Kadang-kadang, ia melakukan kesalahan dan
mencoba menelan Pokémon lain.

entries.original:
"It becomes extremely sluggish after
eating its fill. That’s when Cramorant
swallows it up."
entries.translation_source: It becomes extremely sluggish after eating its fill. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.
entries.translated:
Ia menjadi sangat lamban setelah kenyang.
Saat itulah Cramorant menelannya.

entries.original:
"Its jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and
as strong as steel. It spins its tail fins
to surge forward at over 100 knots."
entries.translation_source: Its jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. It spins its tail fins to surge forward at over 100 knots.
entries.translated:
Rahangnya setajam tombak dan sekokoh baja.
Ia memutar sirip ekornya untuk melesat maju
dengan kecepatan lebih dari 100 knot.

entries.original:
"It manipulates the chemical makeup of
its poison to produce electricity. Despite
a weak voltage, it can cause paralysis."
entries.translation_source: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. Despite a weak voltage, it can cause paralysis.
entries.translated:
Ia memanipulasi komposisi kimia racunnya
untuk menghasilkan ... Meskipun tegangannya
lemah, ia dapat menyebabkan kelumpuhan.

entries.original:
"This short-tempered and aggressive
Pokémon chugs stagnant water to
absorb any toxins it might contain."
entries.translation_source: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang pemarah dan agresif ini
menenggak air tergenang untuk ... racun apa
pun yang mungkin terkandung di dalamnya.

entries.original:
"It stores flammable gas in its body
and uses it to generate heat. It then
coils around its prey and cooks it."
entries.translation_source: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. It then coils around its prey and cooks it.
entries.translated:
Ia menyimpan gas yang mudah terbakar di
dalam tubuhnya ... menghasilkan panas. Ia
kemudian melilit mangsanya dan memasaknya.

entries.original:
"This excessively hostile Pokémon has
large and very sharp fangs in addition
to its dangerous burning body. "
entries.translation_source: This excessively hostile Pokémon has large and very sharp fangs in addition to its dangerous burning body.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang sangat bermusuhan ini memiliki
taring besar dan sangat tajam selain
tubuhnya yang terbakar dan berbahaya.

entries.original:
"It’s very curious, but its means of
investigating things is to try to punch
them with its tentacles."
entries.translation_source: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles.
entries.translated:
Ia sangat penasaran, tetapi cara
menyelidiki sesuatu adalah dengan mencoba
memukulnya dengan tentakelnya.

entries.original:
"Searching for an opponent to test its
skills against, it emerges onto land. Once
the battle is over, it returns to the sea."
entries.translation_source: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
entries.translated:
Mencari lawan untuk menguji kemampuannya,
ia muncul ke darat. Setelah pertarungan
selesai, ia kembali ke laut.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon is said to have been
born when a lonely spirit possessed
a cold, leftover cup of tea."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
entries.translated:
