Pokémon ini dikatakan lahir ketika roh
kesepian merasuki secangkir teh dingin yang
tersisa.

entries.original:
"This species lives in antique teapots.
Most pots are forgeries, but on rare
occasions, an authentic work is found."
entries.translation_source: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
entries.translated:
Spesies ini hidup di teko antik. Sebagian
besar teko adalah palsu, tetapi pada
kesempatan langka, karya asli ditemukan.

entries.original:
"Via the protrusion on its head, it
senses other creatures’ emotions.
It prefers areas without people."
entries.translation_source: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. It prefers areas without people.
entries.translated:
Melalui tonjolan di kepalanya, ia merasakan
emosi makhluk lain. Ia lebih suka area
tanpa orang.

entries.original:
"No matter who you are, if you bring
strong emotions near this Pokémon,
it will silence you violently."
entries.translation_source: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli siapa Anda, jika Anda membawa
emosi kuat di dekat Pokémon ini, ia akan
membungkam Anda dengan keras.

entries.original:
"Known as the Forest Witch, if you are
too loud around it, you risk being torn
apart by the claws on its tentacle."
entries.translation_source: Known as the Forest Witch, if you are too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle.
entries.translated:
Dikenal sebagai Penyihir Hutan, jika Anda
terlalu ... di dekatnya, Anda berisiko
dicabik-cabik oleh cakar di tentakelnya.

entries.original:
"It sneaks into people’s homes, taking
and feasting on the negative energy
of the frustrated occupants."
entries.translation_source: It sneaks into people’s homes, taking and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
entries.translated:
Ia menyelinap ke rumah orang, mengambil dan
memakan energi negatif dari penghuni yang
frustrasi.

entries.original:
"With sly cunning, it lures people into
the woods. Some believe it to have
the power to make crops grow."
entries.translation_source: With sly cunning, it lures people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.
entries.translated:
Dengan kelicikan, ia memikat orang ke dalam
hutan. Beberapa percaya ia memiliki
kekuatan untuk membuat tanaman tumbuh.

entries.original:
"Its hairs work like muscle fibers.
When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to
foes, ensnaring them like tentacles."
entries.translation_source: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to foes, ensnaring them like tentacles.
entries.translated:
Rambutnya bekerja seperti serat otot. Saat
rambutnya terbuka, mereka menempel pada
musuh, menjerat mereka seperti tentakel.

entries.original:
"It evolved after experiencing numerous
fights. While crossing its arms, it lets
out a shout that’d make anyone flinch."
entries.translation_source: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that’d make anyone flinch.
entries.translated:
Ia berevolusi setelah mengalami banyak
pertarungan. Sambil menyilangkan tangan,
... yang bisa membuat siapa pun tersentak.

entries.original:
"What appears to be an iron helmet is
actually hardened hair. This Pokémon
lives for the thrill of battle."
entries.translation_source: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
entries.translated:
Apa yang tampak seperti helm besi
sebenarnya adalah rambut yang mengeras.
Pokémon ini hidup untuk sensasi bertarung.

entries.original:
"Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body
surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff
as stone if you touch it."
entries.translation_source: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati dengan tubuh ektoplasma yang
mengelilingi jiwanya. Anda akan menjadi
kaku seperti batu jika menyentuhnya.

entries.original:
"After deflecting attacks with its hard
leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp
leek stalk. "
entries.translation_source: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk.
entries.translated:
Setelah membelokkan serangan dengan perisai
daunnya yang keras, ia membalas dengan
tangkai daun bawangnya yang tajam.

entries.original:
"Its amusing movements make it very
popular. It releases its psychic power
from the pattern on its belly."
entries.translation_source: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
entries.translated:
Gerakannya yang lucu membuatnya sangat
populer. Ia melepaskan kekuatan psikisnya
dari pola di perutnya.

entries.original:
"Never touch its shadowlike body, or
you’ll be shown the horrific memories
behind the picture carved into it."
entries.translation_source: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
entries.translated:
Jangan pernah menyentuh tubuhnya yang
seperti bayangan, atau kau ... mengerikan
di balik gambar yang terukir di dalamnya.

entries.original:
"They say that any patisserie visited
by Milcery is guaranteed success and
good fortune."
entries.translation_source: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
entries.translated:
Konon, toko kue mana pun yang dikunjungi
Milcery pasti akan sukses dan beruntung.

entries.original:
"It evolved from a Milcery that held
onto a Strawberry Sweet. Its flavor
depends on how it was mixed."
entries.translation_source: It evolved from a Milcery that held onto a Strawberry Sweet. Its flavor depends on how it was mixed.
entries.translated:
Ia berevolusi dari Milcery yang memegang
Strawberry Sweet. Rasanya tergantung pada
cara pencampurannya.

entries.original:
"The six of them work together as one.
Teamwork is also their battle strategy,
and they constantly change formation."
entries.translation_source: The six of them work together as one. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change formation.
entries.translated:
Keenamnya bekerja sama sebagai satu
kesatuan. Kerja sama tim juga ... mereka,
dan mereka terus-menerus mengubah formasi.

entries.original:
"It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth
to scrape it off rocks. Electric current
flows from the tips of its spines."
entries.translation_source: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
entries.translated:
Ia memakan rumput laut, menggunakan giginya
untuk mengikisnya dari bebatuan. Arus
listrik mengalir dari ujung durinya.

entries.original:
"It eats snow that piles up on the
ground. The more snow it eats, the
bigger its spikes grow."
entries.translation_source: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger its spikes grow.
entries.translated:
Ia memakan salju yang menumpuk di tanah.
Semakin banyak salju yang dimakan, semakin
besar durinya tumbuh.

entries.original:
"Icy scales fall from its wings
like snow as it flies over fields
and mountains."
entries.translation_source: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains.
entries.translated:
Sisik es berjatuhan dari sayapnya seperti
salju saat ia terbang melintasi ladang dan
gunung.

entries.original:
"Once a year, on a specific date and
at a specific time, they gather out of
nowhere and form up in a circle."
entries.translation_source: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
entries.translated:
Setahun sekali, pada tanggal dan waktu
tertentu, mereka berkumpul entah dari mana
dan membentuk lingkaran.

entries.original:
"It drifted in on the flow of ocean
waters from a frigid place. It keeps its
head iced constantly to stay cold."
entries.translation_source: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to stay cold.
entries.translated:
Ia terbawa arus air laut dari tempat yang
sangat dingin. Ia terus membekukan
kepalanya agar tetap dingin.

entries.original:
"Through its horns, it can pick up on the
emotions of creatures around it. Males
will act as valets for those they serve."
entries.translation_source: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Males will act as valets for those they serve.
entries.translated:
Melalui tanduknya, ia dapat merasakan emosi
makhluk di ... akan bertindak sebagai
pelayan bagi mereka yang dilayaninya.

entries.original:
"As it eats the seeds stored up in its
pouches, it generates electricity while
satisfying its constant hunger."
entries.translation_source: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pouches, it generates electricity while satisfying its constant hunger.
entries.translated:
Saat memakan biji-bijian yang tersimpan di
kantongnya, ia ... listrik sambil memuaskan
rasa laparnya yang terus-menerus.

entries.original:
"If a job requires serious strength,
Cufant will excel at it. Its copper body
tarnishes in the rain, turning green."
entries.translation_source: If a job requires serious strength, Cufant will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning green.
entries.translated:
Jika suatu pekerjaan ... Cufant akan unggul
dalam hal itu. Tubuh tembaganya ternoda di
tengah hujan, berubah menjadi hijau.

entries.original:
"These Pokémon live in herds. Their
trunks have incredible grip strength,
strong enough to crush giant rocks."
entries.translation_source: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks.
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini hidup dalam kawanan. Belalai
mereka memiliki ... yang luar biasa, cukup
kuat untuk menghancurkan batu raksasa.

entries.original:
"The powerful muscles in its tail
generate its electricity. Its upper half
is entirely too small. "
entries.translation_source: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Its upper half is entirely too small.
entries.translated:
Otot-otot kuat di ekornya menghasilkan
listrik. Bagian atasnya terlalu kecil.

entries.original:
"The shaking of its freezing upper half
is what generates its electricity. It has
a hard time walking around."
entries.translation_source: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
entries.translated:
Gemetaran bagian atasnya yang membekukan
itulah yang menghasilkan listriknya. Ia
kesulitan berjalan-jalan.

entries.original:
"Its mighty legs are capable of running
at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but it can’t
breathe unless it’s underwater."
entries.translation_source: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but it can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
entries.translated:
Kakinya yang perkasa mampu berlari dengan
kecepatan melebihi 40 mph, tetapi ia tidak
bisa bernapas kecuali di dalam air.

entries.original:
"The skin on its face is impervious
to attack, but breathing difficulties
made it go extinct anyway."
entries.translation_source: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made it go extinct anyway.
entries.translated:
Kulit di wajahnya kebal terhadap serangan,
tetapi kesulitan bernapas tetap membuatnya
punah.

entries.original:
"Its body resembles polished metal,
and it’s both lightweight and strong.
However, its body rusts easily."
entries.translation_source: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. However, its body rusts easily.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya menyerupai logam yang dipoles, dan
ringan serta kuat. Namun, tubuhnya mudah
berkarat.

entries.original:
"After being reborn as a ghost, Dreepy
wanders the areas it used to inhabit back
when it was alive in prehistoric seas."
entries.translation_source: After being reborn as a ghost, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
entries.translated:
Setelah terlahir kembali sebagai hantu,
Dreepy berkeliaran di area yang dulu ...
saat masih hidup di lautan prasejarah.

entries.original:
"It’s capable of flying faster than 120
mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and
dotes on them until they evolve."
entries.translation_source: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they evolve.
entries.translated:
Ia mampu terbang lebih cepat dari 120 mph.
Ia bertarung bersama Dreepy dan menyayangi
mereka hingga mereka berevolusi.

entries.original:
"Apparently the Dreepy inside its horns
eagerly look forward to being launched
out at Mach speeds."
entries.translation_source: Apparently the Dreepy inside its horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
entries.translated:
Rupanya Dreepy di dalam tanduknya sangat
menantikan untuk diluncurkan dengan
kecepatan Mach.

entries.original:
"It has slumbered for many years. Some
say it is Zamazenta’s elder sister,
others say the two are rivals."
entries.translation_source: It has slumbered for many years. Some say it is Zamazenta’s elder sister, others say the two are rivals.
entries.translated:
Ia telah tertidur selama bertahun-tahun.
Ada yang mengatakan ia adalah ... ada pula
yang mengatakan keduanya adalah rival.

entries.original:
"It slept for aeons while in the form
of a statue. It was asleep for so long,
people forgot that it ever existed."
entries.translation_source: It slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
entries.translated:
Ia tidur selama ribuan tahun dalam wujud
patung. Ia tertidur begitu lama sehingga
orang-orang lupa bahwa ia pernah ada.

entries.original:
"It was inside a meteorite that fell
20,000 years ago. The energy that
its core absorbs allows it to live."
entries.translation_source: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. The energy that its core absorbs allows it to live.
entries.translated:
Ia berada di dalam meteorit yang jatuh
20.000 tahun lalu. Energi yang diserap
intinya memungkinkannya untuk hidup.

entries.original:
"If it pulls the long white hair on its
head, its fighting spirit heightens and
power wells up from deep in its belly."
entries.translation_source: If it pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from deep in its belly.
entries.translated:
Jika ia menarik rambut putih panjang di
kepalanya, semangat bertarungnya meningkat
dan kekuatan muncul dari dalam perutnya.

entries.original:
"Inhabiting the mountains of a distant
region, it races across sheer cliffs,
training its legs and refining its moves."
entries.translation_source: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, it races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
entries.translated:
Mendiami pegunungan di daerah yang jauh, ia
berlari melintasi tebing curam, melatih
kakinya dan menyempurnakan jurusnya.

entries.original:
"Once the vines on its body tear off,
they become nutrients in the soil. This
helps the plants of the forest grow."
entries.translation_source: Once the vines on its body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
entries.translated:
Begitu sulur di tubuhnya terlepas, mereka
menjadi nutrisi di tanah. Ini membantu
tanaman hutan tumbuh.

entries.original:
"Its entire body is made of an organ that
generates electricity. It is capable of
generating a region’s worth of electricity."
entries.translation_source: Its entire body is made of an organ that generates electricity. It is capable of generating a region’s worth of electricity.
entries.translated:
Seluruh tubuhnya terbuat dari organ yang
menghasilkan listrik. Ia mampu menghasilkan
listrik sebesar satu wilayah.

entries.original:
"Its body is composed of crystallized
dragon energy. It is said to contain the
power of every Dragon Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. It is said to contain the power of every Dragon Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Tubuhnya terdiri dari energi naga yang
mengkristal. Konon ia mengandung kekuatan
setiap Pokémon Naga.

entries.original:
"Glastrier has tremendous physical
strength. The mask covering its face is
100 times stronger than diamond."
entries.translation_source: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength. The mask covering its face is 100 times stronger than diamond.
entries.translated:
Glastrier memiliki kekuatan fisik yang luar
biasa. Topeng yang menutupi wajahnya 100
kali lebih kuat dari berlian.

entries.original:
"As it dashes through the night, it
absorbs the life energy of sleeping
Pokémon. It craves silence and solitude."
entries.translation_source: As it dashes through the night, it absorbs the life energy of sleeping Pokémon. It craves silence and solitude.
entries.translated:
Saat ia melesat di malam hari, ia menyerap
energi ... Pokémon yang sedang tidur. Ia
mendambakan kesunyian dan kesendirian.

entries.original:
"Its every move is filled with grace and
dignity. Extremely intelligent, it is said
to see past, present, and future events."
entries.translation_source: Its every move is filled with grace and dignity. Extremely intelligent, it is said to see past, present, and future events.
entries.translated:
Setiap gerakannya dipenuhi dengan
keanggunan dan martabat. Sangat cerdas, ia
... masa lalu, sekarang, dan masa depan.

entries.original:
"The fur shed from its beard retains heat
well and is a highly useful material for
winter clothing."
entries.translation_source: The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
entries.translated:
Bulu yang rontok dari janggutnya menahan
panas dengan baik dan ... bahan yang sangat
berguna untuk pakaian musim dingin.

entries.original:
"A violent creature that fells towering
trees with its crude axes and shields
itself with hard stone."
entries.translation_source: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone.
entries.translated:
Makhluk ganas yang menebang pohon-pohon
menjulang dengan kapak kasarnya dan
melindungi dirinya dengan batu keras.

entries.original:
"Swampy terrain gave Ursaluna its burly
physique and newfound capacity to
manipulate peat at will."
entries.translation_source: Swampy terrain gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
entries.translated:
Medan rawa memberikan Ursaluna fisik kekar
dan kemampuan baru untuk memanipulasi
gambut sesuka hati.

entries.original:
"It clads itself in the souls of comrades
that perished before fulfilling their
goals of journeying upstream."
entries.translation_source: It clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream.
entries.translated:
Ia melapisi dirinya dengan jiwa rekan-rekan
yang gugur sebelum memenuhi tujuan
perjalanan ke hulu.

entries.original:
"It has virulent poison and daunting
physical prowess. Preferring solitude,
this species does not form packs."
entries.translation_source: It has virulent poison and daunting physical prowess. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
entries.translated:
Ia memiliki racun ganas dan kemampuan fisik
yang menakutkan. Lebih suka menyendiri,
spesies ini tidak membentuk kelompok.

entries.original:
"Its lancelike spikes and savage
temperament have earned it the
nickname \qosea fiend.\qc"
entries.translation_source: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname [quote-open-1]sea fiend.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated:
Duri seperti tombak dan temperamen buasnya
membuatnya mendapat julukan \qoiblis laut.\qc

entries.original:
"According to legend, this Pokémon’s love
gives rise to the budding of fresh life
across the land."
entries.translation_source: According to legend, this Pokémon’s love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across the land.
entries.translated:
Menurut legenda, cinta Pokémon ini
memunculkan tunas kehidupan baru di seluruh
daratan.

entries.original:
"When the sun goes down, it becomes
active. It runs around town on a chase
for good food for its boss-Raticate."
entries.translation_source: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for its boss-Raticate.

entries.original:
"It makes its Rattata underlings gather
food for it, dining solely on the most
nutritious and delicious fare."
entries.translation_source: It makes its Rattata underlings gather food for it, dining solely on the most nutritious and delicious fare.

entries.original:
"It focuses psychic energy into its tail
and rides it like it’s surfing. Another
name for this Pokémon is \qohodad.\qc"
entries.translation_source: It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it’s surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is [quote-open-1]hodad.[quote-close-2]

entries.original:
"It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel
shell is very hard-so much so, it can’t
roll its body up into a ball."
entries.translation_source: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard-so much so, it can’t roll its body up into a ball.

entries.original:
"It runs across snow-covered plains at
high speeds. It developed thick, sharp
claws to plow through the snow."
entries.translation_source: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

entries.original:
"In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice
shards with its six tails and sprays
them around to cool itself off."
entries.translation_source: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

entries.original:
"It lives on mountains perpetually
covered in snow and is revered as a
deity incarnate."
entries.translation_source: It lives on mountains perpetually covered in snow and is revered as a deity incarnate.

entries.original:
"Its golden hairs function as sensors.
It pokes them out of its burrow to
monitor its surroundings."
entries.translation_source: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.

entries.original:
"Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so
it’s not very fast, but it has the
power to dig through bedrock."
entries.translation_source: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it’s not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.

entries.original:
"It’s impulsive, selfish, and fickle.
It’s very popular with Trainers who
like giving it the attention it needs."
entries.translation_source: It’s impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It’s very popular with Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

entries.original:
"These daring Pokémon have coins on
their foreheads. Darker coins are harder,
and harder coins garner more respect."
entries.translation_source: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect.

entries.original:
"It has the classiest coat. The rippling
of its fur in the heat of battle has a
beauty all its own."
entries.translation_source: It has the classiest coat. The rippling of its fur in the heat of battle has a beauty all its own.

entries.original:
"Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand
attaches firmly to the portions of its
body that are particularly magnetic."
entries.translation_source: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

entries.original:
"Graveler’s entire body is tinged with
electricity due to the stones it likes
to eat. It’s very quick-tempered."

who want to battle. The battery
charges while traveling."

entries.translated:
Perangkat yang menunjukkan Pelatih
yang ingin bertarung. Baterainya

entries.original:
"Rare leaves with a horrible smell.
They are very popular among
certain groups of people."
entries.translation_source: Rare leaves with a horrible smell. They are very popular among certain groups of people.

entries.original:
"A case that holds TMs and HMs.

sector for important items."

entries.translated:
Kotak yang menyimpan TM dan HM.
Disimpan di sektor Kubus untuk
barang penting.

entries.original:
"A pouch for carrying Berries.

entries.translated:

entries.original:
"A machine that can be used in place
of HMs. It also mines underwater or
in the KBT Expressway (uses \btn03)."

entries.original:
"A notebook containing research on
Pokémon moves. Inside it’s marked
\qoProperty of Prof. Log’s Aide\qc."
entries.translation_source: A notebook containing research on Pokémon moves. Inside it’s marked [quote-open-1]Property of Prof. Log’s Aide[quote-close-2].

entries.original:
"A device that allows you to access
the Pokémon storage system. There
are some places where it won’t work."
entries.translation_source: A device that allows you to access the Pokémon storage system. There are some places where it won’t work.

entries.original:
"A device used to find Trainers
eager for battle in Borrius. It
also keeps a record of their teams."
entries.translation_source: A device used to find Trainers eager for battle in Borrius. It also keeps a record of their teams.
entries.translated:
Perangkat yang digunakan untuk menemukan
Trainer yang bersemangat bertarung di

entries.original:
"A ticket required to board the ship
to Glimmer Isle.
It sparkles in the moonlight."
entries.translation_source: A ticket required to board the ship to Glimmer Isle. It sparkles in the moonlight.
entries.translated:
Tiket yang diperlukan untuk naik
kapal ke Glimmer Isle. Tiket ini

entries.original:
"Holding it is said to increase the
chance of getting a critical catch.
Curiously, it doesn’t shake much."
entries.translation_source: Holding it is said to increase the chance of getting a critical catch. Curiously, it doesn’t shake much.

entries.original:
"A jar for storing BERRY POWDER

entries.translation_source: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.
entries.translated:
Sebuah toples untuk menyimpan

entries.original:
"A feather that glows like the moon.
It is said to possess the power to

entries.translation_source: A feather that glows like the moon. It is said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.

entries.original:
"A card needed for entering the inn

entries.translation_source: A card needed for entering the inn in Tarmigan Town. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 30 years ago.

entries.original:
"The foe is infested and
attacked for four to
five turns. The target
can’t flee during this."
entries.translation_source: The foe is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can’t flee during this.

"Striking opponents over
and over makes the user’s
fists harder. This
increases the Atk stat."

"The area around the user

poison those hit."

"The user swings its body

inflict damage on

"A strong wind blows away

membuka jalan ke Maxima.

Dan aku pikir aku bisa menangkap
siapa pun.

memancing.

entries.translated:
Aku benar-benar tidak tahu harus
berbuat apa. Setiap beberapa hari,\lPokémon yang mengerikan ini masuk

ke rumahku dan mencuri makananku.
Jika aku punya Pokédex, aku bisa\ltahu apa itu dan cara

menghentikannya\.

entries.original:
"There are some items that exist
soley to be sold.

If you get one of those items, you
should sell it immediately.

I’ve even heard that there are
some maniacs out there who’ll buy\lthose items for an even higher\lamount than Poké Marts."
entries.translation_source: There are some items that exist soley to be sold. If you get one of those items, you should sell it immediately. I’ve even heard that there are some maniacs out there who’ll buy those items for an even higher amount than Poké Marts.
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa item yang hanya ada
untuk dijual. Jika kamu mendapatkan\lsalah satu dari item tersebut, kamu

harus segera menjualnya. Aku bahkan
mendengar bahwa ada beberapa maniak\ldi luar sana yang akan membeli

item-item tersebut dengan harga
yang lebih tinggi daripada di Poké\lMart.

entries.original:
"My grandfather survived the
meteorite lots of years ago!

He’s so cool!"
entries.translation_source: My grandfather survived the meteorite lots of years ago! He’s so cool!
entries.translated:
Kakekku selamat dari meteorit
bertahun-tahun yang lalu! Dia\lsangat keren!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, uses
Pokémon that can be found in\l[green]Flower Paradise[blue].

Catching some good Ice-type
Pokémon from [green]Icicle Cave [blue]can\lreally give you the edge against\lhim."
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, uses Pokémon that can be found in [color-green-1]Flower Paradise[color-blue-2]. Catching some good Ice-type Pokémon from [color-green-3]Icicle Cave [color-blue-4]can really give you the edge against him.
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, Mirskle, menggunakan
Pokémon yang dapat ditemukan di\l[green]Flower Paradise[blue]. Menangkap beberapa

Pokémon tipe Es yang bagus dari
[green]Icicle Cave [blue]benar-benar dapat\lmemberimu keunggulan melawannya.

entries.original:
"Repel not only keeps bugs away,
it also works on weak Pokémon.

Put your strongest Pokémon at the
left of the Pokémon List.

If your first Pokémon is strong,
Repel’s effect is boosted."
entries.translation_source: Repel not only keeps bugs away, it also works on weak Pokémon. Put your strongest Pokémon at the left of the Pokémon List. If your first Pokémon is strong, Repel’s effect is boosted.
entries.translated:
Pengusir tidak hanya mengusir
serangga, tetapi juga bekerja pada\lPokémon lemah. Tempatkan Pokémon

terkuatmu di sebelah kiri Daftar
Pokémon. Jika Pokémon pertamamu\lkuat, efek Pengusir akan meningkat.

entries.original:
"You should try to beat as many
Pokémon Gyms as possible.

Poké Marts will sell more items to
you if you have more badges."
entries.translation_source: You should try to beat as many Pokémon Gyms as possible. Poké Marts will sell more items to you if you have more badges.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus mencoba untuk
mengalahkan sebanyak mungkin Gym\lPokémon. Poké Mart akan menjual

lebih banyak barang kepadamu jika
kamu memiliki lebih banyak lencana.

entries.original:
"This town is fairly quiet.

Not that many enjoy hanging around
a town in the middle of a forest."
entries.translation_source: This town is fairly quiet. Not that many enjoy hanging around a town in the middle of a forest.
entries.translated:
Kota ini cukup sepi. Tidak banyak
yang menikmati berada di kota yang\lterletak di tengah hutan.

entries.original:
"Yo, yo!
I am the official [green]Name Rater[blue]!

Want me to rate the nicknames of
your Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Yo, yo! I am the official [color-green-1]Name Rater[color-blue-2]! Want me to rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Yo, yo! Aku adalah [green]Penilai Nama[blue]
resmi! Mau aku menilai nama\lpanggilan Pokémon-mu?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon’s nickname should
I see?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon’s nickname should I see?
entries.translated:
Nama panggilan Pokémon mana yang
harus kulihat?

entries.original:
"[buffer1], is it?
That is a gucci nickname!

But, would you like me to give it
a swag name?

How about it?"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1], is it? That is a gucci nickname! But, would you like me to give it a swag name? How about it?
entries.translated:
[buffer1], ya? Itu nama panggilan
yang gucci! Tapi, mau aku\lmemberinya nama yang swag?

Bagaimana?

entries.original:
"Cool. Then, what should the new
nickname be?"
entries.translation_source: Cool. Then, what should the new nickname be?
entries.translated:
Keren. Lalu, apa nama panggilan
barunya?

entries.original:
"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

It’s a way better name than before!
You’re so swag!"
entries.translation_source: Done! From now on, this Pokémon will be called [buffer1-1]! It’s a way better name than before! You’re so swag!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Mulai sekarang, Pokémon
ini akan dipanggil [buffer1]! Itu\lnama yang jauh lebih baik dari

sebelumnya! Kamu sangat swag!

entries.original:
"Uh huh.
Come back again."
entries.translation_source: Uh huh. Come back again.
entries.translated: Uh huh. Kembali lagi ya.

entries.original:
"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

It looks the same as before, but
still feels ten times cooler!

You’re so lucky!"
entries.translation_source: Done! From now on, this Pokémon will be called [buffer1-1]! It looks the same as before, but still feels ten times cooler! You’re so lucky!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Mulai sekarang, Pokémon
ini akan dipanggil [buffer1]!\lTampilannya sama seperti

sebelumnya, tapi rasanya sepuluh
kali lebih keren! Kamu sangat\lberuntung!

entries.original:
"[buffer1], is it?
That’s a swagalicious name!

Take good care of [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1], is it? That’s a swagalicious name! Take good care of [buffer1-2]!
entries.translated:
[buffer1], ya? Itu nama yang
swagalicious! Jaga baik-baik\l[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Really?
That’s an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: Really? That’s an Egg!
entries.translated: Sungguh? Itu Telur!

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Dude!

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Dude! I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Aku Bapak Pemancing! Aku sangat
suka memancing! Aku tidak tahan\ljika tidak memancing. Katakan,

apakah kamu suka memancing?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Aku suka gayamu. Kurasa kita
bisa berteman. Ambil ini dan\lpancinglah, teman muda!

entries.original:
"[player] received an Old Rod from
the Fishing Dude."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received an Old Rod from the Fishing Dude.
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Old Rod dari
Bapak Pemancing.

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

From the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, my friend.
entries.translated:
Memancing adalah cara hidup! Ibarat
puisi terindah. Dari laut hingga\lsungai, pergilah dan dapatkan yang

besar, temanku.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
That’s so disappointing\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] That’s so disappointing[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Itu sangat mengecewakan\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, [player]!

How are the fish biting?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, [player-name-1]! How are the fish biting?
entries.translated:
Halo, [player]! Bagaimana hasil
memancingmu?

entries.original:
"Oh, no!

I had a nice gift for you, but you
have no room for it!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I had a nice gift for you, but you have no room for it!
entries.translated:
Oh, tidak! Aku punya hadiah bagus
untukmu, tapi kamu tidak punya\lruang untuknya!

entries.original:
"The urge to battle with someone
you’ve tangled with before\.

Have you ever had that urge?
I’m sure you have.

I wanted to battle certain people
again over and over, too.

So, I’ve been giving these away.
Please, take one!"
entries.translation_source: The urge to battle with someone you’ve tangled with before[game-token-1] Have you ever had that urge? I’m sure you have. I wanted to battle certain people again over and over, too. So, I’ve been giving these away. Please, take one!

entries.original:
"Use that device and you’ll find
Trainers looking for a rematch.

You have to charge its battery to
use it, though."
entries.translation_source: Use that device and you’ll find Trainers looking for a rematch. You have to charge its battery to use it, though.

entries.original:
"How do you use the VS Seeker?
There’s nothing to it.

Use it like beep-beep-beep, and
Trainers around you will notice.

If any Trainer wants a rematch,
it will let you know immediately.

Charge its battery and use it
while you’re on a road."
entries.translation_source: How do you use the VS Seeker? There’s nothing to it. Use it like beep-beep-beep, and Trainers around you will notice. If any Trainer wants a rematch, it will let you know immediately. Charge its battery and use it while you’re on a road.

entries.original:
"Hi!
Do you have a [buffer1]?

Want to trade it for my
[buffer2]?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Do you have a [buffer1-1]? Want to trade it for my [buffer2-2]?
entries.translated:
Hai! Apakah kamu punya [buffer1]?
Mau menukarnya dengan [buffer2]\lmilikku?

entries.original: "That’s too bad."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad.
entries.translated: Sayang sekali.

entries.original:
"\.This is no [buffer1].

If you get one, please trade it
to me!"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]This is no [buffer1-2]. If you get one, please trade it to me!
entries.translated:
\.Ini bukan [buffer1]. Jika kamu
mendapat satu, tolong tukarkan\ldenganku!

entries.original: "Thank you!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you!
entries.translated: Terima kasih!

entries.original:
"How is my old [buffer2]?

My [buffer1] is doing great!"
entries.translation_source: How is my old [buffer2-1]? My [buffer1-2] is doing great!
entries.translated:
Bagaimana [buffer2] lamaku?
[buffer1]ku baik-baik saja!

entries.original:
"Many people in Blizzard City
enjoy the finer delicacies in life.

Roasted Pokémon for instance."
entries.translation_source: Many people in Blizzard City enjoy the finer delicacies in life. Roasted Pokémon for instance.
entries.translated:
Banyak orang di Blizzard City
menikmati makanan lezat dalam\lhidup. Misalnya Pokémon Panggang.

entries.original:
"Hello!
Welcome to Dehara Dept. Store!

The board on the wall describes
the store layout."
entries.translation_source: Hello! Welcome to Dehara Dept. Store! The board on the wall describes the store layout.
entries.translated:
Halo! Selamat datang di Dehara
Dept. Store! Papan di dinding\lmenjelaskan tata letak toko.

entries.original:
"2F: Trainer’s Market

Top-Grade Items for Trainers!"
entries.translation_source: 2F: Trainer’s Market Top-Grade Items for Trainers!
entries.translated:
Lt. 2: Pasar Pelatih – Barang Kelas
Atas untuk Pelatih!

entries.original:
"Pokémon stat enhancers can
only be bought here.

HP Up increases the base HP of a
Pokémon.

Calcium raises the base Sp. Atk
stat of one Pokémon.

Zinc boosts the base Sp. Def stat
of one Pokémon.

Carbos enhances the base Speed
stat."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon stat enhancers can only be bought here. HP Up increases the base HP of a Pokémon. Calcium raises the base Sp. Atk stat of one Pokémon. Zinc boosts the base Sp. Def stat of one Pokémon. Carbos enhances the base Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Peningkat stat Pokémon hanya bisa
dibeli di sini. HP Up meningkatkan\lBase HP Pokémon. Kalsium

meningkatkan Base Sp. Atk satu
Pokémon. Seng meningkatkan Base Sp.\lDef satu Pokémon. Karbos

meningkatkan Base Speed.

entries.original:
"I’m here for Pokémon stat
enhancers.

Protein increases the base Attack
stat.

Iron increases the base Defense
stat."
entries.translation_source: I’m here for Pokémon stat enhancers. Protein increases the base Attack stat. Iron increases the base Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Saya di sini untuk peningkat stat
Pokémon. Protein meningkatkan Base\lAttack. Zat Besi meningkatkan Base

Defense.

entries.original: "Good night everyone."
entries.translation_source: Good night everyone.
entries.translated: Selamat malam semuanya.

entries.original:
"I’m the sprite artist!
I drew you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the sprite artist! I drew you!
entries.translated:
Saya seniman sprite! Saya
menggambarmu!

entries.original:
"I’m the graphic designer!

I made the cool support artwork and
logo!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the graphic designer! I made the cool support artwork and logo!
entries.translated:
Saya desainer grafis! Saya membuat
karya seni pendukung dan logo yang\lkeren!

entries.original:
"I’m the game’s creator!

Filling up your Pokédex is tough,
but don’t quit!

When you finish, come tell me!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the game’s creator! Filling up your Pokédex is tough, but don’t quit! When you finish, come tell me!
entries.translated:
Saya pencipta game ini! Mengisi
Pokédex itu sulit, tapi jangan\lmenyerah! Setelah selesai, datang

dan beri tahu saya!

entries.original: "Unbound Development Room"
entries.translation_source: Unbound Development Room
entries.translated: Ruang Pengembangan Unbound

entries.original:
"No?
Please come play sometime!"
entries.translation_source: No? Please come play sometime!
entries.translated:
Tidak? Silakan datang bermain suatu
saat!

entries.original:
"Oh, I’m sorry.
You don’t have a Coin Case."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I’m sorry. You don’t have a Coin Case.
entries.translated:
Oh, maaf. Kamu tidak memiliki Coin
Case.

entries.original:
"Whoops!
Your Coin Case is full."
entries.translation_source: Whoops! Your Coin Case is full.
entries.translated: Waduh! Coin Case kamu penuh.

entries.original: "You can’t afford the coins."
entries.translation_source: You can’t afford the coins.
entries.translated: Kamu tidak mampu membeli koin.

entries.original:
"Thank you.
Here are your coins!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you. Here are your coins!
entries.translated: Terima kasih. Ini koinmu!

entries.original:
"Keep this quiet.

It’s rumoured these machines are
rigged."
entries.translation_source: Keep this quiet. It’s rumoured these machines are rigged.
entries.translated:
Jaga ini rahasia. Ada rumor bahwa
mesin-mesin ini dicurangi.

entries.original:
"I think these machines have
different odds."
entries.translation_source: I think these machines have different odds.
entries.translated:
Saya pikir mesin-mesin ini memiliki
peluang yang berbeda.

entries.original: "Kid, do you want to play?"
entries.translation_source: Kid, do you want to play?
entries.translated: Nak, kamu mau bermain?

entries.original:
"[player] received 10 Coins
from the man."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received 10 Coins from the man.
entries.translated:
[player] menerima 10 Koin dari pria
itu.

entries.original: "You don’t need my Coins!"
entries.translation_source: You don’t need my Coins!
entries.translated: Kamu tidak perlu Koin-ku!

entries.original:
"Wins seem to come and go.
Nothing’s a sure thing."
entries.translation_source: Wins seem to come and go. Nothing’s a sure thing.
entries.translated:
Kemenangan sepertinya datang dan
pergi. Tidak ada yang pasti.

entries.original:
"These slot games\.
Win or lose, it’s only by luck."
entries.translation_source: These slot games[game-token-1] Win or lose, it’s only by luck.
entries.translated:
Permainan slot ini\. Menang atau
kalah, itu hanya keberuntungan.

entries.original:
"Games are scary!
It’s so easy to get hooked!"
entries.translation_source: Games are scary! It’s so easy to get hooked!
entries.translated:
Permainan menakutkan! Sangat mudah
untuk kecanduan!

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Want some Coins?"
entries.translation_source: What’s up? Want some Coins?
entries.translated: Ada apa? Mau beberapa Koin?

entries.original:
"[player] received 20 Coins
from the nice guy."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received 20 Coins from the nice guy.
entries.translated:
[player] menerima 20 Koin dari pria
baik itu.

entries.original: "You have lots of Coins!"
entries.translation_source: You have lots of Coins!
entries.translated: Kamu punya banyak Koin!

entries.original:
"Darn! I need more Coins for the
Pokémon I want!"
entries.translation_source: Darn! I need more Coins for the Pokémon I want!
entries.translated:
Sial! Aku butuh lebih banyak Koin
untuk Pokémon yang aku inginkan!

entries.original:
"Hey, what? You’re throwing me off!
Here are some Coins, so shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, what? You’re throwing me off! Here are some Coins, so shoo!
entries.translated:
Hei, apa? Kamu menggangguku! Ini
beberapa Koin, jadi pergilah!

entries.original:
"[player] received 20 Coins
from the man."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received 20 Coins from the man.
entries.translated:
[player] menerima 20 Koin dari pria
itu.

entries.original:
"You’ve got plenty of your own
Coins!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve got plenty of your own Coins!
entries.translated: Kamu punya banyak Koin sendiri!

entries.original:
"The trick is to watch the reels
closely."
entries.translation_source: The trick is to watch the reels closely.
entries.translated:
Triknya adalah perhatikan gulungan
dengan saksama.

entries.original: "A Coin Case is required\."
entries.translation_source: A Coin Case is required[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Kotak Koin diperlukan\.

entries.original:
"Oops!
Don’t have the Coin Case!"
entries.translation_source: Oops! Don’t have the Coin Case!
entries.translated: Ups! Tidak punya Kotak Koin!

entries.original:
"A slot machine!
Want to play?"
entries.translation_source: A slot machine! Want to play?
entries.translated: Mesin slot! Mau bermain?

entries.original:
"OUT OF ORDER
This is broken."
entries.translation_source: OUT OF ORDER This is broken.
entries.translated: RUSAK Ini rusak.

entries.original:
"OUT TO LUNCH
This is reserved."
entries.translation_source: OUT TO LUNCH This is reserved.
entries.translated: ISTIRAHAT Ini sudah dipesan.

entries.original:
"Someone’s keys!
They’ll be back."
entries.translation_source: Someone’s keys! They’ll be back.
entries.translated:
Kunci seseorang! Mereka akan
kembali.

entries.original: "A Coin Case is required\."
entries.translation_source: A Coin Case is required[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Diperlukan Coin Case\.

entries.original: "We exchange your Coins for prizes."
entries.translation_source: We exchange your Coins for prizes.
entries.translated:
Kami menukar Coin Anda dengan
hadiah.

entries.original: "Which prize would you like?"
entries.translation_source: Which prize would you like?

entries.original: "So, you want the [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: So, you want the [buffer1-1]?
entries.translated: Jadi, Anda ingin [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Okay, a TM of [buffer2]
is what you want?"
entries.translation_source: Okay, a TM of [buffer2-1] is what you want?
entries.translated:
Oke, TM [buffer2] yang Anda
inginkan?

entries.original:
"Sorry, you’ll need more Coins
than that."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, you’ll need more Coins than that.
entries.translated:
Maaf, Anda perlu lebih banyak Coin
dari itu.

entries.original: "You should make room for this."
entries.translation_source: You should make room for this.
entries.translated: Anda harus memberi ruang untuk ini.

entries.original:
"Dehara Pokémon Gym
Leader: Galavan

Winning Trainers:
[rival]"
entries.translation_source: Dehara Pokémon Gym Leader: Galavan Winning Trainers: [text-token-rival-1]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Dehara:
Galavan Pelatih Pemenang: [rival]

entries.original:
"Dehara Pokémon Gym
Leader: Galavan

Winning Trainers:
[rival], [player]"
entries.translation_source: Dehara Pokémon Gym Leader: Galavan Winning Trainers: [text-token-rival-1], [player-name-2]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Dehara:
Galavan Pelatih Pemenang: [rival],\l[player]

entries.original:
"Aww man\.

I blew all of my money at the Game
Corner!

Looks like I won’t be needing this
anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Aww man[game-token-1] I blew all of my money at the Game Corner! Looks like I won’t be needing this anymore!
entries.translated:
Aduh\. Aku menghabiskan semua uangku
di Game Corner! Sepertinya aku\ltidak akan membutuhkan ini lagi!

entries.original:
"[player] received a Coin Case
from the guy."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received a Coin Case from the guy.
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Coin Case dari
pria itu.

entries.original: "Make room for this!"
entries.translation_source: Make room for this!
entries.translated: Beri ruang untuk ini!

entries.original: "I always thought I could win\."
entries.translation_source: I always thought I could win[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Aku selalu berpikir aku bisa menang\.

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn I saw the clerk
stealing from the cash register\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn I saw the clerk stealing from the cash register[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah melihat pegawai itu
mencuri dari mesin kasir\.

entries.original:
"One day I’m going to be a ninja!

My parents strike with brute force,
but I’m going to be sneaky!"
entries.translation_source: One day I’m going to be a ninja! My parents strike with brute force, but I’m going to be sneaky!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari aku akan menjadi ninja!
Orang tuaku menyerang dengan\lkekuatan kasar, tapi aku akan

menjadi licik!

entries.original:
"Huah! Move boulders with pure
power!

Take this!"
entries.translation_source: Huah! Move boulders with pure power! Take this!
entries.translated:
Huah! Pindahkan batu besar dengan
kekuatan murni! Ambil ini!

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Guru’s older
brother.

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Guru’s older brother. I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Aku kakak laki-laki Fishing Guru.
Aku sangat suka memancing! Aku\ltidak tahan tanpa memancing.

Katakan padaku, apakah kamu suka
memancing?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Aku suka gayamu. Aku pikir
kita bisa berteman. Ambil ini dan\lmancinglah, teman muda!

entries.original:
"[player] received a Good Rod from
the Fishing Guru’s brother."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received a Good Rod from the Fishing Guru’s brother.
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Good Rod dari
kakak Fishing Guru.

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

A crummy Old Rod could only catch
Magikarp, yes?

But with a Good Rod, you can
catch much better Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. A crummy Old Rod could only catch Magikarp, yes? But with a Good Rod, you can catch much better Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Memancing adalah cara hidup! Ini
seperti puisi terbaik. Old Rod yang\lburuk hanya bisa menangkap

Magikarp, ya? Tapi dengan Good Rod,

with one or more Pokémon each.

Each Trainer can have one Pokémon
in battle at a time.

Double Battle is for two Trainers
with two or more Pokémon each.

Each Trainer will send out two
Pokémon in battle at a time.

Multi Battle is for four Trainers
with one or more Pokémon each.

Each Trainer can have one Pokémon
in battle at a time."

Double Battle is for two Trainers with two or more Pokémon each. Each Trainer will send out two Pokémon in battle at a time. Multi Battle is for four Trainers with one or more Pokémon each. Each Trainer can have one Pokémon in battle at a time.
entries.translated:
Ada tiga Mode Pertarungan.

Setiap Pelatih dapat memiliki satu\lPokémon dalam pertarungan pada satu

untuk dua Pelatih yang\lmasing-masing memiliki dua atau

lebih Pokémon. Setiap Pelatih akan
mengeluarkan dua Pokémon dalam\lpertarungan pada satu waktu.

empat Pelatih yang masing-masing\lmemiliki satu atau lebih Pokémon.

Setiap Pelatih dapat memiliki satu
Pokémon dalam pertarungan pada satu\lwaktu.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Pokémon Wireless
Club Union Room.

You may interact directly with
other Trainers here, some of\lwhom you may not even know.

Would you like to enter the room?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Pokémon Wireless Club Union Room. You may interact directly with other Trainers here, some of whom you may not even know. Would you like to enter the room?

entries.original:
"The Trainers in the Union Room
will be those players around you\lwho have also entered the room.

You may do all sorts of things
here, such as exchanging greetings.

You may enter two Pokémon up to
Lv. 30 for a one-on-one battle.

You may take part in a chat with
two to five people.

trade.

Would you like to enter the room?"
entries.translation_source: The Trainers in the Union Room will be those players around you who have also entered the room. You may do all sorts of things here, such as exchanging greetings. You may enter two Pokémon up to Lv. 30 for a one-on-one battle. You may take part in a chat with two to five people. Or, you may register a Pokémon for trade. Would you like to enter the room?

entries.original:
"I hope you enjoy your time in
the Union Room."
entries.translation_source: I hope you enjoy your time in the Union Room.
entries.translated:
Semoga Anda menikmati waktu Anda di
Ruang Persatuan.

entries.original:
"Hello!
My name is Teala.

This must be your first time
up here.

I’ll show you how the Wireless
Communication System works.

First, I need to show you this
floor of our Pokémon Centre.

Right this way, please."

entries.translated:
Halo! Nama saya Teala. Ini pasti
pertama kalinya kamu di sini. Aku\lakan menunjukkan cara kerja Sistem

Komunikasi Nirkabel. Pertama, aku
perlu menunjukkan lantai ini dari\lPusat Pokémon kita. Lewat sini,

silakan.

entries.original:
"On the top floor, there are two
rooms.

First, the room on the left.
It’s the Union Room.

You may link up with Trainers
around you who have also entered\lthe Union Room.

With them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.

Second, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.

You may trade or battle Pokémon
with your friends in this room.

If the Wireless Adapter isn’t
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.

If that is the case, you must go
to the Direct Corner.

I hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System."
entries.translation_source: On the top floor, there are two rooms. First, the room on the left. It’s the Union Room. You may link up with Trainers around you who have also entered the Union Room. With them, you may do things like chat, battle, and trade. Second, the room on the right is the DIRECT CORNER. You may trade or battle Pokémon with your friends in this room. If the Wireless Adapter isn’t connected, you may still link up using a GBA Game Link cable. If that is the case, you must go to the Direct Corner. I hope you enjoy the Wireless Communication System.
entries.translated:
Di lantai paling atas, terdapat dua
ruangan. Pertama, ruangan di\lsebelah kiri. Itu adalah Ruang

Serikat. Kamu dapat terhubung
dengan Pelatih di sekitarmu yang\ljuga telah memasuki Ruang Serikat.

Dengan mereka, kamu dapat melakukan
hal-hal seperti mengobrol,\lbertarung, dan bertukar Pokémon.

Kedua, ruangan di sebelah kanan
adalah POJOK LANGSUNG. Kamu dapat\lbertukar atau bertarung Pokémon

dengan teman-temanmu di ruangan
ini. Jika Adaptor Nirkabel tidak\lterhubung, kamu masih dapat

terhubung menggunakan kabel Game
Link GBA. Jika itu masalahnya, kamu\lharus pergi ke Pojok Langsung. Saya

harap kamu menikmati Sistem
Komunikasi Nirkabel.

Halo, [player]! Ini saya, Teala,

entries.original:
"Let me explain how the Pokémon
Wireless Club works.

On this, the top floor, there are
two rooms.

First, the room on the left.
It’s the Union Room.

You may link up with Trainers
around you who have also entered\lthe Union Room.

With them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.

Second, the room on the right is
the Direct Corner.

You may trade or battle Pokémon
with your friends in this room.

Sometimes, you may not be able to
find your friends in the Union Room\lor the Direct Corner.

In that case, please move closer
to your friends.

If the Wireless Adapter isn’t
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.

If that is the case, you must go
to the Direct Corner.

I hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System."
entries.translation_source: Let me explain how the Pokémon Wireless Club works. On this, the top floor, there are two rooms. First, the room on the left. It’s the Union Room. You may link up with Trainers around you who have also entered the Union Room. With them, you may do things like chat, battle, and trade. Second, the room on the right is the Direct Corner. You may trade or battle Pokémon with your friends in this room. Sometimes, you may not be able to find your friends in the Union Room or the Direct Corner. In that case, please move closer to your friends. If the Wireless Adapter isn’t connected, you may still link up using a GBA Game Link cable. If that is the case, you must go to the Direct Corner. I hope you enjoy the Wireless Communication System.
entries.translated:
Biarkan saya jelaskan cara kerja
Klub Nirkabel Pokémon. Di lantai\lpaling atas ini, ada dua ruangan.

Pertama, ruangan di sebelah kiri.
Itu adalah Ruang Union. Kamu dapat\lterhubung dengan Pelatih di

sekitarmu yang juga telah memasuki
Ruang Union. Dengan mereka, kamu\ldapat melakukan hal-hal seperti

mengobrol, bertarung, dan bertukar
Pokémon. Kedua, ruangan di sebelah\lkanan adalah Direct Corner. Kamu

dapat bertukar atau bertarung
Pokémon dengan teman-temanmu di\lruangan ini. Kadang-kadang, kamu

mungkin tidak dapat menemukan
teman-temanmu di Ruang Union atau\lDirect Corner. Jika demikian,

silakan mendekat ke teman-temanmu.
Jika Adaptor Nirkabel tidak\lterhubung, kamu masih dapat

terhubung menggunakan kabel Game
Link GBA. Jika itu masalahnya, kamu\lharus pergi ke Direct Corner. Saya

harap kamu menikmati Sistem
Komunikasi Nirkabel.

entries.translated:
Semoga kamu menikmati Sistem

\.That’s unfriendly of you.

Hai, senang bertemu denganmu! \.Itu
tidak ramah darimu. Bagaimana kalau\lmembalas sapaan? Jadi, ayolah,

ceritakan tentang dirimu. Aku ingin
mendengar profilmu!

"A profile is written using four
words or phrases.

There’re plenty of words to choose

\.It’s easier than it sounds.

First, choose a group, then choose a word or phrase. [game-token-1]It’s easier than it sounds. Why don’t you try it?
entries.translated:
Profil ditulis menggunakan empat
kata atau frasa. Ada banyak kata\lyang bisa dipilih untuk profil

Anda. Kata dan frasa ditempatkan
dalam beberapa kelompok yang\lnyaman. Pertama, pilih kelompok,

lalu pilih kata atau frasa. \.Ini
lebih mudah dari kedengarannya.\lMengapa Anda tidak mencobanya?

entries.original: "What’s your profile?"
entries.translation_source: What’s your profile?
entries.translated: Apa profil Anda?

entries.original:
"Aww\. Don’t be like that.
You can tell me your profile."
entries.translation_source: Aww[game-token-1] Don’t be like that. You can tell me your profile.
entries.translated:
Aww\. Jangan seperti itu. Anda bisa
memberitahu saya profil Anda.

entries.original:
"Oh, you’ve decided not to?
You’re fickle, aren’t you?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, you’ve decided not to? You’re fickle, aren’t you?
entries.translated:
Oh, Anda memutuskan untuk tidak?
Anda berubah-ubah, ya?

entries.original:
"Hi!
We meet again!"
entries.translation_source: Hi! We meet again!
entries.translated: Hai! Kita bertemu lagi!

entries.original:
"Would you like to change your

entries.translation_source: Would you like to change your profile?

entries.original:
"What are you like now?
I’d really like to know."
entries.translation_source: What are you like now? I’d really like to know.
entries.translated:
Seperti apa Anda sekarang? Saya
benar-benar ingin tahu.

entries.original:
"Okay, you like your profile the
way it is.

I think so, too."

entries.translated:
Oke, Anda menyukai profil Anda
seperti apa adanya. Saya juga\lberpikir begitu.

entries.original:
"Hmhm\.

Your profile really says something
about who you are.

Now that I know you better, it 
makes us better friends than ever!"
entries.translation_source: Hmhm[game-token-1] Your profile really says something about who you are. Now that I know you better, it makes us better friends than ever!
entries.translated:
Hmhm\. Profil Anda benar-benar
mengatakan sesuatu tentang siapa\lAnda. Sekarang setelah saya

mengenal Anda lebih baik, ini
membuat kita menjadi teman yang\llebih baik dari sebelumnya!

"Oh, I’ve heard that before\.

My cousin, who lives far away,

entries.translated:
Oh, saya pernah mendengar itu
sebelumnya\. Sepupu saya, yang\ltinggal jauh, selalu mengatakan

itu, seingat saya.

entries.original:
"Please tell me more about
yourself next time!"
entries.translation_source: Please tell me more about yourself next time!
entries.translated:
Tolong ceritakan lebih banyak
tentang diri Anda lain kali!

entries.original:
"I’m the Day-Care Man.

I help take care of the precious
Pokémon of Trainers.

If you’d like me to raise your
Pokémon, have a word with my wife."

entries.translated:
Saya Pria Day-Care. Saya membantu
merawat Pokémon berharga para\lPelatih. Jika Anda ingin saya

merawat Pokémon Anda, bicaralah
dengan istri saya.

entries.original:
"Ah, it’s you!

We were raising your Pokémon, and
my goodness, were we surprised!

Your Pokémon had an Egg!

We don’t know how it got there,
but your Pokémon had it.

You do want it, yes?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, it’s you! We were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised! Your Pokémon had an Egg! We don’t know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it. You do want it, yes?
entries.translated:
Ah, ini Anda! Kami sedang merawat
Pokémon Anda, dan ya ampun, kami\lterkejut! Pokémon Anda memiliki

Telur! Kami tidak tahu bagaimana
itu bisa sampai di sana, tetapi\lPokémon Anda memilikinya. Anda

menginginkannya, kan?

entries.original:
"Ah, it’s you! Good to see you.
Your [buffer1]’s doing fine."

entries.translated:
Ah, ini Anda! Senang bertemu Anda.
[buffer1] Anda baik-baik saja.

Thanks!"

Baiklah, saya akan menyimpannya.
Terima kasih!

"You have no room for it\.

entries.translated:
Anda tidak punya ruang untuk itu\.
Kembalilah setelah Anda membuat\lruang.

entries.original: "Take good care of it."

"Ah, it’s you! Your [buffer1] and
[buffer2] are doing fine."

entries.translated:
Ah, ini Anda! [buffer1] dan [buffer2]
Anda baik-baik saja.

entries.original:
"I really will keep it.
You do want this, yes?"

entries.translated:
Saya benar-benar akan menyimpannya.
Anda menginginkan ini, kan?

"Now that the entrance to the SES
Expressway isn’t sealed anymore,\lI’ve finally been able to train!

newly trained Pokémon?"

entries.translated:
Sekarang pintu masuk ke SES
Expressway tidak lagi tersegel,\lakhirnya aku bisa berlatih! Hei,

apakah kamu ingin bertarung dengan
Pokémonku yang baru terlatih?

Pokémon yang sangat membutuhkan\lseorang pelatih yang penuh kasih.

berubah pikiran, kamu dipersilakan\lkapan saja!

entries.original:
"I tried travelling through the
Great Desert to the east of town,\lbut the sandstorm was too strong.

It kept whipping sand in my face
and I couldn’t see anything.

Without any sort of protection,
it’s impossible to go anywhere.

I just wish I could find some\."
entries.translation_source: I tried travelling through the Great Desert to the east of town, but the sandstorm was too strong. It kept whipping sand in my face and I couldn’t see anything. Without any sort of protection, it’s impossible to go anywhere. I just wish I could find some[game-token-1]

tidak bisa melihat apa pun. Tanpa\lperlindungan apa pun, mustahil

untuk pergi ke mana pun. Aku hanya
berharap bisa menemukan sesuatu\..

entries.original:
"A case for holding Coins obtained
at the Game Corner.
It holds up to 9,999 Coins."
entries.translation_source: A case for holding Coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 9,999 Coins.
entries.translated:
Kotak untuk menyimpan Koin yang
diperoleh di Game Corner. Dapat
menampung hingga 9.999 Koin.

entries.original:
"A device used for finding items.
If there is a hidden item nearby
when it is used, it emits a signal."
entries.translation_source: A device used for finding items. If there is a hidden item nearby when it is used, it emits a signal.
entries.translated:
Perangkat yang digunakan untuk menemukan
item. Jika ada item tersembunyi di dekatnya
saat digunakan, ia akan mengeluarkan sinyal.

entries.original:
"The pass required for entering
Pokémon CONTESTS. It has a
drawing of an award ribbon on it."
entries.translation_source: The pass required for entering Pokémon CONTESTS. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.
entries.translated:
Pas masuk yang diperlukan untuk
mengikuti KONTES Pokémon. Tiket
ini bergambar pita penghargaan.

entries.original:
"A package that contains mechanical
parts of some sort made by the
DEVON CORPORATION."
entries.translation_source: A package that contains mechanical parts of some sort made by the DEVON CORPORATION.
entries.translated:
Paket yang berisi komponen mekanis
buatan DEVON CORPORATION.

entries.original:
"A folding bicycle that is capable
of stunts like jumps and wheelies."
entries.translation_source: A folding bicycle that is capable of stunts like jumps and wheelies.
entries.translated:
Sepeda lipat yang mampu melakukan
aksi seperti lompatan dan berdiri
dengan roda belakang.

entries.original:
"A case for holding \Po\Ke\Bl\Lo\CkS made
with a BERRY BLENDER. It releases
one \Po\Ke\Bl\Lo\Ck when shaken."
entries.translation_source: A case for holding [pokemon-glyph-1][pokemon-glyph-2][game-token-3][game-token-4][game-token-5]S made with a BERRY BLENDER. It releases one [pokemon-glyph-6][pokemon-glyph-7][game-token-8][game-token-9][game-token-10] when shaken.
entries.translated:
Kotak untuk menyimpan \Po\Ke\Bl\Lo\Ck yang
dibuat dengan Blender Beri. Kotak
ini mengeluarkan satu \Po\Ke\Bl\Lo\Ck saat dikocok.

entries.original:
"A device used to search for
life-forms in water.
It looks too difficult to use."
entries.translation_source: A device used to search for life-forms in water. It looks too difficult to use.
entries.translated:
Alat yang digunakan untuk mencari
makhluk hidup di air. Alat ini
tampak terlalu sulit digunakan.

entries.original:
" a powerful blast of light
that reduces the foe’s accuracy.
It also lights up dark caves."
entries.translation_source: a powerful blast of light that reduces the foe’s accuracy. It also lights up dark caves.

entries.original:
"A flute that is said to instantly
awaken any Pokémon. It has a
lovely tone."
entries.translation_source: A flute that is said to instantly awaken any Pokémon. It has a lovely tone.
entries.translated:
Suling yang dikatakan dapat
membangunkan Pokémon mana pun
secara instan. Suaranya merdu.

entries.original:
"A key that operates the elevator
in TEAM ROCKET’s HIDEOUT.
It bears the TEAM ROCKET logo."
entries.translation_source: A key that operates the elevator in TEAM ROCKET’s HIDEOUT. It bears the TEAM ROCKET logo.
entries.translated:
Kunci yang mengoperasikan lift di
Markas TIM ROKET. Bergambar logo
TIM ROKET.

entries.original:
"A scope that makes unseeable
Pokémon visible.
It is made by SILPH CO."
entries.translation_source: A scope that makes unseeable Pokémon visible. It is made by SILPH CO.
entries.translated:
Lensa yang membuat Pokémon yang
tidak terlihat menjadi terlihat.
Dibuat oleh SILPH CO.

entries.original:
"A folding bicycle that allows
faster movement than the RUNNING
SHOES."
entries.translation_source: A folding bicycle that allows faster movement than the RUNNING SHOES.
entries.translated:
Sepeda lipat yang memungkinkan
pergerakan lebih cepat daripada
Sepatu Lari.

entries.original:
"A device that enables you to
recall what you’ve heard and seen
about famous people."
entries.translation_source: A device that enables you to recall what you’ve heard and seen about famous people.
entries.translated:
Perangkat yang memungkinkan Anda
mengingat kembali apa yang telah Anda
dengar dan lihat tentang orang terkenal.

entries.original:
"A television set that is tuned to
a program with useful tips for
novice Trainers."
entries.translation_source: A television set that is tuned to a program with useful tips for novice Trainers.
entries.translated:
Pesawat televisi yang disetel ke
program dengan tips berguna untuk
Pelatih pemula.

entries.original:
"A pass for ferries between ONE,
TWO, and THREE ISLAND.
It has a drawing of three islands."
entries.translation_source: A pass for ferries between ONE, TWO, and THREE ISLAND. It has a drawing of three islands.
entries.translated:
Pas untuk feri antara PULAU SATU,
PULAU DUA, dan PULAU TIGA.
Bergambar tiga pulau.

entries.original:
"A pass for ferries between
VERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS.
It features a drawing of a rainbow."
entries.translation_source: A pass for ferries between VERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS. It features a drawing of a rainbow.
entries.translated:
Tiket untuk feri antara VERMILION
dan KEPULAUAN SEVII. Tiket ini
bergambar pelangi.

entries.original:
"An aromatic tea prepared by an old
lady. It will slake even the worst
thirst."
entries.translation_source: An aromatic tea prepared by an old lady. It will slake even the worst thirst.
entries.translated:
Teh aromatik yang disiapkan oleh
seorang nenek. Teh ini dapat
menghilangkan dahaga yang paling parah sekalipun.

entries.original:
"A ticket required to board the ship
to NAVEL ROCK.
It glows with a mystic light."

entries.translated:
Tiket yang diperlukan untuk naik
kapal ke NAVEL ROCK. Tiket ini
bersinar dengan cahaya mistis.

entries.original:
"A ticket required to board the ship
to BIRTH ISLAND.
It glows beautifully."
entries.translation_source: A ticket required to board the ship to BIRTH ISLAND. It glows beautifully.
entries.translated:
Tiket yang diperlukan untuk naik
kapal ke BIRTH ISLAND. Tiket ini
bersinar dengan indah.

cahaya merah. Melambangkan gairah.

"An exquisitely beautiful gem that
has a blue glow.

entries.translation_source: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a blue glow. It symbolizes honesty.
entries.translated:

cahaya biru. Melambangkan
kejujuran.

But if you lose, [raw-escape-3], you end up paying prize money[game-token-4] However, since you had no warning this time, I’ll pay for you. But things won’t be this way once you step outside these doors. That’s why you must strengthen your Pokémon by battling wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Log: Hm \. Mengecewakan \. Jika Anda
menang, Anda mendapatkan uang
hadiah, dan Pokémon Anda tumbuh.

harus membayar uang hadiah \. Namun,
karena Anda tidak mendapat
peringatan kali ini, saya akan
membayar untuk Anda. Tapi keadaan
tidak akan seperti ini begitu Anda
melangkah keluar dari pintu ini.
Itulah mengapa Anda harus
memperkuat Pokémon Anda dengan
bertarung melawan Pokémon liar.
