entries.original:
"Hey, all you Trainers out there!
HELLO, Trainers!

\.\.\. \.\.\. \.\.\.

Come on, let me hear you!
HELLO, Trainers!\lIt’s me, the POKé DUDE!

"
entries.translation_source: Hey, all you Trainers out there! HELLO, Trainers! [game-token-1][game-token-2][game-token-3] [game-token-4][game-token-5][game-token-6] [game-token-7][game-token-8][game-token-9] Come on, let me hear you! HELLO, Trainers! It’s me, the POKé DUDE!

entries.original:
"Today, the POKé DUDE’s here to
tell you about how you can battle\lPokémon!

Say you’re out for a stroll when,
suddenly, a wild Pokémon appears!

It’s up to you to smartly use your
Pokémon and their moves to reduce\lthe opponent’s HP to nothing, and\lclaim victory!

I’ll show you how to do that in
person and for sure!

All righty, here goes!

Keep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!"
entries.translation_source: Today, the POKé DUDE’s here to tell you about how you can battle Pokémon! Say you’re out for a stroll when, suddenly, a wild Pokémon appears! It’s up to you to smartly use your Pokémon and their moves to reduce the opponent’s HP to nothing, and claim victory! I’ll show you how to do that in person and for sure! All righty, here goes! Keep your eyes glued to the super POKé DUDE SHOW!

entries.original:
"Well, did you get that?

Even if your own Pokémon’s HP
falls to zero, and it becomes\lunable to battle, not to worry!

Just take it to any Pokémon
CENTER and heal it!

All righty, be seeing you!

Remember, Trainers, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: Well, did you get that? Even if your own Pokémon’s HP falls to zero, and it becomes unable to battle, not to worry! Just take it to any Pokémon CENTER and heal it! All righty, be seeing you! Remember, Trainers, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!

entries.original:
"Today, the POKé DUDE’s here to
tell you about status problems!

Status problems include poisoning,
paralysis, sleep, burn\.

There are a couple others, but
they really are trouble.

Get any one, and your Pokémon
may become useless in battle.

You know, it hurts the POKé DUDE
to see a Pokémon suffer\.

So, what should you do if your
Pokémon gets a status problem?

Well, you’ve got me to show you!

All righty, here goes!

Keep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!"
entries.translation_source: Today, the POKé DUDE’s here to tell you about status problems! Status problems include poisoning, paralysis, sleep, burn[game-token-1] There are a couple others, but they really are trouble. Get any one, and your Pokémon may become useless in battle. You know, it hurts the POKé DUDE to see a Pokémon suffer[game-token-2] So, what should you do if your Pokémon gets a status problem? Well, you’ve got me to show you! All righty, here goes! Keep your eyes glued to the super POKé DUDE SHOW!

entries.original:
"Poisoning or paralysis don’t go
away after a battle.

If a Pokémon is poisoned, it loses
HP even while you’re walking.

You should heal Pokémon of these
kinds of problems right away.

Use an item, or try to get to a
Pokémon CENTER for healing.

That wasn’t hard, was it?
All righty, be seeing you!

Remember, Trainers, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: Poisoning or paralysis don’t go away after a battle. If a Pokémon is poisoned, it loses HP even while you’re walking. You should heal Pokémon of these kinds of problems right away. Use an item, or try to get to a Pokémon CENTER for healing. That wasn’t hard, was it? All righty, be seeing you! Remember, Trainers, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!

entries.original:
"Does everyone know about type
matchups?

Pokémon and their moves all
belong to certain types.

For example, there are such types
as GRASS and WATER.

You need to consider the type of
the move used to attack\.

And, the type of the Pokémon that
is hit by that attack.

Depending on how those two types
match up, the damage can change.

You see, it depends on whether
the type matchup is good or bad.

If you don’t know how matchups
work, battles will be tough.

So, let me demonstrate exactly
what I mean.

All righty, here goes!

Keep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!"
entries.translation_source: Does everyone know about type matchups? Pokémon and their moves all belong to certain types. For example, there are such types as GRASS and WATER. You need to consider the type of the move used to attack[game-token-1] And, the type of the Pokémon that is hit by that attack. Depending on how those two types match up, the damage can change. You see, it depends on whether the type matchup is good or bad. If you don’t know how matchups work, battles will be tough. So, let me demonstrate exactly what I mean. All righty, here goes! Keep your eyes glued to the super POKé DUDE SHOW!

entries.original:
"Is it possible to launch an attack
that will inflict heavy damage?

Does the opposing Pokémon pose
a threat to your Pokémon?

Is there any chance that it may
have disastrously tough moves?

Watch the type matchups to gain
the upper hand!

All righty, be seeing you!

Oh, for the COOL-type POKé DUDE,
AWESOME-type kids like you match\lup perfectly!

Remember, a good deed a day
brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: Is it possible to launch an attack that will inflict heavy damage? Does the opposing Pokémon pose a threat to your Pokémon? Is there any chance that it may have disastrously tough moves? Watch the type matchups to gain the upper hand! All righty, be seeing you! Oh, for the COOL-type POKé DUDE, AWESOME-type kids like you match up perfectly! Remember, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!

entries.original:
"Today, the POKé DUDE’s going to
show you how to catch Pokémon!

Just imagine\. A groovy Pokémon
suddenly appearing in the wild!

Oh, you want it!
You just can’t help it!

Oh, you have to catch it!
You gotta have it!

Let me show you how you can make
it happen!

All righty, here goes!

Keep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!"
entries.translation_source: Today, the POKé DUDE’s going to show you how to catch Pokémon! Just imagine[game-token-1] A groovy Pokémon suddenly appearing in the wild! Oh, you want it! You just can’t help it! Oh, you have to catch it! You gotta have it! Let me show you how you can make it happen! All righty, here goes! Keep your eyes glued to the super POKé DUDE SHOW!

entries.original:
"If your first POKé BALL fails to
catch the Pokémon, don’t give up!

Keep throwing Poké Balls\.
It’s bound to work sometime!

All righty, be seeing you!

Remember, Trainers, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: If your first POKé BALL fails to catch the Pokémon, don’t give up! Keep throwing Poké Balls[game-token-1] It’s bound to work sometime! All righty, be seeing you! Remember, Trainers, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!

entries.original:
"Hey, everyone!
Do you all have TMs?

A TM, Technical Machine, is an
amazingly great item!

It teaches Pokémon a move that
it may not learn when leveling up!

Isn’t that just great? What a
convenient world we live in!

Open the TM Case and check out
the TMs you have.

You can check them out in detail,
too."
entries.translation_source: Hey, everyone! Do you all have TMs? A TM, Technical Machine, is an amazingly great item! It teaches Pokémon a move that it may not learn when leveling up! Isn’t that just great? What a convenient world we live in! Open the TM Case and check out the TMs you have. You can check them out in detail, too.

entries.original:
"POKé DUDE: NORMAL, WATER, GRASS\.
TMs also come in types.

Check the type and teach it to
a Pokémon that matches up well.

For example, WATER PULSE is
suitable for WATER-type Pokémon.

BULLET SEED is a move that most
GRASS-type Pokémon can learn.

There’s one other thing!"
entries.translation_source: POKé DUDE: NORMAL, WATER, GRASS[game-token-1] TMs also come in types. Check the type and teach it to a Pokémon that matches up well. For example, WATER PULSE is suitable for WATER-type Pokémon. BULLET SEED is a move that most GRASS-type Pokémon can learn. There’s one other thing!

entries.original:
"Don’t just look at the type, read
the description, too.

It will contain hints about what
Pokémon might learn the move.

For example, take a move like
FOCUS PUNCH.

It doesn’t sound like anything a
bird or fish Pokémon can learn.

So, try using it on Pokémon with
arms that can throw punches!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t just look at the type, read the description, too. It will contain hints about what Pokémon might learn the move. For example, take a move like FOCUS PUNCH. It doesn’t sound like anything a bird or fish Pokémon can learn. So, try using it on Pokémon with arms that can throw punches!

entries.original:
"Wow, I talked a lot today!
All righty, be seeing you!

Remember, Trainers, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: Wow, I talked a lot today! All righty, be seeing you! Remember, Trainers, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!

entries.original:
"A Trainer’s BAG has a bunch of
nifty, convenient features!

Take stuff in the Key Items
POCKET, for instance.

You can use a key item without
opening the BAG every time.

For example, let’s pretend I have
a TEACHY TV in my BAG.

I can register it for instant use,
and I’ll show you how!

All righty, here goes!

Keep your eyes glued to the sorta
super POKé DUDE SHOW!"
entries.translation_source: A Trainer’s BAG has a bunch of nifty, convenient features! Take stuff in the Key Items POCKET, for instance. You can use a key item without opening the BAG every time. For example, let’s pretend I have a TEACHY TV in my BAG. I can register it for instant use, and I’ll show you how! All righty, here goes! Keep your eyes glued to the sorta super POKé DUDE SHOW!

entries.original:
"And now, your TEACHY TV is
registered.

How do you use it?
Well, here’s how it works.

Once an item in the Key Items
POKCET is registered, you can use\lit by pressing Select.

So, you’ve given yourself
one-touch access to TEACHY TV.

All it takes for you to see me is
pressing one button!

That kind of attention is a little
embarrassing!

All righty, be seeing you!

Remember, Trainers, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: And now, your TEACHY TV is registered. How do you use it? Well, here’s how it works. Once an item in the Key Items POKCET is registered, you can use it by pressing Select. So, you’ve given yourself one-touch access to TEACHY TV. All it takes for you to see me is pressing one button! That kind of attention is a little embarrassing! All righty, be seeing you! Remember, Trainers, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!

Dresco Town

entries.original:
"We just undertook a major drug
bust, but our targets got away,\lagain\.

Now we’re sulking."
entries.translation_source: We just undertook a major drug bust, but our targets got away, again[game-token-1] Now we’re sulking.
entries.translated:
Kami baru saja melakukan
penggerebekan narkoba besar, tapi\ltarget kami lolos lagi\. Sekarang

kami merajuk.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, but you can’t go in here
right now.

My grandfather is taking his daily
nap and doesn’t want anyone to\ldisturb him.

Come back later when he’s awake if
you want to talk with him."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, but you can’t go in here right now. My grandfather is taking his daily nap and doesn’t want anyone to disturb him. Come back later when he’s awake if you want to talk with him.
entries.translated:
Maaf, tapi kamu tidak bisa masuk ke
sini sekarang. Kakekku sedang tidur\lsiang dan tidak ingin diganggu.

Kembalilah nanti saat dia bangun
jika kamu ingin bicara dengannya.

entries.original:
"Have you visited the Dresco Town
Trainer House yet?

It’s the black and blue building at
the south end of town."
entries.translation_source: Have you visited the Dresco Town Trainer House yet? It’s the black and blue building at the south end of town.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah mengunjungi
Dresco Town Trainer House? Itu\ladalah bangunan hitam dan biru di

ujung selatan kota.

entries.original:
"This is a relatively new entrance
to the SES Expressway.

So we’re still working on building
a bridge to it."
entries.translation_source: This is a relatively new entrance to the SES Expressway. So we’re still working on building a bridge to it.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah pintu masuk yang relatif
baru ke SES Expressway. Jadi kami\lmasih mengerjakan pembangunan

jembatan ke sana.

entries.original:
"There’s this really pretty place to
the north of here called Flower\lParadise!

There are flowers everywhere!"
entries.translation_source: There’s this really pretty place to the north of here called Flower Paradise! There are flowers everywhere!
entries.translated:
Ada tempat yang sangat indah di
utara sini bernama Flower Paradise!\lAda bunga di mana-mana!

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Fire Pokémon, Moltres.

It says here that Moltres was once
used as a herald to a great\ldarkness, but now it resides in\lCinder Volcano."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Fire Pokémon, Moltres. It says here that Moltres was once used as a herald to a great darkness, but now it resides in Cinder Volcano.
entries.translated:
Itu patung Pokémon Api Legendaris,
Moltres. Tertulis di sini bahwa\lMoltres dulu digunakan sebagai

pertanda kegelapan besar, tapi
sekarang ia tinggal di Cinder\lVolcano.

entries.original:
"Welcome to Flower Paradise!

Please be careful to respect the
flowers and the Pokémon that live\lin them, while you are here."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to Flower Paradise! Please be careful to respect the flowers and the Pokémon that live in them, while you are here.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Flower Paradise!
Harap berhati-hati untuk\lmenghormati bunga dan Pokémon yang

tinggal di dalamnya, selama kamu di
sini.

entries.original:
"Route 3

\au Flower Paradise
\ad Dresco Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 3 [game-token-1] Flower Paradise [game-token-2] Dresco Town
entries.translated:
Route 3 \au Flower Paradise \ad Dresco
Town

entries.original:
"Here we go!

Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!"
entries.translation_source: Here we go! Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!
entries.translated:
Ayo kita mulai! Abra, Kadabra,
Reuniclus!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind let
me know."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind let me know.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berubah pikiran, beri
tahu aku.

entries.original:
"Hey kid!
Listen up.

The road up ahead is frought with
trainers wanting to battle.

Some people have even dubbed it
\qoChallenge Road\qc.

But hey, I understand if you don’t
want to battle them.

So using my amazing psychic powers,
I can teleport you to the other\lside for free!

What do you say, are you in?"
entries.translation_source: Hey kid! Listen up. The road up ahead is frought with trainers wanting to battle. Some people have even dubbed it [quote-open-1]Challenge Road[quote-close-2]. But hey, I understand if you don’t want to battle them. So using my amazing psychic powers, I can teleport you to the other side for free! What do you say, are you in?
entries.translated:
Hei, nak! Dengarkan. Jalan di depan
penuh dengan pelatih yang ingin\lbertarung. Beberapa orang bahkan

menyebutnya \qoChallenge Road\qc. Tapi
hei, aku mengerti jika kamu tidak\lingin bertarung dengan mereka. Jadi

dengan menggunakan kekuatan
psikisku yang luar biasa, aku bisa\lmemindahkanmu ke sisi lain secara

gratis! Bagaimana, kamu setuju?

entries.original:
"Dresco Town Pokémon Gym
Leader: Mirskle\lThe high up hippy!"
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town Pokémon Gym Leader: Mirskle The high up hippy!
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Dresco Town:
Mirskle Si hippi yang tinggi!

entries.original:
"Breathe it all in\.

That wonderful smell!"
entries.translation_source: Breathe it all in[game-token-1] That wonderful smell!
entries.translated: Hirup semuanya\. Bau yang indah itu!

entries.original:
"The Darkness Badge makes all
Pokémon up to Lv. 30 obey you.

That includes even outsiders you
received in a trade.

You can also now use the [green]HM Cut[blue]
anytime outside of battle.

Use it to cut down small trees to
open up new pathways.

I want you to have my favourite
TM, as well."
entries.translation_source: The Darkness Badge makes all Pokémon up to Lv. 30 obey you. That includes even outsiders you received in a trade. You can also now use the [color-green-1]HM Cut[color-blue-2] anytime outside of battle. Use it to cut down small trees to open up new pathways. I want you to have my favourite TM, as well.
entries.translated:
Lencana Kegelapan membuat semua
Pokémon hingga Lv. 30 mematuhimu.\lItu termasuk bahkan Pokémon luar

yang kamu terima dalam perdagangan.
Kamu juga sekarang bisa menggunakan\l[green]HM Potong[blue] kapan saja di luar

pertarungan. Gunakan untuk menebang
pohon kecil untuk membuka jalur\lbaru. Aku juga ingin kamu memiliki

TM favoritku.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, this feature is
unavailable right now."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, this feature is unavailable right now.
entries.translated:
Maaf, fitur ini tidak tersedia saat
ini.

entries.original:
"Sigh...

My poor Pokémon.

Ever since the entrance to the SES
Expressway froze over, they have\lhad nowhere to train.

Say, how would you like to battle
my Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Sigh... My poor Pokémon. Ever since the entrance to the SES Expressway froze over, they have had nowhere to train. Say, how would you like to battle my Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Huh... Pokémon-ku yang malang.
Sejak pintu masuk SES Expressway\lmembeku, mereka tidak punya tempat

untuk berlatih. Hei, bagaimana
kalau bertarung dengan Pokémon-ku?

entries.original:
"Well if you change your mind, feel
free to come back anytime!"
entries.translation_source: Well if you change your mind, feel free to come back anytime!
entries.translated:
Nah, jika kamu berubah pikiran,
silakan kembali kapan saja!

entries.original: "Let’s get started then!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get started then!
entries.translated: Kalau begitu, mari kita mulai!

entries.original:
"Now that the entrance to the SES
Expressway isn’t sealed anymore,\lI’ve finally been able to train!

Say, would you like to battle my
newly trained Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Now that the entrance to the SES Expressway isn’t sealed anymore, I’ve finally been able to train! Say, would you like to battle my newly trained Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Sekarang pintu masuk SES Expressway
tidak lagi tersegel, aku akhirnya\lbisa berlatih! Hei, apakah kamu

ingin bertarung dengan Pokémon-ku
yang baru dilatih?

entries.original: "Thanks for battling with me!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks for battling with me!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah bertarung
denganku!

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

Looks like ya opened up a pathway
for yurself.

Now just keep heading [green]east[blue] until
you reach [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! Looks like ya opened up a pathway for yurself. Now just keep heading [color-green-1]east[color-blue-2] until you reach [color-green-3]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-4]
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Sepertinya kamu
membuka jalan untuk dirimu sendiri.\lSekarang teruslah menuju [green]timur[blue]

sampai kamu mencapai [green]Gunung
Thundercap[blue]

entries.original:
"Sometimes the [green]Oddish Leaves [blue]get to
me and I see things that aren’t\lreally there."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes the [color-green-1]Oddish Leaves [color-blue-2]get to me and I see things that aren’t really there.
entries.translated:
Kadang-kadang [green]Oddish Leaves
[blue]mempengaruhiku dan aku melihat\lhal-hal yang tidak benar-benar ada.

entries.original: "Do you know what a [green]Gem [blue]is?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know what a [color-green-1]Gem [color-blue-2]is?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu tahu apa itu [green]Gem [blue]?

entries.original: "[black]Krook: [green]Dile!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Krook: [color-green-2]Dile!
entries.translated: [black]Krook: [green]Dile!

entries.original: "Skull!"
entries.translation_source: Skull!
entries.translated: Skull!

entries.original:
"TM46 teaches [green]Thief[blue].

It’s the perfect TM for sneaky
trainers."
entries.translation_source: TM46 teaches [color-green-1]Thief[color-blue-2]. It’s the perfect TM for sneaky trainers.
entries.translated:
TM46 mengajarkan [green]Pencuri[blue]. Itu TM
yang sempurna untuk pelatih yang\llicik.

entries.original:
"One last piece of advice.

Try to stay in the light and out of
the shadows as much as possible.

If you follow this advice, it will
not bring you to ruin.

I promise\."
entries.translation_source: One last piece of advice. Try to stay in the light and out of the shadows as much as possible. If you follow this advice, it will not bring you to ruin. I promise[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Satu nasihat terakhir. Cobalah
untuk tetap di tempat terang dan\lmenjauhi bayang-bayang sebisa

mungkin. Jika kamu mengikuti
nasihat ini, itu tidak akan\lmembawamu ke kehancuran. Aku janji\.

entries.original:
"Looks like you already have
Thief\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you already have Thief[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu sudah memiliki
Pencuri\.

entries.original: "[black]Hitmontop: [green]Top!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Hitmontop: [color-green-2]Top!
entries.translated: [black]Hitmontop: [green]Top!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Ahh\.
Right on schedule.

Tell me, [buffer1], what’s your name?

\.

[player], is it?

At last, we finally meet.

I am Zeph, the man in charge of
The Shadows.

I’ve been informed that you have
trespassed in our laboratory and\lare aware of what we have created.

This is unacceptable.

If word of our experiments got out,
it’d be the end for us.

Our secret must remain in the
shadows until we have reached our\lgoals."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Ahh[game-token-2] Right on schedule. Tell me, [buffer1-3], what’s your name? [game-token-4] [player-name-5], is it? At last, we finally meet. I am Zeph, the man in charge of The Shadows. I’ve been informed that you have trespassed in our laboratory and are aware of what we have created. This is unacceptable. If word of our experiments got out, it’d be the end for us. Our secret must remain in the shadows until we have reached our goals.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Ahh\. Tepat waktu. Katakan
padaku, [buffer1], siapa namamu? \.\l[player], ya? Akhirnya, kita

bertemu. Aku Zeph, orang yang
memimpin The Shadows. Aku diberi\ltahu bahwa kamu telah masuk tanpa

izin ke laboratorium kami dan tahu
apa yang telah kami ciptakan. Ini\ltidak dapat diterima. Jika berita

eksperimen kami bocor, itu akan
menjadi akhir bagi kami. Rahasia\lkami harus tetap dalam

bayang-bayang sampai kami mencapai
tujuan kami.

entries.original:
"[blue]Therefore, Ivory here will be
giving you a little incentive for\lkeeping your mouth shut."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Therefore, Ivory here will be giving you a little incentive for keeping your mouth shut.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oleh karena itu, Ivory di sini akan
memberikanmu sedikit insentif untuk\ltutup mulut.

entries.original:
"Surprise!
It’s time to battle now!"
entries.translation_source: Surprise! It’s time to battle now!

entries.original:
"I guess scaring you didn’t seal in
my victory."
entries.translation_source: I guess scaring you didn’t seal in my victory.

entries.original:
"I’m camping out here to scare
anyone who passes by."
entries.translation_source: I’m camping out here to scare anyone who passes by.
entries.translated:
Aku berkemah di sini untuk
menakut-nakuti siapa pun yang\llewat.

entries.original:
"Epidimy Town

A quaint town surrounded by
mountains."
entries.translation_source: Epidimy Town A quaint town surrounded by mountains.
entries.translated:
Epidimy Town Kota kecil yang
dikelilingi pegunungan.

entries.original:
"Fallshore City

The waterfall capital of Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City The waterfall capital of Borrius.
entries.translated:
Fallshore City Ibu kota air terjun
di Borrius.

entries.original:
"Tehl Town

A town where it’s always Autumn."
entries.translation_source: Tehl Town A town where it’s always Autumn.
entries.translated:
Tehl Town Kota yang selalu musim
gugur.

entries.original:
"I hope I don’t slip and fall off of
this bridge."
entries.translation_source: I hope I don’t slip and fall off of this bridge.
entries.translated:
Semoga aku tidak terpeleset dan
jatuh dari jembatan ini.

entries.original:
"I don’t think it’s a such a good
idea to paint in the rain.

Everything I paint gets
washed away\."
entries.translation_source: I don’t think it’s a such a good idea to paint in the rain. Everything I paint gets washed away[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kurasa bukan ide bagus untuk
melukis di tengah hujan. Semua yang\lkulukis hanyut\.

entries.original:
"A life of gambling is a life of no
regrets."
entries.translation_source: A life of gambling is a life of no regrets.
entries.translated:
Hidup berjudi adalah hidup tanpa
penyesalan.

entries.original:
"I train myself everyday by running
barefoot across these stones."
entries.translation_source: I train myself everyday by running barefoot across these stones.
entries.translated:
Aku melatih diriku setiap hari
dengan berlari tanpa alas kaki di\latas batu-batu ini.

entries.original:
"I am but the first of many
trainers on this road."
entries.translation_source: I am but the first of many trainers on this road.
entries.translated:
Aku hanyalah yang pertama dari
banyak pelatih di jalan ini.

entries.original:
"Drat!
A Zubat bit me back in that cave."
entries.translation_source: Drat! A Zubat bit me back in that cave.
entries.translated:
Sial! Seekor Zubat menggigitku di
gua itu.

entries.original:
"My friend has many cute Pokémon.
I’m so jealous!"
entries.translation_source: My friend has many cute Pokémon. I’m so jealous!

entries.original:
"You came from Icicle Cave?
May I have a Swinub?"
entries.translation_source: You came from Icicle Cave? May I have a Swinub?
entries.translated:
Kamu datang dari Gua Icicle? Boleh
aku minta Swinub?

entries.original:
"Let’s watch them set up hazards
when you’re around, Hitmontop!

We’ll dominate [green]OU Doubles[blue]!

All will fall beneath your head
spike!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s watch them set up hazards when you’re around, Hitmontop! We’ll dominate [color-green-1]OU Doubles[color-blue-2]! All will fall beneath your head spike!
entries.translated:
Ayo lihat mereka memasang hazard
saat kau di dekat, Hitmontop! Kita\lakan mendominasi [green]OU Doubles[blue]! Semua

akan jatuh di bawah paku kepalamu!

entries.original: "Pokémon Day Care"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Day Care
entries.translated: Pokémon Day Care

entries.original:
"When Pokémon gain enough
experience, they can evolve and\lgrow stronger.

Some even learn special moves after
evolution.

However, not all Pokémon can
evolve just by battling enough.

Some require special items like
[green]Fire Stones[blue] or [green]Water Stones[blue]."
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon gain enough experience, they can evolve and grow stronger. Some even learn special moves after evolution. However, not all Pokémon can evolve just by battling enough. Some require special items like [color-green-1]Fire Stones[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Water Stones[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Ketika Pokémon mendapat cukup
pengalaman, mereka bisa berevolusi\ldan menjadi lebih kuat. Beberapa

bahkan mempelajari jurus khusus
setelah evolusi. Namun, tidak semua\lPokémon bisa berevolusi hanya

dengan bertarung cukup. Beberapa
membutuhkan item khusus seperti\l[green]Fire Stones[blue] atau [green]Water Stones[blue].

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Here’s a taste of what’ll
happen to you if you spill!"
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Here’s a taste of what’ll happen to you if you spill!
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Ini sedikit gambaran apa
yang akan terjadi padamu jika kau\lbocor!

entries.original:
"If I had my full team on me, you
would’ve lost!"
entries.translation_source: If I had my full team on me, you would’ve lost!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Oh, Ivory\.

How could you and Marlon both fail
me?

I thought you were stronger than
this\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Oh, Ivory[game-token-2] How could you and Marlon both fail me? I thought you were stronger than this[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Oh, Ivory\. Bagaimana bisa kamu
dan Marlon berdua mengecewakanku?\lKupikir kau lebih kuat dari ini\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Zeph, we’re scientists.

We’re not meant to be doing this
kind of thing\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Zeph, we’re scientists. We’re not meant to be doing this kind of thing[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Zeph, kami ilmuwan. Kami
tidak seharusnya melakukan hal\lseperti ini\.

entries.original: "\au Pokemon Day Care"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] Pokemon Day Care
entries.translated: \au Pokemon Day Care

entries.original:
"The bookshelf by the wall has
great books on advanced battling\ltechniques.

Right now, I’m studying up on the
various [green]Terrains [blue]and their\leffects in battle.

You should definitely check it out
if you’re aiming for the top."
entries.translation_source: The bookshelf by the wall has great books on advanced battling techniques. Right now, I’m studying up on the various [color-green-1]Terrains [color-blue-2]and their effects in battle. You should definitely check it out if you’re aiming for the top.
entries.translated:
Rak buku di dinding memiliki
buku-buku bagus tentang teknik\lbertarung tingkat lanjut. Saat ini,

saya sedang mempelajari berbagai
[green]Medan [blue]dan efeknya dalam\lpertempuran. Kamu pasti harus

memeriksanya jika kamu ingin
menjadi yang teratas.

entries.original:
"Hah!

Those [green]Protective Pads [blue]look great
on you, Krook!

The next time we come up against a
[green]Ferrothorn [blue]holding a [green]Rocky Helmet[blue],\lit’ll be in for a real shocker!"
entries.translation_source: Hah! Those [color-green-1]Protective Pads [color-blue-2]look great on you, Krook! The next time we come up against a [color-green-3]Ferrothorn [color-blue-4]holding a [color-green-5]Rocky Helmet[color-blue-6], it’ll be in for a real shocker!
entries.translated:
Hah! [green]Bantalan Pelindung [blue]itu
terlihat bagus padamu, Krook! Lain\lkali kita bertemu dengan [green]Ferrothorn

[blue]yang memegang [green]Helm Batu[blue], dia akan
mendapat kejutan besar!

entries.original:
"As you can clearly see, the Battle
Tower is a great facility.

Apparently, there are similar
facilities dotted around Borrius."
entries.translation_source: As you can clearly see, the Battle Tower is a great facility. Apparently, there are similar facilities dotted around Borrius.
entries.translated:
Seperti yang bisa kamu lihat dengan
jelas, Menara Pertarungan adalah\lfasilitas yang hebat. Rupanya, ada

fasilitas serupa yang tersebar di
sekitar Borrius.

entries.original:
"Do you see that [green]Porygon[red]?

If you talk to it, you can directly
interface with the Pokémon Storage\lSystem!

Why use a PC when a Pokémon can do
it for you?"
entries.translation_source: Do you see that [color-green-1]Porygon[color-red-2]? If you talk to it, you can directly interface with the Pokémon Storage System! Why use a PC when a Pokémon can do it for you?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu melihat [green]Porygon[red] itu?
Jika kamu berbicara dengannya, kamu\lbisa langsung berinteraksi dengan

Sistem Penyimpanan Pokémon! Kenapa
menggunakan PC jika Pokémon bisa\lmelakukannya untukmu?

entries.original:
"Does battling this high up make
you feel elated?"
entries.translation_source: Does battling this high up make you feel elated?

entries.original: "Maybe I’m just high\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I’m just high[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Huh?
I don’t do Oddish Leaves!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? I don’t do Oddish Leaves!
entries.translated:
Hah? Aku tidak menggunakan Oddish
Leaves!

entries.original:
"I’ve been here for days, but I
can’t seem to catch anything good."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been here for days, but I can’t seem to catch anything good.

entries.original:
"As soon as we finished the bridge
to this new entrance, the walls\lcracked open and the sea water\lstarted flooding in!

Because why would we get a day off?"
entries.translation_source: As soon as we finished the bridge to this new entrance, the walls cracked open and the sea water started flooding in! Because why would we get a day off?
entries.translated:
Begitu kami menyelesaikan jembatan
ke pintu masuk baru ini,\ldinding-dinding retak dan air laut

mulai membanjiri! Karena kenapa
kami bisa mendapatkan hari libur?

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, this road is closed at
the moment.

We’re about to undertake a major
drug bust, and we can’t let anyone\lescape!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, this road is closed at the moment. We’re about to undertake a major drug bust, and we can’t let anyone escape!
entries.translated:
Maaf, jalan ini ditutup saat ini.
Kami akan melakukan penggerebekan\lnarkoba besar-besaran, dan kami

tidak bisa membiarkan siapa pun
melarikan diri!

entries.original:
"Get moving [player].

You don’t want to miss Jax taking
on The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: Get moving [player-name-1]. You don’t want to miss Jax taking on The Shadows.
entries.translated:
Bergeraklah [player]. Kamu tidak
ingin melewatkan Jax yang\lmenghadapi The Shadows.

entries.original:
"I will uncover the secrets of
Cinder Volcano!"
entries.translation_source: I will uncover the secrets of Cinder Volcano!
entries.translated:
Aku akan mengungkap rahasia Cinder
Volcano!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Hold the [green]B-button[black] to run!

Press the [green]L-button[black] to toggle
auto-run!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Hold the [color-green-1]B-button[color-black-2] to run! Press the [color-green-3]L-button[color-black-4] to toggle auto-run!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Tahan [green]Tombol B[black] untuk
berlari! Tekan [green]Tombol L[black] untuk\lmengaktifkan lari otomatis!

entries.original: "???: [blue][buffer3]’s unconcious, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1][buffer3-2]’s unconcious, Hoopa.
entries.translated: ???: [blue][buffer3] tidak sadar, Hoopa.

entries.original:
"Stop!

What did I tell you about
travelling through my Cube Space?

Just because you can’t travel
through your Rings, it doesn’t\lmean you can use my Cube without\lpermission!"
entries.translation_source: Stop! What did I tell you about travelling through my Cube Space? Just because you can’t travel through your Rings, it doesn’t mean you can use my Cube without permission!
entries.translated:
Berhenti! Apa yang sudah kukatakan
tentang bepergian melalui Ruang\lKubusku? Hanya karena kamu tidak

bisa bepergian melalui Cincinmu,
bukan berarti kamu bisa menggunakan\lKubusku tanpa izin!

entries.original:
"And were you responsible for
bringing these two here?"
entries.translation_source: And were you responsible for bringing these two here?
entries.translated:
Dan apakah kamu yang bertanggung
jawab membawa mereka berdua ke\lsini?

entries.original:
"I don’t know what you wanted with
them, but you’ve been a nuisance\lever since I found you on that\lbeach 16 years ago!

I may not be your true \qoguardian\qc,
but I’m your trainer now!

And you will obey me!

These two won’t rescue you from me!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t know what you wanted with them, but you’ve been a nuisance ever since I found you on that beach 16 years ago! I may not be your true [quote-open-1]guardian[quote-close-2], but I’m your trainer now! And you will obey me! These two won’t rescue you from me!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tahu apa yang kamu
inginkan dari mereka, tapi kamu\ltelah menjadi gangguan sejak aku

menemukanmu di pantai itu 16 tahun
yang lalu! Aku mungkin bukan \qowali\qc\lsejatimu, tapi aku pelatihmu

sekarang! Dan kamu akan mematuhiku!
Mereka berdua tidak akan\lmenyelamatkanmu dariku!

entries.original: "What a pain\."
entries.translation_source: What a pain[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sungguh menyebalkan\.

entries.original:
"Where do you think you’re going,
kid?

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Where do you think you’re going, kid? I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir kamu mau ke mana, nak?
Aku diperintahkan secara ketat\luntuk mengurungmu.

entries.original:
"He’s unconscious.
Better leave him alone for now."
entries.translation_source: He’s unconscious. Better leave him alone for now.
entries.translated:
Dia tidak sadar. Lebih baik biarkan
dia sendiri untuk sekarang.

entries.original:
"He’s unconscious.

What’s this?

There’s something written on his
shirt.

It’s his name!
It is\."
entries.translation_source: He’s unconscious. What’s this? There’s something written on his shirt. It’s his name! It is[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dia tidak sadar. Apa ini? Ada
sesuatu yang tertulis di bajunya.\lItu namanya! Namanya adalah\.

entries.original: "Is his name [rival]?"
entries.translation_source: Is his name [text-token-rival-1]?
entries.translated: Apakah namanya [rival]?

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]\.

Huh? What’s going on?
Where am I?"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2][game-token-3] Huh? What’s going on? Where am I?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]\. Hah? Apa yang terjadi?
Di mana aku?

entries.original:
"What’s going on?

\.

Oh, wait\.

You’re that kid from down the
road.

[player], right?

Do you know what we’re doing here?"
entries.translation_source: What’s going on? [game-token-1] Oh, wait[game-token-2] You’re that kid from down the road. [player-name-3], right? Do you know what we’re doing here?
entries.translated:
Ada apa? \. Oh, tunggu\.Kamu anak dari
ujung jalan itu. [player], kan?\lKamu tahu apa yang kita lakukan di

sini?

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Looks like I’m here.

I’d better get moving then."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Looks like I’m here. I’d better get moving then.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Sepertinya aku sudah sampai.
Lebih baik aku segera bergerak\lkalau begitu.

entries.original:
"There are so many Fire Pokémon
here!"
entries.translation_source: There are so many Fire Pokémon here!

entries.original: "I’m just burning up with happiness!"
entries.translation_source: I’m just burning up with happiness!

entries.original:
"Maybe I should check if I have a
fever\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should check if I have a fever[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku harus periksa apakah
aku demam\.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Duskull, use Shadow Sneak!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Duskull, use Shadow Sneak!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Duskull, gunakan Serangan
Bayangan!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Your shadowy reign of terror
stops here and now!

I won’t let you escape from Cinder
Volcano with Moltres in hand!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Your shadowy reign of terror stops here and now! I won’t let you escape from Cinder Volcano with Moltres in hand!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Kekuasaan teror bayanganmu
berhenti di sini dan sekarang! Aku\ltidak akan membiarkanmu kabur dari

Cinder Volcano dengan Moltres di
tangan!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]INSOLENT WHELP!

Who do you think you are
to threaten The Shadows!?

We’ve been ordered to assist Lady
Ivory, so don’t even think for a\lsecond that you can stop us!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]INSOLENT WHELP! Who do you think you are to threaten The Shadows!? We’ve been ordered to assist Lady Ivory, so don’t even think for a second that you can stop us!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]ANAK KURANG AJAR! Kamu
pikir kamu siapa berani mengancam\lThe Shadows!? Kami diperintahkan

untuk membantu Lady Ivory, jadi
jangan pernah berpikir sejenak pun\lkamu bisa menghentikan kami!

entries.original: "Ivory: [red]Well spoken, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Well spoken, Marlon.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Kata-kata yang bagus,
Marlon.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Moltres is sealed away.

I’m heading back to HQ.

You might want to take care of that
kid watching, before you join me."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Moltres is sealed away. I’m heading back to HQ. You might want to take care of that kid watching, before you join me.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Moltres sudah disegel. Aku
akan kembali ke HQ. Kamu mungkin\lingin mengurus anak yang sedang

menonton itu, sebelum bergabung
denganku.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Ohh...
My head..."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Ohh... My head...
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Ohh... Kepalaku...

entries.original:
"[blue]Ahh...

That hurt quite a bit.

Let’s head back to my grandfather’s
house to tell him what happened."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ahh... That hurt quite a bit. Let’s head back to my grandfather’s house to tell him what happened.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ahh... Itu cukup sakit. Ayo kembali
ke rumah kakekku untuk\lmemberitahunya apa yang terjadi.

entries.original:
"[blue]Wha...
How could I lose!?

I’ll retreat for now, but I won’t
forget this!

You’ll be seeing me again soon!

I guarantee it\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Wha... How could I lose!? I’ll retreat for now, but I won’t forget this! You’ll be seeing me again soon! I guarantee it[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa... Bagaimana aku bisa kalah!?
Aku akan mundur untuk sekarang,\ltapi aku tidak akan melupakan ini!

Kamu akan bertemu denganku lagi
segera! Aku jamin\.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Hmm\.

This isn’t good.

At this point, only one Legendary
bird remains, [green]Zapdos[blue].

It’s imperative that it be rescued
before The Shadows can capture it."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]Hmm[game-token-2] This isn’t good. At this point, only one Legendary bird remains, [color-green-3]Zapdos[color-blue-4]. It’s imperative that it be rescued before The Shadows can capture it.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Hmm\. Ini tidak bagus. Pada
titik ini, hanya satu burung\lLegendaris yang tersisa, [green]Zapdos[blue].

Sangat penting untuk
menyelamatkannya sebelum The\lShadows bisa menangkapnya.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Understood, Grandpa.

I’ll go to it right away."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Understood, Grandpa. I’ll go to it right away.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Mengerti, Kakek. Aku akan
segera ke sana.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Actually, Jax, I have a
different task for you.

To the best of my knowledge, The
Shadows are still missing the\lobject used to seal away the dark\lforce.

A friend of mine that lives on
[green]Route 9, [blue]should know its location.

Go to him and explain the sitution.

I’m sure he’ll be willing to help
us find it before The Shadows do."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]Actually, Jax, I have a different task for you. To the best of my knowledge, The Shadows are still missing the object used to seal away the dark force. A friend of mine that lives on [color-green-2]Route 9, [color-blue-3]should know its location. Go to him and explain the sitution. I’m sure he’ll be willing to help us find it before The Shadows do.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Sebenarnya, Jax, aku punya
tugas lain untukmu. Sejauh\lpengetahuanku, The Shadows masih

kehilangan benda yang digunakan
untuk menyegel kekuatan gelap.\lSeorang temanku yang tinggal di

[green]Route 9, [blue]seharusnya tahu lokasinya.
Temui dia dan jelaskan situasinya.\lAku yakin dia akan bersedia

membantu kita menemukannya sebelum
The Shadows melakukannya.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]Okay, Grandpa."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Okay, Grandpa.
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Baiklah, Kakek.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Good, good.

As for you, [player], I want you
to head to [green]Thundercap Mt. [blue]and\lsave [green]Zapdos[blue].

You’ve proven yourself by defending
Jax back in Cinder Volcano, and I\lthink you’re up for the task.

You can get to [green]Thundercap Mt. [blue]
by taking the highway southeast\lfrom the next town over, [green]Crater\lTown[blue].

If you don’t hurry, the Borrius
region will be doomed."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]Good, good. As for you, [player-name-2], I want you to head to [color-green-3]Thundercap Mt. [color-blue-4]and save [color-green-5]Zapdos[color-blue-6]. You’ve proven yourself by defending Jax back in Cinder Volcano, and I think you’re up for the task. You can get to [color-green-7]Thundercap Mt. [color-blue-8] by taking the highway southeast from the next town over, [color-green-9]Crater Town[color-blue-10]. If you don’t hurry, the Borrius region will be doomed.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Bagus, bagus. Sedangkan
untukmu, [player], aku ingin kamu\lpergi ke [green]Thundercap Mt. [blue]dan

selamatkan [green]Zapdos[blue]. Kamu telah
membuktikan dirimu dengan membela\lJax di Cinder Volcano, dan aku

pikir kamu mampu melakukan tugas
ini. Kamu bisa sampai ke [green]Thundercap\lMt. [blue] dengan mengambil jalan tol ke

tenggara dari kota sebelah, [green]Crater
Town[blue]. Jika kamu tidak cepat,\lwilayah Borrius akan hancur.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]I’ll be heading back to [green]Frozen
Heights[blue], [player].

I’ll let your mother know what the
situation is."
entries.translation_source: Log: [color-blue-1]I’ll be heading back to [color-green-2]Frozen Heights[color-blue-3], [player-name-4]. I’ll let your mother know what the situation is.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Aku akan kembali ke [green]Frozen
Heights[blue], [player]. Aku akan memberi\ltahu ibumu tentang situasinya.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]My Staraptor is still pretty
weak from that fight from before,\lbut I should be able to give you a\lride up to Cinder Volcano.

We don’t have much time, so let’s
head out right away."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]My Staraptor is still pretty weak from that fight from before, but I should be able to give you a ride up to Cinder Volcano. We don’t have much time, so let’s head out right away.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Staraptor-ku masih cukup lemah
dari pertarungan sebelumnya, tapi\laku seharusnya bisa mengantarmu

naik ke Cinder Volcano. Kita tidak
punya banyak waktu, jadi ayo\lberangkat sekarang.

entries.original:
"Á
9999999999999Crater Town is an ideal place for
researchers like myself.

So much history\.

So much mystery\."
entries.translation_source: Á 9999999999999Crater Town is an ideal place for researchers like myself. So much history[game-token-1] So much mystery[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Á 9999999999999Crater Town adalah
tempat yang ideal bagi peneliti\lseperti diriku. Begitu banyak

sejarah\. Begitu banyak misteri\.

entries.original:
"The meteorites in Crater Town are
imbued with some sort of cosmic\lpower.

They say that if a certain
Pokémon comes in contact with\lone, strange things will happen."
entries.translation_source: The meteorites in Crater Town are imbued with some sort of cosmic power. They say that if a certain Pokémon comes in contact with one, strange things will happen.
entries.translated:
Meteorit-meteorit di Crater Town
diresapi dengan semacam kekuatan\lkosmik. Mereka bilang bahwa jika

suatu Pokémon bersentuhan dengan
salah satunya, hal-hal aneh akan\lterjadi.

entries.original:
"Through that cave over there is
another way to leave Crater Town.

But since you need the Darkness
Badge to access it, most people\ljust stick to the SES Expressway."
entries.translation_source: Through that cave over there is another way to leave Crater Town. But since you need the Darkness Badge to access it, most people just stick to the SES Expressway.
entries.translated:
Melalui gua di sana ada cara lain
untuk meninggalkan Crater Town.\lTapi karena kamu membutuhkan

Darkness Badge untuk mengaksesnya,
kebanyakan orang hanya menggunakan\lSES Expressway.

entries.original:
"It’s a mysterious meteorite that
fell from the stars."
entries.translation_source: It’s a mysterious meteorite that fell from the stars.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah meteorit misterius yang
jatuh dari bintang-bintang.

entries.original:
"There appears to be a hidden path
behind the bookshelf.

Would you like to follow it?"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be a hidden path behind the bookshelf. Would you like to follow it?
entries.translated:
Sepertinya ada jalan tersembunyi di
balik rak buku. Apakah kamu ingin\lmengikutinya?

entries.original: "The trash can is empty."
entries.translation_source: The trash can is empty.
entries.translated: Tempat sampah kosong.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Dresco Town Trainer
House!

Feel free to battle our five
trainers as many times as you want.

If you wish to rebattle someone,
please leave and come back in.

Enjoy your time!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Dresco Town Trainer House! Feel free to battle our five trainers as many times as you want. If you wish to rebattle someone, please leave and come back in. Enjoy your time!
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Dresco Town
Trainer House! Bebas bertarung\lmelawan lima pelatih kami sebanyak

yang kamu mau. Jika kamu ingin
bertarung ulang dengan seseorang,\lsilakan keluar dan masuk lagi.

Nikmati waktu kamu!

entries.original:
"My water types will soak you to
your core!"
entries.translation_source: My water types will soak you to your core!

entries.original: "You’ve dried up my water."
entries.translation_source: You’ve dried up my water.

entries.original:
"Hello, there.

Wait\.

Can it be\.

Are you the [buffer1] of the
legendary Arceus trainer, [green]Aros[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Hello, there. Wait[game-token-1] Can it be[game-token-2] Are you the [buffer1-3] of the legendary Arceus trainer, [color-green-4]Aros[color-blue-5]?
entries.translated:
Halo, di sana. Tunggu\. Mungkinkah\.
Apakah kamu [buffer1] dari pelatih\llegendaris Arceus, [green]Aros[blue]?

entries.original: "Taste my dark fury!"
entries.translation_source: Taste my dark fury!

entries.original:
"My rage and power only grow from
this defeat."
entries.translation_source: My rage and power only grow from this defeat.

entries.original:
"Hey there [buffer1]\.

How’z it hangin’?

You wanna sniff on some
Oddish Leaves?

They’re really good for the soul.
Makes it nice and mellow\."
entries.translation_source: Hey there [buffer1-1][game-token-2] How’z it hangin’? You wanna sniff on some Oddish Leaves? They’re really good for the soul. Makes it nice and mellow[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Hei [buffer1]\. Gimana kabarnya? Kamu
mau mengendus beberapa Oddish\lLeaves? Mereka sangat baik untuk

jiwa. Membuatnya nyaman dan mellow\.

entries.original:
"[black]You sniffed on some Oddish Leaves.

The repugnant scent assails your
nostrils."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You sniffed on some Oddish Leaves. The repugnant scent assails your nostrils.
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu mengendus beberapa Oddish
Leaves. Bau yang menjijikkan\lmenyerang lubang hidungmu.

entries.original:
"Now, I’m guessin’ you came for a
battle?

I’m in the perfect mood to indulge
you\."
entries.translation_source: Now, I’m guessin’ you came for a battle? I’m in the perfect mood to indulge you[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sekarang, saya kira kamu datang
untuk bertarung? Saya dalam suasana\lhati yang sempurna untuk melayanimu\.

entries.original: "My grass types will help me win!"
entries.translation_source: My grass types will help me win!

entries.original:
"My brother caught his Pokémon
by talking a Poké Ball in\lVivill Woods.

But I heard different Pokémon
appear for different trainers."
entries.translation_source: My brother caught his Pokémon by talking a Poké Ball in Vivill Woods. But I heard different Pokémon appear for different trainers.
entries.translated:
Kakakku menangkap Pokémon-nya
dengan mengambil Poké Ball di\lVivill Woods. Tapi aku dengar

Pokémon yang berbeda muncul untuk
pelatih yang berbeda.

entries.original:
"They say the warehouse on the hill
was abadoned after some experiment\lwent horribly wrong inside."
entries.translation_source: They say the warehouse on the hill was abadoned after some experiment went horribly wrong inside.
entries.translated:
Mereka bilang gudang di bukit itu
ditinggalkan setelah suatu\leksperimen berjalan sangat salah di

dalamnya.

entries.original:
"You came down from the mountain?

It must feel pretty warm to you
here."
entries.translation_source: You came down from the mountain? It must feel pretty warm to you here.
entries.translated:
Kamu turun dari gunung? Pasti
terasa cukup hangat bagimu di sini.

entries.original:
"Normally when the road is clear,
you can visit Dewp’s Bike Shop and\lget some handy bikes!"
entries.translation_source: Normally when the road is clear, you can visit Dewp’s Bike Shop and get some handy bikes!
entries.translated:
Biasanya kalau jalannya bersih,
kamu bisa mengunjungi Dewp{B4}s Bike\lShop dan mendapatkan sepeda yang

berguna!

entries.original: "I love running around on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: I love running around on the beach!

entries.original: "Oh no, you beat me!"
entries.translation_source: Oh no, you beat me!

entries.original:
"No matter how many times I lose, I
will always play after!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how many times I lose, I will always play after!
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli berapa kali aku kalah,
aku akan selalu bermain lagi!

entries.original: "I’m where I love to be."
entries.translation_source: I’m where I love to be.
entries.translated: Aku berada di tempat yang kucintai.

entries.original:
"        It’s you!
The big [buffer1] who saved me!

You’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you! The big [buffer1-1] who saved me! You’re the best!

entries.original:
"The warehouse on the hill has sat
abandoned for as long as I can\lremember.

Apparently it goes so deep into the
ground, there were floors unused by\leven the gang that was there.

I can only imagine what treasures
they hold!"
entries.translation_source: The warehouse on the hill has sat abandoned for as long as I can remember. Apparently it goes so deep into the ground, there were floors unused by even the gang that was there. I can only imagine what treasures they hold!
entries.translated:
Gudang di bukit itu sudah
ditinggalkan selama yang aku ingat.\lRupanya, tempat itu sangat dalam ke

tanah, ada lantai-lantai yang
bahkan tidak digunakan oleh geng\lyang ada di sana. Aku hanya bisa

membayangkan harta apa yang mereka
simpan!

entries.original:
"The SES Expressway runs from Crater
Town to Tehl Town beneath us."
entries.translation_source: The SES Expressway runs from Crater Town to Tehl Town beneath us.
entries.translated:
SES Expressway membentang dari
Crater Town ke Tehl Town di bawah\lkita.

entries.original:
"I wonder how much weight the ground
can hold up?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder how much weight the ground can hold up?

entries.original: "Enough for a good battle!"
entries.translation_source: Enough for a good battle!

entries.original:
"If 100 people like me stood here,
do you the ground could support it?"
entries.translation_source: If 100 people like me stood here, do you the ground could support it?
entries.translated:
Jika 100 orang seperti aku berdiri
di sini, apakah menurutmu tanahnya\lbisa menopangnya?

entries.original: "I love having picnics on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: I love having picnics on the beach!

entries.original: "You ruined my picnic!"
entries.translation_source: You ruined my picnic!

entries.original:
"If only there was someone to have a
picnic with\."
entries.translation_source: If only there was someone to have a picnic with[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Andai saja ada seseorang untuk
piknik bersama\.

entries.original: "What are you looking at?"
entries.translation_source: What are you looking at?
entries.translated: Apa yang kamu lihat?

entries.original: "I’m just relaxing here."
entries.translation_source: I’m just relaxing here.

entries.original:
"Even roughnecks like me need a
break once in a while."
entries.translation_source: Even roughnecks like me need a break once in a while.
entries.translated:
Bahkan preman sepertiku butuh
istirahat sesekali.

entries.original:
"Wahahah! This dude’s going to catch
himself a big one!"
entries.translation_source: Wahahah! This dude’s going to catch himself a big one!

entries.original: "This dude just lost one\."
entries.translation_source: This dude just lost one[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"When those strange thugs marched
into town, we were all sure to lock\lour doors very quickly.

If we hadn’t, they most likely
would’ve barged right in like you,\land taken all our valuables for\ltheir nefarious plot,"
entries.translation_source: When those strange thugs marched into town, we were all sure to lock our doors very quickly. If we hadn’t, they most likely would’ve barged right in like you, and taken all our valuables for their nefarious plot,
entries.translated:
Saat preman aneh itu berbaris masuk
ke kota, kami semua pasti mengunci\lpintu dengan cepat. Jika tidak,

mereka kemungkinan besar akan
menerobos masuk sepertimu, dan\lmengambil semua barang berharga

kami untuk rencana jahat mereka.

entries.original:
"This dude thinks you’re a big one.
No, you’re a big-one-to-be!"
entries.translation_source: This dude thinks you’re a big one. No, you’re a big-one-to-be!
entries.translated:
Orang ini mengira kamu adalah ikan
besar. Tidak, kamu adalah calon\likan besar!

entries.original:
"Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll hook
a big one!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll hook a big one!
entries.translated:
Oh, tidak! Aku punya firasat aku
akan memancing ikan besar!

entries.original:
"I must refine the art of concealment.
I bid thee farewell."
entries.translation_source: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.
entries.translated:
Aku harus menyempurnakan seni
penyamaran. Aku pamit.

entries.original:
"I’ve been in the hot sand and
refreshed my tired bones.\lRight now I’m feeling strong!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve been in the hot sand and refreshed my tired bones. Right now I’m feeling strong!

entries.original:
"Oh, my goodness.
Now, aren’t you something!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, my goodness. Now, aren’t you something!

entries.original:
"Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call
myself an Expert now, can I?"
entries.translation_source: Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call myself an Expert now, can I?
entries.translated:
Nah, nah, aku kalah. Aku tidak bisa
menyebut diriku Pakar sekarang,\lkan?

entries.original:
"It’d be a handful if I hooked
your tough Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: It’d be a handful if I hooked your tough Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Akan merepotkan jika aku memancing
Pokémon tangguhmu!

entries.original: "Stay safe in the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Stay safe in the Great Desert!
entries.translated: Tetap aman di Gurun Besar!

entries.original:
"There used to be a Clefairy by
the bookshelf a long time ago.

I wonder where it went?"
entries.translation_source: There used to be a Clefairy by the bookshelf a long time ago. I wonder where it went?
entries.translated:
Dulu ada Clefairy di dekat rak
buku. Entah ke mana perginya?

entries.original:
"How’s about I toss a free [green]TM[blue]
your way?"
entries.translation_source: How’s about I toss a free [color-green-1]TM[color-blue-2] your way?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kalau aku memberikan [green]TM[blue]
gratis?

entries.original: "Would you like to open the door?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to open the door?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu ingin membuka pintu?

entries.original: "The door is open."
entries.translation_source: The door is open.
entries.translated: Pintu sudah terbuka.

entries.original: "Would you like to open the door?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to open the door?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu ingin membuka pintu?

entries.original: "The door is open."
entries.translation_source: The door is open.
entries.translated: Pintu sudah terbuka.

entries.original:
"The people who live here aren’t
letting me in, so I’m forced to sit\lout here."
entries.translation_source: The people who live here aren’t letting me in, so I’m forced to sit out here.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang yang tinggal di sini
tidak mengizinkanku masuk, jadi aku\lterpaksa duduk di sini.

entries.original:
"People say that to the east of the
city is a hidden forest with a\lpowerful Pokémon inside.

But it’s probably just a rumour, so
most people tend to ignore it."
entries.translation_source: People say that to the east of the city is a hidden forest with a powerful Pokémon inside. But it’s probably just a rumour, so most people tend to ignore it.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang bilang di sebelah timur
kota ada hutan tersembunyi dengan\lPokémon kuat di dalamnya. Tapi itu

mungkin hanya rumor, jadi
kebanyakan orang mengabaikannya.

entries.original:
"I’m eating roasted Snover!
It’s so delicious!"
entries.translation_source: I’m eating roasted Snover! It’s so delicious!
entries.translated:
Aku sedang makan Snover panggang!
Enak sekali!

entries.original:
"Some guy in one of the residences
around here is giving away an item\lthat allows you to rebattle\ltrainers.

But it doesn’t really work so well
on the mountain coming up here\lsince all of those trainers are\ldead tired."
entries.translation_source: Some guy in one of the residences around here is giving away an item that allows you to rebattle trainers. But it doesn’t really work so well on the mountain coming up here since all of those trainers are dead tired.
entries.translated:
Beberapa orang di salah satu rumah
di sekitar sini memberikan item\lyang memungkinkanmu untuk bertarung

ulang dengan pelatih. Tapi itu
tidak terlalu berfungsi di gunung\lyang akan datang ini karena semua

pelatih di sana kelelahan.

entries.original:
"Hey! Listen up.

Have you been travelling and
noticed some boulders in your path\lthat you just couldn’t budge?

Well there’s a guy in Epidimy Town
who is the master of teaching\lPokémon how to move big boulders.

Talk to him ASAP if you want to
move those pesky things."
entries.translation_source: Hey! Listen up. Have you been travelling and noticed some boulders in your path that you just couldn’t budge? Well there’s a guy in Epidimy Town who is the master of teaching Pokémon how to move big boulders. Talk to him ASAP if you want to move those pesky things.
entries.translated:
Hei! Dengarkan. Apakah kamu
bepergian dan melihat batu-batu\lbesar di jalan yang tidak bisa kamu

gerakkan? Nah, ada seorang pria di
Epidimy Town yang ahli mengajari\lPokémon cara memindahkan batu

besar. Bicaralah dengannya
secepatnya jika kamu ingin\lmemindahkan benda-benda mengganggu

itu.

entries.original: "Try going the other way."
entries.translation_source: Try going the other way.
entries.translated: Coba pergi ke arah sebaliknya.

entries.original:
"Sorry bud, but this isn’t the right
way to go."
entries.translation_source: Sorry bud, but this isn’t the right way to go.
entries.translated:
Maaf, sobat, tapi ini bukan jalan
yang benar.

entries.original:
"The fans make the gym really
confusing."
entries.translation_source: The fans make the gym really confusing.
entries.translated:
Kipas angin membuat gym ini sangat
membingungkan.

entries.original:
"I swear\.

Those weird guys have been blocking
off [green]Route 9[blue] for days\.

I wonder what they’re up to?"
entries.translation_source: I swear[game-token-1] Those weird guys have been blocking off [color-green-2]Route 9[color-blue-3] for days[game-token-4] I wonder what they’re up to?
entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah\. Orang-orang aneh itu
telah memblokir [green]Rute 9[blue] selama\lberhari-hari\. Aku penasaran apa yang

mereka lakukan?

entries.original:
"[red]Gliscor!
Use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Gliscor! Use Rock Smash!
entries.translated: [red]Gliscor! Gunakan Rock Smash!

entries.original:
"[red]Gliscor!
Return!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Gliscor! Return!
entries.translated: [red]Gliscor! Kembali!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Staraptor!
Use Aerial Ace!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Staraptor! Use Aerial Ace!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Staraptor! Gunakan Aerial Ace!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Tell me how to get past the
barrier on Route 9!

I don’t have time to deal with you
Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Tell me how to get past the barrier on Route 9! I don’t have time to deal with you Shadows!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Katakan padaku cara melewati
penghalang di Rute 9! Aku tidak\lpunya waktu untuk berurusan dengan

kalian para Shadow!

entries.original: "âÁWould you like to open the door?"
entries.translation_source: âÁWould you like to open the door?

entries.original: "Food!"
entries.translation_source: Food!
entries.translated: Makanan!

entries.original:
"What?
You don’t know?

So you must be in the same
situation as I am\.

Have you seen any sort of exit
around?

\.

There is one, but it’s blocked by
a man dressed in black\.

Take me there.

I’m going to try to break through."
entries.translation_source: What? You don’t know? So you must be in the same situation as I am[game-token-1] Have you seen any sort of exit around? [game-token-2] There is one, but it’s blocked by a man dressed in black[game-token-3] Take me there. I’m going to try to break through.
entries.translated:
Apa? Kamu tidak tahu? Jadi kamu
pasti dalam situasi yang sama\lsepertiku\. Apakah kamu melihat jalan

keluar di sekitar sini? \. Ada satu,
tapi dihalangi oleh seorang pria\lberpakaian hitam\. Bawa aku ke sana.

Aku akan mencoba menerobos.

entries.original:
"Take me to that guy in black.

I’m going to make him wish he
wasn’t there!"
entries.translation_source: Take me to that guy in black. I’m going to make him wish he wasn’t there!
entries.translated:
Bawa aku ke pria berbaju hitam itu.
Aku akan membuatnya menyesal berada\ldi sana!

entries.original:
"Come on, [player].
Let’s find another way out of here."
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player-name-1]. Let’s find another way out of here.
entries.translated:
Ayo, [player]. Mari cari jalan
keluar lain dari sini.

entries.original:
"We need to find those Pokémon!
They could be our way out!"
entries.translation_source: We need to find those Pokémon! They could be our way out!
entries.translated:
Kita harus menemukan Pokémon itu!
Mereka bisa menjadi jalan keluar\lkita!

entries.original:
"Hurry up, [player], choose a
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Hurry up, [player-name-1], choose a Pokémon.
entries.translated: Cepat, [player], pilih Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Let’s use our new Pokémon to break
out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s use our new Pokémon to break out of here!
entries.translated:
Ayo gunakan Pokémon baru kita untuk
kabur dari sini!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Hey!

Who do you think you are?

Do you think you can keep us locked
up in here and get away with it?

You’d better let us through right
now or you’re going to suffer!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Hey! Who do you think you are? Do you think you can keep us locked up in here and get away with it? You’d better let us through right now or you’re going to suffer!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Hei! Kau pikir kau siapa?
Kau pikir kau bisa mengurung kami\ldi sini dan lolos begitu saja?

Sebaiknya kau biarkan kami lewat
sekarang atau kau akan menderita!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Back off, kid.

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Back off, kid. I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Mundur, bocah. Aku
diperintahkan untuk mengurung\lkalian.

entries.original:
"[blue]So scram, unless you want
to\.suffer."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]So scram, unless you want to[game-token-2]suffer.
entries.translated:
[blue]Jadi pergilah, kecuali kau
ingin\.menderita.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Smart choice.

Keep far away from this door, and
you won’t regret it."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Smart choice. Keep far away from this door, and you won’t regret it.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Pilihan cerdas. Jauhi pintu
ini, dan kau tidak akan menyesal.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]It doesn’t look like he’s
going to move, [player].

We’d better look for another way
out of here."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]It doesn’t look like he’s going to move, [player-name-3]. We’d better look for another way out of here.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Sepertinya dia tidak akan
bergerak, [player]. Lebih baik kita\lcari jalan keluar lain dari sini.

"\sfÇ
ÛŒ
ÙÙÛ
Did you hear that, [player]?

It sounded like some Pokémon are
trapped in that cage over there!

Let’s go check it out."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]Ç ÛŒ ÙÙÛ Did you hear that, [player-name-2]? It sounded like some Pokémon are trapped in that cage over there! Let’s go check it out.

"âÁThere are many Pokémon locked
away in the cage\."
entries.translation_source: âÁThere are many Pokémon locked away in the cage[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"The cage door is unlocked.
The Pokémon are gone."
entries.translation_source: The cage door is unlocked. The Pokémon are gone.
entries.translated:
Pintu kandang tidak terkunci.
Pokémon-nya sudah tidak ada.

entries.original:
"The lock appears fragile.
Would you like to break it?"
entries.translation_source: The lock appears fragile. Would you like to break it?
entries.translated:
Kuncinya tampak rapuh. Apakah kamu
ingin memecahkannya?

entries.original:
"The lock has been broken, and the
cage door is now open."
entries.translation_source: The lock has been broken, and the cage door is now open.
entries.translated:
Kuncinya telah dipecahkan, dan
pintu kandang sekarang terbuka.

entries.original:
"[blue]It looks like these Pokémon are
grateful and want to join us!

If we each take one, we can use them
to attack the guard and escape!

Here, take this Poké Ball I
picked up."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It looks like these Pokémon are grateful and want to join us! If we each take one, we can use them to attack the guard and escape! Here, take this Poké Ball I picked up.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya Pokémon ini berterima
kasih dan ingin bergabung dengan\lkita! Jika kita masing-masing

mengambil satu, kita bisa
menggunakannya untuk menyerang\lpenjaga dan melarikan diri! Ini,

ambil Poké Ball yang aku ambil ini.

entries.original: "[blue]Go ahead, choose a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Go ahead, choose a Pokémon.
entries.translated: [blue]Silakan, pilih satu Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Will you take the [buffer2] Pokémon,
[buffer1]? ([green][buffer3][black])"
entries.translation_source: Will you take the [buffer2-1] Pokémon, [buffer1-2]? ([color-green-3][buffer3-4][color-black-5])
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu akan mengambil Pokémon
[buffer2], [buffer1]? ([green][buffer3][black])

entries.original: "The [buffer1] joined [player]’s party!"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] joined [player-name-2]’s party!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] bergabung dengan party
[player]!

entries.original: "[blue]I’ll take this one, then."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I’ll take this one, then.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kalau begitu, aku akan ambil yang
ini.

entries.original: "[black]Disheartened, the [buffer1] left."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Disheartened, the [buffer1-2] left.
entries.translated: [black]Dengan kecewa, [buffer1] pergi.

entries.original:
"Now that we have our own Pokémon,
let’s head back to the exit.

We’ll force our way out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Now that we have our own Pokémon, let’s head back to the exit. We’ll force our way out of here!
entries.translated:
Sekarang kita punya Pokémon
sendiri, ayo kembali ke pintu\lkeluar. Kita akan paksa jalan

keluar dari sini!

entries.original: "Easy"
entries.translation_source: Easy

entries.original: "Medium"
entries.translation_source: Medium

entries.original: "Hard"
entries.translation_source: Hard

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I told you before.

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]I told you before. I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Sudah kubilang sebelumnya.
Aku mendapat perintah ketat untuk\lmenguncimu.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Heh heh heh\.
You don’t really have a choice now.

You’re going to let us out or face
my wrath."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Heh heh heh[game-token-3] You don’t really have a choice now. You’re going to let us out or face my wrath.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Heh heh heh\. Kamu tidak
punya pilihan sekarang. Kamu akan\lmembiarkan kami keluar atau

menghadapi murkaku.

entries.original:
"I’m searching for rare Bug
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m searching for rare Bug Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku sedang mencari Pokémon Bug
langka.

entries.original:
"Who knew that there’d be a whole
other cave, within Icicle Cave?

If it hadn’t been for that
Sandslash, this place may have\lremained hidden forever.

But now that it’s accessible, just
imagine all of the secrets this\lit holds!

Take this tablet for instance.

It has to be at least a thousand
years old, if not more.

I intend to discover all of the
secrets hidden within.

Maybe if you come back some day,
the truth will reveal itself..."
entries.translation_source: Who knew that there’d be a whole other cave, within Icicle Cave? If it hadn’t been for that Sandslash, this place may have remained hidden forever. But now that it’s accessible, just imagine all of the secrets this it holds! Take this tablet for instance. It has to be at least a thousand years old, if not more. I intend to discover all of the secrets hidden within. Maybe if you come back some day, the truth will reveal itself...
entries.translated:
Siapa sangka akan ada gua lain di
dalam Gua Icicle? Jika bukan karena\lSandslash itu, tempat ini mungkin

akan tetap tersembunyi selamanya.
Tapi sekarang sudah bisa diakses,\lbayangkan semua rahasia yang

dimilikinya! Ambil contoh tablet
ini. Umurnya setidaknya seribu\ltahun, jika tidak lebih. Aku

berniat menemukan semua rahasia
yang tersembunyi di dalamnya.\lMungkin jika kamu kembali suatu

hari nanti, kebenaran akan
terungkap...

entries.original:
"I just don’t know what to do.

Every few days this horrible
Pokémon has been coming into my\lhouse and stealing my food.

If I had a Pokémon of my own I
could stop it, but unfortunately I\lhave none.

Oh!
I just had an idea!

Would you be able to..."
entries.translation_source: I just don’t know what to do. Every few days this horrible Pokémon has been coming into my house and stealing my food. If I had a Pokémon of my own I could stop it, but unfortunately I have none. Oh! I just had an idea! Would you be able to...
entries.translated:
Aku benar-benar tidak tahu harus
berbuat apa. Setiap beberapa hari\lPokémon mengerikan ini datang ke

rumahku dan mencuri makananku. Jika
aku punya Pokémon sendiri, aku bisa\lmenghentikannya, tapi sayangnya aku

tidak punya. Oh! Aku baru punya
ide! Apakah kamu bisa...

entries.original:
"Ahh!

There it is again!

It’s come to steal more food!"
entries.translation_source: Ahh! There it is again! It’s come to steal more food!
entries.translated:
Ahh! Itu dia lagi! Datang untuk
mencuri lebih banyak makanan!

entries.original: "It’s stealing my food!"
entries.translation_source: It’s stealing my food!
entries.translated: Dia mencuri makananku!

entries.original:
"[black]Daughter: [red]I’ll stop it from
leaving, Daddy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Daughter: [color-red-2]I’ll stop it from leaving, Daddy!
entries.translated:
[black]Putri: [red]Aku akan menghentikannya
pergi, Ayah!

entries.original:
"[black]Daughter: [red]Waaaah!

Daddy! It hurt me!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Daughter: [color-red-2]Waaaah! Daddy! It hurt me!
entries.translated:
[black]Putri: [red]Waaaah! Ayah! Itu
menyakitiku!

entries.original:
"[black]Guy: [blue]It’s alright sweetie...

Daddy’s not going to let that
Pokémon hurt you anymore."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Guy: [color-blue-2]It’s alright sweetie... Daddy’s not going to let that Pokémon hurt you anymore.
entries.translated:
[black]Pria: [blue]Tidak apa-apa sayang... Ayah
tidak akan membiarkan Pokémon itu\lmenyakitimu lagi.

entries.original:
"If you can help me out and get my
food back from that Pokémon I’d\lbe extremely grateful!

There might be a little something
in it for you as well..."
entries.translation_source: If you can help me out and get my food back from that Pokémon I’d be extremely grateful! There might be a little something in it for you as well...
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa membantuku dan
mengambil kembali makananku dari\lPokémon itu, aku akan sangat

berterima kasih! Mungkin ada
sedikit imbalan untukmu juga...

entries.original:
"I’m extremely grateful for your
help!

I’m going to train my new Pokémon,
and if you’re lucky, maybe you’ll\lbe able to battle me someday."
entries.translation_source: I’m extremely grateful for your help! I’m going to train my new Pokémon, and if you’re lucky, maybe you’ll be able to battle me someday.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat berterima kasih atas
bantuanmu! Aku akan melatih Pokémon\lbaruku, dan jika kamu beruntung,

mungkin kamu bisa bertarung
denganku suatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"Hey! It’s you again! Thanks again
for your help!

Now, how would you like to battle
my Pokémon and me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey! It’s you again! Thanks again for your help! Now, how would you like to battle my Pokémon and me?
entries.translated:
Hei! Kamu lagi! Terima kasih lagi
atas bantuanmu! Sekarang, bagaimana\lkalau kamu bertarung dengan

Pokémonku dan aku?

entries.original:
"Alright!

Just wait and see how strong my
Sandslash has become!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! Just wait and see how strong my Sandslash has become!
entries.translated:
Baiklah! Tunggu saja dan lihat
betapa kuatnya Sandslash-ku\lsekarang!

entries.original:
"Thanks for the battle!

Feel free to come back anytime and
battle me again."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for the battle! Feel free to come back anytime and battle me again.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih untuk pertarungannya!
Silakan kembali kapan saja dan\lbertarung denganku lagi.
