"Whatever will I do\.

My beloved baby was taken from me
by some\.some\.crook!

How can I perform on stage without
her?

Please, help me get my baby back!"
entries.translation_source: Whatever will I do[game-token-1] My beloved baby was taken from me by some[game-token-2]some[game-token-3]crook! How can I perform on stage without her? Please, help me get my baby back!
entries.translated:
Apa yang harus kulakukan\. Bayiku
yang tercinta diambil dariku oleh\lseorang\.seorang\.penjahat! Bagaimana

aku bisa tampil di panggung tanpa
dia? Tolong, bantu aku mendapatkan\lbayiku kembali!

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you!

Thank you, thank you!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you! Thank you, thank you!
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih! Terima kasih,
terima kasih!

"I know that my baby was taken by a
man dressed in gray.

I wish I knew where he went\."

Aku tahu bahwa bayiku diambil oleh
seorang pria berpakaian abu-abu.\lTapi hanya itu yang kuketahui\. Aku

berharap aku tahu ke mana dia pergi\.

"Ivory: [red]Silence!

me will get me to take down the\lbarrier, you’re dead wrong!"

entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Diam! Jika kamu pikir
serangan mendadak padaku akan\lmembuatku menurunkan penghalang,

kamu salah besar!

"[red]Alakazam!
Get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Alakazam! Get rid of him!
entries.translated: [red]Alakazam! Singkirkan dia!

entries.original:
"Oh no, no, no\.

I hope I can find someone to help
me before it’s too late\."

entries.translated:
Oh tidak, tidak, tidak\. Kuharap aku
bisa menemukan seseorang untuk\lmembantuku sebelum terlambat\.

entries.original:
"It’s you again!

The burglar who stole my baby came
back and returned her to me!

I can now perform again!
Thank you, thank you, thank you!

Please, take this [green]Egg[red] she layed!
It’s the least I can do."
entries.translation_source: It’s you again! The burglar who stole my baby came back and returned her to me! I can now perform again! Thank you, thank you, thank you! Please, take this [color-green-1]Egg[color-red-2] she layed! It’s the least I can do.

Kamu lagi! Pencuri yang mencuri
bayiku kembali dan mengembalikannya\lpadaku! Aku sekarang bisa tampil

lagi! Terima kasih, terima kasih,
terima kasih! Silakan, ambil [green]Telur[red]\lyang dia bertelur! Itu yang paling

bisa kulakukan.

entries.original: "Would you like to ride on Lapras?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to ride on Lapras?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin naik di atas
Lapras?

entries.original:
"ËÌÉÁMy school told me it was too
dangerous to come here."
entries.translation_source: ËÌÉÁMy school told me it was too dangerous to come here.

"Be careful here.

There is plenty of exposed magma
everywhere."
entries.translation_source: Be careful here. There is plenty of exposed magma everywhere.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati di sini. Ada banyak magma
yang terbuka di mana-mana.

entries.original:
"This place is so hot, it’s so easy
to light fires here."
entries.translation_source: This place is so hot, it’s so easy to light fires here.
entries.translated:
Tempat ini sangat panas, sangat
mudah untuk menyalakan api di sini.

entries.original:
"It’s up to me to construct bridges
that can withstand the heat."
entries.translation_source: It’s up to me to construct bridges that can withstand the heat.
entries.translated:
Terserah padaku untuk membangun
jembatan yang bisa menahan panas.

entries.original:
"A talented trainer like you fits
right in, in this volcano."
entries.translation_source: A talented trainer like you fits right in, in this volcano.
entries.translated:
Seorang pelatih berbakat sepertimu
sangat cocok di gunung berapi ini.

entries.original:
"I will continue to train.

Forever and ever..."
entries.translation_source: I will continue to train. Forever and ever...
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus berlatih.
Selamanya...

entries.original: "The lava here is my inspiration."
entries.translation_source: The lava here is my inspiration.
entries.translated: Lava di sini adalah inspirasiku.

entries.original:
"I came here to train my Pokémon
since they are naturally weak to\lfire."
entries.translation_source: I came here to train my Pokémon since they are naturally weak to fire.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini untuk melatih
Pokémon-ku karena mereka secara\lalami lemah terhadap Api.

entries.original: "The lava is beautiful, isn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: The lava is beautiful, isn’t it?
entries.translated: Lavanya indah, bukan?

entries.original:
"[red]Mission complete.

Let’s move out."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Mission complete. Let’s move out.
entries.translated: [red]Misi selesai. Ayo berangkat.

"Jax: [blue]Stop right there Shadow!

Release the Moltres you captured!"

entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Berhenti di situ, Shadow!
Lepaskan Moltres yang kau tangkap!

"Oh\.

You don’t have space in your party
for the Egg\."

Oh\. Kamu tidak punya ruang di tim
untuk Telur\.

entries.translated: Raptor!

"Would you also like me to keep the
rest of your Eggs?

entries.translated:
Apakah kamu juga ingin aku
menyimpan sisa Telurmu? Aku\lmemegang total [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Fine then, I’ll keep them all.
Thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Fine then, I’ll keep them all. Thanks!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, aku akan menyimpannya
semua. Terima kasih!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep holding onto your Eggs
for you, then."
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep holding onto your Eggs for you, then.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, aku akan terus
menyimpan Telurmu untukmu.

entries.original:
"Would you like another Egg?

I’m holding on to [green][buffer1][blue] in total."
entries.translation_source: Would you like another Egg? I’m holding on to [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in total.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin Telur yang lain?
Aku memegang total [green][buffer1][blue].

"As you travel, your Pokémon grows

Be always bonded in friendship.
-Pokémon Day Care"

Saat kamu bepergian, Pokémon-mu
tumbuh bersamamu\. Tetaplah terikat\ldalam persahabatan. -Pokémon Day

Care

enough to hold onto [green]100 [blue]of them\lfor you!

great as them."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes, when a boy and girl Pokémon like each other very much, they lay an Egg! And the Day-Care couple are kind enough to hold onto [color-green-1]100 [color-blue-2]of them for you! I wish I could breed Pokémon as great as them.

Kadang-kadang, ketika Pokémon
jantan dan betina saling menyukai,\lmereka bertelur! Dan pasangan

Day-Care cukup baik untuk menyimpan
[green]100 [blue]dari mereka untukmu! Aku\lberharap bisa mengembangbiakkan

Pokémon sehebat mereka.

"I learned in Breeding School that
the best way to raise your partner\lPokémon is to battle with them as\lmuch as possible.

Will you help me raise my
Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: I learned in Breeding School that the best way to raise your partner Pokémon is to battle with them as much as possible. Will you help me raise my Pokémon?

Aku belajar di Sekolah Pembiakan
bahwa cara terbaik untuk\lmembesarkan Pokémon pasanganmu

adalah dengan bertarung sebanyak
mungkin. Maukah kamu membantuku\lmembesarkan Pokémon-ku?

"Well, I’ll still be here if you
want to help me out later!"
entries.translation_source: Well, I’ll still be here if you want to help me out later!
entries.translated:
Yah, aku akan tetap di sini jika
kamu ingin membantuku nanti!

entries.original: "Let’s get started!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get started!
entries.translated: Ayo mulai!

entries.original:
"I can feel my babies getting
stronger already!"
entries.translation_source: I can feel my babies getting stronger already!

entries.original:
"Thank you for battling with me!

I look forward to training my
babies with you again!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you for battling with me! I look forward to training my babies with you again!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah bertarung
denganku! Aku menantikan untuk\lmelatih bayi-bayiku bersamamu lagi!

entries.original: "Take care of my baby’s baby!"
entries.translation_source: Take care of my baby’s baby!
entries.translated: Jaga bayi dari bayiku!

entries.original:
"Burglar: [blue]Huh, who are you?
What are you doing back here?

This is my quiet spot for training
my precious Pokémon.

I don’t like it when other people
come here uninvited.

\.

So you’ve come to take my Pokémon
away from me, is that it?

I won’t let you take her from me!"
entries.translation_source: Burglar: [color-blue-1]Huh, who are you? What are you doing back here? This is my quiet spot for training my precious Pokémon. I don’t like it when other people come here uninvited. [game-token-2] So you’ve come to take my Pokémon away from me, is that it? I won’t let you take her from me!
entries.translated:
Burglar: [blue]Huh, siapa kamu? Apa yang
kamu lakukan di sini? Ini adalah\ltempat tenangku untuk melatih

Pokémon berhargaku. Aku tidak suka
jika orang lain datang ke sini\ltanpa undangan. \. Jadi kamu datang

untuk mengambil Pokémon-ku dariku,
begitu? Aku tidak akan membiarkanmu\lmengambilnya dariku!

"Have you ever heard of [green]Ayla[red]?

She’s the one responsible for
porting Bill’s PC to Borrius!

Thanks to her, we can store our
Pokémon somewhere!"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of [color-green-1]Ayla[color-red-2]? She’s the one responsible for porting Bill’s PC to Borrius! Thanks to her, we can store our Pokémon somewhere!
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang
[green]Ayla[red]? Dialah yang bertanggung jawab\lmemindahkan PC Bill ke Borrius!

Berkat dia, kita bisa menyimpan
Pokémon kita di suatu tempat!

"Crater Town Pokémon Gym
Leader: Vega

Winning Trainers:
[rival]"

entries.translated:

Vega Pelatih Pemenang: [rival]

[rival], [player]"

entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Crater Town:
Vega Pelatih Pemenang: [rival],\l[player]

"Do you think you have what it takes

"Hmph.
You may just have what it takes."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. You may just have what it takes.

entries.translation_source: With your skills you’ll go far!
entries.translated:
Dengan keahlianmu, kamu akan
melangkah jauh!

"Times have changed since back in my
day."

entries.translated:
Zaman telah berubah sejak masa saya
dulu.

entries.original:
"I’d better refine my calculations
for the next time we battle."
entries.translation_source: I’d better refine my calculations for the next time we battle.
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya saya perbaiki perhitungan
saya untuk pertarungan kita\lberikutnya.

entries.original:
"Of all the battles I’ve partaken
in, one stands out above the rest.

It was a sweltering day, and
my oppenent had just sent out her\lRotom-Fan, holding an Air Balloon.

Up until that point, I had been
barely holding on, but upon seeing\lthat redundant freak of nature, I\lcouldn’t take it anymore.

I fainted in disbelief and lost the
battle.

Never underestimate the power of a
[green]Rotom-Fan [red]holding an [green]Air Balloon[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Of all the battles I’ve partaken in, one stands out above the rest. It was a sweltering day, and my oppenent had just sent out her Rotom-Fan, holding an Air Balloon. Up until that point, I had been barely holding on, but upon seeing that redundant freak of nature, I couldn’t take it anymore. I fainted in disbelief and lost the battle. Never underestimate the power of a [color-green-1]Rotom-Fan [color-red-2]holding an [color-green-3]Air Balloon[color-red-4]!
entries.translated:
Dari semua pertarungan yang pernah
saya ikuti, satu pertarungan paling\lmenonjol. Hari itu sangat panas,

dan lawan saya baru saja
mengeluarkan Rotom-Fan-nya, yang\lmemegang Air Balloon. Sampai saat

itu, saya hampir tidak bisa
bertahan, tetapi melihat keanehan\lalam yang berlebihan itu, saya

tidak tahan lagi. Saya pingsan
karena tidak percaya dan kalah\ldalam pertarungan. Jangan pernah

meremehkan kekuatan [green]Rotom-Fan [red]yang
memegang [green]Air Balloon[red]!

Jax: [blue]Aku tidak bisa mengendalikan
tubuhku!

entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Return to me.

"[red]Now that that’s been taken care of,
I’d better get back to Route 9."

Jika kamu ingin bertarung denganku

Ada begitu banyak yang bisa dibeli

Ada banyak sekali barang berguna

Grunt: [blue]Berhentilah membodohi dirimu

mengizinkanmu lewat.

"[rival]: [blue][player], would you like

[rival]: [blue][player], apakah kamu
yang ingin melakukannya?

Yeah that’s right[game-token-6]for training! I was just so lonely, that I figured I’d do that lady a favour. I was about to head back when[game-token-7]

"[blue]What was that!

No it couldn’t be\."

[blue]Apa itu! Mungkinkah itu\.? Tidak,
tidak mungkin\.

entries.translated: [blue]Sekarang, seperti yang saya katakan\.

"[blue]Wahhhh! It’s the monster that

Run for your lives!"

[blue]Wahhhh! Itu monster yang tinggal di
hutan! [green]Crabominable Snowman[blue]! Lari\lselamatkan diri kalian!

\al Route 16
\ar Seaport City"

entries.translated: Rute 17 \al Rute 16 \ar Seaport City

Aku akan menangkap sesuatu yang

Sejujurnya, aku juga sudah di sini

Volcano.

Bergumam\.Bergumam\. \.tunggu sinyal\.

entries.translated: Crabominable: [green]Crah rah rah rah rah!

entries.original:
"Mmmmmm\.

entries.original: "Ah well, that’s too bad."

Suatu hari, aku akan benar-benar

entries.translation_source: Exit F: Fallshore City
entries.translated: Keluar F: Fallshore City

entries.original:
"\al Blizzard City
\au Frozen Heights"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] Blizzard City [game-token-2] Frozen Heights
entries.translated: \al Blizzard City \au Frozen Heights

entries.original: "\ar Dresco Town"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] Dresco Town
entries.translated: \ar Dresco Town

entries.original:
"Hi there! If you can beat me, I’ll
heal your Pokémon for free!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there! If you can beat me, I’ll heal your Pokémon for free!
entries.translated:
Halo! Jika kamu bisa mengalahkanku,
aku akan menyembuhkan Pokémonmu\lsecara gratis!

entries.original: "Healing time!"
entries.translation_source: Healing time!

entries.original: "Time to heal up!"
entries.translation_source: Time to heal up!
entries.translated: Waktunya memulihkan!

entries.original:
"Technology is incredible!

You can now play GBA ROMs
on your phone and computer!"
entries.translation_source: Technology is incredible! You can now play GBA ROMs on your phone and computer!
entries.translated:
Teknologi luar biasa! Kamu sekarang
bisa memainkan ROM GBA di ponsel\ldan komputermu!

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough room in
your party."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough room in your party.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup ruang di
timmu.

entries.original:
"Have you checked out the local
facilities?

The Pokémon Centre heals your
Pokémon for free.

The Poké Mart provides useful
items for trainers."
entries.translation_source: Have you checked out the local facilities? The Pokémon Centre heals your Pokémon for free. The Poké Mart provides useful items for trainers.
entries.translated:
Sudahkah kamu memeriksa fasilitas
lokal? Pokémon Centre menyembuhkan\lPokémonmu secara gratis. Poké Mart

menyediakan item berguna bagi para
pelatih.

entries.original: "I’m on duty, go away."
entries.translation_source: I’m on duty, go away.
entries.translated: Aku sedang bertugas, pergi sana.

entries.original:
"Being nestled in the mountains, our
town is fairly quiet.

Even so, our police officer still
takes his job pretty seriously."
entries.translation_source: Being nestled in the mountains, our town is fairly quiet. Even so, our police officer still takes his job pretty seriously.
entries.translated:
Terletak di pegunungan, kota kami
cukup tenang. Meski begitu, petugas\lpolisi kami masih menjalankan

tugasnya dengan serius.

entries.original:
"Burglar: [blue]That monster was
terrifying!

We must’ve woken it up during our
battle.

\.

So I uh\.guess I’m done training
this Ninetales now\.

It’s time for me to return her to
her owner."
entries.translation_source: Burglar: [color-blue-1]That monster was terrifying! We must’ve woken it up during our battle. [game-token-2] So I uh[game-token-3]guess I’m done training this Ninetales now[game-token-4] It’s time for me to return her to her owner.
entries.translated:
Burglar: [blue]Monster itu sangat
menakutkan! Kami pasti sudah\lmembangunkannya saat pertempuran

kami. \. Jadi, aku uh\.kurasa aku
selesai melatih Ninetales ini\lsekarang\. Sudah waktunya aku

mengembalikannya ke pemiliknya.

entries.original:
"[green]Alice[blue], the Gym Leader, likes to use
[green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon.

I know, it’s not what you’d expect
from a Gym up here."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Alice[color-blue-2], the Gym Leader, likes to use [color-green-3]Flying[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon. I know, it’s not what you’d expect from a Gym up here.
entries.translated:
[green]Alice[blue], Pemimpin Gym, suka
menggunakan Pokémon tipe [green]Terbang[blue].\lAku tahu, itu bukan yang kamu

harapkan dari Gym di sini.

entries.original: "How is my old Pokémon doing?"
entries.translation_source: How is my old Pokémon doing?
entries.translated: Bagaimana kabar Pokémon lamaku?

entries.original:
"Hello there.

By any chance would you like to
have a Riolu?

I hatched it from an egg and have
nothing to do with it."
entries.translation_source: Hello there. By any chance would you like to have a Riolu? I hatched it from an egg and have nothing to do with it.
entries.translated:
Halo. Apakah kamu kebetulan ingin
memiliki Riolu? Aku menetaskannya\ldari telur dan tidak ada yang bisa

kulakukan dengannya.

entries.original:
"Please take care of my dear
Riolu."
entries.translation_source: Please take care of my dear Riolu.
entries.translated: Tolong rawat Riolu kesayanganku.

entries.original: "You don’t have to take it..."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have to take it...
entries.translated: Kamu tidak harus menerimanya...

entries.original:
"How’z it hangin’ down there?

I say down there, ’cause I’m all
the way up in the clouds!"
entries.translation_source: How’z it hangin’ down there? I say down there, ’cause I’m all the way up in the clouds!
entries.translated:
Gimana kabarnya di bawah sana? Aku
bilang di bawah, soalnya aku\lbenar-benar di atas awan!

entries.original:
"Oh, hello, [player]!

I heard from your mother that
you’re finally leaving town!

This is very exciting news!

You can finally follow in your
father’s footsteps and become a\lgreat Pokémon trainer!

Who knows? Perhaps you may even
come to command the great Arceus,\ljust as he did\.

The road to that point will be long
and arduous, but I have faith that\lyou can, and will make it there!

Take this item to help you on your
journey.

It is a rare gemstone that can
power up a single attack in battle.

Use it wisely."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello, [player-name-1]! I heard from your mother that you’re finally leaving town! This is very exciting news! You can finally follow in your father’s footsteps and become a great Pokémon trainer! Who knows? Perhaps you may even come to command the great Arceus, just as he did[game-token-2] The road to that point will be long and arduous, but I have faith that you can, and will make it there! Take this item to help you on your journey. It is a rare gemstone that can power up a single attack in battle. Use it wisely.
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, [player]! Aku dengar dari
ibumu bahwa kamu akhirnya\lmeninggalkan kota! Ini berita yang

sangat menggembirakan! Kamu
akhirnya bisa mengikuti jejak\layahmu dan menjadi pelatih Pokémon

yang hebat! Siapa tahu? Mungkin
kamu bahkan bisa memimpin Arceus\lyang agung, seperti yang dia

lakukan\. Jalan menuju titik itu akan
panjang dan sulit, tapi aku percaya\lkamu bisa, dan akan sampai di sana!

Ambil item ini untuk membantu
perjalananmu. Ini adalah batu\lpermata langka yang bisa memperkuat

satu serangan dalam pertempuran.
Gunakan dengan bijak.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello, [player]!

How is your journey going?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello, [player-name-1]! How is your journey going?
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, [player]! Bagaimana
perjalananmu?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

It appears that you have no space
for my gift."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] It appears that you have no space for my gift.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Sepertinya kamu tidak punya
ruang untuk hadiahku.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I heard a special package
arrived today.

I want to buy it from you."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]I heard a special package arrived today. I want to buy it from you.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Aku dengar paket khusus tiba
hari ini. Aku ingin membelinya\ldarimu.

entries.original:
"Stop!

Where do you think you’re going?

If you think you’re ready to handle
Icicle Cave, prove it to me by\ldelivering [green]Log’s package [blue]to him."
entries.translation_source: Stop! Where do you think you’re going? If you think you’re ready to handle Icicle Cave, prove it to me by delivering [color-green-1]Log’s package [color-blue-2]to him.
entries.translated:
Berhenti! Kamu pikir mau ke mana?
Kalau kamu pikir kamu siap\lmenghadapi Icicle Cave, buktikan

padaku dengan mengantarkan [green]paket
Log [blue]kepadanya.

entries.original:
"I [green]chain[blue] my fishing so I can see
[green]Shiny[blue] Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I [color-green-1]chain[color-blue-2] my fishing so I can see [color-green-3]Shiny[color-blue-4] Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku [green]chain[blue] pancinganku sehingga aku
bisa melihat [green]Shiny[blue] Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Hello there stranger!

Be careful when travelling through
Icicle Cave.

It may not seem that big, but it is
bigger than you would think!"
entries.translation_source: Hello there stranger! Be careful when travelling through Icicle Cave. It may not seem that big, but it is bigger than you would think!
entries.translated:
Halo, orang asing! Hati-hati saat
bepergian melalui Icicle Cave.\lMungkin tidak terlihat sebesar itu,

tapi lebih besar dari yang kamu
kira!

entries.original:
"My Rattata is the best you will
ever see!"
entries.translation_source: My Rattata is the best you will ever see!

entries.original: "My Rattata is still the best."
entries.translation_source: My Rattata is still the best.

entries.original:
"I’m going to make my Rattata even
stronger!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to make my Rattata even stronger!
entries.translated:
Aku akan membuat Rattata-ku semakin
kuat!

entries.original:
"When Pokémon evolve, they get
stronger.

But there is a benefit for not
evolving your Pokémon right away.

Pokémon that can still evolve can
utilise an [green]Eviolite[blue] to become\ltougher to beat in battle.

I have an extra, so why don’t you
take one?"
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon evolve, they get stronger. But there is a benefit for not evolving your Pokémon right away. Pokémon that can still evolve can utilise an [color-green-1]Eviolite[color-blue-2] to become tougher to beat in battle. I have an extra, so why don’t you take one?
entries.translated:
Saat Pokémon berevolusi, mereka
menjadi lebih kuat. Tapi ada\lkeuntungan untuk tidak

mengevolusikan Pokémon-mu segera.
Pokémon yang masih bisa berevolusi\ldapat menggunakan [green]Eviolite[blue] untuk

menjadi lebih sulit dikalahkan
dalam pertempuran. Aku punya\ltambahan, jadi kenapa kamu tidak

mengambil satu?

entries.original:
"Have a Pokémon that can still
evolve hold an [green]Eviolite[blue] in battle\lto double its defenses."
entries.translation_source: Have a Pokémon that can still evolve hold an [color-green-1]Eviolite[color-blue-2] in battle to double its defenses.
entries.translated:
Minta Pokémon yang masih bisa
berevolusi memegang [green]Eviolite[blue] dalam\lpertempuran untuk menggandakan

pertahanannya.

entries.original:
"Where the wind is ice cold, so are
my hands.

Would you like me to teach one of
your Pokémon [green]Ice Punch[blue]?

I require [green]2 [buffer1]s[blue] to share
my frosty hands."
entries.translation_source: Where the wind is ice cold, so are my hands. Would you like me to teach one of your Pokémon [color-green-1]Ice Punch[color-blue-2]? I require [color-green-3]2 [buffer1-4]s[color-blue-5] to share my frosty hands.
entries.translated:
Di mana angin sedingin es, begitu
juga tanganku. Apakah kamu ingin\laku mengajari salah satu Pokémon-mu

[green]Ice Punch[blue]? Aku membutuhkan [green]2
[buffer1]s[blue] untuk berbagi tanganku\lyang dingin.

entries.original:
"Clerk: [blue]I’m sorry sir, I can’t do
that.

That package belongs to someone
already."
entries.translation_source: Clerk: [color-blue-1]I’m sorry sir, I can’t do that. That package belongs to someone already.
entries.translated:
Clerk: [blue]Maaf pak, saya tidak bisa
melakukan itu. Paket itu sudah\lmilik seseorang.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Maybe you misheard me."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Maybe you misheard me.
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Mungkin kamu salah dengar.

entries.original:
"[blue]Give me that package!

I won’t ask again."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Give me that package! I won’t ask again.
entries.translated:
[blue]Berikan aku paket itu! Aku tidak
akan bertanya lagi.

entries.original:
"Clerk: [blue]I really can’t, sir!

As a faithful employee of Poké
Mart, it goes against what I stand\lfor to give you that package!"
entries.translation_source: Clerk: [color-blue-1]I really can’t, sir! As a faithful employee of Poké Mart, it goes against what I stand for to give you that package!
entries.translated:
Clerk: [blue]Saya benar-benar tidak bisa,
Pak! Sebagai karyawan setia Poké\lMart, itu bertentangan dengan

prinsip saya untuk memberikan paket
itu kepada Anda!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I see.

Well, then\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]I see. Well, then[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Begitu. Baiklah, kalau
begitu\.

entries.original:
"[blue][buffer1]!

Grab that package!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][buffer1-2]! Grab that package!
entries.translated: [blue][buffer1]! Ambil paket itu!

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Good work, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Good work, [buffer1-2].
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Kerja bagus, [buffer1].

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon would like to have
their hands frozen with [green]Ice Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon would like to have their hands frozen with [color-green-1]Ice Punch[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang ingin tangannya
dibekukan dengan [green]Pukulan Es[blue]?

entries.original:
"My hands shall remain cold for
all eternity."
entries.translation_source: My hands shall remain cold for all eternity.
entries.translated:
Tanganku akan tetap dingin untuk
selamanya.

entries.original:
"You do not have enough
[green][buffer1]s[blue].

I cannot share my frosty hands with
you for nothing\."
entries.translation_source: You do not have enough [color-green-1][buffer1-2]s[color-blue-3]. I cannot share my frosty hands with you for nothing[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup
[green][buffer1]s[blue]. Aku tidak bisa\lmembagikan tanganku yang beku

kepadamu tanpa imbalan\.

entries.original:
"That TM I gave you contains
[green]Aurora Veil[blue].

It has an effect similar to both
Reflect and Light Screen combined.

The only catch is that it can only
be used in Hail weather."
entries.translation_source: That TM I gave you contains [color-green-1]Aurora Veil[color-blue-2]. It has an effect similar to both Reflect and Light Screen combined. The only catch is that it can only be used in Hail weather.
entries.translated:
TM yang kuberikan padamu berisi
[green]Tirai Aurora[blue]. Efeknya mirip dengan\lgabungan Refleksi dan Layar Cahaya.

Satu-satunya kekurangan adalah
hanya bisa digunakan dalam cuaca\lHujan Es.

entries.original: "Your loss, pal."
entries.translation_source: Your loss, pal.
entries.translated: Rugi kamu, kawan.

entries.original:
"My brother!

Please help me!

I was babysitting him when he ran
away down the mountain!

Please, help me find him!"
entries.translation_source: My brother! Please help me! I was babysitting him when he ran away down the mountain! Please, help me find him!
entries.translated:
Adikku! Tolong aku! Aku sedang
menjaganya saat dia lari turun\lgunung! Tolong, bantu aku

menemukannya!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue][player]!

I flew here as soon as the barrier
went down.

What happened?

\.

So The Shadows got away again\."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! I flew here as soon as the barrier went down. What happened? [game-token-3] So The Shadows got away again[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue][player]! Aku terbang ke sini
begitu penghalang runtuh. Apa yang\lterjadi? \. Jadi The Shadows lolos

lagi\.

entries.original: "[green]Moo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Moo!
entries.translated: [green]Moo!

entries.original: "Break Room"
entries.translation_source: Break Room
entries.translated: Ruang Istirahat

entries.original:
"Fallshore City is home of the
[green]Inverse Battle House[blue] and the\l[green]Mission HQ[blue].

Isn’t that neat?
It’s so cool to live here!"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City is home of the [color-green-1]Inverse Battle House[color-blue-2] and the [color-green-3]Mission HQ[color-blue-4]. Isn’t that neat? It’s so cool to live here!
entries.translated:
Kota Fallshore adalah rumah dari
[green]Rumah Pertarungan Terbalik[blue] dan\l[green]Markas Misi[blue]. Bukankah itu keren?

Sangat asyik tinggal di sini!

entries.original: "Go away."
entries.translation_source: Go away.
entries.translated: Pergi.

entries.original:
"Huah, fellow trainer!

I am training my body and soul by
staring at this tree intently!

You too, can train, with this!"
entries.translation_source: Huah, fellow trainer! I am training my body and soul by staring at this tree intently! You too, can train, with this!
entries.translated:
Huah, sesama pelatih! Aku melatih
tubuh dan jiwaku dengan menatap\lpohon ini dengan sungguh-sungguh!

Kamu juga bisa berlatih, dengan
ini!

entries.original:
"One day, I will be the most
focused trainer."
entries.translation_source: One day, I will be the most focused trainer.
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, aku akan menjadi
pelatih paling fokus.

entries.original: "Please come again!"
entries.translation_source: Please come again!
entries.translated: Silakan datang lagi!

entries.original:
"Only the uncool kids actually go
to school\."
entries.translation_source: Only the uncool kids actually go to school[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Hanya anak-anak yang tidak keren
yang benar-benar pergi ke sekolah\.

entries.original:
"Hmm...
I wonder how to get that item?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm... I wonder how to get that item?
entries.translated:
Hmm... Aku penasaran bagaimana cara
mendapatkan item itu?

entries.original:
"Wow! You managed to get that item!
Good job!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! You managed to get that item! Good job!
entries.translated:
Wow! Kamu berhasil mendapatkan item
itu! Kerja bagus!

entries.original:
"I can’t thank you enough!

My brother’s small so he can’t have
gone far.

My bet is he’s somewhere on
[green]Route 8[red] right about now.

And last I saw, he was wearing his
favourite [green]Pikachu costume[red]."
entries.translation_source: I can’t thank you enough! My brother’s small so he can’t have gone far. My bet is he’s somewhere on [color-green-1]Route 8[color-red-2] right about now. And last I saw, he was wearing his favourite [color-green-3]Pikachu costume[color-red-4].
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa cukup berterima
kasih! Adikku kecil jadi dia tidak\lmungkin pergi jauh. Tebakanku dia

ada di suatu tempat di [green]Rute 8[red] saat
ini. Dan terakhir kulihat, dia\lmemakai [green]kostum Pikachu[red]

kesayangannya.

entries.original: "My parents are going to kill me!"
entries.translation_source: My parents are going to kill me!
entries.translated: Orangtuaku akan membunuhku!

entries.original:
"My brother told me all about his
journey back up here!

You’re amazing!"
entries.translation_source: My brother told me all about his journey back up here! You’re amazing!
entries.translated:
Adikku bercerita semua tentang
perjalanannya kembali ke sini! Kamu\lluar biasa!

entries.original:
"That TM is my thanks for your help!
It contains [green]Return[red]!

It’s a move that gets stronger the
more your Pokémon likes you.

It’s the perfect TM for such a nice
person like you!"
entries.translation_source: That TM is my thanks for your help! It contains [color-green-1]Return[color-red-2]! It’s a move that gets stronger the more your Pokémon likes you. It’s the perfect TM for such a nice person like you!
entries.translated:
TM itu adalah ucapan terima kasihku
atas bantuanmu! Itu berisi [green]Kembali[red]!\lItu adalah jurus yang semakin kuat

semakin Pokémonmu menyukaimu. Itu
adalah TM yang sempurna untuk orang\lbaik sepertimu!

entries.original:
"It’s the amazing person who saved
my brother!

Thank you again!"
entries.translation_source: It’s the amazing person who saved my brother! Thank you again!
entries.translated:
Dia orang hebat yang menyelamatkan
kakakku! Terima kasih lagi!

entries.original:
"Ahhh!
Please don’t eat me!"
entries.translation_source: Ahhh! Please don’t eat me!
entries.translated: Ahhh! Tolong jangan makan aku!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

You’re not a Pokémon.

I thought a Pokémon was going to
eat me."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] You’re not a Pokémon. I thought a Pokémon was going to eat me.
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Kamu bukan Pokémon. Kupikir
ada Pokémon yang akan memakanku.

entries.original:
"I will keep running and enduring
the pain."
entries.translation_source: I will keep running and enduring the pain.
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus berlari dan menahan
rasa sakit.

entries.original:
"An obnoxiously loud episode of a
Unova Pokémon Musical is on.

Watch for too long and it might
fry your brain."
entries.translation_source: An obnoxiously loud episode of a Unova Pokémon Musical is on. Watch for too long and it might fry your brain.
entries.translated:
Sebuah episode Musikal Pokémon
Unova yang sangat keras sedang\ldiputar. Terlalu lama menontonnya

bisa menggoreng otakmu.

entries.original:
"Don’t you wish you could just a
break from life sometimes?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you wish you could just a break from life sometimes?
entries.translated:
Tidakkah kamu berharap bisa
istirahat dari kehidupan\lkadang-kadang?

entries.original: "My grass types didn’t help me."
entries.translation_source: My grass types didn’t help me.

entries.original: "Hold..."
entries.translation_source: Hold...

entries.original: "Picture perfect!"
entries.translation_source: Picture perfect!

entries.original:
"I’m in the process of creating a
masterpiece."
entries.translation_source: I’m in the process of creating a masterpiece.
entries.translated:
Aku sedang dalam proses menciptakan
sebuah mahakarya.

entries.original:
"I love evolutions of starters from
other regions!"
entries.translation_source: I love evolutions of starters from other regions!
entries.translated:
Aku suka evolusi starter dari
daerah lain!

entries.original:
"Well, then, I won’t stand in your
way anymore."
entries.translation_source: Well, then, I won’t stand in your way anymore.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kalau begitu, aku tidak
akan menghalangi jalanmu lagi.

entries.original:
"I want to go home.

I ran away from my mean sister, but
I really miss her now\."
entries.translation_source: I want to go home. I ran away from my mean sister, but I really miss her now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku ingin pulang. Aku kabur dari
kakakku yang jahat, tapi aku\lbenar-benar merindukannya sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Please, take me back up to
[green]Blizzard City[blue].

I’ll follow you there."
entries.translation_source: Please, take me back up to [color-green-1]Blizzard City[color-blue-2]. I’ll follow you there.
entries.translated:
Tolong, bawa aku kembali ke
[green]Blizzard City[blue]. Aku akan mengikutimu\lke sana.

entries.original:
"You see those rocks on the wall?

If you have a Pokémon that knows
[green]Rock Climb[blue], you can cruise up ’em!"
entries.translation_source: You see those rocks on the wall? If you have a Pokémon that knows [color-green-1]Rock Climb[color-blue-2], you can cruise up ’em!
entries.translated:
Kau lihat batu-batu di dinding itu?
Jika kamu memiliki Pokémon yang\ltahu [green]Panjat Tebing[blue], kamu bisa

memanjatnya!

entries.original:
"Na na na na na na na\.
Super Nerd!"
entries.translation_source: Na na na na na na na[game-token-1] Super Nerd!

entries.original:
"Na na na na na na na\.
He lost!"

Kamu harus bicara dengannya!

"You are his [buffer1]!

I knew my eyesight was not
deceiving me!

Your father was, to put it simply,
an amazing man.

I’m sure if you introduced yourself
to people as his [buffer1], you\lwould instantly be regarded with\lmuch affection.

There aren’t many people out there
who have not heard of his exploits.

If only someone knew what happened
to him, I could finally have a\lsense of closure."
entries.translation_source: You are his [buffer1-1]! I knew my eyesight was not deceiving me! Your father was, to put it simply, an amazing man. I’m sure if you introduced yourself to people as his [buffer1-2], you would instantly be regarded with much affection. There aren’t many people out there who have not heard of his exploits. It’s a shame he disappeared. If only someone knew what happened to him, I could finally have a sense of closure.
entries.translated:
Kamu adalah [buffer1]nya! Aku tahu
penglihatanku tidak menipuku!\lAyahmu, sederhananya, adalah pria

yang luar biasa. Aku yakin jika
kamu memperkenalkan dirimu kepada\lorang lain sebagai [buffer1]nya,

kamu akan langsung disambut dengan
banyak kasih sayang. Tidak banyak\lorang yang tidak pernah mendengar

tentang petualangannya. Sayang
sekali dia menghilang. Andai saja\lseseorang tahu apa yang terjadi

padanya, aku akhirnya bisa
mendapatkan ketenangan.

entries.original:
"Oh.
I could have sworn you were\.

My eyesight must be going in my old
age."
entries.translation_source: Oh. I could have sworn you were[game-token-1] My eyesight must be going in my old age.
entries.translated:
Oh. Aku bisa bersumpah kamu adalah\.
Penglihatanku pasti mulai menurun\ldi usia tuaku.

"What?
You know what happened to [green]Aros[blue]?

Please!
You must tell me!

\.

That is a very unfortunate way to
leave this world."

Apa? Kamu tahu apa yang terjadi
pada [green]Aros[blue]? Tolong! Kamu harus\lmemberitahuku! \. Jadi dia terbakar

menjadi abu\. Itu adalah cara yang
sangat tidak beruntung untuk\lmeninggalkan dunia ini.

entries.original:
"This may seem a little ironic, but
please, I wish to give you this\litem as thanks for bringing me\la sense of closure."
entries.translation_source: This may seem a little ironic, but please, I wish to give you this item as thanks for bringing me a sense of closure.
entries.translated:
Ini mungkin tampak sedikit ironis,
tapi tolong, aku ingin memberikan\litem ini sebagai terima kasih

karena telah memberiku rasa
penutupan.

entries.original:
"If only someone could tell me what
happened to your father\.

It would bring be such a sense of
closure."
entries.translation_source: If only someone could tell me what happened to your father[game-token-1] It would bring be such a sense of closure.
entries.translated:
Andai saja seseorang bisa
memberitahuku apa yang terjadi pada\layahmu\. Itu akan memberiku rasa

entries.translated:

legendaris. Semoga perjalananmu\lberjalan lancar.

"Didja know that if you talk to the

Tahukah kamu jika kamu berbicara
dengan wasit Gym sebelum\lmengalahkan Pemimpin Gym, mereka

Tahukah? Tahukah?

entries.original:
"To the west of Dresco Town is Grim
Woods.

It’s filled with lots of cool Bug
and Ghost type Pokémon.

When you have a chance you should
check it out."
entries.translation_source: To the west of Dresco Town is Grim Woods. It’s filled with lots of cool Bug and Ghost type Pokémon. When you have a chance you should check it out.

Grim Woods. Tempat itu dipenuhi\lbanyak Pokémon tipe Serangga dan

Hantu yang keren. Jika ada
kesempatan, kamu harus\lmengunjunginya.

entries.original: "It’s kind of chilly out here."
entries.translation_source: It’s kind of chilly out here.

entries.translation_source: That warmed me right up!

entries.original: "It’s always important to stay warm."
entries.translation_source: It’s always important to stay warm.
entries.translated: Selalu penting untuk tetap hangat.

trainer to ever live."
entries.translation_source: Go, train, and become the strongest trainer to ever live.
entries.translated:

pelatih terkuat yang pernah hidup.

Cliff Cave dari wilayah Johto.\lKenapa dinamai Gunung Thundercap

dan bukan Cliff Cave, aku tidak
paham.

for it, get out of the way!"

entries.translated:
[blue]Apa? Kamu datang untuk mengambil
paket itu juga? Yah, kecuali kamu\lmau bertarung untuk mendapatkannya,

minggir!

entries.original: "Fight"
entries.translation_source: Fight
entries.translated: Fight

entries.original: "Move"
entries.translation_source: Move
entries.translated: Move

entries.original: "[blue]I’m going to put you in your place!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I’m going to put you in your place!
entries.translated: [blue]Aku akan menempatkanmu di tempatmu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Did you honestly think that I would
give up the package even if I lost?

I didn’t come all this way just to
give in to some stupid kid.

Now move!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Did you honestly think that I would give up the package even if I lost? I didn’t come all this way just to give in to some stupid kid. Now move!
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa kamu benar-benar berpikir aku
akan menyerahkan paket itu meskipun\laku kalah? Aku tidak datang sejauh

ini hanya untuk menyerah pada anak
bodoh. Sekarang minggir!

entries.original: "[blue]Get out of my way!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Get out of my way!
entries.translated: [blue]Minggir dari jalanku!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Did you receive the
package from the Mart?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Did you receive the package from the Mart?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Apakah kamu menerima paket
dari Mart?

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, I did, sir."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Yes, I did, sir.
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Ya, aku menerimanya, tuan.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Were you discreet in doing
so?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Were you discreet in doing so?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Apakah kau berhati-hati
dalam melakukannya?

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I was, sir.

I tried not to cause too
much of a commotion.

I even paid for the package as
instructed."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]I was, sir. I tried not to cause too much of a commotion. I even paid for the package as instructed.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Ya, Pak. Saya berusaha tidak
membuat terlalu banyak keributan.\lSaya bahkan membayar paketnya

sesuai instruksi.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Good work.

The last thing we need right now is
the police after us.

We’re too close to the end game to
be stopped now."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Good work. The last thing we need right now is the police after us. We’re too close to the end game to be stopped now.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Kerja bagus. Hal terakhir
yang kita butuhkan saat ini adalah\lpolisi mengejar kita. Kita sudah

terlalu dekat dengan akhir
permainan untuk dihentikan\lsekarang.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Report to Zeph, and inform
him of my current status."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Report to Zeph, and inform him of my current status.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Laporkan kepada Zeph, dan
beri tahu dia tentang status saya\lsaat ini.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Yes, sir!
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Baik, Pak!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, prefers
flowery Pokémon.

If you come prepared with a Fire or
Flying-type Pokémon, you should be\lable to take him out no sweat!

-COUGH- -COUGH-

Also, be aware, Mirskle likes to
hotbox his gym from time to time,\land this may have an effect on your\lbattling.

If you notice a \qothick fog\qc rolling
in, you’ll dodge hits easier, but\lyou’ll also have a harder time\llanding them as well!

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, prefers flowery Pokémon. If you come prepared with a Fire or Flying-type Pokémon, you should be able to take him out no sweat! -COUGH- -COUGH- Also, be aware, Mirskle likes to hotbox his gym from time to time, and this may have an effect on your battling. If you notice a [quote-open-1]thick fog[quote-close-2] rolling in, you’ll dodge hits easier, but you’ll also have a harder time landing them as well! Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Gym Leader, Mirskle, lebih suka
Pokémon bunga-bunga. Jika kamu\ldatang dengan Pokémon Tipe Api atau

Terbang, kamu seharusnya bisa
mengalahkannya tanpa keringat!\l-BATUK- -BATUK- Juga, perlu

diketahui, Mirskle suka mengasapi
gym-nya dari waktu ke waktu, dan\lini dapat mempengaruhi

pertarunganmu. Jika kamu melihat
\qokabut tebal\qc mulai masuk, kamu\lakan lebih mudah menghindari

serangan, tetapi juga akan lebih
sulit untuk mendaratkannya! Semoga\lberhasil di luar sana!

entries.original:
"I’m impressed!

You managed to beat Mirskle even
with your eyes full of \qofog\qc!

Take this as some extra proof of
your victory here."
entries.translation_source: I’m impressed! You managed to beat Mirskle even with your eyes full of [quote-open-1]fog[quote-close-2]! Take this as some extra proof of your victory here.
entries.translated:
Saya terkesan! Kamu berhasil
mengalahkan Mirskle bahkan dengan\lmata penuh \qokabut\qc! Ambil ini

sebagai bukti tambahan kemenanganmu
di sini.

entries.original:
"That’s a rare gemstone that can
power up a grassy move in battle\lfor you!

I’m sure it’ll help you out, champ
in the making."
entries.translation_source: That’s a rare gemstone that can power up a grassy move in battle for you! I’m sure it’ll help you out, champ in the making.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah batu permata langka yang
dapat memperkuat jurus rumput dalam\lpertempuran untukmu! Saya yakin itu

akan membantumu, calon juara.

entries.original:
"Huh.

You have no space for it."
entries.translation_source: Huh. You have no space for it.
entries.translated:
Huh. Kamu tidak punya ruang untuk
itu.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Leaf Badge
from Mirskle!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Leaf Badge from Mirskle!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Lencana Daun dari
Mirskle!

entries.original: "Take this cool, grassy TM toooo\."
entries.translation_source: Take this cool, grassy TM toooo[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ambil TM rumput yang keren ini yaaa\.

entries.original:
"In case you were wonderin’, that
TM contains [green]Grass Knot[blue].

I knew this guy, once.

He’d always be fallin’ over. Said
it was some sorta genetic problem.

But the truth is\.

I just kept usin’ Grass Knot on
him!

It’s a good thing he wasn’t toooo
heavy, or it woulda really hurt."
entries.translation_source: In case you were wonderin’, that TM contains [color-green-1]Grass Knot[color-blue-2]. I knew this guy, once. He’d always be fallin’ over. Said it was some sorta genetic problem. But the truth is[game-token-3] I just kept usin’ Grass Knot on him! It’s a good thing he wasn’t toooo heavy, or it woulda really hurt.
entries.translated:
Kalau kamu penasaran, TM itu berisi
[green]Grass Knot[blue]. Saya kenal orang ini,\ldulu. Dia selalu jatuh. Katanya itu

semacam masalah genetik. Tapi
sebenarnya\. Saya terus menggunakan\lGrass Knot padanya! Untung dia

tidak terlalu berat, atau itu akan
sangat sakit.

entries.original:
"Aww, man\.

You already have Grass Knot\."
entries.translation_source: Aww, man[game-token-1] You already have Grass Knot[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aduh, bung\. Kamu sudah punya Grass
Knot\.

entries.original:
"Everyone hide!

The popo’s here to get us again!"
entries.translation_source: Everyone hide! The popo’s here to get us again!
entries.translated:
Semua bersembunyi! Polisi datang
untuk menangkap kita lagi!

entries.original:
"Officer 1: [blue]Hey, kid!

Did you see which way the Gym
Leader ran?

He’s wanted for trafficking in
Oddish leaves!"
entries.translation_source: Officer 1: [color-blue-1]Hey, kid! Did you see which way the Gym Leader ran? He’s wanted for trafficking in Oddish leaves!
entries.translated:
Polisi 1: [blue]Hei, nak! Apakah kamu
melihat ke mana arah Gym Leader itu\llari? Dia dicari karena perdagangan

daun Oddish!

entries.original: "Would you like to tell them?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to tell them?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin memberitahu
mereka?

entries.original:
"Officer 1: [blue]Looks like [buffer2]
doesn’t know, Frank\.

Should we let [buffer1] off?"
entries.translation_source: Officer 1: [color-blue-1]Looks like [buffer2-2] doesn’t know, Frank[game-token-3] Should we let [buffer1-4] off?
entries.translated:
Polisi 1: [blue]Sepertinya [buffer2] tidak
tahu, Frank\. Haruskah kita\lmelepaskan [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Officer 2: [blue]Let’s let [buffer1] off.

[buffer3] probably just fell victim to
Mirskle’s lies.

Poor kid\."
entries.translation_source: Officer 2: [color-blue-1]Let’s let [buffer1-2] off. [buffer3-3] probably just fell victim to Mirskle’s lies. Poor kid[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Polisi 2: [blue]Ayo lepaskan [buffer1].
[buffer3] mungkin hanya menjadi\lkorban kebohongan Mirskle. Kasihan

nak\.

entries.original:
"Officer 1: [blue]Uh, yeah\.

Your story checks out.
You’re free to go."
entries.translation_source: Officer 1: [color-blue-1]Uh, yeah[game-token-2] Your story checks out. You’re free to go.
entries.translated:
Polisi 1: [blue]Eh, ya\. Ceritamu cocok.
Kamu bebas pergi.

entries.original:
"Officer 1: [blue]The pond?
Thank you!

You’ve made a big difference in the
war on drugs! Good work!"
entries.translation_source: Officer 1: [color-blue-1]The pond? Thank you! You’ve made a big difference in the war on drugs! Good work!
entries.translated:
Polisi 1: [blue]Kolam? Terima kasih! Kamu
telah membuat perbedaan besar dalam\lperang melawan narkoba! Kerja

bagus!

entries.original:
"Well, then, didja know that if you
talk to the Gym referees after\lbeating the Gym Leader, they’ll\lgive you a gift then, also?

Didja? Didja?"
entries.translation_source: Well, then, didja know that if you talk to the Gym referees after beating the Gym Leader, they’ll give you a gift then, also? Didja? Didja?
entries.translated:
Nah, tahukah kamu bahwa jika kamu
berbicara dengan wasit Gym setelah\lmengalahkan Pemimpin Gym, mereka

akan memberimu hadiah juga?
Tahukah? Tahukah?

entries.translation_source: Cacnea, use Cut!
entries.translated: Cacnea, gunakan Potong!

entries.translation_source: Cac!
entries.translated: Cac!

"No!

entries.translated:
Tidak! Kamu perlu mengambil kembali
paketnya!

"âÁThe Pokémon League is airing a
special on Borrian history.

Would you like to watch it?"
entries.translation_source: âÁThe Pokémon League is airing a special on Borrian history. Would you like to watch it?

"No!
You need to return the package!"
entries.translation_source: No! You need to return the package!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Kamu harus mengembalikan
paketnya!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, [green]Alice[red], lives
downstairs.

She’s away running the Gym most of
the time, so she usually leaves\lher kid home alone.

I, personally, would never leave my
son home alone.

His mind is too delicate.

He can’t bear to be without his
mama!"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, [color-green-1]Alice[color-red-2], lives downstairs. She’s away running the Gym most of the time, so she usually leaves her kid home alone. I, personally, would never leave my son home alone. His mind is too delicate. He can’t bear to be without his mama!
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, [green]Alice[red], tinggal di
lantai bawah. Dia biasanya pergi\lmengelola Gym, jadi dia sering

meninggalkan anaknya sendirian di
rumah. Saya, secara pribadi, tidak\lakan pernah meninggalkan anak

laki-laki saya sendirian di rumah.
Pikirannya terlalu rapuh. Dia tidak\ltahan tanpa ibunya!

entries.original:
"You there, young trainer!

Would you mind helping me with a
task?"
entries.translation_source: You there, young trainer! Would you mind helping me with a task?
entries.translated:
Hei, pelatih muda! Maukah kamu
membantu saya dengan sebuah tugas?

entries.original:
"Ahaha, young trainer!

Would you mind helping me with
another task?"
entries.translation_source: Ahaha, young trainer! Would you mind helping me with another task?
entries.translated:
Ahaha, pelatih muda! Maukah kamu
membantu saya dengan tugas lain?

entries.original:
"Oh!
You found Prof. Log’s package!

If it isn’t too much to ask, would
you be able to deliver it to him?

It’s his order, but he doesn’t want
to come pick it up."
entries.translation_source: Oh! You found Prof. Log’s package! If it isn’t too much to ask, would you be able to deliver it to him? It’s his order, but he doesn’t want to come pick it up.
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu menemukan paket Prof. Log!
Jika tidak terlalu merepotkan,\lbisakah kamu mengantarkannya

kepadanya? Itu pesanannya, tapi dia
tidak mau datang mengambilnya.

entries.original:
"Are you sure?
I promise the reward is good."
entries.translation_source: Are you sure? I promise the reward is good.
entries.translated:
Kamu yakin? Aku janji hadiahnya
bagus.

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you!

My grandson’s birthday is coming up
and I want to bake him a pie, but I\ldon’t have all of the ingredients.

I only need:
[green][buffer1][red]

If you could bring them to me as
soon as possible, it would be much\lappreciated."
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you! My grandson’s birthday is coming up and I want to bake him a pie, but I don’t have all of the ingredients. I only need: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] If you could bring them to me as soon as possible, it would be much appreciated.
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih! Ulang tahun cucu
laki-laki saya sudah dekat dan saya\lingin membuatkan dia pai, tetapi

saya tidak memiliki semua bahannya.
Saya hanya perlu: [green][buffer1][red] Jika\lkamu bisa membawanya kepada saya

secepatnya, itu akan sangat saya
hargai.

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you again!

My son’s anniversary is coming up,
and I want to bake him a pie too.

This time I need:
[green][buffer1][red]

Bring them to me with haste, young
trainer!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you again! My son’s anniversary is coming up, and I want to bake him a pie too. This time I need: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] Bring them to me with haste, young trainer!
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih lagi! Hari jadi
anak laki-laki saya sudah dekat,\ldan saya ingin membuatkan dia pai

juga. Kali ini saya perlu: [green][buffer1][red]
Bawakan mereka kepada saya dengan\lcepat, pelatih muda!

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you again!

My ex-husband has found love with
another woman, and I want to bake\la pie to smash in his face!

This time I need:
[green][buffer1]"
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you again! My ex-husband has found love with another woman, and I want to bake a pie to smash in his face! This time I need: [color-green-1][buffer1-2]
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih lagi! Mantan suami
saya telah menemukan cinta dengan\lwanita lain, dan saya ingin membuat

pai untuk dihantamkan ke wajahnya!
Kali ini saya perlu: [green][buffer1]

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][red]

Bring them to me with extreme
haste, young trainer!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] Bring them to me with extreme haste, young trainer!
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red] Bawakan mereka kepada saya
dengan sangat cepat, pelatih muda!

entries.original:
"I still need:
[green][buffer1][red]

Please bring them as soon as you
can."
entries.translation_source: I still need: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] Please bring them as soon as you can.
entries.translated:
Saya masih perlu: [green][buffer1][red] Tolong
bawakan mereka sesegera mungkin.

entries.original:
"I still need:
[green][buffer1]"
entries.translation_source: I still need: [color-green-1][buffer1-2]
entries.translated: Saya masih perlu: [green][buffer1]

entries.original:
"If I had a bike, it would be much
easier to climb.

But where can you even get a bike
around here?"
entries.translation_source: If I had a bike, it would be much easier to climb. But where can you even get a bike around here?
entries.translated:
Jika saya punya sepeda, akan lebih
mudah untuk mendaki. Tapi di mana\lkamu bisa mendapatkan sepeda di

sekitar sini?

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Well\.erm\.

From what I can see, your Pokémon
do have some nice stats\.

I see potential for them to become
strong Pokémon some day."
entries.translation_source: Log: [color-blue-1]Well[game-token-2]erm[game-token-3] From what I can see, your Pokémon do have some nice stats[game-token-4] I see potential for them to become strong Pokémon some day.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Yah\.erm\. Dari yang bisa saya
lihat, Pokémonmu memiliki statistik\lyang bagus\. Saya melihat potensi

bagi mereka untuk menjadi Pokémon
yang kuat suatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Thank you, Log.

That’s the first useful thing
you’ve said all day.

And it’ll be the last.
’Cause I’m outta here."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Thank you, Log. That’s the first useful thing you’ve said all day. And it’ll be the last. ’Cause I’m outta here.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Terima kasih, Log. Itu
hal berguna pertama yang kamu\lkatakan sepanjang hari. Dan itu

akan menjadi yang terakhir. Karena
aku pergi dari sini.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Well, he’s certainly a handful,
isn’t he?

And now that he’s gone, who’ll run
my errands for me?"
entries.translation_source: Log: [color-blue-1]Well, he’s certainly a handful, isn’t he? And now that he’s gone, who’ll run my errands for me?
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Yah, dia memang merepotkan,
bukan? Dan sekarang setelah dia\lpergi, siapa yang akan menjalankan

tugas-tugasku?

entries.original:
"[blue]Aha!

[player], you seem capable, would
you like to run my errands for me?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Aha! [player-name-2], you seem capable, would you like to run my errands for me?
entries.translated:
[blue]Aha! [player], kamu tampak cakap,
apakah kamu mau menjalankan\ltugas-tugasku?

entries.original:
"[blue]Are you sure?

It’s always good to have an in with
the Pokémon Professor!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Are you sure? It’s always good to have an in with the Pokémon Professor!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu yakin? Selalu baik untuk
memiliki hubungan dengan Profesor\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"[blue]What are you doing?

I told you to check in with your
mother!

\.

Don’t look at me like that.

Didn’t your mother ever teach you
to listen to your elders?

Go see her!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What are you doing? I told you to check in with your mother! [game-token-2] Don’t look at me like that. Didn’t your mother ever teach you to listen to your elders? Go see her!
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa yang kamu lakukan? Aku sudah
bilang untuk memeriksakan diri ke\libumu! \. Jangan lihat aku seperti

itu. Bukankah ibumu pernah
mengajarimu untuk mendengarkan\lorang yang lebih tua? Temui dia!

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][red]

Please bring them as soon as you
can."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] Please bring them as soon as you can.
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red] Tolong bawalah mereka
secepat yang kamu bisa.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo, it seems you’ve
brought my ingredients.

Much appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo, it seems you’ve brought my ingredients. Much appreciated.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo, sepertinya kamu telah
membawa bahan-bahanku. Terima kasih\lbanyak.

entries.original:
"The Old Lady took:
[green][buffer1]"
entries.translation_source: The Old Lady took: [color-green-1][buffer1-2]
entries.translated: Nenek tua mengambil: [green][buffer1]

entries.original:
"I’m sure my [buffer2] will love
this pie.

Please, take these in exchange for
your hard work, young trainer."
entries.translation_source: I’m sure my [buffer2-1] will love this pie. Please, take these in exchange for your hard work, young trainer.
entries.translated:
Aku yakin [buffer2]ku akan menyukai
pai ini. Silakan, ambil ini sebagai\limbalan atas kerja kerasmu, pelatih

muda.

entries.original:
"My umbrella always protects me when
it’s raining!"
entries.translation_source: My umbrella always protects me when it’s raining!
entries.translated:
Payungku selalu melindungiku saat
hujan!

entries.original:
"Did you know there is a special
Poké Ball that heals Pokémon?

When you capture a Pokémon, all
damage done to it is undone!

Don’t you wish you had some?"
entries.translation_source: Did you know there is a special Poké Ball that heals Pokémon? When you capture a Pokémon, all damage done to it is undone! Don’t you wish you had some?
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu ada Poké Ball khusus
yang menyembuhkan Pokémon? Saat\lkamu menangkap Pokémon, semua

kerusakan yang diterimanya akan
pulih! Bukankah kamu ingin\lmemilikinya?

entries.original:
"North of here is the entrance to an
underground highway.

The only problem is that it’s
blocked by some skinny trees.

I just wish I knew how to get past
them."
entries.translation_source: North of here is the entrance to an underground highway. The only problem is that it’s blocked by some skinny trees. I just wish I knew how to get past them.
entries.translated:
Di utara sini ada pintu masuk ke
jalan bawah tanah. Satu-satunya\lmasalah adalah terhalang oleh

beberapa pohon kurus. Aku hanya
berharap tahu cara melewatinya.

entries.original: "Mel: [blue]I need to talk to you."
entries.translation_source: Mel: [color-blue-1]I need to talk to you.
entries.translated: Mel: [blue]Aku perlu bicara denganmu.

entries.translation_source: Route 12
entries.translated: Rute 12

entries.original: "Route 12"
entries.translation_source: Route 12
entries.translated: Rute 12

entries.translation_source: 9pidimy Town
entries.translated: 9pidimy Town

"Maybe I should switch to surfing,
too\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should switch to surfing, too[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku juga harus beralih ke
berselancar\.

"Hello, there!

entries.translation_source: Hello, there! Aren’t you going to swim?

entries.translation_source: Hey, champ in the making! It’s been a while! Take a Fresh Water to celebrate your return.
entries.translated:
Hei, juara masa depan! Sudah lama!
Ambil Air Segar untuk merayakan\lkembalimu.

entries.original:
"Go on.

Don’t be shy about talking to
lonely fishermen.

Just don’t you talk to me."
entries.translation_source: Go on. Don’t be shy about talking to lonely fishermen. Just don’t you talk to me.
entries.translated:
Ayo. Jangan malu untuk berbicara
dengan nelayan yang kesepian. Tapi\ljangan bicara padaku.

entries.original:
"This area is sealed off to anyone
who isn’t a member of The Shadows.

Since you’re not one of us,
scram, kid!"
entries.translation_source: This area is sealed off to anyone who isn’t a member of The Shadows. Since you’re not one of us, scram, kid!
entries.translated:
Area ini disegel untuk siapa pun
yang bukan anggota The Shadows.\lKarena kamu bukan salah satu dari

kami, pergilah, nak!

entries.original:
"Sometimes if you talk to sand
castles on the beach, they attack\lyou!

It’s really scary!"
entries.translation_source: Sometimes if you talk to sand castles on the beach, they attack you! It’s really scary!
entries.translated:
Terkadang jika kamu berbicara
dengan istana pasir di pantai,\lmereka akan menyerangmu!

Benar-benar menakutkan!

entries.original: "[red]Please raise them well!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Please raise them well!
entries.translated: [red]Tolong rawat mereka dengan baik!

entries.original:
"That house on my left is known as
the Double Battle Trainer House.

You can battle the trainers inside
as many times as you want.

It’s the perfect place for training
up your Pokemon if you’re thinking\lof taking on the Gym."
entries.translation_source: That house on my left is known as the Double Battle Trainer House. You can battle the trainers inside as many times as you want. It’s the perfect place for training up your Pokemon if you’re thinking of taking on the Gym.
entries.translated:
Rumah di sebelah kiriku dikenal
sebagai Rumah Pelatih Pertarungan\lGanda. Kamu bisa bertarung melawan

para pelatih di dalamnya sebanyak
yang kamu mau. Tempat ini sempurna\luntuk melatih Pokemon-mu jika kamu

berniat menantang Gym.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Alright, grunts.

Our current objective is to head to
[green]Cinder Volcano [blue]and help Ivory\lobtain Specimen TRES."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Alright, grunts. Our current objective is to head to [color-green-2]Cinder Volcano [color-blue-3]and help Ivory obtain Specimen TRES.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Baiklah, anak buah. Tujuan
kita saat ini adalah menuju ke\l[green]Gunung Api Cinder [blue]dan membantu

Ivory mendapatkan Spesimen TRES.

entries.original: "Grunts: [blue]Yes, sir!"
entries.translation_source: Grunts: [color-blue-1]Yes, sir!
entries.translated: Grunts: [blue]Siap, Pak!

entries.original: "You learn something new every day!"
entries.translation_source: You learn something new every day!
entries.translated:
Kamu belajar sesuatu yang baru
setiap hari!

entries.original: "Oh, look at you, smarty pants."
entries.translation_source: Oh, look at you, smarty pants.
entries.translated: Oh, lihat dirimu, si pintar.

entries.original:
"Ah, from the badge on your Trainer
Card, I see that you’ve become a\lrather skilled trainer.

You’ve far surpassed the role of
Log’s errand [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Ah, from the badge on your Trainer Card, I see that you’ve become a rather skilled trainer. You’ve far surpassed the role of Log’s errand [buffer1-1].
entries.translated:
Ah, dari lencana di Kartu
Pelatih-mu, aku melihat bahwa kamu\ltelah menjadi pelatih yang cukup

terampil. Kamu telah jauh melampaui
peran sebagai suruhan Log [buffer1].

"Autumn Aquaway, Route 7, 8, and
Blizzard City"

Autumn Aquaway, Rute 7, 8, dan Kota
Blizzard
