entries.original:
"I’m sure I’ll enjoy smashing this
pie into my ex-husband’s face!

Please, take these in exchange for
your hard work, young trainer."
entries.translation_source: I’m sure I’ll enjoy smashing this pie into my ex-husband’s face! Please, take these in exchange for your hard work, young trainer.
entries.translated:
Aku yakin aku akan menikmati
menghancurkan pai ini ke wajah\lmantan suamiku! Tolong, ambil ini

sebagai imbalan atas kerja kerasmu,
pelatih muda.

entries.original:
"Come back again in the future
sometime.

There are no shortage of
celebrations to bake pies for."
entries.translation_source: Come back again in the future sometime. There are no shortage of celebrations to bake pies for.
entries.translated:
Datang lagi lain kali. Tidak ada
kekurangan perayaan untuk membuat\lpai.

entries.original:
"My family loved all of the pies!

I couldn’t have made such wonderful
food without your help."
entries.translation_source: My family loved all of the pies! I couldn’t have made such wonderful food without your help.
entries.translated:
Keluargaku menyukai semua pai itu!
Aku tidak bisa membuat makanan yang\lbegitu lezat tanpa bantuanmu.

entries.original: "5 Lum Berries\l5 Belue Berries\l5 Watmel Berries\l5 Moomoo Milks"
entries.translation_source: 5 Lum Berries 5 Belue Berries 5 Watmel Berries 5 Moomoo Milks

entries.original:
"5 Maranga Berries
10 Moomoo Milks"
entries.translation_source: 5 Maranga Berries 10 Moomoo Milks

entries.original:
"Many trainers in Blizzard City love
using Flying-type Pokémon.

They pride themselves on their
birds’ resistance to cold."
entries.translation_source: Many trainers in Blizzard City love using Flying-type Pokémon. They pride themselves on their birds’ resistance to cold.
entries.translated:
Banyak pelatih di Blizzard City
suka menggunakan Pokémon tipe\lTerbang. Mereka bangga dengan

ketahanan burung mereka terhadap
dingin.

entries.original:
"Take this item to feel just like
them."
entries.translation_source: Take this item to feel just like them.
entries.translated:
Ambil item ini agar kamu bisa
merasakan seperti mereka.

entries.original:
"The Flying-type is the only type
that is not grounded.

What is [green]grounding[blue]?

Grounded Pokémon take damage from
Spikes, and benefit from the\leffect of Terrains, among other\lthings.

You’ll learn about them all the
more you battle."
entries.translation_source: The Flying-type is the only type that is not grounded. What is [color-green-1]grounding[color-blue-2]? Grounded Pokémon take damage from Spikes, and benefit from the effect of Terrains, among other things. You’ll learn about them all the more you battle.
entries.translated:
Tipe Terbang adalah satu-satunya
tipe yang tidak membumi. Apa itu\l[green]pembumian[blue]? Pokémon yang membumi

menerima damage dari Spikes, dan
mendapat manfaat dari efek Medan,\lantara lain. Kamu akan belajar

tentang semuanya semakin sering
kamu bertarung.

entries.original:
"The Blizzard City Gym is the only
gym in West Borrius with a unique\lexterior design.

The Gym’s interior layout wouldn’t
fit inside a normal Gym."
entries.translation_source: The Blizzard City Gym is the only gym in West Borrius with a unique exterior design. The Gym’s interior layout wouldn’t fit inside a normal Gym.
entries.translated:
Gym Blizzard City adalah
satu-satunya gym di West Borrius\ldengan desain eksterior yang unik.

Tata letak interior Gym tidak akan
muat di dalam Gym biasa.

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of a Pokémon
called [green]Eevee[red]?

Apparently it’ll evolve if you
touch some rock around here.

I’ve also heard it’ll evolve if you
you touch some rock in [green]Grim Woods[red].

I’d love to see an Eevee some
day\."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of a Pokémon called [color-green-1]Eevee[color-red-2]? Apparently it’ll evolve if you touch some rock around here. I’ve also heard it’ll evolve if you you touch some rock in [color-green-3]Grim Woods[color-red-4]. I’d love to see an Eevee some day[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang
Pokémon bernama [green]Eevee[red]? Rupanya dia\lakan berevolusi jika kamu menyentuh

batu di sekitar sini. Aku juga
dengar dia akan berevolusi jika\lkamu menyentuh batu di [green]Grim Woods[red].

Aku ingin sekali melihat Eevee
suatu hari nanti\.

entries.original:
"That’s an Eevee!
That’s an Eevee!

You have an Eevee!

So cute!"
entries.translation_source: That’s an Eevee! That’s an Eevee! You have an Eevee! So cute!
entries.translated:
Itu Eevee! Itu Eevee! Kamu punya
Eevee! Sangat lucu!

entries.original:
"That’s for showing me an Eevee!

It doesn’t evolve Eevee, but I
think it evolves some Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: That’s for showing me an Eevee! It doesn’t evolve Eevee, but I think it evolves some Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Itu untuk menunjukkan Eevee padaku!
Itu tidak membuat Eevee berevolusi,\ltapi aku pikir itu membuat beberapa

Pokémon berevolusi.

entries.original:
"You can evolve your Eevee by
touching some rock around here or\lin [green]Grim Woods[red]."
entries.translation_source: You can evolve your Eevee by touching some rock around here or in [color-green-1]Grim Woods[color-red-2].
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa membuat Eevee-mu
berevolusi dengan menyentuh batu di\lsekitar sini atau di [green]Grim Woods[red].

entries.original:
"Ho, ho, ho!

The look on the your face is
priceless!

Don’t worry, my friend, the [green]Cut
Master[blue] told me you were coming!"
entries.translation_source: Ho, ho, ho! The look on the your face is priceless! Don’t worry, my friend, the [color-green-1]Cut Master[color-blue-2] told me you were coming!
entries.translated:
Ho, ho, ho! Ekspresi wajahmu
sungguh tak ternilai! Jangan\lkhawatir, temanku, [green]Cut Master[blue]

memberitahuku bahwa kamu akan
datang!

entries.original:
"Ah, ha, ha!
So I was right!

I’ve been saying that to every
person who’s walked through my door\lsince I received his call, but\lyou’re the first person to have\la look of relief on their face!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, ha, ha! So I was right! I’ve been saying that to every person who’s walked through my door since I received his call, but you’re the first person to have a look of relief on their face!
entries.translated:
Ah, ha, ha! Jadi aku benar! Aku
telah mengatakan itu kepada setiap\lorang yang melewati pintuku sejak

aku menerima teleponnya, tapi kamu
adalah orang pertama yang memiliki\lekspresi lega di wajah mereka!

entries.original:
"That HM contains [green]Rock Smash[blue], if
it wasn’t already obvious!

You can use it to smash any cracked
rocks in your path.

Just remember, in order to use Rock
Smash, you first need to obtain\l[green]Blizzard City’s Gym Badge[blue]."
entries.translation_source: That HM contains [color-green-1]Rock Smash[color-blue-2], if it wasn’t already obvious! You can use it to smash any cracked rocks in your path. Just remember, in order to use Rock Smash, you first need to obtain [color-green-3]Blizzard City’s Gym Badge[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
HM itu berisi [green]Rock Smash[blue], jika
belum jelas! Kamu bisa\lmenggunakannya untuk menghancurkan

batu retak di jalanmu. Ingat saja,
untuk menggunakan Rock Smash, kamu\lharus mendapatkan [green]Blizzard City{B4}s

Gym Badge[blue].

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s you!
Champ in the making!

How’re you liking the weather up
here?

Welcome to the Blizzard City Gym!

Let’s start you off with some
Fresh Water."
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s you! Champ in the making! How’re you liking the weather up here? Welcome to the Blizzard City Gym! Let’s start you off with some Fresh Water.
entries.translated:
Oh, itu kamu! Juara masa depan!
Bagaimana cuaca di sini? Selamat\ldatang di Gym Kota Blizzard! Mari

kita mulai dengan Air Segar.

entries.original:
"Contrary to popular belief, this
Gym is not an Ice-type gym.

It’s a [green]Flying[blue]-type Gym!

And the best way to counter
Flying-types is to clip their\lwings with [green]ice[blue], [green]rocks[blue], or\l[green]electricity[blue]!

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Contrary to popular belief, this Gym is not an Ice-type gym. It’s a [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-type Gym! And the best way to counter Flying-types is to clip their wings with [color-green-3]ice[color-blue-4], [color-green-5]rocks[color-blue-6], or [color-green-7]electricity[color-blue-8]! Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Bertentangan dengan kepercayaan
umum, Gym ini bukan Gym tipe Es.\lIni adalah Gym tipe [green]Terbang[blue]! Dan

cara terbaik untuk melawan tipe
Terbang adalah dengan memotong\lsayap mereka dengan [green]es[blue], [green]batu[blue], atau

[green]listrik[blue]! Semoga beruntung di luar
sana!

entries.original:
"Well done!

You fought bravely through the
hailstorm and came out on top!

Take this, as an extra reward for
your victory."
entries.translation_source: Well done! You fought bravely through the hailstorm and came out on top! Take this, as an extra reward for your victory.
entries.translated:
Bagus sekali! Kau bertarung dengan
berani melalui badai es dan keluar\lsebagai pemenang! Ambil ini,

sebagai hadiah tambahan untuk
kemenanganmu.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single Flying-type move in battle.

With it, you can land a graceful,
yet still devastating blow!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single Flying-type move in battle. With it, you can land a graceful, yet still devastating blow!
entries.translated:
Permata yang kuberikan padamu bisa
memperkuat satu jurus tipe Terbang\ldalam pertarungan. Dengan itu, kau

bisa mendaratkan pukulan yang
anggun, namun tetap menghancurkan!

entries.original: "The [buffer1] is fast asleep\."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] is fast asleep[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [buffer1] tertidur pulas\.

entries.original: "Crah rah rah rah rah!"
entries.translation_source: Crah rah rah rah rah!
entries.translated: Crah rah rah rah rah!

entries.original: "Great Desert"
entries.translation_source: Great Desert
entries.translated: Gurun Besar

entries.original: "Vivill Town"
entries.translation_source: Vivill Town
entries.translated: Kota Vivill

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] burrowed into
the snow."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] burrowed into the snow.
entries.translated: [buffer1] menggali ke dalam salju.

entries.original:
"Hey there, [buffer1].

You ever been this high up off the
ground before?

When you’re up at this height, the
battles are amazing!

I don’t want to bore you with
chit-chat, so let’s get to it!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, [buffer1-1]. You ever been this high up off the ground before? When you’re up at this height, the battles are amazing! I don’t want to bore you with chit-chat, so let’s get to it!
entries.translated:
Hei, [buffer1]. Apa kau pernah
setinggi ini di atas tanah\lsebelumnya? Saat kau di ketinggian

ini, pertarungannya luar biasa! Aku
tidak ingin membuatmu bosan dengan\lobrolan ringan, jadi mari kita

mulai!

entries.original:
"As proof of your victory against
the Blizzard City Gym Leader, take\lthe [green]Wings Badge[red]."
entries.translation_source: As proof of your victory against the Blizzard City Gym Leader, take the [color-green-1]Wings Badge[color-red-2].
entries.translated:
Sebagai bukti kemenanganmu melawan
Pemimpin Gym Kota Blizzard,\lambillah [green]Lencana Sayap[red].

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Wings Badge
from Alice!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Wings Badge from Alice!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Lencana Sayap
dari Alice!

entries.original:
"With the Wings Badge, you can now
smash cracked rocks with grace!

Not only that, but any Pokémon up
to Lv. 50 will always obey you!

Take this TM, too!"
entries.translation_source: With the Wings Badge, you can now smash cracked rocks with grace! Not only that, but any Pokémon up to Lv. 50 will always obey you! Take this TM, too!
entries.translated:
Dengan Lencana Sayap, kau sekarang
bisa menghancurkan batu retak\ldengan anggun! Bukan hanya itu,

tapi semua Pokémon hingga Level 50
akan selalu menuruti perintahmu!\lAmbil juga TM ini!

entries.original:
"TM40 contains [green]Aerial Ace[red]!
It’s a move that’s sure to hit!"
entries.translation_source: TM40 contains [color-green-1]Aerial Ace[color-red-2]! It’s a move that’s sure to hit!
entries.translated:
TM40 berisi [green]Aerial Ace[red]! Ini adalah
jurus yang pasti kena!

entries.original:
"Remember this!

No matter how icy or shocking the
conditions are, there will still be\lbirds flying high in the sky!"
entries.translation_source: Remember this! No matter how icy or shocking the conditions are, there will still be birds flying high in the sky!
entries.translated:
Ingat ini! Tidak peduli seberapa
dingin atau mengejutkan kondisinya,\lakan tetap ada burung yang terbang

tinggi di langit!

entries.original:
"I’m looking for Battle Items like
[green]X-Attack [blue]and [green]X-Speed[blue].

They raise a Pokémon’s stats in
battle.

But no matter how hard I look, I
can’t seem to find any here\."
entries.translation_source: I’m looking for Battle Items like [color-green-1]X-Attack [color-blue-2]and [color-green-3]X-Speed[color-blue-4]. They raise a Pokémon’s stats in battle. But no matter how hard I look, I can’t seem to find any here[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Aku mencari Item Pertarungan
seperti [green]X-Attack [blue]dan [green]X-Speed[blue].\lMereka meningkatkan statistik

Pokémon dalam pertarungan. Tapi
tidak peduli seberapa keras aku\lmencari, sepertinya aku tidak bisa

menemukannya di sini\.

entries.original:
"What’s saltier?
My tears or the lake\."
entries.translation_source: What’s saltier? My tears or the lake[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"[green]Route 10 [blue]has a cave that resembles
the [green]Lake Caves [blue]of [green]Sinnoh[blue].

I’ve never been in it myself, but
I’ve heard things\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Route 10 [color-blue-2]has a cave that resembles the [color-green-3]Lake Caves [color-blue-4]of [color-green-5]Sinnoh[color-blue-6]. I’ve never been in it myself, but I’ve heard things[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
[green]Rute 10 [blue]memiliki gua yang mirip
dengan [green]Gua Danau [blue]di [green]Sinnoh[blue]. Aku\lsendiri belum pernah masuk, tapi

aku pernah mendengar hal-hal\.

entries.original:
"One day there’s going to be a nice
big statue here.

It’ll make Tehl Town on par with
all those cool towns with statues."
entries.translation_source: One day there’s going to be a nice big statue here. It’ll make Tehl Town on par with all those cool towns with statues.
entries.translated:
Suatu hari nanti akan ada patung
besar yang bagus di sini. Ini akan\lmembuat Kota Tehl setara dengan

semua kota keren yang memiliki
patung.

entries.original:
"My brother and his friend are so
cute!

They look almost identical!"
entries.translation_source: My brother and his friend are so cute! They look almost identical!
entries.translated:
Kakakku dan temannya sangat lucu!
Mereka terlihat hampir identik!

entries.original:
"There are these really loud
waterfalls in my Gym, and the\lracket really hurts my head.

It kind of makes want to just Mega
Punch something!"
entries.translation_source: There are these really loud waterfalls in my Gym, and the racket really hurts my head. It kind of makes want to just Mega Punch something!
entries.translated:
Ada air terjun yang sangat keras di
Gym-ku, dan kebisingan itu\lbenar-benar sakit di kepalaku. Ini

membuatku ingin memukul sesuatu
dengan Mega Punch!

entries.original:
"Oh, sorry!
I forgot to introduce myself!

I’m Mel, the Gym Leader of
[green]Fallshore City[blue].

You’re a challenger?
Then meet me at my Gym.

I’m not really in the mood to go
back right now, so if you don’t put\lup a good fight, I’m gonna loose my\lMega Punch on you!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, sorry! I forgot to introduce myself! I’m Mel, the Gym Leader of [color-green-1]Fallshore City[color-blue-2]. You’re a challenger? Then meet me at my Gym. I’m not really in the mood to go back right now, so if you don’t put up a good fight, I’m gonna loose my Mega Punch on you!
entries.translated:
Oh, maaf! Aku lupa memperkenalkan
diriku! Aku Mel, Pemimpin Gym dari\l[green]Fallshore City[blue]. Kamu seorang

penantang? Kalau begitu, temui aku
di Gym-ku. Aku sedang tidak ingin\lkembali sekarang, jadi jika kamu

tidak memberi perlawanan yang baik,
aku akan melepaskan Mega Punch-ku\lpadamu!

entries.original:
"The sea\.

Full of fury one moment, calm as a
Pokémon’s nature the next\."
entries.translation_source: The sea[game-token-1] Full of fury one moment, calm as a Pokémon’s nature the next[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Laut\. Penuh amarah suatu saat,
tenang seperti Sifat Pokémon di\lsaat berikutnya\.

entries.original:
"A Gem is a special type of held
item that powers up a single attack\lin battle, then disappears\lforever.

Each Gem corresponds to specific
type, and can only power up that\ltype of move.

Every Gym Leader in Borrius has at
least one of their Pokémon holding\la Gem, so be wary.

If you’re concerned about this, you
can use the move [green]Incinerate[blue] to\lmelt their Gem first, before they\lhave a chance to use it."
entries.translation_source: A Gem is a special type of held item that powers up a single attack in battle, then disappears forever. Each Gem corresponds to specific type, and can only power up that type of move. Every Gym Leader in Borrius has at least one of their Pokémon holding a Gem, so be wary. If you’re concerned about this, you can use the move [color-green-1]Incinerate[color-blue-2] to melt their Gem first, before they have a chance to use it.
entries.translated:
Permata adalah jenis item yang
dibawa khusus yang meningkatkan\lkekuatan satu serangan dalam

pertempuran, lalu hilang selamanya.
Setiap Permata sesuai dengan tipe\ltertentu, dan hanya dapat

meningkatkan kekuatan jurus tipe
itu. Setiap Pemimpin Gym di Borrius\lmemiliki setidaknya satu Pokémon

mereka yang membawa Permata, jadi
berhati-hatilah. Jika Anda khawatir\ltentang hal ini, Anda dapat

menggunakan jurus [green]Bakar[blue] untuk
melelehkan Permata mereka terlebih\ldahulu, sebelum mereka sempat

menggunakannya.

entries.original: "You must be an experienced trainer."
entries.translation_source: You must be an experienced trainer.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus menjadi pelatih yang
berpengalaman.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I will tolerate no screw
ups!

Last time, some kid noticed us and
tried to interfere.

I can’t have that happening again.

We don’t have the luxury of 
dealing with [buffer1] now.

Keep a low profile at all costs,
and no matter what, do not get\lnoticed!

Do I make myself clear?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]I will tolerate no screw ups! Last time, some kid noticed us and tried to interfere. I can’t have that happening again. We don’t have the luxury of dealing with [buffer1-2] now. Keep a low profile at all costs, and no matter what, do not get noticed! Do I make myself clear?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Saya tidak akan mentolerir
kesalahan! Terakhir kali, seorang\lanak kecil melihat kami dan mencoba

ikut campur. Saya tidak ingin itu
terjadi lagi. Kami tidak punya\lkemewahan untuk menangani [buffer1]

sekarang. Tetaplah tidak mencolok
dengan segala cara, dan jangan\lsampai diperhatikan! Apakah saya

jelas?

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Move out."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Move out.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Keluar.

entries.original:
"You did well delivering Log’s
package to him.

Oh?

What’s this?

I see that Log has entrusted you
with your very own Poké Balls.

I used to be a whiz Trainer back in
my day.

I could show you a thing or two
about capturing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You did well delivering Log’s package to him. Oh? What’s this? I see that Log has entrusted you with your very own Poké Balls. I used to be a whiz Trainer back in my day. I could show you a thing or two about capturing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu berhasil mengantarkan paket
Log kepadanya. Oh? Apa ini? Aku\llihat Log telah mempercayakanmu

dengan Poké Ball milikmu sendiri.
Dulu aku adalah seorang Pelatih\lhebat pada masaku. Aku bisa

menunjukkan beberapa hal tentang
menangkap Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Alright!
Here we go!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! Here we go!
entries.translated: Baiklah! Ayo kita mulai!

entries.original:
"Phew\.

That one was too close for
comfort\."
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1] That one was too close for comfort[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Fiuh\. Yang itu terlalu dekat untuk
kenyamanan\.

entries.original:
"Let me tell you a secret.

The Gym Leader in Dehara City,
Galavan, uses Electric Pokémon.

He tries to catch opponents who use
Water Pokémon off guard.

But whenever he’s not up to it, he
lowers the bridge between the city\land his gym.

So if you want to battle him then,
you’ll just have to wait."
entries.translation_source: Let me tell you a secret. The Gym Leader in Dehara City, Galavan, uses Electric Pokémon. He tries to catch opponents who use Water Pokémon off guard. But whenever he’s not up to it, he lowers the bridge between the city and his gym. So if you want to battle him then, you’ll just have to wait.
entries.translated:
Biarkan aku memberitahumu sebuah
rahasia. Pemimpin Gym di Kota\lDehara, Galavan, menggunakan

Pokémon Tipe Listrik. Dia mencoba
mengejutkan lawan yang menggunakan\lPokémon Tipe Air. Tapi kapan pun

dia tidak siap, dia akan menurunkan
jembatan antara kota dan Gym-nya.\lJadi, jika kamu ingin bertarung

dengannya saat itu, kamu harus
menunggu saja.

entries.original:
"Through here is the entrance to the
Tomb of Borrius.

It is said that the ancient king,
who summoned the dark force long\lago, is burried here.

But you won’t be able to go
anywhere inside without Galavan’s\lpermission, so don’t bother trying."
entries.translation_source: Through here is the entrance to the Tomb of Borrius. It is said that the ancient king, who summoned the dark force long ago, is burried here. But you won’t be able to go anywhere inside without Galavan’s permission, so don’t bother trying.
entries.translated:
Di sini adalah pintu masuk ke Makam
Borrius. Dikatakan bahwa raja kuno,\lyang memanggil kekuatan gelap

dahulu kala, dimakamkan di sini.
Tetapi kamu tidak akan bisa pergi\lke mana pun di dalam tanpa izin

Galavan, jadi jangan repot-repot
mencoba.

entries.original:
"It’s my job to make sure this city
stays a beautiful oasis at the edge\lof the desert.

All these trees aren’t natural to
this area.

I was responsible for planting
them!"
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to make sure this city stays a beautiful oasis at the edge of the desert. All these trees aren’t natural to this area. I was responsible for planting them!
entries.translated:
Tugasku adalah memastikan kota ini
tetap menjadi oasis yang indah di\ltepi padang pasir. Semua pohon ini

tidak alami di daerah ini. Aku yang
bertanggung jawab menanamnya!

entries.original:
"Dehara City is the perfect blend
between tourism and living.

This whole area of the city is
designed to attract tourists, but\lpeople are still able to live in\lthis city in the north-eastern part\lof town."
entries.translation_source: Dehara City is the perfect blend between tourism and living. This whole area of the city is designed to attract tourists, but people are still able to live in this city in the north-eastern part of town.
entries.translated:
Kota Dehara adalah perpaduan
sempurna antara pariwisata dan\ltempat tinggal. Seluruh area kota

ini dirancang untuk menarik
wisatawan, tetapi orang-orang masih\lbisa tinggal di kota ini di bagian

timur laut kota.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like you have
enough space in your party for my\ldear Riolu.

Come back when you’ve made space,
so I can give it to you."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like you have enough space in your party for my dear Riolu. Come back when you’ve made space, so I can give it to you.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak memiliki
cukup ruang di timmu untuk Riolu\lkesayanganku. Kembalilah saat kamu

sudah membuat ruang, agar aku bisa
memberikannya padamu.

entries.original:
"The strange creature was sucked into
the Cube!"
entries.translation_source: The strange creature was sucked into the Cube!
entries.translated:
Makhluk aneh tersedot ke dalam
Kubus!

entries.original:
"You have collected [green][buffer3] percent[black]
of cells."
entries.translation_source: You have collected [color-green-1][buffer3-2] percent[color-black-3] of cells.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah mengumpulkan [green][buffer3]
persen[black] dari sel-sel.

entries.original:
"You, there!

Trainer!

Wait!"
entries.translation_source: You, there! Trainer! Wait!
entries.translated: Hei, kamu! Pelatih! Tunggu!

entries.original:
"Is that a Super Cube in your
pocket?

\.

It is!

You’re just the person I’ve been
looking for!

Please come with me."
entries.translation_source: Is that a Super Cube in your pocket? [game-token-1] It is! You’re just the person I’ve been looking for! Please come with me.
entries.translated:
Apakah itu Super Cube di sakumu? \.
Benar! Kamu adalah orang yang\lselama ini aku cari! Silakan ikut

aku.

entries.original:
"[blue]Thank you for coming with me.

\.

What’s that?

It’s not like you really had a
choice?

Such nonsense.

I don’t know what you’re talking
about.

Let’s get down to business."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Thank you for coming with me. [game-token-2] What’s that? It’s not like you really had a choice? Such nonsense. I don’t know what you’re talking about. Let’s get down to business.
entries.translated:
[blue]Terima kasih telah datang
bersamaku. \. Apa itu? Bukannya kamu\lbenar-benar punya pilihan? Omong

kosong. Aku tidak tahu apa yang
kamu bicarakan. Ayo kita mulai.

entries.original:
"[red]Recently pieces of a Pokémon known
as Zygarde have been appearing all\lover Borrius.

However, these pieces can only be
seen if you have a Super Cube with\la special feature installed."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Recently pieces of a Pokémon known as Zygarde have been appearing all over Borrius. However, these pieces can only be seen if you have a Super Cube with a special feature installed.
entries.translated:
[red]Belakangan ini, bagian-bagian dari
Pokémon yang dikenal sebagai\lZygarde telah muncul di seluruh

Borrius. Namun, bagian-bagian ini
hanya dapat dilihat jika kamu\lmemiliki Super Cube dengan fitur

khusus yang terpasang.

entries.original:
"[blue]Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos
that appears when the ecosystem is\lin danger.

Why it’s appearing here, and now,
is a mystery to us.

We’re trying to find the answer to
this, but we need someone to go\land collect all of the individual\l\qocells\qc and \qocores\qc of Zygarde."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos that appears when the ecosystem is in danger. Why it’s appearing here, and now, is a mystery to us. We’re trying to find the answer to this, but we need someone to go and collect all of the individual [quote-open-2]cells[quote-close-3] and [quote-open-4]cores[quote-close-5] of Zygarde.
entries.translated:
[blue]Zygarde adalah Pokémon dari Kalos
yang muncul saat ekosistem dalam\lbahaya. Mengapa ia muncul di sini,

dan sekarang, adalah misteri bagi
kami. Kami sedang mencoba mencari\ljawabannya, tetapi kami membutuhkan

seseorang untuk pergi dan
mengumpulkan semua \qosel\qc dan \qointi\qc\lZygarde.

entries.original:
"[red]Do you think you’d be able to help
us with our research?

We need an experienced trainer who
plans on travelling around Borrius."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Do you think you’d be able to help us with our research? We need an experienced trainer who plans on travelling around Borrius.
entries.translated:
[red]Apakah Anda pikir Anda bisa
membantu kami dalam penelitian\lkami? Kami membutuhkan seorang

Pelatih berpengalaman yang
berencana bepergian keliling\lBorrius.

entries.original:
"[red]Are you sure about that?

Your help would be invaluable to
us."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Are you sure about that? Your help would be invaluable to us.
entries.translated:
[red]Apakah Anda yakin? Bantuan Anda
akan sangat berharga bagi kami.

entries.original:
"[blue]Great!

Thank you for agreeing to help!

If you could please give me your
Cube for a sec...

\.

Okay!

Your Cube has been updated to allow
you to see and collect Zygarde\lCells.

The cells can be found scattered
around both West and East Borrius.

Once you’ve collected at least 10
percent, please come see me.

But for now, good luck!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Great! Thank you for agreeing to help! If you could please give me your Cube for a sec... [game-token-2] Okay! Your Cube has been updated to allow you to see and collect Zygarde Cells. The cells can be found scattered around both West and East Borrius. Once you’ve collected at least 10 percent, please come see me. But for now, good luck!
entries.translated:
[blue]Bagus! Terima kasih telah setuju
membantu! Kalau bisa, tolong\lberikan Kubus Anda sebentar... \.

Oke! Kubus Anda telah diperbarui
untuk memungkinkan Anda melihat dan\lmengumpulkan Sel Zygarde. Sel-sel

tersebut dapat ditemukan tersebar
di sekitar Borrius Barat dan Timur.\lSetelah Anda mengumpulkan

setidaknya 10 persen, silakan temui
saya. Tapi untuk sekarang, semoga\lberhasil!

entries.original:
"Back in the day, my husband
travelled the world in search of\lrare Pokémon.

If you have the Pokémon he’s
looking for, would you please trade\lwith him?"
entries.translation_source: Back in the day, my husband travelled the world in search of rare Pokémon. If you have the Pokémon he’s looking for, would you please trade with him?
entries.translated:
Dahulu kala, suamiku berkeliling
dunia mencari Pokémon langka. Jika\lkamu memiliki Pokémon yang dia

cari, maukah kamu berdagang
dengannya?

entries.original:
"Mel is always surrounding himself
with many different women.

He must feel always be feeling
really lonely\."
entries.translation_source: Mel is always surrounding himself with many different women. He must feel always be feeling really lonely[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mel selalu mengelilingi dirinya
dengan banyak wanita berbeda. Dia\lpasti merasa sangat kesepian\.

entries.original:
"Hmm...

There have been numerous reports of
cells being spotted, lately...

What could this mean..."
entries.translation_source: Hmm... There have been numerous reports of cells being spotted, lately... What could this mean...
entries.translated:
Hmm... Akhir-akhir ini ada banyak
laporan tentang sel yang\lterlihat... Apa artinya ini...

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
10 percent of cells, please report\lback to my husband."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least 10 percent of cells, please report back to my husband.
entries.translated:
Ketika Anda telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya 10 persen sel, silakan\llaporkan kembali kepada suami saya.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least 10 percent of the cells.

Good work!

If you haven’t already, please talk
to my husband."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least 10 percent of the cells. Good work! If you haven’t already, please talk to my husband.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Anda telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya 10 persen sel. Kerja\lbagus! Jika belum, silakan bicara

dengan suami saya.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least 50 percent of the cells.

You’re half way there!

If you haven’t already, please talk
to my husband."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least 50 percent of the cells. You’re half way there! If you haven’t already, please talk to my husband.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Anda telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya 50 persen sel. Anda\lsudah setengah jalan! Jika belum,

silakan bicara dengan suami saya.

entries.original:
"You’ve collected all of the cells!

This is a major help to our
research!

Thank you so much!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve collected all of the cells! This is a major help to our research! Thank you so much!
entries.translated:
Anda telah mengumpulkan semua sel!
Ini sangat membantu penelitian\lkami! Terima kasih banyak!

entries.original:
"A trainer!

Thank you so much for coming to my
home!

My wife and I have something very
important that we need taken care\lof."
entries.translation_source: A trainer! Thank you so much for coming to my home! My wife and I have something very important that we need taken care of.
entries.translated:
Seorang Pelatih! Terima kasih
banyak telah datang ke rumahku!\lSaya dan istri saya memiliki

sesuatu yang sangat penting yang
perlu diurus.

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
10 percent of cells, please report\lback to me."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least 10 percent of cells, please report back to me.
entries.translated:
Ketika Anda telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya 10 persen sel, silakan\llaporkan kembali kepada saya.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least 10 percent of the cells.

I can’t do much for you right now,
but I can quickly assemble these\lcells into a temporary Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least 10 percent of the cells. I can’t do much for you right now, but I can quickly assemble these cells into a temporary Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Anda telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya 10 persen sel. Saya\ltidak bisa berbuat banyak untuk

Anda sekarang, tapi saya bisa
dengan cepat merakit sel-sel ini\lmenjadi Pokémon sementara.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like you have any
space in your party for this\lPokémon.

Come back when you’ve made more
space."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like you have any space in your party for this Pokémon. Come back when you’ve made more space.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Anda tidak memiliki
ruang di tim Anda untuk Pokémon\lini. Kembalilah setelah Anda

membuat lebih banyak ruang.

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
50 percent of cells, please report\lback to me."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least 50 percent of cells, please report back to me.
entries.translated:
Ketika Anda telah mengumpulkan
setidaknya 50 persen sel, silakan\llaporkan kembali kepada saya.

entries.original:
"Please be aware that this Zygarde
is only a temporary construct, and\lany stat changes will be lost when\lit is disassembled."
entries.translation_source: Please be aware that this Zygarde is only a temporary construct, and any stat changes will be lost when it is disassembled.
entries.translated:
Harap diperhatikan bahwa Zygarde
ini hanyalah konstruksi sementara,\ldan perubahan stat apa pun akan

hilang saat dibongkar.

entries.original:
"[player] received a Zygarde from the
scientist!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received a Zygarde from the scientist!
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Zygarde dari
ilmuwan!

entries.original:
"He traded me his [green]Magmar[blue] holding a
[green]Magmarizer[blue], and it evolved!"
entries.translation_source: He traded me his [color-green-1]Magmar[color-blue-2] holding a [color-green-3]Magmarizer[color-blue-4], and it evolved!
entries.translated:
Dia menukariku [green]Magmar[blue] yang membawa
[green]Magmarizer[blue], dan ia berevolusi!

entries.original:
"Oh\.

My whole body aches\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] My whole body aches[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Seluruh tubuhku sakit\.

entries.original:
"I have had this Pokémon Egg for a
while, but I think it’s finally\lclose to hatching.

Which Pokémon could it be?"
entries.translation_source: I have had this Pokémon Egg for a while, but I think it’s finally close to hatching. Which Pokémon could it be?
entries.translated:
Aku sudah memiliki Telur Pokémon
ini untuk beberapa waktu, tapi aku\lpikir telur ini akhirnya hampir

menetas. Pokémon apa yang mungkin
ada di dalamnya?

entries.original:
"Log’s words echoed in your head:
[blue]Go make sure [rival] is okay!"
entries.translation_source: Log’s words echoed in your head: [color-blue-1]Go make sure [text-token-rival-2] is okay!
entries.translated:
Kata-kata Log bergema di kepalamu:
[blue]Pergi pastikan [rival] baik-baik\lsaja!

entries.original: "I’m going to catch even more cuties!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to catch even more cuties!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menangkap lebih banyak
Pokémon lucu!

entries.original: "I lost because of the cold."
entries.translation_source: I lost because of the cold.
entries.translated: Aku kalah karena kedinginan.

entries.original:
"Greetings, [player].

I am a researcher studying seasonal
form changes of Pokémon.

Since the seasons don’t change in
Borrius, I’m very interested in\llearning how certain Pokémon\lchange form in this region.

Would you like to help me with my
research?"
entries.translation_source: Greetings, [player-name-1]. I am a researcher studying seasonal form changes of Pokémon. Since the seasons don’t change in Borrius, I’m very interested in learning how certain Pokémon change form in this region. Would you like to help me with my research?
entries.translated:
Salam, [player]. Aku adalah seorang
peneliti yang mempelajari perubahan\lbentuk musiman Pokémon. Karena

musim tidak berubah di Borrius, aku
sangat tertarik untuk mempelajari\lbagaimana Pokémon tertentu berubah

bentuk di wilayah ini. Apakah kamu
ingin membantu penelitianku?

entries.original:
"Splendid!

I’m currently researching the
Pokémon known as [green][buffer1][blue].

To start off the research, I’d like
to study a [green][buffer1][blue] in [green][buffer2][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Splendid! I’m currently researching the Pokémon known as [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. To start off the research, I’d like to study a [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] in [color-green-7][buffer2-8][color-blue-9] form.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Aku saat ini sedang
meneliti Pokémon yang dikenal\lsebagai [green][buffer1][blue]. Untuk memulai

penelitian, aku ingin mempelajari
[green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"No?

If you change your mind, your help
would still be invaluable."
entries.translation_source: No? If you change your mind, your help would still be invaluable.
entries.translated:
Tidak? Jika kamu berubah pikiran,
bantuanmu akan tetap sangat\lberharga.

entries.original:
"Have you brought me a [green][buffer1][blue] in
[green][buffer2][blue] form to study?

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Have you brought me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] form to study? *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu telah membawakanku
[green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue]\luntuk dipelajari? *Mengendus*

*Mengendus*

entries.original:
"Ah, it doesn’t appear you have
brought one.

I’d like to see a [green][buffer1][blue] in
[green][buffer2][blue] form, please."
entries.translation_source: Ah, it doesn’t appear you have brought one. I’d like to see a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] form, please.
entries.translated:
Ah, sepertinya kamu belum
membawanya. Aku ingin melihat\l[green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue],

tolong.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, you have.

Please wait a moment while I study
it."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, you have. Please wait a moment while I study it.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya, kamu membawanya. Tolong
tunggu sebentar sementara aku\lmempelajarinya.

entries.original:
"Interesting\.

I’ve added invaluable data to my
research.

Next, I’d like to see a [green][buffer1][blue]
in [green][buffer3][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Interesting[game-token-1] I’ve added invaluable data to my research. Next, I’d like to see a [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] in [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] form.
entries.translated:
Menarik\. Aku telah menambahkan data
yang tak ternilai untuk\lpenelitianku. Selanjutnya, aku

ingin melihat [green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk
[green][buffer3][blue].

entries.original:
"I’ve done it!
I’ve completed the study!

Several key observations have led
me to the conclusion that although\lthere are no seasonal changes in\lBorrius, different forms of\lseasonal Pokémon appear in\ldifferent locations around Borrius.

Your help has been invaluable in
coming to this conclusion!

If you don’t already have this,
please, take this TM!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve done it! I’ve completed the study! Several key observations have led me to the conclusion that although there are no seasonal changes in Borrius, different forms of seasonal Pokémon appear in different locations around Borrius. Your help has been invaluable in coming to this conclusion! If you don’t already have this, please, take this TM!
entries.translated:
Aku berhasil! Aku telah
menyelesaikan penelitian! Beberapa\lpengamatan kunci telah membawaku

pada kesimpulan bahwa meskipun
tidak ada perubahan musim di\lBorrius, bentuk-bentuk berbeda dari

Pokémon musiman muncul di lokasi
yang berbeda di sekitar Borrius.\lBantuanmu sangat berharga dalam

mencapai kesimpulan ini! Jika kamu
belum memiliki ini, silakan, ambil\lTM ini!

entries.original:
"I passed on my findings to the
National Science Society and was\lregarded with the highest of\lhonours.

I have you to thank you for this.
I will always remember your work."
entries.translation_source: I passed on my findings to the National Science Society and was regarded with the highest of honours. I have you to thank you for this. I will always remember your work.
entries.translated:
Aku menyampaikan temuan-temuanku ke
National Science Society dan\ldihormati dengan penghargaan

tertinggi. Aku berterima kasih
padamu untuk ini. Aku akan selalu\lmengingat karyamu.

entries.original: "Spring"
entries.translation_source: Spring

entries.original: "Autumn"
entries.translation_source: Autumn

entries.original:
"Battle me.

Show me you too, can be as furious
as the sea."
entries.translation_source: Battle me. Show me you too, can be as furious as the sea.
entries.translated:
Bertarunglah denganku. Tunjukkan
padaku bahwa kamu juga bisa menjadi\lseganas lautan.

entries.original:
"The [green]Muscle Band[blue] can increase your
Pokémon’s physical fury."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Muscle Band[color-blue-2] can increase your Pokémon’s physical fury.
entries.translated:
[green]Muscle Band[blue] dapat meningkatkan
keganasan fisik Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"As you witnessed, I sucessfully
captured that Pokémon by throwing\la [green]Poké Ball[blue].

However, this won’t always work.

Many times, Pokémon must be
weakened, before you’ll be able to\lcapture them."
entries.translation_source: As you witnessed, I sucessfully captured that Pokémon by throwing a [color-green-1]Poké Ball[color-blue-2]. However, this won’t always work. Many times, Pokémon must be weakened, before you’ll be able to capture them.
entries.translated:
Seperti yang kamu saksikan, aku
berhasil menangkap Pokémon itu\ldengan melempar [green]Poké Ball[blue]. Namun,

ini tidak selalu berhasil.
Seringkali, Pokémon harus\ldilemahkan, sebelum kamu bisa

menangkapnya.

entries.original: "[red]Hiyah!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Hiyah!
entries.translated: [red]Hiyah!

entries.original:
"If you would ever like to see my
skills again, please, stop by."
entries.translation_source: If you would ever like to see my skills again, please, stop by.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin melihat kemampuanku
lagi, silakan mampir.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]It’s time for you to burn!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]It’s time for you to burn!
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Saatnya kamu terbakar!

entries.original:
"If you ever would like to see me in
action, please, stop by."
entries.translation_source: If you ever would like to see me in action, please, stop by.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin melihatku beraksi,
silakan mampir.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]I’ve just received new
orders from Zeph.

We need to tighten security on
Route 9.

[player] escaped from him through a
portal back in Cinder Volcano.

Zeph is worried about this
happening again and disrupting the\lmission.

I’m going to find a suitable place
to set up a psychic barrier around\lthe route, but I need you three to\lstand guard at the gate."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]I’ve just received new orders from Zeph. We need to tighten security on Route 9. [player-name-2] escaped from him through a portal back in Cinder Volcano. Zeph is worried about this happening again and disrupting the mission. I’m going to find a suitable place to set up a psychic barrier around the route, but I need you three to stand guard at the gate.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Saya baru saja menerima
perintah baru dari Zeph. Kita perlu\lmemperketat keamanan di Route 9.

[player] melarikan diri darinya
melalui portal di Cinder Volcano.\lZeph khawatir hal ini akan terjadi

lagi dan mengganggu misi. Saya akan
mencari tempat yang cocok untuk\lmemasang penghalang psikis di

sekitar rute itu, tetapi aku perlu
kalian bertiga berjaga di gerbang.

entries.original: "Grunts: [blue]Yes, ma’am!"
entries.translation_source: Grunts: [color-blue-1]Yes, ma’am!
entries.translated: Grunts: [blue]Ya, Bu!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Hmm\.

In order to set up a strong
barrier, I should head to the peak\lof Frost Mountain\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Hmm[game-token-2] In order to set up a strong barrier, I should head to the peak of Frost Mountain[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Hmm\. Untuk memasang
penghalang yang kuat, aku harus\lmenuju ke puncak Frost Mountain\.

entries.original: "Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Antisis City
entries.translated: Antisis City

entries.original:
"The Black Emboar won’t fall so
easily!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar won’t fall so easily!
entries.translated:
The Black Emboar tidak akan jatuh
semudah itu!

entries.original:
"The Black Emboar!
Never stop, and never look back!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar! Never stop, and never look back!
entries.translated:
The Black Emboar! Jangan pernah
berhenti, dan jangan pernah menoleh\lke belakang!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his head
somewhere."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head somewhere.
entries.translated:
Mel, Pemimpin Gym, sedang tidak ada
di sini sekarang. Dia mungkin pergi\luntuk menjernihkan pikirannya di

suatu tempat.

entries.original: "Tarmigan Town"
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town
entries.translated: Tarmigan Town

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town

The town located on the
Thundercap Highland."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town The town located on the Thundercap Highland.
entries.translated:
Tarmigan Town adalah kota yang
terletak di Dataran Tinggi\lThundercap.

entries.original:
"Here at the Dream Research Lab,
we study the dreams of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Here at the Dream Research Lab, we study the dreams of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Di sini, di Dream Research Lab,
kami mempelajari mimpi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"In the Unova Region, a scientist
named Fennel created a device that\lallowed people to visually see the\ldreams of Pokémon.

It allowed you to go to the
Pokémon’s \qoDream World\qo and\linteract with them.

We’re trying to create a device
just like it and pass it off as our\lown invention, so don’t tell\lanybody."
entries.translation_source: In the Unova Region, a scientist named Fennel created a device that allowed people to visually see the dreams of Pokémon. It allowed you to go to the Pokémon’s [quote-open-1]Dream World[quote-open-2] and interact with them. We’re trying to create a device just like it and pass it off as our own invention, so don’t tell anybody.
entries.translated:
Di Region Unova, seorang ilmuwan
bernama Fennel menciptakan alat\lyang memungkinkan orang melihat

secara visual mimpi Pokémon. Alat
itu memungkinkanmu pergi ke \qoDunia\lMimpi\qo Pokémon dan berinteraksi

dengan mereka. Kami mencoba
menciptakan alat yang persis\lseperti itu dan mengakuinya sebagai

penemuan kami sendiri, jadi jangan
beri tahu siapa pun.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon, Darkrai, has the
unique ability to damage Pokémon\lwhile they are asleep.

My goal is to find out the reason
why it can just enter a Pokémon’s\ldream without using an attack."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon, Darkrai, has the unique ability to damage Pokémon while they are asleep. My goal is to find out the reason why it can just enter a Pokémon’s dream without using an attack.
entries.translated:
Pokémon, Darkrai, memiliki
kemampuan unik untuk merusak\lPokémon saat mereka tidur. Tujuanku

adalah mencari tahu alasan mengapa
ia bisa memasuki mimpi Pokémon\ltanpa menggunakan serangan.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon walking around this
lab all assist in the research.

They’re all special Pokémon known
for eating dreams."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon walking around this lab all assist in the research. They’re all special Pokémon known for eating dreams.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang berjalan-jalan di
sekitar lab ini semuanya membantu\ldalam penelitian. Mereka semua

adalah Pokémon istimewa yang
dikenal karena memakan mimpi.

entries.original: "Gar!"
entries.translation_source: Gar!
entries.translated: Gar!

entries.original: "Hyyyyyyyyypno..."
entries.translation_source: Hyyyyyyyyypno...
entries.translated: Hyyyyyyyyypno...

entries.original: "Sharna!"
entries.translation_source: Sharna!
entries.translated: Sharna!

entries.original: "Na!"
entries.translation_source: Na!
entries.translated: Na!

entries.original:
"I work at the facility over here
called the Dream Research Lab.

We do exactly as it sounds, we
research dreams.

But my work isn’t going so well, so
I’m taking a breather."
entries.translation_source: I work at the facility over here called the Dream Research Lab. We do exactly as it sounds, we research dreams. But my work isn’t going so well, so I’m taking a breather.
entries.translated:
Saya bekerja di fasilitas di sini
yang disebut Dream Research Lab.\lKami melakukan persis seperti

namanya, kami meneliti mimpi. Tapi
pekerjaanku tidak berjalan dengan\lbaik, jadi aku sedang istirahat.

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is so seculuded in
the mountains, it doesn’t have its\lown entrance to the [green]SES Expressway[red]!

If you wanna go down the mountain,
you’ll have to walk."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is so seculuded in the mountains, it doesn’t have its own entrance to the [color-green-1]SES Expressway[color-red-2]! If you wanna go down the mountain, you’ll have to walk.
entries.translated:
Tarmigan Town sangat terpencil di
pegunungan, sehingga tidak memiliki\lpintu masuk sendiri ke [green]SES

Expressway[red]! Jika kamu ingin turun
dari gunung, kamu harus berjalan\lkaki.

entries.original:
"I prefer swimming in a calm lake
much more than in the sea."
entries.translation_source: I prefer swimming in a calm lake much more than in the sea.
entries.translated:
Saya lebih suka berenang di danau
yang tenang daripada di laut.

entries.original: "Maybe I should start wearing pants."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should start wearing pants.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku harus mulai memakai
celana.

entries.original: "Next time I will crush you!"
entries.translation_source: Next time I will crush you!
entries.translated: Lain kali aku akan menghancurkanmu!

entries.original:
"I heard from a friend that under
[green]Tehl Town[red], that tiny town to the\lwest of here, is a secret\lunderground passage to [green]Route 9[red].

But there can’t actually be\.
Come on! Who’d believe that?"
entries.translation_source: I heard from a friend that under [color-green-1]Tehl Town[color-red-2], that tiny town to the west of here, is a secret underground passage to [color-green-3]Route 9[color-red-4]. But there can’t actually be[game-token-5] Come on! Who’d believe that?
entries.translated:
Aku dengar dari seorang teman bahwa
di bawah [green]Tehl Town[red], kota kecil di\lsebelah barat sini, ada lorong

bawah tanah rahasia menuju [green]Route 9[red].
Tapi ternyata tidak mungkin ada\.\lAyolah! Siapa yang percaya?

entries.original:
"Young trainer.

I have been carrying around this
Egg with me ever since it was laid.

However, I am willing to give it to
a healthy young person.

Would you like to raise the [green]Egg[red],
for me?"
entries.translation_source: Young trainer. I have been carrying around this Egg with me ever since it was laid. However, I am willing to give it to a healthy young person. Would you like to raise the [color-green-1]Egg[color-red-2], for me?
entries.translated:
Pelatih muda. Aku telah membawa
Telur ini sejak ditetaskan. Namun,\laku bersedia memberikannya kepada

orang muda yang sehat. Maukah kamu
merawat [green]Telur[red] untukku?

entries.original:
"Here.
Please take good care of it.

It is a very special Egg."
entries.translation_source: Here. Please take good care of it. It is a very special Egg.
entries.translated:
Ini. Tolong rawat dengan baik. Ini
adalah Telur yang sangat istimewa.

entries.original:
"The [green]Inverse Trainer House[blue] is
famous.

Many people come to Fallshore
City just to battle there."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Inverse Trainer House[color-blue-2] is famous. Many people come to Fallshore City just to battle there.
entries.translated:
[green]Rumah Pelatih Inverse[blue] terkenal.
Banyak orang datang ke Fallshore\lCity hanya untuk bertarung di sana.

entries.original:
"Hi! Welcome to the Inverse Battle
House!

Feel free to battle any of the
trainers here as many times as you\lwant.

If you need an explanation
of Inverse Battles, please come\ltalk to me.

Enjoy battling!"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Welcome to the Inverse Battle House! Feel free to battle any of the trainers here as many times as you want. If you need an explanation of Inverse Battles, please come talk to me. Enjoy battling!
entries.translated:
Hai! Selamat datang di Inverse
Battle House! Silakan bertarung\ldengan pelatih mana pun di sini

sebanyak yang kamu mau. Jika kamu
butuh penjelasan tentang Inverse\lBattle, silakan bicara denganku.

Nikmati pertarungannya!

entries.original:
"An inverse battle works similar to
a normal battle.

The only difference is with
weaknesses and resistances.

In an inverse battle, they swap
places.

So a water type becomes weak to
fire, but it resists grass."
entries.translation_source: An inverse battle works similar to a normal battle. The only difference is with weaknesses and resistances. In an inverse battle, they swap places. So a water type becomes weak to fire, but it resists grass.
entries.translated:
Inverse battle bekerja mirip dengan
pertarungan normal. Satu-satunya\lperbedaan adalah pada kelemahan dan

ketahanan. Dalam inverse battle,
mereka bertukar posisi. Jadi tipe\lAir menjadi lemah terhadap Api,

tetapi tahan terhadap Rumput.

entries.original:
"Mel’s gym is a complicated maze of
ponds, lily pads, and waterfalls.

It’d probably be a breeze to get
through if you had a Pokémon that\lknew Surf and Waterfall.

But I’m pretty sure you can’t surf
until you have the [green]Zap Badge[blue].

And that badge comes after the Fall
Badge\."
entries.translation_source: Mel’s gym is a complicated maze of ponds, lily pads, and waterfalls. It’d probably be a breeze to get through if you had a Pokémon that knew Surf and Waterfall. But I’m pretty sure you can’t surf until you have the [color-green-1]Zap Badge[color-blue-2]. And that badge comes after the Fall Badge[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Gym Mel adalah labirin rumit dari
kolam, daun teratai, dan air\lterjun. Mungkin akan mudah dilewati

jika kamu punya Pokémon yang tahu
Surf dan Waterfall. Tapi aku yakin\lkamu tidak bisa berselancar sampai

kamu memiliki [green]Zap Badge[blue]. Dan
lencana itu datang setelah Fall\lBadge\.

entries.original: "[player] received an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received an Egg!
entries.translated: [player] menerima sebuah Telur!

entries.original:
"It seems you do not have anymore
space in your party.

I recommend depositing a Pokémon
in the PC."
entries.translation_source: It seems you do not have anymore space in your party. I recommend depositing a Pokémon in the PC.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak memiliki
ruang lagi di party-mu. Aku\lsarankan menitipkan Pokémon di PC.

entries.original: "Oh, okay, I understand."
entries.translation_source: Oh, okay, I understand.
entries.translated: Oh, baiklah, aku mengerti.

entries.original:
"The Egg belongs to a special
Pokémon.

Many people consider it a Fairy."
entries.translation_source: The Egg belongs to a special Pokémon. Many people consider it a Fairy.
entries.translated:
Telur itu milik Pokémon istimewa.
Banyak orang menganggapnya sebagai\lPeri.

entries.original:
"It’s none of my business, but Mel
just got out of a relationship with\lBlizzard City’s Gym Leader.

I hope he’s doing okay\.

I think they actually loved each
other.

For real, though!
Like not some fake love\."
entries.translation_source: It’s none of my business, but Mel just got out of a relationship with Blizzard City’s Gym Leader. I hope he’s doing okay[game-token-1] I think they actually loved each other. For real, though! Like not some fake love[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ini bukan urusanku, tapi Mel baru
saja putus hubungan dengan Pemimpin\lGym Blizzard City. Aku harap dia

baik-baik saja\. Aku pikir mereka
benar-benar saling mencintai.\lSungguh! Bukan cinta palsu\.

entries.original:
"Something grotesque is being
synthesized in the tube."
entries.translation_source: Something grotesque is being synthesized in the tube.
entries.translated:
Sesuatu yang mengerikan sedang
disintesis di dalam tabung.

entries.original: "The tube is empty."
entries.translation_source: The tube is empty.
entries.translated: Tabungnya kosong.

entries.original:
"No one from Tehl Town is allowed to
leave this way, right now.

Scram, kid!"
entries.translation_source: No one from Tehl Town is allowed to leave this way, right now. Scram, kid!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada seorang pun dari Tehl
Town yang diizinkan keluar lewat\lsini, sekarang juga. Pergi, nak!

entries.original:
"Brr\.I’m starting to get chilly.
I could use a win to get warmed up."
entries.translation_source: Brr[game-token-1]I’m starting to get chilly. I could use a win to get warmed up.

entries.original:
"My mother has horrible seperation
anxiety.

So much so, that when I moved away,
she forced me to install and path\lbetween our houses."
entries.translation_source: My mother has horrible seperation anxiety. So much so, that when I moved away, she forced me to install and path between our houses.
entries.translated:
Ibuku memiliki kecemasan perpisahan
yang parah. Sedemikian parahnya,\lsehingga ketika aku pindah, dia

memaksaku untuk memasang jalan
setapak di antara rumah kami.

entries.original:
"My wife’s mother is a nut job!

Don’t tell her I said that."
entries.translation_source: My wife’s mother is a nut job! Don’t tell her I said that.
entries.translated:
Ibu dari istriku itu gila! Jangan
bilang dia aku bilang begitu.

entries.original:
"I love my daughter very much and I
can’t stand not seeing her for even\la single day."
entries.translation_source: I love my daughter very much and I can’t stand not seeing her for even a single day.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat mencintai putriku dan
aku tidak tahan tidak melihatnya\lmeski hanya sehari.

entries.original:
"You’d think they would have left
you a sign or something\."
entries.translation_source: You’d think they would have left you a sign or something[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir mereka akan meninggalkan
tanda atau sesuatu\.

entries.original: "Cafeteria"
entries.translation_source: Cafeteria
entries.translated: Kafetaria

entries.original:
"Ahh\.
Camping out in the leaves is great!"
entries.translation_source: Ahh[game-token-1] Camping out in the leaves is great!
entries.translated: Ahh\. Berkemah di dedaunan itu hebat!

entries.original:
"This whole area has a nice Autumn
feel."
entries.translation_source: This whole area has a nice Autumn feel.
entries.translated:
Seluruh area ini memiliki nuansa
Musim Gugur yang indah.

entries.original:
"When those weird people showed up,
I wasn’t able to run anymore."
entries.translation_source: When those weird people showed up, I wasn’t able to run anymore.

entries.original: "Looks like I couldn’t outrun you!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like I couldn’t outrun you!

entries.original:
"It’s so freeing being able to run
again!  "
entries.translation_source: It’s so freeing being able to run again!
entries.translated:
Sungguh membebaskan bisa berlari
lagi!

entries.original:
"I heard there are lots of hidden
items in the [green]Underground Pass[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: I heard there are lots of hidden items in the [color-green-1]Underground Pass[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Kudengar ada banyak item
tersembunyi di [green]Jalur Bawah Tanah[blue]!

entries.original: "Damn that Shadow Admin!"
entries.translation_source: Damn that Shadow Admin!
entries.translated: Sialan Admin Bayangan itu!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Oh, hey, [player].

So you got sent here too, huh?

\.

I see\."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Oh, hey, [player-name-2]. So you got sent here too, huh? [game-token-3] I see[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Oh, hei, [player]. Jadi kamu
juga dikirim ke sini, ya? \. Begitu\.

entries.original:
"[blue]The real question is\.

How much time has passed since I
was sent here?

It feels like I arrived only
hours ago\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]The real question is[game-token-2] How much time has passed since I was sent here? It feels like I arrived only hours ago[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[blue]Pertanyaan sebenarnya adalah\. Berapa
banyak waktu yang telah berlalu\lsejak aku dikirim ke sini? Rasanya

aku baru tiba beberapa jam yang
lalu\.

entries.original:
"There are some Pokémon that can
only evolve during a trade.

But who really trades anymore,
y’know?

That fad died out years ago.

Now you can evolve those Pokémon
using a [green]Link Stone[blue]!

Here, you’ll see!"
entries.translation_source: There are some Pokémon that can only evolve during a trade. But who really trades anymore, y’know? That fad died out years ago. Now you can evolve those Pokémon using a [color-green-1]Link Stone[color-blue-2]! Here, you’ll see!
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Pokémon yang hanya
bisa berevolusi saat perdagangan.\lTapi siapa yang masih berdagang,

tahu? Tren itu sudah punah
bertahun-tahun lalu. Sekarang kamu\lbisa mengevolusi Pokémon itu

menggunakan [green]Link Stone[blue]! Ini, kamu
akan lihat!

entries.original:
"Route 6

\au Valley Cave
\ad Auburn Waterway\l\al Route 7, Frost Mountain\l\ar Route 14"
entries.translation_source: Route 6 [game-token-1] Valley Cave [game-token-2] Auburn Waterway [game-token-3] Route 7, Frost Mountain [game-token-4] Route 14
entries.translated:
Rute 6 \au Gua Lembah \ad Saluran Air
Auburn \al Rute 7, Gunung Beku \ar Rute\l14

entries.original:
"Why are we after Zapdos?

\.

Beats me."
entries.translation_source: Why are we after Zapdos? [game-token-1] Beats me.
entries.translated:
Kenapa kita mengejar Zapdos? \.
Entahlah.

entries.original:
"Blizzard City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Alice

Winning Trainers:
[rival]"
entries.translation_source: Blizzard City Pokémon Gym Leader: Alice Winning Trainers: [text-token-rival-1]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Kota Blizzard:
Alice Pelatih Pemenang: [rival]

entries.original:
"Blizzard City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Alice

Winning Trainers:
[rival], [player]"
entries.translation_source: Blizzard City Pokémon Gym Leader: Alice Winning Trainers: [text-token-rival-1], [player-name-2]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Kota Blizzard:
Alice Pelatih Pemenang: [rival],\l[player]

entries.original:
"If you hadn’t saved me, Staraptor,
I’d be swimming with the fishes\lright about now!

Argh\.

There has to be some way onto
Route 9\."
entries.translation_source: If you hadn’t saved me, Staraptor, I’d be swimming with the fishes right about now! Argh[game-token-1] There has to be some way onto Route 9[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Jika kamu tidak menyelamatkanku,
Staraptor, aku pasti sudah berenang\lbersama ikan sekarang! Argh\. Pasti

ada cara menuju Rute 9\.

entries.original: "Warp House"
entries.translation_source: Warp House
entries.translated: Rumah Warp

entries.original:
"My birds will get stronger from
here on out!"
entries.translation_source: My birds will get stronger from here on out!
entries.translated:
Burung-burungku akan semakin kuat
mulai sekarang!

entries.original:
"Trainer’s like us aren’t afraid of
heights like these!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer’s like us aren’t afraid of heights like these!
entries.translated:
Pelatih seperti kita tidak takut
ketinggian seperti ini!

entries.original:
"Wherever you decide to go, never be
afraid to charge full speed ahead!"
entries.translation_source: Wherever you decide to go, never be afraid to charge full speed ahead!
entries.translated:
Ke mana pun kamu memutuskan pergi,
jangan pernah takut untuk melaju\ldengan kecepatan penuh!

entries.original:
"This chill of the sea, and the
coldness of defeat\."
entries.translation_source: This chill of the sea, and the coldness of defeat[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"I trained under Alice in the
Blizzard City Gym.

Her Gym’s location is what inspired
me to become a Skier."
entries.translation_source: I trained under Alice in the Blizzard City Gym. Her Gym’s location is what inspired me to become a Skier.
entries.translated:
Aku berlatih di bawah Alice di Gym
Kota Blizzard. Lokasi Gymnya yang\lmenginspirasiku menjadi pemain ski.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]STOP!

You’re one of those Shadow tools
aren’t you?

entries.original:
"Thirty years ago, a large meteorite
was hurtling towards Borrius.

The astronomers in Seaport City
predicted that if it wasn’t\lstopped, it would fall directly on\lValley City, this city, and end all\llife living here.

With great haste, we began our
evacuation of the city.

As we were about to make our escape
through the SES Expressway, we\lheard the news.

The meteorite was now predicted to
crush half of the region!

If we attempted to flee
underground, there would be a\llarge chance we’d be buried alive.

Chaos ensued.

All was thought hopeless\.until
HE arrived.

[green]Aros[blue], the legend.

He arrived alongside Arceus
and used a small Pokémon to\lteleport everyone to East Borrius,\lsafe from harm.

He planned to attack the meteorite
head on and smash it to bits.

Once he had transported everyone to
safety, it is said that he rode on\la Rayquaza and smashed into\lthe meteorite!

It shattered, and most of the
smaller fragments fell on\lValley City.

The city was destroyed, but Aros
had saved a region.

I will never forget the heroic act
that man performed."
entries.translation_source: Thirty years ago, a large meteorite was hurtling towards Borrius. The astronomers in Seaport City predicted that if it wasn’t stopped, it would fall directly on Valley City, this city, and end all life living here. With great haste, we began our evacuation of the city. As we were about to make our escape through the SES Expressway, we heard the news. The meteorite was now predicted to crush half of the region! If we attempted to flee underground, there would be a large chance we’d be buried alive. Chaos ensued. All was thought hopeless[game-token-1]until HE arrived. [color-green-2]Aros[color-blue-3], the legend. He arrived alongside Arceus and used a small Pokémon to teleport everyone to East Borrius, safe from harm. He planned to attack the meteorite head on and smash it to bits. Once he had transported everyone to safety, it is said that he rode on a Rayquaza and smashed into the meteorite! It shattered, and most of the smaller fragments fell on Valley City. The city was destroyed, but Aros had saved a region. I will never forget the heroic act that man performed.

memindahkan semua orang ke tempat
aman, dikatakan bahwa dia menaiki\lRayquaza dan menabrak meteorit itu!

Meteorit itu pecah, dan sebagian
besar pecahan kecil jatuh di Valley\lCity. Kota itu hancur, tetapi Aros

telah menyelamatkan satu wilayah.
Aku tidak akan pernah melupakan\ltindakan heroik yang dilakukan pria

itu.

entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Splendid! In [color-green-2]Bellin Town[color-blue-3] at the [color-green-4]Poké Mart[color-blue-5], there is a package waiting for me. I need you to pick it up. I would get it myself, however, like I said previously, I am too old to travel. I have already informed the clerk that I was not going to get it myself, but he insisted that it must be picked up from [color-green-6]Bellin Town[color-blue-7]. It should not be too hard for you since you have your own Pokémon. Ho ho ho! If you need anything from me, I’ll be in my lab. It’s not that far, just down the road. But before you go anywhere, you should check in with your mother. She is likely very worried about you. Good luck, [player-name-8]. My studies depend on you.
entries.translated:
[blue]Luar biasa! Di [green]Bellin Town[blue] di [green]Poké
Mart[blue], ada paket yang menungguku.\lAku perlu kamu mengambilnya. Aku

akan mengambilnya sendiri, namun,
seperti yang kubilang sebelumnya,\laku terlalu tua untuk bepergian.

Aku sudah memberitahu pegawai toko
bahwa aku tidak akan mengambilnya\lsendiri, tetapi dia bersikeras

bahwa itu harus diambil dari [green]Bellin
Town[blue]. Itu seharusnya tidak terlalu\lsulit bagimu karena kamu memiliki

Pokémon milikmu sendiri. Ho ho ho!
Jika kamu membutuhkan sesuatu\ldariku, aku akan berada di

laboratoriumku. Tidak terlalu jauh,
hanya di ujung jalan. Tapi sebelum\lkamu pergi ke mana pun, kamu harus

menemui ibumu. Dia mungkin sangat
khawatir padamu. Semoga beruntung,\l[player]. Penelitianku bergantung

padamu.

entries.original:
"[blue]Lately, the citizens of Epidimy
Town have been complaining about\ltheir inability to visit Thundercap\lMountain.

Some strange guy is apparently
blocking the entrance and saying\lthat he’s there to keep you from\lentering.

I don’t know what’s going on, but
my head can’t handle these\lcomplaints anymore.

As this is likely your mess, meet
me in [green]Epidimy Town[blue] to help clean\lit up.

I don’t have all day, so take this
to get yourself there faster."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Lately, the citizens of Epidimy Town have been complaining about their inability to visit Thundercap Mountain. Some strange guy is apparently blocking the entrance and saying that he’s there to keep you from entering. I don’t know what’s going on, but my head can’t handle these complaints anymore. As this is likely your mess, meet me in [color-green-2]Epidimy Town[color-blue-3] to help clean it up. I don’t have all day, so take this to get yourself there faster.
entries.translated:
[blue]Akhir-akhir ini, warga Kota Epidimy
mengeluh karena tidak bisa\lmengunjungi Gunung Thundercap.

Seorang pria aneh tampaknya
menghalangi pintu masuk dan\lmengatakan bahwa dia ada di sana

untuk mencegahmu masuk. Aku tidak
tahu apa yang terjadi, tapi\lkepalaku sudah tidak tahan dengan

keluhan-keluhan ini. Karena ini
mungkin masalahmu, temui aku di\l[green]Kota Epidimy[blue] untuk membantu

membersihkannya. Aku tidak punya
banyak waktu, jadi ambil ini untuk\lsampai ke sana lebih cepat.

entries.original:
"[blue]Don’t keep me waiting too long,
[player].

I’d rather get this problem solved
sooner rather than later."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Don’t keep me waiting too long, [player-name-2]. I’d rather get this problem solved sooner rather than later.
entries.translated:
[blue]Jangan membuatku menunggu terlalu
lama, [player]. Aku lebih suka\lmasalah ini diselesaikan

secepatnya.

entries.original:
"Galavan likes to use both [green]Electric[blue]-
and [green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon.

Bringing a [green]Ground[blue]-type Pokémon is
a good way to wreck him.

[green]Fire[blue]- and [green]Fighting[blue]-types are also
good against his [green]Steel[blue]-types.

Be advised, however.

An electric current runs across
the battlefield.

This means that all [green]Electric[blue]-type
moves will be powered up.

A hit from one could be
devastating!

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Galavan likes to use both [color-green-1]Electric[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Steel[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon. Bringing a [color-green-5]Ground[color-blue-6]-type Pokémon is a good way to wreck him. [color-green-7]Fire[color-blue-8]- and [color-green-9]Fighting[color-blue-10]-types are also good against his [color-green-11]Steel[color-blue-12]-types. Be advised, however. An electric current runs across the battlefield. This means that all [color-green-13]Electric[color-blue-14]-type moves will be powered up. A hit from one could be devastating! Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Galavan suka menggunakan Pokémon
tipe [green]Listrik[blue] dan [green]Baja[blue]. Membawa\lPokémon tipe [green]Tanah[blue] adalah cara yang

bagus untuk mengalahkannya. Tipe
[green]Api[blue] dan [green]Petarung[blue] juga bagus melawan\ltipe [green]Baja[blue]-nya. Namun, perlu

diingat. Arus listrik mengalir di
medan pertempuran. Ini berarti\lsemua gerakan tipe [green]Listrik[blue] akan

diperkuat. Serangan darinya bisa
sangat menghancurkan! Semoga\lberhasil di luar sana!

entries.original:
"Well done!

Not only did you manage to overcome
the Electric Terrain, but you\lalso managed to fight through\lGalavan’s surprise sandstorm!

Take these two Gems as further
recognition of your accomplishment."
entries.translation_source: Well done! Not only did you manage to overcome the Electric Terrain, but you also managed to fight through Galavan’s surprise sandstorm! Take these two Gems as further recognition of your accomplishment.
entries.translated:
Bagus! Tidak hanya berhasil
mengatasi Medan Listrik, tetapi\ljuga berhasil bertarung melawan

badai pasir kejutan Galavan! Ambil
dua Permata ini sebagai pengakuan\llebih atas pencapaianmu.

entries.original:
"My Pokémon evolved from the energy
in this cave!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon evolved from the energy in this cave!
entries.translated:
Pokémonku berevolusi dari energi di
gua ini!

entries.original:
"Those Gems I can gave you can power
up [green]Electric[blue]- and [green]Steel[blue]-type moves,\lrespectively.

You can zap your opponent with one
Pokémon, then pummel with another!"
entries.translation_source: Those Gems I can gave you can power up [color-green-1]Electric[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Steel[color-blue-4]-type moves, respectively. You can zap your opponent with one Pokémon, then pummel with another!
entries.translated:
Permata yang kuberikan padamu dapat
memperkuat gerakan tipe [green]Listrik[blue] dan\l[green]Baja[blue]. Kamu bisa menyetrum lawan

dengan satu Pokémon, lalu memukul
dengan yang lain!

entries.original:
"Champ in the making!

Welcome to the crime-ridden slums
that is Antisis City!

Have some Fresh Water straight from
my tap."
entries.translation_source: Champ in the making! Welcome to the crime-ridden slums that is Antisis City! Have some Fresh Water straight from my tap.
entries.translated:
Calon Juara! Selamat datang di
daerah kumuh penuh kejahatan,\lAntisis City! Ambil Air Segar

langsung dari keranku.

entries.original:
"There are many watery routes that
you can swim in Borrius.

It puts the Hoenn region to shame!"
entries.translation_source: There are many watery routes that you can swim in Borrius. It puts the Hoenn region to shame!
entries.translated:
Ada banyak rute air yang bisa kamu
renangi di Borrius. Ini membuat\lwilayah Hoenn malu!

entries.original:
"My top speed went down when I got
trapped in that electric web!"
entries.translation_source: My top speed went down when I got trapped in that electric web!
entries.translated:
Kecepatan tertinggiku menurun saat
aku terjebak dalam jaring listrik\litu!

entries.original:
"The air in this mountain is
electrifying!

It’s nothing like Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: The air in this mountain is electrifying! It’s nothing like Antisis City.

entries.original:
"I’m clearly not electrified enough
to win\."
entries.translation_source: I’m clearly not electrified enough to win[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt.

\al Epidimy Town
\ar Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. [game-token-1] Epidimy Town [game-token-2] Antisis City
entries.translated:
Gunung Thundercap \al Kota Epidimy \ar
Antisis City

entries.original: "Have you seen the rare Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Have you seen the rare Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah melihat Pokémon
langka?

entries.original:
"Hmm, should I continue on?
Or should I go home?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm, should I continue on? Or should I go home?

entries.original:
"It’s times like these when I wonder
what the right decision is."
entries.translation_source: It’s times like these when I wonder what the right decision is.

entries.original:
"Big Mo is a lover of tough,
[green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon.

If you have a [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or
[green]Fairy[blue]-type, you’ll win no prob!

But before you can face Big Mo,
you’ll need to clear the Antisis\lGym [green]Ring Challenge[blue].

And for that, no [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-,
or [green]Fairy[blue] types are allowed.

But honestly, as long as you’re not
using a Pokémon weak to Fighting-\lmoves, it’ll be easy to clear.

Good luck in the ring!"
entries.translation_source: Big Mo is a lover of tough, [color-green-1]Fighting[color-blue-2]-type Pokémon. If you have a [color-green-3]Flying[color-blue-4]-, [color-green-5]Psychic[color-blue-6]-, or [color-green-7]Fairy[color-blue-8]-type, you’ll win no prob! But before you can face Big Mo, you’ll need to clear the Antisis Gym [color-green-9]Ring Challenge[color-blue-10]. And for that, no [color-green-11]Flying[color-blue-12]-, [color-green-13]Psychic[color-blue-14]-, or [color-green-15]Fairy[color-blue-16] types are allowed. But honestly, as long as you’re not using a Pokémon weak to Fighting- moves, it’ll be easy to clear. Good luck in the ring!
entries.translated:
Big Mo adalah pencinta Pokémon tipe
[green]Petarung[blue] yang tangguh. Jika kamu\lpunya tipe [green]Terbang[blue], [green]Psikis[blue], atau

[green]Peri[blue], kamu akan menang tanpa
masalah! Tapi sebelum menghadapi\lBig Mo, kamu harus menyelesaikan

[green]Tantangan Ring[blue] Gym Antisis. Dan
untuk itu, tidak ada tipe [green]Terbang[blue],\l[green]Psikis[blue], atau [green]Peri[blue] yang diizinkan.

Tapi sejujurnya, selama kamu tidak
menggunakan Pokémon yang lemah\lterhadap gerakan Petarung, akan

mudah untuk menyelesaikannya.
Semoga berhasil di ring!

entries.original:
"That guy, he just came out of
nowhere\."
entries.translation_source: That guy, he just came out of nowhere[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Orang itu, dia muncul begitu saja\.

entries.original:
"The item is sealed behind the
