elctric barrier."
entries.translation_source: The item is sealed behind the elctric barrier.
entries.translated:
Item tersebut tersegel di balik
penghalang listrik.

entries.original:
"It’s not smart to pick a fight with
The Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: It’s not smart to pick a fight with The Shadows!
entries.translated:
Tidak bijak untuk melawan The
Shadows!

entries.original:
"Doesn’t matter.
You will be consumed."
entries.translation_source: Doesn’t matter. You will be consumed.
entries.translated: Tidak masalah. Kamu akan dimakan.

entries.original:
"Give up.

Life is meaningless."
entries.translation_source: Give up. Life is meaningless.
entries.translated: Menyerahlah. Hidup tidak berarti.

entries.original: "Even you, will die."
entries.translation_source: Even you, will die.
entries.translated: Bahkan kamu, akan mati.

entries.original: "So, you want to see Ivory?"
entries.translation_source: So, you want to see Ivory?
entries.translated: Jadi, kamu ingin bertemu Ivory?

entries.original: "I’d better warn Ivory about you\."
entries.translation_source: I’d better warn Ivory about you[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya aku memperingatkan Ivory
tentangmu\.

entries.original: "I feel your wrath."
entries.translation_source: I feel your wrath.

entries.original:
"You’ll never defeat all of us!
We’re invincible!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll never defeat all of us! We’re invincible!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak akan pernah mengalahkan
kami semua! Kami tak terkalahkan!

entries.original:
"Uh-oh!
I see a kid!"
entries.translation_source: Uh-oh! I see a kid!

entries.original: "Lights out!"
entries.translation_source: Lights out!

entries.original:
"You won’t find Ivory by just
scurrying around!"
entries.translation_source: You won’t find Ivory by just scurrying around!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak akan menemukan Ivory
hanya dengan berlarian!

entries.original:
"I’m Ivory’s last line of defense!

You may have been able to break
onto the route, but you won’t be\lable to break through me!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Ivory’s last line of defense! You may have been able to break onto the route, but you won’t be able to break through me!
entries.translated:
Aku adalah garis pertahanan
terakhir Ivory! Kamu mungkin bisa\lmasuk ke rute ini, tapi kamu tidak

akan bisa melewati aku!

entries.original: "I’d better go warn Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: I’d better go warn Ivory!
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya aku pergi memperingatkan
Ivory!

entries.original:
"[red][player], I forgot to show you
something!

Please come with me to the
SES Expressway."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1][player-name-2], I forgot to show you something! Please come with me to the SES Expressway.
entries.translated:
[red][player], aku lupa menunjukkan
sesuatu padamu! Tolong ikut aku ke\lSES Expressway.

entries.original:
"Oh man, I haven’t seen anyone beat
Big Mo in a while, let alone clear\lthe Ring Challenge!

Well done!
You’ve proven your toughness!

Take this Gem to improve it even
further!"
entries.translation_source: Oh man, I haven’t seen anyone beat Big Mo in a while, let alone clear the Ring Challenge! Well done! You’ve proven your toughness! Take this Gem to improve it even further!
entries.translated:
Oh, aku sudah lama tidak melihat
siapa pun mengalahkan Big Mo,\lapalagi menyelesaikan Ring

Challenge! Bagus sekali! Kamu telah
membuktikan ketangguhanmu! Ambil\lPermata ini untuk meningkatkannya

lebih lanjut!

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single Fighting-type move in battle.

If you use it, you’ll seem tougher
than you already are!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single Fighting-type move in battle. If you use it, you’ll seem tougher than you already are!
entries.translated:
Permata yang kuberikan itu dapat
memperkuat satu jurus tipe Fighting\ldalam pertarungan. Jika kamu

menggunakannya, kamu akan terlihat
lebih tangguh dari sebelumnya!

entries.original:
"Maybe I should go back to
Antisis City.

I’m out of my depth in here."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should go back to Antisis City. I’m out of my depth in here.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku harus kembali ke
Antisis City. Aku tidak sanggup di\lsini.

entries.original:
"Your skill makes my rubber gear
seem useless.

Maybe I should invest in a more
expensive brand."
entries.translation_source: Your skill makes my rubber gear seem useless. Maybe I should invest in a more expensive brand.
entries.translated:
Keahlianmu membuat peralatan
karetku tampak tidak berguna.\lMungkin aku harus berinvestasi pada

merek yang lebih mahal.

entries.original:
"When I was your age, most of the
paths here didn’t exist.

I dug through the cave with my
trusty Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: When I was your age, most of the paths here didn’t exist. I dug through the cave with my trusty Pokémon.

entries.original:
"When I was your age, we respected
our elders.

We didn’t mercilessly beat them."
entries.translation_source: When I was your age, we respected our elders. We didn’t mercilessly beat them.

entries.original:
"Youngsters like you\.
No respect for their elders."
entries.translation_source: Youngsters like you[game-token-1] No respect for their elders.
entries.translated:
Anak muda sepertimu\. Tidak
menghormati orang yang lebih tua.

entries.original:
"Bellin Town

A quiet town nestled deep in the
mountains."
entries.translation_source: Bellin Town A quiet town nestled deep in the mountains.
entries.translated:
Bellin Town Kota yang tenang
tersembunyi di dalam pegunungan.

entries.original:
"Trainer House
Battle to your heart’s content!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer House Battle to your heart’s content!
entries.translated: Trainer House Bertarung sepuasnya!

entries.original:
"Did you know there is a special
Poké Ball that heals Pokémon?

When you capture a Pokémon, all
damage done to it is undone!

Here, try some!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know there is a special Poké Ball that heals Pokémon? When you capture a Pokémon, all damage done to it is undone! Here, try some!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu ada Poké Ball khusus
yang menyembuhkan Pokémon? Saat\lkamu menangkap Pokémon, semua

kerusakan yang diterimanya akan
dipulihkan! Ini, coba beberapa!

entries.original:
"Use them in good health!
Heh, heh, see what I did there?"
entries.translation_source: Use them in good health! Heh, heh, see what I did there?
entries.translated:
Gunakan dengan sehat! Heh, heh,
lihat apa yang kulakukan?

entries.original:
"That is Hoopa!
That is Hoopa!

You are the Guardian of Borrius!
Take the Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: That is Hoopa! That is Hoopa! You are the Guardian of Borrius! Take the Master Ball!
entries.translated:
Itu Hoopa! Itu Hoopa! Kamu adalah
Pelindung Borrius! Ambil Master\lBall!

entries.original:
"Then, I have no time for you.
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Then, I have no time for you. Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, aku tidak punya waktu
untukmu. Pergi! Pergi!

entries.original: "Let’s go, Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: Let’s go, Staraptor.
entries.translated: Ayo, Staraptor.

entries.original:
"Dresco Town

The archipelago of the Borrius
Region."
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town The archipelago of the Borrius Region.
entries.translated:
Dresco Town Kepulauan dari Wilayah
Borrius.

entries.original:
"Cinder Volcano
Passage"
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano Passage
entries.translated: Cinder Volcano Passage

entries.original:
"Crater Town Pokémon Gym
Leader: Vega\lThe Double Agent."
entries.translation_source: Crater Town Pokémon Gym Leader: Vega The Double Agent.
entries.translated:
Crater Town Pemimpin Gym Pokémon:
Vega Agen Ganda.

entries.original: "The door is locked."
entries.translation_source: The door is locked.
entries.translated: Pintu terkunci.

entries.original: "SES Expressway"
entries.translation_source: SES Expressway
entries.translated: SES Expressway

entries.original:
"That is not Hoopa!

I have no time for you!
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: That is not Hoopa! I have no time for you! Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Itu bukan Hoopa! Aku tidak punya
waktu untukmu! Hus! Hus!

entries.original:
"Guardian of Borrius!
It is pleasure being in your midst!"
entries.translation_source: Guardian of Borrius! It is pleasure being in your midst!
entries.translated:
Penjaga Borrius! Senang berada di
tengah-tengahmu!

entries.original:
"Blizzard City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Alice\lThe High Flying Ice Queen."
entries.translation_source: Blizzard City Pokémon Gym Leader: Alice The High Flying Ice Queen.
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Blizzard City:
Alice, Ratu Es yang Terbang Tinggi.

entries.original:
"Blizzard City
The chilly mountain city."
entries.translation_source: Blizzard City The chilly mountain city.
entries.translated:
Blizzard City, kota pegunungan yang
dingin.

entries.original:
"This lighthouse was once a beacon
of hope for tourists.

But ever since Antisis City was
turned into a crime-filled slum,\ltourists have stopped coming to\lthis port."
entries.translation_source: This lighthouse was once a beacon of hope for tourists. But ever since Antisis City was turned into a crime-filled slum, tourists have stopped coming to this port.
entries.translated:
Mercusuar ini dulunya adalah sumber
harapan bagi para turis. Namun\lsejak Antisis City berubah menjadi

kawasan kumuh penuh kejahatan, para
turis berhenti datang ke pelabuhan\lini.

entries.original:
"There are plenty of different
healing methods available to you\lin the mansion.

It’s honestly a little redundant\."
entries.translation_source: There are plenty of different healing methods available to you in the mansion. It’s honestly a little redundant[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ada banyak metode penyembuhan
berbeda yang tersedia untukmu di\lmansion. Sejujurnya, ini agak

berlebihan\.

entries.original:
"I’m responsible for gathering the
daily ingredients."
entries.translation_source: I’m responsible for gathering the daily ingredients.
entries.translated:
Aku bertanggung jawab mengumpulkan
bahan-bahan harian.

entries.original: "Which way will you choose to go?"
entries.translation_source: Which way will you choose to go?
entries.translated: Jalan mana yang akan kamu pilih?

entries.original:
"Hahhh!

I’ll smash you like I smash these
rocks: with my bare hands!"
entries.translation_source: Hahhh! I’ll smash you like I smash these rocks: with my bare hands!

entries.original:
"It looks like I was the one
smashed today\."
entries.translation_source: It looks like I was the one smashed today[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Hahhh!
I have no need for HM slaves!

I will keep smashing rocks with
my bare hands!"
entries.translation_source: Hahhh! I have no need for HM slaves! I will keep smashing rocks with my bare hands!
entries.translated:
Hahhh! Aku tidak butuh budak HM!
Aku akan terus menghancurkan batu\ldengan tangan kosong!

entries.original:
"No matter how fast you run, we’ll
be there to stop you!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how fast you run, we’ll be there to stop you!
entries.translated:
Secepat apapun kamu berlari, kami
akan ada di sana untuk\lmenghentikanmu!

entries.original:
"Even though I lost, I’m still
very happy!

The cavern is glowing with the
fires of passion!"
entries.translation_source: Even though I lost, I’m still very happy! The cavern is glowing with the fires of passion!
entries.translated:
Meskipun aku kalah, aku tetap
sangat bahagia! Gua itu bersinar\ldengan api semangat!

entries.original:
"I sense great power within you.
Power that will kneel to mine!"
entries.translation_source: I sense great power within you. Power that will kneel to mine!

entries.original: "Oh spirits, I have failed you."
entries.translation_source: Oh spirits, I have failed you.

entries.original:
"It appears I need to spend more
time honing my clairvoyance."
entries.translation_source: It appears I need to spend more time honing my clairvoyance.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku perlu menghabiskan
lebih banyak waktu untuk mengasah\lkewaskitaanku.

entries.original:
"The last Guardian of Borrius, [green]Aros[blue],
tasked several older couples with\lguarding rare or powerful objects.

We are one such couple.

Another couple, I believe, lives on
Route 9."
entries.translation_source: The last Guardian of Borrius, [color-green-1]Aros[color-blue-2], tasked several older couples with guarding rare or powerful objects. We are one such couple. Another couple, I believe, lives on Route 9.
entries.translated:
Penjaga terakhir Borrius, [green]Aros[blue],
memberikan tugas kepada beberapa\lpasangan tua untuk menjaga benda

langka atau kuat. Kami adalah salah
satu pasangan tersebut. Pasangan\llain, saya percaya, tinggal di

Route 9.

entries.original: "[black]Lapras: [green]Prasss!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Lapras: [color-green-2]Prasss!
entries.translated: [black]Lapras: [green]Prasss!

entries.original:
"There was a Pokémon hiding under
the lily pad!

The Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: There was a Pokémon hiding under the lily pad! The Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated:
Ada seekor Pokémon bersembunyi di
bawah daun teratai! Pokémon itu\lmenyerang!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] dove back into the
pond."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] dove back into the pond.
entries.translated:
Si [buffer1] menyelam kembali ke
dalam kolam.

entries.original:
"Oh, you finally made it.

My head started hurting again while
waiting for you to show up.

I hope you can make my return to
the Gym, worth it."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you finally made it. My head started hurting again while waiting for you to show up. I hope you can make my return to the Gym, worth it.
entries.translated:
Oh, akhirnya kamu sampai. Kepalaku
mulai sakit lagi saat menunggumu\lmuncul. Kuharap kamu bisa membuat

kembaliku ke Gym menjadi sepadan.

entries.original:
"Well then, I guess you should take
the [green]Fall Badge[blue].

You sure earned it."
entries.translation_source: Well then, I guess you should take the [color-green-1]Fall Badge[color-blue-2]. You sure earned it.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, sepertinya kamu harus
mengambil [green]Fall Badge[blue]. Pasti kamu\lpantas mendapatkannya.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Fall Badge
from Mel!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Fall Badge from Mel!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Fall Badge dari
Mel!

entries.original:
"With the Fall Badge, any Pokémon
up to Lv. 60 will obey you.

It also allows your Pokémon to
move heavy boulders with [green]Strength[blue].

Honestly, I don’t know why any
strong Pokémon can’t already do\lthis\.

But what can you do?

That’s just the way the world
works.

Anyways, take this TM to go along
with that badge. "
entries.translation_source: With the Fall Badge, any Pokémon up to Lv. 60 will obey you. It also allows your Pokémon to move heavy boulders with [color-green-1]Strength[color-blue-2]. Honestly, I don’t know why any strong Pokémon can’t already do this[game-token-3] But what can you do? That’s just the way the world works. Anyways, take this TM to go along with that badge.
entries.translated:
Dengan Lencana Musim Gugur, Pokémon
apa pun hingga Level 60 akan patuh\lpadamu. Itu juga memungkinkan

Pokémon-mu untuk memindahkan batu
besar yang berat dengan [green]Kekuatan[blue].\lSejujurnya, aku tidak tahu mengapa

Pokémon kuat mana pun belum bisa
melakukan ini\. Tapi apa yang bisa\ldilakukan? Memang begitulah cara

kerja dunia. Bagaimanapun, ambillah
TM ini untuk melengkapi Lencana\litu.

entries.original:
"TM42 contains [green]Facade[blue].

If your Pokémon has a status
condition, this move’ll get twice\las powerful.

Even stronger than Mega Punch!

Use it, and make your enemies
regret inflicting you with status!"
entries.translation_source: TM42 contains [color-green-1]Facade[color-blue-2]. If your Pokémon has a status condition, this move’ll get twice as powerful. Even stronger than Mega Punch! Use it, and make your enemies regret inflicting you with status!
entries.translated:
TM42 berisi [green]Facade[blue]. Jika Pokémon
Anda memiliki kondisi status, jurus\lini akan menjadi dua kali lebih

kuat. Bahkan lebih kuat dari Mega
Punch! Gunakan, dan buat musuh Anda\lmenyesal telah memberikan status

pada Anda!

entries.original:
"Now that you’ve beaten me, here
comes another splitting headache\."
entries.translation_source: Now that you’ve beaten me, here comes another splitting headache[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sekarang setelah kamu
mengalahkanku, ini dia sakit kepala\lhebat lainnya\..

entries.original:
"Champ in the making!
How go the battles?

Welcome to the Fallshore City Gym!

Have some Fresh Water, straight
from the ponds of this Gym."
entries.translation_source: Champ in the making! How go the battles? Welcome to the Fallshore City Gym! Have some Fresh Water, straight from the ponds of this Gym.
entries.translated:
Calon Juara! Bagaimana
pertarungannya? Selamat datang di\lFallshore City Gym! Silakan minum

Air Segar, langsung dari
kolam-kolam Gym ini.

entries.original:
"Mel?
Well, he’s just a normal guy!

Punching him or his Pokémon with
some powerful [green]Fighting[blue]-types is a\lgood way to take him down.

If you’re ready to battle, start by
sliding down the slide next to me!

But make sure you’re stocked up on
supplies first.

There’s no going back until you
reach Mel."
entries.translation_source: Mel? Well, he’s just a normal guy! Punching him or his Pokémon with some powerful [color-green-1]Fighting[color-blue-2]-types is a good way to take him down. If you’re ready to battle, start by sliding down the slide next to me! But make sure you’re stocked up on supplies first. There’s no going back until you reach Mel.
entries.translated:
Mel? Yah, dia orang biasa!
Memukulnya atau Pokémon-nya dengan\l[green]Tipe Fighting[blue] yang kuat adalah cara

yang bagus untuk mengalahkannya.
Jika kamu siap bertarung, mulailah\ldengan meluncur menuruni perosotan

di sampingku! Tapi pastikan kamu
sudah menyiapkan bekal persediaan\lterlebih dahulu. Tidak ada jalan

kembali sampai kamu mencapai Mel.

entries.original:
"Bravo!

Mel took quite a beating, didn’t
he?

I bet he’d have taken an even worse
one, had you had this Gem."
entries.translation_source: Bravo! Mel took quite a beating, didn’t he? I bet he’d have taken an even worse one, had you had this Gem.
entries.translated:
Hebat! Mel mendapatkan pukulan yang
cukup keras, bukan? Aku yakin dia\lakan mendapatkan yang lebih buruk

lagi jika kamu memiliki Permata
ini.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single Normal-type move in battle.

Normal-type moves may not be
Super-Effective against anything,\lbut with that Gem, they can sure\lfeel like they are!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single Normal-type move in battle. Normal-type moves may not be Super-Effective against anything, but with that Gem, they can sure feel like they are!
entries.translated:
Permata yang kuberikan padamu dapat
memperkuat satu gerakan tipe Normal\ldalam pertempuran. Gerakan tipe

Normal mungkin tidak Super Efektif
terhadap apa pun, tetapi dengan\lPermata itu, gerakan tersebut bisa

terasa seolah-olah memang Super
Efektif!

entries.original:
"You should stock up on [green]revives[red]!

They heal a fainted Pokémon back
to half health!"
entries.translation_source: You should stock up on [color-green-1]revives[color-red-2]! They heal a fainted Pokémon back to half health!
entries.translated:
Kamu harus menyetok [green]Revive[red]! Mereka
menyembuhkan Pokémon yang pingsan\lkembali ke setengah kesehatan!

entries.original:
"I must study this mountain
some more.

My knowledge is insufficient."
entries.translation_source: I must study this mountain some more. My knowledge is insufficient.
entries.translated:
Saya harus mempelajari gunung ini
lebih lanjut. Pengetahuan saya\ltidak mencukupi.

entries.original:
"What a fun battle!

You got my blood flowing during my
long climb."
entries.translation_source: What a fun battle! You got my blood flowing during my long climb.

entries.original:
"Be careful when climbing the rock
walls, the fall can be treacherous."
entries.translation_source: Be careful when climbing the rock walls, the fall can be treacherous.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati saat memanjat dinding
batu, jatuhnya bisa berbahaya.

entries.original:
"Did you know?

The Dehara City Gym Leader,
Galavan, trains here regularly."
entries.translation_source: Did you know? The Dehara City Gym Leader, Galavan, trains here regularly.

entries.original:
"Wow, you’re strong!
Do you train here too?"
entries.translation_source: Wow, you’re strong! Do you train here too?

entries.original:
"I guess I need to train more to
match Galavan."
entries.translation_source: I guess I need to train more to match Galavan.
entries.translated:
Saya rasa saya perlu berlatih lebih
banyak untuk menyaingi Galavan.

entries.original:
"The electric barrier blocks you
from passing through."
entries.translation_source: The electric barrier blocks you from passing through.
entries.translated:
Penghalang listrik menghalangi kamu
untuk melewati.

entries.original:
"The electric barrier has been
disengaged."
entries.translation_source: The electric barrier has been disengaged.
entries.translated:
Penghalang listrik telah
dinonaktifkan.

entries.original:
"The path through this mountain is
exhausting, isn’t it?

Let me heal you up so you can
continue on, worry free!"
entries.translation_source: The path through this mountain is exhausting, isn’t it? Let me heal you up so you can continue on, worry free!
entries.translated:
Jalan melalui gunung ini
melelahkan, bukan? Biarkan aku\lmemulihkanmu agar kamu bisa

melanjutkan perjalanan tanpa
khawatir!

entries.original:
"Look!
A Trainer lost in Thundercap Mt!"
entries.translation_source: Look! A Trainer lost in Thundercap Mt!

entries.original:
"If you’re working on a Pokédex,
visit Thundercap Mountain.

All sorts of rare Electric Pokémon
live there.

It’s even said that Zapdos roosts
at the peak!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re working on a Pokédex, visit Thundercap Mountain. All sorts of rare Electric Pokémon live there. It’s even said that Zapdos roosts at the peak!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu sedang mengerjakan
Pokédex, kunjungilah Gunung\lThundercap. Berbagai macam Pokémon

Tipe Listrik langka tinggal di
sana. Bahkan dikatakan bahwa Zapdos\lbersarang di puncaknya!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out here
often with some of his closer,\l\qofriends\qc."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out here often with some of his closer, [quote-open-1]friends[quote-close-2].
entries.translated:
Mel, Pemimpin Gym, sering datang ke
sini dengan beberapa teman\ldekatnya, \qoteman\qc.

entries.original:
"Apparently Mel has his own private
island somewhere out in the ocean!"
entries.translation_source: Apparently Mel has his own private island somewhere out in the ocean!
entries.translated:
Rupanya Mel memiliki pulau
pribadinya sendiri di suatu tempat\ldi lautan!

entries.original:
"Are you up to no good?

\.

Just checking.

There’s no telling when a ruffian
will sneak past the gate check."
entries.translation_source: Are you up to no good? [game-token-1] Just checking. There’s no telling when a ruffian will sneak past the gate check.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu berbuat nakal? \. Hanya
memeriksa. Tidak ada yang tahu\lkapan seorang preman akan

menyelinap melewati pemeriksaan
gerbang.

entries.original: "Wiped out in an instant\."
entries.translation_source: Wiped out in an instant[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Musnah dalam sekejap\.

entries.original:
"This guy with red hair just came
out of nowhere and obliterated all\lof my Pokémon before I even had a\lchance to react!"
entries.translation_source: This guy with red hair just came out of nowhere and obliterated all of my Pokémon before I even had a chance to react!
entries.translated:
Orang berambut merah ini baru saja
muncul entah dari mana dan\lmemusnahkan semua Pokémon-ku

sebelum aku sempat bereaksi!

entries.original:
"Route 11

\al Fallshore City
\ar Epidimy Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 11 [game-token-1] Fallshore City [game-token-2] Epidimy Town
entries.translated:
Route 11 \al Fallshore City \ar Epidimy
Town

entries.original:
"Route 1

\au Frozen Heights
\ad Bellin Town, Icicle Cave"
entries.translation_source: Route 1 [game-token-1] Frozen Heights [game-token-2] Bellin Town, Icicle Cave
entries.translated:
Route 1 \au Frozen Heights \ad Bellin
Town, Icicle Cave

entries.original:
"Route 1

\au Frozen Heights, Icicle Cave
\ad Bellin Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 1 [game-token-1] Frozen Heights, Icicle Cave [game-token-2] Bellin Town
entries.translated:
Route 1 \au Frozen Heights, Icicle
Cave \ad Bellin Town

entries.original:
"Route 2

\al Dresco Town
\ar Icicle Cave"
entries.translation_source: Route 2 [game-token-1] Dresco Town [game-token-2] Icicle Cave
entries.translated: Route 2 \al Dresco Town \ar Icicle Cave

entries.original: "Research Lab"
entries.translation_source: Research Lab
entries.translated: Research Lab

entries.original:
"Afterlife, Shadow Base,
Great Desert, Gurun Town"
entries.translation_source: Afterlife, Shadow Base, Great Desert, Gurun Town
entries.translated:
Afterlife, Shadow Base, Great
Desert, Gurun Town

entries.original:
"Route 5

\au Route 4
\ad Crater Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 5 [game-token-1] Route 4 [game-token-2] Crater Town
entries.translated: Route 5 \au Route 4 \ad Crater Town

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is located on the
\qoThundercap Highland\qc.

But if you came to see the
lightning storms, you’re out of\lluck.

Those only happen to the east of
here, by Epidimy Town."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is located on the [quote-open-1]Thundercap Highland[quote-close-2]. But if you came to see the lightning storms, you’re out of luck. Those only happen to the east of here, by Epidimy Town.
entries.translated:
Tarmigan Town terletak di
\qoThundercap Highland\qc. Tapi jika\lkamu datang untuk melihat badai

petir, kamu kurang beruntung. Itu
hanya terjadi di sebelah timur\lsini, dekat Epidimy Town.

entries.original:
"My family has owned Tarmigan
Mansion for generations.

In fact, my ancestors were
responsible for the formation of\lTarmigan Town itself!

As such, I like to sit out here and
watch the town every now and then.

Don’t just sit around like me,
youngster.

Carpe diem, child!
Seize the day!"
entries.translation_source: My family has owned Tarmigan Mansion for generations. In fact, my ancestors were responsible for the formation of Tarmigan Town itself! As such, I like to sit out here and watch the town every now and then. Don’t just sit around like me, youngster. Carpe diem, child! Seize the day!
entries.translated:
Keluargaku telah memiliki Tarmigan
Mansion selama beberapa generasi.\lFaktanya, nenek moyangku

bertanggung jawab atas pembentukan
Tarmigan Town itu sendiri! Oleh\lkarena itu, aku suka duduk di sini

dan menonton kota itu sesekali.
Jangan hanya duduk-duduk seperti\laku, anak muda. Carpe diem, nak!

Raih hari ini!

entries.original:
"Someone has been experimenting
today\."
entries.translation_source: Someone has been experimenting today[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Seseorang telah bereksperimen hari
ini\.

entries.original:
"Yo, wazzup fella?

Howzit goin’?

The name’s Galavan.

If ya couldn’t tell, I’m the Gym
Leader here.

I’m sure ya had a tough time
making your way across the\lshocking floor, didn’t ya?

Well, don’t fret, ’cause you
won’t have to fight at a\ldisadvantage anymore."
entries.translation_source: Yo, wazzup fella? Howzit goin’? The name’s Galavan. If ya couldn’t tell, I’m the Gym Leader here. I’m sure ya had a tough time making your way across the shocking floor, didn’t ya? Well, don’t fret, ’cause you won’t have to fight at a disadvantage anymore.
entries.translated:
Yo, apa kabar sobat? Gimana
kabarnya? Namaku Galavan. Kalau\lkamu belum tahu, aku adalah

Pemimpin Gym di sini. Aku yakin
kamu kesulitan melewati lantai yang\lmengejutkan itu, kan? Yah, jangan

khawatir, karena kamu tidak perlu
bertarung dalam posisi tidak\ldiuntungkan lagi.

entries.original:
"Ever since ancient times, the
mythical Pokémon Darkrai has\lhaunted this town.

It is said, every night when the
clock strikes one, he comes out\lto haunt the dreams of the masses.

Be wary, child!
Don’t fall into the dark void!"
entries.translation_source: Ever since ancient times, the mythical Pokémon Darkrai has haunted this town. It is said, every night when the clock strikes one, he comes out to haunt the dreams of the masses. Be wary, child! Don’t fall into the dark void!
entries.translated:
Sejak zaman kuno, Pokémon mitos
Darkrai telah menghantui kota ini.\lDikatakan, setiap malam ketika jam

menunjukkan pukul satu, dia keluar
untuk menghantui mimpi orang\lbanyak. Hati-hati, anak! Jangan

jatuh ke dalam kehampaan gelap!

entries.original:
"If I can’t slow you down, at least
this room will."
entries.translation_source: If I can’t slow you down, at least this room will.
entries.translated:
Jika aku tidak bisa memperlambatmu,
setidaknya ruangan ini akan.

entries.original: "[black]Chansey: [red]Seyyyy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Chansey: [color-red-2]Seyyyy!
entries.translated: [black]Chansey: [red]Seyyyy!

entries.original:
"How can you climb up a mountain
with no stairs?"
entries.translation_source: How can you climb up a mountain with no stairs?

entries.original: "Think on that."
entries.translation_source: Think on that.

entries.original:
"Suprisingly, you can’t catch any
[green]Voltorb[blue] here.

I hear they’re only found in one of
the Gyms."
entries.translation_source: Suprisingly, you can’t catch any [color-green-1]Voltorb[color-blue-2] here. I hear they’re only found in one of the Gyms.
entries.translated:
Yang mengejutkan, kamu tidak bisa
menangkap [green]Voltorb[blue] di sini. Kudengar\lmereka hanya ditemukan di salah

satu Gym.

entries.original:
"I hope none of the other grunts
fell off the mountain\."
entries.translation_source: I hope none of the other grunts fell off the mountain[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kuharap tidak ada anggota lain yang
jatuh dari gunung\.

entries.original:
"If those tremors mean what I think
they mean\."
entries.translation_source: If those tremors mean what I think they mean[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Jika gempa itu berarti seperti yang
kukira\.

entries.original:
"Now I can’t get back up the ladder,
no matter how hard I try."
entries.translation_source: Now I can’t get back up the ladder, no matter how hard I try.
entries.translated:
Sekarang aku tidak bisa naik
kembali ke tangga, tidak peduli\lseberapa keras aku mencoba.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [red]Uh oh!

[player]’s hot on our tails!

I’d better go warn Marlon!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-red-1]Uh oh! [player-name-2]’s hot on our tails! I’d better go warn Marlon!
entries.translated:
Anggota: [red]Uh oh! [player] membuntuti
kita! Lebih baik aku peringatkan\lMarlon!

entries.original: "I strayed from the battle plan!"
entries.translation_source: I strayed from the battle plan!

entries.original:
"Me? No, I’m not lost.
I live here!"
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not lost. I live here!
entries.translated:
Aku? Tidak, aku tidak tersesat. Aku
tinggal di sini!

entries.original:
"Whew\. I better take a rest\.

Groan\.

That volcano takes a lot out of
you!

Let me heal your Pokémon so you
don’t get tired too."
entries.translation_source: Whew[game-token-1] I better take a rest[game-token-2] Groan[game-token-3] That volcano takes a lot out of you! Let me heal your Pokémon so you don’t get tired too.
entries.translated:
Wah\. Aku lebih baik istirahat\. Erang\.
Gunung berapi itu sangat menguras\ltenagamu! Biarkan aku menyembuhkan

Pokémon-mu agar kamu tidak
kelelahan juga.

entries.original: "Take care of yourself."
entries.translation_source: Take care of yourself.
entries.translated: Jaga dirimu baik-baik.

entries.original:
"[blue]Quick!

Grab her now!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Quick! Grab her now!
entries.translated: [blue]Cepat! Tangkap dia sekarang!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I’m really sorry sir, those
people you asked me to guard\lfound some Pokémon and escaped."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]I’m really sorry sir, those people you asked me to guard found some Pokémon and escaped.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Maaf sekali, Pak,
orang-orang yang Anda suruh saya\ljaga menemukan beberapa Pokémon dan

melarikan diri.

entries.original: "???: [blue]FOOL!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]FOOL!
entries.translated: ???: [blue]BODOH!

entries.original:
"Auburn Waterway

\au Route 6, Valley Cave
\ad Route 10"
entries.translation_source: Auburn Waterway [game-token-1] Route 6, Valley Cave [game-token-2] Route 10
entries.translated:
Auburn Waterway \au Route 6, Valley
Cave \ad Route 10

entries.original: "Power Grid"
entries.translation_source: Power Grid
entries.translated: Jaringan Listrik

entries.original: "Rest Room"
entries.translation_source: Rest Room
entries.translated: Kamar Istirahat

entries.original:
"Dream Research Lab

We study your dreams."
entries.translation_source: Dream Research Lab We study your dreams.
entries.translated:
Lab Penelitian Mimpi Kami
mempelajari mimpimu.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]No sir, I don’t. But it was
just a small mistake.

I promise, it won’t happen again."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]No sir, I don’t. But it was just a small mistake. I promise, it won’t happen again.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Tidak, Pak. Tapi itu hanya
kesalahan kecil. Saya janji, tidak\lakan terulang lagi.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Marlon, I need you to send
someone to obtain the weekly\lsupplies from the Poké Mart.

Make sure they also obtain a
special package that is arriving\ltoday.

It’s critical for our operation to
capture specimen UNO."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Marlon, I need you to send someone to obtain the weekly supplies from the Poké Mart. Make sure they also obtain a special package that is arriving today. It’s critical for our operation to capture specimen UNO.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Marlon, aku perlu kamu
mengirim seseorang untuk mengambil\lperlengkapan mingguan dari Poké

Mart. Pastikan mereka juga
mengambil paket khusus yang tiba\lhari ini. Itu penting untuk operasi

kita menangkap spesimen UNO.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]On it."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]On it.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Siap.

entries.original: "[blue]Grunt!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Grunt!
entries.translated: [blue]Grunt!

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir?"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Yes, sir?
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Ya, Pak?

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1][game-token-2]
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]\.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Right away."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Right away.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Segera.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Yes, sir!
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Ya, Pak!

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Anything else?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Anything else?
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Ada lagi?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Once that grunt has obtained
that package, take it, and use it\lto capture specimen UNO."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Once that grunt has obtained that package, take it, and use it to capture specimen UNO.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Setelah grunt itu mendapatkan
paket itu, ambil, dan gunakan untuk\lmenangkap spesimen UNO.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]As for you, I’m going to make
an example out of you.

It’s time you pay for your blunder."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]As for you, I’m going to make an example out of you. It’s time you pay for your blunder.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Sedangkan untukmu, aku akan
membuat contoh darimu. Saatnya kamu\lmembayar atas kesalahanmu.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]No! Please!
I’m really sorry!\lI’ll do anything to fix this!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]No! Please! I’m really sorry! I’ll do anything to fix this!
entries.translated:
Preman: [blue]Tidak! Kumohon! Aku
benar-benar minta maaf! Aku akan\lmelakukan apa saja untuk

memperbaiki ini!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Houndoom, incinerate this
piece of trash."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Houndoom, incinerate this piece of trash.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Houndoom, bakar habis sampah
ini.

entries.original: "Here, take some potions."
entries.translation_source: Here, take some potions.
entries.translated: Ini, ambil beberapa ramuan.

entries.original:
"But let’s see how ya do in a
sandstorm!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: But let’s see how ya do in a sandstorm! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Tapi mari kita lihat bagaimana kau
bertahan di badai pasir! Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Man\.

You sure zapped me silly!

Take the [green]Zap Badge[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Man[game-token-1] You sure zapped me silly! Take the [color-green-2]Zap Badge[color-blue-3]!
entries.translated:
Wah\. Kau benar-benar menyetrumku
sampai linglung! Ambil [green]Lencana Zap[blue]!

entries.original:
"But I’m too scared to go home as
long as there are trainers around\lhere who haven’t been beaten\."
entries.translation_source: But I’m too scared to go home as long as there are trainers around here who haven’t been beaten[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tapi aku terlalu takut pulang
selama masih ada pelatih di sekitar\lsini yang belum dikalahkan\.

entries.original:
"I hear there’s a Pokémon that has
mushrooms growing on its back.

Not around here, though.
I wonder if they taste any good?"
entries.translation_source: I hear there’s a Pokémon that has mushrooms growing on its back. Not around here, though. I wonder if they taste any good?
entries.translated:
Kudengar ada Pokémon yang memiliki
jamur tumbuh di punggungnya. Tapi\ltidak di sekitar sini. Aku

penasaran apakah rasanya enak?

entries.original:
"Speaking of crying, I’m positive I
heard before\."
entries.translation_source: Speaking of crying, I’m positive I heard before[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Bicara soal menangis, aku yakin aku
pernah mendengarnya sebelumnya\.

entries.original:
"I’m playing hide-and-seek here.
I like some underground tag, too."
entries.translation_source: I’m playing hide-and-seek here. I like some underground tag, too.
entries.translated:
Aku sedang bermain petak umpet di
sini. Aku juga suka bermain\lkejar-kejaran bawah tanah.

entries.original:
"I got separated from my friends\.

I’ve got my Pokémon with me so
I’m okay, but\."
entries.translation_source: I got separated from my friends[game-token-1] I’ve got my Pokémon with me so I’m okay, but[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku terpisah dari teman-temanku\. Aku
membawa Pokémon-ku jadi aku\lbaik-baik saja, tapi\.

entries.original:
"Where am I? Am I lost?
Who are you?

Are you a Pokémon Trainer?"
entries.translation_source: Where am I? Am I lost? Who are you? Are you a Pokémon Trainer?

entries.original:
"Okay, so we’re both Trainers.
That’s a start, right?"
entries.translation_source: Okay, so we’re both Trainers. That’s a start, right?

entries.original:
"I just wanted to have a picnic in
Thundercap Mt.

I didn’t think I would get lost
in a place like this\."
entries.translation_source: I just wanted to have a picnic in Thundercap Mt. I didn’t think I would get lost in a place like this[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku hanya ingin piknik di Gunung
Thundercap. Aku tidak menyangka\lakan tersesat di tempat seperti ini\.

entries.original:
"Why have a picnic here?
I don’t know.

There’s no deep meaning to it."
entries.translation_source: Why have a picnic here? I don’t know. There’s no deep meaning to it.
entries.translated:
Kenapa piknik di sini? Entahlah.
Tidak ada makna mendalam di\lbaliknya.

entries.original:
"I’m not lost, I tell you!
I’m camping! That’s my story!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not lost, I tell you! I’m camping! That’s my story!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tersesat, kubilang! Aku
berkemah! Itu ceritaku!

entries.original:
"I’m Milo\.

I was catching Pokémon, and then
I got lost\.

I’m so scared\.

Please!
Please take me to the exit!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Milo[game-token-1] I was catching Pokémon, and then I got lost[game-token-2] I’m so scared[game-token-3] Please! Please take me to the exit!
entries.translated:
Aku Milo\. Aku sedang menangkap
Pokémon, lalu aku tersesat\. Aku\lsangat takut\. Tolong! Tolong antar

aku ke pintu keluar!

entries.original: "[player] decided to go with Milo!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] decided to go with Milo!
entries.translated:
[player] memutuskan untuk pergi
bersama Milo!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy
all the time!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy all the time!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menjaga Pokémonmu tetap
sehat setiap saat!

entries.original:
"Oh\.
I’m so scared\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] I’m so scared[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Aku sangat takut\.

entries.original:
"I like useful moves like Growl and
Tail Whip.

Those are my favourites."
entries.translation_source: I like useful moves like Growl and Tail Whip. Those are my favourites.
entries.translated:
Aku suka jurus berguna seperti
Raungan dan Kibas Ekor. Itu\lfavoritku.

entries.original:
"The mountain\.
It’s so easy to get confused.

Do you know where we are?"
entries.translation_source: The mountain[game-token-1] It’s so easy to get confused. Do you know where we are?
entries.translated:
Gunung ini\. Sangat mudah untuk
bingung. Apakah kau tahu di mana\lkita?

entries.original:
"[player], did you get to be
so good because you’re always\lwith your Pokémon?

Yes! That has to be it!
Milo will try like you!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], did you get to be so good because you’re always with your Pokémon? Yes! That has to be it! Milo will try like you!
entries.translated:
[player], apakah kau menjadi begitu
hebat karena kau selalu bersama\lPokémon-mu? Ya! Pasti itu! Milo

akan berusaha sepertimu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh! There’s the ladder!

I want to get tougher so I
won’t be such a scaredy-cat.

[player], bye-bye!
Thank you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh! There’s the ladder! I want to get tougher so I won’t be such a scaredy-cat. [player-name-2], bye-bye! Thank you!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh! Itu tangganya! Aku ingin
menjadi lebih kuat agar tidak\lmenjadi penakut. [player], dah!

Terima kasih!

entries.original:
"It appears Milo has left something
behind\."
entries.translation_source: It appears Milo has left something behind[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Tampaknya Milo meninggalkan sesuatu\.

entries.original:
"Take a look at this rock, isn’t
it fascinating?"
entries.translation_source: Take a look at this rock, isn’t it fascinating?

entries.original:
"What, are you surprised I’m not
building a machine?"
entries.translation_source: What, are you surprised I’m not building a machine?

entries.original:
"People assume just because I’m a
Super Nerd, I’m required to do\lnerdy things.

I can study rocks if I want to!

Nobody can tell me who I have
to be!"
entries.translation_source: People assume just because I’m a Super Nerd, I’m required to do nerdy things. I can study rocks if I want to! Nobody can tell me who I have to be!
entries.translated:
Orang-orang menganggap hanya karena
aku seorang Super Nerd, aku harus\lmelakukan hal-hal kutu buku. Aku

bisa mempelajari batu jika aku mau!
Tidak ada yang bisa memberitahu aku\lharus menjadi siapa!

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn my Electric-types
were acting funny until they were\lknocked out\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn my Electric-types were acting funny until they were knocked out[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah tipe Listrikku
bertingkah aneh sampai mereka\ltumbang\.

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]No\.Electivire\.please!
Why are you acting like this?"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]No[game-token-2]Electivire[game-token-3]please! Why are you acting like this?
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Tidak\.Electivire\.kumohon!
Kenapa kau bersikap seperti ini?

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.why don’t you
go back in your Poké Ball?

Yes\.come on, now\.return!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Electivire[game-token-2]why don’t you go back in your Poké Ball? Yes[game-token-3]come on, now[game-token-4]return!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.kenapa kau tidak
kembali ke Poké Ball-mu? Ya\.ayo,\lsekarang\.kembali!

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Oh\.come on, Electivire\.
don’t knock your ball away\."
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Oh[game-token-2]come on, Electivire[game-token-3] don’t knock your ball away[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Oh\.ayolah, Electivire\. jangan
menjatuhkan bola-mu\.

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.that could’ve
killed me!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Electivire[game-token-2]that could’ve killed me!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.itu bisa saja
membunuhku!

entries.original:
"[blue]Help!

Somebody help me!

My Electivire’s gone rogue!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Help! Somebody help me! My Electivire’s gone rogue!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tolong! Seseorang tolong aku!
Electivire-ku menjadi liar!

entries.original: "Would you like to protect the nerd?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to protect the nerd?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin melindungi si
kutu buku itu?

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Thank you!
Thank you for protecting me!

Now, please, battle my Electivire
and bring it back to its senses!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Thank you! Thank you for protecting me! Now, please, battle my Electivire and bring it back to its senses!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Terima kasih! Terima kasih
telah melindungiku! Sekarang,\ltolong, bertarunglah dengan

Electivire-ku dan buat dia sadar
kembali!

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire!
Come back!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Electivire! Come back!
entries.translated: Nerd: [blue]Electivire! Kembalilah!

entries.original: "[blue]And he’s gone\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]And he’s gone[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [blue]Dan dia pergi\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Please\.you were kind enough to
protect me\.so please, chase after\lmy Electivire!

He’s the only friend I have\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Please[game-token-2]you were kind enough to protect me[game-token-3]so please, chase after my Electivire! He’s the only friend I have[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]Kumohon\.kau cukup baik telah
melindungiku\.jadi tolong, kejar\lElectivire-ku! Dia satu-satunya

teman yang kumiliki\.

entries.original: "Electivire: [green]Vire\."
entries.translation_source: Electivire: [color-green-1]Vire[game-token-2]

entries.original: "Electivire: [green]Vire!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire: [color-green-1]Vire!

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.please\.just
listen to me\.

Return to your Poké Ball!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Electivire[game-token-2]please[game-token-3]just listen to me[game-token-4] Return to your Poké Ball!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.kumohon\.dengarkan
aku\. Kembalilah ke Poké Ball-mu!

entries.original:
"[blue]I owe you one for helping my
Electivire.

I can’t give you anything here, so
meet me in the [green]Epidimy Town\lPokémon Centre [blue]if you want a\lreward for your help."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I owe you one for helping my Electivire. I can’t give you anything here, so meet me in the [color-green-2]Epidimy Town Pokémon Centre [color-blue-3]if you want a reward for your help.
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku berutang budi padamu karena
membantu Electivire-ku. Aku tidak\lbisa memberikan apa pun di sini,

jadi temui aku di [green]Pusat Pokémon
Epidimy Town [blue]jika kau ingin hadiah\latas bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"???: [red]Epidimy Town you say\.

Then I must head there\.for the
sake of science\."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-red-1]Epidimy Town you say[game-token-2] Then I must head there[game-token-3]for the sake of science[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
???: [red]Epidimy Town katamu\. Maka aku
harus ke sana\.demi ilmu pengetahuan\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
I didn’t expect to see you here!

Shouldn’t you be running errands
for Log or something?

\.

Oh, so you are running an errand\.

That cheapskate\.can’t do anything
himself\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I didn’t expect to see you here! Shouldn’t you be running errands for Log or something? [game-token-2] Oh, so you are running an errand[game-token-3] That cheapskate[game-token-4]can’t do anything himself[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku tidak menyangka
melihatmu di sini! Bukankah kau\lharus menjalankan tugas untuk Log

atau sesuatu? \. Oh, jadi kau sedang
menjalankan tugas\. Si pelit itu\.tidak\lbisa melakukan apa pun sendiri\.

entries.original:
"What’s that?
Log gave you something for me?"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Log gave you something for me?
entries.translated:
Apa itu? Log memberimu sesuatu
untukku?

entries.original:
"[player] handed the Pokedex
over to [rival]."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] handed the Pokedex over to [text-token-rival-2].
entries.translated:
[player] menyerahkan Pokédex kepada
[rival].

entries.original:
"Oh, great.

Now Log’s voice’ll never stop
echoing in my head."
entries.translation_source: Oh, great. Now Log’s voice’ll never stop echoing in my head.
entries.translated:
Oh, hebat. Sekarang suara Log tidak
akan pernah berhenti bergema di\lkepalaku.

entries.original:
"Well, if Log has you filling this
out, let’s see if you’ve gotten any\lstronger because of it!"
entries.translation_source: Well, if Log has you filling this out, let’s see if you’ve gotten any stronger because of it!
entries.translated:
Nah, jika Log menyuruhmu mengisi
ini, mari kita lihat apakah kau\lmenjadi lebih kuat karenanya!

entries.original:
"Well, if Log has you filling this
out, let’s see if your Pokémon can\lbeat mine this time."
entries.translation_source: Well, if Log has you filling this out, let’s see if your Pokémon can beat mine this time.
entries.translated:
Nah, jika Log menyuruhmu mengisi
ini, mari kita lihat apakah\lPokémon-mu bisa mengalahkanku kali

ini.

entries.original:
"Yeah, I guess I can help fill this
thing out.

If it leads to me becoming
stronger, I’ll take it.

When I find my parents they’ll be
amazed at how far I’ve come.

Next time our paths cross, the
outcome of our battle won’t be the\lsame!

I promise you that!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, I guess I can help fill this thing out. If it leads to me becoming stronger, I’ll take it. When I find my parents they’ll be amazed at how far I’ve come. Next time our paths cross, the outcome of our battle won’t be the same! I promise you that!
entries.translated:
Ya, kurasa aku bisa membantu
mengisi ini. Jika ini membuatku\lsemakin kuat, aku akan menerimanya.

Saat aku menemukan orang tuaku,
mereka akan takjub melihat seberapa\ljauh aku telah berkembang. Lain

kali kita bertemu, hasil
pertarungan kita tidak akan sama!\lAku janji!

entries.original: "[green]Slash!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Slash!

entries.original:
"Aha!

I’ve cornered you!

After that battle, you’re too weak
to escape!

Now, return the food you stole!"
entries.translation_source: Aha! I’ve cornered you! After that battle, you’re too weak to escape! Now, return the food you stole!
entries.translated:
Aha! Aku sudah menjebakmu! Setelah
pertempuran itu, kau terlalu lemah\luntuk melarikan diri! Sekarang,

kembalikan makanan yang kau curi!

entries.original:
"Huh, what’s this?

Have you been stealing my food for
your friends and family?"
entries.translation_source: Huh, what’s this? Have you been stealing my food for your friends and family?
entries.translated:
Hah, apa ini? Apakah kau mencuri
makananku untuk teman dan\lkeluargamu?

entries.original:
"That cry\.

I’ve heard it somewhere before\.

Ah!

You must be one of those rare Ice-
type Sandslash that lives up here!

Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped
coming to feed you?

Now that I mention it, I haven’t
seen them around in a while\."
entries.translation_source: That cry[game-token-1] I’ve heard it somewhere before[game-token-2] Ah! You must be one of those rare Ice- type Sandslash that lives up here! Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped coming to feed you? Now that I mention it, I haven’t seen them around in a while[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tangisan itu\. Aku pernah
mendengarnya di suatu tempat\lsebelumnya\. Ah! Kau pasti salah satu

Sandslash tipe Es langka yang
tinggal di sini! Apakah Pokémon\lRangers berhenti datang untuk

memberimu makan? Ngomong-ngomong,
aku sudah lama tidak melihat mereka\ldi sekitar\.

entries.original:
"Then I was right.

You’ve been hungry because your
food supply stopped coming.

Let me make you a deal then,
Sandslash.

If you become my Pokémon and help
me make an income through battling,\lI will support you, your friends,\land your family through the money\lwe make.

Does that work for you?"
entries.translation_source: Then I was right. You’ve been hungry because your food supply stopped coming. Let me make you a deal then, Sandslash. If you become my Pokémon and help me make an income through battling, I will support you, your friends, and your family through the money we make. Does that work for you?
entries.translated:
Berarti aku benar. Kau lapar karena
pasokan makananmu berhenti datang.\lBiar kuusulkan kesepakatan,

Sandslash. Jika kau menjadi
Pokémon-ku dan membantuku\lmendapatkan penghasilan melalui

pertarungan, aku akan mendukungmu,
teman-temanmu, dan keluargamu\ldengan uang yang kita hasilkan.

Apakah itu setuju?

entries.original: "Then it’s settled, let’s go."
entries.translation_source: Then it’s settled, let’s go.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu sudah beres, ayo
pergi.

entries.original:
"Thanks for helping track down the
food thief!

As promised, here’s your little
something."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for helping track down the food thief! As promised, here’s your little something.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah membantu
menemukan pencuri makanan! Seperti\lyang dijanjikan, ini hadiah kecil

untukmu.

entries.original:
"That TM contains [green]Hone Claws[blue].

If you plan on challenging the
[green]Dresco Gym[blue], it’ll help you a lot.

It’s very foggy and hard to see in
there\."
entries.translation_source: That TM contains [color-green-1]Hone Claws[color-blue-2]. If you plan on challenging the [color-green-3]Dresco Gym[color-blue-4], it’ll help you a lot. It’s very foggy and hard to see in there[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
TM itu berisi [green]Cakar Asah[blue]. Jika kamu
berencana menantang [green]Dresco Gym[blue], itu\lakan sangat membantu. Di sana

sangat berkabut dan sulit melihat\.

entries.original: "Hello, good citizen!"
entries.translation_source: Hello, good citizen!
entries.translated: Halo, warga yang baik!

entries.original:
"Oh, I remember you!

You’re that [buffer1] who assisted us in
the Dresco Town Gym!

For that, you can have these
five Revives."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I remember you! You’re that [buffer1-1] who assisted us in the Dresco Town Gym! For that, you can have these five Revives.
entries.translated:
Oh, aku ingat kamu! Kamu adalah
[buffer1] yang membantu kami di Gym\lDresco Town! Untuk itu, kamu bisa

mendapatkan lima Revive ini.

entries.original:
"Say, would you like to help out by
assisting the police again?"
entries.translation_source: Say, would you like to help out by assisting the police again?
entries.translated:
Katakan, apakah kamu ingin membantu
dengan menjadi asisten polisi lagi?

entries.original:
"Would you like to lend a hand to
the local police force?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to lend a hand to the local police force?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin membantu
kepolisian setempat?

entries.original:
"Don’t you know its rude to barge in
on someone else’s meeting?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you know its rude to barge in on someone else’s meeting?
entries.translated:
Tidakkah kamu tahu itu kasar untuk
masuk ke pertemuan orang lain?

entries.original:
"Goon 1: [blue]Huh?
It’s some punk kid!

Let’s rough [buffer2] up and steal [buffer1]
cash!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 1: [color-blue-1]Huh? It’s some punk kid! Let’s rough [buffer2-2] up and steal [buffer1-3] cash!
entries.translated:
Goon 1: [blue]Hah? Itu anak punk! Ayo
kita kasarin [buffer2] dan curi uang\l[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Goon 2: [blue]Yeah, we’ll make [buffer2] cry
for [buffer1] mommy!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 2: [color-blue-1]Yeah, we’ll make [buffer2-2] cry for [buffer1-3] mommy!
entries.translated:
Goon 2: [blue]Ya, kita akan buat [buffer2]
menangis panggil mama [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Goon 1: [blue]I wanna hear you snivel,
kid!

We’re gonna beat you so hard
you’re never gonna forget us!

The Terror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 1: [color-blue-1]I wanna hear you snivel, kid! We’re gonna beat you so hard you’re never gonna forget us! The Terror Granbull!
entries.translated:
Goon 1: [blue]Aku ingin dengar kau
merengek, nak! Kami akan\lmenghajarmu habis-habisan sampai

kau tidak akan pernah melupakan
kami! The Terror Granbull!

entries.original: "Cop: [blue]You’re all under arrest!"
entries.translation_source: Cop: [color-blue-1]You’re all under arrest!
entries.translated: Cop: [blue]Kalian semua ditahan!

entries.original:
"Goon 2: [blue]Oh man, it’s the popo!

Scatter, boys!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 2: [color-blue-1]Oh man, it’s the popo! Scatter, boys!
entries.translated:
Goon 2: [blue]Ya ampun, itu polisi! Cerai
berai, kawan-kawan!

entries.original:
"[blue]Darn\.
They got away\.

They can’t have gone far.
Let’s split up and look for them."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Darn[game-token-2] They got away[game-token-3] They can’t have gone far. Let’s split up and look for them.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sial\. Mereka kabur\. Pasti belum jauh.
Ayo kita pisah dan cari mereka.

entries.original:
"Hey!
You there!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! You there!
entries.translated: Hei! Kamu di sana!

entries.original:
"It’s you!
That punk kid from before!

Not so tough now, huh?

Without the police, you’re just
some pathetic wimp!

And pathetic wimps gotta cry!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you! That punk kid from before! Not so tough now, huh? Without the police, you’re just some pathetic wimp! And pathetic wimps gotta cry!
entries.translated:
Itu kamu! Anak punk dari tadi!
Tidak begitu kuat sekarang, ha?\lTanpa polisi, kau hanya seorang

pengecut menyedihkan! Dan pengecut
menyedihkan harus menangis!

entries.original: "Snivel\."
entries.translation_source: Snivel[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"[black]Cop: [blue]You’re under arrest for
several felonies.

You’re coming with me."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Cop: [color-blue-2]You’re under arrest for several felonies. You’re coming with me.
entries.translated:
[black]Polisi: [blue]Kau ditangkap karena
beberapa kejahatan. Kau ikut\ldenganku.

entries.original:
"In Borrius, it is well known that
thugs and hoodlums are mainly\lconfined to Antisis City.

However, one of the gangs from
there, the \qoTerror Granbull\qc,\lseems to have left that area.

We’ve received several reports
lately about some of their members\lcongregating and causing trouble\lon [green]Route 10[blue].

Our police force is spread fairly
thin at the moment, and any extra\lhelp rounding up these goons would\lbe much appreciated.

I’ll ask you again.

Would you like to lend a hand to
the local police force?"
entries.translation_source: In Borrius, it is well known that thugs and hoodlums are mainly confined to Antisis City. However, one of the gangs from there, the [quote-open-1]Terror Granbull[quote-close-2], seems to have left that area. We’ve received several reports lately about some of their members congregating and causing trouble on [color-green-3]Route 10[color-blue-4]. Our police force is spread fairly thin at the moment, and any extra help rounding up these goons would be much appreciated. I’ll ask you again. Would you like to lend a hand to the local police force?
entries.translated:
Di Borrius, sudah diketahui bahwa
para preman dan kriminal terutama\lterbatas di Antisis City. Namun,

salah satu geng dari sana, \qoTerror
Granbull\qc, sepertinya telah\lmeninggalkan daerah itu. Kami

menerima beberapa laporan
akhir-akhir ini tentang beberapa\langgota mereka berkumpul dan

menyebabkan masalah di [green]Route 10[blue].
Pasukan polisi kami saat ini cukup\ltipis, dan bantuan ekstra untuk

menangkap para penjahat ini akan
sangat dihargai. Aku akan bertanya\llagi. Apakah kamu ingin membantu

kepolisian setempat?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Welcome, [player].

We’ve been expecting you."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Welcome, [player-name-2]. We’ve been expecting you.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Selamat datang, [player].
Kami sudah menunggumu.

entries.original:
"[red]I want you to watch what is about
to happen."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I want you to watch what is about to happen.
entries.translated:
[red]Aku ingin kamu melihat apa yang
akan terjadi.

entries.original:
"[red]Now, Harth, please be cooperative
and hand over the void stone.

If you don’t, I can’t guarantee
your wife’s safety\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Now, Harth, please be cooperative and hand over the void stone. If you don’t, I can’t guarantee your wife’s safety[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang, Harth, tolong bekerja
sama dan serahkan Void Stone. Jika\ltidak, aku tidak bisa menjamin

keselamatan istrimu\.

entries.original:
"Wife: [red]Don’t do it! If you hand it
over, we’ll all be doomed!"
entries.translation_source: Wife: [color-red-1]Don’t do it! If you hand it over, we’ll all be doomed!
entries.translated:
Istri: [red]Jangan lakukan itu! Jika kau
menyerahkannya, kita semua akan\lhancur!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Silence you old hag!

Keep your head out of what doesn’t
concern you."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Silence you old hag! Keep your head out of what doesn’t concern you.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Diam kau tua bangka! Jangan
campuri urusan yang bukan urusanmu.

entries.original:
"Harth: [blue]I’m sorry dear, but I can’t
let them harm you.

If the world ends because of my
actions, then so be it."
entries.translation_source: Harth: [color-blue-1]I’m sorry dear, but I can’t let them harm you. If the world ends because of my actions, then so be it.
entries.translated:
Harth: [blue]Maafkan sayang, tapi aku
tidak bisa membiarkan mereka\lmenyakitimu. Jika dunia berakhir

karena tindakanku, biarlah.

entries.original: "[blue]Here, take it."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Here, take it.
entries.translated: [blue]Ini, ambillah.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Thanks, Harth.

You’ve just helped us pave the way
to doing the impossible\.

It’s too bad that you won’t live
long enough to see it."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Thanks, Harth. You’ve just helped us pave the way to doing the impossible[game-token-2] It’s too bad that you won’t live long enough to see it.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Terima kasih, Harth. Kau
baru saja membantu kami membuka\ljalan untuk melakukan hal yang

mustahil\. Sayang sekali kau tidak
akan hidup cukup lama untuk\lmelihatnya.

entries.original: "Harth: [blue]Wait, huh\.?"
entries.translation_source: Harth: [color-blue-1]Wait, huh[game-token-2]?
entries.translated: Harth: [blue]Tunggu, hah\.?

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Zap Badge from
Galavan!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Zap Badge from Galavan!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Zap Badge dari
Galavan!

entries.original:
"Ah, thank you for your assistance.

When you are prepared, meet me at
the east side of [green]Route 10[blue], just up\lthe first set of stairs you see.

I recommend making sure your
Pokémon are healed up."
entries.translation_source: Ah, thank you for your assistance. When you are prepared, meet me at the east side of [color-green-1]Route 10[color-blue-2], just up the first set of stairs you see. I recommend making sure your Pokémon are healed up.
entries.translated:
Ah, terima kasih atas bantuanmu.
Jika kamu sudah siap, temui aku di\lsisi timur [green]Route 10[blue], tepat di atas

tangga pertama yang kamu lihat. Aku
sarankan pastikan Pokémon-mu sudah\lsembuh.

entries.original:
"The power of evolution\.
It compels me to give this to you!"
entries.translation_source: The power of evolution[game-token-1] It compels me to give this to you!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan evolusi\. Itu memaksaku
untuk memberikan ini padamu!

entries.original:
"I’m not talking to you.
You’re too mean."
entries.translation_source: I’m not talking to you. You’re too mean.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak berbicara denganmu. Kau
terlalu jahat.

entries.original:
"I may feel compelled to give you
something tomorrow, as well."
entries.translation_source: I may feel compelled to give you something tomorrow, as well.
entries.translated:
Aku mungkin merasa terpaksa
memberikan sesuatu padamu besok\ljuga.

entries.original:
"Please, return as many times as
you wish.

As long as you have [green]Yellow Shards[red],
of course."
entries.translation_source: Please, return as many times as you wish. As long as you have [color-green-1]Yellow Shards[color-red-2], of course.
entries.translated:
Silakan, kembalilah sebanyak yang
Anda mau. Tentu saja, selama Anda\lmemiliki [green]Serpihan Kuning[red].

entries.original: "Distortion World"
entries.translation_source: Distortion World
entries.translated: Dunia Distorsi

entries.original: "[green]Dollllll!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Dollllll!
entries.translated: [green]Dollllll!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his head
by the SES Expressway in Tehl Town."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head by the SES Expressway in Tehl Town.
entries.translated:
Mel, Pemimpin Gym, sedang tidak ada
di sini saat ini. Dia mungkin\lsedang pergi menjernihkan pikiran

di Jalan Tol SES di Kota Tehl.

entries.original: "Here, take these!"
entries.translation_source: Here, take these!
entries.translated: Ini, ambil ini!

entries.original:
"One of Professor Log’s Aides who
lives in Tehl Town will give you a\lgift if you’ve captured enough\lPokémon.

I hope those help you fill up your
Pokédex!"
entries.translation_source: One of Professor Log’s Aides who lives in Tehl Town will give you a gift if you’ve captured enough Pokémon. I hope those help you fill up your Pokédex!
entries.translated:
Salah satu Asisten Profesor Log
yang tinggal di Kota Tehl akan\lmemberimu hadiah jika kamu telah

menangkap cukup banyak Pokémon.
Semoga itu membantumu mengisi\lPokédex-mu!

entries.original: "Hey there! Please, enjoy this gift!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there! Please, enjoy this gift!
entries.translated: Hei! Silakan, nikmati hadiah ini!

entries.original:
"There are a few Pokémon in this
area that only evolve via a Water\lStone."
entries.translation_source: There are a few Pokémon in this area that only evolve via a Water Stone.
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Pokémon di area ini
yang hanya berevolusi menggunakan\lBatu Air.

entries.original:
"Our forces will be spread thin for
the forseeable future.

If you would like to lend a hand,
it will always be appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Our forces will be spread thin for the forseeable future. If you would like to lend a hand, it will always be appreciated.
entries.translated:
Pasukan kami akan tersebar tipis
untuk masa depan yang dapat\ldiperkirakan. Jika Anda ingin

membantu, itu akan selalu dihargai.

entries.original:
"It’s time for a grassy battle on a
grassy island!"
entries.translation_source: It’s time for a grassy battle on a grassy island!

entries.original: "A grassy defeat!"
entries.translation_source: A grassy defeat!

entries.original:
"Good work, [player].

Now there’s one less criminal on
the loose.

Only [buffer1] left.

Keep searching while I take this
man back to the station."
entries.translation_source: Good work, [player-name-1]. Now there’s one less criminal on the loose. Only [buffer1-2] left. Keep searching while I take this man back to the station.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, [player]. Sekarang ada
satu penjahat yang buron lebih\lsedikit. Hanya [buffer1] yang

tersisa. Teruslah mencari sementara
aku membawa pria ini kembali ke\lkantor polisi.

entries.original:
"Good work, [player].

You appear to have apprehended all
of the goons.

Only their boss is still is at
large.

Let’s regroup on [green]Route 10[blue] by the
stairs to determine his location."
entries.translation_source: Good work, [player-name-1]. You appear to have apprehended all of the goons. Only their boss is still is at large. Let’s regroup on [color-green-2]Route 10[color-blue-3] by the stairs to determine his location.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, [player]. Kamu
sepertinya telah menangkap semua\lpreman itu. Hanya bos mereka yang

masih buron. Mari berkumpul kembali
di [green]Rute 10[blue] dekat tangga untuk\lmenentukan lokasinya.

entries.original:
"Hoo hah!

This little punk kid found me!

I’m gonna teach this punk kid a
little lesson!"
entries.translation_source: Hoo hah! This little punk kid found me! I’m gonna teach this punk kid a little lesson!
entries.translated:
Hoo hah! Anak punk kecil ini
menemukanku! Aku akan memberi\lpelajaran kecil pada anak punk ini!

entries.original:
"Heh, looks like the little
detective has come after me.

I’ll teach you not to cross the
Terror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: Heh, looks like the little detective has come after me. I’ll teach you not to cross the Terror Granbull!
entries.translated:
Heh, sepertinya detektif kecil
mengejarku. Aku akan mengajarimu\luntuk tidak melawan Terror

Granbull!

entries.original:
"How could a punk kid like you beat
me?"
entries.translation_source: How could a punk kid like you beat me?

entries.original:
"My hidden power is telling me that
you want this!"
entries.translation_source: My hidden power is telling me that you want this!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan tersembunyiku
memberitahuku bahwa kamu\lmenginginkan ini!

entries.original:
"In Borrius, the move Hidden Power,
has a Base Power of 70.

So no matter what type it is, it’ll
always do the same amount of harm!"
entries.translation_source: In Borrius, the move Hidden Power, has a Base Power of 70. So no matter what type it is, it’ll always do the same amount of harm!
entries.translated:
Di Borrius, jurus Kekuatan
Tersembunyi, memiliki Kekuatan\lDasar 70. Jadi tidak peduli tipenya

apa, jurus itu akan selalu
memberikan jumlah kerusakan yang\lsama!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader Mel lives here when
he’s not on Gym duty.

I just take care of his house for
him."
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader Mel lives here when he’s not on Gym duty. I just take care of his house for him.
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Mel tinggal di sini
ketika tidak sedang bertugas di\lGym. Aku hanya merawat rumahnya

untuknya.

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated:
Siap semua! Tetap aman di luar
sana!

entries.original:
"They say the grass is always
greener on the other side.

That’s especially true in Epidimy
Town. Just look at the grass here!"
entries.translation_source: They say the grass is always greener on the other side. That’s especially true in Epidimy Town. Just look at the grass here!
entries.translated:
Mereka bilang rumput selalu lebih
hijau di sisi lain. Itu terutama\lbenar di Epidimy Town. Lihat saja

rumput di sini!

entries.original:
"He’s sleeping peacefully on the
bench.

Better leave him alone."
entries.translation_source: He’s sleeping peacefully on the bench. Better leave him alone.
entries.translated:
Dia tidur dengan tenang di bangku.
Lebih baik biarkan dia sendiri.

entries.original:
"Ahh\.

I love coming out here every day
and relaxing on this bench.

It’s always the most enjoyable part
of my day."
entries.translation_source: Ahh[game-token-1] I love coming out here every day and relaxing on this bench. It’s always the most enjoyable part of my day.
entries.translated:
Ahh\. Aku suka datang ke sini setiap
hari dan bersantai di bangku ini.\lItu selalu menjadi bagian paling

menyenangkan dari hariku.

entries.original:
"Antisis City Port

\al Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Antisis City Port [game-token-1] Antisis City
entries.translated:
Pelabuhan Antisis City \al Antisis
City

entries.original:
"Epidimy town is the epitome of
bliss!

\.

\.

What? You don’t think its funny?
Sorry\.

I feel bad now\.

You know what? Take these. It’ll
help me feel better."
entries.translation_source: Epidimy town is the epitome of bliss! [game-token-1] [game-token-2] What? You don’t think its funny? Sorry[game-token-3] I feel bad now[game-token-4] You know what? Take these. It’ll help me feel better.
entries.translated:
Kota Epidimy adalah puncak
kebahagiaan! \. \. Apa? Kau pikir itu\ltidak lucu? Maaf\. Aku merasa

bersalah sekarang\. Kau tahu? Ambil
ini. Ini akan membantuku merasa\llebih baik.

entries.original:
"I wish our town had a better name
to make a joke of."
entries.translation_source: I wish our town had a better name to make a joke of.
entries.translated:
Aku berharap kota kami memiliki
nama yang lebih baik untuk\ldijadikan bahan lelucon.

entries.original:
"Punk kid!

Prepare to face the terrors of the
Terror Granbull!

\.

That sounded better in my head\."
entries.translation_source: Punk kid! Prepare to face the terrors of the Terror Granbull! [game-token-1] That sounded better in my head[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Anak punk! Bersiaplah menghadapi
kengerian dari Terror Granbull! \.\lKedengarannya lebih baik di

kepalaku\.

entries.original:
"I’m Lily, President of the Skiers
Club.

I’m warning you, I’m not easy to
beat!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Lily, President of the Skiers Club. I’m warning you, I’m not easy to beat!
entries.translated:
Aku Lily, Presiden dari Skiers
Club. Aku peringatkan, aku tidak\lmudah dikalahkan!

entries.original:
"Oh yeah?

Well my Miltank is super powerful,
too!

I got it on Route 10!
You’re going down!"
entries.translation_source: Oh yeah? Well my Miltank is super powerful, too! I got it on Route 10! You’re going down!
entries.translated:
Oh ya? Miltank-ku juga sangat kuat!
Aku mendapatkannya di Route 10! Kau\lakan kalah!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] disappeared into the
ruins."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] disappeared into the ruins.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] menghilang ke dalam
reruntuhan.

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mountain can be accessed
through that hole down the stairs.

It’s really dangerous, so if you
go, make sure you have lots of\lrevives and Paralyze Heals!"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mountain can be accessed through that hole down the stairs. It’s really dangerous, so if you go, make sure you have lots of revives and Paralyze Heals!
entries.translated:
Thundercap Mountain dapat diakses
melalui lubang di bawah tangga.\lTempat itu sangat berbahaya, jadi

jika kau pergi, pastikan kau punya
banyak Revive dan Obat Lumpuh!

entries.original:
"I really wanna explore Thundercap
Mountain!

But my mommy says it’s too
dangerous ’cause there are a bunch\lof bad men on the other side."
entries.translation_source: I really wanna explore Thundercap Mountain! But my mommy says it’s too dangerous ’cause there are a bunch of bad men on the other side.
entries.translated:
Aku benar-benar ingin menjelajahi
Thundercap Mountain! Tapi ibuku\lbilang itu terlalu berbahaya karena

ada sekelompok pria jahat di sisi
lain.

entries.original:
"Great job!

You rounded up all four of those
Terror Granbull goons.

However, their leader is still at
large.

I wonder where he could be\.
Maybe back in Antisis City?"
entries.translation_source: Great job! You rounded up all four of those Terror Granbull goons. However, their leader is still at large. I wonder where he could be[game-token-1] Maybe back in Antisis City?
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus! Kau telah mengumpulkan
keempat preman Terror Granbull itu.\lNamun, pemimpin mereka masih buron.

Aku heran di mana dia bisa berada\.
Mungkin kembali ke Antisis City?

entries.original:
"[black]???: [blue]Hahaha!

I, the great G-Roughs, haven’t gone
anywhere!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]???: [color-blue-2]Hahaha! I, the great G-Roughs, haven’t gone anywhere!
entries.translated:
[black]???: [blue]Hahaha! Aku, G-Roughs yang
hebat, tidak pergi ke mana pun!

entries.original:
"[black]Cop: [blue]Stop!

You’re under arrest for
several felonies.

You’re coming with me."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Cop: [color-blue-2]Stop! You’re under arrest for several felonies. You’re coming with me.
entries.translated:
[black]Polisi: [blue]Berhenti! Kau ditangkap
atas beberapa kejahatan. Kau ikut\ldenganku.

entries.original:
"[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha!
Good luck trying!

As for you, punk kid, you did
alright beating my goons.

But you’ll find I’m not as much of
a weakling!

Let’s see what you got!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]G-Roughs: [color-blue-2]Hahaha! Good luck trying! As for you, punk kid, you did alright beating my goons. But you’ll find I’m not as much of a weakling! Let’s see what you got!
entries.translated:
[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha! Coba saja!
Sedangkan untukmu, anak punk, kau\llumayan bagus mengalahkan anak

buahku. Tapi kau akan lihat aku
bukanlah seorang lemah! Mari kita\llihat apa yang kau punya!

entries.original:
"Aargh!
How could you beat me?"
entries.translation_source: Aargh! How could you beat me?

entries.original:
"[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha!

Just because you beat me, it
doesn’t mean I’m turning myself in!

I’m hopping on the next boat to
East Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]G-Roughs: [color-blue-2]Hahaha! Just because you beat me, it doesn’t mean I’m turning myself in! I’m hopping on the next boat to East Borrius!
entries.translated:
[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha! Hanya karena kau
mengalahkanku, bukan berarti aku\lakan menyerahkan diri! Aku akan

naik kapal berikutnya ke East
Borrius!

entries.original:
"Thanks for all your help,
[player].

I’ll radio my colleagues in
Seaport City so he can’t escape\lthrough there.

Anyway, here’s a reward for a model
citizen such as yourself."
