entries.translation_source: Thanks for all your help, [player-name-1]. I’ll radio my colleagues in Seaport City so he can’t escape through there. Anyway, here’s a reward for a model citizen such as yourself.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih atas semua bantuanmu,
[player]. Aku akan menghubungi\lrekan-rekanku di Seaport City agar

dia tidak bisa melarikan diri lewat
sana. Bagaimanapun, ini hadiah\luntuk warga teladan sepertimu.

entries.original:
"I’m looking forward to solving more
cases with you in the future.

Until then, stay safe and be
vigilant."
entries.translation_source: I’m looking forward to solving more cases with you in the future. Until then, stay safe and be vigilant.
entries.translated:
Aku menantikan untuk memecahkan
lebih banyak kasus bersamamu di\lmasa depan. Sampai saat itu, tetap

aman dan waspada.

entries.original:
"I come here every day to pray to
Zapdos.

Zapdos saved me once, and I can
never thank it enough."
entries.translation_source: I come here every day to pray to Zapdos. Zapdos saved me once, and I can never thank it enough.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini setiap hari
untuk berdoa kepada Zapdos. Zapdos\lpernah menyelamatkanku, dan aku

tidak bisa cukup berterima kasih.

entries.original:
"We girls make Mel feel
better when he’s down."
entries.translation_source: We girls make Mel feel better when he’s down.
entries.translated:
Kami para gadis membuat Mel merasa
lebih baik saat dia sedih.

entries.original:
"I wonder if you’ll figure out the
way from here?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder if you’ll figure out the way from here?
entries.translated:
Aku penasaran apakah kau akan
menemukan jalan dari sini?

entries.original:
"Mel surrounds himself with as many
beautiful women as he can to\lalleviate the stress of the\lpounding waterfall behind him."
entries.translation_source: Mel surrounds himself with as many beautiful women as he can to alleviate the stress of the pounding waterfall behind him.
entries.translated:
Mel mengelilingi dirinya dengan
sebanyak mungkin wanita cantik\luntuk mengurangi stres dari air

terjun yang menderu di belakangnya.

entries.original:
"I may not be a woman, but I’m still
part of Mel’s fighting force!"
entries.translation_source: I may not be a woman, but I’m still part of Mel’s fighting force!
entries.translated:
Aku mungkin bukan seorang wanita,
tapi aku masih bagian dari pasukan\ltempur Mel!

entries.original:
"You’re pretty powerful, I’m
impressed!

You should make a career change and
join our club.

\.

What\.not interested?

Then at least take this!"
entries.translation_source: You’re pretty powerful, I’m impressed! You should make a career change and join our club. [game-token-1] What[game-token-2]not interested? Then at least take this!
entries.translated:
Kamu cukup kuat, aku terkesan! Kamu
harus ganti karier dan bergabung\ldengan klub kami. \. Apa\.tidak

tertarik? Kalau begitu setidaknya
ambil ini!

entries.original:
"We have plenty of Ice Gems here at
the Skiers Club.

They always stick to the bottoms of
our skis!"
entries.translation_source: We have plenty of Ice Gems here at the Skiers Club. They always stick to the bottoms of our skis!
entries.translated:
Kami punya banyak Permata Es di
sini di Klub Ski. Mereka selalu\lmenempel di bagian bawah ski kami!

entries.original:
"I’ve watched over this port ever
since the once glorious Antisis\lCity stood proud\.

This port is all that remains of
that city\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve watched over this port ever since the once glorious Antisis City stood proud[game-token-1] This port is all that remains of that city[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku telah menjaga pelabuhan ini
sejak Antisis City yang dulunya\lgemilang berdiri dengan bangga\.

Pelabuhan ini adalah satu-satunya
yang tersisa dari kota itu\.

entries.original:
"Do you plan on exploring Thundercap
Mountain?

If you do, you’re going to need
these!"
entries.translation_source: Do you plan on exploring Thundercap Mountain? If you do, you’re going to need these!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu berencana menjelajahi
Gunung Thundercap? Jika iya, kamu\lakan membutuhkan ini!

entries.original:
"It never hurt to be prepared for
anything!"
entries.translation_source: It never hurt to be prepared for anything!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada salahnya bersiap untuk
apa pun!

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mountain is a dangerous
place!

I tried exploring it once, but oh
boy, I got smoked!

Ever since then, my lovely wife has
been giving Max Repels to any\ltravellers who talk to her."
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mountain is a dangerous place! I tried exploring it once, but oh boy, I got smoked! Ever since then, my lovely wife has been giving Max Repels to any travellers who talk to her.
entries.translated:
Gunung Thundercap adalah tempat
yang berbahaya! Aku pernah mencoba\lmenjelajahinya, tapi wah, aku

dibuat babak belur! Sejak saat itu,
istriku yang manis memberikan Max\lRepel kepada setiap pengelana yang

berbicara dengannya.

entries.original:
"These boulders have been placed so
strategically!

It’s almost as if someone doesn’t
want people going this way\lright now\."
entries.translation_source: These boulders have been placed so strategically! It’s almost as if someone doesn’t want people going this way right now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Batu-batu besar ini ditempatkan
dengan sangat strategis! Sepertinya\lseseorang tidak ingin orang-orang

lewat sini saat ini\.

entries.original:
"Strength lets you move giant
boulders with raw power!

But only if you have the Fall
Badge from the Fallshore Gym!

Huah!"
entries.translation_source: Strength lets you move giant boulders with raw power! But only if you have the Fall Badge from the Fallshore Gym! Huah!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan memungkinkanmu memindahkan
batu-batu besar dengan kekuatan\lmentah! Tapi hanya jika kamu

memiliki Lencana Fall dari
Fallshore Gym! Huah!

entries.original: "[player] found one Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] found one Master Ball!
entries.translated:
[player] menemukan satu Master
Ball!

entries.original:
"Thief! Put that back!
That’s my prized possesion!"
entries.translation_source: Thief! Put that back! That’s my prized possesion!
entries.translated:
Maling! Kembalikan itu! Itu milikku
yang berharga!

entries.original:
"Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis
Port is mainly used for the import\lof goods from other regions.

Once dropped off here, the goods
are moved along to Fallshore City\lwhere they can be distributed\lacross Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis Port is mainly used for the import of goods from other regions. Once dropped off here, the goods are moved along to Fallshore City where they can be distributed across Borrius.
entries.translated:
Tidak seperti Seaport City,
Pelabuhan Antisis terutama\ldigunakan untuk impor barang dari

daerah lain. Setelah diturunkan di
sini, barang-barang dipindahkan ke\lFallshore City untuk

didistribusikan ke seluruh Borrius.

entries.original:
"The yellow barricades are moved
routinely throughout the day to\lcorrespond to the arrivals of\ldifferent shipments.

If you want to get to an area
that’s blocked off, you’ll just\lhave to come back later."
entries.translation_source: The yellow barricades are moved routinely throughout the day to correspond to the arrivals of different shipments. If you want to get to an area that’s blocked off, you’ll just have to come back later.
entries.translated:
Barikade kuning dipindahkan secara
rutin sepanjang hari sesuai dengan\lkedatangan kiriman yang berbeda.

Jika kamu ingin mencapai area yang
diblokir, kamu harus kembali lagi\lnanti.

entries.original:
"Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies
to Fallshore City during the day.

It’s too dangerous to move them
through Antisis City, which is why\lthis job exists."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies to Fallshore City during the day. It’s too dangerous to move them through Antisis City, which is why this job exists.
entries.translated:
Ya, akulah orang yang memindahkan
persediaan ke Fallshore City pada\lsiang hari. Terlalu berbahaya untuk

memindahkannya melalui Antisis
City, makanya pekerjaan ini ada.

entries.original:
"Ya know what’s not fair?

That I have to go through a
rigourous screenin’ process just to\lbe let onto the port so I can work\levery day!

If it weren’t for those lunkheads in
Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be\lan issue."
entries.translation_source: Ya know what’s not fair? That I have to go through a rigourous screenin’ process just to be let onto the port so I can work every day! If it weren’t for those lunkheads in Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be an issue.
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu apa yang tidak adil?
Bahwa aku harus melalui proses\lpenyaringan yang ketat hanya untuk

diizinkan masuk ke pelabuhan agar
aku bisa bekerja setiap hari! Jika\lbukan karena orang-orang bodoh di

Antisis City, ini bahkan tidak akan
menjadi masalah.

entries.original:
"You know the Pokémon Miltank?
That big adorable pink cow?

I’ve always wanted one, but they’re
just so hard to catch!

Would you be willing to trade one
for my [buffer2]?"
entries.translation_source: You know the Pokémon Miltank? That big adorable pink cow? I’ve always wanted one, but they’re just so hard to catch! Would you be willing to trade one for my [buffer2-1]?
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu Pokémon Miltank? Sapi
merah muda besar yang menggemaskan\litu? Aku selalu menginginkannya,

tapi susah banget ditangkap! Apakah
kamu bersedia menukar satu dengan\l[buffer2] milikku?

entries.original:
"Thank you so much! I’m going to
take good care of it!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you so much! I’m going to take good care of it!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih banyak! Aku akan
merawatnya dengan baik!

entries.original:
"I was taking inventory for the
berry shipments this morning, and\las usual, we have a surplus.

Why don’t you take a berry?"
entries.translation_source: I was taking inventory for the berry shipments this morning, and as usual, we have a surplus. Why don’t you take a berry?
entries.translated:
Aku sedang mencatat inventaris
untuk kiriman buah beri pagi ini,\ldan seperti biasa, kita punya

kelebihan. Kenapa kamu tidak
mengambil satu buah beri?

entries.original:
"Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency
to send a few extra berries.

There may be some more in
tomorrow’s shipment too.

I wonder how they don’t lose
money\."
entries.translation_source: Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency to send a few extra berries. There may be some more in tomorrow’s shipment too. I wonder how they don’t lose money[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tropius Berries Inc. cenderung
mengirim beberapa buah beri ekstra.\lMungkin ada lagi di kiriman besok.

Aku heran bagaimana mereka tidak
rugi\.

entries.original:
"Night deliveries are by far better
than day deliveries.

Why?

For starters, there’s less ocean
traffic!"
entries.translation_source: Night deliveries are by far better than day deliveries. Why? For starters, there’s less ocean traffic!
entries.translated:
Pengiriman malam hari jauh lebih
baik daripada pengiriman siang\lhari. Kenapa? Pertama, lalu lintas

laut lebih sedikit!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Lava Cookie[blue] before?

If you take it, you won’t need a
Burn Heal!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [color-green-1]Lava Cookie[color-blue-2] before? If you take it, you won’t need a Burn Heal!
entries.translated:
Kamu pernah mencoba [green]Lava Cookie[blue]?
Jika kamu memakannya, kamu tidak\lakan butuh Obat Luka Bakar!

entries.original:
"Pardon me\.

Would you care for an [green]Old Gateau[blue]?

Oui, oui, yes, you would."
entries.translation_source: Pardon me[game-token-1] Would you care for an [color-green-2]Old Gateau[color-blue-3]? Oui, oui, yes, you would.
entries.translated:
Maaf\. Apakah kamu mau [green]Old Gateau[blue]?
Oui, oui, ya, kamu pasti mau.

entries.original:
"Quick!

Take a [green]Casteliacone[blue] before it
melts!"
entries.translation_source: Quick! Take a [color-green-1]Casteliacone[color-blue-2] before it melts!
entries.translated:
Cepat! Ambil [green]Casteliacone[blue] sebelum
meleleh!

entries.original:
"The city of lights and biscuits\.

Have this token of Lumiose City,
the [green]Lumiose Galette[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The city of lights and biscuits[game-token-1] Have this token of Lumiose City, the [color-green-2]Lumiose Galette[color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Kota lampu dan biskuit\. Ambil token
dari Lumiose City ini, [green]Lumiose\lGalette[blue].

entries.original:
"The fact that you battled me, means
that you’re going the right way."
entries.translation_source: The fact that you battled me, means that you’re going the right way.
entries.translated:
Fakta bahwa kamu bertarung
denganku, berarti kamu sedang\lmenuju jalan yang benar.

entries.original: "5F: Medicine Box"
entries.translation_source: 5F: Medicine Box
entries.translated: 5F: Kotak Obat

entries.original:
"Feel the power of Mega Evolution
when you bite into this [green]Shalour\lSable[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Feel the power of Mega Evolution when you bite into this [color-green-1]Shalour Sable[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Rasakan kekuatan Mega Evolution
saat kamu menggigit [green]Shalour Sable[blue]\lini!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Big Malasada[blue]
before?

I hear it’s really good for the
heart.

Try some, straight from the Alola
region!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [color-green-1]Big Malasada[color-blue-2] before? I hear it’s really good for the heart. Try some, straight from the Alola region!
entries.translated:
Kamu pernah mencoba [green]Big Malasada[blue]?
Kudengar itu sangat baik untuk\ljantung. Coba, langsung dari region

Alola!

entries.original:
"Feed the [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon with a status condition.

It’ll get all better, just like
that!"
entries.translation_source: Feed the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] to a Pokémon with a status condition. It’ll get all better, just like that!
entries.translated:
Beri [green][buffer1][blue] pada Pokémon yang
memiliki kondisi status. Pokémon\litu akan sembuh total, begitu saja!

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local
shipments today.

If you come by any other day of the
week, I may have souvenirs from\lvarious regions to give out."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local shipments today. If you come by any other day of the week, I may have souvenirs from various regions to give out.
entries.translated:
Maaf, nak, aku hanya membawa
kiriman lokal hari ini. Jika kamu\ldatang di hari lain, mungkin aku

punya oleh-oleh dari berbagai
region untuk dibagikan.

entries.original:
"Yawn\.
These early morning are rough\.

I don’t know how you Borrian folk
do it\."
entries.translation_source: Yawn[game-token-1] These early morning are rough[game-token-2] I don’t know how you Borrian folk do it[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Menguap\. Pagi-pagi begini berat\. Aku
tidak tahu bagaimana kalian orang\lBorrian melakukannya\.

entries.original:
"I’ve got a shipment for one\.uh\.
Swomoli?

Man\.these names are hard to read
sometimes."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got a shipment for one[game-token-1]uh[game-token-2] Swomoli? Man[game-token-3]these names are hard to read sometimes.
entries.translated:
Aku punya kiriman untuk satu\.uh\.
Swomoli? Astaga\.nama-nama ini kadang\lsusah dibaca.

entries.original:
"A fresh batch of [green]Premier Balls[blue] has
just arrived!

Why don’t you take a few?
They’ll never notice\."
entries.translation_source: A fresh batch of [color-green-1]Premier Balls[color-blue-2] has just arrived! Why don’t you take a few? They’ll never notice[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Satu kiriman baru [green]Premier Ball[blue] baru
saja tiba! Kenapa kamu tidak ambil\lbeberapa? Mereka tidak akan sadar\.

entries.original:
"I’ve always advocated for a smaller
Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio.

Ten to one? Are you kidding me?
Who even buys ten Poké Balls?"
entries.translation_source: I’ve always advocated for a smaller Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio. Ten to one? Are you kidding me? Who even buys ten Poké Balls?
entries.translated:
Aku selalu menganjurkan rasio Poké
Ball yang lebih kecil ke Premier\lBall. Sepuluh banding satu? Apa

kamu bercanda? Siapa yang membeli
sepuluh Poké Ball?

entries.original:
"My [green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon!

I train them to smash the
[green]challenge rock[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: My [color-green-1]Fighting[color-blue-2]-type Pokémon! I train them to smash the [color-green-3]challenge rock[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Pokémon tipe [green]Fighting[blue]-ku! Aku
melatih mereka untuk menghancurkan\l[green]batu tantangan[blue]!

entries.original:
"Okay, then!

Abra, use teleport!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, then! Abra, use teleport!
entries.translated:
Oke, kalau begitu! Abra, gunakan
Teleport!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind,
come back.

We’ll be sitting here."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind, come back. We’ll be sitting here.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berubah pikiran, kembali
lagi. Kami akan duduk di sini.

entries.original:
"There’s been this locked house near
[green]Tarmigan Mansion[red] for a really long\ltime.

I think it was once a small inn for
visitors of this town.

But it closed down after the guests
started suffering from horrendous\lnightmares."
entries.translation_source: There’s been this locked house near [color-green-1]Tarmigan Mansion[color-red-2] for a really long time. I think it was once a small inn for visitors of this town. But it closed down after the guests started suffering from horrendous nightmares.
entries.translated:
Sudah lama ada rumah terkunci di
dekat [green]Tarmigan Mansion[red]. Kurasa dulu\litu adalah penginapan kecil untuk

pengunjung kota ini. Tapi tutup
setelah para tamu mulai menderita\lmimpi buruk yang mengerikan.

entries.original:
"Those are some hot hands ya got
there, fella!

You wannem to burn up with fiery
power?

I can teach your Pokémon [green]Fire
Punch[blue] for just [green]2 [buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Those are some hot hands ya got there, fella! You wannem to burn up with fiery power? I can teach your Pokémon [color-green-1]Fire Punch[color-blue-2] for just [color-green-3]2 [buffer1-4]s[color-blue-5]!
entries.translated:
Tangan panas sekali yang kamu
punya, bung! Kamu mau mereka\lterbakar dengan kekuatan api? Aku

bisa mengajari Pokémon-mu [green]Fire
Punch[blue] hanya dengan [green]2 [buffer1][blue]!

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon is raring to fire up
their hands with [green]Fire Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is raring to fire up their hands with [color-green-1]Fire Punch[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang bersemangat untuk
menyalakan tangannya dengan [green]Fire\lPunch[blue]?

entries.original: "Fire power!"
entries.translation_source: Fire power!
entries.translated: Kekuatan api!

entries.original:
"Fizzle\.
You don’t have enough [green][buffer1]s[blue].

I can’t burn up those hands for
nothing\."
entries.translation_source: Fizzle[game-token-1] You don’t have enough [color-green-2][buffer1-3]s[color-blue-4]. I can’t burn up those hands for nothing[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Gagal\. Kamu tidak punya cukup
[green][buffer1][blue]. Aku tidak bisa membakar\ltangan-tangan itu untuk apa-apa\.

entries.original:
"Listen up, youngster.

That swindler over there is
constantly extorting [green]Red Shards[blue]\lfrom youngsters, like yourself.

Here, I stole a couple from his
collection for you to enjoy."
entries.translation_source: Listen up, youngster. That swindler over there is constantly extorting [color-green-1]Red Shards[color-blue-2] from youngsters, like yourself. Here, I stole a couple from his collection for you to enjoy.
entries.translated:
Dengarkan, anak muda. Penipu di
sana terus-menerus memeras [green]Red\lShards[blue] dari anak-anak muda, seperti

dirimu. Ini, aku mencuri beberapa
dari koleksinya untukmu nikmati.

entries.original:
"I hold by the principle that it is
permitted to steal from thieves."
entries.translation_source: I hold by the principle that it is permitted to steal from thieves.
entries.translated:
Saya berpegang pada prinsip bahwa
diperbolehkan mencuri dari pencuri.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should learn
[green]Thunder Punch[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should learn [color-green-1]Thunder Punch[color-red-2]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang seharusnya
mempelajari [green]Thunder Punch[red]?

entries.original:
"The door is tightly shut.
It appears impossible to open."
entries.translation_source: The door is tightly shut. It appears impossible to open.
entries.translated:
Pintunya tertutup rapat. Tampaknya
tidak mungkin dibuka.

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Inn\.
The text is too faded to read."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Inn[game-token-1] The text is too faded to read.
entries.translated:
Pengarapan Tarmigan\. Teksnya terlalu
pudar untuk dibaca.

entries.original: "It’s an ordinary statue."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ordinary statue.
entries.translated: Itu patung biasa.

entries.original:
"It’s a book detailing various
aspects of Mega Evolution."
entries.translation_source: It’s a book detailing various aspects of Mega Evolution.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah buku yang menjelaskan
berbagai aspek Mega Evolution.

entries.original:
"Rumour has it, if you can fight
your way through this mansion, you\lcan learn the valuable art of\lMega Evolution."
entries.translation_source: Rumour has it, if you can fight your way through this mansion, you can learn the valuable art of Mega Evolution.
entries.translated:
Ada rumor, jika kamu bisa bertarung
melewati mansion ini, kamu bisa\lmempelajari seni berharga dari Mega

Evolution.

entries.original:
"Somewhere in this house resides
Successor Maxima.

If you find you her, she’ll give
you something special."
entries.translation_source: Somewhere in this house resides Successor Maxima. If you find you her, she’ll give you something special.
entries.translated:
Di suatu tempat di rumah ini
tinggal Penerus Maxima. Jika kamu\lmenemukannya, dia akan memberikan

sesuatu yang istimewa.

entries.original:
"A switch is hidden in one of the
statues in the Mansion.

If you manage to find it, it will
open up a new passageway."
entries.translation_source: A switch is hidden in one of the statues in the Mansion. If you manage to find it, it will open up a new passageway.
entries.translated:
Sebuah saklar tersembunyi di salah
satu patung di Mansion. Jika kamu\lberhasil menemukannya, itu akan

membuka jalan baru.

entries.original:
"As chefs, it is our sworn duty to
prepare the finest quality food for\lthe master of this mansion.

That being Successor Maxima of
course."
entries.translation_source: As chefs, it is our sworn duty to prepare the finest quality food for the master of this mansion. That being Successor Maxima of course.
entries.translated:
Sebagai koki, tugas sumpah kami
adalah menyiapkan makanan kualitas\lterbaik untuk tuan mansion ini.

Yakni Penerus Maxima tentunya.

entries.original:
"I got stuck on dishes duty\.
What a drag\."
entries.translation_source: I got stuck on dishes duty[game-token-1] What a drag[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku terjebak tugas cuci piring\.
Menyebalkan\.

entries.original:
"I’m cooking a meal fit for a king!
It’s called \qoBidoof Roussir.\qo"
entries.translation_source: I’m cooking a meal fit for a king! It’s called [quote-open-1]Bidoof Roussir.[quote-open-2]
entries.translated:
Aku memasak hidangan yang layak
untuk raja! Namanya \qoBidoof\lRoussir.\qo

entries.original:
"When I was kid, I started my own
cooking show.

It was called \qoCooking With Simon\qo,
or \qoCWS\qo for short."
entries.translation_source: When I was kid, I started my own cooking show. It was called [quote-open-1]Cooking With Simon[quote-open-2], or [quote-open-3]CWS[quote-open-4] for short.
entries.translated:
Saat saya kecil, saya memulai acara
memasak sendiri. Namanya \qoCooking\lWith Simon\qo, atau disingkat \qoCWS\qo.

entries.original:
"The Zap Badge let’s ya Surf over
both water and lava!

But not only that, any Pokémon
will also obey ya as long as it’s\lnot over level 70!

How electrifying is that?"
entries.translation_source: The Zap Badge let’s ya Surf over both water and lava! But not only that, any Pokémon will also obey ya as long as it’s not over level 70! How electrifying is that?
entries.translated:
Lencana Zap membuatmu bisa
Berselancar di atas air dan lava!\lTapi bukan hanya itu, Pokémon apa

pun juga akan menuruti perintahmu
selama levelnya tidak di atas 70!\lBetapa menggetarkan itu?

entries.original:
"Mega Evolution was first discovered
in the Kalos Region by the renowned\lProfessor Sycamore.

Thanks to his research, Pokémon
are now able to Mega Evolve\lmid-battle.

However, a large part of Mega
Evolution still remains a mystery."
entries.translation_source: Mega Evolution was first discovered in the Kalos Region by the renowned Professor Sycamore. Thanks to his research, Pokémon are now able to Mega Evolve mid-battle. However, a large part of Mega Evolution still remains a mystery.
entries.translated:
Mega Evolution pertama kali
ditemukan di Wilayah Kalos oleh\lProfesor Sycamore yang terkenal.

Berkat penelitiannya, Pokémon
sekarang bisa Mega Evolve di tengah\lpertempuran. Namun, sebagian besar

Mega Evolution masih menjadi
misteri.

entries.original:
"Child, where do you think
you’re going?"
entries.translation_source: Child, where do you think you’re going?

entries.original:
"To obtain the power of
Mega Evolution?"
entries.translation_source: To obtain the power of Mega Evolution?

entries.original:
"Remember this: power corrupts, and
absolute power corrupts absolutely.

The same can be said about
Mega Evolution.

Be careful."
entries.translation_source: Remember this: power corrupts, and absolute power corrupts absolutely. The same can be said about Mega Evolution. Be careful.
entries.translated:
Ingat ini: kekuasaan korupsi, dan
kekuasaan absolut korupsi absolut.\lHal yang sama dapat dikatakan

tentang Mega Evolution. Hati-hati.

entries.original:
"I need to grow even stronger to
surpass the others."
entries.translation_source: I need to grow even stronger to surpass the others.
entries.translated:
Aku perlu menjadi lebih kuat untuk
melampaui yang lain.

entries.original:
"I’d say this point in the challenge
is around the mid-point."
entries.translation_source: I’d say this point in the challenge is around the mid-point.
entries.translated:
Saya rasa titik dalam tantangan ini
sekitar pertengahan.

entries.original:
"How does it feel to know that your
opponents are growing stronger?"
entries.translation_source: How does it feel to know that your opponents are growing stronger?

entries.original: "It must sting, mustn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: It must sting, mustn’t it?

entries.original:
"You’d better hope you have enough
healing items."
entries.translation_source: You’d better hope you have enough healing items.
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya kau berharap memiliki
cukup item penyembuh.

entries.original:
"One day my dragons will soar high
in their Mega-Evolved forms!"
entries.translation_source: One day my dragons will soar high in their Mega-Evolved forms!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari naga-nagaku akan terbang
tinggi dalam bentuk Mega-Evolusi\lmereka!

entries.original:
"Unlike the other experts, I’m still
young and free!"
entries.translation_source: Unlike the other experts, I’m still young and free!
entries.translated:
Tidak seperti pakar lainnya, aku
masih muda dan bebas!

entries.original: "You won’t make it past here."
entries.translation_source: You won’t make it past here.

entries.original: "Proceed."
entries.translation_source: Proceed.

entries.original: "The end is nigh."
entries.translation_source: The end is nigh.
entries.translated: Akhir sudah dekat.

entries.original:
"Whenever you’re ready to face
Maxima, just walk off the ledge.

Don’t worry, it won’t hurt."
entries.translation_source: Whenever you’re ready to face Maxima, just walk off the ledge. Don’t worry, it won’t hurt.
entries.translated:
Kapan pun kau siap menghadapi
Maxima, pergilah dari tepian.\lJangan khawatir, tidak akan sakit.

entries.original:
"The Mega Ring lets you use the
power of Mega Evolution.

To access it, the Pokémon battling
must be holding its Mega Stone.

To Mega Evolve in battle, when you
see the Mega symbol appear, press\lthe Start Button.

Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve
and become even more powerful!

Just remember, you can only Mega
Evolve one Pokémon per battle.

The Mega Evolution’s effects will
wear off once the battle is over,\lso choose carefully.

I have faith that you’ll use this
Mega Ring to help benefit humanity.

Don’t let me down, [player].

I’m counting on you to make a
difference in the world."
entries.translation_source: The Mega Ring lets you use the power of Mega Evolution. To access it, the Pokémon battling must be holding its Mega Stone. To Mega Evolve in battle, when you see the Mega symbol appear, press the Start Button. Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve and become even more powerful! Just remember, you can only Mega Evolve one Pokémon per battle. The Mega Evolution’s effects will wear off once the battle is over, so choose carefully. I have faith that you’ll use this Mega Ring to help benefit humanity. Don’t let me down, [player-name-1]. I’m counting on you to make a difference in the world.
entries.translated:
Mega Ring memungkinkanmu
menggunakan kekuatan Mega Evolusi.\lUntuk mengaksesnya, Pokémon yang

bertarung harus memegang Mega
Stone-nya. Untuk Mega Berevolusi\ldalam pertarungan, saat melihat

simbol Mega muncul, tekan Tombol
Start. Pokémonmu kemudian akan Mega\lBerevolusi dan menjadi lebih kuat!

Ingat, kamu hanya bisa Mega
Berevolusi satu Pokémon per\lpertarungan. Efek Mega Evolusi akan

hilang setelah pertarungan selesai,
jadi pilihlah dengan hati-hati. Aku\lpercaya kamu akan menggunakan Mega

Ring ini untuk membantu
kemanusiaan. Jangan mengecewakanku,\l[player]. Aku mengandalkanmu untuk

membuat perbedaan di dunia.

entries.original:
"Hello there, trainer.
My name is Successor Maxima.

Making it through my mansion is no
easy feat.

There are so many ups and downs
even I get lost some times!

But in the end I always end up back
down here.

You’ve fought hard to get down
here and that is commendable.

Am I correct in assuming you’ve
come seeking the power of Mega\lEvolution?

\.\.\.

\.\.\.

I see\."
entries.translation_source: Hello there, trainer. My name is Successor Maxima. Making it through my mansion is no easy feat. There are so many ups and downs even I get lost some times! But in the end I always end up back down here. You’ve fought hard to get down here and that is commendable. Am I correct in assuming you’ve come seeking the power of Mega Evolution? [game-token-1][game-token-2][game-token-3] [game-token-4][game-token-5][game-token-6] I see[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Halo, trainer. Namaku Successor
Maxima. Melewati mansionku bukanlah\lhal yang mudah. Ada begitu banyak

naik turun bahkan aku sendiri
kadang tersesat! Tapi pada akhirnya\laku selalu kembali ke sini. Kamu

telah berjuang keras untuk sampai
ke sini dan itu patut dipuji. Apa\laku benar jika mengira kamu datang

mencari kekuatan Mega Evolusi? \.\.\. \.\.\.
Begitu rupanya\.

entries.original:
"Then if you want the power, you’ll
have to fight me for it!"
entries.translation_source: Then if you want the power, you’ll have to fight me for it!
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu jika kamu menginginkan
kekuatan itu, kamu harus bertarung\ldenganku untuk mendapatkannya!

entries.original: "Ughhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: Ughhhhh[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ughhhhh\.

entries.original: "It’s a challenge rock."
entries.translation_source: It’s a challenge rock.
entries.translated: Itu batu tantangan.

entries.original:
"Would you like to have [buffer1]
smash the rock?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to have [buffer1-1] smash the rock?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin [buffer1]
menghancurkan batu itu?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] tried to smash the
challenge rock.

A piece of the rock broke away!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] tried to smash the challenge rock. A piece of the rock broke away!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] mencoba menghancurkan batu
tantangan. Sepotong batu itu pecah!

entries.original:
"Be cautious, trainer!

You’re about to enter Antisis City!
A very dangerous place!

If you’re coming from there, well\.
this gate only really goes one way."
entries.translation_source: Be cautious, trainer! You’re about to enter Antisis City! A very dangerous place! If you’re coming from there, well[game-token-1] this gate only really goes one way.
entries.translated:
Berhati-hatilah, trainer! Kau akan
memasuki Antisis City! Tempat yang\lsangat berbahaya! Jika kau datang

dari sana, well\. gerbang ini hanya
bisa ke satu arah.

entries.original:
"A bunch of softies live on the
other side of this mountain!

I eat softies for breakfast!
Sofities like you!"
entries.translation_source: A bunch of softies live on the other side of this mountain! I eat softies for breakfast! Sofities like you!

entries.original: "I was eaten!"
entries.translation_source: I was eaten!

entries.original:
"Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy
Town and terrorize ’em, for fun.

But then that white-haired Gym
Leader always chases me away.

I give him such a headache\."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy Town and terrorize ’em, for fun. But then that white-haired Gym Leader always chases me away. I give him such a headache[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kadang-kadang aku berjalan ke
Epidimy Town dan meneror mereka,\luntuk bersenang-senang. Tapi

kemudian Pemimpin Gym berambut
putih itu selalu mengusirku. Aku\lmembuatnya pusing sekali\.

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt.
East Entrance

\ar Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. East Entrance [game-token-1] Antisis City
entries.translated:
Pintu Masuk Timur Gn. Thundercap \ar
Antisis City

entries.original:
"Would you like to return to the
[green]Ruins of Void[black]?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to return to the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-black-2]?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin kembali ke
[green]Reruntuhan Void[black]?

entries.original:
"Would you like to return to
[green]Dehara City[black]?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to return to [color-green-1]Dehara City[color-black-2]?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin kembali ke [green]Kota
Dehara[black]?

entries.original:
"Hello, there!

Do you happen to have one of those
rare [green]Ice-type [buffer1][blue]?

I’ve always had trouble getting my
hands on one.

If you do, would you agree to a
trade for my [green][buffer2][blue]?

It’s very useful against the Gym,
here."
entries.translation_source: Hello, there! Do you happen to have one of those rare [color-green-1]Ice-type [buffer1-2][color-blue-3]? I’ve always had trouble getting my hands on one. If you do, would you agree to a trade for my [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]? It’s very useful against the Gym, here.
entries.translated:
Halo! Apakah kamu kebetulan
memiliki salah satu [green]tipe Es\l[buffer1][blue] yang langka? Aku selalu

kesulitan mendapatkannya. Jika kamu
punya, maukah kamu bertukar dengan\l[green][buffer2][blue] milikku? Ini sangat

berguna melawan Gym di sini.

entries.original: "Many thanks."
entries.translation_source: Many thanks.
entries.translated: Terima kasih banyak.

entries.original:
"The [buffer2] that I traded you,
has it helped you out?"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer2-1] that I traded you, has it helped you out?
entries.translated:
Apakah [buffer2] yang saya tukarkan
kepadamu sudah membantumu?

entries.original: "Well, if you don’t want to\."
entries.translation_source: Well, if you don’t want to[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Yah, jika kamu tidak mau\..

entries.original:
"Hmmm?
This isn’t an [green]Ice-type [buffer1][blue].

Think of me if you get one."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm? This isn’t an [color-green-1]Ice-type [buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. Think of me if you get one.
entries.translated:
Hmmm? Ini bukan [green]tipe Es [buffer1][blue].
Pikirkan saya jika kamu mendapatkan\lsatu.

entries.original:
"We just undertook a major drug bust
and finally apprehended the\lcriminal responsible for selling\l[green]Oddish Leaves [blue]in Borrius!

Now we’re dancing here to
celebrate."
entries.translation_source: We just undertook a major drug bust and finally apprehended the criminal responsible for selling [color-green-1]Oddish Leaves [color-blue-2]in Borrius! Now we’re dancing here to celebrate.
entries.translated:
Kami baru saja melakukan
penggerebekan narkoba besar dan\lakhirnya menangkap penjahat yang

bertanggung jawab menjual [green]Daun
Oddish [blue]di Borrius! Sekarang kami\lmenari di sini untuk merayakan.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]\.one with the wind.
One with the snow.

A howling blizzard.

A world frozen.

Heed my call!

Articuno!

Sankren fimbulvetr!

Come to me!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1][game-token-2]one with the wind. One with the snow. A howling blizzard. A world frozen. Heed my call! Articuno! Sankren fimbulvetr! Come to me!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]\.satu dengan angin. Satu
dengan salju. Badai salju yang\lmenderu. Dunia yang membeku.

Dengarkan panggilanku! Articuno!
Sankren fimbulvetr! Datanglah\lpadaku!

entries.original:
"[blue]Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated: [blue]Prajurit Bayangan! Tahan dia!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to
become mine."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to become mine.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang, Articuno, saatnya kamu
menjadi milikku.

entries.original:
"[blue]The mission has been completed.

Now let’s report back to Zeph."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]The mission has been completed. Now let’s report back to Zeph.
entries.translated:
[blue]Misi telah selesai. Sekarang mari
kita laporkan kembali kepada Zeph.

entries.original:
"[blue]You again!

What are you doing here?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You again! What are you doing here?
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu lagi! Apa yang kamu lakukan di
sini?

entries.original:
"[blue]Grunts!

One of you, get rid of [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Grunts! One of you, get rid of [buffer1-2]!
entries.translated:
[blue]Prajurit! Salah satu dari kalian,
singkirkan [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[red]Don’t expect any mercy from
[black]The Shadows[red]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Don’t expect any mercy from [color-black-2]The Shadows[color-red-3]!
entries.translated:
[red]Jangan harapkan belas kasihan dari
[black]The Shadows[red]!

entries.original: "Squeal!"
entries.translation_source: Squeal!

entries.original:
"[red]It doesn’t matter.

I bought enough time for everyone
else to escape.

But nice try, kid.

Take this package as a consolation
prize.

We’ve taken what we needed from it."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]It doesn’t matter. I bought enough time for everyone else to escape. But nice try, kid. Take this package as a consolation prize. We’ve taken what we needed from it.
entries.translated:
[red]Tidak masalah. Aku mengulur waktu
yang cukup bagi yang lain untuk\lmelarikan diri. Tapi usaha yang

bagus, nak. Ambil paket ini sebagai
hadiah hiburan. Kami sudah\lmengambil apa yang kami butuhkan

darinya.

entries.original:
"I’m a lover of all things wings.

If you show me some beautiful wings
over the course of 4 different\ldays, I’ll share some of my\lbeautiful wings with you.

You wing it?"
entries.translation_source: I’m a lover of all things wings. If you show me some beautiful wings over the course of 4 different days, I’ll share some of my beautiful wings with you. You wing it?
entries.translated:
Aku adalah pencinta segala hal
tentang sayap. Jika kamu\lmenunjukkan padaku beberapa sayap

indah selama 4 hari berbeda, aku
akan berbagi beberapa sayap indahku\ldenganmu. Kamu bisa melakukannya?

entries.original:
"Wingderful!

For today, I’d like to see the
beautiful wings of a [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Wingderful! For today, I’d like to see the beautiful wings of a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Wingderful! Untuk hari ini, aku
ingin melihat sayap indah dari\lseekor [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original: "That wings."
entries.translation_source: That wings.
entries.translated: Sayap itu.

entries.original:
"Let’s see those beautiful
[green][buffer1][blue] wings!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s see those beautiful [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] wings!
entries.translated:
Mari kita lihat [green][buffer1][blue] sayap
indah itu!

entries.original: "Those are some mighty fine wings\."
entries.translation_source: Those are some mighty fine wings[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Itu adalah sayap yang sangat bagus\.

entries.original:
"What\.?

I can’t see those beautiful
[green][buffer1][blue] wings anywhere\."
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1]? I can’t see those beautiful [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] wings anywhere[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Apa\.? Saya tidak bisa melihat indah
[green][buffer1][blue] sayap-sayap itu di mana\lpun\.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice
[green][buffer1][blue] wings.

Just don’t bring them today.
I’m all winged out."
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] wings. Just don’t bring them today. I’m all winged out.
entries.translated:
Besok aku ingin melihat sayap
[green][buffer1][blue] yang bagus. Jangan bawa\lmereka hari ini. Aku sudah muak

dengan sayap.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice
[green][buffer2][blue] wings.

Just don’t bring them today.
I’m all winged out."
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] wings. Just don’t bring them today. I’m all winged out.
entries.translated:
Besok aku ingin melihat beberapa
[green][buffer2][blue] sayap yang bagus. Jangan\lbawa itu hari ini. Aku sudah muak

dengan sayap.

entries.original:
"Wingderful!

I’ve seen all those beautiful wings
I’ve never seen before!

As promised, I’d like to share my
wings with you!"
entries.translation_source: Wingderful! I’ve seen all those beautiful wings I’ve never seen before! As promised, I’d like to share my wings with you!
entries.translated:
Wingderful! Saya telah melihat
semua sayap indah yang belum pernah\lsaya lihat sebelumnya! Seperti yang

dijanjikan, saya ingin berbagi
sayap saya dengan Anda!

entries.original:
"After seeing all those beautiful
wings, I’m all winged out for life!"
entries.translation_source: After seeing all those beautiful wings, I’m all winged out for life!
entries.translated:
Setelah melihat semua sayap indah
itu, saya sudah cukup dengan sayap\luntuk seumur hidup!

entries.original:
"Oh heavens\.

My daughter, I can’t find her!

We were on holiday at the [green]beach[red],
when all of sudden, she vanished!

Please, [buffer1], search for her!"
entries.translation_source: Oh heavens[game-token-1] My daughter, I can’t find her! We were on holiday at the [color-green-2]beach[color-red-3], when all of sudden, she vanished! Please, [buffer1-4], search for her!
entries.translated:
Oh ya ampun\. Putri saya, saya tidak
bisa menemukannya! Kami sedang\lberlibur di [green]pantai[red], ketika

tiba-tiba, dia menghilang! Tolong,
[buffer1], carilah dia!

entries.original:
"Thank you, [buffer1]!

As appearances go, she resembles
any ordinary [green]female tuber[red]."
entries.translation_source: Thank you, [buffer1-1]! As appearances go, she resembles any ordinary [color-green-2]female tuber[color-red-3].
entries.translated:
Terima kasih, [buffer1]! Secara
penampilan, dia mirip dengan [green]female\ltuber[red] biasa.

entries.original:
"Oh, dear\.

What will I do now\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear[game-token-1] What will I do now[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Oh, sayang\. Apa yang akan saya
lakukan sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Pardon me?

You say my daughter was blown away
by a strong wind?

She cannot have been blown far!

Strong winds like those aren’t
powerful enough to carry a child\loutside of the city limits.

Please, continue to search for her!"
entries.translation_source: Pardon me? You say my daughter was blown away by a strong wind? She cannot have been blown far! Strong winds like those aren’t powerful enough to carry a child outside of the city limits. Please, continue to search for her!
entries.translated:
Maaf? Anda bilang putri saya
diterbangkan oleh angin kencang?\lDia tidak mungkin terbang jauh!

Angin kencang seperti itu tidak
cukup kuat untuk membawa seorang\lanak keluar dari batas kota.

Tolong, teruslah mencarinya!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

My mommy left me out here all
alone\.

I don’t think she cares about me
anymore\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] My mommy left me out here all alone[game-token-2] I don’t think she cares about me anymore[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Ibuku meninggalkanku di sini
sendirian\. Aku rasa dia tidak peduli\llagi padaku\.

entries.original:
"What’s that?

Did you say my mommy sent you to
find me?

Sniff\.

Maybe she really does care about
me\."
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Did you say my mommy sent you to find me? Sniff[game-token-1] Maybe she really does care about me[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Apa itu? Apakah kamu bilang ibuku
menyuruhmu mencariku? Hiks\. Mungkin\ldia benar-benar peduli padaku\.

entries.original:
"Okay\.

Please take me back to my mommy."
entries.translation_source: Okay[game-token-1] Please take me back to my mommy.
entries.translated:
Oke\. Tolong antar aku kembali ke
ibuku.

entries.original:
"The little girl appears to have
been blown away."
entries.translation_source: The little girl appears to have been blown away.
entries.translated:
Gadis kecil itu tampaknya telah
diterbangkan.

entries.original:
"Waaaah!

This big wind blew me all the way
out here!

Lemme hold onto you so I don’t blow
away, again!"
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! This big wind blew me all the way out here! Lemme hold onto you so I don’t blow away, again!
entries.translated:
Waaaah! Angin besar ini
menerbangkanku jauh ke sini!\lBiarkan aku berpegangan padamu agar

aku tidak terbang lagi!

entries.original:
"Waaaah!

That big wind blew me away again!

I’m scared now\.
I wanna go home\."
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! That big wind blew me away again! I’m scared now[game-token-1] I wanna go home[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Waaaah! Angin besar itu
menerbangkanku lagi! Aku takut\lsekarang\. Aku ingin pulang\.

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

I hate the wind\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] I hate the wind[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Hiks\. Aku benci angin\.

entries.original:
"Huh?

I’m not being blown away anymore\.

Yay!

It’s over!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? I’m not being blown away anymore[game-token-1] Yay! It’s over!
entries.translated:
Hah? Aku tidak diterbangkan lagi\.
Yay! Sudah selesai!

entries.original: "I’m\.so\.dizzy\."
entries.translation_source: I’m[game-token-1]so[game-token-2]dizzy[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Aku\.sangat\.pusing\.

entries.original:
"Mommy!
You found me!

I missed you so much!
I was so scared\.

This big bad wind kept blowing me
all over!

But I’m okay now, thanks to this
person!"
entries.translation_source: Mommy! You found me! I missed you so much! I was so scared[game-token-1] This big bad wind kept blowing me all over! But I’m okay now, thanks to this person!
entries.translated:
Ibu! Kamu menemukanku! Aku sangat
merindukanmu! Aku sangat takut\.\lAngin jahat besar ini terus

menerbangkanku ke mana-mana! Tapi
aku baik-baik saja sekarang, terima\lkasih kepada orang ini!

entries.original:
"I wanna go home now, Mommy.
I’m really dizzy\."
entries.translation_source: I wanna go home now, Mommy. I’m really dizzy[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku ingin pulang sekarang, Bu. Aku
benar-benar pusing\.

entries.original: "Mommy, wait!"
entries.translation_source: Mommy, wait!
entries.translated: Ibu, tunggu!

entries.original:
"We forgot to give a gift to the
[buffer1] who helped me!"
entries.translation_source: We forgot to give a gift to the [buffer1-1] who helped me!
entries.translated:
Kita lupa memberikan hadiah kepada
[buffer1] yang membantuku!

entries.original:
"Mommy\.

What happened to you\.?"
entries.translation_source: Mommy[game-token-1] What happened to you[game-token-2]?
entries.translated: Ibu\. Apa yang terjadi padamu\.?

entries.original:
"Aye, I do deliveries from the
Antisis Port during the day.

Without me, there’d be no
Fallshore Market!"
entries.translation_source: Aye, I do deliveries from the Antisis Port during the day. Without me, there’d be no Fallshore Market!
entries.translated:
Ya, saya melakukan pengiriman dari
Pelabuhan Antisis pada siang hari.\lTanpa saya, tidak akan ada Pasar

Fallshore!

entries.original:
"Aye, I just finished delivering
goods to all the Poké Marts.

Soon, I’ll be heading back to
Antisis City for the night."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I just finished delivering goods to all the Poké Marts. Soon, I’ll be heading back to Antisis City for the night.
entries.translated:
Ya, saya baru saja selesai mengirim
barang ke semua Poké Mart. Sebentar\llagi, saya akan kembali ke Kota

Antisis untuk malam hari.

entries.original:
"But it looks like I have some
leftover items.

How about instead of tossing ’em, I
let you have ’em!"
entries.translation_source: But it looks like I have some leftover items. How about instead of tossing ’em, I let you have ’em!
entries.translated:
Tapi sepertinya saya punya beberapa
barang sisa. Bagaimana kalau\ldaripada membuangnya, saya berikan

padamu!

entries.original:
"Hoo boy, Trainer!

I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m
wondering if you can help me out.

I got to this island by digging
up from a hidden tunnel, but my\lGraveler forgot Dig when it\llearned a new move.

Now I’m stuck here with no way off
this island.

Can you help me get back home?"
entries.translation_source: Hoo boy, Trainer! I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m wondering if you can help me out. I got to this island by digging up from a hidden tunnel, but my Graveler forgot Dig when it learned a new move. Now I’m stuck here with no way off this island. Can you help me get back home?
entries.translated:
Wah, Trainer! Saya sedikit dalam
masalah, dan saya ingin tahu apakah\lAnda bisa membantu saya. Saya

sampai di pulau ini dengan menggali
dari terowongan tersembunyi, tapi\lGraveler saya lupa Dig saat

mempelajari jurus baru. Sekarang
saya terjebak di sini tanpa jalan\lkeluar dari pulau ini. Bisakah Anda

membantu saya pulang?

entries.original:
"Awesome!

All you need is a Pokemon that
knows [green]Dig[blue].

Do you have one with you?"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! All you need is a Pokemon that knows [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]. Do you have one with you?
entries.translated:
Hebat! Yang Anda butuhkan hanyalah
Pokemon yang tahu [green]Dig[blue]. Apakah Anda\lpunya satu bersama Anda?

entries.original:
"Amazing!

The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re
ready to go into the tunnel.

There is no going back until you
reach the other exit."
entries.translation_source: Amazing! The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re ready to go into the tunnel. There is no going back until you reach the other exit.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Hal terakhir yang akan
saya tanyakan adalah apakah Anda\lsiap untuk masuk ke terowongan.

Tidak ada jalan kembali sampai Anda
mencapai pintu keluar lainnya.

entries.original:
"I’m going to challenge you to a
battle before we go.

I need to be sure you’re strong
enough to survive down there."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to challenge you to a battle before we go. I need to be sure you’re strong enough to survive down there.
entries.translated:
Saya akan menantang Anda bertarung
sebelum kita pergi. Saya perlu\lmemastikan Anda cukup kuat untuk

bertahan di sana.

entries.original:
"Alrighty, let’s go!
Use Dig!"
entries.translation_source: Alrighty, let’s go! Use Dig!
entries.translated: Baiklah, ayo pergi! Gunakan Dig!

entries.original:
"What are you getting at?
None of your Pokemon know [green]Dig[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: What are you getting at? None of your Pokemon know [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Apa maksudmu? Tidak ada Pokemon
Anda yang tahu [green]Dig[blue]!

entries.original:
"No?

Well I hope the rising tide won’t
drown me\."
entries.translation_source: No? Well I hope the rising tide won’t drown me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tidak? Yah, saya harap pasang naik
tidak akan menenggelamkan saya\.

entries.original:
"No?

[green]Sandshrew[blue] and [green]Sandslash[blue] in the
[green]Great Desert[blue] usually know Dig."
entries.translation_source: No? [color-green-1]Sandshrew[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Sandslash[color-blue-4] in the [color-green-5]Great Desert[color-blue-6] usually know Dig.
entries.translated:
Tidak? [green]Sandshrew[blue] dan [green]Sandslash[blue] di
[green]Great Desert[blue] biasanya tahu Dig.

entries.original:
"It’s just a tunnel, what’s there
to be scared about?"
entries.translation_source: It’s just a tunnel, what’s there to be scared about?
entries.translated:
Ini hanya terowongan, apa yang
perlu ditakutkan?

entries.original:
"Well, we’re here!
The Lost Tunnel\.

It’s rather dank in here\.
It’s also really dark.

I don’t think even a Pokemon could
light it up.

Well, we’d better get going!

There’s a ladder up, somewhere
around here.

I’ll keep you healed up after
every battle."
entries.translation_source: Well, we’re here! The Lost Tunnel[game-token-1] It’s rather dank in here[game-token-2] It’s also really dark. I don’t think even a Pokemon could light it up. Well, we’d better get going! There’s a ladder up, somewhere around here. I’ll keep you healed up after every battle.
entries.translated:
Yah, kita sampai! Lost Tunnel\. Agak
lembab di sini\. Juga sangat gelap.\lSaya pikir bahkan Pokemon pun tidak

bisa meneranginya. Yah, sebaiknya
kita berangkat! Ada tangga di atas,\ldi suatu tempat di sekitar sini.

Saya akan menyembuhkanmu setelah
setiap pertarungan.

entries.original:
"Yo, I ain’t done yet!

Take this TM too!"
entries.translation_source: Yo, I ain’t done yet! Take this TM too!
entries.translated:
Yo, saya belum selesai! Ambil TM
ini juga!

entries.original:
"TM92 is [green]Volt Switch[blue]!

It lets you switch out when you’re
at a disadvantage!

Shows your enemies what you’re
made of!"
entries.translation_source: TM92 is [color-green-1]Volt Switch[color-blue-2]! It lets you switch out when you’re at a disadvantage! Shows your enemies what you’re made of!
entries.translated:
TM92 adalah [green]Volt Switch[blue]! Ini
memungkinkanmu untuk bertukar saat\lkamu dalam posisi tidak

menguntungkan! Tunjukkan pada
musuhmu siapa dirimu!

entries.original:
"Don’t let anything stand in your
way, [player]!

And never let any disadvantage hold
you back from realizing your goals!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let anything stand in your way, [player-name-1]! And never let any disadvantage hold you back from realizing your goals!
entries.translated:
Jangan biarkan apa pun menghalangi
jalanmu, [player]! Dan jangan\lpernah biarkan kerugian apa pun

menghalangimu untuk mewujudkan
tujuanmu!

entries.original:
"What?
An earthquake? Now?"
entries.translation_source: What? An earthquake? Now?
entries.translated: Apa? Gempa bumi? Sekarang?

entries.original:
"Wow, you wiped the floor with
that Diglett!

Have you ever wondered what a
Diglett’s feet look like?"
entries.translation_source: Wow, you wiped the floor with that Diglett! Have you ever wondered what a Diglett’s feet look like?
entries.translated:
Wow, kamu benar-benar mengalahkan
Diglett itu! Pernahkah kamu\lbertanya-tanya seperti apa bentuk

kaki Diglett?

entries.original:
"Again?
I hope no rocks fall on me\."
entries.translation_source: Again? I hope no rocks fall on me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Lagi? Saya harap tidak ada batu
yang jatuh menimpa saya\.

entries.original:
"That was a tough Golem!

I wonder if it would get along
with my Graveler\."
entries.translation_source: That was a tough Golem! I wonder if it would get along with my Graveler[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Golem yang tangguh! Saya ingin tahu
apakah ia akan akur dengan Graveler\lsaya\.

entries.original:
"A third time?
This can’t be a coincidence!"
entries.translation_source: A third time? This can’t be a coincidence!
entries.translated:
Ketiga kalinya? Ini pasti bukan
kebetulan!

entries.original:
"Phew, that was a tough battle!
I’m tired just from watching!

But now that you took out that
Dugtrio, the tremors should stop."
entries.translation_source: Phew, that was a tough battle! I’m tired just from watching! But now that you took out that Dugtrio, the tremors should stop.
entries.translated:
Fiuh, pertarungan yang sulit! Aku
saja lelah hanya dengan menonton!\lTapi sekarang setelah kamu

mengalahkan Dugtrio itu, gempa bumi
seharusnya berhenti.

entries.original:
"There’s the ladder!

I thought we would be stuck here
forever\.

Let’s get out of here."
entries.translation_source: There’s the ladder! I thought we would be stuck here forever[game-token-1] Let’s get out of here.
entries.translated:
Itu tangganya! Kupikir kita akan
terjebak di sini selamanya\. Ayo\lkeluar dari sini.

entries.original:
"What? A dead end!

I’m sure there’s a way out of
here\."
entries.translation_source: What? A dead end! I’m sure there’s a way out of here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Apa? Jalan buntu! Aku yakin ada
jalan keluar dari sini\.

entries.original: "Let me see\."
entries.translation_source: Let me see[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Biarkan aku lihat\.

entries.original:
"Aha! Found it!

A weak spot in the wall, right
here."
entries.translation_source: Aha! Found it! A weak spot in the wall, right here.
entries.translated:
Aha! Ketemu! Titik lemah di
dinding, tepat di sini.

entries.original: "Graveler, use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Graveler, use Rock Smash!
entries.translated: Graveler, gunakan Pukulan Batu!

entries.original:
"[red]Now, Moltres, it’s time for you to
become ours."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Now, Moltres, it’s time for you to become ours.
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang, Moltres, saatnya kau
menjadi milik kami.

entries.original:
"Thanks for all your help!
Here, take this TM.

I forgot I had it this whole
time."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for all your help! Here, take this TM. I forgot I had it this whole time.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih atas semua bantuanmu!
Ini, ambil TM ini. Aku lupa aku\lmemilikinya selama ini.

entries.original:
"TM28 contains [green]Dig[blue].

We should have just used it right
away, eh?"
entries.translation_source: TM28 contains [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]. We should have just used it right away, eh?
entries.translated:
TM28 berisi [green]Gali[blue]. Seharusnya kita
langsung menggunakannya, ya?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]If Ivory is unable, then
Houndoom and I will have to show\lyou the meaning of pain ourselves!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]If Ivory is unable, then Houndoom and I will have to show you the meaning of pain ourselves!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Jika Ivory tidak mampu, maka
Houndoom dan aku harus menunjukkan\lsendiri arti rasa sakit kepadamu!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Zeph, I really don’t think
you should\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Zeph, I really don’t think you should[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Zeph, aku benar-benar tidak
berpikir kamu seharusnya\.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]Silence, Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Silence, Ivory!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Diam, Ivory!

entries.original: "[blue]Time to suffer!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Time to suffer!
entries.translated: [blue]Waktunya menderita!

entries.original:
"[blue]Enjoy your victory while you can,
because you’re about to leave this\lworld.

It’s too risky to leave you alive
at this point."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Enjoy your victory while you can, because you’re about to leave this world. It’s too risky to leave you alive at this point.
entries.translated:
[blue]Nikmati kemenanganmu selagi bisa,
karena kamu akan meninggalkan dunia\lini. Terlalu berisiko membiarkanmu

hidup pada titik ini.

entries.original:
"[blue]Houndoom!

Incinerate!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Houndoom! Incinerate!
entries.translated: [blue]Houndoom! Bakar Habis!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Wait!

Houndoom!
Pull back!

Something’s happening!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Wait! Houndoom! Pull back! Something’s happening!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Tunggu! Houndoom! Mundur!
Sesuatu terjadi!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Grunts!

Grab [buffer1] now before [buffer2] gets away!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Grunts! Grab [buffer1-2] now before [buffer2-3] gets away!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Para Grunt! Tangkap [buffer1]
sekarang sebelum [buffer2] kabur!

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

If that ain’t the darndest thing
I ever did see!

A [buffer1] coming outta some magic
portal!

Where’d ya come from, [buffer1]?

\.

What’s that?

Ya were tryin’ to get to
Thundercap Mt. when all of a\lsudden ya were kidnapped!

Hoooo weeee!

That sure sounds scary, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! If that ain’t the darndest thing I ever did see! A [buffer1-1] coming outta some magic portal! Where’d ya come from, [buffer1-2]? [game-token-3] What’s that? Ya were tryin’ to get to Thundercap Mt. when all of a sudden ya were kidnapped! Hoooo weeee! That sure sounds scary, [buffer1-4].
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Kalau itu bukan hal
paling aneh yang pernah kulihat!\lSeekor [buffer1] keluar dari portal

ajaib! Dari mana asalmu, [buffer1]? \.
Apa itu? Kamu sedang mencoba pergi\lke Gn. Thundercap ketika tiba-tiba

kamu diculik! Hoooo weeee! Itu
pasti terdengar menakutkan,\l[buffer1].

entries.original:
"Well, if ya hadn’t been kidnapped,
ya’d be havin’ a lot less trouble\lgettin’ to Thundercap Mt.

Ya see, part of the ceiling
collapsed not long ago and\lblocked off the road!

And unless ya have the HM for [green]Rock
Smash[blue], you’ll be in a bit of a\lpickle gettin’ through ’em.

But\.

I’m guessin’ ya don’t or ya
wouldn’t still be talkin’ to me.

In thatta case, a friend of mine in
[green]Blizzard City[blue] can help ya out by\lgiving ya Rock Smash.

So, take this HM to help yurself
get to him."
entries.translation_source: Well, if ya hadn’t been kidnapped, ya’d be havin’ a lot less trouble gettin’ to Thundercap Mt. Ya see, part of the ceiling collapsed not long ago and blocked off the road! And unless ya have the HM for [color-green-1]Rock Smash[color-blue-2], you’ll be in a bit of a pickle gettin’ through ’em. But[game-token-3] I’m guessin’ ya don’t or ya wouldn’t still be talkin’ to me. In thatta case, a friend of mine in [color-green-4]Blizzard City[color-blue-5] can help ya out by giving ya Rock Smash. So, take this HM to help yurself get to him.
entries.translated:
Nah, jika kamu tidak diculik, kamu
akan mengalami lebih sedikit\lmasalah untuk sampai ke Gn.

Thundercap. Soalnya, sebagian
langit-langit runtuh belum lama ini\ldan menutup jalan! Dan kecuali kamu

memiliki HM untuk [green]Pukulan Batu[blue],
kamu akan sedikit kesulitan\lmelewatinya. Tapi\. aku tebak kamu

tidak punya atau kamu tidak akan
masih berbicara denganku. Dalam hal\litu, seorang temanku di [green]Blizzard

City[blue] dapat membantumu dengan
memberimu Pukulan Batu. Jadi, ambil\lHM ini untuk membantu dirimu

sendiri sampai kepadanya.

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

Looks like ya made contact with my
friend.

Now go over to those rocks and give
’em a good smashin’!"
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! Looks like ya made contact with my friend. Now go over to those rocks and give ’em a good smashin’!
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Sepertinya kamu sudah
menghubungi temanku. Sekarang\lpergilah ke batu-batu itu dan

hancurkan mereka dengan baik!

entries.original:
"Use [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of that pesky
tree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Use [color-green-1]Cut[color-blue-2] to get rid of that pesky tree blocking [color-green-3]Valley Cave[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Gunakan [green]Cut[blue] untuk menyingkirkan
pohon nakal yang menghalangi [green]Valley\lCave[blue].

entries.original:
"Mel: [blue]This is your final warning.
Move or be moved."
entries.translation_source: Mel: [color-blue-1]This is your final warning. Move or be moved.
entries.translated:
Mel: [blue]Ini peringatan terakhirmu.
Bergerak atau digerakkan.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I refuse to abandon my post.

I must prevent [player] from entering
Thundercap Mountain at all cost."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]I refuse to abandon my post. I must prevent [player-name-2] from entering Thundercap Mountain at all cost.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Saya menolak meninggalkan
pos saya. Saya harus mencegah\l[player] memasuki Thundercap

Mountain dengan segala cara.

entries.original:
"Mel: [blue]I don’t have time for this
right now.

My head is pounding and I have a
Gym to run."
entries.translation_source: Mel: [color-blue-1]I don’t have time for this right now. My head is pounding and I have a Gym to run.
entries.translated:
Mel: [blue]Saya tidak punya waktu untuk
ini sekarang. Kepala saya\lberdenyut-denyut dan saya punya Gym

untuk diurus.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Arghhhhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Arghhhhhhh[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Arghhhhhhh\.

entries.original:
"[blue]You can handle the rest from here
[player].

Whatever they’re up to, they
obviously don’t want you\linterfering.

So go nuts."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You can handle the rest from here [player-name-2]. Whatever they’re up to, they obviously don’t want you interfering. So go nuts.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu bisa menangani sisanya dari
sini [player]. Apa pun yang mereka\lrencanakan, jelas mereka tidak

ingin kamu ikut campur. Jadi,
berbuat sesukamu.

entries.original: "[buffer1], use [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1], use [buffer2-2]!
entries.translated: [buffer1], gunakan [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Owww\.
My head\."
entries.translation_source: Owww[game-token-1] My head[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Aduh\. Kepalaku\.

entries.original: "STOP!"
entries.translation_source: STOP!
entries.translated: BERHENTI!

entries.original:
"I can’t let you through!

If you get past me, I’ll be burned
alive!

You’re not getting any farther!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t let you through! If you get past me, I’ll be burned alive! You’re not getting any farther!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa membiarkanmu lewat!
Jika kamu melewatiku, aku akan\ldibakar hidup-hidup! Kamu tidak

akan melangkah lebih jauh!

entries.original:
"What’s that?

Ya don’t know what an HM is?

Hoooo weeee!

Well, an [green]HM[blue], or Hidden Machine, is
a special type of move a Pokémon\lcan learn to bypass obstacles.

When a Pokémon learns an HM, as
long as it takes a [green]single step[blue]\lknowin’ that move, it can keep\lusin’ that move in the field, even\lif it can’t in battle!

In other words, [green]yur Pokémon don’t
need to know the HM to use it[blue].

Ain’t that convenient!

Anyways, use that HM for [green]Cut[blue] to get
rid of that pesky tree blocking\l[green]Valley Cave[blue].

Then head on up to [green]Blizzard City[blue] to
get [green]Rock Smash[blue] from my friend.

Best of luck on yur quest!"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Ya don’t know what an HM is? Hoooo weeee! Well, an [color-green-1]HM[color-blue-2], or Hidden Machine, is a special type of move a Pokémon can learn to bypass obstacles. When a Pokémon learns an HM, as long as it takes a [color-green-3]single step[color-blue-4] knowin’ that move, it can keep usin’ that move in the field, even if it can’t in battle! In other words, [color-green-5]yur Pokémon don’t need to know the HM to use it[color-blue-6]. Ain’t that convenient! Anyways, use that HM for [color-green-7]Cut[color-blue-8] to get rid of that pesky tree blocking [color-green-9]Valley Cave[color-blue-10]. Then head on up to [color-green-11]Blizzard City[color-blue-12] to get [color-green-13]Rock Smash[color-blue-14] from my friend. Best of luck on yur quest!
entries.translated:
Apa itu? Kamu tidak tahu apa itu
HM? Hoooo weeee! Nah, [green]HM[blue], atau\lHidden Machine, adalah jenis

gerakan khusus yang bisa dipelajari
Pokémon untuk melewati rintangan.\lKetika seekor Pokémon mempelajari

HM, selama ia mengambil [green]satu
langkah[blue] mengetahui gerakan itu, ia\ldapat terus menggunakan gerakan itu

di lapangan, meskipun tidak bisa
dalam pertempuran! Dengan kata\llain, [green]Pokémon-mu tidak perlu tahu

HM untuk menggunakannya[blue]. Bukankah
itu praktis! Pokoknya, gunakan HM\litu untuk [green]Cut[blue] untuk menyingkirkan

pohon nakal yang menghalangi [green]Valley
Cave[blue]. Lalu pergilah ke [green]Blizzard\lCity[blue] untuk mendapatkan [green]Rock Smash[blue]

dari temanku. Semoga berhasil dalam
petualanganmu!

entries.original:
"ÚÚ
As proof of your victory at the
Crater Town Gym, take the\l[green]Darkness Badge[blue]."
entries.translation_source: ÚÚ As proof of your victory at the Crater Town Gym, take the [color-green-1]Darkness Badge[color-blue-2].

entries.original:
"Come on\.

I really need your help.
Please\."
entries.translation_source: Come on[game-token-1] I really need your help. Please[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ayolah\. Aku sangat butuh bantuanmu.
Tolong\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Houndoom!

Zeph gave you to me to fulfill one
purpose!

Incinerate this old fool!"
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Houndoom! Zeph gave you to me to fulfill one purpose! Incinerate this old fool!
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Houndoom! Zeph memberikanku
kepadamu untuk memenuhi satu\ltujuan! Bakar habis orang bodoh tua

ini!

entries.original:
"Wife: [red]NOOOOOO!

You killed him you vile scum!"
entries.translation_source: Wife: [color-red-1]NOOOOOO! You killed him you vile scum!
entries.translated:
Istri: [red]TIDAAAAAAAAK! Kamu
membunuhnya, dasar sampah keji!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Incinerate her also,
Houndoom.

We have no more use for her."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Incinerate her also, Houndoom. We have no more use for her.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Bakar habis dia juga,
Houndoom. Kita tidak ada gunanya\llagi untuknya.

entries.original:
"Have you ever been in the SES
Expressway?

It’s an undergound highway that
goes all around Borrius.

It a real backpacker’s paradise!"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever been in the SES Expressway? It’s an undergound highway that goes all around Borrius. It a real backpacker’s paradise!
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu berada di SES
Expressway? Itu adalah jalan raya\lbawah tanah yang mengelilingi

seluruh Borrius. Ini benar-benar
surga para backpacker!

entries.original:
"I heard that there’s someone in
Tarmigan Town that teaches the art\lof Mega Evolution!"
entries.translation_source: I heard that there’s someone in Tarmigan Town that teaches the art of Mega Evolution!
entries.translated:
Kudengar ada seseorang di Tarmigan
Town yang mengajarkan seni Mega\lEvolution!

entries.original:
"Did you come up here to obtain the
power of [green]Mega Evolution[blue] from\l[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]?

Most people who come here are
usually after it.

All this town has to offer
otherwise, is horrific nightmares."
entries.translation_source: Did you come up here to obtain the power of [color-green-1]Mega Evolution[color-blue-2] from [color-green-3]Tarmigan Mansion[color-blue-4]? Most people who come here are usually after it. All this town has to offer otherwise, is horrific nightmares.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu datang ke sini untuk
mendapatkan kekuatan [green]Mega Evolution[blue]\ldari [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]? Kebanyakan

orang yang datang ke sini biasanya
mencarinya. Selain itu, kota ini\lhanya menawarkan mimpi buruk yang

mengerikan.

entries.original:
"Hi [player]!

I can show you your Pokémon’s
specific EVs and IVs if you want."
entries.translation_source: Hi [player-name-1]! I can show you your Pokémon’s specific EVs and IVs if you want.
entries.translated:
Hai [player]! Aku bisa menunjukkan
EVs dan IVs spesifik Pokémon-mu\ljika kamu mau.

entries.original:
"Feel free to come back and see them
any time."
entries.translation_source: Feel free to come back and see them any time.
entries.translated:
Jangan ragu untuk kembali dan
melihatnya kapan saja.

entries.original:
"Well if you change your mind let me
know.

I’ll be happy to show you."
entries.translation_source: Well if you change your mind let me know. I’ll be happy to show you.
entries.translated:
Kalau kamu berubah pikiran, beri
tahu aku. Aku akan dengan senang\lhati menunjukkannya padamu.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]At long last, the final
piece of the puzzle is ours."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]At long last, the final piece of the puzzle is ours.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Akhirnya, bagian terakhir
dari teka-teki ini milik kita.

entries.original:
"[blue]One with thunder, one with
lightning.

A fierce storm.

A world paralyzed.

Heed my call!

Zapdos!

Sankren thoron!

I command you!

Come forth from the stormy clouds
in which you dwell!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]One with thunder, one with lightning. A fierce storm. A world paralyzed. Heed my call! Zapdos! Sankren thoron! I command you! Come forth from the stormy clouds in which you dwell!
entries.translated:
[blue]Yang satu dengan guntur, yang satu
dengan kilat. Badai yang dahsyat.\lDunia yang lumpuh. Dengarkan

panggilanku! Zapdos! Sankren
thoron! Aku perintahkan kau! Muncul\ldari awan badai tempat kau tinggal!

entries.original: "[blue]Now, Zapdos, you will become\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now, Zapdos, you will become[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [blue]Sekarang, Zapdos, kau akan menjadi\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]It just disintigrated
him\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]It just disintigrated him[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Itu baru saja
menghancurkannya\.

entries.original:
"[blue]All remaining grunts and Shadow
Warriors, restrain Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]All remaining grunts and Shadow Warriors, restrain Zapdos!
entries.translated:
[blue]Semua grenin dan Shadow Warriors
yang tersisa, tahan Zapdos!

entries.original: "[blue]They were wiped out by Discharge\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]They were wiped out by Discharge[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [blue]Mereka habis oleh Discharge\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Well, Zapdos, you leave me no
choice\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Well, Zapdos, you leave me no choice[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Yah, Zapdos, kau tidak meninggalkan
pilihan lain\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Heh\.
Nice try, Zapdos.

But I don’t fall as easily as the
grunts."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Heh[game-token-2] Nice try, Zapdos. But I don’t fall as easily as the grunts.
entries.translated:
[blue]Heh\. Percobaan yang bagus, Zapdos.
Tapi aku tidak jatuh semudah para\lgrenin.

entries.original: "[blue]Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!
entries.translated: [blue]Krookodile! Gunakan Stone Edge!

entries.original: "A critical hit!"
entries.translation_source: A critical hit!
entries.translated: Serangan kritis!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you to
become mine."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you to become mine.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang, Zapdos, saatnya kau
menjadi milikku.

entries.original:
"[blue]That took a lot longer than
expected."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]That took a lot longer than expected.
entries.translated:
[blue]Itu memakan waktu lebih lama dari
yang diperkirakan.

entries.original:
"[blue]It’s finally time to head to the
[green]Ruins of Void[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It’s finally time to head to the [color-green-2]Ruins of Void[color-blue-3][game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]Akhirnya saatnya menuju ke [green]Ruins of
Void[blue]\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I had countless guards stationed to
prevent you from showing up!

I even had the stairs destroyed!

How did you manage to get past all
of it\.?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I had countless guards stationed to prevent you from showing up! I even had the stairs destroyed! How did you manage to get past all of it[game-token-2]?
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku menempatkan banyak penjaga
untuk mencegahmu muncul! Bahkan aku\lmenghancurkan tangga! Bagaimana

caramu bisa melewati semua itu\.?

entries.original:
"[blue]Eh, It doesn’t matter anymore.
We’ve already won.

Zapdos now belongs to me.

And with this new power, I’ll
finally succeed in wiping you out!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Eh, It doesn’t matter anymore. We’ve already won. Zapdos now belongs to me. And with this new power, I’ll finally succeed in wiping you out!
entries.translated:
[blue]Eh, itu tidak penting lagi. Kita
sudah menang. Zapdos sekarang\lmilikku. Dan dengan kekuatan baru

ini, aku akhirnya akan berhasil
memusnahkan kalian!

entries.original:
"It doesn’t matter if I lose here.
We’ve already won."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t matter if I lose here. We’ve already won.

entries.original: "Stop! How’d you get past the guard?"
entries.translation_source: Stop! How’d you get past the guard?

entries.original: "I’m guessing the guard failed."
entries.translation_source: I’m guessing the guard failed.

entries.original:
"I can only imagine the horrors
Zeph will instill on him\."
entries.translation_source: I can only imagine the horrors Zeph will instill on him[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku hanya bisa membayangkan
kengerian yang akan ditimpakan Zeph\lpadanya\.

entries.original:
"There is only one way to free the
Pokémon.

But I’m not telling you what it is!"
entries.translation_source: There is only one way to free the Pokémon. But I’m not telling you what it is!
entries.translated:
Hanya ada satu cara untuk
membebaskan Pokémon. Tapi aku tidak\lakan memberitahumu apa itu!

entries.original:
"One of us has a key to release
the Pokémon.

But I’m not telling you who has it."
entries.translation_source: One of us has a key to release the Pokémon. But I’m not telling you who has it.
entries.translated:
Salah satu dari kami memiliki kunci
untuk membebaskan Pokémon. Tapi aku\ltidak akan memberitahumu siapa yang

memilikinya.

entries.original:
"I’ve blown up the stairs so nothing
can interrupt the procedure."
entries.translation_source: I’ve blown up the stairs so nothing can interrupt the procedure.
entries.translated:
