Aku telah meledakkan tangga
sehingga tidak ada yang bisa\lmengganggu prosedur ini.

entries.original:
"I have the key to free the
Pokémon!

But you’re not getting it!"
entries.translation_source: I have the key to free the Pokémon! But you’re not getting it!
entries.translated:
Aku memiliki kunci untuk
membebaskan Pokémon! Tapi kau tidak\lakan mendapatkannya!

entries.original: "Here, just take it!"
entries.translation_source: Here, just take it!

entries.original:
"The other grunts are gonna kill
me\."
entries.translation_source: The other grunts are gonna kill me[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Para grunt lainnya akan membunuhku\.

entries.original:
"There appear to be some Pokémon
sealed behind an electric barrier."
entries.translation_source: There appear to be some Pokémon sealed behind an electric barrier.
entries.translated:
Tampaknya ada beberapa Pokémon yang
tersegel di balik penghalang\llistrik.

entries.original:
"Would you like to disengage the
barrier and free them?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to disengage the barrier and free them?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin melepaskan
penghalang dan membebaskan mereka?

entries.original: "[player] disengaged the barrier!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] disengaged the barrier!
entries.translated: [player] melepaskan penghalang!

entries.original:
"The captive Pokémon have escaped
back into the wild."
entries.translation_source: The captive Pokémon have escaped back into the wild.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang ditawan telah
melarikan diri kembali ke alam\lliar.

entries.original:
"You never cease to impress me,
[player].

But take a word of advice: don’t
follow me.

If you keep your head out of other
people’s business, you won’t get\lhurt.

It’s better to stay safe than to
try to play the hero\."
entries.translation_source: You never cease to impress me, [player-name-1]. But take a word of advice: don’t follow me. If you keep your head out of other people’s business, you won’t get hurt. It’s better to stay safe than to try to play the hero[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Kau tidak pernah berhenti membuatku
terkesan, [player]. Tapi ambil\lsaran: jangan ikuti aku. Jika kau

tidak ikut campur urusan orang
lain, kau tidak akan terluka. Lebih\lbaik tetap aman daripada mencoba

menjadi pahlawan\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

What are you doing here?

Are you trying to complete your
Pokédex?

\.

So you’re trying to get Rock Smash
in order to stop The Shadows\.

Well while you’ve been running
around playing hero, I’ve gotten\lmuch more powerful.

You don’t even stand a chance
against me any more.

In fact, I’ll demonstrate my might,
here and now!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! What are you doing here? Are you trying to complete your Pokédex? [game-token-2] So you’re trying to get Rock Smash in order to stop The Shadows[game-token-3] Well while you’ve been running around playing hero, I’ve gotten much more powerful. You don’t even stand a chance against me any more. In fact, I’ll demonstrate my might, here and now!
entries.translated:
[player]! Apa yang kau lakukan di
sini? Apakah kau mencoba\lmenyelesaikan Pokédex-mu? \. Jadi kau

mencoba mendapatkan Palu Penghancur
untuk menghentikan The Shadows\. Nah,\lselagi kau berlarian berperan

sebagai pahlawan, aku sudah menjadi
jauh lebih kuat. Kau bahkan tidak\lpunya kesempatan lagi melawanku.

Bahkan, aku akan menunjukkan
kekuatanku, di sini dan sekarang!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]And just in case [rival] is
following me\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]And just in case [text-token-rival-2] is following me[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Dan untuk jaga-jaga [rival]
mengikutiku\.

entries.original:
"[red]As for you, [player], I’m not going
to kill you yet.

You need to be made into an example
for anyone who is foolish enough to\lbelieve that they can take on The\lShadows.

I’m going to do what both Marlon
and Zeph have failed to do.

It’s time to meet your end in
battle!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]As for you, [player-name-2], I’m not going to kill you yet. You need to be made into an example for anyone who is foolish enough to believe that they can take on The Shadows. I’m going to do what both Marlon and Zeph have failed to do. It’s time to meet your end in battle!
entries.translated:
[red]Untukmu, [player], aku belum akan
membunuhmu. Kau harus dijadikan\lcontoh bagi siapa pun yang cukup

bodoh untuk percaya bahwa mereka
bisa melawan The Shadows. Aku akan\lmelakukan apa yang gagal dilakukan

Marlon dan Zeph. Saatnya untuk
menemui akhirmu dalam pertempuran!

entries.original: "This is disappointing."
entries.translation_source: This is disappointing.

entries.original:
"[red]\.

I may have failed as well, but
we’re not done here, yet!

Houndoom!

I want [buffer1] ashes to stain the floor
black!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1][game-token-2] I may have failed as well, but we’re not done here, yet! Houndoom! I want [buffer1-3] ashes to stain the floor black!
entries.translated:
[red]\. Aku mungkin juga gagal, tapi kita
belum selesai di sini! Houndoom!\lAku ingin abu [buffer1] menodai

lantai hitam!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Houndoom!

Do it now, before [buffer2] gets
away again!"
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Houndoom! Do it now, before [buffer2-2] gets away again!
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Houndoom! Lakukan sekarang,
sebelum [buffer2] kabur lagi!

entries.original:
"Actually, that guy over there is my
only friend now\."
entries.translation_source: Actually, that guy over there is my only friend now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, pria di sana adalah
satu-satunya temanku sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Do you know what frustrates me the
most about this?

The police won’t even do anything
about them, because they refuse to\lbelieve me that some shadowy\lorganization even exists!

They still treat me like a kid,
despite what I’ve accomplished\.

Argh\."
entries.translation_source: Do you know what frustrates me the most about this? The police won’t even do anything about them, because they refuse to believe me that some shadowy organization even exists! They still treat me like a kid, despite what I’ve accomplished[game-token-1] Argh[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Tahukah kau apa yang paling
membuatku frustrasi tentang ini?\lPolisi bahkan tidak akan melakukan

apa pun terhadap mereka, karena
mereka menolak percaya padaku bahwa\lorganisasi bayangan itu ada! Mereka

masih memperlakukanku seperti anak
kecil, meskipun apa yang telah aku\lcapai\. Argh\.

entries.original:
"Wait\.

I remember now\.

There is someone I can contact for
help after all\."
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1] I remember now[game-token-2] There is someone I can contact for help after all[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tunggu\. Aku ingat sekarang\. Ada
seseorang yang bisa kuhubungi untuk\lmeminta bantuan ternyata\.

entries.original:
"While I’m doing that, you should be
heading to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

The move [green]Strength[blue] is needed to go
anywhere inside, so you’ll need to\lbeat the [green]Fallshore Gym[blue] first.

I think I saw the Gym Leader
standing around in [green]Tehl Town[blue],\lactually\.

I’ll catch up with you again after
you rescue [green]Zapdos[blue]."
entries.translation_source: While I’m doing that, you should be heading to [color-green-1]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-2] The move [color-green-3]Strength[color-blue-4] is needed to go anywhere inside, so you’ll need to beat the [color-green-5]Fallshore Gym[color-blue-6] first. I think I saw the Gym Leader standing around in [color-green-7]Tehl Town[color-blue-8], actually[game-token-9] I’ll catch up with you again after you rescue [color-green-10]Zapdos[color-blue-11].
entries.translated:
Selagi aku melakukan itu, kau harus
menuju ke [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] Gerakan\l[green]Kekuatan[blue] diperlukan untuk pergi ke

mana pun di dalam, jadi kau harus
mengalahkan [green]Fallshore Gym[blue] terlebih\ldahulu. Kukira aku melihat Pemimpin

Gym berdiri di [green]Tehl Town[blue],
sebenarnya\. Aku akan menyusulmu lagi\lsetelah kau menyelamatkan [green]Zapdos[blue].

entries.original: "Let’s go, Starapator!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s go, Starapator!
entries.translated: Ayo pergi, Starapator!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon were very hard to
find.

They do not often appear in the
wild around here."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon were very hard to find. They do not often appear in the wild around here.

entries.original:
"It seems rarity does not indicate
exceptional strength."
entries.translation_source: It seems rarity does not indicate exceptional strength.

entries.original:
"My dream is to one day team up with
a Fighting-type trainer.

We will be called\.
\qoBrains & Brawn\qc."
entries.translation_source: My dream is to one day team up with a Fighting-type trainer. We will be called[game-token-1] [quote-open-2]Brains & Brawn[quote-close-3].
entries.translated:
Mimpiku adalah suatu hari bekerja
sama dengan pelatih tipe Fighting.\lKami akan dipanggil\. \qoBrains &

Brawn\qc.

entries.original:
"Notice the cliffs here\.

This is only place in West Borrius
where they’re this vertical!"
entries.translation_source: Notice the cliffs here[game-token-1] This is only place in West Borrius where they’re this vertical!

entries.original: "All the more fun to climb!"
entries.translation_source: All the more fun to climb!

entries.original:
"When I climb down the bluffs, I
find very interesting things hidden\lin the seashells on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: When I climb down the bluffs, I find very interesting things hidden in the seashells on the beach!
entries.translated:
Saat aku turun dari tebing, aku
menemukan hal-hal yang sangat\lmenarik tersembunyi di dalam

kerang-kerang di pantai!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon and I have been
running across Borrius.

We can take a kid Trainer like you!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon and I have been running across Borrius. We can take a kid Trainer like you!

entries.original:
"I guess we need to run less and
train more\."
entries.translation_source: I guess we need to run less and train more[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Huff\.Puff\.

Jogging and battling make a tiring
combo!"
entries.translation_source: Huff[game-token-1]Puff[game-token-2] Jogging and battling make a tiring combo!
entries.translated:
Huff\.Puff\. Joging dan bertarung
adalah kombinasi yang melelahkan!

entries.original:
"I trained my Zangoose and Seviper
to play together nicely!"
entries.translation_source: I trained my Zangoose and Seviper to play together nicely!
entries.translated:
Aku melatih Zangoose dan Seviper-ku
untuk bermain bersama dengan baik!

entries.original:
"I know there are bug Pokémon
around here!

One day I saw a huge [green]swarm[blue] of them
flying around!"
entries.translation_source: I know there are bug Pokémon around here! One day I saw a huge [color-green-1]swarm[color-blue-2] of them flying around!
entries.translated:
Aku tahu ada Pokémon serangga di
sekitar sini! Suatu hari aku\lmelihat [green]kawanan[blue] besar mereka

terbang kemana-mana!

entries.original:
"The more I run, the closer my
babies get to me!"
entries.translation_source: The more I run, the closer my babies get to me!

entries.original:
"Wah!

Now they’re not as close anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Wah! Now they’re not as close anymore!

entries.original:
"Thank you again for helping me
before!

My family and I had a great two day
feast because of your help.

Now it’s time to prepare for next
year’s feast!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you again for helping me before! My family and I had a great two day feast because of your help. Now it’s time to prepare for next year’s feast!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih lagi karena telah
membantuku sebelumnya! Aku dan\lkeluargaku mengadakan pesta besar

selama dua hari berkat bantuanmu.
Sekarang saatnya mempersiapkan\lpesta tahun depan!

entries.original:
"Cinder Volcano is dangerous.

If you don’t have your Pokémon to
protect you, you could die."
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano is dangerous. If you don’t have your Pokémon to protect you, you could die.
entries.translated:
Gunung Berapi Cinder berbahaya.
Jika kamu tidak memiliki Pokémon\luntuk melindungimu, kamu bisa mati.

entries.original:
"Never mind\.

You have enough."
entries.translation_source: Never mind[game-token-1] You have enough.
entries.translated: Sudahlah\. Kamu sudah cukup.

entries.original:
"One day my babies will use a
powerful Return and beat you up\lfor what you did to them!"
entries.translation_source: One day my babies will use a powerful Return and beat you up for what you did to them!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari anak-anakku akan
menggunakan Return yang kuat dan\lmenghajar kamu karena apa yang kamu

lakukan pada mereka!

entries.original:
"Well, well, well\.
If it isn’t [player]!

The boss told me not to let you
into Thundercap Mountain, so you\lcan’t interfere with our plans.

Even if I did let you in, you’d be
toast without the power of Mega\lEvolution.

So don’t you see?

You should stay out here for your
own good."
entries.translation_source: Well, well, well[game-token-1] If it isn’t [player-name-2]! The boss told me not to let you into Thundercap Mountain, so you can’t interfere with our plans. Even if I did let you in, you’d be toast without the power of Mega Evolution. So don’t you see? You should stay out here for your own good.
entries.translated:
Wah, wah, wah\. Kalau bukan [player]!
Bos menyuruhku untuk tidak\lmembiarkanmu masuk ke Gunung

Thundercap, jadi kamu tidak bisa
mengganggu rencana kami. Bahkan\ljika aku membiarkanmu masuk, kamu

akan hancur tanpa kekuatan Mega
Evolution. Jadi tidakkah kamu\llihat? Kamu sebaiknya tetap di sini

demi kebaikanmu sendiri.

entries.original:
"As per our arrangement, for
defeating me, take this Mega Ring."
entries.translation_source: As per our arrangement, for defeating me, take this Mega Ring.
entries.translated:
Sesuai kesepakatan kita, karena
telah mengalahkanku, ambillah Mega\lRing ini.

entries.original:
"[player] received the Mega Ring from
Successor Maxima!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received the Mega Ring from Successor Maxima!
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Mega Ring dari
Successor Maxima!

entries.original:
"[player] put the Mega Ring in the
Key Items Sector."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] put the Mega Ring in the Key Items Sector.
entries.translated:
[player] menaruh Mega Ring di
Sektor Key Items.

entries.original:
"Oh, one last thing.

Take this Mega Stone for the
Pokémon, Lucario, from me."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one last thing. Take this Mega Stone for the Pokémon, Lucario, from me.
entries.translated:
Oh, satu hal lagi. Ambillah Mega
Stone ini untuk Pokémon Lucario\ldariku.

entries.original:
"Sorry, it doesn’t look like you
have any space for my gift."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, it doesn’t look like you have any space for my gift.
entries.translated:
Maaf, sepertinya kamu tidak
memiliki ruang untuk hadiahku.

entries.original:
"I’m glad I caught up to you.

I just destroyed Successor Maxima.

Let me guess, you’ve also claimed
the power of Mega Evolution?"
entries.translation_source: I’m glad I caught up to you. I just destroyed Successor Maxima. Let me guess, you’ve also claimed the power of Mega Evolution?
entries.translated:
Aku senang bisa mengejarmu. Aku
baru saja menghancurkan Successor\lMaxima. Coba tebak, kamu juga telah

mengklaim kekuatan Mega Evolution?

entries.original:
"Of course you did, [player].

I’d expect nothing less from the
[buffer1] who beat me all those times.

Now, let’s see if you can still
beat me!"
entries.translation_source: Of course you did, [player-name-1]. I’d expect nothing less from the [buffer1-2] who beat me all those times. Now, let’s see if you can still beat me!
entries.translated:
Tentu saja kamu melakukannya,
[player]. Aku tidak mengharapkan\lkurang dari [buffer1] yang telah

mengalahkanku berkali-kali.
Sekarang, mari kita lihat apakah\lkamu masih bisa mengalahkanku!

entries.original:
"What are you saying, [player]?

I can clearly see that Mega Ring on
your finger!

Is it, maybe, you don’t know how
to use Mega Evolution?

Well, first you’ve gotta be able to
battle like this!"
entries.translation_source: What are you saying, [player-name-1]? I can clearly see that Mega Ring on your finger! Is it, maybe, you don’t know how to use Mega Evolution? Well, first you’ve gotta be able to battle like this!
entries.translated:
Apa yang kamu katakan, [player]?
Aku bisa melihat dengan jelas Mega\lRing di jarimu! Mungkin, kamu tidak

tahu cara menggunakan Mega
Evolution? Yah, pertama-tama kamu\lharus bisa bertarung seperti ini!

entries.original:
"That’s what I’d expect from a
wielder of Mega Evolution!"
entries.translation_source: That’s what I’d expect from a wielder of Mega Evolution!

entries.original:
"Nice job, [player].

For defeating me yet again, I want
you to take this."
entries.translation_source: Nice job, [player-name-1]. For defeating me yet again, I want you to take this.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, [player]. Karena telah
mengalahkanku lagi, aku ingin kamu\lmengambil ini.

entries.original:
"That old fart Log caught up with
me a while back.

He gave that to me, and said that I
should give it to you the next time\lwe crossed paths.

He gave me my own also, but he
knows I would’ve wrecked him if\lhe hadn’t\."
entries.translation_source: That old fart Log caught up with me a while back. He gave that to me, and said that I should give it to you the next time we crossed paths. He gave me my own also, but he knows I would’ve wrecked him if he hadn’t[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Orang tua Log itu mengejarku
beberapa waktu lalu. Dia memberikan\litu padaku, dan berkata bahwa aku

harus memberikannya padamu saat
kita bertemu lagi. Dia juga\lmemberikanku milikku sendiri, tapi

dia tahu aku akan menghancurkannya
jika dia tidak\.

entries.original:
"So, where are you going next,
[player]?

\.

Dehara City, huh?
I’m headed there too.

Log mentioned a guy over there who
knows how to cross water.

As you know, I’ve been looking for
my parents, and my research is\ltelling me that The Shadows were\linvolved in their disappearance.

I managed to track The Shadows to
the Ruins of Void, but I can’t get\lthere on foot or by flight yet.

If you need a way to ride the
waves too, you should find [green]Dehara\lCity’s surfing guy[blue].

See you later, [player]."
entries.translation_source: So, where are you going next, [player-name-1]? [game-token-2] Dehara City, huh? I’m headed there too. Log mentioned a guy over there who knows how to cross water. As you know, I’ve been looking for my parents, and my research is telling me that The Shadows were involved in their disappearance. I managed to track The Shadows to the Ruins of Void, but I can’t get there on foot or by flight yet. If you need a way to ride the waves too, you should find [color-green-3]Dehara City’s surfing guy[color-blue-4]. See you later, [player-name-5].
entries.translated:
Jadi, ke mana kamu selanjutnya,
[player]? \. Kota Dehara, ya? Aku\ljuga menuju ke sana. Log

menyebutkan seseorang di sana yang
tahu cara menyeberangi air. Seperti\lyang kamu tahu, aku sudah mencari

orang tuaku, dan penelitianku
mengatakan bahwa The Shadows\lterlibat dalam hilangnya mereka.

Aku berhasil melacak The Shadows ke
Reruntuhan Void, tapi aku belum\lbisa sampai ke sana dengan berjalan

kaki atau terbang. Jika kamu juga
butuh cara untuk menaiki ombak,\lkamu harus mencari [green]peselancar Kota

Dehara[blue]. Sampai jumpa, [player].

entries.original:
"Go make some more space in your Cube
for this Mega Stone."
entries.translation_source: Go make some more space in your Cube for this Mega Stone.
entries.translated:
Buatlah lebih banyak ruang di
Kubus-mu untuk Batu Mega ini.

entries.original:
"Did you make space in your Cube
for the Mega Stone?"
entries.translation_source: Did you make space in your Cube for the Mega Stone?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah membuat ruang di
Kubusmu untuk Batu Mega?

entries.original:
"My Malamar’s [green]Suction Cups[blue] ability
helps me reel in Pokémon!

At least, I think it has Suction
Cups\."
entries.translation_source: My Malamar’s [color-green-1]Suction Cups[color-blue-2] ability helps me reel in Pokémon! At least, I think it has Suction Cups[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Kemampuan [green]Piala Hisap[blue] milik
Malamar-ku membantu saya menarik\lPokémon! Setidaknya, saya pikir ia

memiliki Piala Hisap\.

entries.original: "It’s a seashell."
entries.translation_source: It’s a seashell.
entries.translated: Ini adalah kerang.

entries.original: "[blue]Derrrr!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Derrrr!
entries.translated: [blue]Derrrr!

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid!

A fight between some Zangoose and
Seviper took out the bridge.

It’ll take some time before we get
it fixed.

You should talk to our boss about
finding an alternative way to\lSeaport City in the meantime."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid! A fight between some Zangoose and Seviper took out the bridge. It’ll take some time before we get it fixed. You should talk to our boss about finding an alternative way to Seaport City in the meantime.
entries.translated:
Maaf, nak! Pertarungan antara
Zangoose dan Seviper menghancurkan\ljembatan. Butuh beberapa waktu

sebelum kami memperbaikinya.
Sementara itu, kamu harus bicara\ldengan bos kami untuk mencari jalan

alternatif menuju Seaport City.

entries.original:
"Oh, geez\.
Another trainer\.

Well, here you go."
entries.translation_source: Oh, geez[game-token-1] Another trainer[game-token-2] Well, here you go.
entries.translated:
Oh, astaga\. Pelatih lain\. Nah, ini
dia.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]It’s finally time for Zeph
to finish what he started.

He now has all three legendary
birds in his possesion.

All that’s left is for me to join
him at the Ruins of Void.

So why do I feel so much dread?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]It’s finally time for Zeph to finish what he started. He now has all three legendary birds in his possesion. All that’s left is for me to join him at the Ruins of Void. So why do I feel so much dread?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Akhirnya tiba saatnya bagi
Zeph untuk menyelesaikan apa yang\ldia mulai. Dia sekarang memiliki

ketiga burung legendaris dalam
kekuasaannya. Yang tersisa hanyalah\laku bergabung dengannya di

Reruntuhan Kekosongan. Jadi mengapa
aku merasa begitu cemas?

entries.original:
"[blue]No\.

I shouldn’t be feeling this way\.

Everything we’ve worked for is 
about to transpire.

I’ll even be able to see my son
again\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]No[game-token-2] I shouldn’t be feeling this way[game-token-3] Everything we’ve worked for is about to transpire. I’ll even be able to see my son again[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]Tidak\. Aku seharusnya tidak merasa
seperti ini\. Semua yang telah kita\lperjuangkan akan terwujud. Aku

bahkan akan bisa melihat putraku
lagi\.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Sorry, old man.

If you’re getting cold feet now,
you could be a big problem down\lthe road.

I can’t have anything standing in
the way of the unbinding.

Your son will just have to be
fatherless forever."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Sorry, old man. If you’re getting cold feet now, you could be a big problem down the road. I can’t have anything standing in the way of the unbinding. Your son will just have to be fatherless forever.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Maaf, pak tua. Jika kamu
mundur karena takut sekarang, kamu\lbisa menjadi masalah besar di

kemudian hari. Aku tidak bisa
membiarkan apapun menghalangi\lpembebasan. Putramu harus menjadi

yatim selamanya.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]What is this, Hoopa?

I asked you to summon me a powerful
Pokémon capable of flying us to\lthe Ruins of Void, and this is what\lyou give me?

Pathetic!

This Pokémon is just so\.so\.
so nebby!

A poor excuse for a legendary
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]What is this, Hoopa? I asked you to summon me a powerful Pokémon capable of flying us to the Ruins of Void, and this is what you give me? Pathetic! This Pokémon is just so[game-token-2]so[game-token-3] so nebby! A poor excuse for a legendary Pokémon.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Apa ini, Hoopa? Aku memintamu
untuk memanggilkan Pokémon kuat\lyang bisa terbang membawa kita ke

Reruntuhan Kekosongan, dan ini yang
kau berikan? Menyedihkan! Pokémon\lini sangat\.sangat\. sangat lemah!

Alasan yang buruk untuk disebut
Pokémon legendaris.

entries.original:
"[blue]Stay in the bag, you useless
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Stay in the bag, you useless Pokémon.
entries.translated:
[blue]Tetap di dalam tas, Pokémon yang
tidak berguna.

entries.original:
"[blue]I guess we have no choice but to
leave it here, Hoopa.

Maybe some lucky trainer will find
it and decide to train the useless\lthing."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I guess we have no choice but to leave it here, Hoopa. Maybe some lucky trainer will find it and decide to train the useless thing.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya kita tidak punya pilihan
selain meninggalkannya di sini,\lHoopa. Mungkin beberapa pelatih

beruntung akan menemukannya dan
memutuskan untuk melatih benda tak\lberguna itu.

entries.original:
"[blue]We don’t have any more time to
waste, Hoopa.

I know I didn’t want to go this
way, but I need you to send me\lthrough one of your rings to\lthe Ruins of Void.

I’ll go ahead, and since you can’t
travel through your own rings\lwithout a tether, latch onto my\lCube’s signal once I arrive there.

Just try to make it inconspicuous,
please.

I can’t have Zeph catching on to
our plan.

Don’t take too long, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]We don’t have any more time to waste, Hoopa. I know I didn’t want to go this way, but I need you to send me through one of your rings to the Ruins of Void. I’ll go ahead, and since you can’t travel through your own rings without a tether, latch onto my Cube’s signal once I arrive there. Just try to make it inconspicuous, please. I can’t have Zeph catching on to our plan. Don’t take too long, Hoopa.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kita tidak punya waktu lagi untuk
disia-siakan, Hoopa. Aku tahu aku\ltidak ingin melalui cara ini, tapi

aku perlu kau mengirimku melalui
salah satu cincinmu ke Ruins of\lVoid. Aku akan pergi duluan, dan

karena kau tidak bisa bepergian
melalui cincinmu sendiri tanpa\lpengikat, ikatlah sinyal Cube-ku

begitu aku tiba di sana. Cobalah
untuk membuatnya tidak mencolok,\lkumohon. Aku tidak bisa membiarkan

Zeph mengetahui rencana kita.
Jangan terlalu lama, Hoopa.

entries.original: "[green]Hoop!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoop!
entries.translated: [green]Hoop!

entries.original:
"There appears to be a Pokémon in
the bag.

Would you like to take it?"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be a Pokémon in the bag. Would you like to take it?
entries.translated:
Sepertinya ada Pokémon di dalam
tas. Apakah Anda ingin\lmengambilnya?

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough space for
this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough space for this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak punya cukup ruang untuk
Pokémon ini.

entries.original: "You found a [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: You found a [buffer1-1]!

entries.original:
"This mountain pass has a very
unique layout.

It descends slowly, but then dips
suddenly!"
entries.translation_source: This mountain pass has a very unique layout. It descends slowly, but then dips suddenly!
entries.translated:
Jalur gunung ini memiliki tata
letak yang sangat unik. Ia menurun\lperlahan, tetapi kemudian tiba-tiba

menurun tajam!

entries.original:
"Some man in a red hood was pushed
into the ocean.

He hasn’t resurfaced yet, either\."
entries.translation_source: Some man in a red hood was pushed into the ocean. He hasn’t resurfaced yet, either[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Seorang pria berkerudung merah
didorong ke laut. Dia juga belum\lmuncul ke permukaan\.

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn that that
Pokémon from the legends floated\lthrough here just now\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn that that Pokémon from the legends floated through here just now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah bahwa Pokémon dari
legenda itu melayang melewati sini\lbarusan\.

entries.original:
"Passing through this gate can
either get you to Dehara City or\lRoute 12."
entries.translation_source: Passing through this gate can either get you to Dehara City or Route 12.
entries.translated:
Melewati gerbang ini dapat
membawamu ke Dehara City atau Route\l12.

entries.original:
"Would you happen to be [player] by
any chance?

\.

I thought so.

I recognized you from this picture
I found of you, on the interwebs.

My name is Looker.

Agent Looker, of the International
Police.

I had just finished dealing with
Team Rocket in the Kanto Region,\lwhen I was deployed to deal with a\lsituation that was brewing in the\lBorrius Region.

A young man, Jax, I believe, has
informed me that you have some\levidence for crimes committed by an\lorganization calling themselves\l\qoThe Shadows\qc.

Please meet me in the [green]Dehara Game
Corner [blue]so we can discuss further.

Jax is there, as well.

Looker, out."
entries.translation_source: Would you happen to be [player-name-1] by any chance? [game-token-2] I thought so. I recognized you from this picture I found of you, on the interwebs. My name is Looker. Agent Looker, of the International Police. I had just finished dealing with Team Rocket in the Kanto Region, when I was deployed to deal with a situation that was brewing in the Borrius Region. A young man, Jax, I believe, has informed me that you have some evidence for crimes committed by an organization calling themselves [quote-open-3]The Shadows[quote-close-4]. Please meet me in the [color-green-5]Dehara Game Corner [color-blue-6]so we can discuss further. Jax is there, as well. Looker, out.
entries.translated:
Apakah kebetulan kamu adalah
[player]? \. Aku pikir begitu. Aku\lmengenalimu dari foto yang

kutemukan tentangmu di internet.
Namaku Looker. Agen Looker, dari\lPolisi Internasional. Aku baru saja

selesai menangani Team Rocket di
Region Kanto, ketika aku dikerahkan\luntuk menangani situasi yang sedang

berkembang di Region Borrius.
Seorang pria muda, Jax, kurasa,\ltelah memberitahuku bahwa kamu

memiliki beberapa bukti untuk
kejahatan yang dilakukan oleh\lsebuah organisasi yang menyebut

diri mereka \qoThe Shadows\qc. Silakan
temui aku di [green]Dehara Game Corner\l[blue]agar kita bisa berdiskusi lebih

lanjut. Jax juga ada di sana.
Sekian, Looker.

entries.original:
"He’s too engrossed in his slot game
to hear you from behind.

Maybe try yelling in his ear?"
entries.translation_source: He’s too engrossed in his slot game to hear you from behind. Maybe try yelling in his ear?
entries.translated:
Dia terlalu asyik dengan permainan
slotnya untuk mendengarmu dari\lbelakang. Mungkin coba berteriak di

telinganya?

entries.original:
"He appears to be deeply engrossed
in a slot game."
entries.translation_source: He appears to be deeply engrossed in a slot game.
entries.translated:
Dia tampak sangat asyik dalam
permainan slot.

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Jax!
The game finally cashed out!

I just won big!"
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]Jax! The game finally cashed out! I just won big!
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Jax! Permainan akhirnya
membayar! Aku baru saja menang\lbesar!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Just now, Mr. Looker?
I cashed out ages ago!

I’ve already won it big several
times!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Just now, Mr. Looker? I cashed out ages ago! I’ve already won it big several times!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Baru saja, Tuan Looker? Saya
sudah mencairkan sejak lama! Saya\lsudah menang besar beberapa kali!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh! [player]!

You came just in time!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh! [player-name-2]! You came just in time!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh! [player]! Kau datang tepat pada
waktunya!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Ah, it is you, [player].
Sorry, I did not see you, there.

I was too wrapped up in trying to
win this slot game.

You know, there is actually a Game
Corner just like this in Kanto.

Except there it was a cover for
Team Rocket\.

Anyway, thank you for meeting me.

Let us all go outside, where it is
quieter, to discuss."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]Ah, it is you, [player-name-2]. Sorry, I did not see you, there. I was too wrapped up in trying to win this slot game. You know, there is actually a Game Corner just like this in Kanto. Except there it was a cover for Team Rocket[game-token-3] Anyway, thank you for meeting me. Let us all go outside, where it is quieter, to discuss.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Ah, itu kamu, [player].
Maaf, aku tidak melihatmu di sana.\lAku terlalu asyik mencoba

memenangkan permainan slot ini. Kau
tahu, sebenarnya ada Game Corner\lseperti ini di Kanto. Kecuali di

sana itu adalah kedok untuk Team
Rocket\. Bagaimanapun, terima kasih\lsudah menemuiku. Ayo kita semua

pergi ke luar, di mana lebih
tenang, untuk berdiskusi.

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Alright, [player].

Now that we are outside, tell me
everything that transpired,\lstarting from the beginning.

\.

\.

Hmm\.

With these facts, there is clear
evidence that The Shadows wish to\lrelease the dark force and cause\lchaos in Borrius.

Now, if only there were some way we
could reach the Ruins of Void\lquickly so we could stop them\."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]Alright, [player-name-2]. Now that we are outside, tell me everything that transpired, starting from the beginning. [game-token-3] [game-token-4] Hmm[game-token-5] With these facts, there is clear evidence that The Shadows wish to release the dark force and cause chaos in Borrius. Now, if only there were some way we could reach the Ruins of Void quickly so we could stop them[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Baiklah, [player]. Sekarang
kita sudah di luar, ceritakan semua\lyang terjadi, mulai dari awal. \. \.

Hmm\. Dengan fakta-fakta ini, ada
bukti jelas bahwa The Shadows ingin\lmelepaskan kekuatan gelap dan

menyebabkan kekacauan di Borrius.
Sekarang, andai saja ada cara untuk\lmencapai Ruins of Void dengan cepat

sehingga kita bisa menghentikan
mereka\.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]What’s going on?

[player]!
Look out!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]What’s going on? [player-name-2]! Look out!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Apa yang terjadi? [player]!
Awas!

entries.original: "Jax: [blue][player]!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue][player]!

entries.original:
"It is the Ruins of Void!

And those\.

Those are Shadow Grunts!"
entries.translation_source: It is the Ruins of Void! And those[game-token-1] Those are Shadow Grunts!
entries.translated:
Ini adalah Reruntuhan Void! Dan
mereka\. Mereka adalah Rekrut\lBayangan!

entries.original:
"Are you alright?

This strange ring appeared beneath
you, back in Dehara City.

I was afraid something bad was
about to happen, so I grabbed onto\lyour shirt before you were\lteleported away.

But it looks like Looker didn’t
have the same idea\."
entries.translation_source: Are you alright? This strange ring appeared beneath you, back in Dehara City. I was afraid something bad was about to happen, so I grabbed onto your shirt before you were teleported away. But it looks like Looker didn’t have the same idea[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu baik-baik saja? Cincin
aneh ini muncul di bawahmu, di Kota\lDehara. Aku takut sesuatu yang

buruk akan terjadi, jadi aku meraih
kemejamu sebelum kamu diteleportasi\lpergi. Tapi sepertinya Looker tidak

memiliki ide yang sama\.

entries.original:
"Where are we, anyways?

Could this be\.
the Ruins of Void?"
entries.translation_source: Where are we, anyways? Could this be[game-token-1] the Ruins of Void?
entries.translated:
Kita di mana, sih? Mungkinkah ini
adalah\. Ruins of Void?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]This is where we make our
stand, men.

For the sake of the unbinding, they
must not be allowed up here.

Execute Light of Ruin order number
sixty-five!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]This is where we make our stand, men. For the sake of the unbinding, they must not be allowed up here. Execute Light of Ruin order number sixty-five!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Di sinilah kita bertahan,
kawan-kawan. Demi pelepasan ikatan,\lmereka tidak boleh diizinkan naik

ke sini. Laksanakan perintah Light
of Ruin nomor enam puluh lima!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Staraptor!

Take out those Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Staraptor! Take out those Shadows!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Staraptor! Kalahkan Shadows
itu!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]STARAPTOR!

NOOOOOO!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]STARAPTOR! NOOOOOO!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]STARAPTOR! TIDAAAAAK!

entries.original:
"[blue]They just destroyed our only way
up, along with my Staraptor\.

Sniff\.

No.

I can’t focus on that right now.

I need to stay strong."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]They just destroyed our only way up, along with my Staraptor[game-token-2] Sniff[game-token-3] No. I can’t focus on that right now. I need to stay strong.
entries.translated:
[blue]Mereka baru saja menghancurkan
satu-satunya jalan ke atas kami,\lbersama dengan Staraptor-ku\. Hiks\.

Tidak. Aku tidak bisa fokus pada
itu sekarang. Aku harus tetap kuat.

entries.original:
"[blue]It looks like an entrance to the
ruins was uncovered by the blast."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It looks like an entrance to the ruins was uncovered by the blast.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya pintu masuk ke
reruntuhan terungkap oleh ledakan.

entries.original:
"[blue]You should go in and try to find
another way up to the top.

I would come along, but Staraptor
was the only Pokémon I had on me.

I’d just wear you down if you had
to protect me from wild Pokémon.

Instead, I’ll wait here and take
care of healing for you."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You should go in and try to find another way up to the top. I would come along, but Staraptor was the only Pokémon I had on me. I’d just wear you down if you had to protect me from wild Pokémon. Instead, I’ll wait here and take care of healing for you.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu seharusnya masuk dan mencoba
mencari jalan lain ke atas. Aku\lakan ikut, tapi Staraptor adalah

satu-satunya Pokémon yang kubawa.
Aku hanya akan membuatmu lelah jika\lkau harus melindungiku dari Pokémon

liar. Sebagai gantinya, aku akan
menunggu di sini dan mengurus\lpemulihan untukmu.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, and if you find Staraptor,
please, bring him back to me."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh, and if you find Staraptor, please, bring him back to me.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, dan jika kamu menemukan
Staraptor, tolong, bawa dia kembali\lpadaku.

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient switch.
Would you like to flip it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient switch. Would you like to flip it?
entries.translated:
Ini adalah saklar kuno. Apakah kamu
ingin membaliknya?

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient switch.
Would you like to flip it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient switch. Would you like to flip it?
entries.translated:
Ini adalah saklar kuno. Apakah kamu
ingin membaliknya?

entries.original:
"PROVE YOUR WORTH TO THE GUARDIAN OF
THE RUINS, IF YOU WISH TO PASS!"
entries.translation_source: PROVE YOUR WORTH TO THE GUARDIAN OF THE RUINS, IF YOU WISH TO PASS!
entries.translated:
BUKTIKAN NILAIMU KEPADA PENJAGA
RERUNTUHAN, JIKA KAMU INGIN LEWAT!

entries.original: "YOU HAVE PROVEN YOUR WORTH."
entries.translation_source: YOU HAVE PROVEN YOUR WORTH.
entries.translated: KAMU TELAH MEMBUKTIKAN NILAIMU.

entries.original: "Grunt 1: [blue]Uh oh."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]Uh oh.
entries.translated: Grunt 1: [blue]Uh oh.

entries.original:
"Grunt 2: [blue]Sir, [player] is attempting
to make [buffer1] way up here by coming\lthrough the ruins!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [color-blue-1]Sir, [player-name-2] is attempting to make [buffer1-3] way up here by coming through the ruins!
entries.translated:
Grunt 2: [blue]Tuan, [player] mencoba
untuk membuat [buffer1] jalan ke\lsini dengan melewati reruntuhan!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]It doesn’t matter.

By the time [player] gets up here,
Zeph will be ready for the\lunbinding.

However, I still need you two to
stall [player] as much as possible."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]It doesn’t matter. By the time [player-name-2] gets up here, Zeph will be ready for the unbinding. However, I still need you two to stall [player-name-3] as much as possible.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Tidak masalah. Saat [player]
sampai di sini, Zeph akan siap\luntuk pelepasan ikatan. Namun, aku

masih perlu kalian berdua untuk
menahan [player] sebanyak mungkin.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]If I didn’t need you, Hoopa,
I’d throw your Poké Ball into the\locean for all of the\linconveniencies you’ve caused me!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]If I didn’t need you, Hoopa, I’d throw your Poké Ball into the ocean for all of the inconveniencies you’ve caused me!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Jika aku tidak membutuhkanmu,
Hoopa, aku akan melempar Poké\lBallmu ke laut karena semua

ketidaknyamanan yang telah kamu
timbulkan padaku!

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]I’ve got a bad feeling
about that Claydol\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]I’ve got a bad feeling about that Claydol[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Aku punya firasat buruk
tentang Claydol itu\.

entries.original: "Grunt 2: [blue]What the\.?"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [color-blue-1]What the[game-token-2]?
entries.translated: Grunt 2: [blue]Apa\.?

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]We’ve got nothing to
prove!

We’re The Shadows!

Let’s take it down!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]We’ve got nothing to prove! We’re The Shadows! Let’s take it down!
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Kami tidak perlu
membuktikan apa pun! Kami adalah\lThe Shadows! Mari kita hancurkan!

entries.original: "Grunts: [blue]Groan\."
entries.translation_source: Grunts: [color-blue-1]Groan[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Grunts: [blue]Erangan\.

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU HAVE FAILED TO PROVE YOUR
WORTH!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU HAVE FAILED TO PROVE YOUR WORTH!
entries.translated:
[blue]KAMU TELAH GAGAL MEMBUKTIKAN
NILAIMU!

entries.original:
"DEFEAT THE GUARDIANS OF THE PORTAL
IF YOU WISH TO PROCEED!"
entries.translation_source: DEFEAT THE GUARDIANS OF THE PORTAL IF YOU WISH TO PROCEED!
entries.translated:
KALAHKAN PENJAGA PORTAL JIKA KAMU
INGIN MELANJUTKAN!

entries.original:
"You gaze into the portal\.

\.

Pokémon are attempting to cross
through from the other side!

Are you ready to face them?

Be aware, once the battles begin,
there will be no chance to recover."
entries.translation_source: You gaze into the portal[game-token-1] [game-token-2] Pokémon are attempting to cross through from the other side! Are you ready to face them? Be aware, once the battles begin, there will be no chance to recover.
entries.translated:
Kamu menatap ke dalam portal\. \.
Pokémon berusaha menyeberang dari\lsisi lain! Apakah kamu siap

menghadapi mereka? Ketahuilah,
begitu pertarungan dimulai, tidak\lakan ada kesempatan untuk pulih.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] ran back into the
portal."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] ran back into the portal.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] berlari kembali ke dalam
portal.

entries.original:
"Another Pokémon is making its way
through the portal!"
entries.translation_source: Another Pokémon is making its way through the portal!
entries.translated:
Pokémon lain sedang melewati
portal!

entries.original: "YOU HAVE PROVEN YOURSELF!"
entries.translation_source: YOU HAVE PROVEN YOURSELF!
entries.translated: KAMU TELAH MEMBUKTIKAN DIRIMU!

entries.original:
"It’s a mysterious portal.

Where could it lead?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a mysterious portal. Where could it lead?
entries.translated:
Ini adalah portal misterius. Ke
mana arahnya?

entries.original: "It’s Jax’s Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: It’s Jax’s Staraptor.
entries.translated: Ini Staraptor milik Jax.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue][player]!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue][player]!

entries.original:
"[blue]Thank you for finding my Staraptor!

I was able to heal him in time, so
it looks like he’ll be alright.

Great job, by the way, on getting
this far.

It looks like we’re almost at the
top.

One more floor up, and we’ll be
able to stop The Shadows.

I’ll leave you to it, then.

If you need healing, I’ll be
waiting by the side entrance on\lthis floor of the ruins."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Thank you for finding my Staraptor! I was able to heal him in time, so it looks like he’ll be alright. Great job, by the way, on getting this far. It looks like we’re almost at the top. One more floor up, and we’ll be able to stop The Shadows. I’ll leave you to it, then. If you need healing, I’ll be waiting by the side entrance on this floor of the ruins.
entries.translated:
[blue]Terima kasih telah menemukan
Staraptor-ku! Aku berhasil\lmenyembuhkannya tepat waktu, jadi

sepertinya dia akan baik-baik saja.
Kerja bagus, omong-omong, sudah\lsejauh ini. Sepertinya kita hampir

sampai di puncak. Satu lantai lagi,
dan kita bisa menghentikan The\lShadows. Aku akan menyerahkan

sisanya padamu. Jika kamu perlu
penyembuhan, aku akan menunggu di\lpintu samping di lantai reruntuhan

ini.

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]That Claydol may have
temporarily incapacitated us, but\lwe’re still not going to let you\lthrough without a fight!

The unbinding must not be
disrupted!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]That Claydol may have temporarily incapacitated us, but we’re still not going to let you through without a fight! The unbinding must not be disrupted!
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Claydol itu mungkin untuk
sementara melumpuhkan kami, tapi\lkami tetap tidak akan membiarkanmu

lewat tanpa bertarung! Pembebasan
tidak boleh diganggu!

entries.original:
"Grunt 2: [blue]We’re not done here, yet!

It’s my turn to take you down!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [color-blue-1]We’re not done here, yet! It’s my turn to take you down!
entries.translated:
Grunt 2: [blue]Kami belum selesai di
sini! Giliranku untuk\lmengalahkanmu!

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]Wait!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Wait!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Tunggu!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue][player] has more important
things to do, than deal with you.

If you want to take someone on, why
don’t you try me on for size!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1][player-name-2] has more important things to do, than deal with you. If you want to take someone on, why don’t you try me on for size!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue][player] punya urusan yang
lebih penting daripada berurusan\ldenganmu. Jika kamu ingin melawan

seseorang, kenapa tidak coba lawan
aku!

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!

I’ll take care of these goons.

You go stop The Shadows from
carrying out their \qounbinding\qc.

We’re counting on you."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! I’ll take care of these goons. You go stop The Shadows from carrying out their [quote-open-3]unbinding[quote-close-4]. We’re counting on you.
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Aku akan mengurus para
preman ini. Kamu pergi hentikan The\lShadows dari melaksanakan

\qopembebasan\qc mereka. Kami
mengandalkanmu.

entries.original:
"Once we take care of you, we’re
going to finish [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Once we take care of you, we’re going to finish [player-name-1]!
entries.translated:
Setelah kami mengurusimu, kami akan
menghabisi [player]!

entries.original: "Need healing, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: Need healing, [player-name-1]?
entries.translated: Butuh penyembuhan, [player]?

entries.original:
"Okay, you’re all set, [player].

I’ll be here if you need to heal
again."
entries.translation_source: Okay, you’re all set, [player-name-1]. I’ll be here if you need to heal again.
entries.translated:
Oke, kamu sudah siap, [player]. Aku
akan di sini jika kamu perlu\lpenyembuhan lagi.

entries.original:
"[player]!

I’m trying to battle these grunts,
but I can heal you quickly!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I’m trying to battle these grunts, but I can heal you quickly!
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku sedang mencoba
bertarung melawan para grunt ini,\ltapi aku bisa menyembuhkanmu dengan

cepat!

entries.original: "Grunt 1: [red]Some people never learn\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-red-1]Some people never learn[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [red]Beberapa orang tidak
pernah belajar\.

entries.original:
"Grunt 2: [blue]Get moving, kid.
You’re going to want to see this\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [color-blue-1]Get moving, kid. You’re going to want to see this[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Grunt 2: [blue]Bergeraklah, nak. Kamu
pasti ingin melihat ini\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]All preparations have been
completed, Zeph.

You can proceed with the unbinding
when ready."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]All preparations have been completed, Zeph. You can proceed with the unbinding when ready.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Semua persiapan telah
selesai, Zeph. Kamu bisa\lmelanjutkan pembebasan kapan pun

siap.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Thank you, Ivory.

Just one more thing before I am
ready to begin.

Where is Marlon?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Thank you, Ivory. Just one more thing before I am ready to begin. Where is Marlon?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Terima kasih, Ivory. Satu hal
lagi sebelum aku siap memulai. Di\lmana Marlon?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]I’m sorry, Zeph, but I’m not
sure where he is.

He confirmed that he was on his way
here a while ago, but I haven’t\lheard from him since."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]I’m sorry, Zeph, but I’m not sure where he is. He confirmed that he was on his way here a while ago, but I haven’t heard from him since.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Maaf, Zeph, tapi aku tidak
yakin di mana dia. Dia\lmengonfirmasi bahwa dia sedang

dalam perjalanan ke sini beberapa
waktu lalu, tapi sejak itu aku\ltidak mendengar kabar darinya.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Hmm\.

He has been rather on edge
lately\.

I hope he hasn’t gotten cold
feet\.

It would be a shame for him to miss
what we’ve worked so hard for."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Hmm[game-token-2] He has been rather on edge lately[game-token-3] I hope he hasn’t gotten cold feet[game-token-4] It would be a shame for him to miss what we’ve worked so hard for.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Hmm\. Dia agak gelisah
akhir-akhir ini\. Kuharap dia tidak\lmundur\. Sayang sekali jika dia

melewatkan apa yang telah kita
perjuangkan.

entries.original:
"[blue]Either way, with or without him, I
am now ready to begin."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Either way, with or without him, I am now ready to begin.
entries.translated:
[blue]Bagaimanapun, dengan atau tanpa
dia, aku sekarang siap untuk\lmemulai.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]The time has come to make my
dream a reality.

Once the dark force is unbound, I
will use it to undo the tragedies\lof all those years ago\.

Then, finally, I will be able to
see his smile once again\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]The time has come to make my dream a reality. Once the dark force is unbound, I will use it to undo the tragedies of all those years ago[game-token-2] Then, finally, I will be able to see his smile once again[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Waktunya telah tiba untuk
mewujudkan mimpiku. Setelah\lkekuatan gelap dilepaskan, aku akan

menggunakannya untuk membatalkan
tragedi beberapa tahun yang lalu\.\lKemudian, akhirnya, aku akan bisa

melihat senyumnya lagi\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Zapdos!

Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Zapdos! Come forth!
entries.translated: [blue]Zapdos! Muncullah!

entries.original:
"[blue]Moltres!

Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Moltres! Come forth!
entries.translated: [blue]Moltres! Muncullah!

entries.original:
"[blue]Articuno!

Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Articuno! Come forth!
entries.translated: [blue]Articuno! Muncullah!

entries.original:
"[blue]With these three legendary bird
Pokémon assembled here alongside\lthe Void Stone, the seal can\lbe broken."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]With these three legendary bird Pokémon assembled here alongside the Void Stone, the seal can be broken.
entries.translated:
[blue]Dengan tiga Pokémon burung
legendaris ini yang berkumpul di\lsini bersama Void Stone, segelnya

bisa dipatahkan.

entries.original:
"[blue]One with the shadows, and one with
the night.

A dark hole.

A ring of fury.

A force encapsulated.

Let that be no longer!

What was once sealed is now free!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]One with the shadows, and one with the night. A dark hole. A ring of fury. A force encapsulated. Let that be no longer! What was once sealed is now free!
entries.translated:
[blue]Satu dengan bayangan, dan satu
dengan malam. Sebuah lubang gelap.\lSebuah cincin kemarahan. Sebuah

kekuatan yang terkurung. Jangan
biarkan itu terjadi lagi! Apa yang\ldulu tersegel kini bebas!

entries.original:
"[blue]The bottle is now free.

Once I open it, the dark force will
be mine to command."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]The bottle is now free. Once I open it, the dark force will be mine to command.
entries.translated:
[blue]Botolnya sekarang bebas. Begitu aku
membukanya, kekuatan gelap akan\lmenjadi milikku untuk diperintah.

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh?
Why is nothing happening?

The bottle is open\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Huh? Why is nothing happening? The bottle is open[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Hah? Kenapa tidak ada yang terjadi?
Botolnya terbuka\.

entries.original: "???: [blue]Heh heh heh."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Heh heh heh.
entries.translated: ???: [blue]Heh heh heh.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Who do you think you are!?

And what have you done to the
unbinding!?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Who do you think you are!? And what have you done to the unbinding!?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Siapa kau pikir kau!? Dan apa
yang telah kau lakukan pada\lpembukaan segel!?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Who, me?

The name is Aklove.

I’m just a lowly grunt of The
Shadows."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Who, me? The name is Aklove. I’m just a lowly grunt of The Shadows.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Siapa, aku? Namaku Aklove. Aku
hanyalah grunt rendahan dari The\lShadows.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Answer my question, Grunt!

What have you done!?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Answer my question, Grunt! What have you done!?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Jawab pertanyaanku, Grunt!
Apa yang telah kau lakukan!?

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]What have I done?

I have done nothing to interrupt
the unbinding.

In fact, I commend you on an almost
flawless execution.

However, there was one key
component you were missing."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]What have I done? I have done nothing to interrupt the unbinding. In fact, I commend you on an almost flawless execution. However, there was one key component you were missing.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Apa yang telah kulakukan?
Aku tidak melakukan apa pun untuk\lmengganggu pembukaan segel.

Faktanya, aku memujimu atas
pelaksanaan yang hampir sempurna.\lNamun, ada satu komponen kunci yang

kau lewatkan.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]And what would that be?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]And what would that be?
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Dan apa itu?

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]If you want to release the
power from the Prison Bottle, there\lneeds to be somewhere for that\lpower to go.

Or more specifically, you need the
Pokémon that used to be the dark\lforce, something you’re lacking.

Of course, you would know that had
I not erased that detail from your\lfiles.

Honestly, I knew it would be easy
to manipulate you if I infiltrated\lyour organization, but I didn’t\lthink it would be this easy!

You played right into my hands,
Zeph!

You unsealed the Prison Bottle
right in front of me!

And now I can use it to truly
finish the unbinding!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]If you want to release the power from the Prison Bottle, there needs to be somewhere for that power to go. Or more specifically, you need the Pokémon that used to be the dark force, something you’re lacking. Of course, you would know that had I not erased that detail from your files. Honestly, I knew it would be easy to manipulate you if I infiltrated your organization, but I didn’t think it would be this easy! You played right into my hands, Zeph! You unsealed the Prison Bottle right in front of me! And now I can use it to truly finish the unbinding!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Jika kau ingin melepaskan
kekuatan dari Prison Bottle, harus\lada tempat untuk kekuatan itu

pergi. Atau lebih spesifik, kau
membutuhkan Pokémon yang dulunya\ladalah kekuatan gelap itu, sesuatu

yang tidak kau miliki. Tentu saja,
kau akan tahu itu jika aku tidak\lmenghapus detail itu dari file-mu.

Sejujurnya, aku tahu akan mudah
untuk memanipulasimu jika aku\lmenyusup ke organisasimu, tapi aku

tidak mengira akan semudah ini! Kau
bermain tepat di tanganku, Zeph!\lKau membuka segel Prison Bottle

tepat di depanku! Dan sekarang aku
bisa menggunakannya untuk\lbenar-benar menyelesaikan pembukaan

segel!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Wha\.

How dare you make a fool of me!

You’ll pay for this!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Wha[game-token-2] How dare you make a fool of me! You’ll pay for this!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Wha\. Beraninya kau
mempermainkanku! Kau akan membayar\luntuk ini!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Houndoom!

Incinerate this fool!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Houndoom! Incinerate this fool!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Houndoom! Menghanguskan orang
bodoh ini!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Hoopa!
Get rid of Houndoom!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Hoopa! Get rid of Houndoom!
entries.translated: Aklove: [blue]Hoopa! Singkirkan Houndoom!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]No way\.

My Houndoom\.

So then it was you who rescued
[player] all those times\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]No way[game-token-2] My Houndoom[game-token-3] So then it was you who rescued [player-name-4] all those times[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Tidak mungkin\. Houndoom-ku\.
Jadi kaulah yang menyelamatkan\l[player] selama ini\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Actually, that was Hoopa
acting on its own accord.

It was desperate for someone to
rescue it from me.

It felt obligated to protect
[player] as [buffer2] is its true trainer.

I want nothing more than to see
[player] eliminated.

Once [buffer2]’s gone, Hoopa will finally
accept me as its true trainer\.

Only then will I be able to use
its full power, capable of moving\lentire land masses\."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Actually, that was Hoopa acting on its own accord. It was desperate for someone to rescue it from me. It felt obligated to protect [player-name-2] as [buffer2-3] is its true trainer. I want nothing more than to see [player-name-4] eliminated. Once [buffer2-5]’s gone, Hoopa will finally accept me as its true trainer[game-token-6] Only then will I be able to use its full power, capable of moving entire land masses[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Sebenarnya, itu adalah
Hoopa yang bertindak atas\lkemauannya sendiri. Ia putus asa

mencari seseorang untuk
menyelamatkannya dariku. Ia merasa\lberkewajiban untuk melindungi

[player] karena [buffer2] adalah
pelatih sejatinya. Aku tidak\lmenginginkan apa pun selain melihat

[player] dilenyapkan. Setelah
[buffer2] pergi, Hoopa akhirnya akan\lmenerimaku sebagai pelatih

sejatinya\. Hanya saat itu aku bisa
menggunakan kekuatan penuhnya, yang\lmampu memindahkan seluruh daratan\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]I concede\.

I stand no chance against a
Pokémon like that."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]I concede[game-token-2] I stand no chance against a Pokémon like that.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Aku mengaku kalah\. Aku tidak
punya kesempatan melawan Pokémon\lseperti itu.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]That’s a wise decision.

Now move out of my way!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]That’s a wise decision. Now move out of my way!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Itu keputusan yang bijak.
Sekarang minggir dari jalanku!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]I’m sorry, Ivory.

I wasn’t able to complete the
mission.

However, this isn’t the end.

We will still find a way to bring
them back\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]I’m sorry, Ivory. I wasn’t able to complete the mission. However, this isn’t the end. We will still find a way to bring them back[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Maaf, Ivory. Aku tidak bisa
menyelesaikan misinya. Namun, ini\lbukanlah akhir. Kita masih akan

menemukan cara untuk membawa mereka
kembali\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]And now, let the main event
begin."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]And now, let the main event begin.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Dan sekarang, mari kita
mulai acara utamanya.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa, prepare yourself!

Your true power is about to be
released from the Prison Bottle!

And as your trainer, I am fully
capable of releasing it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hoopa, prepare yourself! Your true power is about to be released from the Prison Bottle! And as your trainer, I am fully capable of releasing it!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa, bersiaplah! Kekuatan
sejatimu akan segera dilepaskan\ldari Botol Penjara! Dan sebagai

pelatihmu, aku sepenuhnya mampu
melepaskannya!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]At last!

I’ve waited years for this moment!

Hoopa!

The seal on your power has finally
been broken!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]At last! I’ve waited years for this moment! Hoopa! The seal on your power has finally been broken!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Akhirnya! Aku sudah
menunggu bertahun-tahun untuk momen\lini! Hoopa! Segel pada kekuatanmu

akhirnya terpecahkan!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Aklove, tell me!

What is your reason for doing all
of this?

Perhaps if we have a common goal,
we can work together!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Aklove, tell me! What is your reason for doing all of this? Perhaps if we have a common goal, we can work together!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Aklove, katakan padaku! Apa
alasanmu melakukan semua ini?\lMungkin jika kita memiliki tujuan

yang sama, kita bisa bekerja sama!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Fool.

We have no common goal.

I am a descendant of the king of
Kalos during the Great War.

My goal is simply to finish what he
started and destroy this region.

With this unbound Hoopa, I will
bring the Ultimate Weapon of Kalos\lhere and use it to turn Borrius\linto a region of death and\ldestruction!

Then, finally, his suffering will
be at its end\.

Now tell me, Zeph. What are your
goals?"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Fool. We have no common goal. I am a descendant of the king of Kalos during the Great War. My goal is simply to finish what he started and destroy this region. With this unbound Hoopa, I will bring the Ultimate Weapon of Kalos here and use it to turn Borrius into a region of death and destruction! Then, finally, his suffering will be at its end[game-token-2] Now tell me, Zeph. What are your goals?
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Bodoh. Kami tidak memiliki
tujuan yang sama. Aku adalah\lketurunan raja Kalos selama Perang

Besar. Tujuanku sederhana,
menyelesaikan apa yang ia mulai dan\lmenghancurkan wilayah ini. Dengan

Hoopa yang tak terikat ini, aku
akan membawa Senjata Pamungkas\lKalos ke sini dan menggunakannya

untuk mengubah Borrius menjadi
wilayah kematian dan kehancuran!\lLalu, akhirnya, penderitaannya akan

berakhir\. Sekarang katakan padaku,
Zeph. Apa tujuanmu?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]My goals?

I have but one goal.

To see those I cared about once
more."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]My goals? I have but one goal. To see those I cared about once more.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Tujuanku? Aku hanya punya
satu tujuan. Untuk melihat mereka\lyang kuperhatikan sekali lagi.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]To use such a great power
for something like that\.

I never could’ve imagined anyone
would try that!

You are truly a strange one, Zeph."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]To use such a great power for something like that[game-token-2] I never could’ve imagined anyone would try that! You are truly a strange one, Zeph.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Menggunakan kekuatan
sebesar itu untuk sesuatu seperti\litu\. Aku tidak pernah membayangkan

ada yang akan mencoba itu! Kamu
benar-benar aneh, Zeph.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]I\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]I[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Aku\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Enough!

Remove yourself from my presence.

The Shadows are finshed.

It’s time for Borrius to be
enveloped in The Light of Ruin.

But first\.

Grunts!

Bring [player] to me!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Enough! Remove yourself from my presence. The Shadows are finshed. It’s time for Borrius to be enveloped in The Light of Ruin. But first[game-token-2] Grunts! Bring [player-name-3] to me!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Cukup! Enyahlah dari
hadapanku. The Shadows sudah\lselesai. Saatnya Borrius diselimuti

oleh Cahaya Kehancuran. Tapi
pertama-tama\. Para Grunts! Bawa\l[player] kepadaku!

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]My grunts\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]My grunts[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Grunts-ku\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Are you really surprised
your grunts would join me?

You burn them alive if they disobey
you!

I promised them safety
from the coming storm if they\lworked for me instead."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Are you really surprised your grunts would join me? You burn them alive if they disobey you! I promised them safety from the coming storm if they worked for me instead.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Apakah kamu benar-benar
terkejut bahwa grunts-mu bergabung\ldenganku? Kamu membakar mereka

hidup-hidup jika mereka tidak
menaatimu! Aku menjanjikan mereka\lkeselamatan dari badai yang akan

datang jika mereka bekerja untukku
sebagai gantinya.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Now, [player], it’s time you
were eliminated once and for all.

I’ve watched as you’ve been a
repeated nuisance to The Shadows.

I can’t have you becoming a
nuisance to me, as well."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Now, [player-name-2], it’s time you were eliminated once and for all. I’ve watched as you’ve been a repeated nuisance to The Shadows. I can’t have you becoming a nuisance to me, as well.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Sekarang, [player], saatnya
kamu dieliminasi sekali dan untuk\lselamanya. Aku telah melihat

bagaimana kamu menjadi gangguan
berulang bagi The Shadows. Aku\ltidak bisa membiarkan kamu menjadi

gangguan bagiku juga.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Summon a Pokémon to eliminate
[player]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hoopa! Summon a Pokémon to eliminate [player-name-2]!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa! Panggil seekor Pokémon untuk
mengeliminasi [player]!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] flew back into the
portal."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] flew back into the portal.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] itu terbang kembali ke
portal.

entries.original: "Aklove: [blue]Summon another, Hoopa!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Summon another, Hoopa!
entries.translated: Aklove: [blue]Panggil yang lain, Hoopa!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Is that the best you’ve
got, Hoopa?"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Is that the best you’ve got, Hoopa?
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Apakah itu yang terbaik
yang kau punya, Hoopa?

entries.original:
"[blue]It’s over, [player].
I’ve had enough of this.

I’m going to have you incinerated.

My Hoopa won’t save you now."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It’s over, [player-name-2]. I’ve had enough of this. I’m going to have you incinerated. My Hoopa won’t save you now.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sudah berakhir, [player]. Aku sudah
muak dengan ini. Aku akan membuatmu\ldibakar habis. Hoopa-ku tidak akan

menyelamatkanmu sekarang.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Summon an incineration!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hoopa! Summon an incineration!
entries.translated: [blue]Hoopa! Panggil pembakaran!

entries.original: "Aklove: [blue]Farewell, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Farewell, [player-name-2].
entries.translated: Aklove: [blue]Selamat tinggal, [player].

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s you.

I guess your time was finally up
then, huh?

So tell me, how did you go?

\.

Incineration\.

That figures\.

Well, it’s still a better way than
drowning."
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s you. I guess your time was finally up then, huh? So tell me, how did you go? [game-token-1] Incineration[game-token-2] That figures[game-token-3] Well, it’s still a better way than drowning.
entries.translated:
Oh, kamu. Kurasa waktumu akhirnya
habis, ya? Jadi ceritakan,\lbagaimana kau mati? \. Dibakar\. Masuk

akal\. Yah, itu masih lebih baik
daripada tenggelam.

entries.original:
"You must be wondering where we are,
am I right?

\.

I thought so.

I guess you could say this is what
people call the \qoJudgement Zone\qc.

It is here where the great creator
of the universe, Arceus himself,\lpasses judgement on those who have\lleft the world."
entries.translation_source: You must be wondering where we are, am I right? [game-token-1] I thought so. I guess you could say this is what people call the [quote-open-2]Judgement Zone[quote-close-3]. It is here where the great creator of the universe, Arceus himself, passes judgement on those who have left the world.
entries.translated:
Kamu pasti bertanya-tanya di mana
kita, benar? \. Kupikir begitu.\lKurasa bisa dibilang ini yang

disebut \qoZona Penghakiman\qc. Di
sinilah pencipta agung alam\lsemesta, Arceus sendiri, menghakimi

mereka yang telah meninggalkan
dunia.

entries.original:
"I’ve heard that this place is
supposed to reflect your home.

\.

I don’t know what you see, but I
see the sea, everywhere I look.

The region I’m from\.

Well, as some would put it, it had
\qotoo much water\qc.

I think I may have stayed there
forever, had Zeph not convinced\lIvory and me to leave."
entries.translation_source: I’ve heard that this place is supposed to reflect your home. [game-token-1] I don’t know what you see, but I see the sea, everywhere I look. The region I’m from[game-token-2] Well, as some would put it, it had [quote-open-3]too much water[quote-close-4]. I think I may have stayed there forever, had Zeph not convinced Ivory and me to leave.
entries.translated:
Kudengar tempat ini seharusnya
mencerminkan rumahmu. \. Aku tidak\ltahu apa yang kamu lihat, tapi aku

melihat laut, ke mana pun aku
memandang. Daerah asalku\. Yah,\lseperti yang dikatakan beberapa

orang, daerah itu \qokebanyakan air\qc.
Kurasa aku mungkin akan tinggal di\lsana selamanya, jika Zeph tidak

meyakinkan Ivory dan aku untuk
pergi.

entries.original:
"What do you see, [player]?

\.

Snow, huh?

Makes sense\.

Frozen Heights is the home your
father chose for you, after all."
entries.translation_source: What do you see, [player-name-1]? [game-token-2] Snow, huh? Makes sense[game-token-3] Frozen Heights is the home your father chose for you, after all.
entries.translated:
Apa yang kamu lihat, [player]? \.
Salju, ya? Masuk akal\. Frozen\lHeights adalah rumah yang dipilih

ayahmu untukmu.

entries.original:
"You know, [player], I knew your
father well.

He was a good man.

I even had the pleasure of working
with him at one point\."
entries.translation_source: You know, [player-name-1], I knew your father well. He was a good man. I even had the pleasure of working with him at one point[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, [player], aku kenal baik
ayahmu. Dia orang baik. Bahkan aku\lpernah senang bekerja dengannya

suatu saat\.

entries.original:
"He used to say that even the
worst of men had the best of\lintent at some point in their\lcareer.

\.

His words echoed in my head until
the day I died."
entries.translation_source: He used to say that even the worst of men had the best of intent at some point in their career. [game-token-1] His words echoed in my head until the day I died.
entries.translated:
Dia dulu berkata bahwa bahkan pria
terburuk pun memiliki niat terbaik\ldi suatu titik dalam karir mereka. \.

Kata-katanya bergema di kepalaku
sampai hari aku mati.

entries.original:
"I know you must have the impression
that I’m some sort of \qodespicable\lvillain\qc, but I can’t even begin to\ltell you how wrong that notion is.

It just seems that way because of
the things you’ve witnessed The\lShadows do."
entries.translation_source: I know you must have the impression that I’m some sort of [quote-open-1]despicable villain[quote-close-2], but I can’t even begin to tell you how wrong that notion is. It just seems that way because of the things you’ve witnessed The Shadows do.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu kamu pasti memiliki kesan
bahwa aku semacam \qopenjahat keji\qc,\ltapi aku bahkan tidak bisa mulai

mengatakan betapa salahnya anggapan
itu. Sepertinya begitu karena\lhal-hal yang kamu saksikan

dilakukan The Shadows.

entries.original:
"We started out with good intent.

It was only some time later on when
things began to get out of hand.

When did it go all wrong\."
entries.translation_source: We started out with good intent. It was only some time later on when things began to get out of hand. When did it go all wrong[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kami memulai dengan niat baik.
Hanya beberapa waktu kemudian\lsemuanya mulai tidak terkendali.

Kapan semuanya menjadi salah\.

entries.original: "It’s time, [player]."
entries.translation_source: It’s time, [player-name-1].
entries.translated: Sudah waktunya, [player].

entries.original: "MARLON. [player]."
entries.translation_source: MARLON. [player-name-1].
entries.translated: MARLON. [player].

entries.original:
"[black]Marlon: [blue]Arceus\.

The creator of the universe\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Marlon: [color-blue-2]Arceus[game-token-3] The creator of the universe[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[black]Marlon: [blue]Arceus\. Pencipta alam
semesta\.

entries.original:
"[black]Arceus: [blue]\.YES.

IT IS TIME FOR YOUR JUDGEMENT."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Arceus: [color-blue-2][game-token-3]YES. IT IS TIME FOR YOUR JUDGEMENT.
entries.translated:
[black]Arceus: [blue]\.YA. INI WAKTU UNTUK
PENGHAKIMANMU.

entries.original:
"MARLON!

DABBLING IN THE FORBIDDEN ART.

RESSURECTION.

SIN.

YOU WILL BE RETURNED TO YOUR
WORLD, IMMORTAL UNTIL THE WORLD\lIS CLEANSED.

ONLY ONE OTHER HAS EVER ENDURED
THIS PUNISHMENT, AND TO THIS DAY\lHE STILL ROAMS THE WORLD, A\lTHOUSAND YEARS LATER!

RIGHT YOUR WRONGS!

FREE THOSE WHOSE SOULS HAVE BEEN
TRAPPED IN [green]CINDER VOLCANO[blue]!

BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE\.

THIS IS MY VERDICT!

BEGONE!"
entries.translation_source: MARLON! DABBLING IN THE FORBIDDEN ART. RESSURECTION. SIN. YOU WILL BE RETURNED TO YOUR WORLD, IMMORTAL UNTIL THE WORLD IS CLEANSED. ONLY ONE OTHER HAS EVER ENDURED THIS PUNISHMENT, AND TO THIS DAY HE STILL ROAMS THE WORLD, A THOUSAND YEARS LATER! RIGHT YOUR WRONGS! FREE THOSE WHOSE SOULS HAVE BEEN TRAPPED IN [color-green-1]CINDER VOLCANO[color-blue-2]! BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE[game-token-3] THIS IS MY VERDICT! BEGONE!
entries.translated:
MARLON! MENCAMPURI SENI TERLARANG.
KEBANGKITAN. DOSA. KAMU AKAN\lDIKEMBALIKAN KE DUNIAMU, ABADI

SAMPAI DUNIA DIBERSIHKAN. HANYA
SATU ORANG LAIN YANG PERNAH MENAHAN\lHUKUMAN INI, DAN HINGGA HARI INI

DIA MASIH BERKELIARAN DI DUNIA,
SERIBU TAHUN KEMUDIAN! PERBAIKI\lKESALAHANMU! BEBASKAN MEREKA YANG

JIWANYA TERPERANGKAP DI [green]GUNUNG
BERAPI CINDER[blue]! SEBELUM TERLAMBAT\.\lINI VONISKU! PERGILAH!

entries.original:
"[player]!

PREMATURE DEATH.

A CURSE ON YOUR SOUL.

FOR AROS, I SHALL RESTORE YOU TO
LIFE!

ONE CONDITION.

SUCCEED IN STOPPING THE ENDLESS
TORMENT OF SOULS, OR I WILL\lRETURN YOU TO ASH.

THIS IS MY VERDICT.

BEGONE!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! PREMATURE DEATH. A CURSE ON YOUR SOUL. FOR AROS, I SHALL RESTORE YOU TO LIFE! ONE CONDITION. SUCCEED IN STOPPING THE ENDLESS TORMENT OF SOULS, OR I WILL RETURN YOU TO ASH. THIS IS MY VERDICT. BEGONE!
entries.translated:
[player]! KEMATIAN PREMATUR.
KUTUKAN PADA JIWAMU. DEMI AROS, AKU\lAKAN MEMULIHKANMU KEHIDUPAN! SATU

SYARAT. BERHASILLAH MENGHENTIKAN
SIKSAA TAK BERAKHIR JIWA-JIWA, ATAU\lAKU AKAN MENGEMBALIKANMU MENJADI

ABU. INI VONISKU. PERGILAH!

entries.original:
"I don’t know who you are, but
you’re not getting past me like\lthat other guy did!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t know who you are, but you’re not getting past me like that other guy did!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tahu siapa dirimu, tapi
kau tidak akan melewatiku seperti\lorang lain itu!

entries.original:
"\.[player]?

But\.but\.but you’re supposed to
be dead!

How is this possible?

I need to warn the others!"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1][player-name-2]? But[game-token-3]but[game-token-4]but you’re supposed to be dead! How is this possible? I need to warn the others!
entries.translated:
\.[player]? Tapi\.tapi\.tapi kau
seharusnya sudah mati! Bagaimana\lini mungkin? Aku harus

memperingatkan yang lain!

entries.original: "[red]No, no, no, no, no!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]No, no, no, no, no!
entries.translated: [red]Tidak, tidak, tidak, tidak, tidak!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Véga!

How could you betray The Shadows!?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Véga! How could you betray The Shadows!?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Véga! Bagaimana kau bisa
mengkhianati The Shadows!?

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Marlon!?

Aklove told us he killed you!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Marlon!? Aklove told us he killed you!
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Marlon!? Aklove bilang dia
membunuhmu!

entries.original:
