If you come back with any, I’ll be
happy to teach your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It appears that you do not have any Yellow Shards. You can find them popping up occassionally in the Great Desert. If you come back with any, I’ll be happy to teach your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Tampaknya Anda tidak memiliki
Belahan Kuning. Anda bisa\lmenemukannya muncul sesekali di

Gurun Besar. Jika Anda kembali
dengan membawanya, saya akan dengan\lsenang hati mengajarkan Pokémon

Anda.

entries.original:
"I’ll be here, waiting, if you
change your mind."
entries.translation_source: I’ll be here, waiting, if you change your mind.
entries.translated:
Saya akan di sini, menunggu, jika
Anda berubah pikiran.

entries.original:
"Hi there!

My grandmother has a business of
teaching Pokémon a move in\lexchange for a Yellow Shard.

If you haven’t had a chance to find
any, let me help you out."
entries.translation_source: Hi there! My grandmother has a business of teaching Pokémon a move in exchange for a Yellow Shard. If you haven’t had a chance to find any, let me help you out.
entries.translated:
Halo! Nenek saya memiliki usaha
mengajarkan jurus kepada Pokémon\ldengan imbalan Belahan Kuning. Jika

Anda belum sempat menemukannya,
biarkan saya membantu Anda.

entries.original:
"You’ll be able to shock your
enemies when you learn her move!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll be able to shock your enemies when you learn her move!
entries.translated:
Anda akan bisa menyetrum musuh Anda
saat mempelajari jurusnya!

entries.original:
"Looks like you don’t need any after
all. You have no space."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you don’t need any after all. You have no space.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Anda tidak
membutuhkannya lagi. Anda tidak\lmemiliki ruang.

entries.original:
"Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet
deal for ya!

You know how Pokemon like to hide
behind stones or rocks, yeah?

Sometimes they hide cool bones,
too.

If you find a [green]Rare Bone [blue]somewhere,
you should bring it to me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet deal for ya! You know how Pokemon like to hide behind stones or rocks, yeah? Sometimes they hide cool bones, too. If you find a [color-green-1]Rare Bone [color-blue-2]somewhere, you should bring it to me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Hei, coba lihat. Saya punya tawaran
menarik untukmu! Kamu tahu\lbagaimana Pokémon suka bersembunyi

di balik batu, ya? Kadang-kadang
mereka juga menyembunyikan tulang\lkeren. Jika kamu menemukan [green]Tulang

Langka [blue]di suatu tempat, kamu harus
membawanya kepadaku. Aku akan\lmembuatnya sepadan.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Did you find a [green]Rare Bone [blue]for me?

Looks like you did.

If you want to sell it, I’ll buy
it from you for [green]$10000[blue]."
entries.translation_source: What’s up? Did you find a [color-green-1]Rare Bone [color-blue-2]for me? Looks like you did. If you want to sell it, I’ll buy it from you for [color-green-3]$10000[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Ada apa? Apakah kamu menemukan
[green]Tulang Langka [blue]untukku? Sepertinya\lkamu punya. Jika kamu ingin

menjualnya, aku akan membelinya
darimu seharga [green]$10000[blue].

entries.original:
"[black]You gave the guy a Rare Bone in
exchange for $10000."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You gave the guy a Rare Bone in exchange for $10000.
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu memberikan pria itu Tulang
Langka sebagai ganti $10000.

entries.original:
"If you find any more Rare Bones
come see me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: If you find any more Rare Bones come see me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu menemukan Tulang Langka
lagi, temui aku. Aku akan\lmembuatnya sepadan.

entries.original:
"Hey, come see me if you find a
Rare Bone, got it?

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, come see me if you find a Rare Bone, got it? I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Hei, temui aku jika kamu menemukan
Tulang Langka, mengerti? Aku akan\lmembuatnya sepadan.

entries.original:
"I just simply adore ores.

Don’t you have an adorable ore that
shakes my core?"
entries.translation_source: I just simply adore ores. Don’t you have an adorable ore that shakes my core?
entries.translated:
Saya hanya benar-benar memuja
bijih. Apakah kamu tidak punya\lbijih yang menggemaskan yang

mengguncang inti saya?

entries.original:
"Oh, I do adore the ores!

That [green][buffer3][blue], it’s shaking me!
Will you sell it for [green]$[buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I do adore the ores! That [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3], it’s shaking me! Will you sell it for [color-green-4]$[buffer2-5][color-blue-6]?
entries.translated:
Oh, saya sangat memuja bijih!
[green][buffer3][blue] itu, mengguncang saya!\lMaukah kamu menjualnya seharga

[green]$[buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"Turned over the [green][buffer3] [blue]and
received [green]$[buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Turned over the [color-green-1][buffer3-2] [color-blue-3]and received [color-green-4]$[buffer2-5][color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Menyerahkan [green][buffer3] [blue]dan menerima
[green]$[buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"The deal is done!
I’ve scored an ore I can adore!"
entries.translation_source: The deal is done! I’ve scored an ore I can adore!
entries.translated:
Kesepakatan selesai! Saya
mendapatkan bijih yang bisa saya\lpuja!

entries.original:
"Hmmmm. You don’t seem to have any
[green][buffer3]s[blue]. Come back again."
entries.translation_source: Hmmmm. You don’t seem to have any [color-green-1][buffer3-2]s[color-blue-3]. Come back again.
entries.translated:
Hmmmm. Sepertinya kamu tidak
memiliki [green][buffer3]s[blue] apa pun. Kembali\llagi nanti.

entries.original:
"Hmmm. My core won’t change.
I hope you sell it to me someday."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm. My core won’t change. I hope you sell it to me someday.
entries.translated:
Hmmm. Inti saya tidak akan berubah.
Saya harap kamu menjualnya kepada\lsaya suatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"Never mind, looks ya already beat
it.

Great job!

Take these Go-Goggles and explore
the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Never mind, looks ya already beat it. Great job! Take these Go-Goggles and explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Sudahlah, sepertinya kamu sudah
mengalahkannya. Kerja bagus! Ambil\lGo-Goggles ini dan jelajahi Gurun

Besar!

entries.original:
"It’s my job to keep the torches
around here lit at night.

The desert can pretty cold once the
sun goes down.

Those torches are our only reliable
source of heat during that time."
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to keep the torches around here lit at night. The desert can pretty cold once the sun goes down. Those torches are our only reliable source of heat during that time.
entries.translated:
Tugasku adalah menjaga obor-obor di
sekitar sini tetap menyala di malam\lhari. Gurun bisa menjadi sangat

dingin begitu matahari terbenam.
Obor-obor itu adalah satu-satunya\lsumber panas yang dapat diandalkan

saat itu.

entries.original:
"It’s my job to keep the torches
around here lit at night.

The desert can pretty cold now that
the sun is down.

Those torches are our only reliable
source of heat right now."
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to keep the torches around here lit at night. The desert can pretty cold now that the sun is down. Those torches are our only reliable source of heat right now.
entries.translated:
Tugasku adalah menjaga obor-obor di
sekitar sini tetap menyala di malam\lhari. Gurun bisa menjadi sangat

dingin sekarang setelah matahari
terbenam. Obor-obor itu adalah\lsatu-satunya sumber panas yang

dapat diandalkan saat ini.

entries.original:
"It seems pretty odd that there’s a
forest filled with so many rare\lBug Pokémon, so close to a desert.

Well, that’s Borrius for you!"
entries.translation_source: It seems pretty odd that there’s a forest filled with so many rare Bug Pokémon, so close to a desert. Well, that’s Borrius for you!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya agak aneh ada hutan yang
dipenuhi begitu banyak Pokémon Bug\llangka, begitu dekat dengan gurun.

Ya, itulah Borrius!

entries.original:
"Gurun Town

A town that has survived the sands
of time."
entries.translation_source: Gurun Town A town that has survived the sands of time.
entries.translated:
Gurun Town Sebuah kota yang
bertahan dari pasir waktu.

entries.original: "We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Black Emboar, kamu
bajingan!

entries.original:
"I’ve spent years trying to uncover
the secret of the Regi Pokémon!

I’ve had some progress lately and
discovered that Regirock must live\lin that strange rock formation in\lthe Great Desert.

Now if only there were some way to
unseal it\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve spent years trying to uncover the secret of the Regi Pokémon! I’ve had some progress lately and discovered that Regirock must live in that strange rock formation in the Great Desert. Now if only there were some way to unseal it[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku telah bertahun-tahun mencoba
mengungkap rahasia Pokémon Regi!\lAkhir-akhir ini aku mendapat

kemajuan dan menemukan bahwa
Regirock pasti tinggal di formasi\lbatu aneh di Gurun Besar. Andai

saja ada cara untuk membuka
segelnya\.

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Rock Pokémon, Regirock.

It says here that in ancient times,
Regirock helped Regigigas form and\lmove together the Borrius Region.

It now dwells somewhere in the
Great Desert."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Rock Pokémon, Regirock. It says here that in ancient times, Regirock helped Regigigas form and move together the Borrius Region. It now dwells somewhere in the Great Desert.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah patung Pokémon Batu
Legendaris, Regirock. Di sini\ltertulis bahwa di zaman kuno,

Regirock membantu Regigigas
membentuk dan menyatukan Wilayah\lBorrius. Sekarang ia berdiam di

suatu tempat di Gurun Besar.

entries.original:
"The desert ends pretty soon after
you leave the town to the south of\lhere.

However, the route itself to
Antisis and Seaport Cities is\lnot as straightforward as you\lwould think\."
entries.translation_source: The desert ends pretty soon after you leave the town to the south of here. However, the route itself to Antisis and Seaport Cities is not as straightforward as you would think[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Gurun berakhir tidak lama setelah
kamu meninggalkan kota di sebelah\lselatan sini. Namun, rute menuju

Antisis dan Kota Pelabuhan tidak
semudah yang kamu kira\.

entries.original:
"The houses here are based off a
design found in the Unova region.

They’re from some town that boasts
of pottery made from volcanic clay.

There’s actually a maniac here as
well, who’ll buy some kind of relic\lpottery for a high price."
entries.translation_source: The houses here are based off a design found in the Unova region. They’re from some town that boasts of pottery made from volcanic clay. There’s actually a maniac here as well, who’ll buy some kind of relic pottery for a high price.
entries.translated:
Rumah-rumah di sini didasarkan pada
desain yang ditemukan di wilayah\lUnova. Mereka berasal dari suatu

kota yang terkenal dengan tembikar
dari tanah liat vulkanik.\lSebenarnya ada seorang maniak di

sini juga, yang akan membeli
tembikar peninggalan dengan harga\ltinggi.

entries.original:
"Just your average everyday
warehouse.

Nothing to see here."
entries.translation_source: Just your average everyday warehouse. Nothing to see here.
entries.translated:
Hanya gudang biasa sehari-hari.
Tidak ada yang bisa dilihat di\lsini.

entries.original:
"Vivill Town

The town filled with light and
prosperity."
entries.translation_source: Vivill Town The town filled with light and prosperity.
entries.translated:
Vivill Town Kota yang dipenuhi
cahaya dan kemakmuran.

entries.original: "The door is locked."
entries.translation_source: The door is locked.
entries.translated: Pintunya terkunci.

entries.original:
"Hey there.

\.

What? You want me to say something
interesting?

Fine then\.

I’ve been having trouble with my
brother, lately.

He’s gotten himself in deep with
this gang calling themselves the\l\qoBlack Emboar\qo.

I don’t really know what it’s all
about, but I’m really worried for\lhis safety.

I haven’t spoken with him in days
so I’m afraid something bad has\lhappened to him.

\.

What’s that?

You’d be willing to check up on
him for me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey there. [game-token-1] What? You want me to say something interesting? Fine then[game-token-2] I’ve been having trouble with my brother, lately. He’s gotten himself in deep with this gang calling themselves the [quote-open-3]Black Emboar[quote-open-4]. I don’t really know what it’s all about, but I’m really worried for his safety. I haven’t spoken with him in days so I’m afraid something bad has happened to him. [game-token-5] What’s that? You’d be willing to check up on him for me?
entries.translated:
Hei, \. Apa? Kamu ingin aku
mengatakan sesuatu yang menarik?\lBaiklah \. Akhir-akhir ini aku punya

masalah dengan saudaraku. Dia
terlibat dalam geng yang menyebut\ldiri mereka \qoBlack Emboar\qo. Aku

tidak terlalu tahu apa itu semua,
tapi aku sangat khawatir akan\lkeselamatannya. Aku belum berbicara

dengannya selama berhari-hari jadi
aku khawatir sesuatu yang buruk\ltelah terjadi padanya. \. Ada apa?

Kamu bersedia memeriksanya untukku?

entries.original:
"Thank you!

My brother can probably be found
in the northern SES Expressway.

I’d go myself, but I’m too weak of
a trainer.

They say these Black Emboar are
insanely vicious."
entries.translation_source: Thank you! My brother can probably be found in the northern SES Expressway. I’d go myself, but I’m too weak of a trainer. They say these Black Emboar are insanely vicious.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih! Saudaraku mungkin
bisa ditemukan di SES Expressway\lbagian utara. Aku akan pergi

sendiri, tapi aku terlalu lemah
sebagai pelatih. Mereka bilang\lBlack Emboar ini sangat ganas.

entries.original: "You’re the one who asked."
entries.translation_source: You’re the one who asked.
entries.translated: Kamu yang bertanya.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Yeah, you, the little brat
there!

Get over here!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hey! Yeah, you, the little brat there! Get over here!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hei! Ya, kamu, bocah kecil di sana!
Kemari!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass through
here?

This place belongs to us, the Black
Emboar!

It’s like our Gym, kid!

So scram! Toddle off home to your
ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This place belongs to us, the Black Emboar! It’s like our Gym, kid! So scram! Toddle off home to your ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hei! Siapa bilang kamu bisa lewat
sini? Tempat ini milik kami, Black\lEmboar! Ini seperti Gym kami, nak!

Jadi pergi! Pulanglah ke ibumu,
dasar bocah sok suci!

entries.original:
"[blue]Ha! Fine!

Brats like you with a future so
bright\.

Just go on back home and be nice to
your parents.

Don’t forget your baby bottle!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ha! Fine! Brats like you with a future so bright[game-token-2] Just go on back home and be nice to your parents. Don’t forget your baby bottle!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ha! Baik! Anak nakal sepertimu
dengan masa depan yang cerah\. Pulang\lsaja ke rumah dan bersikap baik

pada orang tuamu. Jangan lupa botol
bayimu!

entries.original:
"[blue]What didja say, ya little creep?

I’ll teach ya to take the Black
Emboar seriously!

I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon
right down to the ground!

With relish!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What didja say, ya little creep? I’ll teach ya to take the Black Emboar seriously! I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon right down to the ground! With relish!
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa katamu, bocah kecil? Aku akan
mengajarimu untuk menganggap serius\lBlack Emboar! Aku akan menghajar

Pokémon cantikmu sampai ke tanah!
Dengan senang hati!

entries.original:
"[blue]Don’t get all high and mighty
because you beat me!

If you really want to pick a fight
with the Black Emboar,\lgo duke it out with our leader!

He’s somewhere in this tunnel!"

entries.original:
"Maybe one day they’ll get an
import of sand paper.

But for necks."
entries.translation_source: Maybe one day they’ll get an import of sand paper. But for necks.
entries.translated:
Mungkin suatu hari mereka akan
mendapatkan impor amplas. Tapi\luntuk leher.

entries.original:
"A lover of sea is of course one to
dabble with the evolutionary!"
entries.translation_source: A lover of sea is of course one to dabble with the evolutionary!
entries.translated:
Seorang pencinta laut tentu saja
suka bermain dengan evolusi!

entries.original:
"Maybe I should invest in some
powerful TMs."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should invest in some powerful TMs.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku harus berinvestasi pada
beberapa TM yang kuat.

entries.original:
"I’m looking for the perfect letter
to send to my boyfriend.

But there are just so many options!

I just don’t know which one to
choose!"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking for the perfect letter to send to my boyfriend. But there are just so many options! I just don’t know which one to choose!
entries.translated:
Aku sedang mencari surat yang
sempurna untuk dikirim ke pacarku.\lTapi ada begitu banyak pilihan! Aku

tidak tahu yang mana yang harus
dipilih!

entries.original:
"I must go into seculsion to
study the art of the shop."
entries.translation_source: I must go into seculsion to study the art of the shop.
entries.translated:
Aku harus pergi ke pengasingan
untuk mempelajari seni toko.

entries.original: "We have arrived at Floor [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: We have arrived at Floor [buffer1-1].
entries.translated: Kami telah tiba di Lantai [buffer1].

entries.original: "Certainly."
entries.translation_source: Certainly.
entries.translated: Tentu.

entries.original: "Uh\.we are already on that floor?"
entries.translation_source: Uh[game-token-1]we are already on that floor?
entries.translated: Uh\.kita sudah di lantai itu?

entries.original:
"I look forward to serving you
again."
entries.translation_source: I look forward to serving you again.
entries.translated:
Saya menantikan untuk melayani Anda
lagi.
