should lead back to our world.

Giratina was written in legend as
being on the other side of our\lworld.

It stands to reason that it has a
link to the other side."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Let’s go back home. The portal where Giratina was should lead back to our world. Giratina was written in legend as being on the other side of our world. It stands to reason that it has a link to the other side.
entries.translated:
[blue]Mari pulang ke rumah. Portal tempat
Giratina berada seharusnya mengarah\lkembali ke dunia kita. Giratina

tertulis dalam legenda sebagai
berada di sisi lain dunia kita.\lMasuk akal bahwa ia memiliki

hubungan ke sisi lain.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]\.This place?!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1][game-token-2]This place?!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]\.Tempat ini?!

entries.original:
"[blue]It’s Rift Cave\.

It’s said to somehow have a
connection to the great beyond\.

And Giratina was said to live in an
opposite world from ours\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It’s Rift Cave[game-token-2] It’s said to somehow have a connection to the great beyond[game-token-3] And Giratina was said to live in an opposite world from ours[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]Ini Gua Rift\. Konon memiliki
hubungan dengan alam yang tak\lterbatas\. Dan Giratina dikatakan

hidup di dunia yang berlawanan dari
kita\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I guess that must mean we’ve
arrived back in our world.

I can’t thank you enough for
helping me escape that place.

But now we need to focus.

It’s time to find The Shadows and
end their evil plan!

\.

What?
The Shadows are already finished?

But there’s a new threat hiding in
Vivill Town?

There’s no time to waste then!
Off to Vivill Town!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I guess that must mean we’ve arrived back in our world. I can’t thank you enough for helping me escape that place. But now we need to focus. It’s time to find The Shadows and end their evil plan! [game-token-2] What? The Shadows are already finished? But there’s a new threat hiding in Vivill Town? There’s no time to waste then! Off to Vivill Town!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kurasa itu berarti kita sudah
kembali ke dunia kita. Aku tidak\lbisa cukup berterima kasih karena

membantu melarikan diri dari tempat
itu. Tapi sekarang kita harus\lfokus. Saatnya menemukan The

Shadows dan mengakhiri rencana
jahat mereka! \. Apa? The Shadows\lsudah selesai? Tapi ada ancaman

baru bersembunyi di Vivill Town?
Tidak ada waktu untuk disia-siakan!\lAyo ke Vivill Town!

entries.original: "Something unseeable is in the way."
entries.translation_source: Something unseeable is in the way.
entries.translated:
Sesuatu yang tidak terlihat
menghalangi jalan.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Move, kid!

You’re blocking the road!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Move, kid! You’re blocking the road!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Minggir, nak! Kamu menghalangi
jalan!

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh?

There’s somethin’ in the way?

It better not be that Pokémon
again\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Huh? There’s somethin’ in the way? It better not be that Pokémon again[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Hah? Ada sesuatu yang menghalangi?
Semoga bukan Pokémon itu lagi\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Take this.

It should get rid of whatever’s
blocking the road."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Take this. It should get rid of whatever’s blocking the road.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ambil ini. Seharusnya bisa
menyingkirkan apa pun yang\lmenghalangi jalan.

entries.original: "[blue]Try talking to the obstacle now."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Try talking to the obstacle now.
entries.translated:
[blue]Coba bicara dengan penghalang
sekarang.

entries.original:
"Something unseeable is in the way.

Want to use the Devon Scope?"
entries.translation_source: Something unseeable is in the way. Want to use the Devon Scope?
entries.translated:
Sesuatu yang tidak terlihat
menghalangi jalan. Ingin\lmenggunakan Devon Scope?

entries.original:
"[player] used the Devon Scope.

An invisible Pokémon became
completely visible!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] used the Devon Scope. An invisible Pokémon became completely visible!
entries.translated:
[player] menggunakan Devon Scope.
Seekor Pokémon tak terlihat menjadi\lsepenuhnya terlihat!

entries.original: "The startled Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: The startled Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated: Pokémon yang terkejut menyerang!

entries.original: "The [buffer1] ran way."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] ran way.
entries.translated: [buffer1] melarikan diri.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Hmph.

I like the way you battle, kid.
You’ve got potential.

You should take on the Antisis Gym
with your Pokémon.

I hear the Gym Leader there has
been pretty bored lately."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Hmph. I like the way you battle, kid. You’ve got potential. You should take on the Antisis Gym with your Pokémon. I hear the Gym Leader there has been pretty bored lately.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Hmph. Aku suka cara
bertarungmu, nak. Kamu punya\lpotensi. Kamu harus menantang

Antisis Gym dengan Pokémon-mu.
Kudengar Pemimpin Gym di sana sudah\lcukup bosan akhir-akhir ini.

entries.original:
"I came here in hopes of bringing
new life back into the area."
entries.translation_source: I came here in hopes of bringing new life back into the area.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini dengan harapan
membawa kehidupan baru kembali ke\larea ini.

entries.original: "Look at these magnificent wings!"
entries.translation_source: Look at these magnificent wings!

entries.original: "I’m going to peck you for that!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to peck you for that!

entries.original:
"Did you know that there’s a bird
Pokémon that can mimic speech?"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that there’s a bird Pokémon that can mimic speech?
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa ada seekor
Pokémon burung yang bisa meniru\lucapan?

entries.original:
"Is it possible to become more
powerful by understanding Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Is it possible to become more powerful by understanding Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Apakah mungkin menjadi lebih kuat
dengan memahami Pokémon?

entries.original:
"I just can’t decide which Pokémon
to pamper."
entries.translation_source: I just can’t decide which Pokémon to pamper.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa memutuskan Pokémon
mana yang harus dimanjakan.

entries.original:
"This is a nice place to camp out.
It’s not too far from the city."
entries.translation_source: This is a nice place to camp out. It’s not too far from the city.
entries.translated:
Ini tempat yang bagus untuk
berkemah. Tidak terlalu jauh dari\lkota.

entries.original:
"Listen, you! Whatever happens,
never lose sight of your dream!"
entries.translation_source: Listen, you! Whatever happens, never lose sight of your dream!
entries.translated:
Dengar, kau! Apa pun yang terjadi,
jangan pernah kehilangan pandangan\lakan mimpimu!

entries.original:
"Yes, I know I can surf, but I’d
rather swim instead.

It does seem weird, I agree."
entries.translation_source: Yes, I know I can surf, but I’d rather swim instead. It does seem weird, I agree.

entries.original: "Kaploosh!"
entries.translation_source: Kaploosh!

entries.original:
"If you don’t know how, I’m willing
to show you how to swim."
entries.translation_source: If you don’t know how, I’m willing to show you how to swim.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu tidak tahu caranya, aku
bersedia mengajarkanmu berenang.

entries.original:
"Don’t get me wrong, it’s not as if
I don’t like mountain men.

But, you know, my favourite kind of
guy looks great with Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t get me wrong, it’s not as if I don’t like mountain men. But, you know, my favourite kind of guy looks great with Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Jangan salah sangka, bukan berarti
aku tidak suka pria gunung. Tapi,\lkau tahu, tipe pria favoritku

tampak hebat bersama Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Oh right\.
I was fishing, wasn’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Oh right[game-token-1] I was fishing, wasn’t I?
entries.translated:
Oh benar\. Aku sedang memancing,
bukan?

entries.original:
"Hey, there!
Let’s have ourselves a good time!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! Let’s have ourselves a good time!

entries.original: "Don’t make me mad!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t make me mad!

entries.original:
"I get my kicks by harassing people
with my stinking Pokémon.

They’re great for startling people.
And, they bite, too."
entries.translation_source: I get my kicks by harassing people with my stinking Pokémon. They’re great for startling people. And, they bite, too.
entries.translated:
Aku mendapatkan kesenangan dengan
mengganggu orang menggunakan\lPokémon bauku. Mereka hebat untuk

mengejutkan orang. Dan, mereka juga
menggigit.

entries.original:
"Leaving so soon?

There’s an exit toll to pay!"
entries.translation_source: Leaving so soon? There’s an exit toll to pay!

entries.original: "You took my money!"
entries.translation_source: You took my money!

entries.original:
"Forget it!
I don’t need your money!"
entries.translation_source: Forget it! I don’t need your money!
entries.translated:
Lupakan saja! Aku tidak butuh
uangmu!

entries.original:
"Route 16

\au Gurun Town
\ad Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Route 16 [game-token-1] Gurun Town [game-token-2] Antisis City
entries.translated:
Route 16 \au Gurun Town \ad Antisis
City

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]\.but now the whole base
has been mostly abandoned\."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1][game-token-2]but now the whole base has been mostly abandoned[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]\.tapi sekarang seluruh
markas sudah sebagian besar\lditinggalkan\.

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!

I’m glad you could join us.
There’s much we need to discuss."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! I’m glad you could join us. There’s much we need to discuss.
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Aku senang kau bisa
bergabung dengan kami. Banyak yang\lperlu kita diskusikan.

entries.original:
"[blue]I was just catching up Jax on
everything that has occured since\lyour disappearance from Dehara City."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I was just catching up Jax on everything that has occured since your disappearance from Dehara City.
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku baru saja memberi tahu Jax
tentang semua yang terjadi sejak\lkau menghilang dari Dehara City.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Looker has been filling me in
on a ton.

A lot has happened since I was sent
to the Distortion World\.

I may have only been there for a
few hours by the time you showed\lup, but a lot more time passed in\lthe real world while I was there."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Looker has been filling me in on a ton. A lot has happened since I was sent to the Distortion World[game-token-2] I may have only been there for a few hours by the time you showed up, but a lot more time passed in the real world while I was there.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Looker sudah banyak memberi
tahuku. Banyak hal terjadi sejak\laku dikirim ke Dunia Distorsi\. Aku

mungkin hanya di sana beberapa jam
saat kau muncul, tapi lebih banyak\lwaktu berlalu di dunia nyata saat

aku di sana.

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]You missed quite a lot as
well, [player].

As planned, I was waiting outside
the warehouse for you and [rival],\lwhen some cloaked figures exited\lthe warehouse with a large,\lpurple Pokémon.

I was prepared to arrest them, when
all of a sudden, their leader\lyelled something to the Pokémon\lbehind them.

The next thing I knew, they had
vanished without a trace.

I immediately searched the
warehouse for any stragglers, but\lbut I was only able to find one\lgrunt who remained behind.

He informed me that all he knew,
was that the Light of Ruin is\lheading somewhere in [green]East Borrius[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]You missed quite a lot as well, [player-name-2]. As planned, I was waiting outside the warehouse for you and [text-token-rival-3], when some cloaked figures exited the warehouse with a large, purple Pokémon. I was prepared to arrest them, when all of a sudden, their leader yelled something to the Pokémon behind them. The next thing I knew, they had vanished without a trace. I immediately searched the warehouse for any stragglers, but but I was only able to find one grunt who remained behind. He informed me that all he knew, was that the Light of Ruin is heading somewhere in [color-green-4]East Borrius[color-blue-5].
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Kau juga melewatkan banyak
hal, [player]. Seperti yang\ldirencanakan, aku menunggu di luar

gudang untukmu dan [rival], ketika
beberapa sosok berjubah keluar dari\lgudang dengan seekor Pokémon ungu

besar. Aku bersiap untuk menangkap
mereka, ketika tiba-tiba, pemimpin\lmereka berteriak sesuatu kepada

Pokémon di belakang mereka.
Selanjutnya aku tahu, mereka lenyap\ltanpa jejak. Aku segera mencari

gudang untuk para penyusup, tetapi
aku hanya bisa menemukan satu\lprajurit yang tertinggal. Dia

memberitahuku bahwa yang dia tahu,
adalah bahwa Light of Ruin menuju\lke suatu tempat di [green]East Borrius[blue].

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue][green]East Borrius[blue]?

What would the Light of Ruin be
doing there?"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1][color-green-2]East Borrius[color-blue-3]? What would the Light of Ruin be doing there?
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue][green]East Borrius[blue]? Apa yang akan
dilakukan Light of Ruin di sana?

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]I’m not sure, Jax.

That’s all the grunt knew, and all
data had been wiped from their\lcomputer system."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]I’m not sure, Jax. That’s all the grunt knew, and all data had been wiped from their computer system.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Aku tidak yakin, Jax. Itu
saja yang diketahui prajurit itu,\ldan semua data telah dihapus dari

sistem komputer mereka.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Well we won’t figure anything
out by just standing here.

We need to hop on a boat to [green]East
Borrius [blue]from [green]Seaport City[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Well we won’t figure anything out by just standing here. We need to hop on a boat to [color-green-2]East Borrius [color-blue-3]from [color-green-4]Seaport City[color-blue-5]!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Yah kita tidak akan menemukan
apa pun hanya dengan berdiri di\lsini. Kita harus naik perahu ke

[green]East Borrius [blue]dari [green]Seaport City[blue]!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Agreed.
I’ll arrange the tickets.

You two should meet me there."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]Agreed. I’ll arrange the tickets. You two should meet me there.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Setuju. Aku akan mengatur
tiketnya. Kalian berdua harus\lmenemuiku di sana.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]You got that, [player]?

We’re going to [green]Seaport City!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]You got that, [player-name-2]? We’re going to [color-green-3]Seaport City!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Kau mengerti, [player]? Kita
akan pergi ke [green]Seaport City!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Excuse me.
I must be going now as well."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]Excuse me. I must be going now as well.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Permisi. Aku juga harus
pergi sekarang.

entries.original: "[rival]: [blue]I’m going to end him!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]I’m going to end him!
entries.translated: [rival]: [blue]Aku akan menghabisinya!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]They’re gone\.
All gone!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]They’re gone[game-token-3] All gone!
entries.translated: [rival]: [blue]Mereka pergi\. Semua pergi!

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!

Where’s the Light of Ruin?

\.

[green]East Borrius[blue]?

Then I need to hurry to [green]Seaport
City [blue]before the next boat leaves!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! Where’s the Light of Ruin? [game-token-3] [color-green-4]East Borrius[color-blue-5]? Then I need to hurry to [color-green-6]Seaport City [color-blue-7]before the next boat leaves!
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Di mana Light of Ruin? \.
[green]East Borrius[blue]? Kalau begitu aku\lharus bergegas ke [green]Seaport City

[blue]sebelum perahu berikutnya
berangkat!

entries.original:
"Its a news report:

The Terror Granbull, the gang
responsible for terrorizing the\lcitizens of Antisis City, has\ldisappeared!

Will this usher in a new age of
peace and prosperity for the city,\lnow that all crime has been wiped\laway?

Citizens are encouraged to leave
their homes and restore Antisis\lCity to its former glory.

Make Antisis great again!"
entries.translation_source: Its a news report: The Terror Granbull, the gang responsible for terrorizing the citizens of Antisis City, has disappeared! Will this usher in a new age of peace and prosperity for the city, now that all crime has been wiped away? Citizens are encouraged to leave their homes and restore Antisis City to its former glory. Make Antisis great again!
entries.translated:
Ini laporan berita: Terror
Granbull, geng yang bertanggung\ljawab meneror warga Antisis City,

telah menghilang! Akankah ini
membawa era baru perdamaian dan\lkemakmuran bagi kota, sekarang

semua kejahatan telah terhapus?
Warga didorong untuk meninggalkan\lrumah mereka dan mengembalikan

Antisis City ke kejayaannya semula.
Jadikan Antisis hebat lagi!

entries.original:
"Those poozers think that Antisis
City is safe now that the Terror\lGranbull are gone!

Haw haw!

They couldn’t be more wrong!"
entries.translation_source: Those poozers think that Antisis City is safe now that the Terror Granbull are gone! Haw haw! They couldn’t be more wrong!
entries.translated:
Para poozer itu mengira Antisis
City aman sekarang setelah Terror\lGranbull pergi! Haw haw! Mereka

tidak bisa lebih salah lagi!

entries.original:
"My boyfriend is so strong and
tough!

There ain’t no one like him here in
the city!

Well, aside from Big Mo, of course."
entries.translation_source: My boyfriend is so strong and tough! There ain’t no one like him here in the city! Well, aside from Big Mo, of course.
entries.translated:
Pacarku sangat kuat dan tangguh!
Tidak ada yang seperti dia di kota\lini! Yah, selain Big Mo, tentu

saja.

entries.original:
"You wanna prove you’re tough?
Huh, boy?

You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo.

He’s the biggest, toughest guy in
all of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You wanna prove you’re tough? Huh, boy? You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo. He’s the biggest, toughest guy in all of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Kamu mau membuktikan bahwa kamu
tangguh? Huh, nak? Kamu harus\lmenghadapi Big Mo. Dia pria

terbesar dan terkuat di seluruh
Antisis City.

entries.original:
"You wanna prove you’re tough?
Huh, girly?

You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo.

He’s the biggest, toughest guy in
all of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You wanna prove you’re tough? Huh, girly? You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo. He’s the biggest, toughest guy in all of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Kamu mau membuktikan bahwa kamu
tangguh? Huh, nona? Kamu harus\lmenghadapi Big Mo. Dia pria

terbesar dan terkuat di seluruh
Antisis City.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You must be pretty tough if you
took down Big Mo.

That ain’t easy.

You know what, take these as a
congrats from me."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] You must be pretty tough if you took down Big Mo. That ain’t easy. You know what, take these as a congrats from me.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Kamu pasti cukup tangguh jika
bisa mengalahkan Big Mo. Itu tidak\lmudah. Kamu tahu, ambil ini sebagai

ucapan selamat dariku.

entries.original:
"Use those balls to catch even more
tough Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Use those balls to catch even more tough Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Gunakan bola-bola itu untuk
menangkap Pokémon yang lebih\ltangguh.

entries.original: "You don’t need ’em."
entries.translation_source: You don’t need ’em.
entries.translated: Kamu tidak membutuhkannya.

entries.original: "Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!"
entries.translation_source: Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!
entries.translated: Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!

entries.original:
"Yeah\.I think your Pokémon are
healed.

But I didn’t go through Nursing
School so I can’t really tell."
entries.translation_source: Yeah[game-token-1]I think your Pokémon are healed. But I didn’t go through Nursing School so I can’t really tell.

entries.original:
"I really hope I see you and your
money again."
entries.translation_source: I really hope I see you and your money again.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Antisis City
Police HQ!

\.

Well, actually its just my home,
now.

The gangs around here have gotten
too rowdy for us, lately."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Antisis City Police HQ! [game-token-1] Well, actually its just my home, now. The gangs around here have gotten too rowdy for us, lately.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Markas Polisi
Antisis City! \. Yah, sebenarnya ini\lhanya rumahku sekarang. Geng-geng

di sini sudah terlalu ribut bagi
kami akhir-akhir ini.

entries.original:
"It’s good that someone your age is
pursuing the healthy career of\lPokémon Trainer.

It’s much better than being part of
a gang.

Trust me, I know.
I see what goes on around here."
entries.translation_source: It’s good that someone your age is pursuing the healthy career of Pokémon Trainer. It’s much better than being part of a gang. Trust me, I know. I see what goes on around here.
entries.translated:
Bagus bahwa seseorang seusiamu
mengejar karir sehat sebagai\lPelatih Pokémon. Itu jauh lebih

baik daripada menjadi bagian dari
geng. Percayalah, aku tahu. Aku\llihat apa yang terjadi di sini.

entries.original:
"It’s too bad that someone of your
age is part of a gang.

It’s a shame, really.

You could’ve had so much potential,
but now, you have none at all."
entries.translation_source: It’s too bad that someone of your age is part of a gang. It’s a shame, really. You could’ve had so much potential, but now, you have none at all.
entries.translated:
Sangat disayangkan bahwa seseorang
seusiamu menjadi bagian dari geng.\lSungguh memalukan. Kamu bisa

memiliki begitu banyak potensi,
tapi sekarang, kamu tidak punya\lsama sekali.

entries.original:
"It’s nice that in a city like this,
an outcast, like me, can fit in.

No one judges me for anything I do,
anymore."
entries.translation_source: It’s nice that in a city like this, an outcast, like me, can fit in. No one judges me for anything I do, anymore.
entries.translated:
Senang bahwa di kota seperti ini,
seorang buangan seperti aku bisa\lcocok. Tidak ada lagi yang

menghakimiku untuk apapun yang aku
lakukan.

entries.original:
"I used to be part of the Terror
Granbull, the gang that ran this\ltown.

But the Black Ferrothorn took us by
surprise and attacked our base\lthrough the sewers.

Now I’m back to being a nobody,
living with their mom.

Don’t let that ever happen to you,
kid!

Stay in school!"
entries.translation_source: I used to be part of the Terror Granbull, the gang that ran this town. But the Black Ferrothorn took us by surprise and attacked our base through the sewers. Now I’m back to being a nobody, living with their mom. Don’t let that ever happen to you, kid! Stay in school!
entries.translated:
Aku dulu bagian dari Terror
Granbull, geng yang menguasai kota\lini. Tapi Black Ferrothorn

mengejutkan kami dan menyerang
basis kami melalui selokan.\lSekarang aku kembali menjadi orang

tak berarti, tinggal dengan ibuku.
Jangan biarkan itu terjadi padamu,\lnak! Tetap di sekolah!

entries.original:
"My son is such a lowlife.

When will he ever get a real job
and leave the house?"
entries.translation_source: My son is such a lowlife. When will he ever get a real job and leave the house?
entries.translated:
Anakku benar-benar sampah. Kapan
dia akan mendapatkan pekerjaan\lnyata dan keluar rumah?

entries.original:
"Antisis City is the most
crime-ridden city in Borrius.

But because of its existance, most
lowlives in the region are drawn\lhere, causing crime rates to\ldecrease everywhere else."
entries.translation_source: Antisis City is the most crime-ridden city in Borrius. But because of its existance, most lowlives in the region are drawn here, causing crime rates to decrease everywhere else.
entries.translated:
Antisis City adalah kota paling
penuh kejahatan di Borrius. Tapi\lkarena keberadaannya, sebagian

besar sampah di wilayah ini
tertarik ke sini, menyebabkan\ltingkat kejahatan menurun di tempat

lain.

entries.original: "Uh\.whaddya want?"
entries.translation_source: Uh[game-token-1]whaddya want?

entries.original: "Don’t come back."
entries.translation_source: Don’t come back.
entries.translated: Jangan kembali.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], buddy, how’s it
hangin’?

Listen, man, the other day I
accidentally flushed my favourite\lpair of socks down the toilet."
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player-name-1], buddy, how’s it hangin’? Listen, man, the other day I accidentally flushed my favourite pair of socks down the toilet.
entries.translated:
Hei, [player], sobat, apa kabar?
Dengar, teman, beberapa hari lalu\laku tidak sengaja menyiram kaus

kaki favoritku ke toilet.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], buddy, how’s it
hangin’?

Listen, girl, the other day I
accidentally flushed my favourite\lpair of socks down the toilet."
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player-name-1], buddy, how’s it hangin’? Listen, girl, the other day I accidentally flushed my favourite pair of socks down the toilet.
entries.translated:
Hei, [player], sobat, gimana
kabarnya? Denger ya, nona, beberapa\lwaktu lalu aku tidak sengaja

menyiram kaus kaki favoritku ke
toilet.

entries.original:
"I went down to the sewers to go
look for ’em, but I just couldn’t\lfind ’em for the life of me.

Now I know you must be wondering
why my socks were even in the\ltoilet in the first place.

But that’s another story for
another time.

So I was thinkin’ maybe you could
have a go at searching for me?"
entries.translation_source: I went down to the sewers to go look for ’em, but I just couldn’t find ’em for the life of me. Now I know you must be wondering why my socks were even in the toilet in the first place. But that’s another story for another time. So I was thinkin’ maybe you could have a go at searching for me?
entries.translated:
Aku turun ke selokan untuk
mencarinya, tapi tidak kutemukan\lsama sekali. Sekarang aku tahu kau

pasti bertanya-tanya kenapa kaus
kakiku ada di toilet sejak awal.\lTapi itu cerita lain untuk lain

waktu. Jadi aku berpikir, mungkin
kau bisa mencoba mencarikanku?

entries.original:
"Thanks, man. I knew I could count
on you."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, man. I knew I could count on you.
entries.translated:
Makasih, kawan. Aku tahu aku bisa
mengandalkanmu.

entries.original:
"Thanks, girl. I knew I could count
on you."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, girl. I knew I could count on you.
entries.translated:
Makasih, nona. Aku tahu aku bisa
mengandalkanmu.

entries.original:
"Just go down to the sewers and look
for my socks.

The main entrance is by the SES
Expressway."
entries.translation_source: Just go down to the sewers and look for my socks. The main entrance is by the SES Expressway.
entries.translated:
Turun saja ke selokan dan cari kaus
kakiku. Pintu masuk utamanya di\ldekat SES Expressway.

entries.original:
"I don’t blame you, [player].
No hard feelin’s.

I’ll just have to live without my
favourite pair of socks from now\lon.  Sniff ."
entries.translation_source: I don’t blame you, [player-name-1]. No hard feelin’s. I’ll just have to live without my favourite pair of socks from now on. Sniff .
entries.translated:
Aku tidak menyalahkanmu, [player].
Tidak ada perasaan kesal. Aku harus\lhidup tanpa kaus kaki favoritku

mulai sekarang. Hiks.

entries.original:
"You found ’em!

But oh man, do they reek!"
entries.translation_source: You found ’em! But oh man, do they reek!
entries.translated:
Kau menemukannya! Tapi ya ampun,
baunya busuk sekali!

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the grimy socks
to the Black [player] goon."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over the grimy socks to the Black [player-name-3] goon.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan kaus kaki
kotor itu kepada preman Black\l[player].

entries.original:
"Uh\.oh yeah, I should probably
give you something for your\ltrouble."
entries.translation_source: Uh[game-token-1]oh yeah, I should probably give you something for your trouble.
entries.translated:
Uh\.oh ya, sepertinya aku harus
memberimu sesuatu sebagai imbalan\latas susah payahmu.

entries.original:
"I wiped that grime off of my socks,
but I don’t know what it does.

I’m sure you can make better use
of it than me."
entries.translation_source: I wiped that grime off of my socks, but I don’t know what it does. I’m sure you can make better use of it than me.
entries.translated:
Aku membersihkan kotoran itu dari
kaus kakiku, tapi aku tidak tahu\lfungsinya. Aku yakin kau bisa

menggunakannya lebih baik dariku.

entries.original:
"I put my socks right on without
even washing em’!

That’s how excited I am to have
’em back."
entries.translation_source: I put my socks right on without even washing em’! That’s how excited I am to have ’em back.
entries.translated:
Aku langsung memakai kaus kakiku
tanpa mencucinya! Begitu senangnya\laku mendapatkannya kembali.

entries.original:
"If you want it, you need more space
in your bag."
entries.translation_source: If you want it, you need more space in your bag.
entries.translated:
Jika kau menginginkannya, kau perlu
ruang lebih di tasmu.

entries.original:
"This base used to belong to the old
gang that used to run Antisis City.

After the Black Ferrothorn kicked
them out, they left this base\labandoned.

We fixed it up when we came, and
even replaced the hole to the sewer\lwith stairs!"
entries.translation_source: This base used to belong to the old gang that used to run Antisis City. After the Black Ferrothorn kicked them out, they left this base abandoned. We fixed it up when we came, and even replaced the hole to the sewer with stairs!
entries.translated:
Markas ini dulunya milik geng lama
yang menguasai Antisis City.\lSetelah Black Ferrothorn mengusir

mereka, mereka meninggalkan markas
ini. Kami memperbaikinya saat\ldatang, dan bahkan mengganti lubang

ke selokan dengan tangga!

entries.original:
"We’re discussing our strategy for
taking down the Black Ferrothorn."
entries.translation_source: We’re discussing our strategy for taking down the Black Ferrothorn.
entries.translated:
Kami sedang mendiskusikan strategi
untuk mengalahkan Black Ferrothorn.

entries.original:
"James: [blue][player]!

You made it!
Welcome to the Black [player] HQ!"
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! You made it! Welcome to the Black [player-name-3] HQ!
entries.translated:
James: [blue][player]! Kau berhasil!
Selamat datang di Markas Black\l[player]!

entries.original:
"[blue]It may not look like much right
now, but once we take out the Black\lFerrothorn, we’ll fix it up.

You’re more than welcome to stick
around and help us deal with ’em.

We’re still discussing our
strategy, so in the mean time, you\lshould see if any of your fellow\lBlack [player]s need a hand."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It may not look like much right now, but once we take out the Black Ferrothorn, we’ll fix it up. You’re more than welcome to stick around and help us deal with ’em. We’re still discussing our strategy, so in the mean time, you should see if any of your fellow Black [player-name-2]s need a hand.
entries.translated:
[blue]Mungkin tidak terlihat seperti
apa-apa sekarang, tapi setelah kita\lmengalahkan Black Ferrothorn, kita

akan memperbaikinya. Kau
dipersilakan untuk tetap tinggal\ldan membantu kami menghadapi

mereka. Kami masih mendiskusikan
strategi, jadi sementara itu, kau\lharus lihat apakah sesama Black

[player]s butuh bantuan.

entries.original:
"James: [blue]You’re just in time,
[player].

We figured out how we’re gonna take
down those Black Ferrothorns.

We’re gonna pull a gutsy move and
attack from the sewers.

Gwa ha ha ha!

Those arrogant loaves of meat won’t
know what hit em’!"
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1]You’re just in time, [player-name-2]. We figured out how we’re gonna take down those Black Ferrothorns. We’re gonna pull a gutsy move and attack from the sewers. Gwa ha ha ha! Those arrogant loaves of meat won’t know what hit em’!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Kau datang tepat waktu,
[player]. Kami sudah tahu cara\lmengalahkan Black Ferrothorn itu.

Kami akan melakukan tindakan berani
dan menyerang dari selokan. Gwa ha\lha ha! Potongan-potongan daging

sombong itu tidak akan tahu apa
yang menimpa mereka!

entries.original:
"[blue]Goons! Mount your bikes!
We’re goin’ to the sewers!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Goons! Mount your bikes! We’re goin’ to the sewers!
entries.translated:
[blue]Preman! Naiki sepeda kalian! Kita
pergi ke selokan!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]Help out your fellow Black
[player]s while we plan our attack."
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1]Help out your fellow Black [player-name-2]s while we plan our attack.
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Bantu sesama Black [player]s
sementara kami merencanakan\lserangan.

entries.original:
"One day I’m gonna strike it rich
and buy a real couch."
entries.translation_source: One day I’m gonna strike it rich and buy a real couch.
entries.translated:
Suatu hari aku akan menjadi kaya
raya dan membeli sofa sungguhan.

entries.original:
"âÁYo! [player]!

This lady in the city has really
been pissin’ me off, lately.

Help me nab her prized Pokémon!
She needs to be suffer!"
entries.translation_source: âÁYo! [player-name-1]! This lady in the city has really been pissin’ me off, lately. Help me nab her prized Pokémon! She needs to be suffer!

entries.original:
"Alright!

Before we go, you probably should
put on a mask or somethin’ so no\lone can recognize you.

I don’t want you to end up like me
’cause someone saw you commit a\lfelony when you were young."
entries.translation_source: Alright! Before we go, you probably should put on a mask or somethin’ so no one can recognize you. I don’t want you to end up like me ’cause someone saw you commit a felony when you were young.
entries.translated:
Baiklah! Sebelum kita pergi,
sebaiknya kamu pakai masker atau\lsesuatu agar tidak ada yang bisa

mengenalimu. Aku tidak ingin kamu
berakhir seperti aku karena\lseseorang melihatmu melakukan

kejahatan saat kamu masih muda.

entries.original: "[black]Put on Marlon’s uniform?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Put on Marlon’s uniform?
entries.translated: [black]Pakai seragam Marlon?

entries.original: "Fine! I’ll do it myself, then!"
entries.translation_source: Fine! I’ll do it myself, then!
entries.translated:
Baik! Aku akan melakukannya
sendiri, kalau begitu!

entries.original:
"How’re you enjoying that fancy new
Pokémon, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: How’re you enjoying that fancy new Pokémon, [player-name-1]?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kau menikmati Pokémon
baru yang mewah itu, [player]?

entries.original:
"Yo, [player].

I tried sending the Pokémon out to
see what it was, but when I did, it\ljust refused to obey me.

I was thinking that the reason is
because we stole the Pokémon.

So here’s what we’re gonna do.

I’m gonna release the Pokémon from
its ball, and you’re gonna battle,\land capture it yourself,

You ready?"
entries.translation_source: Yo, [player-name-1]. I tried sending the Pokémon out to see what it was, but when I did, it just refused to obey me. I was thinking that the reason is because we stole the Pokémon. So here’s what we’re gonna do. I’m gonna release the Pokémon from its ball, and you’re gonna battle, and capture it yourself, You ready?
entries.translated:
Yo, [player]. Aku mencoba
mengeluarkan Pokémon itu untuk\lmelihat apa itu, tapi saat

kulakukan, ia menolak untuk
mematuhiku. Kurasa alasannya karena\lkita mencuri Pokémon itu. Jadi

begini yang akan kita lakukan. Aku
akan melepaskan Pokémon itu dari\lbola, dan kamu akan bertarung dan

menangkapnya sendiri. Kamu siap?

entries.original:
"Take these Ultra Balls to help you
catch it."
entries.translation_source: Take these Ultra Balls to help you catch it.
entries.translated:
Ambil Bola Ultra ini untuk membantu
menangkapnya.

entries.original:
"Hurry up and get ready.

I think it’s a Lv. 35 Poison type
of some kind."
entries.translation_source: Hurry up and get ready. I think it’s a Lv. 35 Poison type of some kind.
entries.translated:
Cepat bersiap. Kurasa ini Pokémon
tipe Racun level 35.

entries.original:
"Never mind, looks like you don’t
need ’em."
entries.translation_source: Never mind, looks like you don’t need ’em.
entries.translated:
Sudahlah, sepertinya kau tidak
membutuhkannya.

entries.original:
"Alright!
You caught it!

That’ll show that lady!

Her Pokémon is now in the hands of
a grade A trainer!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! You caught it! That’ll show that lady! Her Pokémon is now in the hands of a grade A trainer!
entries.translated:
Baik! Kamu menangkapnya! Itu akan
menunjukkan pada wanita itu!\lPokémonnya sekarang ada di tangan

pelatih kelas A!

entries.original:
"Why’d you go and knock it out?

Now I we have to heal it, and you
have to battle it all over again!"
entries.translation_source: Why’d you go and knock it out? Now I we have to heal it, and you have to battle it all over again!
entries.translated:
Kenapa kau membuatnya pingsan?
Sekarang kita harus\lmenyembuhkannya, dan kau harus

bertarung lagi dari awal!

entries.original:
"The Grimer is all healed up.
Are you ready to fight it, again?"
entries.translation_source: The Grimer is all healed up. Are you ready to fight it, again?
entries.translated:
Grimer sudah sembuh total. Apakah
kamu siap bertarung lagi?

entries.original: "You have already solved the puzzle."
entries.translation_source: You have already solved the puzzle.
entries.translated:
Kamu sudah memecahkan teka-teki
ini.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], you wanna help out
with a little problem I’m having\lwith those Black Ferrothorns?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player-name-1], you wanna help out with a little problem I’m having with those Black Ferrothorns?
entries.translated:
Hei, [player], kau mau membantu
dengan masalah kecil yang kuhadapi\ldengan para Black Ferrothorn itu?

entries.original:
"Here’s the low down.

I fought these Black Ferrothorn
goons a while back, but they\lwrecked me totally.

One of the goons used his partner’s
Pokémon also to battle me, so I\ldidn’t stand a chance.

I really wanna put ’em in their
place, but I just ain’t strong\lenough.

You think you can take ’em both out
for me?"
entries.translation_source: Here’s the low down. I fought these Black Ferrothorn goons a while back, but they wrecked me totally. One of the goons used his partner’s Pokémon also to battle me, so I didn’t stand a chance. I really wanna put ’em in their place, but I just ain’t strong enough. You think you can take ’em both out for me?
entries.translated:
Ini dia ceritanya. Aku bertarung
melawan preman Black Ferrothorn ini\lbeberapa waktu lalu, tapi mereka

menghancurkanku total. Salah satu
preman itu juga menggunakan Pokémon\lpasangannya untuk melawanku, jadi

aku tidak punya kesempatan. Aku
benar-benar ingin membuat mereka\ljera, tapi aku tidak cukup kuat.

Menurutmu kau bisa mengalahkan
mereka berdua untukku?

entries.original:
"You’re gutsy, [player].

I’ll take you to ’em now."
entries.translation_source: You’re gutsy, [player-name-1]. I’ll take you to ’em now.
entries.translated:
Kau berani, [player]. Aku akan
membawamu ke mereka sekarang.

entries.original:
"Hmph.
I thought you had guts, kid."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. I thought you had guts, kid.
entries.translated: Hmph. Kukira kau punya nyali, Nak.

entries.original:
"You’re gonna need at least two
Pokemon if they team up on you."
entries.translation_source: You’re gonna need at least two Pokemon if they team up on you.
entries.translated:
Kau akan butuh setidaknya dua
Pokémon jika mereka bekerja sama\lmelawanmu.

entries.original:
"You ready to give it another shot
[player]?

Those goons need to be put in their
place."
entries.translation_source: You ready to give it another shot [player-name-1]? Those goons need to be put in their place.
entries.translated:
Kau siap mencoba lagi [player]?
Preman-preman itu perlu diberi\lpelajaran.

entries.original:
"You really showed those Black
Ferrothorn goons, [player].

You really are the gutsiest trainer
I know."
entries.translation_source: You really showed those Black Ferrothorn goons, [player-name-1]. You really are the gutsiest trainer I know.
entries.translated:
Kau benar-benar menunjukkan pada
preman Black Ferrothorn itu,\l[player]. Kau benar-benar pelatih

paling pemberani yang kukenal.

entries.original:
"That item I just gave you is an
essential for any gutsy trainer.

Whenever your enemy touches your
Pokémon they’ll get hurt too."
entries.translation_source: That item I just gave you is an essential for any gutsy trainer. Whenever your enemy touches your Pokémon they’ll get hurt too.
entries.translated:
Barang yang baru kuberikan padamu
adalah barang penting bagi setiap\lpelatih pemberani. Setiap kali

musuh menyentuh Pokémonmu, mereka
juga akan terluka.

entries.original:
"Those goons won’t be bothering me
anymore. Thanks [player]."
entries.translation_source: Those goons won’t be bothering me anymore. Thanks [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Para preman itu tidak akan
menggangguku lagi. Terima kasih\l[player].

entries.original:
"I wanted to give you an item, but
you don’t have space."
entries.translation_source: I wanted to give you an item, but you don’t have space.
entries.translated:
Aku ingin memberimu barang, tapi
ruangmu penuh.

entries.original:
"Goon: [blue]Hey, you Black Ferrothorn
bozos! I’m here for a rematch!"
entries.translation_source: Goon: [color-blue-1]Hey, you Black Ferrothorn bozos! I’m here for a rematch!
entries.translated:
Preman: [blue]Hei, kalian para konyol
Black Ferrothorn! Aku di sini untuk\ltanding ulang!

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]You hear that, Chad?

This weak punk thinks he can beat
us!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [color-blue-1]You hear that, Chad? This weak punk thinks he can beat us!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Kau dengar itu, Chad?
Pengecut lemah ini pikir dia bisa\lmengalahkan kita!

entries.original:
"Goon: [blue]Oh, I aint gonna be doin’ any
fightin’.

My pal, [player], here, is gonna
destroy youse guys for me!"
entries.translation_source: Goon: [color-blue-1]Oh, I aint gonna be doin’ any fightin’. My pal, [player-name-2], here, is gonna destroy youse guys for me!
entries.translated:
Preman: [blue]Oh, aku tidak akan
bertarung. Temanku, [player], di\lsini, akan menghancurkan kalian

untukku!

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]Is that so?

Well, then we’re just gonna have to
pummel him into the ground!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [color-blue-1]Is that so? Well, then we’re just gonna have to pummel him into the ground!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Benarkah? Kalau begitu, kami
harus menghajarnya sampai babak\lbelur!

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]Is that so?

Well, then we’re just gonna have to
pummel her into the ground!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [color-blue-1]Is that so? Well, then we’re just gonna have to pummel her into the ground!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Benarkah? Kalau begitu, kami
harus menghajarnya sampai babak\lbelur!

entries.original:
"[blue]Chad! Gimme your Pokémon!

I’m gonna take ’em down with our
combined strength!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Chad! Gimme your Pokémon! I’m gonna take ’em down with our combined strength!
entries.translated:
[blue]Chad! Berikan Pokémonmu! Aku akan
menjatuhkan mereka dengan kekuatan\lgabungan kita!

entries.original:
"Chad: [blue]Go do this, man!

Rock their socks off and throw ’em in
the sewer like that other guy’s!"
entries.translation_source: Chad: [color-blue-1]Go do this, man! Rock their socks off and throw ’em in the sewer like that other guy’s!
entries.translated:
Chad: [blue]Ayo lakukan, kawan! Hajar
mereka habis-habisan dan buang ke\lselokan seperti yang lainnya!

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]You’d better hope you’re
prepared for my double rage!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [color-blue-1]You’d better hope you’re prepared for my double rage!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Kau sebaiknya berharap sudah
siap menghadapi amarah gandaku!

entries.original:
"Wha\.no way\.
You rocked my socks noff!"
entries.translation_source: Wha[game-token-1]no way[game-token-2] You rocked my socks noff!

entries.original:
"Gwa ha ha ha! That’ll learn ya, you
little punk!"
entries.translation_source: Gwa ha ha ha! That’ll learn ya, you little punk!

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]Wha\.you shouldn’t be able
to beat the Black Ferrothorn!

Our hides are iron thick!
How’s this possible!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [color-blue-1]Wha[game-token-2]you shouldn’t be able to beat the Black Ferrothorn! Our hides are iron thick! How’s this possible!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Apa\.kamu seharusnya tidak bisa
mengalahkan Black Ferrothorn! Kulit\lkami setebal besi! Bagaimana ini

mungkin!

entries.original:
"Goon: [blue]Now you see the real
toughness of the Black [player]!

Your hides aren’t thick, they’re as
soft as a Smoochum!

Hahaha!"
entries.translation_source: Goon: [color-blue-1]Now you see the real toughness of the Black [player-name-2]! Your hides aren’t thick, they’re as soft as a Smoochum! Hahaha!
entries.translated:
Preman: [blue]Sekarang kau lihat
ketangguhan sebenarnya dari Black\l[player]! Kulitmu tidak tebal,

mereka selembut Smoochum! Hahaha!

entries.original:
"[blue]You’re one gutsy trainer,
[player]!

I dunno anyone else who’d had the
guts to take on two trainers’\lPokémon at once!

Ya know what\.come back to the
base an’ I’ll give you a little\lsomething for your help."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You’re one gutsy trainer, [player-name-2]! I dunno anyone else who’d had the guts to take on two trainers’ Pokémon at once! Ya know what[game-token-3]come back to the base an’ I’ll give you a little something for your help.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu pelatih pemberani, [player]!
Aku tidak tahu orang lain yang\lpunya nyali melawan Pokémon dua

pelatih sekaligus! Kau tahu\.kembali
ke markas dan aku akan memberimu\lsesuatu kecil sebagai bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]What\.did you actually think
you could beat us?

The Black Ferrothorn?"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [color-blue-1]What[game-token-2]did you actually think you could beat us? The Black Ferrothorn?
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Apa\.apa kau benar-benar pikir
bisa mengalahkan kami? Black\lFerrothorn?

entries.original:
"Goon: [blue]I thought you could beat ’em
[player]\.

Now you’ve gone and humiliated the
Black [player]\.

You better get stronger so ya can
take ’em out next time."
entries.translation_source: Goon: [color-blue-1]I thought you could beat ’em [player-name-2][game-token-3] Now you’ve gone and humiliated the Black [player-name-4][game-token-5] You better get stronger so ya can take ’em out next time.
entries.translated:
Preman: [blue]Kupikir kau bisa
mengalahkan mereka [player]\.\lSekarang kau telah mempermalukan

Black [player]\. Kau sebaiknya
menjadi lebih kuat agar bisa\lmengalahkan mereka lain kali.

entries.original:
"Rory: [blue]Is that so?

Well, then it’s time to get
pummelled into the ground again!"
entries.translation_source: Rory: [color-blue-1]Is that so? Well, then it’s time to get pummelled into the ground again!
entries.translated:
Rory: [blue]Benarkah? Kalau begitu,
saatnya dihajar lagi sampai babak\lbelur!

entries.original:
"Humans need sewers, but what
about Pokémon?

Take that question, and take this
battle challenge with it!"
entries.translation_source: Humans need sewers, but what about Pokémon? Take that question, and take this battle challenge with it!

entries.original:
"There appears to be no barrier
between you and your Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be no barrier between you and your Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Since we built this sewer, all
kinds of Pokémon have shown up."
entries.translation_source: Since we built this sewer, all kinds of Pokémon have shown up.
entries.translated:
Sejak kita membangun selokan ini,
berbagai macam Pokémon muncul.

entries.original:
"Isn’t it fun how shouting in a
sewer makes your voice echo?"
entries.translation_source: Isn’t it fun how shouting in a sewer makes your voice echo?
entries.translated:
Bukankah menyenangkan bagaimana
berteriak di selokan membuat\lsuaramu bergema?

entries.original:
"Even odours that might seem awful to
humans might be perfume to Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Even odours that might seem awful to humans might be perfume to Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Bahkan bau yang mungkin tampak
buruk bagi manusia bisa menjadi\lparfum bagi Pokémon.

entries.original: "Sine, cosine, tangent!"
entries.translation_source: Sine, cosine, tangent!

entries.original: "Hmm\.Tautology"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1]Tautology

entries.original: "What a catastrophic theorem!"
entries.translation_source: What a catastrophic theorem!
entries.translated: Teorema yang sangat mengerikan!

entries.original:
"I love cleaning, so it’s like I’m
never working a day in my life!"
entries.translation_source: I love cleaning, so it’s like I’m never working a day in my life!
entries.translated:
Aku suka membersihkan, jadi
seakan-akan aku tidak pernah\lbekerja sehari pun dalam hidupku!

entries.original:
"Did you know that there’s a second
area of the sewers?"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that there’s a second area of the sewers?

entries.original: "It’s a fun a trip\."
entries.translation_source: It’s a fun a trip[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"You can crawl through a pipe to go
to the sewers underneath the\lsouthern half of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You can crawl through a pipe to go to the sewers underneath the southern half of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa merangkak melalui pipa
untuk pergi ke selokan di bawah\lbagian selatan Kota Antisis.

entries.original:
"Lots of toxins build up in the
sewer system.

I think I can use them to make
medicines!

So I’m running an experiment!

If this works, I might be able to
use the venom of Poison-type\lPokémon to make different\lmedicines. How exciting!

Well, well\.

The result of today’s experiment
was\."
entries.translation_source: Lots of toxins build up in the sewer system. I think I can use them to make medicines! So I’m running an experiment! If this works, I might be able to use the venom of Poison-type Pokémon to make different medicines. How exciting! Well, well[game-token-1] The result of today’s experiment was[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Banyak racun menumpuk di sistem
selokan. Aku pikir aku bisa\lmenggunakannya untuk membuat obat!

Jadi aku sedang melakukan
eksperimen! Jika ini berhasil, aku\lmungkin bisa menggunakan racun

Pokémon Tipe Racun untuk membuat
berbagai obat. Menyenangkan sekali!\lNah, nah\. Hasil eksperimen hari ini

adalah\.

entries.original:
"Wow! Today’s experiment was super
successful!

Here! Please accept
the [buffer1] I made!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Today’s experiment was super successful! Here! Please accept the [buffer1-1] I made!
entries.translated:
Wow! Eksperimen hari ini sukses
besar! Ini! Silakan terima [buffer1]\lyang kubuat!

entries.original:
"There’s no more space in the bag
for a [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no more space in the bag for a [buffer1-1]!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada lagi ruang di tas untuk
[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep experimenting every day!
It’s important to keep trying.

Come back and see how it’s going!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep experimenting every day! It’s important to keep trying. Come back and see how it’s going!
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus bereksperimen setiap
hari! Penting untuk terus mencoba.\lKembalilah dan lihat bagaimana

perkembangannya!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]Alright ya goons!
It’s game time!"
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1]Alright ya goons! It’s game time!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Baiklah kalian para goblok!
Saatnya bermain!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]The bomb’s ready to blow!

Cover your freakin’ ears unless ya
wanna lose em!"
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1]The bomb’s ready to blow! Cover your freakin’ ears unless ya wanna lose em!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Bomnya siap meledak! Tutup
telinga sialanmu kalau tidak mau\lkehilangan telinga!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]Let’s go!
Jump up through the hole!"
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1]Let’s go! Jump up through the hole!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Ayo! Lompat ke atas melalui
lubang itu!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Who do you bozos think you
are, comin’ into my home, and\lattackin’ my goons?

We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
And I’m Barbs, the leader!

Do ya really want to keep messin’
with us?

We’ll destroy ya in an instant!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Who do you bozos think you are, comin’ into my home, and attackin’ my goons? We’re the Black Ferrothorn! And I’m Barbs, the leader! Do ya really want to keep messin’ with us? We’ll destroy ya in an instant!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Siapa kalian para goblok,
masuk ke rumahku, dan menyerang\lanak buahku? Kami adalah Black

Ferrothorn! Dan aku Barbs,
pemimpinnya! Apa kalian benar-benar\lingin terus macam-macam dengan

kami? Kami akan menghancurkan
kalian dalam sekejap!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]We’re the Black [player]!

And we’re gonna take you Black
Ferrothorns out so we can rule\lthis town instead of ya!

Gwa ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1]We’re the Black [player-name-2]! And we’re gonna take you Black Ferrothorns out so we can rule this town instead of ya! Gwa ha ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Kami adalah Black [player]!
Dan kami akan mengusir kalian Black\lFerrothorn sehingga kami bisa

memerintah kota ini menggantikan
kalian! Gwa ha ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Barbs: [blue]The Black [player]?

Youse guys must be that low-level
gang I’ve been hearin’ about\.

Someone oughta put ya in your
place!

And that someone oughta be me!

Who is this [player] youse guys keep
talkin’ about?

I’m gonna take ’em out and teach
youse a lesson ya won’t forget!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs: [color-blue-1]The Black [player-name-2]? Youse guys must be that low-level gang I’ve been hearin’ about[game-token-3] Someone oughta put ya in your place! And that someone oughta be me! Who is this [player-name-4] youse guys keep talkin’ about? I’m gonna take ’em out and teach youse a lesson ya won’t forget!
entries.translated:
Barbs: [blue]Black [player]? Kalian pasti
geng kelas rendah yang kudengar\.\lSeseorang seharusnya menempatkan

kalian pada tempatnya! Dan orang
itu seharusnya aku! Siapa [player]\lyang terus kalian bicarakan? Aku

akan mengalahkannya dan memberi
kalian pelajaran yang tidak akan\lkalian lupakan!

entries.original: "James: [blue]This fella, right here!"
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1]This fella, right here!
entries.translated: James: [blue]Orang ini, tepat di sini!

entries.original:
"[blue]But ya ain’t near strong enough to
take [player] out!

You’ll be crushed tryin’!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]But ya ain’t near strong enough to take [player-name-2] out! You’ll be crushed tryin’!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tapi kau tidak cukup kuat untuk
mengalahkan [player]! Kau akan\lhancur jika mencoba!

entries.original:
"Barbs: [blue]Chaw ha ha ha!

Ya really think some kid can beat
me? Barbs?

I lead the Black Ferrothorn!

I am the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs: [color-blue-1]Chaw ha ha ha! Ya really think some kid can beat me? Barbs? I lead the Black Ferrothorn! I am the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Barbs: [blue]Chaw ha ha ha! Kau
benar-benar pikir anak kecil bisa\lmengalahkanku? Barbs? Aku memimpin

Black Ferrothorn! Akulah Black
Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"Barbs: [blue]Let’s see who the real
toughest chump in Antisis City is!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs: [color-blue-1]Let’s see who the real toughest chump in Antisis City is!
entries.translated:
Barbs: [blue]Ayo lihat siapa yang
benar-benar yang paling kuat di\lKota Antisis!

entries.original:
"Barbs: [blue]You put up a good fight,
[player].

I’d be proud if you were one of us,
the Black Ferrothorn.

It’s too bad you’re loyal to those
bozos.

Speaking of those bozos, looks like
my men utterly totalled ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs: [color-blue-1]You put up a good fight, [player-name-2]. I’d be proud if you were one of us, the Black Ferrothorn. It’s too bad you’re loyal to those bozos. Speaking of those bozos, looks like my men utterly totalled ’em!
entries.translated:
Barbs: [blue]Kau bertarung dengan baik,
[player]. Aku akan bangga jika kau\lmenjadi salah satu dari kami, Black

Ferrothorn. Sayang sekali kau setia
pada para goblok itu. Bicara soal\lpara goblok itu, sepertinya anak

buahku menghancurkan mereka total!

entries.original: "James: [blue]No, my gang, my life’s work!"
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1]No, my gang, my life’s work!
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Tidak, gengku, kerja
hidupku!

entries.original:
"[blue]Well, [player], looks like this is
it.

Ya put up a good fight, kid.
Ya made us proud ’til the end.

But it’s time for the Black
[player] to move on.

We’ve been run outta town, so it’s
back to fittin’ in no place, again.

We’re living life on the lam until
we find a new home."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Well, [player-name-2], looks like this is it. Ya put up a good fight, kid. Ya made us proud ’til the end. But it’s time for the Black [player-name-3] to move on. We’ve been run outta town, so it’s back to fittin’ in no place, again. We’re living life on the lam until we find a new home.
entries.translated:
[blue]Nah, [player], sepertinya ini dia.
Kau bertarung dengan baik, nak. Kau\lmembuat kami bangga sampai akhir.

Tapi sudah waktunya bagi Black
[player] untuk melanjutkan\lperjalanan. Kami diusir dari kota,

jadi kembali tidak cocok di mana
pun, lagi. Kami hidup dalam\lpelarian sampai kami menemukan

rumah baru.

entries.original:
"[blue]Maybe we’ll run into each other
somewhere down the line, kid.

I look foward to that day."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Maybe we’ll run into each other somewhere down the line, kid. I look foward to that day.
entries.translated:
[blue]Mungkin kita akan bertemu lagi di
lain waktu, nak. Aku menantikan\lhari itu.

entries.original:
"Barbs: [blue]Look, kid, I respect ya,
now, I really do.

But it’s time for ya to get outta
our house an’ never come back.

\.

I’m serious.

GET OUT!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs: [color-blue-1]Look, kid, I respect ya, now, I really do. But it’s time for ya to get outta our house an’ never come back. [game-token-2] I’m serious. GET OUT!
entries.translated:
Barbs: [blue]Dengar, nak, aku
menghormatimu, sungguh. Tapi sudah\lwaktunya kau keluar dari rumah kami

dan jangan pernah kembali. \. Aku
serius. KELUAR!

entries.original:
"This is the Antisis Gym!

Do ya think ya got what it takes to
survive the ring?"
entries.translation_source: This is the Antisis Gym! Do ya think ya got what it takes to survive the ring?
entries.translated:
Ini Antisis Gym! Apa kau pikir kau
punya apa yang diperlukan untuk\lbertahan di ring?

entries.original:
"Not many challengers survive the
ring like you did.

You’re a real special one, kid."
entries.translation_source: Not many challengers survive the ring like you did. You’re a real special one, kid.
entries.translated:
Tidak banyak penantang yang
bertahan di ring sepertimu. Kau\lbenar-benar spesial, nak.

entries.original: "Enter"
entries.translation_source: Enter
entries.translated: Masuk

entries.original: "Rules"
entries.translation_source: Rules
entries.translated: Aturan

entries.original: "Leave"
entries.translation_source: Leave
entries.translated: Keluar

entries.original: "Stay here."
entries.translation_source: Stay here.
entries.translated: Tetaplah di sini.

entries.original:
"I’m gonna knock ya right outta the
ring before ya can even get going!"
entries.translation_source: I’m gonna knock ya right outta the ring before ya can even get going!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menghempaskanmu keluar
ring sebelum kau sempat mulai!

entries.original:
"I have come to test your strength
in the ring.

Hiyah!"
entries.translation_source: I have come to test your strength in the ring. Hiyah!
entries.translated:
Aku datang untuk menguji kekuatanmu
di ring. Hiyah!

entries.original:
"Beat me and it’s smooth sailin’ to
Big Mo!

It’s too bad I ain’t gonna let that
happen!"
entries.translation_source: Beat me and it’s smooth sailin’ to Big Mo! It’s too bad I ain’t gonna let that happen!
entries.translated:
Kalahkan aku dan kau akan melaju
mulus ke Big Mo! Sayangnya aku\ltidak akan membiarkan itu terjadi!

entries.original: "Your strength is admirable."
entries.translation_source: Your strength is admirable.

entries.original:
"You survived the ring.
Good job.

Go through that door, now, if you
want to see Big Mo."
entries.translation_source: You survived the ring. Good job. Go through that door, now, if you want to see Big Mo.
entries.translated:
Kau selamat dari ring. Kerja bagus.
Pergilah melalui pintu itu\lsekarang, jika kau ingin bertemu

Big Mo.

entries.original:
"The rules are simple.

You choose one Pokémon to battle
three trainers in a row.

Each trainer is also only using
one Pokémon.

But no [green]Flying[blue], [green]Psychic[blue], or [green]Fairy[blue]
types!

You can use those types if you get
to Big Mo, but we don’t like those\ltypes here, in the ring."
entries.translation_source: The rules are simple. You choose one Pokémon to battle three trainers in a row. Each trainer is also only using one Pokémon. But no [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2], [color-green-3]Psychic[color-blue-4], or [color-green-5]Fairy[color-blue-6] types! You can use those types if you get to Big Mo, but we don’t like those types here, in the ring.
entries.translated:
Aturannya sederhana. Kau memilih
satu Pokémon untuk bertarung\lmelawan tiga pelatih

berturut-turut. Setiap pelatih juga
hanya menggunakan satu Pokémon.\lTapi tidak ada tipe [green]Terbang[blue],

[green]Psikis[blue], atau [green]Peri[blue]! Kau bisa
menggunakan tipe-tipe itu jika kau\lsampai ke Big Mo, tapi kami tidak

suka tipe-tipe itu di sini, di
ring.

entries.original:
"You have too many Pokémon!
You can only use one!

Go get rid of some Pokémon if you
want to take the challenge!"
entries.translation_source: You have too many Pokémon! You can only use one! Go get rid of some Pokémon if you want to take the challenge!
entries.translated:
Kau punya terlalu banyak Pokémon!
Kau hanya bisa menggunakan satu!\lSingkirkan beberapa Pokémon jika

kau ingin menerima tantangan!

entries.original:
"No [green][buffer1][blue]-type Pokémon are
allowed in the ring!

Go change your Pokémon if you
want to fight!"
entries.translation_source: No [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]-type Pokémon are allowed in the ring! Go change your Pokémon if you want to fight!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada Pokémon tipe [green][buffer1][blue]
yang diizinkan di ring! Ganti\lPokémon-mu jika kau ingin

bertarung!

entries.original:
"Not only did you survive the ring,
but you also took down Big Mo!

I don’t get impressed easy, but
you’ve done the job, kid."
entries.translation_source: Not only did you survive the ring, but you also took down Big Mo! I don’t get impressed easy, but you’ve done the job, kid.
entries.translated:
Kau tidak hanya selamat dari ring,
tapi juga mengalahkan Big Mo! Aku\ltidak mudah terkesan, tapi kau

berhasil, nak.

entries.original: "Psychic"
entries.translation_source: Psychic

entries.original:
"Look who finally decided to ease
my boredom!

Kid from Route 16!

\.

What’s that?
Your name is [player]?

Then allow me to introduce myself
properly too!

Folks around here call me Big Mo!

I’m the one force that keeps the
Antisis underworld under control!"
entries.translation_source: Look who finally decided to ease my boredom! Kid from Route 16! [game-token-1] What’s that? Your name is [player-name-2]? Then allow me to introduce myself properly too! Folks around here call me Big Mo! I’m the one force that keeps the Antisis underworld under control!
entries.translated:
Lihat siapa yang akhirnya
memutuskan untuk menghilangkan\lkebosananku! Nak dari Rute 16! \. Apa

itu? Namamu [player]? Kalau begitu
izinkan aku memperkenalkan diri\ldengan benar! Orang-orang di sini

memanggilku Big Mo! Akulah
satu-satunya kekuatan yang\lmengendalikan dunia bawah Antisis!

entries.original:
"Oh, man, kid\.
What a fight\.

Take the Brawl Badge as proof of
your victory at the Antisis Gym!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, man, kid[game-token-1] What a fight[game-token-2] Take the Brawl Badge as proof of your victory at the Antisis Gym!
entries.translated:
Oh, wah, nak\. Pertarungan yang hebat\.
Ambil Lencana Brawl sebagai bukti\lkemenanganmu di Antisis Gym!

entries.original:
"[player] received the Brawl Badge
from Big Mo!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received the Brawl Badge from Big Mo!
entries.translated:
[player] menerima Lencana Brawl
dari Big Mo!

entries.original:
"With the Brawl Badge, all Pokémon
up to Lv. 70 will acknowledge your\lstrength and obey you!

You can also now scale rocky cliffs
with the move, Rock Climb!

Tell me that ain’t useful!

Take this TM too!"
entries.translation_source: With the Brawl Badge, all Pokémon up to Lv. 70 will acknowledge your strength and obey you! You can also now scale rocky cliffs with the move, Rock Climb! Tell me that ain’t useful! Take this TM too!
entries.translated:
Dengan Lencana Brawl, semua Pokémon
hingga Lv. 70 akan mengakui\lkekuatanmu dan menuruti perintahmu!

Kau juga sekarang bisa memanjat
tebing batu dengan jurus Panjat\lTebing! Katakan itu tidak berguna!

Ambil TM ini juga!

entries.original:
"[player] received TM60
from Big Mo!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received TM60 from Big Mo!
entries.translated: [player] menerima TM60 dari Big Mo!

entries.original:
"TM60 contains Drain Punch!

It does damage and saps your
enemy’s health at the same time!"
entries.translation_source: TM60 contains Drain Punch! It does damage and saps your enemy’s health at the same time!
entries.translated:
TM60 berisi Pukulan Penguras! Ini
memberikan kerusakan dan menguras\lkesehatan musuh pada saat yang

sama!

entries.original:
"If you want my TM, you’ll need to
make some room in your bag!"
entries.translation_source: If you want my TM, you’ll need to make some room in your bag!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu menginginkan TM-ku, kamu
perlu membuat sedikit ruang di\ltasmu!

entries.original:
"If you ever come back to Antisis
City, [player], just know I’ve got my\leye on you!

Ha ha ha ha!

I’ve got my eye on everyone here!
It’s my job!"
entries.translation_source: If you ever come back to Antisis City, [player-name-1], just know I’ve got my eye on you! Ha ha ha ha! I’ve got my eye on everyone here! It’s my job!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu kembali ke Antisis City,
[player], ketahuilah aku\lmengawasimu! Ha ha ha ha! Aku

mengawasi semua orang di sini! Itu
tugasku!

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo? Huh?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo? Huh?
entries.translated:
Apa kamu benar-benar berpikir bisa
mengalahkan Big Mo? Hah?

entries.original:
"You’re the new toughest chump in
Antisis City!"
entries.translation_source: You’re the new toughest chump in Antisis City!
entries.translated:
Kamu adalah orang bodoh terkuat
yang baru di Antisis City!

entries.original:
"Antisis Pokémon Gym
Leader: Big Mo

Winning Trainers:
[rival]"
entries.translation_source: Antisis Pokémon Gym Leader: Big Mo Winning Trainers: [text-token-rival-1]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Antisis: Big
Mo Pelatih Pemenang: [rival]

entries.original:
"Antisis Pokémon Gym
Leader: Big Mo

Winning Trainers:
[rival], [player]"
entries.translation_source: Antisis Pokémon Gym Leader: Big Mo Winning Trainers: [text-token-rival-1], [player-name-2]
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym Pokémon Antisis: Big
Mo Pelatih Pemenang: [rival],\l[player]

entries.original:
"It had no effect on
\\10\."
entries.translation_source: It had no effect on [raw-escape-1][game-token-2]
entries.translated: Tidak mempan pada \\10\.

entries.original: "Numerical Mode: Borrius"
entries.translation_source: Numerical Mode: Borrius

entries.original: "Scale rocky walls."
entries.translation_source: Scale rocky walls.

entries.original:
"[buffer1] used Sunny Day!
It became Sunny outside."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] used Sunny Day! It became Sunny outside.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] menggunakan Hari Cerah!
