entries.original:
"Oh!
Silly me!

How can I expect you to find [green]Icicle
Cave[blue] if you don’t know the way?

This [green]Town Map[blue] should aid you
immensely!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! Silly me! How can I expect you to find [color-green-1]Icicle Cave[color-blue-2] if you don’t know the way? This [color-green-3]Town Map[color-blue-4] should aid you immensely!
entries.translated:
Oh! Bodohnya aku! Bagaimana aku
bisa mengharapkanmu menemukan\l[green]Icicle Cave[blue] jika kamu tidak tahu

jalannya? [green]Peta Kota[blue] ini seharusnya
sangat membantumu!

entries.original:
"And you know what?

If you’re going to Dresco Town, you
should assist me with another task!

My friend, Oak, requested that I
give his Pokédex to two trainers.

It’s some sort of high-tech
encyclopedia for recording Pokémon\ldata.

Apparently, Borrius is known for
having plenty of Pokémon Kanto\ldoes not."
entries.translation_source: And you know what? If you’re going to Dresco Town, you should assist me with another task! My friend, Oak, requested that I give his Pokédex to two trainers. It’s some sort of high-tech encyclopedia for recording Pokémon data. Apparently, Borrius is known for having plenty of Pokémon Kanto does not.
entries.translated:
Dan kamu tahu? Jika kamu pergi ke
Dresco Town, kamu harus membantu\lsaya dengan tugas lain! Temanku,

Oak, meminta saya memberikan
Pokédex-nya kepada dua pelatih. Itu\lsemacam ensiklopedia teknologi

tinggi untuk merekam data Pokémon.
Rupanya, Borrius dikenal memiliki\lbanyak Pokémon yang tidak dimiliki

Kanto.

entries.original:
"You can’t get detailed data on
Pokémon by just seeing them.

You must catch them to obtain
complete data.

So, here are some tools for
catching wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You can’t get detailed data on Pokémon by just seeing them. You must catch them to obtain complete data. So, here are some tools for catching wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak bisa mendapatkan data
detail tentang Pokémon hanya dengan\lmelihatnya. Kamu harus menangkapnya

untuk mendapatkan data lengkap.
Jadi, ini beberapa alat untuk\lmenangkap Pokémon liar.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received 5 Poké Balls
from Log!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received 5 Poké Balls from Log!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima 5 Poké Ball dari
Log!

entries.original:
"If you don’t know how to capture
Wild Pokémon, an old friend of\lmine on Route 1 can show you how."
entries.translation_source: If you don’t know how to capture Wild Pokémon, an old friend of mine on Route 1 can show you how.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu tidak tahu cara menangkap
Pokémon Liar, seorang teman lamaku\ldi Route 1 bisa menunjukkannya.

entries.original:
"Oh!

My memory seems to be going\.I
have one more thing to give you.

Please, the next time you see
[rival], give him this Pokédex."
entries.translation_source: Oh! My memory seems to be going[game-token-1]I have one more thing to give you. Please, the next time you see [text-token-rival-2], give him this Pokédex.
entries.translated:
Oh! Ingatanku sepertinya mulai
hilang\.Aku punya satu hal lagi untuk\ldiberikan kepadamu. Tolong, lain

kali kamu melihat [rival], berikan
dia Pokédex ini.

entries.original:
"He’s been rather cold to me ever
since his parents left him with me\las a child, but he seems to get\lalong fine with you.

I’m sure if you give him the
Pokédex he’d be willing to assist."
entries.translation_source: He’s been rather cold to me ever since his parents left him with me as a child, but he seems to get along fine with you. I’m sure if you give him the Pokédex he’d be willing to assist.
entries.translated:
Dia agak dingin padaku sejak orang
tuanya meninggalkannya bersamaku\lsaat kecil, tapi dia tampaknya

akrab denganmu. Aku yakin jika kamu
memberinya Pokédex, dia akan\lbersedia membantu.

entries.original:
"Please visit my friend in [green]Dresco
Town[blue], [player].

I’m counting on you."
entries.translation_source: Please visit my friend in [color-green-1]Dresco Town[color-blue-2], [player-name-3]. I’m counting on you.
entries.translated:
Tolong kunjungi temanku di [green]Dresco
Town[blue], [player]. Aku mengandalkanmu.

entries.original:
"[player], You need to hurry to
[green]Thundercap Mountain[blue]!

If The Shadows get there before
you, Borrius is doomed!

Head north of town and take the [green]SES
Expressway[blue] far [green]south[blue] to go quickly."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], You need to hurry to [color-green-2]Thundercap Mountain[color-blue-3]! If The Shadows get there before you, Borrius is doomed! Head north of town and take the [color-green-4]SES Expressway[color-blue-5] far [color-green-6]south[color-blue-7] to go quickly.
entries.translated:
[player], Anda harus bergegas ke
[green]Gunung Thundercap[blue]! Jika The Shadows\lsampai di sana sebelum Anda,

Borrius akan hancur! Pergilah ke
utara kota dan naik [green]Jalan Tol SES[blue]\ljauh ke [green]selatan[blue] untuk pergi dengan

cepat.

entries.original:
"With Zapdos now in their possesion,
all The Shadows need to do to\lrelease the dark force is bring the\lthree birds to the [green]Ruins of Void[blue].

If they succeed in doing so and
break the seal\.

I don’t even want to think about
it.

Please hurry there with Jax and
make one last attempt to stop them.

The future is in your hands,
[player]!"
entries.translation_source: With Zapdos now in their possesion, all The Shadows need to do to release the dark force is bring the three birds to the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2]. If they succeed in doing so and break the seal[game-token-3] I don’t even want to think about it. Please hurry there with Jax and make one last attempt to stop them. The future is in your hands, [player-name-4]!
entries.translated:
Dengan Zapdos sekarang dalam
kepemilikan mereka, yang perlu\ldilakukan The Shadows untuk

melepaskan kekuatan gelap adalah
membawa ketiga burung ke [green]Reruntuhan\lVoid[blue]. Jika mereka berhasil

melakukannya dan memecahkan segel\.
Aku bahkan tidak ingin\lmemikirkannya. Tolong cepat ke sana

bersama Jax dan lakukan satu upaya
terakhir untuk menghentikan mereka.\lMasa depan ada di tanganmu,

[player]!

entries.original:
"Now that dark force has been
released, our end is near.

But until then, all we can do is
live our lives normally."
entries.translation_source: Now that dark force has been released, our end is near. But until then, all we can do is live our lives normally.
entries.translated:
Sekarang kekuatan gelap telah
dilepaskan, akhir kita sudah dekat.\lNamun sampai saat itu, yang bisa

kita lakukan hanyalah menjalani
hidup kita secara normal.

entries.original:
"[player]!

You saved Borrius!
You saved us all!

Thank you!

Your father would be proud of you,
Guardian of Borrius."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You saved Borrius! You saved us all! Thank you! Your father would be proud of you, Guardian of Borrius.
entries.translated:
[player]! Anda menyelamatkan
Borrius! Anda menyelamatkan kita\lsemua! Terima kasih! Ayahmu akan

bangga padamu, Penjaga Borrius.

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, [player], I have no
more errands for you to run.

Have you considered taking on the
[green]Pokémon League[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, [player-name-1], I have no more errands for you to run. Have you considered taking on the [color-green-2]Pokémon League[color-blue-3]?
entries.translated:
Sayangnya, [player], saya tidak
memiliki tugas lagi untuk Anda.\lApakah Anda sudah mempertimbangkan

untuk menantang [green]Liga Pokémon[blue]?

entries.original: "Long ago\."
entries.translation_source: Long ago[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Dahulu kala\.

entries.original:
"The Borrius Region was engulfed by
a great war with the Kalos Region.

It was a brutal war, one lasting
many years.

In that time, Kalos managed to
seize the upper hand\."
entries.translation_source: The Borrius Region was engulfed by a great war with the Kalos Region. It was a brutal war, one lasting many years. In that time, Kalos managed to seize the upper hand[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Wilayah Borrius dilanda perang
besar dengan Wilayah Kalos. Itu\ladalah perang brutal, yang

berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun.
Pada saat itu, Kalos berhasil\lmerebut keunggulan\.

entries.original:
"On the brink of defeat, the Borrian
king summoned a dark force to help\lturn the tides of battle\."
entries.translation_source: On the brink of defeat, the Borrian king summoned a dark force to help turn the tides of battle[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Di ambang kekalahan, raja Borrian
memanggil kekuatan gelap untuk\lmembantu membalikkan keadaan

pertempuran\.

entries.original:
"The Kalosian army’s advantage was
lost almost instantly.

As soon as it entered the battlefield,
the dark force used its power to\lcreate portals and transport the\linvading army back to Kalos\."
entries.translation_source: The Kalosian army’s advantage was lost almost instantly. As soon as it entered the battlefield, the dark force used its power to create portals and transport the invading army back to Kalos[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Keuntungan tentara Kalosian hilang
hampir seketika. Begitu memasuki\lmedan perang, kekuatan gelap

menggunakan kekuatannya untuk
membuat portal dan mengangkut\lpasukan penyerang kembali ke Kalos\.

entries.original:
"With the foreign army gone, the war
seemed at an end for Borrius.

However, their king, overcome by
his lust for power, sent the Borrian\larmy through the portals as well\."
entries.translation_source: With the foreign army gone, the war seemed at an end for Borrius. However, their king, overcome by his lust for power, sent the Borrian army through the portals as well[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dengan pasukan asing pergi, perang
tampaknya berakhir bagi Borrius.\lNamun, raja mereka, yang diliputi

oleh nafsu kekuasaan, juga mengirim
pasukan Borrian melalui\lportal-portal tersebut\.

entries.original:
"The war continued to rage in Kalos
for several years.

Many more men and Pokémon were
conscripted to fight and inevitably\lmet their end on the battlefield.

One such Pokémon having been a
dear friend of the Kalosian king\."
entries.translation_source: The war continued to rage in Kalos for several years. Many more men and Pokémon were conscripted to fight and inevitably met their end on the battlefield. One such Pokémon having been a dear friend of the Kalosian king[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Perang terus berkecamuk di Kalos
selama beberapa tahun. Lebih banyak\lmanusia dan Pokémon yang direkrut

untuk bertempur dan akhirnya
menemui ajal mereka di medan\lperang. Salah satu Pokémon tersebut

adalah sahabat karib raja Kalosian\.

entries.original:
"Overcome with grief, the king built a
device to restore it to life, granting\lhimself immortality in the process."
entries.translation_source: Overcome with grief, the king built a device to restore it to life, granting himself immortality in the process.
entries.translated:
Dipenuhi dengan kesedihan, raja
membangun sebuah perangkat untuk\lmenghidupkannya kembali, sekaligus

memberikan keabadian pada dirinya
sendiri.

entries.original:
"But this traumatic event left him
scarred and filled with anger.

Unable to forgive the world that
had hurt his precious Pokémon, he\lturned his machine into a giant\lweapon, the Ultimate Weapon.

The king became a bringer of
destruction that ended the war."
entries.translation_source: But this traumatic event left him scarred and filled with anger. Unable to forgive the world that had hurt his precious Pokémon, he turned his machine into a giant weapon, the Ultimate Weapon. The king became a bringer of destruction that ended the war.
entries.translated:
Namun peristiwa traumatis ini
membuatnya terluka dan dipenuhi\lamarah. Tidak mampu memaafkan dunia

yang telah menyakiti Pokémon
berharganya, ia mengubah mesinnya\lmenjadi senjata raksasa, Ultimate

Weapon. Sang raja menjadi pembawa
kehancuran yang mengakhiri perang.

entries.original:
"With the war over, what little
remained of the Borrian army\lreturned home.

The king’s Pokémon left him, and
the battlefield became silent\."
entries.translation_source: With the war over, what little remained of the Borrian army returned home. The king’s Pokémon left him, and the battlefield became silent[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dengan perang berakhir, sedikit
yang tersisa dari pasukan Borrian\lkembali ke rumah. Pokémon raja

meninggalkannya, dan medan perang
menjadi sunyi\.

entries.original: "Yet, peace was still to come."
entries.translation_source: Yet, peace was still to come.
entries.translated:
Namun, perdamaian masih akan
datang.

entries.original:
"The dark force of Borrius wanted
compensation for its help.

When the king had nothing to offer
it, the dark force was enraged.

It began to destroy countless
cities and towns for sport."
entries.translation_source: The dark force of Borrius wanted compensation for its help. When the king had nothing to offer it, the dark force was enraged. It began to destroy countless cities and towns for sport.
entries.translated:
Kekuatan gelap Borrius menginginkan
kompensasi atas bantuannya. Ketika\lraja tidak memiliki apa-apa untuk

ditawarkan, kekuatan gelap menjadi
marah. Ia mulai menghancurkan\lbanyak kota dan desa untuk

bersenang-senang.

entries.original:
"In an effort to stop its madness,
the Borrian king gathered the\llegendary Pokémon:"
entries.translation_source: In an effort to stop its madness, the Borrian king gathered the legendary Pokémon:
entries.translated:
Dalam upaya menghentikan
kegilaannya, raja Borrian\lmengumpulkan Pokémon legendaris:

entries.original: "Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: Zapdos!

entries.original:
"Using the power of the three birds
combined with a divine bottle given\lto him by Arceus, creator of all\lPokémon, the dark force was bound."
entries.translation_source: Using the power of the three birds combined with a divine bottle given to him by Arceus, creator of all Pokémon, the dark force was bound.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan kekuatan ketiga burung
yang digabungkan dengan botol ilahi\lyang diberikan oleh Arceus,

pencipta semua Pokémon, kekuatan
gelap itu terikat.

entries.original:
"It became a shadow of its former
self."
entries.translation_source: It became a shadow of its former self.
entries.translated:
Ia menjadi bayangan dari dirinya
yang dahulu.

entries.original:
"Stripped of its power, it was taken
in by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until one, fateful day\."
entries.translation_source: Stripped of its power, it was taken in by the king, and supervised by his progeny, until one, fateful day[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dicabut dari kekuatannya, ia
diambil oleh raja, dan diawasi oleh\lketurunannya, hingga suatu hari

yang menentukan\.

entries.original:
"Stripped of its power, it was taken
in by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until this very day."
entries.translation_source: Stripped of its power, it was taken in by the king, and supervised by his progeny, until this very day.
entries.translated:
Kehilangan kekuatannya, ia diambil
oleh raja, dan diawasi oleh\lketurunannya, hingga hari ini.

entries.original: "            16 Years Ago"
entries.translation_source: 16 Years Ago
entries.translated: 16 Tahun yang Lalu

entries.original: "             Elsewhere"
entries.translation_source: Elsewhere
entries.translated: Di Tempat Lain

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Arceus\.

I can’t go on like this\."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Arceus[game-token-2] I can’t go on like this[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Arceus\. Aku tidak bisa terus
seperti ini\.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon\.

I know it’s my duty to watch over
it, but where I’m headed, it\lcannot go!"
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon[game-token-1] I know it’s my duty to watch over it, but where I’m headed, it cannot go!
entries.translated:
Pokémon ini\. Aku tahu itu tugasku
untuk menjaganya, tapi ke mana aku\lpergi, ia tidak bisa ikut!

entries.original:
"I know I told him that using its
power would be a bad idea, but I\lworry that soon, he’ll no longer\llisten to me\."
entries.translation_source: I know I told him that using its power would be a bad idea, but I worry that soon, he’ll no longer listen to me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku tahu aku bilang padanya bahwa
menggunakan kekuatannya adalah ide\lburuk, tapi aku khawatir bahwa

segera, dia tidak akan lagi
mendengarkanku\.

entries.original: "And that’s why I need to do this!"
entries.translation_source: And that’s why I need to do this!
entries.translated:
Dan itulah kenapa aku harus
melakukan ini!

entries.original: "It’s gone\."
entries.translation_source: It’s gone[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sudah hilang\.

entries.original:
"Now it’s time for you to go too,
Arceus\.

I don’t want you around for what
will happen next\.

Just promise me one thing\.

Please, watch over my child\."
entries.translation_source: Now it’s time for you to go too, Arceus[game-token-1] I don’t want you around for what will happen next[game-token-2] Just promise me one thing[game-token-3] Please, watch over my child[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Sekarang saatnya bagimu untuk pergi
juga, Arceus\. Aku tidak ingin kamu\lada di sini untuk apa yang akan

terjadi selanjutnya\. Janjikan aku
satu hal\. Tolong, jaga anakku\.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]ARGH!

How can I fulfill Grampy’s wish if I
can’t even catch a single Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]ARGH! How can I fulfill Grampy’s wish if I can’t even catch a single Pokémon!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]ARGH! Bagaimana aku bisa
memenuhi keinginan Grampy jika aku\lbahkan tidak bisa menangkap satu

Pokémon pun!

entries.original:
"[blue]I promised Grampy I’d eradicate the
root of the suffering, but at this\lpoint, I don’t see how that’ll\leven be possible!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I promised Grampy I’d eradicate the root of the suffering, but at this point, I don’t see how that’ll even be possible!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aku berjanji pada Grampy untuk
membasmi akar penderitaan, tapi\lpada titik ini, aku tidak melihat

bagaimana itu mungkin!

entries.original:
"[blue]Please, Arceus!

If you’re real, give me a sign that
everything will work out!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Please, Arceus! If you’re real, give me a sign that everything will work out!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tolong, Arceus! Jika kamu nyata,
beri aku tanda bahwa semuanya akan\lberhasil!

entries.original:
"[blue]A Poké Ball? Here? Now?

Arceus is real after all\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]A Poké Ball? Here? Now? Arceus is real after all[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Poké Ball? Di sini? Sekarang?
Arceus benar-benar nyata\.

entries.original: "[blue]This Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]This Pokémon[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [blue]Pokémon ini\.

entries.original: "[green]Hoo...pa\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo...pa[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Hoo...pa\.

entries.original:
"[blue]It appears, Grampy, that there may
be a way after all\.

It’s time for the eternal flower to
bloom, once more\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It appears, Grampy, that there may be a way after all[game-token-2] It’s time for the eternal flower to bloom, once more[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[blue]Tampaknya, Grampy, mungkin ada
jalan bagaimanapun\. Saatnya bagi\lbunga abadi untuk mekar, sekali

lagi\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, young [buffer1]!
What can I do for you?

\.

\.

Ah, so Log sent you.

I hope I can shed a little light on
what is bothering him.

Are you well versed in Borrian
history?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, young [buffer1-1]! What can I do for you? [game-token-2] [game-token-3] Ah, so Log sent you. I hope I can shed a little light on what is bothering him. Are you well versed in Borrian history?
entries.translated:
Halo, [buffer1] muda! Ada yang bisa
saya bantu? \. \. Ah, jadi Log\lmengirimmu. Saya harap saya bisa

sedikit menjelaskan apa yang
mengganggunya. Apakah kamu paham\ldengan sejarah Borrius?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.
Is that so\.

There is a special airing on the
television right now, that could\ljog your memory."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] Is that so[game-token-2] There is a special airing on the television right now, that could jog your memory.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Begitukah\. Ada siaran spesial di
televisi sekarang, yang bisa\lmengingatkanmu.

entries.original:
"Excellent.

Then, as you know, the dark force
of Borrius was sealed away, many\lyears ago.

But it is said that if the three
legendary Pokémon used to seal it\laway are brought back together at\lthe [green]Ruins of Void[blue], the power can be\lreleased once again.

This must be what those thugs you
encountered are after.

They must want to engulf Borrius in
shadows once again.

If I’m right, then their next
target will be\."
entries.translation_source: Excellent. Then, as you know, the dark force of Borrius was sealed away, many years ago. But it is said that if the three legendary Pokémon used to seal it away are brought back together at the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2], the power can be released once again. This must be what those thugs you encountered are after. They must want to engulf Borrius in shadows once again. If I’m right, then their next target will be[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Bagus. Lalu, seperti yang kamu
tahu, kekuatan gelap Borrius telah\ldisegel, bertahun-tahun lalu. Tapi

dikatakan bahwa jika tiga Pokémon
legendaris yang digunakan untuk\lmenyegelnya dikumpulkan kembali di

[green]Ruins of Void[blue], kekuatan itu bisa
dilepaskan lagi. Ini pasti yang\ldicari oleh para preman yang kamu

temui. Mereka pasti ingin
menyelimuti Borrius dalam kegelapan\llagi. Jika aku benar, maka target

mereka selanjutnya adalah\.

entries.original: "???: [blue]Grampa Arthur! "
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Grampa Arthur!
entries.translated: ???: [blue]Grampa Arthur!

entries.original: "Arthur: [blue]What’s wrong, Jax?"
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]What’s wrong, Jax?
entries.translated: Arthur: [blue]Ada apa, Jax?

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]I just saw those guys in black
heading in the direction of\l[green]Cinder Volcano[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]I just saw those guys in black heading in the direction of [color-green-2]Cinder Volcano[color-blue-3]!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Aku baru saja melihat
orang-orang berbaju hitam itu\lmenuju ke arah [green]Gunung Cinder[blue]!

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]I was just telling
[player], here, about their\lpossible aim, but this\lconfirms my suspicions.

They are going after the Legendary
bird Pokémon, [green]Moltres[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]I was just telling [player-name-2], here, about their possible aim, but this confirms my suspicions. They are going after the Legendary bird Pokémon, [color-green-3]Moltres[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Saya baru saja memberitahu
[player] di sini tentang\lkemungkinan tujuan mereka, tetapi

ini mengonfirmasi kecurigaan saya.
Mereka mengejar Pokémon Burung\lLegendaris, [green]Moltres[blue].

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]Should I try and stop them?"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Should I try and stop them?
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Haruskah aku mencoba
menghentikan mereka?

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Not yet, Jax.

I need you to first fly to Frozen
Heights and bring Prof. Log here."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]Not yet, Jax. I need you to first fly to Frozen Heights and bring Prof. Log here.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Belum, Jax. Aku perlu kamu
terbang dulu ke Frozen Heights dan\lbawa Prof. Log ke sini.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]Right away, Grampa!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Right away, Grampa!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Baiklah, Kakek!

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Hmm\.

So it is as bad as I feared\.

What do you think should be done
about this, Arthur?"
entries.translation_source: Log: [color-blue-1]Hmm[game-token-2] So it is as bad as I feared[game-token-3] What do you think should be done about this, Arthur?
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Hmm\. Jadi, ini seburuk yang aku
khawatirkan\. Menurutmu apa yang\lharus dilakukan tentang ini,

Arthur?

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]I think Jax is capable of
solving this problem.

He has proven himself at this
point.

I was planning on sending him to
confront these \qoShadows\qc and stop\lthem before they reach Moltres."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]I think Jax is capable of solving this problem. He has proven himself at this point. I was planning on sending him to confront these [quote-open-2]Shadows[quote-close-3] and stop them before they reach Moltres.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Saya pikir Jax mampu
menyelesaikan masalah ini. Dia\lsudah membuktikan dirinya saat ini.

Saya berencana mengirimnya untuk
menghadapi \qoBayangan\qc ini dan\lmenghentikan mereka sebelum mereka

mencapai Moltres.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Of course.

I’m sure the police are already on
their way, but his assistance could\lbe invaluble to them."
entries.translation_source: Log: [color-blue-1]Of course. I’m sure the police are already on their way, but his assistance could be invaluble to them.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Tentu saja. Saya yakin polisi
sudah dalam perjalanan, tetapi\lbantuannya bisa sangat berharga

bagi mereka.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Understood, Grampa.

I’m heading out.

I’ll stop them and save Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Understood, Grampa. I’m heading out. I’ll stop them and save Moltres!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Dimengerti, Kakek. Aku
berangkat. Aku akan menghentikan\lmereka dan menyelamatkan Moltres!

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Well, [player], I think it
is time for you to head home.

You’ve completed your errand, and
I’m sure your mother misses you."
entries.translation_source: Log: [color-blue-1]Well, [player-name-2], I think it is time for you to head home. You’ve completed your errand, and I’m sure your mother misses you.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Baiklah, [player], saya pikir
sudah waktunya kamu pulang. Kamu\ltelah menyelesaikan tugasmu, dan

saya yakin ibumu merindukanmu.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Now, wait just a minute,
Log.

I’m sure [player] could gain some
valuable experience watching Jax\ltake on The Shadows.

I think you should let [buffer1] go."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]Now, wait just a minute, Log. I’m sure [player-name-2] could gain some valuable experience watching Jax take on The Shadows. I think you should let [buffer1-3] go.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Sekarang, tunggu sebentar,
Log. Saya yakin [player] bisa\lmendapatkan pengalaman berharga

dengan melihat Jax menghadapi The
Shadows. Saya pikir kamu harus\lmembiarkan [buffer1] pergi.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Hmm\.

Maybe you’re right.

If [buffer2] gains experience, I can send
[buffer1] on more complicated errands\."
entries.translation_source: Log: [color-blue-1]Hmm[game-token-2] Maybe you’re right. If [buffer2-3] gains experience, I can send [buffer1-4] on more complicated errands[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Hmm\. Mungkin kamu benar. Jika
[buffer2] mendapatkan pengalaman,\laku bisa mengirim [buffer1] untuk

tugas yang lebih rumit\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Alright, [player], I think you
should follow Jax.

I’ll tell your mother you’ll be a
while.

I’m sure she’ll be fine with it."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Alright, [player-name-2], I think you should follow Jax. I’ll tell your mother you’ll be a while. I’m sure she’ll be fine with it.
entries.translated:
[blue]Baiklah, [player], kupikir kau
harus mengikuti Jax. Aku akan\lmemberi tahu ibumu bahwa kau akan

agak lama. Aku yakin dia tidak
masalah dengan itu.

entries.original:
"Head to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] and watch
Jax save [green]Moltres[blue].

You could gain some valauable
experience that way."
entries.translation_source: Head to [color-green-1]Cinder Volcano[color-blue-2] and watch Jax save [color-green-3]Moltres[color-blue-4]. You could gain some valauable experience that way.
entries.translated:
Pergilah ke [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] dan
saksikan Jax menyelamatkan [green]Moltres[blue].\lKamu bisa mendapatkan pengalaman

berharga dengan cara itu.

entries.original:
"We’re running out of time,
[player].

You need to hurry to [green]Thundercap
Mountain[blue] and save [green]Zapdos[blue]!

If it’s captured too, we’ll all be
doomed\."
entries.translation_source: We’re running out of time, [player-name-1]. You need to hurry to [color-green-2]Thundercap Mountain[color-blue-3] and save [color-green-4]Zapdos[color-blue-5]! If it’s captured too, we’ll all be doomed[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Kita kehabisan waktu, [player].
Kamu harus bergegas ke [green]Thundercap\lMountain[blue] dan selamatkan [green]Zapdos[blue]!

Jika ia juga tertangkap, kita semua
akan binasa\.

entries.original:
"With all three legendary Pokémon
in their grasp, The Shadows are\lonly momemnts away from releasing\lthe dark force.

Jax is in [green]Dehara City[blue] waiting to
take you to the [green]Ruins of Void[blue] and\lstop The Shadows from carrying out\ltheir plan."
entries.translation_source: With all three legendary Pokémon in their grasp, The Shadows are only momemnts away from releasing the dark force. Jax is in [color-green-1]Dehara City[color-blue-2] waiting to take you to the [color-green-3]Ruins of Void[color-blue-4] and stop The Shadows from carrying out their plan.
entries.translated:
Dengan ketiga Pokémon legendaris
dalam genggaman mereka, The Shadows\lhanya beberapa saat lagi dari

melepaskan kekuatan gelap. Jax
berada di [green]Kota Dehara[blue] menunggu\luntuk membawamu ke [green]Reruntuhan Void[blue]

dan menghentikan The Shadows dari
melaksanakan rencana mereka.

entries.original:
"So, the dark force has been
released\.

If it isn’t stopped, it could
destroy the whole region!

You must find Jax and seal it away
once more!"
entries.translation_source: So, the dark force has been released[game-token-1] If it isn’t stopped, it could destroy the whole region! You must find Jax and seal it away once more!
entries.translated:
Jadi, kekuatan gelap telah
dilepaskan\. Jika tidak dihentikan,\litu bisa menghancurkan seluruh

region! Kamu harus menemukan Jax
dan menyegelnya sekali lagi!

entries.original:
"You did it!

You defeated the Light of Ruin and
saved us!

You are a true Guardian of Borrius!

Your father would be proud."
entries.translation_source: You did it! You defeated the Light of Ruin and saved us! You are a true Guardian of Borrius! Your father would be proud.
entries.translated:
Kamu berhasil! Kamu mengalahkan
Cahaya Penghancur dan menyelamatkan\lkami! Kamu adalah Penjaga sejati

Borrius! Ayahmu pasti bangga.

entries.original:
"Now that everything is at peace
once more, why don’t you take on\lthe [green]Pokémon League[blue]?

I’m sure someone with your skill
could easily become the champion."
entries.translation_source: Now that everything is at peace once more, why don’t you take on the [color-green-1]Pokémon League[color-blue-2]? I’m sure someone with your skill could easily become the champion.
entries.translated:
Sekarang setelah semuanya kembali
damai, kenapa kamu tidak menantang\l[green]Liga Pokémon[blue]? Aku yakin seseorang

dengan kemampuanmu bisa dengan
mudah menjadi juara.

entries.original: "How go your travels, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: How go your travels, [player-name-1]?
entries.translated: Bagaimana perjalananmu, [player]?

entries.original:
"Welcome to Pokémon Unbound!

Before you begin playing, please
be aware that this is a non-profit
fan game.

If you paid for this game, reclaim
your money immediately!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to Pokémon Unbound! Before you begin playing, please be aware that this is a non-profit fan game. If you paid for this game, reclaim your money immediately!
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Pokémon Unbound!
Sebelum kamu mulai bermain, harap
sadari bahwa ini adalah game fan

non-profit. Jika kamu membayar
untuk game ini, mintalah uangmu
kembali segera!

entries.original:
"With that in mind, you are almost
ready to enter the Borrius Region!
But first\."
entries.translation_source: With that in mind, you are almost ready to enter the Borrius Region! But first[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dengan demikian, kamu hampir siap
memasuki Region Borrius! Tapi
pertama\.

entries.original: "Choose your character."
entries.translation_source: Choose your character.

entries.original: "Choose your outfit colour."
entries.translation_source: Choose your outfit colour.

entries.original:
"Last, but not least, what is your
name?"
entries.translation_source: Last, but not least, what is your name?
entries.translated:
Terakhir, tapi tidak kalah penting,
siapa namamu?

entries.original: "Your name is [player]?"
entries.translation_source: Your name is [player-name-1]?
entries.translated: Namamu [player]?

entries.original: "             Present Day"
entries.translation_source: Present Day
entries.translated: Hari Ini

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Mission HQ!

This is your first time here, isn’t
it?

Then, tell me, do you know about
[green]Missions[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Mission HQ! This is your first time here, isn’t it? Then, tell me, do you know about [color-green-1]Missions[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Markas Misi! Ini
pertama kalinya kamu di sini, kan?\lKalau begitu, katakan padaku,

apakah kamu tahu tentang [green]Misi[blue]?

entries.original:
"Of course you do!
Who doesn’t?

But\.

Just in case your absentmindedly
saying yes, allow me to give a\lformal explanation."
entries.translation_source: Of course you do! Who doesn’t? But[game-token-1] Just in case your absentmindedly saying yes, allow me to give a formal explanation.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja kamu tahu! Siapa yang
tidak? Tapi\. Seandainya kamu dengan\ltidak sadar mengatakan ya, izinkan

saya memberikan penjelasan formal.

entries.original:
"I see\.

Well, then in that case, allow me
to give a formal explanation."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] Well, then in that case, allow me to give a formal explanation.
entries.translated:
Begitu\. Baiklah, kalau begitu,
izinkan saya memberikan penjelasan\lformal.

entries.original:
"A Mission is an extra objective you
receive by accepting a request for\lhelp.

Many people out there are unable to
solve their own problems and\lrequire assistance from others.

Once you accept the Mission, the
details are automatically recorded\lin the Quest Log.

Missions can often yield great
rewards, be it items, money, or\leven new areas to explore.

If someone requests a Mission from
you, accept it immediately.

Even if you have no intention of
completing it right away, there’s\lno harm in having it registered in\lyour Quest Log.

With that being said, there are
several people here in need of\lassistance.

Look around and see if there’s
anyone you’d like to help!

And come see me when you’ve
completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions."
entries.translation_source: A Mission is an extra objective you receive by accepting a request for help. Many people out there are unable to solve their own problems and require assistance from others. Once you accept the Mission, the details are automatically recorded in the Quest Log. Missions can often yield great rewards, be it items, money, or even new areas to explore. If someone requests a Mission from you, accept it immediately. Even if you have no intention of completing it right away, there’s no harm in having it registered in your Quest Log. With that being said, there are several people here in need of assistance. Look around and see if there’s anyone you’d like to help! And come see me when you’ve completed at least [color-green-1]5[color-blue-2] Missions.
entries.translated:
Misi adalah tujuan tambahan yang
kamu terima dengan menerima\lpermintaan bantuan. Banyak orang di

luar sana tidak bisa menyelesaikan
masalah mereka sendiri dan\lmembutuhkan bantuan dari orang

lain. Setelah kamu menerima Misi,
detailnya secara otomatis dicatat\ldi Catatan Quest. Misi sering kali

memberikan hadiah besar, baik itu
item, uang, atau bahkan area baru\luntuk dijelajahi. Jika seseorang

meminta Misi darimu, terimalah
segera. Meskipun kamu tidak berniat\lmenyelesaikannya saat ini, tidak

ada salahnya untuk mendaftarkannya
di Catatan Quest. Dengan demikian,\lada beberapa orang di sini yang

membutuhkan bantuan. Lihatlah
sekeliling dan lihat apakah ada\lseseorang yang ingin kamu bantu!

Dan temui aku setelah kamu
menyelesaikan setidaknya [green]5[blue] Misi.

entries.original:
"Come see me when you’ve completed
at least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions."
entries.translation_source: Come see me when you’ve completed at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] Missions.
entries.translated:
Temui aku setelah kamu
menyelesaikan setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue]\lMisi.

entries.original:
"Looks like you’ve completed at
least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions!

For that, you get\.

[buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’ve completed at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] Missions! For that, you get[game-token-4] [buffer2-5]!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu telah menyelesaikan
setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] Misi! Untuk\litu, kamu mendapatkan\. [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"I’ve given you all I can give!
You’ve exceeded my expectations!

Any Missions you complete now will
just have to count for bonus."
entries.translation_source: I’ve given you all I can give! You’ve exceeded my expectations! Any Missions you complete now will just have to count for bonus.
entries.translated:
Aku sudah memberikan semua yang
bisa kuberikan! Kamu melampaui\lekspektasiku! Misi apa pun yang

kamu selesaikan sekarang hanya akan
dihitung sebagai bonus.

entries.original: "You received a [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: You received a [buffer1-1]!

entries.original:
"You don’t have any space left in
your party or PC for this Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any space left in your party or PC for this Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki ruang tersisa
di tim atau PC untuk Pokémon ini!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Man, you’re only leaving
Dehara City now?

You sure are slow!

Well, while you were loitering
around, I figured out how to get\lto the Ruins of Void.

But by the time I got over there,
it was too late to do anything.

Whatever The Shadows were planning,
they’d already done.

There were some signs of a battle
in the main room and a strange pile\lof ashes on the floor.

Maybe it was used in some sort of
ritual?

\.

\.

What!?

That’s insane!

You died and came back to life!?"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Man, you’re only leaving Dehara City now? You sure are slow! Well, while you were loitering around, I figured out how to get to the Ruins of Void. But by the time I got over there, it was too late to do anything. Whatever The Shadows were planning, they’d already done. There were some signs of a battle in the main room and a strange pile of ashes on the floor. Maybe it was used in some sort of ritual? [game-token-3] [game-token-4] What!? That’s insane! You died and came back to life!?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Astaga, kamu baru
meninggalkan Dehara City sekarang?\lKamu benar-benar lambat! Yah,

selagi kamu berkeliaran, aku
mencari cara untuk sampai ke\lReruntuhan Kekosongan. Tapi saat

aku sampai di sana, sudah terlambat
untuk melakukan apa pun. Apa pun\lyang direncanakan The Shadows,

mereka sudah melakukannya. Ada
beberapa tanda pertempuran di ruang\lutama dan tumpukan abu aneh di

lantai. Mungkin itu digunakan dalam
semacam ritual? \. \. Apa!? Itu gila!\lKamu mati dan hidup kembali!?

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]What the\.

Who are you supposed to be?"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]What the[game-token-3] Who are you supposed to be?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Apa apaan\. Siapa kamu
sebenarnya?

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]\.

[player], you must be wondering
why I did not follow you into the\lportal alongside Jax.

You see, the moment that portal
appeared, I was apprehensive.

So, unlike Jax, I took a cautious
step backwards, an action which\lled to me losing track of you.

For that, I am sorry.

I assumed you had been teleported
to the Ruins of Void.

As such, I attempted to make my
way over there as well.

However, as I have no Pokémon of
my own, I was unable to reach it.

Tell me, [player], what happened to
you two on the other side of that\lportal?

\.

\.

I see\.

Then, I believe our best course of
action is to head to [green]Vivill Town[blue]\land assist The Shadows.

Once they and the Light of Ruin
clash, it will be the perfect\loppurtunity to swoop in and\larrest them all.

Go assist The Shadows with
their final mission.

Once you are victorious, I will
meet you outside with a team of\lpolice to end this madness."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1][game-token-2] [player-name-3], you must be wondering why I did not follow you into the portal alongside Jax. You see, the moment that portal appeared, I was apprehensive. So, unlike Jax, I took a cautious step backwards, an action which led to me losing track of you. For that, I am sorry. I assumed you had been teleported to the Ruins of Void. As such, I attempted to make my way over there as well. However, as I have no Pokémon of my own, I was unable to reach it. Tell me, [player-name-4], what happened to you two on the other side of that portal? [game-token-5] [game-token-6] I see[game-token-7] Then, I believe our best course of action is to head to [color-green-8]Vivill Town[color-blue-9] and assist The Shadows. Once they and the Light of Ruin clash, it will be the perfect oppurtunity to swoop in and arrest them all. Go assist The Shadows with their final mission. Once you are victorious, I will meet you outside with a team of police to end this madness.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]\. [player], kamu pasti
bertanya-tanya mengapa aku tidak\lmengikutimu ke portal bersama Jax.

Begini, saat portal itu muncul, aku
merasa khawatir. Jadi, tidak\lseperti Jax, aku mengambil langkah

mundur hati-hati, tindakan yang
menyebabkan aku kehilangan jejakmu.\lUntuk itu, aku minta maaf. Aku

mengira kamu telah diteleportasi ke
Reruntuhan Kekosongan. Oleh karena\litu, aku mencoba pergi ke sana

juga. Namun, karena aku tidak
memiliki Pokémon sendiri, aku tidak\lbisa mencapainya. Katakan padaku,

[player], apa yang terjadi pada
kalian berdua di sisi lain portal\litu? \. \. Begitu\. Lalu, menurutku

tindakan terbaik kita adalah menuju
ke [green]Vivill Town[blue] dan membantu The\lShadows. Begitu mereka dan Cahaya

Kehancuran bentrok, itu akan
menjadi kesempatan sempurna untuk\lmenyergap dan menangkap mereka

semua. Bantu The Shadows dengan
misi terakhir mereka. Setelah kamu\lmenang, aku akan menemuimu di luar

dengan tim polisi untuk mengakhiri
kegilaan ini.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Hey!
Don’t ignore me!

I don’t know who you are or what’s
happening, but if whatever’s going\lon has to do with The Shadows, I\lwant in!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Hey! Don’t ignore me! I don’t know who you are or what’s happening, but if whatever’s going on has to do with The Shadows, I want in!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Hei! Jangan abaikan aku!
Aku tidak tahu siapa kamu atau apa\lyang terjadi, tapi jika apa pun

yang terjadi berkaitan dengan The
Shadows, aku ikut!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]And who might you be,
young man?"
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]And who might you be, young man?
entries.translated: Looker: [blue]Dan siapa kamu, anak muda?

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]I’m mad as all else!

I came this close to catching up
with The Shadows and finding my\lparents, and then they got away\lfrom me again!

Now I hear that they’re going to
Vivill Town?

Then that’s where I’m going!
To stop them once and for all!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]I’m mad as all else! I came this close to catching up with The Shadows and finding my parents, and then they got away from me again! Now I hear that they’re going to Vivill Town? Then that’s where I’m going! To stop them once and for all!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Aku sangat marah! Aku
hampir berhasil mengejar The\lShadows dan menemukan orang tuaku,

dan kemudian mereka lolos lagi!
Sekarang aku dengar mereka pergi ke\lVivill Town? Kalau begitu ke

sanalah aku pergi! Untuk
menghentikan mereka sekali dan\luntuk selamanya!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Wait, just wait!

As of now, The Shadows are our
pawns to fix a greater problem!

At least hold off on your act of
vengeance until this ordeal is\lover, understood?"
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]Wait, just wait! As of now, The Shadows are our pawns to fix a greater problem! At least hold off on your act of vengeance until this ordeal is over, understood?
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Tunggu, tunggu dulu! Mulai
sekarang, The Shadows adalah pion\lkita untuk memperbaiki masalah yang

lebih besar! Setidaknya tunda aksi
balas dendammu sampai masalah ini\lselesai, mengerti?

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]\.Fine.

But as soon as this problem is
dealt with, there’s nothing you\lcan do to stop me from going after\levery last one of them!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2][game-token-3]Fine. But as soon as this problem is dealt with, there’s nothing you can do to stop me from going after every last one of them!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]\.Baik. Tapi begitu masalah
ini selesai, tidak ada yang bisa\lkau lakukan untuk menghentikanku

memburu mereka satu per satu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Since this is officially your
\qomission\qc, I’ll be waiting for\lyou in [green]Vivill Town[blue].

And for your sake, I’ll even \qoplay
nice\qc with The Shadows until\lwe’re done.

Don’t be late, [player]."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Since this is officially your [quote-open-2]mission[quote-close-3], I’ll be waiting for you in [color-green-4]Vivill Town[color-blue-5]. And for your sake, I’ll even [quote-open-6]play nice[quote-close-7] with The Shadows until we’re done. Don’t be late, [player-name-8].
entries.translated:
[blue]Karena ini secara resmi \qomisi\qc-mu,
aku akan menunggumu di [green]Kota Vivill[blue].\lDan demi kebaikanmu, aku bahkan

akan \qobersikap baik\qc dengan The
Shadows sampai kita selesai. Jangan\lterlambat, [player].

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]That boy\.he certainly is
something\.

Well, I wish you luck on your

entries.original:
"with the battlefield electrified!

Grounded Pokémon can’t fall asleep
and have stronger Electric-moves!"
entries.translation_source: with the battlefield electrified! Grounded Pokémon can’t fall asleep and have stronger Electric-moves!

entries.original:
"with the battlefield grassy!

Grounded Pokémon have stronger
Grass-moves and heal every turn!"
entries.translation_source: with the battlefield grassy! Grounded Pokémon have stronger Grass-moves and heal every turn!

entries.original:
"with the battlefield misty!

Grounded Pokémon have stronger
Fairy-moves and can’t be afflicted\lwith status conditions!"
entries.translation_source: with the battlefield misty! Grounded Pokémon have stronger Fairy-moves and can’t be afflicted with status conditions!

entries.original:
"with the battlefield weird!

Grounded Pokémon have stronger
Psychic-moves and can’t be hit\lby priority moves!"
entries.translation_source: with the battlefield weird! Grounded Pokémon have stronger Psychic-moves and can’t be hit by priority moves!

entries.original:
"with strong winds blowing!

Flying-type Pokémon take less
damage from super effective moves!"
entries.translation_source: with strong winds blowing! Flying-type Pokémon take less damage from super effective moves!

entries.original:
"with intense gravity!

No Pokémon will remain airborne!"
entries.translation_source: with intense gravity! No Pokémon will remain airborne!

entries.original:
"with electromagnetism on the field!

Electric- and Steel-type Pokémon
can’t be hit by Ground-type moves!"
entries.translation_source: with electromagnetism on the field! Electric- and Steel-type Pokémon can’t be hit by Ground-type moves!

entries.original:
"with the battlefield locked down!

No Pokémon will be able to switch
out!"
entries.translation_source: with the battlefield locked down! No Pokémon will be able to switch out!

entries.original:
"with pixies in the air!

Fairy-type Pokémon will have their
lowest defensive stat boosted!"
entries.translation_source: with pixies in the air! Fairy-type Pokémon will have their lowest defensive stat boosted!

entries.original:
"with negative emotions in the air!

Pokémon that aren’t part Dark-
type, Ghost-type, Psychic-type,\lor have one of the Abilities\lUnaware, Oblivious, or Magic Guard\lwill be hurt each turn!"
entries.translation_source: with negative emotions in the air! Pokémon that aren’t part Dark- type, Ghost-type, Psychic-type, or have one of the Abilities Unaware, Oblivious, or Magic Guard will be hurt each turn!

entries.original:
"with a Power Spot active!

All Pokémon will be able to
Dynamax!

However, no Pokémon may Mega
Evolve, undergo Primal Reversion,\lUltra Burst, or use Z-Moves!"
entries.translation_source: with a Power Spot active! All Pokémon will be able to Dynamax! However, no Pokémon may Mega Evolve, undergo Primal Reversion, Ultra Burst, or use Z-Moves!

entries.original:
"with Pokémon swapped!

Each side will use one of the
opposing side’s Pokémon at random!"
entries.translation_source: with Pokémon swapped! Each side will use one of the opposing side’s Pokémon at random!

entries.original:
"with a veil protecting both sides\lof the battlefield!

No Pokémon may inflict status
conditions on another!"
entries.translation_source: with a veil protecting both sides of the battlefield! No Pokémon may inflict status conditions on another!

entries.original:
"with Mist surrounding both sides\lof the battlefield!

No Pokémon may have their stats
lowered by another!"
entries.translation_source: with Mist surrounding both sides of the battlefield! No Pokémon may have their stats lowered by another!

entries.original:
"with a Sea of Fire engulfing both\lsides of the battlefield!

All non-Fire-type Pokémon will be
damaged each turn!"
entries.translation_source: with a Sea of Fire engulfing both sides of the battlefield! All non-Fire-type Pokémon will be damaged each turn!

entries.original:
"with a Rainbow present on both\lsides of the battlefield!

All moves have their secondary
effect chance doubled!"
entries.translation_source: with a Rainbow present on both sides of the battlefield! All moves have their secondary effect chance doubled!

entries.original: "with all Pokémon confused!"
entries.translation_source: with all Pokémon confused!

entries.original:
"with all Pokémon taunted!

No status moves can be used!"
entries.translation_source: with all Pokémon taunted! No status moves can be used!

entries.original:
"with all Pokémon tormented!

No move can be used twice in a row."
entries.translation_source: with all Pokémon tormented! No move can be used twice in a row.

entries.original:
"with all Pokémon Heal Blocked!

No Pokémon will be able to heal!"
entries.translation_source: with all Pokémon Heal Blocked! No Pokémon will be able to heal!

entries.original:
"with all Pokémon Throat Chopped!

No sound-based moves can be used!"
entries.translation_source: with all Pokémon Throat Chopped! No sound-based moves can be used!

entries.original:
"with all Pokémon Laser Focused!

Moves will always score critical
hits!"
entries.translation_source: with all Pokémon Laser Focused! Moves will always score critical hits!

entries.original: "with no Pokémon being able to\lscore a critical hit!"
entries.translation_source: with no Pokémon being able to score a critical hit!

entries.original: "with all Pokémon having their\labilities suppressed!"
entries.translation_source: with all Pokémon having their abilities suppressed!

entries.original:
"Surprised to see someone my age?
I promise you, I’m not weak."
entries.translation_source: Surprised to see someone my age? I promise you, I’m not weak.

entries.original:
"I guess dropping out of school
wasn’t so smart\."
entries.translation_source: I guess dropping out of school wasn’t so smart[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Heh, I told you I wasn’t a
pushover!"
entries.translation_source: Heh, I told you I wasn’t a pushover!

entries.original:
"I left school to be here\.

I won’t let you stand between me
and greatness!"
entries.translation_source: I left school to be here[game-token-1] I won’t let you stand between me and greatness!

entries.original:
"That was a good battle!
I look forward to our rematch."
entries.translation_source: That was a good battle! I look forward to our rematch.

entries.original:
"You fight worse than my grandma!
Though Grandma’s a tough cookie\."
entries.translation_source: You fight worse than my grandma! Though Grandma’s a tough cookie[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"I’m just a young kid, you should
go easy on me!"
entries.translation_source: I’m just a young kid, you should go easy on me!

entries.original: "Waaah! I’m telling on you!"
entries.translation_source: Waaah! I’m telling on you!

entries.original:
"Beaten by a little kid\.
How can you sleep at night?"
entries.translation_source: Beaten by a little kid[game-token-1] How can you sleep at night?

entries.original:
"The way of the Bug Catcher!
Bear witness to it!"
entries.translation_source: The way of the Bug Catcher! Bear witness to it!

entries.original: "All hail Bug Catchers!"
entries.translation_source: All hail Bug Catchers!

entries.original:
"This is the way of the Bug
Catcher!"
entries.translation_source: This is the way of the Bug Catcher!

entries.original: "I’ll snag you with my net!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll snag you with my net!

entries.original: "Hey! Don’t run away!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Don’t run away!

entries.original: "It’s in the bag!"
entries.translation_source: It’s in the bag!

entries.original:
"I catch and raise all sorts of Bug
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I catch and raise all sorts of Bug Pokémon.

entries.original:
"I need to raise my Pokémon some
more!"
entries.translation_source: I need to raise my Pokémon some more!

entries.original: "See? I’ve raised them pretty good."
entries.translation_source: See? I’ve raised them pretty good.

entries.original:
"I’m on the lookout for adorable
accessories."
entries.translation_source: I’m on the lookout for adorable accessories.

entries.original: "I wish I could dress up!"
entries.translation_source: I wish I could dress up!

entries.original:
"Let me know if you find any nice
accessories!"
entries.translation_source: Let me know if you find any nice accessories!

entries.original:
"I make it a policy to wear
miniskirts!"
entries.translation_source: I make it a policy to wear miniskirts!

entries.original: "What’s your policy?"
entries.translation_source: What’s your policy?

entries.original: "Miniskirts are the ultimate!"
entries.translation_source: Miniskirts are the ultimate!

entries.original: "Here goes!"
entries.translation_source: Here goes!

entries.original:
"How could you bully a poor little
girl?"
entries.translation_source: How could you bully a poor little girl?

entries.original: "Caught you snoozing!"
entries.translation_source: Caught you snoozing!

entries.original: "The sea, my beautiful sea!"
entries.translation_source: The sea, my beautiful sea!

entries.original:
"I want to become a big man.
Big like the sea big."
entries.translation_source: I want to become a big man. Big like the sea big.

entries.original:
"Oh\. I hear them\.

I hear the sound of waves\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] I hear them[game-token-2] I hear the sound of waves[game-token-3]

entries.original:
"I’m the Sailor among Sailors!
I was born on the high seas!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Sailor among Sailors! I was born on the high seas!

entries.original:
"Urp\. Gweh\.

So, when I get up on land, I get
no-motion sickness\."
entries.translation_source: Urp[game-token-1] Gweh[game-token-2] So, when I get up on land, I get no-motion sickness[game-token-3]

entries.original:
"The waves rocked me to sleep!
The sea was my mother!"
entries.translation_source: The waves rocked me to sleep! The sea was my mother!

entries.original:
"Come on! Take a run at me! I can
take it!"
entries.translation_source: Come on! Take a run at me! I can take it!

entries.original: "Good job! Way to overcome my size!"
entries.translation_source: Good job! Way to overcome my size!

entries.original:
"So, what’d you think?
I was too burly for you to handle?"
entries.translation_source: So, what’d you think? I was too burly for you to handle?

entries.original: "My Pokémon trained in forests."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon trained in forests.

entries.original: "I’m going back to the forest."
entries.translation_source: I’m going back to the forest.

entries.original: "It’s the power of the forests."
entries.translation_source: It’s the power of the forests.

entries.original:
"The indefatigable Camper makes his
stand!"
entries.translation_source: The indefatigable Camper makes his stand!

entries.original:
"I wish I could become your
devotee."
entries.translation_source: I wish I could become your devotee.

entries.original:
"You can become a devotee if you’d
like."
entries.translation_source: You can become a devotee if you’d like.

entries.original: "Hunh? Where is everyone?"
entries.translation_source: Hunh? Where is everyone?

entries.original:
"I came to camp, but I think I got
separated from my friends\."
entries.translation_source: I came to camp, but I think I got separated from my friends[game-token-1]

entries.original: "Hey, guys! Where are you?!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, guys! Where are you?!

entries.original:
"I’ll battle you like I’m on a
picnic!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll battle you like I’m on a picnic!

entries.original:
"Pretending this is a picnic won’t
let me win."
entries.translation_source: Pretending this is a picnic won’t let me win.

entries.original: "Lalala!"
entries.translation_source: Lalala!

entries.original:
"Win or lose, let’s not bear any
grudges."
entries.translation_source: Win or lose, let’s not bear any grudges.

entries.original: "Oh, you! Don’t ever forget this!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, you! Don’t ever forget this!

entries.original: "Yay, yay, yay! We did it!"
entries.translation_source: Yay, yay, yay! We did it!

entries.original:
"I’ll teach you what’s fun about
battling."
entries.translation_source: I’ll teach you what’s fun about battling.

entries.original:
