entries.translation_source: What do you think you’re doin’, huh, kid? This is Black Ferrothorn turf! You’re not welcome here!
entries.translated:
Apa yang kamu lakukan, hah, nak?
Ini wilayah Black Ferrothorn! Kamu\ltidak diizinkan di sini!

entries.original:
"Hey!
What’s goin’ on in there?

You think it’s funny to lock me
out? Huh?"
entries.translation_source: Hey! What’s goin’ on in there? You think it’s funny to lock me out? Huh?
entries.translated:
Hei! Ada apa di dalam sana? Kamu
pikir lucu mengunciku di luar? Hah?

entries.original:
"It’s too scary to go into the city\.

There are bad people everywhere!"
entries.translation_source: It’s too scary to go into the city[game-token-1] There are bad people everywhere!
entries.translated:
Terlalu menakutkan untuk masuk ke
kota\. Ada orang jahat di mana-mana!

entries.original:
"I came here with my grandson to
show him the city I grew up in, but\lhe’s much too afraid to enter it.

Sometime after I moved away, it was
overrun by hoodlums."
entries.translation_source: I came here with my grandson to show him the city I grew up in, but he’s much too afraid to enter it. Sometime after I moved away, it was overrun by hoodlums.
entries.translated:
Saya datang ke sini bersama cucu
saya untuk menunjukkan kepadanya\lkota tempat saya dibesarkan, tapi

dia terlalu takut untuk
memasukinya. Beberapa waktu setelah\lsaya pindah, kota itu dikuasai oleh

preman-preman.

entries.original:
"I can’t believe it\.

The legend\.\CC0820 the conquerer\.\CC0820
[player]!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t believe it[game-token-1] The legend[game-token-2][control-code-3] the conquerer[game-token-4][control-code-5] [player-name-6]!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak percaya\. Sang legenda\.\CC0820 sang
penakluk\.\CC0820 [player]!

entries.original:
"You wanna mess with the Black
Ferrothorn, kid?"
entries.translation_source: You wanna mess with the Black Ferrothorn, kid?

entries.original: "Don’t mess with us!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t mess with us!

entries.original:
"  VROOM   VROOM

The Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: VROOM VROOM The Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated: VROOM VROOM The Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"I’m a member of the Black
Ferrothorn!

Stare at me too long and I’ll
poke you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m a member of the Black Ferrothorn! Stare at me too long and I’ll poke you!
entries.translated:
Aku anggota Black Ferrothorn! Jika
kau menatapku terlalu lama, aku\lakan menusukmu!

entries.original:
"Those Black [player] always gettin’
in the way\.

Hey!
Quit starin’!"
entries.translation_source: Those Black [player-name-1] always gettin’ in the way[game-token-2] Hey! Quit starin’!
entries.translated:
Para Black [player] itu selalu
menghalangi\. Hei! Berhenti menatap!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
Ain’t nobody ever takin’ us down!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! Ain’t nobody ever takin’ us down!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Black Ferrothorn! Tidak
ada yang pernah mengalahkan kami!

entries.original:
"We just booted the old gang around
here outta town!

We’re set to rule it, now!
We’re the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: We just booted the old gang around here outta town! We’re set to rule it, now! We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Kami baru saja mengusir geng lama
dari sini keluar kota! Kami siap\luntuk menguasainya sekarang! Kami

adalah Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"One day, we’re gonna boot those
Black [player] right outta town\.

Hey!
Quit starin’!"
entries.translation_source: One day, we’re gonna boot those Black [player-name-1] right outta town[game-token-2] Hey! Quit starin’!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, kami akan mengusir
Black [player] itu keluar kota\. Hei!\lBerhenti melotot!

entries.original:
"We just booted the new gang around
here outta town!

The Black [player] is gone forever!
We’re the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: We just booted the new gang around here outta town! The Black [player-name-1] is gone forever! We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Kami baru saja mengusir geng baru
dari sini keluar kota! Black\l[player] sudah pergi selamanya!

Kami adalah Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original: "The trash bin is empty."
entries.translation_source: The trash bin is empty.
entries.translated: Tempat sampah kosong.

entries.original:
"It’s a dumpster.
Open it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a dumpster. Open it?
entries.translated: Ini tong sampah. Buka?

entries.original: "The dumpster is empty."
entries.translation_source: The dumpster is empty.
entries.translated: Tong sampah kosong.

entries.original:
"There is a Pokémon feeding on the
garbage in the dumpster.

The Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: There is a Pokémon feeding on the garbage in the dumpster. The Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated:
Ada seekor Pokémon yang sedang
memakan sampah di tong sampah.\lPokémon itu menyerang!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] dug deeper into
the dumpster."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] dug deeper into the dumpster.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] menggali lebih dalam ke
dalam tong sampah.

entries.original:
"Some words are crossed out.

It appears to read now:
Black [player] HQ"
entries.translation_source: Some words are crossed out. It appears to read now: Black [player-name-1] HQ
entries.translated:
Beberapa kata dicoret. Tampaknya
sekarang terbaca: Black [player] HQ

entries.original:
"The words are faded.

It appears to read:
Black [player] HQ"
entries.translation_source: The words are faded. It appears to read: Black [player-name-1] HQ
entries.translated:
Kata-katanya pudar. Tampaknya
terbaca: Black [player] HQ

entries.original:
"The words are faded.

It appears to read:
Terror Granbull HQ"
entries.translation_source: The words are faded. It appears to read: Terror Granbull HQ
entries.translated:
Kata-katanya pudar. Tampaknya
terbaca: Terror Granbull HQ

entries.original:
"It’s full of cardboard boxes with
electrical appliances in them."
entries.translation_source: It’s full of cardboard boxes with electrical appliances in them.
entries.translated:
Isinya penuh dengan kotak kardus
berisi peralatan listrik.

entries.original:
"Oh? [buffer1] would like to
investigate the motors of\lthe electrical appliances."
entries.translation_source: Oh? [buffer1-1] would like to investigate the motors of the electrical appliances.
entries.translated:
Oh? [buffer1] ingin menyelidiki
motor-motor dari peralatan listrik.

entries.original:
"Which appliance’s motor should
[buffer1] enter?"
entries.translation_source: Which appliance’s motor should [buffer1-1] enter?
entries.translated:
Motor alat mana yang harus [buffer1]
masuki?

entries.original: "[buffer1] entered the motor."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] entered the motor.
entries.translated: [buffer1] memasuki motor.

entries.original: "Which move should be forgotten?"
entries.translation_source: Which move should be forgotten?
entries.translated: Jurusan mana yang harus dilupakan?

entries.original: "[buffer1] emerged from the motor."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] emerged from the motor.
entries.translated: [buffer1] muncul dari motor.

entries.original:
"[buffer1] didn’t learn
[buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] didn’t learn [buffer2-2].
entries.translated:
[buffer1] tidak mempelajari
[buffer2].

entries.original: "[buffer1] is already in this motor."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] is already in this motor.
entries.translated: [buffer1] sudah ada di motor ini.

entries.original: "[buffer1] is not in this motor."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] is not in this motor.
entries.translated: [buffer1] tidak ada di motor ini.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Antisis City
Police HQ!

Well\. actually, now it’s just
my home.

Ever since the gangs\.\CC0818 er\.\CC0818
\qorequested\qc that we leave, the\lpolice force around here has been\lbasically nonexistent.

And you can see what that has
led to.

Total anarchy and lawlessness."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Antisis City Police HQ! Well[game-token-1] actually, now it’s just my home. Ever since the gangs[game-token-2][control-code-3] er[game-token-4][control-code-5] [quote-open-6]requested[quote-close-7] that we leave, the police force around here has been basically nonexistent. And you can see what that has led to. Total anarchy and lawlessness.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Markas Polisi
Antisis City! Sebenarnya\. sekarang\lini hanya rumahku. Sejak geng-geng\.\CC0818

eh\.\CC0818 \qomeminta\qc kami pergi, kepolisian
di sini hampir tidak ada. Dan kau\lbisa lihat akibatnya. Anarki total

dan ketiadaan hukum.

entries.original:
"It’s great to see someone your age
pursuing the healthy career of\lPokémon Trainer.

You’ve made a much better choice
than by joining a gang.

Trust me, I know.

I see what goes on around here.
You want no part in that."
entries.translation_source: It’s great to see someone your age pursuing the healthy career of Pokémon Trainer. You’ve made a much better choice than by joining a gang. Trust me, I know. I see what goes on around here. You want no part in that.
entries.translated:
Senang melihat seseorang seusiamu
mengejar karier sehat sebagai\lPelatih Pokémon. Kau telah membuat

pilihan yang jauh lebih baik
daripada bergabung dengan geng.\lPercayalah, aku tahu. Aku melihat

apa yang terjadi di sini. Kau tidak
ingin terlibat dalam itu.

entries.original:
"It’s a shame that someone your age
is part of a gang.

You could’ve had so much potential,
but now, you have none at all."
entries.translation_source: It’s a shame that someone your age is part of a gang. You could’ve had so much potential, but now, you have none at all.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali seseorang seusiamu
menjadi bagian dari geng. Kau bisa\lmemiliki begitu banyak potensi,

tapi sekarang, kau tidak punya
potensi sama sekali.

entries.original:
"It’s been almost\.\CC0818 too calm lately.

I just can’t take it, anymore!

I think I need some\.\CC0818 some sort of
[green]eerie pulse[blue] to shake the nerves\."
entries.translation_source: It’s been almost[game-token-1][control-code-2] too calm lately. I just can’t take it, anymore! I think I need some[game-token-3][control-code-4] some sort of [color-green-5]eerie pulse[color-blue-6] to shake the nerves[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Akhir-akhir ini hampir\.\CC0818 terlalu
tenang. Aku sudah tidak tahan lagi!\lKurasa aku perlu\.\CC0818 semacam [green]denyut

aneh[blue] untuk mengguncang saraf\.

entries.original:
"Your [buffer1] has just given me
the chills!

Its Eerie Impulse sure brings back
memories from the days when I was\la Bird Keeper.

The power of Electric-types was
what inspired me to change which\lkind of Pokémon I trained.

Since I have no more use for this,
I want you to have it."
entries.translation_source: Your [buffer1-1] has just given me the chills! Its Eerie Impulse sure brings back memories from the days when I was a Bird Keeper. The power of Electric-types was what inspired me to change which kind of Pokémon I trained. Since I have no more use for this, I want you to have it.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] milikmu baru saja
membuatku merinding! Denyut\lMisteriusnya pasti membawa kenangan

dari masa ketika aku menjadi
Penjaga Burung. Kekuatan tipe\lListriklah yang menginspirasiku

untuk mengubah jenis Pokémon yang
kulatih. Karena aku tidak lagi\lberguna untuk ini, aku ingin kau

memilikinya.

entries.original:
"[green]Acrobatics[blue] becomes a powerful
attack if your Pokémon isn’t\lholdin’ an item.

It’s not eerie at all, but it’ll
still make Fightin’-types go\lrunnin’ in terror!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Acrobatics[color-blue-2] becomes a powerful attack if your Pokémon isn’t holdin’ an item. It’s not eerie at all, but it’ll still make Fightin’-types go runnin’ in terror!
entries.translated:
[green]Akrobatik[blue] menjadi serangan kuat
jika Pokémon-mu tidak memegang\litem. Ini sama sekali tidak

misterius, tapi tetap akan membuat
tipe Petarung lari ketakutan!

entries.original:
"Antisis City is the most
crime-ridden city in Borrius.

However, because of its existence,
most lowlives in the region are\ldrawn here, causing crime rates to\ldecrease everywhere else.

That’s the main reason the police
didn’t fight back after they were\lforcibly expelled during the riots.

They won’t tell you that, though.

In order for Antisis City to keep
on existing as is, the police need\lto feign ignorance to anything\lthat’s not too serious of a crime.

But if anything starts to get out
of hand around here, that’s when\lBig Mo comes in and takes control."
entries.translation_source: Antisis City is the most crime-ridden city in Borrius. However, because of its existence, most lowlives in the region are drawn here, causing crime rates to decrease everywhere else. That’s the main reason the police didn’t fight back after they were forcibly expelled during the riots. They won’t tell you that, though. In order for Antisis City to keep on existing as is, the police need to feign ignorance to anything that’s not too serious of a crime. But if anything starts to get out of hand around here, that’s when Big Mo comes in and takes control.
entries.translated:
Antisis City adalah kota paling
rawan kejahatan di Borrius. Namun,\lkarena keberadaannya, sebagian

besar penjahat di wilayah itu
tertarik ke sini, menyebabkan\ltingkat kejahatan menurun di tempat

lain. Itulah alasan utama polisi
tidak melawan setelah mereka diusir\lsecara paksa selama kerusuhan.

Mereka tidak akan memberitahumu
itu. Agar Antisis City tetap ada\lseperti sekarang, polisi perlu

pura-pura tidak tahu terhadap apa
pun yang bukan kejahatan serius.\lTapi jika ada sesuatu yang mulai di

luar kendali di sini, saat itulah
Big Mo datang dan mengambil alih.

entries.original: "[green]Crooooak\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Crooooak[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Crooooak\.

entries.original:
"I used to be a proud member of the
Terror Granbull - the gang that\lran this joint.

We were at the top of our game
until those Black Ferrothorn\lshowed up.

They took us by surprise and
attacked our base through the\lsewers.

Now, I’m back to bein’ a nobody,
livin’ with his mama.

And since I don’t really battle
anymore, there ain’t much I can\ldo with this."
entries.translation_source: I used to be a proud member of the Terror Granbull - the gang that ran this joint. We were at the top of our game until those Black Ferrothorn showed up. They took us by surprise and attacked our base through the sewers. Now, I’m back to bein’ a nobody, livin’ with his mama. And since I don’t really battle anymore, there ain’t much I can do with this.
entries.translated:
Aku dulu anggota bangga dari Terror
Granbull - geng yang menguasai\ltempat ini. Kami berada di puncak

permainan kami sampai Black
Ferrothorn muncul. Mereka\lmengejutkan kami dan menyerang

basis kami melalui selokan.
Sekarang, aku kembali menjadi orang\ltak berarti, tinggal dengan ibuku.

Dan karena aku tidak benar-benar
bertarung lagi, tidak banyak yang\lbisa kulakukan dengan ini.

entries.original:
"Don’t let what happened to me,
happen to you, kid!

Stay away from gangs, and stay
in school!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let what happened to me, happen to you, kid! Stay away from gangs, and stay in school!
entries.translated:
Jangan biarkan apa yang terjadi
padaku terjadi padamu, nak! Jauhi\lgeng, dan tetap bersekolah!

entries.original:
"I was so happy for my son when he
joined the Terror Granbull.

Yes, I admit that joining a gang is
not the best of careers, but at\lleast he had one!

Now, he’s just another lowlife.

When will he ever get a real job
and leave the house again?"
entries.translation_source: I was so happy for my son when he joined the Terror Granbull. Yes, I admit that joining a gang is not the best of careers, but at least he had one! Now, he’s just another lowlife. When will he ever get a real job and leave the house again?
entries.translated:
Aku sangat senang untuk anakku
ketika dia bergabung dengan Terror\lGranbull. Ya, aku akui bahwa

bergabung dengan geng bukanlah
karier terbaik, tapi setidaknya dia\lpunya satu! Sekarang, dia hanya

seorang penjahat biasa. Kapan dia
akan mendapatkan pekerjaan nyata\ldan meninggalkan rumah lagi?

entries.original:
"Those poozers think that Antisis
City is safe now that the Terror\lGranbull are gone!

Haw haw!

They couldn’t be more wrong!"
entries.translation_source: Those poozers think that Antisis City is safe now that the Terror Granbull are gone! Haw haw! They couldn’t be more wrong!
entries.translated:
Orang-orang bodoh itu mengira
Antisis City aman sekarang setelah\lTerror Granbull pergi! Haw haw!

Mereka tidak mungkin lebih salah!

entries.original:
"My boyfriend is so strong and
tough!

There ain’t no one like him here in
the city!

Well, aside from Big Mo, of course."
entries.translation_source: My boyfriend is so strong and tough! There ain’t no one like him here in the city! Well, aside from Big Mo, of course.
entries.translated:
Pacarku sangat kuat dan tangguh!
Tidak ada yang seperti dia di kota\lini! Yah, selain Big Mo, tentu

saja.

entries.original: "Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!"
entries.translation_source: Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!
entries.translated: Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!

entries.original:
"You wanna prove you’re tough?
Huh, [buffer1]?

You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo.

He’s the biggest, toughest guy in
all of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You wanna prove you’re tough? Huh, [buffer1-1]? You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo. He’s the biggest, toughest guy in all of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Kau ingin membuktikan dirimu
tangguh? Huh, [buffer1]? Kau pasti\lingin melawan Big Mo. Dia pria

terbesar dan terkuat di seluruh
Antisis City.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You must be pretty tough if you
took down Big Mo.

That ain’t easy.

You know what, take these as a
congrats from me."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] You must be pretty tough if you took down Big Mo. That ain’t easy. You know what, take these as a congrats from me.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Kau pasti cukup tangguh jika
berhasil mengalahkan Big Mo. Itu\ltidak mudah. Kau tahu, ambil ini

sebagai ucapan selamat dariku.

entries.original:
"Use those Balls to catch even more
tough Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Use those Balls to catch even more tough Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Gunakan Bola-Bola itu untuk
menangkap Pokémon yang lebih\ltangguh.

entries.original: "Uh\. whaddya want?"
entries.translation_source: Uh[game-token-1] whaddya want?
entries.translated: Uh\. mau apa?

entries.original: "Don’t come back."
entries.translation_source: Don’t come back.
entries.translated: Jangan kembali.

entries.original: "[green]Kek!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Kek!
entries.translated: [green]Kek!

entries.original:
"Be cautious, Trainer!

You’re about to enter Antisis City!
A very dangerous place!

If you’re coming from there\. well\.
this gate really only goes one way."
entries.translation_source: Be cautious, Trainer! You’re about to enter Antisis City! A very dangerous place! If you’re coming from there[game-token-1] well[game-token-2] this gate really only goes one way.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati, Pelatih! Kamu akan
memasuki Antisis City! Tempat yang\lsangat berbahaya! Jika kamu datang

dari sana\. yah\. gerbang ini
benar-benar hanya satu arah.

entries.original:
"You will need to possess some sort
of valid identification if you wish\laccess to the port."
entries.translation_source: You will need to possess some sort of valid identification if you wish access to the port.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus memiliki semacam
identifikasi yang sah jika ingin\lmengakses pelabuhan.

entries.original:
"Do not even think of bringing in
any illegal merchandise into\lAntisis City.

I will know if you try something."
entries.translation_source: Do not even think of bringing in any illegal merchandise into Antisis City. I will know if you try something.
entries.translated:
Jangan pernah berpikir untuk
membawa barang ilegal ke Antisis\lCity. Aku akan tahu jika kamu

mencoba sesuatu.

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Feel free to come and go as
you please.

With a Trainer Card like yours,
you have more than proved your\ltrustworthiness."
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player-name-1]! Feel free to come and go as you please. With a Trainer Card like yours, you have more than proved your trustworthiness.
entries.translated:
Hai, [player]! Silakan datang dan
pergi sesukamu. Dengan Kartu\lPelatih seperti milikmu, kamu sudah

lebih dari cukup membuktikan
kepercayaanmu.

entries.original:
"Yawn\.
These early mornings are rough\.

I don’t know how you Borrian folk
do it\."
entries.translation_source: Yawn[game-token-1] These early mornings are rough[game-token-2] I don’t know how you Borrian folk do it[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Menguap\. Pagi-pagi begini berat\. Aku
tidak tahu bagaimana kalian orang\lBorrian melakukannya\.

entries.original:
"I’ve got a shipment for one\. uh\.
Swomoli?

Man\. these names are hard to
read sometimes."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got a shipment for one[game-token-1] uh[game-token-2] Swomoli? Man[game-token-3] these names are hard to read sometimes.
entries.translated:
Aku punya kiriman untuk satu\. uh\.
Swomoli? Astaga\. nama-nama ini\lkadang susah dibaca.

entries.original:
"A fresh batch of [green]Premier Balls[blue] has
just arrived!

Why don’t you take a few?
They’ll never notice\."
entries.translation_source: A fresh batch of [color-green-1]Premier Balls[color-blue-2] has just arrived! Why don’t you take a few? They’ll never notice[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Satu set baru [green]Premier Ball[blue] baru
saja tiba! Kenapa kamu tidak\lmengambil beberapa? Mereka tidak

akan pernah tahu\.

entries.original:
"I’ve always advocated for a smaller
Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio.

Ten to one? Are you kidding me?
Who even buys ten Poké Balls?

At least you Borrian folk hand them
out for any type of Poké Ball."
entries.translation_source: I’ve always advocated for a smaller Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio. Ten to one? Are you kidding me? Who even buys ten Poké Balls? At least you Borrian folk hand them out for any type of Poké Ball.
entries.translated:
Aku selalu menganjurkan rasio Poké
Ball ke Premier Ball yang lebih\lkecil. Sepuluh banding satu? Kamu

bercanda? Siapa yang membeli
sepuluh Poké Ball? Setidaknya\lkalian orang Borrian memberikannya

untuk semua jenis Poké Ball.

entries.original:
"Night deliveries are by far better
than day deliveries.

Why?

For starters, there’s less
ocean traffic!"
entries.translation_source: Night deliveries are by far better than day deliveries. Why? For starters, there’s less ocean traffic!
entries.translated:
Pengiriman malam hari jauh lebih
baik daripada pengiriman siang.\lKenapa? Pertama, lalu lintas laut

lebih sedikit!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Lava Cookie[blue] before?

If you take it, you won’t need a
Burn Heal!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [color-green-1]Lava Cookie[color-blue-2] before? If you take it, you won’t need a Burn Heal!
entries.translated:
Kamu pernah punya [green]Lava Cookie[blue]
sebelumnya? Jika kamu mengambilnya,\lkamu tidak perlu Obat Luka Bakar!

entries.original:
"Pardon me\.

Would you care for an [green]Old Gateau[blue]?

Oui, oui, yes, you would."
entries.translation_source: Pardon me[game-token-1] Would you care for an [color-green-2]Old Gateau[color-blue-3]? Oui, oui, yes, you would.
entries.translated:
Maaf\. Apakah kamu mau [green]Old Gateau[blue]?
Oui, oui, ya, kamu mau.

entries.original:
"Quick!

Take a [green]Casteliacone[blue] before
it melts!"
entries.translation_source: Quick! Take a [color-green-1]Casteliacone[color-blue-2] before it melts!
entries.translated:
Cepat! Ambil [green]Casteliacone[blue] sebelum
meleleh!

entries.original:
"The city of lights and biscuits\.

Have this token of Lumiose City,
the [green]Lumiose Galette[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The city of lights and biscuits[game-token-1] Have this token of Lumiose City, the [color-green-2]Lumiose Galette[color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Kota cahaya dan biskuit\. Ambil token
dari Lumiose City ini, yaitu\l[green]Lumiose Galette[blue].

entries.original:
"Feel the power of Mega Evolution
when you take a bite out of this\l[green]Shalour Sable[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Feel the power of Mega Evolution when you take a bite out of this [color-green-1]Shalour Sable[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Rasakan kekuatan Mega Evolution
saat kamu menggigit [green]Shalour Sable[blue]\lini!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Big Malasada[blue]
before?

I hear it’s really good for
the heart.

Try some, straight from the
Alola region!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [color-green-1]Big Malasada[color-blue-2] before? I hear it’s really good for the heart. Try some, straight from the Alola region!
entries.translated:
Kamu pernah punya [green]Big Malasada[blue]
sebelumnya? Kudengar itu sangat\lbaik untuk jantung. Coba beberapa,

langsung dari region Alola!

entries.original:
"Feed the [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon with a status condition.

It’ll get all better, just
like that!"
entries.translation_source: Feed the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] to a Pokémon with a status condition. It’ll get all better, just like that!
entries.translated:
Berikan [green][buffer1][blue] kepada Pokémon
yang mengalami kondisi status. Dia\lakan sembuh total, begitu saja!

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local
shipments today.

If you come by any other day of the
week, I may have souvenirs from\lvarious regions to give out."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local shipments today. If you come by any other day of the week, I may have souvenirs from various regions to give out.
entries.translated:
Maaf, nak, aku hanya membawa
kiriman lokal hari ini. Jika kamu\ldatang pada hari lain dalam

seminggu, mungkin aku punya
oleh-oleh dari berbagai region\luntuk dibagikan.

entries.original:
"I was taking inventory for the
Berry shipments this morning, and\las usual, we have a surplus.

Why don’t you take a Berry?"
entries.translation_source: I was taking inventory for the Berry shipments this morning, and as usual, we have a surplus. Why don’t you take a Berry?
entries.translated:
Aku sedang melakukan inventaris
untuk kiriman Berry pagi ini, dan\lseperti biasa, kita punya

kelebihan. Kenapa kamu tidak
mengambil satu Berry?

entries.original:
"Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency
to send a few extra Berries.

There may be some more in
tomorrow’s shipment, too.

I wonder how they don’t lose
money\."
entries.translation_source: Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency to send a few extra Berries. There may be some more in tomorrow’s shipment, too. I wonder how they don’t lose money[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tropius Berries Inc. cenderung
mengirim beberapa Berry ekstra.\lMungkin ada lebih banyak di kiriman

besok juga. Aku heran bagaimana
mereka tidak rugi\.

entries.original:
"Oh, drat!

I’m going to be late for my
next job!

I’ll be back tomorrow morning,
as usual!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, drat! I’m going to be late for my next job! I’ll be back tomorrow morning, as usual!
entries.translated:
Oh, sial! Aku akan terlambat untuk
pekerjaan selanjutnya! Aku akan\lkembali besok pagi, seperti biasa!

entries.original:
"Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies
to Fallshore City during the day.

It’s too dangerous to move them
through Antisis City, which is why\lthis job exists."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies to Fallshore City during the day. It’s too dangerous to move them through Antisis City, which is why this job exists.
entries.translated:
Aye, akulah orang yang memindahkan
persediaan ke Fallshore City pada\lsiang hari. Terlalu berbahaya untuk

memindahkannya melalui Antisis
City, itulah sebabnya pekerjaan ini\lada.

entries.original:
"We policemen are the only things
standing between the gangs and\ltotal destruction of the port."
entries.translation_source: We policemen are the only things standing between the gangs and total destruction of the port.
entries.translated:
Kami polisi adalah satu-satunya
yang berdiri di antara geng-geng\ldan kehancuran total pelabuhan.

entries.original:
"Are you up to no good?

\.

Just checking.

There’s no telling when a ruffian
will sneak past the gate check."
entries.translation_source: Are you up to no good? [game-token-1] Just checking. There’s no telling when a ruffian will sneak past the gate check.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu berniat jahat? \. Hanya
memeriksa. Tidak ada yang tahu\lkapan seorang preman akan

menyelinap melewati pemeriksaan
gerbang.

entries.original:
"I’ve watched over this port ever
since the once glorious Antisis\lCity stood proud\.

This port is all that remains of
that city\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve watched over this port ever since the once glorious Antisis City stood proud[game-token-1] This port is all that remains of that city[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku telah mengawasi pelabuhan ini
sejak Antisis City yang dulunya\lmegah berdiri dengan bangga\.

Pelabuhan ini adalah satu-satunya
yang tersisa dari kota itu\.

entries.original:
"This lighthouse was once a beacon
of hope for tourists.

But ever since Antisis City was
turned into a crime-filled slum,\ltourists have stopped coming to\lthis port."
entries.translation_source: This lighthouse was once a beacon of hope for tourists. But ever since Antisis City was turned into a crime-filled slum, tourists have stopped coming to this port.
entries.translated:
Mercusuar ini dulunya adalah
mercusuar harapan bagi para\lwisatawan. Tetapi sejak Antisis

City berubah menjadi kawasan kumuh
yang penuh kejahatan, wisatawan\lberhenti datang ke pelabuhan ini.

entries.original:
"Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis
Port is mainly used for the import\lof goods from other regions.

Once dropped off here, the goods
are moved along to Fallshore City\lwhere they can then be distributed\lacross Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis Port is mainly used for the import of goods from other regions. Once dropped off here, the goods are moved along to Fallshore City where they can then be distributed across Borrius.
entries.translated:
Tidak seperti Seaport City,
Pelabuhan Antisis terutama\ldigunakan untuk impor barang dari

daerah lain. Setelah diturunkan di
sini, barang-barang dipindahkan ke\lFallshore City di mana kemudian

dapat didistribusikan ke seluruh
Borrius.

entries.original:
"The yellow barricades are moved
routinely throughout the day to\lcorrespond to the arrivals of\ldifferent shipments.

If you want to get to an area
that’s blocked off, you’ll just\lhave to come back later."
entries.translation_source: The yellow barricades are moved routinely throughout the day to correspond to the arrivals of different shipments. If you want to get to an area that’s blocked off, you’ll just have to come back later.
entries.translated:
Barikade kuning dipindahkan secara
rutin sepanjang hari sesuai dengan\lkedatangan berbagai pengiriman.

Jika kamu ingin pergi ke area yang
diblokir, kamu harus kembali nanti.

entries.original:
"Ya know what’s not fair?

That I have to go through a
rigourous screenin’ process just to\lbe let onto the port so I can work\levery day!

If it weren’t for those lunkheads in
Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be\lan issue."
entries.translation_source: Ya know what’s not fair? That I have to go through a rigourous screenin’ process just to be let onto the port so I can work every day! If it weren’t for those lunkheads in Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be an issue.
entries.translated:
Tahu nggak apa yang tidak adil?
Bahwa aku harus melalui proses\lpenyaringan yang ketat hanya untuk

diizinkan masuk ke pelabuhan agar
bisa bekerja setiap hari! Jika\lbukan karena orang-orang bodoh di

Antisis City, ini bahkan tidak akan
menjadi masalah.

entries.original: "Are you a ruffian?"
entries.translation_source: Are you a ruffian?

entries.original:
"Nope.
You don’t fight like one."
entries.translation_source: Nope. You don’t fight like one.

entries.original: "Antisis Sewers"
entries.translation_source: Antisis Sewers

entries.original:
"A sewer system running underneath
both halves of Antisis City.
Certain individuals like to convert
the sewage here into medicine
each day."
entries.translation_source: A sewer system running underneath both halves of Antisis City. Certain individuals like to convert the sewage here into medicine each day.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo\.
Stinky, stinky!

What a stench, what a stench!

Assail my nostrils\.
It is necessary!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo[game-token-1] Stinky, stinky! What a stench, what a stench! Assail my nostrils[game-token-2] It is necessary!
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. Bau, bau! Bau
sekali, bau sekali! Serang lubang\lhidungku\. Itu perlu!

entries.original:
"Boo hoo\.
Stinky, stinky!"
entries.translation_source: Boo hoo[game-token-1] Stinky, stinky!
entries.translated: Boo hoo\. Bau, bau!

entries.original:
"Boo hoo\.
Still stinky, stinky!"
entries.translation_source: Boo hoo[game-token-1] Still stinky, stinky!
entries.translated: Boo hoo\. Masih bau, bau!

entries.original:
"Ahhhhh\.

The foul stench has evaporated\.
You have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ahhhhh[game-token-1] The foul stench has evaporated[game-token-2] You have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ahhhhh\. Bau busuk itu telah menguap\.
Kamu mendapat rasa terima kasihku.

entries.original:
"’Til the sweet smelling aromas
bringeth us together again, I bid\lyou adieu."
entries.translation_source: ’Til the sweet smelling aromas bringeth us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Sampai aroma wangi mempertemukan
kita lagi, aku ucapkan selamat\ltinggal.

entries.original:
"Lots of toxins build up in the
sewer system.

I think I can use them to make
medicines!

So, I’m running an experiment!

If this works, I might be able to
use the venom of Poison-type\lPokémon to make different\lmedicines. How exciting!

Well, well\.

The result of today’s experiment
was\."
entries.translation_source: Lots of toxins build up in the sewer system. I think I can use them to make medicines! So, I’m running an experiment! If this works, I might be able to use the venom of Poison-type Pokémon to make different medicines. How exciting! Well, well[game-token-1] The result of today’s experiment was[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Banyak racun menumpuk di sistem
saluran pembuangan. Saya pikir saya\lbisa menggunakannya untuk membuat

obat-obatan! Jadi, saya sedang
melakukan percobaan! Jika ini\lberhasil, saya mungkin bisa

menggunakan racun Pokémon tipe
Racun untuk membuat berbagai obat.\lMenyenangkan! Nah, nah\. Hasil

percobaan hari ini adalah\.

entries.original:
"Wow! Today’s experiment was super
successful!

Here! Please accept
the [buffer1] I made!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Today’s experiment was super successful! Here! Please accept the [buffer1-1] I made!
entries.translated:
Wow! Percobaan hari ini sangat
sukses! Ini! Silakan terima\l[buffer1] yang saya buat!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep experimenting every day!
It’s important to keep trying.

Come back and see how it’s going!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep experimenting every day! It’s important to keep trying. Come back and see how it’s going!
entries.translated:
Saya akan terus bereksperimen
setiap hari! Penting untuk terus\lmencoba. Kembalilah dan lihat

bagaimana keadaannya!

entries.original:
"Big Mo hired me to clean up
the sewers."
entries.translation_source: Big Mo hired me to clean up the sewers.

entries.original: "I kind of enjoy it, actually."
entries.translation_source: I kind of enjoy it, actually.

entries.original:
"I love cleaning, so it’s like I’m
never working a day in my life!"
entries.translation_source: I love cleaning, so it’s like I’m never working a day in my life!
entries.translated:
Saya suka membersihkan, jadi
sepertinya saya tidak pernah\lbekerja sehari pun dalam hidup

saya!

entries.original:
"[green]Whirlipede[blue] infest the sewers from
time to time.

They like to cause all sorts of
trouble down here."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Whirlipede[color-blue-2] infest the sewers from time to time. They like to cause all sorts of trouble down here.
entries.translated:
[green]Whirlipede[blue] menginfestasi saluran
pembuangan dari waktu ke waktu.\lMereka suka menyebabkan segala

macam masalah di sini.

entries.original:
"You can crawl through a pipe to go
to the sewers underneath the\lsouthern half of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You can crawl through a pipe to go to the sewers underneath the southern half of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa merangkak melalui pipa
untuk pergi ke saluran pembuangan\ldi bawah bagian selatan Antisis

City.

entries.original:
"Since we built this sewer, all
kinds of Pokémon have shown up."
entries.translation_source: Since we built this sewer, all kinds of Pokémon have shown up.
entries.translated:
Sejak kami membangun saluran
pembuangan ini, semua jenis Pokémon\ltelah muncul.

entries.original:
"The Science Society sent me to
the sewers to study the smell here!"
entries.translation_source: The Science Society sent me to the sewers to study the smell here!

entries.original:
"If I were to express my
disappointment with a scent, I’d\lput it on par with a Gloom’s."
entries.translation_source: If I were to express my disappointment with a scent, I’d put it on par with a Gloom’s.

entries.original:
"Even odours that might seem awful to
humans might be perfume to Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Even odours that might seem awful to humans might be perfume to Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Bahkan bau yang mungkin tampak
mengerikan bagi manusia bisa\lmenjadi parfum bagi Pokémon.

entries.original: "What a catastrophic theorem!"
entries.translation_source: What a catastrophic theorem!
entries.translated: Teorema yang sangat buruk!

entries.original: "Auburn Waterway"
entries.translation_source: Auburn Waterway

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!
You found this old clown!

I thought the rain would wash away
my tears forever.

For that, you have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! You found this old clown! I thought the rain would wash away my tears forever. For that, you have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Kamu menemukan
badut tua ini! Kukira hujan akan\lmenghapus air mataku selamanya.

Untuk itu, aku berterima kasih
padamu.

entries.original:
"’Til the rain bringeth us together
again, I bid you adieu."
entries.translation_source: ’Til the rain bringeth us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Sampai hujan menyatukan kita
kembali, aku ucapkan selamat\ltinggal.

entries.original:
"The water in this lake\.

It’s so clear!"
entries.translation_source: The water in this lake[game-token-1] It’s so clear!

entries.original: "As clear as your victory\."
entries.translation_source: As clear as your victory[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"I prefer swimming in a calm lake
much more than in the sea."
entries.translation_source: I prefer swimming in a calm lake much more than in the sea.
entries.translated:
Aku lebih suka berenang di danau
yang tenang daripada di laut.

entries.original:
"Brr\. I’m starting to get chilly.
I could use a win to get warmed up."
entries.translation_source: Brr[game-token-1] I’m starting to get chilly. I could use a win to get warmed up.
entries.translated:
Brr\. Aku mulai kedinginan. Aku butuh
kemenangan untuk menghangatkan\lbadan.

entries.original:
"Hi, wave-riding Trainer!
How about a battle on the lake?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, wave-riding Trainer! How about a battle on the lake?

entries.original: "You sure schooled me there."
entries.translation_source: You sure schooled me there.

entries.original:
"Maybe I should switch to surfing,
too\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should switch to surfing, too[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku juga harus beralih ke
berselancar\.

entries.original:
"There are many watery routes that
you can swim in Borrius.

It puts the Hoenn region to shame!"
entries.translation_source: There are many watery routes that you can swim in Borrius. It puts the Hoenn region to shame!
entries.translated:
Ada banyak rute berair yang bisa
kamu renangi di Borrius. Itu\lmembuat wilayah Hoenn malu!

entries.original:
"Waah! Now! Just now!
I was just about to reel it in!"
entries.translation_source: Waah! Now! Just now! I was just about to reel it in!

entries.original:
"You need to have more respect for a
fisherman\."
entries.translation_source: You need to have more respect for a fisherman[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Go on.

Don’t be shy about talking to
lonely fishermen.

Just don’t you talk to me."
entries.translation_source: Go on. Don’t be shy about talking to lonely fishermen. Just don’t you talk to me.
entries.translated:
Ayolah. Jangan malu berbicara
dengan nelayan yang kesepian. Hanya\lsaja jangan bicara padaku.

entries.original: "Battleground"
entries.translation_source: Battleground
entries.translated: Medan Pertempuran

entries.original:
"Champ in the making!

Or should I say, Champ?

Long time no see!

Guess all my advice really helped
you out, eh?

Welcome to the Battleground!

In this club, you can battle with
the best in Borrius.

So enjoy your time here, especially
because you’re one of them!

Oh, and if you want to take part in
the [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue], come find me."
entries.translation_source: Champ in the making! Or should I say, Champ? Long time no see! Guess all my advice really helped you out, eh? Welcome to the Battleground! In this club, you can battle with the best in Borrius. So enjoy your time here, especially because you’re one of them! Oh, and if you want to take part in the [color-green-1]Leaders Gauntlet[color-blue-2], come find me.
entries.translated:
Juara dalam pembuatan! Atau
sebaiknya kukatakan, Juara? Lama\ltak jumpa! Sepertinya semua saranku

benar-benar membantumu, ya? Selamat
datang di Medan Pertempuran! Di\lklub ini, kamu bisa bertarung

dengan yang terbaik di Borrius.
Jadi nikmati waktumu di sini,\lterutama karena kamu adalah salah

satu dari mereka! Oh, dan jika kamu
ingin berpartisipasi dalam [green]Leaders\lGauntlet[blue], datang dan temui aku.

entries.original:
"[black]Stand and face [buffer1] on the other
side of the field to begin battling."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Stand and face [buffer1-2] on the other side of the field to begin battling.
entries.translated:
[black]Berdiri dan hadapi [buffer1] di sisi
lain lapangan untuk memulai\lpertarungan.

entries.original: "Are you ready to begin the battle?"
entries.translation_source: Are you ready to begin the battle?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu siap untuk memulai
pertarungan?

entries.original:
"Hey, Champ!

Interested in taking part in the
[green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Champ! Interested in taking part in the [color-green-1]Leaders Gauntlet[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Hei, Juara! Tertarik untuk
berpartisipasi dalam [green]Leaders\lGauntlet[blue]?

entries.original:
"Hey, Champ!

If you’re interested in taking part in
the [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue], get rid of\lthat guy following you first!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Champ! If you’re interested in taking part in the [color-green-1]Leaders Gauntlet[color-blue-2], get rid of that guy following you first!
entries.translated:
Hei, Juara! Jika kamu tertarik
untuk berpartisipasi dalam [green]Leaders\lGauntlet[blue], singkirkan dulu orang

yang mengikutimu itu!

entries.original:
"Interested in taking part in the
[green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Interested in taking part in the [color-green-1]Leaders Gauntlet[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Tertarik untuk berpartisipasi dalam
[green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue]?

entries.original:
"You need at least [green]2 Pokémon[blue] if you
want to take part in this gauntlet."
entries.translation_source: You need at least [color-green-1]2 Pokémon[color-blue-2] if you want to take part in this gauntlet.
entries.translated:
Kamu membutuhkan setidaknya [green]2
Pokémon[blue] jika ingin berpartisipasi\ldalam gauntlet ini.

entries.original:
"Sorry, Champ, but the [green]Insane[blue] Classic
Leaders Gauntlet is still locked.

You’ll need to clear the [green]Expert[blue]
Classic Leaders Gauntlet first.

Just open up the [green]Options Menu[blue] and
lower your [green]Battle Difficulty[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, Champ, but the [color-green-1]Insane[color-blue-2] Classic Leaders Gauntlet is still locked. You’ll need to clear the [color-green-3]Expert[color-blue-4] Classic Leaders Gauntlet first. Just open up the [color-green-5]Options Menu[color-blue-6] and lower your [color-green-7]Battle Difficulty[color-blue-8].
entries.translated:
Maaf, Juara, tetapi [green]Insane[blue] Classic
Leaders Gauntlet masih terkunci.\lKamu harus menyelesaikan [green]Expert[blue]

Classic Leaders Gauntlet terlebih
dahulu. Buka saja [green]Menu Opsi[blue] dan\lturunkan [green]Kesulitan Pertempuran[blue] mu.

entries.original:
"No prob, Champ.

If you ever want to take part,
just let me know."
entries.translation_source: No prob, Champ. If you ever want to take part, just let me know.
entries.translated:
Tidak masalah, Juara. Jika kamu
ingin berpartisipasi, beri tahu\laku.

entries.original:
"Which Leaders Gauntlet should
I explain?"
entries.translation_source: Which Leaders Gauntlet should I explain?
entries.translated:
Leaders Gauntlet mana yang harus
aku jelaskan?

entries.original:
"In the [green]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[blue],
you’ll be pitted against each Gym\lLeader, one after the other.

But despite the fights being back
to back, you will get a chance to\lsave and adjust your team in\lbetween each fight.

As for the Gym Leaders’ teams,
they’ll be using much stronger\lPokémon than when you fought\lthem in their Gyms.

They’ll also be fighting with the
same battle effects as back then,\lso keep that in mind.

If you manage to defeat a Gym
Leader, and you’ve already\lreceived a Z-Crystal from them,\lthey’ll give you their daily Gem\lafter the battle, assuming they\lhaven’t already given you one.

If you manage to defeat
all of them, you’ll win fantastic\lprizes!

And of course, the harder your
[green]Battle Difficulty[blue], the better the\lprizes you can win."
entries.translation_source: In the [color-green-1]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[color-blue-2], you’ll be pitted against each Gym Leader, one after the other. But despite the fights being back to back, you will get a chance to save and adjust your team in between each fight. As for the Gym Leaders’ teams, they’ll be using much stronger Pokémon than when you fought them in their Gyms. They’ll also be fighting with the same battle effects as back then, so keep that in mind. If you manage to defeat a Gym Leader, and you’ve already received a Z-Crystal from them, they’ll give you their daily Gem after the battle, assuming they haven’t already given you one. If you manage to defeat all of them, you’ll win fantastic prizes! And of course, the harder your [color-green-3]Battle Difficulty[color-blue-4], the better the prizes you can win.
entries.translated:
Di [green]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[blue], Anda
akan diadu melawan setiap Pemimpin\lGym, satu per satu. Meskipun

pertarungan berlangsung
berturut-turut, Anda akan mendapat\lkesempatan untuk menyimpan dan

menyesuaikan tim Anda di antara
setiap pertarungan. Sedangkan untuk\ltim para Pemimpin Gym, mereka akan

menggunakan Pokémon yang jauh lebih
kuat daripada saat Anda melawan\lmereka di Gym mereka. Mereka juga

akan bertarung dengan efek
pertarungan yang sama seperti saat\litu, jadi ingatlah itu. Jika Anda

berhasil mengalahkan seorang
Pemimpin Gym, dan Anda sudah\lmenerima Z-Crystal dari mereka,

mereka akan memberikan Permata
harian mereka setelah pertarungan,\ldengan asumsi mereka belum

memberikannya kepada Anda. Jika
Anda berhasil mengalahkan semuanya,\lAnda akan memenangkan hadiah

fantastis! Dan tentu saja, semakin
sulit [green]Kesulitan Pertarungan[blue] Anda,\lsemakin baik hadiah yang bisa Anda

menangkan.

entries.original:
"In the [green]Frontier Leaders Gauntlet[blue],
you’ll be pitted against each Gym\lLeader, one after the other.

Each battle is fought like a 6v6
battle in the Battle Frontier.

Your Pokémon will automatically be
set to \Lv 100 for the fights, and\lyour team cannot be adjusted in\lbetween each fight.

However, you will see a preview of
your opponents’ teams before each\lbattle, and you will be allowed to\lchoose your leads.

If you can clear the gauntlet
without taking a break, you will\learn a generous amount of BP.

This gauntlet is unaffected by your
chosen [green]Battle Difficulty[blue]."
entries.translation_source: In the [color-green-1]Frontier Leaders Gauntlet[color-blue-2], you’ll be pitted against each Gym Leader, one after the other. Each battle is fought like a 6v6 battle in the Battle Frontier. Your Pokémon will automatically be set to [game-token-3] 100 for the fights, and your team cannot be adjusted in between each fight. However, you will see a preview of your opponents’ teams before each battle, and you will be allowed to choose your leads. If you can clear the gauntlet without taking a break, you will earn a generous amount of BP. This gauntlet is unaffected by your chosen [color-green-4]Battle Difficulty[color-blue-5].
entries.translated:
Di [green]Frontier Leaders Gauntlet[blue], Anda

pertarungan 6v6 di Battle Frontier.\lPokémon Anda akan secara otomatis

pertarungan. Namun, Anda akan

Pokémon pertama Anda. Jika Anda\ldapat menyelesaikan gauntlet tanpa

istirahat, Anda akan mendapatkan
sejumlah besar BP. Gauntlet ini\ltidak terpengaruh oleh [green]Kesulitan

Pertarungan[blue] yang Anda pilih.

"Ah, [player].

Champion of the Borrius Region,\lyes?

Leader, and as an agent, require\lme to often\.\CC0818 conceal my true\lstrength.

If you are willing, perhaps you
would care to test yourself\lagainst me?

I’m aware, of course, that you may
still hold some grudges for my\lactions back at Cinder Volcano.

If nothing else, think of it as an
opportunity to\.\CC0818 relieve some pent-\lup frustrations."

kembali. Jika kau bersedia, mungkin

tindakanku di Gunung Cinder. Jika\ltidak ada yang lain, anggap saja

sekali lagi memenuhi ekspektasiku.

entries.original:
"I remember I once remarked on how
you would make a good agent.

Now, however, I believe this
occupation suits you best.

A life of secrecy is for those with
secrets to hide\. that cannot ever\lsee the light\.

And I\.\CC0818 no, forget it.

It is not for a public hero such as
yourself to know."
entries.translation_source: I remember I once remarked on how you would make a good agent. Now, however, I believe this occupation suits you best. A life of secrecy is for those with secrets to hide[game-token-1] that cannot ever see the light[game-token-2] And I[game-token-3][control-code-4] no, forget it. It is not for a public hero such as yourself to know.
entries.translated:
Aku ingat aku pernah berkata bahwa
kau akan menjadi agen yang baik.\lNamun sekarang, aku yakin pekerjaan

ini paling cocok untukmu. Kehidupan
penuh kerahasiaan adalah untuk\lmereka yang memiliki rahasia untuk

disembunyikan\. yang tidak boleh
pernah terlihat\. Dan aku\.\CC0818 tidak,\llupakan. Bukan untuk pahlawan

publik sepertimu untuk tahu.

entries.original:
"[player]! Quite the chance meeting
we’ve got here!

Look at you!
You’re the new Champion of Borrius!

You’ve soared to heights not even
I dared to reach!

And it got me wondering\. what sort
of winds blew your way, to let you\lreach the apex?

Well, I just got me the dandiest
idea.

I’m looking for another battle.

I want to see which winds you rode
to glory.

Was it truly fortuitous\. or are
your skills good enough to sway\lchance itself?

How about it? Are you game for
another battle?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Quite the chance meeting we’ve got here! Look at you! You’re the new Champion of Borrius! You’ve soared to heights not even I dared to reach! And it got me wondering[game-token-2] what sort of winds blew your way, to let you reach the apex? Well, I just got me the dandiest idea. I’m looking for another battle. I want to see which winds you rode to glory. Was it truly fortuitous[game-token-3] or are your skills good enough to sway chance itself? How about it? Are you game for another battle?
entries.translated:
[player]! Sungguh pertemuan
kebetulan yang kita dapatkan ini!\lLihat dirimu! Kau Juara baru

Borrius! Kau terbang ke ketinggian
yang bahkan aku tidak berani capai!\lDan itu membuatku bertanya-tanya\.

angin apa yang bertiup ke arahmu,
sehingga membuatmu mencapai puncak?\lYah, aku baru mendapat ide yang

sangat bagus. Aku ingin bertarung
lagi. Aku ingin melihat angin mana\lyang kau tunggangi menuju kejayaan.

Apakah itu benar-benar kebetulan\.
atau keterampilanmu cukup baik\luntuk mempengaruhi keberuntungan

itu sendiri? Bagaimana? Kau
tertarik untuk bertarung lagi?

entries.original:
"Oh, I see\. well, I don’t leave
until tomorrow.

If you change your mind, I’m here."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I see[game-token-1] well, I don’t leave until tomorrow. If you change your mind, I’m here.
entries.translated:
Oh, begitu\. yah, aku tidak pergi
sampai besok. Jika kau berubah\lpikiran, aku di sini.

entries.original:
"Fantastic!
I’ll wait up at the battle area!

Don’t take too long, now."
entries.translation_source: Fantastic! I’ll wait up at the battle area! Don’t take too long, now.
entries.translated:
Fantastis! Aku akan menunggu di
area pertarungan! Jangan terlalu\llama, ya.

entries.original:
"[red]While my Pokémon’s wings still beat
strong, we’ll never surrender!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]While my Pokémon’s wings still beat strong, we’ll never surrender!
entries.translated:
[red]Selama sayap Pokémonku masih
mengepak kuat, kami tidak akan\lpernah menyerah!

entries.original:
"[red]Hah\. so that’s how it panned out in
the end?

That was inspiring. Truly.

I suppose whether it was chance
or skill\. it hardly matters.

I was moved, all the same.

You can have this.

Perhaps this Z-Crystal can turn the
next battle on its ear\. just like\lthat."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Hah[game-token-2] so that’s how it panned out in the end? That was inspiring. Truly. I suppose whether it was chance or skill[game-token-3] it hardly matters. I was moved, all the same. You can have this. Perhaps this Z-Crystal can turn the next battle on its ear[game-token-4] just like that.
entries.translated:
[red]Hah\. Jadi seperti itulah hasil
akhirnya? Sungguh menginspirasi.\lBenar-benar. Kurasa apakah itu

kebetulan atau keterampilan\. tidak
penting. Aku tetap terharu. Kau\lboleh ambil ini. Mungkin Z-Crystal

ini bisa mengubah pertempuran
selanjutnya secara drastis\. begitu\lsaja.

entries.original:
"[red]The [green]Flyinium Z[red] changes a [green]Flying[red]-type
attack into a powerful [green]Z-Move[red].

Z-Moves can only be used once per
battle, however.

Keep that in mind.

The steeper the climb, the more
painful the crash\.

As I’m sure any Pokémon will know
after a good [green]Supersonic Skystrike[red]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]The [color-green-2]Flyinium Z[color-red-3] changes a [color-green-4]Flying[color-red-5]-type attack into a powerful [color-green-6]Z-Move[color-red-7]. Z-Moves can only be used once per battle, however. Keep that in mind. The steeper the climb, the more painful the crash[game-token-8] As I’m sure any Pokémon will know after a good [color-green-9]Supersonic Skystrike[color-red-10]!
entries.translated:
[red] [green]Flyinium Z[red] mengubah serangan tipe
[green]Terbang[red] menjadi [green]Z-Move[red] yang kuat.\lNamun, Z-Move hanya bisa digunakan

sekali per pertempuran. Ingat itu.
Semakin curam pendakian, semakin\lmenyakitkan kejatuhannya\. Seperti

yang pasti diketahui Pokémon mana
pun setelah [green]Supersonic Skystrike[red]\lyang hebat!

entries.original:
"[player]!
So you’re here today, too\.

I got the urge to battle again, so
I’m back for another shot!

I don’t care how often it takes,
how many times I must fall\.

I just need to seize one single
moment.

You agree, don’t you?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! So you’re here today, too[game-token-2] I got the urge to battle again, so I’m back for another shot! I don’t care how often it takes, how many times I must fall[game-token-3] I just need to seize one single moment. You agree, don’t you?
entries.translated:
[player]! Jadi kau di sini hari ini
juga\. Aku ingin bertarung lagi, jadi\laku kembali untuk mencoba lagi! Aku

tidak peduli berapa kali pun,
berapa kali aku harus jatuh\. Aku\lhanya perlu merebut satu momen

saja. Kau setuju, kan?

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, fiddlesticks.

I don’t think this losing streak can
be chalked up to coincidence\lanymore\. here.

I have something that might just
come in handy for your next battle."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh, fiddlesticks. I don’t think this losing streak can be chalked up to coincidence anymore[game-token-2] here. I have something that might just come in handy for your next battle.
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, sial. Kurasa kekalahan beruntun
ini tidak bisa lagi dianggap\lkebetulan\. ini. Aku punya sesuatu

yang mungkin berguna untuk
pertempuranmu selanjutnya.

entries.original:
"Truthfully?

I don’t have patience for people
who bleat on about \qodestiny\qc or\lnonsense like that.

What people call destiny, I call
\qocalculated chance.\qc

Even if it is 99% certain I’ll lose\.

If my life were on the line, I
would gamble on that 1%.

You understand, right?"
entries.translation_source: Truthfully? I don’t have patience for people who bleat on about [quote-open-1]destiny[quote-close-2] or nonsense like that. What people call destiny, I call [quote-open-3]calculated chance.[quote-close-4] Even if it is 99% certain I’ll lose[game-token-5] If my life were on the line, I would gamble on that 1%. You understand, right?
entries.translated:
Sejujurnya? Aku tidak punya
kesabaran untuk orang-orang yang\lterus bicara tentang \qotakdir\qc atau

omong kosong seperti itu. Apa yang
disebut orang takdir, aku sebut\l\qokesempatan yang diperhitungkan.\qc

Bahkan jika 99% pasti aku akan
kalah\. Jika hidupku dipertaruhkan,\laku akan bertaruh pada 1% itu. Kau

mengerti, kan?

entries.original:
"Well, lookie here\.

If it ain’t [player].

I guess all that ruckus after
Thundercap Mt. worked out, right?

Since then\. there’s been somethin’
different about yer look.

Nah, ya didn’t get as handsome
as me\.

No-one’s more of a looker than
ol’ Mel.

I mean yer more relaxed.

I remember at my Gym, y’all were
wound up tight as a lasso.

Actually\. now that we’re here\.
how’d ya like a rematch with this\lhandsome fella?

I wanna see how ya really battle -
no distractions to hold ya back.

What do ya say?
To another rodeo?"
entries.translation_source: Well, lookie here[game-token-1] If it ain’t [player-name-2]. I guess all that ruckus after Thundercap Mt. worked out, right? Since then[game-token-3] there’s been somethin’ different about yer look. Nah, ya didn’t get as handsome as me[game-token-4] No-one’s more of a looker than ol’ Mel. I mean yer more relaxed. I remember at my Gym, y’all were wound up tight as a lasso. Actually[game-token-5] now that we’re here[game-token-6] how’d ya like a rematch with this handsome fella? I wanna see how ya really battle - no distractions to hold ya back. What do ya say? To another rodeo?
entries.translated:
Nah, lihat nih\. Kalau bukan
[player]. Kurasa semua keributan\lsetelah Thundercap Mt. beres, kan?

Sejak itu\. ada sesuatu yang berbeda
dari penampilanmu. Nah, kau tidak\lsetampan aku\. Tidak ada yang lebih

tampan dari Mel tua. Maksudku kau
lebih santai. Aku ingat di Gym-ku,\lkalian tegang seperti lasso.

Sebenarnya\. sekarang kita di sini\.
bagaimana kalau pertandingan ulang\ldengan pria tampan ini? Aku ingin

melihat bagaimana kau bertarung
sungguhan - tanpa gangguan yang\lmenahanmu. Bagaimana? Rodeo lagi?

entries.original:
"Aw\. well, I ain’t goin’ anywhere
’til tomorrow.

If y’all change yer mind\. I’ll be
right here."
entries.translation_source: Aw[game-token-1] well, I ain’t goin’ anywhere ’til tomorrow. If y’all change yer mind[game-token-2] I’ll be right here.
entries.translated:
Ah\. yah, aku tidak pergi ke mana pun
sampai besok. Jika kalian berubah\lpikiran\. aku akan di sini.

entries.original:
"That’s the spirit. I’ll just mosey
along to the battle area, shall I?"
entries.translation_source: That’s the spirit. I’ll just mosey along to the battle area, shall I?
entries.translated:
Itu semangat. Aku akan berjalan ke
area pertarungan, ya?

entries.original:
"[blue]Brace yerself, partner! Yer getting
the full body experience!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Brace yerself, partner! Yer getting the full body experience!
entries.translated:
[blue]Bersiaplah, partner! Kau akan
merasakan pengalaman penuh!

entries.original:
"[blue]So\.\CC0818 that’s the new Champion of
Borrius, huh\.?

Well, ain’t that really somethin’\.

That’s a way different battle ya
showed me.

It felt more natural, focused - no
wasted movements at all.

Alright!

Someone who can battle like that
just has to have this Z-Crystal!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]So[game-token-2][control-code-3] that’s the new Champion of Borrius, huh[game-token-4]? Well, ain’t that really somethin’[game-token-5] That’s a way different battle ya showed me. It felt more natural, focused - no wasted movements at all. Alright! Someone who can battle like that just has to have this Z-Crystal!
entries.translated:
[blue]Jadi\.\CC0818 itu Juara baru Borrius, ya\.?
Wah, itu sungguh sesuatu\.\lPertarungan yang kau tunjukkan

sangat berbeda. Terasa lebih alami,
fokus - tidak ada gerakan yang\lsia-sia. Baiklah! Seseorang yang

bisa bertarung seperti itu pasti
pantas mendapatkan Z-Crystal ini!

entries.original:
"[green]Normalium Z[blue]\. it’s basic, but [green]Normal[blue]-
type attacks transform into [green]Z-Moves[blue]\lwhen activated.

Only good once per battle, though -
any more and ya’d wear yerself out.

Usually, nothin’ takes extra damage
from Normal-type attacks, so that’s\lwhy Inverse Battles are more\lmy thing.

[green]Breakneck Blitz[blue]\.

It gets overlooked over other Z
Moves, but I’m sure some use’ll\lcome of it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Normalium Z[color-blue-2][game-token-3] it’s basic, but [color-green-4]Normal[color-blue-5]- type attacks transform into [color-green-6]Z-Moves[color-blue-7] when activated. Only good once per battle, though - any more and ya’d wear yerself out. Usually, nothin’ takes extra damage from Normal-type attacks, so that’s why Inverse Battles are more my thing. [color-green-8]Breakneck Blitz[color-blue-9][game-token-10] It gets overlooked over other Z Moves, but I’m sure some use’ll come of it!
entries.translated:
[green]Normalium Z[blue]\. itu dasar, tapi
serangan tipe [green]Normal[blue] berubah\lmenjadi [green]Z-Move[blue] saat diaktifkan.

Hanya bagus sekali per pertempuran
- lebih dari itu kau akan\lkelelahan. Biasanya, tidak ada yang

menerima damage tambahan dari
serangan tipe Normal, jadi itu\lsebabnya Inverse Battle lebih cocok

untukku. [green]Breakneck Blitz[blue]\. Gerakan
ini sering diabaikan dibandingkan\lZ-Move lain, tapi aku yakin pasti

berguna!

entries.original:
"Howdy, [player].
Back again?

Thought if I hung around long
enough, y’all would show up!

Listen\. I got itchin’\. for another
battle.

Though I’d do ya a favour.

After all, surely ya can’t keep
yerself away from ol’ Mel for too\llong, right?"
entries.translation_source: Howdy, [player-name-1]. Back again? Thought if I hung around long enough, y’all would show up! Listen[game-token-2] I got itchin’[game-token-3] for another battle. Though I’d do ya a favour. After all, surely ya can’t keep yerself away from ol’ Mel for too long, right?
entries.translated:
Halo, [player]. Kembali lagi?
Kupikir jika aku bertahan cukup\llama, kalian pasti akan muncul!

Dengar\. Aku gatal\. untuk bertarung
lagi. Meskipun aku akan memberimu\lbantuan. Lagipula, pasti kau tidak

bisa menjauh dari Mel tua terlalu
lama, kan?

entries.original:
"[blue]Not bad, partner.

Sometimes ya grabbed that Tauros
by the horns\. other times, ya let\lit go where it will.

It was a fun battle.

Here, a little present from me."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Not bad, partner. Sometimes ya grabbed that Tauros by the horns[game-token-2] other times, ya let it go where it will. It was a fun battle. Here, a little present from me.
entries.translated:
[blue]Tidak buruk, partner. Kadang kau
menggenggam Tauros itu dari\ltanduknya\. di lain waktu, kau

biarkan dia pergi ke mana pun dia
mau. Itu pertarungan yang\lmenyenangkan. Ini, hadiah kecil

dariku.

entries.original:
"Recently, I got myself thinkin’
about what I’d do if I hung up mah\lhat, an’ quit the whole Gym Leader\lschding.

Not like I’m keepin’ these good
looks forever, ya know what I’m\lsayin’?

Kind of a soberin’ thought, but I
once dated a gal\. who said I can’t\lhold onto everthin’.

So\. I’ll age gracefully with time,
and not a moment sooner, understand?"
entries.translation_source: Recently, I got myself thinkin’ about what I’d do if I hung up mah hat, an’ quit the whole Gym Leader schding. Not like I’m keepin’ these good looks forever, ya know what I’m sayin’? Kind of a soberin’ thought, but I once dated a gal[game-token-1] who said I can’t hold onto everthin’. So[game-token-2] I’ll age gracefully with time, and not a moment sooner, understand?
entries.translated:
Akhir-akhir ini, aku berpikir
tentang apa yang akan kulakukan\ljika aku gantung topi, dan berhenti

sebagai Pemimpin Gym. Bukannya aku
akan mempertahankan ketampanan ini\lselamanya, kau tahu maksudku?

Pemikiran yang menyadarkan, tapi
aku pernah berpacaran dengan\lseorang wanita\. yang bilang aku

tidak bisa mempertahankan
segalanya. Jadi\. aku akan menua\ldengan anggun seiring waktu, dan

tidak lebih cepat, mengerti?

entries.original:
"Yo, wazzap, fella?

Howzit goin’?

Ha ha ha ha!
I’m back, baby!

Galavan’s in the house, louder and
brighter than ever!

I’ve been temperin’ my Pokémon’s
iron bodies, all for another match\lwith ya!

And now, you’re lookin’ at the
latest, greatest, most up-to-date\ledition of Galavan!

So ya know what I’m gonna ask
next, right? Course ya do!

Battle me! Let me show off my latest
pride and joy right here!

In return, I can get to see how ya
improved on your own techs and\ltricks.

Two fellow tech-heads, striving to
improve.

C’mon, whaddya say?"

I’ve been temperin’ my Pokémon’s iron bodies, all for another match with ya! And now, you’re lookin’ at the latest, greatest, most up-to-date edition of Galavan! So ya know what I’m gonna ask next, right? Course ya do! Battle me! Let me show off my latest pride and joy right here! In return, I can get to see how ya improved on your own techs and tricks. Two fellow tech-heads, striving to improve. C’mon, whaddya say?
entries.translated:
Yo, apa kabar, kawan? Gimana
kabarnya? Ha ha ha ha! Aku kembali,\lsayang! Galavan ada di sini, lebih

keras dan lebih terang dari
sebelumnya! Aku sudah menempa tubuh\lbaja Pokémonku, semuanya untuk

pertandingan lain denganmu! Dan
sekarang, kau melihat edisi\lterbaru, terhebat, paling mutakhir

dari Galavan! Jadi kau tahu apa
yang akan kutanyakan selanjutnya,\lkan? Tentu saja! Bertarunglah

denganku! Biarkan aku memamerkan
kebanggaan dan kegembiraan\lterbaruku di sini! Sebagai

imbalannya, aku bisa melihat
bagaimana kau meningkatkan teknik\ldan trikmu sendiri. Dua sesama

penggemar teknologi, berusaha untuk
maju. Ayo, bagaimana?

entries.original:
"Whaaaaa?

C’mon, don’t leave ol’ Galavan
hanging here - ya gotta say yes!"
entries.translation_source: Whaaaaa? C’mon, don’t leave ol’ Galavan hanging here - ya gotta say yes!
entries.translated:
Whaaaaa? Ayolah, jangan biarkan
Galavan tua menggantung di sini -\lkau harus bilang ya!

entries.original:
"Ah, what a champ ya are!

And for such a champ, let’s do our
battle as a [green]Double Battle[blue]!

Awright, race ya to the battle area!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, what a champ ya are! And for such a champ, let’s do our battle as a [color-green-1]Double Battle[color-blue-2]! Awright, race ya to the battle area!
entries.translated:
Ah, kau benar-benar juara! Dan
untuk juara seperti itu, mari kita\llakukan pertarungan sebagai [green]Double

Battle[blue]! Baiklah, adu cepat ke area
pertarungan!

entries.original:
"[blue]My machines of war are geared up
and ready to roll! Woooooar!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]My machines of war are geared up and ready to roll! Woooooar!
entries.translated:
[blue]Mesin perangku sudah siap dan siap
beraksi! Woooooar!

entries.original:
"[blue]Gaaaah!

How do ya keep doin’ that?
Seriously?

Guess it’s back to the drawing
board for ol’ Galavan, and so soon\lafter, too\.

Actually, why don’t ya improve
your own battling on the side?

I got two of these Z-Crystals
here\. ah, I’m such a swell guy,\lI’ll let ya have both!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Gaaaah! How do ya keep doin’ that? Seriously? Guess it’s back to the drawing board for ol’ Galavan, and so soon after, too[game-token-2] Actually, why don’t ya improve your own battling on the side? I got two of these Z-Crystals here[game-token-3] ah, I’m such a swell guy, I’ll let ya have both!
entries.translated:
[blue]Gaaaah! Bagaimana kau terus
melakukannya? Serius? Sepertinya\lGalavan tua harus kembali ke papan

gambar, dan begitu cepat pula\.
Sebenarnya, kenapa kau tidak\lmeningkatkan pertarunganmu di

samping? Aku punya dua Z-Crystal di
sini\. ah, aku orang yang baik, aku\lakan berikan keduanya!

entries.original:
"[green]Steelium Z[blue], [green]Electrium Z[blue]\. those two
crystals supercharge [green]Steel[blue]- and\l[green]Electric[blue]-type attacks.

Shame ya can’t use both in the
same battle, but I guess life ain’t\lfair sometimes.

Honestly, I can’t really decide
which one’s better for shaking up\lthe battlefield myself.

Grind ’em into the floor with
[green]Corkscrew Crash[blue]\.

Or leave ’em twitchin’ on the floor
with a good ol’ [green]Gigavolt Havoc[blue]?

They’re both great!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Steelium Z[color-blue-2], [color-green-3]Electrium Z[color-blue-4][game-token-5] those two crystals supercharge [color-green-6]Steel[color-blue-7]- and [color-green-8]Electric[color-blue-9]-type attacks. Shame ya can’t use both in the same battle, but I guess life ain’t fair sometimes. Honestly, I can’t really decide which one’s better for shaking up the battlefield myself. Grind ’em into the floor with [color-green-10]Corkscrew Crash[color-blue-11][game-token-12] Or leave ’em twitchin’ on the floor with a good ol’ [color-green-13]Gigavolt Havoc[color-blue-14]? They’re both great!
entries.translated:
[green]Steelium Z[blue], [green]Electrium Z[blue]\. kedua
kristal itu memperkuat serangan\ltipe [green]Steel[blue]- dan [green]Electric[blue]. Sayangnya

kamu tidak bisa menggunakan
keduanya dalam pertempuran yang\lsama, tapi kurasa hidup tidak

selalu adil. Sejujurnya, aku
sendiri tidak bisa memutuskan mana\lyang lebih baik untuk menggebrak

medan pertempuran. Hancurkan mereka
ke lantai dengan [green]Corkscrew Crash[blue]\.\lAtau biarkan mereka kejang-kejang

di lantai dengan [green]Gigavolt Havoc[blue]?
Keduanya hebat!

entries.original:
"[player]! You’re back!
Great timing!

There’s still a few bugs in my own
battling, I think, but there’s only\lone way to know!

And that’s with a good old-
fashioned field test!

I’ll help ya iron out your own
team, too!

Let’s help us help each other
here!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You’re back! Great timing! There’s still a few bugs in my own battling, I think, but there’s only one way to know! And that’s with a good old- fashioned field test! I’ll help ya iron out your own team, too! Let’s help us help each other here!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu kembali! Waktu yang
tepat! Masih ada beberapa\lkekurangan dalam pertarunganku

sendiri, kupikir, tapi hanya ada
satu cara untuk tahu! Yaitu dengan\luji lapangan yang klasik! Aku juga

akan membantumu merapikan timmu!
Mari kita saling membantu di sini!

entries.original:
"[blue]Gaaaah! Broken down again!

We gotta do this again sometime!

Here, consider this a promise from
me, because ol’ Galavan ain’t done\lwith ya yet!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Gaaaah! Broken down again! We gotta do this again sometime! Here, consider this a promise from me, because ol’ Galavan ain’t done with ya yet!
entries.translated:
[blue]Gaaaah! Rusak lagi! Kita harus
melakukannya lagi lain kali! Ini,\langgap saja ini janji dariku,

karena Galavan tua belum selesai
denganmu!

entries.original:
"There’s a stereotype among Electric-
type Trainers\.

Apparently, ya gotta be good with
machines to even train ’em properly.

I mean, ol’ Galavan doesn’t believe
in labels, but I see their point.

Have you SEEN the damage they can
do to our tech?

We’d go broke if we couldn’t fix what
they break ourselves!

Ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: There’s a stereotype among Electric- type Trainers[game-token-1] Apparently, ya gotta be good with machines to even train ’em properly. I mean, ol’ Galavan doesn’t believe in labels, but I see their point. Have you SEEN the damage they can do to our tech? We’d go broke if we couldn’t fix what they break ourselves! Ha ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Ada stereotip di kalangan Pelatih
tipe Listrik\. Rupanya, kamu harus\lmahir dengan mesin untuk bisa

melatih mereka dengan benar.
Maksudku, Galavan tua tidak percaya\lpada label, tapi aku mengerti

maksud mereka. Pernahkah kamu
MELIHAT kerusakan yang bisa mereka\llakukan pada teknologi kita? Kita

akan bangkrut jika kita tidak bisa
memperbaiki apa yang mereka rusak\lsendiri! Ha ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha ha!
Look who decided to show up!

If it isn’t our latest Champion,
[player]!

Hah! If you’re here, then I guess
you’ve staked a claim on this turf\lalready, huh?

Last time I lost, I knew I had to
get out and\. let’s say, assert\lmyself elsewhere, you get me?

But I guess I gotta keep lookin’
for Big Mo’s new base, huh?

Unless\. you wanna try taking on the
kingpin, right here, right now?

For real this time. The joint

I warn ya, I’m not the same as
before!

Well? What’s it gonna be, squirt?
Or are you quaking in yer boots\lalready?"
