If you’re here, then I guess you’ve staked a claim on this turf already, huh? Last time I lost, I knew I had to get out and[game-token-2] let’s say, assert myself elsewhere, you get me? But I guess I gotta keep lookin’ for Big Mo’s new base, huh? Unless[game-token-3] you wanna try taking on the kingpin, right here, right now? For real this time. The joint belongs to whoever wins. I warn ya, I’m not the same as before! Well? What’s it gonna be, squirt? Or are you quaking in yer boots already?
entries.translated:
Ha ha ha ha! Lihat siapa yang
datang! Bukankah ini Juara terbaru\lkita, [player]! Hah! Jika kau di

sini, sepertinya kau sudah
mengklaim wilayah ini, ya? Terakhir\lkali aku kalah, aku tahu aku harus

pergi dan\. katakanlah, menegaskan
diriku di tempat lain, mengerti?\lTapi sepertinya aku harus terus

mencari markas baru Big Mo, ya?
Kecuali\. kau ingin mencoba\lmenghadapi bosnya, di sini,

sekarang? Untuk sungguhan kali ini.
Tempat ini milik siapa pun yang\lmenang. Aku peringatkan, aku tidak

sama seperti sebelumnya! Nah? Mau
bagaimana, bocah? Atau kau sudah\lgemetar ketakutan?

entries.original:
"Grr\. you lookin’ down on me, ya
snot-nosed punk?

Well, I’m stayin’ here until ya
chase me out, got it?

\.or until the next day.
I got places to be."
entries.translation_source: Grr[game-token-1] you lookin’ down on me, ya snot-nosed punk? Well, I’m stayin’ here until ya chase me out, got it? [game-token-2]or until the next day. I got places to be.
entries.translated:
Grr\. kau meremehkanku, ya bocah
ingusan? Baiklah, aku akan tetap di\lsini sampai kau mengusirku, paham?

\.atau sampai hari berikutnya. Aku
punya urusan.

entries.original:
"Heh\. sucker.

Alright, let’s take this to the
battle area already."
entries.translation_source: Heh[game-token-1] sucker. Alright, let’s take this to the battle area already.
entries.translated:
Heh\. bodoh. Baiklah, ayo kita bawa
ini ke area pertempuran sekarang.

entries.original:
"[blue]You’re trapped in this cage with me,
and there’s nowhere to run, punk!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You’re trapped in this cage with me, and there’s nowhere to run, punk!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu terjebak di dalam kandang ini
bersamaku, dan tidak ada tempat\luntuk lari, anak nakal!

entries.original:
"[blue]Ha! So even the kingpin can’t do a
thing against the Champion, huh?

But don’t think that’s gonna keep
Big Mo down forever!

I just need to see more of
whatever the world outside Antisis\lhas to offer!

Here. Use this Z-Crystal.

That should keep you winning\. until
I take ya down myself!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ha! So even the kingpin can’t do a thing against the Champion, huh? But don’t think that’s gonna keep Big Mo down forever! I just need to see more of whatever the world outside Antisis has to offer! Here. Use this Z-Crystal. That should keep you winning[game-token-2] until I take ya down myself!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ha! Jadi bahkan raja kriminal pun
tidak bisa berbuat apa-apa melawan\lJuara, ya? Tapi jangan kira itu

akan membuat Big Mo tetap terpuruk
selamanya! Aku hanya perlu melihat\llebih banyak apa yang dunia di luar

Antisis tawarkan! Ini. Gunakan
Z-Crystal ini. Itu akan membuatmu\lterus menang\. sampai aku sendiri

yang mengalahkanmu!

entries.original:
"[blue]That’s the [green]Fightinium Z[blue]!

[green]Fighting[blue]-type attacks get all
souped up with that thing!

But, they’re pretty exhausting.

I’m Big Mo, and even I can only do
it once a battle!

But for the one moment I tap into
that Z-Crystal\.

Any poor sucker in the way gets an
[green]All-Out Pummeling[blue]!

No-holds barred!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]That’s the [color-green-2]Fightinium Z[color-blue-3]! [color-green-4]Fighting[color-blue-5]-type attacks get all souped up with that thing! But, they’re pretty exhausting. I’m Big Mo, and even I can only do it once a battle! But for the one moment I tap into that Z-Crystal[game-token-6] Any poor sucker in the way gets an [color-green-7]All-Out Pummeling[color-blue-8]! No-holds barred!
entries.translated:
[blue]Itu [green]Fightinium Z[blue]! [green]Serangan tipe
Fighting[blue] jadi sangat kuat dengan\lbenda itu! Tapi, cukup melelahkan.

Aku Big Mo, dan bahkan aku hanya
bisa melakukannya sekali dalam\lpertempuran! Tapi untuk satu momen

saat aku memanfaatkan Kristal Z\.
siapa pun yang menghalangi akan\lmendapat [green]Pukulan Total[blue]! Tanpa

ampun!

entries.original:
"Well, look who’s here!

I’m back for another chance to
settle the score with ya!

One more try at dethroning the
untouchable Champion!

So, you willin’ to put it all on the
line and take on the kingpin?"
entries.translation_source: Well, look who’s here! I’m back for another chance to settle the score with ya! One more try at dethroning the untouchable Champion! So, you willin’ to put it all on the line and take on the kingpin?
entries.translated:
Nah, lihat siapa yang datang! Aku
kembali untuk kesempatan lain\lmenyelesaikan urusan denganmu! Satu

kali lagi mencoba menjatuhkan Juara
yang tak tersentuh! Jadi, kamu\lbersedia mempertaruhkan semuanya

dan menghadapi pemimpin tertinggi?

entries.original:
"[blue]Tch\. beaten down again\.
unbelievable\.

Ha ha ha ha!
Guess I gotta keep training!

Here, a little something so you
don’t lose your edge!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Tch[game-token-2] beaten down again[game-token-3] unbelievable[game-token-4] Ha ha ha ha! Guess I gotta keep training! Here, a little something so you don’t lose your edge!
entries.translated:
[blue]Cih\. dikalahkan lagi\. tidak percaya\.
Ha ha ha ha! Sepertinya aku harus\lterus berlatih! Ini, sedikit

sesuatu agar kamu tidak kehilangan
keunggulanmu!

entries.original:
"By the way\. I’ve been revamping my
Gym back in Antisis, lately.

Losing to ya made me realize I
needed to let more fish into\lthe pond.

It ain’t much - all it offers is an
extra challenge\.

But all the visitors seem to
like it.

Even if they don’t like me!

Ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: By the way[game-token-1] I’ve been revamping my Gym back in Antisis, lately. Losing to ya made me realize I needed to let more fish into the pond. It ain’t much - all it offers is an extra challenge[game-token-2] But all the visitors seem to like it. Even if they don’t like me! Ha ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Ngomong-ngomong\. Saya baru-baru ini
merombak Gym saya kembali di\lAntisis. Kalah darimu membuatku

sadar bahwa aku perlu membiarkan
lebih banyak ikan masuk ke kolam.\lItu tidak seberapa - semua yang

ditawarkan hanyalah tantangan
tambahan\. Tapi semua pengunjung\lsepertinya menyukainya. Meskipun

mereka tidak menyukai saya! Ha ha
ha ha!

entries.original:
"Howdy, sugah!
Fancy meeting ya here!

I got worried sick ’bout ya after
our Gym Battle, but I guess I\ldidn’t need to be!

Me? Ah, well\. even I need some time
away from the swamp - clear my\lhead some, see?

Plus, word is that this place here
is where the best in Borrius come\ltogether.

Must be true, if you’re here.

So, while we’re both killin’ time\.
ya fancy another round? You and I?

Last time ya seemed\. a mite
desperate, like getting my Badge\lmeant life or death.

This time, I wanna battle the real
[player].

Whaddya say? I’m itchin’ to show ya
how we’ve gotten better, too!"
entries.translation_source: Howdy, sugah! Fancy meeting ya here! I got worried sick ’bout ya after our Gym Battle, but I guess I didn’t need to be! Me? Ah, well[game-token-1] even I need some time away from the swamp - clear my head some, see? Plus, word is that this place here is where the best in Borrius come together. Must be true, if you’re here. So, while we’re both killin’ time[game-token-2] ya fancy another round? You and I? Last time ya seemed[game-token-3] a mite desperate, like getting my Badge meant life or death. This time, I wanna battle the real [player-name-4]. Whaddya say? I’m itchin’ to show ya how we’ve gotten better, too!
entries.translated:
Halo, sayang! Senang bertemu di
sini! Aku khawatir banget sama kamu\lsetelah Pertarungan Gym kita, tapi

sepertinya aku tidak perlu
khawatir! Aku? Ah, ya\. bahkan aku\lbutuh waktu jauh dari rawa -

menjernihkan pikiran, mengerti?
Lagipula, katanya tempat ini adalah\ltempat berkumpulnya yang terbaik di

Borrius. Pasti benar, jika kamu ada
di sini. Jadi, selagi kita berdua\lmengisi waktu\. kamu mau tanding

lagi? Kamu dan aku? Terakhir kali
kamu tampak\. agak putus asa, seolah\lmendapatkan Lencanaku berarti hidup

atau mati. Kali ini, aku ingin
bertarung melawan [player] yang\lsebenarnya. Bagaimana? Aku tak

sabar menunjukkan bahwa kami juga
sudah semakin baik!

entries.original:
"Too busy? I get it.

Still, I’m here all day, so if ya
change your mind\. drop by again."
entries.translation_source: Too busy? I get it. Still, I’m here all day, so if ya change your mind[game-token-1] drop by again.
entries.translated:
Terlalu sibuk? Aku mengerti. Namun,
aku di sini sepanjang hari, jadi\lkalau kau berubah pikiran\. mampir

lagi.

entries.original:
"Aw yeah, that’s what I’m talkin’
about! Meet ya at the battle area!"
entries.translation_source: Aw yeah, that’s what I’m talkin’ about! Meet ya at the battle area!
entries.translated:
Yeah, itu yang saya maksud! Ketemu
di arena pertarungan!

entries.original:
"[red]Yer already in deep\. and it’s only
gonna get deeper! Get ready!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Yer already in deep[game-token-2] and it’s only gonna get deeper! Get ready!
entries.translated:
[red]Kamu sudah dalam masalah\. dan ini
akan semakin dalam! Bersiaplah!

entries.original:
"Ah, dang it! But then, I guess ya
ain’t Champion for nuthin’\."
entries.translation_source: Ah, dang it! But then, I guess ya ain’t Champion for nuthin’[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"[red]I got swamped again?
Well, don’t that just beat all!

Coulda sworn I trained enough to
catch up to ya, but guess not.

Alright, that settles it!
I’ll let ya have this!

Call it a present, just for being
that dang amazing - it’s my\lfavourite Z-Crystal!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I got swamped again? Well, don’t that just beat all! Coulda sworn I trained enough to catch up to ya, but guess not. Alright, that settles it! I’ll let ya have this! Call it a present, just for being that dang amazing - it’s my favourite Z-Crystal!
entries.translated:
[red]Aku kewalahan lagi? Wah, sungguh
tak terduga! Aku bersumpah aku\lberlatih cukup untuk menyusulmu,

tapi ternyata tidak. Baiklah, sudah
diputuskan! Aku akan memberikan ini\lpadamu! Sebut saja ini hadiah,

karena kamu begitu hebat - ini
Z-Crystal favoritku!

entries.original:
"[red]Use that [green]Waterium Z[red], and it’ll turn
any [green]Water[red]-type attack into a\lpowerful [green]Z-Move[red]!

But it’s only good once a battle,
so ya gotta make the shot count.

Watching a move like [green]Hydro Vortex[red]\.

Sure am glad the swamp don’t
suffer from that sorta thing!

I mean, it’s been havin’ its own
problems as it is, lately\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Use that [color-green-2]Waterium Z[color-red-3], and it’ll turn any [color-green-4]Water[color-red-5]-type attack into a powerful [color-green-6]Z-Move[color-red-7]! But it’s only good once a battle, so ya gotta make the shot count. Watching a move like [color-green-8]Hydro Vortex[color-red-9][game-token-10] Sure am glad the swamp don’t suffer from that sorta thing! I mean, it’s been havin’ its own problems as it is, lately[game-token-11]
entries.translated:
[red]Gunakan [green]Waterium Z[red] itu, dan ia akan
mengubah serangan tipe [green]Air[red] menjadi\l[green]Z-Move[red] yang kuat! Tapi hanya bisa

digunakan sekali per pertempuran,
jadi kamu harus memastikan\lseranganmu tepat sasaran. Melihat

gerakan seperti [green]Hydro Vortex[red]\. Aku
senang rawa-rawa tidak mengalami\lhal seperti itu! Maksudku,

rawa-rawa ini sudah punya
masalahnya sendiri akhir-akhir ini\.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]! Great timing!

Last time left a li’l raincloud over
my head that won’t go away.

And the only way I’m gonna clear my
mind\. is a shot at redemption!

If y’all have time to spare today,
ya wanna throw down one more time?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player-name-1]! Great timing! Last time left a li’l raincloud over my head that won’t go away. And the only way I’m gonna clear my mind[game-token-2] is a shot at redemption! If y’all have time to spare today, ya wanna throw down one more time?
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Waktu yang tepat!
Pertemuan terakhir meninggalkan\lawan mendung kecil di atas kepalaku

yang tidak mau pergi. Dan
satu-satunya cara untuk\lmenjernihkan pikiranku\. adalah

kesempatan untuk menebus diri! Jika
kalian punya waktu luang hari ini,\lkalian mau bertanding sekali lagi?

entries.original:
"[red]Aw, dangit. You’re a whole lot better
than I thought, sugah.

Here, ya can have this.

Call it a promise to take ya
on again!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Aw, dangit. You’re a whole lot better than I thought, sugah. Here, ya can have this. Call it a promise to take ya on again!
entries.translated:
[red]Ah, sial. Kamu jauh lebih hebat
dari yang kukira, sayang. Ini,\lambil ini. Anggap saja janji untuk

bertarung lagi!

entries.original:
"I wonder how Mel’s doin’?

He always had a hard time lettin’
go of anythin’.

Gifts, his past, even grudges\. he
holds ’em tight.

It ain’t obvious unless ya pay
attention, though.

I tried to part on good terms,
when I moved to Polder - gave him\lthe ol’ Gym before I left.

If he showed up here, same day as
me\. wonder what he’d say\.\lor if he’d say anythin’ at all?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder how Mel’s doin’? He always had a hard time lettin’ go of anythin’. Gifts, his past, even grudges[game-token-1] he holds ’em tight. It ain’t obvious unless ya pay attention, though. I tried to part on good terms, when I moved to Polder - gave him the ol’ Gym before I left. If he showed up here, same day as me[game-token-2] wonder what he’d say[game-token-3] or if he’d say anythin’ at all?
entries.translated:
Aku penasaran bagaimana kabar Mel?
Dia selalu sulit melepaskan apa\lpun. Hadiah, masa lalunya, bahkan

dendam\. dia pegang erat-erat. Tapi
itu tidak kentara kecuali kamu\lperhatikan. Aku mencoba berpisah

dengan baik, saat aku pindah ke
Polder - memberinya Gym lama\lsebelum pergi. Jika dia muncul di

sini, hari yang sama denganku\. entah
apa yang akan dia katakan\. atau\lapakah dia akan berkata apa-apa?

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. it’s been ages\.
ages, I say, since I’ve felt such a\lstrong urge to cross paths with a\lfellow Trainer once more.

Hello again, and my heartiest
congratulations on becoming\lChampion.

And, I suppose, my most heartfelt
thanks for ridding the world of a\lmost terrible evil.

I remember when we last battled, I
was fortunate enough to catch you\lquite near the end of your quest\lto the Pokémon League.

You were much like a Butterfree,
newly emerged, with nothing left\lbut to wait for its wings to dry\land harden.

But now, I wish to see your
strength at its fullest.

What did you experience?

What ground have you tread as you
lived through those moments?

I desire another battle, so I may
observe the results.

Will you indulge this old man?"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo[game-token-1] it’s been ages[game-token-2] ages, I say, since I’ve felt such a strong urge to cross paths with a fellow Trainer once more. Hello again, and my heartiest congratulations on becoming Champion. And, I suppose, my most heartfelt thanks for ridding the world of a most terrible evil. I remember when we last battled, I was fortunate enough to catch you quite near the end of your quest to the Pokémon League. You were much like a Butterfree, newly emerged, with nothing left but to wait for its wings to dry and harden. But now, I wish to see your strength at its fullest. What did you experience? What ground have you tread as you lived through those moments? I desire another battle, so I may observe the results. Will you indulge this old man?
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. sudah lama sekali\.
lama sekali, kataku, sejak aku\lmerasakan keinginan kuat untuk

bertemu dengan sesama Pelatih lagi.
Halo lagi, dan ucapan selamat\lpaling tulus atas menjadi Juara.

Dan, kurasa, terima kasih yang
paling tulus karena telah\lmembebaskan dunia dari kejahatan

yang paling mengerikan. Aku ingat
saat kita bertarung terakhir kali,\laku cukup beruntung menangkapmu

menjelang akhir perjalananmu ke
Pokémon League. Kamu seperti\lButterfree yang baru muncul, tidak

ada yang tersisa selain menunggu
sayapnya kering dan mengeras. Tapi\lsekarang, aku ingin melihat

kekuatanmu yang paling maksimal.
Apa yang kamu alami? Tanah apa yang\ltelah kamu injak saat menjalani

momen-momen itu? Aku menginginkan
pertarungan lain, agar aku bisa\lmengamati hasilnya. Maukah kamu

memenuhi keinginan orang tua ini?

entries.original:
"I see\. if you change your mind,
I’ll be here all day.

I would say I’m not getting any
younger waiting, but\."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] if you change your mind, I’ll be here all day. I would say I’m not getting any younger waiting, but[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku mengerti\. jika kamu berubah
pikiran, aku akan di sini sepanjang\lhari. Aku akan bilang aku tidak

semakin muda menunggu, tapi\.

entries.original:
"Ah, you have my thanks.

Then I shall make my way to the
battle area."
entries.translation_source: Ah, you have my thanks. Then I shall make my way to the battle area.
entries.translated:
Ah, terima kasih. Kalau begitu aku
akan menuju ke area pertarungan.

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, bear witness, to the tempered
resilience of my Pokémon and I!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now, bear witness, to the tempered resilience of my Pokémon and I!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang, saksikanlah ketangguhan
yang ditempa dari Pokémon dan\ldiriku!

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. you never fail to
impress, as always."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo[game-token-1] you never fail to impress, as always.

entries.original:
"[blue]Goodness\. I think I’ve gotten a bit
too excited again.

But I can’t help it!

I can’t help but smile, when the
pride of Borrius is truly so strong.

Take this Z-Crystal.

I believe that you should have no
problem tapping into its power."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Goodness[game-token-2] I think I’ve gotten a bit too excited again. But I can’t help it! I can’t help but smile, when the pride of Borrius is truly so strong. Take this Z-Crystal. I believe that you should have no problem tapping into its power.
entries.translated:
[blue]Astaga\. Sepertinya aku terlalu
bersemangat lagi. Tapi aku tidak\lbisa menahannya! Aku tidak bisa

tidak tersenyum, saat kebanggaan
Borrius benar-benar begitu kuat.\lAmbil Z-Crystal ini. Aku yakin kamu

tidak akan kesulitan mengakses
kekuatannya.

entries.original:
"[blue]The [green]Buginium Z[blue] empowers [green]Bug[blue]-type
attacks, as you’ve probably\lguessed.

It unleashes a powerful [green]Z-Move[blue],
but this trump card is only useable\lonce per battle.

I found that I have a certain
fondness for the result, the deadly\l[green]Savage Spin-Out[blue].

My old teacher was known to use
it, for students who couldn’t tell\lthe difference between a cocoon\land a chrysalis\.

Incidentally, cocoons are
structures made of silk, made to\lhouse a creature.

A chrysalis IS the creature."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]The [color-green-2]Buginium Z[color-blue-3] empowers [color-green-4]Bug[color-blue-5]-type attacks, as you’ve probably guessed. It unleashes a powerful [color-green-6]Z-Move[color-blue-7], but this trump card is only useable once per battle. I found that I have a certain fondness for the result, the deadly [color-green-8]Savage Spin-Out[color-blue-9]. My old teacher was known to use it, for students who couldn’t tell the difference between a cocoon and a chrysalis[game-token-10] Incidentally, cocoons are structures made of silk, made to house a creature. A chrysalis IS the creature.
entries.translated:
[blue] [green]Buginium Z[blue] memperkuat serangan
[green]tipe Serangga[blue], seperti yang mungkin\lsudah kamu duga. Serangan ini

melepaskan [green]Z-Move[blue] yang kuat, tapi
kartu truf ini hanya bisa digunakan\lsekali per pertarungan. Aku merasa

agak suka dengan hasilnya, yaitu
[green]Savage Spin-Out[blue] yang mematikan.\lGuruku yang dulu dikenal

menggunakannya, untuk murid yang
tidak bisa membedakan antara kokon\ldan kepompong\. Omong-omong, kokon

adalah struktur yang terbuat dari
sutra, dibuat untuk menampung\lmakhluk. Kepompong ADALAH makhluk

itu sendiri.

entries.original:
"Ah, [player]\. your arrival is
somewhat timely.

I couldn’t help but think about how
much I wanted to battle you again\.

I suppose your journey with
Pokémon is far from over, and I\lwant to observe your growth,\levery step of the way.

So, would you allow this old man
to be part of your journey,\lonce more?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, [player-name-1][game-token-2] your arrival is somewhat timely. I couldn’t help but think about how much I wanted to battle you again[game-token-3] I suppose your journey with Pokémon is far from over, and I want to observe your growth, every step of the way. So, would you allow this old man to be part of your journey, once more?
entries.translated:
Ah, [player]\. kedatanganmu cukup
tepat waktu. Aku tidak bisa tidak\lmemikirkan betapa aku ingin

bertarung denganmu lagi\. Kurasa
perjalananmu dengan Pokémon masih\ljauh dari selesai, dan aku ingin

mengamati pertumbuhanmu, setiap
langkahnya. Jadi, sudikah kamu\lmengizinkan orang tua ini menjadi

bagian dari perjalananmu, sekali
lagi?

entries.original:
"[blue]Ah\. just seeing how strong the
newest generation of Trainers is\lalways brings a smile to my face.

You never fail to make me feel -
and look - younger.

For that, I think you should
have this."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ah[game-token-2] just seeing how strong the newest generation of Trainers is always brings a smile to my face. You never fail to make me feel - and look - younger. For that, I think you should have this.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ah\. hanya melihat betapa kuatnya
generasi Pelatih terbaru selalu\lmembuatku tersenyum. Kamu tidak

pernah gagal membuatku merasa - dan
terlihat - lebih muda. Untuk itu,\laku pikir kamu harus memiliki ini.

entries.original:
"My odd condition\. it is rather
taxing on my body.

Nowadays, my old bones ache, but
when I battle, it’s like all my\ltiredness disappears.

It does, however, throw some
people off, when I don’t act how\lI should.

But no matter my age and
appearance, when it comes to\lPokémon, I will always be a child\lat heart."
entries.translation_source: My odd condition[game-token-1] it is rather taxing on my body. Nowadays, my old bones ache, but when I battle, it’s like all my tiredness disappears. It does, however, throw some people off, when I don’t act how I should. But no matter my age and appearance, when it comes to Pokémon, I will always be a child at heart.
entries.translated:
Kondisiku yang aneh\. cukup
memberatkan tubuhku. Sekarang,\ltulang-tulang lamaku sakit, tapi

saat bertarung, semua kelelahanku
hilang. Namun, hal ini membuat\lbeberapa orang bingung, saat aku

tidak bertindak sebagaimana
mestinya. Tapi tidak peduli usia\ldan penampilanku, soal Pokémon, aku

akan selalu berjiwa anak-anak.

entries.original: "Referee"
entries.translation_source: Referee
entries.translated: Wasit

"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Mirskle, the room will be\lfilled with a dense [green]Fog[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Mirskle, the room will be filled with a dense [color-green-1]Fog[color-blue-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Mirskle, ruangan akan dipenuhi\l[green]Kabut[blue] yang pekat\.

"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Véga, [green]negative emotions[blue]\lwill fill the air!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Véga, [color-green-1]negative emotions[color-blue-2] will fill the air!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Véga, [green]emosi negatif[blue] akan\lmemenuhi udara!

"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Alice, a [green]Tailwind[blue] will blow\lbehind all Flying-type Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Alice, a [color-green-1]Tailwind[color-blue-2] will blow behind all Flying-type Pokémon!

Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Alice, [green]Angin Ekor[blue] akan bertiup\ldi belakang semua Pokémon tipe

Terbang!

"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Alice, a [green]Tailwind[blue] will blow\lbehind all Flying-type Pokémon, in\laddition to [green]weakening super\leffective attacks[blue] against them!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Alice, a [color-green-1]Tailwind[color-blue-2] will blow behind all Flying-type Pokémon, in addition to [color-green-3]weakening super effective attacks[color-blue-4] against them!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Alice, [green]Angin Ekor[blue] akan bertiup\ldi belakang semua Pokémon tipe

Terbang, selain [green]melemahkan serangan
yang sangat efektif[blue] terhadap\lmereka!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Mel, all [green]type matchups[blue]\lwill be [green]reversed[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Mel, all [color-green-1]type matchups[color-blue-2] will be [color-green-3]reversed[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Mel, semua [green]kecocokan tipe[blue] akan\l[green]dibalik[blue]!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Galavan, [green]Electric[blue]- and\l[green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon will avoid\l[green]Ground[blue]-type moves!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Galavan, [color-green-1]Electric[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Steel[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon will avoid [color-green-5]Ground[color-blue-6]-type moves!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Galavan, Pokémon [green]tipe Listrik[blue]\ldan [green]tipe Baja[blue] akan menghindari

[green]serangan tipe Tanah[blue]!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Galavan, [green]Electric[blue]- and\l[green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon will avoid\l[green]Ground[blue]-type moves, while also\lbenefiting from an [green]Electric Terrain[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Galavan, [color-green-1]Electric[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Steel[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon will avoid [color-green-5]Ground[color-blue-6]-type moves, while also benefiting from an [color-green-7]Electric Terrain[color-blue-8]!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Galavan, Pokémon [green]tipe Listrik[blue]\ldan [green]tipe Baja[blue] akan menghindari

[green]serangan tipe Tanah[blue], sementara juga
mendapat manfaat dari [green]Medan\lListrik[blue]!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Big Mo, [green]Flying[blue]- and\l[green]Fairy[blue]-type moves cannot be used!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Big Mo, [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Fairy[color-blue-4]-type moves cannot be used!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Big Mo, [green]serangan tipe Terbang[blue]\ldan [green]tipe Peri[blue] tidak dapat

digunakan!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Big Mo, a Pokémon’s speed\lwill be determined by its weight!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Big Mo, a Pokémon’s speed will be determined by its weight!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertempuran melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Big Mo, kecepatan Pokémon akan\lditentukan oleh beratnya!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Tessy, it will be [green]raining[blue]\land Pokémon will become the [green]types[blue]\lof their [green]first two moves[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Tessy, it will be [color-green-1]raining[color-blue-2] and Pokémon will become the [color-green-3]types[color-blue-4] of their [color-green-5]first two moves[color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Tessy, akan [green]hujan[blue] dan Pokémon\lakan menjadi [green]tipe[blue] dari [green]dua jurusan

pertama[blue] mereka!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Tessy, a [green]heavy rain[blue] will\lbe falling, and Pokémon will take\lthe [green]types[blue] of their [green]first two moves[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Tessy, a [color-green-1]heavy rain[color-blue-2] will be falling, and Pokémon will take the [color-green-3]types[color-blue-4] of their [color-green-5]first two moves[color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Tessy, [green]hujan lebat[blue] akan turun,\ldan Pokémon akan mengambil [green]tipe[blue]

dari [green]dua jurus pertama[blue] mereka!

entries.original:
"In the battle against the Gym
Leader, Benjamin, Pokémon will\l[green]devolve[blue] when they are defeated!"
entries.translation_source: In the battle against the Gym Leader, Benjamin, Pokémon will [color-green-1]devolve[color-blue-2] when they are defeated!
entries.translated:
Dalam pertarungan melawan Pemimpin
Gym, Benjamin, Pokémon akan\l[green]berevolusi mundur[blue] saat mereka

dikalahkan!

entries.original:
"[red]Mommy brings me here so I can watch
her \qokick some noob heinie!\qc

That what she says, anyway."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Mommy brings me here so I can watch her [quote-open-2]kick some noob heinie![quote-close-3] That what she says, anyway.
entries.translated:
[red]Ibu membawaku ke sini agar aku bisa
melihatnya \qomenendang pantat para\lnoob!\qc Itulah yang dia katakan,

setidaknya.

entries.original:
"[red]Give me an M!

Give me an E!

Give me an L!

What does that spell?

Mel, Mel, Mel!

Goooooooooo, Mel!

\.What?

I’m Mel’s personal cheerleader.

It’s my job to cheer him on, and I
don’t care one bit if it bothers you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Give me an M! Give me an E! Give me an L! What does that spell? Mel, Mel, Mel! Goooooooooo, Mel! [game-token-2]What? I’m Mel’s personal cheerleader. It’s my job to cheer him on, and I don’t care one bit if it bothers you!
entries.translated:
[red]Beri aku M! Beri aku E! Beri aku L!
Apa ejaannya? Mel, Mel, Mel! Ayo,\lMel! \.Apa? Aku adalah pemandu sorak

pribadi Mel. Tugasku adalah
menyemangatinya, dan aku tidak\lpeduli sedikit pun jika itu

mengganggumu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo? Huh?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo? Huh?
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa kau benar-benar berpikir bisa
mengalahkan Big Mo? Hah?

entries.original: "Gimme a V"
entries.translation_source: Gimme a V
entries.translated: Kasih aku V

entries.original:
"Be victorious by defeating all eight
of Borrius’ Gym Leaders in the
Classic Leaders Gauntlet!"
entries.translation_source: Be victorious by defeating all eight of Borrius’ Gym Leaders in the Classic Leaders Gauntlet!

entries.original:
"Do you see this Pokémon I have
here right next to me?

It’s the Mythical Victory Pokémon,
[green]Victini[red].

It’s known for bringing victory to
the Trainers that use it.

But in truth, the victories only come
if Victini chooses to share its\lpower with its Trainer.

And unfortunately for me, it doesn’t
seem too interested in helping\lsomeone who’s overly reliant on it.

Maybe\. if it could see a Trainer
who can win over and over with\lno miracles necessary\.

Actually, now that I think about
it, you’re the Champion, right?

The Gym Leaders seem to visit this
club pretty often\.

So I thought, maybe if you could
defeat all eight of them again\.

Do you think you could show [green]Victini[red]
that you’re worthy of being its\lideal Trainer?"
entries.translation_source: Do you see this Pokémon I have here right next to me? It’s the Mythical Victory Pokémon, [color-green-1]Victini[color-red-2]. It’s known for bringing victory to the Trainers that use it. But in truth, the victories only come if Victini chooses to share its power with its Trainer. And unfortunately for me, it doesn’t seem too interested in helping someone who’s overly reliant on it. Maybe[game-token-3] if it could see a Trainer who can win over and over with no miracles necessary[game-token-4] Actually, now that I think about it, you’re the Champion, right? The Gym Leaders seem to visit this club pretty often[game-token-5] So I thought, maybe if you could defeat all eight of them again[game-token-6] Do you think you could show [color-green-7]Victini[color-red-8] that you’re worthy of being its ideal Trainer?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu melihat Pokémon yang
ada di sini di sebelahku ini? Ini\ladalah Pokémon Kemenangan Mitos,

[green]Victini[red]. Ia dikenal membawa
kemenangan bagi para Trainer yang\lmenggunakannya. Namun sebenarnya,

kemenangan hanya datang jika
Victini memilih untuk berbagi\lkekuatannya dengan Trainernya. Dan

sayangnya bagiku, ia tampaknya
tidak terlalu tertarik membantu\lseseorang yang terlalu bergantung

padanya. Mungkin\. jika ia bisa
melihat seorang Trainer yang bisa\lmenang terus-menerus tanpa perlu

keajaiban\. Sebenarnya, sekarang aku
pikir-pikir, kamu adalah Juara,\lkan? Para Pemimpin Gym tampaknya

sering mengunjungi klub ini\. Jadi
aku berpikir, mungkin jika kamu\lbisa mengalahkan kedelapan dari

mereka lagi\. Menurutmu, bisakah kamu
menunjukkan pada [green]Victini[red] bahwa kamu\llayak menjadi Trainer idealnya?

entries.original:
"Oh\. I see.
I hoped you’d say yes\.

Victini gets up to all sorts of
trouble since it’s always frustrated\lwith me."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] I see. I hoped you’d say yes[game-token-2] Victini gets up to all sorts of trouble since it’s always frustrated with me.
entries.translated:
Oh\. Aku mengerti. Aku berharap kamu
mengatakan ya\. Victini suka membuat\lberbagai masalah karena selalu

kesal padaku.

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you so much!

Victini and I will be staying here
for the time being.

I just need you to let us both see
your brilliant victories here at\lthe Battleground\.

But, that’s not enough\.

I think that to really satisfy
Victini\.

You have to clear the entire
[green]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[red].

Beat all eight of Borrius’
Gym Leaders, in a way only the\lChampion of our region can!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you so much! Victini and I will be staying here for the time being. I just need you to let us both see your brilliant victories here at the Battleground[game-token-1] But, that’s not enough[game-token-2] I think that to really satisfy Victini[game-token-3] You have to clear the entire [color-green-4]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[color-red-5]. Beat all eight of Borrius’ Gym Leaders, in a way only the Champion of our region can!
entries.translated:
Oh, terima kasih banyak! Victini
dan aku akan tinggal di sini untuk\lsementara waktu. Aku hanya perlu

kau membiarkan kami berdua melihat
kemenangan gemilangmu di sini di\lBattleground\. Tapi, itu belum cukup\.

Aku pikir untuk benar-benar
memuaskan Victini\. Kau harus\lmenyelesaikan seluruh [green]Classic

Leaders Gauntlet[red]. Kalahkan semua
delapan Pemimpin Gym Borrius,\ldengan cara yang hanya bisa

dilakukan oleh Juara region kita!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry about either of us.

The establishment serves food and
drink to patrons, so we can stay\lhere for as long as it’s necessary.

You should just focus on winning
and satisfying Victini’s desire\.

A desire for true victory!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry about either of us. The establishment serves food and drink to patrons, so we can stay here for as long as it’s necessary. You should just focus on winning and satisfying Victini’s desire[game-token-1] A desire for true victory!
entries.translated:
Jangan khawatir tentang kami
berdua. Tempat ini menyediakan\lmakanan dan minuman untuk para

pengunjung, jadi kita bisa tinggal
di sini selama diperlukan. Kamu\lhanya perlu fokus untuk menang dan

memuaskan keinginan Victini\.
Keinginan untuk kemenangan sejati!

entries.original:
"Oh, your brilliance\. it was something
else altogether!

It shone so bright, and yet neither
Victini nor myself dared to ever\llook away!

I think that settles it, then!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, your brilliance[game-token-1] it was something else altogether! It shone so bright, and yet neither Victini nor myself dared to ever look away! I think that settles it, then!
entries.translated:
Oh, kecerdasanmu\. itu benar-benar
lain! Bersinar begitu terang, namun\lbaik Victini maupun aku tidak

berani pernah berpaling! Kurasa itu
sudah cukup, kalau begitu!

entries.original:
"Oh, but first, you should deposit one
of your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Oh, but first, you should deposit one of your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Oh, tapi pertama, kamu sebaiknya
menyimpan salah satu Pokémon kamu.

entries.original: "The Victory Pokémon is yours!"
entries.translation_source: The Victory Pokémon is yours!
entries.translated: Pokémon Kemenangan adalah milikmu!

entries.original:
"Just remember, victory is only
meaningful when it’s grasped for\lyourself, with hard work and\ldetermination!"
entries.translation_source: Just remember, victory is only meaningful when it’s grasped for yourself, with hard work and determination!
entries.translated:
Ingat saja, kemenangan hanya
berarti ketika diraih sendiri,\ldengan kerja keras dan tekad!

entries.original:
"Is Victini doing alright with you?

I hope it’s a lot happier with you
than it was with me\."
entries.translation_source: Is Victini doing alright with you? I hope it’s a lot happier with you than it was with me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Apakah Victini baik-baik saja
bersamamu? Aku harap dia jauh lebih\lbahagia bersamamu daripada

bersamaku\.

entries.original: "Bellin Town"
entries.translation_source: Bellin Town

entries.original: "Bellin Town D"
entries.translation_source: Bellin Town D

entries.original: "Bellin Town N"
entries.translation_source: Bellin Town N

entries.original:
"Hello, there.

By any chance, would you like to
have a [green][buffer1][blue]?

I hatched it from an Egg and have
no way to train it."
entries.translation_source: Hello, there. By any chance, would you like to have a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]? I hatched it from an Egg and have no way to train it.
entries.translated:
Halo. Apakah Anda kebetulan ingin
memiliki [green][buffer1][blue]? Saya\lmenetaskannya dari Telur dan tidak

punya cara untuk melatihnya.

entries.original:
"I have been holding on to this
Pokémon Egg for a while now.

I think it is finally close
to hatching!

Any moment now, we will know which
Pokémon is contained within!

\.

\.Nope! Not yet!
Come back later!"
entries.translation_source: I have been holding on to this Pokémon Egg for a while now. I think it is finally close to hatching! Any moment now, we will know which Pokémon is contained within! [game-token-1] [game-token-2]Nope! Not yet! Come back later!
entries.translated:
Saya sudah menyimpan Telur Pokémon
ini untuk beberapa waktu. Saya\lpikir telur ini akhirnya hampir

menetas! Kapan saja sekarang, kita
akan tahu Pokémon apa yang ada di\ldalamnya! \. \.Tidak! Belum! Kembali

lagi nanti!

entries.original:
"I guess I will have to find another
Trainer for it."
entries.translation_source: I guess I will have to find another Trainer for it.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku harus mencari
Pelatih lain untuknya.

entries.original:
"It does not look like you have
enough space in your party for\lthis newly hatched Pokémon.

Come back when you have made space."
entries.translation_source: It does not look like you have enough space in your party for this newly hatched Pokémon. Come back when you have made space.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak memiliki
cukup ruang di timmu untuk Pokémon\lyang baru menetas ini. Kembalilah

setelah kamu membuat ruang.

entries.original:
"It is new to the world, so please
take good care of this [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: It is new to the world, so please take good care of this [buffer1-1].
entries.translated:
Ini baru di dunia, jadi tolong jaga
baik-baik [buffer1] ini.

entries.original:
"How is my old Pokémon doing?

I hope you have spent time showing
it around this wonderful world!"
entries.translation_source: How is my old Pokémon doing? I hope you have spent time showing it around this wonderful world!
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kabar Pokémon lamaku? Aku
harap kamu sudah meluangkan waktu\luntuk menunjukkannya ke dunia yang

indah ini!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received a [buffer1]!
It has the [green][buffer2][black] nature."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received a [buffer1-3]! It has the [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-black-6] nature.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima [buffer1]! Ia
memiliki [green][buffer2][black] sifat.

entries.original:
"Please, don’t disturb me, citizen.
I’m on duty."
entries.translation_source: Please, don’t disturb me, citizen. I’m on duty.
entries.translated:
Mohon, jangan ganggu saya, warga.
Saya sedang bertugas.

entries.original:
"What’s that, citizen?
A stolen package?

I’ll let the Pokémon Rangers
handle this one.

I’m on duty."
entries.translation_source: What’s that, citizen? A stolen package? I’ll let the Pokémon Rangers handle this one. I’m on duty.
entries.translated:
Apa itu, warga? Sebuah paket yang
dicuri? Aku akan biarkan Pokémon\lRangers yang menangani yang ini.

Aku sedang bertugas.

entries.original:
"Have you taken a moment to check
out the local facilities?

The [green]Pokémon Center[blue] heals your
Pokémon for free.

The [green]Poké Mart[blue] sells useful
items for Trainers.

In most other towns, the two
buildings can be distinguished by\ltheir unique red and blue colours."
entries.translation_source: Have you taken a moment to check out the local facilities? The [color-green-1]Pokémon Center[color-blue-2] heals your Pokémon for free. The [color-green-3]Poké Mart[color-blue-4] sells useful items for Trainers. In most other towns, the two buildings can be distinguished by their unique red and blue colours.
entries.translated:
Sudahkah Anda meluangkan waktu
untuk memeriksa fasilitas setempat?\l[green]Pusat Pokémon[blue] menyembuhkan Pokémon

Anda secara gratis. [green]Poké Mart[blue]
menjual barang-barang berguna bagi\lPelatih. Di sebagian besar kota

lain, kedua bangunan tersebut dapat
dibedakan dari warna merah dan biru\lkhas mereka.

entries.original:
"That statue over there is of the
legendary Pokémon, Articuno.

It was built from scratch by none
other than my father, himself!

In fact, I’ll have you know that
he travels around Borrius building\lstatues like this one in many\ldifferent towns!

My father is so cool!

But still not as cool as the
weather here!

Ahahaha!"
entries.translation_source: That statue over there is of the legendary Pokémon, Articuno. It was built from scratch by none other than my father, himself! In fact, I’ll have you know that he travels around Borrius building statues like this one in many different towns! My father is so cool! But still not as cool as the weather here! Ahahaha!
entries.translated:
Patung di sana adalah patung
Pokémon legendaris, Articuno.\lPatung itu dibangun dari awal oleh

ayahku sendiri! Faktanya, aku akan
memberitahumu bahwa dia berkeliling\lBorrius membangun patung seperti

ini di banyak kota yang berbeda!
Ayahku sangat keren! Tapi tetap\ltidak sekeren cuaca di sini!

Ahahaha!

entries.original:

entries.original:
"Ah, [player]!

Good of you to drop by.

Have you ever heard a saying my
grandmother used to be fond of?

\qoIf humans were meant to fly,
we’d have wings like a Gligar\land feathers like a Pidgeotto.\qc

Well, I’m pretty sure I’ve got the
first part down, but\.

I might need a little bit of help
for the second.

So if you have any time today,
would you be willing to help\la nice lady out?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, [player-name-1]! Good of you to drop by. Have you ever heard a saying my grandmother used to be fond of? [quote-open-2]If humans were meant to fly, we’d have wings like a Gligar and feathers like a Pidgeotto.[quote-close-3] Well, I’m pretty sure I’ve got the first part down, but[game-token-4] I might need a little bit of help for the second. So if you have any time today, would you be willing to help a nice lady out?
entries.translated:
Ah, [player]! Baik sekali Anda
mampir. Pernahkah Anda mendengar\lpepatah yang dulu sering diucapkan

nenek saya? \qoJika manusia
ditakdirkan untuk terbang, kita\lakan memiliki sayap seperti Gligar

dan bulu seperti Pidgeotto.\qc Ya,
saya yakin bagian pertama sudah\lsaya kuasai, tapi\. saya mungkin

butuh sedikit bantuan untuk yang
kedua. Jadi, jika Anda punya waktu\lhari ini, maukah Anda membantu

seorang wanita baik?

entries.original:
"Ah, excellent!

Then, let me explain the problem
here.

I need the feathers necessary
to finish the wings I’ve been\lworking on.

But not just any feathers will do -
I need [green]Pretty Wings[red].

[green][buffer2][red] of them, to be exact.

I mean, I could use other wings,
but a lady’s gotta have nice\lthings, right?

So, if you could fetch me [green][buffer2][red]
of those [green]Pretty Wings[red] and bring\lthem here, there’ll be something\lnice in it for you, too!

You can find Pretty Wings being
carried by wild [green]Wingull[red]\land [green]Pelipper[red].

If you have a Pokémon with Thief,
Covet, or Knock Off, getting those\lPretty Wings will be a lot easier.

I recommend [green]Knock Off[red] the most,
because it saves you having to\ltake the item from your Pokémon.

Also, a Pokémon with [green]Compound Eyes[red]
or [green]Super Luck[red] at the front of\lyour party increases the odds of\lwild Pokémon holding items, so keep\lthat in mind!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, excellent! Then, let me explain the problem here. I need the feathers necessary to finish the wings I’ve been working on. But not just any feathers will do - I need [color-green-1]Pretty Wings[color-red-2]. [color-green-3][buffer2-4][color-red-5] of them, to be exact. I mean, I could use other wings, but a lady’s gotta have nice things, right? So, if you could fetch me [color-green-6][buffer2-7][color-red-8] of those [color-green-9]Pretty Wings[color-red-10] and bring them here, there’ll be something nice in it for you, too! You can find Pretty Wings being carried by wild [color-green-11]Wingull[color-red-12] and [color-green-13]Pelipper[color-red-14]. If you have a Pokémon with Thief, Covet, or Knock Off, getting those Pretty Wings will be a lot easier. I recommend [color-green-15]Knock Off[color-red-16] the most, because it saves you having to take the item from your Pokémon. Also, a Pokémon with [color-green-17]Compound Eyes[color-red-18] or [color-green-19]Super Luck[color-red-20] at the front of your party increases the odds of wild Pokémon holding items, so keep that in mind!
entries.translated:
Ah, bagus! Kalau begitu, biarkan
saya jelaskan masalahnya. Saya\lbutuh bulu untuk menyelesaikan

sayap yang sedang saya kerjakan.
Tapi bukan sembarang bulu – saya\lbutuh [green]Sayap Indah[red]. Tepatnya

[green][buffer2][red] buah. Maksud saya, saya
bisa pakai sayap lain, tapi wanita\lharus punya barang bagus, kan?

Jadi, jika Anda bisa bawakan saya
[green][buffer2][red] dari [green]Sayap Indah[red] itu dan\lbawa ke sini, akan ada hadiah untuk

Anda juga! Anda bisa menemukan
Sayap Indah dibawa oleh [green]Wingull[red] dan\l[green]Pelipper[red] liar. Jika Anda punya

Pokémon dengan Mencuri, Mengingini,
atau Menjatuhkan, mendapatkan Sayap\lIndah akan lebih mudah. Saya

rekomendasikan [green]Menjatuhkan[red] paling
utama, karena Anda tidak perlu\lmengambil item dari Pokémon Anda.

Juga, Pokémon dengan [green]Mata Majemuk[red]
atau [green]Keberuntungan Super[red] di depan\lregu meningkatkan peluang Pokémon

liar membawa item, jadi ingat itu!

yang mereka lakukan! Terima kasih\latas bantuan Anda, [player] -

meskipun impian saya terbang dengan
sayap gagal. Ambil ini, sebagai\lpembayaran.

entries.original:
"It’s okay, [buffer1].

If you end up changing your mind,
I’ll be here."
entries.translation_source: It’s okay, [buffer1-1]. If you end up changing your mind, I’ll be here.
entries.translated:
Tidak apa-apa, [buffer1]. Jika Anda
berubah pikiran, saya akan di sini.

entries.original:
"I need to go back to the Gym now,
so take care, [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: I need to go back to the Gym now, so take care, [buffer1-1]!
entries.translated:
Saya harus kembali ke Gym sekarang,
jadi hati-hati, [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Whoa\.
You look exhausted.

Did you climb all the way up the
mountain from Crater Town?

Then I’m sure our greeter gave you
a nice gift!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa[game-token-1] You look exhausted. Did you climb all the way up the mountain from Crater Town? Then I’m sure our greeter gave you a nice gift!
entries.translated:
Wah\. Anda terlihat lelah. Apakah
Anda mendaki gunung dari Crater\lTown? Maka saya yakin penyambut

kami memberi Anda hadiah yang
bagus!

entries.original:
"Now that the entrance to the KBT
Expressway is clear, travellers can

save their strength by coming up
through there instead of hiking up!"
entries.translation_source: Now that the entrance to the KBT Expressway is clear, travellers can save their strength by coming up through there instead of hiking up!
entries.translated:
Sekarang pintu masuk ke KBT
Expressway sudah jelas, para\lpelancong bisa menghemat tenaga

dengan melewati sana daripada
mendaki!

entries.original:
"The Flying-type is the only type
that is not grounded.

What is [green]grounding[blue]?

Grounded Pokémon take damage from
Spikes and benefit from the\leffects of Terrains, among other\lthings.

You’ll learn about them all the
more you battle."
entries.translation_source: The Flying-type is the only type that is not grounded. What is [color-green-1]grounding[color-blue-2]? Grounded Pokémon take damage from Spikes and benefit from the effects of Terrains, among other things. You’ll learn about them all the more you battle.
entries.translated:
Tipe Terbang adalah satu-satunya
tipe yang tidak membumi. Apa itu\l[green]membumi[blue]? Pokémon yang membumi

menerima damage dari Spikes dan
mendapatkan manfaat dari efek\lmedan, antara lain. Anda akan

belajar semua itu semakin sering
bertarung.

entries.original:
"The Flying-type is the only type
that is not grounded.

They don’t benefit from Terrains,
but they also don’t take damage\lfrom Spikes.

But you already knew that, didn’t
you, Champion?"
entries.translation_source: The Flying-type is the only type that is not grounded. They don’t benefit from Terrains, but they also don’t take damage from Spikes. But you already knew that, didn’t you, Champion?
entries.translated:
Tipe Terbang adalah satu-satunya
tipe yang tidak membumi. Mereka\ltidak mendapatkan manfaat dari

medan, tapi juga tidak menerima
damage dari Spikes. Tapi Anda sudah\ltahu itu, kan, Juara?

entries.original:
"The Blizzard City Gym is the only
Gym in West Borrius with a unique\lexterior design.

The Gym’s interior layout wouldn’t
fit inside a normal Gym."
entries.translation_source: The Blizzard City Gym is the only Gym in West Borrius with a unique exterior design. The Gym’s interior layout wouldn’t fit inside a normal Gym.
entries.translated:
Gym Blizzard City adalah
satu-satunya Gym di West Borrius\ldengan desain eksterior unik. Tata

letak interior Gym tidak akan muat
di dalam Gym biasa.

entries.original: "[black]Fly to Crater Town?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Fly to Crater Town?
entries.translated: [black]Terbang ke Crater Town?

entries.original: "[black]Fly to Blizzard City?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Fly to Blizzard City?
entries.translated: [black]Terbang ke Blizzard City?

entries.original: "The trash can is empty."
entries.translation_source: The trash can is empty.
entries.translated: Tempat sampah kosong.

entries.original: "The door is open."
entries.translation_source: The door is open.
entries.translated: Pintunya terbuka.

entries.original:
"Each day, I try to cook delicious
meals for my family.

I need some inspiration, though.

Do you think you could show me a
Pokémon that’s the [green][buffer1][red]-type?"
entries.translation_source: Each day, I try to cook delicious meals for my family. I need some inspiration, though. Do you think you could show me a Pokémon that’s the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]-type?
entries.translated:
Setiap hari, aku mencoba memasak
makanan lezat untuk keluargaku.\lTapi aku butuh inspirasi. Bisakah

kamu menunjukkan padaku Pokémon
yang bertipe [green][buffer1][red]?

entries.original:
"If you catch a Pokémon that’s the
[buffer1]-type, please show it\lto me!

I’ll give you a little something."
entries.translation_source: If you catch a Pokémon that’s the [buffer1-1]-type, please show it to me! I’ll give you a little something.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu menangkap Pokémon yang
bertipe [buffer1], tolong tunjukkan\lpadaku! Aku akan memberimu sesuatu.

entries.original:
"Please show me a Pokémon that’s
the [green][buffer1][red]-type!"
entries.translation_source: Please show me a Pokémon that’s the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]-type!
entries.translated:
Tolong tunjukkan padaku Pokémon
yang bertipe [green][buffer1][red]!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon you chose is not the
one I requested.

What I want to see is a Pokémon
that’s the [buffer1]-type!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon you chose is not the one I requested. What I want to see is a Pokémon that’s the [buffer1-1]-type!
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang kamu pilih bukan yang
aku minta. Yang ingin aku lihat\ladalah Pokémon yang bertipe

[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"How can I tell what type of
Pokémon that is if it’s in an Egg?

What I want to see is a Pokémon
that’s the [buffer1]-type!"
entries.translation_source: How can I tell what type of Pokémon that is if it’s in an Egg? What I want to see is a Pokémon that’s the [buffer1-1]-type!
entries.translated:
Bagaimana aku bisa tahu tipe
Pokémon itu jika ada di dalam\lTelur? Yang ingin aku lihat adalah

Pokémon yang bertipe [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Oh! You have that type!
I’m inspired!

Thank you! As a token of my
gratitude, would you like a Berry?"
entries.translation_source: Oh! You have that type! I’m inspired! Thank you! As a token of my gratitude, would you like a Berry?
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu punya tipe itu! Aku
terinspirasi! Terima kasih! Sebagai\ltanda terima kasih, apakah kamu mau

Berry?

entries.original:
"One [buffer1]!
It’s all yours now!"
entries.translation_source: One [buffer1-1]! It’s all yours now!
entries.translated:
Satu [buffer1]! Sekarang ini
milikmu!

entries.original:
"[buffer2] [buffer1]!
They’re all yours now!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer2-1] [buffer1-2]! They’re all yours now!
entries.translated:
[buffer2] [buffer1]! Sekarang
semuanya milikmu!

entries.original:
"Aww. You are the best!
Please come back tomorrow, too!"
entries.translation_source: Aww. You are the best! Please come back tomorrow, too!
entries.translated:
Aww. Kamu yang terbaik! Tolong
datang lagi besok, ya!

entries.original:
"As long as the chef enjoys creating
a meal, it doesn’t matter if the\lfood is judged as bad or good."
entries.translation_source: As long as the chef enjoys creating a meal, it doesn’t matter if the food is judged as bad or good.
entries.translated:
Selama koki menikmati membuat
hidangan, tidak masalah apakah\lmakanan itu dinilai buruk atau

baik.

entries.original: "Cheri Berry"
entries.translation_source: Cheri Berry
entries.translated: Cheri Berry

entries.original: "Chesto Berry"
entries.translation_source: Chesto Berry
entries.translated: Chesto Berry

entries.original: "Pecha Berry"
entries.translation_source: Pecha Berry
entries.translated: Pecha Berry

entries.original: "Rawst Berry"
entries.translation_source: Rawst Berry
entries.translated: Rawst Berry

entries.original: "Aspear Berry"
entries.translation_source: Aspear Berry
entries.translated: Aspear Berry

entries.original: "Leppa Berry"
entries.translation_source: Leppa Berry
entries.translated: Leppa Berry

entries.original:
"Trainer!

Please help my mommy cook me food!
I’m soooo hungry!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer! Please help my mommy cook me food! I’m soooo hungry!
entries.translated:
Pelatih! Tolong bantu Ibuku
memasakkan makanan! Aku laaaapar!

entries.original:
"Trainer!

Thank you for helping my mommy
cook me food!

It was soooo delicious!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer! Thank you for helping my mommy cook me food! It was soooo delicious!
entries.translated:
Pelatih! Terima kasih sudah
membantu Ibuku memasakkan makanan!\lItu sangat enaaaak!

entries.original:
"People say that to the east of the
city is a hidden forest with a\lpowerful Pokémon inside.

But it’s probably just a rumour, so
most people tend to ignore it."
entries.translation_source: People say that to the east of the city is a hidden forest with a powerful Pokémon inside. But it’s probably just a rumour, so most people tend to ignore it.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang bilang bahwa di timur
kota ada hutan tersembunyi dengan\lPokémon kuat di dalamnya. Tapi itu

mungkin hanya rumor, jadi
kebanyakan orang cenderung\lmengabaikannya.

entries.original:
"A powerful Pokémon sleeps in the
forest to the east of the city.

Have no fear - it won’t cause you
any harm.

It’s only dangerous if you come
near it on a [green]Thursday[blue]."
entries.translation_source: A powerful Pokémon sleeps in the forest to the east of the city. Have no fear - it won’t cause you any harm. It’s only dangerous if you come near it on a [color-green-1]Thursday[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Seekor Pokémon kuat tidur di hutan
di timur kota. Jangan takut - dia\ltidak akan menyakitimu. Itu hanya

berbahaya jika kamu mendekatinya
pada hari [green]Kamis[blue].

entries.original:
"The people who live here aren’t
letting me in, so I’m forced\lto sit out here.

Other people get to just press
\btn00 next to the door and get let in.

But not me.
Life sucks."
entries.translation_source: The people who live here aren’t letting me in, so I’m forced to sit out here. Other people get to just press [button-icon-1] next to the door and get let in. But not me. Life sucks.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang yang tinggal di sini
tidak mengizinkanku masuk, jadi aku\lterpaksa duduk di luar sini. Orang

lain bisa tinggal menekan \btn00 di
dekat pintu dan bisa masuk. Tapi\ltidak denganku. Hidup ini

menyebalkan.

entries.original:
"The urge to battle with someone
you’ve tangled with before\.

Have you ever had that urge?
I’m sure you have.

I wanted to battle certain people
again over and over, too.

So, I’ve been giving these away.
Please, take one!"
entries.translation_source: The urge to battle with someone you’ve tangled with before[game-token-1] Have you ever had that urge? I’m sure you have. I wanted to battle certain people again over and over, too. So, I’ve been giving these away. Please, take one!
entries.translated:
Dorongan untuk bertarung dengan
seseorang yang pernah kau lawan\lsebelumnya\. Apakah kau pernah

merasakan dorongan itu? Aku yakin
kau pernah. Aku juga ingin\lbertarung dengan orang-orang

tertentu lagi dan lagi. Jadi, aku
telah memberikan ini. Silakan,\lambil satu!

entries.original:
"Use that device and you’ll find
Trainers looking for a rematch.

You have to charge its battery to
use it, though."
entries.translation_source: Use that device and you’ll find Trainers looking for a rematch. You have to charge its battery to use it, though.
entries.translated:
Gunakan perangkat itu dan kau akan
menemukan Pelatih yang mencari\lpertandingan ulang. Tapi kau harus

mengisi baterainya untuk
menggunakannya.

entries.original:
"How do you use the [green]VS Seeker[blue]?
There’s nothing to it.

Use it like beep-beep-beep, and
Trainers around you will notice.

If any Trainer wants a rematch,
it will let you know immediately.

Charge its battery and use it
while you’re on a road."
entries.translation_source: How do you use the [color-green-1]VS Seeker[color-blue-2]? There’s nothing to it. Use it like beep-beep-beep, and Trainers around you will notice. If any Trainer wants a rematch, it will let you know immediately. Charge its battery and use it while you’re on a road.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana cara menggunakan [green]Pencari
VS[blue]? Tidak ada yang rumit. Gunakan\lseperti bip-bip-bip, dan Pelatih di

sekitarmu akan memperhatikan. Jika
ada Pelatih yang ingin pertandingan\lulang, itu akan memberitahumu

segera. Isi baterainya dan gunakan
saat kau di jalan.

entries.original:
"Where the wind is ice cold, so are
my hands.

Would you like me to teach one of
your Pokémon [green]Ice Punch[blue]?

I require [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue] to share
my frosty hands."
entries.translation_source: Where the wind is ice cold, so are my hands. Would you like me to teach one of your Pokémon [color-green-1]Ice Punch[color-blue-2]? I require [color-green-3][buffer2-4] [buffer1-5]s[color-blue-6] to share my frosty hands.
entries.translated:
Di mana angin sedingin es, begitu
juga tanganku. Apakah kau ingin aku\lmengajari salah satu Pokémon-mu

[green]Pukulan Es[blue]? Aku memerlukan [green][buffer2]
[buffer1]s[blue] untuk berbagi tanganku\lyang dingin.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon would like to have
their hands frozen with [green]Ice Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon would like to have their hands frozen with [color-green-1]Ice Punch[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang ingin tangannya
dibekukan dengan [green]Pukulan Es[blue]?

entries.original:
"My hands shall remain cold for
all eternity."
entries.translation_source: My hands shall remain cold for all eternity.
entries.translated:
Tanganku akan tetap dingin
selamanya.

entries.original:
"You do not have enough
[buffer1]s.

I cannot share my frosty hands with
you for nothing\."
entries.translation_source: You do not have enough [buffer1-1]s. I cannot share my frosty hands with you for nothing[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Kau tidak memiliki cukup [buffer1]s.
Aku tidak bisa berbagi tanganku\lyang dingin denganmu tanpa imbalan\.

entries.original:
"How’s about I toss a [green]free TM[blue]
your way?"
entries.translation_source: How’s about I toss a [color-green-1]free TM[color-blue-2] your way?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kalau aku melemparkan [green]TM
gratis[blue] ke arahmu?

entries.original:
"That TM I gave you contains
[green]Aurora Veil[blue].

It has an effect similar to both
Reflect and Light Screen combined.

The only catch is that it can only
be used in [green]Hail[blue] weather."
entries.translation_source: That TM I gave you contains [color-green-1]Aurora Veil[color-blue-2]. It has an effect similar to both Reflect and Light Screen combined. The only catch is that it can only be used in [color-green-3]Hail[color-blue-4] weather.
entries.translated:
TM yang kuberikan padamu berisi
[green]Tirai Aurora[blue]. Efeknya mirip dengan\lgabungan Refleks dan Layar Cahaya.

Satu-satunya kelemahan adalah hanya
bisa digunakan saat cuaca [green]Hujan Es[blue].

entries.original: "Your loss, pal."
entries.translation_source: Your loss, pal.
entries.translated: Ruginya kau, teman.

entries.original:
"Some guy in one of the residences
around here is giving away\lan item that allows you to\lrebattle Trainers.

It doesn’t really work in caves,
but on routes it’s super useful!"
entries.translation_source: Some guy in one of the residences around here is giving away an item that allows you to rebattle Trainers. It doesn’t really work in caves, but on routes it’s super useful!
entries.translated:
Seorang pria di salah satu
perumahan di sekitar sini\lmemberikan item yang memungkinkanmu

bertarung ulang dengan Pelatih.
Item itu tidak terlalu berfungsi di\lgua, tapi di rute sangat berguna!

entries.original:
"[red]Hi!
Do you have an [green][buffer1][red]?

Wanna trade it for my
[green][buffer2][red]?

It’s great for if you want to
battle my mommy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Hi! Do you have an [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4]? Wanna trade it for my [color-green-5][buffer2-6][color-red-7]? It’s great for if you want to battle my mommy!
entries.translated:
[red]Hai! Apakah kau punya [green][buffer1][red]? Mau
menukarnya dengan [green][buffer2][red] milikku?\lIni bagus jika kau ingin bertarung

dengan mamiku!

entries.original:
"[red]My mommy’s gonna flip when she sees
my new Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]My mommy’s gonna flip when she sees my new Pokémon!
entries.translated:
[red]Mamiku akan senang sekali saat
melihat Pokémon baruku!

entries.original:
"[red]How is my old [buffer2]?

My [buffer1] is doing amazing!

It almost made a hole in the
ceiling when I let it out!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]How is my old [buffer2-2]? My [buffer1-3] is doing amazing! It almost made a hole in the ceiling when I let it out!
entries.translated:
[red]Bagaimana [buffer2] lamaku? [buffer1]
milikku sangat hebat! Hampir\lmembuat lubang di langit-langit

saat kulepaskan!

entries.original:
"[red]Aww\.

Don’t you know who my Mommy is?
I’m going to tell on you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Aww[game-token-2] Don’t you know who my Mommy is? I’m going to tell on you!
entries.translated:
[red]Aduh\. Apa kau tidak tahu siapa
Mamiku? Aku akan mengadumu!

entries.original:
"[red]I’m little, not stupid.
That’s not an [green][buffer1][red]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’m little, not stupid. That’s not an [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4]!
entries.translated:
[red]Aku kecil, bukan bodoh. Itu bukan
[green][buffer1][red]!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, [green]Alice[red], lives
downstairs.

She’s away running the Gym most of
the time, so she usually leaves\lher kid home alone.

I, personally, would never leave my
son home alone.

His mind is too delicate.

He can’t bear to be without
his mama!"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, [color-green-1]Alice[color-red-2], lives downstairs. She’s away running the Gym most of the time, so she usually leaves her kid home alone. I, personally, would never leave my son home alone. His mind is too delicate. He can’t bear to be without his mama!
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, [green]Alice[red], tinggal di
lantai bawah. Dia sering pergi\lmengelola Gym, jadi biasanya dia

meninggalkan anaknya sendirian di
rumah. Aku pribadi tidak akan\lpernah meninggalkan anakku

sendirian di rumah. Pikirannya
terlalu rapuh. Dia tidak tahan\ltanpa mamanya!

entries.original:
"\qoWho builds a city on top of a
frozen mountain?\qc you may\lbe wondering.

Well, about 20 years ago, a bunch
of Bird Keepers got together and\ldecided they wanted a nice high\lplace for their Pokémon to train.

With the help of this dude named
Aros and his partner Pokémon, they\lbuilt this city in under a year!

It amazes me what great things
people and Pokémon can accomplish\lby working together.

Say\.

Your face reminds me of his
a little\."
entries.translation_source: [quote-open-1]Who builds a city on top of a frozen mountain?[quote-close-2] you may be wondering. Well, about 20 years ago, a bunch of Bird Keepers got together and decided they wanted a nice high place for their Pokémon to train. With the help of this dude named Aros and his partner Pokémon, they built this city in under a year! It amazes me what great things people and Pokémon can accomplish by working together. Say[game-token-3] Your face reminds me of his a little[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
\qoSiapa yang membangun kota di atas
gunung beku?\qc mungkin kau\lbertanya-tanya. Nah, sekitar 20

tahun yang lalu, sekelompok Bird
Keeper berkumpul dan memutuskan\lmereka ingin tempat tinggi yang

bagus untuk melatih Pokémon mereka.
Dengan bantuan seorang pria bernama\lAros dan Pokémon rekannya, mereka

membangun kota ini dalam waktu
kurang dari setahun! Sungguh\lmenakjubkan apa yang bisa dicapai

manusia dan Pokémon dengan bekerja
sama. Ngomong-ngomong\. Wajahmu\lsedikit mengingatkanku padanya\.

entries.original: "Nat Log"
entries.translation_source: Nat Log
entries.translated: Nat Log

entries.original:
"Oh!
You’re [player]!

Euler said you’d be coming.

Oh, who am I?

I may not look it, but I’m
his sister! Natasha Log!

He told me to expect a new Trainer
with a Pokédex, so if you’ve\lcaught at least [green][buffer1][red] species of\lPokémon, I have just the thing\lprepared."
entries.translation_source: Oh! You’re [player-name-1]! Euler said you’d be coming. Oh, who am I? I may not look it, but I’m his sister! Natasha Log! He told me to expect a new Trainer with a Pokédex, so if you’ve caught at least [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4] species of Pokémon, I have just the thing prepared.
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu [player]! Euler bilang
kamu akan datang. Oh, siapa aku?\lAku mungkin tidak terlihat seperti

itu, tapi aku saudarinya! Natasha
Log! Dia bilang aku harus menunggu\lseorang Pelatih baru dengan

Pokédex, jadi jika kamu sudah
menangkap setidaknya [green][buffer1][red]\lspesies Pokémon, aku punya sesuatu

yang sudah disiapkan.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You’ve only caught [buffer2] species
so far.

Get to [green][buffer1][red] and I’ll upgrade your
Pokédex!"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] You’ve only caught [buffer2-2] species so far. Get to [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-red-5] and I’ll upgrade your Pokédex!
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Anda baru menangkap [buffer2]
spesies sejauh ini. Capai [green][buffer1][red]\ldan saya akan meningkatkan Pokédex

Anda!

entries.original:
"[black][player]’s Pokédex was upgraded
with the [green]DexNav[black]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2]’s Pokédex was upgraded with the [color-green-3]DexNav[color-black-4]!
entries.translated:
[black]Pokédex [player] telah ditingkatkan
dengan [green]DexNav[black]!

entries.original:
"What I gave you was a [green]DexNav[red]!

It’ll make your task of capturing
Pokémon plenty easier.

Once you’ve seen a Pokémon, search
for it using the DexNav, and\lthen there’s a high chance of it\lappearing around you!

My assistant can provide
further explanations."
entries.translation_source: What I gave you was a [color-green-1]DexNav[color-red-2]! It’ll make your task of capturing Pokémon plenty easier. Once you’ve seen a Pokémon, search for it using the DexNav, and then there’s a high chance of it appearing around you! My assistant can provide further explanations.
entries.translated:
Apa yang kuberikan padamu adalah
[green]DexNav[red]! Ini akan membuat tugasmu\lmenangkap Pokémon jauh lebih mudah.

Setelah kamu melihat Pokémon, cari
menggunakan DexNav, dan kemungkinan\lbesar Pokémon itu akan muncul di

sekitarmu! Asistenku bisa
memberikan penjelasan lebih lanjut.

entries.original:
"The name’s Ayla!

Under the tutelage of Nat, I was
able to bring Bill’s PC over to\lBorrius and develop my own version!

Thanks to my improvements, you can
now store up to [green]750[red] different\lPokémon in my PC!

That’s a far cry from the 420
allowed in Bill’s PC."
entries.translation_source: The name’s Ayla! Under the tutelage of Nat, I was able to bring Bill’s PC over to Borrius and develop my own version! entries.original:
"The DexNav consists of two parts:
an [green]interface[blue] and a [green]search bar[blue].

The interface can be accessed from
the [green]Start Menu[blue] and allows you to\lchoose a Pokémon to search for.

If a Pokémon can be found in your
current location, and the Pokémon\lis registered as at least \qo[green]seen[blue]\qc\lin your Pokédex, then it will\lappear as searchable.

Once a Pokémon is chosen with \btn00,
it will appear on the search bar\lwhile the search is active.

To find the Pokémon you’ve chosen
to search for, keep an eye out for\lphenomenon such as [green]rustling grass[blue]\lor [green]dust clouds[blue] in caves.

You need to approach these slowly,
otherwise the Pokémon will flee.

Do note that if the Pokémon is
not registered as \qo[green]caught[blue]\qc in your\lPokédex, it may be difficult to\llocate before it is captured.

Each time you encounter a Pokémon
with the DexNav, its [green]search level[blue]\lincreases, and future searches may\lyield better Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The DexNav consists of two parts: an [color-green-1]interface[color-blue-2] and a [color-green-3]search bar[color-blue-4]. The interface can be accessed from the [color-green-5]Start Menu[color-blue-6] and allows you to choose a Pokémon to search for. If a Pokémon can be found in your current location, and the Pokémon is registered as at least [quote-open-7][color-green-8]seen[color-blue-9][quote-close-10] in your Pokédex, then it will appear as searchable. Once a Pokémon is chosen with [button-icon-11], it will appear on the search bar while the search is active. To find the Pokémon you’ve chosen to search for, keep an eye out for phenomenon such as [color-green-12]rustling grass[color-blue-13] or [color-green-14]dust clouds[color-blue-15] in caves. You need to approach these slowly, otherwise the Pokémon will flee. Do note that if the Pokémon is not registered as [quote-open-16][color-green-17]caught[color-blue-18][quote-close-19] in your Pokédex, it may be difficult to locate before it is captured. Each time you encounter a Pokémon with the DexNav, its [color-green-20]search level[color-blue-21] increases, and future searches may yield better Pokémon.

entries.original:
"When searching for Pokémon, you
can choose to search for either\lland-based Pokémon or water-based\lPokémon.

Water-based Pokémon include both
Pokémon found by Surfing and by\lFishing.

However, Pokémon found by fishing
will only appear as searchable if\lyou have obtained the necessary\lRod to hook them yourself.

Additionally, it is important to
note, regardless of the Pokémon\lyou are searching for, it will be\lmuch more difficult to find if\lyou have not caught the species\lprior."
entries.translation_source: When searching for Pokémon, you can choose to search for either land-based Pokémon or water-based Pokémon. Water-based Pokémon include both Pokémon found by Surfing and by Fishing. However, Pokémon found by fishing will only appear as searchable if you have obtained the necessary Rod to hook them yourself. Additionally, it is important to note, regardless of the Pokémon you are searching for, it will be much more difficult to find if you have not caught the species prior.

entries.original:
"As your search level increases, so
does the chance of perfect stats.

The potential of having a perfect
stat is indicated on the search bar\lwith a silver star as you approach\lthe Pokémon.

A Pokémon can have at most three
perfect stats, each indicated by a\lgold star."
entries.translation_source: As your search level increases, so does the chance of perfect stats. The potential of having a perfect stat is indicated on the search bar with a silver star as you approach the Pokémon. A Pokémon can have at most three perfect stats, each indicated by a gold star.

entries.original:
"Some Pokémon may be encountered
with special moves.

The chance of this happening is
higher with a higher search level.

Regardless of whether or not the
Pokémon has a special move, if\lyour search level is high enough,\lthe Pokémon’s first move will be\lindicated on the search bar as you\lapproach the Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Some Pokémon may be encountered with special moves. The chance of this happening is higher with a higher search level. Regardless of whether or not the Pokémon has a special move, if your search level is high enough, the Pokémon’s first move will be indicated on the search bar as you approach the Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Some Pokémon may be encountered
with their Hidden Ability.

The chance of this happening is
higher with a higher search level.

A Pokémon’s Ability, regardless of
whether or not it is Hidden, is\lindicated on the search bar as you\lapproach the Pokémon, if your\lsearch level is high enough."
entries.translation_source: Some Pokémon may be encountered with their Hidden Ability. The chance of this happening is higher with a higher search level. A Pokémon’s Ability, regardless of whether or not it is Hidden, is indicated on the search bar as you approach the Pokémon, if your search level is high enough.

entries.original:
"Some Pokémon may be encountered
with a held item.

This is indicated on the search bar
if the search level is high enough."
entries.translation_source: Some Pokémon may be encountered with a held item. This is indicated on the search bar if the search level is high enough.

entries.original:
"Pokémon may be registered for
searching by pressing \btn03 while\lthe interface is open.

If a Pokémon is registered, and
the [green]R-Button mode[blue] is set to [green]DexNav\lScan[blue], then pressing \btn03 outside of\lbattle will allow for an immediate\lsearch of the Pokémon, provided it\lappears in the area."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon may be registered for searching by pressing [button-icon-1] while the interface is open. If a Pokémon is registered, and the [color-green-2]R-Button mode[color-blue-3] is set to [color-green-4]DexNav Scan[color-blue-5], then pressing [button-icon-6] outside of battle will allow for an immediate search of the Pokémon, provided it appears in the area.

entries.original:
"Chaining is when the DexNav is
used to encounter Pokémon many\ltimes in a row.

A chain builds every time you
capture or defeat a Pokémon\lencountered with the DexNav.

If you do not capture or defeat the
Pokémon, the chain breaks.

A chain will also break if, outside
of battle, a Pokémon runs away\lfrom you or you encounter a\lPokémon not using the DexNav.

Saving and restarting the game
also breaks the chain.

The chain resets every 100 battles,
and the higher the chain, the\lhigher the Pokémon level.

Additionally, whenever the chain
reaches 50 or 100, Pokémon have a\lhigher chance of being found shiny.

This is indicated by a gold star next
to the chain length on the HUD."
entries.translation_source: Chaining is when the DexNav is used to encounter Pokémon many times in a row. A chain builds every time you capture or defeat a Pokémon encountered with the DexNav. If you do not capture or defeat the Pokémon, the chain breaks. A chain will also break if, outside of battle, a Pokémon runs away from you or you encounter a Pokémon not using the DexNav. Saving and restarting the game also breaks the chain. The chain resets every 100 battles, and the higher the chain, the higher the Pokémon level. Additionally, whenever the chain reaches 50 or 100, Pokémon have a higher chance of being found shiny. This is indicated by a gold star next to the chain length on the HUD.
