I know, it’s not what you’d expect
from a Gym up here."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Alice[color-blue-2], the Gym Leader, likes to use [color-green-3]Flying[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon. I know, it’s not what you’d expect from a Gym up here.
entries.translated:
[green]Alice[blue], Pemimpin Gym, suka
menggunakan Pokémon [green]Terbang[blue]-tipe.\lAku tahu, itu bukan yang kau

harapkan dari sebuah Gym di sini.

entries.original:
"When Pokémon evolve, they
get stronger.

But there is a benefit to not
evolving your Pokémon right away.

Pokémon that can still evolve can
utilise an [green]Eviolite[blue] to become\ltougher to beat in battle.

I have an extra, so I’d be willing
to part with it if you can show me\la Pokémon that can still evolve."
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon evolve, they get stronger. But there is a benefit to not evolving your Pokémon right away. Pokémon that can still evolve can utilise an [color-green-1]Eviolite[color-blue-2] to become tougher to beat in battle. I have an extra, so I’d be willing to part with it if you can show me a Pokémon that can still evolve.
entries.translated:
Ketika Pokémon berevolusi, mereka
menjadi lebih kuat. Tapi ada\lkeuntungan untuk tidak

mengevolusikan Pokémon Anda segera.
Pokémon yang masih bisa berevolusi\ldapat menggunakan sebuah [green]Eviolite[blue]

untuk menjadi lebih sulit
dikalahkan dalam pertempuran. Saya\lmemiliki satu tambahan, jadi saya

bersedia melepaskannya jika Anda
dapat menunjukkan kepada saya\lPokémon yang masih bisa berevolusi.

entries.original:
"Pokémon that can still evolve are
in abundance in the wild."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon that can still evolve are in abundance in the wild.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang masih bisa berevolusi
berlimpah di alam liar.

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, that Pokémon can
evolve no longer.

Even if you were to give it an
Eviolite, it would have no effect."
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, that Pokémon can evolve no longer. Even if you were to give it an Eviolite, it would have no effect.
entries.translated:
Sayangnya, Pokémon itu sudah tidak
bisa berevolusi lagi. Bahkan jika\lkamu memberinya Eviolite, itu tidak

akan berpengaruh.

entries.original:
"There’s no guarantee that whatever
is in that Egg can evolve.

Not to mention the fact that Eggs
can’t hold items."
entries.translation_source: There’s no guarantee that whatever is in that Egg can evolve. Not to mention the fact that Eggs can’t hold items.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada jaminan bahwa apa pun
yang ada di dalam Telur itu dapat\lberevolusi. Belum lagi fakta bahwa

Telur tidak bisa memegang item.

entries.original:
"You are correct.

Your [buffer1] can indeed still
evolve.

So, as promised\."
entries.translation_source: You are correct. Your [buffer1-1] can indeed still evolve. So, as promised[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Kamu benar. [buffer1] milikmu masih
bisa berevolusi. Jadi, seperti yang\ldijanjikan\.

entries.original:
"Have a Pokémon that can still
evolve hold an [green]Eviolite[blue] in battle\lto increase its defenses."
entries.translation_source: Have a Pokémon that can still evolve hold an [color-green-1]Eviolite[color-blue-2] in battle to increase its defenses.
entries.translated:
Miliki Pokémon yang masih bisa
berevolusi memegang [green]Eviolit[blue] dalam\lpertempuran untuk meningkatkan

pertahanannya.

entries.original:
"They say some of the ugliest people
shop at Poké Mart.

I’ve heard there’s even a website
documenting them all."
entries.translation_source: They say some of the ugliest people shop at Poké Mart. I’ve heard there’s even a website documenting them all.
entries.translated:
Mereka bilang beberapa orang paling
jelek berbelanja di Poké Mart. Saya\ldengar bahkan ada situs web yang

mendokumentasikan mereka semua.

entries.original:
"One of the Sinnoh Gym Leaders likes
to come here on vacation.

She likes battling, so if you find
her, make sure you’re prepared\lfor a tough fight!"
entries.translation_source: One of the Sinnoh Gym Leaders likes to come here on vacation. She likes battling, so if you find her, make sure you’re prepared for a tough fight!
entries.translated:
Salah satu Pemimpin Gym Sinnoh suka
datang ke sini untuk liburan. Dia\lsuka bertarung, jadi jika kamu

menemukannya, pastikan kamu siap
untuk pertarungan yang berat!

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of a Pokémon
called [green]Eevee[red]?

It’s a super adorable Pokémon!

I’d love to see an Eevee
some day\."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of a Pokémon called [color-green-1]Eevee[color-red-2]? It’s a super adorable Pokémon! I’d love to see an Eevee some day[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mendengar tentang
Pokémon yang bernama [green]Eevee[red]? Ini\ladalah Pokémon yang sangat

menggemaskan! Aku ingin sekali
melihat Eevee suatu hari\.

entries.original:
"That’s an Eevee!
That’s an Eevee!

You have an Eevee!

So cute!"
entries.translation_source: That’s an Eevee! That’s an Eevee! You have an Eevee! So cute!
entries.translated:
Itu Eevee! Itu Eevee! Kamu punya
Eevee! Imut sekali!

entries.original:
"That’s for showing me an Eevee!

That item can evolve [green]Eevee[red] into
[green]Glaceon[red]!"
entries.translation_source: That’s for showing me an Eevee! That item can evolve [color-green-1]Eevee[color-red-2] into [color-green-3]Glaceon[color-red-4]!
entries.translated:
Itu untuk menunjukkan Eevee padaku!
Item itu dapat mengevolusi [green]Eevee[red]\lmenjadi [green]Glaceon[red]!

entries.original:
"Eevee used to evolve into [green]Glaceon[red]
by touching some rock around here.

But lately it seems all it needs
is an [green]Ice Stone[red]."
entries.translation_source: Eevee used to evolve into [color-green-1]Glaceon[color-red-2] by touching some rock around here. But lately it seems all it needs is an [color-green-3]Ice Stone[color-red-4].
entries.translated:
Eevee dulu berevolusi menjadi
[green]Glaceon[red] dengan menyentuh batu\ltertentu di sekitar sini. Namun

akhir-akhir ini sepertinya hanya
membutuhkan [green]Batu Es[red].

entries.original:
"Ooh, ooh, Champion!
Can you show me [green][buffer1][red] now?"
entries.translation_source: Ooh, ooh, Champion! Can you show me [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] now?
entries.translated:
Ooh, ooh, Champion! Bisakah kamu
menunjukkan [green][buffer1][red] sekarang?

entries.original:
"That’s [buffer1]!
That’s [buffer1]!

You have [buffer1]!

So cute!"
entries.translation_source: That’s [buffer1-1]! That’s [buffer1-2]! You have [buffer1-3]! So cute!
entries.translated:
Itu [buffer1]! Itu [buffer1]! Kamu
punya [buffer1]! Lucu sekali!

entries.original:
"That [green]Eevium Z[red] is for showing me
all of Eevee’s evolutions!

You can turn [green]Eevee[red]’s [green]Last Resort[red]
into a [green]Z-Move[red] that can boost all of\lits stats if you let Eevee hold it!"
entries.translation_source: That [color-green-1]Eevium Z[color-red-2] is for showing me all of Eevee’s evolutions! You can turn [color-green-3]Eevee[color-red-4]’s [color-green-5]Last Resort[color-red-6] into a [color-green-7]Z-Move[color-red-8] that can boost all of its stats if you let Eevee hold it!
entries.translated:
Itu [green]Eevium Z[red] adalah untuk
menunjukkan semua evolusi Eevee\lkepadaku! Kamu bisa mengubah

[green]Eevee[red]{B4}s [green]Upaya Terakhir[red] menjadi
[green]Gerakan Z[red] yang bisa meningkatkan\lsemua statistiknya jika kamu

membiarkan Eevee membawanya!

entries.original:
"Ooh aww\.

I wanted to see a [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh aww[game-token-1] I wanted to see a [buffer1-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated: Oh aduh\. aku ingin melihat [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"Ooh aww\.

That’s not a [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh aww[game-token-1] That’s not a [buffer1-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated: Ooh aduh\. Itu bukan [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"Ooh aww\.

That’s an Egg\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh aww[game-token-1] That’s an Egg[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Ooh aww\. Itu sebuah Telur\.

entries.original: "Cave of Being"
entries.translation_source: Cave of Being

entries.original:
"A mysterious cave said to have a
connection to the Sinnoh region.
Unfortunately, it has remained
empty for years."
entries.translation_source: A mysterious cave said to have a connection to the Sinnoh region. Unfortunately, it has remained empty for years.

entries.original: "Cinder Volcano"
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano

entries.original:
"A dangerous active volcano
overlooking Routes 4 and 5.
Legends say a powerful Pokémon
roosts at the summit."
entries.translation_source: A dangerous active volcano overlooking Routes 4 and 5. Legends say a powerful Pokémon roosts at the summit.

entries.original: "[green]Gyaoo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gyaoo!
entries.translated: [green]Gyaoo!

entries.original: "[green]Gwogobo gwobobobo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gwogobo gwobobobo!
entries.translated: [green]Gogobo gogobobo!

entries.original: "[green]Grrgggrrrrah!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Grrgggrrrrah!
entries.translated: [green]Grrgggrrrrah!

entries.original:
"[black]Volcanion filled itself with steam
and increased its size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Volcanion filled itself with steam and increased its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Volcanion mengisi dirinya dengan
uap dan meningkatkan ukurannya!

entries.original: "[black]The [buffer1] flew away!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] flew away!
entries.translated: [black]Si [buffer1] terbang pergi!

entries.original: "[black]The [buffer1] dove into the magma."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] dove into the magma.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] menyelam ke dalam magma.

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] receded into the magma."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] receded into the magma.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] tenggelam ke dalam magma.

entries.original: "Call out to [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Call out to [buffer1-1]?
entries.translated: Panggil [buffer1]?

entries.original: "Sankren bolganone!"
entries.translation_source: Sankren bolganone!
entries.translated: Sankren bolganone!

entries.original:
"[player]’s Red Orb suddenly
began glowing!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]’s Red Orb suddenly began glowing!
entries.translated:
Bola Merah milik [player] tiba-tiba
mulai bersinar!

entries.original:
"PRESSURE IS
THE KEY."
entries.translation_source: PRESSURE IS THE KEY.
entries.translated: Tekanan adalah kuncinya.

entries.original:
"This tablet\.
What could it be?

I’m sure the answer will reveal
itself someday soon\."
entries.translation_source: This tablet[game-token-1] What could it be? I’m sure the answer will reveal itself someday soon[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Tablet ini\. Apa itu? Saya yakin
jawabannya akan terungkap suatu\lhari nanti\.

entries.original:
"The tablet!

I was studying it when, all of a
sudden, it collapsed before my\lvery eyes!

What could this mean?
Is it a sign?

Or, perhaps, was this your doing?"
entries.translation_source: The tablet! I was studying it when, all of a sudden, it collapsed before my very eyes! What could this mean? Is it a sign? Or, perhaps, was this your doing?
entries.translated:
Tablet itu! Saya sedang
mempelajarinya ketika tiba-tiba\ltablet itu runtuh di depan mataku

sendiri! Apa artinya ini? Apakah
ini sebuah pertanda? Atau, mungkin,\lini perbuatanmu?

entries.original:
"[black]It appears to be the remains of
what used to be a Shadow Warrior.

Remove the cloak and lay it
to rest?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]It appears to be the remains of what used to be a Shadow Warrior. Remove the cloak and lay it to rest?
entries.translated:
[black]Tampaknya ini adalah sisa-sisa dari
yang dulu adalah seorang Prajurit\lBayangan. Lepaskan jubahnya dan

istirahatkan?

entries.original:
"[black]The cloak was removed from the
Shadow Warrior."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The cloak was removed from the Shadow Warrior.
entries.translated:
[black]Jubah telah dilepaskan dari Shadow
Warrior.

entries.original:
"[black]The remains of the Shadow Warrior
fell apart, and its soul was laid\lto rest."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The remains of the Shadow Warrior fell apart, and its soul was laid to rest.
entries.translated:
[black]Sisa-sisa Prajurit Bayangan hancur,
dan jiwanya pun beristirahat dengan\ltenang.

entries.original:
"Be careful while exploring
the volcano.

There’s plenty of exposed magma
everywhere."
entries.translation_source: Be careful while exploring the volcano. There’s plenty of exposed magma everywhere.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati saat menjelajahi gunung
berapi. Ada banyak magma yang\lterbuka di mana-mana.

entries.original:
"There’s no such thing as a
bird-type Pokémon, is there?

No wonder I can’t find the
rare Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no such thing as a bird-type Pokémon, is there? No wonder I can’t find the rare Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang namanya Pokémon tipe
burung, kan? Pantas saja aku tidak\ldapat menemukan Pokémon langka itu!

entries.original:
"When one is this far into the
volcano, one should ask themself:\lshould I continue on, or go home?"
entries.translation_source: When one is this far into the volcano, one should ask themself: should I continue on, or go home?

entries.original:
"One does not simply decide in
an instant."
entries.translation_source: One does not simply decide in an instant.

entries.original: "Which way will you choose to go?"
entries.translation_source: Which way will you choose to go?
entries.translated: Jalan mana yang akan kamu pilih?

entries.original:
"This place is so hot.

It’s too easy to start a fire!"
entries.translation_source: This place is so hot. It’s too easy to start a fire!
entries.translated:
Tempat ini sangat panas. Terlalu
mudah untuk menyalakan api!

entries.original:
"I came here to train my Pokémon
that have a natural weakness to\lFire-types."
entries.translation_source: I came here to train my Pokémon that have a natural weakness to Fire-types.
entries.translated:
Saya datang ke sini untuk melatih
Pokémon saya yang memiliki\lkelemahan alami terhadap tipe Api.

entries.original:
"All these bridges were designed
to withstand the immense heat.

That’s why they’re red, as opposed
to the normal light blue."
entries.translation_source: All these bridges were designed to withstand the immense heat. That’s why they’re red, as opposed to the normal light blue.
entries.translated:
Semua jembatan ini dirancang untuk
menahan panas yang sangat besar.\lItulah mengapa mereka berwarna

merah, berbeda dengan warna biru
muda biasa.

entries.original:
"I have secluded myself in this cave
to train my mind and body.

Bring your worst!"
entries.translation_source: I have secluded myself in this cave to train my mind and body. Bring your worst!

entries.original: "I must not have trained enough."
entries.translation_source: I must not have trained enough.

entries.original:
"I will continue to train.

Someday, I will become the
ultimate warrior."
entries.translation_source: I will continue to train. Someday, I will become the ultimate warrior.
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus berlatih. Suatu
hari, aku akan menjadi petarung\lyang paling hebat.

entries.original:
"The lava here is the inspiration
for all my greatest works."
entries.translation_source: The lava here is the inspiration for all my greatest works.
entries.translated:
Lava di sini adalah inspirasi untuk
semua karya terbesarku.

entries.original:
"I will unravel the secrets of
Cinder Volcano!"
entries.translation_source: I will unravel the secrets of Cinder Volcano!
entries.translated:
Aku akan mengungkap rahasia Gunung
Berapi Cinder!

entries.original:
"I’m going to stay rooted to this
spot for all of eternity."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to stay rooted to this spot for all of eternity.
entries.translated:
Aku akan tetap berakar di tempat
ini untuk selama-lamanya.

entries.original:
"Did you know?

The Slugma in this volcano burn
hotter than the sun!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know? The Slugma in this volcano burn hotter than the sun!

entries.original: "Ahhhhh! I’m melting!"
entries.translation_source: Ahhhhh! I’m melting!

entries.original:
"Who in their right mind would
believe that Slugma and Magcargo\lburn hotter than the sun?

We’d all roast alive if they did!"
entries.translation_source: Who in their right mind would believe that Slugma and Magcargo burn hotter than the sun? We’d all roast alive if they did!
entries.translated:
Siapa yang waras akan percaya bahwa
Slugma dan Magcargo lebih panas\ldari matahari? Kita semua akan

hangus hidup-hidup jika itu benar!

entries.original:
"Staring out into the vast ocean of
lava just melts my heart."
entries.translation_source: Staring out into the vast ocean of lava just melts my heart.
entries.translated:
Menatap lautan lava yang luas
benar-benar melelehkan hatiku.

entries.original:
"Sometimes I like to stare at Gems
like these to become one with the\lmagma.

You are deserving of this Gem."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes I like to stare at Gems like these to become one with the magma. You are deserving of this Gem.
entries.translated:
Kadang-kadang aku suka menatap Batu
Permata seperti ini untuk menyatu\ldengan magma. Kamu layak

mendapatkan Batu Permata ini.

entries.original:
"The magma is beautiful, isn’t it?

Sometimes I like to let my
[green]Fire[red]-type Pokémon take me for a\lride on it."
entries.translation_source: The magma is beautiful, isn’t it? Sometimes I like to let my [color-green-1]Fire[color-red-2]-type Pokémon take me for a ride on it.
entries.translated:
Magma itu indah, bukan?
Kadang-kadang aku suka membiarkan\lPokémon [green]Api[red]-tipeku membawaku

berkeliling di atasnya.

entries.original:
"The fact that you are here means
you have acquired at least four\lGym Badges.

But Badges alone are not enough to
prove your worth to me.

I will challenge you to a battle
if, and only if you defeat all\lother Trainers in Cinder Volcano."
entries.translation_source: The fact that you are here means you have acquired at least four Gym Badges. But Badges alone are not enough to prove your worth to me. I will challenge you to a battle if, and only if you defeat all other Trainers in Cinder Volcano.
entries.translated:
Fakta bahwa kamu di sini berarti
kamu telah memperoleh setidaknya\lempat Lencana Gym. Tetapi Lencana

saja tidak cukup untuk membuktikan
nilaimu di hadapanku. Aku akan\lmenantangmu bertarung jika, dan

hanya jika kamu mengalahkan semua
Pelatih lain di Cinder Volcano.

entries.original:
"The fact that you’re here means
you have acquired at least four\lGym Badges.

Now, show me the strength of a
Trainer with four Badges!"
entries.translation_source: The fact that you’re here means you have acquired at least four Gym Badges. Now, show me the strength of a Trainer with four Badges!
entries.translated:
Fakta bahwa kamu di sini berarti
kamu telah memperoleh setidaknya\lempat Lencana Gym. Sekarang,

tunjukkan padaku kekuatan seorang
Pelatih dengan empat Lencana!

entries.original: "Take this."
entries.translation_source: Take this.
entries.translated: Ambil ini.

entries.original:
"That is a gift for defeating me.

Give it to a [green]Camerupt[blue] and it will
be able to Mega Evolve in battle,\lassuming you have a Keystone."
entries.translation_source: That is a gift for defeating me. Give it to a [color-green-1]Camerupt[color-blue-2] and it will be able to Mega Evolve in battle, assuming you have a Keystone.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah hadiah karena
mengalahkanku. Berikan itu kepada\l[green]Camerupt[blue] dan ia akan dapat

melakukan Mega Evolusi dalam
pertarungan, asalkan kamu memiliki\lKeystone.

entries.original: "Cootes Bog"
entries.translation_source: Cootes Bog

entries.original: "Hunter of the Swamp"
entries.translation_source: Hunter of the Swamp
entries.translated: Pemburu Rawa

entries.original:
"Help a scientist learn about the
Pokémon living in Cootes Bog! Use
the DexNav to help catch them all."
entries.translation_source: Help a scientist learn about the Pokémon living in Cootes Bog! Use the DexNav to help catch them all.

entries.original:
"Hi, Trainer.

Oh! I see you possess a DexNav.
I have just the task for you.

Would you use your DexNav to aid
yourself in the capture of all of\lthe Pokémon that live in this area?

I want to know all about the
Pokémon that live in Cootes Bog."
entries.translation_source: Hi, Trainer. Oh! I see you possess a DexNav. I have just the task for you. Would you use your DexNav to aid yourself in the capture of all of the Pokémon that live in this area? I want to know all about the Pokémon that live in Cootes Bog.
entries.translated:
Hai, Pelatih. Oh! Aku lihat kamu
memiliki DexNav. Aku punya tugas\lyang tepat untukmu. Maukah kamu

menggunakan DexNav-mu untuk
membantu dirimu sendiri menangkap\lsemua Pokémon yang tinggal di area

ini? Aku ingin tahu semua tentang
Pokémon yang tinggal di Cootes Bog.

entries.original:
"Hi, Trainer.

If you acquire a DexNav, would you
come back and speak with me?

I have a task only capable of
being completed by a Trainer\lpossessing a DexNav."
entries.translation_source: Hi, Trainer. If you acquire a DexNav, would you come back and speak with me? I have a task only capable of being completed by a Trainer possessing a DexNav.
entries.translated:
Hai, Pelatih. Jika kamu mendapatkan
DexNav, maukah kamu kembali dan\lberbicara denganku? Aku punya tugas

yang hanya bisa diselesaikan oleh
seorang Pelatih yang memiliki\lDexNav.

entries.original:
"Perfect!

Please report back to me when your
DexNav indicates that all of the\lPokémon here have been caught."
entries.translation_source: Perfect! Please report back to me when your DexNav indicates that all of the Pokémon here have been caught.
entries.translated:
Sempurna! Tolong laporkan kembali
kepadaku ketika DexNav-mu\lmenunjukkan bahwa semua Pokémon di

sini telah tertangkap.

entries.original:
"It seems you are not as interested
in your DexNav as I am, I suppose."
entries.translation_source: It seems you are not as interested in your DexNav as I am, I suppose.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak terlalu
tertarik pada DexNav-mu seperti\laku, kurasa.

entries.original:
"Your DexNav shows that you’ve
caught all of the Pokémon that\llive in the swamp!

Perfect!
This is my thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Your DexNav shows that you’ve caught all of the Pokémon that live in the swamp! Perfect! This is my thanks!
entries.translated:
DexNav-mu menunjukkan bahwa kamu
telah menangkap semua Pokémon yang\ltinggal di rawa! Sempurna! Ini

adalah terima kasihku!

entries.original: "And let me modify your DexNav, too!"
entries.translation_source: And let me modify your DexNav, too!
entries.translated:
Dan biarkan aku memodifikasi
DexNav-mu juga!

entries.original:
"[black]The DexNav has been upgraded to
show possible held items!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The DexNav has been upgraded to show possible held items!
entries.translated:
[black]DexNav telah ditingkatkan untuk
menampilkan kemungkinan item yang\ldibawa!

entries.original:
"Your DexNav shows that there are
still some Pokémon here you\lhaven’t caught, yet.

Keep on hunting!"
entries.translation_source: Your DexNav shows that there are still some Pokémon here you haven’t caught, yet. Keep on hunting!
entries.translated:
DexNav-mu menunjukkan bahwa masih
ada beberapa Pokémon di sini yang\lbelum kamu tangkap. Teruslah

berburu!

entries.original:
"Finding all of the Pokémon that can
be found in the swamp is amazing!"
entries.translation_source: Finding all of the Pokémon that can be found in the swamp is amazing!
entries.translated:
Menemukan semua Pokémon yang dapat
ditemukan di rawa itu luar biasa!

entries.original:
"This is the path through the bog.

You can take it to get to
Crystal Peak.

If you want to take the bridge
path, go back."
entries.translation_source: This is the path through the bog. You can take it to get to Crystal Peak. If you want to take the bridge path, go back.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah jalan melalui rawa. Kamu
bisa melewatinya untuk sampai ke\lPuncak Kristal. Jika kamu ingin

melewati jalan jembatan,
kembalilah.

entries.original:
"This swamp is watched over by one
of Tessy’s Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: This swamp is watched over by one of Tessy’s Pokémon.

entries.original:
"It’s a good thing I am not the only
one watching over this swamp."
entries.translation_source: It’s a good thing I am not the only one watching over this swamp.

entries.original:
"We Rangers assist the swamp’s
protector by any means necessary."
entries.translation_source: We Rangers assist the swamp’s protector by any means necessary.
entries.translated:
Kami para Ranger membantu pelindung
rawa dengan segala cara yang\ldiperlukan.

entries.original:
"This swamp has so many places
to hide, who knows what might\lbe hidden here?"
entries.translation_source: This swamp has so many places to hide, who knows what might be hidden here?
entries.translated:
Rawa ini memiliki begitu banyak
tempat untuk bersembunyi, siapa\ltahu apa yang mungkin tersembunyi

di sini?

entries.original:
"This swamp is really a living being
with a powerful spirit."
entries.translation_source: This swamp is really a living being with a powerful spirit.

entries.original:
"The spirit of the swamp is
with you."
entries.translation_source: The spirit of the swamp is with you.

entries.original:
"We must respect the spirit of the
swamp, so don’t litter."
entries.translation_source: We must respect the spirit of the swamp, so don’t litter.
entries.translated:
Kita harus menghormati roh rawa,
jadi jangan membuang sampah\lsembarangan.

entries.original:
"I hope my method is approved by
PETP: People for the Ethical\lTreatment of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I hope my method is approved by PETP: People for the Ethical Treatment of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Saya harap metode saya disetujui
oleh PETP: Masyarakat untuk\lPerlakuan Etis terhadap Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A picnic in a swamp?

Yuck!
Who’d want to do that?"
entries.translation_source: A picnic in a swamp? Yuck! Who’d want to do that?

entries.original: "I’m just here to train my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I’m just here to train my Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Swamps: good to play with Pokémon
in, not to eat in."
entries.translation_source: Swamps: good to play with Pokémon in, not to eat in.
entries.translated:
Rawa: bagus untuk bermain dengan
Pokémon di dalamnya, bukan untuk\lmakan di dalamnya.

entries.original:
"More pretty flowers will make
anything pretty, even an icky\lswamp such as this one."
entries.translation_source: More pretty flowers will make anything pretty, even an icky swamp such as this one.
entries.translated:
Bunga yang lebih cantik akan
membuat apa pun menjadi cantik,\lbahkan rawa yang menjijikkan

seperti ini.

entries.original:
"Just over yonder is the entrance to
Crystal Peak."
entries.translation_source: Just over yonder is the entrance to Crystal Peak.

entries.original:
"Wow!
Go right on ahead to Crystal Peak!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Go right on ahead to Crystal Peak!

entries.original:
"Just go up that waterfall, and
you’re at the base of Crystal Peak."
entries.translation_source: Just go up that waterfall, and you’re at the base of Crystal Peak.
entries.translated:
Naik saja air terjun itu, dan kamu
akan sampai di dasar Puncak\lKristal.

entries.original:
"Have you ever used the
KBT Expressway?

It’s an underground highway that
goes around most of West Borrius!

The acronym \qoKBT\qc is short for
King Borrius the Third.

He was the king of Borrius that
created the concept of a region-\lwide highway."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever used the KBT Expressway? It’s an underground highway that goes around most of West Borrius! The acronym [quote-open-1]KBT[quote-close-2] is short for King Borrius the Third. He was the king of Borrius that created the concept of a region- wide highway.
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu menggunakan Jalan
Tol KBT? Itu adalah jalan raya\lbawah tanah yang melingkari

sebagian besar West Borrius!
Akronim \qoKBT\qc adalah singkatan dari\lRaja Borrius yang Ketiga. Dialah

raja Borrius yang menciptakan
konsep jalan raya se-region.

entries.original:
"The meteorites in Crater Town
are imbued with some sort of\lcosmic power.

They say that if a certain Pokémon
comes in contact with one, strange\lthings will happen."
entries.translation_source: The meteorites in Crater Town are imbued with some sort of cosmic power. They say that if a certain Pokémon comes in contact with one, strange things will happen.
entries.translated:
Meteorit di Kota Kawah diisi dengan
semacam kekuatan kosmik. Konon jika\lPokémon tertentu bersentuhan dengan

salah satunya, hal-hal aneh akan
terjadi.

entries.original:
"This cave takes you out of town
to Route 6.

From there, it’s a straight shot
through Route 7, up Frost Mountain,\land up Route 8 to [green]Blizzard City[blue].

If you’re going to hike all the way
up there, make sure you have many\lPoké Balls for catching Pokémon.

Most people don’t go that way,
though, since they don’t have the\l[green]Vision Badge[blue].

Without it, they can’t cut down
that [green]Skinny Tree[blue] in front of the\lentrance."
entries.translation_source: This cave takes you out of town to Route 6. From there, it’s a straight shot through Route 7, up Frost Mountain, and up Route 8 to [color-green-1]Blizzard City[color-blue-2]. If you’re going to hike all the way up there, make sure you have many Poké Balls for catching Pokémon. Most people don’t go that way, though, since they don’t have the [color-green-3]Vision Badge[color-blue-4]. Without it, they can’t cut down that [color-green-5]Skinny Tree[color-blue-6] in front of the entrance.
entries.translated:
Gua ini membawamu keluar kota
menuju Rute 6. Dari sana,\lperjalanan lurus melalui Rute 7,

naik ke Gunung Frost, dan sampai
Rute 8 menuju [green]Kota Blizzard[blue]. Jika\lkamu akan mendaki sampai ke sana,

pastikan kamu memiliki banyak Poké
Ball untuk menangkap Pokémon.\lKebanyakan orang tidak pergi ke

arah itu, karena mereka tidak
memiliki [green]Lencana Visi[blue]. Tanpa itu,\lmereka tidak bisa menebang [green]Pohon

Kurus[blue] di depan pintu masuk.

entries.original:
"That cave down there takes you out
of town to Route 6.

From there, it’s a straight shot
through Route 7, up Frost Mountain,\land up Route 8 to [green]Blizzard City[blue].

If you’re going to hike all the way
up there, make sure you have many\lPoké Balls for catching Pokémon.

Now that the Skinny Tree blocking
it has been cut down, it is much\lmore frequently used."
entries.translation_source: That cave down there takes you out of town to Route 6. From there, it’s a straight shot through Route 7, up Frost Mountain, and up Route 8 to [color-green-1]Blizzard City[color-blue-2]. If you’re going to hike all the way up there, make sure you have many Poké Balls for catching Pokémon. Now that the Skinny Tree blocking it has been cut down, it is much more frequently used.
entries.translated:
Gua di bawah sana membawamu keluar
kota menuju Rute 6. Dari sana,\lperjalanan lurus melalui Rute 7,

naik ke Gunung Frost, dan naik Rute
8 ke [green]Kota Badai Salju[blue]. Jika kamu\lakan mendaki sampai ke sana,

pastikan kamu memiliki banyak Bola
Poké untuk menangkap Pokémon.\lSekarang setelah Pohon Kurus yang

menghalanginya telah ditebang,
tempat itu lebih sering digunakan.

entries.original:
"I heard there’s someone in
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] who teaches\lthe art of [green]Mega Evolution[red]!"
entries.translation_source: I heard there’s someone in [color-green-1]Tarmigan Town[color-red-2] who teaches the art of [color-green-3]Mega Evolution[color-red-4]!
entries.translated:
Saya dengar ada seseorang di
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] yang mengajarkan seni\l[green]Evolusi Mega[red]!

entries.original:
"I heard there’s someone in
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] who teaches\lthe art of [green]Mega Evolution[red]!

But you already knew that,
didn’t you?

That [buffer1] you’re wearing
gave it away."
entries.translation_source: I heard there’s someone in [color-green-1]Tarmigan Town[color-red-2] who teaches the art of [color-green-3]Mega Evolution[color-red-4]! But you already knew that, didn’t you? That [buffer1-5] you’re wearing gave it away.
entries.translated:
Aku dengar ada seseorang di
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] yang mengajarkan seni\l[green]Mega Evolusi[red]! Tapi kau sudah tahu

itu, kan? [buffer1] yang kau pakai
itu mengungkapkannya.

entries.original:
"Didja know that if you talk to the
Gym referees before beating the\lGym Leader, they’ll give you a\lfree gift?

Didja? Didja?"
entries.translation_source: Didja know that if you talk to the Gym referees before beating the Gym Leader, they’ll give you a free gift? Didja? Didja?
entries.translated:
Tahu nggak, kalau kamu bicara
dengan wasit Gym sebelum\lmengalahkan Pemimpin Gym, mereka

akan memberimu hadiah gratis? Tahu?
Tahu?

entries.original:
"Well, then, didja know that if you
talk to the Gym referees after\lbeating the Gym Leader, they’ll\lgive you a gift then, too?

Didja? Didja?"
entries.translation_source: Well, then, didja know that if you talk to the Gym referees after beating the Gym Leader, they’ll give you a gift then, too? Didja? Didja?
entries.translated:
Nah, kalau begitu, tahu nggak kalau
kamu bicara dengan wasit Gym\lsetelah mengalahkan Pemimpin Gym,

mereka juga akan memberikan hadiah?
Tahu? Tahu?

entries.original: "You learn something new every day!"
entries.translation_source: You learn something new every day!
entries.translated:
Kamu belajar sesuatu yang baru
setiap hari!

entries.original: "Oh, look at you, smarty pants."
entries.translation_source: Oh, look at you, smarty pants.
entries.translated: Oh, lihat dirimu, si pintar.

entries.translated: Major Miner

entries.original:
"Use the ADM to dig through the
collapsed doorways in the KBT
Expressway, and capture [buffer1] Carbink."
entries.translation_source: Use the ADM to dig through the collapsed doorways in the KBT Expressway, and capture [buffer1-1] Carbink.

entries.original:
"There are rumours of rare Pokémon
known as [green]Carbink[blue] appearing in\lthe KBT Expressway.

However, the rumours indicate
that they can only be found\lbehind the collapsed doorways\lthat litter the tunnel.

If only there were some way to
[green]mine[blue] through the rubble\."
entries.translation_source: There are rumours of rare Pokémon known as [color-green-1]Carbink[color-blue-2] appearing in the KBT Expressway. However, the rumours indicate that they can only be found behind the collapsed doorways that litter the tunnel. If only there were some way to [color-green-3]mine[color-blue-4] through the rubble[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Ada rumor tentang Pokémon langka
yang dikenal sebagai [green]Carbink[blue] yang\lmuncul di KBT Expressway. Namun,

rumor tersebut menunjukkan bahwa
mereka hanya dapat ditemukan di\lbalik pintu yang runtuh yang

berserakan di terowongan. Andai
saja ada cara untuk [green]menambang[blue]\lmelalui puing-puing\.

entries.original:
"That ADM you own, it’s just the
machine I’m searching for!

I’m looking for a way to destroy
the collapsed doorways that litter\lthe KBT Expressway, and you can\lprovide me just the method!

Please, use your [green]ADM[blue] and assist
me in my task!"
entries.translation_source: That ADM you own, it’s just the machine I’m searching for! I’m looking for a way to destroy the collapsed doorways that litter the KBT Expressway, and you can provide me just the method! Please, use your [color-green-1]ADM[color-blue-2] and assist me in my task!
entries.translated:
ADM yang kamu miliki, itulah mesin
yang aku cari! Aku sedang mencari\lcara untuk menghancurkan pintu yang

runtuh yang berserakan di KBT
Expressway, dan kamu bisa\lmemberikanku cara yang tepat!

Tolong, gunakan [green]ADM[blue] milikmu dan
bantu aku dalam tugas ini!

entries.original:
"Splendid!

My task involves the following:
destroy the [green]collapsed doorways[blue]\lthat litter the [green]KBT Expressway[blue]\lusing your [green]ADM[blue] and capture\l[green]3 Carbink[blue], starting now.

In order to break down a doorway,
you’ll need to charge your ADM\lfirst.

If you charge up your ADM with [green]3
Light Clay[blue], it will be powerful\lenough to destroy the rubble!

Where do you find Light Clay?

It has a decent chance of appearing
when you mine in the walls of the\lKBT Expressway.

Once you have done that, please
return to me for a reward."
entries.translation_source: Splendid! My task involves the following: destroy the [color-green-1]collapsed doorways[color-blue-2] that litter the [color-green-3]KBT Expressway[color-blue-4] using your [color-green-5]ADM[color-blue-6] and capture [color-green-7]3 Carbink[color-blue-8], starting now. In order to break down a doorway, you’ll need to charge your ADM first. If you charge up your ADM with [color-green-9]3 Light Clay[color-blue-10], it will be powerful enough to destroy the rubble! Where do you find Light Clay? It has a decent chance of appearing when you mine in the walls of the KBT Expressway. Once you have done that, please return to me for a reward.
entries.translated:
Hebat! Tugasku meliputi: hancurkan
[green]pintu yang runtuh[blue] yang berserakan\ldi [green]KBT Expressway[blue] menggunakan [green]ADM[blue]

milikmu dan tangkap [green]3 Carbink[blue],
mulai sekarang. Untuk merobohkan\lpintu, kamu perlu mengisi daya

ADM-mu terlebih dahulu. Jika kamu
mengisi ADM-mu dengan [green]3 Light Clay[blue],\litu akan cukup kuat untuk

menghancurkan puing-puing! Di mana
kamu menemukan Light Clay? Itu\lmemiliki peluang yang cukup besar

untuk muncul saat kamu menambang di
dinding KBT Expressway. Setelah\lkamu melakukannya, kembalilah

padaku untuk mendapatkan hadiah.

entries.original:
"Not very splendid.

You are the only Trainer I am aware
of that has purchased an ADM.

Without you, my purpose here
is meaningless."
entries.translation_source: Not very splendid. You are the only Trainer I am aware of that has purchased an ADM. Without you, my purpose here is meaningless.
entries.translated:
Tidak terlalu hebat. Kamu
satu-satunya Pelatih yang aku tahu\lyang telah membeli ADM. Tanpamu,

tujuanku di sini tidak berarti.

entries.original:
"Destroy the [green]collapsed doorways[blue]
that litter the [green]KBT Expressway[blue]\lusing your [green]ADM[blue] and capture\lat least [green][buffer1] more Carbink[blue].

In order to break down a doorway,
you’ll need to charge your ADM\lfirst.

If you charge up your ADM with [green]3
Light Clay[blue], it will be powerful\lenough to destroy the rubble!

Where do you find Light Clay?

It has a decent chance of appearing
when you mine in the walls of the\lKBT Expressway.

Once you have done that, please
return to me for a reward."
entries.translation_source: Destroy the [color-green-1]collapsed doorways[color-blue-2] that litter the [color-green-3]KBT Expressway[color-blue-4] using your [color-green-5]ADM[color-blue-6] and capture at least [color-green-7][buffer1-8] more Carbink[color-blue-9]. In order to break down a doorway, you’ll need to charge your ADM first. If you charge up your ADM with [color-green-10]3 Light Clay[color-blue-11], it will be powerful enough to destroy the rubble! Where do you find Light Clay? It has a decent chance of appearing when you mine in the walls of the KBT Expressway. Once you have done that, please return to me for a reward.
entries.translated:
Hancurkan [green]pintu yang runtuh[blue] yang
berserakan di [green]KBT Expressway[blue]\lmenggunakan [green]ADM[blue] milikmu dan tangkap

setidaknya [green][buffer1] Carbink lagi[blue].
Untuk merobohkan pintu, kamu perlu\lmengisi daya ADM-mu terlebih

dahulu. Jika kamu mengisi ADM-mu
dengan [green]3 Light Clay[blue], itu akan cukup\lkuat untuk menghancurkan

puing-puing! Di mana kamu menemukan
Light Clay? Itu memiliki peluang\lyang cukup besar untuk muncul saat

kamu menambang di dinding KBT
Expressway. Setelah kamu\lmelakukannya, kembalilah padaku

untuk mendapatkan hadiah.

entries.original:
"You and your ADM have done
wonderful work!

Please, accept this, a rare
Mega Stone!"
entries.translation_source: You and your ADM have done wonderful work! Please, accept this, a rare Mega Stone!
entries.translated:
Kamu dan ADM-mu telah melakukan
pekerjaan yang luar biasa! Silakan,\lterimalah ini, sebuah Batu Mega

yang langka!

entries.original:
"The true reward for my task still
lies within the KBT Expressway.

I would not be surprised if a
certain Pokémon appeared in one\lof those caves some day soon\."
entries.translation_source: The true reward for my task still lies within the KBT Expressway. I would not be surprised if a certain Pokémon appeared in one of those caves some day soon[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Hadiah sebenarnya dari tugasku
masih terletak di dalam KBT\lExpressway. Aku tidak akan terkejut

jika suatu Pokémon tertentu muncul
di salah satu gua itu suatu hari\lnanti\.

entries.translated: [green]Weeeeooooweeeeeeeeoooo!

entries.original:

[green][buffer1][red]! They said there’s

entries.translation_source: You know what I saw on TV? [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]! They said there’s a whole bunch of [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-red-6] there!
entries.translated:
Kau tahu apa yang kulihat di TV?
[green][buffer1][red]! Mereka bilang ada banyak\l[green][buffer2][red] di sana!

"You know what it said on
the radio?

[green][buffer1][red]! They said there’s
a whole bunch of [green][buffer2][red] there!"

entries.translated:
Kamu tahu apa yang dikatakan di
radio? [green][buffer1][red]! Mereka bilang ada\lbanyak sekali [green][buffer2][red] di sana!

entries.original:
"[black]It’s an old radio.

It’s broadcasting something about
Pokémon Swarms."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]It’s an old radio. It’s broadcasting something about Pokémon Swarms.
entries.translated:
[black]Itu radio tua. Itu menyiarkan
sesuatu tentang Kawanan Pokémon.

entries.original:
"My daughter loves [buffer1].

I’d set a time limit, but if it
weren’t for her, my son would never\lknow when Pokémon [green]Swarms[red] appear!

And it’s not like those Pokémon
are easy to find any other time\."
entries.translation_source: My daughter loves [buffer1-1]. I’d set a time limit, but if it weren’t for her, my son would never know when Pokémon [color-green-2]Swarms[color-red-3] appear! And it’s not like those Pokémon are easy to find any other time[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Putri saya suka [buffer1]. Saya akan
menetapkan batas waktu, tetapi jika\lbukan karena dia, putra saya tidak

akan pernah tahu kapan Pokémon
[green]Kerumunan[red] muncul! Dan bukan berarti\lPokémon tersebut mudah ditemukan di

waktu lain\.

entries.original:
"listening to
the radio"
entries.translation_source: listening to the radio

entries.original:
"Every hour, different groups of
Pokémon roam around Borrius.

My daughter loves hearing about
these Pokémon on [buffer2], and\lshe’s been dying to meet\lone of them.

You don’t by any chance happen to
have a [green][buffer1][blue], do you?

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Every hour, different groups of Pokémon roam around Borrius. My daughter loves hearing about these Pokémon on [buffer2-1], and she’s been dying to meet one of them. You don’t by any chance happen to have a [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4], do you? *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Setiap jam, kelompok Pokémon yang
berbeda berkeliaran di sekitar\lBorrius. Putri saya suka mendengar

tentang Pokémon ini di [buffer2],
dan dia sangat ingin bertemu salah\lsatunya. Kamu tidak kebetulan

entries.original:
"Twenty years ago, a large meteorite
was hurtling towards Borrius.

The astronomers at Cube Corp.
predicted that if it wasn’t\lstopped, it would fall directly on\lValley City, this city, and end all\llife living here.

With great haste, we began our
evacuation of the city.

As we were about to make our escape
through the KBT Expressway, we\lheard the news.

The meteorite was now predicted to
crush half of the region!

If we attempted to flee
underground, there would be a\llarge chance we’d be buried alive.

Chaos ensued.

All was thought hopeless\. until
HE arrived.

[green]Aros[blue], the legend.

He arrived alongside a small Pokémon
he used to teleport everyone to\lEast Borrius, safe from harm.

He planned to attack the meteorite
head on and smash it to bits.

Once he had transported everyone to
safety, it is said that he rode on\la Rayquaza and smashed into\lthe meteorite!

It shattered, and most of the
smaller fragments fell on\lValley City.

The city was destroyed, but Aros
had saved a region.

I will never forget the heroic act
that man performed."
entries.translation_source: Twenty years ago, a large meteorite was hurtling towards Borrius. The astronomers at Cube Corp. predicted that if it wasn’t stopped, it would fall directly on Valley City, this city, and end all life living here. With great haste, we began our evacuation of the city. As we were about to make our escape through the KBT Expressway, we heard the news. The meteorite was now predicted to crush half of the region! If we attempted to flee underground, there would be a large chance we’d be buried alive. Chaos ensued. All was thought hopeless[game-token-1] until HE arrived. [color-green-2]Aros[color-blue-3], the legend. He arrived alongside a small Pokémon he used to teleport everyone to East Borrius, safe from harm. He planned to attack the meteorite head on and smash it to bits. Once he had transported everyone to safety, it is said that he rode on a Rayquaza and smashed into the meteorite! It shattered, and most of the smaller fragments fell on Valley City. The city was destroyed, but Aros had saved a region. I will never forget the heroic act that man performed.
entries.translated:
Dua puluh tahun yang lalu, sebuah
meteor besar meluncur ke arah\lBorrius. Para astronom di Cube

Corp. memprediksi bahwa jika tidak
dihentikan, meteor itu akan jatuh\llangsung di Valley City, kota ini,

dan mengakhiri semua kehidupan yang
tinggal di sini. Dengan\ltergesa-gesa, kami memulai evakuasi

kota. Saat kami hendak melarikan
diri melalui KBT Expressway, kami\lmendengar berita itu. Meteor itu

sekarang diprediksi akan
menghancurkan setengah dari\lwilayah! Jika kami mencoba

melarikan diri ke bawah tanah,
kemungkinan besar kami akan\lterkubur hidup-hidup. Kekacauan

terjadi. Semua dianggap sia-sia\.
sampai DIA tiba. [green]Aros[blue], sang\llegenda. Dia tiba bersama seekor

Pokémon kecil yang digunakannya
untuk teleport semua orang ke East\lBorrius, aman dari bahaya. Dia

berencana menyerang meteor itu
secara langsung dan\lmenghancurkannya menjadi

berkeping-keping. Setelah dia
memindahkan semua orang ke tempat\laman, dikatakan bahwa dia

menunggangi Rayquaza dan menabrak
meteor itu! Meteor itu hancur, dan\lsebagian besar pecahan kecilnya

jatuh di Valley City. Kota itu
hancur, tetapi Aros telah\lmenyelamatkan sebuah wilayah. Aku

tidak akan pernah melupakan
tindakan heroik yang dilakukan pria\litu.

entries.original:
"Following the meteorite strike all
those years ago, two Pokémon were\ldiscovered to have landed on Earth.

One of them was a very powerful
Pokémon capable of granting any\lwish the heart desired.

At first, the townspeople and I
thought this was wonderful!

We could use it to restore our
broken city!

However, we soon learned that all
our wishes came at a cost.

Fearing an even more devastating
outcome, we locked up this Pokémon.

But now that the [buffer2] of Aros
has become Champion, I feel that it\lis fitting we bestow this Pokémon\lunto you.

Would you care to give this
Pokémon a loving home?"
entries.translation_source: Following the meteorite strike all those years ago, two Pokémon were discovered to have landed on Earth. One of them was a very powerful Pokémon capable of granting any wish the heart desired. At first, the townspeople and I thought this was wonderful! We could use it to restore our broken city! However, we soon learned that all our wishes came at a cost. Fearing an even more devastating outcome, we locked up this Pokémon. But now that the [buffer2-1] of Aros has become Champion, I feel that it is fitting we bestow this Pokémon unto you. Would you care to give this Pokémon a loving home?
entries.translated:
Setelah hantaman meteorit
bertahun-tahun yang lalu, dua\lPokémon ditemukan telah mendarat di

Bumi. Salah satunya adalah Pokémon
yang sangat kuat, mampu mengabulkan\lkeinginan apa pun yang diinginkan

hati. Pada awalnya, penduduk kota
dan saya mengira ini luar biasa!\lKami bisa menggunakannya untuk

memulihkan kota kami yang hancur!
Namun, kami segera menyadari bahwa\lsemua keinginan kami ada harganya.

Karena takut akan hasil yang lebih
buruk, kami mengurung Pokémon ini.\lTapi sekarang karena [buffer2] dari

Aros telah menjadi Juara, saya
merasa sudah sepantasnya kami\lmenganugerahkan Pokémon ini

kepadamu. Maukah kamu memberikan
rumah yang penuh kasih sayang\lkepada Pokémon ini?

entries.original:
"The tallest mountain in Borrius.
It gets its name from the large
crystal found at its peak.
The crystals found here are said to
give off immense amounts of energy."
entries.translation_source: The tallest mountain in Borrius. It gets its name from the large crystal found at its peak. The crystals found here are said to give off immense amounts of energy.

entries.original:
"FOUR HOLES.
PATIENCE IN
THE CENTRE
IS THE KEY."
entries.translation_source: FOUR HOLES. PATIENCE IN THE CENTRE IS THE KEY.
entries.translated:
EMPAT LUBANG. KESABARAN DI PUSAT
ADALAH KUNCI.

entries.original:
"Hrm\.

This doohickey\. how do I use\.?"
entries.translation_source: Hrm[game-token-1] This doohickey[game-token-2] how do I use[game-token-3]?
entries.translated:
Hrm\. Benda ini\. bagaimana cara
menggunakannya\.?

entries.original:
"Ooh, hello ’dere\.

Just learned how to use these
totem doohickeys I did, yes, yes.

Learn do you want, too?"
entries.translation_source: Ooh, hello ’dere[game-token-1] Just learned how to use these totem doohickeys I did, yes, yes. Learn do you want, too?
entries.translated:
Ooh, halo di sana\. Baru saja belajar
cara menggunakan totem doohickey\lini saya, ya, ya. Belajar kamu juga

mau?

entries.original: "Over here you look now, yes, yes."
entries.translation_source: Over here you look now, yes, yes.
entries.translated:
Ke sini kamu lihat sekarang, ya,
ya.

entries.original:
"Now up goes the crystal, yes, yes.

And kablam!"
entries.translation_source: Now up goes the crystal, yes, yes. And kablam!
entries.translated:
Sekarang ke atas kristal naik, ya,
ya. Dan kablam!

entries.original:
"Disappeared all the blue crystals
have now, yes, yes.

Other totems do similar things I
believe, yes, yes."
entries.translation_source: Disappeared all the blue crystals have now, yes, yes. Other totems do similar things I believe, yes, yes.
entries.translated:
Hilang semua kristal biru sekarang,
ya, ya. Totem lain melakukan hal\lserupa saya percaya, ya, ya.

entries.original:
"If up go the crystals in the
totems, disappear other crystals\ldo, yes, yes!

If down go the crystals, come back
the other crystals, do, yes, yes."
entries.translation_source: If up go the crystals in the totems, disappear other crystals do, yes, yes! If down go the crystals, come back the other crystals, do, yes, yes.
entries.translated:
Jika ke atas kristal di totem naik,
menghilang kristal lain, ya, ya!\lJika ke bawah kristal turun,

kembali kristal lain, ya, ya.

entries.original: "Learn you will not, no, no."
entries.translation_source: Learn you will not, no, no.
entries.translated:
Belajar kamu tidak akan, tidak,
tidak.

entries.original:
"It’s a strange totem with a hole
in the centre.

What could it be for?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a strange totem with a hole in the centre. What could it be for?
entries.translated:
Ini totem aneh dengan lubang di
tengah. Untuk apa ya?

entries.original: "Slide the crystal upwards?"
entries.translation_source: Slide the crystal upwards?
entries.translated: Geser kristal ke atas?

entries.original: "Slide the crystal downwards?"
entries.translation_source: Slide the crystal downwards?
entries.translated: Geser kristal ke bawah?

entries.original:
"These crystals are just full of
wonders.

Dig in a little, and you’ll find
loads of Gems!

How about I share one with you?"
entries.translation_source: These crystals are just full of wonders. Dig in a little, and you’ll find loads of Gems! How about I share one with you?
entries.translated:
Kristal-kristal ini sungguh penuh
keajaiban. Gali sedikit, dan kamu\lakan menemukan banyak Permata!

Bagaimana kalau kubagikan satu
padamu?

entries.original:
"I dig for Gems in this room with my
ADM every single day.

If you have an ADM, you should dig
in here, too!

It’s the one place in Crystal Peak
that you can!"
entries.translation_source: I dig for Gems in this room with my ADM every single day. If you have an ADM, you should dig in here, too! It’s the one place in Crystal Peak that you can!
entries.translated:
Aku menggali Permata di ruangan ini
dengan ADM-ku setiap hari. Jika\lkamu punya ADM, kamu juga harus

menggali di sini! Ini satu-satunya
tempat di Crystal Peak yang bisa\lkamu lakukan!

entries.original: "One Purple Balloon"
entries.translation_source: One Purple Balloon
entries.translated: Satu Balon Ungu

entries.original:
"A little girl has been snatched up
by a Drifloon! Find her, and return
her safely to her worried mother."
entries.translation_source: A little girl has been snatched up by a Drifloon! Find her, and return her safely to her worried mother.

entries.original:
"[red]Oh heavens\.

My daughter, I can’t find her!

We were on holiday in this place
when all of a sudden, an evil\lPokémon carried her away!

I followed it out here, but I’ve
lost sight of it\.

Please, [buffer1], search for her!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh heavens[game-token-2] My daughter, I can’t find her! We were on holiday in this place when all of a sudden, an evil Pokémon carried her away! I followed it out here, but I’ve lost sight of it[game-token-3] Please, [buffer1-4], search for her!
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, astaga\. Putriku, aku tidak bisa
menemukannya! Kami sedang berlibur\ldi tempat ini ketika tiba-tiba,

seekor Pokémon jahat membawanya
pergi! Aku mengikutinya sampai ke\lsini, tapi aku kehilangan jejaknya\.

Tolong, [buffer1], carilah dia!

entries.original:
"[red]Thank you, [buffer1]!

She was taken by one of those evil
Pokémon\. [green]Drifloon[red]!

If you find the Drifloon, you will
find my daughter!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Thank you, [buffer1-2]! She was taken by one of those evil Pokémon[game-token-3] [color-green-4]Drifloon[color-red-5]! If you find the Drifloon, you will find my daughter!
entries.translated:
[red]Terima kasih, [buffer1]! Dia dibawa
oleh salah satu dari Pokémon jahat\litu\. [green]Drifloon[red]! Jika kamu menemukan

Drifloon, kamu akan menemukan
putriku!

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, dear\.

What will I do now\.?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh, dear[game-token-2] What will I do now[game-token-3]?
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, astaga\. Apa yang akan aku
lakukan sekarang\.?

entries.original:
"[red]Sniff\.

This scary balloon carried me
out here!

I wanna go home, but I’m too scared
to leave while it’s watching me\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Sniff[game-token-2] This scary balloon carried me out here! I wanna go home, but I’m too scared to leave while it’s watching me[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[red]Hiks\. Balon menakutkan ini membawaku
ke sini! Aku ingin pulang, tapi aku\lterlalu takut untuk pergi selama

dia mengawasiku\.

entries.original:
"[red]The scary balloon carried me back
to my mommy!

But I know when we turn around it
will grab me again!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]The scary balloon carried me back to my mommy! But I know when we turn around it will grab me again!
entries.translated:
[red]Balon menakutkan itu membawaku
kembali ke ibuku! Tapi aku tahu\lsaat kita berbalik, ia akan

menangkapku lagi!

entries.original: "[green]Floooooon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Floooooon!
entries.translated: [green]Floooooon!

entries.original:
"[black]The little girl was carried off
by the Drifloon."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little girl was carried off by the Drifloon.
entries.translated:
[black]Gadis kecil itu dibawa pergi oleh
Drifloon.

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, thank heavens you’re back!

This\. this\. evil Pokémon won’t
leave my daughter alone!

No matter what I do, it just
won’t\.\CC0820 go\.\CC0820 away\.\CC0820 urk\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh, thank heavens you’re back! This[game-token-2] this[game-token-3] evil Pokémon won’t leave my daughter alone! No matter what I do, it just won’t[game-token-4][control-code-5] go[game-token-6][control-code-7] away[game-token-8][control-code-9] urk[game-token-10]
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, syukurlah kau kembali! Pokémon
jahat ini\. ini\. tidak mau\lmeninggalkan putriku sendirian!

Tidak peduli apa yang kulakukan, ia
tidak mau\.\CC0820 pergi\.\CC0820 menjauh\.\CC0820 urk\.

entries.original:
"[black]The Ditto was carried off
by the Drifloon.

Oh?

It looks like the Ditto dropped
something before it disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Ditto was carried off by the Drifloon. Oh? It looks like the Ditto dropped something before it disappeared.
entries.translated:
[black]Ditto itu dibawa pergi oleh
Drifloon. Oh? Sepertinya Ditto\lmenjatuhkan sesuatu sebelum

menghilang.

My emeralds are on fiya!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

So hot!"
entries.translation_source: Watch me! Watch me! My emeralds are on fiya! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! So hot!
entries.translated:
Lihat aku! Lihat aku! Zamrudku
terbakar! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!\lSangat panas!

entries.original:
"The emerald was absorbed by
the Cube!"
entries.translation_source: The emerald was absorbed by the Cube!
entries.translated: Zamrud itu diserap oleh Kubus!
