entries.original:
"[player]’s Jade Orb suddenly
began glowing!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]’s Jade Orb suddenly began glowing!
entries.translated:
Batu Giok [player] tiba-tiba mulai
bersinar!

entries.original: "[green]Kiyuryursheeah!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Kiyuryursheeah!
entries.translated: [green]Kiyuryursheeah!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] flew away!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] flew away!
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] terbang pergi!

entries.original:
"That giant crystal at the summit is
definitely not the Ultimate Weapon\lin disguise.

No siree!"
entries.translation_source: That giant crystal at the summit is definitely not the Ultimate Weapon in disguise. No siree!
entries.translated:
Kristal raksasa di puncak itu jelas
bukan Senjata Pamungkas yang\lmenyamar. Tidak mungkin!

entries.original:
"[red]The Ultimate Weapon?

Never heard of it!

We’re just here to make friends
with the wild Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]The Ultimate Weapon? Never heard of it! We’re just here to make friends with the wild Pokémon!

entries.original: "Will you be our friend, too?"
entries.translation_source: Will you be our friend, too?

entries.original:
"[red]Okay, fine, I give.

We couldn’t care less about the
Pokémon living here.

It’s not like they’re going to be
around much longer anyway."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Okay, fine, I give. We couldn’t care less about the Pokémon living here. It’s not like they’re going to be around much longer anyway.
entries.translated:
[red]Baiklah, aku menyerah. Kami tidak
peduli dengan Pokémon yang tinggal\ldi sini. Lagipula mereka tidak akan

bertahan lama lagi.

entries.original:
"Aklove hired me himself.

He promised me untold riches if I
helped him, but I never got squat!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove hired me himself. He promised me untold riches if I helped him, but I never got squat!
entries.translated:
Aklove sendiri yang
mempekerjakanku. Dia menjanjikan\lkekayaan yang tak terhitung jika

aku membantunya, tapi aku tidak
mendapat apa-apa!

entries.original:
"[red]Now that I’ve failed my one job,
there’s nothing left for me to do.

I should just join some other
group\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Now that I’ve failed my one job, there’s nothing left for me to do. I should just join some other group[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang karena aku gagal dalam
satu tugasku, tidak ada lagi yang\lbisa kulakukan. Aku sebaiknya

bergabung dengan grup lain\.

entries.original:
"I bet you don’t remember me, huh?

You saved my hide from a Shadow
Warrior back at our base!

Allow me to not return that favour!"
entries.translation_source: I bet you don’t remember me, huh? You saved my hide from a Shadow Warrior back at our base! Allow me to not return that favour!

entries.original: "I don’t owe you anything."
entries.translation_source: I don’t owe you anything.

entries.original:
"You think I’d be grateful for your
help, right?

Feh\."
entries.translation_source: You think I’d be grateful for your help, right? Feh[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir aku akan berterima kasih
atas bantuanmu? Feh\.

entries.original:
"Why didn’t you Trainers just come
up together?

It would save us a whole lot of
trouble having to deal with you\lTrainers multiple times."
entries.translation_source: Why didn’t you Trainers just come up together? It would save us a whole lot of trouble having to deal with you Trainers multiple times.
entries.translated:
Kenapa kalian para Pelatih tidak
datang bersama-sama? Itu akan\lmenghemat banyak masalah bagi kami

yang harus menghadapi kalian
berkali-kali.

entries.original:
"You know that Pokémon Aklove walks
around with?

It gives me nightmares\."
entries.translation_source: You know that Pokémon Aklove walks around with? It gives me nightmares[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu Pokémon yang dibawa
Aklove kemana-mana? Itu membuatku\lmimpi buruk\.

entries.original:
"I’m from Hoenn.

So I’m all for decreasing the
landmass around here.

There just isn’t enough water,
y’know?"
entries.translation_source: I’m from Hoenn. So I’m all for decreasing the landmass around here. There just isn’t enough water, y’know?
entries.translated:
Aku dari Hoenn. Jadi aku setuju
untuk mengurangi luas daratan di\lsini. Airnya kurang, kau tahu?

entries.original:
"Aha!

Do you think Aklove left me with
nothing to use against you?

Surprise!"
entries.translation_source: Aha! Do you think Aklove left me with nothing to use against you? Surprise!
entries.translated:
Aha! Apa kau pikir Aklove
meninggalkanku tanpa apa pun untuk\lmelawanmu? Kejutan!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now stay in our prison for your
own safekeeping.

When the weapon goes off, this
mountain will be the only safe\lplace to be in Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now stay in our prison for your own safekeeping. When the weapon goes off, this mountain will be the only safe place to be in Borrius!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sekarang tetaplah di penjara kami
untuk keselamatanmu sendiri. Ketika\lsenjata itu meledak, gunung ini

akan menjadi satu-satunya tempat
aman di Borrius!

entries.original:
"Don’t let the ghost balloons carry
you away, child!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let the ghost balloons carry you away, child!
entries.translated:
Jangan biarkan balon hantu
membawamu pergi, Nak!

entries.original:
"The natural energy found here is
even stronger than electricity!"
entries.translation_source: The natural energy found here is even stronger than electricity!
entries.translated:
Energi alami yang ditemukan di sini
bahkan lebih kuat dari listrik!

entries.original:
"That giant crystal is said to have
mysteriously appeared on top of\lthis mountain centuries ago.

No one knows where it came from or
how it got there."
entries.translation_source: That giant crystal is said to have mysteriously appeared on top of this mountain centuries ago. No one knows where it came from or how it got there.
entries.translated:
Kristal raksasa itu dikatakan
muncul secara misterius di puncak\lgunung ini berabad-abad lalu. Tidak

ada yang tahu dari mana asalnya
atau bagaimana sampai di sana.

entries.original:
"Try not to be shocked when you lay
your eyes on my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Try not to be shocked when you lay your eyes on my Pokémon!

entries.original:
"A dragon Pokémon’s real power is
nothing like mine!"
entries.translation_source: A dragon Pokémon’s real power is nothing like mine!

entries.original:
"You again?

You must really like the dragon
Pokémon I use."
entries.translation_source: You again? You must really like the dragon Pokémon I use.
entries.translated:
Kamu lagi? Kamu pasti sangat suka
dengan Pokémon naga yang kugunakan.

entries.original:
"I train here to make my tough
Pokémon even tougher."
entries.translation_source: I train here to make my tough Pokémon even tougher.
entries.translated:
Saya berlatih di sini untuk membuat
Pokémon tangguh saya semakin\ltangguh.

entries.original:
"Huff\. Puff\.

I’m climbing up the mountain just
to show my friends I can!

You’ll be good practice on the
way up!"
entries.translation_source: Huff[game-token-1] Puff[game-token-2] I’m climbing up the mountain just to show my friends I can! You’ll be good practice on the way up!

entries.original:
"Huff\. Puff\.
I think I’m out of energy\."
entries.translation_source: Huff[game-token-1] Puff[game-token-2] I think I’m out of energy[game-token-3]

entries.original:
"Would you believe it if I told you
Crystal Peak was the tallest\lmountain in all of Borrius?"
entries.translation_source: Would you believe it if I told you Crystal Peak was the tallest mountain in all of Borrius?
entries.translated:
Percayakah Anda jika saya bilang
Crystal Peak adalah gunung\ltertinggi di seluruh Borrius?

entries.original:
"We’re representatives from
Cube Corp.!

We’re here to harness power for
our facility!"
entries.translation_source: We’re representatives from Cube Corp.! We’re here to harness power for our facility!

entries.original:
"The power we have wasn’t enough to
defeat you!"
entries.translation_source: The power we have wasn’t enough to defeat you!

entries.original:
"Stop by Cube Corp. sometime!

Using the energy only found here,
we’ve been able to put together\lsome truly wonderful products!"
entries.translation_source: Stop by Cube Corp. sometime! Using the energy only found here, we’ve been able to put together some truly wonderful products!
entries.translated:
Mampirlah ke Cube Corp. suatu saat!
Dengan menggunakan energi yang\lhanya ditemukan di sini, kami telah

berhasil merakit produk-produk yang
benar-benar luar biasa!

entries.original:
"I’ve been a proud member of Cube
Corp. since way back when it was\lowned by Mr. Zeph!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve been a proud member of Cube Corp. since way back when it was owned by Mr. Zeph!
entries.translated:
Saya telah menjadi anggota bangga
Cube Corp. sejak dulu saat masih\ldimiliki oleh Mr. Zeph!

entries.original:
"My name is Krystal.

Yes\. my parents were very fond
of this place.

So it’s only fitting that I became
the strongest Trainer in here.

If you can defeat all of the other
Trainers in Crystal Peak, I’ll let\lyou have a go at my title."
entries.translation_source: My name is Krystal. Yes[game-token-1] my parents were very fond of this place. So it’s only fitting that I became the strongest Trainer in here. If you can defeat all of the other Trainers in Crystal Peak, I’ll let you have a go at my title.
entries.translated:
Nama saya Krystal. Ya\. orang tua
saya sangat menyukai tempat ini.\lJadi sudah sepantasnya saya menjadi

Pelatih terkuat di sini. Jika Anda
bisa mengalahkan semua Pelatih lain\ldi Crystal Peak, saya akan memberi

Anda kesempatan untuk merebut gelar
saya.

entries.original:
"My name is Krystal.

Yes\. my parents were very fond
of this place.

So it’s only fitting that I became
the strongest Trainer in here.

If you can defeat me, I’ll let you
call yourself Krystal, too!"
entries.translation_source: My name is Krystal. Yes[game-token-1] my parents were very fond of this place. So it’s only fitting that I became the strongest Trainer in here. If you can defeat me, I’ll let you call yourself Krystal, too!
entries.translated:
Nama saya Krystal. Ya\. orang tua
saya sangat menyukai tempat ini.\lJadi sudah sepantasnya saya menjadi

Pelatih terkuat di sini. Jika Anda
bisa mengalahkan saya, saya akan\lmengizinkan Anda memanggil diri

Anda Krystal juga!

entries.original:
"Well done.

I confer upon you the title of
Krystal.

\.What?
You want more?

Fine\. take this, too."
entries.translation_source: Well done. I confer upon you the title of Krystal. [game-token-1]What? You want more? Fine[game-token-2] take this, too.
entries.translated:
Bagus sekali. Saya menganugerahkan
gelar Krystal kepada Anda. \.Apa?\lAnda ingin lebih? Baiklah\. ambil ini

juga.

entries.original:
"If [green]Absol[red] holds the [green]Absolite[red],
it can Mega Evolve and be worthy\lof even Trainers named Krystal."
entries.translation_source: If [color-green-1]Absol[color-red-2] holds the [color-green-3]Absolite[color-red-4], it can Mega Evolve and be worthy of even Trainers named Krystal.
entries.translated:
Jika [green]Absol[red] memegang [green]Absolit[red], ia
bisa Mega Evolusi dan layak bahkan\luntuk Pelatih bernama Krystal.

entries.original: "[blue]Gastrodon! Use [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Gastrodon! Use [buffer1-2]!
entries.translated: [blue]Gastrodon! Gunakan [buffer1]!

entries.original: "[blue]Roserade! Counter with [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Roserade! Counter with [buffer1-2]!
entries.translated: [blue]Roserade! Balas dengan [buffer1]!

entries.original: "[buffer1]! Protect yourself!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! Protect yourself!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Lindungi dirimu!

entries.original:
"[blue]Krookodile! Let’s shake things up
with Earthquake!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Krookodile! Let’s shake things up with Earthquake!
entries.translated:
[blue]Krookodile! Mari kita guncang
dengan Gempa!

entries.original:
"[red]Alakazam! Increase your Defense
with Barrier!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Alakazam! Increase your Defense with Barrier!
entries.translated:
[red]Alakazam! Tingkatkan Pertahananmu
dengan Penghalang!

entries.original:
"[black]Hoopa looks like it wants to
join you!

Accept it onto your team?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Hoopa looks like it wants to join you! Accept it onto your team?
entries.translated:
[black]Hoopa sepertinya ingin bergabung
denganmu! Terima dia ke dalam\ltimmu?

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] happily joined your side!
It has a [green][buffer2][black] nature."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] happily joined your side! It has a [color-green-3][buffer2-4][color-black-5] nature.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] dengan senang hati
bergabung ke pihakmu! Ia memiliki\lsifat [green][buffer2][black].

entries.original:
"Oh, [rival]\.
Why can’t you just see what I see\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, [text-token-rival-1][game-token-2] Why can’t you just see what I see[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Oh, [rival]\. Kenapa kau tidak bisa
melihat apa yang aku lihat\.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
Where did my daddy go?"
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] Where did my daddy go?
entries.translated: Oh\. Kemana perginya ayahku?

entries.original:
"We’ve been assigned by the police
department to guard this rather\llarge crystal.

Don’t try anything funny, kid.
We’re keeping an eye on you."
entries.translation_source: We’ve been assigned by the police department to guard this rather large crystal. Don’t try anything funny, kid. We’re keeping an eye on you.
entries.translated:
Kami ditugaskan oleh kepolisian
untuk menjaga kristal yang agak\lbesar ini. Jangan coba-coba

macam-macam, nak. Kami mengawasimu.

entries.original: "Cube Corp."
entries.translation_source: Cube Corp.
entries.translated: Cube Corp.

entries.original: "Cube Corp. Outside"
entries.translation_source: Cube Corp. Outside

entries.original: "Cube Corp. Inside"
entries.translation_source: Cube Corp. Inside

entries.original:
"Poké Balls and Cubes are pretty
similar, right?

I mean, they’re built to make things
smaller and easier to carry.

I guess I should be grateful that
the Cube is\. well, a cube.

Can you imagine if you tried throwing
your Cube to catch a wild Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Poké Balls and Cubes are pretty similar, right? I mean, they’re built to make things smaller and easier to carry. I guess I should be grateful that the Cube is[game-token-1] well, a cube. Can you imagine if you tried throwing your Cube to catch a wild Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Poké Ball dan Cube cukup mirip,
kan? Maksudku, mereka dibuat untuk\lmembuat benda lebih kecil dan mudah

dibawa. Kurasa aku harus bersyukur
bahwa Cube itu\. yah, berbentuk\lkubus. Bayangkan jika kau mencoba

melempar Cube-mu untuk menangkap
Pokémon liar?

entries.original:
"All I wanted was to speak to
someone to fix my Cube V3\.

And somehow, I came away with this
brand-new robot arm."
entries.translation_source: All I wanted was to speak to someone to fix my Cube V3[game-token-1] And somehow, I came away with this brand-new robot arm.
entries.translated:
Yang saya inginkan hanyalah
berbicara dengan seseorang untuk\lmemperbaiki Cube V3\. Dan entah

bagaimana, saya malah mendapatkan
lengan robot baru ini.

entries.original:
"Here at Cube Corp., we believe that
with science, we should always\lshoot for the moon.

\.And if we miss, shoot for it
again.

One day, you’ll succeed in destroying
the moon once and for all."
entries.translation_source: Here at Cube Corp., we believe that with science, we should always shoot for the moon. [game-token-1]And if we miss, shoot for it again. One day, you’ll succeed in destroying the moon once and for all.
entries.translated:
Di Cube Corp., kami percaya bahwa
dengan sains, kita harus selalu\lmembidik bulan. \.Dan jika kita

meleset, bidik lagi. Suatu hari,
kamu akan berhasil menghancurkan\lbulan untuk selamanya.

entries.original:
"Pokémon Rangers regularly protest
outside this place.

Seriously, why don’t they go back to
protecting the public, like they’re\lpaid to do?"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Rangers regularly protest outside this place. Seriously, why don’t they go back to protecting the public, like they’re paid to do?
entries.translated:
Pokémon Rangers secara teratur
memprotes di luar tempat ini.\lSerius, kenapa mereka tidak kembali

melindungi publik, seperti yang
mereka dibayar untuk lakukan?

entries.original:
"Oh no\. my uniform’s colours ran in
the wash\.

I really hope they don’t mind me
taking casual wear to work\."
entries.translation_source: Oh no[game-token-1] my uniform’s colours ran in the wash[game-token-2] I really hope they don’t mind me taking casual wear to work[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Oh tidak\. warna seragamku luntur
saat dicuci\. Saya sangat berharap\lmereka tidak keberatan saya memakai

pakaian kasual ke kantor\.

entries.original:
"I paid some lady with [green]Bottle Caps[red] to
increase my Pokémon’s potential\.

And I paid money to have a scientist
at the [green]Battle Frontier[red] change my\lPokémon’s [green]Nature[red]\.

So what if I’m sacrificing their
wellbeing and happiness?

All that matters is if they can win
a battle!"
entries.translation_source: I paid some lady with [color-green-1]Bottle Caps[color-red-2] to increase my Pokémon’s potential[game-token-3] And I paid money to have a scientist at the [color-green-4]Battle Frontier[color-red-5] change my Pokémon’s [color-green-6]Nature[color-red-7][game-token-8] So what if I’m sacrificing their wellbeing and happiness? All that matters is if they can win a battle!
entries.translated:
Saya membayar seorang wanita dengan
[green]Bottle Caps[red] untuk meningkatkan\lpotensi Pokémon saya\. Dan saya

membayar uang kepada seorang
ilmuwan di [green]Battle Frontier[red] untuk\lmengubah [green]Nature[red] Pokémon saya\. Jadi

bagaimana jika saya mengorbankan
kesejahteraan dan kebahagiaan\lmereka? Yang penting adalah apakah

mereka bisa memenangkan
pertarungan!

entries.original:
"The workers at Cube Corp. are so
great, they even take time out of\ltheir busy schedules to conduct\ltours of the place!

But word is, though, there’s a secret
lab underground they don’t take\lyou to see."
entries.translation_source: The workers at Cube Corp. are so great, they even take time out of their busy schedules to conduct tours of the place! But word is, though, there’s a secret lab underground they don’t take you to see.
entries.translated:
Para pekerja di Cube Corp. sangat
hebat, mereka bahkan meluangkan\lwaktu dari jadwal sibuk mereka

untuk memandu tur tempat ini! Tapi
kabarnya, ada laboratorium rahasia\ldi bawah tanah yang tidak mereka

bawa untuk dilihat.

entries.original:
"All these Rangers ever do is protest
the \qoevils\qc of Cube Corp.

I’ll have you know there’s nothing
evil about Cube Corp. whatsoever!

Let me tell you, they were even so
generous as to grant us police\lofficers extra storage sectors in\lour Cubes!

Why? So we may better serve the
people, of course!

Tell me, is that really so wrong?"
entries.translation_source: All these Rangers ever do is protest the [quote-open-1]evils[quote-close-2] of Cube Corp. I’ll have you know there’s nothing evil about Cube Corp. whatsoever! Let me tell you, they were even so generous as to grant us police officers extra storage sectors in our Cubes! Why? So we may better serve the people, of course! Tell me, is that really so wrong?
entries.translated:
Yang dilakukan semua Rangers ini
hanyalah memprotes \qokejahatan\qc Cube\lCorp. Aku akan memberitahumu bahwa

tidak ada yang jahat tentang Cube
Corp. sama sekali! Biarkan aku\lmemberitahu, mereka bahkan begitu

murah hati memberikan kami petugas
polisi sektor penyimpanan tambahan\ldi Cube kami! Kenapa? Tentu saja

agar kami bisa lebih melayani
masyarakat! Katakan padaku, apakah\litu benar-benar salah?

entries.original:
"Now that management has had a
complete overhaul, what will\lbecome of Cube Corp.?

Will we continuously strive to
improve the lives of the Borrian\lcitizens, or was that just a lie\lfrom the very beginning?"
entries.translation_source: Now that management has had a complete overhaul, what will become of Cube Corp.? Will we continuously strive to improve the lives of the Borrian citizens, or was that just a lie from the very beginning?
entries.translated:
Sekarang setelah manajemen
mengalami perombakan total, apa\lyang akan terjadi dengan Cube

Corp.? Akankah kita terus berusaha
meningkatkan kehidupan warga\lBorrian, atau itu hanya kebohongan

dari awal?

entries.original:
"There’s no Pokémon Center here at
Cube Corp., so let me heal your\lPokémon for you instead!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no Pokémon Center here at Cube Corp., so let me heal your Pokémon for you instead!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada Pokémon Center di sini di
Cube Corp., jadi biarkan aku\lmenyembuhkan Pokémonmu sebagai

gantinya!

entries.original:
"While there may be no Pokémon
Center here, you’ll find no\lshortage of [green]Porygon[red] if you need\lto access the Pokémon PC.

Isn’t that convenient?

These scientists sure thought of
everything!"
entries.translation_source: While there may be no Pokémon Center here, you’ll find no shortage of [color-green-1]Porygon[color-red-2] if you need to access the Pokémon PC. Isn’t that convenient? These scientists sure thought of everything!
entries.translated:
Meskipun mungkin tidak ada Pokémon
Center di sini, kamu tidak akan\lkekurangan [green]Porygon[red] jika kamu perlu

mengakses Pokémon PC. Bukankah itu
praktis? Para ilmuwan ini\lbenar-benar memikirkan segalanya!

entries.original: "Where could my girl be\.?"
entries.translation_source: Where could my girl be[game-token-1]?
entries.translated: Di mana pacarku mungkin berada\.?

entries.original:
"Sorry, champ!

You mind waiting a little before
heading in there?

I’m waiting for my girl to show up,
so I need all this space to keep\lan eye out for her!

I appreciate ya, Champ!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry, champ! You mind waiting a little before heading in there? I’m waiting for my girl to show up, so I need all this space to keep an eye out for her! I appreciate ya, Champ!
entries.translated:
Maaf, juara! Apakah kamu keberatan
menunggu sebentar sebelum masuk ke\lsana? Aku sedang menunggu pacarku

muncul, jadi aku butuh semua ruang
ini untuk mengawasinya! Aku hargai,\lJuara!

entries.original:
"Down with Cube Corp!
Down with Cube Corp!

I’m protesting against the evils of
Cube Corp, and especially the\lScience Society.

They’ve been running cruel
experiments on Pokémon, including\lthe ones I’m responsible for!

Hmm\.? I have [green]hard, snowy scales[blue]
stuck to my clothes?

Yes, that’s right\. I help keep one
of their imported experiments fed,\lafter their population increased\lhere in Borrius, at [green]Icicle Cave[blue].

I forget their names\. they’re some
sort of Pokémon from the [green]Alola\lregion[blue]\.

What were they called?"
entries.translation_source: Down with Cube Corp! Down with Cube Corp! I’m protesting against the evils of Cube Corp, and especially the Science Society. They’ve been running cruel experiments on Pokémon, including the ones I’m responsible for! Hmm[game-token-1]? I have [color-green-2]hard, snowy scales[color-blue-3] stuck to my clothes? Yes, that’s right[game-token-4] I help keep one of their imported experiments fed, after their population increased here in Borrius, at [color-green-5]Icicle Cave[color-blue-6]. I forget their names[game-token-7] they’re some sort of Pokémon from the [color-green-8]Alola region[color-blue-9][game-token-10] What were they called?
entries.translated:
Hancurkan Cube Corp! Hancurkan Cube
Corp! Aku memprotes kejahatan Cube\lCorp, dan terutama Science Society.

Mereka telah melakukan eksperimen
kejam pada Pokémon, termasuk yang\lmenjadi tanggung jawabku! Hmm\.? Aku

punya [green]sisik keras bersalju[blue] menempel
di bajuku? Ya, benar\. Aku membantu\lmemberi makan salah satu eksperimen

impor mereka, setelah populasi
mereka meningkat di sini di\lBorrius, di [green]Icicle Cave[blue]. Aku lupa

nama mereka\. mereka semacam Pokémon
dari [green]wilayah Alola[blue]\. Siapa nama\lmereka?

entries.original: "No\. that wasn’t it\."
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] that wasn’t it[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Tidak\. bukan itu\.

entries.original:
"That’s it! They’re the ones!

Wait\.\CC0818 how long has it been since
I last checked on their food\lsupply\.?

That was\.

\.ack! Ages ago!

How have they managed without
me all this time!?

I can’t be wasting time here!

But first, uh\.\CC0818 thanks for
reminding me!"
entries.translation_source: That’s it! They’re the ones! Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] how long has it been since I last checked on their food supply[game-token-3]? That was[game-token-4] [game-token-5]ack! Ages ago! How have they managed without me all this time!? I can’t be wasting time here! But first, uh[game-token-6][control-code-7] thanks for reminding me!
entries.translated:
Itu dia! Merekalah itu! Tunggu\.\CC0818
sudah berapa lama sejak terakhir\lkali aku memeriksa persediaan

makanan mereka\.? Itu\. \.ah! Sudah lama
sekali! Bagaimana mereka bertahan\ltanpaku selama ini!? Aku tidak bisa

membuang waktu di sini! Tapi
pertama, uh\.\CC0818 terima kasih sudah\lmengingatkanku!

entries.original:
"These Ice-type Sandshrew and
Sandslash aren’t native to Borrius.

Someone always has to be here, to
make sure they don’t interfere with\lthe other Pokémon in Icicle Cave\.

After all, it’s impossible to capture
the whole population now, anyway."
entries.translation_source: These Ice-type Sandshrew and Sandslash aren’t native to Borrius. Someone always has to be here, to make sure they don’t interfere with the other Pokémon in Icicle Cave[game-token-1] After all, it’s impossible to capture the whole population now, anyway.
entries.translated:
Sandshrew dan Sandslash tipe Es ini
bukan asli Borrius. Seseorang harus\lselalu di sini, untuk memastikan

mereka tidak mengganggu Pokémon
lain di Icicle Cave\. Lagipula, tidak\lmungkin menangkap seluruh populasi

sekarang.

entries.original:
"Down with Cube Corp.!
Down with the Science Society!"
entries.translation_source: Down with Cube Corp.! Down with the Science Society!
entries.translated:
Hancurkan Cube Corp.! Hancurkan
Science Society!

entries.original:
"We’re risking our jobs just protesting
here, I know that.

But this is about taking a stand
against injustice, against unethical\labuse of Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We’re risking our jobs just protesting here, I know that. But this is about taking a stand against injustice, against unethical abuse of Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kami mempertaruhkan pekerjaan kami
hanya dengan memprotes di sini, aku\ltahu itu. Tapi ini tentang

mengambil sikap melawan
ketidakadilan, melawan\lpenyalahgunaan Pokémon yang tidak

etis!

entries.original:
"Only Pokémon Breeders have the right
to meddle with Pokémon genetics!

Not a crazy group of scientists!

Grr\.\CC0818 just thinking about it makes my
blood boil as hot as a [green]Magma Stone[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Only Pokémon Breeders have the right to meddle with Pokémon genetics! Not a crazy group of scientists! Grr[game-token-1][control-code-2] just thinking about it makes my blood boil as hot as a [color-green-3]Magma Stone[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Hanya Pokémon Breeders yang berhak
mencampuri genetika Pokémon! Bukan\lsekelompok ilmuwan gila! Grr\.\CC0818 hanya

memikirkannya saja membuat darahku
mendidih sepanas [green]Magma Stone[blue]!

entries.original:
"That Magma Stone in your Cube\.

It radiates such intense heat!

It reminds me of the days when I
was an avid Pokémon Breeder.

\.

Hold on a minute\.

Ack! That’s right!

I completely forgot about my
precious partner!

I should have picked her up from
the Day Care ages ago!

Uh\. thanks for reminding me.
Here, you can have this."
entries.translation_source: That Magma Stone in your Cube[game-token-1] It radiates such intense heat! It reminds me of the days when I was an avid Pokémon Breeder. [game-token-2] Hold on a minute[game-token-3] Ack! That’s right! I completely forgot about my precious partner! I should have picked her up from the Day Care ages ago! Uh[game-token-4] thanks for reminding me. Here, you can have this.
entries.translated:
Magma Stone di Cube-mu itu\.
Memancarkan panas yang sangat\lintens! Itu mengingatkanku pada

masa-masa ketika aku menjadi
Pokémon Breeder yang rajin. \. Tunggu\lsebentar\. Ack! Benar! Aku

benar-benar lupa tentang rekan
berhargaku! Seharusnya aku\lmenjemputnya dari Day Care sejak

lama! Uh\. terima kasih sudah
mengingatkanku. Ini, kamu boleh\lpunya ini.

entries.original:
"You should bring that [green]Magma Stone[blue]
to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue].

I hear a rare Pokémon will appear
when it senses one in your Cube."
entries.translation_source: You should bring that [color-green-1]Magma Stone[color-blue-2] to [color-green-3]Cinder Volcano[color-blue-4]. I hear a rare Pokémon will appear when it senses one in your Cube.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus membawa [green]Magma Stone[blue] itu
ke [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]. Kudengar seekor\lPokémon langka akan muncul ketika

ia merasakan satu di Cube-mu.

entries.original:
"Grr\.\CC0818 I must leave for now,
Cube Corp\.

But I’ll be back, time and again,
until justice is finally served!"
entries.translation_source: Grr[game-token-1][control-code-2] I must leave for now, Cube Corp[game-token-3] But I’ll be back, time and again, until justice is finally served!
entries.translated:
Grr\.\CC0818 Aku harus pergi untuk saat ini,
Cube Corp\. Tapi aku akan kembali,\lberulang kali, sampai keadilan

akhirnya ditegakkan!

entries.original:
"It’s only a matter of time before
the public finds out what’s been\lreally going on in there!

We know you’ve been making monsters,
and soon we’ll be able to prove it!"
entries.translation_source: It’s only a matter of time before the public finds out what’s been really going on in there! We know you’ve been making monsters, and soon we’ll be able to prove it!
entries.translated:
Hanya masalah waktu sebelum publik
mengetahui apa yang sebenarnya\lterjadi di sana! Kami tahu kamu

telah membuat monster, dan segera
kami akan bisa membuktikannya!

entries.original:
"You can’t fool us, Cube Corp!
We know what you’re up to in there!

We know you’re really run by the
Science Society!

And one day, we’ll oust you
once and for all!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t fool us, Cube Corp! We know what you’re up to in there! We know you’re really run by the Science Society! And one day, we’ll oust you once and for all!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak bisa membodohi kami,
Cube Corp! Kami tahu apa yang kamu\llakukan di dalam sana! Kami tahu

kamu benar-benar dijalankan oleh
Science Society! Dan suatu hari,\lkami akan mengusir kamu sekali dan

untuk selamanya!

entries.original:
"People say that [green]Master Balls[blue] are
effective, but in exchange,\lthey’re hard to produce\.

Shows what they know, because I’m
knee-deep\.\CC0818 in Balls!

In fact, I’ll let you take my many
[green]Master Balls[blue] off my hands\.

But only if you can spare me
[green][buffer2] Gems[blue] for my research."
entries.translation_source: People say that [color-green-1]Master Balls[color-blue-2] are effective, but in exchange, they’re hard to produce[game-token-3] Shows what they know, because I’m knee-deep[game-token-4][control-code-5] in Balls! In fact, I’ll let you take my many [color-green-6]Master Balls[color-blue-7] off my hands[game-token-8] But only if you can spare me [color-green-9][buffer2-10] Gems[color-blue-11] for my research.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang bilang bahwa [green]Master
Ball[blue] itu efektif, tapi sebagai\lgantinya, mereka sulit diproduksi\.

Itu menunjukkan apa yang mereka
tahu, karena aku sampai lutut\.\CC0818 di\ldalam Bola! Faktanya, aku akan

membiarkanmu mengambil banyak
[green]Master Ball[blue] milikku\. Tapi hanya jika\lkamu bisa memberiku [green][buffer2]

Permata[blue] untuk penelitianku.

entries.original: "Which Gems are you offering?"
entries.translation_source: Which Gems are you offering?
entries.translated: Permata mana yang kamu tawarkan?

entries.original:
"And we have a deal!
Here you go.

Don’t blow it on anything stupid,
like a Magikarp."
entries.translation_source: And we have a deal! Here you go. Don’t blow it on anything stupid, like a Magikarp.
entries.translated:
Dan kita sepakat! Ini dia. Jangan
menyia-nyiakannya untuk hal bodoh,\lseperti Magikarp.

entries.original:
"I’m still knees-deep in Balls!

Bring another [green][buffer2][blue] Gems and I’ll trade
you some more Master Balls."
entries.translation_source: I’m still knees-deep in Balls! Bring another [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] Gems and I’ll trade you some more Master Balls.
entries.translated:
Aku masih sibuk dengan Balls!
Bawakan [green][buffer2][blue] Gems lagi dan aku\lakan menukarnya dengan beberapa

Master Ball lagi.

entries.original:
"Come on, now\.

I’m running out of room to hide
them all\."
entries.translation_source: Come on, now[game-token-1] I’m running out of room to hide them all[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ayolah, sekarang\. Aku kehabisan
tempat untuk menyembunyikan\lsemuanya\.

entries.original:
"Come on, now\.
That’s not a Gem!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, now[game-token-1] That’s not a Gem!
entries.translated: Ayo, sekarang\. Itu bukan Permata!

entries.original:
"Come on, now\.

You don’t have at least [green][buffer2][blue]
[green][buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, now[game-token-1] You don’t have at least [color-green-2][buffer2-3][color-blue-4] [color-green-5][buffer1-6]s[color-blue-7]!
entries.translated:
Ayo, sekarang\. Kamu tidak punya
setidaknya [green][buffer2][blue] [green][buffer1]s[blue]!

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

I recognize you\. you’re the Champion
of Borrius, aren’t you?

Have you found any of those strange
portals around Borrius yet?

And have you found strange creatures
from another dimension emerging\lfrom the other side\.

Fierce creatures, resistant to
almost every type of Poké Ball in\lyour Cube?

Well, you need a special kind of
Poké Ball to take them on - [green]Beast\lBalls[red]!

And it just so happens I know how to
create them!

All I require is the most important
raw material - [green]Iron Balls[red].

If you bring enough of those, I can
create [green]Beast Balls[red] for you."
entries.translation_source: Upupupu[game-token-1] I recognize you[game-token-2] you’re the Champion of Borrius, aren’t you? Have you found any of those strange portals around Borrius yet? And have you found strange creatures from another dimension emerging from the other side[game-token-3] Fierce creatures, resistant to almost every type of Poké Ball in your Cube? Well, you need a special kind of Poké Ball to take them on - [color-green-4]Beast Balls[color-red-5]! And it just so happens I know how to create them! All I require is the most important raw material - [color-green-6]Iron Balls[color-red-7]. If you bring enough of those, I can create [color-green-8]Beast Balls[color-red-9] for you.
entries.translated:
Upupupu\. Aku mengenali kamu\. kamu
adalah Juara Borrius, kan? Sudahkah\lkamu menemukan portal aneh di

sekitar Borrius? Dan sudahkah kamu
menemukan makhluk aneh dari dimensi\llain yang muncul dari sisi lain\.

Makhluk garang, kebal terhadap
hampir semua jenis Poké Ball di\lKubusmu? Nah, kamu membutuhkan

jenis Poké Ball khusus untuk
menghadapi mereka - [green]Bola Beast[red]! Dan\lkebetulan aku tahu cara membuatnya!

Yang aku butuhkan hanyalah bahan
baku terpenting - [green]Bola Besi[red]. Jika\lkamu membawa cukup banyak, aku bisa

membuat [green]Bola Beast[red] untukmu.

entries.original:
"So, have you brought any
[green]Iron Balls[red]?

I’ll make [green]Beast Balls[red] out of
them, if you want."
entries.translation_source: So, have you brought any [color-green-1]Iron Balls[color-red-2]? I’ll make [color-green-3]Beast Balls[color-red-4] out of them, if you want.
entries.translated:
Jadi, apakah kamu membawa [green]Bola-Bola
Besi[red]? Aku akan membuat [green]Bola-Bola\lBeast[red] dari mereka, jika kamu mau.

entries.original:
"How many Iron Balls will you
part with?"
entries.translation_source: How many Iron Balls will you part with?
entries.translated:
Berapa banyak Bola Besi yang akan
kamu berikan?

entries.original:
"You’ll part with [buffer1] of the
Iron Balls?"
entries.translation_source: You’ll part with [buffer1-1] of the Iron Balls?
entries.translated:
Kau akan menyerahkan [buffer1] Bola
Besi?

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

Thank you kindly.

There’s an art to this\. they respond
badly to the dimensions inside a\lPoké Ball\.

So, I create an alternate space for
them, and\.\CC0815 \.\CC0815 \.\CC0815\CC103100there we go!"
entries.translation_source: Upupupu[game-token-1] Thank you kindly. There’s an art to this[game-token-2] they respond badly to the dimensions inside a Poké Ball[game-token-3] So, I create an alternate space for them, and[game-token-4][control-code-5] [game-token-6][control-code-7] [game-token-8][control-code-9][control-code-10]there we go!
entries.translated:
Upupupu\. Terima kasih banyak. Ada
seni dalam hal ini\. mereka bereaksi\lburuk terhadap dimensi di dalam

Poké Ball\. Jadi, saya menciptakan
ruang alternatif untuk mereka, dan\.\CC0815 \.\CC0815\l\.\CC0815\CC103100Nah, ini dia!

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

The portals from which those
creatures emerge tend to reappear.

I hope you’ll use those Beast Balls
for good, and tame these threats\lto our world\."
entries.translation_source: Upupupu[game-token-1] The portals from which those creatures emerge tend to reappear. I hope you’ll use those Beast Balls for good, and tame these threats to our world[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Upupupu\. Portal-portal tempat
makhluk-makhluk itu muncul\lcenderung muncul kembali. Saya

harap Anda akan menggunakan Beast
Balls itu untuk kebaikan, dan\lmenjinakkan ancaman-ancaman ini

terhadap dunia kita\..

entries.original:
"Not interested?

How can you not find monsters from
another world fascinating?"
entries.translation_source: Not interested? How can you not find monsters from another world fascinating?
entries.translated:
Tidak tertarik? Bagaimana kamu bisa
tidak menganggap monster dari dunia\llain menarik?

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

You have no Iron Balls\."
entries.translation_source: Upupupu[game-token-1] You have no Iron Balls[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Upupupu\. Kamu tidak memiliki Bola
Besi\.

entries.original:
"Bwahahaha! You there, Trainer!

If you will let me, I shall
demonstrate a feat of science many\lbelieve to be impossible!

Just give me [green][buffer2] Everstones[blue], and I will
transform them into a rare Evolution\lStone - any kind you please!"
entries.translation_source: Bwahahaha! You there, Trainer! If you will let me, I shall demonstrate a feat of science many believe to be impossible! Just give me [color-green-1][buffer2-2] Everstones[color-blue-3], and I will transform them into a rare Evolution Stone - any kind you please!
entries.translated:
Bwahahaha! Kau di sana, Trainer!
Jika kau mengizinkanku, aku akan\lmendemonstrasikan prestasi sains

yang banyak orang yakini mustahil!
Beri saja aku [green][buffer2] Batu Abadi[blue],\ldan aku akan mengubahnya menjadi

Batu Evolusi langka - jenis apa pun
yang kau inginkan!

entries.original: "Which Stone shall I make for you?"
entries.translation_source: Which Stone shall I make for you?
entries.translated:
Batu mana yang harus aku buat
untukmu?

entries.original:
"Then, you want me to turn your
Everstones into a [green][buffer1][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Then, you want me to turn your Everstones into a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]?
entries.translated:
Lalu, kau ingin aku mengubah Batu
Abadi milikmu menjadi [green][buffer1][blue]?

entries.original: "Into the machine they go\. and\."
entries.translation_source: Into the machine they go[game-token-1] and[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Mereka masuk ke dalam mesin\. dan\.

entries.original:
"Bwahahaha! Did you see that!?

They all said an item meant to
prevent evolution could never\linduce evolution!

FOOLS! FOOLS, ALL OF THEM!

\.Oh, right.
Here, take it\. I guess."
entries.translation_source: Bwahahaha! Did you see that!? They all said an item meant to prevent evolution could never induce evolution! FOOLS! FOOLS, ALL OF THEM! [game-token-1]Oh, right. Here, take it[game-token-2] I guess.
entries.translated:
Bwahahaha! Apa kau lihat itu!?
Mereka semua bilang benda yang\ldimaksudkan untuk mencegah evolusi

tidak akan pernah bisa menyebabkan
evolusi! BODOH! BODOH, SEMUANYA!\l\.Oh, benar. Ini, ambil\. kurasa.

entries.original:
"If you come across any more
Everstones, I’ll be happy to tell\lconventional science to sit down\land shut up for you again."
entries.translation_source: If you come across any more Everstones, I’ll be happy to tell conventional science to sit down and shut up for you again.
entries.translated:
Jika kau menemukan Batu Abadi lagi,
aku akan dengan senang hati\lmenyuruh sains konvensional untuk

duduk dan diam untukmu.

entries.original:
"Shun! Shun the non-believer!

Shuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuun!"
entries.translation_source: Shun! Shun the non-believer! Shuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuun!
entries.translated:
Jauhi! Jauhi orang yang tidak
percaya! Jauuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuhi!

entries.original:
"So, you would hoard your
Everstones, like a fool?

What purpose would that ever
serve anyone?"
entries.translation_source: So, you would hoard your Everstones, like a fool? What purpose would that ever serve anyone?
entries.translated:
Jadi, kau akan menimbun Batu
Abadimu seperti orang bodoh? Tujuan\lapa yang akan dilayani itu untuk

siapa pun?

entries.original:
"Gah! You lack the Everstones for my
grand demonstration!"
entries.translation_source: Gah! You lack the Everstones for my grand demonstration!
entries.translated:
Gah! Kau kekurangan Batu Abadi
untuk demonstrasi besarku!

entries.original: "Dawn Stone"
entries.translation_source: Dawn Stone

entries.original: "Dusk Stone"
entries.translation_source: Dusk Stone

entries.original: "Ice Stone"
entries.translation_source: Ice Stone

entries.original: "Moon Stone"
entries.translation_source: Moon Stone

entries.original: "Shiny Stone"
entries.translation_source: Shiny Stone

entries.original: "Sun Stone"
entries.translation_source: Sun Stone

entries.original:
"Hey, you! Yes, you!

Have you any [green]Star Pieces[blue] or [green]Fossils[blue]
to spare this humble researcher?

In exchange, I can offer you a
special concoction, one that\lcan raise how often a Pokémon can\luse its attacks\."
entries.translation_source: Hey, you! Yes, you! Have you any [color-green-1]Star Pieces[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Fossils[color-blue-4] to spare this humble researcher? In exchange, I can offer you a special concoction, one that can raise how often a Pokémon can use its attacks[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Hei, kau! Ya, kau! Apakah kau punya
[green]Keping Bintang[blue] atau [green]Fosil[blue] untuk\ldiberikan pada peneliti rendah hati

ini? Sebagai gantinya, aku bisa
menawarkanmu ramuan spesial, yang\ldapat meningkatkan seberapa sering

Pokémon dapat menggunakan
serangannya\.

entries.original: "What will you trade?"
entries.translation_source: What will you trade?
entries.translated: Apa yang akan kau tukar?

entries.original:
"How many [green][buffer1]s[blue] will
you trade?"
entries.translation_source: How many [color-green-1][buffer1-2]s[color-blue-3] will you trade?
entries.translated:
Berapa banyak [green][buffer1]s[blue] yang akan
kau tukar?

entries.original:
"So, you’re willing to part with your
[green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue], in exchange for\l[green][buffer3][blue] of my [green]PP Ups[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: So, you’re willing to part with your [color-green-1][buffer2-2] [buffer1-3]s[color-blue-4], in exchange for [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] of my [color-green-8]PP Ups[color-blue-9]?
entries.translated:
Jadi, kau bersedia berpisah dengan
[green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue] milikmu, sebagai\lganti [green][buffer3][blue] dari [green]PP Ups[blue] milikku?

entries.original:
"Excellent! I’ll just take those,
thank you very much!"
entries.translation_source: Excellent! I’ll just take those, thank you very much!
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Aku akan ambil itu,
terima kasih banyak!

entries.original:
"And now, for me to hold up my end
of the deal\. here!"
entries.translation_source: And now, for me to hold up my end of the deal[game-token-1] here!
entries.translated:
Dan sekarang, untukku menepati
bagianku dari kesepakatan\. ini!

entries.original:

"According to these research notes

mythical Pokémon, Arceus\.

in order to fight creatures from\lanother world.

Borrius, but our results were no\lmore successful than theirs.

the two we created.

needs to change its type."

They were made when a meteorite
containing otherworldly energy\lnearly crashed into Borrius.

I’ve heard that in a faraway region,
the people there underwent very\lmuch the same thing\.

Thus creating the Dens - a space
where Pokémon receive the energy\lto grow very large, and yet cannot\lleave that space until captured\.

Would you be willing to take on a
quick test for me, now that you’ve\lheard my little spiel?"

lain hampir menabrak Borrius.\lKudengar di daerah yang jauh,

orang-orang di sana mengalami hal
yang sangat sama\. Dengan demikian\lmenciptakan Sarang – sebuah ruang

di mana Pokémon menerima energi
untuk tumbuh sangat besar, namun\ltidak dapat meninggalkan ruang itu

sampai tertangkap\. Maukah kamu
melakukan ujian cepat untukku,\lsekarang setelah kamu mendengar

penjelasan singkatku?

Pokémon of Trainers.

Pokémon, have a word with my wife."

but your Pokémon had it.

You do want it, yes?"

entries.translated:
[black][player] mengambil kembali [buffer1]
dari Ibu Penitipan.

entries.original:
"Oh? But you have just one
Pokémon.

Come back another time."
entries.translation_source: Oh? But you have just one Pokémon. Come back another time.
entries.translated:
Oh? Tapi kamu hanya memiliki satu
Pokémon. Kembalilah lain kali.

entries.original: "Will you take your Pokémon back?"
entries.translation_source: Will you take your Pokémon back?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu akan mengambil
Pokémonmu kembali?

entries.original:
"If you leave me that Pokémon,
what will you battle with?

Come back another time."
entries.translation_source: If you leave me that Pokémon, what will you battle with? Come back another time.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu meninggalkan Pokémon itu
padaku, apa yang akan kamu gunakan\luntuk bertarung? Kembalilah lain

kali.

entries.original: "Extreme Hyperosmia"
entries.translation_source: Extreme Hyperosmia
entries.translated: Extreme Hyperosmia

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show
different Pokémon bred with
Incense items."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show different Pokémon bred with Incense items.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Munchlax to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Munchlax to the Pokémon Breeder.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Wynaut to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Wynaut to the Pokémon Breeder.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Happiny to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Happiny to the Pokémon Breeder.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Mime Jr. to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Mime Jr. to the Pokémon Breeder.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Chingling to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Chingling to the Pokémon Breeder.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Bonsly to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Bonsly to the Pokémon Breeder.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Budew to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Budew to the Pokémon Breeder.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show an
Azurill to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show an Azurill to the Pokémon Breeder.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Mantyke to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Mantyke to the Pokémon Breeder.

entries.original:
"I’ve been researching the
relationship between [green]Incense[blue] and\lPokémon Breeding.

It’s slow going but would be
faster if someone helped me out.

Say\.

Would you like to help me with my
research?"
entries.translation_source: I’ve been researching the relationship between [color-green-1]Incense[color-blue-2] and Pokémon Breeding. It’s slow going but would be faster if someone helped me out. Say[game-token-3] Would you like to help me with my research?
entries.translated:
Saya sudah meneliti hubungan antara
[green]Dupa[blue] dan Pembiakan Pokémon.\lProsesnya lambat tapi akan lebih

cepat jika ada yang membantu saya.
Katakan\. Apakah kamu ingin membantu\lpenelitian saya?

entries.original:
"Sigh\.

I guess I’ll have to find someone
else to help me, then."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1] I guess I’ll have to find someone else to help me, then.
entries.translated:
Huh\. Sepertinya aku harus mencari
orang lain untuk membantu, kalau\lbegitu.

entries.original:
"Great!

To start off, please bring me a
[green][buffer1][blue].

I’ve added limited data for
[buffer1] and [buffer2] to your\lPokédex to help you start out."
entries.translation_source: Great! To start off, please bring me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. I’ve added limited data for [buffer1-4] and [buffer2-5] to your Pokédex to help you start out.
entries.translated:
Hebat! Untuk memulai, tolong
bawakan saya sebuah [green][buffer1][blue]. Saya\lsudah menambahkan data terbatas

untuk [buffer1] dan [buffer2] ke
Pokédex-mu untuk membantu kamu\lmemulai.

entries.original:
"Have you brought me a [green][buffer1]
[blue]to study?

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Have you brought me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2] [color-blue-3]to study? *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah membawakan saya
[green][buffer1] [blue]untuk dipelajari?\l*Mengendus* *Mengendus*

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like it.

Please help me with my research,
and bring me a [green][buffer1][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like it. Please help me with my research, and bring me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya tidak. Tolong bantu aku
dengan penelitianku, dan bawakan\laku sebuah [green][buffer1][blue]!

entries.original:
"Mmm\.

Smells faintly of [green][buffer3][blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Mmm[game-token-1] Smells faintly of [color-green-2][buffer3-3][color-blue-4][game-token-5]
entries.translated: Mmm\. Berbau samar [green][buffer3][blue]\.

entries.original:
"The scent has assailed my
nostrils!

For that, you can have this
[buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: The scent has assailed my nostrils! For that, you can have this [buffer1-1]!
entries.translated:
Aroma ini menyerang lubang
hidungku! Untuk itu, kamu bisa\lmendapatkan [buffer1] ini!

entries.original:
"Please bring me a [green][buffer1][blue] so I
can study it too!

I’ve added limited data for
[buffer1] and [buffer2] to your\lPokédex to help you continue on."
entries.translation_source: Please bring me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] so I can study it too! I’ve added limited data for [buffer1-4] and [buffer2-5] to your Pokédex to help you continue on.
entries.translated:
Tolong bawakan saya [green][buffer1][blue] agar
saya bisa mempelajarinya juga! Saya\lsudah menambahkan data terbatas

untuk [buffer1] dan [buffer2] ke
Pokédex-mu untuk membantu kamu\lmelanjutkan.

entries.original:
"When added on to all of the other
scents you brought me, this scent\lis overwhleming!

It must be because you’ve done it!
You helped me finish my research!

You’ve become a true master
breeder.

Please, you have to take this
rare item!"
entries.translation_source: When added on to all of the other scents you brought me, this scent is overwhleming! It must be because you’ve done it! You helped me finish my research! You’ve become a true master breeder. Please, you have to take this rare item!
entries.translated:
Ketika ditambahkan ke semua aroma
lain yang kamu bawakan, aroma ini\lluar biasa! Pasti karena kamu

berhasil! Kamu membantuku
menyelesaikan penelitianku! Kamu\ltelah menjadi peternak master

sejati. Tolong, kamu harus
mengambil barang langka ini!

entries.original:
"When added on to all of the other
scents you brought me, this scent\lis overwhleming!

It must be because you’ve done it!
You helped me finish my research!

You’ve become a true master
breeder.

Please, you have to take this
specially bred Pokémon Egg!"
entries.translation_source: When added on to all of the other scents you brought me, this scent is overwhleming! It must be because you’ve done it! You helped me finish my research! You’ve become a true master breeder. Please, you have to take this specially bred Pokémon Egg!
entries.translated:
Ketika ditambahkan ke semua aroma
lain yang kamu bawakan, aroma ini\lluar biasa! Pasti karena kamu

berhasil! Kamu membantuku
menyelesaikan penelitianku! Kamu\ltelah menjadi peternak master

sejati. Tolong, kamu harus
mengambil Telur Pokémon yang\ldibiakkan secara khusus ini!

entries.original:
"You received a specially bred Egg
from the Pokémon Breeder!"
entries.translation_source: You received a specially bred Egg from the Pokémon Breeder!
entries.translated:
Kamu menerima Telur yang dibiakkan
secara khusus dari Peternak\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"Or, I mean I would give it you, but
you must make space for it, first!"
entries.translation_source: Or, I mean I would give it you, but you must make space for it, first!
entries.translated:
Atau, maksudku aku akan
memberikannya padamu, tapi kamu\lharus menyediakan ruang untuknya

dulu!

entries.original:
"You’ve been a great help with my
research!

I feel like now, I can finally
be the Breeder I was meant to be."
entries.translation_source: You’ve been a great help with my research! I feel like now, I can finally be the Breeder I was meant to be.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah sangat membantu
penelitianku! Aku merasa sekarang,\laku akhirnya bisa menjadi Peternak

yang seharusnya aku menjadi.

entries.original:
"When I was a student in the
Pokémon Breeder’s School, I\llearned that the best way to raise\lloving Pokémon is to battle with\lthem in important battles.

You seem like an important Trainer.
Can you help me raise my Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: When I was a student in the Pokémon Breeder’s School, I learned that the best way to raise loving Pokémon is to battle with them in important battles. You seem like an important Trainer. Can you help me raise my Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Saat aku masih menjadi siswa di
Sekolah Peternak Pokémon, aku\lbelajar bahwa cara terbaik untuk

membesarkan Pokémon yang penuh
kasih adalah dengan bertarung\lbersama mereka dalam pertempuran

penting. Kamu sepertinya Pelatih
yang penting. Bisakah kamu membantu\lmembesarkan Pokémon-ku?

entries.original: "Let’s get started!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get started!
entries.translated: Ayo mulai!

entries.original:
"I can feel my babies getting
stronger already!"
entries.translation_source: I can feel my babies getting stronger already!

entries.original:
"Thank you for battling with me!

Come back tomorrow to help train
my babies again!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you for battling with me! Come back tomorrow to help train my babies again!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah bertarung
denganku! Kembalilah besok untuk\lmembantu melatih bayiku lagi!

entries.original:
"Well, I’ll still be here if you
want to help me out later!"
entries.translation_source: Well, I’ll still be here if you want to help me out later!
entries.translated:
Yah, aku akan tetap di sini jika
kamu ingin membantuku nanti!

entries.original:
"Sometimes, when a boy and girl
Pokémon like each other very much,\lthey lay an Egg!

And the Day-Care couple is kind
enough to hold onto [green]100[blue] of those\lEggs for you!

I wish I could breed Pokémon as
great as they can."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes, when a boy and girl Pokémon like each other very much, they lay an Egg! And the Day-Care couple is kind enough to hold onto [color-green-1]100[color-blue-2] of those Eggs for you! I wish I could breed Pokémon as great as they can.
entries.translated:
Terkadang, ketika Pokémon jantan
dan betina sangat menyukai satu\lsama lain, mereka menghasilkan

Telur! Dan pasangan Day-Care cukup
baik untuk menyimpan [green]100[blue] Telur\ltersebut untukmu! Aku berharap aku

bisa membiakkan Pokémon sehebat
mereka.

entries.original:
"The Clefairy out in the yard was
captured by a Ranger hailing from\lCrater Town.

Where did he get it from, though?

Last I remember, there were no wild
Clefairy around here\.

No wonder the one in the yard looks
so sad\. it has no friends!"
entries.translation_source: The Clefairy out in the yard was captured by a Ranger hailing from Crater Town. Where did he get it from, though? Last I remember, there were no wild Clefairy around here[game-token-1] No wonder the one in the yard looks so sad[game-token-2] it has no friends!
entries.translated:
Clefairy di halaman itu ditangkap
oleh seorang Ranger yang berasal\ldari Crater Town. Tapi dari mana

dia mendapatkannya? Terakhir aku
ingat, tidak ada Clefairy liar di\lsekitar sini\. Pantas saja yang di

halaman terlihat begitu sedih\. dia
tidak punya teman!

entries.original:
"There used to be a Clefairy out in
the yard that was left by a Ranger\lhailing from Crater Town.

Where did he get it from, though?

Last I remember, there were no wild
Clefairy around here\."
entries.translation_source: There used to be a Clefairy out in the yard that was left by a Ranger hailing from Crater Town. Where did he get it from, though? Last I remember, there were no wild Clefairy around here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dulu ada Clefairy di halaman yang
ditinggalkan oleh seorang Ranger\lyang berasal dari Crater Town. Tapi

dari mana dia mendapatkannya?
Terakhir aku ingat, tidak ada\lClefairy liar di sekitar sini\.

entries.original:
"There are some horrible Trainers
out there who breed, and breed,\land breed\. and when they’re done\lbreeding, they release any Pokémon\lthey don’t want!

How despicable!

You’re not one of those Trainers,
are you?"
entries.translation_source: There are some horrible Trainers out there who breed, and breed, and breed[game-token-1] and when they’re done breeding, they release any Pokémon they don’t want! How despicable! You’re not one of those Trainers, are you?
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Pelatih yang
mengerikan di luar sana yang\lberkembang biak, dan berkembang

biak, dan berkembang biak\. dan
ketika mereka selesai berkembang\lbiak, mereka melepaskan Pokémon apa

pun yang tidak mereka inginkan!
Sungguh keji! Kamu bukan salah satu\lPelatih itu, kan?

entries.original:
"Ugh, you again! Did you come to
leave more Pokémon with me?"
entries.translation_source: Ugh, you again! Did you come to leave more Pokémon with me?
entries.translated:
Ugh, kamu lagi! Apakah kamu datang
untuk menitipkan lebih banyak\lPokémon padaku?

entries.original:
"Ugh! You are?
How despicable!

\.Well, I can’t stop you from
releasing those Pokémon, so how\labout leaving them in my care\linstead?"
entries.translation_source: Ugh! You are? How despicable! [game-token-1]Well, I can’t stop you from releasing those Pokémon, so how about leaving them in my care instead?
entries.translated:
Ugh! Kamu adalah? Sungguh keji!
\.Yah, aku tidak bisa menghentikanmu\lmelepaskan Pokémon itu, jadi

bagaimana kalau menitipkannya
kepadaku saja?

entries.original:
"So to confirm, you want to leave
all Pokémon in Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc\lwith me?"
entries.translation_source: So to confirm, you want to leave all Pokémon in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4][quote-close-5] with me?
entries.translated:
Jadi untuk konfirmasi, kamu ingin
meninggalkan semua Pokémon di Kotak\l\qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc bersamaku?

entries.original:
"You will never see any of these
Pokémon again.

Are you absolutely SURE you want
to leave all Pokémon in Box\l\qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc with me?"
entries.translation_source: You will never see any of these Pokémon again. Are you absolutely SURE you want to leave all Pokémon in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4][quote-close-5] with me?
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak akan pernah melihat
Pokémon ini lagi. Apakah kamu\lBENAR-BENAR yakin ingin

meninggalkan semua Pokémon di Kotak
\qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc bersamaku?

entries.original:
"Okay, your Pokémon that were in
Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc will now have a\lloving home in my care.

You’re a despicable Trainer and I
wish you would mend your ways."
entries.translation_source: Okay, your Pokémon that were in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4][quote-close-5] will now have a loving home in my care. You’re a despicable Trainer and I wish you would mend your ways.
entries.translated:
Oke, Pokémon-mu yang ada di Kotak
\qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc sekarang akan memiliki\lrumah yang penuh kasih dalam

perawatanku. Kamu adalah Pelatih
yang keji dan aku berharap kamu mau\lmemperbaiki perilakumu.

entries.original:
"I didn’t think so.
You don’t look the part."
entries.translation_source: I didn’t think so. You don’t look the part.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak berpikir begitu. Kamu
tidak terlihat seperti itu.

entries.original: "Ugh, how despicable!"
entries.translation_source: Ugh, how despicable!
entries.translated: Ugh, sungguh keji!

entries.original:
"Fortunately, you have no Pokémon
in Box \qo[green][buffer1][red].\qc

I won’t be needing to rescue any
Pokémon from you this time."
entries.translation_source: Fortunately, you have no Pokémon in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4].[quote-close-5] I won’t be needing to rescue any Pokémon from you this time.
entries.translated:
Untungnya, kamu tidak memiliki
Pokémon di Kotak \qo[green][buffer1][red].\qc Aku\ltidak perlu menyelamatkan Pokémon

apa pun darimu kali ini.

entries.original:
"Everyone knows about Egg Moves.

They’re those special moves
Pokémon can only learn when\lbreeding with another Pokémon\lthat knows one.

But listen here.

I have a special technique that can
move Egg Moves from one Pokémon\lto another!

Provided that they’re in the same
species family, of course.

What do you say, would you like me
to move Egg Moves from one Pokémon\lto another?

It’ll only cost you $[green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Everyone knows about Egg Moves. They’re those special moves Pokémon can only learn when breeding with another Pokémon that knows one. But listen here. I have a special technique that can move Egg Moves from one Pokémon to another! Provided that they’re in the same species family, of course. What do you say, would you like me to move Egg Moves from one Pokémon to another? It’ll only cost you $[color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Semua orang tahu tentang Jurusan
Telur. Itu adalah jurus spesial\lyang hanya bisa dipelajari Pokémon

saat berkembang biak dengan Pokémon
lain yang mengetahuinya. Tapi\ldengarkan. Aku punya teknik spesial

yang bisa memindahkan Jurusan Telur
dari satu Pokémon ke Pokémon lain!\lAsalkan mereka dalam keluarga

spesies yang sama, tentu saja.
Bagaimana, apakah kamu ingin aku\lmemindahkan Jurusan Telur dari satu

Pokémon ke Pokémon lain? Biayanya
hanya $[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Would you like me to move Egg Moves
from one Pokémon to another in the\lsame species family?

It’ll only cost you $[green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Would you like me to move Egg Moves from one Pokémon to another in the same species family? It’ll only cost you $[color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu ingin aku memindahkan
Jurusan Telur dari satu Pokémon ke\lPokémon lain dalam keluarga spesies

yang sama? Biayanya hanya
$[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon will you be
transferring Egg Moves from?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon will you be transferring Egg Moves from?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang akan kamu
transfer Jurusan Telurnya?

entries.original:
"So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves
from [green][buffer1][blue]?

Choose the Pokémon in the
[green][buffer2][blue] family to transfer\lmoves to."
entries.translation_source: So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves from [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]? Choose the Pokémon in the [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] family to transfer moves to.
entries.translated:
Jadi kamu akan mentransfer Jurusan
Telur dari [green][buffer1][blue]? Pilih Pokémon\ldalam keluarga [green][buffer2][blue] untuk

mentransfer jurus.

entries.original:
"So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves
from [green][buffer1][blue] to [green][buffer2][blue].

Should the new moves only fill the
remaining space [buffer2] has\lavailable in its moveset, or can\lmoves be deleted if need be?"
entries.translation_source: So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves from [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] to [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]. Should the new moves only fill the remaining space [buffer2-7] has available in its moveset, or can moves be deleted if need be?
entries.translated:
Jadi kamu akan mentransfer Jurusan
Telur dari [green][buffer1][blue] ke [green][buffer2][blue].\lHaruskah jurus baru hanya mengisi

ruang tersisa yang dimiliki
[buffer2] di kumpulan jurusnya, atau\lbisakah jurus dihapus jika perlu?

entries.original:
"The transfer was a success!
[buffer1] has learned new moves.

And that’ll be $[green][buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: The transfer was a success! [buffer1-1] has learned new moves. And that’ll be $[color-green-2][buffer2-3][color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Transfer berhasil! [buffer1] telah
mempelajari jurus baru. Dan itu\lakan menjadi $[green][buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"If you need to transfer Egg Moves,
come see me anytime!"
entries.translation_source: If you need to transfer Egg Moves, come see me anytime!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu perlu mentransfer Jurusan
Telur, datanglah padaku kapan saja!

entries.original:
"I’m afraid you don’t have enough
money for my special technique."
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid you don’t have enough money for my special technique.
entries.translated:
Maaf, kamu tidak memiliki cukup
uang untuk teknik spesialku.

entries.original:
"My technique is for Egg Moves,
not Eggs themselves."
entries.translation_source: My technique is for Egg Moves, not Eggs themselves.
entries.translated:
Teknikku untuk Jurusan Telur, bukan
untuk Telur itu sendiri.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like [buffer1]
knows any Egg Moves.

It won’t be able to transfer any
moves unless it learns some."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like [buffer1-1] knows any Egg Moves. It won’t be able to transfer any moves unless it learns some.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya [buffer1] tidak tahu
Jurusan Telur apa pun. Ia tidak\lakan bisa mentransfer jurus apa pun

kecuali ia mempelajari beberapa.

entries.original:
"Whoops, looks like you already
chose that Pokémon.

Could you choose a different
Pokémon in [green][buffer1][blue]’s family?"
entries.translation_source: Whoops, looks like you already chose that Pokémon. Could you choose a different Pokémon in [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]’s family?
entries.translated:
Ups, sepertinya kamu sudah memilih
Pokémon itu. Bisakah kamu memilih\lPokémon lain dalam keluarga

[green][buffer1][blue]?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] and [buffer2] don’t
belong to the same species family.

My technique only works on Pokémon
that have evolutions in common.

For instance, I can transfer moves
between a Snorunt and a Glalie, or\la Glalie and a Froslass.

I cannot, however, transfer moves
from Snorunt to Vanillite, as they\lshare no evolutions."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] and [buffer2-2] don’t belong to the same species family. My technique only works on Pokémon that have evolutions in common. For instance, I can transfer moves between a Snorunt and a Glalie, or a Glalie and a Froslass. I cannot, however, transfer moves from Snorunt to Vanillite, as they share no evolutions.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] dan [buffer2] bukan dari
keluarga spesies yang sama.\lTeknikku hanya bekerja pada Pokémon

yang memiliki evolusi yang sama.
Misalnya, saya dapat mentransfer\lserangan antara Snorunt dan Glalie,

atau Glalie dan Froslass. Namun,
saya tidak dapat mentransfer\lserangan dari Snorunt ke Vanillite,

karena mereka tidak berbagi
evolusi.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like [buffer2] has
any space in its moveset to learn\lnew moves.

If you don’t want me to delete the
moves at the top of its moveset,\lthen choose moves to delete at the\l[green]Move Deleter[blue] in [green]Epidimy Town[blue]."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like [buffer2-1] has any space in its moveset to learn new moves. If you don’t want me to delete the moves at the top of its moveset, then choose moves to delete at the [color-green-2]Move Deleter[color-blue-3] in [color-green-4]Epidimy Town[color-blue-5].
entries.translated:
Sepertinya [buffer2] tidak memiliki
ruang di kumpulan jurusnya untuk\lmempelajari jurus baru. Jika kamu

tidak ingin aku menghapus jurus di
bagian atas kumpulan jurusnya, maka\lpilih jurus yang akan dihapus di

[green]Penghapus Jurus[blue] di [green]Epidimy Town[blue].

entries.original:
"Whoops, looks like [buffer1]
already knows the moves it was\lgoing to learn.

I guess I won’t be charging you
after all!"
entries.translation_source: Whoops, looks like [buffer1-1] already knows the moves it was going to learn. I guess I won’t be charging you after all!
entries.translated:
Ups, sepertinya [buffer1] sudah tahu
jurus-jurus yang akan\ldipelajarinya. Kurasa aku tidak

akan meminta bayaran darimu!

entries.original: "Fill Remaining Space"
entries.translation_source: Fill Remaining Space
entries.translated: Isi Sisa Ruang

entries.original: "Delete Old Moves"
entries.translation_source: Delete Old Moves
entries.translated: Hapus Jurusan Lama

entries.original: "Dehara City"
entries.translation_source: Dehara City

entries.original: "Dehara City D"
entries.translation_source: Dehara City D

entries.original: "Dehara City N"
entries.translation_source: Dehara City N

entries.original:
"Whooa, [buffer1]!

If a Pokémon uses the move [green]Surf[blue],
it can catch a wave!

I’ve seen the move lying around
somewhere in the city, [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: Whooa, [buffer1-1]! If a Pokémon uses the move [color-green-2]Surf[color-blue-3], it can catch a wave! I’ve seen the move lying around somewhere in the city, [buffer1-4][game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Wah, [buffer1]! Jika seekor Pokémon
menggunakan jurus [green]Berselancar[blue], ia\lbisa menangkap ombak! Aku pernah

melihat jurus itu tergeletak di
suatu tempat di kota ini, [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"Whooa, [buffer1]!

If a Pokémon uses the move [green]Surf[blue],
it can catch a wave!

And if a [green]Fire[blue]-type Pokémon goes to
the volcano, it can ride on [green]lava[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Whooa, [buffer1-1]! If a Pokémon uses the move [color-green-2]Surf[color-blue-3], it can catch a wave! And if a [color-green-4]Fire[color-blue-5]-type Pokémon goes to the volcano, it can ride on [color-green-6]lava[color-blue-7]!
entries.translated:
Whooa, [buffer1]! Jika seekor
Pokémon menggunakan jurus [green]Surf[blue], ia\ldapat menangkap ombak! Dan jika

seekor Pokémon tipe [green]Api[blue] pergi ke
gunung berapi, ia dapat menaiki\l[green]lava[blue]!

entries.original: "dude"
entries.translation_source: dude

entries.original:
"I just can’t stop shopping!

There’s so much variety at the
[green]Dehara Department Store[red]!"
entries.translation_source: I just can’t stop shopping! There’s so much variety at the [color-green-1]Dehara Department Store[color-red-2]!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa berhenti berbelanja!
Ada begitu banyak variasi di [green]Dehara\lDepartment Store[red]!

entries.original:
"It’s my job to make sure this city
stays a beautiful oasis at the edge\lof the desert.

All these trees aren’t natural to
this area.

I planted each and every one
of ’em!"
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to make sure this city stays a beautiful oasis at the edge of the desert. All these trees aren’t natural to this area. I planted each and every one of ’em!
entries.translated:
Tugas saya memastikan kota ini
tetap menjadi oasis yang indah di\ltepi gurun. Semua pohon ini tidak

alami di daerah ini. Saya menanam
setiap satu dari mereka!

entries.original:
"The history books say the ancient
king of Borrius had his castle\lbuilt in this very spot!

That makes sense - his tomb is
nearby in the Great Desert,\lafter all."
entries.translation_source: The history books say the ancient king of Borrius had his castle built in this very spot! That makes sense - his tomb is nearby in the Great Desert, after all.
entries.translated:
Buku-buku sejarah mengatakan bahwa
raja kuno Borrius membangun\lkastilnya di tempat ini! Itu masuk

akal - lagipula, makamnya ada di
dekat sini di Gurun Besar.

entries.original:
"Mmm\.

A park at the edge of a desert city
is so relaxing.

Dehara City is just a wonderful
oasis paradise!"
entries.translation_source: Mmm[game-token-1] A park at the edge of a desert city is so relaxing. Dehara City is just a wonderful oasis paradise!
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Taman di pinggir kota padang
pasir sangat menenangkan. Dehara\lCity benar-benar surga oasis yang

indah!

entries.original:
"This house over here is known as
the [green]Double Battle House[blue].

Like the other Trainer Houses, the
Trainers inside can be battled as\lmany times as you want.

It’s a great place for training up
your Pokémon if you’re thinking of\ltaking on the Gym."
entries.translation_source: This house over here is known as the [color-green-1]Double Battle House[color-blue-2]. Like the other Trainer Houses, the Trainers inside can be battled as many times as you want. It’s a great place for training up your Pokémon if you’re thinking of taking on the Gym.
entries.translated:
Rumah di sini dikenal sebagai [green]Rumah
Pertarungan Ganda[blue]. Seperti Rumah\lPelatih lainnya, Pelatih di

dalamnya dapat dilawan sebanyak
yang kamu mau. Tempat ini bagus\luntuk melatih Pokémon-mu jika kamu

berniat menantang Gym.

entries.original:
"This cave is known as Rift Cave.

During my research, I discovered
it has many similarities with\lSinnoh’s [green]Turnback Cave[blue].

Could this mean it is somehow
connected to the mysterious\l[green]Distortion World[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: This cave is known as Rift Cave. During my research, I discovered it has many similarities with Sinnoh’s [color-green-1]Turnback Cave[color-blue-2]. Could this mean it is somehow connected to the mysterious [color-green-3]Distortion World[color-blue-4]?
entries.translated:
Gua ini dikenal sebagai Rift Cave.
Selama penelitianku, aku menemukan\lbahwa gua ini memiliki banyak

kesamaan dengan [green]Turnback Cave[blue] milik
Sinnoh. Mungkinkah ini berarti gua\lini terhubung dengan [green]Dunia Distorsi[blue]

yang misterius?

entries.original:
"Aren’t you boiling in those clothes?

What would compel you to wear
that outfit by the desert?"
entries.translation_source: Aren’t you boiling in those clothes? What would compel you to wear that outfit by the desert?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tidak kepanasan dengan
pakaian itu? Apa yang membuatmu\lmemakai pakaian itu di dekat gurun?

entries.original:
"What’s with your getup?

You couldn’t have picked a worse
thing to wear out here!

The whole cloak-and-dagger look is
sure to burn you to a crisp!"
entries.translation_source: What’s with your getup? You couldn’t have picked a worse thing to wear out here! The whole cloak-and-dagger look is sure to burn you to a crisp!
entries.translated:
Ada apa dengan pakaianmu? Kamu
tidak bisa memilih sesuatu yang\llebih buruk untuk dipakai di sini!

Penampilan seperti jubah dan belati
pasti akan membuatmu hangus!

entries.original:
"That outfit you’re wearing really
gives off the aura of \qoChampion\qc,\ly’know?

There’s no one else who could pull
it off but you, Champion!"
entries.translation_source: That outfit you’re wearing really gives off the aura of [quote-open-1]Champion[quote-close-2], y’know? There’s no one else who could pull it off but you, Champion!
entries.translated:
Pakaian yang kamu kenakan itu
benar-benar memancarkan aura\l\qoJuara\qc, kamu tahu? Tidak ada orang

lain yang bisa melakukannya selain
kamu, Juara!

entries.original:
"Your outfit looks nice and cool!

It’s not perfect for the desert,
but you won’t boil, that’s for sure!"
entries.translation_source: Your outfit looks nice and cool! It’s not perfect for the desert, but you won’t boil, that’s for sure!
entries.translated:
Pakaianmu terlihat bagus dan keren!
Meskipun tidak sempurna untuk\lgurun, kamu pasti tidak akan

kepanasan, itu pasti!

entries.original:
"Your outift is nice and silvery!

Or is that a golden sheen I
see?

Either way, you’re looking like quite
the hero in that outfit!"
entries.translation_source: Your outift is nice and silvery! Or is that a golden sheen I see? Either way, you’re looking like quite the hero in that outfit!
entries.translated:
Pakaianmu bagus dan keperakan! Atau
apakah itu kilau keemasan yang\lkulihat? Bagaimanapun, kamu

terlihat seperti pahlawan sejati
dengan pakaian itu!

entries.original:
"I tried travelling through the
[green]Great Desert[red] to the east of town,\lbut the sandstorm was too strong.

It kept whipping sand in my face,
and I couldn’t see anything.

Without [green]Go-Goggles[red] to protect my
eyes, it was impossible to go\lanywhere.

I know some guy around here has a
whole collection of them, but he’s\lvery particular about who he gives\lout to."
entries.translation_source: I tried travelling through the [color-green-1]Great Desert[color-red-2] to the east of town, but the sandstorm was too strong. It kept whipping sand in my face, and I couldn’t see anything. Without [color-green-3]Go-Goggles[color-red-4] to protect my eyes, it was impossible to go anywhere. I know some guy around here has a whole collection of them, but he’s very particular about who he gives out to.
entries.translated:
Saya mencoba menjelajahi [green]Gurun
Besar[red] di sebelah timur kota, tetapi\lbadai pasirnya terlalu kuat. Pasir

terus menerpa wajahku, dan aku
tidak bisa melihat apa pun. Tanpa\l[green]Kacamata Go[red] untuk melindungi

mataku, mustahil untuk pergi ke
mana pun. Aku tahu seseorang di\lsini memiliki koleksi lengkapnya,

tetapi dia sangat pemilih soal
kepada siapa dia memberikannya.

entries.original:
"I tried travelling through the
[green]Great Desert[red] to the east of town,\lbut the sandstorm was too strong.

It kept whipping sand in my face,
