and I couldn’t see anything.

If I had Go-Goggles like you, I’d
be able to explore it no problem!"
entries.translation_source: I tried travelling through the [color-green-1]Great Desert[color-red-2] to the east of town, but the sandstorm was too strong. It kept whipping sand in my face, and I couldn’t see anything. If I had Go-Goggles like you, I’d be able to explore it no problem!
entries.translated:
Saya mencoba melintasi [green]Great Desert[red]
di sebelah timur kota, tapi badai\lpasirnya terlalu kuat. Pasir terus

menerpa wajah saya, dan saya tidak
bisa melihat apa-apa. Jika saya\lmemiliki Kacamata Go seperti kamu,

saya pasti bisa menjelajahinya
tanpa masalah!

entries.original:
"Whew.

I.\CC0818 Am.\CC0818 Parched.

I could really go for a Soda Pop
right about now\."
entries.translation_source: Whew. I.[control-code-1] Am.[control-code-2] Parched. I could really go for a Soda Pop right about now[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Fiuh. Aku.\CC0818 Adalah.\CC0818 Haus. Aku
benar-benar ingin Soda Pop sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Hey! That’s a Soda Pop I sense
in your Cube!

Mind sharing it with me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey! That’s a Soda Pop I sense in your Cube! Mind sharing it with me?
entries.translated:
Hei! Itu Soda Pop yang aku cium di
Kubusmu! Mau berbagi denganku?

entries.original:
"[black]You shared a Soda Pop with the
Battle Girl."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You shared a Soda Pop with the Battle Girl.
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu berbagi Soda Pop dengan Gadis
Pertarungan.

entries.original:
"Mmm\.\CC0820 That.\CC0818 Was.\CC0818 Sweet!

Thanks a whole bunch, Trainer!
Here, you can have this."
entries.translation_source: Mmm[game-token-1][control-code-2] That.[control-code-3] Was.[control-code-4] Sweet! Thanks a whole bunch, Trainer! Here, you can have this.
entries.translated:
Mmm\.\CC0820 Itu.\CC0818 Sungguh.\CC0818 Mantap! Terima
kasih banyak, Pelatih! Ini, kamu\lbisa ambil ini.

entries.original:
"Give the [green]Expert Belt[red] to a Pokémon,
and all its super effective attacks\lwill deal more damage!

Sweet, yeah?"
entries.translation_source: Give the [color-green-1]Expert Belt[color-red-2] to a Pokémon, and all its super effective attacks will deal more damage! Sweet, yeah?
entries.translated:
Beri [green]Sabuk Pakar[red] pada Pokémon, dan
semua serangan super efektifnya\lakan memberikan lebih banyak

kerusakan! Keren, ya?

entries.original:
"You sure are stingy, Trainer.

That’s a habit you should drop if
you know what’s good for you."
entries.translation_source: You sure are stingy, Trainer. That’s a habit you should drop if you know what’s good for you.
entries.translated:
Kamu memang pelit sekali, Pelatih.
Kebiasaan itu harus kamu buang jika\lkamu tahu apa yang baik untukmu.

entries.original:
"Whenever I play with sand castles on
[green]Sundays[blue] and [green]Wednesdays[blue], they jump\lup and attack me!

It’s really scary!"
entries.translation_source: Whenever I play with sand castles on [color-green-1]Sundays[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Wednesdays[color-blue-4], they jump up and attack me! It’s really scary!
entries.translated:
Setiap kali aku bermain dengan
istana pasir pada [green]hari Minggu[blue] dan\l[green]hari Rabu[blue], mereka melompat dan

menyerangku! Ini sangat menakutkan!

entries.original:
"Do you like my sand castle?

I worked really hard to make it!"
entries.translation_source: Do you like my sand castle? I worked really hard to make it!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu suka istana pasirku?
Aku bekerja sangat keras untuk\lmembuatnya!

entries.original:
"Wahhhh!

My sand castle is gone!"
entries.translation_source: Wahhhh! My sand castle is gone!
entries.translated: Wahhhh! Kastil pasirku hilang!

entries.original:
"Galavan lowers the bridge to his
Gym while he’s out travelling.

He’ll return eventually, you just
need to be patient."
entries.translation_source: Galavan lowers the bridge to his Gym while he’s out travelling. He’ll return eventually, you just need to be patient.
entries.translated:
Galavan menurunkan jembatan menuju
Gym-nya saat dia sedang bepergian.\lDia akan kembali pada akhirnya,

kamu hanya perlu bersabar.

entries.original:
"Looks like Galavan has raised the
bridge to his Gym!

Now would be a great time to head
in there and challenge him."
entries.translation_source: Looks like Galavan has raised the bridge to his Gym! Now would be a great time to head in there and challenge him.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Galavan telah menaikkan
jembatan menuju Gym-nya! Sekarang\ladalah waktu yang tepat untuk masuk

ke sana dan menantangnya.

entries.original:
"Looks like Galavan has raised the
bridge to his Gym!

Now’s a great time for aspiring
Trainers to challenge him.

Lucky for you, you already did!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like Galavan has raised the bridge to his Gym! Now’s a great time for aspiring Trainers to challenge him. Lucky for you, you already did!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Galavan telah menaikkan
jembatan menuju Gym-nya! Sekarang\ladalah waktu yang tepat bagi para

Trainer yang bercita-cita untuk
menantangnya. Untungnya, kamu sudah\lmelakukannya!

entries.original:
"Aw, jeez\.

I blew all of my money at the
Game Corner!

Looks like I won’t be needing
this anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Aw, jeez[game-token-1] I blew all of my money at the Game Corner! Looks like I won’t be needing this anymore!
entries.translated:
Astaga\. Aku menghabiskan semua
uangku di Pojok Permainan!\lSepertinya aku tidak akan

membutuhkan ini lagi!

entries.original: "I always thought I could win\."
entries.translation_source: I always thought I could win[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Aku selalu berpikir aku bisa menang\.

entries.original:
"This apartment is owned by an
illustrious businessman in\lSeaport City.

The apartment is in high demand, so
I’m afraid you will not be able to\lrent it for yourself."
entries.translation_source: This apartment is owned by an illustrious businessman in Seaport City. The apartment is in high demand, so I’m afraid you will not be able to rent it for yourself.
entries.translated:
Apartemen ini dimiliki oleh seorang
pengusaha terkemuka di Seaport\lCity. Apartemen ini sangat

diminati, jadi saya khawatir Anda
tidak akan bisa menyewanya untuk\ldiri sendiri.

entries.original:
"I’m pretty lucky for scoring
this apartment!

Everyone knows it’s hard to score
an apartment owned by that guy\ldown in Seaport."
entries.translation_source: I’m pretty lucky for scoring this apartment! Everyone knows it’s hard to score an apartment owned by that guy down in Seaport.
entries.translated:
Aku cukup beruntung mendapatkan
apartemen ini! Semua orang tahu\lsulit mendapatkan apartemen yang

dimiliki oleh orang itu di Seaport.

entries.original:
"Hey you!
Let me play with your Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Hey you! Let me play with your Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Hei kamu! Biarkan aku bermain
dengan Pokémon-mu!

entries.original:
"[black]The little boy played with
[buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little boy played with [buffer1-2].
entries.translated:
[black]Anak laki-laki kecil itu bermain
dengan [buffer1].

entries.original:
"But\. but\. but in Magnolia Town, I
play so much with the Pokémon!

They’ve all become super [green]friendly[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: But[game-token-1] but[game-token-2] but in Magnolia Town, I play so much with the Pokémon! They’ve all become super [color-green-3]friendly[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Tapi\. tapi\. tapi di Magnolia Town,
aku sangat sering bermain dengan\lPokémon! Mereka semua menjadi super

[green]ramah[blue]!

entries.original:
"I can’t play with an Egg!

I wanna play with a Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t play with an Egg! I wanna play with a Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa bermain dengan
Telur! Aku ingin bermain dengan\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"I wanna play with your Pokémon
again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: I wanna play with your Pokémon again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Aku ingin bermain dengan Pokémon-mu
lagi besok!

entries.original:
"If you treat your Pokémon nicely,
they will love you in return.

Oh? Let me see your Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: If you treat your Pokémon nicely, they will love you in return. Oh? Let me see your Pokémon[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Jika kamu memperlakukan Pokémon-mu
dengan baik, mereka akan\lmenyayangimu sebagai balasannya.

Oh? Biarkan aku melihat Pokémon-mu\.

entries.original:
"It looks really happy!
It must love you a lot."
entries.translation_source: It looks really happy! It must love you a lot.

entries.original:
"I get the feeling that it really
trusts you."
entries.translation_source: I get the feeling that it really trusts you.

entries.original:
"It’s friendly toward you.
It looks sort of happy."
entries.translation_source: It’s friendly toward you. It looks sort of happy.

entries.original: "It’s quite cute."
entries.translation_source: It’s quite cute.

entries.original:
"You should treat it better.
It’s not used to you."
entries.translation_source: You should treat it better. It’s not used to you.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t seem to like you at all.
It looks mean."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t seem to like you at all. It looks mean.

entries.original: "Pyukumuku Chucker"
entries.translation_source: Pyukumuku Chucker
entries.translated: Pyukumuku Chucker

entries.original:
"Pyukumuku have been washing ashore
and are scaring away the tourists!
Throw them all back in the ocean."
entries.translation_source: Pyukumuku have been washing ashore and are scaring away the tourists! Throw them all back in the ocean.

entries.original:
"The Dehara beach used to be a
popular tourist destination for\lmany tourists from East Borrius.

But their attendance has dwindled
recently ever since Pokémon known\las Pyukumuku began to wash ashore.

They’re spiky and cause injuries
to the tourists who step on them.

I’m in dire need of a Trainer to
throw them back in the ocean.

So what do you say?

Think you’ve got what it takes to
be a [green]Pyukumuku chucker[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: The Dehara beach used to be a popular tourist destination for many tourists from East Borrius. But their attendance has dwindled recently ever since Pokémon known as Pyukumuku began to wash ashore. They’re spiky and cause injuries to the tourists who step on them. I’m in dire need of a Trainer to throw them back in the ocean. So what do you say? Think you’ve got what it takes to be a [color-green-1]Pyukumuku chucker[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Pantai Dehara dulu merupakan
destinasi wisata populer bagi\lbanyak turis dari Borrius Timur.

Namun, jumlah pengunjung menurun
akhir-akhir ini sejak Pokémon yang\ldikenal sebagai Pyukumuku mulai

terdampar di pantai. Mereka berduri
dan menyebabkan cedera pada turis\lyang menginjaknya. Aku sangat

membutuhkan seorang Pelatih untuk
melempar mereka kembali ke laut.\lJadi, bagaimana? Kamu pikir kamu

punya kemampuan untuk menjadi
seorang [green]pelempar Pyukumuku[blue]?

entries.original:
"It really doesn’t take much skill!

Besides, being a Pyukumuku chucker
is fun!"
entries.translation_source: It really doesn’t take much skill! Besides, being a Pyukumuku chucker is fun!
entries.translated:
Ini sebenarnya tidak membutuhkan
banyak keterampilan! Lagipula,\lmenjadi pelempar Pyukumuku itu

menyenangkan!

entries.original:
"Get every last Pyukumuku on the
beach diving right back to the sea!

Let’s see\.

I can still see [buffer1] Pyukumuku left on
the sand and in need of chucking."
entries.translation_source: Get every last Pyukumuku on the beach diving right back to the sea! Let’s see[game-token-1] I can still see [buffer1-2] Pyukumuku left on the sand and in need of chucking.
entries.translated:
Lempar setiap Pyukumuku yang ada di
pantai kembali ke laut! Mari kita\llihat\. Aku masih bisa melihat

[buffer1] Pyukumuku tersisa di pasir
dan perlu dilempar.

entries.original:
"Good job!

You’ve got every last Pyukumuku
that was stranded on the beach\lback into the sea!

You’re a real good worker,
you know?

You have a real knack for
Pyukumuku chucking.

Now they are safe back where they
should be, and the beach is safe\lfor tourists.

And I’ve got your reward ready for
you right here.

Take it!
You’ve earned it!"
entries.translation_source: Good job! You’ve got every last Pyukumuku that was stranded on the beach back into the sea! You’re a real good worker, you know? You have a real knack for Pyukumuku chucking. Now they are safe back where they should be, and the beach is safe for tourists. And I’ve got your reward ready for you right here. Take it! You’ve earned it!
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus! Kamu telah
mengembalikan semua Pyukumuku yang\lterdampar di pantai ke laut! Kamu

pekerja yang sangat baik, tahu?
Kamu benar-benar berbakat dalam\lmelempar Pyukumuku. Sekarang mereka

aman kembali ke tempat yang
seharusnya, dan pantai aman bagi\lturis. Dan aku sudah menyiapkan

hadiahmu di sini. Ambillah! Kamu
layak mendapatkannya!

entries.original:
"Pyukumuku are one of the most
famous Alolan Pokémon.

But a lot of tourists from
East Borrius don’t understand\ltheir appeal.

It’s a real shame."
entries.translation_source: Pyukumuku are one of the most famous Alolan Pokémon. But a lot of tourists from East Borrius don’t understand their appeal. It’s a real shame.
entries.translated:
Pyukumuku adalah salah satu Pokémon
Alola yang paling terkenal. Tapi\lbanyak turis dari Borrius Timur

tidak memahami daya tarik mereka.
Sungguh disayangkan.

entries.original:
"[green]Puke?

Muke\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Puke? Muke[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Puke? Muke\.

entries.original:
"[black]You chucked the Pyukumuku back
into the sea\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You chucked the Pyukumuku back into the sea[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu melempar Pyukumuku kembali ke
laut\.

entries.original:
"[black]There are no more Pyukumuku left
on the beach."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]There are no more Pyukumuku left on the beach.
entries.translated:
[black]Tidak ada lagi Pyukumuku yang
tersisa di pantai.

entries.original:
"Hi! I am a humble Maid!

My master has a big heart to match
his big belly. He’s a gourmet!

So I am looking for ingredients
that will make his heart jump\lfor joy!

Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\.

Oh, that aroma!
It smells so gourmet!

Do you have a wonderful ingredient
in your bag?

Would you consider selling it
to me?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! I am a humble Maid! My master has a big heart to match his big belly. He’s a gourmet! So I am looking for ingredients that will make his heart jump for joy! Sniff, sniff[game-token-1] Sniff, sniff[game-token-2] Oh, that aroma! It smells so gourmet! Do you have a wonderful ingredient in your bag? Would you consider selling it to me?
entries.translated:
Hai! Aku adalah Pembantu yang
rendah hati! Tuanku memiliki hati\lyang besar sebanding dengan perut

besarnya. Dia seorang gourmet! Jadi
aku mencari bahan-bahan yang akan\lmembuat hatinya melompat

kegirangan! Mengendus, mengendus\.
Mengendus, mengendus\. Oh, aroma itu!\lBaunya sangat gourmet! Apakah kamu

memiliki bahan yang luar biasa di
dalam tasmu? Apakah kamu bersedia\lmenjualnya kepadaku?

entries.original:
"Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\.

Oh, that aroma!
It smells so gourmet!

Do you have a wonderful ingredient
in your bag?

Would you consider selling it
to me?"
entries.translation_source: Sniff, sniff[game-token-1] Sniff, sniff[game-token-2] Oh, that aroma! It smells so gourmet! Do you have a wonderful ingredient in your bag? Would you consider selling it to me?
entries.translated:
Mengendus, mengendus\. Mengendus,
mengendus\. Oh, aroma itu! Baunya\lsangat gourmet! Apakah kamu

memiliki bahan yang luar biasa di
dalam tasmu? Apakah kamu bersedia\lmenjualnya kepadaku?

entries.original:
"Oh, it smells so good!

That [green][buffer3][red] of yours is a
very rare ingredient indeed!

Would you take $[green][buffer2][red] for it?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, it smells so good! That [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-red-3] of yours is a very rare ingredient indeed! Would you take $[color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-red-6] for it?
entries.translated:
Oh, baunya enak sekali! [green][buffer3][red]
milikmu itu benar-benar bahan yang\lsangat langka! Maukah kamu menerima

$[green][buffer2][red] untuk itu?

entries.original:
"Merci! Thank you!

With this, I can create a superb
menu!

My master will be so surprised!"
entries.translation_source: Merci! Thank you! With this, I can create a superb menu! My master will be so surprised!
entries.translated:
Merci! Terima kasih! Dengan ini,
aku bisa membuat menu yang luar\lbiasa! Tuanku akan sangat terkejut!

entries.original:
"Hmm\. This is not quite what I’m
looking for.

I don’t think my master will be
satisfied with such a smell\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] This is not quite what I’m looking for. I don’t think my master will be satisfied with such a smell[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Ini bukan yang aku cari. Aku
rasa tuanku tidak akan puas dengan\laroma seperti itu\.

entries.original:
"Aww\. Well, that’s okay.

If you find a gourmet ingredient
for me, please let me know!"
entries.translation_source: Aww[game-token-1] Well, that’s okay. If you find a gourmet ingredient for me, please let me know!
entries.translated:
Aww\. Yah, tidak apa-apa. Jika kamu
menemukan bahan gourmet untukku,\ltolong beri tahu aku!

entries.original: "Choose Item"
entries.translation_source: Choose Item
entries.translated: Pilih Item

entries.original: "Choose Berry"
entries.translation_source: Choose Berry
entries.translated: Pilih Berry

entries.original:
"I just simply adore ores.

Don’t you have an adorable ore that
shakes my core?"
entries.translation_source: I just simply adore ores. Don’t you have an adorable ore that shakes my core?
entries.translated:
Aku hanya sangat menyukai bijih.
Apakah kamu tidak memiliki bijih\lyang menggemaskan yang mengguncang

hatiku?

entries.original:
"Don’t you have an adorable ore that
shakes my core?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you have an adorable ore that shakes my core?
entries.translated:
Bukankah kamu punya bijih
menggemaskan yang mengguncang\lintiku?

entries.original:
"Oh, I do adore the ores!

That [green][buffer3][blue], it’s shaking me!
Will you sell it for $[green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I do adore the ores! That [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3], it’s shaking me! Will you sell it for $[color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]?
entries.translated:
Oh, aku sangat menyukai
bijih-bijih! Itu [green][buffer3][blue] membuatku\lgemetar! Maukah kau menjualnya

seharga $[green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"[black]Handed over [green][buffer1][black] of [green][buffer3][black]
and received $[green][buffer2][black]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Handed over [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-black-4] of [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-black-7] and received $[color-green-8][buffer2-9][color-black-10]!
entries.translated:
[black]Menyerahkan [green][buffer1][black] dari [green][buffer3][black]
dan menerima $[green][buffer2][black]!

entries.original:
"The deal is done!
I’ve scored an ore I can adore!"
entries.translation_source: The deal is done! I’ve scored an ore I can adore!
entries.translated:
Urusan beres! Aku berhasil
mendapatkan bijih yang kusukai!

entries.original:
"Huh? What on earth is this?

You can’t shake my core with
an ore so poor!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What on earth is this? You can’t shake my core with an ore so poor!
entries.translated:
Hah? Apa-apaan ini? Kau tak bisa
mengguncang intiku dengan bijih\lyang buruk!

entries.original:
"Hmmm. My core won’t change.
I hope you sell it to me someday."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm. My core won’t change. I hope you sell it to me someday.
entries.translated:
Hmm. Inti saya tidak akan berubah.
Saya harap Anda menjualnya kepada\lsaya suatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet
deal for ya!

You know how Pokémon like to hide
behind stones or rocks, yeah?

Sometimes they hide cool bones,
too.

If you find a [green]Rare Bone[blue] somewhere,
you should bring it to me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet deal for ya! You know how Pokémon like to hide behind stones or rocks, yeah? Sometimes they hide cool bones, too. If you find a [color-green-1]Rare Bone[color-blue-2] somewhere, you should bring it to me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Hei, lihat ini. Aku punya tawaran
menarik untukmu! Kamu tahu\lbagaimana Pokémon suka bersembunyi

di balik batu atau bebatuan, ya?
Kadang-kadang mereka juga\lmenyembunyikan tulang keren. Jika

kamu menemukan [green]Tulang Langka[blue] di
suatu tempat, kamu harus membawanya\lkepadaku. Aku akan membuatnya

sepadan untukmu.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Did you find a [green]Rare Bone[blue] for me?

Looks like you did.

If you want to sell it, I’ll buy
it from you for $[green]10000[blue]."
entries.translation_source: What’s up? Did you find a [color-green-1]Rare Bone[color-blue-2] for me? Looks like you did. If you want to sell it, I’ll buy it from you for $[color-green-3]10000[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Ada apa? Apakah kamu menemukan
[green]Tulang Langka[blue] untukku? Sepertinya\lkamu menemukannya. Jika kamu ingin

menjualnya, aku akan membelinya
darimu seharga $[green]10000[blue].

entries.original:
"If you find any more Rare Bones
come see me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: If you find any more Rare Bones come see me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu menemukan lebih banyak
Tulang Langka, datanglah menemuiku.\lAku akan membuatnya sepadan

untukmu.

entries.original:
"Hey, come see me if you find a
Rare Bone, got it?

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, come see me if you find a Rare Bone, got it? I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Hei, temui aku jika kamu menemukan
Tulang Langka, oke? Aku akan\lmembuatnya sepadan.

entries.original:
"Ha hoo!
You have a Pokédex.

How many Pokémon have you found?"
entries.translation_source: Ha hoo! You have a Pokédex. How many Pokémon have you found?
entries.translated:
Ha hoo! Kamu punya Pokédex. Berapa
banyak Pokémon yang sudah kamu\ltemukan?

entries.original:
"Hoo ha! You’ve found [buffer1] or more!
Now we’re talking! This is for you!"
entries.translation_source: Hoo ha! You’ve found [buffer1-1] or more! Now we’re talking! This is for you!
entries.translated:
Hore! Kamu telah menemukan [buffer1]
atau lebih! Nah, ini baru namanya!\lIni untukmu!

entries.original:
"Hoo ha!
You’ve only found [green][buffer2][blue].

Come show me your Pokédex again
when you’ve found at least [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Hoo ha! You’ve only found [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3]. Come show me your Pokédex again when you’ve found at least [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6].
entries.translated:
Hoo ha! Kamu hanya menemukan
[green][buffer2][blue]. Datang tunjukkan\lPokédex-mu lagi saat kamu sudah

menemukan setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"A Pokémon holding a [green]Binding Band[blue]
can do more continuous damage with\lits trapping moves.

But what’s more important is this.

Have you shown your Pokédex to a
professor?"
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon holding a [color-green-1]Binding Band[color-blue-2] can do more continuous damage with its trapping moves. But what’s more important is this. Have you shown your Pokédex to a professor?
entries.translated:
Seekor Pokémon yang memegang [green]Gelang
Pengikat[blue] dapat memberikan kerusakan\lterus-menerus lebih besar dengan

serangan menjebaknya. Tapi yang
lebih penting adalah ini. Sudahkah\lkamu menunjukkan Pokédex-mu kepada

seorang profesor?

entries.original:
"Yawn\.

Raising so many Pokémon from the
Sinnoh region is exhausting\.

Oh!

You seem like a strong Trainer!

How would you like to raise one
for me?"
entries.translation_source: Yawn[game-token-1] Raising so many Pokémon from the Sinnoh region is exhausting[game-token-2] Oh! You seem like a strong Trainer! How would you like to raise one for me?
entries.translated:
Menguap\. Membesarkan begitu banyak
Pokémon dari wilayah Sinnoh sangat\lmelelahkan\. Oh! Kamu kelihatan

seperti Pelatih yang kuat!
Bagaimana kalau kamu membesarkan\lsatu untukku?

entries.original:
"Yawn\.

Raising so many Pokémon from the
Sinnoh region is exhausting\.

Which of my Pokémon would you like?"
entries.translation_source: Yawn[game-token-1] Raising so many Pokémon from the Sinnoh region is exhausting[game-token-2] Which of my Pokémon would you like?
entries.translated:
Menguap\. Membesarkan begitu banyak
Pokémon dari wilayah Sinnoh sangat\lmelelahkan\. Pokémon mana dari

milikku yang kamu inginkan?

entries.original:
"Oh, alright.

I’ll just have to keep struggling,
then."
entries.translation_source: Oh, alright. I’ll just have to keep struggling, then.
entries.translated:
Oh, baiklah. Aku harus terus
berjuang, kalau begitu.

entries.original:
"I’m so exhausted\.

But you’re in no state to help me
with a full party of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m so exhausted[game-token-1] But you’re in no state to help me with a full party of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat lelah\. Tapi kamu tidak
dalam kondisi untuk membantuku\ldengan tim Pokémon yang penuh.

entries.original:
"Please raise it well!

If you come back when you have [green][buffer1]
Badges[red], I’ll give you another."
entries.translation_source: Please raise it well! If you come back when you have [color-green-1][buffer1-2] Badges[color-red-3], I’ll give you another.
entries.translated:
Tolong rawat dengan baik! Jika kamu
kembali saat memiliki [green][buffer1]\lLencana[red], aku akan memberimu satu

lagi.

entries.original:
"I have been able to get much more
rest now that I have fewer Pokémon\lto look after!

Thank you for that, Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: I have been able to get much more rest now that I have fewer Pokémon to look after! Thank you for that, Trainer!
entries.translated:
Saya bisa beristirahat lebih banyak
sekarang karena saya memiliki lebih\lsedikit Pokémon untuk dijaga!

Terima kasih untuk itu, Pelatih!

entries.original: "[green]Turtwig"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Turtwig

entries.original: "[lightgreen]Chimchar"
entries.translation_source: [color-lightgreen-1]Chimchar

entries.original: "[blue]Piplup"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Piplup

entries.original:
"[black]Oh! The Pokémon has something in
its mouth."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Oh! The Pokémon has something in its mouth.
entries.translated:
[black]Oh! Pokémon itu memiliki sesuatu di
mulutnya.

entries.original: "[green]Ooh ooh!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Ooh ooh!
entries.translated: [green]Ooh ooh!

entries.original:
"Hiya!

My grandmother has a business of
teaching Pokémon a move in\lexchange for some Yellow Shards.

If you haven’t had a chance to find
any, let me help you out."
entries.translation_source: Hiya! My grandmother has a business of teaching Pokémon a move in exchange for some Yellow Shards. If you haven’t had a chance to find any, let me help you out.
entries.translated:
Hai! Nenekku memiliki bisnis
mengajarkan jurus kepada Pokémon\ldengan imbalan beberapa Yellow

Shards. Jika kamu belum sempat
menemukannya, biarkan aku\lmembantumu.

entries.original:
"You’ll be able to shock your
enemies when you learn her move!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll be able to shock your enemies when you learn her move!
entries.translated:
Kamu akan bisa menyetrum
musuh-musuhmu saat kamu mempelajari\ljurusnya!

entries.original:
"Hello there, dearie.

From my many years as a Pokémon
expert, I have gained the ability\lto teach the move, [green]Thunder Punch[red].

However, if you wish for me to
teach one of your Pokémon this\lmove, it’ll cost [green]2 Yellow Shards[red].

What do you say?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, dearie. From my many years as a Pokémon expert, I have gained the ability to teach the move, [color-green-1]Thunder Punch[color-red-2]. However, if you wish for me to teach one of your Pokémon this move, it’ll cost [color-green-3]2 Yellow Shards[color-red-4]. What do you say?
entries.translated:
Halo, sayang. Dari pengalamanku
bertahun-tahun sebagai ahli\lPokémon, aku telah mendapatkan

kemampuan untuk mengajarkan jurus,
[green]Thunder Punch[red]. Namun, jika kamu\lingin aku mengajarkan jurus ini

kepada salah satu Pokémon-mu,
biayanya [green]2 Yellow Shards[red]. Bagaimana\lmenurutmu?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should learn
[green]Thunder Punch[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should learn [color-green-1]Thunder Punch[color-red-2]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang harus belajar
[green]Thunder Punch[red]?

entries.original:
"Please, return as many times
as you wish.

As long as you have [green]Yellow Shards[red],
of course."
entries.translation_source: Please, return as many times as you wish. As long as you have [color-green-1]Yellow Shards[color-red-2], of course.
entries.translated:
Silakan, datanglah sebanyak yang
kamu mau. Tentu saja, selama kamu\lmemiliki [green]Yellow Shards[red].

entries.original:
"It appears that you do not have
any Yellow Shards.

You can find them popping up
occassionally in the Great Desert.

If you come back with any, I’ll be
happy to teach your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It appears that you do not have any Yellow Shards. You can find them popping up occassionally in the Great Desert. If you come back with any, I’ll be happy to teach your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu tidak memiliki
Yellow Shards. Kamu bisa\lmenemukannya muncul sesekali di

Great Desert. Jika kamu kembali
dengan membawanya, aku akan senang\lmengajari Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"I am a balloon man!

And I wish to see a balloon
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I am a balloon man! And I wish to see a balloon Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Aku adalah seorang balloon man! Dan
aku ingin melihat Pokémon balon!

entries.original:
"Yes! That is it!

Now, I’ll give this to you!
I’ll give you the item, Air Balloon!"
entries.translation_source: Yes! That is it! Now, I’ll give this to you! I’ll give you the item, Air Balloon!
entries.translated:
Ya! Itu dia! Sekarang, aku akan
memberikan ini padamu! Aku akan\lmemberimu item, Air Balloon!

entries.original:
"A Pokémon who has an [green]Air Balloon[blue]
can float!

Until it gets hurt, it can avoid
[green]Ground[blue]-type moves.

Yes!
I am a balloon man!"
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon who has an [color-green-1]Air Balloon[color-blue-2] can float! Until it gets hurt, it can avoid [color-green-3]Ground[color-blue-4]-type moves. Yes! I am a balloon man!
entries.translated:
Seekor Pokémon yang memiliki [green]Air
Balloon[blue] bisa melayang! Sampai\lterluka, ia bisa menghindari jurus

tipe [green]Tanah[blue]. Ya! Aku adalah seorang
balloon man!

entries.original: "I am a balloon man!"
entries.translation_source: I am a balloon man!
entries.translated: Aku adalah seorang balloon man!

entries.original:
"No!
I wish to see a balloon Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: No! I wish to see a balloon Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Aku ingin melihat Pokémon
balon!

entries.original:
"Let me tell ya something, young
feller.

To the east of here is a
vast desert.

It is so amazing, that it is
simply called the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Words can’t even begin to
describe it!

However, it’s really difficult to
traverse without the proper gear.

So don’t think ya can just waltz
out there without preppin’ first.

Yer outfit seems a little hot
for the desert, but it’ll do ya a\lgood job of protecting yer body.

As for yer eyes, I’d recommend
getting yerself a good pair of\l[green]Go-Goggles[blue].

In fact, I’d actually be willing to
give ya mine if ya can show me how\lstrong ya are by [green]beatin’ the Gym[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Let me tell ya something, young feller. To the east of here is a vast desert. It is so amazing, that it is simply called the [color-green-1]Great Desert[color-blue-2]. Words can’t even begin to describe it! However, it’s really difficult to traverse without the proper gear. So don’t think ya can just waltz out there without preppin’ first. Yer outfit seems a little hot for the desert, but it’ll do ya a good job of protecting yer body. As for yer eyes, I’d recommend getting yerself a good pair of [color-green-3]Go-Goggles[color-blue-4]. In fact, I’d actually be willing to give ya mine if ya can show me how strong ya are by [color-green-5]beatin’ the Gym[color-blue-6].
entries.translated:
Biarkan aku memberitahumu sesuatu,
anak muda. Di sebelah timur sini\lada gurun yang luas. Sangat

menakjubkan, sehingga disebut [green]Great
Desert[blue]. Kata-kata bahkan tidak bisa\lmenggambarkannya! Namun, sangat

sulit untuk melintasinya tanpa
perlengkapan yang tepat. Jadi\ljangan kira kamu bisa jalan-jalan

begitu saja tanpa persiapan.
Pakaianmu tampak sedikit panas\luntuk gurun, tapi itu akan

melindungi tubuhmu dengan baik.
Untuk matamu, aku sarankan kamu\lmendapatkan [green]Go-Goggles[blue] yang bagus.

Faktanya, aku akan memberikannya
padamu jika kamu bisa menunjukkan\lseberapa kuat kamu dengan

[green]mengalahkan Gym[blue].

entries.original:
"Never mind, looks ya already beat
it.

Great job!

Take these Go-Goggles, and explore
the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Never mind, looks ya already beat it. Great job! Take these Go-Goggles, and explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Sudahlah, sepertinya kamu sudah
mengalahkannya. Kerja bagus! Ambil\lGo-Goggles ini, dan jelajahi Great

Desert!

entries.original:
"Go young feller!

Explore the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Go young feller! Explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Pergilah anak muda! Jelajahi Great
Desert!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!

I’m Skeli, the main developer of
Pokémon Unbound.

I’m glad you took the time to play
up to this point!

Keep playing, and if you defeat
the Pokémon League, I’d love\lto battle you!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Skeli, the main developer of Pokémon Unbound. I’m glad you took the time to play up to this point! Keep playing, and if you defeat the Pokémon League, I’d love to battle you!
entries.translated:
Hei, hai! Aku Skeli, pengembang
utama Pokémon Unbound. Aku senang\lkamu meluangkan waktu untuk bermain

sampai titik ini! Teruslah bermain,
dan jika kamu mengalahkan Pokémon\lLeague, aku ingin bertarung

denganmu!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!

I’m Skeli, the main developer of
Pokémon Unbound.

I’m glad you took the time to
complete the game and continue\lexploring!

You wanna have a battle?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Skeli, the main developer of Pokémon Unbound. I’m glad you took the time to complete the game and continue exploring! You wanna have a battle?
entries.translated:
Hei, hai! Aku Skeli, pengembang
utama Pokémon Unbound. Aku senang\lkamu meluangkan waktu untuk

menyelesaikan game dan terus
menjelajah! Kamu ingin bertarung?

entries.original:
"Sweet!

I’m warning you, though, this isn’t
going to be easy!"
entries.translation_source: Sweet! I’m warning you, though, this isn’t going to be easy!
entries.translated:
Mantap! Tapi aku peringatkan, ini
tidak akan mudah!

entries.original:
"Sweet!

Let’s have ourselves a
Double Battle today!

I’m warning you, though, this isn’t
going to be easy!"
entries.translation_source: Sweet! Let’s have ourselves a Double Battle today! I’m warning you, though, this isn’t going to be easy!
entries.translated:
Mantap! Ayo kita lakukan Double
Battle hari ini! Tapi aku\lperingatkan, ini tidak akan mudah!

entries.original:
"Sure, no prob.

If you wanna battle me, I’ll still
be here."
entries.translation_source: Sure, no prob. If you wanna battle me, I’ll still be here.
entries.translated:
Tentu, tidak masalah. Jika kamu
ingin bertarung denganku, aku akan\ltetap di sini.

entries.original:
"Oh, you don’t have enough Pokémon
to battle me today.

On even dates I like to battle two
on two, so you’ll need more."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you don’t have enough Pokémon to battle me today. On even dates I like to battle two on two, so you’ll need more.
entries.translated:
Oh, kamu tidak memiliki cukup
Pokémon untuk bertarung denganku\lhari ini. Pada tanggal genap aku

suka bertarung dua lawan dua, jadi
kamu perlu lebih banyak.

entries.original:
"That was a fun battle!
You were a tough opponent!

Come again tomorrow for another
battle!"
entries.translation_source: That was a fun battle! You were a tough opponent! Come again tomorrow for another battle!
entries.translated:
Pertarungan yang menyenangkan! Kamu
lawan yang tangguh! Datang lagi\lbesok untuk pertarungan lain!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!
I’m Golche!

The strategies of the Trainers
you faced?

I helped design them!

If you can defeat the Pokémon
League, I’d even be willing to\lshow you my own strategies!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Golche! The strategies of the Trainers you faced? I helped design them! If you can defeat the Pokémon League, I’d even be willing to show you my own strategies!
entries.translated:
Hei, halo! Aku Golche! Strategi
para Trainer yang kamu hadapi? Aku\likut mendesainnya! Jika kamu bisa

mengalahkan Pokémon League, aku
bahkan bersedia menunjukkan\lstrategiku sendiri!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!
I’m Golche!

The strategies of the Trainers
you faced?

I helped design them!

If you want, I’m willing to show
you my own strategy."
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Golche! The strategies of the Trainers you faced? I helped design them! If you want, I’m willing to show you my own strategy.
entries.translated:
Hei, halo! Aku Golche! Strategi
para Trainer yang kamu hadapi? Aku\likut mendesainnya! Jika kamu mau,

aku bersedia menunjukkan strategiku
sendiri.

entries.original:
"Time to face off against the
ultimate strategy!"
entries.translation_source: Time to face off against the ultimate strategy!
entries.translated:
Waktunya menghadapi strategi
pamungkas!

entries.original:
"No pressure.

Take your time coming up against a
way to combat my strategy."
entries.translation_source: No pressure. Take your time coming up against a way to combat my strategy.
entries.translated:
Tidak perlu terburu-buru. Luangkan
waktumu untuk mencari cara melawan\lstrategiku.

entries.original:
"Your strategy was something else!

Let me refine mine, and we can
battle again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: Your strategy was something else! Let me refine mine, and we can battle again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Strategimu luar biasa! Biarkan aku
menyempurnakan strategiku, dan kita\lbisa bertarung lagi besok!

entries.original:
"I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer\.
Thanasis!

It’s thanks to me, you were even
able to get up to this point!

I found and fixed a ton of bugs.

Not to mention, I tested the entire
battle engine from start to finish!

You’re welcome!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer[game-token-1] Thanasis! It’s thanks to me, you were even able to get up to this point! I found and fixed a ton of bugs. Not to mention, I tested the entire battle engine from start to finish! You’re welcome!
entries.translated:
Aku adalah Trainer Pokémon legasi\.
Thanasis! Berkat diriku, kamu bisa\lsampai di titik ini! Aku menemukan

dan memperbaiki banyak bug. Belum
lagi, aku menguji seluruh mesin\lpertarungan dari awal hingga akhir!

Sama-sama!

entries.original:
"I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer\.
Thanasis!

It’s thanks to me, you were even
able to get up to this point!

I found and fixed a ton of bugs.

Not to mention I tested the entire
battle engine from start to finish!

Do you want to sample what the
battle engine is capable of by\lbattling Lixdel and me?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer[game-token-1] Thanasis! It’s thanks to me, you were even able to get up to this point! I found and fixed a ton of bugs. Not to mention I tested the entire battle engine from start to finish! Do you want to sample what the battle engine is capable of by battling Lixdel and me?
entries.translated:
Aku adalah Trainer Pokémon legasi\.
Thanasis! Berkat diriku, kamu bisa\lsampai di titik ini! Aku menemukan

dan memperbaiki banyak bug. Belum
lagi aku menguji seluruh mesin\lpertarungan dari awal hingga akhir!

Apakah kamu ingin mencoba kemampuan
mesin pertarungan dengan bertarung\lmelawan Lixdel dan aku?

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, we can’t battle you
unless you have two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, we can’t battle you unless you have two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Sayangnya, kami tidak bisa
bertarung denganmu kecuali kamu\lmemiliki dua Pokémon!

entries.original:
"The legacy Pokémon Trainer\.
Is ready to begin his battle!"
entries.translation_source: The legacy Pokémon Trainer[game-token-1] Is ready to begin his battle!
entries.translated:
Trainer Pokémon legasi\. siap memulai
pertarungannya!

entries.original:
"No?
Your loss."
entries.translation_source: No? Your loss.
entries.translated: Tidak? Rugi kamu.

entries.original:
"You see?

That battle was only possible
because I helped make sure it\lwas bug-free!

Let’s do this again some other
day."
entries.translation_source: You see? That battle was only possible because I helped make sure it was bug-free! Let’s do this again some other day.
entries.translated:
Kau lihat? Pertarungan itu hanya
mungkin terjadi karena aku membantu\lmemastikannya bebas bug! Lakukan

ini lagi lain hari.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
I’m Lixdel!

I created a large chunk of those
beautiful attack animations you’ve\lbeen seeing."
entries.translation_source: What’s up? I’m Lixdel! I created a large chunk of those beautiful attack animations you’ve been seeing.
entries.translated:
Apa kabar? Aku Lixdel! Aku yang
membuat sebagian besar animasi\lserangan indah yang telah kamu

lihat.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
I’m Lixdel!

I created a large chunk of those
beautiful attack animations you’ve\lbeen seeing.

Do you want to experience some by
battling Thanasis and me?"
entries.translation_source: What’s up? I’m Lixdel! I created a large chunk of those beautiful attack animations you’ve been seeing. Do you want to experience some by battling Thanasis and me?
entries.translated:
Apa kabar? Aku Lixdel! Aku yang
membuat sebagian besar animasi\lserangan indah yang telah kamu

lihat. Apakah kamu ingin merasakan
beberapa dengan bertarung melawan\lThanasis dan aku?

entries.original:
"Sorry, you can’t battle us without
two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry, you can’t battle us without two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Maaf, kamu tidak bisa bertarung
dengan kami tanpa dua Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Let us show you some beautiful
animations!"
entries.translation_source: Let us show you some beautiful animations!
entries.translated:
Biarkan kami menunjukkan beberapa
animasi indah!

entries.original: "Not ready yet, huh?"
entries.translation_source: Not ready yet, huh?
entries.translated: Belum siap, ya?

entries.original:
"That was a great battle with some
great animations!

Come back tomorrow and we can do
this again!"
entries.translation_source: That was a great battle with some great animations! Come back tomorrow and we can do this again!
entries.translated:
Pertarungan yang hebat dengan
animasi yang keren! Kembali besok\ldan kita bisa lakukan ini lagi!

entries.original:
"Hi there, I’m Criminon!

I dedicated countless hours to a
ton of the art that you’ve seen.

I’ve sprited Trainers, Pokémon,
interfaces, and much much more.

The hardest thing that I worked on
was definitely the Costume Box.

It was so much work!

I would say my favourite thing that
I did is Cube Space!

I hope you enjoyed it!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, I’m Criminon! I dedicated countless hours to a ton of the art that you’ve seen. I’ve sprited Trainers, Pokémon, interfaces, and much much more. The hardest thing that I worked on was definitely the Costume Box. It was so much work! I would say my favourite thing that I did is Cube Space! I hope you enjoyed it!
entries.translated:
Halo, saya Criminon! Saya
menghabiskan waktu berjam-jam untuk\lbanyak karya seni yang Anda lihat.

Saya membuat sprite untuk Pelatih,
Pokémon, antarmuka, dan masih\lbanyak lagi. Hal tersulit yang saya

kerjakan pastinya adalah Kotak
Kostum. Itu sangat berat! Menurut\lsaya, hal favorit yang saya lakukan

adalah Cube Space! Saya harap Anda
menikmatinya!

entries.original:
"Hi there, I’m Criminon!

I dedicated countless hours to a
ton of the art that you’ve seen.

I can’t show you my favorite Pokémon
just yet, but how about you try\lthis team on for size!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, I’m Criminon! I dedicated countless hours to a ton of the art that you’ve seen. I can’t show you my favorite Pokémon just yet, but how about you try this team on for size!
entries.translated:
Halo, saya Criminon! Saya
menghabiskan banyak waktu untuk\lbanyak karya seni yang Anda lihat.

Saya belum bisa menunjukkan Pokémon
favorit saya, tetapi bagaimana jika\lAnda mencoba tim ini?

entries.original: "Now, watch as you get stalled out!"
entries.translation_source: Now, watch as you get stalled out!
entries.translated: Sekarang, lihat saat Anda terhenti!

entries.original:
"Yeah, I knew you wouldn’t be able
to handle it.

Toxic stall teams are the best!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, I knew you wouldn’t be able to handle it. Toxic stall teams are the best!
entries.translated:
Ya, aku tahu kamu tidak akan
sanggup menghadapinya. Tim stall\lToxic adalah yang terbaik!

entries.original:
"I’m gonna get back to training and
toughen up my team!

I’ll show you how much better I’ll
be tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: I’m gonna get back to training and toughen up my team! I’ll show you how much better I’ll be tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Aku akan kembali berlatih dan
memperkuat timku! Aku akan\lmenunjukkan betapa lebih baiknya

aku besok!

entries.original:
" to kick my butt.

It was a great battle, Champion!

You’re going places!

By the way, check your 6th item
slot!

\.

Haha!

Just kidding! "
entries.translation_source: to kick my butt. It was a great battle, Champion! You’re going places! By the way, check your 6th item slot! [game-token-1] Haha! Just kidding!

entries.original: "Dr. Fuji"
entries.translation_source: Dr. Fuji
entries.translated: Dr. Fuji

entries.original:
"The name’s Fuji.

I made the maps from Seaport City
to Cootes Bog.

And not only that, I’m largely
to thank for the game being done!

Crystal Peak was the last big
obstacle in Skeli’s way, and if I\lhadn’t created the tileset for it,\lthe game never would have been\lfinished!"
entries.translation_source: The name’s Fuji. I made the maps from Seaport City to Cootes Bog. And not only that, I’m largely to thank for the game being done! Crystal Peak was the last big obstacle in Skeli’s way, and if I hadn’t created the tileset for it, the game never would have been finished!
entries.translated:
Namaku Fuji. Aku membuat peta dari
Seaport City hingga Cootes Bog. Dan\lbukan hanya itu, aku berterima

kasih banyak karena gamenya
selesai! Crystal Peak adalah\lpenghalang besar terakhir di jalan

Skeli, dan jika aku tidak membuat
tileset untuknya, game ini tidak\lakan pernah selesai!

entries.original: "Sound Director"
entries.translation_source: Sound Director
entries.translated: Direktur Suara

entries.original:
"I’m the Sound Director!

I make sure all of the music works
properly!

Did you know a whopping 17 people
worked on the completely original\lsoundtrack and custom instruments?

I hope you’ve been enjoying all of
the music so far!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Sound Director! I make sure all of the music works properly! Did you know a whopping 17 people worked on the completely original soundtrack and custom instruments? I hope you’ve been enjoying all of the music so far!
entries.translated:
Saya adalah Direktur Suara! Saya
memastikan semua musik berfungsi\ldengan baik! Tahukah Anda bahwa 17

orang bekerja pada soundtrack yang
sepenuhnya asli dan instrumen\lkhusus? Saya harap Anda menikmati

semua musik sejauh ini!

entries.original: "Kwen"
entries.translation_source: Kwen
entries.translated: Kwen

entries.original:
"Hi, I’m Kwen.

Being an amateur fashion designer
is a huge hassle\. deadlines just\lkeep piling up!

I left my career as a Trainer to
tailor Aklove’s clothes\.

And of course, there’s also Jax and
that workout routine I gave him."
entries.translation_source: Hi, I’m Kwen. Being an amateur fashion designer is a huge hassle[game-token-1] deadlines just keep piling up! I left my career as a Trainer to tailor Aklove’s clothes[game-token-2] And of course, there’s also Jax and that workout routine I gave him.
entries.translated:
Hai, saya Kwen. Menjadi perancang
busana amatir adalah masalah besar\.\ltenggat waktu terus menumpuk! Saya

meninggalkan karier saya sebagai
Pelatih untuk menjahit pakaian\lAklove\. Dan tentu saja, ada juga Jax

dan rutinitas latihan yang saya
berikan kepadanya.

entries.original:
"Nice jacket, by the way\.\CC0818 I designed
it for you!"
entries.translation_source: Nice jacket, by the way[game-token-1][control-code-2] I designed it for you!
entries.translated:
Jaket yang bagus, omong-omong\.\CC0818 Aku
mendesainnya untukmu!

entries.original: "The Strongest There Is"
entries.translation_source: The Strongest There Is
entries.translated: Yang Terkuat yang Ada

entries.translation_source: Skeli
entries.translated: Skeli

"Defeated Skeli in a rousing
battle."
entries.translation_source: Defeated Skeli in a rousing battle.

entries.original:
"Defeated Golche in a stimulating
battle."
entries.translation_source: Defeated Golche in a stimulating battle.

entries.original:
"Defeated both Lixdel and Thanasis
in a tough two on two battle."
entries.translation_source: Defeated both Lixdel and Thanasis in a tough two on two battle.

entries.original:
"Defeated Criminon in an upbeat
battle."
entries.translation_source: Defeated Criminon in an upbeat battle.

entries.original:
"Defeat all of the Unbound devs in
Dehara City in a single day!"
entries.translation_source: Defeat all of the Unbound devs in Dehara City in a single day!

entries.original:
"The guys downstairs claim they
created the world we live in.

They must be out of their minds.
Who’d believe that?"
entries.translation_source: The guys downstairs claim they created the world we live in. They must be out of their minds. Who’d believe that?
entries.translated:
Orang-orang di bawah mengaku mereka
menciptakan dunia yang kita\ltinggali. Mereka pasti sudah gila.

Siapa yang akan percaya itu?

entries.original:
"The guys downstairs claim they
created the world we live in.

They must be out of their minds.

Someone really oughta put them in
their place.

Do you think you can do it?"
entries.translation_source: The guys downstairs claim they created the world we live in. They must be out of their minds. Someone really oughta put them in their place. Do you think you can do it?
entries.translated:
Orang-orang di bawah mengaku mereka
menciptakan dunia yang kita\ltinggali. Mereka pasti sudah gila.

Seseorang seharusnya menempatkan
mereka pada tempatnya. Menurutmu,\lbisakah kamu melakukannya?

entries.original:
"I knew I could count on you!

If you can beat all of the guys
downstairs in a single day, and\lreport back to me that same day,\lI’ll give you something that I\.\lliberated from them while they\lweren’t home."
entries.translation_source: I knew I could count on you! If you can beat all of the guys downstairs in a single day, and report back to me that same day, I’ll give you something that I[game-token-1] liberated from them while they weren’t home.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu aku bisa mengandalkanmu!
Jika kamu bisa mengalahkan semua\lorang di bawah dalam satu hari, dan

melapor kembali padaku di hari yang
sama, aku akan memberimu sesuatu\lyang aku\. bebaskan dari mereka saat

mereka tidak di rumah.

entries.original:
"If you can beat all of the guys
downstairs in a single day, and\lreport back to me that same day,\lI’ll give you something that I\.\lliberated from them while they\lweren’t home."
entries.translation_source: If you can beat all of the guys downstairs in a single day, and report back to me that same day, I’ll give you something that I[game-token-1] liberated from them while they weren’t home.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa mengalahkan semua
orang di bawah dalam satu hari, dan\lmelapor kembali padaku di hari yang

sama, aku akan memberimu sesuatu
yang aku\. bebaskan dari mereka saat\lmereka tidak di rumah.

entries.original:
"You sure showed those guys
downstairs who’s the real Trainer\laround here!

As promised, the item I liberated
from them."
entries.translation_source: You sure showed those guys downstairs who’s the real Trainer around here! As promised, the item I liberated from them.
entries.translated:
Kamu benar-benar menunjukkan pada
orang-orang di bawah siapa Pelatih\lsebenarnya di sini! Seperti yang

dijanjikan, item yang aku bebaskan
dari mereka.

entries.original:
"I knew you couldn’t do it.
You just don’t look the type."
entries.translation_source: I knew you couldn’t do it. You just don’t look the type.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu kamu tidak bisa
melakukannya. Kamu memang tidak\ltampak seperti tipe yang bisa.

entries.original:
"How’s the liberated item workin’
for ya?"
entries.translation_source: How’s the liberated item workin’ for ya?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana item yang dibebaskan itu
bekerja untukmu?

entries.original:
"You’d think those guys downstairs
stay home all day, right?

WRONG!

I see them leave home every day!

They spend a lot of time helping
renovate the Battle Frontier."
entries.translation_source: You’d think those guys downstairs stay home all day, right? WRONG! I see them leave home every day! They spend a lot of time helping renovate the Battle Frontier.
entries.translated:
Kamu pasti mengira orang-orang di
bawah itu tinggal di rumah\lsepanjang hari, kan? SALAH! Aku

melihat mereka pergi dari rumah
setiap hari! Mereka menghabiskan\lbanyak waktu membantu merenovasi

Battle Frontier.

entries.original:
"You’d think those guys downstairs
stay home all day, right?

WRONG!

I see them leave home every day!

They spend a lot of time battling
Trainers in the [green]Battle Frontier[red]\lby [green]Seaport City[red]."
entries.translation_source: You’d think those guys downstairs stay home all day, right? WRONG! I see them leave home every day! They spend a lot of time battling Trainers in the [color-green-1]Battle Frontier[color-red-2] by [color-green-3]Seaport City[color-red-4].
entries.translated:
Kamu pasti mengira orang-orang di
bawah itu tinggal di rumah\lsepanjang hari, kan? SALAH! Aku

melihat mereka pergi dari rumah
setiap hari! Mereka menghabiskan\lbanyak waktu bertarung melawan

Pelatih di [green]Battle Frontier[red] dekat
[green]Seaport City[red].

entries.original:
"Hi! Welcome to the Double
Battle House!

Feel free to battle any of the
trainers here as many times as\lyou want.

If you need an explanation
of [green]Double Battles[red], please come\ltalk to me.

Enjoy battling!"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Welcome to the Double Battle House! Feel free to battle any of the trainers here as many times as you want. If you need an explanation of [color-green-1]Double Battles[color-red-2], please come talk to me. Enjoy battling!
entries.translated:
Hai! Selamat datang di Double
Battle House! Silakan bertarung\ldengan pelatih mana pun di sini

sebanyak yang kamu mau. Jika kamu
perlu penjelasan tentang [green]Double\lBattles[red], silakan datang bicara

padaku. Selamat bertarung!

entries.original:
"Battles here are fought as
[green]Double[red] battles.

Meaning all battles are two
on two!

You’ll have to carefully coordinate
two of your Pokémon if you want to\lwin battles."
entries.translation_source: Battles here are fought as [color-green-1]Double[color-red-2] battles. Meaning all battles are two on two! You’ll have to carefully coordinate two of your Pokémon if you want to win battles.
entries.translated:
Pertarungan di sini dilakukan
sebagai pertarungan [green]Double[red]. Artinya\lsemua pertarungan adalah dua lawan

dua! Kamu harus mengoordinasikan
dua Pokémon-mu dengan hati-hati\ljika ingin memenangkan pertarungan.

entries.original:
"What happens when you double the
amount of birds you have?"
entries.translation_source: What happens when you double the amount of birds you have?

entries.original: "You double your wings!"
entries.translation_source: You double your wings!

entries.original:
"You’ll need at least two Pokémon
if you want to battle me."
entries.translation_source: You’ll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle me.

entries.original:
"Oh, who might you be?

\.

[player]?

Am I correct in assuming you’re
looking for [rival]?

He came by here a while ago asking
for an easy and quick way to get\lto the [green]Ruins of Void[blue].

I’ll tell you exactly what I
told him.

The only way I’m aware of is by
taking a boat or by surfing down\l[green]Route 14[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Oh, who might you be? [game-token-1] [player-name-2]? Am I correct in assuming you’re looking for [text-token-rival-3]? He came by here a while ago asking for an easy and quick way to get to the [color-green-4]Ruins of Void[color-blue-5]. I’ll tell you exactly what I told him. The only way I’m aware of is by taking a boat or by surfing down [color-green-6]Route 14[color-blue-7].
entries.translated:
Oh, siapa kamu? \. [player]? Apakah
benar aku menduga kamu mencari\l[rival]? Dia datang ke sini

beberapa waktu lalu bertanya
tentang cara mudah dan cepat menuju\l[green]Ruins of Void[blue]. Aku akan

memberitahumu persis seperti yang
aku katakan padanya. Satu-satunya\lcara yang aku tahu adalah dengan

naik perahu atau berselancar
menyusuri [green]Route 14[blue].

entries.original:
"I’ll tell you exactly what I
told [rival].

The only way to get to the Ruins
of Void is by taking a boat or by\lsurfing down [green]Route 14[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’ll tell you exactly what I told [text-token-rival-1]. The only way to get to the Ruins of Void is by taking a boat or by surfing down [color-green-2]Route 14[color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Aku akan memberitahumu persis
seperti yang aku katakan pada\l[rival]. Satu-satunya cara menuju

Ruins of Void adalah dengan naik
perahu atau berselancar menyusuri\l[green]Route 14[blue].

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of Prof. Log?

He’s an old research buddy of mine.

We used to research the history of
Borrius together.

That is until we discovered
something one day that we\lshouldn’t have\.

Ever since then, he’s been studying
Pokémon stats and capture rates,\lwhile I sit here retired."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of Prof. Log? He’s an old research buddy of mine. We used to research the history of Borrius together. That is until we discovered something one day that we shouldn’t have[game-token-1] Ever since then, he’s been studying Pokémon stats and capture rates, while I sit here retired.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu pernah mendengar Prof.
Log? Dia adalah teman riset lamaku.\lKami dulu meneliti sejarah Borrius

bersama. Sampai suatu hari kami
menemukan sesuatu yang seharusnya\ltidak kami temukan\. Sejak saat itu,

dia mempelajari statistik Pokémon
dan tingkat penangkapan, sementara\laku duduk di sini pensiun.

entries.original:
"Hello!
Welcome to Dehara Dept. Store!

The board on the wall describes
the store layout."
entries.translation_source: Hello! Welcome to Dehara Dept. Store! The board on the wall describes the store layout.
entries.translated:
Halo! Selamat datang di Dehara
Dept. Store! Papan di dinding\lmenjelaskan tata letak toko.

entries.original:
"I love the Dehara Department
Store!

I’ve been shopping here since it
opened back in the day!"
entries.translation_source: I love the Dehara Department Store! I’ve been shopping here since it opened back in the day!
entries.translated:
Aku suka Dehara Department Store!
Aku sudah berbelanja di sini sejak\ldibuka dulu!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.

My wife has insisted I bring her
here ever since this store opened.

Oh!

That’s the sign she just purchased
something with my credit card.

That’s another ten years of my
life, wasted\."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1] My wife has insisted I bring her here ever since this store opened. Oh! That’s the sign she just purchased something with my credit card. That’s another ten years of my life, wasted[game-token-2]

entries.original: "Do you know what a [green]Gem[blue] is?"

entries.original:
"A Gem is a special type of held
item that powers up a single attack\lin battle.

Each Gem corresponds to a specific
Type and can only power up that\lType of move.

Gems usually disappear after use,
but like most consumable items,\lthey’re returned to you after\limportant battles, such as battles\lagainst Gym Leaders.

Most Gym Leaders in Borrius have at
least one of their Pokémon holding\la Gem, so be wary.

If you’re concerned about this, you
can use the move [green]Incinerate[blue] to\lmelt their Gem first, before they\lhave a chance to use it."
entries.translation_source: A Gem is a special type of held item that powers up a single attack in battle. Each Gem corresponds to a specific Type and can only power up that Type of move. Gems usually disappear after use, but like most consumable items, they’re returned to you after important battles, such as battles against Gym Leaders. Most Gym Leaders in Borrius have at least one of their Pokémon holding a Gem, so be wary. If you’re concerned about this, you can use the move [color-green-1]Incinerate[color-blue-2] to melt their Gem first, before they have a chance to use it.
entries.translated:
Permata adalah jenis item yang
dipegang khusus yang memperkuat\lsatu serangan dalam pertempuran.

Setiap Permata sesuai dengan Tipe
tertentu dan hanya bisa memperkuat\ljurus Tipe itu. Permata biasanya

hilang setelah digunakan, tetapi
seperti kebanyakan item habis\lpakai, mereka akan kembali setelah

pertempuran penting, seperti
pertempuran melawan Pemimpin Gym.\lKebanyakan Pemimpin Gym di Borrius

memiliki setidaknya satu Pokémon
mereka yang memegang Permata, jadi\lwaspadalah. Jika kamu khawatir

tentang ini, kamu bisa menggunakan
jurus [green]Membakar[blue] untuk melelehkan\lPermata mereka terlebih dahulu,

sebelum mereka memiliki kesempatan
untuk menggunakannya.

I’m sure if you introduced yourself to people as his [buffer2-2], you would instantly be regarded with much affection. There aren’t many people out there who have not heard of his exploits. It’s a shame he disappeared. If only someone knew what happened to him, I would finally have a sense of closure.

entries.translation_source: If only someone could tell me what happened to your father[game-token-1] It would bring me such a sense of closure.
entries.translated:
Andai saja seseorang bisa
memberitahuku apa yang terjadi pada\layahmu\. Itu akan membuatku merasa

lega.

entries.original:
"What?
You know what happened to Aros?

Please!
You must tell me!

\."
entries.translation_source: What? You know what happened to Aros? Please! You must tell me! [game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Apa? Kamu tahu apa yang terjadi
pada Aros? Kumohon! Kamu harus\lmemberitahuku! \.

entries.original:
"Inside a Cube!

You’re joking with me!

I refuse to believe it!"
entries.translation_source: Inside a Cube! You’re joking with me! I refuse to believe it!
entries.translated:
Di dalam Kubus! Kamu bercanda
denganku! Aku menolak untuk\lpercaya!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

But I presume you are telling
the truth.

You have no reason to lie to me."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] But I presume you are telling the truth. You have no reason to lie to me.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Tapi aku rasa kamu mengatakan
yang sebenarnya. Kamu tidak punya\lalasan untuk berbohong padaku.

entries.original:
"Please, I wish to give you this
item as thanks for bringing me\la sense of closure.

It may not help your father out,
but it should assist you if you\lencounter one of those creatures\lyour father tasked you with\ldismantling."
entries.translation_source: Please, I wish to give you this item as thanks for bringing me a sense of closure. It may not help your father out, but it should assist you if you encounter one of those creatures your father tasked you with dismantling.
entries.translated:
Kumohon, aku ingin memberikan item
ini sebagai terima kasih karena\ltelah membuatku merasa lega.

Mungkin ini tidak membantu ayahmu,
tapi seharusnya ini membantumu jika\lkamu menemui salah satu makhluk

yang ayahmu tugaskan untuk kamu
hancurkan.

entries.original:
"Oh.
I could have sworn you were\.

My eyesight must be going in my
old age."
entries.translation_source: Oh. I could have sworn you were[game-token-1] My eyesight must be going in my old age.
entries.translated:
Oh. Aku bisa bersumpah kamu adalah\.
Penglihatanku pasti mulai menurun\ldi usia tuaku.

entries.original:
"Hello, [buffer2] of Aros.
I hope your travels are going well."
entries.translation_source: Hello, [buffer2-1] of Aros. I hope your travels are going well.
entries.translated:
Halo, [buffer2] dari Aros. Semoga
perjalananmu berjalan lancar.

entries.original: "Don’t Turn Off the Power"
entries.translation_source: Don’t Turn Off the Power
entries.translated: Jangan Matikan Daya

entries.original:
"Practice saving lives by saving the
game at least [buffer1] times."
entries.translation_source: Practice saving lives by saving the game at least [buffer1-1] times.

entries.original:
"Fun fact, did you know that when
you turn off your console without\lsaving, a powerful bomb goes off\land destroys our entire world?

You never notice because a parallel
dimension is created whenever you\lreload.

Please commit to not destroying our
world anymore.

[green][buffer1][blue] times will show your commitment."
entries.translation_source: Fun fact, did you know that when you turn off your console without saving, a powerful bomb goes off and destroys our entire world? You never notice because a parallel dimension is created whenever you reload. Please commit to not destroying our world anymore. [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] times will show your commitment.
entries.translated:
Fakta menarik, tahukah kamu bahwa
ketika kamu mematikan konsol tanpa\lmenyimpan, sebuah bom kuat meledak

dan menghancurkan seluruh dunia
kita? Kamu tidak pernah\lmenyadarinya karena dimensi paralel

diciptakan setiap kali kamu memuat
ulang. Tolong berkomitmen untuk\ltidak menghancurkan dunia kita

lagi. [green][buffer1][blue] kali akan
menunjukkan komitmenmu.

entries.original:
"Thank you for agreeing to not
start armageddon, again.

I will reward you once I see your
commitment of [green][buffer1][blue] manual saves."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for agreeing to not start armageddon, again. I will reward you once I see your commitment of [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] manual saves.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah setuju untuk
tidak memulai kiamat, lagi. Aku\lakan memberikan hadiah padamu

setelah aku melihat komitmenmu
sebanyak [green][buffer1][blue] penyimpanan\lmanual.

entries.original:
"Some people just want to watch the
world burn\."
entries.translation_source: Some people just want to watch the world burn[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Beberapa orang hanya ingin melihat
dunia terbakar\.

entries.original:
"You have managed to save [green][buffer2][blue]
world\\07.

But I will only believe your
commitment to non-aggression if\lyou save [green][buffer3][blue] more world\\08."
entries.translation_source: You have managed to save [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] world[raw-escape-4]. But I will only believe your commitment to non-aggression if you save [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] more world[raw-escape-8].
entries.translated:
Kamu berhasil menyelamatkan
[green][buffer2][blue] dunia\\07. Tapi aku hanya\lakan percaya komitmenmu untuk tidak

agresif jika kamu menyelamatkan
[green][buffer3][blue] dunia lagi\\08.

entries.original:
"Here is your reward for not
destroying our world.

It is a relic of a world that was
destroyed by a selfish child.

Please, don’t let us go through
that again\."
entries.translation_source: Here is your reward for not destroying our world. It is a relic of a world that was destroyed by a selfish child. Please, don’t let us go through that again[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ini hadiahmu karena tidak
menghancurkan dunia kami. Ini\ladalah peninggalan dari dunia yang

dihancurkan oleh seorang anak yang
egois. Tolong, jangan biarkan kami\lmengalaminya lagi\.

entries.original:
"Remember to save before you power
down!

Otherwise we’ll all suffer a slow
and painful demise\."
entries.translation_source: Remember to save before you power down! Otherwise we’ll all suffer a slow and painful demise[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ingatlah untuk menyimpan sebelum
kamu mematikan daya! Jika tidak,\lkita semua akan menderita kematian

yang lambat dan menyakitkan\.

entries.original:
"Hello, there!

Do you happen to have one of those
rare [green]Ice[blue]-type [green][buffer1][blue]?

I’ve always had trouble getting my
hands on one.

If you do, would you agree to a
trade for my [green][buffer2][blue]?

It’ll be very useful if you plan to
fight in a foggy area."
entries.translation_source: Hello, there! Do you happen to have one of those rare [color-green-1]Ice[color-blue-2]-type [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-blue-5]? I’ve always had trouble getting my hands on one. If you do, would you agree to a trade for my [color-green-6][buffer2-7][color-blue-8]? It’ll be very useful if you plan to fight in a foggy area.
entries.translated:
Halo, hai! Apakah kamu kebetulan
memiliki salah satu [green]Ice[blue]-type\l[green][buffer1][blue] yang langka itu? Aku

selalu kesulitan mendapatkannya.
Jika kamu punya, maukah kamu setuju\luntuk bertukar dengan [green][buffer2][blue]

milikku? Ini akan sangat berguna
jika kamu berencana bertarung di\larea berkabut.

entries.original: "Well, if you don’t want to\."
entries.translation_source: Well, if you don’t want to[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Yah, jika kamu tidak mau\.

entries.original:
"Hmmm?
This isn’t an [green]Ice[blue]-type [green][buffer1][blue].

Think of me if you get one."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm? This isn’t an [color-green-1]Ice[color-blue-2]-type [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-blue-5]. Think of me if you get one.
entries.translated:
Hmmm? Ini bukan [green]Ice[blue]-type [green][buffer1][blue].
Ingat aku jika kamu mendapatkannya.

entries.original:
"Many thanks.

The [buffer2] I traded you knows
[green]Defog[blue], and you can use it to\lremove the fog from the Gym!"
entries.translation_source: Many thanks. The [buffer2-1] I traded you knows [color-green-2]Defog[color-blue-3], and you can use it to remove the fog from the Gym!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih banyak. [buffer2] yang
aku tukarkan denganmu tahu [green]Defog[blue],\ldan kamu bisa menggunakannya untuk

menghilangkan kabut dari Gym!

entries.original: "Many thanks."
entries.translation_source: Many thanks.
entries.translated: Terima kasih banyak.

entries.original:
"The [buffer2] that I traded you,
has it helped you out?"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer2-1] that I traded you, has it helped you out?
entries.translated:
[buffer2] yang saya tukarkan
denganmu, apakah itu membantumu?

entries.original:
"Back in his younger days, my
husband travelled the world in\lsearch of rare Pokémon.

Unfortunately, his search was cut
short when he fell victim to an\luntimely illness.

If you have the Pokémon he’s
looking for, would you please\ltrade with him?

The doctor says that it could help
speed up the recovery if you do."
entries.translation_source: Back in his younger days, my husband travelled the world in search of rare Pokémon. Unfortunately, his search was cut short when he fell victim to an untimely illness. If you have the Pokémon he’s looking for, would you please trade with him? The doctor says that it could help speed up the recovery if you do.
entries.translated:
Dulu di masa mudanya, suamiku
berkeliling dunia mencari Pokémon\llangka. Sayangnya, pencariannya

terhenti saat ia jatuh sakit
sebelum waktunya. Jika kamu\lmemiliki Pokémon yang ia cari,

maukah kamu bertukar dengannya?
Kata dokter, hal itu bisa membantu\lmempercepat pemulihannya jika kamu

melakukannya.

entries.original:
"Oh, Trainer, thank you for trading
Pokémon with my husband!

It seems that thanks to you, he’ll
soon be making a full recovery from\lhis illness.

Take these as a show of gratitude
for what you’ve done for him!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, Trainer, thank you for trading Pokémon with my husband! It seems that thanks to you, he’ll soon be making a full recovery from his illness. Take these as a show of gratitude for what you’ve done for him!
entries.translated:
Oh, Pelatih, terima kasih telah
bertukar Pokémon dengan suamiku!\lSepertinya berkat kamu, dia akan

segera pulih sepenuhnya dari
penyakitnya. Terimalah ini sebagai\ltanda terima kasih atas apa yang

telah kamu lakukan untuknya!

entries.original:
"My husband is on his way to making
a full recovery.

Thank you again, Trainer!
We are forever in your debt."
entries.translation_source: My husband is on his way to making a full recovery. Thank you again, Trainer! We are forever in your debt.
entries.translated:
Suamiku sedang dalam proses
pemulihan penuh. Terima kasih lagi,\lPelatih! Kami berhutang budi padamu

selamanya.

entries.original: "Can I help you with something?"
entries.translation_source: Can I help you with something?
entries.translated: Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

entries.original:
"Feel free to battle our Trainers
as many times as you wish.

If you have the urge to rebattle
someone, please leave and then\lcome back inside.

Enjoy your time!"
entries.translation_source: Feel free to battle our Trainers as many times as you wish. If you have the urge to rebattle someone, please leave and then come back inside. Enjoy your time!
entries.translated:
Silakan bertarung dengan Pelatih
kami sebanyak yang kamu mau. Jika\lkamu ingin bertarung ulang dengan

seseorang, silakan keluar lalu
masuk kembali. Nikmati waktumu!

entries.original: "Should I move in front of the door?"
entries.translation_source: Should I move in front of the door?
entries.translated: Haruskah aku pindah ke depan pintu?

entries.original: "Should I move next to the door?"
entries.translation_source: Should I move next to the door?
entries.translated:
Haruskah aku pindah ke samping
pintu?

entries.original: "Enjoy your time!"
entries.translation_source: Enjoy your time!
entries.translated: Nikmati waktumu!

entries.original: "Change Position"
entries.translation_source: Change Position
entries.translated: Ubah Posisi

entries.original:
"My fast [green]Water[red]-types will soak you
to your core!"
entries.translation_source: My fast [color-green-1]Water[color-red-2]-types will soak you to your core!

entries.original: "You’ve dried up my water."
entries.translation_source: You’ve dried up my water.

entries.original:
"If you want to battle me again,
leave and come back inside."
entries.translation_source: If you want to battle me again, leave and come back inside.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin bertarung denganku
lagi, keluar dan masuk kembali.

entries.original:
"[red]If you want to battle me again,
leave and come back inside."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]If you want to battle me again, leave and come back inside.
entries.translated:
[red]Jika kamu ingin bertarung denganku
lagi, keluar dan masuk kembali.

entries.original:
"for
a battle?

I’m in the perfect mood to indulge
you\."
entries.translation_source: for a battle? I’m in the perfect mood to indulge you[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Whoa, [buffer3]\.

Welcome to the Soil.

Feel free to make yourself at home
as long as you want, [buffer3].

Take in all the good air\."
entries.translation_source: Whoa, [buffer3-1][game-token-2] Welcome to the Soil. Feel free to make yourself at home as long as you want, [buffer3-3]. Take in all the good air[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Whoa, [buffer3]\. Selamat datang di
Soil. Silakan merasa seperti di\lrumah selama yang kamu mau,

[buffer3]. Hiruplah semua udara
segar\.

entries.original:
"I’m the one guy with a clear head
around here.

If you bring me [green]Oddish[blue], I can
harvest the leaves and make some\lgood mist for your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m the one guy with a clear head around here. If you bring me [color-green-1]Oddish[color-blue-2], I can harvest the leaves and make some good mist for your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Akulah satu-satunya orang yang
berpikiran jernih di sini. Jika\lkamu membawakanku [green]Oddish[blue], aku bisa

memanen daunnya dan membuat kabut
yang baik untuk Pokémon-mu.

entries.original: "Do you have some Oddish for me?"
entries.translation_source: Do you have some Oddish for me?
entries.translated: Apakah kamu punya Oddish untukku?

entries.original: "Choose from Party"
entries.translation_source: Choose from Party
entries.translated: Pilih dari Tim

entries.original: "All in Party"
entries.translation_source: All in Party
entries.translated: Semua di Tim

entries.original: "All in PC Box"
entries.translation_source: All in PC Box
entries.translated: Semua di Kotak PC

entries.translation_source: Which Oddish will you give me?
entries.translated:
Oddish mana yang akan kamu berikan
kepadaku?

entries.original: "You want to give me [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: You want to give me [buffer1-1]?
entries.translated:
Kamu ingin memberikan [buffer1]
kepadaku?

"[black][player] handed [buffer1] over
to the Scientist."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed [buffer1-3] over to the Scientist.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer1]
kepada Ilmuwan.

"You want to give me the [green][buffer1][blue] Oddish
in your party?"
entries.translation_source: You want to give me the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] Oddish in your party?
entries.translated:
Kamu ingin memberikan [green][buffer1][blue]
Oddish yang ada di timmu kepadaku?

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed [buffer1] Oddish over
to the Scientist."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed [buffer1-3] Oddish over to the Scientist.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer1]
Oddish kepada Ilmuwan.
