"You want to give me the [green][buffer2][blue] Oddish
in Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc?"
entries.translation_source: You want to give me the [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] Oddish in Box [quote-open-4][color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-blue-7][quote-close-8]?
entries.translated:
Kamu ingin memberikan [green][buffer2][blue]
Oddish yang ada di Kotak \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\lkepadaku?

entries.original:
"Looks like I have just enough
Oddish now to make some mist for\lyour Pokémon!

Just give me a sec\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like I have just enough Oddish now to make some mist for your Pokémon! Just give me a sec[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku punya cukup Oddish
sekarang untuk membuat kabut untuk\lPokémon-mu! Tunggu sebentar\.

entries.original:
"Mmm\.

That smells nice\.

\.

Uh\. anyway, here you go!"
entries.translation_source: Mmm[game-token-1] That smells nice[game-token-2] [game-token-3] Uh[game-token-4] anyway, here you go!
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Wanginya enak\. \. Uh\. Baiklah, ini
dia!

entries.original:
"That’s [green]Dream Mist[blue].

Have a Pokémon inhale it to unlock
its [green]Hidden Ability[blue].

Just make sure you don’t breathe
it in yourself!"
entries.translation_source: That’s [color-green-1]Dream Mist[color-blue-2]. Have a Pokémon inhale it to unlock its [color-green-3]Hidden Ability[color-blue-4]. Just make sure you don’t breathe it in yourself!
entries.translated:
Itu [green]Dream Mist[blue]. Suruh Pokémon
menghirupnya untuk membuka [green]Hidden\lAbility[blue]-nya. Pastikan kamu tidak

menghirupnya sendiri!

entries.original:
"Welcome back, [player]!

So far you’ve given me [green][buffer2] Oddish[blue].
I need [green][buffer1][blue] to make a special mist\.

Do you want to give me more?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome back, [player-name-1]! So far you’ve given me [color-green-2][buffer2-3] Oddish[color-blue-4]. I need [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-blue-7] to make a special mist[game-token-8] Do you want to give me more?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang kembali, [player]!
Sejauh ini kamu sudah memberikan\l[green][buffer2] Oddish[blue] kepadaku. Aku butuh

[green][buffer1][blue] untuk membuat kabut
spesial\. Apakah kamu ingin\lmemberikan lebih banyak?

entries.original:
"You’re not the sensible type,
are you?"
entries.translation_source: You’re not the sensible type, are you?
entries.translated:
Kau bukan tipe yang masuk akal,
kan?

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough Pokémon in
your party to hand over any more\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough Pokémon in your party to hand over any more[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup Pokémon
di timmu untuk menyerahkan lebih\lbanyak\.

entries.original:
"I can’t take those Oddish if you
don’t have at least one other\lPokémon that can battle in your\lparty\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t take those Oddish if you don’t have at least one other Pokémon that can battle in your party[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa mengambil Oddish itu
jika kamu tidak memiliki setidaknya\lsatu Pokémon lain yang bisa

bertarung di timmu\.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any Oddish in your
party\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any Oddish in your party[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki Oddish apa pun
di timmu\.

entries.original:
"I can’t harvest Oddish Leaves
from an Egg\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t harvest Oddish Leaves from an Egg[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa memanen Daun Oddish
dari Telur\.

entries.original:
"I can’t harvest Oddish Leaves
from that Pokémon.

It’s not an Oddish\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t harvest Oddish Leaves from that Pokémon. It’s not an Oddish[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa memanen Daun Oddish
dari Pokémon itu. Itu bukan Oddish\.

entries.original:
"I can’t take that Oddish.

You’d have no Pokémon left to
fight with\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t take that Oddish. You’d have no Pokémon left to fight with[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa mengambil Oddish
itu. Kamu tidak akan memiliki\lPokémon tersisa untuk bertarung\.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any Oddish in the
Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any Oddish in the Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4][quote-close-5][game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki Oddish apa pun
di Kotak \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\.

entries.original:
"Bring me [green][buffer1][blue] more Oddish and I can
make you a special mist."
entries.translation_source: Bring me [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] more Oddish and I can make you a special mist.
entries.translated:
Bawakan aku [green][buffer1][blue] Oddish lagi
dan aku bisa membuatkanmu kabut\lspesial.

"Heyyyy\.

You wanna buy some herbs?"
entries.translation_source: Heyyyy[game-token-1] You wanna buy some herbs?
entries.translated: Heyyyyy\. Kamu mau beli ramuan?

entries.original: "Come back anytimeeeee\."
entries.translation_source: Come back anytimeeeee[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Kembali lagi kapan sajaaaaa\.

I remember you\.

I’ll give you some Heart Scales
for ’emmmm\."
entries.translation_source: Heyyyy[game-token-1] I remember you[game-token-2] You wanna gimme some mushrooooms[game-token-3]? I’ll give you some Heart Scales for ’emmmm[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Heeeyyy\. Aku ingat kamu\. Kamu mau

mereka\.

entries.original:
"How many mushrooooms are you gonna
gimmeeee\.?"

entries.translated:
Berapa banyak jamurrr yang akan
kamu kasih akuuu\.?

entries.original:
"Mmmm\.

Mushrooooms\."
entries.translation_source: Mmmm[game-token-1] Mushrooooms[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Mmmm\. Jamurrr\.

"[black][player] handed over [buffer2]
[buffer1]."

[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer2]
[buffer1].

entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan total [buffer2]
[buffer1].

"You don’t have enough of those
mushrooooms\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough of those mushrooooms[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak punya cukup jamur-jamur
itu\.

"When Pokémon gain enough
experience, they can evolve and\lgrow stronger.

Some even learn special moves
immediately after evolution.

However, not all Pokémon can
evolve just by battling enough.

Some require special items like
[green]Fire Stones[blue] or [green]Link Stones[blue]."
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon gain enough experience, they can evolve and grow stronger. Some even learn special moves immediately after evolution. However, not all Pokémon can evolve just by battling enough. Some require special items like [color-green-1]Fire Stones[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Link Stones[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Ketika Pokémon mendapatkan cukup
pengalaman, mereka dapat berevolusi\ldan menjadi lebih kuat. Beberapa

bahkan mempelajari jurus khusus
segera setelah evolusi. Namun,\ltidak semua Pokémon dapat

berevolusi hanya dengan bertarung
cukup. Beberapa membutuhkan item\lkhusus seperti [green]Batu Api[blue] atau [green]Batu

Tautan[blue].

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, likes to
fill his Gym with a dense fog.

Usually, this makes it harder for
attacks to land.

But if you bring a Pokémon
with the abilities [green]Keen Eye[blue] or\l[green]Infiltrator[blue], its attacks will\lland no problem.

[green]Pikipek[blue] and [green]Hoothoot[blue] on [green]Route 2[blue] can
be caught with Keen Eye, so why\ldon’t you head over there and nab\lyourself one of them?"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, likes to fill his Gym with a dense fog. Usually, this makes it harder for attacks to land. But if you bring a Pokémon with the abilities [color-green-1]Keen Eye[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Infiltrator[color-blue-4], its attacks will land no problem. [color-green-5]Pikipek[color-blue-6] and [color-green-7]Hoothoot[color-blue-8] on [color-green-9]Route 2[color-blue-10] can be caught with Keen Eye, so why don’t you head over there and nab yourself one of them?
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, Mirskle, suka
memenuhi Gynya dengan kabut tebal.\lBiasanya, ini membuat serangan

lebih sulit mendarat. Tapi jika
kamu membawa Pokémon dengan\lkemampuan [green]Mata Elang[blue] atau [green]Penyusup[blue],

serangannya akan mendarat tanpa
masalah. [green]Pikipek[blue] dan [green]Hoothoot[blue] di\l[green]Rute 2[blue] dapat ditangkap dengan Mata

Elang, jadi kenapa kamu tidak pergi
ke sana dan ambil salah satunya?

entries.original:
"Pokémon with the abilities [green]Keen
Eye[blue] and [green]Infiltrator[blue] can easily land\ltheir attacks in foggy weather.

I don’t think that can happen
anywhere outside of Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon with the abilities [color-green-1]Keen Eye[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Infiltrator[color-blue-4] can easily land their attacks in foggy weather. I don’t think that can happen anywhere outside of Borrius!
entries.translated:
Pokémon dengan kemampuan [green]Mata Elang[blue]
dan [green]Penyusup[blue] dapat dengan mudah\lmendaratkan serangan mereka di

cuaca berkabut. Aku rasa itu tidak
bisa terjadi di mana pun di luar\lBorrius!

entries.original:
"[green]Flower Paradise[red] is so pretty!

Everywhere you look, there are
different coloured flowers with\ldifferent Pokémon hiding in them!

I caught my [green]Cutiefly[red] up there, and
I used [green]Sweet Scent[red] to make it\leasier to hit Pokémon in the Gym!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Flower Paradise[color-red-2] is so pretty! Everywhere you look, there are different coloured flowers with different Pokémon hiding in them! I caught my [color-green-3]Cutiefly[color-red-4] up there, and I used [color-green-5]Sweet Scent[color-red-6] to make it easier to hit Pokémon in the Gym!
entries.translated:
[green]Surga Bunga[red] sangat indah! Ke mana
pun kamu lihat, ada bunga\lberwarna-warni dengan berbagai

Pokémon bersembunyi di dalamnya!
Aku menangkap [green]Cutiefly[red] -ku di sana,\ldan aku menggunakan [green]Aroma Manis[red]

untuk mempermudah mengenai Pokémon
di Gym!

entries.original:
"Like repellants, some Pokémon
Abilities like [green]Stench[blue] can also\lhelp keep wild Pokémon away."
entries.translation_source: Like repellants, some Pokémon Abilities like [color-green-1]Stench[color-blue-2] can also help keep wild Pokémon away.
entries.translated:
Seperti pengusir, beberapa
Kemampuan Pokémon seperti [green]Bau Busuk[blue]\ljuga dapat membantu menjauhkan

Pokémon liar.

entries.original:
"You should try to beat as many
Pokémon Gyms as possible.

Poké Marts will sell more items to
you the more Badges you have."
entries.translation_source: You should try to beat as many Pokémon Gyms as possible. Poké Marts will sell more items to you the more Badges you have.
entries.translated:
Kamu harus mencoba mengalahkan
sebanyak mungkin Pokémon Gym. Poké\lMart akan menjual lebih banyak item

kepada kamu semakin banyak Lencana
yang kamu miliki.

entries.original: "Epidimy Town"
entries.translation_source: Epidimy Town
entries.translated: Epidimy Town

entries.original: "Epidimy Town D"
entries.translation_source: Epidimy Town D

entries.original: "Epidimy Town N"
entries.translation_source: Epidimy Town N

entries.original:
"I come here every day to pray
to Zapdos.

Zapdos saved me once, and I can
never thank it enough."
entries.translation_source: I come here every day to pray to Zapdos. Zapdos saved me once, and I can never thank it enough.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini setiap hari
untuk berdoa kepada Zapdos. Zapdos\lpernah menyelamatkanku, dan aku

tidak pernah bisa cukup berterima
kasih padanya.

entries.original:
"Ahh\.

I love coming out here every day
and relaxing on this bench.

It’s always the most enjoyable part
of my day.

Why don’t you take a break on the
bench next to me?

I assure you, it’s very relaxing.

There’s just something magical
about sitting down on a bench\."
entries.translation_source: Ahh[game-token-1] I love coming out here every day and relaxing on this bench. It’s always the most enjoyable part of my day. Why don’t you take a break on the bench next to me? I assure you, it’s very relaxing. There’s just something magical about sitting down on a bench[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ahh\. Aku suka datang ke sini setiap
hari dan bersantai di bangku ini.\lItu selalu menjadi bagian paling

menyenangkan dari hariku. Kenapa
kamu tidak beristirahat di bangku\ldi sebelahku? Aku jamin, ini sangat

santai. Ada sesuatu yang ajaib
tentang duduk di bangku\.

entries.original:
"They say the grass is always
greener on the other side.

That’s especially true in
Epidimy Town.

Just look at the grass here!"
entries.translation_source: They say the grass is always greener on the other side. That’s especially true in Epidimy Town. Just look at the grass here!
entries.translated:
Mereka bilang rumput selalu lebih
hijau di sisi lain. Itu sangat\lbenar di Epidimy Town. Lihat saja

rumput di sini!

entries.original:
"Epidimy Town is the epitome
of bliss!

\.

\.

What? You don’t think it’s funny?
Sorry\.

I feel bad now\.

You know what? Take these.
It’ll help me feel better."
entries.translation_source: Epidimy Town is the epitome of bliss! [game-token-1] [game-token-2] What? You don’t think it’s funny? Sorry[game-token-3] I feel bad now[game-token-4] You know what? Take these. It’ll help me feel better.
entries.translated:
Epidimy Town adalah lambang
kebahagiaan! \. \. Apa? Kamu tidak\lmenganggapnya lucu? Maaf\. Aku merasa

bersalah sekarang\. Kamu tahu? Ambil
ini. Ini akan membuatku merasa\llebih baik.

entries.original:
"I wish it was easier to make a good
joke out of our town’s name."
entries.translation_source: I wish it was easier to make a good joke out of our town’s name.
entries.translated:
Aku berharap lebih mudah membuat
lelucon yang bagus dari nama kota\lkita.

entries.original:
"I really wanna explore
Thundercap Mt!

But my mommy says it’s too
dangerous ’cause there are a bunch\lof bad men on the other side."
entries.translation_source: I really wanna explore Thundercap Mt! But my mommy says it’s too dangerous ’cause there are a bunch of bad men on the other side.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat ingin menjelajahi
Thundercap Mt! Tapi ibuku bilang\litu terlalu berbahaya karena ada

banyak orang jahat di sisi lain.

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt. can be accessed
through that hole down the stairs.

It’s really dangerous, so if you
go, make sure you have lots of\lRevives and Paralyze Heals!"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. can be accessed through that hole down the stairs. It’s really dangerous, so if you go, make sure you have lots of Revives and Paralyze Heals!
entries.translated:
Thundercap Mt. bisa diakses melalui
lubang di bawah tangga. Itu sangat\lberbahaya, jadi jika kamu pergi,

pastikan kamu punya banyak Revive
dan Paralyze Heal!

entries.original:
"Well, well, well\.
If it isn’t [player]!

Marlon told me not to let you
into Thundercap Mt., so you\lcan’t interfere with our plans.

Even if I did let you in, you’d be
toast without the power of\l[green]Mega Evolution[blue].

So don’t you see?

You should stay out here for your
own good."
entries.translation_source: Well, well, well[game-token-1] If it isn’t [player-name-2]! Marlon told me not to let you into Thundercap Mt., so you can’t interfere with our plans. Even if I did let you in, you’d be toast without the power of [color-green-3]Mega Evolution[color-blue-4]. So don’t you see? You should stay out here for your own good.
entries.translated:
Wah, wah, wah\. Kalau bukan [player]!
Marlon bilang padaku untuk tidak\lmembiarkanmu masuk ke Thundercap

Mt., jadi kamu tidak bisa
mengganggu rencana kami. Bahkan\ljika aku membiarkanmu masuk, kamu

akan hancur tanpa kekuatan [green]Mega
Evolution[blue]. Jadi tidakkah kamu\llihat? Kamu sebaiknya tetap di sini

demi kebaikanmu sendiri.

entries.original:
"You placed yourself firmly on
the bench."
entries.translation_source: You placed yourself firmly on the bench.
entries.translated: Kamu duduk dengan mantap di bangku.

entries.original:
"Huh? What’s this?

It looks like someone left
something on the bench!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What’s this? It looks like someone left something on the bench!
entries.translated:
Hah? Ada apa ini? Sepertinya
seseorang meninggalkan sesuatu di\lbangku!

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt. has two different
entrances: one in Epidimy Town, and\lthe other in Antisis City.

These entrances take you to the
peak where Zapdos roosts.

I don’t recommend you use the
entrance by Antisis City, though.

That place is messed up\."
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. has two different entrances: one in Epidimy Town, and the other in Antisis City. These entrances take you to the peak where Zapdos roosts. I don’t recommend you use the entrance by Antisis City, though. That place is messed up[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Thundercap Mt. memiliki dua pintu
masuk yang berbeda: satu di Epidimy\lTown, dan satu lagi di Antisis

City. Pintu masuk ini membawamu ke
puncak tempat Zapdos bertengger.\lNamun, aku tidak menyarankan kamu

menggunakan pintu masuk di dekat
Antisis City. Tempat itu berantakan\.

entries.original:
"I tried exploring Thundercap Mt.
through the nearby entrance once.

The opening where Zapdos is said to
roost goes really high up!

I actually got really dizzy and
fell down while climbing!

The doctor says I now suffer from
minor head trauma.

Take this item, so you don’t have
to worry about head trauma, too."
entries.translation_source: I tried exploring Thundercap Mt. through the nearby entrance once. The opening where Zapdos is said to roost goes really high up! I actually got really dizzy and fell down while climbing! The doctor says I now suffer from minor head trauma. Take this item, so you don’t have to worry about head trauma, too.
entries.translated:
Aku pernah mencoba menjelajahi
Thundercap Mt. melalui pintu masuk\ldi dekat sini. Bukaan tempat Zapdos

dikatakan bertengger sangat tinggi!
Aku benar-benar pusing dan jatuh\lsaat memanjat! Dokter bilang aku

sekarang menderita trauma kepala
ringan. Ambil item ini, agar kamu\ltidak perlu khawatir tentang trauma

kepala juga.

entries.original:
"If your Pokémon wears the [green]Rocky
Helmet[red], any Pokémon that touches\lit will suffer from head trauma!"
entries.translation_source: If your Pokémon wears the [color-green-1]Rocky Helmet[color-red-2], any Pokémon that touches it will suffer from head trauma!
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon-mu mengenakan [green]Rocky
Helmet[red], Pokémon mana pun yang\lmenyentuhnya akan menderita trauma

kepala!

entries.original:
"[black]Too bad!

There’s no room in the Cube for
a [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Too bad! There’s no room in the Cube for a [buffer2-2]!

entries.original:
"Huah!
Move boulders with pure power!

Take this!"
entries.translation_source: Huah! Move boulders with pure power! Take this!
entries.translated:
Huah! Pindahkan batu besar dengan
kekuatan murni! Ambil ini!

entries.original:
"[green]Strength[blue] lets you move giant
boulders with raw power!

But only if you have the [green]Fall
Badge[blue] from the Fallshore Gym!

Huah!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Strength[color-blue-2] lets you move giant boulders with raw power! But only if you have the [color-green-3]Fall Badge[color-blue-4] from the Fallshore Gym! Huah!
entries.translated:
[green]Strength[blue] memungkinkanmu memindahkan
batu raksasa dengan kekuatan\lmentah! Tapi hanya jika kamu

memiliki [green]Fall Badge[blue] dari Fallshore
Gym! Huah!

entries.original:
"One day, I’m going to be a ninja!

My parents strike with brute force,
but I’m going to be sneaky!

I’m going to hide in holes in
sand and scare Trainers!"
entries.translation_source: One day, I’m going to be a ninja! My parents strike with brute force, but I’m going to be sneaky! I’m going to hide in holes in sand and scare Trainers!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, aku akan menjadi
seorang ninja! Orang tuaku\lmenyerang dengan kekuatan kasar,

tapi aku akan menjadi licik! Aku
akan bersembunyi di lubang pasir\ldan menakuti para Trainer!

entries.original:
"You know the Pokémon [green][buffer1][red]?
That big adorable pink blob?

I’ve always wanted one, but they’re
just so hard to catch!

Would you be willing to trade one
for my [green][buffer2][red]?"
entries.translation_source: You know the Pokémon [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]? That big adorable pink blob? I’ve always wanted one, but they’re just so hard to catch! Would you be willing to trade one for my [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-red-6]?
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu Pokémon [green][buffer1][red]?
Gumpalan merah muda yang besar dan\lmenggemaskan itu? Aku selalu

menginginkannya, tapi mereka sangat
sulit ditangkap! Apakah kamu\lbersedia menukar satu dengan

[green][buffer2][red] milikku?

entries.original: "That’s too bad."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad.
entries.translated: Sayang sekali.

entries.original:
"In what universe is that a [buffer1],
huh?

If you get one, trade it with me."
entries.translation_source: In what universe is that a [buffer1-1], huh? If you get one, trade it with me.
entries.translated:
Di alam semesta mana itu [buffer1],
ya? Kalau kamu dapat satu, tukarlah\ldenganku.

entries.original:
"Thank you so much! I’m going to
take good care of it!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you so much! I’m going to take good care of it!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih banyak! Aku akan
merawatnya dengan baik!

entries.original:
"My old [buffer2], has it helped you
win any battles?"
entries.translation_source: My old [buffer2-1], has it helped you win any battles?
entries.translated:
[buffer2] lamaku, apakah itu
membantumu memenangkan pertempuran?

entries.original:
"Do you see that item on the table?

That is my prized possession,
the [green]Master Ball[red].

It is a rare Poké Ball that can
capture any Pokémon without fail.

The man who gave it to me, [green]Aros[red],
said to watch over it as if my life\ldepended on it.

That is until someone shows me a
small purple Pokémon, [green]Hoopa[red].

Aros said the one who controls
Hoopa is the Guardian of Borrius\land worthy of this Ball.

Are you the Guardian of Borrius,
or just another brat?"
entries.translation_source: Do you see that item on the table? That is my prized possession, the [color-green-1]Master Ball[color-red-2]. It is a rare Poké Ball that can capture any Pokémon without fail. The man who gave it to me, [color-green-3]Aros[color-red-4], said to watch over it as if my life depended on it. That is until someone shows me a small purple Pokémon, [color-green-5]Hoopa[color-red-6]. Aros said the one who controls Hoopa is the Guardian of Borrius and worthy of this Ball. Are you the Guardian of Borrius, or just another brat?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu melihat barang di atas
meja itu? Itu adalah barang\lberhargaku, [green]Master Ball[red]. Ini adalah

Poké Ball langka yang bisa
menangkap Pokémon apa pun tanpa\lgagal. Pria yang memberikannya

padaku, [green]Aros[red], berkata untuk
menjaganya seolah hidupku\lbergantung padanya. Sampai

seseorang menunjukkan padaku
Pokémon ungu kecil, [green]Hoopa[red]. Aros\lberkata bahwa yang mengendalikan

Hoopa adalah Penjaga Borrius dan
layak mendapatkan Bola ini. Apakah\lkamu Penjaga Borrius, atau hanya

anak nakal lainnya?

entries.original:
"Really?
Prove it to me!

Show me the Pokémon known
as [green]Hoopa[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Really? Prove it to me! Show me the Pokémon known as [color-green-1]Hoopa[color-red-2]!
entries.translated:
Sungguh? Buktikan padaku! Tunjukkan
padaku Pokémon yang dikenal sebagai\l[green]Hoopa[red]!

entries.original:
"That is Hoopa!
That is Hoopa!

You are the Guardian of Borrius!
Take the Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: That is Hoopa! That is Hoopa! You are the Guardian of Borrius! Take the Master Ball!
entries.translated:
Itu Hoopa! Itu Hoopa! Kamu adalah
Penjaga Borrius! Ambil Master\lBall-nya!

entries.original:
"Then, I have no time for you.
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Then, I have no time for you. Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, aku tidak punya waktu
untukmu. Hus! Hus!

entries.original:
"That is not Hoopa!

I have no time for you!
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: That is not Hoopa! I have no time for you! Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Itu bukan Hoopa! Aku tidak punya
waktu untukmu! Hus! Hus!

entries.original:
"Guardian of Borrius!
It is pleasure being in your midst!"
entries.translation_source: Guardian of Borrius! It is pleasure being in your midst!
entries.translated:
Penjaga Borrius! Senang bisa berada
di tengah-tengahmu!

entries.original: "[player] found one Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] found one Master Ball!
entries.translated:
[player] menemukan satu Master
Ball!

entries.original:
"Thief! Put that back!
That’s my prized possession!"
entries.translation_source: Thief! Put that back! That’s my prized possession!
entries.translated:
Pencuri! Kembalikan itu! Itu barang
berhargaku!

entries.original:
"The last Guardian of Borrius, [green]Aros[blue],
tasked several older couples with\lguarding rare or powerful objects.

We are one such couple.

Another couple, I believe, lives
on Route 9."
entries.translation_source: The last Guardian of Borrius, [color-green-1]Aros[color-blue-2], tasked several older couples with guarding rare or powerful objects. We are one such couple. Another couple, I believe, lives on Route 9.
entries.translated:
Penjaga Borrius terakhir, [green]Aros[blue],
menugaskan beberapa pasangan tua\luntuk menjaga benda langka atau

kuat. Kami adalah salah satu
pasangan itu. Pasangan lain, saya\lyakin, tinggal di Rute 9.

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Dude’s older
brother.

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Dude’s older brother. I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Aku kakak laki-laki dari Fishing
Dude. Aku sangat suka memancing!\lAku tidak tahan untuk tidak

melakukannya. Katakan, apakah kamu
suka memancing?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Bagus! Aku suka gayamu. Kurasa kita
bisa berteman. Ambil ini dan\lpancinglah, teman muda!

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

A crummy Old Rod can only catch
Magikarp, yes?

But with a Good Rod, you can
catch much better Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. A crummy Old Rod can only catch Magikarp, yes? But with a Good Rod, you can catch much better Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Memancing adalah cara hidup! Ini
seperti puisi terbaik. Pancing Tua\lyang buruk hanya bisa menangkap

Magikarp, ya? Tapi dengan Pancing
Bagus, kamu bisa menangkap Pokémon\lyang jauh lebih baik.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
That’s so disappointing\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] That’s so disappointing[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Itu sangat mengecewakan\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, [player]!

How are the fish biting?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, [player-name-1]! How are the fish biting?
entries.translated:
Halo, [player]! Bagaimana gigitan
ikannya?

entries.original:
"Do you plan on exploring
Thundercap Mt.?

If you do, you’re going to
need these!"
entries.translation_source: Do you plan on exploring Thundercap Mt.? If you do, you’re going to need these!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu berencana menjelajahi
Gunung Thundercap? Jika iya, kamu\lakan membutuhkan ini!

entries.original:
"It never hurts to be prepared
for anything!"
entries.translation_source: It never hurts to be prepared for anything!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada salahnya untuk siap
menghadapi apa pun!

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt. is a dangerous
place!

I tried exploring it once, but oh
boy, I got smoked!

Ever since then, my lovely wife has
been giving Max Repels daily to any\ltravellers who talk to her."
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. is a dangerous place! I tried exploring it once, but oh boy, I got smoked! Ever since then, my lovely wife has been giving Max Repels daily to any travellers who talk to her.
entries.translated:
Thundercap Mt. adalah tempat yang
berbahaya! Saya pernah mencoba\lmenjelajahinya, tapi astaga, saya

kewalahan! Sejak saat itu, istri
saya yang tercinta memberikan Max\lRepel setiap hari kepada para

pelancong yang berbicara dengannya.

entries.original:
"Uh\.
Er, yes, I’m the Move Deleter.

I can make Pokémon forget their
moves.

Would you like me to do that?"
entries.translation_source: Uh[game-token-1] Er, yes, I’m the Move Deleter. I can make Pokémon forget their moves. Would you like me to do that?
entries.translated:
Uh\. Er, ya, saya Move Deleter. Saya
bisa membuat Pokémon melupakan\ljurus mereka. Apakah kamu ingin

saya melakukannya?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should forget a
move?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should forget a move?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang harus melupakan
sebuah jurus?

entries.original: "Which move should be forgotten?"
entries.translation_source: Which move should be forgotten?
entries.translated: Jurus mana yang harus dilupakan?

entries.original:
"Hm! [green][buffer1][blue]’s [green][buffer2][blue]?
That move should be forgotten?"
entries.translation_source: Hm! [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]’s [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]? That move should be forgotten?
entries.translated:
Hm! [green][buffer1][blue] punya [green][buffer2][blue]? Jurus
itu harus dilupakan?

entries.original:
"It worked to perfection!

[buffer1] has forgotten
[buffer2] completely."
entries.translation_source: It worked to perfection! [buffer1-1] has forgotten [buffer2-2] completely.
entries.translated:
Berhasil sempurna! [buffer1] telah
melupakan [buffer2] sepenuhnya.

entries.original:
"[buffer1] seems to know only one
move\."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] seems to know only one move[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[buffer1] sepertinya hanya tahu satu
jurus\.

entries.original:
"What?
No Egg should know any moves."
entries.translation_source: What? No Egg should know any moves.
entries.translated:
Apa? Tidak ada Telur yang
seharusnya tahu jurus apa pun.

entries.original:
"Come again if there are other
moves to be forgotten."
entries.translation_source: Come again if there are other moves to be forgotten.
entries.translated:
Datang lagi jika ada jurus lain
yang perlu dilupakan.

entries.original:
"If you’re working on a Pokédex,
visit [green]Thundercap Mt.[red]!

All sorts of rare Electric-type
Pokémon live there.

It’s even said that Zapdos roosts
at the peak!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re working on a Pokédex, visit [color-green-1]Thundercap Mt.[color-red-2]! All sorts of rare Electric-type Pokémon live there. It’s even said that Zapdos roosts at the peak!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu sedang mengerjakan
Pokédex, kunjungi [green]Gunung\lThundercap[red]! Semua jenis Pokémon

langka tipe Listrik tinggal di
sana. Bahkan dikatakan bahwa Zapdos\lbersarang di puncaknya!

entries.original:
"A [green]Dusk Ball[blue] is one of the best
Balls you could use at night or\lin a cave.

It’s much more useful than the
inferior Ultra Ball.

Plus, it has the most excellent
name!

Dusk!
The Dusk Ball!

I believe it can even catch
and control the darkness found\lin hearts."
entries.translation_source: A [color-green-1]Dusk Ball[color-blue-2] is one of the best Balls you could use at night or in a cave. It’s much more useful than the inferior Ultra Ball. Plus, it has the most excellent name! Dusk! The Dusk Ball! I believe it can even catch and control the darkness found in hearts.
entries.translated:
Sebuah [green]Dusk Ball[blue] adalah salah satu
Bola terbaik yang bisa kamu gunakan\ldi malam hari atau di gua. Jauh

lebih berguna daripada Ultra Ball
yang inferior. Ditambah lagi,\lnamanya paling keren! Dusk! Dusk

Ball! Saya percaya bola ini bahkan
bisa menangkap dan mengendalikan\lkegelapan yang ada di dalam hati.

entries.original:
"I hear Hyper Potions are diluted in
other regions to be less potent.

Whoever came up with that idea is
a thief and a crook."
entries.translation_source: I hear Hyper Potions are diluted in other regions to be less potent. Whoever came up with that idea is a thief and a crook.
entries.translated:
Saya dengar Hyper Potions
diencerkan di daerah lain agar\ltidak terlalu kuat. Siapa pun yang

punya ide itu adalah pencuri dan
penjahat.

entries.original: "Fallshore City"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City
entries.translated: Fallshore City

entries.original: "Fallshore City D"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City D

entries.original: "Fallshore City N"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City N

entries.original:
"Heya!

Get your stat reducing items here!"
entries.translation_source: Heya! Get your stat reducing items here!
entries.translated:
Heya! Dapatkan item penurun stat di
sini!

entries.original:
"Huah!

Get your stat boosting items here!"
entries.translation_source: Huah! Get your stat boosting items here!
entries.translated:
Huah! Dapatkan item peningkat stat
di sini!

entries.original:
"How’d you like some Moomoo Milk?

It’s the pride and joy of
Magnolia Town!

Give it to a Pokémon to restore
HP!

I’ll give it to you for just $550."
entries.translation_source: How’d you like some Moomoo Milk? It’s the pride and joy of Magnolia Town! Give it to a Pokémon to restore HP! I’ll give it to you for just $550.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kalau kamu mau Susu
Moomoo? Itu adalah kebanggaan dan\lkegembiraan Magnolia Town! Berikan

pada Pokémon untuk memulihkan HP!
Saya akan memberikannya hanya\ldengan $550.

entries.original: "And that’ll be $550!"
entries.translation_source: And that’ll be $550!
entries.translated: Dan itu akan menjadi $550!

entries.original: "And that’ll be $6600!"
entries.translation_source: And that’ll be $6600!
entries.translated: Dan itu akan menjadi $6600!

entries.original:
"Aye, I do deliveries from the
Antisis Port during the day.

Without me, there’d be no
Fallshore Market!"
entries.translation_source: Aye, I do deliveries from the Antisis Port during the day. Without me, there’d be no Fallshore Market!
entries.translated:
Aye, saya melakukan pengiriman dari
Pelabuhan Antisis pada siang hari.\lTanpa saya, tidak akan ada

Fallshore Market!

entries.original:
"Aye, I just finished delivering
goods to all the Poké Marts.

Soon, I’ll be heading back to
Antisis City for the night.

But it looks like I still have
some leftover items.

How about instead of tossing ’em,
I let you have ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Aye, I just finished delivering goods to all the Poké Marts. Soon, I’ll be heading back to Antisis City for the night. But it looks like I still have some leftover items. How about instead of tossing ’em, I let you have ’em!
entries.translated:
Aye, saya baru saja selesai
mengirim barang ke semua Poké Mart.\lSebentar lagi, saya akan kembali ke

Antisis City untuk malam. Tapi
sepertinya saya masih punya\lbeberapa barang sisa. Bagaimana

kalau alih-alih membuangnya, saya
berikan padamu!

entries.original:
"Aye, I just finished delivering
goods to all the Poké Marts.

Soon, I’ll be heading back to
Antisis City for the night."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I just finished delivering goods to all the Poké Marts. Soon, I’ll be heading back to Antisis City for the night.
entries.translated:
Aye, saya baru saja selesai
mengirim barang ke semua Poké Mart.\lSebentar lagi, saya akan kembali ke

Antisis City untuk bermalam.

entries.original:
"Whenever I’m battling in the
[green]Inverse Battle House[blue], I try to\lmake the most of the effectiveness\larrows shown when selecting a move.

It’s a lot easier than actually
knowing what’s good on what,\lya catch my drift?"
entries.translation_source: Whenever I’m battling in the [color-green-1]Inverse Battle House[color-blue-2], I try to make the most of the effectiveness arrows shown when selecting a move. It’s a lot easier than actually knowing what’s good on what, ya catch my drift?
entries.translated:
Setiap kali saya bertarung di
[green]Inverse Battle House[blue], saya berusaha\lmemanfaatkan panah efektivitas yang

ditampilkan saat memilih jurus. Itu
jauh lebih mudah daripada\lbenar-benar tahu apa yang bagus

untuk apa, kamu mengerti maksudku?

entries.original:
"I heard from a friend that under
[green]Tehl Town[red], that tiny town to the\lwest of here, is a secret\lunderground passage to [green]Route 9[red].

But there can’t actually be\.
Come on! Who’d believe that?"
entries.translation_source: I heard from a friend that under [color-green-1]Tehl Town[color-red-2], that tiny town to the west of here, is a secret underground passage to [color-green-3]Route 9[color-red-4]. But there can’t actually be[game-token-5] Come on! Who’d believe that?
entries.translated:
Saya mendengar dari seorang teman
bahwa di bawah [green]Tehl Town[red], kota\lkecil di sebelah barat sini, ada

lorong bawah tanah rahasia menuju
[green]Route 9[red]. Tapi tidak mungkin ada\.\lAyolah! Siapa yang akan percaya

itu?

entries.original:
"You’d never catch me outside when
it’s raining!

\.

Actually, most people here would
probably head indoors."
entries.translation_source: You’d never catch me outside when it’s raining! [game-token-1] Actually, most people here would probably head indoors.
entries.translated:
Kau tidak akan pernah menangkapku
di luar saat hujan! \. Sebenarnya,\lkebanyakan orang di sini mungkin

akan masuk ke dalam.

entries.original:
"Mel’s Gym is a complicated maze of
ponds, lily pads, and waterfalls.

It originally belonged to the
Water-type Gym Leader, Tessy.

When she moved back to East
Borrius, Mel took over the Gym.

He was too busy working on his
perfectly toned body to redesign\lthe entire Gym, so now he runs his\l[green]Normal[blue]-type Gym in a place that’s\lfull of water."
entries.translation_source: Mel’s Gym is a complicated maze of ponds, lily pads, and waterfalls. It originally belonged to the Water-type Gym Leader, Tessy. When she moved back to East Borrius, Mel took over the Gym. He was too busy working on his perfectly toned body to redesign the entire Gym, so now he runs his [color-green-1]Normal[color-blue-2]-type Gym in a place that’s full of water.
entries.translated:
Gym Milik Mel adalah labirin rumit
dari kolam, daun teratai, dan air\lterjun. Awalnya milik Pemimpin Gym

Tipe Air, Tessy. Saat dia pindah
kembali ke East Borrius, Mel\lmengambil alih Gym. Dia terlalu

sibuk membentuk tubuhnya yang
sempurna untuk mendesain ulang\lseluruh Gym, jadi sekarang dia

menjalankan Gym [green]Normal[blue]-typenya di
tempat yang penuh air.

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out
here often with some of his\lcloser friends."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out here often with some of his closer friends.
entries.translated:
Mel, Pemimpin Gym, sering datang ke
sini bersama beberapa teman\ldekatnya.

entries.original:
"Apparently, Mel has his own private
island somewhere out in the ocean!"
entries.translation_source: Apparently, Mel has his own private island somewhere out in the ocean!
entries.translated:
Rupanya, Mel memiliki pulau
pribadinya sendiri di suatu tempat\ldi lautan!

entries.original:
"The [green]Moomoo Milk[red] they sell here is
so sweet!

I buy a dozen at once each time
I come here!"
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Moomoo Milk[color-red-2] they sell here is so sweet! I buy a dozen at once each time I come here!
entries.translated:
[green]Susu Moomoo[red] yang mereka jual di
sini sangat manis! Saya membeli\lselusin sekaligus setiap kali saya

ke sini!

entries.original:
"My umbrella always protects me
when it’s raining!"
entries.translation_source: My umbrella always protects me when it’s raining!
entries.translated:
Payungku selalu melindungiku saat
hujan!

entries.original:
"There are a whole bunch of useful
items for Trainers here!

My favourites are the Berries
they sell.

They reduce Effort Values by
a whole ten points!"
entries.translation_source: There are a whole bunch of useful items for Trainers here! My favourites are the Berries they sell. They reduce Effort Values by a whole ten points!
entries.translated:
Ada banyak barang berguna untuk
Pelatih di sini! Favoritku adalah\lBuah Beri yang mereka jual. Buah

Beri itu mengurangi Nilai Usaha
sebanyak sepuluh poin!

entries.original:
"I hate it when it rains.

I don’t live here, so it’s not like
I can go inside like everyone else\."
entries.translation_source: I hate it when it rains. I don’t live here, so it’s not like I can go inside like everyone else[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku benci saat hujan. Aku tidak
tinggal di sini, jadi aku tidak\lbisa masuk ke dalam seperti orang

lain\.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

How do I get the TM contained in
that yellow Poké Ball\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] How do I get the TM contained in that yellow Poké Ball[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Bagaimana cara mendapatkan TM
yang ada di dalam Poké Ball kuning\litu\.

entries.original:
"Wow!

I saw you glide up that waterfall
like an angel and grab that TM!

Good job!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! I saw you glide up that waterfall like an angel and grab that TM! Good job!
entries.translated:
Wow! Aku melihatmu meluncur naik
air terjun itu seperti malaikat dan\lmengambil TM itu! Kerja bagus!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his
head somewhere."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head somewhere.
entries.translated:
Mel, Pemimpin Gym, tidak ada di
sini sekarang. Dia mungkin sedang\lmenjernihkan pikirannya di suatu

tempat.

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his head
by the [green]KBT Expressway[red] in [green]Tehl Town[red]."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head by the [color-green-1]KBT Expressway[color-red-2] in [color-green-3]Tehl Town[color-red-4].
entries.translated:
Mel, Pemimpin Gym, tidak ada di
sini sekarang. Dia mungkin sedang\lmenjernihkan pikirannya di [green]KBT

Expressway[red] di [green]Tehl Town[red].

entries.original:
"My hidden power is telling me that
you want this!"
entries.translation_source: My hidden power is telling me that you want this!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan Tersembunyiku mengatakan
bahwa kamu menginginkan ini!

entries.original:
"[green]Hidden Power[blue] is a special move
that changes type depending on\lwhich Pokémon uses it."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hidden Power[color-blue-2] is a special move that changes type depending on which Pokémon uses it.
entries.translated:
[green]Kekuatan Tersembunyi[blue] adalah jurus
spesial yang berubah tipe\ltergantung pada Pokémon yang

menggunakannya.

entries.original:
"I can tell you which type of
Hidden Power your Pokémon\lwill learn!

Do you want to know?"
entries.translation_source: I can tell you which type of Hidden Power your Pokémon will learn! Do you want to know?
entries.translated:
Aku bisa memberitahumu tipe
Kekuatan Tersembunyi apa yang akan\ldipelajari Pokémon-mu! Apakah kamu

ingin tahu?

entries.original:
"If [green][buffer1][blue] were to learn
Hidden Power, the move’s type\lwould be [green][buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: If [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] were to learn Hidden Power, the move’s type would be [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Jika [green][buffer1][blue] mempelajari Kekuatan
Tersembunyi, tipe jurusnya akan\lmenjadi [green][buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"If you want to know, ask me, and
I’ll activate my hidden power!"
entries.translation_source: If you want to know, ask me, and I’ll activate my hidden power!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin tahu, tanyakan
padaku, dan aku akan mengaktifkan\lkekuatan tersembunyiku!

entries.original:
"It’s not possible for an Egg to
use Hidden Power!"
entries.translation_source: It’s not possible for an Egg to use Hidden Power!
entries.translated:
Tidak mungkin bagi sebuah Telur
untuk menggunakan Hidden Power!

entries.original:
"Young Trainer.

I have been carrying around this
Egg with me ever since it was laid.

However, I am willing to give it to
a healthy young person.

Would you like to hatch the [green]Egg[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Young Trainer. I have been carrying around this Egg with me ever since it was laid. However, I am willing to give it to a healthy young person. Would you like to hatch the [color-green-1]Egg[color-red-2]?
entries.translated:
Pelatih Muda. Aku telah membawa
Telur ini sejak ditetaskan. Namun,\laku bersedia memberikannya kepada

orang muda yang sehat. Apakah kamu
ingin menetaskan [green]Telur[red]?

entries.original:
"Here.
Please take good care of it.

It is a very special Egg."
entries.translation_source: Here. Please take good care of it. It is a very special Egg.
entries.translated:
Ini. Tolong rawat dengan baik. Ini
adalah Telur yang sangat istimewa.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received an Egg from
the kindly old woman!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received an Egg from the kindly old woman!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima sebuah Telur dari
wanita tua yang baik hati!

entries.original:
"The Egg belongs to a special
Pokémon.

Nowadays, it is considered by
many to be a Fairy."
entries.translation_source: The Egg belongs to a special Pokémon. Nowadays, it is considered by many to be a Fairy.
entries.translated:
Telur ini milik Pokémon spesial.
Saat ini, banyak yang menganggapnya\lsebagai Peri.

entries.original:
"As you wish, then\.

If you have a change of heart about
hatching this Egg, I will be here."
entries.translation_source: As you wish, then[game-token-1] If you have a change of heart about hatching this Egg, I will be here.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kalau begitu\. Jika kamu
berubah pikiran tentang menetaskan\lTelur ini, aku akan ada di sini.

entries.original:
"Oh? You’ve too many Pokémon.
There’s no room for this Egg\."
entries.translation_source: Oh? You’ve too many Pokémon. There’s no room for this Egg[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh? Kamu memiliki terlalu banyak
Pokémon. Tidak ada ruang untuk\lTelur ini\.

entries.original:
"An odd Pokémon Egg obtained
as a gift."
entries.translation_source: An odd Pokémon Egg obtained as a gift.

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mel, lives here
when he’s not on Gym duty or\lstaring at brightly coloured trees.

I just take care of his house for
him while he’s away."
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mel, lives here when he’s not on Gym duty or staring at brightly coloured trees. I just take care of his house for him while he’s away.
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, Mel, tinggal di sini
saat tidak bertugas di Gym atau\lmemandangi pohon berwarna cerah.

Aku hanya merawat rumahnya saat dia
pergi.

entries.original:
"Mel used to date Tessy, the old
Fallshore City Gym Leader.

They broke up when she moved away
to Polder Town in East Borrius, but\lshe left him her Gym as a parting\lgift.

I think that’s the real reason he
didn’t renovate the Gym after she\lleft.

It’s the one thing he has left
from her\."
entries.translation_source: Mel used to date Tessy, the old Fallshore City Gym Leader. They broke up when she moved away to Polder Town in East Borrius, but she left him her Gym as a parting gift. I think that’s the real reason he didn’t renovate the Gym after she left. It’s the one thing he has left from her[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mel dulu berpacaran dengan Tessy,
mantan Pemimpin Gym Kota Fallshore.\lMereka putus saat dia pindah ke

Polder Town di Borrius Timur,
tetapi dia meninggalkan Gym-nya\lsebagai hadiah perpisahan. Kurasa

itulah alasan sebenarnya dia tidak
merenovasi Gym setelah dia pergi.\lItu satu-satunya hal yang tersisa

darinya\.

entries.original:
"Mel is always surrounding himself
with many different women.

He must always be feeling
really lonely\."
entries.translation_source: Mel is always surrounding himself with many different women. He must always be feeling really lonely[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mel selalu mengelilingi dirinya
dengan banyak wanita berbeda. Dia\lpasti selalu merasa sangat kesepian\.

entries.original:
"He traded me his [green]Magmar[blue] holding a
[green]Magmarizer[blue], and it evolved!"
entries.translation_source: He traded me his [color-green-1]Magmar[color-blue-2] holding a [color-green-3]Magmarizer[color-blue-4], and it evolved!
entries.translated:
Dia menukarkan [green]Magmar[blue] miliknya yang
membawa [green]Magmarizer[blue] kepadaku, dan ia\lberevolusi!

entries.original:
"He traded me his [green]Electabuzz[blue], so I
used an [green]Electirizer[blue] on it like an\l[green]Evolution Stone[blue], and it evolved!"
entries.translation_source: He traded me his [color-green-1]Electabuzz[color-blue-2], so I used an [color-green-3]Electirizer[color-blue-4] on it like an [color-green-5]Evolution Stone[color-blue-6], and it evolved!
entries.translated:
Dia menukarkan [green]Electabuzz[blue] miliknya
kepadaku, jadi aku menggunakan\l[green]Electirizer[blue] padanya seperti [green]Batu

Evolusi[blue], dan ia berevolusi!

entries.original:
"There are some Pokémon that can
only evolve during a trade.

But who really trades anymore,
y’know?

That fad died out years ago.

Now you can evolve those Pokémon
using a [green]Link Stone[blue]!

Here, you’ll see!"
entries.translation_source: There are some Pokémon that can only evolve during a trade. But who really trades anymore, y’know? That fad died out years ago. Now you can evolve those Pokémon using a [color-green-1]Link Stone[color-blue-2]! Here, you’ll see!
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Pokémon yang hanya
bisa berevolusi saat perdagangan.\lTapi siapa yang masih bertukar, ya?

Tren itu sudah mati bertahun-tahun
lalu. Sekarang kamu bisa berevolusi\lPokémon itu menggunakan [green]Link Stone[blue]!

Ini, lihat saja!

entries.original:
"The [green]Link Stone[blue] can be used to
evolve certain Pokémon that only\levolve by trading normally."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Link Stone[color-blue-2] can be used to evolve certain Pokémon that only evolve by trading normally.
entries.translated:
[green]Link Stone[blue] dapat digunakan untuk
mengevolusikan Pokémon tertentu\lyang biasanya hanya berevolusi

melalui perdagangan.

entries.original:
"Everyone around here is like,
\qoevolution this\qc and \qoevolution\lthat.\qc

But I think evolution is stupid!

My personal favourite way of
preventing evolution is not by\lpressing \btn01 when my Pokémon is\labout to evolve, but by having it\lhold an [green]Everstone[blue].

That way I can skip the whole
evolution thing altogether!

And you know what?

I’ll actually share one with you
if you can show me a Pokémon that\lhas never evolved and can’t evolve!

Do you have a Pokémon like this in
your party?"
entries.translation_source: Everyone around here is like, [quote-open-1]evolution this[quote-close-2] and [quote-open-3]evolution that.[quote-close-4] But I think evolution is stupid! My personal favourite way of preventing evolution is not by pressing [button-icon-5] when my Pokémon is about to evolve, but by having it hold an [color-green-6]Everstone[color-blue-7]. That way I can skip the whole evolution thing altogether! And you know what? I’ll actually share one with you if you can show me a Pokémon that has never evolved and can’t evolve! Do you have a Pokémon like this in your party?
entries.translated:
Semua orang di sini seperti,
\qoevolusi ini\qc dan \qoevolusi itu.\qc\lTapi menurutku evolusi itu bodoh!

Cara favoritku untuk mencegah
evolusi bukan dengan menekan \btn01 saat\lPokémonku akan berevolusi, tetapi

dengan membiarkannya memegang
[green]Everstone[blue]. Dengan begitu aku bisa\lmelewatkan semua urusan evolusi

itu! Dan tahukah kamu? Aku akan
membagikan satu padamu jika kamu\lbisa menunjukkan Pokémon yang belum

pernah berevolusi dan tidak bisa
berevolusi! Apakah kamu memiliki\lPokémon seperti ini di timmu?

entries.original: "Which Pokémon is it?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is it?
entries.translated: Pokémon yang mana?

entries.original:
"Yup, that Pokémon has never
evolved and can never evolve.

As promised, take an [green]Everstone[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Yup, that Pokémon has never evolved and can never evolve. As promised, take an [color-green-1]Everstone[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Ya, Pokémon itu belum pernah
berevolusi dan tidak akan pernah\lbisa berevolusi. Seperti yang

dijanjikan, ambillah [green]Everstone[blue]!

entries.original:
"If a Pokémon holds an [green]Everstone[blue] it
won’t evolve!

If a Pokémon holds one while
breeding, it’ll pass on its nature!

Aren’t Everstones great?

If you’re looking for more, I hear
there are a whole bunch of them\lstuck in the [green]walls[blue] of the [green]KBT\lExpressway[blue].

How do you get them out, though?
I have no idea\."

entries.original:
"A Mission is an extra objective you
receive by accepting a request\lfor help.

Many people out there are unable to
solve their own problems and\lrequire assistance from others.

Once you accept the Mission, the
details are automatically recorded\lin the Mission Log.

Missions can often yield great
rewards, be it items, money, or\leven new areas to explore.

If someone requests a Mission from
you, accept it immediately.

Even if you have no intention of
completing it right away, there’s\lno harm in having it registered\lin your Mission Log.

With that being said, there are
several people here in need\lof assistance.

Look around and see if there’s
anyone you’d like to help!

And come see me when you’ve
completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions."
entries.translation_source: A Mission is an extra objective you receive by accepting a request for help. Many people out there are unable to solve their own problems and require assistance from others. Once you accept the Mission, the details are automatically recorded in the Mission Log. Missions can often yield great rewards, be it items, money, or even new areas to explore. If someone requests a Mission from you, accept it immediately. Even if you have no intention of completing it right away, there’s no harm in having it registered in your Mission Log. With that being said, there are several people here in need of assistance. Look around and see if there’s anyone you’d like to help! And come see me when you’ve completed at least [color-green-1]5[color-blue-2] Missions.

Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful, wonderful wings! Show the beautiful wings of a Staraptor.

entries.original:
"Wonderful, wonderful wings!
Show the beautiful wings of a
Talonflame."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful, wonderful wings! Show the beautiful wings of a Talonflame.

entries.original:
"Wonderful, wonderful wings!
Show the beautiful wings of a
Hawlucha."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful, wonderful wings! Show the beautiful wings of a Hawlucha.

entries.original:
"Wonderful, wonderful wings!
Show the beautiful wings of a
Pa’u Style Oricorio."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful, wonderful wings! Show the beautiful wings of a Pa’u Style Oricorio.

entries.original:
"I’m a lover of all things wings.

If you show me some beautiful wings
over the course of 4 different\ldays, I’ll share some of my\lbeautiful wings with you.

You wing it?"
entries.translation_source: I’m a lover of all things wings. If you show me some beautiful wings over the course of 4 different days, I’ll share some of my beautiful wings with you. You wing it?
entries.translated:
Aku pecinta segala sesuatu yang
bersayap. Jika kamu menunjukkan\lpadaku beberapa sayap indah selama

4 hari yang berbeda, aku akan
berbagi beberapa sayap indahku\ldenganmu. Kau mau sayap?

entries.original:
"Wingderful!

For today, I’d like to see the
beautiful wings of a [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Wingderful! For today, I’d like to see the beautiful wings of a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Sayapderful! Untuk hari ini, saya
ingin melihat sayap indah dari\l[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original: "That wings."
entries.translation_source: That wings.
entries.translated: Sayap itu.

entries.original:
"Let’s see those beautiful
[green][buffer1][blue] wings!

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Let’s see those beautiful [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] wings! *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Mari kita lihat sayap-sayap indah
[green][buffer1][blue] itu! *Frisk* *Frisk*

entries.original: "Those are some mighty fine wings\."
entries.translation_source: Those are some mighty fine wings[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Itu adalah beberapa sayap yang
sangat bagus\.

entries.original:
"What\.?

I can’t see those beautiful
[green][buffer1][blue] wings anywhere\."
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1]? I can’t see those beautiful [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] wings anywhere[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Apa\.? Aku tidak bisa melihat
[green][buffer1][blue] sayap yang indah itu di\lmana pun\.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice
[green][buffer1][blue] wings.

Just don’t bring them today.
I’m all winged out."
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] wings. Just don’t bring them today. I’m all winged out.
entries.translated:
Besok saya ingin melihat beberapa
[green][buffer1][blue] sayap indah. Jangan bawa\lhari ini. Saya sudah muak dengan

sayap.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice
[green][buffer2][blue] wings.

Just don’t bring them today.
I’m all winged out."
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] wings. Just don’t bring them today. I’m all winged out.
entries.translated:
Besok aku ingin melihat [green][buffer2][blue]
sayap yang bagus. Tapi jangan bawa\lmereka hari ini. Aku sudah muak

dengan sayap.

entries.original:
"Wingderful!

I’ve seen all those beautiful wings
I’d never seen before!

As promised, I’d like to share my
wings with you!"
entries.translation_source: Wingderful! I’ve seen all those beautiful wings I’d never seen before! As promised, I’d like to share my wings with you!
entries.translated:
Wingderful! Aku sudah melihat semua
sayap indah yang belum pernah\lkulihat sebelumnya! Seperti yang

dijanjikan, aku ingin berbagi
sayapku denganmu!

entries.original:
"After seeing all those beautiful
wings, I’m all winged out for life!"
entries.translation_source: After seeing all those beautiful wings, I’m all winged out for life!
entries.translated:
Setelah melihat semua sayap indah
itu, aku sudah muak dengan sayap\lseumur hidup!

entries.original: "Oricorio-Pa’u"
entries.translation_source: Oricorio-Pa’u

entries.original: "Bye-Bye, Butterfree"
entries.translation_source: Bye-Bye, Butterfree
entries.translated: Selamat Tinggal,

entries.original:
"The sweet sorrow of goodbyes! Form
a deep bond with a Butterfree by
training it to at least Level 70."
entries.translation_source: The sweet sorrow of goodbyes! Form a deep bond with a Butterfree by training it to at least Level 70.

entries.original: "Ash"
entries.translation_source: Ash

entries.original:
"No\.

I need an experienced Trainer who’s
proven themself by defeating the\lElite 4 for my task."
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] I need an experienced Trainer who’s proven themself by defeating the Elite 4 for my task.
entries.translated:
Tidak\. Aku butuh Trainer
berpengalaman yang sudah\lmembuktikan diri dengan mengalahkan

Elite 4 untuk tugasku.

entries.original:
"Ah, if it isn’t the Champion of the
Borrius region!

I have just the request for someone
of your skill level.

Would you like to hear it?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, if it isn’t the Champion of the Borrius region! I have just the request for someone of your skill level. Would you like to hear it?
entries.translated:
Ah, kalau bukan Juara dari region
Borrius! Aku punya permintaan yang\ltepat untuk seseorang dengan level

keterampilanmu. Maukah kamu
mendengarnya?

entries.original:
"The task is simple: train a
[green]Butterfree[blue] to Level [green]70[blue] and\lpresent it to me.

It can be over Level 70, but it
must be at least that.

Once you’ve done that, I’ll inform
you of the next part of the task."
entries.translation_source: The task is simple: train a [color-green-1]Butterfree[color-blue-2] to Level [color-green-3]70[color-blue-4] and present it to me. It can be over Level 70, but it must be at least that. Once you’ve done that, I’ll inform you of the next part of the task.
entries.translated:
Tugasnya sederhana: latih seekor
[green]Butterfree[blue] ke Level [green]70[blue] dan\ltunjukkan padaku. Bisa di atas

Level 70, tapi minimal harus
segitu. Setelah itu, aku akan\lmemberitahumu bagian selanjutnya

dari tugas.

entries.original:
"Trainers like you don’t come
around every day."
entries.translation_source: Trainers like you don’t come around every day.
entries.translated:
Trainer sepertimu tidak muncul
setiap hari.

entries.original:
"Have you brought me a
Level [green]70 Butterfree[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Have you brought me a Level [color-green-1]70 Butterfree[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah membawakanku
seekor [green]Butterfree Level 70[blue]?

entries.original:
"Good, that’s just the Butterfree I
was looking for.

Now, [lightgreen]release[blue] it into the wild so
it can find love."
entries.translation_source: Good, that’s just the Butterfree I was looking for. Now, [color-lightgreen-1]release[color-blue-2] it into the wild so it can find love.
entries.translated:
Bagus, itu Butterfree yang sedang
kucari. Sekarang, [lightgreen]lepaskan[blue] ke alam\lliar agar dia bisa menemukan cinta.

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] was released.
Bye-bye, [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] was released. Bye-bye, [buffer1-3]!
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] telah dilepaskan. Selamat
tinggal, [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

Isn’t it beautiful?

That Butterfree will now find love
and be happy forever\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] Isn’t it beautiful? That Butterfree will now find love and be happy forever[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Indah, bukan? Butterfree itu
sekarang akan menemukan cinta dan\lbahagia selamanya\.

entries.original:
"For your heroic actions, I want
you to have my Butterfree in\lplace of the one you released."
entries.translation_source: For your heroic actions, I want you to have my Butterfree in place of the one you released.
entries.translated:
Atas tindakan heroikmu, aku ingin
kau memiliki Butterfree-ku sebagai\lpengganti yang kau lepaskan.

entries.original:
"That Butterfree I gave you is
capable of [green]Gigantamaxing[blue]!

What’s that?

Well, use it in a [green]Hidden Grotto
Raid Battle[blue] and you’ll see!"
entries.translation_source: That Butterfree I gave you is capable of [color-green-1]Gigantamaxing[color-blue-2]! What’s that? Well, use it in a [color-green-3]Hidden Grotto Raid Battle[color-blue-4] and you’ll see!
entries.translated:
Butterfree yang kuberikan itu bisa
[green]Gigantamax[blue]! Ada apa? Nah, gunakan\ldia dalam [green]Pertempuran Raid di Gua

Tersembunyi[blue] dan kau akan lihat!

entries.original:
"I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has
been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I want to see a [color-green-1]Butterfree[color-blue-2] that has been trained to at least Level [color-green-3]70[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Aku ingin melihat seekor [green]Butterfree[blue]
yang telah dilatih setidaknya ke\lLevel [green]70[blue].

entries.original:
"That’s not the Pokémon I’m
looking for.

I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has
been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue]."
entries.translation_source: That’s not the Pokémon I’m looking for. I want to see a [color-green-1]Butterfree[color-blue-2] that has been trained to at least Level [color-green-3]70[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Itu bukan Pokémon yang kucari. Aku
ingin melihat seekor [green]Butterfree[blue]\lyang telah dilatih setidaknya ke

Level [green]70[blue].

entries.original:
"That Butterfree is indeed Level 70
or higher, but you didn’t train it\lyourself!

I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has
been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue]."
entries.translation_source: That Butterfree is indeed Level 70 or higher, but you didn’t train it yourself! I want to see a [color-green-1]Butterfree[color-blue-2] that has been trained to at least Level [color-green-3]70[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Butterfree itu memang Level 70 atau
lebih tinggi, tapi kamu tidak\lmelatihnya sendiri! Aku ingin

melihat seekor [green]Butterfree[blue] yang
telah dilatih setidaknya ke Level\l[green]70[blue].

entries.original:
"But\.

If you don’t release it, how will
your Butterfree ever find love?"
entries.translation_source: But[game-token-1] If you don’t release it, how will your Butterfree ever find love?
entries.translated:
Tapi\. Jika kamu tidak melepaskannya,
bagaimana Butterfree-mu bisa\lmenemukan cinta?

entries.original: "The Communist Revolution"
entries.translation_source: The Communist Revolution
entries.translated: Revolusi Komunis

entries.original:
"Rise up in the name of communism!
Heal at Pokémon Centers [buffer1] times."
entries.translation_source: Rise up in the name of communism! Heal at Pokémon Centers [buffer1-1] times.

entries.original:
"Come here, kid, quietly.

Our whole region is secretly
controlled by the bourgeoisie\land the capitalists.

We in the working class have to
band together and rise up against\lthem in the name of communism!

Their weakness is free services.

If you heal at a Pokémon Center
enough times, their machine of\loppression will crumble."
entries.translation_source: Come here, kid, quietly. Our whole region is secretly controlled by the bourgeoisie and the capitalists. We in the working class have to band together and rise up against them in the name of communism! Their weakness is free services. If you heal at a Pokémon Center enough times, their machine of oppression will crumble.
entries.translated:
Kemari, nak, diam-diam. Seluruh
region kita diam-diam dikuasai oleh\lborjuis dan kapitalis. Kita dari

kelas pekerja harus bersatu dan
bangkit melawan mereka atas nama\lkomunisme! Kelemahan mereka adalah

layanan gratis. Jika kamu cukup
sering menyembuhkan di Pokémon\lCenter, mesin penindasan mereka

akan runtuh.

entries.original:
"Workers of the world unite!

All you need to do is heal [green][buffer1][red]
times at any Pokémon Center.

Other than the one in Antisis City,
they’re all in on the revolution."
entries.translation_source: Workers of the world unite! All you need to do is heal [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] times at any Pokémon Center. Other than the one in Antisis City, they’re all in on the revolution.
entries.translated:
Pekerja dunia bersatu! Yang perlu
kamu lakukan adalah menyembuhkan\l[green][buffer1][red] kali di Pokémon Center

mana pun. Selain yang di Antisis
City, semuanya ikut revolusi.

entries.original:
"Another proletarian brainwashed by
the capitalist machine of tyranny."
entries.translation_source: Another proletarian brainwashed by the capitalist machine of tyranny.
entries.translated:
Proletar lain yang dicuci otak oleh
mesin kapitalis tirani.

entries.original:
"So far you have used our free
service [green][buffer2][red] time\\07.

In order to overthrow the
capitalist tyrants, you will\lneed to heal another [green][buffer3][red] time\\08."
entries.translation_source: So far you have used our free service [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-red-3] time[raw-escape-4]. In order to overthrow the capitalist tyrants, you will need to heal another [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-red-7] time[raw-escape-8].
entries.translated:
Sejauh ini kamu telah menggunakan
layanan gratis kami [green][buffer2][red] kali\\07.\lUntuk menggulingkan para tiran

kapitalis, kamu perlu menyembuhkan
lagi [green][buffer3][red] kali\\08.

entries.original:
"Great work!

Now that the cogs of the capitalist
machine are broken, the workers of\lour world will unite in revolution\lagainst the bourgeoisie!

Here is a token of our
appreciation, comrade [player]."
entries.translation_source: Great work! Now that the cogs of the capitalist machine are broken, the workers of our world will unite in revolution against the bourgeoisie! Here is a token of our appreciation, comrade [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus! Sekarang setelah roda
mesin kapitalis hancur, para\lpekerja dunia kita akan bersatu

dalam revolusi melawan borjuis! Ini
adalah tanda penghargaan kami,\lkawan [player].

entries.original:
"The communist revolution will
always be thankful to you,\lcomrade [player]."
entries.translation_source: The communist revolution will always be thankful to you, comrade [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Revolusi komunis akan selalu
berterima kasih kepadamu, kawan\l[player].

entries.original: "The Capitalist Revolution"
entries.translation_source: The Capitalist Revolution
entries.translated: Revolusi Kapitalis

entries.original:
"Rise up in the name of capitalism!
Make [buffer1] purchases from shops."
entries.translation_source: Rise up in the name of capitalism! Make [buffer1-1] purchases from shops.

entries.original:
"Shush, quiet.

Did you know that the Borrius
region is secretly governed by a\lcommunist consortium, that does\lcommunist things?

We can fight the power by you
buying enough unregistered goods\lfrom Poké Marts.

All Poké Marts are in on it.
You up for a capitalist revolution?"
entries.translation_source: Shush, quiet. Did you know that the Borrius region is secretly governed by a communist consortium, that does communist things? We can fight the power by you buying enough unregistered goods from Poké Marts. All Poké Marts are in on it. You up for a capitalist revolution?
entries.translated:
Ssst, diam. Tahukah kamu bahwa
wilayah Borrius diam-diam\ldiperintah oleh sebuah konsorsium

komunis, yang melakukan hal-hal
komunis? Kita bisa melawan\lkekuasaan dengan kamu membeli cukup

banyak barang tidak terdaftar dari
Poké Mart. Semua Poké Mart\lterlibat. Kamu siap untuk revolusi

kapitalis?

entries.original:
"Long live the revolution!

If you make [green][buffer1][red] purchases from
Poké Marts, the communist system\lwill collapse, and our capitalist\lrevolution can begin."
entries.translation_source: Long live the revolution! If you make [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] purchases from Poké Marts, the communist system will collapse, and our capitalist revolution can begin.
entries.translated:
Hidup revolusi! Jika kamu melakukan
[green][buffer1][red] pembelian dari Poké Mart,\lsistem komunis akan runtuh, dan

revolusi kapitalis kita bisa
dimulai.

entries.original:
"You are just another pawn of the
communist swines."
entries.translation_source: You are just another pawn of the communist swines.
entries.translated:
Kamu hanyalah pion lain dari
babi-babi komunis.

entries.original:
"Our records show that so far you
have made [green][buffer2][red] purchase\\07.

We need another [green][buffer3][red] before our
capitalist revolution can begin."
entries.translation_source: Our records show that so far you have made [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-red-3] purchase[raw-escape-4]. We need another [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-red-7] before our capitalist revolution can begin.
entries.translated:
Catatan kami menunjukkan bahwa
sejauh ini kamu telah melakukan\l[green][buffer2][red] pembelian\\07. Kami

membutuhkan [green][buffer3][red] lagi sebelum
revolusi kapitalis kita bisa\ldimulai.

entries.original:
"Our records show that you have made
enough purchases.

We can now begin our capitalist
revolution.

Here, take these.

You will need them in our fight
against the communist swine."
entries.translation_source: Our records show that you have made enough purchases. We can now begin our capitalist revolution. Here, take these. You will need them in our fight against the communist swine.
entries.translated:
Catatan kami menunjukkan bahwa kamu
telah melakukan cukup banyak\lpembelian. Kita sekarang bisa

memulai revolusi kapitalis kita.
Ini, ambil ini. Kamu akan\lmembutuhkannya dalam perjuangan

kita melawan babi komunis.

entries.original:
"The great war between the
capitalists and the communists\lwill begin any moment now."
entries.translation_source: The great war between the capitalists and the communists will begin any moment now.
entries.translated:
Perang besar antara kaum kapitalis
dan kaum komunis akan dimulai kapan\lsaja sekarang.

entries.original: "Population Control"
entries.translation_source: Population Control
entries.translated: Kontrol Populasi

entries.original:
"Capture [buffer1] Pokémon in one day to
reduce overpopulation."
entries.translation_source: Capture [buffer1-1] Pokémon in one day to reduce overpopulation.

entries.original:
"Pokémon are evolutionarily
superior to people.

But as a consequence of this, they
have started to overpopulate.

We need to lower their wild
population before they realize that\lthey have the upper hand over us.

Can you catch [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon outside
of the Safari Zone in one day to\lslow their growth rate?"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon are evolutionarily superior to people. But as a consequence of this, they have started to overpopulate. We need to lower their wild population before they realize that they have the upper hand over us. Can you catch [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] Pokémon outside of the Safari Zone in one day to slow their growth rate?
entries.translated:
Pokémon secara evolusi lebih unggul
daripada manusia. Namun sebagai\lkonsekuensinya, mereka mulai

mengalami kelebihan populasi. Kita
perlu menurunkan populasi liar\lmereka sebelum mereka menyadari

bahwa mereka memiliki keunggulan
atas kita. Bisakah kamu menangkap\l[green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon di luar Safari

Zone dalam satu hari untuk
memperlambat laju pertumbuhan\lmereka?

entries.original:
"Hurry!

You must stop the Pokémon before
their numbers become too great."
entries.translation_source: Hurry! You must stop the Pokémon before their numbers become too great.
entries.translated:
Cepat! Kamu harus menghentikan
Pokémon sebelum jumlah mereka\lmenjadi terlalu besar.

entries.original:
"If Pokémon multiply and take over
the world, it’s your fault!"
entries.translation_source: If Pokémon multiply and take over the world, it’s your fault!
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon berkembang biak dan
menguasai dunia, itu salahmu!

entries.original:
"You have caught [green][buffer2][blue] Pokémon so far,
so you still need to capture [green][buffer3][blue]\lPokémon today.

Otherwise, there will be nothing
stopping the wild Pokémon from\lbecoming the dominant life forms."
entries.translation_source: You have caught [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] Pokémon so far, so you still need to capture [color-green-4][buffer3-5][color-blue-6] Pokémon today. Otherwise, there will be nothing stopping the wild Pokémon from becoming the dominant life forms.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah menangkap [green][buffer2][blue]
Pokémon sejauh ini, jadi kamu masih\lperlu menangkap [green][buffer3][blue] Pokémon

hari ini. Jika tidak, tidak akan
ada yang menghentikan Pokémon liar\luntuk menjadi bentuk kehidupan yang

dominan.

entries.original:
"Excellent work!

After your catching spree, you have
reduced the number of wild Pokémon\lby a significant number!

They will no longer be able to
overthrow us humans, and will\lalways remain subservient to us.

Here is a reward for your help to
the species."
entries.translation_source: Excellent work! After your catching spree, you have reduced the number of wild Pokémon by a significant number! They will no longer be able to overthrow us humans, and will always remain subservient to us. Here is a reward for your help to the species.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus! Setelah aksi
menangkapmu, kamu telah mengurangi\ljumlah Pokémon liar secara

signifikan! Mereka tidak akan lagi
bisa menggulingkan kita manusia,\ldan akan selalu tetap tunduk kepada

kita. Ini adalah hadiah untuk
bantuanmu kepada spesies ini.

entries.original:
"[black]All Poké Ball catch rates have
been increased by [buffer1]%!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]All Poké Ball catch rates have been increased by [buffer1-2]%!
entries.translated:
[black]Semua tingkat tangkapan Poké Ball
telah ditingkatkan sebesar\l[buffer1]%!

entries.original:
"Pokémon should not be allowed to
rule over humans."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon should not be allowed to rule over humans.
entries.translated:
Pokémon tidak boleh diizinkan untuk
memerintah manusia.

entries.original: "The Trash-Man"
entries.translation_source: The Trash-Man
entries.translated: Manusia Sampah

entries.original:
"Become part of the trash! Search
lucrative trash cans for [buffer1] items."
entries.translation_source: Become part of the trash! Search lucrative trash cans for [buffer1-1] items.

entries.original:
"I am the Trash-Man!

I live in trash!
I eat trash!

Don’t ask, that’s what I do.

I am not looking for garbage, I am
looking for the classiest pieces of\ltrash, but this requires effort.

I would rather pay you to do it
for me.

Will you search trash cans for me
to find at least [green][buffer1][blue] items?"
entries.translation_source: I am the Trash-Man! I live in trash! I eat trash! Don’t ask, that’s what I do. I am not looking for garbage, I am looking for the classiest pieces of trash, but this requires effort. I would rather pay you to do it for me. Will you search trash cans for me to find at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] items?
entries.translated:
Aku adalah Manusia Sampah! Aku
tinggal di sampah! Aku makan\lsampah! Jangan tanya, itulah yang

aku lakukan. Aku tidak mencari
sampah sembarangan, aku mencari\lpotongan sampah paling kelas, tapi

ini butuh usaha. Aku lebih baik
membayarmu untuk melakukannya\luntukku. Maukah kamu mencari tempat

sampah untukku dan menemukan
setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] item?

entries.original:
"Go out and find me the most
delectable trash out there!"
entries.translation_source: Go out and find me the most delectable trash out there!
entries.translated:
Pergilah dan temukan sampah paling
lezat di luar sana!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry, I’ll just wait for
the next chump who wants to be\lhandsomely rewarded."
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry, I’ll just wait for the next chump who wants to be handsomely rewarded.
entries.translated:
Jangan khawatir, aku akan menunggu
orang bodoh berikutnya yang ingin\ldihadiahi dengan baik.

entries.original:
"My trash senses tell me that you
have found [green][buffer2][blue] item\\07 in the trash\lso far.

Go search more lucrative trash and
find at least [green][buffer3][blue] more item\\08!"
entries.translation_source: My trash senses tell me that you have found [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] item[raw-escape-4] in the trash so far. Go search more lucrative trash and find at least [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] more item[raw-escape-8]!
entries.translated:
