entries.original:
"I often skip school to come
pop balloons.

It’s just addicting, y’know?

It’s fun, and I get so many Coins
at the same time!"
entries.translation_source: I often skip school to come pop balloons. It’s just addicting, y’know? It’s fun, and I get so many Coins at the same time!
entries.translated:
Aku sering bolos sekolah untuk
datang meletuskan balon. Ini\lbenar-benar membuat ketagihan,

tahu? Ini menyenangkan, dan aku
dapat banyak Koin sekaligus!

entries.original:
"This silly machine decided to lag
when I turned on my BGM!

Maybe I’ll play the old slots
instead."
entries.translation_source: This silly machine decided to lag when I turned on my BGM! Maybe I’ll play the old slots instead.
entries.translated:
Mesin bodoh ini memutuskan untuk
lag saat aku menyalakan BGM!\lMungkin aku akan main mesin slot

lama saja.

entries.original: "What, you want to play?"
entries.translation_source: What, you want to play?
entries.translated: Apa, kamu mau main?

entries.original: "[black][player] received [green][buffer1][black] Coins!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-black-5] Coins!
entries.translated: [black][player] menerima [green][buffer1][black] Koin!

entries.original:
"Pop a [green]green[blue] balloon as soon as
you see one!

Not only will it double your Coins,
it’ll speed you up, and any Coins\lcollected while sped up will be\ldoubled too!"
entries.translation_source: Pop a [color-green-1]green[color-blue-2] balloon as soon as you see one! Not only will it double your Coins, it’ll speed you up, and any Coins collected while sped up will be doubled too!
entries.translated:
Letuskan balon [green]hijau[blue] segera setelah
kamu melihatnya! Tidak hanya akan\lmenggandakan Koinmu, itu juga akan

mempercepatmu, dan Koin yang
terkumpul saat dipercepat akan\ldigandakan juga!

entries.original:
"[black]Oops!
Don’t have the Coin Case!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Oops! Don’t have the Coin Case!
entries.translated: [black]Ups! Tidak punya Kotak Koin!

entries.original: "[black]You have too many Coins!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You have too many Coins!
entries.translated: [black]Kamu memiliki terlalu banyak Koin!

entries.original:
"I’ve heard some regions have games
just like this one!

But I also heard that instead of
there being a goal in those\lregions, you’re just supposed to\lfly around an empty map.

Who needs that? That’s so boring!
I’d rather pop balloons any day!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve heard some regions have games just like this one! But I also heard that instead of there being a goal in those regions, you’re just supposed to fly around an empty map. Who needs that? That’s so boring! I’d rather pop balloons any day!
entries.translated:
Saya dengar beberapa daerah punya
permainan seperti ini! Tapi saya\ljuga dengar bahwa alih-alih ada

tujuan di daerah-daerah tersebut,
Anda hanya dimaksudkan untuk\lterbang di sekitar peta kosong.

Siapa yang butuh itu? Itu sangat
membosankan! Saya lebih suka\lmemecahkan balon kapan saja!

entries.original:
"A friend of mine nabbed a ton of
Coins playing on one of these old\lslot machines.

Why mess with a good thing?
I’ll try the same spot, too!"
entries.translation_source: A friend of mine nabbed a ton of Coins playing on one of these old slot machines. Why mess with a good thing? I’ll try the same spot, too!
entries.translated:
Seorang temanku mendapatkan banyak
Koin dengan bermain di salah satu\lmesin slot tua ini. Kenapa mengubah

hal yang sudah bagus? Aku akan coba
tempat yang sama juga!

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Want some Coins?"
entries.translation_source: What’s up? Want some Coins?
entries.translated: Ada apa? Mau beberapa Koin?

entries.original:
"Darn! Those polka dot balloons keep
sapping all my Coins!"
entries.translation_source: Darn! Those polka dot balloons keep sapping all my Coins!
entries.translated:
Sial! Balon-balon polkadot itu
terus menguras semua Koin-ku!

entries.original:
"Hey, what? You’re throwing me off!
Here are some Coins, so shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, what? You’re throwing me off! Here are some Coins, so shoo!
entries.translated:
Hei, apa? Kamu menggangguku! Ini
beberapa Koin, jadi pergilah!

entries.original:
"The trick is to always play on the
hardest game mode.

Yes, you may get less time, but the
speed more than makes up for it."
entries.translation_source: The trick is to always play on the hardest game mode. Yes, you may get less time, but the speed more than makes up for it.
entries.translated:
Triknya adalah selalu bermain pada
mode permainan tersulit. Ya, kamu\lmungkin mendapat waktu lebih

sedikit, tetapi kecepatan lebih
dari cukup untuk mengimbanginya.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]!
I haven’t seen you in ages!

Congratulations on becoming the
Champion!

If you haven’t tried already, might
I recommend Cloud Burst?

The Altaria you fly is modeled off
of my own, I’ll have you know.

Play it and you’ll see the
resemblance, I swear it!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player-name-1]! I haven’t seen you in ages! Congratulations on becoming the Champion! If you haven’t tried already, might I recommend Cloud Burst? The Altaria you fly is modeled off of my own, I’ll have you know. Play it and you’ll see the resemblance, I swear it!
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Aku sudah lama tidak
bertemu denganmu! Selamat menjadi\lJuara! Jika kamu belum mencobanya,

mungkin aku bisa merekomendasikan
Cloud Burst? Altaria yang kamu\lkendarai itu dimodelkan dari

punyaku, lho. Cobalah dan kamu akan
melihat kemiripannya, aku\lbersumpah!

entries.original:
"Play Cloud Burst and you’ll see
the resemblance to my Altaria!

I come here every day just to see
it, you know."
entries.translation_source: Play Cloud Burst and you’ll see the resemblance to my Altaria! I come here every day just to see it, you know.
entries.translated:
Gunakan Cloud Burst dan kamu akan
melihat kemiripan dengan\lAltaria-ku! Aku datang ke sini

setiap hari hanya untuk melihatnya,
lho.

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient slot machine!
Want to play?"
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient slot machine! Want to play?
entries.translated: Ini mesin slot kuno! Mau main?

entries.original: "A [green]Coin Case[black] is required\."
entries.translation_source: A [color-green-1]Coin Case[color-black-2] is required[game-token-3]
entries.translated: [green]Kotak Koin[black] diperlukan\.

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient slot machine!

But the amount of Coins in your
Coin Case are overwhelming it!

Spend some Coins before trying
to play."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient slot machine! But the amount of Coins in your Coin Case are overwhelming it! Spend some Coins before trying to play.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah mesin slot kuno! Tetapi
jumlah Koin di Kotak Koinmu\lmembuatnya kewalahan! Habiskan

beberapa Koin sebelum mencoba
bermain.

entries.original:
"OUT OF ORDER
This is broken."
entries.translation_source: OUT OF ORDER This is broken.
entries.translated: RUSAK. Ini rusak.

entries.original: "A Life of No Regrets"
entries.translation_source: A Life of No Regrets
entries.translated: Hidup Tanpa Penyesalan

entries.original:
"Get popping! Play Cloud Burst and
collect 3000 Coins in a single day.
Remaining: [buffer1]"
entries.translation_source: Get popping! Play Cloud Burst and collect 3000 Coins in a single day. Remaining: [buffer1-1]

entries.original:
"My mother always told me to get a
job I’d love.

But work requires effort, so I
became a Gambler.

Sometimes, I win and make money;
other times, I become indebted to\lthe Black Ferrothorn.

I want to quit, but I’m the best,
and I can’t quit while I’m number\lone.

Can you out pop me in balloons?"
entries.translation_source: My mother always told me to get a job I’d love. But work requires effort, so I became a Gambler. Sometimes, I win and make money; other times, I become indebted to the Black Ferrothorn. I want to quit, but I’m the best, and I can’t quit while I’m number one. Can you out pop me in balloons?
entries.translated:
Ibuku selalu mengatakan untuk
mendapatkan pekerjaan yang\lkucintai. Tapi pekerjaan butuh

usaha, jadi aku menjadi Penjudi.
Kadang-kadang, aku menang dan dapat\luang; di lain waktu, aku berhutang

kepada Black Ferrothorn. Aku ingin
berhenti, tapi aku yang terbaik,\ldan aku tidak bisa berhenti selagi

aku nomor satu. Bisakah kamu
mengalahkanku dalam memecahkan\lbalon?

entries.original:
"You have some spirit.

To beat my record, you’ll need to
collect at least [green][buffer1][blue] Coins in a\lsingle day by playing [green]Cloud Burst[blue].

I would spot you some Coins to
play, but I still owe the Black\lFerrothorn some money."
entries.translation_source: You have some spirit. To beat my record, you’ll need to collect at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] Coins in a single day by playing [color-green-4]Cloud Burst[color-blue-5]. I would spot you some Coins to play, but I still owe the Black Ferrothorn some money.
entries.translated:
Kamu punya semangat. Untuk
mengalahkan rekorku, kamu perlu\lmengumpulkan setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue]

Koin dalam satu hari dengan bermain
[green]Cloud Burst[blue]. Aku akan meminjamkanmu\lbeberapa Koin untuk bermain, tapi

aku masih berutang uang kepada
Black Ferrothorn.

entries.original:
"Why, aren’t you an upright fellow,
not wanting to give in to the evils\lof gambling?"
entries.translation_source: Why, aren’t you an upright fellow, not wanting to give in to the evils of gambling?
entries.translated:
Wah, bukankah kamu orang yang
berintegritas, tidak mau menyerah\lpada kejahatan perjudian?

entries.original:
"Now is not the time to quit.

Your earnings of [buffer1] today are
not so far off from [green][buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Now is not the time to quit. Your earnings of [buffer1-1] today are not so far off from [color-green-2][buffer2-3][color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Sekarang bukan waktunya untuk
menyerah. Pendapatanmu sebesar\l[buffer1] hari ini tidak jauh

berbeda dari [green][buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"You actually out did me at my
own game\.

I guess I can quit, now that some
possibly underaged kid beat my\lrecord.

Here, take my Pokémon.

I thought it would help me fly to
new heights, but instead it just\lplunged me into deeper debt."
entries.translation_source: You actually out did me at my own game[game-token-1] I guess I can quit, now that some possibly underaged kid beat my record. Here, take my Pokémon. I thought it would help me fly to new heights, but instead it just plunged me into deeper debt.
entries.translated:
Kamu benar-benar mengalahkanku
dalam permainanku sendiri\. Kurasa\laku bisa berhenti, sekarang karena

seorang anak yang mungkin di bawah
umur memecahkan rekorku. Ini, ambil\lPokémon-ku. Aku pikir itu akan

membantuku terbang ke ketinggian
baru, tetapi malah menjerumuskanku\lke dalam hutang yang lebih dalam.

entries.original:
"Or, I would give it to you, if you
had more space in your party."
entries.translation_source: Or, I would give it to you, if you had more space in your party.
entries.translated:
Atau, aku akan memberikannya
kepadamu, jika kamu memiliki lebih\lbanyak ruang di timmu.

entries.original:
"You know, as a long-time customer,
I have a bit of sway here.

If you’d like, I can have
[green]Happy Hour[blue] started for you."

entries.original:
"New Game \+ is a special feature that
allows you to start a new game\lwith special bonuses:

1) A team of max 6 Pokémon can
be carried over to the new game.

These 6 Pokémon are created from
the party in the previous save.

The Pokémon will be devolved to
their base species and will forget\lany moves barring Egg Moves.

Held items will be retained barring
Z-Crystals.

Additionally, stats such as EVs and
IVs will be retained.

2) If any of the following items
have been obtained in the previous\lsave, they will be carried over to\lthe new game:

Stat Scanner, Motorcycle, DexNav,
Dowsing Machine, Baby Monitor, ADM,\lTrainer Catalogue, Shiny Charm,\lOval Charm, Catching Charm, Magma\lStone, Frontier Card, Porta-PC,\lTime Turner, any unlocked item\lupgrades, and any BP earned.

3) The game’s difficulty may be
increased or decreased at any point\lwithout penalty.

4) Certain main story puzzles
solved in the previous save will\lremain solved in the new game.

5) If the Frontier Card is carried
over, then the Battle Frontier\lmay be accessed immediately upon\larrival in Seaport City.

6) Additional NPCs for modifying
IVs, EVs, and natures will be\lavailable in Crater Town until\lthe game is cleared (when not\lplaying on Sandbox Mode).

Note that some may charge BP for
their services, so make sure you\learn enough before starting the\lnew game.

7) Certain Legendary Pokémon
previously locked to the post-game\lwill now be obtainable before the\lgame is cleared."
entries.translation_source: New Game [game-token-1] is a special feature that allows you to start a new game with special bonuses: 1) A team of max 6 Pokémon can be carried over to the new game. These 6 Pokémon are created from the party in the previous save. The Pokémon will be devolved to their base species and will forget any moves barring Egg Moves. Held items will be retained barring Z-Crystals. Additionally, stats such as EVs and IVs will be retained. 2) If any of the following items have been obtained in the previous save, they will be carried over to the new game: Stat Scanner, Motorcycle, DexNav, Dowsing Machine, Baby Monitor, ADM, Trainer Catalogue, Shiny Charm, Oval Charm, Catching Charm, Magma Stone, Frontier Card, Porta-PC, Time Turner, any unlocked item upgrades, and any BP earned. 3) The game’s difficulty may be increased or decreased at any point without penalty. 4) Certain main story puzzles solved in the previous save will remain solved in the new game. 5) If the Frontier Card is carried over, then the Battle Frontier may be accessed immediately upon arrival in Seaport City. 6) Additional NPCs for modifying IVs, EVs, and natures will be available in Crater Town until the game is cleared (when not playing on Sandbox Mode). Note that some may charge BP for their services, so make sure you earn enough before starting the new game. 7) Certain Legendary Pokémon previously locked to the post-game will now be obtainable before the game is cleared.
entries.translated:
New Game \+ adalah fitur khusus yang
memungkinkan Anda memulai permainan\lbaru dengan bonus khusus: 1) Tim

maksimal 6 Pokémon dapat dibawa ke
permainan baru. 6 Pokémon ini\ldibuat dari tim di save sebelumnya.

Pokémon akan dikembalikan ke
spesies dasarnya dan akan melupakan\lsemua jurus kecuali Jurus Telur.

Item yang dibawa akan dipertahankan
kecuali Z-Crystal. Selain itu, stat\lseperti EV dan IV akan

dipertahankan. 2) Jika salah satu
item berikut telah diperoleh di\lsave sebelumnya, item tersebut akan

dibawa ke permainan baru: Pemindai
Stat, Motor, DexNav, Mesin Deteksi,\lBaby Monitor, ADM, Katalog Pelatih,

Pesona Shiny, Pesona Oval, Pesona
Tangkap, Batu Magma, Kartu\lFrontier, Porta-PC, Pemutar Waktu,

peningkatan item yang telah dibuka,
dan BP yang diperoleh. 3) Tingkat\lkesulitan permainan dapat dinaikkan

atau diturunkan kapan saja tanpa
penalti. 4) Teka-teki cerita utama\ltertentu yang telah diselesaikan di

save sebelumnya akan tetap
terselesaikan di permainan baru. 5)\lJika Kartu Frontier dibawa, maka

Battle Frontier dapat diakses
segera setelah tiba di Kota\lSeaport. 6) NPC tambahan untuk

mengubah IV, EV, dan sifat akan
tersedia di Kota Crater hingga\lpermainan diselesaikan (saat tidak

bermain dalam Mode Sandbox).
Catatan: beberapa mungkin\lmengenakan biaya BP untuk layanan

mereka, jadi pastikan Anda
mengumpulkan cukup sebelum memulai\lpermainan baru. 7) Pokémon

Legendaris tertentu yang sebelumnya
terkunci setelah permainan selesai\lsekarang dapat diperoleh sebelum

permainan diselesaikan.

entries.translated:
Dalam varian penyeimbangan ulang,
semua Pokémon yang berevolusi\lpenuh, termasuk garis spesies

tunggal, akan memiliki statistik
mereka kecuali HP diskalakan untuk\lmemberikan perkiraan total base

stat 600. Namun, Shedinja tidak
akan memiliki statistiknya\ldiskalakan, dan Ability Huge Power

tidak akan berpengaruh pada spesies
yang diskalakan.

entries.original:
"In Sandbox Mode, the following
changes are present:

1) The Stat Scanner can change EVs,
IVs, Natures, Levels, Abilities,\lgenders, moves, and evolutions.

2) The DexNav, Dowsing Machine,
Stat Scanner, Porta-PC, Bicycle,\land Time Turner can be used\linstantly.

3) The in-battle team preview will
always reveal the enemy team.

4) The Pokédex comes prefilled,
allowing easy scans with the\lDexNav.

5) All Pokémon have a 100%
capture rate.

6) Consumable items always return
after Trainer battles.

7) HMs can always be used as long
as the HM is in your Cube.

8) The difficulty CANNOT be reduced
past Expert at any point in the\lgame.

If you are on New Game \+ only, you
may switch between Expert and\lInsane freely.

9) There is LIMITED post-game.

All important battles will be
available from the Battle Frontier\lafter entering the Hall of Fame.

Additionally, fully evolved Pokémon
will be purchaseable in the\lBattle Tower.

However, there will be no more
exploration."
entries.translation_source: In Sandbox Mode, the following changes are present: 1) The Stat Scanner can change EVs, IVs, Natures, Levels, Abilities, genders, moves, and evolutions. 2) The DexNav, Dowsing Machine, Stat Scanner, Porta-PC, Bicycle, and Time Turner can be used instantly. 3) The in-battle team preview will always reveal the enemy team. 4) The Pokédex comes prefilled, allowing easy scans with the DexNav. 5) All Pokémon have a 100% capture rate. 6) Consumable items always return after Trainer battles. 7) HMs can always be used as long as the HM is in your Cube. 8) The difficulty CANNOT be reduced past Expert at any point in the game. If you are on New Game [game-token-1] only, you may switch between Expert and Insane freely. 9) There is LIMITED post-game. All important battles will be available from the Battle Frontier after entering the Hall of Fame. Additionally, fully evolved Pokémon will be purchaseable in the Battle Tower. However, there will be no more exploration.
entries.translated:
Dalam Mode Sandbox, perubahan
berikut ada: 1) Pemindai Stat dapat\lmengubah EV, IV, Sifat, Level,

Ability, jenis kelamin, jurus, dan
evolusi. 2) DexNav, Mesin Deteksi,\lPemindai Stat, Porta-PC, Sepeda,

dan Time Turner dapat digunakan
seketika. 3) Pratinjau tim saat\lbertarung akan selalu mengungkapkan

tim lawan. 4) Pokédex sudah terisi
sebelumnya, memungkinkan pemindaian\lmudah dengan DexNav. 5) Semua

Pokémon memiliki tingkat tangkap
100%. 6) Item habis pakai selalu\lkembali setelah pertarungan

Trainer. 7) HM selalu dapat
digunakan selama ada di Cube Anda.\l8) Tingkat kesulitan TIDAK dapat

dikurangi di bawah Expert kapan pun
dalam permainan. Jika Anda berada\ldi New Game \+ saja, Anda dapat

beralih antara Expert dan Insane
secara bebas. 9) Ada konten\lpasca-cerita TERBATAS. Semua

pertarungan penting akan tersedia
dari Battle Frontier setelah\lmemasuki Hall of Fame. Selain itu,

Pokémon yang berevolusi penuh dapat
dibeli di Battle Tower. Namun,\ltidak akan ada lagi eksplorasi.

entries.original: "Long ago\."
entries.translation_source: Long ago[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Dahulu kala\.

entries.original:
"The Borrius Region was engulfed by
a great war with a foreign land.

It was a brutal war, one which
lasted many years.

During that time, the enemy managed
to seize the upper hand\."
entries.translation_source: The Borrius Region was engulfed by a great war with a foreign land. It was a brutal war, one which lasted many years. During that time, the enemy managed to seize the upper hand[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Wilayah Borrius dilanda perang
besar dengan negeri asing. Itu

adalah perang brutal yang
berlangsung bertahun-tahun. Selama

waktu itu, musuh berhasil
mendapatkan keunggulan\.

entries.original:
"On the brink of defeat, the Borrian
king summoned a dark force to help\lturn the tides of battle\."
entries.translation_source: On the brink of defeat, the Borrian king summoned a dark force to help turn the tides of battle[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Di ambang kekalahan, raja Borrian
memanggil kekuatan gelap untuk\lmembantu membalikkan keadaan

pertempuran\.

entries.original:
"The foreign army’s advantage was
lost almost instantly.

As soon as it entered the battlefield,
the dark force used its power to\lcreate portals and transport the\linvading army back home\."
entries.translation_source: The foreign army’s advantage was lost almost instantly. As soon as it entered the battlefield, the dark force used its power to create portals and transport the invading army back home[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Keunggulan tentara asing hilang
hampir seketika. Begitu memasuki\lmedan perang, kekuatan gelap

menggunakan kekuatannya untuk
membuat portal dan mengangkut\ltentara penyerbu kembali ke rumah\.

entries.original:
"With the foreign army gone, the war
seemed at an end for Borrius.

However, their king, overcome by
his lust for power, sent the Borrian\larmy through the portals as well\."
entries.translation_source: With the foreign army gone, the war seemed at an end for Borrius. However, their king, overcome by his lust for power, sent the Borrian army through the portals as well[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dengan perginya tentara asing,
perang tampaknya berakhir bagi\lBorrius. Namun, raja mereka, yang

diliputi nafsu akan kekuasaan,
mengirim tentara Borrian melalui\lportal juga\.

entries.original:
"The war continued to rage in the
foreign land for several years.

Many more men and Pokémon were
conscripted to fight and inevitably\lmet their end on the battlefield.

One such Pokémon having been a
dear friend of the enemy king\."
entries.translation_source: The war continued to rage in the foreign land for several years. Many more men and Pokémon were conscripted to fight and inevitably met their end on the battlefield. One such Pokémon having been a dear friend of the enemy king[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Perang terus berkecamuk di negeri
asing selama beberapa tahun. Lebih\lbanyak manusia dan Pokémon yang

dikerahkan untuk bertempur dan
akhirnya menemui ajal di medan\lperang. Salah satu Pokémon tersebut

adalah teman dekat raja musuh\.

entries.original:
"Overcome with grief, the king built a
device to restore its life, granting\lhimself immortality in the process."
entries.translation_source: Overcome with grief, the king built a device to restore its life, granting himself immortality in the process.
entries.translated:
Diliputi kesedihan, raja membangun
sebuah perangkat untuk\lmenghidupkannya kembali, membuat

dirinya abadi dalam prosesnya.

entries.original:
"But this traumatic event left him
scarred and filled with anger.

Unable to forgive the world that
had hurt his precious Pokémon, he\lturned his machine into a giant\lweapon, the Ultimate Weapon.

The king became a bringer of
destruction that ended the war."
entries.translation_source: But this traumatic event left him scarred and filled with anger. Unable to forgive the world that had hurt his precious Pokémon, he turned his machine into a giant weapon, the Ultimate Weapon. The king became a bringer of destruction that ended the war.
entries.translated:
Namun peristiwa traumatis ini
membuatnya terluka dan dipenuhi\lamarah. Tidak bisa memaafkan dunia

yang telah menyakiti Pokémon
kesayangannya, ia mengubah mesinnya\lmenjadi senjata raksasa, Senjata

Pamungkas. Sang raja menjadi
pembawa kehancuran yang mengakhiri\lperang.

entries.original:
"With the war over, what little
remained of the Borrian army\lreturned home.

The king’s Pokémon left him, and
the battlefield became silent\."
entries.translation_source: With the war over, what little remained of the Borrian army returned home. The king’s Pokémon left him, and the battlefield became silent[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dengan berakhirnya perang, sedikit
yang tersisa dari pasukan Borrian\lpulang ke rumah. Pokémon sang raja

meninggalkannya, dan medan perang
menjadi sunyi\.

entries.original: "Yet, peace was still to come."
entries.translation_source: Yet, peace was still to come.
entries.translated: Namun, kedamaian masih akan datang.

entries.original:
"Enraged over the fruitless war
fought, survivors of the war wished\lfor ample compensation from the\lBorrian king.

When he had nothing to offer them,
they began to manipulate the dark\lforce to attack the Borrian kingdom\lin an attempted coup."
entries.translation_source: Enraged over the fruitless war fought, survivors of the war wished for ample compensation from the Borrian king. When he had nothing to offer them, they began to manipulate the dark force to attack the Borrian kingdom in an attempted coup.
entries.translated:
Marah karena perang sia-sia yang
diperjuangkan, para penyintas\lperang menginginkan kompensasi yang

besar dari raja Borrian. Ketika dia
tidak memiliki apa pun untuk\lditawarkan kepada mereka, mereka

mulai memanipulasi kekuatan gelap
untuk menyerang kerajaan Borrian\ldalam upaya kudeta.

entries.original:
"In an effort to stop the madness,
the Borrian king gathered the\llegendary Pokémon:"
entries.translation_source: In an effort to stop the madness, the Borrian king gathered the legendary Pokémon:
entries.translated:
Dalam upaya menghentikan kegilaan,
raja Borrian mengumpulkan Pokémon\llegendaris:

entries.original: "Articuno!"
entries.translation_source: Articuno!
entries.translated: Articuno!

entries.original: "Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: Zapdos!
entries.translated: Zapdos!

entries.original: "Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: Moltres!
entries.translated: Moltres!

entries.original:
"Using the power of the three birds,
a Prison was created for the dark\lforce, sealing its power."
entries.translation_source: Using the power of the three birds, a Prison was created for the dark force, sealing its power.
entries.translated:
Menggunakan kekuatan tiga burung,
sebuah Penjara diciptakan untuk\lkekuatan gelap, menyegel

kekuatannya.

entries.original:
"It became a shadow of its former
self."
entries.translation_source: It became a shadow of its former self.
entries.translated:
Ia menjadi bayangan dari dirinya
yang dulu.

entries.original:
"Stripped of its power, it was taken
in by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until one fateful day\."
entries.translation_source: Stripped of its power, it was taken in by the king, and supervised by his progeny, until one fateful day[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dicabut kekuatannya, ia diambil
oleh raja, dan diawasi oleh\lketurunannya, hingga suatu hari

yang menentukan\.

entries.original:
"Stripped of its power, it was taken
in by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until this very day."
entries.translation_source: Stripped of its power, it was taken in by the king, and supervised by his progeny, until this very day.
entries.translated:
Dicabut kekuatannya, ia diambil
oleh raja, dan diawasi oleh

keturunannya, hingga hari ini juga.

entries.translation_source: 16 Years Ago

entries.translation_source: 15 Years Later
entries.translated: 15 Tahun Kemudian

entries.original: "Yes   "
entries.translation_source: Yes
entries.translated: Ya

entries.original: "No"
entries.translation_source: No
entries.translated: Tidak

entries.original:
"Hoopa\.

I worry, old friend, for the future
- for if, no\.\CC0818 when SHE arrives."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa[game-token-1] I worry, old friend, for the future - for if, no[game-token-2][control-code-3] when SHE arrives.
entries.translated:
Hoopa\. Aku khawatir, teman lama,
akan masa depan - karena jika,\lbukan\.\CC0818 ketika DIA tiba.

entries.original:
"I won’t be able to protect you if
she tries something.

No\.\CC0818 she will try something.

It’s a matter of what it will be."
entries.translation_source: I won’t be able to protect you if she tries something. No[game-token-1][control-code-2] she will try something. It’s a matter of what it will be.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak akan bisa melindungimu
jika dia mencoba sesuatu. Bukan\.\CC0818 dia\lakan mencoba sesuatu. Ini soal apa

yang akan dia lakukan.

entries.original:
"That’s why, my friend, you must
go into hiding.

I’ll send your Poké Ball adrift,
amidst the waves\.

You’ll surely be safer lost at sea,
than if you were to remain with me.

If I’m wrong, and nothing happens,
I’ll call you back.

But if this is to be our final time
together\.

Protect my [buffer3] if [buffer2] is
ever in danger.

And in turn, should the wrong sort
try to force your true power free\.

Then trust [buffer1] to protect you.

Farewell, my good friend."
entries.translation_source: That’s why, my friend, you must go into hiding. I’ll send your Poké Ball adrift, amidst the waves[game-token-1] You’ll surely be safer lost at sea, than if you were to remain with me. If I’m wrong, and nothing happens, I’ll call you back. But if this is to be our final time together[game-token-2] Protect my [buffer3-3] if [buffer2-4] is ever in danger. And in turn, should the wrong sort try to force your true power free[game-token-5] Then trust [buffer1-6] to protect you. Farewell, my good friend.
entries.translated:
Itulah sebabnya, temanku, kamu
harus bersembunyi. Aku akan\lmengirimkan Poké Ball-mu hanyut, di

tengah ombak\. Kamu pasti akan lebih
aman hilang di laut, daripada jika\lkamu tetap bersamaku. Jika aku

salah, dan tidak terjadi apa-apa,
aku akan memanggilmu kembali. Tapi\ljika ini adalah waktu terakhir kita

bersama\. Lindungi [buffer3]ku jika
[buffer2] dalam bahaya. Dan\lsebaliknya, jika orang jahat

mencoba memaksa kekuatan sejatimu
keluar\. Maka percayakan [buffer1]\luntuk melindungimu. Selamat

tinggal, teman baikku.

entries.original: "It’s gone\."
entries.translation_source: It’s gone[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sudah hilang\.

entries.original:
"So, you came after all.

Let’s get this over with."
entries.translation_source: So, you came after all. Let’s get this over with.
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu datang juga. Ayo kita
selesaikan ini.

entries.original:
"ARGH!

How can I fulfill Grandpapa’s wish
if I cannot catch a single Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: ARGH! How can I fulfill Grandpapa’s wish if I cannot catch a single Pokémon?
entries.translated:
ARGH! Bagaimana aku bisa memenuhi
keinginan Kakek jika aku tidak bisa\lmenangkap satu Pokémon pun?

entries.original:
"I promised him\.\CC0820 I promised I would
finish the war, but right now\.

I cannot even begin to fathom the
possibility!"
entries.translation_source: I promised him[game-token-1][control-code-2] I promised I would finish the war, but right now[game-token-3] I cannot even begin to fathom the possibility!
entries.translated:
Aku berjanji padanya\.\CC0820 Aku berjanji
akan mengakhiri perang, tetapi\lsekarang\. aku bahkan tidak bisa

mulai membayangkan kemungkinan itu!

entries.original: "What ever should I do\.?"
entries.translation_source: What ever should I do[game-token-1]?
entries.translated: Apa yang harus aku lakukan\.?

entries.original: "A Poké Ball? Here? Now?"
entries.translation_source: A Poké Ball? Here? Now?
entries.translated: Poké Ball? Di sini? Sekarang?

entries.original: "This Pokémon\.\CC0820 it can’t be\.!"
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon[game-token-1][control-code-2] it can’t be[game-token-3]!
entries.translated: Pokémon ini\.\CC0820 tidak mungkin\.!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0818 pa\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2][control-code-3] pa[game-token-4]
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0818 pa\.

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha\.

It appears, Grandpapa, there may be
a way after all.

It is time for destruction to engulf
the land\.

And for the Eternal Flower to bloom
once again\."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha[game-token-1] It appears, Grandpapa, there may be a way after all. It is time for destruction to engulf the land[game-token-2] And for the Eternal Flower to bloom once again[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ha ha ha\. Tampaknya, Kakek, mungkin
masih ada jalan. Sudah waktunya\lkehancuran melanda negeri\. dan Bunga

Abadi mekar kembali\.

"

entries.original:

Just leave it up to me!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, let’s get you all fixed up! Just leave it up to me!
entries.translated:
Oke, biar aku perbaiki semuanya!
Serahkan saja padaku!

entries.original:

explore the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Be careful of sandstorms as you explore the Great Desert!

Hati-hati dengan badai pasir saat
menjelajahi Gurun Besar!

clown of the sand!

As long as there are breakable
rocks to the west of this canyon\land to the north of the southern\lcanyon, I am not truly free\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo, you found the clown of the sand! But the shackles that bind me still linger. As long as there are breakable rocks to the west of this canyon and to the north of the southern canyon, I am not truly free[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo, kamu menemukan
badut pasir! Tapi belenggu yang\lmengikatku masih ada. Selama masih

ada batu yang bisa dipecah di
sebelah barat ngarai ini dan di\lutara ngarai selatan, aku tidak

benar-benar bebas\.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo, you found the
clown of the sand!

And you even broke all of my
shackles along the way!

For that, you have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo, you found the clown of the sand! And you even broke all of my shackles along the way! For that, you have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo, kamu menemukan
badut pasir! Dan kamu bahkan\lmematahkan semua belengguku di

sepanjang jalan! Untuk itu, aku
berterima kasih.

entries.original: "Whirly, twirly, sandy, dandy\."
entries.translation_source: Whirly, twirly, sandy, dandy[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Berputar, memutar, berpasir,
menawan\.

entries.original: "Warmonger"
entries.translation_source: Warmonger
entries.translated: Penghasut Perang

entries.original:
"Become one of the Undying Lucario!
Fight [buffer1] battles to be initiated."
entries.translation_source: Become one of the Undying Lucario! Fight [buffer1-1] battles to be initiated.
entries.translated:
Jadilah salah satu dari Undying
Lucario! Bertarung [buffer1]
pertempuran untuk memulai.

entries.original:
"I am a member of the powerful
warrior cult known simply as the\lUndying Lucario.

In the olden days, we would fight
not for riches, but for sport.

However, modern society has deemed
human battles to be \qoinhumane\qc, so\lwe now battle with our Pokémon.

Do you think you have what it takes
to become one of us?"
entries.translation_source: I am a member of the powerful warrior cult known simply as the Undying Lucario. In the olden days, we would fight not for riches, but for sport. However, modern society has deemed human battles to be [quote-open-1]inhumane[quote-close-2], so we now battle with our Pokémon. Do you think you have what it takes to become one of us?
entries.translated:
Aku adalah anggota kultus prajurit
kuat yang dikenal sebagai Undying\lLucario. Di masa lalu, kami

bertarung bukan untuk kekayaan,
tetapi untuk olahraga. Namun,\lmasyarakat modern menganggap

pertarungan manusia sebagai \qotidak
manusiawi\qc, jadi kami sekarang\lbertarung dengan Pokémon kami.

Apakah kamu pikir kamu memiliki apa
yang diperlukan untuk menjadi salah\lsatu dari kami?

entries.original:
"In order to complete your initiation,
you must enjoy the thrill of battle\lat least [green][buffer1][blue] times."
entries.translation_source: In order to complete your initiation, you must enjoy the thrill of battle at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] times.
entries.translated:
Untuk menyelesaikan inisiasi, kamu
harus menikmati sensasi pertempuran\lsetidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] kali.

entries.original:
"Not all have the heart to become of
of the Undying Lucario."
entries.translation_source: Not all have the heart to become of of the Undying Lucario.
entries.translated:
Tidak semua memiliki hati untuk
menjadi salah satu dari Undying\lLucario.

entries.original:
"You have fought many battles.

But in order to be a true member of
the Undying Lucario, you must wage\l[green][buffer3][blue] more."
entries.translation_source: You have fought many battles. But in order to be a true member of the Undying Lucario, you must wage [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3] more.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah bertarung dalam banyak
pertempuran. Tapi untuk menjadi\langgota sejati Undying Lucario,

kamu harus bertarung [green][buffer3][blue] lagi.

entries.original:
"You have demonstrated that you have
the heart of a warrior.

I now induct you into the cult of
the Undying Lucario, in which you\lwill also receive our sacred rock."
entries.translation_source: You have demonstrated that you have the heart of a warrior. I now induct you into the cult of the Undying Lucario, in which you will also receive our sacred rock.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah menunjukkan bahwa kamu
memiliki hati seorang prajurit. Aku\lsekarang meresmikanmu ke dalam

kultus Undying Lucario, di mana
kamu juga akan menerima batu suci\lkami.

entries.original:
"The Undying Lucario always enjoy a
good battle just for the sport of it."
entries.translation_source: The Undying Lucario always enjoy a good battle just for the sport of it.
entries.translated:
Undying Lucario selalu menikmati
pertempuran yang baik hanya untuk\lolahraga.

entries.original:
"Through this gateway lies the great
King Borrius the Third.

He is the king who released and
bound the dark force in days past.

No one has yet succeeded in mapping
out the tomb, but legends say that\lthere is immense wealth waiting for\lany who are able to reach the\lburial chamber."
entries.translation_source: Through this gateway lies the great King Borrius the Third. He is the king who released and bound the dark force in days past. No one has yet succeeded in mapping out the tomb, but legends say that there is immense wealth waiting for any who are able to reach the burial chamber.
entries.translated:
Di balik gerbang ini terbaring Raja
Borrius yang Agung yang Ketiga. Dia\ladalah raja yang melepaskan dan

mengikat kekuatan gelap di masa
lalu. Belum ada yang berhasil\lmemetakan makam ini, tetapi legenda

mengatakan bahwa ada kekayaan besar
yang menunggu bagi siapa pun yang\lmampu mencapai ruang pemakaman.

entries.original:
"Word around here is that I’m the
strongest Trainer in the desert.

It took much time to gain the
respect of the Trainers around\lhere, so if you want my respect,\lyou’ll earn their respect first."
entries.translation_source: Word around here is that I’m the strongest Trainer in the desert. It took much time to gain the respect of the Trainers around here, so if you want my respect, you’ll earn their respect first.
entries.translated:
Kabar di sini mengatakan bahwa aku
adalah Trainer terkuat di gurun.\lButuh waktu lama untuk mendapatkan

rasa hormat dari para Trainer di
sini, jadi jika kamu ingin rasa\lhormatku, kamu harus mendapatkan

rasa hormat mereka terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"Word around here is that I’m the
strongest Trainer in the desert.

It took much time to gain the
respect of the Trainers around\lhere, so if you want my respect,\lyou’ll have to fight me for it!"
entries.translation_source: Word around here is that I’m the strongest Trainer in the desert. It took much time to gain the respect of the Trainers around here, so if you want my respect, you’ll have to fight me for it!
entries.translated:
Kabar di sini mengatakan bahwa aku
adalah Trainer terkuat di gurun.\lButuh waktu lama untuk mendapatkan

rasa hormat dari para Trainer di
sini, jadi jika kamu ingin rasa\lhormatku, kamu harus melawanku

untuk mendapatkannya!

entries.original:
"Done!
You’ve earned my respect!"
entries.translation_source: Done! You’ve earned my respect!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Kamu telah mendapatkan
rasa hormatku!

entries.original:
"Any good desert Trainer can use an
item like this."
entries.translation_source: Any good desert Trainer can use an item like this.
entries.translated:
Setiap Trainer gurun yang baik bisa
menggunakan item seperti ini.

entries.original:
"That item is a [green]Scizorite[blue]!

If you catch a Scyther and evolve
it into a [green]Scizor[blue], let it hold that\lto unleash its metallic fury!"
entries.translation_source: That item is a [color-green-1]Scizorite[color-blue-2]! If you catch a Scyther and evolve it into a [color-green-3]Scizor[color-blue-4], let it hold that to unleash its metallic fury!
entries.translated:
Item itu adalah [green]Scizorite[blue]! Jika
kamu menangkap Scyther dan\lmengevolusinya menjadi [green]Scizor[blue],

biarkan ia memegangnya untuk
melepaskan amukan metaliknya!

entries.original:
"How tough are you?
We shall expose that secret!"
entries.translation_source: How tough are you? We shall expose that secret!
entries.translated:
Seberapa tangguh kamu? Kami akan
mengungkap rahasia itu!

entries.original: "Your secret has been revealed."
entries.translation_source: Your secret has been revealed.
entries.translated: Rahasia kamu telah terungkap.

entries.original:
"This desert hoards mysteries in
its shifting sands!"
entries.translation_source: This desert hoards mysteries in its shifting sands!
entries.translated:
Gurun ini menyimpan misteri di
pasirnya yang berubah-ubah!

entries.original:
"I’m telling you, this rock
formation has significance!

I can feel it!"
entries.translation_source: I’m telling you, this rock formation has significance! I can feel it!
entries.translated:
Aku bilang, formasi batu ini
memiliki arti penting! Aku bisa\lmerasakannya!

entries.original:
"Hmph.

I wound up in this pit somehow."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. I wound up in this pit somehow.
entries.translated:
Hmph. Entah bagaimana aku berakhir
di lubang ini.

entries.original:
"Hmph.

You beat me."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. You beat me.
entries.translated: Hmph. Kamu mengalahkanku.

entries.original:
"Hmph.

I really dug myself into a hole,
didn’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Hmph. I really dug myself into a hole, didn’t I?
entries.translated:
Hmph. Aku benar-benar menggali
lubang untuk diriku sendiri, ya?

entries.original:
"Because of my efforts, this desert
is like a paradise for Pokémon!

It is truly a great desert!"
entries.translation_source: Because of my efforts, this desert is like a paradise for Pokémon! It is truly a great desert!
entries.translated:
Berkat usahaku, gurun ini seperti
surga bagi Pokémon! Ini benar-benar\lgurun yang hebat!

entries.original:
"I heard there are fossils to be found
in the desert.

Where could they be?"
entries.translation_source: I heard there are fossils to be found in the desert. Where could they be?
entries.translated:
Aku dengar ada fosil yang bisa
ditemukan di gurun. Di mana mereka\lberada?

entries.original: "I came up short\."
entries.translation_source: I came up short[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Saya kurang berhasil\.

entries.original:
"If there are fossils hidden in
the desert, it must have been\lunderwater a long time ago."
entries.translation_source: If there are fossils hidden in the desert, it must have been underwater a long time ago.
entries.translated:
Jika ada fosil yang tersembunyi di
gurun, pasti tempat ini dulu pernah\lberada di bawah air.

entries.original:
"I’m going to be a real hero
one day.

I’m going to work harder to make me
and my Pokémon stronger."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to be a real hero one day. I’m going to work harder to make me and my Pokémon stronger.
entries.translated:
Suatu hari nanti aku akan menjadi
pahlawan sejati. Aku akan bekerja\llebih keras untuk membuatku dan

Pokémonku lebih kuat.

entries.original:
"The boys and I are gonna have a
concert soon!

It’s gonna be rockin’!"
entries.translation_source: The boys and I are gonna have a concert soon! It’s gonna be rockin’!
entries.translated:
Aku dan teman-teman akan segera
mengadakan konser! Ini akan menjadi\lkeren!

entries.original: "I can’t jam out in a sandstorm!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t jam out in a sandstorm!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa bermain musik di
tengah badai pasir!

entries.original:
"I came to play music in the desert,
but sand is getting in my guitar."
entries.translation_source: I came to play music in the desert, but sand is getting in my guitar.
entries.translated:
Aku datang untuk bermain musik di
gurun, tapi pasir masuk ke gitarku.

entries.original:
"In your future, I sense that you
will meet many others.

I think you will be linked to each
other by a strange power."
entries.translation_source: In your future, I sense that you will meet many others. I think you will be linked to each other by a strange power.
entries.translated:
Di masa depanmu, aku merasakan
bahwa kamu akan bertemu banyak\lorang lain. Kupikir kalian akan

terhubung satu sama lain oleh
kekuatan aneh.

entries.original:
"I smashed rocks with my fists and
found these Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I smashed rocks with my fists and found these Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Aku menghancurkan batu dengan
tinjuku dan menemukan Pokémon ini!

entries.original: "I could not smash you."
entries.translation_source: I could not smash you.
entries.translated: Aku tidak bisa menghancurkanmu.

entries.original:
"Shattering rocks here can yield
valuable rewards!"
entries.translation_source: Shattering rocks here can yield valuable rewards!
entries.translated:
Menghancurkan batu di sini bisa
memberikan hadiah berharga!

entries.original:
"I think [green]Rufflet[blue] can only be found
here on [green]Mondays[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I think [color-green-1]Rufflet[color-blue-2] can only be found here on [color-green-3]Mondays[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Kupikir [green]Rufflet[blue] hanya bisa
ditemukan di sini pada hari [green]Senin[blue].

entries.original:
"I’m keeping a close eye out for
Vullaby.

Have you seen any today?"
entries.translation_source: I’m keeping a close eye out for Vullaby. Have you seen any today?
entries.translated:
Aku mengawasi dengan saksama untuk
Vullaby. Apakah kamu melihatnya\lhari ini?

entries.original:
"My friend thinks Rufflet are better
than Vullaby. He’s wrong."
entries.translation_source: My friend thinks Rufflet are better than Vullaby. He’s wrong.
entries.translated:
Temanku mengira Rufflet lebih baik
daripada Vullaby. Dia salah.

entries.original:
"I’ve only seen [green]Vullaby[blue] around here
on [green]Thursdays[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’ve only seen [color-green-1]Vullaby[color-blue-2] around here on [color-green-3]Thursdays[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Aku hanya melihat [green]Vullaby[blue] di sini
pada hari [green]Kamis[blue].

entries.original:
"This desert’ll always keep me
fired up!"
entries.translation_source: This desert’ll always keep me fired up!
entries.translated:
Gurun ini akan selalu membuatku
bersemangat!

entries.original:
"Leave me alone!
The desert sand is so warm\.

Zzz\."
entries.translation_source: Leave me alone! The desert sand is so warm[game-token-1] Zzz[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Tinggalkan aku sendiri! Pasir gurun
ini sangat hangat\. Zzz\.

entries.original:
"The flora in the desert is so
fascinating!"
entries.translation_source: The flora in the desert is so fascinating!
entries.translated: Flora di gurun ini sangat menarik!

entries.original:
"Who cares about winning when we can
gush over my flora?"
entries.translation_source: Who cares about winning when we can gush over my flora?
entries.translated:
Siapa peduli tentang menang ketika
kita bisa mengagumi floraku?

entries.original:
"I found my Pokémon pretending to
be a cactus!

Or maybe that’s just because it’s
the Cactus Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: I found my Pokémon pretending to be a cactus! Or maybe that’s just because it’s the Cactus Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Aku menemukan Pokémonku
berpura-pura menjadi kaktus! Atau\lmungkin itu hanya karena dia adalah

Pokémon Kaktus?

entries.original: "[green]Ra ra ra ra!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Ra ra ra ra!
entries.translated: [green]Ra ra ra ra!

entries.original: "[green]Awwwk!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Awwwk!
entries.translated: [green]Awwwk!

entries.original: "[green]Blip bloop!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Blip bloop!
entries.translated: [green]Blip bloop!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] disappeared in the
shifting sands."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] disappeared in the shifting sands.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] menghilang di pasir yang
bergeser.

entries.original: "Grim Woods"
entries.translation_source: Grim Woods
entries.translated: Grim Woods

entries.original:
"A spooky forest filled with many
Ghost-type Pokémon.
Many children have gone missing
in these woods."
entries.translation_source: A spooky forest filled with many Ghost-type Pokémon. Many children have gone missing in these woods.

entries.original: "Weed Whacker"
entries.translation_source: Weed Whacker
entries.translated: Weed Whacker

entries.original:
"Help a rich businessman build his
dream pancake restaurant by cutting
down all of the grass in Grim Woods."
entries.translation_source: Help a rich businessman build his dream pancake restaurant by cutting down all of the grass in Grim Woods.
entries.translated:
Bantu seorang pengusaha kaya
membangun restoran pancake ...
semua rumput di Grim Woods.

entries.original:
"Hello, Trainer!

You are precisely the type of
person I am looking for.

I am a businessman trying to build
my dream pancake restaurant right\lhere in the forest.

There’s just one problem.

There is all this pesky tall grass
in the way.

Are your services available to Cut
all the tall grass in the area?"
entries.translation_source: Hello, Trainer! You are precisely the type of person I am looking for. I am a businessman trying to build my dream pancake restaurant right here in the forest. There’s just one problem. There is all this pesky tall grass in the way. Are your services available to Cut all the tall grass in the area?
entries.translated:
Halo, Trainer! Kamu persis tipe
orang yang saya cari. Saya seorang\lpengusaha yang mencoba membangun

restoran pancake impian saya tepat
di sini di hutan. Hanya ada satu\lmasalah. Ada semua rumput tinggi

yang mengganggu ini. Apakah jasamu
tersedia untuk memotong semua\lrumput tinggi di area ini?

entries.original:
"Excellent!

Now get going and use [green]Cut[blue] to take
down all the tall grass!"
entries.translation_source: Excellent! Now get going and use [color-green-1]Cut[color-blue-2] to take down all the tall grass!
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Sekarang berangkat dan
gunakan [green]Cut[blue] untuk menebang semua\lrumput tinggi!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry, Trainer, I will find
someone else who wants to develop\lmy land for a handsome payment."
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry, Trainer, I will find someone else who wants to develop my land for a handsome payment.
entries.translated:
Jangan khawatir, Trainer, saya akan
mencari orang lain yang ingin\lmengembangkan tanah saya dengan

bayaran yang menggiurkan.

entries.original:
"There is still tall grass in these
woods you need to [green]Cut[blue] down.

Get hacking!"
entries.translation_source: There is still tall grass in these woods you need to [color-green-1]Cut[color-blue-2] down. Get hacking!
entries.translated:
Masih ada rumput tinggi di hutan
ini yang perlu kamu [green]Cut[blue] tebang. Ayo\ltebang!

entries.original:
"Excellent work, but I am afraid I
have some bad news.

The Pokémon Rangers have just shut
down our operation.

Apparently the tall grass around
here is endangered, despite always\lgrowing back.

However, I am still contractually
obligated to pay you for your\lservice."
entries.translation_source: Excellent work, but I am afraid I have some bad news. The Pokémon Rangers have just shut down our operation. Apparently the tall grass around here is endangered, despite always growing back. However, I am still contractually obligated to pay you for your service.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, tapi saya khawatir ada
kabar buruk. Pokémon Rangers baru\lsaja menghentikan operasi kami.

Rupanya rumput tinggi di sekitar
sini terancam punah, meskipun\lselalu tumbuh kembali. Namun, saya

tetap terikat kontrak untuk
membayar jasamu.

entries.original:
"First I will take down the
Pokémon Rangers, then I will\lbuild my pancake empire."
entries.translation_source: First I will take down the Pokémon Rangers, then I will build my pancake empire.
entries.translated:
Pertama saya akan menjatuhkan
Pokémon Rangers, lalu saya akan\lmembangun kerajaan pancake saya.

entries.original:
"With a few more battles like the
one we had, this place’ll become\lhappenin’ in no time!"
entries.translation_source: With a few more battles like the one we had, this place’ll become happenin’ in no time!
entries.translated:
Dengan beberapa pertarungan lagi
seperti yang kita lakukan, tempat\lini akan menjadi ramai dalam waktu

singkat!

entries.original:
"Is it just me, or do different
Bug-type Pokémon appear at night?"
entries.translation_source: Is it just me, or do different Bug-type Pokémon appear at night?
entries.translated:
Apa hanya aku, atau apakah Pokémon
tipe Serangga yang berbeda muncul\ldi malam hari?

entries.original: "It can’t be just me, right?"
entries.translation_source: It can’t be just me, right?
entries.translated: Tidak mungkin hanya aku, kan?

entries.original:
"I’m pretty sure Caterpie like to
frequent these woods during the\ldaytime while Weedle like to\lpopulate them at night."
entries.translation_source: I’m pretty sure Caterpie like to frequent these woods during the daytime while Weedle like to populate them at night.
entries.translated:
Saya yakin Caterpie suka sering
datang ke hutan ini pada siang hari\lsementara Weedle suka mengisinya

pada malam hari.

entries.original:
"Pokémon get stronger when they
evolve.

But how much stronger is my Pokémon
compared to other evolved Pokémon?

I bet a whole bunch!"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon get stronger when they evolve. But how much stronger is my Pokémon compared to other evolved Pokémon? I bet a whole bunch!
entries.translated:
Pokémon menjadi lebih kuat saat
mereka berevolusi. Tapi seberapa\lkuat Pokémon saya dibandingkan

dengan Pokémon berevolusi lainnya?
Saya yakin jauh lebih kuat!

entries.original:
"Due to the grim nature of these
woods, Ghost-type Pokémon feel\lat home here."
entries.translation_source: Due to the grim nature of these woods, Ghost-type Pokémon feel at home here.
entries.translated:
Karena sifat suram hutan ini,
Pokémon tipe Hantu merasa betah di\lsini.

entries.original:
"According to old tales, Phantump
are tree stumps possessed by the\lspirits of children who died while\llost in these woods."
entries.translation_source: According to old tales, Phantump are tree stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in these woods.
entries.translated:
Menurut cerita lama, Phantump
adalah tunggul pohon yang dirasuki\loleh roh anak-anak yang meninggal

saat tersesat di hutan ini.

entries.original:
"Pumpkaboo come in many different
sizes."
entries.translation_source: Pumpkaboo come in many different sizes.
entries.translated:
Pumpkaboo hadir dalam berbagai
ukuran berbeda.

entries.original:
"There are four Pumpkaboo sizes
in total."
entries.translation_source: There are four Pumpkaboo sizes in total.
entries.translated: Total ada empat ukuran Pumpkaboo.

entries.original:
"An old colleague of mine in Seaport
City measures and records the sizes\lof all Pumpkaboo she sees."
entries.translation_source: An old colleague of mine in Seaport City measures and records the sizes of all Pumpkaboo she sees.
entries.translated:
Seorang rekan lama saya di Seaport
City mengukur dan mencatat ukuran\lsemua Pumpkaboo yang dia lihat.

entries.original: "Gurun Town"
entries.translation_source: Gurun Town
entries.translated: Gurun Town

entries.original: "Gurun Town D"
entries.translation_source: Gurun Town D

entries.original: "Gurun Town N"
entries.translation_source: Gurun Town N

entries.original:
"I’ve dedicated my life to studying
the secrets of the legendary titan\lPokémon!

Recently, I discovered that these
Pokémon must live in the strange\lrock formations that can be found\laround Borrius.

If only I had discovered how to
unseal them, too\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve dedicated my life to studying the secrets of the legendary titan Pokémon! Recently, I discovered that these Pokémon must live in the strange rock formations that can be found around Borrius. If only I had discovered how to unseal them, too[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Saya telah mengabdikan hidup saya
untuk mempelajari rahasia Pokémon\ltitan legendaris! Baru-baru ini,

saya menemukan bahwa Pokémon ini
pasti tinggal di formasi batu aneh\lyang dapat ditemukan di sekitar

Borrius. Andai saja saya juga
menemukan cara untuk membuka\lsegelnya\.

entries.original:
"It’s pretty odd that there’s a
forest filled with so many Bug-type\lPokémon this close to a desert.

Well, that’s Borrius for you!"
entries.translation_source: It’s pretty odd that there’s a forest filled with so many Bug-type Pokémon this close to a desert. Well, that’s Borrius for you!
entries.translated:
Cukup aneh bahwa ada hutan yang
dipenuhi begitu banyak Pokémon Tipe\lSerangga sedekat ini dengan gurun.

Yah, itulah Borrius!

entries.original:
"The houses here are based off of a
design found in the Unova region.

They’re from some town that boasts
of pottery made from volcanic clay.

Speaking of, there’s a maniac
somewhere around here who will\lbuy some kind of relic pottery\lfor a high price."
entries.translation_source: The houses here are based off of a design found in the Unova region. They’re from some town that boasts of pottery made from volcanic clay. Speaking of, there’s a maniac somewhere around here who will buy some kind of relic pottery for a high price.
entries.translated:
Rumah-rumah di sini didasarkan pada
desain yang ditemukan di wilayah\lUnova. Mereka berasal dari suatu

kota yang membanggakan tembikar
yang terbuat dari tanah liat\lvulkanik. Ngomong-ngomong, ada

seorang maniak di suatu tempat di
sekitar sini yang akan membeli\lsemacam relic pottery dengan harga

tinggi.

entries.original:
"The desert doesn’t continue on for
much longer once you head south\lof town.

Be careful if you decide to travel
in that direction, though.

You’ll end up in Antisis City if
you travel too far.

And Lord knows you don’t want to
go anywhere near that place\."
entries.translation_source: The desert doesn’t continue on for much longer once you head south of town. Be careful if you decide to travel in that direction, though. You’ll end up in Antisis City if you travel too far. And Lord knows you don’t want to go anywhere near that place[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Gurun tidak berlanjut terlalu jauh
begitu Anda menuju ke selatan kota.\lHati-hati jika Anda memutuskan

untuk bepergian ke arah itu. Anda
akan berakhir di Antisis City jika\lAnda bepergian terlalu jauh. Dan

Tuhan tahu Anda tidak ingin
mendekati tempat itu\.

entries.original:
"It’s my job to light up all of the
torches at night.

The desert can get pretty cold once
the sun goes down.

The torches then provide a reliable
source of heat."
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to light up all of the torches at night. The desert can get pretty cold once the sun goes down. The torches then provide a reliable source of heat.
entries.translated:
Tugas saya adalah menyalakan semua
obor di malam hari. Gurun bisa\lmenjadi sangat dingin begitu

matahari terbenam. Obor-obor itu
kemudian menyediakan sumber panas\lyang andal.

entries.original:
"It’s my job to keep the torches
around here lit at night.

The desert can get pretty cold,
now that the sun is down.

Those torches are our only reliable
source of heat right now."
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to keep the torches around here lit at night. The desert can get pretty cold, now that the sun is down. Those torches are our only reliable source of heat right now.
entries.translated:
Tugas saya adalah menjaga obor di
sekitar sini tetap menyala di malam\lhari. Gurun bisa menjadi sangat

dingin, sekarang setelah matahari
terbenam. Obor-obor itu adalah\lsatu-satunya sumber panas andal

kami saat ini.

entries.original:
"Hello, I have been stationed here
by the Science Society to study\lfossils.

If you have found one, I can take
a stab at reviving it for you."
entries.translation_source: Hello, I have been stationed here by the Science Society to study fossils. If you have found one, I can take a stab at reviving it for you.
entries.translated:
Halo, saya ditempatkan di sini oleh
Science Society untuk mempelajari\lfosil. Jika Anda menemukan satu,

saya bisa mencoba menghidupkannya
kembali untuk Anda.

entries.original:
"It seems you haven’t found a fossil
either\."
entries.translation_source: It seems you haven’t found a fossil either[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sepertinya Anda juga belum
menemukan fosil\.

entries.original:
"Oh!
That’s wonderful!

Which fossil would you like me to
revive into a Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Oh! That’s wonderful! Which fossil would you like me to revive into a Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Oh! Luar biasa! Fosil mana yang
ingin saya hidupkan kembali menjadi\lPokémon?

entries.original:
"\.Huh?

That doesn’t look like a fossil
to me\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]Huh? That doesn’t look like a fossil to me[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
\.Hah? Itu tidak terlihat seperti
fosil bagiku\.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the
[buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over the [buffer2-3].
entries.translated: [black][player] menyerahkan [buffer2].

entries.original:
"It will take some time to revive.
Come back later."
entries.translation_source: It will take some time to revive. Come back later.
entries.translated:
Butuh beberapa waktu untuk
menghidupkannya kembali. Kembalilah\lnanti.

entries.original:
"Welcome back!

I’ve successfully revived your
fossil into a healthy [buffer1]!

But you’ll need some space in your
party if you want to take it."
entries.translation_source: Welcome back! I’ve successfully revived your fossil into a healthy [buffer1-1]! But you’ll need some space in your party if you want to take it.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang kembali! Saya telah
berhasil menghidupkan kembali fosil\lAnda menjadi [buffer1] yang sehat!

Tapi Anda perlu ruang di tim Anda
jika ingin membawanya.

entries.original:
"Welcome back!

I’ve successfully revived your
fossil into a healthy [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome back! I’ve successfully revived your fossil into a healthy [buffer1-1]!
entries.translated:
Selamat datang kembali! Saya telah
berhasil menghidupkan kembali fosil\lAnda menjadi [buffer1] yang sehat!

entries.original:
"Do you have any other fossils you’d
like me to revive into a Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Do you have any other fossils you’d like me to revive into a Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda memiliki fosil lain
yang ingin saya hidupkan kembali\lmenjadi Pokémon?

entries.original:
"At least I got to study a fossil
earlier!

The Science Society will be pleased
with my research\."
entries.translation_source: At least I got to study a fossil earlier! The Science Society will be pleased with my research[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Setidaknya saya bisa mempelajari
fosil sebelumnya! Science Society\lakan senang dengan penelitian saya\.

entries.original:
"There’s something that this
enthusiast wants to get his hands\lon, even if it means spending a\llot of money.

Do you have such a rare item?
Do you?"
entries.translation_source: There’s something that this enthusiast wants to get his hands on, even if it means spending a lot of money. Do you have such a rare item? Do you?
entries.translated:
Ada sesuatu yang ingin didapatkan
oleh penggemar ini, meskipun harus\lmenghabiskan banyak uang. Apakah

Anda memiliki barang langka seperti
itu? Apakah Anda?

entries.original:
"That [green][buffer3][blue]! Will you sell it
to me for $[green][buffer2][blue]? Will you?"
entries.translation_source: That [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3]! Will you sell it to me for $[color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]? Will you?
entries.translated:
Itu [green][buffer3][blue]! Maukah Anda
menjualnya kepada saya seharga\l$[green][buffer2][blue]? Mau?

entries.original:
"I got a very good item!
Don’t you think it’s great?\lDon’t you?"
entries.translation_source: I got a very good item! Don’t you think it’s great? Don’t you?
entries.translated:
Aku mendapat item yang sangat
bagus! Bukankah itu hebat? Bukankah\lbegitu?

entries.original:
"This is slightly different.
Don’t you think so, too? Don’t you?"
entries.translation_source: This is slightly different. Don’t you think so, too? Don’t you?
entries.translated:
Ini sedikit berbeda. Bukankah kamu
juga berpikir begitu? Bukankah?

entries.original:
"If you ever change your mind, will
you sell me the rare item?\lWill you?"
entries.translation_source: If you ever change your mind, will you sell me the rare item? Will you?
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berubah pikiran, maukah
kamu menjual item langka itu\lpadaku? Maukah?

entries.original: "As Hard as They Come"
entries.translation_source: As Hard as They Come
entries.translated: Sekeraskeras Mereka

entries.original:
"There ain’t nothin’ in this world
harder than a Hard Stone! Collect
20 of them for an enthusiast."
entries.translation_source: There ain’t nothin’ in this world harder than a Hard Stone! Collect 20 of them for an enthusiast.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang ... di dunia ini
dari Hard Stone! Kumpulkan 20
buah untuk seorang penggemar.

entries.original:
"Hey, you.
I gots a favour to ask you for.

I’m an enthusiast.

A lover of hard thin’s, if I do say
so myself.

But unlike my friend over there,
I’m not interested in buyin’\lanythin’ off of ya.

I just want ya to collect
[green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue] for me.

Ya think ya can do it?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, you. I gots a favour to ask you for. I’m an enthusiast. A lover of hard thin’s, if I do say so myself. But unlike my friend over there, I’m not interested in buyin’ anythin’ off of ya. I just want ya to collect [color-green-1][buffer1-2] Hard Stones[color-blue-3] for me. Ya think ya can do it?
entries.translated:
Hei, kau. Aku minta tolong. Aku
seorang penggemar. Pencinta benda\lkeras, kalau boleh saya bilang.

Tapi tidak seperti temanku di sana,
aku tidak tertarik membeli apa pun\ldarimu. Aku hanya ingin kamu

mengumpulkan [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue]
untukku. Kamu pikir bisa?

entries.original:
"Yee haw!

[green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya
smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Heck, I bet if you dug into the
walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue],\lyou’d find ’em there, too."
entries.translation_source: Yee haw! [color-green-1]Hard Stones[color-blue-2] might pop up when ya smash rocks in the [color-green-3]Great Desert[color-blue-4]. Heck, I bet if you dug into the walls of the [color-green-5]KBT Expressway[color-blue-6], you’d find ’em there, too.
entries.translated:
Yee haw! [green]Hard Stones[blue] mungkin muncul
saat kamu menghancurkan batu di\l[green]Great Desert[blue]. Heh, aku yakin jika

kamu menggali dinding [green]KBT
Expressway[blue], kamu juga akan\lmenemukannya di sana.

entries.original:
"Those hard objects in your Cube are
the items I asked for!

Here, let me take ’em from ya."
entries.translation_source: Those hard objects in your Cube are the items I asked for! Here, let me take ’em from ya.
entries.translated:
Benda-benda keras di Cube-mu adalah
item yang kuminta! Kemari, biarkan\laku mengambilnya darimu.

entries.original:
"Oh, you lookin’ for a reward or
somethin’?

Then, here ya go."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you lookin’ for a reward or somethin’? Then, here ya go.
entries.translated:
Oh, kamu cari hadiah atau sesuatu?
Kalau begitu, ini dia.

entries.original:
"[green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya
smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Heck, I bet if you dug into the
walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue],\lyou’d find ’em there, too.

Do either one of those thin’s and
bring me [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hard Stones[color-blue-2] might pop up when ya smash rocks in the [color-green-3]Great Desert[color-blue-4]. Heck, I bet if you dug into the walls of the [color-green-5]KBT Expressway[color-blue-6], you’d find ’em there, too. Do either one of those thin’s and bring me [color-green-7][buffer1-8][color-blue-9] of ’em.
entries.translated:
[green]Hard Stones[blue] mungkin muncul saat
kamu menghancurkan batu di [green]Great\lDesert[blue]. Heh, aku yakin jika kamu

menggali dinding [green]KBT Expressway[blue],
kamu juga akan menemukannya di\lsana. Lakukan salah satu dari

hal-hal itu dan bawakan aku
[green][buffer1][blue] buah darinya.

entries.original:
"I can tell you’re not an
enthusiast."
entries.translation_source: I can tell you’re not an enthusiast.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu kamu bukan seorang
penggemar.

entries.original:
"Say, ya know what?

Bring me even more hard thin’s!

I’ve gotta a mountain of [green]Gems[blue] I’m
sittin’ on over here, and I\lcouldn’t care one lick for ’em!

I’ll give ’em to you in exchange
for some more Hard Stones."
entries.translation_source: Say, ya know what? Bring me even more hard thin’s! I’ve gotta a mountain of [color-green-1]Gems[color-blue-2] I’m sittin’ on over here, and I couldn’t care one lick for ’em! I’ll give ’em to you in exchange for some more Hard Stones.
entries.translated:
Hei, tahu tidak? Bawakan aku lebih
banyak benda keras! Aku punya\lsegunung [green]Gems[blue] yang kududuki di

sini, dan aku tidak peduli sama
sekali! Aku akan memberikannya\lpadamu sebagai ganti lebih banyak

Hard Stones.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over
[buffer2] [buffer1]s."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over [buffer2-3] [buffer1-4]s.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer2]
[buffer1].

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the
[buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over the [buffer1-3].
entries.translated: [black][player] menyerahkan [buffer1].

entries.original:
"Didja bring me some more
[green]Hard Stones[blue]?

I’ll give ya some [green]Gems[blue] if you don’t
mind forkin’ [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em over."
entries.translation_source: Didja bring me some more [color-green-1]Hard Stones[color-blue-2]? I’ll give ya some [color-green-3]Gems[color-blue-4] if you don’t mind forkin’ [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-blue-7] of ’em over.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu membawakanku lebih
banyak [green]Hard Stones[blue]? Aku akan\lmemberimu beberapa [green]Gems[blue] jika kamu

tidak keberatan menyerahkan
[green][buffer1][blue] buah darinya.

entries.original: "Which Gem can I do you for?"
entries.translation_source: Which Gem can I do you for?
entries.translated: Gem mana yang kamu mau?

entries.original:
"So you’ll fork [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue] over
for a [green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: So you’ll fork [color-green-1][buffer1-2] Hard Stones[color-blue-3] over for a [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]?
entries.translated:
Jadi kamu akan menyerahkan [green][buffer1]
Hard Stones[blue] untuk sebuah [green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"Yee haw!

You wanna trade for some more
Gems?"
entries.translation_source: Yee haw! You wanna trade for some more Gems?
entries.translated:
Yee haw! Kamu mau bertukar untuk
lebih banyak Gems?

entries.original:
"If you get another [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue],
come back and trade ’em, will ya?"
entries.translation_source: If you get another [color-green-1][buffer1-2] Hard Stones[color-blue-3], come back and trade ’em, will ya?
entries.translated:
Jika kamu mendapatkan [green][buffer1] Hard
Stones[blue] lagi, kembalilah dan\ltukarkan, mau?

entries.original:
"[green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya
smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Heck, I bet if you dug into the
walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue],\lyou’d find ’em there, too.

Do either one of those thin’s and
bring me [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em.

I’ll give ya a Gem of your choosin’
in exchange."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hard Stones[color-blue-2] might pop up when ya smash rocks in the [color-green-3]Great Desert[color-blue-4]. Heck, I bet if you dug into the walls of the [color-green-5]KBT Expressway[color-blue-6], you’d find ’em there, too. Do either one of those thin’s and bring me [color-green-7][buffer1-8][color-blue-9] of ’em. I’ll give ya a Gem of your choosin’ in exchange.
entries.translated:
[green]Hard Stones[blue] mungkin muncul saat
kamu menghancurkan batu di [green]Great\lDesert[blue]. Heh, aku yakin jika kamu

menggali dinding [green]KBT Expressway[blue],
kamu juga akan menemukannya di\lsana. Lakukan salah satu dari

hal-hal itu dan bawakan aku
[green][buffer1][blue] buah darinya. Aku akan\lmemberimu Gem pilihanmu sebagai

gantinya.

entries.original:
"Ya have less than [green][buffer1] Hard Stones[blue],
pal.

[green]Hard Stones[blue] might pop up when ya
smash rocks in the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Heck, I bet if you dug into the
walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue],\lyou’d find ’em there, too."
entries.translation_source: Ya have less than [color-green-1][buffer1-2] Hard Stones[color-blue-3], pal. [color-green-4]Hard Stones[color-blue-5] might pop up when ya smash rocks in the [color-green-6]Great Desert[color-blue-7]. Heck, I bet if you dug into the walls of the [color-green-8]KBT Expressway[color-blue-9], you’d find ’em there, too.
entries.translated:
Kamu memiliki kurang dari [green][buffer1]
Batu Keras[blue], sobat. [green]Batu Keras[blue]\lmungkin muncul saat kamu

menghancurkan batu di [green]Gurun Besar[blue].
Sial, aku yakin jika kamu menggali\ldinding [green]KBT Expressway[blue], kamu juga

akan menemukannya di sana.
