Choose one Pokémon to battle three
Trainers in a row.

Each Trainer is also only using
one Pokémon.

You can use whatever Pokémon you
want in the ring, but you can’t use\l[green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type\lmoves in the battles.

For moves that change their types
in battles, we only care about the\ltypes those moves become.

We don’t like those types here in
the Gym, but Big Mo is a nice guy,\land he’ll only [green]stop[blue] you from using\l[green]Fairy[blue]-type moves if you can get to\lhim."
entries.translation_source: The rules are simple. Choose one Pokémon to battle three Trainers in a row. Each Trainer is also only using one Pokémon. You can use whatever Pokémon you want in the ring, but you can’t use [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-, [color-green-3]Psychic[color-blue-4]-, or [color-green-5]Fairy[color-blue-6]-type moves in the battles. For moves that change their types in battles, we only care about the types those moves become. We don’t like those types here in the Gym, but Big Mo is a nice guy, and he’ll only [color-green-7]stop[color-blue-8] you from using [color-green-9]Fairy[color-blue-10]-type moves if you can get to him.
entries.translated:
Aturannya sederhana. Pilih satu
Pokémon untuk bertarung melawan\ltiga Pelatih berturut-turut. Setiap

Pelatih juga hanya menggunakan satu
Pokémon. Kamu bisa menggunakan\lPokémon apa pun yang kamu mau di

ring, tetapi kamu tidak bisa
menggunakan gerakan tipe [green]Terbang[blue]-,\l[green]Psikis[blue]-, atau [green]Peri[blue]- dalam

pertempuran. Untuk gerakan yang
mengubah tipe mereka dalam\lpertempuran, kami hanya peduli

dengan tipe yang dihasilkan gerakan
tersebut. Kami tidak suka tipe-tipe\litu di sini di Gym, tetapi Big Mo

orang yang baik, dan dia hanya akan
[green]menghentikan[blue]mu dari menggunakan\lgerakan tipe [green]Peri[blue]- jika kamu bisa

sampai kepadanya.

entries.original:
"You think I wanna hold onto your
Pokémon for you?

Go dump your Pokémon in the PC
until you only have one left!"
entries.translation_source: You think I wanna hold onto your Pokémon for you? Go dump your Pokémon in the PC until you only have one left!
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir aku mau menjaga
Pokémonmu untukmu? Pergi masukkan\lPokémonmu ke PC sampai hanya

tersisa satu!

entries.original:
"You survived the ring.
Good job, kid.

Go through that door if you wanna
battle Big Mo."
entries.translation_source: You survived the ring. Good job, kid. Go through that door if you wanna battle Big Mo.
entries.translated:
Kamu selamat dari ring. Kerja
bagus, nak. Lewati pintu itu jika\lkamu ingin bertarung melawan Big

Mo.

entries.original:
"Not only did you survive the ring,
but you also took down Big Mo!

I don’t get impressed easy, but
you’ve done the job, kid."
entries.translation_source: Not only did you survive the ring, but you also took down Big Mo! I don’t get impressed easy, but you’ve done the job, kid.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak hanya selamat dari ring,
tetapi juga mengalahkan Big Mo! Aku\ltidak mudah terkesan, tetapi kamu

berhasil, nak.

entries.original:
"This is the Antisis Gym!

Do ya think ya got what it takes to
survive the ring, and beat Big Mo?"
entries.translation_source: This is the Antisis Gym! Do ya think ya got what it takes to survive the ring, and beat Big Mo?
entries.translated:
Ini adalah Gym Antisis! Apakah kamu
pikir kamu punya kemampuan untuk\lselamat dari ring, dan mengalahkan

Big Mo?

entries.original:
"Not many challengers survive the
ring like you did.

You’re a real special one, kid."
entries.translation_source: Not many challengers survive the ring like you did. You’re a real special one, kid.
entries.translated:
Tidak banyak penantang yang selamat
dari ring seperti yang kamu\llakukan. Kamu benar-benar spesial,

nak.

entries.original:
"Big Mo just turned our old Ring
Challenge into some sorta fancy\lbattle facility.

He even convinced those dinguses at
the Battle Frontier to send over\lone of their poozers to referee it!

But no matter what he did, he
couldn’t convince ’em to add it\las an \qoofficial\qc battle facility.

So, since you can’t get any sorta
print by winnin’ here, if you can\lsomehow manage to get to [green]100[blue] wins,\lyou’ll get a shiny new star on your\lTrainer Card.

Now, ain’t that sweet?"
entries.translation_source: Big Mo just turned our old Ring Challenge into some sorta fancy battle facility. He even convinced those dinguses at the Battle Frontier to send over one of their poozers to referee it! But no matter what he did, he couldn’t convince ’em to add it as an [quote-open-1]official[quote-close-2] battle facility. So, since you can’t get any sorta print by winnin’ here, if you can somehow manage to get to [color-green-3]100[color-blue-4] wins, you’ll get a shiny new star on your Trainer Card. Now, ain’t that sweet?
entries.translated:
Big Mo baru saja mengubah Ring
Challenge lama kami menjadi semacam\lfasilitas pertarungan yang mewah.

Dia bahkan meyakinkan orang-orang
bodoh di Battle Frontier untuk\lmengirimkan salah satu pengawas

mereka untuk menjadi wasitnya! Tapi
apa pun yang dia lakukan, dia tidak\lbisa meyakinkan mereka untuk

menambahkannya sebagai fasilitas
pertarungan \qoresmi\qc. Jadi, karena\lkamu tidak bisa mendapatkan semacam

pengakuan dengan menang di sini,
jika kamu entah bagaimana bisa\lmencapai [green]100[blue] kemenangan, kamu akan

mendapatkan bintang baru yang
mengilap di Kartu Pelatihmu. Nah,\lbukankah itu manis?

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo with no [green][buffer1][blue]-type\lmoves? Huh?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo with no [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]-type moves? Huh?
entries.translated:
Apa kau benar-benar berpikir kau
bisa mengalahkan Big Mo tanpa\lgerakan tipe [green][buffer1][blue]? Hah?

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo when your [green]speed[blue] is\lyour [green]weight[blue], and you [green]can’t use[blue]\lany [green]priority Abilities[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo when your [color-green-1]speed[color-blue-2] is your [color-green-3]weight[color-blue-4], and you [color-green-5]can’t use[color-blue-6] any [color-green-7]priority Abilities[color-blue-8]?
entries.translated:
Apa kau benar-benar berpikir kau
bisa mengalahkan Big Mo ketika\l[green]Kecepatan[blue]mu adalah [green]Berat[blue]mu, dan

kamu [green]tidak bisa menggunakan[blue] [green]Ability
Prioritas[blue] apa pun?

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo when your [green]speed[blue] is\lyour [green]weight[blue], and you [green]can’t use[blue] any\l[green]Fairy[blue]-type moves or [green]priority\lAbilities[blue], huh?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo when your [color-green-1]speed[color-blue-2] is your [color-green-3]weight[color-blue-4], and you [color-green-5]can’t use[color-blue-6] any [color-green-7]Fairy[color-blue-8]-type moves or [color-green-9]priority Abilities[color-blue-10], huh?
entries.translated:
Apa kau benar-benar berpikir kau
bisa mengalahkan Big Mo ketika\l[green]Kecepatan[blue]mu adalah [green]Berat[blue]mu, dan

kamu [green]tidak bisa menggunakan[blue] gerakan
tipe [green]Fairy[blue] atau [green]Ability Prioritas[blue]\lapa pun, hah?

entries.original:
"You’re the new toughest chump in
Antisis City!"
entries.translation_source: You’re the new toughest chump in Antisis City!
entries.translated:
Kau adalah jawara terkuat baru di
Antisis City!

entries.original:
"The constant waves have washed all
of the fish away.

Make sure you don’t travel too far
in the water.

Otherwise, you’ll be washed away
like those fish!"
entries.translation_source: The constant waves have washed all of the fish away. Make sure you don’t travel too far in the water. Otherwise, you’ll be washed away like those fish!
entries.translated:
Gelombang yang terus-menerus telah
menghanyutkan semua ikan. Pastikan\lkamu tidak bepergian terlalu jauh

di air. Jika tidak, kamu akan
hanyut seperti ikan-ikan itu!

entries.original:
"Staying on land keeps you safe
during the waves.

I don’t really even need my
inner tube!"
entries.translation_source: Staying on land keeps you safe during the waves. I don’t really even need my inner tube!
entries.translated:
Tetap di darat membuatmu aman
selama gelombang. Aku bahkan tidak\lbenar-benar perlu ban dalamku!

entries.original:
"Have you noticed?

The distance you can travel between
each platform varies."
entries.translation_source: Have you noticed? The distance you can travel between each platform varies.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu menyadarinya? Jarak
yang bisa kamu tempuh di antara\lsetiap platform bervariasi.

entries.original:
"Sometimes you can travel a lot
and other times not!"
entries.translation_source: Sometimes you can travel a lot and other times not!
entries.translated:
Terkadang kamu bisa bepergian jauh
dan di waktu lain tidak!

entries.original:
"Some platforms allow you to travel
farther from them than others."
entries.translation_source: Some platforms allow you to travel farther from them than others.
entries.translated:
Beberapa platform memungkinkanmu
untuk bepergian lebih jauh dari\lplatform lainnya.

entries.original:
"It may be safer, but it’s not
always the best idea to land on\lthe first spot you see.

There are only so many steps you
can take before the wave hits.

Landing farther on a platform can
increase your chances of\lsurviving the following wave."
entries.translation_source: It may be safer, but it’s not always the best idea to land on the first spot you see. There are only so many steps you can take before the wave hits. Landing farther on a platform can increase your chances of surviving the following wave.
entries.translated:
Ini mungkin lebih aman, tapi tidak
selalu ide terbaik untuk mendarat\ldi tempat pertama yang kamu lihat.

Hanya ada beberapa langkah yang
bisa kamu ambil sebelum gelombang\lmenerjang. Mendarat lebih jauh di

platform dapat meningkatkan
peluangmu untuk bertahan dari\lgelombang berikutnya.

entries.original:
"There’s a button embedded in the
rock!

Press it?"
entries.translation_source: There’s a button embedded in the rock! Press it?
entries.translated:
Ada sebuah tombol yang tertanam di
batu! Tekan?

entries.original:
"The door to the Gym Leader has
been unlocked."
entries.translation_source: The door to the Gym Leader has been unlocked.
entries.translated:
Pintu menuju Pemimpin Gym telah
terbuka.

entries.original:
"The buttons were not pressed in
the correct order.

The puzzle has been reset."
entries.translation_source: The buttons were not pressed in the correct order. The puzzle has been reset.
entries.translated:
Tombol-tombol tidak ditekan dalam
urutan yang benar. Teka-teki telah\ldiatur ulang.

entries.original:
"The button embedded in this rock
has already been pressed."
entries.translation_source: The button embedded in this rock has already been pressed.
entries.translated:
Tombol yang tertanam di batu ini
sudah ditekan.

entries.original:
"The door to the Gym Leader has
already been unlocked."
entries.translation_source: The door to the Gym Leader has already been unlocked.
entries.translated:
Pintu menuju Pemimpin Gym sudah
terbuka.

entries.original:
"Don’t forget, if you press the
buttons in the rocks too early,\lyou won’t be able to get to\lBenjamin!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t forget, if you press the buttons in the rocks too early, you won’t be able to get to Benjamin!
entries.translated:
Jangan lupa, jika kamu menekan
tombol-tombol di batu terlalu awal,\lkamu tidak akan bisa mencapai

Benjamin!

entries.original:
"Be careful of the Pokémon you
choose to use!

Sometimes, they forget every move
they know when they devolve!

When that happens, all you’ll be
able to do is Struggle!"
entries.translation_source: Be careful of the Pokémon you choose to use! Sometimes, they forget every move they know when they devolve! When that happens, all you’ll be able to do is Struggle!
entries.translated:
Hati-hati dengan Pokémon yang kamu
pilih untuk digunakan! Terkadang,\lmereka melupakan semua gerakan yang

mereka ketahui saat berevolusi
mundur! Saat itu terjadi, yang bisa\lkamu lakukan hanyalah Struggle!

entries.original:
"When I think of the correct order
of the buttons, I think back to the\lcurious case of Benjamin Butterfree\."
entries.translation_source: When I think of the correct order of the buttons, I think back to the curious case of Benjamin Butterfree[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Saat aku memikirkan urutan tombol
yang benar, aku teringat pada kasus\laneh Benjamin Butterfree\.

entries.original:
"The experiences on your journey
thus far\.

Can you picture them?"
entries.translation_source: The experiences on your journey thus far[game-token-1] Can you picture them?
entries.translated:
Pengalaman dalam perjalananmu
sejauh ini\. Bisakah kamu\lmembayangkannya?

entries.original:
"I see\.
You do remember them."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] You do remember them.
entries.translated:
Aku lihat\. Kamu benar-benar
mengingat mereka.

entries.original:
"Use your memories.
They will guide you."
entries.translation_source: Use your memories. They will guide you.
entries.translated:
Gunakan kenanganmu. Mereka akan
menuntunmu.

entries.original:
"Hey there, kid!

-HACK- -COUGH-

Welcome to your first Gym
Challenge!

Let me start you off with a
small gift.

-COUGH- -WHEEZE-"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, kid! -HACK- -COUGH- Welcome to your first Gym Challenge! Let me start you off with a small gift. -COUGH- -WHEEZE-
entries.translated:
Hei, Nak! -HACK- -BATUK- Selamat
datang di Tantangan Gym pertamamu!\lBiarkan aku memberimu hadiah kecil.

-BATUK- -MENGI-

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, prefers
flowery Pokémon.

If you come prepared with a [green]Fire[blue] or
[green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon, you should be\lable to take him out no sweat!

-COUGH- -COUGH-

Also, be aware, Mirskle likes to
fill his Gym with fog from time to\ltime, and this may have an effect\lon your battling.

It’ll allow you to dodge hits
easily, but you’ll also have a\lharder time landing them as well!

Your main strategy should be to
first remove the Fog from the\lbattlefield, and then lay it on\lyour opponent.

You know, with a move like
[green]Sandstorm[blue] or [green]Defog[blue].

Good luck out there!

-COUGH- -WHEEZE-"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, prefers flowery Pokémon. If you come prepared with a [color-green-1]Fire[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Flying[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon, you should be able to take him out no sweat! -COUGH- -COUGH- Also, be aware, Mirskle likes to fill his Gym with fog from time to time, and this may have an effect on your battling. It’ll allow you to dodge hits easily, but you’ll also have a harder time landing them as well! Your main strategy should be to first remove the Fog from the battlefield, and then lay it on your opponent. You know, with a move like [color-green-5]Sandstorm[color-blue-6] or [color-green-7]Defog[color-blue-8]. Good luck out there! -COUGH- -WHEEZE-
entries.translated:
Pemimpin Gym, Mirskle, lebih
menyukai Pokémon bunga. Jika kamu\ldatang dengan Pokémon tipe [green]Api[blue] atau

[green]Terbang[blue], kamu seharusnya bisa
mengalahkannya tanpa berkeringat!\l-BATUK- -BATUK- Juga, ketahuilah,

Mirskle suka mengisi Gym-nya dengan
kabut dari waktu ke waktu, dan ini\lmungkin mempengaruhi pertarunganmu.

Ini akan membuatmu lebih mudah
menghindari serangan, tetapi juga\lakan lebih sulit untuk mendaratkan

serangan! Strategi utama kamu
adalah menghilangkan Kabut dari\lmedan perang terlebih dahulu, lalu

berikan pada lawanmu. Kamu tahu,
dengan jurus seperti [green]Badai Pasir[blue]\latau [green]Penghilang Kabut[blue]. Semoga

berhasil! -BATUK- -MENGI-

entries.original:
"I’m impressed!

You managed to beat Mirskle even
with your eyes full of \qofog\qc!

Take this as some extra proof of
your victory here."
entries.translation_source: I’m impressed! You managed to beat Mirskle even with your eyes full of [quote-open-1]fog[quote-close-2]! Take this as some extra proof of your victory here.
entries.translated:
Aku terkesan! Kamu berhasil
mengalahkan Mirskle bahkan dengan\lmata penuh \qokabut\qc! Ambil ini

sebagai bukti tambahan kemenanganmu
di sini.

entries.original:
"That’s a rare gemstone that can
power up a [green]grassy[blue] move in battle\lfor you!

I’m sure it’ll help you out, champ
in the making."
entries.translation_source: That’s a rare gemstone that can power up a [color-green-1]grassy[color-blue-2] move in battle for you! I’m sure it’ll help you out, champ in the making.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah batu permata langka yang
dapat memperkuat jurus [green]Rumput[blue] dalam\lpertarungan untukmu! Aku yakin itu

akan membantumu, calon juara.

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s you!
Champ in the making!

I didn’t see you there!

Welcome to the Crater Town Gym!

Let’s start you off with some
Fresh Water."
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s you! Champ in the making! I didn’t see you there! Welcome to the Crater Town Gym! Let’s start you off with some Fresh Water.
entries.translated:
Oh, kamu! Calon juara! Aku tidak
melihatmu di sana! Selamat datang\ldi Gym Crater Town! Biarkan aku

memberimu Air Segar.

entries.original:
"As you can or can’t see, this Gym
is centred around [green]Dark[blue]-types.

If you want to win here, a good
starting point would be bringing\l[green]Fighting[blue]-, [green]Bug[blue]- or [green]Fairy[blue]-types.

Just be aware, because of the many
Trainers that struggle in this Gym,\l[green]negative emotions[blue] will fill the air\las you battle.

These emotions will inflict damage
at the end of each turn.

Only [green]Dark[blue]-types, [green]Psychic[blue]-types,
[green]Ghost[blue]-types, and Pokémon with the\lAbilities [green]Magic Guard[blue], [green]Unaware[blue], or\l[green]Oblivious[blue] are unaffected.

If you end up struggling because of
the negative emotions, bringing a\lPokémon that isn’t affected could\lreally help you out.

Now, getting to Véga, the Leader,
is relatively simple.

Navigate the dimly lit hallways, and
don’t get spotted.

If you get spotted, you’ll either
have to battle some Trainers or be\lsent back to the beginning of\lthe hallway.

Every Trainer you defeat will
brighten up the room, so I\lrecommend battling them all first.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: As you can or can’t see, this Gym is centred around [color-green-1]Dark[color-blue-2]-types. If you want to win here, a good starting point would be bringing [color-green-3]Fighting[color-blue-4]-, [color-green-5]Bug[color-blue-6]- or [color-green-7]Fairy[color-blue-8]-types. Just be aware, because of the many Trainers that struggle in this Gym, [color-green-9]negative emotions[color-blue-10] will fill the air as you battle. These emotions will inflict damage at the end of each turn. Only [color-green-11]Dark[color-blue-12]-types, [color-green-13]Psychic[color-blue-14]-types, [color-green-15]Ghost[color-blue-16]-types, and Pokémon with the Abilities [color-green-17]Magic Guard[color-blue-18], [color-green-19]Unaware[color-blue-20], or [color-green-21]Oblivious[color-blue-22] are unaffected. If you end up struggling because of the negative emotions, bringing a Pokémon that isn’t affected could really help you out. Now, getting to Véga, the Leader, is relatively simple. Navigate the dimly lit hallways, and don’t get spotted. If you get spotted, you’ll either have to battle some Trainers or be sent back to the beginning of the hallway. Every Trainer you defeat will brighten up the room, so I recommend battling them all first. Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Seperti yang bisa atau tidak bisa
kamu lihat, Gym ini berpusat pada\ltipe [green]Gelap[blue]. Jika kamu ingin menang

di sini, titik awal yang baik
adalah membawa tipe [green]Petarung[blue],\l[green]Serangga[blue], atau [green]Peri[blue]. Ketahuilah,

karena banyaknya Pelatih yang
kesulitan di Gym ini, [green]emosi negatif[blue]\lakan memenuhi udara saat kamu

bertarung. Emosi ini akan
memberikan kerusakan di akhir\lsetiap giliran. Hanya tipe [green]Gelap[blue],

tipe [green]Psikis[blue], tipe [green]Hantu[blue], dan
Pokémon dengan Kemampuan [green]Penjaga\lAjaib[blue], [green]Tidak Sadar[blue], atau [green]Pelupa[blue]

yang tidak terpengaruh. Jika kamu
akhirnya kesulitan karena emosi\lnegatif, membawa Pokémon yang tidak

terpengaruh bisa sangat membantumu.
Sekarang, mencapai Véga, Pemimpin,\lrelatif sederhana. Navigasi lorong

yang remang-remang, dan jangan
terdeteksi. Jika kamu terdeteksi,\lkamu harus bertarung dengan

beberapa Pelatih atau dikirim
kembali ke awal lorong. Setiap\lPelatih yang kamu kalahkan akan

mencerahkan ruangan, jadi aku
sarankan untuk bertarung dengan\lmereka semua terlebih dahulu.

Semoga berhasil!

entries.original:
"Well done!

You managed to find your way
through the dark and take\ldown Véga!

Take this, as an extra reward for
your victory."
entries.translation_source: Well done! You managed to find your way through the dark and take down Véga! Take this, as an extra reward for your victory.
entries.translated:
Bagus! Kamu berhasil menemukan
jalan melalui kegelapan dan\lmengalahkan Véga! Ambil ini,

sebagai hadiah tambahan untuk
kemenanganmu.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single [green]Dark[blue]-type move in battle.

With it, you can unleash your
dark fury!

Mwahahahaha!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single [color-green-1]Dark[color-blue-2]-type move in battle. With it, you can unleash your dark fury! Mwahahahaha!
entries.translated:
Permata yang kuberikan itu dapat
memperkuat satu jurus tipe [green]Gelap[blue]\ldalam pertarungan. Dengan itu, kamu

bisa melepaskan amarah gelapmu!
Mwahahahaha!

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s you!
Champ in the making!

How’re you liking the weather
up here?

Welcome to the Blizzard City Gym!

Let’s start you off with some
Fresh Water."
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s you! Champ in the making! How’re you liking the weather up here? Welcome to the Blizzard City Gym! Let’s start you off with some Fresh Water.
entries.translated:
Oh, kamu! Calon juara! Bagaimana
cuaca di sini? Selamat datang di\lGym Blizzard City! Biarkan aku

memberimu Air Segar.

entries.original:
"Contrary to popular belief, this
Gym is not an Ice-type gym.

It’s a [green]Flying[blue]-type Gym!

And the best way to counter
Flying-types is to clip their\lwings with [green]ice[blue], [green]rocks[blue],\lor [green]electricity[blue]!

But be careful, because there’s a
tailwind in this Gym!

This [green]Tailwind[blue] will increase the
speed of all Flying-type Pokémon,\lso don’t get cocky just because\lyour Pokémon might have a high\lspeed stat.

Unless it’s part Flying-type,
of course.

Getting to Alice requires using
the fans and holes on the ground\lto move between levels of the Gym.

It’s not too complicated, just make
sure you remember where you have\land haven’t been before.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Contrary to popular belief, this Gym is not an Ice-type gym. It’s a [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-type Gym! And the best way to counter Flying-types is to clip their wings with [color-green-3]ice[color-blue-4], [color-green-5]rocks[color-blue-6], or [color-green-7]electricity[color-blue-8]! But be careful, because there’s a tailwind in this Gym! This [color-green-9]Tailwind[color-blue-10] will increase the speed of all Flying-type Pokémon, so don’t get cocky just because your Pokémon might have a high speed stat. Unless it’s part Flying-type, of course. Getting to Alice requires using the fans and holes on the ground to move between levels of the Gym. It’s not too complicated, just make sure you remember where you have and haven’t been before. Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Bertentangan dengan kepercayaan
umum, Gym ini bukan Gym tipe Es.\lIni adalah Gym tipe [green]Terbang[blue]! Dan

cara terbaik untuk mengalahkan tipe
Terbang adalah dengan memotong\lsayap mereka dengan [green]es[blue], [green]batu[blue], atau

[green]listrik[blue]! Tapi hati-hati, karena ada
angin ekor di Gym ini! [green]Angin Ekor[blue]\lini akan meningkatkan kecepatan

semua Pokémon tipe Terbang, jadi
jangan sombong hanya karena\lPokémonmu mungkin memiliki stat

kecepatan tinggi. Kecuali jika ia
juga bertipe Terbang, tentu saja.\lMencapai Alice membutuhkan

penggunaan kipas dan lubang di
tanah untuk bergerak antar level\lGym. Tidak terlalu rumit, pastikan

kamu ingat di mana kamu sudah dan
belum pernah pergi. Semoga\lberhasil!

entries.original:
"Even with the winds against you,
you fought bravely and came out\lon top!

Take this, as an extra reward for
your victory."
entries.translation_source: Even with the winds against you, you fought bravely and came out on top! Take this, as an extra reward for your victory.
entries.translated:
Bahkan dengan angin yang melawanmu,
kamu bertarung dengan berani dan\lkeluar sebagai pemenang! Ambil ini,

sebagai hadiah tambahan untuk
kemenanganmu.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single [green]Flying[blue]-type move in battle.

With it, you can land a graceful,
yet still devastating blow!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-type move in battle. With it, you can land a graceful, yet still devastating blow!
entries.translated:
Permata yang kuberikan itu dapat
memperkuat satu jurus tipe [green]Terbang[blue]\ldalam pertarungan. Dengan itu, kamu

bisa mendaratkan pukulan yang
anggun namun tetap menghancurkan!

entries.original:
"Champ in the making!
How go the battles?

Welcome to the Fallshore City Gym!

Have some Fresh Water, straight
from the ponds of this Gym."
entries.translation_source: Champ in the making! How go the battles? Welcome to the Fallshore City Gym! Have some Fresh Water, straight from the ponds of this Gym.
entries.translated:
Calon juara! Bagaimana
pertarungannya? Selamat datang di\lGym Fallshore City! Silakan minum

Air Segar, langsung dari kolam Gym
ini.

entries.original:
"Mel?
Well, he’s just a [green]normal[blue] guy!

If this were a normal Normal-type
Gym, I’d say using Fighting-types\lwould be a great way to take him\ldown.

But, it isn’t.

In this Gym, all battles are
[green]Inverse Battles[blue]!

Meaning, all type matchups will
be reversed.

So, can you guess what type would
be best suited to take down Mel?

\.

You’re right! There isn’t one!

[green]Ghost[blue]-type moves will be super
effective against his Normal-types,\lbut Normal-type moves will also\lbe super effective on Ghost-types.

Your best bet to take Mel down is to
use a Pokémon that knows Ghost-\ltype moves, but isn’t one itself.

If you need more practice getting
used to this kind of battle, you\lshould check out the [green]Inverse Battle\lHouse[blue] in town.

If you’re ready to start, head
down the slide next to me.

Your goal is to use the Lapras to
make your way back up here.

But make sure you’ve stocked up on
supplies first.

There’s no going back until you
reach Mel."
entries.translation_source: Mel? Well, he’s just a [color-green-1]normal[color-blue-2] guy! If this were a normal Normal-type Gym, I’d say using Fighting-types would be a great way to take him down. But, it isn’t. In this Gym, all battles are [color-green-3]Inverse Battles[color-blue-4]! Meaning, all type matchups will be reversed. So, can you guess what type would be best suited to take down Mel? [game-token-5] You’re right! There isn’t one! [color-green-6]Ghost[color-blue-7]-type moves will be super effective against his Normal-types, but Normal-type moves will also be super effective on Ghost-types. Your best bet to take Mel down is to use a Pokémon that knows Ghost- type moves, but isn’t one itself. If you need more practice getting used to this kind of battle, you should check out the [color-green-8]Inverse Battle House[color-blue-9] in town. If you’re ready to start, head down the slide next to me. Your goal is to use the Lapras to make your way back up here. But make sure you’ve stocked up on supplies first. There’s no going back until you reach Mel.
entries.translated:
Mel? Yah, dia hanya pria [green]normal[blue]!
Jika ini adalah Gym Normal biasa,\laku akan bilang menggunakan tipe

Petarung akan menjadi cara yang
bagus untuk mengalahkannya. Tapi,\ltidak. Di Gym ini, semua

pertarungan adalah [green]Pertarungan
Terbalik[blue]! Artinya, semua kecocokan\ltipe akan terbalik. Jadi, bisakah

kamu menebak tipe apa yang paling
cocok untuk mengalahkan Mel? \. Kamu\lbenar! Tidak ada! Jurus tipe [green]Hantu[blue]

akan sangat efektif melawan tipe
Normal miliknya, tapi jurus tipe\lNormal juga akan sangat efektif

melawan tipe Hantu. Taruhan
terbaikmu untuk mengalahkan Mel\ladalah menggunakan Pokémon yang

tahu jurus tipe Hantu, tapi bukan
Pokémon tipe Hantu itu sendiri.\lJika kamu perlu lebih banyak

latihan untuk terbiasa dengan
pertarungan semacam ini, kamu harus\lmengunjungi [green]Rumah Pertarungan

Terbalik[blue] di kota. Jika kamu siap
untuk memulai, turuni seluncuran di\lsebelahku. Tujuanmu adalah

menggunakan Lapras untuk kembali ke
sini. Tapi pastikan kamu sudah\lmenyediakan persediaan terlebih

dahulu. Tidak ada jalan kembali
sampai kamu mencapai Mel.

entries.original:
"Bravo!

Mel took quite a beating,
didn’t he?

I bet he’d have taken an even worse
one, had you had this Gem."
entries.translation_source: Bravo! Mel took quite a beating, didn’t he? I bet he’d have taken an even worse one, had you had this Gem.
entries.translated:
Bravo! Mel mendapat pukulan telak,
bukan? Aku yakin dia akan mendapat\lyang lebih parah lagi, jika kamu

memiliki Permata ini.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single [green]Normal[blue]-type move in battle.

Normal-type moves may not be
Super-Effective against anything,\lbut with that Gem, they can sure\lfeel like they are!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single [color-green-1]Normal[color-blue-2]-type move in battle. Normal-type moves may not be Super-Effective against anything, but with that Gem, they can sure feel like they are!
entries.translated:
Permata yang kuberikan itu dapat
memperkuat satu jurus tipe [green]Normal[blue]\ldalam pertarungan. Jurus tipe

Normal mungkin tidak Sangat Efektif
terhadap apa pun, tapi dengan\lPermata itu, mereka pasti terasa

seperti itu!

entries.original:
"Surprised to see me here, Champ in
the making?

Great to see you’re taking up the
mansion’s challenge!

Have some of the finest fresh water
taken from the pond out back."
entries.translation_source: Surprised to see me here, Champ in the making? Great to see you’re taking up the mansion’s challenge! Have some of the finest fresh water taken from the pond out back.
entries.translated:
Terkejut melihatku di sini, Calon
juara? Senang melihatmu mengambil\ltantangan mansion! Silakan minum

air segar terbaik yang diambil dari
kolam di belakang.

entries.original:
"Let’s start off with Successor
Maxima.

She’s in charge around here, but
unlike regular Gym Leaders, she\ldoesn’t use any specific Pokémon.

Bringing a well rounded team
prepared for anything will do you\la world of good!

As for how to get to her, somewhere
in this mansion a switch is hidden\lin a statue.

Flip that switch and it’ll open up
a new passage down to Maxima.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s start off with Successor Maxima. She’s in charge around here, but unlike regular Gym Leaders, she doesn’t use any specific Pokémon. Bringing a well rounded team prepared for anything will do you a world of good! As for how to get to her, somewhere in this mansion a switch is hidden in a statue. Flip that switch and it’ll open up a new passage down to Maxima. Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Mari kita mulai dengan Penerus
Maxima. Dia yang bertanggung jawab\ldi sini, tapi tidak seperti

Pemimpin Gym biasa, dia tidak
menggunakan Pokémon spesifik.\lMembawa tim yang seimbang yang siap

untuk apa pun akan sangat
membantumu! Adapun cara untuk\lmenuju ke dia, di suatu tempat di

mansion ini ada saklar yang
tersembunyi di dalam patung. Balik\lsaklar itu dan itu akan membuka

jalan baru menuju Maxima. Semoga
berhasil!

entries.original:

entries.original:
"For the most part, Big Mo is a
lover of big, slow, and tough\lPokémon, often [green]Fighting[blue]-type.

If you’re just an average Trainer,
and have a [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or\l[green]Fairy[blue]-type, you may win no prob!

But before you can face Big Mo,
you’ll need to clear the Gym’s\l[green]Ring Challenge[blue].

And in that, no [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-,
or [green]Fairy[blue]-type moves are allowed.

That may seem difficult, but
honestly, if you’re not using a\lPokémon weak to Fighting-type\lmoves, it should be a cinch for\lyou to clear.

And be aware that depending on how
hardcore you want to fight, there\lmay be certain restrictions in the\lbattle against Big Mo as well.

The [green]boys out back[blue] will let you know
what’s up with the fight, though,\lso don’t sweat remembering.

Good luck in the ring!"
entries.translation_source: For the most part, Big Mo is a lover of big, slow, and tough Pokémon, often [color-green-1]Fighting[color-blue-2]-type. If you’re just an average Trainer, and have a [color-green-3]Flying[color-blue-4]-, [color-green-5]Psychic[color-blue-6]-, or [color-green-7]Fairy[color-blue-8]-type, you may win no prob! But before you can face Big Mo, you’ll need to clear the Gym’s [color-green-9]Ring Challenge[color-blue-10]. And in that, no [color-green-11]Flying[color-blue-12]-, [color-green-13]Psychic[color-blue-14]-, or [color-green-15]Fairy[color-blue-16]-type moves are allowed. That may seem difficult, but honestly, if you’re not using a Pokémon weak to Fighting-type moves, it should be a cinch for you to clear. And be aware that depending on how hardcore you want to fight, there may be certain restrictions in the battle against Big Mo as well. The [color-green-17]boys out back[color-blue-18] will let you know what’s up with the fight, though, so don’t sweat remembering. Good luck in the ring!
entries.translated:
Sebagian besar, Big Mo menyukai
Pokémon yang besar, lambat, dan\ltangguh, seringkali tipe [green]Fighting[blue].

Jika kamu hanya seorang Trainer
biasa, dan memiliki tipe [green]Flying[blue],\l[green]Psychic[blue], atau [green]Fairy[blue], kamu mungkin

menang tanpa masalah! Tapi sebelum

ini. Dan dalam tantangan itu, tidak
ada jurus tipe [green]Flying[blue], [green]Psychic[blue],\latau [green]Fairy[blue] yang diizinkan. Itu

mungkin tampak sulit, tapi
sejujurnya, jika kamu tidak\lmenggunakan Pokémon yang lemah

terhadap jurus tipe Fighting,
seharusnya mudah bagimu untuk\lmenyelesaikannya. Dan ketahuilah

bahwa tergantung pada seberapa
keras kamu ingin bertarung, mungkin\lada batasan tertentu dalam

pertarungan melawan Big Mo juga.
[green]Anak-anak di belakang[blue] akan\lmemberitahumu apa yang terjadi

dengan pertarungan itu, jadi jangan
khawatir untuk mengingatnya. Semoga\lberhasil di arena!

entries.original:
"Just like back in Mel’s Gym, this
Gym is centred around [green]water[blue].

But unlike his Gym, the Trainers
here actually use [green]Water[blue]-types!

Bringing electrifying [green]Electric[blue]-
types or grassy [green]Grass[blue]-types will\ldo you wonders.

Just be careful.

Trainers in this Gym are masters
of adaptation.

When you fight them, all Pokémon
in battle will become the [green]same type[blue]\las their [green]first two moves[blue].

As for how to get to Tessy,
you’ll need a Pokémon that can\lSurf across the waves.

But be careful, spending too much
time in the water can get you\lwashed back to the entrance!

You’ll need to scout ahead and
find the shortest path to the\lnext platform.

And be aware that although moving
on land will advance the timer,\lyou won’t get washed away if\lyou’re not in the water.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Just like back in Mel’s Gym, this Gym is centred around [color-green-1]water[color-blue-2]. But unlike his Gym, the Trainers here actually use [color-green-3]Water[color-blue-4]-types! Bringing electrifying [color-green-5]Electric[color-blue-6]- types or grassy [color-green-7]Grass[color-blue-8]-types will do you wonders. Just be careful. Trainers in this Gym are masters of adaptation. When you fight them, all Pokémon in battle will become the [color-green-9]same type[color-blue-10] as their [color-green-11]first two moves[color-blue-12]. As for how to get to Tessy, you’ll need a Pokémon that can Surf across the waves. But be careful, spending too much time in the water can get you washed back to the entrance! You’ll need to scout ahead and find the shortest path to the next platform. And be aware that although moving on land will advance the timer, you won’t get washed away if you’re not in the water. Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Seperti di Gym Mel, Gym ini
berpusat pada [green]air[blue]. Tapi tidak\lseperti Gym-nya, para Trainer di

sini benar-benar menggunakan tipe
[green]Water[blue]! Membawa Pokémon tipe\l[green]Electric[blue] yang menggetarkan atau

ombak. Tapi hati-hati, menghabiskan

masuk! Kamu perlu mencari ke depan
dan menemukan jalan terpendek ke\lplatform berikutnya. Dan ketahuilah

bahwa meskipun bergerak di darat
akan memajukan timer, kamu tidak\lakan tersapu jika tidak berada di

air. Semoga berhasil di luar sana!

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of the curious
case of Benjamin Butterfree?

Born a Butterfree, fainted a
Caterpie, poor Benjamin aged\lbackwards his entire life.

And in the spirit of Butterfree,
our Leader, Benjamin designed\lthis Gym.

And you guessed it, in this Gym
Trainers like to use [green]Bug[blue]-types!

Bringing some [green]Rock[blue]-, [green]Flying[blue]-, or
[green]Fire[blue]-types can really put them\lin their place.

But be careful, because in this Gym
when a Pokémon is defeated, it\lregresses to an earlier state.

Pokémon only faint when they can
regress no more.

Because of this unique battling
condition, Pokémon won’t earn any\lExp. in this Gym.

And as for how to find Benjamin,
I’ll tell you this.

In each of the rooms along the
wall, buttons are hidden in rocks.

Press these buttons in the right
order, and you’ll open up a path\lto ol’ Benjamin.

And what is the correct order?

All I can tell you to do is think
back to the curious case of\lBenjamin Butterfree\."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of the curious case of Benjamin Butterfree? Born a Butterfree, fainted a Caterpie, poor Benjamin aged backwards his entire life. And in the spirit of Butterfree, our Leader, Benjamin designed this Gym. And you guessed it, in this Gym Trainers like to use [color-green-1]Bug[color-blue-2]-types! Bringing some [color-green-3]Rock[color-blue-4]-, [color-green-5]Flying[color-blue-6]-, or [color-green-7]Fire[color-blue-8]-types can really put them in their place. But be careful, because in this Gym when a Pokémon is defeated, it regresses to an earlier state. Pokémon only faint when they can regress no more. Because of this unique battling condition, Pokémon won’t earn any Exp. in this Gym. And as for how to find Benjamin, I’ll tell you this. In each of the rooms along the wall, buttons are hidden in rocks. Press these buttons in the right order, and you’ll open up a path to ol’ Benjamin. And what is the correct order? All I can tell you to do is think back to the curious case of Benjamin Butterfree[game-token-9]
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kamu mendengar kasus aneh
Benjamin Butterfree? Lahir sebagai\lButterfree, pingsan sebagai

Caterpie, Benjamin malang menua
mundur sepanjang hidupnya. Dan\ldalam semangat Butterfree, Pemimpin

kami, Benjamin merancang Gym ini.
Dan kamu tebak, di Gym ini para\lTrainer suka menggunakan tipe [green]Bug[blue]!

Membawa tipe [green]Rock[blue], [green]Flying[blue], atau
[green]Fire[blue] benar-benar bisa menjatuhkan\lmereka. Tapi hati-hati, karena di

Gym ini saat Pokémon dikalahkan, ia
mundur ke keadaan sebelumnya.\lPokémon hanya pingsan saat tidak

bisa mundur lagi. Karena kondisi
pertempuran yang unik ini, Pokémon\ltidak akan mendapatkan Exp. di Gym

ini. Dan untuk cara menemukan
Benjamin, aku akan memberitahumu\lini. Di setiap ruangan di sepanjang

dinding, tombol tersembunyi di
batu. Tekan tombol-tombol ini dalam\lurutan yang benar, dan kamu akan

membuka jalan menuju Benjamin tua.
Dan urutan yang benar? Yang bisa\lkukatakan adalah pikirkan kembali

kasus aneh Benjamin Butterfree\.

entries.original:
"Ya ever met that Mirskle guy?

Don’t get too cozy with him - he’s
real loco in the coco!

And what he does in his spare time
ain’t fer good boys and gals like\lyou, right?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Ya ever met that Mirskle guy? Don’t get too cozy with him - he’s real loco in the coco! And what he does in his spare time ain’t fer good boys and gals like you, right? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Pernah ketemu orang Mirskle itu?
Jangan terlalu akrab dengannya -\ldia benar-benar gila! Dan apa yang

dia lakukan di waktu senggangnya
bukan untuk anak baik sepertimu,\lkan? Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"What’s the deal with that Véga
guy, anyway?

Ya ever seen him crack a smile?
’Cos I sure haven’t!

I mean, it wouldn’t kill him to
lighten up a bit, would it?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: What’s the deal with that Véga guy, anyway? Ya ever seen him crack a smile? ’Cos I sure haven’t! I mean, it wouldn’t kill him to lighten up a bit, would it? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Ada apa sih dengan orang itu, Véga?
Apa kau pernah lihat dia tersenyum?\lSoalnya aku belum! Maksudku, nggak

bakal mati kan dia kalau sedikit
santai? Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Ya been to see Alice yet?

Let me tell ya, she’s somethin’
else.

When she ain’t battlin’, she’s workin’
on somethin’ to let people fly\lwithout machines.

Now that\.\CC0818 that’s somethin’ I can
get behind!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Ya been to see Alice yet? Let me tell ya, she’s somethin’ else. When she ain’t battlin’, she’s workin’ on somethin’ to let people fly without machines. Now that[game-token-1][control-code-2] that’s somethin’ I can get behind! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Kau sudah menemui Alice? Biar
kuberi tahu, dia benar-benar luar\lbiasa. Saat dia tidak bertarung,

dia sedang mengerjakan sesuatu
untuk membuat orang terbang tanpa\lmesin. Nah itu\.\CC0818 itu sesuatu yang

bisa kudukung! Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"For a Normal-type Gym Leader,
Mel is anything but.

He’s always payin’ attention to
his body and not his Pokémon!

What kind of example does that
set for young Trainers, huh?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: For a Normal-type Gym Leader, Mel is anything but. He’s always payin’ attention to his body and not his Pokémon! What kind of example does that set for young Trainers, huh? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Untuk seorang Pemimpin Gym tipe
Normal, Mel justru sebaliknya. Dia\lselalu memperhatikan tubuhnya

sendiri, bukan Pokémon-nya! Contoh
apa yang diberikan itu untuk para\lTrainer muda, ya? Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Now, ol’ Galavan - that guy’s clearly
the best Gym Leader, no doubt\.

Why? ’Cos he’s handsome, and strong,
and he’s a genius at machines!

What?\.\CC0820 c’mon, can’t a guy have
favourites or somethin’?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Now, ol’ Galavan - that guy’s clearly the best Gym Leader, no doubt[game-token-1] Why? ’Cos he’s handsome, and strong, and he’s a genius at machines! What?[game-token-2][control-code-3] c’mon, can’t a guy have favourites or somethin’? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Nah, Galavan tua - orang itu jelas
Pemimpin Gym terbaik, tidak\ldiragukan lagi\. Kenapa? Soalnya dia

tampan, kuat, dan jenius dalam
mesin! Apa?\.\CC0820 ayolah, apa seorang\lpria tidak boleh punya favorit? Ha

ha ha!

entries.original:
"Ya ever seen Big Mo?
The guy’s huge - seriously!

He’s so big, a Lickilicky thought
he was its mama!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Ya ever seen Big Mo? The guy’s huge - seriously! He’s so big, a Lickilicky thought he was its mama! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Kau pernah lihat Big Mo? Orang itu
besar - serius! Dia begitu besar,\lseekor Lickilicky mengira dia

ibunya! Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Ya know, that Tessy chick’s pretty
young, but don’t be fooled.

That’s a lady who ain’t afraid ta
play as dirty as Cootes Bog!

But hey, ya got everythin’ to beat
her at her own game, right?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Ya know, that Tessy chick’s pretty young, but don’t be fooled. That’s a lady who ain’t afraid ta play as dirty as Cootes Bog! But hey, ya got everythin’ to beat her at her own game, right? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, gadis Tessy itu masih
muda, tapi jangan tertipu. Itu\lseorang wanita yang tidak takut

bermain kotor seperti Cootes Bog!
Tapi hei, kau punya segalanya untuk\lmengalahkannya dalam permainannya

sendiri, kan? Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"The curious case of Benjamin
Butterfree\.

Man, if I could get younger, that
would be pretty cool.

’Course, bein’ too small to reach
the shelves would be pretty\lannoyin’, no doubt!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: The curious case of Benjamin Butterfree[game-token-1] Man, if I could get younger, that would be pretty cool. ’Course, bein’ too small to reach the shelves would be pretty annoyin’, no doubt! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Kasus aneh Benjamin Butterfree\.
Astaga, jika aku bisa lebih muda,\litu akan sangat keren. Tentu saja,

terlalu kecil untuk meraih rak akan
sangat menyebalkan, tidak diragukan\llagi! Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"You’re almost there, [player]!

The final climb to the Pokémon
League is about to begin!

And knowing ya, I’m sure you’ll
get there in one piece!

I can’t say the same for the
Trainers you’ll come across on\lthe way, though\.

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: You’re almost there, [player-name-1]! The final climb to the Pokémon League is about to begin! And knowing ya, I’m sure you’ll get there in one piece! I can’t say the same for the Trainers you’ll come across on the way, though[game-token-2] Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Kau hampir sampai, [player]!
Pendakian terakhir menuju Pokémon\lLeague akan segera dimulai! Dan

mengenalmu, aku yakin kau akan
sampai dengan selamat! Aku tidak\lbisa mengatakan hal yang sama untuk

para Trainer yang akan kau temui di
jalan, sih\. Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"[player], ya made it to the
Pokémon League!

So, ya wanna hear ol’ Galavan
gossip about the Elite 4, huh?

Man, if ya got time to chat, that’s
time better spent preppin’ for the\lfinal push, right?

Doncha worry ’bout a thing!

Ol’ Galavan’s behind ya, the whole
way, so go get ’em!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], ya made it to the Pokémon League! So, ya wanna hear ol’ Galavan gossip about the Elite 4, huh? Man, if ya got time to chat, that’s time better spent preppin’ for the final push, right? Doncha worry ’bout a thing! Ol’ Galavan’s behind ya, the whole way, so go get ’em! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
[player], kau berhasil sampai ke
Pokémon League! Jadi, kau mau\ldengar gosip Galavan tua tentang

Elite 4, ya? Astaga, jika kau punya
waktu untuk mengobrol, itu waktu\lyang lebih baik digunakan untuk

persiapan dorongan terakhir, kan?
Jangan khawatir tentang apa pun!\lGalavan tua mendukungmu, sepanjang

jalan, jadi lawan mereka! Ha ha ha!

entries.original: "Icicle Cave"
entries.translation_source: Icicle Cave
entries.translated: Gua Icicle

entries.original:
"A cave which is filled to the
brim with icicles.
Many Ice-type Pokémon make
it their home."
entries.translation_source: A cave which is filled to the brim with icicles. Many Ice-type Pokémon make it their home.

entries.original: "Am I Blind?"
entries.translation_source: Am I Blind?
entries.translated: Apa Aku Buta?

entries.original:
"Uncover the secrets behind the
mysterious stone tablets!"
entries.translation_source: Uncover the secrets behind the mysterious stone tablets!
entries.translated:
Temukan rahasia di balik
lempengan batu misterius!

entries.original:
"Hello there, stranger!

Take time to explore Icicle Cave.

It may not seem that big, but it is
larger than it appears!

Why in fact, just the other day, I
saw a Pokémon burrow its way\lthrough the wall to what must be\lan entirely new cave!"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, stranger! Take time to explore Icicle Cave. It may not seem that big, but it is larger than it appears! Why in fact, just the other day, I saw a Pokémon burrow its way through the wall to what must be an entirely new cave!
entries.translated:
Halo, orang asing! Luangkan waktu
untuk menjelajahi Gua Icicle.\lMungkin tidak terlihat besar, tapi

lebih luas dari yang terlihat!
Bahkan, beberapa hari yang lalu,\laku melihat seekor Pokémon menggali

tembok menuju gua yang pasti
benar-benar baru!

entries.original:
"Who could have predicted there
would be a hidden section of\lIcicle Cave?

If it had not been for that
Sandslash’s sloppy digging, this\lplace may have remained hidden for\lfar longer.

But now that it is accessible, I
was able to discover another one\lof the ancient relics!

The tablet that [buffer1] here\. there are
several similar around Borrius.

On each is text in an ancient
dialect, long since forgotten.

However!

After many years of studying the
language, I have created a device\lcapable of translating the text.

In fact, if you are willing to
assist me in uncovering the secrets\lof these stone walls, I will be\lwilling to share it with you."
entries.translation_source: Who could have predicted there would be a hidden section of Icicle Cave? If it had not been for that Sandslash’s sloppy digging, this place may have remained hidden for far longer. But now that it is accessible, I was able to discover another one of the ancient relics! The tablet that [buffer1-1] here[game-token-2] there are several similar around Borrius. On each is text in an ancient dialect, long since forgotten. However! After many years of studying the language, I have created a device capable of translating the text. In fact, if you are willing to assist me in uncovering the secrets of these stone walls, I will be willing to share it with you.
entries.translated:
Siapa yang bisa meramalkan bahwa
ada bagian tersembunyi dari Gua\lIcicle? Jika bukan karena

penggalian Sandslash yang ceroboh,
tempat ini mungkin akan tetap\ltersembunyi lebih lama. Tapi

sekarang sudah bisa diakses, aku
berhasil menemukan satu lagi\lpeninggalan kuno! Lempengan yang

[buffer1] di sini\. ada beberapa yang
serupa di sekitar Borrius.\lMasing-masing berisi teks dalam

dialek kuno, yang sudah lama
dilupakan. Namun! Setelah\lbertahun-tahun mempelajari bahasa

itu, aku menciptakan alat yang
mampu menerjemahkan teks tersebut.\lFaktanya, jika kau bersedia

membantuku mengungkap rahasia di
balik dinding batu ini, aku akan\lbersedia membagikannya denganmu.

entries.original:
"Hmph\. that is rather unfortunate.

No one in the Archeology Society
has managed to learn this dialect\.\lother than myself, of course.

I doubt an inexperienced Trainer
like you could read it without my\lassistance."
entries.translation_source: Hmph[game-token-1] that is rather unfortunate. No one in the Archeology Society has managed to learn this dialect[game-token-2] other than myself, of course. I doubt an inexperienced Trainer like you could read it without my assistance.
entries.translated:
Hmph\. itu agak disayangkan. Tidak
seorang pun di Masyarakat Arkeologi\lyang berhasil mempelajari dialek

ini\. selain diriku sendiri, tentu
saja. Aku ragu seorang Trainer yang\ltidak berpengalaman sepertimu bisa

membacanya tanpa bantuanku.

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

This is the device you will need to
read the text on these tablets."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! This is the device you will need to read the text on these tablets.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Ini adalah alat yang
akan kau butuhkan untuk membaca\lteks pada lempengan-lempengan ini.

entries.original:
"With the [green][buffer1][blue] in hand,
you will be able to translate the\lancient dialect, if you so desire.

In fact, it may be advantageous for
you to discover what is behind\lthese tablets.

Once you have solved the riddle on
each of the tablets in Borrius,\lcome see me, and I will reward you\lfor your efforts."
entries.translation_source: With the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in hand, you will be able to translate the ancient dialect, if you so desire. In fact, it may be advantageous for you to discover what is behind these tablets. Once you have solved the riddle on each of the tablets in Borrius, come see me, and I will reward you for your efforts.
entries.translated:
Dengan [green][buffer1][blue] di tangan, kau akan
bisa menerjemahkan dialek kuno itu,\ljika kau menginginkannya. Faktanya,

mungkin menguntungkan bagimu untuk
mengetahui apa yang ada di balik\llempengan-lempengan ini. Setelah

kau memecahkan teka-teki di setiap
lempengan di Borrius, temui aku,\ldan aku akan memberimu hadiah atas

usahamu.

entries.original:
"As of now, the secrets behind [green][buffer3][blue]
tablet\\08 have yet to be uncovered.

Once you have uncovered what is
behind all of them, come see me\lfor a reward."
entries.translation_source: As of now, the secrets behind [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3] tablet[raw-escape-4] have yet to be uncovered. Once you have uncovered what is behind all of them, come see me for a reward.
entries.translated:
Saat ini, rahasia di balik
lempengan [green][buffer3][blue]\\08 belum\lterungkap. Setelah kau mengungkap

apa yang ada di balik semuanya,
temui aku untuk mendapatkan hadiah.

entries.original:
"You have done it!

You have uncovered the secrets
behind each of the ancient stone\ltablets in Borrius!

Not even I, the greatest mind in
the Archeology Society, was able to\lsolve the mysteries.

I must be honest\. I may have
misjudged you at first.

However, I have come to learn that
there certainly is more to one than\lcan be discerned at first glance.

You have my apologies, and once
more, my thanks."
entries.translation_source: You have done it! You have uncovered the secrets behind each of the ancient stone tablets in Borrius! Not even I, the greatest mind in the Archeology Society, was able to solve the mysteries. I must be honest[game-token-1] I may have misjudged you at first. However, I have come to learn that there certainly is more to one than can be discerned at first glance. You have my apologies, and once more, my thanks.
entries.translated:
Kau berhasil! Kau telah mengungkap
rahasia di balik setiap lempengan\lbatu kuno di Borrius! Bahkan aku,

pikiran terhebat di Masyarakat
Arkeologi, tidak mampu memecahkan\lmisteri tersebut. Jujur saja\. Aku

mungkin salah menilaimu pada
awalnya. Namun, aku belajar bahwa\lpasti ada lebih banyak hal dari

seseorang daripada yang terlihat
pada pandangan pertama. Kau\lmendapat permintaan maafku, dan

sekali lagi, terima kasihku.

entries.original:
"I am sure you noticed the ancient
dens behind each of the tablets,\lyes?

Once a den has been emptied for the
day, throw in one of those [green]Wishing\lPieces[blue].

They will allow a new Pokémon to
be encountered.

And with that, I tip my hat to you,
Trainer, and farewell.

Until we meet again!"
entries.translation_source: I am sure you noticed the ancient dens behind each of the tablets, yes? Once a den has been emptied for the day, throw in one of those [color-green-1]Wishing Pieces[color-blue-2]. They will allow a new Pokémon to be encountered. And with that, I tip my hat to you, Trainer, and farewell. Until we meet again!
entries.translated:
Aku yakin kau memperhatikan sarang
kuno di balik setiap lempengan, ya?\lSetelah sarang dikosongkan untuk

hari itu, masukkan salah satu
[green]Wishing Pieces[blue] itu. Mereka akan\lmemungkinkan Pokémon baru

ditemukan. Dan dengan itu, aku
memberi hormat padamu, Trainer, dan\lselamat tinggal. Sampai jumpa lagi!

entries.original:
"This tablet was found in the hidden
section of Icicle Cave uncovered
during \qoThe Food Thief\qc."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found in the hidden section of Icicle Cave uncovered during [quote-open-1]The Food Thief[quote-close-2].
entries.translated:
Tablet ini ditemukan di bagian
tersembunyi dari Gua Icicle yang\lterungkap selama \qoPencuri Makanan\qc.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found on 2F after
hopping across some rocks close to
the uppermost wall of the cavern."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found on 2F after hopping across some rocks close to the uppermost wall of the cavern.
entries.translated:
Tablet ini ditemukan di Lantai 2
setelah melompati beberapa batu di\ldekat dinding paling atas gua.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found on B1F close
to the ladder out to Route 6, and
beneath the waterfall."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found on B1F close to the ladder out to Route 6, and beneath the waterfall.
entries.translated:
Tablet ini ditemukan di B1F dekat
tangga keluar menuju Rute 6, dan di\lbawah air terjun.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found on 1F after
using Rock Climb in the upper west
most part of the cavern."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found on 1F after using Rock Climb in the upper west most part of the cavern.
entries.translated:
Tablet ini ditemukan di 1F setelah
menggunakan Memanjat Tebing di\lbagian paling barat atas gua.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found in the
section of 3F with the electric
barrier."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found in the section of 3F with the electric barrier.
entries.translated:
Tablet ini ditemukan di bagian 3F
yang memiliki penghalang listrik.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found on B3F near
the entrance to the ruins."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found on B3F near the entrance to the ruins.
entries.translated:
Tablet ini ditemukan di B3F dekat
pintu masuk reruntuhan.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found in the large
room on 1F after hiding the red,
yellow, and blue crystals."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found in the large room on 1F after hiding the red, yellow, and blue crystals.
entries.translated:
Tablet ini ditemukan di ruangan
besar di 1F setelah menyembunyikan\lkristal merah, kuning, dan biru.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found on B1F in the
magma chamber accessed from the
west ladder on 1F."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found on B1F in the magma chamber accessed from the west ladder on 1F.
entries.translated:
Tablet ini ditemukan di B1F di
ruang magma yang diakses dari\ltangga barat di 1F.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found after using
Rock Climb to access a dive spot
at the Ruins of Void."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found after using Rock Climb to access a dive spot at the Ruins of Void.
entries.translated:
Tablet ini ditemukan setelah
menggunakan Memanjat Tebing untuk\lmengakses titik menyelam di

Reruntuhan Kekosongan.

entries.original: "[green]Seyyyy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Seyyyy!
entries.translated: [green]Seyyyy!

entries.original:
"This Chansey charges [green]$[buffer1][black] to heal
Insane Trainers."
entries.translation_source: This Chansey charges [color-green-1]$[buffer1-2][color-black-3] to heal Insane Trainers.
entries.translated:
Chansey ini mengenakan biaya
[green]$[buffer1][black] untuk menyembuhkan\lPelatih Insane.

entries.original:
"If you are crazy enough to attempt
Insane, then you should be crazy\lenough to buy healing items, or be\lprepared to pay the price of\l6 Full Restores, 5 Revives, and\l6 Max Elixirs every time you need\lto heal.

Don’t like this?

Play on a lower difficulty.

This game mode is not meant for
those who want to take the easy\lway out.

You have been warned."
entries.translation_source: If you are crazy enough to attempt Insane, then you should be crazy enough to buy healing items, or be prepared to pay the price of 6 Full Restores, 5 Revives, and 6 Max Elixirs every time you need to heal. Don’t like this? Play on a lower difficulty. This game mode is not meant for those who want to take the easy way out. You have been warned.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu cukup gila untuk mencoba
Insane, maka kamu harus cukup gila\luntuk membeli item penyembuhan,

atau bersiaplah untuk membayar
harga 6 Pemulihan Penuh, 5\lHidupkan, dan 6 Eliksir Maks setiap

kali kamu perlu menyembuhkan. Tidak
suka ini? Main di tingkat kesulitan\lyang lebih rendah. Mode permainan

ini tidak dimaksudkan bagi mereka
yang ingin mengambil jalan keluar\lyang mudah. Kamu telah

diperingatkan.

entries.original: "You don’t have enough money."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough money.
entries.translated: Kamu tidak memiliki cukup uang.

entries.original: "Why"
entries.translation_source: Why
entries.translated: Kenapa

entries.original:
"[player]!
Fancy meeting you here!

Figured you’d be out running one of
Log’s \qoerrands\qc, or something.

\.

Oh, you are. Typical.

menggali lagi, kamu tahu di mana
menemukanku.

"If you ever want to give mining
another go, you know where to\lfind me."
entries.translation_source: If you ever want to give mining another go, you know where to find me.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin mencoba menambang
lagi, kamu tahu di mana\lmenemukanku.

"If you ever want to give mining
a go, you know where to find me."
entries.translation_source: If you ever want to give mining a go, you know where to find me.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin mencoba menambang,
kamu tahu di mana menemukanku.

entries.original:
"Looks like you don’t have enough
money to pay me.

I can’t just let you do this
for free.

I’m not a saint, you know!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you don’t have enough money to pay me. I can’t just let you do this for free. I’m not a saint, you know!

Sepertinya kamu tidak punya cukup
uang untuk membayarku. Aku tidak\lbisa membiarkanmu melakukan ini

secara gratis. Aku bukan orang
suci, kamu tahu!

entries.original:
"These boulders have been placed
so strategically!

It’s almost as if someone doesn’t
want people going this way\lright now\."
entries.translation_source: These boulders have been placed so strategically! It’s almost as if someone doesn’t want people going this way right now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Batu-batu besar ini ditempatkan
dengan sangat strategis! Sepertinya\lseseorang tidak ingin orang lewat

sini sekarang\.

entries.original:
"The boulders that were here!
They mysteriously vanished!

One moment I was standing here,
and the next thing I knew, they\lwere gone!

What could have happened to them?"
entries.translation_source: The boulders that were here! They mysteriously vanished! One moment I was standing here, and the next thing I knew, they were gone! What could have happened to them?
entries.translated:
Batu-batu besar yang ada di sini!
Mereka menghilang secara misterius!\lBeberapa saat yang lalu aku berdiri

di sini, dan kemudian aku tahu,
mereka sudah pergi! Apa yang\lmungkin terjadi pada mereka?

entries.original:
"As soon as we finished the bridge
to this new entrance, the walls\lcracked open, and the sea water\lstarted flooding in!

Because why would we get a day off?"
entries.translation_source: As soon as we finished the bridge to this new entrance, the walls cracked open, and the sea water started flooding in! Because why would we get a day off?
entries.translated:
Begitu kami menyelesaikan jembatan
ke pintu masuk baru ini, dindingnya\lretak, dan air laut mulai

membanjiri! Karena kenapa kita bisa
mendapat hari libur?

entries.original:
"This section of the tunnel will go
to Vivill Town when it’s completed.

We’re working as fast as we can,
but I have no idea when we’ll\lget there."
entries.translation_source: This section of the tunnel will go to Vivill Town when it’s completed. We’re working as fast as we can, but I have no idea when we’ll get there.
entries.translated:
Bagian terowongan ini akan menuju
ke Vivill Town setelah selesai.\lKami bekerja secepat yang kami

bisa, tapi aku tidak tahu kapan
kami akan sampai di sana.

entries.original:
"The walls of the tunnel just keep
collapsing for some reason!

One of these days\. I swear\.

We’re going on strike!"
entries.translation_source: The walls of the tunnel just keep collapsing for some reason! One of these days[game-token-1] I swear[game-token-2] We’re going on strike!
entries.translated:
Dinding terowongan terus runtuh
karena suatu alasan! Suatu hari\lnanti\. aku bersumpah\. Kami akan

mogok!

entries.original:
"This section of the Expressway was
intentionally blocked off due to\lthe high crime rate in Antisis\lCity.

If you’re stuck here without a way
back home, I can teleport you over\lthe blockage.

Would you like that?"
entries.translation_source: This section of the Expressway was intentionally blocked off due to the high crime rate in Antisis City. If you’re stuck here without a way back home, I can teleport you over the blockage. Would you like that?
entries.translated:
Bagian Expressway ini sengaja
diblokir karena tingginya tingkat\lkejahatan di Antisis City. Jika

kamu terjebak di sini tanpa cara
untuk pulang, aku bisa teleport\lkamu melewati blokade. Apakah kamu

mau?

entries.original:
"Okay, here we go!

Solosis, Duosion, Alakazam!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, here we go! Solosis, Duosion, Alakazam!
entries.translated:
Oke, ayo kita mulai! Solosis,
Duosion, Alakazam!

entries.original: "Stay safe in Antisis City."

\.
