entries.original:
"I have one more errand for you
to run, [player].

An old friend of mine lives in
[green]Dresco Town[blue].

He has a vast knowledge of Borrian
history.

I need you to tell him everything
that has transpired thus far.

I have a theory about what is going
on, but I need him to confirm it.

You have your own Pokémon now, so
this shouldn’t be too difficult.

You can get to [green]Dresco Town[blue] by going
through [green]Icicle Cave[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I have one more errand for you to run, [player-name-1]. An old friend of mine lives in [color-green-2]Dresco Town[color-blue-3]. He has a vast knowledge of Borrian history. I need you to tell him everything that has transpired thus far. I have a theory about what is going on, but I need him to confirm it. You have your own Pokémon now, so this shouldn’t be too difficult. You can get to [color-green-4]Dresco Town[color-blue-5] by going through [color-green-6]Icicle Cave[color-blue-7].
entries.translated:
Ada satu tugas lagi yang harus kau
lakukan, [player]. Seorang teman\llamaku tinggal di [green]Dresco Town[blue]. Dia

memiliki pengetahuan luas tentang
sejarah Borrian. Aku perlu kau\lmenceritakan semua yang terjadi

sejauh ini. Aku punya teori tentang
apa yang terjadi, tapi aku butuh\ldia untuk mengonfirmasinya. Kau

sudah punya Pokémon sendiri
sekarang, jadi ini seharusnya tidak\lterlalu sulit. Kau bisa sampai ke

[green]Dresco Town[blue] dengan melewati [green]Icicle
Cave[blue].

entries.original:
"Oh!
Silly me!

How can I expect you to find [green]Icicle
Cave[blue] if you don’t know the way?

This [green]Town Map[blue] should aid you
immensely!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! Silly me! How can I expect you to find [color-green-1]Icicle Cave[color-blue-2] if you don’t know the way? This [color-green-3]Town Map[color-blue-4] should aid you immensely!
entries.translated:
Oh! Bodohnya aku! Bagaimana aku
bisa mengharapkan kau menemukan\l[green]Icicle Cave[blue] jika kau tidak tahu

jalannya? [green]Peta Kota[blue] ini seharusnya
sangat membantu!

entries.original:
"Now, let’s take a look at the
Town Map, shall we?"
entries.translation_source: Now, let’s take a look at the Town Map, shall we?
entries.translated:
Sekarang, mari kita lihat Peta
Kota, ya?

entries.original:
"Did you notice the yellow X over
Dresco Town?

That marker will automatically move
when you have a new destination."
entries.translation_source: Did you notice the yellow X over Dresco Town? That marker will automatically move when you have a new destination.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu melihat tanda X kuning
di atas Dresco Town? Penanda itu\lakan bergerak secara otomatis

ketika kamu memiliki tujuan baru.

entries.original:
"Did you notice the yellow X over
Dresco Town?

That marker will automatically move
when you have a new destination.

And you know what?

Now that you have your own Mission
Log, allow me to record my request\lfrom earlier!

First, you should aim to see every
Pokémon in the Borrius Pokédex.

Or, as it’s more commonly known,
the West Borrius Pokédex.

Pokémon that only appear in East
Borrius are conspicuously left out."
entries.translation_source: Did you notice the yellow X over Dresco Town? That marker will automatically move when you have a new destination. And you know what? Now that you have your own Mission Log, allow me to record my request from earlier! First, you should aim to see every Pokémon in the Borrius Pokédex. Or, as it’s more commonly known, the West Borrius Pokédex. Pokémon that only appear in East Borrius are conspicuously left out.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu melihat X kuning di
atas Dresco Town? Penanda itu akan\lbergerak secara otomatis saat kamu

memiliki tujuan baru. Dan tahukah
kamu? Sekarang kamu punya Log Misi\lsendiri, izinkan aku mencatat

permintaan aku dari sebelumnya!
Pertama, kamu harus bertujuan untuk\lmelihat setiap Pokémon di Pokédex

Borrius. Atau, seperti yang lebih
dikenal, Pokédex Borrius Barat.\lPokémon yang hanya muncul di

Borrius Timur secara mencolok tidak
disertakan.

entries.original:
"Once you’ve completed that task,
aim to capture every Pokémon\llisted in the Pokédex!

Ho ho ho!"
entries.translation_source: Once you’ve completed that task, aim to capture every Pokémon listed in the Pokédex! Ho ho ho!
entries.translated:
Setelah kamu menyelesaikan tugas
itu, bertujuan untuk menangkap\lsetiap Pokémon yang terdaftar di

Pokédex! Ho ho ho!

entries.original:
"Additionally, my younger sister,
Natasha Log, lives in [green]Blizzard City[blue].

If you ever meet her, she can
upgrade your Pokédex and make it\leasier for you to encounter\lPokémon you are looking for."
entries.translation_source: Additionally, my younger sister, Natasha Log, lives in [color-green-1]Blizzard City[color-blue-2]. If you ever meet her, she can upgrade your Pokédex and make it easier for you to encounter Pokémon you are looking for.
entries.translated:
Selain itu, adik perempuan saya,
Natasha Log, tinggal di [green]Blizzard\lCity[blue]. Jika kamu pernah bertemu

dengannya, dia dapat meningkatkan
Pokédex-mu dan membuatmu lebih\lmudah bertemu Pokémon yang kamu

cari.

entries.original:
"Oh!

My memory seems to be going\. I
have one more thing to give you.

Please, the next time you see
[rival], give him this Pokédex."
entries.translation_source: Oh! My memory seems to be going[game-token-1] I have one more thing to give you. Please, the next time you see [text-token-rival-2], give him this Pokédex.
entries.translated:
Oh! Ingatanku sepertinya mulai
hilang\. Aku masih punya satu hal\llagi untuk diberikan padamu.

Tolong, lain kali kau bertemu
[rival], berikan Pokédex ini\lpadanya.

entries.original:
"He’s been rather cold to me ever
since he arrived here, but he seems\lto get along fine with you.

I’m sure if you give him the
Pokédex, he’d be willing to assist."
entries.translation_source: He’s been rather cold to me ever since he arrived here, but he seems to get along fine with you. I’m sure if you give him the Pokédex, he’d be willing to assist.
entries.translated:
Dia bersikap agak dingin padaku
sejak dia tiba di sini, tapi dia\ltampaknya cocok denganmu. Aku yakin

jika kamu memberinya Pokédex, dia
akan bersedia membantu.

entries.original:
"Please visit my friend in [green]Dresco
Town[blue], [player].

I’m counting on you."
entries.translation_source: Please visit my friend in [color-green-1]Dresco Town[color-blue-2], [player-name-3]. I’m counting on you.
entries.translated:
Tolong kunjungi temanku di [green]Dresco
Town[blue], [player]. Aku mengandalkanmu.

entries.original:
"[player], you need to hurry to
[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]!

If the Shadows get there before
you, Borrius is doomed!

Head north of town and take the [green]KBT
Expressway[blue] far [green]south[blue] to go quickly."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], you need to hurry to [color-green-2]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-3]! If the Shadows get there before you, Borrius is doomed! Head north of town and take the [color-green-4]KBT Expressway[color-blue-5] far [color-green-6]south[color-blue-7] to go quickly.
entries.translated:
[player], kamu harus bergegas ke
[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]! Jika para Bayangan\lsampai di sana sebelum kamu,

Borrius akan hancur! Pergilah ke
utara kota dan naik [green]KBT Expressway[blue]\ljauh ke [green]selatan[blue] untuk pergi dengan

cepat.

entries.original:
"Ho ho ho!

[player]!
I heard the wonderful news!

Now that Zapdos is safe, we can
all rest easy at night.

But don’t fret, your errands are
not completed yet!

You must now retrieve Articuno and
Moltres from the Shadows."
entries.translation_source: Ho ho ho! [player-name-1]! I heard the wonderful news! Now that Zapdos is safe, we can all rest easy at night. But don’t fret, your errands are not completed yet! You must now retrieve Articuno and Moltres from the Shadows.
entries.translated:
Ho ho ho! [player]! Aku mendengar
kabar yang luar biasa! Sekarang\lsetelah Zapdos aman, kita semua

bisa tidur nyenyak di malam hari.
Tapi jangan khawatir, tugasmu belum\lselesai! Sekarang kamu harus

mengambil Articuno dan Moltres dari
Bayangan.

entries.original:
"Now that the dark force has been
released, the end of Borrius\lis near.

[player]!

You need to find Jax and help him
seal away the power once more!"
entries.translation_source: Now that the dark force has been released, the end of Borrius is near. [player-name-1]! You need to find Jax and help him seal away the power once more!
entries.translated:
Sekarang setelah kekuatan gelap
telah dilepaskan, akhir dari\lBorrius sudah dekat. [player]! Kamu

perlu menemukan Jax dan membantunya
menyegel kekuatan itu sekali lagi!

entries.original:
"[player]!

You saved Borrius!
You saved us all!

Thank you!

Your father would be proud of you,
Guardian of Borrius.

Unfortunately, I have no more
errands for you to run.

Have you considered taking on the
[green]Pokémon League[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You saved Borrius! You saved us all! Thank you! Your father would be proud of you, Guardian of Borrius. Unfortunately, I have no more errands for you to run. Have you considered taking on the [color-green-2]Pokémon League[color-blue-3]?
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu menyelamatkan
Borrius! Kamu menyelamatkan kita\lsemua! Terima kasih! Ayahmu pasti

bangga padamu, Penjaga Borrius.
Sayangnya, aku tidak punya tugas\llagi untukmu. Apakah kamu sudah

mempertimbangkan untuk menantang
[green]Liga Pokémon[blue]?

entries.original:
"[player]!
It’s good to see you!

How goes the hunt for the
mysterious portals?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! It’s good to see you! How goes the hunt for the mysterious portals?
entries.translated:
[player]! Senang melihatmu!
Bagaimana perburuan portal\lmisterius itu?

entries.original:
"My, oh, my!

You’ve done it!
You’ve actually done it!

You’ve completed the National
Pokédex!

But if you want the reward for your
excellent work, you’ll need to make\lspace in your party for it."
entries.translation_source: My, oh, my! You’ve done it! You’ve actually done it! You’ve completed the National Pokédex! But if you want the reward for your excellent work, you’ll need to make space in your party for it.
entries.translated:
Astaga! Anda berhasil! Anda
benar-benar melakukannya! Anda\ltelah melengkapi Pokédex Nasional!

Namun jika Anda menginginkan hadiah
untuk kerja bagus Anda, Anda harus\lmengosongkan tempat di tim Anda

untuknya.

entries.original:
"My, oh, my!

What a wonderful set of species
you’ve recorded there in your\lWest Borrius Pokédex!

They certainly all have some very
nice stats.

For your excellent work, my friend
has requested that I entrust this\lto you."
entries.translation_source: My, oh, my! What a wonderful set of species you’ve recorded there in your West Borrius Pokédex! They certainly all have some very nice stats. For your excellent work, my friend has requested that I entrust this to you.
entries.translated:
Wah, wah! Betapa indahnya kumpulan
spesies yang telah kamu catat di\lPokédex West Borrius-mu! Mereka

semua pasti memiliki statistik yang
sangat bagus. Untuk kerjamu yang\lluar biasa, temanku meminta agar

aku mempercayakan ini padamu.

entries.original:
"That charm will aid you immensely
in your task of completing the\lNational Pokédex.

Come see me again when you’ve
done that!"
entries.translation_source: That charm will aid you immensely in your task of completing the National Pokédex. Come see me again when you’ve done that!
entries.translated:
Jimat itu akan sangat membantu Anda
dalam tugas menyelesaikan Pokédex\lNasional. Kembalilah menemuiku lagi

setelah Anda melakukannya!

entries.original:
"My, oh, my!

You’ve done it!
You’ve actually done it!

You’ve completed the National
Pokédex!

Ho ho ho!

My friend will be beyond words for
your simply unparalleled work.

As a reward, you deserve nothing
less than this rare Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: My, oh, my! You’ve done it! You’ve actually done it! You’ve completed the National Pokédex! Ho ho ho! My friend will be beyond words for your simply unparalleled work. As a reward, you deserve nothing less than this rare Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Wah, wah, wah! Kamu berhasil! Kamu
benar-benar berhasil! Kamu telah\lmenyelesaikan Pokédex Nasional! Ho

ho ho! Temanku pasti tidak bisa
berkata-kata melihat karyamu yang\ltak tertandingi. Sebagai hadiah,

kamu pantas mendapatkan Pokémon
langka ini.

entries.original:
"[blue]Although you have already managed
to capture every Pokémon, I’m sure\lyou don’t have one that looks quite\llike that one yet!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Although you have already managed to capture every Pokémon, I’m sure you don’t have one that looks quite like that one yet!
entries.translated:
[blue]Meskipun kamu sudah berhasil
menangkap setiap Pokémon, aku yakin\lkamu belum memiliki satu pun yang

terlihat persis seperti yang itu!

entries.original:
"What are you doing?

I told you to check in with your
mother!

\.

Don’t look at me like that.

Didn’t your mother ever teach you
to listen to your elders?

Go see her!"
entries.translation_source: What are you doing? I told you to check in with your mother! [game-token-1] Don’t look at me like that. Didn’t your mother ever teach you to listen to your elders? Go see her!
entries.translated:
Apa yang kau lakukan? Aku sudah
bilang untuk menemui ibumu! \. Jangan\lmelihatku seperti itu. Apakah ibumu

tidak pernah mengajarimu untuk
mendengarkan orang yang lebih tua?\lPergi temui dia!

entries.original:
"Pokémon have hidden stat potential
that determines how well their\lstats grow.

This potential is indicated by a
letter grading in a Pokémon’s\l[green]summary[blue].

[green]S[blue] represents the best possible
value, while [green]E-[blue] represents the\lworst."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon have hidden stat potential that determines how well their stats grow. This potential is indicated by a letter grading in a Pokémon’s [color-green-1]summary[color-blue-2]. [color-green-3]S[color-blue-4] represents the best possible value, while [color-green-5]E-[color-blue-6] represents the worst.
entries.translated:
Pokémon memiliki potensi stat
tersembunyi yang menentukan\lseberapa baik stat mereka

berkembang. Potensi ini ditunjukkan
dengan peringkat huruf pada\l[green]ringkasan[blue] Pokémon. [green]S[blue] mewakili nilai

terbaik yang mungkin, sementara [green]E-[blue]
mewakili yang terburuk.

entries.original:
"Pokémon have hidden stat potential
that determines how well their\lstats grow.

And if you become Champion, an
indicator for this potential will\lappear in your Pokémon’s summary!

Unless\.\CC0818 you’d like to see them on
the summary screen now?"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon have hidden stat potential that determines how well their stats grow. And if you become Champion, an indicator for this potential will appear in your Pokémon’s summary! Unless[game-token-1][control-code-2] you’d like to see them on the summary screen now?
entries.translated:
Pokémon memiliki potensi stat
tersembunyi yang menentukan\lseberapa baik stat mereka tumbuh.

Dan jika Anda menjadi Champion,
indikator untuk potensi ini akan\lmuncul di ringkasan Pokémon Anda!

Kecuali\.\CC0818 Anda ingin melihatnya di
layar ringkasan sekarang?

entries.original:
"Smart choice, [player]!

Just be happy with the Pokémon
you catch!"
entries.translation_source: Smart choice, [player-name-1]! Just be happy with the Pokémon you catch!
entries.translated:
Pilihan cerdas, [player]! Nikmati
saja Pokémon yang kamu tangkap!

entries.original:
"Alright, [player].

Your Pokémon’s potential is now
indicated by a letter grading in\ltheir [green]summaries[blue].

[green]S[blue] represents the best possible
value, while [green]E-[blue] represents the\lworst.

If you’d ever like to hide them,
don’t hesitate to ask, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Alright, [player-name-1]. Your Pokémon’s potential is now indicated by a letter grading in their [color-green-2]summaries[color-blue-3]. [color-green-4]S[color-blue-5] represents the best possible value, while [color-green-6]E-[color-blue-7] represents the worst. If you’d ever like to hide them, don’t hesitate to ask, [player-name-8].
entries.translated:
Baiklah, [player]. Potensi
Pokémon-mu sekarang ditunjukkan\ldengan peringkat huruf di [green]ringkasan[blue]

mereka. [green]S[blue] mewakili nilai terbaik
yang mungkin, sementara [green]E-[blue] mewakili\lyang terburuk. Jika suatu saat

ingin menyembunyikannya, jangan
ragu untuk bertanya, [player].

entries.original:
"Pokémon have hidden stat potential
that determines how well their\lstats grow.

This potential is indicated by a
letter grading in a Pokémon’s\l[green]summary[blue].

[green]S[blue] represents the best possible
value, while [green]E-[blue] represents the\lworst.

Would you like to hide these rankings
until you become Champion?"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon have hidden stat potential that determines how well their stats grow. This potential is indicated by a letter grading in a Pokémon’s [color-green-1]summary[color-blue-2]. [color-green-3]S[color-blue-4] represents the best possible value, while [color-green-5]E-[color-blue-6] represents the worst. Would you like to hide these rankings until you become Champion?
entries.translated:
Pokémon memiliki potensi stat
tersembunyi yang menentukan\lseberapa baik stat mereka tumbuh.

Potensi ini ditunjukkan dengan
peringkat huruf di [green]ringkasan[blue]\lPokémon. [green]S[blue] mewakili nilai terbaik

yang mungkin, sementara [green]E-[blue] mewakili
yang terburuk. Apakah Anda ingin\lmenyembunyikan peringkat ini sampai

Anda menjadi Champion?

entries.original:
"If you’d ever like to hide them,
don’t hesitate to ask, [player]."
entries.translation_source: If you’d ever like to hide them, don’t hesitate to ask, [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Jika suatu saat ingin
menyembunyikannya, jangan ragu\luntuk bertanya, [player].

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Did you know your Pokémon have
hidden stats called [green]Effort Values[blue]\land [green]Individual Values[blue]?

I can show you those stats if
you’d like!"
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player-name-1]! Did you know your Pokémon have hidden stats called [color-green-2]Effort Values[color-blue-3] and [color-green-4]Individual Values[color-blue-5]? I can show you those stats if you’d like!
entries.translated:
Hai, [player]! Tahukah Anda bahwa
Pokémon Anda memiliki stat\ltersembunyi yang disebut [green]Effort

Values[blue] dan [green]Individual Values[blue]? Saya
bisa menunjukkan stat tersebut jika\lAnda mau!

entries.original:
"What’s that?

You want this device for yourself?"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? You want this device for yourself?
entries.translated:
Apa itu? Kamu ingin perangkat ini
untuk dirimu sendiri?

entries.original:
"Of course you can have this
device!

You have been a huge asset to
Prof. Log, after all!"
entries.translation_source: Of course you can have this device! You have been a huge asset to Prof. Log, after all!
entries.translated:
Tentu saja kamu bisa memiliki
perangkat ini! Lagipula, kamu telah\lmenjadi aset besar bagi Prof. Log!

entries.original:
"I’ll have you know, Prof. Log and I
toiled day and night to create\lthis device!

I can’t just go around handing it
out to just anyone, you know!

However\.

If you were to satisfy part of 
Prof. Log’s request\.

Say\. register at least [green][buffer1][blue] 
different species as [green]captured[blue] in\lyour Pokédex?

If you can do that, I will let you
have this device."
entries.translation_source: I’ll have you know, Prof. Log and I toiled day and night to create this device! I can’t just go around handing it out to just anyone, you know! However[game-token-1] If you were to satisfy part of Prof. Log’s request[game-token-2] Say[game-token-3] register at least [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] different species as [color-green-7]captured[color-blue-8] in your Pokédex? If you can do that, I will let you have this device.
entries.translated:
Perlu kamu tahu, Prof. Log dan saya
bekerja siang malam untuk\lmenciptakan perangkat ini! Saya

tidak bisa membagikannya
sembarangan, lho! Namun\. Jika kamu\lmemenuhi sebagian dari permintaan

Prof. Log\. Katakanlah\. mendaftarkan
setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] spesies berbeda\lsebagai [green]tertangkap[blue] di Pokédex-mu?

Jika kamu bisa melakukan itu, saya
akan mengizinkanmu memiliki\lperangkat ini.

entries.original:
"With the [green]Stat Scanner[blue], you can
view your Pokémon’s hidden stats\lanywhere in the region!

You can even view the moves it can
learn by pressing \btn02 or \btn03!

Oh, and for convenience’s sake, you
can also open it quickly from your\l[green]party list[blue] by pressing \btn03."
entries.translation_source: With the [color-green-1]Stat Scanner[color-blue-2], you can view your Pokémon’s hidden stats anywhere in the region! You can even view the moves it can learn by pressing [button-icon-3] or [button-icon-4]! Oh, and for convenience’s sake, you can also open it quickly from your [color-green-5]party list[color-blue-6] by pressing [button-icon-7].
entries.translated:
Dengan [green]Stat Scanner[blue], Anda dapat
melihat stat tersembunyi Pokémon\lAnda di mana saja di wilayah ini!

Anda bahkan dapat melihat gerakan
yang bisa dipelajarinya dengan\lmenekan \btn02 atau \btn03! Oh, dan demi

kenyamanan, Anda juga dapat
membukanya dengan cepat dari [green]daftar\lparty[blue] Anda dengan menekan \btn03.

entries.original:
"My notebook!

You found it!

I had recorded the different people
in Borrius who could teach your\lPokémon moves inside the book,\lbut I must’ve misplaced it.

Now that you found it, hand back
your Stat Scanner for a moment."
entries.translation_source: My notebook! You found it! I had recorded the different people in Borrius who could teach your Pokémon moves inside the book, but I must’ve misplaced it. Now that you found it, hand back your Stat Scanner for a moment.
entries.translated:
Buku catatanku! Kamu menemukannya!
Saya telah mencatat orang-orang\lberbeda di Borrius yang bisa

mengajarkan gerakan ke Pokémon-mu
di dalam buku itu, tapi saya pasti\lsalah meletakkannya. Sekarang kamu

menemukannya, kembalikan Stat
Scanner-mu sebentar.

entries.original:
"My notebook!

You found it!

I had recorded the different people
in Borrius who could teach your\lPokémon moves inside the book,\lbut I must’ve misplaced it.

Please, take these as my thanks!"
entries.translation_source: My notebook! You found it! I had recorded the different people in Borrius who could teach your Pokémon moves inside the book, but I must’ve misplaced it. Please, take these as my thanks!
entries.translated:
Buku catatanku! Kamu menemukannya!
Saya telah mencatat orang-orang\lberbeda di Borrius yang bisa

mengajarkan gerakan ke Pokémon-mu
di dalam buku itu, tapi saya pasti\lsalah meletakkannya. Tolong,

terimalah ini sebagai tanda terima
kasihku!

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the Notebook
and the Stat Scanner."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over the Notebook and the Stat Scanner.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan Notebook dan
Stat Scanner.

entries.original: "[black][player] handed over the Notebook."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over the Notebook.
entries.translated: [black][player] menyerahkan Notebook.

entries.original:
"Okay! The upgrades are all done!
Please take back your Stat Scanner."
entries.translation_source: Okay! The upgrades are all done! Please take back your Stat Scanner.
entries.translated:
Oke! Peningkatan sudah selesai!
Silakan ambil kembali Stat\lScanner-mu.

entries.original: "[black][player] took back the Stat Scanner."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] took back the Stat Scanner.
entries.translated:
[black][player] mengambil kembali Stat
Scanner.

entries.original:
"With the upgraded [green]Stat Scanner[blue], not
only can you view your Pokémon’s\lhidden stats and moves anywhere in\lthe region, you can also teach\lyour Pokémon moves that would\lotherwise require you to visit a\lcertain place or person!

Just press \btn02 or \btn03 to view the
moves, and then pick one to teach\lwith \btn00.

And of course, for convenience’s
sake, you can still open it quickly\lfrom your [green]party list[blue] with \btn03."
entries.translation_source: With the upgraded [color-green-1]Stat Scanner[color-blue-2], not only can you view your Pokémon’s hidden stats and moves anywhere in the region, you can also teach your Pokémon moves that would otherwise require you to visit a certain place or person! Just press [button-icon-3] or [button-icon-4] to view the moves, and then pick one to teach with [button-icon-5]. And of course, for convenience’s sake, you can still open it quickly from your [color-green-6]party list[color-blue-7] with [button-icon-8].
entries.translated:
Dengan [green]Stat Scanner[blue] yang
ditingkatkan, Anda tidak hanya\ldapat melihat stat tersembunyi dan

gerakan Pokémon Anda di mana saja
di wilayah ini, Anda juga dapat\lmengajarkan gerakan kepada Pokémon

Anda yang sebaliknya memerlukan
kunjungan ke tempat atau orang\ltertentu! Cukup tekan \btn02 atau \btn03

untuk melihat gerakan, lalu pilih
satu untuk diajarkan dengan \btn00. Dan\ltentu saja, demi kenyamanan, Anda

masih dapat membukanya dengan cepat
dari [green]daftar party[blue] Anda dengan \btn03.

entries.original:
"[player], I have wonderful news
for you!

Thanks to the help of\.\CC0818 a certain
organization, I have cracked the\lcode for altering Pokémon stats!

Please, hand over your Stat Scanner
for a moment."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], I have wonderful news for you! Thanks to the help of[game-token-2][control-code-3] a certain organization, I have cracked the code for altering Pokémon stats! Please, hand over your Stat Scanner for a moment.
entries.translated:
[player], saya punya kabar baik
untukmu! Berkat bantuan dari\.\CC0818 sebuah\lorganisasi tertentu, saya telah

memecahkan kode untuk mengubah stat
Pokémon! Tolong, serahkan Stat\lScanner-mu sebentar.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the
Stat Scanner."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over the Stat Scanner.
entries.translated: [black][player] menyerahkan Stat Scanner.

entries.original:
"With the fully upgraded [green]Stat
Scanner[blue], you can modify virtually\lany aspect of your Pokémon!

Just press \btn00 on the Pokémon you
wish to edit, and you’ll be able to\lalter its Ability, Nature, Gender,\lLevel, EVs, IVs, and even its\lHidden Power with ease!

And of course, after pressing \btn02 or
\btn03, you can still teach your\lPokémon new attacks."
entries.translation_source: With the fully upgraded [color-green-1]Stat Scanner[color-blue-2], you can modify virtually any aspect of your Pokémon! Just press [button-icon-3] on the Pokémon you wish to edit, and you’ll be able to alter its Ability, Nature, Gender, Level, EVs, IVs, and even its Hidden Power with ease! And of course, after pressing [button-icon-4] or [button-icon-5], you can still teach your Pokémon new attacks.
entries.translated:
Dengan [green]Stat Scanner[blue] yang
ditingkatkan sepenuhnya, Anda dapat\lmemodifikasi hampir semua aspek

Pokémon Anda! Cukup tekan \btn00 pada
Pokémon yang ingin Anda edit, dan\lAnda akan dapat mengubah Ability,

Nature, Gender, Level, EVs, IVs,
dan bahkan Hidden Power-nya dengan\lmudah! Dan tentu saja, setelah

menekan \btn02 atau \btn03, Anda masih dapat
mengajarkan serangan baru kepada\lPokémon Anda.

entries.original:
"Feel free to come back and view
your Pokémon’s stats any time."
entries.translation_source: Feel free to come back and view your Pokémon’s stats any time.
entries.translated:
Silakan kembali dan lihat stat
Pokémon-mu kapan saja.

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Did you know your Pokémon stats
can grow in more ways that just by\lleveling up?

When you defeat Pokémon in battle,
your team will gain hidden stats\lcorresponding to the Pokémon you\ldefeated.

These stats can also be increased
by using vitamins like Protein.

In fact, Prof. Log and I developed
a device capable of viewing these\lhidden stats, but a [green]vanilla[blue] Trainer\llike you shouldn’t worry about them\lat all.

So just go out and enjoy using
whatever you catch!"
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player-name-1]! Did you know your Pokémon stats can grow in more ways that just by leveling up? When you defeat Pokémon in battle, your team will gain hidden stats corresponding to the Pokémon you defeated. These stats can also be increased by using vitamins like Protein. In fact, Prof. Log and I developed a device capable of viewing these hidden stats, but a [color-green-2]vanilla[color-blue-3] Trainer like you shouldn’t worry about them at all. So just go out and enjoy using whatever you catch!
entries.translated:
Hai, [player]! Tahukah kamu kalau
statistik Pokémon-mu bisa tumbuh\llebih dari sekadar naik level? Saat

kamu mengalahkan Pokémon dalam
pertarungan, timmu akan mendapatkan\lstat tersembunyi yang sesuai dengan

Pokémon yang kamu kalahkan. Stat
ini juga bisa ditingkatkan dengan\lmenggunakan vitamin seperti

Protein. Faktanya, Prof. Log dan
saya mengembangkan perangkat yang\lbisa melihat stat tersembunyi ini,

tapi seorang Pelatih [green]biasa[blue]
sepertimu tidak perlu khawatir\ltentang itu sama sekali. Jadi

keluarlah dan nikmati apa pun yang
kamu tangkap!

entries.original:
"Prof. Log has spent many years
studying Pokémon stats.

He even managed to upgrade the
Pokédex to display the base stats\lof every Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Prof. Log has spent many years studying Pokémon stats. He even managed to upgrade the Pokédex to display the base stats of every Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Prof. Log telah menghabiskan
bertahun-tahun mempelajari\lstatistik Pokémon. Dia bahkan

berhasil meningkatkan Pokédex untuk
menampilkan stat dasar setiap\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"You’re still getting started on
this mission!

That’s okay!
You’ll see more in due time."
entries.translation_source: You’re still getting started on this mission! That’s okay! You’ll see more in due time.

entries.original:
"There are many more Pokémon in the
West Borrius Pokédex to be found!

Keep looking!
I’m sure you’ll find more."
entries.translation_source: There are many more Pokémon in the West Borrius Pokédex to be found! Keep looking! I’m sure you’ll find more.

entries.original:
"Wow!

You’ve seen over 200 species
so far!

You’re getting much closer to
seeing every Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! You’ve seen over 200 species so far! You’re getting much closer to seeing every Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Amazing!

You’ve seen over half of the
Pokémon in West Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Amazing! You’ve seen over half of the Pokémon in West Borrius!

entries.original:
"Just a few more Pokémon to go
before you will have seen every\lPokémon in West Borrius!

Keep up the diligent work!"
entries.translation_source: Just a few more Pokémon to go before you will have seen every Pokémon in West Borrius! Keep up the diligent work!

entries.original:
"You’ve seen every Pokémon in the
West Borrius Pokédex!

Congratulations!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve seen every Pokémon in the West Borrius Pokédex! Congratulations!
entries.translated:
Kamu telah melihat semua Pokémon di
Pokédex Borrius Barat! Selamat!

entries.original:
"You’ve captured every Pokémon in
listed in the Pokédex!

Ho ho ho!

You are truly a magnificent
Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve captured every Pokémon in listed in the Pokédex! Ho ho ho! You are truly a magnificent Trainer!
entries.translated:
Kamu telah menangkap semua Pokémon
yang terdaftar di Pokédex! Ho ho\lho! Kamu benar-benar seorang

Pelatih yang luar biasa!

entries.original:
"Come by my lab when you get a
chance.

I have a reward for all your
hard work!"
entries.translation_source: Come by my lab when you get a chance. I have a reward for all your hard work!
entries.translated:
Datanglah ke lab saya jika ada
kesempatan. Saya punya hadiah untuk\lsemua kerja kerasmu!

entries.original: "Lost Tunnel"
entries.translation_source: Lost Tunnel
entries.translated: Terowongan Hilang

entries.original:
"A dark and winding tunnel recently
discovered by a lost Hiker.
It connects to the KBT Expressway."
entries.translation_source: A dark and winding tunnel recently discovered by a lost Hiker. It connects to the KBT Expressway.

entries.original:
"Who dares enter the domain of the
Moleman?

Hmm? It’s you\. the surface-dweller
known as the Champion of Borrius\.!

For years, my fellow mole people
and I were forced to scrape a\lliving from mining these walls.

And yet, you have come here to
take our spoils for yourselves!?

Bah! Very well - take this with you,
but you shall have nothing else!"
entries.translation_source: Who dares enter the domain of the Moleman? Hmm? It’s you[game-token-1] the surface-dweller known as the Champion of Borrius[game-token-2]! For years, my fellow mole people and I were forced to scrape a living from mining these walls. And yet, you have come here to take our spoils for yourselves!? Bah! Very well - take this with you, but you shall have nothing else!
entries.translated:
Siapa yang berani memasuki wilayah
Moleman? Hmm? Itu kamu\. penghuni\lpermukaan yang dikenal sebagai

Juara Borrius\.! Selama
bertahun-tahun, sesama manusia\ltikus tanah saya dan saya dipaksa

untuk mencari nafkah dari
penambangan dinding-dinding ini.\lNamun, kamu datang ke sini untuk

mengambil hasil jerih payah kami
untuk dirimu sendiri!? Bah! Baiklah\l- bawa ini bersamamu, tapi kamu

tidak akan mendapatkan apa-apa
lagi!

entries.original:
"We mine every day, and yet our
findings are meagre\.

Hmph! And so, I have no intention of
offering any more treasure today!

If I must regularly appease you,
surface-dweller, return tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: We mine every day, and yet our findings are meagre[game-token-1] Hmph! And so, I have no intention of offering any more treasure today! If I must regularly appease you, surface-dweller, return tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Kami menambang setiap hari, namun
temuan kami sedikit\. Hmph! Jadi,\lsaya tidak berniat menawarkan lebih

banyak harta hari ini! Jika saya
harus secara rutin memuaskanmu,\lpenghuni permukaan, kembalilah

besok!

entries.original: "Magnolia Fields"
entries.translation_source: Magnolia Fields
entries.translated: Ladang Magnolia

entries.original:
"Feller, you ever wanted to charge
right at yer foe like a raging\lMudsdale?

No sweat, I can teach yer Pokémon
[green]HiHorsepower[red] for [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Feller, you ever wanted to charge right at yer foe like a raging Mudsdale? No sweat, I can teach yer Pokémon [color-green-1]HiHorsepower[color-red-2] for [color-green-3][buffer2-4] [buffer1-5]s[color-red-6]!
entries.translated:
Kawan, kamu pernah ingin menyerbu
langsung ke musuh seperti Mudsdale\lyang mengamuk? Gampang, saya bisa

mengajari Pokémon-mu [green]HiHorsepower[red]
seharga [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[red]!

entries.original:
"Whoop dee doo, which Pokémon’ll
it be?"
entries.translation_source: Whoop dee doo, which Pokémon’ll it be?
entries.translated:
Whoop dee doo, Pokémon mana yang
akan dipilih?

entries.original:
"I always have a hoot chargin’ like
a Mudsdale!"
entries.translation_source: I always have a hoot chargin’ like a Mudsdale!
entries.translated:
Aku selalu asyik menyerbu seperti
Mudsdale!

entries.original:
"You ain’t got enough of those
[green][buffer1]s[red] for this\."
entries.translation_source: You ain’t got enough of those [color-green-1][buffer1-2]s[color-red-3] for this[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak punya cukup [green][buffer1]s[red]
untuk ini\.

entries.original:
"Oh, great Landorus!

Please bless this land, so our
fields may yield crops once again!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, great Landorus! Please bless this land, so our fields may yield crops once again!
entries.translated:
Oh, Landorus yang agung! Tolong
berkahi tanah ini, agar ladang kami\ldapat menghasilkan panen lagi!

entries.original:
"The great Landorus is known as
the \qoGuardian of the Fields.\qc

Lands visited by Landorus grant
such bountiful crops.

If only it would bless our land,
as well."
entries.translation_source: The great Landorus is known as the [quote-open-1]Guardian of the Fields.[quote-close-2] Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops. If only it would bless our land, as well.
entries.translated:
Landorus yang agung dikenal sebagai
\qoPenjaga Ladang.\qc Tanah yang\ldikunjungi Landorus memberikan

panen yang melimpah. Andai saja ia
mau memberkati tanah kami juga.

entries.original:
"They’ve returned!

Those horrible Pokémon that
destroyed our crops!"
entries.translation_source: They’ve returned! Those horrible Pokémon that destroyed our crops!
entries.translated:
Mereka kembali! Pokémon mengerikan
yang menghancurkan tanaman kami!

entries.original: "[black]Tornadus and Thundurus flew off!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Tornadus and Thundurus flew off!
entries.translated: [black]Tornadus dan Thundurus terbang!

entries.original:
"What is this?

Those Pokémon seem to have fled
at the sight of you.

Could they perhaps\. be afraid
of your presence?"
entries.translation_source: What is this? Those Pokémon seem to have fled at the sight of you. Could they perhaps[game-token-1] be afraid of your presence?
entries.translated:
Apa ini? Pokémon itu sepertinya
melarikan diri saat melihatmu.\lMungkinkah mereka\. takut dengan

kehadiranmu?

entries.original:
"Those Pokémon seem to have fled
at the sight of you.

I hope they are not terrorizing
other areas in Borrius\."
entries.translation_source: Those Pokémon seem to have fled at the sight of you. I hope they are not terrorizing other areas in Borrius[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Pokémon itu sepertinya melarikan
diri saat melihatmu. Saya harap\lmereka tidak meneror daerah lain di

Borrius\.

entries.original:
"The great Landorus!

He has returned to bless our crops!"
entries.translation_source: The great Landorus! He has returned to bless our crops!
entries.translated:
Landorus yang agung! Dia telah
kembali untuk memberkati tanaman\lkita!

entries.original:
"The great Landorus has
disappeared!

Oh\. when will it return to bless
our fields?"
entries.translation_source: The great Landorus has disappeared! Oh[game-token-1] when will it return to bless our fields?
entries.translated:
Landorus yang agung telah
menghilang! Oh\. kapan dia akan\lkembali untuk memberkati ladang

kita?

entries.original:
"Now that our fields have received
a blessing from the great Landorus,\lit is only a matter of weeks before\lthe land around here returns to\lits former state.

Thank you, Trainer, for all you’ve
done.

This is the thanks you deserve."
entries.translation_source: Now that our fields have received a blessing from the great Landorus, it is only a matter of weeks before the land around here returns to its former state. Thank you, Trainer, for all you’ve done. This is the thanks you deserve.
entries.translated:
Sekarang ladang kita telah menerima
berkat dari Landorus yang agung,\lhanya masalah beberapa minggu

sebelum tanah di sekitar sini
kembali ke keadaan semula. Terima\lkasih, Pelatih, atas semua yang

telah kamu lakukan. Inilah rasa
terima kasih yang pantas kamu\lterima.

entries.original:
"The [green]Reveal Glass[red] can reveal the
true forms of the Pokémon you\lcaptured.

Take good care of them, Trainer."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Reveal Glass[color-red-2] can reveal the true forms of the Pokémon you captured. Take good care of them, Trainer.
entries.translated:
[green]Kaca Pengungkap[red] dapat mengungkapkan
bentuk asli dari Pokémon yang kamu\ltangkap. Jagalah mereka dengan

baik, Pelatih.

entries.original: "Tornadus"
entries.translation_source: Tornadus
entries.translated: Tornadus

entries.original: "Thundurus"
entries.translation_source: Thundurus
entries.translated: Thundurus

entries.original: "[green]Whhhwhhhwhhh!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Whhhwhhhwhhh!
entries.translated: [green]Whhhwhhhwhhh!

entries.original: "[green]Krrrkrrrkrrak!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Krrrkrrrkrrak!
entries.translated: [green]Krrrkrrrkrrak!

entries.original:
"[black]Summoning the power of the land,
Landorus grew to an enormous size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Summoning the power of the land, Landorus grew to an enormous size!
entries.translated:
[black]Memanggil kekuatan tanah, Landorus
tumbuh menjadi ukuran yang sangat\lbesar!

entries.original:
"[red]Hold it!

See these footprints here?

They’re mine!

I stepped in some dung back on the
farm and tracked it all the way\lout here!

Ain’t they fascinatin’?

I gotta take a pitcher!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Hold it! See these footprints here? They’re mine! I stepped in some dung back on the farm and tracked it all the way out here! Ain’t they fascinatin’? I gotta take a pitcher!
entries.translated:
[red]Tahan! Lihat jejak kaki ini? Itu
milikku! Aku menginjak kotoran di\lpertanian dan melacaknya sampai ke

sini! Bukankah itu menarik? Aku
harus mengambil gambar!

entries.original:
"Always pay close attention to where
you’re walkin’!

You never know when you might step
in some dung!

But lemme tell you, it sure makes
for some fascinatin’ pitchers!"
entries.translation_source: Always pay close attention to where you’re walkin’! You never know when you might step in some dung! But lemme tell you, it sure makes for some fascinatin’ pitchers!
entries.translated:
Selalu perhatikan dengan seksama ke
mana kamu berjalan! Kamu tidak\lpernah tahu kapan kamu mungkin

menginjak kotoran! Tapi biarkan aku
memberitahumu, itu pasti\lmenghasilkan gambar yang menarik!

entries.original: "The Most Dangerous Game"
entries.translation_source: The Most Dangerous Game
entries.translated: Permainan Paling Berbahaya

entries.original:
"Pokémon are the most dangerous
of beasts. Tame them by setting a
record of 25 in the Safari Zone."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon are the most dangerous of beasts. Tame them by setting a record of 25 in the Safari Zone.
entries.translated:
Pokémon adalah yang paling ...
Jinakkan mereka dengan membuat
rekor 25 di Zona Safari.

entries.original:
"Trainer, I am looking for one who
can master the most dangerous of\lbeasts\. Pokémon.

They can shoot fire, summon
lightning, and control your mind.

Truly, the most dangerous game.

Do you think you can get a catch
streak of at least [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon\lin the Safari Zone, and master\lthese creatures?"
entries.translation_source: Trainer, I am looking for one who can master the most dangerous of beasts[game-token-1] Pokémon. They can shoot fire, summon lightning, and control your mind. Truly, the most dangerous game. Do you think you can get a catch streak of at least [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] Pokémon in the Safari Zone, and master these creatures?
entries.translated:
Pelatih, saya mencari seseorang
yang bisa menguasai binatang paling\lberbahaya\. Pokémon. Mereka bisa

menembakkan api, memanggil petir,
dan mengendalikan pikiranmu.\lSungguh, permainan paling

berbahaya. Apakah kamu pikir kamu
bisa mendapatkan rekor tangkapan\lberuntun setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue]

Pokémon di Zona Safari, dan
menguasai makhluk-makhluk ini?

entries.original:
"Good luck, and remember you only
have at most 30 Safari Balls to use\lin one game."
entries.translation_source: Good luck, and remember you only have at most 30 Safari Balls to use in one game.
entries.translated:
Semoga berhasil, dan ingat kamu
hanya memiliki paling banyak 30\lBola Safari untuk digunakan dalam

satu permainan.

entries.original:
"I am sure there is someone out
there who can tame these beasts."
entries.translation_source: I am sure there is someone out there who can tame these beasts.
entries.translated:
Saya yakin ada seseorang di luar
sana yang bisa menjinakkan binatang\lbuas ini.

entries.original:
"I see you currently have no streak
in the Safari Game.

You can play a round of the Safari
Game east of Polder Town."
entries.translation_source: I see you currently have no streak in the Safari Game. You can play a round of the Safari Game east of Polder Town.
entries.translated:
Saya lihat kamu saat ini tidak
memiliki rekor beruntun di\lPermainan Safari. Kamu bisa bermain

satu putaran Permainan Safari di
timur Kota Polder.

entries.original:
"I see you were only able to get a
streak of [green][buffer2][blue] in the Safari Zone.

Unfortunately, that is less than
the [green][buffer1][blue] required to master the most\ldangerous game."
entries.translation_source: I see you were only able to get a streak of [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] in the Safari Zone. Unfortunately, that is less than the [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] required to master the most dangerous game.
entries.translated:
Saya lihat kamu hanya bisa
mendapatkan rekor beruntun [green][buffer2][blue]\ldi Zona Safari. Sayangnya, itu

kurang dari [green][buffer1][blue] yang
diperlukan untuk menguasai\lpermainan paling berbahaya.

entries.original:
"You have truly mastered the
Pokémon hunt.

Here is a reward so you can flaunt
your mastery.

Perhaps these can help you tame
more vicious beasts than the ones\lfound in the Safari Zone."
entries.translation_source: You have truly mastered the Pokémon hunt. Here is a reward so you can flaunt your mastery. Perhaps these can help you tame more vicious beasts than the ones found in the Safari Zone.
entries.translated:
Kamu benar-benar telah menguasai
perburuan Pokémon. Ini hadiah agar\lkamu bisa memamerkan penguasaanmu.

Mungkin ini bisa membantumu
menjinakkan binatang yang lebih\lganas daripada yang ditemukan di

Zona Safari.

entries.original:
"I am going to search the world for
a game more dangerous than Pokémon\lto hunt."
entries.translation_source: I am going to search the world for a game more dangerous than Pokémon to hunt.
entries.translated:
Saya akan mencari di seluruh dunia
untuk permainan yang lebih\lberbahaya daripada Pokémon untuk

diburu.

entries.original:
"When my Furfrou’s hair gets all
mangled, I have Furfrité groom it\lat the [green]Magnolia Cafe[blue].

Now, let me tell you!

That woman is so mysterious!

She just comes and goes whenever
she pleases."
entries.translation_source: When my Furfrou’s hair gets all mangled, I have Furfrité groom it at the [color-green-1]Magnolia Cafe[color-blue-2]. Now, let me tell you! That woman is so mysterious! She just comes and goes whenever she pleases.
entries.translated:
Saat rambut Furfrou-ku kusut, aku
meminta Furfrité merawatnya di\l[green]Magnolia Cafe[blue]. Sekarang, biarkan

aku memberitahumu! Wanita itu
sangat misterius! Dia datang dan\lpergi seenaknya.

entries.original:
"Qwilfish are extremely rare
Pokémon.

They appear here if you fish with
a Super Rod, but you’ll have to\lwait for hours like I did just to\lfind any."
entries.translation_source: Qwilfish are extremely rare Pokémon. They appear here if you fish with a Super Rod, but you’ll have to wait for hours like I did just to find any.
entries.translated:
Qwilfish adalah Pokémon yang sangat
langka. Mereka muncul di sini jika\lkamu memancing dengan Super Rod,

tapi kamu harus menunggu berjam-jam
seperti yang aku lakukan untuk\lmenemukannya.

entries.original:
"Magnolia Fields?

Please, more like Magnolia
Wasteland!

Do you see any crops growin’?

I’m so gosh darn angry, I’m gonna
take it out on you!"
entries.translation_source: Magnolia Fields? Please, more like Magnolia Wasteland! Do you see any crops growin’? I’m so gosh darn angry, I’m gonna take it out on you!
entries.translated:
Magnolia Fields? Ayolah, lebih
seperti Magnolia Wasteland! Apa\lkamu melihat tanaman yang tumbuh?

Aku sangat marah, aku akan
melampiaskannya padamu!

entries.original:
"There haven’t been fields here
in years!"
entries.translation_source: There haven’t been fields here in years!
entries.translated:
Sudah bertahun-tahun tidak ada
ladang di sini!

entries.original:
"The great bein’ that used to bless
our crops vanished a while back.

The fields have been dried up,
ever since."
entries.translation_source: The great bein’ that used to bless our crops vanished a while back. The fields have been dried up, ever since.
entries.translated:
Makhluk agung yang dulu memberkati
tanaman kami menghilang beberapa\lwaktu lalu. Ladang-ladang itu

menjadi kering sejak saat itu.

entries.original:
"Did you know?

Male Unfezant look different than
female Unfezant.

Here, let me show you!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know? Male Unfezant look different than female Unfezant. Here, let me show you!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu? Unfezant jantan
terlihat berbeda dari Unfezant\lbetina. Di sini, biarkan aku

tunjukkan!

entries.original:
"Or, I would have shown you, if I
had different Unfezant\."
entries.translation_source: Or, I would have shown you, if I had different Unfezant[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Atau, aku akan menunjukkannya
padamu, jika aku memiliki Unfezant\lyang berbeda\.

entries.original:
"Female Unfezant are known for their
stamina, while the males outclass\lthem in terms of speed.

Between you and me, I’ve never seen
a difference in battle."
entries.translation_source: Female Unfezant are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed. Between you and me, I’ve never seen a difference in battle.
entries.translated:
Unfezant betina dikenal karena
stamina mereka, sementara yang\ljantan lebih unggul dalam hal

kecepatan. Antara kamu dan aku, aku
tidak pernah melihat perbedaan\ldalam pertempuran.

entries.original:
"I felt something prickly while I
was swimming!

Was that sensation not caused by
Jellicent?"
entries.translation_source: I felt something prickly while I was swimming! Was that sensation not caused by Jellicent?
entries.translated:
Aku merasakan sesuatu yang menusuk
saat berenang! Apakah sensasi itu\ltidak disebabkan oleh Jellicent?

entries.original:
"I like to bash my head on trees.

Sometimes, rare Pokémon pop out!"
entries.translation_source: I like to bash my head on trees. Sometimes, rare Pokémon pop out!
entries.translated:

pohon. Kadang-kadang, Pokémon\llangka muncul!

entries.original:
"Ow\.
I think I hurt my head\."
entries.translation_source: Ow[game-token-1] I think I hurt my head[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Aduh\. Kurasa kepalaku sakit\.

entries.original:
"I found my Pokémon when I bashed
my head against a tree in Redwood\lVillage!"
entries.translation_source: I found my Pokémon when I bashed my head against a tree in Redwood Village!
entries.translated:

membenturkan kepalaku ke pohon di\lRedwood Village!

"Scour both West and East Borrius to
find the Vivillon hidden about."
entries.translation_source: Scour both West and East Borrius to find the Vivillon hidden about.

Timur untuk menemukan Vivillon

entries.original:
"I have a dream\.

I’ve had it for many years, yet
no one has been able to make it\la reality\.

Would you like to hear about
my dream?"
entries.translation_source: I have a dream[game-token-1] I’ve had it for many years, yet no one has been able to make it a reality[game-token-2] Would you like to hear about my dream?
entries.translated:
Aku punya mimpi\. Aku sudah
memimpikannya selama\lbertahun-tahun, namun tidak ada

yang bisa mewujudkannya\. Apakah kamu
ingin mendengar tentang mimpiku?

entries.original:
"You see\.

I have spent many years of my life
scouring the world in search of\lthe many different Vivillon.

Vivillon is a special Pokémon -
it has many different appearances.

Meadow, Archipelago, Continental,
Elegant, Garden, High Plains, Icy\lSnow, Jungle, Marine, Modern,\lMonsoon, Ocean, Polar, River,\lSandstorm, Savanna, Sun, Tundra,\lFancy, and one final special one.

And after many years, I have
succeeded in finding them all.

Of these 20 forms, I have hidden 19
of them around Borrius.

Do you think you’re up to the
challenge of hunting my Vivillon?

You do not need to capture them,
although, if you’re a collector\llike myself, you may wish to."
entries.translation_source: You see[game-token-1] I have spent many years of my life scouring the world in search of the many different Vivillon. Vivillon is a special Pokémon - it has many different appearances. Meadow, Archipelago, Continental, Elegant, Garden, High Plains, Icy Snow, Jungle, Marine, Modern, Monsoon, Ocean, Polar, River, Sandstorm, Savanna, Sun, Tundra, Fancy, and one final special one. And after many years, I have succeeded in finding them all. Of these 20 forms, I have hidden 19 of them around Borrius. Do you think you’re up to the challenge of hunting my Vivillon? You do not need to capture them, although, if you’re a collector like myself, you may wish to.
entries.translated:
Kamu lihat\. Aku telah menghabiskan
bertahun-tahun hidupku menjelajahi\ldunia untuk mencari berbagai bentuk

Vivillon. Vivillon adalah Pokémon
istimewa - ia memiliki banyak\lpenampilan berbeda. Meadow,

Archipelago, Continental, Elegant,
Garden, High Plains, Icy Snow,\lJungle, Marine, Modern, Monsoon,

Ocean, Polar, River, Sandstorm,
Savanna, Sun, Tundra, Fancy, dan\lsatu bentuk istimewa terakhir. Dan

setelah bertahun-tahun, aku
berhasil menemukan semuanya. Dari\l20 bentuk ini, aku telah

menyembunyikan 19 di antaranya di
sekitar Borrius. Apakah kamu pikir\lkamu sanggup menghadapi tantangan

berburu Vivillon-ku? Kamu tidak
perlu menangkapnya, meskipun, jika\lkamu seorang kolektor seperti aku,

kamu mungkin ingin melakukannya.

entries.original:
"Magnificent.

Scour both West and East Borrius to
find the Vivillon I have hidden.

When you have captured or defeated
all of them in battle, return here."
entries.translation_source: Magnificent. Scour both West and East Borrius to find the Vivillon I have hidden. When you have captured or defeated all of them in battle, return here.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa. Jelajahi Borrius Barat
dan Timur untuk menemukan Vivillon\lyang aku sembunyikan. Setelah kamu

menangkap atau mengalahkan semuanya
dalam pertempuran, kembalilah ke\lsini.

entries.original:
"I see\.

So, you’re no different than all
the rest\."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] So, you’re no different than all the rest[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku mengerti\. Jadi, kamu tidak
berbeda dari yang lain\.

entries.original:
"You still have not finished
locating the Vivillon I scattered\lthroughout Borrius.

Of the [green][buffer2][blue] forms I hid, you have
only captured [green][buffer1][blue] so far.

I’ve hidden the following forms
around Borrius:

Meadow, Archipelago, Continental,
Elegant, Garden, High Plains, Icy\lSnow, Jungle, Marine, Modern,\lMonsoon, Ocean, Polar, River,\lSandstorm, Savanna, Sun, Tundra,\land Fancy."
entries.translation_source: You still have not finished locating the Vivillon I scattered throughout Borrius. Of the [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] forms I hid, you have only captured [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] so far. I’ve hidden the following forms around Borrius: Meadow, Archipelago, Continental, Elegant, Garden, High Plains, Icy Snow, Jungle, Marine, Modern, Monsoon, Ocean, Polar, River, Sandstorm, Savanna, Sun, Tundra, and Fancy.
entries.translated:

Vivillon yang aku sebarkan di\lseluruh Borrius. Dari [green][buffer2][blue]

bentuk yang aku sembunyikan, kamu
baru menangkap [green][buffer1][blue] sejauh ini.\lAku telah menyembunyikan

bentuk-bentuk berikut di sekitar
Borrius: Meadow, Archipelago,\lContinental, Elegant, Garden, High

Plains, Icy Snow, Jungle, Marine,
Modern, Monsoon, Ocean, Polar,\lRiver, Sandstorm, Savanna, Sun,

Tundra, dan Fancy.

Vivillon as a gift from me."
entries.translation_source: Magnificent[game-token-1] You’ve made my dream a reality. Please, take this one final Vivillon as a gift from me.
entries.translated:

mimpiku. Silakan, ambil Vivillon\lterakhir ini sebagai hadiah dariku.

entries.original:
"Magnificent\.
You’ve made my dream a reality.

However\.

The gift I would like to give you
needs an open space in your party."
entries.translation_source: Magnificent[game-token-1] You’ve made my dream a reality. However[game-token-2] The gift I would like to give you needs an open space in your party.
entries.translated:

mimpiku. Namun\. Hadiah yang ingin\lkuberikan kepadamu membutuhkan

ruang kosong di timmu.

entries.original:
"Thanks to you, my dream has been
made a reality.

I am now at peace\."
entries.translation_source: Thanks to you, my dream has been made a reality. I am now at peace[game-token-1]
entries.translated:

kenyataan. Aku sekarang merasa\ltenang\.

Furfrou terkenal yang dikenal\lsebagai Furfité. Dengan [green]$[buffer1][red],

aku bisa memberikan tampilan unik
pada Furfrou-mu. Nah, apakah kamu\lmemiliki [green]Furfrou[red] yang ingin aku

ini.

sangat membutuhkan lebih banyak,
saya selalu bisa menjualnya\lkepadamu\. Saya yakin Pria Penitipan

Pokémon tidak akan keberatan dengan

tangannya. Sebaiknya kembalikan\lkepada pemiliknya yang sah!

Aku adalah peternak master! Apa

entries.translated:
Itu berarti aku adalah master dari

entries.translated:
Pokémonku sangat bersemangat! Kami

"Do you love the Pokémon Eevee?

But I always wondered, why is Eevee

this Z-Crystal for instance.

It gets all this special attention. I know it’s cute and all, but take this Z-Crystal for instance. Why does Eevee get one? Oh, well[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu menyukai Pokémon Eevee?
Tentu saja! Aku tidak memilikinya,\ltapi aku tetap penggemar beratnya.

Tapi aku selalu bertanya-tanya,
kenapa Eevee begitu populer? Ia\lmendapatkan perhatian khusus ini.

Aku tahu dia imut dan sebagainya,
tapi ambil contoh Z-Crystal ini.\lKenapa Eevee mendapatkannya? Oh,

baiklah\.

entries.original:
"Now you have the Z-Crystal meant
for Eevee!

of my head\."
entries.translation_source: Now you have the Z-Crystal meant for Eevee! I can worry less now that it’s out of my head[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sekarang kamu memiliki Z-Crystal
yang ditujukan untuk Eevee! Aku\lbisa kurang khawatir sekarang

entries.original:
"Heya!

I don’t believe I’ve formally
introduced myself.

My name’s Catherine!
But most people call me Cathy.

I came here from Kanto with my
friend Mahina.

Prof. Oak wanted us to complete the
Pokédex, so every day we travel\laround Borrius searching for as\lmany rare Pokémon as we can.

It’s thanks to these travels that I
was able to unlock a hidden power\lliving within my Blastoise.

If you have a Blastoise too,
this’ll help you unlock your\lBlastoise’s hidden potential, too."
entries.translation_source: Heya! I don’t believe I’ve formally introduced myself. My name’s Catherine! But most people call me Cathy. I came here from Kanto with my friend Mahina. Prof. Oak wanted us to complete the Pokédex, so every day we travel around Borrius searching for as many rare Pokémon as we can. It’s thanks to these travels that I was able to unlock a hidden power living within my Blastoise. If you have a Blastoise too, this’ll help you unlock your Blastoise’s hidden potential, too.
entries.translated:
Hei! Sepertinya aku belum pernah
memperkenalkan diri secara resmi.\lNamaku Catherine! Tapi kebanyakan

orang memanggilku Cathy. Aku datang
ke sini dari Kanto bersama temanku\lMahina. Profesor Oak ingin kami

melengkapi Pokédex, jadi setiap
hari kami bepergian keliling\lBorrius untuk mencari sebanyak

mungkin Pokémon langka yang kami
bisa. Berkat perjalanan-perjalanan\linilah aku bisa membuka kekuatan

tersembunyi yang hidup di dalam
Blastoise-ku. Jika Anda juga\lmemiliki Blastoise, ini akan

membantu Anda membuka potensi
tersembunyi Blastoise Anda juga.

entries.original:
"I like battling in Hidden Grottos
with my Blastoise, so if you ever\lfind yourself in one, let’s team\lup and fight together!

We make a powerful team.

But I prefer to only use Blastoise
when absolutely necessary."
entries.translation_source: I like battling in Hidden Grottos with my Blastoise, so if you ever find yourself in one, let’s team up and fight together! We make a powerful team. But I prefer to only use Blastoise when absolutely necessary.
entries.translated:
Saya suka bertarung di Gua
Tersembunyi bersama Blastoise saya,\ljadi jika kamu menemukan dirimu di

salah satunya, mari kita bekerja
sama dan bertarung bersama! Kita\lmembentuk tim yang kuat. Tapi saya

lebih suka hanya menggunakan
Blastoise saat benar-benar\ldiperlukan.

entries.original:
"Abimbola!

What’s an Abimbola?

But my friends call me Abimbol
for short. I love it!

I think you should take this for
listening to me tell you all\labout my name!"
entries.translation_source: Abimbola! That’s my name! What’s an Abimbola? Beats me! But my friends call me Abimbol for short. I love it! I think you should take this for listening to me tell you all about my name!

Abimbola! Itu namaku! Apa itu
Abimbola? Entahlah! Tapi\lteman-temanku memanggilku Abimbol

untuk pendek. Aku suka! Aku pikir
kau harus ambil ini karena telah\lmendengarkan aku menceritakan semua

Kamu kelihatan seperti Pelatih yang

Tersembunyi, jadi jika kamu melihat
aku ada di sana juga, pilih aku\luntuk bertarung! Aku suka memulai

Jadi, kamu telah memilih untuk
berbicara dengan aku, Alford yang\lagung dan mulia. Karena

agung. Pokémon yang saya bawa ini\lmendefinisikan siapa saya. Jika

Anda memerlukan bantuan, jangan

Temanku, Cathy dan aku datang ke

dan ditugaskan untuk melengkapi
Pokédex. Selama perjalananku, aku\lmemperdalam ikatanku dengan

Venusaur-ku, dan sekarang kami
bertarung sebagai satu kesatuan.\lJika kamu memiliki Venusaur seperti

milikku, kamu mungkin menemukan ini

Yah, kurasa kau punya hal yang

Saya seorang agen, spesialis dalam

saja saya tahu kualitasnya setinggi\lini sebelumnya\.

Itu bukan [green][buffer1][blue] - apa yang harus

bagian akhir yang kubutuhkan.

entries.translated:
Ah, kau benar-benar penyelamat,
serius!

Ngomong-ngomong, bagaimana biasanya

MERASAKAN kopi itu memberiku
energi, beri aku dorongan untuk\lmenyelesaikan apa yang kumulai.

oke?

Granbull mencoba mengambil tempat

lagi, jika mereka tahu apa yang

[player]."

[player].

Saya hanya mengunjungi kafe sebelum
saya harus melaksanakan tugas saya\lsebagai Pemimpin Gym. Terakhir

kali, saya mundur ke usia yang

mereka.

Saya diperintahkan oleh Liga untuk

permukaan.

our oppressors, before they drove\lus underground\.

Tch\. but it shall not avail you,

besarnya. Ini aku sumpah, atas nama
semua orang tahi lalat!

"I admit that the coffee here\.

Saya akui bahwa kopi di sini\.
bukanlah sesuatu yang saya tidak\lsuka. Ini sangat mengingatkan saya

pada sepiring tanah yang dibuat ibu
saya di masa muda saya. Mungkin\lsaya akan menjadikannya

satu-satunya milik dunia permukaan,
setelah balas dendam kita sudah\ldekat\.

hah\."

Itu [green]Ghostium Z[blue] adalah pelanggan

Apakah kamu tahu Liga tidak
membayar saya untuk apa pun lagi?\lSaya sudah mati, jadi saya tidak

butuh makanan, dan saya tidak
lelah, jadi saya tidak tidur, jadi\lsaya tidak butuh tempat tinggal,

jadi saya tidak butuh uang sewa.

dan benda bodoh ini inginkan\. Yang
termasuk mendapatkan kopi\. Yang\lbahkan bukan untuk saya\. Dan dibayar

oleh inang saya dengan mencuri dari
pelanggan lain.

[player]! Kamu datang untuk pesta

[green]Fairium Z[red] memiliki semua kekuatan

Daddy said I shouldn’t bring any food

So I just bought all the different
tea here, and had a big tea party\lwith all my friends!

teh yang berbeda di sini, dan

\.

Aku tidak tahu apa yang kamu

Kita harus menemukan

kabur dari sini!

Hei! Kamu pikir kamu siapa? Kamu
pikir kamu bisa lolos dengan\lmengunciku di sini? Lebih baik kau

biarkan aku lewat sekarang, atau
kamu akan merasakan amarahku!

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Back off, kid. I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Mundur, nak. Aku diperintahkan
dengan ketat untuk menguncimu.

"So scram, unless you want

entries.translated:
Jadi pergi, kecuali kau ingin\.\CC0820
merasakan amarahku.

Keep far away from this door,
and you won’t regret it."
entries.translation_source: Smart choice. Keep far away from this door, and you won’t regret it.
entries.translated:
Pilihan cerdas. Jauhi pintu ini,
dan kau tidak akan menyesal.

Pretty sure I was by myself
when they threw me in here.

\.

[player], huh?

in here by a magic portal?

Hah? Siapa kamu? Yakin aku
sendirian saat mereka melemparkanku\lke sini. \. [player], ya? Dan kamu

bilang kamu tersedot ke sini oleh
portal ajaib? Itu masuk yang cukup\ldramatis.

Hei\. Pakaian itu\. Apakah kamu tinggal

mampir untuk menyapa.

myself, partner.

Hei\.\CC0818 bagaimana kalau kita berteman
dan mencari jalan keluar bersama?\lPintu di belakang sana macet karena

penjaga itu. Oh ya, sepertinya aku
harus memperkenalkan diri, kawan.\lNamaku adalah\.

thought these people would have\la lead on them.

it when people go snooping.

Anyway, we’d better start looking
for another exit, so let’s move."
entries.translation_source: My name’s [text-token-rival-1]. I’m looking for my parents, and I thought these people would have a lead on them. And, well[game-token-2][control-code-3] you can see they hate it when people go snooping. Anyway, we’d better start looking for another exit, so let’s move.

Namaku [rival]. Aku mencari orang
tuaku, dan kupikir orang-orang ini\lakan tahu tentang mereka. Dan, yah\.\CC0818

kamu bisa lihat mereka benci kalau
orang mengintai. Pokoknya, kita\lsebaiknya mulai mencari pintu

keluar lain, jadi ayo bergerak.

"À.

We’d better look for another way
out of here."

Let’s go check it out."

Apakah kamu mendengar itu,
[player]? Kedengarannya ada\lbeberapa Pokémon yang terperangkap

di dalam kandang di sana! Ayo kita
periksa.

Ada banyak Pokémon yang terkunci di
dalam kandang\.

Pintu kandang tidak terkunci.
Pokémon-nya sudah pergi.

Break it?"

Bola Pokémon yang aku kumpulkan,\lkita bisa menggunakannya untuk

mendapat perintah ketat untuk\lmengurung kalian.

entries.original:
"Heh heh heh\.

You don’t really have a choice
anymore.

You’re gonna let us out, or get your
sorry butt handed to you."
entries.translation_source: Heh heh heh[game-token-1] You don’t really have a choice anymore. You’re gonna let us out, or get your sorry butt handed to you.
entries.translated:
Heh heh heh\. Kalian tidak punya
pilihan lagi. Kalian akan\lmembiarkan kami keluar, atau pantat

kalian akan dihajar.

entries.original:
"Quit fooling yourself.

There’s nothing you can do to make
me let you through."
entries.translation_source: Quit fooling yourself. There’s nothing you can do to make me let you through.
entries.translated:
Berhentilah membodohi diri sendiri.
Tidak ada yang bisa kalian lakukan\luntuk membuatku membiarkan kalian

lewat.

entries.original:
"[player], let’s team up and show
this guy what we can do!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], let’s team up and show this guy what we can do!
entries.translated:
[player], ayo kita bekerja sama dan
tunjukkan pada orang ini apa yang\lbisa kita lakukan!

entries.original:
"You both are really starting
to get on my nerves!

Inkay! Skorupi!

Show them why you don’t mess
with the [black]Shadows[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: You both are really starting to get on my nerves! Inkay! Skorupi! Show them why you don’t mess with the [color-black-1]Shadows[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Kalian berdua benar-benar mulai
membuatku kesal! Inkay! Skorupi!\lTunjukkan pada mereka mengapa

kalian tidak boleh macam-macam
dengan [black]Shadows[blue]!

entries.original:
"I knew it was a bad idea to lock
them up in here\."
entries.translation_source: I knew it was a bad idea to lock them up in here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku tahu itu ide buruk untuk
mengurung mereka di sini\.

entries.original:
"That’s what you get for messing
with the Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: That’s what you get for messing with the Shadows!
entries.translated:
Itulah yang kamu dapat karena
macam-macam dengan Shadows!

entries.original:
"Not bad, [player]!
You and I make a pretty good team!

But I’ll take it from here.

Let me use these items on your
Pokémon to heal it from the fight."
entries.translation_source: Not bad, [player-name-1]! You and I make a pretty good team! But I’ll take it from here. Let me use these items on your Pokémon to heal it from the fight.
entries.translated:
Tidak buruk, [player]! Kau dan aku
menjadi tim yang cukup baik! Tapi\lbiarkan aku yang melanjutkannya

dari sini. Biarkan aku menggunakan
item ini pada Pokémonmu untuk\lmenyembuhkannya dari pertarungan.

entries.original:
"That’s a letdown.

I really thought you and I could
handle him together.

I guess I’ll deal with him myself.

Use this Potion on your Pokémon
to make it feel better."
entries.translation_source: That’s a letdown. I really thought you and I could handle him together. I guess I’ll deal with him myself. Use this Potion on your Pokémon to make it feel better.
entries.translated:
Itu mengecewakan. Aku benar-benar
berpikir kau dan aku bisa\lmenghadapinya bersama. Sepertinya

aku akan menghadapinya sendiri.
Gunakan Ramuan ini pada Pokémonmu\luntuk membuatnya merasa lebih baik.

entries.original:
"No!
My Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: No! My Pokémon!
entries.translated: Tidak! Pokémon-ku!

entries.original:
"No!
My Inkay!"
entries.translation_source: No! My Inkay!
entries.translated: Tidak! Inkay-ku!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]!
Move in and strike!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! Move in and strike!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Mendekat dan serang!

entries.original: "[buffer1]! Use [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! Use [buffer2-2]!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Gunakan [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Alright, alright, I give up!
I’ll let you through!

Please, have mercy on me!
Don’t hurt me anymore! Please!"
entries.translation_source: Alright, alright, I give up! I’ll let you through! Please, have mercy on me! Don’t hurt me anymore! Please!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, baiklah, aku menyerah!
Akan kubiarkan kamu lewat! Tolong,\lkasihanilah aku! Jangan sakiti aku

lagi! Tolong!

entries.original: "[buffer1]! Return!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! Return!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Kembali!

entries.original:
"I’m getting out of here now,
[player].

I’m sure you’re capable of taking
care of yourself from here on out.

If you run into any trouble, just
use your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m getting out of here now, [player-name-1]. I’m sure you’re capable of taking care of yourself from here on out. If you run into any trouble, just use your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku akan pergi dari sini sekarang,
[player]. Aku yakin kamu mampu\lmenjaga dirimu sendiri mulai

sekarang. Jika kamu menghadapi
masalah, gunakan saja Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You impressed me when we battled
together, so I want to see how I’ll\lfare against you.

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You impressed me when we battled together, so I want to see how I’ll fare against you. Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
Oh, satu hal lagi. Begitu kamu
sampai di rumah, kita akan\lbertarung. Kamu membuatku terkesan

saat kita bertarung bersama, jadi
aku ingin tahu bagaimana aku akan\lmenghadapimu. Sampai saat itu,

jangan terlalu memaksakan dirimu.

entries.original:
"Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You have a lot to learn about
battling, and I wouldn’t mind\lshowing you a thing or two.

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You have a lot to learn about battling, and I wouldn’t mind showing you a thing or two. Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
Oh, satu hal lagi. Begitu kamu
sampai di rumah, kita akan\lbertarung. Kamu masih banyak yang

harus dipelajari tentang bertarung,
dan aku tidak keberatan menunjukkan\lbeberapa hal. Sampai saat itu,

jangan terlalu memaksakan dirimu.

entries.original:
"Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You torchickened out earlier, but I
won’t let you skip out next time!

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You torchickened out earlier, but I won’t let you skip out next time! Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
Oh, satu hal lagi. Begitu kamu
sampai di rumah, kita akan\lbertarung. Kamu mengecut

sebelumnya, tapi aku tidak akan
membiarkanmu kabur lain kali!\lSampai saat itu, jangan terlalu

memaksakan dirimu.

entries.original: "Now burn it."
entries.translation_source: Now burn it.
entries.translated: Sekarang bakar itu.

entries.original:
"[red]As you observed, these specimens
are completely immune to extreme\lcold and extreme heat."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]As you observed, these specimens are completely immune to extreme cold and extreme heat.
entries.translated:
[red]Seperti yang kamu amati, spesimen
ini sepenuhnya kebal terhadap suhu\ldingin dan panas yang ekstrem.

entries.original:
"What about the immunity to
electricity?"
entries.translation_source: What about the immunity to electricity?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana dengan kekebalan terhadap
listrik?

entries.original:
"[red]We have yet to complete that, sir.

It is difficult to enhance the
specimens quickly when we have our\lexternal research as well."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]We have yet to complete that, sir. It is difficult to enhance the specimens quickly when we have our external research as well.
entries.translated:
[red]Kami belum menyelesaikannya, Tuan.
Sulit untuk meningkatkan spesimen\ldengan cepat ketika kami juga

memiliki penelitian eksternal.

entries.original:
"Very well.
This will do for now."
entries.translation_source: Very well. This will do for now.
entries.translated: Baik. Ini cukup untuk sekarang.

entries.original:
"Ah, Marlon, perfect timing.

We’re moving up our timetable.

I’m unsure as to why, but our target
seems to have relocated to our\lvicinity earlier than anticipated.

With the Shadow Warriors enhanced
and the package we need arriving\ltoday, we can begin the operation."
entries.translation_source: Ah, Marlon, perfect timing. We’re moving up our timetable. I’m unsure as to why, but our target seems to have relocated to our vicinity earlier than anticipated. With the Shadow Warriors enhanced and the package we need arriving today, we can begin the operation.
entries.translated:
Ah, Marlon, waktu yang tepat. Kami
memajukan jadwal kami. Aku tidak\lyakin kenapa, tapi target kami

tampaknya sudah pindah ke sekitar
kita lebih awal dari yang\ldiperkirakan. Dengan Shadow

Warriors yang sudah ditingkatkan
dan paket yang kita butuhkan tiba\lhari ini, kita bisa memulai

operasi.

entries.original:
"Understood.

There’s just one more thing to
discuss before I head out.

The trespassers we locked up
in the warehouse have escaped."
entries.translation_source: Understood. There’s just one more thing to discuss before I head out. The trespassers we locked up in the warehouse have escaped.
entries.translated:
Dimengerti. Ada satu hal lagi yang
perlu dibahas sebelum aku\lberangkat. Para penyusup yang kita

kunci di gudang telah melarikan
diri.

entries.original:
"This grunt over here let them
get away."
entries.translation_source: This grunt over here let them get away.
entries.translated:
Anggota bawah ini yang membiarkan
mereka kabur.

entries.original:
"How bad is it?
What did those two see?"
entries.translation_source: How bad is it? What did those two see?
entries.translated:
Seberapa parah? Apa yang mereka
berdua lihat?

entries.original:
"The first one, the boy with
red hair, saw nothing relevant.

The second one, however\.

If Fey finds out that [buffer2] was in
the lab, she will insist on\lrelocating in the middle of our\loperation.

You know that’s time and resources
we can’t afford\."
entries.translation_source: The first one, the boy with red hair, saw nothing relevant. The second one, however[game-token-1] If Fey finds out that [buffer2-2] was in the lab, she will insist on relocating in the middle of our operation. You know that’s time and resources we can’t afford[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Yang pertama, anak laki-laki
berambut merah, tidak melihat apa\lpun yang relevan. Yang kedua,

bagaimanapun\. Jika Fey tahu bahwa
[buffer2] ada di lab, dia akan\lbersikeras untuk pindah di tengah

operasi kita. Kamu tahu itu waktu
dan sumber daya yang tidak bisa\lkita tanggung\.

entries.original:
"Then make sure Fey doesn’t find
out about what happened.

Our priority right now is obtaining
the package needed for the mission.

We’ll deal with that second one
who escaped at a later time."
entries.translation_source: Then make sure Fey doesn’t find out about what happened. Our priority right now is obtaining the package needed for the mission. We’ll deal with that second one who escaped at a later time.
entries.translated:
Lalu pastikan Fey tidak tahu
tentang apa yang terjadi. Prioritas\lkita sekarang adalah mendapatkan

paket yang diperlukan untuk misi.
Kita akan urus yang kedua yang\lkabur itu nanti.

entries.original:
"Understood.

I have a plan to obtain that
package, and it’ll even allow this\lfailure of a grunt here to redeem\lhimself.

Once I have it, I’ll head straight
for the target."
entries.translation_source: Understood. I have a plan to obtain that package, and it’ll even allow this failure of a grunt here to redeem himself. Once I have it, I’ll head straight for the target.
entries.translated:
Dimengerti. Aku punya rencana untuk
mendapatkan paket itu, dan itu\lbahkan akan memungkinkan anggota

rendahan yang gagal ini untuk
menebus dirinya. Setelah aku\lmendapatkannya, aku akan langsung

menuju target.

entries.original: "Then good luck, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: Then good luck, Marlon.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu semoga berhasil,
Marlon.

entries.original:
"Close\.\CC0818 We’re getting so close\.

Soon, it won’t be long before that
power finally becomes ours\."
entries.translation_source: Close[game-token-1][control-code-2] We’re getting so close[game-token-3] Soon, it won’t be long before that power finally becomes ours[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Dekat\.\CC0818 Kita semakin dekat\. Sebentar
lagi, tidak akan lama sebelum\lkekuatan itu akhirnya menjadi milik

kita\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
You finally made it out!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You finally made it out!
entries.translated:
[player]! Akhirnya kamu berhasil
keluar!

entries.original:
"Have you met old man Log yet?

He’s supposed to be an expert on
Pokémon’s stats, or whatever\.

I just filled him in on what
happened."
entries.translation_source: Have you met old man Log yet? He’s supposed to be an expert on Pokémon’s stats, or whatever[game-token-1] I just filled him in on what happened.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah bertemu Kakek
Log? Dia seharusnya ahli dalam\lstatistik Pokémon, atau apa pun itu\.

Aku baru saja memberitahunya apa
yang terjadi.

entries.original:
"I study all aspects of Pokémon
stats and capture rates.

And my title is Professor,
not \qoold man\qc!

Anyway, that must have been quite
the ordeal you both went through.

I’m relieved to see both of you
are unharmed.

And it seems you’ve even managed to
acquire rare Pokémon!

I was planning on giving [rival]
