a Pokémon of his own someday,\lbut now I don’t have to!

Ho ho ho!"
entries.translation_source: I study all aspects of Pokémon stats and capture rates. And my title is Professor, not [quote-open-1]old man[quote-close-2]! Anyway, that must have been quite the ordeal you both went through. I’m relieved to see both of you are unharmed. And it seems you’ve even managed to acquire rare Pokémon! I was planning on giving [text-token-rival-3] a Pokémon of his own someday, but now I don’t have to! Ho ho ho!
entries.translated:
Saya mempelajari semua aspek
statistik Pokémon dan tingkat\ltangkap. Dan gelar saya adalah

Profesor, bukan \qokakek\qc! Pokoknya,
pasti itu pengalaman yang berat\lbagi kalian berdua. Saya lega

melihat kalian berdua tidak
terluka. Dan sepertinya kalian\lbahkan berhasil mendapatkan Pokémon

langka! Saya tadinya berencana
memberikan [rival] Pokémon suatu\lhari nanti, tapi sekarang saya

tidak perlu lagi! Ho ho ho!

entries.original:
"Someday?

I’ve been here a whole week,
and I was expecting one ASAP!"
entries.translation_source: Someday? I’ve been here a whole week, and I was expecting one ASAP!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari nanti? Aku sudah di sini
seminggu penuh, dan aku\lmengharapkannya secepatnya!

entries.original:
"Well, of course I was always going
to give you one, [rival]!

There are plenty of errands I’m too
old to run myself, after all!

It’s just that\.\CC0818 you’re insistent
on looking for your parents.

I keep telling you, no one has
seen them in years!

Even if they are somehow still in
Borrius, finding them is much too\lbig a task for you alone.

I was hoping you’d accept that fact
before giving you a Pokémon,\lbut you refuse to listen!"
entries.translation_source: Well, of course I was always going to give you one, [text-token-rival-1]! There are plenty of errands I’m too old to run myself, after all! It’s just that[game-token-2][control-code-3] you’re insistent on looking for your parents. I keep telling you, no one has seen them in years! Even if they are somehow still in Borrius, finding them is much too big a task for you alone. I was hoping you’d accept that fact before giving you a Pokémon, but you refuse to listen!
entries.translated:
Yah, tentu saja saya selalu akan
memberimu satu, [rival]! Lagipula,\lada banyak tugas yang terlalu berat

untuk saya lakukan sendiri di usia
saya! Hanya saja\.\CC0818 kamu bersikeras\lmencari orang tuamu. Saya sudah

bilang, tidak ada yang melihat
mereka selama bertahun-tahun!\lBahkan jika mereka entah bagaimana

masih di Borrius, menemukan mereka
adalah tugas yang terlalu besar\luntukmu sendirian. Saya berharap

kamu mau menerima kenyataan itu
sebelum memberikanmu Pokémon, tapi\lkamu menolak untuk mendengarkan!

entries.original:
"You may be my \qolegal guardian\qc or
whatever in Borrius, but you sure\ldon’t know anything about me!

I’m strong!
Strong enough to fend for myself!

And when I see my parents, they’ll
see just how strong I really am!

Just like you’re about to!"
entries.translation_source: You may be my [quote-open-1]legal guardian[quote-close-2] or whatever in Borrius, but you sure don’t know anything about me! I’m strong! Strong enough to fend for myself! And when I see my parents, they’ll see just how strong I really am! Just like you’re about to!
entries.translated:
Kamu mungkin \qowali sah\qc atau apa
pun di Borrius, tapi kamu pasti\ltidak tahu apa-apa tentang aku! Aku

kuat! Cukup kuat untuk menjaga
diriku sendiri! Dan saat aku\lbertemu orang tuaku, mereka akan

melihat betapa kuatnya aku
sebenarnya! Sama seperti yang akan\lkamu lihat!

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]!

I said I owed you a battle before,
so lemme show you both how a real\lTrainer does it!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player-name-1]! I said I owed you a battle before, so lemme show you both how a real Trainer does it!
entries.translated:
Ayo, [player]! Aku bilang aku
berhutang pertarungan padamu\lsebelumnya, jadi biarkan aku

menunjukkan kepada kalian berdua
bagaimana seorang Pelatih sejati\lmelakukannya!

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]!

I said I’d show you the ropes,
so lemme teach you both how a\lreal Trainer does it!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player-name-1]! I said I’d show you the ropes, so lemme teach you both how a real Trainer does it!
entries.translated:
Ayo, [player]! Aku bilang aku akan
mengajarimu dasar-dasarnya, jadi\lbiarkan aku mengajari kalian berdua

bagaimana seorang Pelatih sejati
melakukannya!

entries.original:
"That was a fine battle.

Very enthralling, if I do say so,
myself."
entries.translation_source: That was a fine battle. Very enthralling, if I do say so, myself.
entries.translated:
Itu pertarungan yang bagus. Sangat
mempesona, menurutku.

entries.original:
"Tch\.\CC0820 no one cares how it made
you feel, old man.

I only care about how strong it made
our Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Tch[game-token-1][control-code-2] no one cares how it made you feel, old man. I only care about how strong it made our Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Cih\.\CC0820 tidak ada yang peduli bagaimana
perasaanmu, kakek. Aku hanya peduli\lseberapa kuat pertarungan itu

membuat Pokémon kita.

entries.original:
"Well\.\CC0818 erm\.

From what I can see, your Pokémon
do have some nice stats\.

I see potential for them to become
strong Pokémon some day."
entries.translation_source: Well[game-token-1][control-code-2] erm[game-token-3] From what I can see, your Pokémon do have some nice stats[game-token-4] I see potential for them to become strong Pokémon some day.
entries.translated:
Yah\.\CC0818 um\. Dari yang saya lihat,
Pokémonmu memiliki statistik yang\lbagus\. Saya melihat potensi bagi

mereka untuk menjadi Pokémon kuat
suatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"Finally, the first useful thing
you’ve said all day.

And it’s gonna be the last, because
I’m outta here."
entries.translation_source: Finally, the first useful thing you’ve said all day. And it’s gonna be the last, because I’m outta here.
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, hal berguna pertama yang
kamu katakan sepanjang hari. Dan\lini akan menjadi yang terakhir,

karena aku pergi dari sini.

entries.original:
"Well, he’s certainly a handful,
isn’t he?

And now that he’s gone, who will
run my errands for me?"
entries.translation_source: Well, he’s certainly a handful, isn’t he? And now that he’s gone, who will run my errands for me?
entries.translated:
Yah, dia memang sulit diatur,
bukan? Dan sekarang dia pergi,\lsiapa yang akan menjalankan

tugas-tugasku?

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, [player].

You seem rather capable\.\CC0818 you should
assist me!

Ah, what a splendid idea, your
father was well known for helping\lothers, after all.

It’s only fitting that his [buffer2]
would follow in his footsteps.

As for the task, there’s a package in
[green]Bellin Town[blue] at the [green]Poké Mart[blue].

I would go get it myself, but my
assistants and I are much too busy\lwith our own research\.

Don’t fret, the clerk knows someone
will be picking it up in my stead.

Since you have your own Pokémon
with you, it should be easy!

But, just in case, this repellent will
make the journey easier for you."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, [player-name-1]. You seem rather capable[game-token-2][control-code-3] you should assist me! Ah, what a splendid idea, your father was well known for helping others, after all. It’s only fitting that his [buffer2-4] would follow in his footsteps. As for the task, there’s a package in [color-green-5]Bellin Town[color-blue-6] at the [color-green-7]Poké Mart[color-blue-8]. I would go get it myself, but my assistants and I are much too busy with our own research[game-token-9] Don’t fret, the clerk knows someone will be picking it up in my stead. Since you have your own Pokémon with you, it should be easy! But, just in case, this repellent will make the journey easier for you.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya, [player]. Kamu tampaknya
cukup cakap\.\CC0818 kamu harus membantuku!\lAh, ide yang hebat, ayahmu terkenal

suka membantu orang lain, bukan?
Pantas saja jika [buffer2]nya\lmengikuti jejaknya. Untuk tugasnya,

ada paket di [green]Bellin Town[blue] di [green]Poké
Mart[blue]. Saya akan mengambilnya\lsendiri, tapi asisten saya dan saya

terlalu sibuk dengan penelitian
kami sendiri\. Jangan khawatir,\lpegawainya tahu seseorang akan

mengambilnya menggantikan saya.
Karena kamu memiliki Pokémon\lsendiri, seharusnya mudah! Tapi,

untuk berjaga-jaga, pengusir ini
akan membuat perjalananmu lebih\lmudah.

entries.original:
"And while you’re at it, you could
assist me with another task!

A fellow Professor, Oak, asked me to
give these to two young Trainers.

It’s an encyclopedia for recording
the data of Pokémon.

Apparently, Borrius has plenty of
Pokémon his own region lacks."
entries.translation_source: And while you’re at it, you could assist me with another task! A fellow Professor, Oak, asked me to give these to two young Trainers. It’s an encyclopedia for recording the data of Pokémon. Apparently, Borrius has plenty of Pokémon his own region lacks.
entries.translated:
Dan selagi kamu melakukannya, kamu
bisa membantuku dengan tugas lain!\lSeorang Profesor, Oak, memintaku

untuk memberikan ini kepada dua
Pelatih muda. Ini adalah\lensiklopedia untuk merekam data

Pokémon. Rupanya, Borrius memiliki
banyak Pokémon yang tidak dimiliki\lwilayahnya sendiri.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Pokédex
from Prof. Log!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Pokédex from Prof. Log!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima Pokédex dari
Prof. Log!

entries.original:
"Personally, I’m content with just
observing species for the Pokédex.

However, if you want complete data
on Pokémon, including their base\lstats, you’ll need to catch them.

So, here are some tools for
catching wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Personally, I’m content with just observing species for the Pokédex. However, if you want complete data on Pokémon, including their base stats, you’ll need to catch them. So, here are some tools for catching wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Secara pribadi, saya puas hanya
mengamati spesies untuk Pokédex.\lNamun, jika Anda ingin data lengkap

tentang Pokémon, termasuk statistik
dasar mereka, Anda harus\lmenangkapnya. Jadi, ini beberapa

alat untuk menangkap Pokémon liar.

entries.original:
"If you’re not in the mood for
catching Pokémon, use that Repel I\lgave you to keep them away.

If you need anything else from me,
I’ll be in my lab.

But before you depart, you should
head home and inform your mother.

She’s been very worried about you.

Good luck, [player].
My studies are depending on you!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re not in the mood for catching Pokémon, use that Repel I gave you to keep them away. If you need anything else from me, I’ll be in my lab. But before you depart, you should head home and inform your mother. She’s been very worried about you. Good luck, [player-name-1]. My studies are depending on you!
entries.translated:
Jika Anda tidak ingin menangkap
Pokémon, gunakan Pengusir yang saya\lberikan untuk mengusir mereka. Jika

Anda butuh sesuatu yang lain dari
saya, saya akan berada di\llaboratorium saya. Tapi sebelum

berangkat, Anda harus pulang dan
memberi tahu ibu Anda. Dia sangat\lmengkhawatirkan Anda. Semoga

berhasil, [player]. Penelitian saya
bergantung pada Anda!

entries.original: "You!"
entries.translation_source: You!
entries.translated: Kamu!

entries.original: "Uh, I mean, excuse me."
entries.translation_source: Uh, I mean, excuse me.
entries.translated: Uh, maksud saya, permisi.

entries.original:
"Hi, there!
May I help you?

\.

Wait\.\CC0818 you’re telling me Prof. Log
sent you to get his package?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, there! May I help you? [game-token-1] Wait[game-token-2][control-code-3] you’re telling me Prof. Log sent you to get his package?
entries.translated:
Hai! Ada yang bisa dibantu? \. Tunggu\.\CC0818
Anda mengatakan Prof. Log mengirim\lAnda untuk mengambil paketnya?

entries.original:
"Uh, oh.
I thought that guy smelled fishy\."
entries.translation_source: Uh, oh. I thought that guy smelled fishy[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Uh, oh. Saya pikir pria itu
mencurigakan\.

entries.original:
"Here’s the deal, kid.

I already gave the package to the
man who was just here.

But if you want to blame anyone for
this mix-up, blame Prof. Log.

I told him he needed to tell me
who he’d be sending, but he just\lkept saying \qosomeone will get it.\qc

There’s nothing I can do for you
at this point, but maybe if you\lchase after that man, you can\lcatch him before he gets too far!"
entries.translation_source: Here’s the deal, kid. I already gave the package to the man who was just here. But if you want to blame anyone for this mix-up, blame Prof. Log. I told him he needed to tell me who he’d be sending, but he just kept saying [quote-open-1]someone will get it.[quote-close-2] There’s nothing I can do for you at this point, but maybe if you chase after that man, you can catch him before he gets too far!
entries.translated:
Begini, nak. Saya sudah memberikan
paket itu kepada pria yang baru\lsaja di sini. Tapi jika Anda ingin

menyalahkan seseorang atas
kekacauan ini, salahkan Prof. Log.\lSaya bilang dia perlu memberi tahu

saya siapa yang akan dia kirim,
tapi dia hanya terus berkata\l\qoseseorang akan mengambilnya.\qc

Tidak ada yang bisa saya lakukan
untuk Anda saat ini, tapi mungkin\ljika Anda mengejar pria itu, Anda

bisa menangkapnya sebelum dia pergi
terlalu jauh!

entries.original:
"Did you receive the package
from the Mart?"
entries.translation_source: Did you receive the package from the Mart?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda menerima paket dari
Mart?

entries.original: "Yes, I did, sir."
entries.translation_source: Yes, I did, sir.
entries.translated: Ya, saya terima, Tuan.

entries.original: "Were you discreet in doing so?"
entries.translation_source: Were you discreet in doing so?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda bersikap hati-hati saat
melakukannya?

entries.original:
"I was, sir.

I even ran into one of the two I
let escape from the warehouse, but\lI chose to avoid a confrontation.

As far as I’m aware, I wasn’t
followed."
entries.translation_source: I was, sir. I even ran into one of the two I let escape from the warehouse, but I chose to avoid a confrontation. As far as I’m aware, I wasn’t followed.
entries.translated:
Saya berhati-hati, Tuan. Saya
bahkan bertemu dengan salah satu\ldari dua yang saya biarkan kabur

dari gudang, tapi saya memilih
untuk menghindari konfrontasi.\lSejauh yang saya tahu, saya tidak

diikuti.

entries.original:
"Good work.

I’d say you’re back on the road to
earning whatever you asked for\lwhen you joined us."
entries.translation_source: Good work. I’d say you’re back on the road to earning whatever you asked for when you joined us.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus. Saya rasa Anda kembali
di jalan untuk mendapatkan apa pun\lyang Anda minta saat bergabung

dengan kami.

entries.original:
"It was a mechanical leg for my
mother, sir."
entries.translation_source: It was a mechanical leg for my mother, sir.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah kaki mekanik untuk ibu
saya, Tuan.

entries.original:
"Legs, arms, another head,
whatever.

As long as this package contains all
of the goods that we need for the\loperation, the scientists will build\las many limbs as your mother wants."
entries.translation_source: Legs, arms, another head, whatever. As long as this package contains all of the goods that we need for the operation, the scientists will build as many limbs as your mother wants.
entries.translated:
Kaki, lengan, kepala lain,
terserah. Selama paket ini berisi\lsemua barang yang kita butuhkan

untuk operasi, para ilmuwan akan
membuat sebanyak anggota tubuh yang\libu Anda inginkan.

entries.original:
"I’m heading [green]north of Frozen Heights[blue]
to capture the target.

Report back to Zeph and inform
him of my current status."
entries.translation_source: I’m heading [color-green-1]north of Frozen Heights[color-blue-2] to capture the target. Report back to Zeph and inform him of my current status.
entries.translated:
Saya menuju [green]utara Frozen Heights[blue]
untuk menangkap target. Laporkan\lkembali ke Zeph dan beri tahu dia

status saya saat ini.

entries.original: "[blue]Cacnea, use Cut!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Cacnea, use Cut!
entries.translated: [blue]Cacnea, gunakan Potong!

entries.original: "[green]Cac!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Cac!
entries.translated: [green]Cac!

entries.original:
"No!
You need to recover the package!"
entries.translation_source: No! You need to recover the package!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Anda harus mengambil kembali
paketnya!

entries.original:
"One with the wind, one with the
snow\.

A heart that is frozen in absolute
zero!

Now, become the snow that drives the
harshest blizzard!

Sankren fimbulvetr!

Descend to me, Articuno!"
entries.translation_source: One with the wind, one with the snow[game-token-1] A heart that is frozen in absolute zero! Now, become the snow that drives the harshest blizzard! Sankren fimbulvetr! Descend to me, Articuno!
entries.translated:
Satu dengan angin, satu dengan
salju\. Hati yang membeku di nol\lmutlak! Sekarang, jadilah salju

yang mendorong badai salju paling
dahsyat! Sankren fimbulvetr!\lTurunlah padaku, Articuno!

entries.original:
"Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated: Prajurit Bayangan! Tahan dia!

entries.original:
"Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to
become ours."
entries.translation_source: Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to become ours.
entries.translated:
Sekarang, Articuno, saatnya kau
menjadi milik kami.

entries.original:
"The operation was a success.

Time to report back to Zeph."
entries.translation_source: The operation was a success. Time to report back to Zeph.
entries.translated:
Operasi berhasil. Saatnya melapor
kembali ke Zeph.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 I recognize you from the lab!

I’d have thought your imprisonment,
however brief, would have taught\lyou better\.

Do you just enjoy being locked up?
Or did someone\.\CC0818 send you?

\.\CC0818no. We don’t have time to deal
with you now.

But regardless, we can’t have you
pursuing us any further."
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1][control-code-2] I recognize you from the lab! I’d have thought your imprisonment, however brief, would have taught you better[game-token-3] Do you just enjoy being locked up? Or did someone[game-token-4][control-code-5] send you? [game-token-6][control-code-7]no. We don’t have time to deal with you now. But regardless, we can’t have you pursuing us any further.
entries.translated:
Kau\.\CC0820 Aku mengenalimu dari
laboratorium! Kupikir\lpemenjaraanmu, meskipun singkat,

seharusnya membuatmu lebih
bijaksana\. Apa kau menikmati\ldikurung? Atau apakah seseorang\.\CC0818

mengutusmu? \.\CC0818tidak. Kami tidak punya
waktu untuk berurusan denganmu\lsekarang. Tapi bagaimanapun, kami

tidak bisa membiarkanmu mengejar
kami lebih jauh.

entries.original:
"Grunts!

One of you, stall [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Grunts! One of you, stall [buffer1-1]!
entries.translated:
Prajurit! Salah satu dari kalian,
tahan [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[red]Who do you think you are, huh?

Do you think you can just follow
us and get away with it?

Don’t expect any mercy from
the [black]Shadows[red]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Who do you think you are, huh? Do you think you can just follow us and get away with it? Don’t expect any mercy from the [color-black-2]Shadows[color-red-3]!
entries.translated:
[red]Siapa kau kira dirimu, hah? Apa kau
pikir kau bisa begitu saja\lmengikuti kami dan lolos begitu

saja? Jangan harapkan belas kasihan
dari [black]Shadows[red]!

entries.original:
"[red]\.\CC0818Oh, you wanted this package.

Here, you can have it.
We’ve taken what we needed from it."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1][game-token-2][control-code-3]Oh, you wanted this package. Here, you can have it. We’ve taken what we needed from it.
entries.translated:
[red]\.\CC0818Oh, kau menginginkan paket ini.
Ini, ambillah. Kami sudah mengambil\lapa yang kami butuhkan dari paket

itu.

entries.original:
"[red]You’d be smart not to follow
us again."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]You’d be smart not to follow us again.
entries.translated:
[red]Kau akan bijak jika tidak mengikuti
kami lagi.

entries.original:
"No!
You need to return Log’s package!"
entries.translation_source: No! You need to return Log’s package!
entries.translated:
Tidak! Kau harus mengembalikan
paket Log!

entries.original:
"Alright, grunts.

For our next operation, we’ll be
heading to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] and\lensuring Ivory obtains her target."
entries.translation_source: Alright, grunts. For our next operation, we’ll be heading to [color-green-1]Cinder Volcano[color-blue-2] and ensuring Ivory obtains her target.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, para prajurit. Untuk
operasi kami selanjutnya, kami akan\lmenuju ke [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] dan

memastikan Ivory mendapatkan
targetnya.

entries.original:
"I will tolerate no screw ups!

Last time we were followed, and I
can’t have that happening again.

We don’t have the luxury of dealing
with unwanted Trainers right now.

Keep a low profile at all costs,
and no matter what, do not get\lnoticed!

Do I make myself clear?"
entries.translation_source: I will tolerate no screw ups! Last time we were followed, and I can’t have that happening again. We don’t have the luxury of dealing with unwanted Trainers right now. Keep a low profile at all costs, and no matter what, do not get noticed! Do I make myself clear?
entries.translated:
Aku tidak akan mentolerir
kesalahan! Terakhir kali kita\ldiikuti, dan aku tidak bisa

membiarkan itu terjadi lagi. Kita
tidak punya kemewahan untuk\lberurusan dengan Trainer yang tidak

diinginkan saat ini. Jaga profil
rendah dengan segala cara, dan apa\lpun yang terjadi, jangan sampai

diperhatikan! Apakah aku berbicara
dengan jelas?

entries.original: "Yes, sir!"
entries.translation_source: Yes, sir!
entries.translated: Siap, Pak!

entries.original: "Move out."
entries.translation_source: Move out.
entries.translated: Bergerak.

entries.original: "Arthur"
entries.translation_source: Arthur
entries.translated: Arthur

entries.original:
"Hello there, young [buffer1]!

What can I do for you?

\.

Ah, so Prof. Euler Log sent you.

What you describe sounds troubling
indeed.

Well, I believe I can shed some
light on what those scoundrels are\ltrying to achieve.

Incidentally, are you well-versed in
Borrius’ history?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, young [buffer1-1]! What can I do for you? [game-token-2] Ah, so Prof. Euler Log sent you. What you describe sounds troubling indeed. Well, I believe I can shed some light on what those scoundrels are trying to achieve. Incidentally, are you well-versed in Borrius’ history?
entries.translated:
Halo, [buffer1] muda! Ada yang bisa
saya bantu? \. Ah, jadi Prof. Euler\lLog yang mengutusmu. Apa yang kamu

gambarkan terdengar meresahkan.
Yah, saya rasa saya bisa memberi\lsedikit penjelasan tentang apa yang

ingin dicapai para penjahat itu.
Ngomong-ngomong, apakah kamu paham\ltentang sejarah Borrius?

entries.original:
"Is that so?

Then you may use my [green]television[blue]
over there.

I recorded a program from last night
that may help you fill in the gaps."
entries.translation_source: Is that so? Then you may use my [color-green-1]television[color-blue-2] over there. I recorded a program from last night that may help you fill in the gaps.
entries.translated:
Begitu kah? Kalau begitu kamu boleh
menggunakan [green]televisi[blue] saya di sana.\lSaya merekam acara semalam yang

mungkin bisa membantu mengisi celah
pengetahuanmu.

entries.original:
"Excellent.

Then, as you know, the dark force
of Borrius was sealed away, many,\lmany years ago.

However, it is said that if the
three legendary Pokémon used to\lseal it away are brought back\ltogether at a place called the\l[green]Ruins of Void[blue], the power can be\lreleased once again.

This must be what those thugs you
encountered are after - to engulf\lBorrius in darkness once again.

If what you say is accurate,
their next target will surely be\."
entries.translation_source: Excellent. Then, as you know, the dark force of Borrius was sealed away, many, many years ago. However, it is said that if the three legendary Pokémon used to seal it away are brought back together at a place called the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2], the power can be released once again. This must be what those thugs you encountered are after - to engulf Borrius in darkness once again. If what you say is accurate, their next target will surely be[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Bagus. Lalu, seperti yang kau tahu,
kekuatan gelap Borrius telah\ldisegel, bertahun-tahun yang lalu.

Namun, dikatakan bahwa jika tiga
Pokémon legendaris yang digunakan\luntuk menyegelnya dikumpulkan

kembali di tempat yang disebut
[green]Ruins of Void[blue], kekuatan itu bisa\ldilepaskan lagi. Ini pasti yang

dikejar oleh para preman yang kau
temui - untuk menyelimuti Borrius\ldalam kegelapan lagi. Jika apa yang

kau katakan akurat, target mereka
selanjutnya pasti\.

entries.original: "Grampa Arthur!"
entries.translation_source: Grampa Arthur!
entries.translated: Kakek Arthur!

entries.original: "What’s wrong, Jax?"
entries.translation_source: What’s wrong, Jax?
entries.translated: Ada apa, Jax?

entries.original:
"I just saw those guys in black
heading in the direction of\l[green]Cinder Volcano[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: I just saw those guys in black heading in the direction of [color-green-1]Cinder Volcano[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Aku baru saja melihat orang-orang
berbaju hitam itu menuju ke arah\l[green]Cinder Volcano[blue]!

entries.original:
"So it’s true\.

I was just telling [player] here
about their possible aims\.\lbut this confirms my suspicions.

Those thugs must be after the
legendary Pokémon, [green]Moltres[blue]."
entries.translation_source: So it’s true[game-token-1] I was just telling [player-name-2] here about their possible aims[game-token-3] but this confirms my suspicions. Those thugs must be after the legendary Pokémon, [color-green-4]Moltres[color-blue-5].
entries.translated:
Jadi itu benar\. Aku baru saja
memberi tahu [player] di sini\ltentang kemungkinan tujuan mereka\.

tapi ini mengonfirmasi
kecurigaanku. Para preman itu pasti\lmengejar Pokémon legendaris,

[green]Moltres[blue].

entries.original:
"[player]? Gah, no, what am I
talking about?

Grampa, we have to stop those guys,
right?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]? Gah, no, what am I talking about? Grampa, we have to stop those guys, right?
entries.translated:
[player]? Ah, bukan, apa yang aku
bicarakan? Kakek, kita harus\lmenghentikan mereka, kan?

entries.original:
"Not yet, Jax.

First things first, I need you to
fly to Frozen Heights and bring\lProf. Log here.

He needs to be informed of what
has transpired."
entries.translation_source: Not yet, Jax. First things first, I need you to fly to Frozen Heights and bring Prof. Log here. He needs to be informed of what has transpired.
entries.translated:
Belum, Jax. Yang pertama, aku perlu
kamu terbang ke Frozen Heights dan\lbawa Prof. Log ke sini. Dia perlu

diberi tahu apa yang telah terjadi.

entries.original: "Right away, Grampa!"
entries.translation_source: Right away, Grampa!
entries.translated: Baiklah, Kakek!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

So, it is as bad as I feared\.

What do you think should be done
about this, Arthur?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] So, it is as bad as I feared[game-token-2] What do you think should be done about this, Arthur?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Jadi, seburuk yang aku
khawatirkan\. Menurutmu apa yang\lharus dilakukan tentang ini,

Arthur?

entries.original:
"Jax will fly out to intercept these
\qoShadows\qc.

So far, he’s shown himself to be a
quite capable Trainer\.

And as you know, Euler, I’ve been
training him as my successor, so I\lbelieve he’s our best hope.

He’ll confront these \qoShadows\qc and
stop them before they reach\lMoltres."
entries.translation_source: Jax will fly out to intercept these [quote-open-1]Shadows[quote-close-2]. So far, he’s shown himself to be a quite capable Trainer[game-token-3] And as you know, Euler, I’ve been training him as my successor, so I believe he’s our best hope. He’ll confront these [quote-open-4]Shadows[quote-close-5] and stop them before they reach Moltres.
entries.translated:
Jax akan terbang untuk mencegat
\qoShadows\qc ini. Sejauh ini, dia\lmenunjukkan dirinya sebagai Pelatih

yang cukup mampu\. Dan seperti yang
kau tahu, Euler, aku telah\lmelatihnya sebagai penerusku, jadi

aku percaya dia adalah harapan
terbaik kita. Dia akan menghadapi\l\qoShadows\qc ini dan menghentikan

mereka sebelum mereka mencapai
Moltres.

entries.original:
"Of course.

That seems like a very reasonable
plan, Arthur."
entries.translation_source: Of course. That seems like a very reasonable plan, Arthur.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja. Itu sepertinya rencana
yang sangat masuk akal, Arthur.

entries.original:
"Understood, Grampa.

I’m heading out.

I’ll stop them and save Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: Understood, Grampa. I’m heading out. I’ll stop them and save Moltres!
entries.translated:
Dimengerti, Kakek. Aku berangkat.
Aku akan menghentikan mereka dan\lmenyelamatkan Moltres!

entries.original:
"Well, [player], I think it’s time
for you to head home.

You’ve completed your errand, and
I’m sure your mother misses you.

But still, I’m surprised that you
managed to get here so easily\.

I’ll have to brag to your mother
about what a reliable errand [buffer1]\lyou’ve become!

Ho ho ho!"
entries.translation_source: Well, [player-name-1], I think it’s time for you to head home. You’ve completed your errand, and I’m sure your mother misses you. But still, I’m surprised that you managed to get here so easily[game-token-2] I’ll have to brag to your mother about what a reliable errand [buffer1-3] you’ve become! Ho ho ho!
entries.translated:
Yah, [player], aku pikir sudah
waktunya kamu pulang. Kamu telah\lmenyelesaikan tugasmu, dan aku

yakin ibumu merindukanmu. Tapi
tetap saja, aku terkejut kamu bisa\lsampai di sini dengan mudah\. Aku

harus membanggakan kepada ibumu
tentang betapa andalnya tugas\l[buffer1] kamu! Ho ho ho!

entries.original:
"Now, wait just a moment, Euler.

I know Jax is capable, but I believe
this young [buffer1] may be just as\luseful.

[player] has had prior experience
with these \qoShadows\qc, and Jax very\lwell might benefit from the extra\lassistance [player] could lend."
entries.translation_source: Now, wait just a moment, Euler. I know Jax is capable, but I believe this young [buffer1-1] may be just as useful. [player-name-2] has had prior experience with these [quote-open-3]Shadows[quote-close-4], and Jax very well might benefit from the extra assistance [player-name-5] could lend.
entries.translated:
Sekarang, tunggu sebentar, Euler.
Aku tahu Jax mampu, tapi aku yakin\l[buffer1] muda ini mungkin sama

bergunanya. [player] sudah memiliki
pengalaman sebelumnya dengan\l\qoShadows\qc ini, dan Jax mungkin akan

mendapatkan manfaat dari bantuan
tambahan yang bisa diberikan\l[player].

entries.original:
"Assistance?

Arthur, [player] only became a
Trainer very recently\."
entries.translation_source: Assistance? Arthur, [player-name-1] only became a Trainer very recently[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Bantuan? Arthur, [player] baru
menjadi Pelatih baru-baru ini\.

entries.original:
"Is that\.\CC0818 is that Dresco Town’s
Gym Badge?

To think that you’d make this much
progress so quickly\."
entries.translation_source: Is that[game-token-1][control-code-2] is that Dresco Town’s Gym Badge? To think that you’d make this much progress so quickly[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Apa itu\.\CC0818 apakah itu Lencana Gym
Dresco Town? Tidak menyangka kamu\lbisa membuat kemajuan sebesar ini

begitu cepat\.

entries.original:
"You see, Euler?

I think that Badge shows that
[player]’s more than capable of\ltaking care of [buffer1]self.

Right now, the four of us are the
only ones who know the true aim of\lthe Shadows.

Having another Trainer capable of
fighting them\.\CC0818 surely you see\lmy point."
entries.translation_source: You see, Euler? I think that Badge shows that [player-name-1]’s more than capable of taking care of [buffer1-2]self. Right now, the four of us are the only ones who know the true aim of the Shadows. Having another Trainer capable of fighting them[game-token-3][control-code-4] surely you see my point.
entries.translated:
Kau lihat, Euler? Aku pikir Lencana
itu menunjukkan bahwa [player]\llebih dari mampu menjaga [buffer1]

sendiri. Saat ini, kita berempat
adalah satu-satunya yang tahu\ltujuan sebenarnya dari para

Shadows. Memiliki Pelatih lain yang
mampu melawan mereka\.\CC0818 pasti kau\lmengerti maksudku.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

Maybe you’re right.

If this takes a turn for the worse,
we’ll need all the help we can get."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] Maybe you’re right. If this takes a turn for the worse, we’ll need all the help we can get.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Mungkin kau benar. Jika ini
berubah menjadi lebih buruk, kita\lakan membutuhkan semua bantuan yang

bisa kita dapatkan.

entries.original:
"Alright, [player], you may follow
after Jax.

I’ll\.\CC0820 tell your mother you finished
my errand, and you’ve left home to\ltake the Gym Leader challenge.

Yes, I think that will do it."
entries.translation_source: Alright, [player-name-1], you may follow after Jax. I’ll[game-token-2][control-code-3] tell your mother you finished my errand, and you’ve left home to take the Gym Leader challenge. Yes, I think that will do it.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, [player], kamu boleh
mengikuti Jax. Aku akan\.\CC0820 memberi\ltahu ibumu bahwa kamu menyelesaikan

tugasku, dan kamu telah
meninggalkan rumah untuk mengambil\ltantangan Pemimpin Gym. Ya, aku

pikir itu akan berhasil.

entries.original:
"Don’t force yourself, [player].

If you feel you are too injured to
continue, then you must fall back.

Jax will help, if it comes to that.

Good luck, youngster."
entries.translation_source: Don’t force yourself, [player-name-1]. If you feel you are too injured to continue, then you must fall back. Jax will help, if it comes to that. Good luck, youngster.
entries.translated:
Jangan memaksakan diri, [player].
Jika kamu merasa terlalu terluka\luntuk melanjutkan, maka kamu harus

mundur. Jax akan membantu, jika
sampai pada itu. Semoga berhasil,\lanak muda.

entries.original:
"We’re running out of time, [player].

You need to hurry to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]
and save [green]Zapdos[blue]!

If it’s captured too, we’ll all be
doomed\."
entries.translation_source: We’re running out of time, [player-name-1]. You need to hurry to [color-green-2]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-3] and save [color-green-4]Zapdos[color-blue-5]! If it’s captured too, we’ll all be doomed[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Waktu kita hampir habis, [player].
Kamu harus bergegas ke [green]Gunung\lThundercap[blue] dan selamatkan [green]Zapdos[blue]!

Jika ia juga ditangkap, kita semua
akan binasa\.

entries.original:
"Jax told me the news.

A job well done saving Zapdos,
[player]!

All that remains now is retrieving
Moltres and Articuno from the\lShadows.

Jax is in [green]Dehara City[blue] waiting to
discuss the next move."
entries.translation_source: Jax told me the news. A job well done saving Zapdos, [player-name-1]! All that remains now is retrieving Moltres and Articuno from the Shadows. Jax is in [color-green-2]Dehara City[color-blue-3] waiting to discuss the next move.
entries.translated:
Jax memberi tahu aku beritanya.
Kerja bagus menyelamatkan Zapdos,\l[player]! Yang tersisa sekarang

adalah mengambil Moltres dan
Articuno dari para Shadows. Jax\lberada di [green]Kota Dehara[blue] menunggu

untuk mendiskusikan langkah
selanjutnya.

entries.original:
"So, the dark force has been
released\.

If it isn’t stopped, it could be
used to destroy the whole region!

You must find Jax and seal it away
once more!"
entries.translation_source: So, the dark force has been released[game-token-1] If it isn’t stopped, it could be used to destroy the whole region! You must find Jax and seal it away once more!
entries.translated:
Jadi, kekuatan gelap telah
dilepaskan\. Jika tidak dihentikan,\litu bisa digunakan untuk

menghancurkan seluruh wilayah! Kamu
harus menemukan Jax dan menyegelnya\llagi!

entries.original:
"You did it!

You defeated the Light of Ruin and
saved us!

You are a true Guardian of Borrius!

Your father would be proud."
entries.translation_source: You did it! You defeated the Light of Ruin and saved us! You are a true Guardian of Borrius! Your father would be proud.
entries.translated:
Kau berhasil! Kau mengalahkan
Cahaya Kehancuran dan menyelamatkan\lkami! Kau adalah Pelindung sejati

Borrius! Ayahmu akan bangga.

entries.original:
"Now that everything is at peace
once more, why don’t you take on\lthe [green]Pokémon League[blue]?

I’m sure someone with your skill
could easily become the champion."
entries.translation_source: Now that everything is at peace once more, why don’t you take on the [color-green-1]Pokémon League[color-blue-2]? I’m sure someone with your skill could easily become the champion.
entries.translated:
Sekarang semuanya damai kembali,
kenapa kamu tidak mengikuti [green]Liga\lPokémon[blue]? Aku yakin seseorang dengan

kemampuanmu bisa dengan mudah
menjadi juara.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]! Welcome.

Thank you for assisting Jax
in my rescue.

He\.\CC0818 well, actually, he came to see
me just before.

He told me about how the pressure
of trying to live up to my legacy\lwas messing with his head\.

All the more so after the setbacks
against the Shadows and the Light\lof Ruin.

I admit, perhaps I was asking
too much of him\.

So I told him that he should
improve himself, for his own sake,\lnot mine.

Although\. I wouldn’t mind if
he became strong enough to take\lyour place as Champion, myself.

Ho ho ho!

Oh, yes.

As thanks for rescuing me,
I’d like you to have this."
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player-name-1]! Welcome. Thank you for assisting Jax in my rescue. He[game-token-2][control-code-3] well, actually, he came to see me just before. He told me about how the pressure of trying to live up to my legacy was messing with his head[game-token-4] All the more so after the setbacks against the Shadows and the Light of Ruin. I admit, perhaps I was asking too much of him[game-token-5] So I told him that he should improve himself, for his own sake, not mine. Although[game-token-6] I wouldn’t mind if he became strong enough to take your place as Champion, myself. Ho ho ho! Oh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me, I’d like you to have this.
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Selamat datang.
Terima kasih telah membantu Jax\ldalam penyelamatanku. Dia\.\CC0818

sebenarnya, dia datang menemuiku
sebelumnya. Dia bercerita tentang\lbagaimana tekanan untuk mencoba

hidup sesuai dengan warisanku
mengganggu pikirannya\. Terlebih lagi\lsetelah kemunduran melawan Shadows

dan Light of Ruin. Aku akui,
mungkin aku terlalu banyak\lmemintanya\. Jadi aku mengatakan

kepadanya bahwa dia harus
memperbaiki dirinya sendiri, untuk\lkebaikannya sendiri, bukan untukku.

Meskipun\. aku tidak keberatan jika
dia menjadi cukup kuat untuk\lmenggantikanmu sebagai Juara, aku

sendiri. Ho ho ho! Oh, ya. Sebagai
ucapan terima kasih karena telah\lmenyelamatkanku, aku ingin

memberimu ini.

entries.original:
"Have a [green]Salamence[blue] hold that,
and it’ll be able to Mega Evolve.

Jax was training a Bagon, on the
side\.\CC0818 but he needed something to\lfly with in the meantime, so\lhe trained a Starly, as well.

Now though, he’s grown rather fond
of both of them!"
entries.translation_source: Have a [color-green-1]Salamence[color-blue-2] hold that, and it’ll be able to Mega Evolve. Jax was training a Bagon, on the side[game-token-3][control-code-4] but he needed something to fly with in the meantime, so he trained a Starly, as well. Now though, he’s grown rather fond of both of them!
entries.translated:
Mintalah [green]Salamence[blue] untuk memegang
itu, dan ia akan bisa Mega Evolve.\lJax sedang melatih Bagon, di

sampingnya\.\CC0818 tetapi ia butuh sesuatu
untuk terbang sementara itu, jadi\lia juga melatih Starly. Namun

sekarang, dia sudah menjadi sangat
sayang kepada keduanya!

entries.original: "How go your travels, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: How go your travels, [player-name-1]?
entries.translated: Bagaimana perjalananmu, [player]?

entries.original:
"Get moving, [player], to Cinder
Volcano - and be quick.

I don’t think it’s anything Jax can’t
handle, but he may appreciate\lyour help."
entries.translation_source: Get moving, [player-name-1], to Cinder Volcano - and be quick. I don’t think it’s anything Jax can’t handle, but he may appreciate your help.
entries.translated:
Bergeraklah, [player], ke Cinder
Volcano - dan cepatlah. Kupikir itu\lbukan sesuatu yang tidak bisa Jax

tangani, tapi dia mungkin akan
menghargai bantuanmu.

entries.original:
"Looks like I’m here.

I’d better get moving, then."
entries.translation_source: Looks like I’m here. I’d better get moving, then.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku sudah sampai. Lebih
baik aku bergerak, kalau begitu.

entries.original:
"One with the wind, one with the
flames\.

The guard that keeps vigil over
the sacred torch!

Now, become the inferno that
scorches the wastelands!

Sankren bolganone!

Descend to me, Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: One with the wind, one with the flames[game-token-1] The guard that keeps vigil over the sacred torch! Now, become the inferno that scorches the wastelands! Sankren bolganone! Descend to me, Moltres!
entries.translated:
Satu dengan angin, satu dengan api\.
Penjaga yang berjaga atas obor\lsuci! Sekarang, jadilah inferno

yang membakar tanah gersang!
Sankren bolganone! Turunlah padaku,\lMoltres!

entries.original: "And now for the capture!"
entries.translation_source: And now for the capture!
entries.translated: Dan sekarang, saatnya menangkap!

entries.original:
"Now, Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: Now, Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, Prajurit Bayangan! Tahan
dia!

entries.original:
"That was about as routine as it
could get.

Mission complete.

Let’s move out."
entries.translation_source: That was about as routine as it could get. Mission complete. Let’s move out.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah hal yang paling biasa.
Misi selesai. Ayo berangkat.

entries.original:
"[blue]Stop right there, Shadow!

Return Moltres back to where
it belongs!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Stop right there, Shadow! Return Moltres back to where it belongs!
entries.translated:
[blue]Berhenti di situ, Shadow!
Kembalikan Moltres ke tempatnya!

entries.original:
"[red]Unfortunately, I see no reason
to humor your foolish request.

Step aside, if you know what’s good
for you."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Unfortunately, I see no reason to humor your foolish request. Step aside, if you know what’s good for you.
entries.translated:
[red]Sayangnya, saya tidak melihat
alasan untuk menuruti permintaan\lbodoh Anda. Menyingkirlah, jika

Anda tahu apa yang baik untuk Anda.

entries.original:
"[blue]Sorry, but you’re not going anywhere
until Moltres is free.

If you won’t come quietly, then I’ll
have to use force."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Sorry, but you’re not going anywhere until Moltres is free. If you won’t come quietly, then I’ll have to use force.
entries.translated:
[blue]Maaf, tetapi kamu tidak akan pergi
ke mana pun sampai Moltres bebas.\lJika kamu tidak mau ikut dengan

tenang, maka aku harus menggunakan
kekerasan.

entries.original:
"[red]Sigh\.\CC0818 I had hoped it wouldn’t
come to this\.

My party was kept light for this
mission, but fortunately, I have\lother allies besides my Pokémon\.

Shadow Warriors\.\CC0820 if you would\.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Sigh[game-token-2][control-code-3] I had hoped it wouldn’t come to this[game-token-4] My party was kept light for this mission, but fortunately, I have other allies besides my Pokémon[game-token-5] Shadow Warriors[game-token-6][control-code-7] if you would[game-token-8][color-blue-9]
entries.translated:
[red]Ah\.\CC0818 Aku berharap tidak sampai begini\.
Timku sengaja dibuat ringan untuk\lmisi ini, tapi untungnya, aku

memiliki sekutu lain selain
Pokémonku\. Prajurit Bayangan\.\CC0820 jika\lkalian bersedia\.[blue]

entries.original: "[blue]Ivory, wait!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ivory, wait!
entries.translated: [blue]Ivory, tunggu!

entries.original:
"[blue]You don’t need to waste time over
this lone Trainer.

I’ll hold him off.
Just focus on the mission!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You don’t need to waste time over this lone Trainer. I’ll hold him off. Just focus on the mission!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu tidak perlu membuang waktu
untuk Trainer sendirian ini. Aku\lakan menahannya. Fokus saja pada

misi!

entries.original: "[red]Let’s go, Shadow Warriors\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Let’s go, Shadow Warriors[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [red]Ayo, Prajurit Bayangan\.

entries.original:
"[blue]No\.\CC0818 they escaped with Moltres\.

Gah! This isn’t the time to feel
sorry for myself.

I gotta chase after them\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]No[game-token-2][control-code-3] they escaped with Moltres[game-token-4] Gah! This isn’t the time to feel sorry for myself. I gotta chase after them[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
[blue]Tidak\.\CC0818 mereka kabur dengan Moltres\.
Gah! Ini bukan waktunya untuk\lmengasihani diri sendiri. Aku harus

mengejar mereka\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh? Wait, you’re\.\CC0820 [player],
I think?

Did Grampa Arthur send you here?

\.

Ah, so you were sent as backup.

Jeez, I got embarrassed in front
of you\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Huh? Wait, you’re[game-token-2][control-code-3] [player-name-4], I think? Did Grampa Arthur send you here? [game-token-5] Ah, so you were sent as backup. Jeez, I got embarrassed in front of you[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
[blue]Huh? Tunggu, kamu\.\CC0820 [player], kurasa?
Apakah Kakek Arthur mengirimmu ke\lsini? \. Ah, jadi kamu dikirim

sebagai cadangan. Ya ampun, aku
jadi malu di depanmu\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Well\.

Now that you’re here, why don’t you
and I team up?

You were sent to help, and I gotta
admit I could do with some right now\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Well[game-token-2] Now that you’re here, why don’t you and I team up? You were sent to help, and I gotta admit I could do with some right now[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[blue]Baik\. Sekarang setelah kamu di sini,
kenapa kita tidak bergabung? Kamu\ldikirim untuk membantu, dan harus

kuakui aku sangat membutuhkannya
saat ini\.

entries.original: "[black][player] decided to go with Jax!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] decided to go with Jax!
entries.translated:
[black][player] memutuskan untuk pergi
bersama Jax!

entries.original:
"[blue]Alright!
I bet we’ll make a good team!

Your Pokémon are in better shape
than I am right now, so you lead.

I can hang back and support.

I’ll make sure to keep us both
healed up, too."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Alright! I bet we’ll make a good team! Your Pokémon are in better shape than I am right now, so you lead. I can hang back and support. I’ll make sure to keep us both healed up, too.
entries.translated:
[blue]Baiklah! Aku yakin kita akan
menjadi tim yang bagus! Pokémon-mu\ldalam kondisi lebih baik daripada

aku sekarang, jadi kamu yang
memimpin. Aku bisa bertahan di\lbelakang dan mendukung. Aku juga

akan memastikan kita berdua tetap
dipulihkan.

entries.original:
"[blue]In that case, Staravia.
Let’s cut them off at the exit."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]In that case, Staravia. Let’s cut them off at the exit.
entries.translated:
[blue]Kalau begitu, Staravia. Mari kita
hadang mereka di pintu keluar.

entries.original:
"[black]While teamed up with Jax, the
[green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]While teamed up with Jax, the [color-green-2]first 3[color-black-3] viable Pokémon in your party will be selected for battle.
entries.translated:
[black]Saat bekerja sama dengan Jax, [green]3
Pokémon pertama[black] yang layak di timmu\lakan dipilih untuk bertarung.

entries.original:
"Let’s get to the exit as quick as
possible and stop the Shadows from\lescaping with Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get to the exit as quick as possible and stop the Shadows from escaping with Moltres!
entries.translated:
Ayo kita secepat mungkin ke pintu
keluar dan hentikan para Shadow\lmelarikan diri dengan Moltres!

entries.original:
"[blue]Where are you going, [player]?
The exit’s the other way!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Where are you going, [player-name-2]? The exit’s the other way!
entries.translated:
[blue]Mau ke mana, [player]? Pintu
keluarnya di arah sebaliknya!

entries.original:
"[blue]Looks like we’ve reached the
exit, [player].

I’ll go on ahead.
Don’t stay too far behind!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Looks like we’ve reached the exit, [player-name-2]. I’ll go on ahead. Don’t stay too far behind!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya kita sudah sampai di
pintu keluar, [player]. Aku akan\ljalan duluan. Jangan terlalu jauh

di belakang!

entries.original: "Staravia! Use Aerial Ace!"
entries.translation_source: Staravia! Use Aerial Ace!
entries.translated: Staravia! Gunakan Aerial Ace!

entries.original: "[green]Ravia!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Ravia!
entries.translated: [green]Ravia!

entries.original: "[green]Raptor!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Raptor!
entries.translated: [green]Raptor!

entries.original: "Duskull! Use Payback!"
entries.translation_source: Duskull! Use Payback!
entries.translated: Duskull! Gunakan Payback!

entries.original: "Cacnea! Use Feint Attack!"
entries.translation_source: Cacnea! Use Feint Attack!
entries.translated: Cacnea! Gunakan Feint Attack!

entries.original: "[green]Skull\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Skull[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Skull\.

entries.original:
"Your shadowy reign of terror
ends here and now!

I won’t let you escape from Cinder
Volcano with Moltres in hand!"
entries.translation_source: Your shadowy reign of terror ends here and now! I won’t let you escape from Cinder Volcano with Moltres in hand!
entries.translated:
Pemerintahan teror bayanganmu
berakhir di sini dan sekarang! Aku\ltidak akan membiarkanmu melarikan

diri dari Cinder Volcano dengan
Moltres di tangan!

entries.original:
"\qoShadowy reign of terror\qc?
Seriously?

We have Moltres, and we’re well
within our rights to keep it.

You may have some self-righteous
notion that what we’re doing is\l\qoevil\qc, but you’re wrong!

You simply don’t understand what’s
at stake here\."
entries.translation_source: [quote-open-1]Shadowy reign of terror[quote-close-2]? Seriously? We have Moltres, and we’re well within our rights to keep it. You may have some self-righteous notion that what we’re doing is [quote-open-3]evil[quote-close-4], but you’re wrong! You simply don’t understand what’s at stake here[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
\qoPemerintahan teror bayangan\qc?
Serius? Kami punya Moltres, dan\lkami berhak menyimpannya. Mungkin

kau punya pemikiran benar sendiri
bahwa apa yang kami lakukan adalah\l\qojahat\qc, tapi kau salah! Kau tidak

mengerti apa yang dipertaruhkan di
sini\.

entries.original:
"[red]That’s it, Marlon.
Stall him for just a little longer.

These Shadow Warriors have been out
in the light for too long\.

They’ll revert to dust if they
remain here.

I need to return to base with
them now."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]That’s it, Marlon. Stall him for just a little longer. These Shadow Warriors have been out in the light for too long[game-token-2] They’ll revert to dust if they remain here. I need to return to base with them now.
entries.translated:
[red]Itu dia, Marlon. Tahan dia sebentar
lagi. Para Shadow Warriors ini\lsudah terlalu lama berada di luar

cahaya\. Mereka akan kembali menjadi
debu jika tetap di sini. Aku harus\lkembali ke markas dengan mereka

sekarang.

entries.original:
"Of course, Ivory.
I have this under control.

Take the Shadow Warriors and go.

I can hold off this boy until
you escape with Moltres."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Ivory. I have this under control. Take the Shadow Warriors and go. I can hold off this boy until you escape with Moltres.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Ivory. Aku punya ini
terkendali. Bawa Shadow Warriors\ldan pergi. Aku bisa menahan anak

ini sampai kau melarikan diri
dengan Moltres.

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!
Help me out against him!

I don’t care what he claims is really
at stake here, we have to blast\lthrough him and chase after Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! Help me out against him! I don’t care what he claims is really at stake here, we have to blast through him and chase after Moltres!
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Bantu aku melawannya! Aku
tidak peduli apa yang dia klaim\lsebenarnya dipertaruhkan di sini,

kita harus menerobosnya dan
mengejar Moltres!

entries.original:
"So, we meet again, [player].

I take it, then, you’ve decided to
make it your business to interfere?

That’s unfortunate.

But two of you trying to get
past makes no difference to me."
entries.translation_source: So, we meet again, [player-name-1]. I take it, then, you’ve decided to make it your business to interfere? That’s unfortunate. But two of you trying to get past makes no difference to me.
entries.translated:
Jadi, kita bertemu lagi, [player].
Kukira, kau memutuskan untuk ikut\lcampur? Itu tidak beruntung. Tapi

kalian berdua yang mencoba lewat
tidak membuat perbedaan bagiku.

entries.original:
"One of you grunts, give me a hand
over here!"
entries.translation_source: One of you grunts, give me a hand over here!
entries.translated:
Salah satu dari kalian, prajurit,
bantu aku di sini!

entries.original:
"[red]I’ll assist you in your battle,
Marlon, sir!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’ll assist you in your battle, Marlon, sir!
entries.translated:
[red]Aku akan membantumu dalam
pertarunganmu, Tuan Marlon!

entries.original:
"[black]Choose up to three Pokémon to
battle with."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Choose up to three Pokémon to battle with.
entries.translated:
[black]Pilih hingga tiga Pokémon untuk
bertarung.

entries.original:
"Well, I suppose that’s fine.
Our operation was a success.

Ivory is long gone by now."
entries.translation_source: Well, I suppose that’s fine. Our operation was a success. Ivory is long gone by now.
entries.translated:
Yah, kurasa tidak apa-apa. Operasi
kita berhasil. Ivory sudah pergi\ljauh sekarang.

entries.original:
"You can follow me if you want, but
it won’t do you any good.

You already know I’ll never lead
you to Moltres\.

So I advise both of you to do the
smart thing, and leave us alone."
entries.translation_source: You can follow me if you want, but it won’t do you any good. You already know I’ll never lead you to Moltres[game-token-1] So I advise both of you to do the smart thing, and leave us alone.
entries.translated:
Kau bisa ikuti aku jika mau, tapi
tidak akan berguna. Kau sudah tahu\laku tidak akan pernah membawamu ke

Moltres\. Jadi aku menyarankan kalian
berdua melakukan hal yang cerdas,\ldan tinggalkan kami sendiri.

entries.original: "Let’s move."
entries.translation_source: Let’s move.
entries.translated: Ayo bergerak.

entries.original:
"Grr\.\CC0818 He’s right\.\CC0818

It’s not even worth chasing him\.

That woman was the one who
took Moltres\."
entries.translation_source: Grr[game-token-1][control-code-2] He’s right[game-token-3][control-code-4] It’s not even worth chasing him[game-token-5] That woman was the one who took Moltres[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Grr\.\CC0818 Dia benar\.\CC0818 Bahkan tidak layak
mengejarnya\. Wanita itu yang\lmengambil Moltres\.

entries.original:
"Anyway, thanks, [player] - he was a
lot tougher than I thought\.

Let’s head back to Grampa’s house,
and tell him what happened."
entries.translation_source: Anyway, thanks, [player-name-1] - he was a lot tougher than I thought[game-token-2] Let’s head back to Grampa’s house, and tell him what happened.
entries.translated:
Ngomong-ngomong, terima kasih,
[player] - dia jauh lebih tangguh\ldari yang kukira\. Ayo kembali ke

rumah Kakek, dan beri tahu dia apa
yang terjadi.

entries.original:
"I see\.\CC0820 this isn’t good.

At this point, there’s now only one
Legendary Pokémon left - [green]Zapdos[blue].

It’s imperative that it be rescued
before the Shadows can capture it."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1][control-code-2] this isn’t good. At this point, there’s now only one Legendary Pokémon left - [color-green-3]Zapdos[color-blue-4]. It’s imperative that it be rescued before the Shadows can capture it.
entries.translated:
Begitu\.\CC0820 ini tidak bagus. Pada titik
ini, sekarang hanya tersisa satu\lPokémon Legendaris - [green]Zapdos[blue]. Sangat

penting untuk menyelamatkannya
sebelum Shadows dapat menangkapnya.

entries.original:
"Zapdos\.

It lives in [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue], right?

I’ll head on out right away."
entries.translation_source: Zapdos[game-token-1] It lives in [color-green-2]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-3], right? I’ll head on out right away.
entries.translated:
Zapdos\. Ia tinggal di [green]Thundercap
Mt.[blue], kan? Aku akan berangkat\lsekarang juga.

entries.original:
"Actually, Jax, I have a different
task for you.

To the best of my knowledge,
the Shadows still lack the object\lused to seal the dark force.

Friends of mine that live on [green]Route 9[blue]
should know of its location.

Go to them and explain the
situation.

I’m sure they’ll be willing to help
us find it before the Shadows do."
entries.translation_source: Actually, Jax, I have a different task for you. To the best of my knowledge, the Shadows still lack the object used to seal the dark force. Friends of mine that live on [color-green-1]Route 9[color-blue-2] should know of its location. Go to them and explain the situation. I’m sure they’ll be willing to help us find it before the Shadows do.
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, Jax, aku punya tugas
berbeda untukmu. Sejauh\lpengetahuanku, Shadows masih

kekurangan benda yang digunakan
untuk menyegel kekuatan gelap.\lTeman-temanku yang tinggal di [green]Route

9[blue] seharusnya tahu lokasinya. Temui
mereka dan jelaskan situasinya. Aku\lyakin mereka akan bersedia membantu

kita menemukannya sebelum Shadows
melakukannya.

entries.original: "You got it, Grampa."
entries.translation_source: You got it, Grampa.
entries.translated: Siap, Kakek.

entries.original:
"Good, good.

In the meantime, [player] will be
the one who will head to\l[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] and save [green]Zapdos[blue].

[player]\.\CC0818 you’ve proven yourself
by defending Jax back at Cinder\lVolcano, and I think you’re up to\lthe task.

You can head there by taking the
highway south-east from the next\ltown over, [green]Crater Town[blue].

You may need the Badge there in
order to travel to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue],\lso make sure that obtaining the\lBadge is your utmost priority."
entries.translation_source: Good, good. In the meantime, [player-name-1] will be the one who will head to [color-green-2]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-3] and save [color-green-4]Zapdos[color-blue-5]. [player-name-6][game-token-7][control-code-8] you’ve proven yourself by defending Jax back at Cinder Volcano, and I think you’re up to the task. You can head there by taking the highway south-east from the next town over, [color-green-9]Crater Town[color-blue-10]. You may need the Badge there in order to travel to [color-green-11]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-12], so make sure that obtaining the Badge is your utmost priority.
entries.translated:
Baik, baik. Sementara itu, [player]
akan menjadi orang yang pergi ke\l[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] dan menyelamatkan

[green]Zapdos[blue]. [player]\.\CC0818 kamu telah
membuktikan diri dengan membela Jax\ldi Cinder Volcano, dan aku pikir

kamu mampu melakukannya. Kamu bisa
ke sana dengan mengambil jalan raya\lke tenggara dari kota berikutnya,

[green]Crater Town[blue]. Kamu mungkin
memerlukan Badge di sana untuk\lbepergian ke [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue], jadi

pastikan mendapatkan Badge adalah
prioritas utamamu.

entries.original:
"I’ll head back to Frozen Heights,
[player].

I’ll explain to your mother that
I’ve seen you off, and you’re on\lyour way to the next Gym Badge.

No sense in letting her worry,
after all."
entries.translation_source: I’ll head back to Frozen Heights, [player-name-1]. I’ll explain to your mother that I’ve seen you off, and you’re on your way to the next Gym Badge. No sense in letting her worry, after all.
entries.translated:
Aku akan kembali ke Frozen Heights,
[player]. Aku akan menjelaskan\lkepada ibumu bahwa aku telah

mengantarmu pergi, dan kamu sedang
dalam perjalanan ke Gym Badge\lberikutnya. Tidak ada gunanya

membuatnya khawatir.

entries.original:
"My Staravia’s still tired from the
battle earlier, but I should still\lbe able to give you a lift back to\l[green]Cinder Volcano[blue].

Do you want me to do that?"
entries.translation_source: My Staravia’s still tired from the battle earlier, but I should still be able to give you a lift back to [color-green-1]Cinder Volcano[color-blue-2]. Do you want me to do that?
entries.translated:
Staravia-ku masih lelah dari
pertempuran sebelumnya, tapi aku\lseharusnya masih bisa mengantarmu

kembali ke [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]. Kau
ingin aku melakukannya?

entries.original: "Let’s head out right away."
entries.translation_source: Let’s head out right away.
entries.translated: Ayo berangkat sekarang juga.

entries.original:
"In that case, these Repels should
help you get back through Grim\lWoods and Cinder Volcano quicker."
entries.translation_source: In that case, these Repels should help you get back through Grim Woods and Cinder Volcano quicker.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, Repel ini seharusnya
membantumu kembali melalui Grim\lWoods dan Cinder Volcano lebih

cepat.

entries.original:
"The asset has sent word.

The target is on the move."
entries.translation_source: The asset has sent word. The target is on the move.
entries.translated:
Aset telah mengirim kabar. Target
sedang bergerak.

entries.original:
"Alright, then.

Let’s move into position."
entries.translation_source: Alright, then. Let’s move into position.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kalau begitu. Ayo bergerak
ke posisi.

entries.original:
"Quick!

Grab [buffer1] now!"
entries.translation_source: Quick! Grab [buffer1-1] now!
entries.translated: Cepat! Ambil [buffer1] sekarang!

entries.original:
"Ah, right on schedule.

Tell me, [buffer1], what is your name?

\.

[player], was it?

At last, we finally meet.

I am Zeph, the man lurking in the
Shadows behind this organization."
entries.translation_source: Ah, right on schedule. Tell me, [buffer1-1], what is your name? [game-token-2] [player-name-3], was it? At last, we finally meet. I am Zeph, the man lurking in the Shadows behind this organization.
entries.translated:
Ah, tepat sesuai jadwal. Katakan,
[buffer1], siapa namamu? \. [player],\lkan? Akhirnya, kita bertemu. Aku

Zeph, orang yang mengintai di
bayang-bayang di balik organisasi\lini.

entries.original:
"I shall get to the point - I’ve
been informed that not only have\lyou trespassed in our laboratory,\lbut you’ve tried to interfere with\ltwo of our operations as well.

That, make no mistake,
is unacceptable.

However, it does beg the question,
of who exactly you’re working for\.

\.

You work for no one?
Nonsense.

Surely you can craft a more
plausible lie than that.

You’re not even trying."
entries.translation_source: I shall get to the point - I’ve been informed that not only have you trespassed in our laboratory, but you’ve tried to interfere with two of our operations as well. That, make no mistake, is unacceptable. However, it does beg the question, of who exactly you’re working for[game-token-1] [game-token-2] You work for no one? Nonsense. Surely you can craft a more plausible lie than that. You’re not even trying.
entries.translated:
Aku akan langsung ke intinya - Aku
telah diberitahu bahwa kamu tidak\lhanya melanggar batas laboratorium

kami, tetapi juga mencoba
mengganggu dua operasi kami. Itu,\ljangan salah, tidak bisa diterima.

Namun, ini menimbulkan pertanyaan,
untuk siapa sebenarnya kamu bekerja\.\l\. Kamu tidak bekerja untuk siapa

pun? Omong kosong. Pasti kamu bisa
membuat kebohongan yang lebih masuk\lakal dari itu. Kamu bahkan tidak

berusaha.

entries.original:
"Very well, if you will not talk,
then Ivory here will have to give\lyou a little\.\CC0818 incentive."
entries.translation_source: Very well, if you will not talk, then Ivory here will have to give you a little[game-token-1][control-code-2] incentive.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, jika kamu tidak mau
bicara, maka Ivory di sini harus\lmemberimu sedikit\.\CC0818 insentif.

entries.original:
"[red]So, you’re the Trainer Marlon seems
to have a score to settle with\.

Try not to struggle so much - it’ll
only hurt all the more."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]So, you’re the Trainer Marlon seems to have a score to settle with[game-token-2] Try not to struggle so much - it’ll only hurt all the more.
entries.translated:
[red]Jadi, kamu adalah Pelatih yang
Marlon tampaknya memiliki dendam\ldengan\. Cobalah untuk tidak banyak

melawan - itu hanya akan semakin
menyakitkan.

entries.original:
"Oh, Ivory\.

How are we supposed to scare [buffer1]
straight if you cannot even defeat\l[buffer1] in a simple battle?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, Ivory[game-token-1] How are we supposed to scare [buffer1-2] straight if you cannot even defeat [buffer1-3] in a simple battle?
entries.translated:
Oh, Ivory\. Bagaimana kita bisa
menakuti [buffer1] menjadi benar\ljika kamu bahkan tidak bisa

mengalahkan [buffer1] dalam
pertarungan sederhana?

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph, I’m a scientist.

My best skills lie elsewhere."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Zeph, I’m a scientist. My best skills lie elsewhere.
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph, aku seorang ilmuwan. Keahlian
terbaikku ada di tempat lain.

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0818 very well.

In the absence of anyone else,
Houndoom and I will personally\lshow you the meaning of pain."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1][control-code-2] very well. In the absence of anyone else, Houndoom and I will personally show you the meaning of pain.
entries.translated:
Huh\.\CC0818 baiklah. Tanpa adanya orang
lain, Houndoom dan aku akan secara\lpribadi menunjukkan arti sakit

padamu.

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph, I’m not sure Houndoom alone
will be enough to beat [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Zeph, I’m not sure Houndoom alone will be enough to beat [buffer1-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph, aku tidak yakin Houndoom
sendirian akan cukup untuk\lmengalahkan [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"You doubt me, Ivory?

Houndoom and I are more than
capable of finishing [buffer1] off."
entries.translation_source: You doubt me, Ivory? Houndoom and I are more than capable of finishing [buffer1-1] off.
entries.translated:
Kamu meragukanku, Ivory? Houndoom
dan aku lebih dari mampu untuk\lmenghabisi [buffer1].

entries.original:
"Now then, [player].

I’ve been quite patient with you,
but I’m afraid you’ve forced\lmy hand.

Time to suffer for your interference!"
entries.translation_source: Now then, [player-name-1]. I’ve been quite patient with you, but I’m afraid you’ve forced my hand. Time to suffer for your interference!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, [player]. Aku sudah cukup
sabar denganmu, tapi aku khawatir\lkamu memaksaku. Waktunya menderita

karena campur tanganmu!

entries.original:
"I’ve got to hand it to you.
You’re stronger than I anticipated.

I do like that about you, [buffer1].

That strength is something I wished
for my son, too\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got to hand it to you. You’re stronger than I anticipated. I do like that about you, [buffer1-1]. That strength is something I wished for my son, too[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Harus kuakui. Kamu lebih kuat dari
yang kuduga. Aku suka itu darimu,\l[buffer1]. Kekuatan itu juga yang

kuharapkan untuk anakku\.

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph! Marlon has just sent word.

He’s finished with his investigation
of the green-hatted boy.

You’ll want to hear this."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Zeph! Marlon has just sent word. He’s finished with his investigation of the green-hatted boy. You’ll want to hear this.
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph! Marlon baru saja mengirim
kabar. Dia selesai dengan\lpenyelidikannya terhadap anak

laki-laki bertopi hijau. Kamu pasti
ingin mendengar ini.

entries.original:
"Yes, what is it?

\.

I see\."
entries.translation_source: Yes, what is it? [game-token-1] I see[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Ya, ada apa? \. Oh begitu\.

entries.original:
"I’m afraid, [player], that you’ve now
lost your leverage.

I’m told there was a boy with you
when you happened upon our last\loperation.

We have successfully identified him
as the grandson of a well-known\lhistorian named Arthur.

Was he involved in your appearance
there?

\.

Your reaction speaks volumes.
It was indeed his doing.

That old fool\.\CC0818 how long must he
interfere with us\.?"
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid, [player-name-1], that you’ve now lost your leverage. I’m told there was a boy with you when you happened upon our last operation. We have successfully identified him as the grandson of a well-known historian named Arthur. Was he involved in your appearance there? [game-token-2] Your reaction speaks volumes. It was indeed his doing. That old fool[game-token-3][control-code-4] how long must he interfere with us[game-token-5]?
entries.translated:
Aku khawatir, [player], bahwa kamu
sekarang kehilangan pengaruhmu. Aku\ldiberitahu ada seorang anak

laki-laki bersamamu saat kamu
kebetulan menemukan operasi\lterakhir kami. Kami berhasil

mengidentifikasinya sebagai cucu
dari seorang sejarawan terkenal\lbernama Arthur. Apakah dia terlibat

dalam kemunculanmu di sana? \.
Reaksimu sudah cukup menjelaskan.\lMemang itu perbuatannya. Orang tua

bodoh itu\.\CC0818 berapa lama lagi dia
harus ikut campur dengan kami\.?

entries.original:
"[red]Sir!

A monster just appeared out of thin
air in the basement chamber!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Sir! A monster just appeared out of thin air in the basement chamber!
entries.translated:
[red]Pak! Seorang monster baru saja
muncul dari udara tipis di ruang\lbawah tanah!

entries.original:
"All grunts get down there NOW!

Stop whatever that monster is and
protect the Shadow Warriors!"
entries.translation_source: All grunts get down there NOW! Stop whatever that monster is and protect the Shadow Warriors!
entries.translated:
Semua prajurit turun ke sana
SEKARANG! Hentikan monster apa pun\litu dan lindungi Shadow Warriors!

entries.original:
"Ivory, we’ll heal our Pokémon and
join the containment efforts.

We cannot afford to lose even
a single Shadow Warrior right now.

If any are destroyed and Fey
finds out\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory, we’ll heal our Pokémon and join the containment efforts. We cannot afford to lose even a single Shadow Warrior right now. If any are destroyed and Fey finds out[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ivory, kita akan menyembuhkan
Pokémon kita dan bergabung dalam\lupaya penahanan. Kita tidak bisa

kehilangan satu pun Shadow Warriors
saat ini. Jika ada yang hancur dan\lFey mengetahuinya\.

entries.original:
"[red]I understand, Zeph.

But what should we do about
the [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I understand, Zeph. But what should we do about the [buffer1-2]?
entries.translated:
[red]Aku mengerti, Zeph. Tapi apa yang
harus kita lakukan tentang\l[buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Let [buffer1] go, for now.

As long as their public appearances
remain scarce, there is no reason\lfor Fey and Arthur to ever speak\lwith one another.

There is little chance he would ever
tell her."
entries.translation_source: Let [buffer1-1] go, for now. As long as their public appearances remain scarce, there is no reason for Fey and Arthur to ever speak with one another. There is little chance he would ever tell her.
entries.translated:
Biarkan [buffer1] pergi, untuk
sekarang. Selama penampilan publik\lmereka jarang, tidak ada alasan

bagi Fey dan Arthur untuk saling
berbicara. Kecil kemungkinan dia\lakan memberitahunya.

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 I suspect you have
no intention of obeying, but I will\lonly warn you once.

Keep out of our business, or you
may find things will escalate\lbeyond your control\.

So for your sake, I hope we don’t
need to meet again, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] I suspect you have no intention of obeying, but I will only warn you once. Keep out of our business, or you may find things will escalate beyond your control[game-token-4] So for your sake, I hope we don’t need to meet again, [buffer1-5].
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 Aku curiga kamu tidak
punya niat untuk patuh, tapi aku\lhanya akan memperingatkanmu sekali.

Jauhi urusan kami, atau kamu
mungkin akan menemukan hal-hal yang\lmeningkat di luar kendalimu\. Jadi

demi kebaikanmu, aku harap kita
tidak perlu bertemu lagi, [buffer1].

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0830 pa\.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2][control-code-3] pa[game-token-4][control-code-5]
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0830 pa\.\CC0830

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

If that ain’t the darndest thing
I ever did see - a [buffer1] coming\loutta some magic portal!

Where’d ya come from, [buffer1]?

\.

What’s that?

Ya were tryin’ to get to
Thundercap Mt. when all of a\lsudden ya were kidnapped?

Hoooo weeee!
That sure sounds scary, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! If that ain’t the darndest thing I ever did see - a [buffer1-1] coming outta some magic portal! Where’d ya come from, [buffer1-2]? [game-token-3] What’s that? Ya were tryin’ to get to Thundercap Mt. when all of a sudden ya were kidnapped? Hoooo weeee! That sure sounds scary, [buffer1-4].
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Jika itu bukan hal
paling aneh yang pernah kulihat -\lseorang [buffer1] keluar dari portal

ajaib! Dari mana kau datang,
[buffer1]? \. Apa itu? Kau sedang\lmencoba pergi ke Thundercap Mt.

ketika tiba-tiba kau diculik? Hoooo
weeee! Pasti terdengar menakutkan,\l[buffer1].

entries.original:
"Well, if ya hadn’t been kidnapped,
ya’d be havin’ a lot less trouble\lgettin’ to Thundercap Mt.

Ya see, part of the ceiling
collapsed not long ago and\lblocked off the road!

And unless ya have the HM for [green]Rock
Smash[blue], you’ll be in a bit of a\lpickle gettin’ through ’em.

But\.\CC0818 I’m guessin’ ya don’t, or ya
wouldn’t still be talkin’ to me.

In thatta case, a friend of mine in
[green]Blizzard City[blue] can help ya out by\lgivin’ ya Rock Smash.

So, take this HM to help yerself
get to him."
entries.translation_source: Well, if ya hadn’t been kidnapped, ya’d be havin’ a lot less trouble gettin’ to Thundercap Mt. Ya see, part of the ceiling collapsed not long ago and blocked off the road! And unless ya have the HM for [color-green-1]Rock Smash[color-blue-2], you’ll be in a bit of a pickle gettin’ through ’em. But[game-token-3][control-code-4] I’m guessin’ ya don’t, or ya wouldn’t still be talkin’ to me. In thatta case, a friend of mine in [color-green-5]Blizzard City[color-blue-6] can help ya out by givin’ ya Rock Smash. So, take this HM to help yerself get to him.
entries.translated:
Yah, jika kau tidak diculik, kau
akan jauh lebih mudah sampai ke\lGunung Thundercap. Begini, sebagian

langit-langit runtuh belum lama ini
dan menghalangi jalan! Dan kecuali\lkau memiliki HM untuk [green]Penghancur

Batu[blue], kau akan sedikit kesulitan
melewatinya. Tapi\.\CC0818 kurasa kau tidak\lmemilikinya, atau kau tidak akan

masih bicara denganku. Kalau
begitu, seorang temanku di [green]Blizzard\lCity[blue] bisa membantumu dengan

memberimu Penghancur Batu. Jadi,
ambil HM ini untuk membantu dirimu\lsampai ke dia.

entries.original:
"What’s that?
Ya don’t know what an HM is?

Hoooo weeee!

Well, an [green]HM[blue] or Hidden Machine, is
a special type of move a Pokémon\lcan use to remove obstacles.

As long as an HM is in yer Cube,
and ya have a Pokémon in your\lparty capable of learning the HM,\lit can be used in the field, even\lif the Pokémon can’t battle!

In other words, [green]yer Pokémon don’t
need to know the HM to use it[blue].

Ain’t that convenient?

Anyway, ya can start by using that
HM for [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of the pesky\ltree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue].

Good luck to ya, [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Ya don’t know what an HM is? Hoooo weeee! Well, an [color-green-1]HM[color-blue-2] or Hidden Machine, is a special type of move a Pokémon can use to remove obstacles. As long as an HM is in yer Cube, and ya have a Pokémon in your party capable of learning the HM, it can be used in the field, even if the Pokémon can’t battle! In other words, [color-green-3]yer Pokémon don’t need to know the HM to use it[color-blue-4]. Ain’t that convenient? Anyway, ya can start by using that HM for [color-green-5]Cut[color-blue-6] to get rid of the pesky tree blocking [color-green-7]Valley Cave[color-blue-8]. Good luck to ya, [buffer1-9]!
entries.translated:
Apa itu? Kamu tidak tahu apa itu
HM? Hoooo weeee! Yah, [green]HM[blue] atau\lHidden Machine, adalah jenis

gerakan khusus yang bisa digunakan
Pokémon untuk menghilangkan\lrintangan. Selama HM ada di

Cube-mu, dan kamu memiliki Pokémon
di tim yang bisa mempelajari HM\ltersebut, HM bisa digunakan di

lapangan, bahkan jika Pokémon tidak
bisa bertarung! Dengan kata lain,\l[green]Pokémon-mu tidak perlu mengetahui

HM untuk menggunakannya[blue]. Bukankah
itu praktis? Ngomong-ngomong, kamu\lbisa mulai dengan menggunakan HM

itu untuk [green]Cut[blue] untuk menyingkirkan
pohon menjengkelkan yang\lmenghalangi [green]Valley Cave[blue]. Semoga

beruntung, [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"I’ve just received new directions
from Zeph.

We’ll be tightening security
on Route 9.

The green-hatted boy who tried to
interfere with our operation in\lCinder Volcano has been spotted\lflying overhead.

While you three stand guard at the
gate, I’m going to find a suitable\lplace to set up a psychic barrier\laround the route."
entries.translation_source: I’ve just received new directions from Zeph. We’ll be tightening security on Route 9. The green-hatted boy who tried to interfere with our operation in Cinder Volcano has been spotted flying overhead. While you three stand guard at the gate, I’m going to find a suitable place to set up a psychic barrier around the route.
