Saya baru saja menerima arahan baru
dari Zeph. Kami akan memperketat\lkeamanan di Route 9. Anak laki-laki

bertopi hijau yang mencoba
mengganggu operasi kami di Gunung\lBerapi Cinder telah terlihat

terbang di atas. Sementara kalian
bertiga berjaga di gerbang, saya\lakan mencari tempat yang cocok

untuk memasang penghalang psikis di
sekitar rute tersebut.

entries.translated: [blue]Ya, Bu!

In order to set up a strong
barrier, I should head to the peak\lof [green]Frost Mountain[red]\."

entries.translated:
Hmm\. Untuk memasang penghalang yang
kuat, aku harus menuju ke puncak\l[green]Frost Mountain[red]\.

You’re one of those Shadow goons,
aren’t you?

I’d recognize the symbol on
your chest anywhere.

You’re going to tell me what I
want to know, or I’m going to do\lto you what I did to those dumb\lgoons back at your hideout."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You! Hold it right there! You’re one of those Shadow goons, aren’t you? I’d recognize the symbol on your chest anywhere. You’re going to tell me what I want to know, or I’m going to do to you what I did to those dumb goons back at your hideout.

[blue]Hei! Berhenti di situ! Kau salah
satu anggota Shadow itu, kan? Aku\lakan mengenali simbol di dadamu di

mana pun. Kau akan memberitahuku
apa yang ingin kuketahui, atau aku\lakan melakukan padamu apa yang

kulakukan pada para anggota bodoh
itu di markas kalian.

someone, [rival]?

entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Is that really any way to talk to someone, [text-token-rival-2]? Move aside. You should learn threats are only effective if you can follow through on them.

[red]Apakah itu cara yang pantas untuk

belajar bahwa ancaman hanya efektif
jika kamu bisa menepatinya.

"[blue]Wha\.

You can’t just pretend like you
know me and treat me like I’m\lsome kid!

My Pokémon will beat you to
a pulp!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Wha[game-token-2] You can’t just pretend like you know me and treat me like I’m some kid! My Pokémon will beat you to a pulp!
entries.translated:
[blue]Wha\. Kamu tidak bisa berpura-pura
seolah mengenalku dan\lmemperlakukanku seperti anak kecil!

Pokémon-ku akan menghajarmu
habis-habisan!

I’m sorry about this, [rival]\."

entries.translated:
[red]Haa\.\CC0818 Ya sudah\. Maaf soal ini,
[rival]\.

entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Alakazam! Use Psychic!

entries.translated: [green]Shhhhzzz!

entries.original:

Return."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]That’s enough, Alakazam. Return.

entries.original:
"Oh\.

My whole body aches\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] My whole body aches[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Seluruh tubuhku sakit\.

What brings you all the way
out here?

Wait\.\CC0818 don’t tell me\.\CC0818 you came here

Well, that’s what I’ve been doing,
anyway.

As far as progress goes, I’ve
registered over 100 species, now.

\.\CC0818and you’ve decided you have a bone

Mmm? [player]\.\CC0820 apa itu kamu? Apa
yang membawamu jauh-jauh ke sini?\lTunggu\.\CC0818 jangan bilang\.\CC0818 kamu datang ke

Pokémon? Yah, itulah yang aku\llakukan juga. Sejauh

perkembangannya, aku sudah
mendaftarkan lebih dari 100 spesies\lsekarang. Apakah kamu pernah dengar

punya peluang lagi melawanku,\l[player]. Bahkan, aku akan

entries.original: "Gah\. not bad, [player]\."

entries.original:
"Heh\.\CC0820 looks like I still can’t
stand up to you yet.

That’s\.\CC0818 fine.

It just means there’s still a level
of strength I can still reach.

But I’ll get there.

I’m gonna be strong.
Stronger than anyone!

Just wait until the next time we
meet, [player], because you’re\lgoing down for sure, then!

important stuff to do."
entries.translation_source: Heh[game-token-1][control-code-2] looks like I still can’t stand up to you yet. That’s[game-token-3][control-code-4] fine. Just wait until the next time we meet, [player-name-5], because you’re going down for sure, then! Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got important stuff to do.
entries.translated:
Heh\.\CC0820 sepertinya aku masih belum bisa
mengalahkanmu. Itu\.\CC0818 tidak masalah.\lItu berarti masih ada level

kekuatan yang bisa kuraih. Tapi aku
akan sampai di sana. Aku akan\lmenjadi kuat. Lebih kuat dari siapa

pun! Tunggu saja sampai kita
bertemu lagi, [player], karena kamu\lpasti akan kalah saat itu!

Sekarang, jika kau permisi, aku
punya urusan penting.

entries.original:
"Log’s words echoed in your head:
[blue]Go make sure [rival] is okay!"
entries.translation_source: Log’s words echoed in your head: [color-blue-1]Go make sure [text-token-rival-2] is okay!
entries.translated:
Kata-kata Log bergema di kepalamu:
[blue]Pergi pastikan [rival] baik-baik\lsaja!

entries.original:
"Zeph?

Yeah, it’s Ivory.

I’ve successfully set up a barrier
around Route 9 from Blizzard City.

\.

Roger that.

I’ll head back down right away."
entries.translation_source: Zeph? Yeah, it’s Ivory. I’ve successfully set up a barrier around Route 9 from Blizzard City. [game-token-1] Roger that. I’ll head back down right away.
entries.translated:
Zeph? Ya, ini Ivory. Aku berhasil
memasang penghalang di sekitar Rute\l9 dari Blizzard City. \. Roger. Aku

akan segera kembali ke bawah.

entries.original:
"And just in case [rival] is
following me\."
entries.translation_source: And just in case [text-token-rival-1] is following me[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Dan untuk jaga-jaga [rival]
mengikuti saya\.

entries.original:
"[player], I forgot to show
you something!

Please, come with me to
the KBT Expressway."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], I forgot to show you something! Please, come with me to the KBT Expressway.
entries.translated:
[player], aku lupa menunjukkan
sesuatu kepadamu! Tolong, ikutlah\ldenganku ke KBT Expressway.

"For some reason, the entrance to
the KBT Expressway has frozen over.

As Gym Leader of this city, it’s
my job to take care of it.

Watch how I can use the move,
Rock Smash, to break the ice!"
entries.translation_source: For some reason, the entrance to the KBT Expressway has frozen over. As Gym Leader of this city, it’s my job to take care of it. Watch how I can use the move, Rock Smash, to break the ice!
entries.translated:
Untuk beberapa alasan, pintu masuk
ke KBT Expressway telah membeku.\lSebagai Pemimpin Gym di kota ini,

adalah tugasku untuk mengatasinya.
Lihat bagaimana aku bisa\lmenggunakan jurus, Penghancur Batu,

untuk memecahkan es!

entries.original:
"Gliscor!
Use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Gliscor! Use Rock Smash!
entries.translated: Gliscor! Gunakan Rock Smash!

entries.original:
"Gliscor!
Return!"
entries.translation_source: Gliscor! Return!
entries.translated: Gliscor! Kembali!

entries.original:
"Just face a cracked rock with a
Pokémon that can learn Rock Smash,\land you’ll be able to break it by\lpressing \btn00.

And if you have [green]Quick HMs[red] turned
on, the rock will go instantly!

You won’t even be asked if you want
to break it first!

I hope you understand the basics of
using Rock Smash now!

I have to get back to the Gym, so
I’ll see you again another time!"
entries.translation_source: Just face a cracked rock with a Pokémon that can learn Rock Smash, and you’ll be able to break it by pressing [button-icon-1]. And if you have [color-green-2]Quick HMs[color-red-3] turned on, the rock will go instantly! You won’t even be asked if you want to break it first! I hope you understand the basics of using Rock Smash now! I have to get back to the Gym, so I’ll see you again another time!

Hadapi saja batu retak dengan
Pokémon yang bisa mempelajari Rock\lSmash, dan kamu bisa memecahkannya

dengan menekan \btn00. Dan jika kamu
mengaktifkan [green]Quick HMs[red], batu itu\lakan langsung hancur! Kamu bahkan

tidak akan ditanya apakah ingin
memecahkannya terlebih dahulu!\lSemoga kamu mengerti dasar-dasar

penggunaan Rock Smash sekarang! Aku
harus kembali ke Gym, jadi sampai\ljumpa lagi lain kali!

entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Staraptor! Use Aerial Ace!
entries.translated: [blue]Staraptor! Gunakan Aerial Ace!

"[blue]Tell me how to get past the
barrier on Route 9!

I don’t have time to deal with
you Shadows!"

[blue]Katakan padaku cara melewati
penghalang di Route 9! Aku tidak\lpunya waktu untuk urusan dengan

kalian Shadow!

"[red]And why should I?

If you think a simple surprise attack
on me is enough to remove it,\lyou’re sorely mistaken.

\.\CC0820Your silly attempts to play hero
are tiring."

[red]Dan kenapa aku harus? Jika kamu
pikir serangan kejutan sederhana\lpadaku cukup untuk

keliru. \.\CC0820Usaha bodohmu untuk\lberlagak pahlawan itu melelahkan.

entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Alakazam! Get rid of him!
entries.translated: [red]Alakazam! Singkirkan dia!

"[blue]Gah!

My body\.\CC0820 won’t do\.\CC0820 as it’s told\.!"

entries.translated:
[blue]Gah! Tubuhku\.\CC0820 tidak mau\.\CC0820 menurut
perintah\.!

entries.original:
"[red]Good work.
Return, Alakazam."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Good work. Return, Alakazam.
entries.translated: [red]Kerja bagus. Kembali, Alakazam.

entries.original:
"[red]Now that that’s been taken care of,
I’d better get back to Route 9."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Now that that’s been taken care of, I’d better get back to Route 9.
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang setelah itu selesai,
sebaiknya aku kembali ke Route 9.

"Gah! That Shadow Admin really
ticks me off!"

entries.translated:
Gah! Shadow Admin itu benar-benar
membuatku kesal!

"If you hadn’t saved me, Staraptor,

There has to be some way onto
Route 9\."

Jika kamu tidak menyelamatkanku,
Staraptor, aku pasti sudah berenang\lbersama ikan sekarang! Argh\. Pasti

ada cara untuk masuk ke Route 9\.

"Argh\.

There has to be some way onto
Route 9\."

entries.translated:
Argh\. Pasti ada cara untuk masuk ke
Route 9\.

"[player]!

Uh\.\CC0818 I hope you didn’t\.\CC0818 you know\.\CC0818

[player]! Uh\.\CC0818 Kuharap kamu tidak\.\CC0818

punya waktu sebentar untuk\lmelakukannya?

entries.original:
"Thanks, [player].
I really appreciate it.

I’m going to try to find some way
onto [green]Route 9[blue] from [green]Tehl Town[blue].

You should probably try
something similar."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, [player-name-1]. I really appreciate it. I’m going to try to find some way onto [color-green-2]Route 9[color-blue-3] from [color-green-4]Tehl Town[color-blue-5]. You should probably try something similar.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih, [player]. Aku sangat
menghargainya. Aku akan mencoba\lmencari jalan ke [green]Route 9[blue] dari [green]Tehl

Town[blue]. Kamu sebaiknya mencoba hal
yang serupa.

"Oh!

You’ll need to take [green]Route 10[blue] to get
over to [green]Tehl Town[blue], so this could\lhelp you get there quickly."
entries.translation_source: Oh! You’ll need to take [color-green-1]Route 10[color-blue-2] to get over to [color-green-3]Tehl Town[color-blue-4], so this could help you get there quickly.
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu harus melewati [green]Route 10[blue]
untuk sampai ke [green]Tehl Town[blue], jadi ini\lbisa membantumu sampai di sana

dengan cepat.

entries.original: "Let’s go, Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: Let’s go, Staraptor.
entries.translated: Ayo pergi, Staraptor.

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]\.

I tried everything, and nothing
works\.

I could really use some help\."
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player-name-1][game-token-2] I tried everything, and nothing works[game-token-3] I could really use some help[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Ayolah, [player]\. Aku sudah mencoba
semuanya, dan tidak ada yang\lberhasil\. Aku benar-benar butuh

bantuan\.

entries.original: "LET ME IN!"
entries.translation_source: LET ME IN!
entries.translated: BIARKAN AKU MASUK!

"I swear, as soon as this
barrier is disengaged, I’m coming\lfor you grunts!"

entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah, begitu penghalang
ini disingkirkan, aku akan datang\luntuk kalian, para grunt!

"Good luck with that.

This barrier isn’t going down until
we’ve completed our operation.

There’s no way you’re getting in."
entries.translation_source: Good luck with that. This barrier isn’t going down until we’ve completed our operation. There’s no way you’re getting in.

Semoga beruntung dengan itu.
Penghalang ini tidak akan runtuh\lsampai kami menyelesaikan operasi

kami. Tidak mungkin kamu bisa
masuk.

"ARGH!

Come on, Staraptor. There has to
be another way onto the route.

Maybe there’s a secret [green]underground
passage[blue] in town\.

Let’s go look around."
entries.translation_source: ARGH! Come on, Staraptor. There has to be another way onto the route. Maybe there’s a secret [color-green-1]underground passage[color-blue-2] in town[game-token-3] Let’s go look around.
entries.translated:
ARGH! Ayo, Staraptor. Pasti ada
cara lain menuju rute itu. Mungkin\lada [green]jalan bawah tanah rahasia[blue] di

kota\. Ayo kita lihat-lihat.

entries.original:
"[player]!

So you found the hidden passage
too, I see.

But it looks like we’ll have a ton
of Shadows to fight through just to\lget to my grampa’s friend.

Actually, why don’t we team up?
We could move quicker that way."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! So you found the hidden passage too, I see. But it looks like we’ll have a ton of Shadows to fight through just to get to my grampa’s friend. Actually, why don’t we team up? We could move quicker that way.

[player]! Jadi kamu juga menemukan
jalan tersembunyi itu, ya. Tapi\lsepertinya kita harus melawan

banyak Bayangan hanya untuk sampai
ke teman kakekku. Sebenarnya,\lkenapa kita tidak bekerja sama

saja? Kita bisa bergerak lebih
cepat dengan cara itu.

"What?\CC0818 Are\.\CC0818 are you sure you can
make it on your own?

But I\.\CC0818 Sigh\. I understand,
[player].

If you’ve got other things to take
care of first, I’ll look for my\lgrampa’s friend on my own."

But I[game-token-4][control-code-5] Sigh[game-token-6] I understand, [player-name-7]. If you’ve got other things to take care of first, I’ll look for my grampa’s friend on my own.

Apa?\CC0818 Apakah\.\CC0818 kamu yakin bisa

ada urusan lain yang harus
diselesaikan dulu, aku akan mencari\lteman kakekku sendiri.

like a two-Trainer job.

Why don’t you take the lead?

I’ll support your Pokémon and keep
them healed.

Let’s do this thing, [player]!"

entries.translated:
Hebat! Rutenya cukup besar, jadi
sepertinya ini pekerjaan dua\lTrainer. Kenapa kamu tidak

memimpin? Aku akan mendukung
Pokémon-mu dan menjaga mereka tetap\lpulih. Ayo kita lakukan ini,

[player]!

"Let’s find my grampa’s friend,
[player]!

Before the Shadows do something
unspeakable\."
entries.translation_source: Let’s find my grampa’s friend, [player-name-1]! Before the Shadows do something unspeakable[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ayo kita temukan teman kakekku,
[player]! Sebelum Bayangan\lmelakukan sesuatu yang tak

terkatakan\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
Where are you going?

We don’t have time to leave
Route 9.

Unless, you’re saying you no longer
want to team up with me?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Where are you going? We don’t have time to leave Route 9. Unless, you’re saying you no longer want to team up with me?
entries.translated:
[player]! Mau ke mana? Kita tidak
punya waktu untuk meninggalkan\lRoute 9. Kecuali, kau mengatakan

tidak ingin lagi bekerja sama
denganku?

entries.original:
"Looks like the path to the house is
on our right, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Looks like the path to the house is on our right, [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Sepertinya jalan menuju rumah ada
di sebelah kanan kita, [player].

entries.original:
"Let’s hurry that way before it’s
too late!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s hurry that way before it’s too late!
entries.translated:
Ayo cepat ke sana sebelum
terlambat!

entries.original:
"[blue]It looks like we made it.
I’ll go on ahead.

Follow me inside quickly!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It looks like we made it. I’ll go on ahead. Follow me inside quickly!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sepertinya kita berhasil. Aku akan
maju dulu. Ikuti aku ke dalam\ldengan cepat!

entries.original: "Dr. Harth"
entries.translation_source: Dr. Harth
entries.translated: Dr. Harth

entries.original:
"[blue]You think I’m gonna let you walk out
of here!?

You stole the Prison Stone\.
the very thing needed to seal\land unseal the dark force!

You couldn’t possibly want it for
anything, except evil!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You think I’m gonna let you walk out of here!? You stole the Prison Stone[game-token-2] the very thing needed to seal and unseal the dark force! You couldn’t possibly want it for anything, except evil!
entries.translated:
[blue]Kamu pikir aku akan membiarkanmu
keluar dari sini!? Kamu mencuri\lPrison Stone\. barang yang diperlukan

untuk menyegel dan membuka segel
kekuatan gelap! Kamu tidak mungkin\lmenginginkannya untuk hal lain,

kecuali kejahatan!

entries.original:
"I’m afraid, as always, you are quite
mistaken, boy.

But I’ll humor you for a moment\.

What, exactly, do you think we
have planned?

Based on what you’ve seen of us?
Please, enlighten me."
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid, as always, you are quite mistaken, boy. But I’ll humor you for a moment[game-token-1] What, exactly, do you think we have planned? Based on what you’ve seen of us? Please, enlighten me.
entries.translated:
Aku khawatir, seperti biasa, kamu
benar-benar salah, nak. Tapi aku\lakan melayanimu sebentar\. Apa,

tepatnya, yang kau pikir kami
rencanakan? Berdasarkan apa yang\lkau lihat dari kami? Tolong,

jelaskan padaku.

entries.original:
"[blue]What else?

Capturing the Legendary bird
Pokémon\.\CC0818 stealing the Prison Stone\.

You intend to plunge Borrius into war
and darkness!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What else? Capturing the Legendary bird Pokémon[game-token-2][control-code-3] stealing the Prison Stone[game-token-4] You intend to plunge Borrius into war and darkness!
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa lagi? Menangkap Pokémon Burung
Legendaris\.\CC0818 mencuri Prison Stone\.\lKamu berniat menjerumuskan Borrius

ke dalam perang dan kegelapan!

entries.original:
"[red]Interesting.

Then I ask you: why would we ever
do that?

Send our own region into chaos?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Interesting. Then I ask you: why would we ever do that? Send our own region into chaos?
entries.translated:
[red]Menarik. Lalu saya bertanya kepada
Anda: mengapa kita akan melakukan\litu? Mengirim daerah kita sendiri

ke dalam kekacauan?

entries.original:
"[blue]What?

Well\.\CC0820 rule the world?

The dark force is an incredible
power, and\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What? Well[game-token-2][control-code-3] rule the world? The dark force is an incredible power, and[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa? Baiklah\.\CC0820 menguasai dunia?
Kekuatan gelap adalah kekuatan yang\lluar biasa, dan\.

entries.original:
"[red]I knew it. You can only think of
simple, immature motives.

You think that the \qoforce we intend
to release\qc is only for destruction.

In fact, our intent is to save.

Save something that we unjustly lost,
and would sacrifice much to regain\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I knew it. You can only think of simple, immature motives. You think that the [quote-open-2]force we intend to release[quote-close-3] is only for destruction. In fact, our intent is to save. Save something that we unjustly lost, and would sacrifice much to regain[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[red]Aku sudah tahu. Kamu hanya bisa
memikirkan motif sederhana dan\lkekanak-kanakan. Kamu pikir bahwa

\qokekuatan yang kami maksud untuk
lepaskan\qc hanya untuk kehancuran.\lSebenarnya, niat kami adalah untuk

menyelamatkan. Menyelamatkan
sesuatu yang secara tidak adil kami\lkehilangan, dan akan berkorban

banyak untuk mendapatkannya kembali\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh? What are you talking about?

I don’t get what you’re saying
at all!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Huh? What are you talking about? I don’t get what you’re saying at all!
entries.translated:
[blue]Huh? Apa yang kamu bicarakan? Aku
sama sekali tidak mengerti apa yang\lkamu katakan!

entries.original:
"[red]I won’t waste any more time
explaining.

That time can be better spent making
sure you\.\CC0820 and your friend waiting\lby the door are dealt with."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I won’t waste any more time explaining. That time can be better spent making sure you[game-token-2][control-code-3] and your friend waiting by the door are dealt with.
entries.translated:
[red]Saya tidak akan membuang waktu lagi
untuk menjelaskan. Waktu itu bisa\llebih baik digunakan untuk

memastikan Anda\.\CC0820 dan teman Anda yang
menunggu di pintu sudah ditangani.

entries.original:
"[blue][player]! You’re right on time!

The Shadows have the Prison Stone,
the object needed to release the\ldark force!

You gotta help me get that thing
back!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! You’re right on time! The Shadows have the Prison Stone, the object needed to release the dark force! You gotta help me get that thing back!
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Kamu tepat waktu! Para
Shadow memiliki Prison Stone, benda\lyang diperlukan untuk melepaskan

kekuatan gelap! Kamu harus
membantuku mengambilnya kembali!

entries.original:
"I should have known they wouldn’t
go quietly.

You, grunt, assist me."
entries.translation_source: I should have known they wouldn’t go quietly. You, grunt, assist me.
entries.translated:
Aku seharusnya tahu mereka tidak
akan pergi dengan tenang. Kau,\lpreman, bantu aku.

entries.original:
"Scientists, prepare the backup plan
in case we’re defeated."
entries.translation_source: Scientists, prepare the backup plan in case we’re defeated.
entries.translated:
Para ilmuwan, siapkan rencana
cadangan kalau kita dikalahkan.

entries.original:
"Right away.

We’ll activate the mobile creation
pods."
entries.translation_source: Right away. We’ll activate the mobile creation pods.
entries.translated:
Segera. Kami akan mengaktifkan pod
pembuatan bergerak.

entries.original:
"Please don’t take this personally,
but I’ll have to escort both of\lyou out\.\CC0818 the hard way."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t take this personally, but I’ll have to escort both of you out[game-token-1][control-code-2] the hard way.
entries.translated:
Jangan anggap ini pribadi, tapi aku
harus mengantar kalian berdua\lkeluar\.\CC0818 dengan cara kasar.

entries.original:
"[blue]How’s that!

As long as I’ve got my Pokémon,
I’m unstoppable!

No\.\CC0818 we’re unstoppable!

Now, hand over the Prison Stone!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]How’s that! As long as I’ve got my Pokémon, I’m unstoppable! No[game-token-2][control-code-3] we’re unstoppable! Now, hand over the Prison Stone!
entries.translated:
[blue]Bagaimana! Selama aku punya
Pokémon-ku, aku tak terhentikan!\lTidak\.\CC0818 kita tak terhentikan!

Sekarang, serahkan Batu Penjara!

entries.original:
"Hmph\.

Funny thing to say, considering your
friend did most of the work\."
entries.translation_source: Hmph[game-token-1] Funny thing to say, considering your friend did most of the work[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Hmph\. Lucu bicaranya, mengingat
temanmu yang melakukan sebagian\lbesar pekerjaan\.

entries.original: "[blue]W-what did you say!?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]W-what did you say!?
entries.translated: [blue]A-apa katamu!?

entries.original:
"No matter the numbers, we’re not
beaten yet\.\CC0818 assuming they’re ready.

And they should be functional by
now, I hope?"
entries.translation_source: No matter the numbers, we’re not beaten yet[game-token-1][control-code-2] assuming they’re ready. And they should be functional by now, I hope?
entries.translated:
Berapa pun jumlahnya, kami belum
kalah\.\CC0818 dengan asumsi mereka sudah\lsiap. Dan mereka seharusnya sudah

berfungsi sekarang, kuharap?

entries.original:
"Yes, ma’am.

They are not as powerful as the ones
we can synthesize in the lab\.

However, they should serve well
enough as a distraction."
entries.translation_source: Yes, ma’am. They are not as powerful as the ones we can synthesize in the lab[game-token-1] However, they should serve well enough as a distraction.
entries.translated:
Ya, Nyonya. Mereka tidak sekuat
yang bisa kami sintesis di\llaboratorium\. Namun, mereka

seharusnya cukup berguna sebagai
pengalih perhatian.

entries.original:
"[blue]What\.\CC0820 are those things?

Don’t tell me\.\CC0820 that’s the
old couple!?

What did you do to them!?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What[game-token-2][control-code-3] are those things? Don’t tell me[game-token-4][control-code-5] that’s the old couple!? What did you do to them!?
entries.translated:
[blue]Apa\.\CC0820 benda-benda itu? Jangan bilang\.\CC0820
itu pasangan tua itu!? Apa yang kau\llakukan pada mereka!?

entries.original:
"They’ve been optimized, into
something more fit for our purpose.

And right now, their purpose\.\CC0818 is to
hold you off, as we retreat."
entries.translation_source: They’ve been optimized, into something more fit for our purpose. And right now, their purpose[game-token-1][control-code-2] is to hold you off, as we retreat.
entries.translated:
Mereka telah dioptimalkan, menjadi
sesuatu yang lebih sesuai untuk\ltujuan kita. Dan sekarang, tujuan

mereka\.\CC0818 adalah menahan kalian, saat
kami mundur.

entries.original:
"Dangit\.\CC0818 I don’t wanna let them
get away, but we have to help\lthose poor people!

Maybe we’re not too late!

If we can beat them quickly enough,
hopefully they’ll go back to the\lway they were!"
entries.translation_source: Dangit[game-token-1][control-code-2] I don’t wanna let them get away, but we have to help those poor people! Maybe we’re not too late! If we can beat them quickly enough, hopefully they’ll go back to the way they were!
entries.translated:
Sial\.\CC0818 Aku tidak ingin membiarkan
mereka lolos, tapi kita harus\lmembantu orang-orang malang itu!

Mungkin kita belum terlambat! Jika
kita bisa mengalahkan mereka cukup\lcepat, semoga mereka kembali

seperti semula!

entries.original: "[red]Shadow Warriors, attack!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Shadow Warriors, attack!
entries.translated: [red]Shadow Warriors, serang!

entries.original:
"Ohh\.

What did I\.\CC0820 what was I doing\.?"
entries.translation_source: Ohh[game-token-1] What did I[game-token-2][control-code-3] what was I doing[game-token-4]?
entries.translated:
Ohh\. Apa yang aku\.\CC0820 apa yang sedang
kulakukan\.?

entries.original:
"We did it!
They’re okay!"
entries.translation_source: We did it! They’re okay!
entries.translated:
Kita berhasil! Mereka baik-baik
saja!

entries.original:
"Oh! Thank you, Jax\.\CC0820 and my thanks
to you too\.\CC0820 [player], was it?

Any longer, and our will would have
been overwritten entirely."
entries.translation_source: Oh! Thank you, Jax[game-token-1][control-code-2] and my thanks to you too[game-token-3][control-code-4] [player-name-5], was it? Any longer, and our will would have been overwritten entirely.
entries.translated:
Oh! Terima kasih, Jax\.\CC0820 dan terima
kasih juga padamu\.\CC0820 [player], {B4}kan?\lLebih lama lagi, dan kemauan kami

akan ditimpa sepenuhnya.

entries.original:
"What matters is that you’re
safe now."
entries.translation_source: What matters is that you’re safe now.
entries.translated:
Yang penting adalah kau aman
sekarang.

entries.original:
"But dangit\.\CC0820 they got away with the
Prison Stone\."
entries.translation_source: But dangit[game-token-1][control-code-2] they got away with the Prison Stone[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tapi sial\.\CC0820 mereka kabur dengan Batu
Penjara\.

entries.original:
"So they managed to escape with it\.

Jax, you must give chase!

If they break the stone and use
the bottle inside, then the results\lcould be catastrophic!"
entries.translation_source: So they managed to escape with it[game-token-1] Jax, you must give chase! If they break the stone and use the bottle inside, then the results could be catastrophic!
entries.translated:
Jadi mereka berhasil kabur dengan
itu\. Jax, kau harus mengejar! Jika\lmereka memecahkan batu itu dan

menggunakan botol di dalamnya, maka
hasilnya bisa menjadi bencana!

entries.original:
"I know\.\CC0818 do you know where they
could be headed, Dr. Harth?"
entries.translation_source: I know[game-token-1][control-code-2] do you know where they could be headed, Dr. Harth?
entries.translated:
Aku tahu\.\CC0818 apakah kau tahu ke mana
mereka mungkin pergi, Dr. Harth?

entries.original:
"If they intend to release the seal
on the stone, they will be heading\lfor the [green]Ruins of Void[blue].

Only there can the bottle within
be obtained."
entries.translation_source: If they intend to release the seal on the stone, they will be heading for the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2]. Only there can the bottle within be obtained.
entries.translated:
Jika mereka berniat melepaskan
segel pada batu tersebut, mereka\lakan menuju ke [green]Reruntuhan

Kekosongan[blue]. Hanya di sana botol di
dalamnya dapat diperoleh.

entries.original:
"The [green]Ruins of Void[blue], he said\.

[player], I’m heading back to brief
Grampa on what’s happened.

While I’m doing that, you should
head to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

As long as the Shadows don’t have
Zapdos, there’s still a chance to\lstop them!

Oh yeah\.\CC0818 since you need the HM
move [green]Strength[blue] to navigate the\lmountain path\.

You should probably head back to
[green]Fallshore City[blue], and get the Gym\lBadge there.

I think I last saw the Gym Leader,
back in [green]Tehl Town[blue], actually\.

Once you’ve done that and rescued
[green]Zapdos[blue], I’ll meet up with you in\l[green]Epidimy Town[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2], he said[game-token-3] [player-name-4], I’m heading back to brief Grampa on what’s happened. While I’m doing that, you should head to [color-green-5]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-6] As long as the Shadows don’t have Zapdos, there’s still a chance to stop them! Oh yeah[game-token-7][control-code-8] since you need the HM move [color-green-9]Strength[color-blue-10] to navigate the mountain path[game-token-11] You should probably head back to [color-green-12]Fallshore City[color-blue-13], and get the Gym Badge there. I think I last saw the Gym Leader, back in [color-green-14]Tehl Town[color-blue-15], actually[game-token-16] Once you’ve done that and rescued [color-green-17]Zapdos[color-blue-18], I’ll meet up with you in [color-green-19]Epidimy Town[color-blue-20].
entries.translated:
[green]Reruntuhan Kekosongan[blue], katanya\.
[player], aku akan kembali untuk\lmemberi tahu Grampa tentang apa

yang terjadi. Selagi aku
melakukannya, kamu harus pergi ke\l[green]Gunung Thundercap[blue] Selama Shadow

tidak memiliki Zapdos, masih ada
kesempatan untuk menghentikan\lmereka! Oh ya\.\CC0818 karena kamu butuh

gerakan HM [green]Kekuatan[blue] untuk melewati
jalur gunung\. Kamu mungkin harus\lkembali ke [green]Kota Fallshore[blue], dan

mendapatkan Lencana Gym di sana.
Sepertinya aku terakhir melihat\lPemimpin Gym, di [green]Kota Tehl[blue],

sebenarnya\. Setelah kamu
melakukannya dan menyelamatkan\l[green]Zapdos[blue], aku akan menemuimu di [green]Kota

Epidimy[blue].

entries.original:
"Phew\.\CC0820 nothin’ beats gettin’ away
from the city life and comin’ back\lto Mother Nature.

I mean, how else are ya gonna get
a great natural tan like mine, huh?

Good looks are things ya gotta put
in effort to keep up, after all.

Beauty is the most important virtue,
ammirite?"
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1][control-code-2] nothin’ beats gettin’ away from the city life and comin’ back to Mother Nature. I mean, how else are ya gonna get a great natural tan like mine, huh? Good looks are things ya gotta put in effort to keep up, after all. Beauty is the most important virtue, ammirite?
entries.translated:
Fiuh\.\CC0820 tidak ada yang mengalahkan
menjauh dari kehidupan kota dan\lkembali ke Alam. Maksudku,

bagaimana lagi kau bisa mendapatkan
kulit sawo matang alami yang bagus\lseperti milikku, ya? Penampilan

adalah hal yang harus kamu usahakan
untuk dijaga, bagaimanapun juga.\lKecantikan adalah kebajikan yang

paling penting, betul kan?

entries.original:
"Right. Ya know what’s important
in life. I like that."
entries.translation_source: Right. Ya know what’s important in life. I like that.
entries.translated:
Benar. Kau tahu apa yang penting
dalam hidup. Aku suka itu.

entries.original:
"Partner, ya dunno what yer missin’,
then."
entries.translation_source: Partner, ya dunno what yer missin’, then.
entries.translated:
Partner, kau tidak tahu apa yang
kau lewatkan, kalau begitu.

entries.original:
"This place is perfect for my
routine.

Whenever I head back to the Gym,
the mist from the waterfalls\lcomplements my well-toned bod.

Wanna feel? All natural pecs,
right here."
entries.translation_source: This place is perfect for my routine. Whenever I head back to the Gym, the mist from the waterfalls complements my well-toned bod. Wanna feel? All natural pecs, right here.
entries.translated:
Tempat ini sempurna untuk
rutinitasku. Setiap kali aku\lkembali ke Gym, kabut dari air

terjun melengkapi tubuhku yang
terawat. Mau merasakan? Otot dada\lalami, di sini.

entries.original:
"Oh, sorry, name’s Mel, the
[green]Fallshore City[blue] Gym Leader.

Sorry I wasn’t in when ya came
knockin’, but, well\.\CC0818 my workout\lwaits for no one.

It’s a lotta pressure, but the gals
back at the Gym don’t seem to\lmind\.

Anyway, I’m just about done for
the day, so if ya wanna battle,\lI got time for it.

See ya soon, partner."
entries.translation_source: Oh, sorry, name’s Mel, the [color-green-1]Fallshore City[color-blue-2] Gym Leader. Sorry I wasn’t in when ya came knockin’, but, well[game-token-3][control-code-4] my workout waits for no one. It’s a lotta pressure, but the gals back at the Gym don’t seem to mind[game-token-5] Anyway, I’m just about done for the day, so if ya wanna battle, I got time for it. See ya soon, partner.
entries.translated:
Oh, maaf, namaku Mel, Pemimpin Gym
[green]Fallshore City[blue]. Maaf aku tidak ada\lsaat kamu datang mengetuk, tapi, ya\.\CC0818

latihanku tidak menunggu siapa pun.
Itu banyak tekanan, tapi para gadis\ldi Gym sepertinya tidak keberatan\.

Bagaimanapun, aku hampir selesai
untuk hari ini, jadi jika kamu\lingin bertarung, aku punya waktu

untuk itu. Sampai jumpa, partner.

entries.original:
"Just wanna quick word with ya,
before ya hightail it."
entries.translation_source: Just wanna quick word with ya, before ya hightail it.
entries.translated:
Cuma mau ngomong sebentar sama
kamu, sebelum kamu kabur.

entries.original:
"Right ’fore ya arrived, I’d been
hearin’ some hubbub about some\lrascals stoppin’ the townsfolk\lin [green]Epidimy[blue] from explorin’ ol’\l[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

Now, I was thinkin’ ’bout layin’ down
the law on them outlaws.

’Cos not only do I look good,
I do good, too.

And I do it while lookin’ good!

Anyway, one of ’em said they were
guardin’ the mountain to keep\lya out.

Mentioned yer name an’ everythin’.

Now, I don’t rightly know what
kinda hullabaloo yer mixed up in,\lbut I’m gonna help ya fix it.

So, take this and get yer heinie to
Epidimy faster."
entries.translation_source: Right ’fore ya arrived, I’d been hearin’ some hubbub about some rascals stoppin’ the townsfolk in [color-green-1]Epidimy[color-blue-2] from explorin’ ol’ [color-green-3]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-4] Now, I was thinkin’ ’bout layin’ down the law on them outlaws. ’Cos not only do I look good, I do good, too. And I do it while lookin’ good! Anyway, one of ’em said they were guardin’ the mountain to keep ya out. Mentioned yer name an’ everythin’. Now, I don’t rightly know what kinda hullabaloo yer mixed up in, but I’m gonna help ya fix it. So, take this and get yer heinie to Epidimy faster.
entries.translated:
Tepat sebelum kamu tiba, aku sudah
mendengar keributan tentang\lbeberapa berandal yang menghalangi

penduduk di [green]Epidimy[blue] untuk
menjelajahi [green]Gunung Thundercap.[blue]\lSekarang, aku berpikir untuk

menegakkan hukum pada para penjahat
itu. Karena tidak hanya aku tampan,\laku juga berbuat baik. Dan aku

melakukannya sambil tetap tampan!
Bagaimanapun, salah satu dari\lmereka bilang mereka menjaga gunung

itu untuk mengusirmu. Mereka
menyebut namamu dan segalanya.\lSekarang, aku tidak tahu benar apa

keributan yang kamu terlibat, tapi
aku akan membantumu\lmenyelesaikannya. Jadi, ambil ini

dan cepatlah pergi ke Epidimy.

entries.original:
"[blue]Just like the other HM’s, if ya
got a Pokémon that can learn it,\lit can use it.

Just choose a Pokémon that can
learn it, and as long as it ain’t\lgot four HM moves learned already,\lthat nifty doodad can take ya\lanywhere ya been before.

Anyway, don’t keep me waitin’ too
long, partner.

Ya don’t wanna miss my fine an’
dandy work!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Just like the other HM’s, if ya got a Pokémon that can learn it, it can use it. Just choose a Pokémon that can learn it, and as long as it ain’t got four HM moves learned already, that nifty doodad can take ya anywhere ya been before. Anyway, don’t keep me waitin’ too long, partner. Ya don’t wanna miss my fine an’ dandy work!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sama seperti HM lainnya, jika kamu
punya Pokémon yang bisa\lmempelajarinya, ia bisa

menggunakannya. Pilih saja Pokémon
yang bisa mempelajarinya, dan\lselama ia belum mempelajari empat

jurus HM, gadget keren itu bisa
membawamu ke mana pun yang pernah\lkamu kunjungi sebelumnya.

Bagaimanapun, jangan buat aku
menunggu terlalu lama, kawan. Kamu\ltidak ingin melewatkan hasil

karyaku yang bagus dan hebat!

entries.original:
"This is your final warning, rascal.
Move or be moved."
entries.translation_source: This is your final warning, rascal. Move or be moved.
entries.translated:
Ini peringatan terakhirmu, nakal.
Pindah atau dipindahkan.

entries.original:
"I refuse to abandon my post.

I must prevent [player] from entering
Thundercap Mt. at all cost."
entries.translation_source: I refuse to abandon my post. I must prevent [player-name-1] from entering Thundercap Mt. at all cost.
entries.translated:
Saya menolak untuk meninggalkan pos
saya. Saya harus mencegah [player]\lmemasuki Gunung Thundercap dengan

segala cara.

entries.original: "[buffer1], hit ’em with a [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1], hit ’em with a [buffer2-2]!
entries.translated:
[buffer1], pukul mereka dengan
[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Now, I don’t wanna hurt ya,
but I got a deep-tissue massage\llater today\.

And if I’m late ’cos yer holdin’ me
up, well, there’s gonna be trouble."
entries.translation_source: Now, I don’t wanna hurt ya, but I got a deep-tissue massage later today[game-token-1] And if I’m late ’cos yer holdin’ me up, well, there’s gonna be trouble.
entries.translated:
Sekarang, aku tidak ingin
menyakitimu, tapi aku ada pijat\ljaringan dalam hari ini\. Dan jika

aku terlambat karena kau menahanku,
yah, akan ada masalah.

entries.original:
"Urgh\.\CC0820 so why’d you\.\CC0820 hit me first,
then\.?"
entries.translation_source: Urgh[game-token-1][control-code-2] so why’d you[game-token-3][control-code-4] hit me first, then[game-token-5]?
entries.translated:
Urgh\.\CC0820 jadi kenapa kamu\.\CC0820 memukul aku
duluan, lalu\.?

entries.original:
"Awright, I reckon ya got this from
here, partner.

As for me, I gotta run.

Whatever these rascals are up to,
they don’ want ya interferin’.

Go wild in there fer me, okay?"
entries.translation_source: Awright, I reckon ya got this from here, partner. As for me, I gotta run. Whatever these rascals are up to, they don’ want ya interferin’. Go wild in there fer me, okay?
entries.translated:
Baiklah, menurutku kamu bisa ambil
alih dari sini, kawan. Sedangkan\laku, aku harus pergi dulu. Apapun

yang sedang dilakukan oleh para
berandal ini, mereka tidak ingin\lkamu ikut campur. Bikin onar di

sana untukku, oke?

entries.original:
"Owww\.
My head\."
entries.translation_source: Owww[game-token-1] My head[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Aduh\. Kepalaku\.

entries.original: "STOP!"
entries.translation_source: STOP!
entries.translated: BERHENTI!

entries.original:
"I can’t let you through!

\.

That look\.\CC0818 do you seriously not
remember me?

I’m the grunt you and your friend
disgraced back at our base!

I’ve gotten stronger since then,
so it’s time for a little payback!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t let you through! [game-token-1] That look[game-token-2][control-code-3] do you seriously not remember me? I’m the grunt you and your friend disgraced back at our base! I’ve gotten stronger since then, so it’s time for a little payback!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa membiarkanmu lewat! \.
Tampang\.\CC0818 apa kau benar-benar tidak\lmengingatku? Aku preman yang kau

dan temanmu permalukan di markas
kami! Aku telah menjadi lebih kuat\lsejak saat itu, jadi saatnya untuk

sedikit balas dendam!

entries.original:
"You’ve really done it now!

This was my last chance to get back
in good standing with the higher-\lups, and you ruined it!

I’ll never forget this!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve really done it now! This was my last chance to get back in good standing with the higher- ups, and you ruined it! I’ll never forget this!
entries.translated:
Kamu benar-benar sudah melakukannya
sekarang! Ini adalah kesempatan\lterakhirku untuk mendapatkan

kembali reputasi baik di mata para
petinggi, dan kamu merusaknya! Aku\ltidak akan pernah melupakan ini!

entries.original:
"[red]Uh oh!

[player]’s hot on our tails!

I’d better go warn Marlon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Uh oh! [player-name-2]’s hot on our tails! I’d better go warn Marlon!
entries.translated:
[red]Uh oh! [player] mengejar kita!
Lebih baik aku peringatkan Marlon!

entries.original:
"I have the key to free
the Pokémon!

But you’re not getting it!"
entries.translation_source: I have the key to free the Pokémon! But you’re not getting it!
entries.translated:
Aku punya kunci untuk membebaskan
Pokémon! Tapi kau tidak akan\lmendapatkannya!

entries.original: "Okay, maybe you ARE getting it\."
entries.translation_source: Okay, maybe you ARE getting it[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oke, mungkin kau BENAR-BENAR
mendapatkannya\.

entries.original:
"The other grunts are gonna be
peeved\."
entries.translation_source: The other grunts are gonna be peeved[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Preman-preman lainnya akan kesal\.

entries.original:
"[black]There appear to be some Pokémon
sealed behind an electric barrier."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]There appear to be some Pokémon sealed behind an electric barrier.
entries.translated:
[black]Tampaknya ada beberapa Pokémon yang
tersegel di balik penghalang\llistrik.

entries.original:
"[black]There appear to be some Pokémon
sealed behind an electric barrier.

Disengage the barrier to free them?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]There appear to be some Pokémon sealed behind an electric barrier. Disengage the barrier to free them?
entries.translated:
[black]Tampaknya ada beberapa Pokémon yang
tersegel di balik penghalang\llistrik. Nonaktifkan penghalang

untuk membebaskan mereka?

entries.original: "[black][player] disengaged the barrier!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] disengaged the barrier!
entries.translated: [black][player] menonaktifkan penghalang!

entries.original:
"[black]The freed Pokémon appear to be
headed up the mountain."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The freed Pokémon appear to be headed up the mountain.
entries.translated:
[black]Pokémon yang dibebaskan tampaknya
menuju ke atas gunung.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon you freed are
repairing the stairs!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon you freed are repairing the stairs!
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang kau bebaskan sedang
memperbaiki tangga!

entries.original:
"One with the wind, one with the
lightning\.

The all-seeing eye of the raging
thunderstorm!

Now, become the lightning that
smites all evil!

Sankren thoron!

Descend to me, Zapdos!
Shake the sky and let thunder roar!

Come forth from the stormy clouds
in which you dwell!"
entries.translation_source: One with the wind, one with the lightning[game-token-1] The all-seeing eye of the raging thunderstorm! Now, become the lightning that smites all evil! Sankren thoron! Descend to me, Zapdos! Shake the sky and let thunder roar! Come forth from the stormy clouds in which you dwell!
entries.translated:
Satu dengan angin, satu dengan
petir\. Mata yang melihat segalanya\ldari badai guntur yang mengamuk!

Sekarang, jadilah petir yang
menghantam semua kejahatan! Sankren\lthoron! Turunlah padaku, Zapdos!

Guncangkan langit dan biarkan
guntur mengaum! Keluarlah dari awan\lbadai tempat kau bersemayam!

entries.original:
"Finally, the very last key appears in
front of us\.\CC0820 and now\."
entries.translation_source: Finally, the very last key appears in front of us[game-token-1][control-code-2] and now[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, kunci yang terakhir
muncul di depan kita\.\CC0820 dan sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Wha - it knocked out that Shadow
Warrior in a single blow!?

So much for its \qoelectrical
resistance\qc\."
entries.translation_source: Wha - it knocked out that Shadow Warrior in a single blow!? So much for its [quote-open-1]electrical resistance[quote-close-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Wha - dia mengalahkan Prajurit
Bayangan itu dalam satu pukulan!?\lJadi inilah \qoketahanan listrik\qcnya\.

entries.original:
"All remaining Shadow Warriors,
restrain Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: All remaining Shadow Warriors, restrain Zapdos!
entries.translated:
Semua Prajurit Bayangan yang
tersisa, tahan Zapdos!

entries.original: "Tch\.\CC0818 so that’s its Discharge attack\."
entries.translation_source: Tch[game-token-1][control-code-2] so that’s its Discharge attack[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tch\.\CC0818 jadi itu serangan Pelepasan
Muatan miliknya\.

entries.original:
"Well, Zapdos, you leave me
no choice\."
entries.translation_source: Well, Zapdos, you leave me no choice[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Yah, Zapdos, kau tidak memberiku
pilihan\.

entries.original:
"Heh\.
Nice try, Zapdos.

But I don’t make the same
mistake twice."
entries.translation_source: Heh[game-token-1] Nice try, Zapdos. But I don’t make the same mistake twice.
entries.translated:
Heh\. Usaha yang bagus, Zapdos. Tapi
aku tidak membuat kesalahan yang\lsama dua kali.

entries.original: "Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!"
entries.translation_source: Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!
entries.translated: Krookodile! Gunakan Cadas Tajam!

entries.original: "[green]Dile!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Dile!
entries.translated: [green]Dile!

entries.original: "[lightgreen]A critical hit!"
entries.translation_source: [color-lightgreen-1]A critical hit!
entries.translated: [lightgreen]Serangan kritis!

entries.original:
"Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you\.\CC0818
to finally be ours!"
entries.translation_source: Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you[game-token-1][control-code-2] to finally be ours!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, Zapdos, saatnya bagimu\.\CC0818
untuk akhirnya menjadi milik kita!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0818 that took a lot longer
than I expected\."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1][control-code-2] that took a lot longer than I expected[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Huh\.\CC0818 itu memakan waktu lebih lama
dari yang kuduga\.

entries.original:
"Now, all that’s left is to rendezvous
at the [green]Ruins of Void[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Now, all that’s left is to rendezvous at the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Sekarang, yang tersisa hanyalah
bertemu di [green]Reruntuhan Void[blue]\.

entries.original:
"You again!

What were those guards doing?

I had them all stationed to prevent
you or that green-hatted boy from\linterfering!

I even destroyed the stairs behind
me\.\CC0818 and yet\.\CC0818 you’re here.

How did you manage to pull
it off\.?

It would take a monumental amount of
stubbornness to not realize it was\lsupposed to be impossible."
entries.translation_source: You again! What were those guards doing? I had them all stationed to prevent you or that green-hatted boy from interfering! I even destroyed the stairs behind me[game-token-1][control-code-2] and yet[game-token-3][control-code-4] you’re here. How did you manage to pull it off[game-token-5]? It would take a monumental amount of stubbornness to not realize it was supposed to be impossible.
entries.translated:
Kamu lagi! Apa yang dilakukan para
penjaga itu? Aku sudah menempatkan\lmereka semua untuk mencegahmu atau

anak laki-laki bertopi hijau itu
ikut campur! Aku bahkan\lmenghancurkan tangga di belakangku\.\CC0818

dan tetap saja\.\CC0818 kamu ada di sini.
Bagaimana caramu berhasil\lmelakukannya\.? Dibutuhkan sifat

keras kepala yang luar biasa untuk
tidak menyadari bahwa itu\lseharusnya mustahil.

entries.original:
"But\.\CC0818 no matter how it happened,
no matter that you’re here now\.

None of it changes the fact that
I have Zapdos in my possession.

With its power in my hands, there’s
no chance you’ll be able to stop\lme from leaving.

And if you think there is, then, I
will show you first-hand\.

The power of Zapdos!
The power of a Legendary Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: But[game-token-1][control-code-2] no matter how it happened, no matter that you’re here now[game-token-3] None of it changes the fact that I have Zapdos in my possession. With its power in my hands, there’s no chance you’ll be able to stop me from leaving. And if you think there is, then, I will show you first-hand[game-token-4] The power of Zapdos! The power of a Legendary Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Tapi\.\CC0818 tidak peduli bagaimana hal itu
terjadi, tidak peduli bahwa kau di\lsini sekarang\. Semua itu tidak

mengubah fakta bahwa aku memiliki
Zapdos. Dengan kekuatannya di\ltanganku, tidak ada kemungkinan kau

bisa menghentikanku pergi. Dan jika
kau pikir ada, maka, aku akan\lmenunjukkan kepadamu secara

langsung\. Kekuatan Zapdos! Kekuatan
Pokémon Legendaris!

entries.original:
"I will show you first-hand\.

The power of Zapdos!
The power of a Legendary Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I will show you first-hand[game-token-1] The power of Zapdos! The power of a Legendary Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menunjukkan kepadamu
secara langsung\. Kekuatan Zapdos!\lKekuatan Pokémon Legendaris!

entries.original:
"Even with a Legendary Pokémon\.
it all amounted to nothing\.!?"
entries.translation_source: Even with a Legendary Pokémon[game-token-1] it all amounted to nothing[game-token-2]!?
entries.translated:
Bahkan dengan Pokémon Legendaris\.
semuanya tidak berarti apa-apa\.!?

entries.original:
"So\.\CC0818 it’s over for me.

Zapdos destroyed all of my Shadow
Warriors, and the Grunts I brought\lfor the mission have all been\ldefeated\.

I concede\.

I can’t stop you from taking Zapdos
from me by force.

Fine, then, I’ll release Zapdos back
into the wild.

I give you my word that I won’t
go after it again\."
entries.translation_source: So[game-token-1][control-code-2] it’s over for me. Zapdos destroyed all of my Shadow Warriors, and the Grunts I brought for the mission have all been defeated[game-token-3] I concede[game-token-4] I can’t stop you from taking Zapdos from me by force. Fine, then, I’ll release Zapdos back into the wild. I give you my word that I won’t go after it again[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Jadi\.\CC0818 ini sudah berakhir untukku.
Zapdos menghancurkan semua Shadow\lWarriors-ku, dan Grunts yang kubawa

untuk misi ini semuanya telah
dikalahkan\. Aku mengaku kalah\. Aku\ltidak bisa menghentikanmu untuk

mengambil Zapdos dariku dengan
paksa. Baiklah, kalau begitu, aku\lakan melepaskan Zapdos kembali ke

alam liar. Aku berjanji bahwa aku
tidak akan mengejarnya lagi\.

entries.original:
"Please tell me you have good news
for me.

Zapdos, is it\.?

\.

Really? That’s amazing news!

I thought for sure Marlon would
escape with Zapdos, even if you\ldefeated him.

And you say he just let it go?

Guess even he knew when to fold,
huh?"
entries.translation_source: Please tell me you have good news for me. Zapdos, is it[game-token-1]? [game-token-2] Really? That’s amazing news! I thought for sure Marlon would escape with Zapdos, even if you defeated him. And you say he just let it go? Guess even he knew when to fold, huh?
entries.translated:
Tolong katakan kau punya kabar baik
untukku. Zapdos, benarkah itu\.? \.\lBenarkah? Itu kabar yang luar

biasa! Aku yakin Marlon akan lolos
dengan Zapdos, meskipun kau\lmengalahkannya. Dan kau bilang dia

hanya melepaskannya? Kukira dia pun
tahu kapan harus menyerah, ya?

entries.original:
"Well, if Zapdos is safe, we can take
a well-earned breather for the\ltime being.

Oh yeah\.\CC0818 you’re taking on
the Gym challenge, right?

In that case, you should probably
check out [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue].

It’s not exactly an official Gym,
but think of it like Gym 4.5!

I heard that if you can defeat
the Successor of the Mansion,\lyou’ll be able to wield an\lincredible new power!

What kind? Ha ha, that would be
spoiling the surprise!"
entries.translation_source: Well, if Zapdos is safe, we can take a well-earned breather for the time being. Oh yeah[game-token-1][control-code-2] you’re taking on the Gym challenge, right? In that case, you should probably check out [color-green-3]Tarmigan Mansion[color-blue-4]. It’s not exactly an official Gym, but think of it like Gym 4.5! I heard that if you can defeat the Successor of the Mansion, you’ll be able to wield an incredible new power! What kind? Ha ha, that would be spoiling the surprise!
entries.translated:
Ya, jika Zapdos aman, kita bisa
istirahat sejenak yang sudah layak\lkita dapatkan untuk saat ini. Oh ya\.\CC0818

kamu sedang menerima tantangan Gym,
kan? Kalau begitu, kamu sebaiknya\lperiksa [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]. Ini bukan

Gym resmi, tapi anggap saja seperti
Gym 4.5! Kudengar jika kamu bisa\lmengalahkan Penerus Mansion, kamu

akan bisa menggunakan kekuatan baru
yang luar biasa! Yang seperti apa?\lHa ha, itu akan merusak kejutan!

entries.original:
"\.

\CC0600You’re really amazing, [player]\.
I mean\.\CC0818 all by yourself, you\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] [control-code-2]You’re really amazing, [player-name-3][game-token-4] I mean[game-token-5][control-code-6] all by yourself, you[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
\. \CC0600Kamu benar-benar luar biasa,
[player]\. Maksudku\.\CC0818 sendirian, kamu\.

entries.original:
"But, let’s not take too long of
a break.

We can’t forget the Shadows are still
out there, and they still have\lMoltres and Articuno.

Luckily, I finished talking with
Grampa, and I think I might know\lhow to get them back.

Once you’re finished with
[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue], head [green]north[blue]\ltowards [green]Route 12[blue].

I’ll meet up with you in
[green]Dehara City[blue].

We can go over the plan to
rescue them from the Shadows\lonce you arrive.

Alright, see you then!"
entries.translation_source: But, let’s not take too long of a break. We can’t forget the Shadows are still out there, and they still have Moltres and Articuno. Luckily, I finished talking with Grampa, and I think I might know how to get them back. Once you’re finished with [color-green-1]Tarmigan Mansion[color-blue-2], head [color-green-3]north[color-blue-4] towards [color-green-5]Route 12[color-blue-6]. I’ll meet up with you in [color-green-7]Dehara City[color-blue-8]. We can go over the plan to rescue them from the Shadows once you arrive. Alright, see you then!
entries.translated:
Tapi, jangan terlalu lama
beristirahat. Kita tidak boleh lupa\lbahwa Shadow masih ada di luar

sana, dan mereka masih memiliki
Moltres dan Articuno. Untungnya,\laku selesai bicara dengan Kakek,

dan kupikir aku mungkin tahu cara
mendapatkan mereka kembali. Setelah\lkamu selesai dengan [green]Tarmigan

Mansion[blue], pergilah ke [green]utara[blue] menuju
[green]Rute 12[blue]. Aku akan menemuimu di [green]Kota\lDehara[blue]. Kita bisa membahas rencana

untuk menyelamatkan mereka dari
Shadow begitu kamu tiba. Baiklah,\lsampai jumpa!

entries.original:
"Staraptor!

Let’s go!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! Let’s go!
entries.translated: Staraptor! Ayo!

entries.original:
"Caught up to you at last!

I’d beaten Successor Maxima, but I
figured a bit more training at the\lMansion couldn’t hurt.

Let me guess, you also got the
power of Mega Evolution?

\.

What am I saying?
Of course you did.

Anyone who’s beaten me that many
times wouldn’t have been slowed\ldown by that.

Of course, I’m gonna be putting
an end to your record, right here,\lright now!

Come on then!
Lemme show you my new power!"
entries.translation_source: Caught up to you at last! I’d beaten Successor Maxima, but I figured a bit more training at the Mansion couldn’t hurt. Let me guess, you also got the power of Mega Evolution? [game-token-1] What am I saying? Of course you did. Anyone who’s beaten me that many times wouldn’t have been slowed down by that. Of course, I’m gonna be putting an end to your record, right here, right now! Come on then! Lemme show you my new power!
entries.translated:
Akhirnya aku menyusulmu! Aku sudah
mengalahkan Successor Maxima, tapi\lkupikir sedikit latihan di Mansion

tidak ada salahnya. Coba tebak, kau
juga mendapatkan kekuatan Mega\lEvolution? \. Apa yang aku katakan?

Tentu saja kau mendapatkannya.
Siapa pun yang sudah mengalahkanku\lberkali-kali pasti tidak akan

terhambat oleh itu. Tentu saja, aku
akan mengakhiri rekormu, di sini,\lsekarang juga! Ayo! Biarkan aku

menunjukkan kekuatan baruku!

entries.original:
"How do you keep doing it, [player]?

No matter how much I train, it’s
like you’re always two steps ahead\."
entries.translation_source: How do you keep doing it, [player-name-1]? No matter how much I train, it’s like you’re always two steps ahead[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Bagaimana kamu terus melakukannya,
[player]? Tidak peduli seberapa\lbanyak aku berlatih, sepertinya

kamu selalu dua langkah di depan\.

entries.original:
"Huff\.\CC0820 huff\.

Good thing I was able to catch up
to you two."
entries.translation_source: Huff[game-token-1][control-code-2] huff[game-token-3] Good thing I was able to catch up to you two.
entries.translated:
Huff\.\CC0820 huff\. Untunglah aku berhasil
menyusul kalian berdua.

entries.original:
"Old man Log?

Jeez, I’m surprised you can still run
that fast at your age."
entries.translation_source: Old man Log? Jeez, I’m surprised you can still run that fast at your age.
entries.translated:
Pak Tua Log? Astaga, aku heran kamu
masih bisa lari secepat itu di\lusiamu.

entries.original:
"How rude, [rival]\.

I came all the way out here with
something for you, you know!

Well, I suppose it can’t be helped -
I was like that myself, in my\lyouth, truth be told.

Oh, those were the days, back
when Arthur and I were Trainers.

We were quite the fierce rivals\.

So fierce, our spars could last for
days without stopping!"
entries.translation_source: How rude, [text-token-rival-1][game-token-2] I came all the way out here with something for you, you know! Well, I suppose it can’t be helped - I was like that myself, in my youth, truth be told. Oh, those were the days, back when Arthur and I were Trainers. We were quite the fierce rivals[game-token-3] So fierce, our spars could last for days without stopping!
entries.translated:
Betapa kasar, [rival]\. Aku datang
jauh-jauh ke sini membawa sesuatu\luntukmu, lho! Yah, sepertinya tidak

bisa dihindari – aku juga seperti
itu dulu, saat muda, sejujurnya.\lOh, masa-masa itu, dulu saat Arthur

dan aku menjadi Pelatih. Kami
adalah saingan yang sangat sengit\.\lBegitu sengitnya, pertarungan kami

bisa berlangsung berhari-hari tanpa
henti!

entries.original:
"I really don’t have time for your
trip down memory lane, old man.

Are you going to give us what you
brought along or not?"
entries.translation_source: I really don’t have time for your trip down memory lane, old man. Are you going to give us what you brought along or not?
entries.translated:
Saya benar-benar tidak punya waktu
untuk nostalgia Anda, kakek. Apakah\lAnda akan memberikan apa yang Anda

bawa atau tidak?

entries.original:
"[player], this is for you.

If you’re going to keep at the
Gym Challenge, you’ll need this to\lcross the sea."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], this is for you. If you’re going to keep at the Gym Challenge, you’ll need this to cross the sea.
entries.translated:
[player], ini untukmu. Jika kamu
akan melanjutkan Tantangan Gym,\lkamu akan membutuhkan ini untuk

menyeberangi laut.

entries.original:
"And while your attitude certainly
needs an adjustment, [rival], you\lmay have one as well."
entries.translation_source: And while your attitude certainly needs an adjustment, [text-token-rival-1], you may have one as well.
entries.translated:
Dan meskipun sikapmu pasti perlu
penyesuaian, [rival], kamu mungkin\ljuga punya satu.

entries.original:
"Surf, huh\.
Yeah, this’ll be useful.

I figured out the Shadows had
something to do with my parents’\ldisappearance, and I managed to\ltrack them to the Ruins of Void.

Once I get directions, I’ll Surf
there, and find out what happened\lto them once and for all!

So, thanks, I guess, Log."
entries.translation_source: Surf, huh[game-token-1] Yeah, this’ll be useful. I figured out the Shadows had something to do with my parents’ disappearance, and I managed to track them to the Ruins of Void. Once I get directions, I’ll Surf there, and find out what happened to them once and for all! So, thanks, I guess, Log.
entries.translated:
Surf, ya\. Yeah, ini akan berguna.
Aku tahu Shadows ada hubungannya\ldengan hilangnya orang tuaku, dan

aku berhasil melacak mereka ke
Ruins of Void. Setelah aku mendapat\lpetunjuk arah, aku akan Surf ke

sana, dan mencari tahu apa yang
terjadi pada mereka sekali dan\luntuk selamanya! Jadi, terima

kasih, kurasa, Log.

entries.original:
"The Shadows, you say?

Ah, yes\. that reminds me what I
came here for."
entries.translation_source: The Shadows, you say? Ah, yes[game-token-1] that reminds me what I came here for.
entries.translated:
Shadows, katamu? Ah, ya\. itu
mengingatkanku kenapa aku ke sini.

entries.original:
"[player], Arthur has filled me in on
your recent escapades.

First, let me congratulate you on
rescuing Zapdos.

But of course, I never doubted you
for a moment, [player]!

Ho ho ho!

\.

Anyway, if you’re looking to head
in the same direction as the\lShadows\.

There’s an old colleague of mine
living in Dehara City, who is a\lfastidious researcher of the\lRuins of Void.

I’ve been told that Jax went on
ahead to look for him.

If needed, he can provide you with
the Surfing directions."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], Arthur has filled me in on your recent escapades. First, let me congratulate you on rescuing Zapdos. But of course, I never doubted you for a moment, [player-name-2]! Ho ho ho! [game-token-3] Anyway, if you’re looking to head in the same direction as the Shadows[game-token-4] There’s an old colleague of mine living in Dehara City, who is a fastidious researcher of the Ruins of Void. I’ve been told that Jax went on ahead to look for him. If needed, he can provide you with the Surfing directions.
entries.translated:
[player], Arthur sudah
memberitahuku tentang petualanganmu\lbaru-baru ini. Pertama, izinkan aku

mengucapkan selamat atas
penyelamatan Zapdos. Tapi tentu\lsaja, aku tidak pernah meragukanmu

sedetik pun, [player]! Ho ho ho! \.
Bagaimanapun, jika kamu berniat\lpergi ke arah yang sama dengan

Shadows\. Ada seorang rekan lama saya
yang tinggal di Dehara City,\lseorang peneliti yang teliti

tentang Ruins of Void. Saya diberi
tahu bahwa Jax sudah pergi lebih\ldulu untuk mencarinya. Jika perlu,

dia bisa memberikan petunjuk arah
untuk Surf.

entries.original:
"Some old guy in Dehara City knows
the way to the Ruins of Void?

Guess that takes care of where
I’ll be heading next.

Thanks, Log, for saying something
worth listening to for once."
entries.translation_source: Some old guy in Dehara City knows the way to the Ruins of Void? Guess that takes care of where I’ll be heading next. Thanks, Log, for saying something worth listening to for once.
entries.translated:
Beberapa orang tua di Dehara City
tahu jalan ke Ruins of Void?\lSepertinya itu memutuskan ke mana

aku akan pergi selanjutnya. Terima
kasih, Log, karena sekali ini\lmengatakan sesuatu yang layak

didengar.

entries.original:
"Catch you later, [player].

Next time, I swear I’ll close that
gap between us for sure!"
entries.translation_source: Catch you later, [player-name-1]. Next time, I swear I’ll close that gap between us for sure!
entries.translated:
Sampai jumpa nanti, [player]. Lain
kali, aku bersumpah akan menutup\ljarak antara kita untuk selamanya!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0820 looks like his journey
with Pokémon hasn’t mellowed him\lout at all.

\.\CC0820Well, good luck, [player].
I’ll be praying for your success."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1][control-code-2] looks like his journey with Pokémon hasn’t mellowed him out at all. [game-token-3][control-code-4]Well, good luck, [player-name-5]. I’ll be praying for your success.
entries.translated:
Huh\.\CC0820 sepertinya perjalanannya
bersama Pokémon tidak membuatnya\llebih tenang sama sekali. \.\CC0820Baiklah,

semoga beruntung, [player]. Aku
akan berdoa untuk kesuksesanmu.

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0820 now what am I supposed
to do\.?

I have nothing to show Zeph and
Ivory\.

The goal is no longer reachable
without Zapdos\.

Should we\.\CC0818 abandon our cause?

Truthfully, I’ve been having doubts
about the lengths we’ve gone to\.

I think it’s time I returned back
home, to my children."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1][control-code-2] now what am I supposed to do[game-token-3]? I have nothing to show Zeph and Ivory[game-token-4] The goal is no longer reachable without Zapdos[game-token-5] Should we[game-token-6][control-code-7] abandon our cause? Truthfully, I’ve been having doubts about the lengths we’ve gone to[game-token-8] I think it’s time I returned back home, to my children.
entries.translated:
Huh\.\CC0820 sekarang apa yang harus aku
lakukan\.? Aku tidak punya apa-apa\luntuk ditunjukkan kepada Zeph dan

Ivory\. Tujuan itu tidak lagi dapat
dicapai tanpa Zapdos\. Haruskah kita\.\CC0818\lmeninggalkan perjuangan kita?

Sejujurnya, aku mulai ragu dengan
sejauh mana yang telah kita lakukan\.\lAku pikir sudah waktunya aku

kembali ke rumah, kepada
anak-anakku.

entries.original:
"Incredible\.\CC0820 such a marvel of
modern technology!

To think that such a feat was even
possible\.

Oh, Marlon\.\CC0818 you had done so well,
up until that last blunder\.

But do not fret, for I can take
care of the rest from here.

In the meantime, I think you will
have all the time in the world for\lreflection\.\CC0818 and regret."
entries.translation_source: Incredible[game-token-1][control-code-2] such a marvel of modern technology! To think that such a feat was even possible[game-token-3] Oh, Marlon[game-token-4][control-code-5] you had done so well, up until that last blunder[game-token-6] But do not fret, for I can take care of the rest from here. In the meantime, I think you will have all the time in the world for reflection[game-token-7][control-code-8] and regret.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa\.\CC0820 sungguh keajaiban
teknologi modern! Untuk berpikir\lbahwa prestasi seperti itu mungkin

saja terjadi\. Oh, Marlon\.\CC0818 kamu
melakukannya dengan baik, sampai\lkesalahan terakhir itu\. Tapi jangan

khawatir, karena aku bisa mengurus
sisanya dari sini. Sementara itu,\lkurasa kamu akan punya banyak waktu

untuk merenung\.\CC0818 dan menyesal.

entries.original:
"What\.\CC0820 exactly is this, Hoopa?

I ask you to summon another Zapdos,
to make up for Marlon’s failure,\land you bring me this?

Pathetic!
This does not even resemble Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1][control-code-2] exactly is this, Hoopa? I ask you to summon another Zapdos, to make up for Marlon’s failure, and you bring me this? Pathetic! This does not even resemble Zapdos!
entries.translated:
Apa\.\CC0820 sebenarnya ini, Hoopa? Aku
memintamu untuk memanggil Zapdos\llain, untuk mengganti kegagalan

Marlon, dan kamu membawakanku ini?
Menyedihkan! Ini bahkan tidak\lmenyerupai Zapdos!

entries.original:
"Such a useless creature\.\CC0818 it does
nothing but cower inside that\lold bag!"
entries.translation_source: Such a useless creature[game-token-1][control-code-2] it does nothing but cower inside that old bag!
entries.translated:
Makhluk yang tidak berguna\.\CC0818 ia tidak
melakukan apa-apa selain\lbersembunyi di dalam tas tua itu!

entries.original:
"Hoopa, I know it is difficult for
you, but get it right this time.

Summon forth a Zapdos.

I do not care where you must summon
it from.

Even if you have to expend every
last ounce of energy to summon one\lfrom another region\.

Just bring me a Zapdos.

UNDERSTOOD?"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, I know it is difficult for you, but get it right this time. Summon forth a Zapdos. I do not care where you must summon it from. Even if you have to expend every last ounce of energy to summon one from another region[game-token-1] Just bring me a Zapdos. UNDERSTOOD?
entries.translated:
Hoopa, aku tahu ini sulit bagimu,
tapi lakukan dengan benar kali ini.\lPanggillah Zapdos. Aku tidak peduli

dari mana kamu harus memanggilnya.
Bahkan jika kamu harus mengeluarkan\lsetiap ons energi terakhir untuk

memanggil satu dari region lain\.
Bawakan saja aku Zapdos. MENGERTI?

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.

entries.original:
"That is more like it!
Much better, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: That is more like it! Much better, Hoopa.
entries.translated:
Itu baru seperti yang kuinginkan!
Jauh lebih baik, Hoopa.

entries.original: "[black]CHZKKK.\CC0815.\CC0815.\CC0815"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]CHZKKK.[control-code-2].[control-code-3].[control-code-4]
entries.translated: [black]CHZKKK.\CC0815.\CC0815.\CC0815

entries.original:
"Hello, have we connected?

\.\CC0820It is I, the grunt you met
with earlier.

I have just secured the final
necessary Pokémon.

I will be moving on to the Ruins of
Void, momentarily.

\.\CC0820Yes, of course.
So then, just as promised\.

I will be assuming command of
the branch?

\.\CC0820Certainly - as long as Hoopa is
relatively unharmed, you may\ldiscover whatever you like.

\.\CC0820Not to worry - the disposal of the
Shadow Warriors will be a quick and\lclean one.

There will be no trace\.

\.\CC0820Understood. We will speak later
when I report my progress."
entries.translation_source: Hello, have we connected? [game-token-1][control-code-2]It is I, the grunt you met with earlier. I have just secured the final necessary Pokémon. I will be moving on to the Ruins of Void, momentarily. [game-token-3][control-code-4]Yes, of course. So then, just as promised[game-token-5] I will be assuming command of the branch? [game-token-6][control-code-7]Certainly - as long as Hoopa is relatively unharmed, you may discover whatever you like. [game-token-8][control-code-9]Not to worry - the disposal of the Shadow Warriors will be a quick and clean one. There will be no trace[game-token-10] [game-token-11][control-code-12]Understood. We will speak later when I report my progress.
entries.translated:
Halo, apakah kita sudah terhubung?
\.\CC0820Ini aku, preman yang kamu temui\lsebelumnya. Aku baru saja

mengamankan Pokémon terakhir yang
diperlukan. Aku akan segera\lbergerak menuju Ruins of Void. \.\CC0820Ya,

tentu saja. Jadi, seperti yang
dijanjikan\. Aku akan mengambil alih\lkomando cabang? \.\CC0820Tentu - selama

Hoopa relatif tidak terluka, kamu
boleh menemukan apa pun yang kamu\lsuka. \.\CC0820Jangan khawatir - pemusnahan

Shadow Warriors akan cepat dan
bersih. Tidak akan ada jejak\.\l\.\CC0820Mengerti. Kita akan bicara nanti

ketika saya melaporkan kemajuan.

entries.original:
"Now then\.\CC0818 we have no more time to
waste.

With Zapdos in my hands, Zeph
finally has the last piece needed\lto perform the unbinding.

Now\.\CC0818 open up a portal to the Ruins
of Void, Hoopa.

You surely still have energy left to
do that, even after summoning such\la powerful Pokémon\.

Of course, once you have regained
all your power, exhaustion will no\llonger be an issue\.

Recover your strength, and then
transport yourself over too.

You will find me by my Cube’s
signal.

And as a reminder\.\CC0820 remain
inconspicuous.

Zeph still has a loyal following
who may prove\.\CC0818 problematic.

He must not know.
It would ruin everything.

I am placing my faith in you this
one last time, Hoopa, so do not\lerr!"
entries.translation_source: Now then[game-token-1][control-code-2] we have no more time to waste. With Zapdos in my hands, Zeph finally has the last piece needed to perform the unbinding. Now[game-token-3][control-code-4] open up a portal to the Ruins of Void, Hoopa. You surely still have energy left to do that, even after summoning such a powerful Pokémon[game-token-5] Of course, once you have regained all your power, exhaustion will no longer be an issue[game-token-6] Recover your strength, and then transport yourself over too. You will find me by my Cube’s signal. And as a reminder[game-token-7][control-code-8] remain inconspicuous. Zeph still has a loyal following who may prove[game-token-9][control-code-10] problematic. He must not know. It would ruin everything. I am placing my faith in you this one last time, Hoopa, so do not err!
entries.translated:
Sekarang\.\CC0818 kita tidak punya waktu
lagi untuk disia-siakan. Dengan\lZapdos di tanganku, Zeph akhirnya

memiliki bagian terakhir yang
diperlukan untuk melakukan\lpembebasan. Sekarang\.\CC0818 bukalah portal

ke Ruins of Void, Hoopa. Kamu pasti
masih memiliki energi untuk\lmelakukan itu, bahkan setelah

memanggil Pokémon sekuat itu\. Tentu,
setelah kamu memulihkan semua\lkekuatanmu, kelelahan tidak akan

menjadi masalah lagi\. Pulihkan
kekuatanmu, lalu pindahkan dirimu\ljuga. Kamu akan menemukanku melalui

sinyal Kubusku. Dan sebagai
pengingat\.\CC0820 tetaplah tidak mencolok.\lZeph masih memiliki pengikut setia

yang mungkin terbukti\.\CC0818 bermasalah.
Dia tidak boleh tahu. Itu akan\lmenghancurkan segalanya. Aku

menaruh kepercayaanku padamu untuk
terakhir kalinya, Hoopa, jadi\ljangan salah!

entries.original:
"[player]! You made it!

Sorry I didn’t see you - I was
killing time on these machines\.

This [green]Cloud Burst[blue] game’s really
addictive, and I guess I just\ltuned out.

In the process, though, I actually
earned enough Coins to buy not\lone, but two [green]Ability Capsules[blue]!

Have you heard of them?

If a Pokémon has two possible
Abilities, the Capsules change one\linto the other."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You made it! Sorry I didn’t see you - I was killing time on these machines[game-token-2] This [color-green-3]Cloud Burst[color-blue-4] game’s really addictive, and I guess I just tuned out. In the process, though, I actually earned enough Coins to buy not one, but two [color-green-5]Ability Capsules[color-blue-6]! Have you heard of them? If a Pokémon has two possible Abilities, the Capsules change one into the other.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu berhasil! Maaf aku
tidak melihatmu - aku sedang\lmenghabiskan waktu di mesin-mesin

ini\. Game [green]Cloud Burst[blue] ini sangat
adiktif, dan kurasa aku hanya tidak\lfokus. Namun dalam prosesnya, aku

benar-benar mengumpulkan cukup Koin
untuk membeli bukan satu, tapi dua\l[green]Kapsul Ability[blue]! Pernah dengar

tentang itu? Jika seekor Pokémon
memiliki dua Ability yang mungkin,\lKapsul tersebut mengubah satu

menjadi yang lain.

entries.original:
"But, Cloud Burst can wait.

Let’s take this somewhere outside,
where it’s a bit less noisy."
entries.translation_source: But, Cloud Burst can wait. Let’s take this somewhere outside, where it’s a bit less noisy.
entries.translated:
Tapi, Cloud Burst bisa menunggu.
Ayo kita bawa ini ke luar, di\ltempat yang sedikit lebih sepi.

entries.original:
"Alright, I guess this’ll do.

Okay, listen up.

While I was waiting for you, I saw
a bunch of Shadow Grunts heading\lwest, towards the Ruins of Void.

According to Grampa, the only
reason for them to go there\.\CC0818 is if\lthey’ve gotten everything they\lneeded to perform the unbinding.

You know, the ritual needed to
release the dark force.

But, it shouldn’t be possible
without Zapdos\.

That’s why Grampa thinks they’re
going to try the unbinding anyway,\land hope the incomplete ritual is\lenough for their purposes.

This is our chance to head over
there too, and steal back Articuno\land Moltres!

It’s perfect.

They’ll be the only ones at the
ruins, so we won’t have to worry\labout them turning innocent people\linto those monsters!"
entries.translation_source: Alright, I guess this’ll do. Okay, listen up. While I was waiting for you, I saw a bunch of Shadow Grunts heading west, towards the Ruins of Void. According to Grampa, the only reason for them to go there[game-token-1][control-code-2] is if they’ve gotten everything they needed to perform the unbinding. You know, the ritual needed to release the dark force. But, it shouldn’t be possible without Zapdos[game-token-3] That’s why Grampa thinks they’re going to try the unbinding anyway, and hope the incomplete ritual is enough for their purposes. This is our chance to head over there too, and steal back Articuno and Moltres! It’s perfect. They’ll be the only ones at the ruins, so we won’t have to worry about them turning innocent people into those monsters!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kurasa ini cukup. Oke,
dengarkan. Saat aku menunggumu, aku\lmelihat sekelompok Shadow Grunts

menuju barat, ke arah Ruins of
Void. Menurut Kakek, satu-satunya\lalasan mereka pergi ke sana\.\CC0818 adalah

jika mereka sudah mendapatkan semua
yang mereka butuhkan untuk\lmelakukan pembebasan. Kamu tahu,

ritual yang diperlukan untuk
melepaskan kekuatan gelap. Tapi,\lseharusnya tidak mungkin tanpa

Zapdos\. Itulah sebabnya Kakek
berpikir mereka akan tetap mencoba\lpembebasan, dan berharap ritual

yang tidak lengkap cukup untuk
tujuan mereka. Ini kesempatan kita\luntuk pergi ke sana juga, dan

mencuri kembali Articuno dan
Moltres! Sempurna. Mereka akan\lmenjadi satu-satunya di reruntuhan,

jadi kita tidak perlu khawatir
mereka mengubah orang yang tidak\lbersalah menjadi monster-monster

itu!

entries.original:
"But before we do that, first
things first, you ought to get\lDehara City’s Gym Badge.

You’ll need it in order to Surf to
the Ruins of Void with me, after\lall, since there’s no way to get\lthere on foot.

Alright - I’ll head home to prepare
my Pokémon.

In the meantime, you go get that
Badge."
entries.translation_source: But before we do that, first things first, you ought to get Dehara City’s Gym Badge. You’ll need it in order to Surf to the Ruins of Void with me, after all, since there’s no way to get there on foot. Alright - I’ll head home to prepare my Pokémon. In the meantime, you go get that Badge.
entries.translated:
Tapi sebelum kita melakukan itu,
yang pertama, kamu harus\lmendapatkan Lencana Gym Dehara

City. Kamu akan membutuhkannya
untuk Surf ke Ruins of Void\lbersamaku, karena tidak ada cara

untuk sampai ke sana dengan
berjalan kaki. Baiklah - aku akan\lpulang untuk mempersiapkan

Pokémon-ku. Sementara itu, kamu
ambil Lencana itu.

entries.original:
"What the-?
