[player], look out!"
entries.translation_source: What the-? [player-name-1], look out!
entries.translated: Apa-apaan-? [player], awas!

entries.original:
"Are you alright?
What happened?

All of a sudden a strange ring
appeared, and we got sucked here\.

I was afraid of losing you, so I
tried jumping in after you\."
entries.translation_source: Are you alright? What happened? All of a sudden a strange ring appeared, and we got sucked here[game-token-1] I was afraid of losing you, so I tried jumping in after you[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Apa kamu baik-baik saja? Apa yang
terjadi? Tiba-tiba sebuah cincin\laneh muncul, dan kita tersedot ke

sini\. Aku takut kehilanganmu, jadi
aku mencoba melompat mengejarmu\.

entries.original:
"Where are we, anyway?

Wait\.\CC0820 is this\.\CC0820 the Ruins of Void?"
entries.translation_source: Where are we, anyway? Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] is this[game-token-3][control-code-4] the Ruins of Void?
entries.translated:
Di mana kita sebenarnya? Tunggu\.\CC0820
apakah ini\.\CC0820 Ruins of Void?

entries.original:
"It has to be.

Look, those are Shadow Grunts at the
top of the stairs!"
entries.translation_source: It has to be. Look, those are Shadow Grunts at the top of the stairs!
entries.translated:
Pasti itu. Lihat, itu Shadow Grunt
di puncak tangga!

entries.original:
"Understood?

This is where you must make your
stand.

For the sake of the unbinding, those
two must not be allowed up here.

Demonstrate to them\.\CC0818 the power
of the Light of Ruin!"
entries.translation_source: Understood? This is where you must make your stand. For the sake of the unbinding, those two must not be allowed up here. Demonstrate to them[game-token-1][control-code-2] the power of the Light of Ruin!
entries.translated:
Mengerti? Di sinilah kau harus
bertahan. Demi pelepasan ikatan,\lkeduanya tidak boleh diizinkan naik

ke sini. Tunjukkan pada mereka\.\CC0818
kekuatan Cahaya Kehancuran!

entries.original:
"I can’t hear them from here,
but whatever they’re saying,\lit can’t be good!

Staraptor!

Take out those Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t hear them from here, but whatever they’re saying, it can’t be good! Staraptor! Take out those Shadows!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa mendengar mereka
dari sini, tapi apa pun yang mereka\lkatakan, pasti tidak baik!

Staraptor! Hajar para Shadow itu!

entries.original:
"Staraptor!

STARAPTOR!

NOOOOOO!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! STARAPTOR! NOOOOOO!
entries.translated: Staraptor! STARAPTOR! TIDAAAAAK!

entries.original:
"That blast\.\CC0820 it destroyed the
staircase!

And Staraptor was\.\CC0820 Staraptor was-!

\. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \.

Sniff\.

Guh\.\CC0820 sorry\.\CC0820 I’m finding it hard\.\CC0820 to
stay focused\."
entries.translation_source: That blast[game-token-1][control-code-2] it destroyed the staircase! And Staraptor was[game-token-3][control-code-4] Staraptor was-! [game-token-5] [game-token-6] [game-token-7] [game-token-8] [game-token-9] [game-token-10] [game-token-11] [game-token-12] [game-token-13] [game-token-14] Sniff[game-token-15] Guh[game-token-16][control-code-17] sorry[game-token-18][control-code-19] I’m finding it hard[game-token-20][control-code-21] to stay focused[game-token-22]
entries.translated:
Ledakan itu\.\CC0820 menghancurkan tangga!
Dan Staraptor was\.\CC0820 Staraptor was-! \. \.\l\. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. Hiks\. Guh\.\CC0820 maaf\.\CC0820 Aku sulit\.\CC0820

untuk tetap fokus\.

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0818 I think that blast just
uncovered an entrance into\lthe Ruins."
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] I think that blast just uncovered an entrance into the Ruins.
entries.translated:
Tunggu\.\CC0818 Kurasa ledakan itu baru saja
membuka pintu masuk ke Reruntuhan.

entries.original:
"You should go in there and find a
way to the top.

I\.\CC0820 I only brought Staraptor with
me, so I can’t go with you.

I’ll\.\CC0818 stay here and heal up your
Pokémon, if you want."
entries.translation_source: You should go in there and find a way to the top. I[game-token-1][control-code-2] I only brought Staraptor with me, so I can’t go with you. I’ll[game-token-3][control-code-4] stay here and heal up your Pokémon, if you want.
entries.translated:
Kau harus masuk ke sana dan mencari
jalan ke puncak. Aku\.\CC0820 Aku hanya\lmembawa Staraptor bersamaku, jadi

aku tidak bisa ikut denganmu. Aku
akan\.\CC0818 tinggal di sini dan\lmenyembuhkan Pokémon-mu, jika kau

mau.

entries.original:
"And please\.\CC0818 find Staraptor for me.

That blast must’ve hurt it really
badly.

When you find it, shout down to me."
entries.translation_source: And please[game-token-1][control-code-2] find Staraptor for me. That blast must’ve hurt it really badly. When you find it, shout down to me.
entries.translated:
Dan tolong\.\CC0818 temukan Staraptor
untukku. Ledakan itu pasti\lmelukainya dengan parah. Saat kau

menemukannya, berteriaklah padaku
dari bawah.

entries.original: "Ethereal Voice"
entries.translation_source: Ethereal Voice
entries.translated: Ethereal Voice

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO SEEK PASSAGE TO THE HEART
OF THE TEMPLE OF VOID\.

PROVE YOUR WORTH, AGAINST THE
GUARDIAN OF THIS SACRED GROUND!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU WHO SEEK PASSAGE TO THE HEART OF THE TEMPLE OF VOID[game-token-2] PROVE YOUR WORTH, AGAINST THE GUARDIAN OF THIS SACRED GROUND!
entries.translated:
[blue]KAMU YANG MENCARI JALAN MENUJU HATI
KUIL KEKOSONGAN\. BUKTIKAN NILAIMU,\lMELAWAN PENJAGA TANAH SUCI INI!

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF
PASSAGE\.

YOUR NEXT TRIAL AWAITS, FURTHER
WITHIN THESE HALLS\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF PASSAGE[game-token-2] YOUR NEXT TRIAL AWAITS, FURTHER WITHIN THESE HALLS[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[blue]KAMU YANG SEKARANG MEMILIKI HAK
JALAN\. UJIAN SELANJUTNYA MENANTI,\lLEBIH DALAM DI DALAM AULA INI\.

entries.original: "Uh oh."
entries.translation_source: Uh oh.
entries.translated: Uh oh.

entries.original:
"Sir, [player] is attempting to
make [buffer1] way up here by coming\lthrough the ruins!"
entries.translation_source: Sir, [player-name-1] is attempting to make [buffer1-2] way up here by coming through the ruins!
entries.translated:
Tuan, [player] sedang mencoba untuk
membuat [buffer1] jalan ke sini\ldengan melewati reruntuhan!

entries.original:
"No matter.

By the time [player] ascends, Zeph
will be ready for the unbinding.

However, should the need arise, I
will require you to stall [player]\lfor as long as possible."
entries.translation_source: No matter. By the time [player-name-1] ascends, Zeph will be ready for the unbinding. However, should the need arise, I will require you to stall [player-name-2] for as long as possible.
entries.translated:
Tidak masalah. Saat [player] naik,
Zeph akan siap untuk pelepasan\likatan. Namun, jika diperlukan, aku

akan memintamu untuk menunda
[player] selama mungkin.

entries.original:
"If I did not need you, Hoopa,
I would throw your Poké Ball\lright back into the ocean for all\lof the trouble you have caused!"
entries.translation_source: If I did not need you, Hoopa, I would throw your Poké Ball right back into the ocean for all of the trouble you have caused!
entries.translated:
Jika aku tidak membutuhkanmu,
Hoopa, aku akan melemparkan Poké\lBall-mu kembali ke laut karena

semua masalah yang kau timbulkan!

entries.original:
"I’ve got a bad feeling
about that Claydol\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got a bad feeling about that Claydol[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku punya firasat buruk tentang
Claydol itu\.

entries.original: "What the\.?"
entries.translation_source: What the[game-token-1]?
entries.translated: Apa-apaan\.?

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO SEEK TO VIOLATE THESE
SACRED GROUNDS\.

DEMONSTRATE YOUR WORTH, OR BE
SMOTE BY MY JUDGMENT!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU WHO SEEK TO VIOLATE THESE SACRED GROUNDS[game-token-2] DEMONSTRATE YOUR WORTH, OR BE SMOTE BY MY JUDGMENT!
entries.translated:
[blue]KAMU YANG BERUSAHA MELANGGAR TANAH
SUCI INI\. BUKTIKAN KELAYAKANMU, ATAU\lKENALAH HUKUMANKU!

entries.original:
"Huh? This Pokémon wants to fight?

We handle Shadow Warriors on
the daily!

One normal Pokémon’s nothing to us!
Let’s take it down!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? This Pokémon wants to fight? We handle Shadow Warriors on the daily! One normal Pokémon’s nothing to us! Let’s take it down!
entries.translated:
Hah? Pokémon ini ingin bertarung?
Kami menangani Shadow Warriors\lsetiap hari! Satu Pokémon biasa

bukan apa-apa bagi kami! Ayo
kalahkan dia!

entries.original: "Groan\."
entries.translation_source: Groan[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Mengerang\.

entries.original:
"YOU WHO LACK THE RIGHT\.

BEGONE FROM THIS PLACE, LEST YE BE
CAST INTO THE VOID!"
entries.translation_source: YOU WHO LACK THE RIGHT[game-token-1] BEGONE FROM THIS PLACE, LEST YE BE CAST INTO THE VOID!
entries.translated:
KAMU YANG TIDAK MEMILIKI HAK\.
PERGILAH DARI TEMPAT INI, ATAU KAMU\lAKAN DILEMPARKAN KE KEKOSONGAN!

entries.original: "It’s Jax’s Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: It’s Jax’s Staraptor.
entries.translated: Itu Staraptor milik Jax.

entries.original:
"Thank goodness\.\CC0818 it looks like
Staraptor will make a full recovery."
entries.translation_source: Thank goodness[game-token-1][control-code-2] it looks like Staraptor will make a full recovery.
entries.translated:
Syukurlah\.\CC0818 sepertinya Staraptor akan
pulih sepenuhnya.

entries.original:
"Thanks for finding Staraptor for
me\.

\.

I’m sorry\.\CC0820 I had to rely on you
yet again\.

Mmm? Ah, never mind me.

Anyway, great job on getting this
far up.

It looks like we’re nearly at the
top - just a little more and we’ll\lreach the Shadows.

Sorry I can’t be\.\CC0818 more useful\.

But, uh\.\CC0818 if you need healing,
I’ll be waiting right outside."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for finding Staraptor for me[game-token-1] [game-token-2] I’m sorry[game-token-3][control-code-4] I had to rely on you yet again[game-token-5] Mmm? Ah, never mind me. Anyway, great job on getting this far up. It looks like we’re nearly at the top - just a little more and we’ll reach the Shadows. Sorry I can’t be[game-token-6][control-code-7] more useful[game-token-8] But, uh[game-token-9][control-code-10] if you need healing, I’ll be waiting right outside.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah menemukan
Staraptor untukku\. \. Maaf\.\CC0820 aku harus\lmengandalkanmu lagi\. Mmm? Ah, jangan

pedulikan aku. Bagaimanapun, kerja
bagus bisa sampai sejauh ini.\lSepertinya kita hampir sampai di

puncak - sedikit lagi dan kita akan
mencapai Shadows. Maaf aku tidak\lbisa\.\CC0818 lebih berguna\. Tapi, uh\.\CC0818 jika

kamu butuh penyembuhan, aku akan
menunggu di luar.

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO WOULD ENTER THE HEART OF
THE TEMPLE OF VOID\.

AGAINST THE THREE, DEMONSTRATE
YOUR STRENGTH OF BODY AND SOUL."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU WHO WOULD ENTER THE HEART OF THE TEMPLE OF VOID[game-token-2] AGAINST THE THREE, DEMONSTRATE YOUR STRENGTH OF BODY AND SOUL.
entries.translated:
[blue]KAMU YANG AKAN MEMASUKI PUSAT KUIL
KEKOSONGAN\. MELAWAN KETIGANYA,\lBUKTIKAN KEKUATAN TUBUH DAN JIWAMU.

entries.original:
"You gaze into the portal\.

\.

Pokémon are attempting to cross
through from the other side!

Are you ready to face them?

Be aware, once the battles begin,
there will be no chance to recover."
entries.translation_source: You gaze into the portal[game-token-1] [game-token-2] Pokémon are attempting to cross through from the other side! Are you ready to face them? Be aware, once the battles begin, there will be no chance to recover.
entries.translated:
Kamu menatap ke dalam portal\. \.
Pokémon sedang mencoba menyeberang\ldari sisi lain! Apakah kamu siap

menghadapi mereka? Ketahuilah,
begitu pertarungan dimulai, tidak\lakan ada kesempatan untuk pulih.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] ran back into
the portal."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] ran back into the portal.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] itu berlari kembali ke
dalam portal.

entries.original:
"Another Pokémon is making its way
through the portal!"
entries.translation_source: Another Pokémon is making its way through the portal!
entries.translated:
Pokémon lain sedang melewati
portal!

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF
PASSAGE\.

WITH FORTIFIED BODY, AND RIGHTEOUS
SOUL, STEP FORTH!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF PASSAGE[game-token-2] WITH FORTIFIED BODY, AND RIGHTEOUS SOUL, STEP FORTH!
entries.translated:
[blue]KAMU YANG SEKARANG MEMILIKI HAK
LINTAS\. DENGAN TUBUH TANGGUH DAN\lJIWA BENAR, MAJULAH!

entries.original:
"That Claydol may have knocked us
down before, but we’re still not\lgoing to let you through without\la fight!

We can’t let the unbinding be
disrupted!"
entries.translation_source: That Claydol may have knocked us down before, but we’re still not going to let you through without a fight! We can’t let the unbinding be disrupted!
entries.translated:
Claydol itu mungkin pernah
menjatuhkan kami sebelumnya, tapi\lkami tetap tidak akan membiarkanmu

lewat tanpa bertarung! Kami tidak
boleh membiarkan unbinding\lterganggu!

entries.original:
"We’re not done yet!

It’s my turn to take you down!"
entries.translation_source: We’re not done yet! It’s my turn to take you down!
entries.translated:
Kami belum selesai! Giliranku untuk
mengalahkanmu!

entries.original: "Wait!"
entries.translation_source: Wait!
entries.translated: Tunggu!

entries.original:
"[player] has more important things
to do than deal with you.

If you want to take someone on,
why don’t you try me on for size!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] has more important things to do than deal with you. If you want to take someone on, why don’t you try me on for size!
entries.translated:
[player] punya hal yang lebih
penting untuk dilakukan daripada\lberurusan denganmu. Jika kamu ingin

melawan seseorang, kenapa tidak
coba hadapi aku!

entries.original:
"[player]!

I don’t know how it’s possible,
but from the way these guys have\lbeen talking, the Shadows must\lhave captured Zapdos!

I’ll take care of these goons.

In the meantime, you gotta stop the
Shadows from carrying out their\l\qounbinding\qc!

Hurry! There’s no time left!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I don’t know how it’s possible, but from the way these guys have been talking, the Shadows must have captured Zapdos! I’ll take care of these goons. In the meantime, you gotta stop the Shadows from carrying out their [quote-open-2]unbinding[quote-close-3]! Hurry! There’s no time left!
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku tidak tahu bagaimana
mungkin, tapi dari cara mereka\lbicara, para Shadows pasti telah

menangkap Zapdos! Aku akan mengurus
para preman ini. Sementara itu,\lkamu harus menghentikan Shadows

dari melaksanakan \qounbinding\qc
mereka! Cepat! Tidak ada waktu\llagi!

entries.original:
"[red]Gotcha! You seriously never learn,
do you, kid?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Gotcha! You seriously never learn, do you, kid?
entries.translated:
[red]Kena kamu! Kamu benar-benar tidak
pernah belajar, ya, nak?

entries.original:
"Get moving.
You’re going to want to see this\."
entries.translation_source: Get moving. You’re going to want to see this[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Bergeraklah. Kamu pasti ingin
melihat ini\.

entries.original:
"[red]All preparations have been
completed, Zeph.

You can proceed with the unbinding
when ready."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]All preparations have been completed, Zeph. You can proceed with the unbinding when ready.
entries.translated:
[red]Semua persiapan telah selesai,
Zeph. Kamu bisa melanjutkan\lunbinding kapan pun siap.

entries.original:
"Thank you, Ivory.

Just\.\CC0818 one last thing, before we get
started.

Marlon\.\CC0818 where is he, exactly?"
entries.translation_source: Thank you, Ivory. Just[game-token-1][control-code-2] one last thing, before we get started. Marlon[game-token-3][control-code-4] where is he, exactly?
entries.translated:
Terima kasih, Ivory. \.\CC0818 Satu hal
terakhir, sebelum kita mulai.\lMarlon\.\CC0818 di mana dia, tepatnya?

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry, Zeph, we still don’t know
where he is.

According to the Grunt who delivered
Zapdos to us, Marlon’s off dealing\lwith some unofficial business.

The Grunt said he wouldn’t clarify
any further, and I haven’t heard\lfrom him either."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’m sorry, Zeph, we still don’t know where he is. According to the Grunt who delivered Zapdos to us, Marlon’s off dealing with some unofficial business. The Grunt said he wouldn’t clarify any further, and I haven’t heard from him either.
entries.translated:
[red]Maaf, Zeph, kami masih tidak tahu
di mana dia. Menurut Grunt yang\lmengantarkan Zapdos kepada kami,

Marlon sedang menangani urusan
tidak resmi. Grunt itu bilang dia\ltidak akan memberi penjelasan lebih

lanjut, dan aku juga belum
mendengar kabar darinya.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.\CC0820 he HAS been rather on edge,
lately\.

I hope he hasn’t gotten cold feet,
now of all times.

I would hate for him to miss
everything we have worked so\lhard for\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1][control-code-2] he HAS been rather on edge, lately[game-token-3] I hope he hasn’t gotten cold feet, now of all times. I would hate for him to miss everything we have worked so hard for[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Hmm\.\CC0820 dia memang agak gelisah
akhir-akhir ini\. Aku harap dia tidak\lmenjadi ragu-ragu, sekarang dari

semua waktu. Aku benci jika dia
melewatkan semua yang telah kita\lkerjakan dengan susah payah\.

entries.original:
"But either way, with or without him,
the unbinding must proceed."
entries.translation_source: But either way, with or without him, the unbinding must proceed.
entries.translated:
Tapi bagaimanapun, dengan atau
tanpa dia, pelepasan harus\ldilanjutkan.

entries.original:
"Finally\.\CC0818 the time has come to make
our dream a reality.

Once the dark force is unbound,
I shall use its power to undo the\ltragedies of all those years ago\.

And then, at long last\.\CC0820 his smile will
finally return to me\."
entries.translation_source: Finally[game-token-1][control-code-2] the time has come to make our dream a reality. Once the dark force is unbound, I shall use its power to undo the tragedies of all those years ago[game-token-3] And then, at long last[game-token-4][control-code-5] his smile will finally return to me[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Akhirnya\.\CC0818 waktunya tiba untuk
mewujudkan mimpi kita. Setelah\lkekuatan gelap dilepaskan, aku akan

menggunakan kekuatannya untuk
membatalkan tragedi tahun-tahun\lyang lalu\. Dan kemudian, akhirnya\.\CC0820

senyumnya akan kembali padaku\.

entries.original:
"The keeper of storms, Zapdos!
Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: The keeper of storms, Zapdos! Come forth!
entries.translated: Penjaga badai, Zapdos! Keluarlah!

entries.original:
"The sacred flame, Moltres!
Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: The sacred flame, Moltres! Come forth!
entries.translated: Api suci, Moltres! Keluarlah!

entries.original:
"The disciple of ice, Articuno!
Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: The disciple of ice, Articuno! Come forth!
entries.translated: Murid es, Articuno! Keluarlah!

entries.original:
"With these three legendary bird
Pokémon assembled here alongside\lthe Prison Stone, the seal can\lbe broken."
entries.translation_source: With these three legendary bird Pokémon assembled here alongside the Prison Stone, the seal can be broken.
entries.translated:
Dengan ketiga Pokémon burung
legendaris ini berkumpul di sini\lbersama Prison Stone, segelnya bisa

dipatahkan.

entries.original:
"One with the shadows, one with
the night\.

A dark hole traced by a ring
of fury!

With keys of ice, fire and lightning,
let the sealed force no longer\lbe caged!"
entries.translation_source: One with the shadows, one with the night[game-token-1] A dark hole traced by a ring of fury! With keys of ice, fire and lightning, let the sealed force no longer be caged!
entries.translated:
Satu dengan bayangan, satu dengan
malam\. Sebuah lubang gelap yang\ldilacak oleh lingkaran amarah!

Dengan kunci es, api, dan petir,
biarkan kekuatan yang tersegel\ltidak lagi dikurung!

entries.original:
"At last, the bottle\.

With this, the dark force is mine
to command\."
entries.translation_source: At last, the bottle[game-token-1] With this, the dark force is mine to command[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, botolnya\. Dengan ini,
kekuatan gelap ada di bawah\lperintahku\.

entries.original:
"What\.? Nothing is happening?

Why!? The bottle is open\.!"
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1]? Nothing is happening? Why!? The bottle is open[game-token-2]!
entries.translated:
Apa\.? Tidak ada yang terjadi?
Kenapa!? Botolnya terbuka\.!

entries.original: "Heh heh heh\."
entries.translation_source: Heh heh heh[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Heh heh heh\.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 who do you think you are!?

Have you tampered with the
unbinding?

Answer me!"
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1][control-code-2] who do you think you are!? Have you tampered with the unbinding? Answer me!
entries.translated:
Kau\.\CC0820 siapa kau pikir kau!? Apakah
kau telah mengutak-atik pelepasan?\lJawab aku!

entries.original:
"Who, me?

The name is Aklove.

I am just a lowly Grunt among the
Shadows, nothing more."
entries.translation_source: Who, me? The name is Aklove. I am just a lowly Grunt among the Shadows, nothing more.
entries.translated:
Siapa, aku? Namaku Aklove. Aku
hanyalah Grunt rendahan di antara\lShadows, tidak lebih.

entries.original:
"Answer my question, grunt!

What have you done!?"
entries.translation_source: Answer my question, grunt! What have you done!?
entries.translated:
Jawab pertanyaanku, grunt! Apa yang
telah kau lakukan!?

entries.original:
"What have I done\.?

Nothing.

The ritual itself went completely
uninterrupted.

In fact, I commend you on an
almost flawless execution.

However, there was one key
component you were missing."
entries.translation_source: What have I done[game-token-1]? Nothing. The ritual itself went completely uninterrupted. In fact, I commend you on an almost flawless execution. However, there was one key component you were missing.
entries.translated:
Apa yang telah kulakukan\.? Tidak
ada. Ritualnya sendiri berlangsung\ltanpa gangguan. Bahkan, aku

memujimu atas eksekusi yang hampir
sempurna. Namun, ada satu komponen\lkunci yang kau lewatkan.

entries.original:
"Missing\.?

And what, exactly, would that be?"
entries.translation_source: Missing[game-token-1]? And what, exactly, would that be?
entries.translated: Hilang\.? Dan apa, tepatnya, itu?

entries.original:
"In order to release the dark force
from the Prison Bottle, naturally,\lthere needs to be somewhere for\lthat power to go.

To be exact, you need the Pokémon
that used to HOUSE the dark force\l- something, I notice, you are\lsorely lacking.

Of course, you would have known
that, had I not deleted that little\ldetail from your files.

Honestly, I hoped to manipulate you
by infiltrating your organization,\lbut I am almost disappointed - it\lwas laughably easy!

And now, you have played right into
my hands and released the Prison\lBottle for me!

All that is left is for you to
step aside.

I shall finish the unbinding myself!"
entries.translation_source: In order to release the dark force from the Prison Bottle, naturally, there needs to be somewhere for that power to go. To be exact, you need the Pokémon that used to HOUSE the dark force - something, I notice, you are sorely lacking. Of course, you would have known that, had I not deleted that little detail from your files. Honestly, I hoped to manipulate you by infiltrating your organization, but I am almost disappointed - it was laughably easy! And now, you have played right into my hands and released the Prison Bottle for me! All that is left is for you to step aside. I shall finish the unbinding myself!
entries.translated:
Untuk melepaskan kekuatan gelap
dari Prison Bottle, tentu saja,\lharus ada tempat bagi kekuatan itu

untuk pergi. Tepatnya, kau
membutuhkan Pokémon yang dulu\lMENAMPUNG kekuatan gelap - sesuatu

yang, kulihat, sangat kau kurang.
Tentu saja, kau akan tahu itu, jika\laku tidak menghapus detail kecil

itu dari file-file-mu. Sejujurnya,
aku berharap bisa memanipulasimu\ldengan menyusup ke organisasimu,

tapi aku hampir kecewa - itu sangat
mudah hingga menggelikan! Dan\lsekarang, kau telah bermain ke

tanganku dan melepaskan Prison
Bottle untukku! Yang tersisa\lhanyalah kau minggir. Aku akan

menyelesaikan pelepasan itu
sendiri!

entries.original:
"Wha-?
How dare you make a fool of me!

You will pay for this insult!"
entries.translation_source: Wha-? How dare you make a fool of me! You will pay for this insult!
entries.translated:
Apa-? Beraninya kau menjadikanku
bodoh! Kau akan membayar untuk\lpenghinaan ini!

entries.original:
"Houndoom!

Teach this fool a lesson!"
entries.translation_source: Houndoom! Teach this fool a lesson!
entries.translated:
Houndoom! Ajari orang bodoh ini
pelajaran!

entries.original:
"Hoopa!
Remove the threat!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Remove the threat!
entries.translated: Hoopa! Singkirkan ancaman itu!

entries.original:
"Impossible\.\CC0820 Houndoom was\.

That portal\.\CC0818 so it was you who
brought [player] into our base!"
entries.translation_source: Impossible[game-token-1][control-code-2] Houndoom was[game-token-3] That portal[game-token-4][control-code-5] so it was you who brought [player-name-6] into our base!
entries.translated:
Mustahil\.\CC0820 Houndoom tadi\. Portal itu\.\CC0818
jadi kaulah yang membawa [player]\lke markas kami!

entries.original:
"Actually, that was Hoopa acting of
its own accord.

It knew we were about to begin
the process of releasing its power,\lso in a futile act of desperation,\lit summoned [player] to rescue it\lfrom me.

For you see\.\CC0818 for reasons I cannot
fathom, it is [player], not I, that\lHoopa prefers as its Trainer.

And so, naturally, I want to see
[player] eliminated.

Once [buffer2] is gone, Hoopa will have
to accept ME as its true Trainer\.

Only then will I finally be able to
use its true power, capable of\lmoving entire landmasses\."
entries.translation_source: Actually, that was Hoopa acting of its own accord. It knew we were about to begin the process of releasing its power, so in a futile act of desperation, it summoned [player-name-1] to rescue it from me. For you see[game-token-2][control-code-3] for reasons I cannot fathom, it is [player-name-4], not I, that Hoopa prefers as its Trainer. And so, naturally, I want to see [player-name-5] eliminated. Once [buffer2-6] is gone, Hoopa will have to accept ME as its true Trainer[game-token-7] Only then will I finally be able to use its true power, capable of moving entire landmasses[game-token-8]
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, itu adalah Hoopa yang
bertindak atas kemauannya sendiri.\lIa tahu kami akan segera memulai

proses melepaskan kekuatannya, jadi
dalam tindakan putus asa yang\lsia-sia, ia memanggil [player]

untuk menyelamatkannya dariku.
Soalnya\.\CC0818 karena alasan yang tidak\lbisa kupahami, [player], bukan aku,

yang lebih disukai Hoopa sebagai
Trainernya. Jadi, tentu saja, aku\lingin melihat [player]

disingkirkan. Begitu [buffer2] tidak
ada, Hoopa harus menerima AKU\lsebagai Trainer sejatinya\. Hanya

saat itulah aku akhirnya bisa
menggunakan kekuatan sejatinya,\lyang mampu memindahkan daratan\.

entries.original:
"I\.\CC0820 concede\.

I cannot hope to fight a Pokémon
like that\."
entries.translation_source: I[game-token-1][control-code-2] concede[game-token-3] I cannot hope to fight a Pokémon like that[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Aku\.\CC0820 mengaku\. Aku tak bisa berharap
melawan Pokémon seperti itu\.

entries.original:
"That is a wise decision.

Now, stand aside!"
entries.translation_source: That is a wise decision. Now, stand aside!
entries.translated:
Itu keputusan yang bijaksana.
Sekarang, minggir!

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, Ivory\.

I couldn’t\.\CC0818 finish what we started\.

But this is not the end\.\CC0818 we will find
another way to bring them back\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, Ivory[game-token-1] I couldn’t[game-token-2][control-code-3] finish what we started[game-token-4] But this is not the end[game-token-5][control-code-6] we will find another way to bring them back[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Maaf, Ivory\. Aku tidak bisa\.\CC0818
menyelesaikan apa yang kita mulai\.\lTapi ini bukan akhir\.\CC0818 kita akan

temukan cara lain untuk membawa
mereka kembali\.

entries.original: "And now, let the main event begin."
entries.translation_source: And now, let the main event begin.
entries.translated:
Dan sekarang, mari kita mulai acara
utamanya.

entries.original:
"Hoopa! The time has come!

Your true power is about to be
released from the Prison Bottle!

And as your Trainer, I am fully
capable of controlling it!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! The time has come! Your true power is about to be released from the Prison Bottle! And as your Trainer, I am fully capable of controlling it!
entries.translated:
Hoopa! Saatnya telah tiba! Kekuatan
sejatimu akan segera dilepaskan\ldari Botol Penjara! Dan sebagai

Trainermu, aku sepenuhnya mampu
mengendalikannya!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0810 pa\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2][control-code-3] pa[game-token-4]
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0810 pa\.

entries.original:
"At last\. I have waited so long for
this moment\.

Hoopa!

The seal on your power has finally
been broken!"
entries.translation_source: At last[game-token-1] I have waited so long for this moment[game-token-2] Hoopa! The seal on your power has finally been broken!
entries.translated:
Akhirnya\. Aku sudah menunggu lama
untuk momen ini\. Hoopa! Segel\lkekuatanmu akhirnya terputus!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo hoo hoo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo hoo hoo!
entries.translated: [green]Hoo hoo hoo!

entries.original:
"Aklove! Tell me!

What reason could you have for
doing any of this?

If we share a common goal, perhaps
we can work together!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove! Tell me! What reason could you have for doing any of this? If we share a common goal, perhaps we can work together!
entries.translated:
Aklove! Katakan padaku! Alasan apa
yang kau miliki untuk melakukan\lsemua ini? Jika kita memiliki

tujuan yang sama, mungkin kita bisa
bekerja sama!

entries.original:
"Fool\.\CC0818 our goals are inevitably at
odds.

I am a descendant of the so-called
\qoforeign king\qc from the great war.

My goal is simply to finish what he
started - and win the war.

With Hoopa’s power now unbound, I
will bring the weapon he created,\land use it to rain fire and\ldestruction across Borrius!

Then, finally, his suffering can
be at its end\.

Now, tell me, Zeph.
What were your goals?"
entries.translation_source: Fool[game-token-1][control-code-2] our goals are inevitably at odds. I am a descendant of the so-called [quote-open-3]foreign king[quote-close-4] from the great war. My goal is simply to finish what he started - and win the war. With Hoopa’s power now unbound, I will bring the weapon he created, and use it to rain fire and destruction across Borrius! Then, finally, his suffering can be at its end[game-token-5] Now, tell me, Zeph. What were your goals?
entries.translated:
Bodoh\.\CC0818 tujuan kita pasti
bertentangan. Aku adalah keturunan\ldari yang disebut \qoraja asing\qc dari

perang besar. Tujuanku sederhana:
menyelesaikan apa yang ia mulai -\ldan memenangkan perang. Dengan

kekuatan Hoopa yang kini tak
terikat, aku akan membawa senjata\lyang ia ciptakan, dan

menggunakannya untuk menghujani api
dan kehancuran ke seluruh Borrius!\lLalu, akhirnya, penderitaannya bisa

berakhir\. Sekarang, katakan padaku,
Zeph. Apa tujuanmu?

entries.original:
"My goals?

There was only one\.\CC0820 one I always
kept at the forefront of my mind\.

It was\.\CC0820 to see him again\.

My little boy\."
entries.translation_source: My goals? There was only one[game-token-1][control-code-2] one I always kept at the forefront of my mind[game-token-3] It was[game-token-4][control-code-5] to see him again[game-token-6] My little boy[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Tujuanku? Hanya ada satu\.\CC0820 satu yang
selalu kujaga di benakku\. Itu adalah\.\CC0820\luntuk melihatnya lagi\. Anak lelakiku\.

entries.original:
"Ah\.\CC0818 what a waste\.\CC0818 such great
power, for such a meagre wish\.

You lack ambition, Zeph!"
entries.translation_source: Ah[game-token-1][control-code-2] what a waste[game-token-3][control-code-4] such great power, for such a meagre wish[game-token-5] You lack ambition, Zeph!
entries.translated:
Ah\.\CC0818 sungguh sia-sia\.\CC0818 kekuatan sebesar
itu, untuk keinginan sekecil itu\.\lKau kurang ambisi, Zeph!

entries.original:
"Enough of this!
Remove yourself from my presence.

The Shadows are finished.

It is time for Borrius to see
the light\.\CC0818 the Light of Ruin!

Ah, but first\.

I see that our guest of honour has
deigned to join us.

Grunts, bring [buffer1] to me."
entries.translation_source: Enough of this! Remove yourself from my presence. The Shadows are finished. It is time for Borrius to see the light[game-token-1][control-code-2] the Light of Ruin! Ah, but first[game-token-3] I see that our guest of honour has deigned to join us. Grunts, bring [buffer1-4] to me.
entries.translated:
Cukup! Enyahlah dari hadapanku. The
Shadows sudah berakhir. Saatnya\lBorrius melihat cahaya\.\CC0818 Cahaya

Kehancuran! Ah, tapi pertama\. Aku
lihat tamu kehormatan kita berkenan\lbergabung. Grunts, bawa [buffer1] ke

sini.

entries.original: "My grunts\."
entries.translation_source: My grunts[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Para grunts-ku\.

entries.original:
"Is this truly so surprising, Zeph?

You and I both know that you are
not the ultimate authority here.

I have gone above you\.

I have spoken with Fey.

And she has agreed that as long as I
provide her with a small sample of\lHoopa’s power to study, I will be\lgranted control of her Shadow\lbranch to do with as I please."
entries.translation_source: Is this truly so surprising, Zeph? You and I both know that you are not the ultimate authority here. I have gone above you[game-token-1] I have spoken with Fey. And she has agreed that as long as I provide her with a small sample of Hoopa’s power to study, I will be granted control of her Shadow branch to do with as I please.
entries.translated:
Apakah ini benar-benar mengejutkan,
Zeph? Kau dan aku sama-sama tahu\lbahwa kau bukan otoritas tertinggi

di sini. Aku telah melampauimu\. Aku
telah bicara dengan Fey. Dan dia\lsetuju bahwa selama aku memberinya

sampel kecil kekuatan Hoopa untuk
diteliti, aku akan diberi kendali\latas cabang Shadow-nya untuk

kulakukan sesukaku.

entries.original:
"But this is\.

THIS IS MY ORGANIZATION!

I founded the company, and this
branch was only allowed to exist\lbecause I approved it!

I may have retired and handed over
the reins, but that does not mean\lI can simply be\.\CC0818 replaced!

She and I had a deal!"
entries.translation_source: But this is[game-token-1] THIS IS MY ORGANIZATION! I founded the company, and this branch was only allowed to exist because I approved it! I may have retired and handed over the reins, but that does not mean I can simply be[game-token-2][control-code-3] replaced! She and I had a deal!
entries.translated:
Tapi ini\. INI ORGANISASIKU! Aku yang
mendirikan perusahaan ini, dan\lcabang ini hanya boleh ada karena

aku menyetujuinya! Mungkin aku
sudah pensiun dan menyerahkan\lkendali, tapi itu bukan berarti aku

bisa begitu saja\.\CC0818 digantikan! Dia
dan aku punya kesepakatan!

entries.original:
"A deal which, need I remind you,
you transgressed, Zeph.

And no one is irreplaceable in an
organization - not even you.

But enough of this.

Nothing you can say will change
the outcome of these events.

And now\."
entries.translation_source: A deal which, need I remind you, you transgressed, Zeph. And no one is irreplaceable in an organization - not even you. But enough of this. Nothing you can say will change the outcome of these events. And now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sebuah kesepakatan yang, perlu saya
ingatkan, Anda langgar, Zeph. Dan\ltidak ada seorang pun yang tidak

tergantikan dalam sebuah organisasi
- bahkan Anda. Tapi cukup. Tidak\lada yang bisa Anda katakan yang

akan mengubah hasil dari peristiwa
ini. Dan sekarang\.

entries.original:
"[player]\.

I can finally have the satisfaction
of eliminating you once and\lfor all.

You have been a repeated nuisance
to the Shadows\.

And I cannot have you becoming
a nuisance to me as well."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1][game-token-2] I can finally have the satisfaction of eliminating you once and for all. You have been a repeated nuisance to the Shadows[game-token-3] And I cannot have you becoming a nuisance to me as well.
entries.translated:
[player]\. Akhirnya saya bisa
mendapatkan kepuasan untuk\lmelenyapkanmu sekali dan untuk

selamanya. Kamu telah menjadi
gangguan berulang bagi Shadows\. Dan\laku tidak bisa membiarkanmu menjadi

gangguan juga bagiku.

entries.original:
"Hoopa!

Summon a Pokémon to crush this fool!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Summon a Pokémon to crush this fool!
entries.translated:
Hoopa! Panggil seekor Pokémon untuk
menghancurkan orang bodoh ini!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] flew back into
the portal."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] flew back into the portal.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] terbang kembali ke dalam
portal.

entries.original:
"What\.?
You actually defeated it?"
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1]? You actually defeated it?
entries.translated:
Apa\.? Kamu benar-benar
mengalahkannya?

entries.original: "Summon another, Hoopa!"
entries.translation_source: Summon another, Hoopa!
entries.translated: Panggil yang lain, Hoopa!

entries.original:
"Is that truly your best, Hoopa?

Perhaps I should have simply done it
myself\."
entries.translation_source: Is that truly your best, Hoopa? Perhaps I should have simply done it myself[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Apakah itu benar-benar yang terbaik
darimu, Hoopa? Mungkin aku\lseharusnya melakukannya sendiri\.

entries.original:
"[player]! You have been an eyesore
for too long!

However, no matter how strong you
may be, I still have my trump card."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You have been an eyesore for too long! However, no matter how strong you may be, I still have my trump card.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu sudah menjadi
pemandangan yang menyebalkan\lterlalu lama! Namun, tidak peduli

sekuat apa pun dirimu, aku masih
memiliki kartu trufku.

entries.original:
"When I was granted control of these
grunts, it came with a request.

My beneficiary seems to have taken
an interest in you, [player].

Which is why\.

\.I have been instructed to seal you
inside this very Cube!"
entries.translation_source: When I was granted control of these grunts, it came with a request. My beneficiary seems to have taken an interest in you, [player-name-1]. Which is why[game-token-2] [game-token-3]I have been instructed to seal you inside this very Cube!
entries.translated:
Ketika saya diberi kendali atas
para grunt ini, itu datang dengan\lsebuah permintaan. Penerima manfaat

saya tampaknya tertarik padamu,
[player]. Itulah mengapa\. \.saya telah\ldiperintahkan untuk menyegelmu di

dalam Kubus ini sendiri!

entries.original:
"No\. you can’t be serious\.

The Cube would never accept live
organic matter!

I would know\.\CC0818 I built in the security
measures, myself!"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] you can’t be serious[game-token-2] The Cube would never accept live organic matter! I would know[game-token-3][control-code-4] I built in the security measures, myself!
entries.translated:
Tidak\. kamu tidak mungkin serius\.
Kubus tidak akan pernah menerima\lmateri organik hidup! Aku tahu\.\CC0818 Aku

sendiri yang memasang tindakan
pengamanannya!

entries.original:
"Heh\. you really have not kept
yourself up to speed since you\lretired, have you?

Fey has done marvelous work on this
special Cube of hers.

So watch carefully, Zeph - watch
just how far your invention has come!"
entries.translation_source: Heh[game-token-1] you really have not kept yourself up to speed since you retired, have you? Fey has done marvelous work on this special Cube of hers. So watch carefully, Zeph - watch just how far your invention has come!
entries.translated:
Heh\. kamu benar-benar tidak
mengikuti perkembangan sejak\lpensiun, ya? Fey telah melakukan

pekerjaan luar biasa pada Kubus
istimewanya. Jadi perhatikan\lbaik-baik, Zeph - perhatikan sejauh

mana penemuanmu telah berkembang!

entries.original:
"Aklove, don’t proceed with this!

What you’re attempting\.\CC0818 could very
well end [player]’s life!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove, don’t proceed with this! What you’re attempting[game-token-1][control-code-2] could very well end [player-name-3]’s life!
entries.translated:
Aklove, jangan lanjutkan ini! Apa
yang kau coba\.\CC0818 bisa saja mengakhiri\lnyawa [player]!

entries.original:
"If that truly is the case, whether
[buffer2] goes now or when the weapon is\lfired, makes no difference to me."
entries.translation_source: If that truly is the case, whether [buffer2-1] goes now or when the weapon is fired, makes no difference to me.
entries.translated:
Jika memang itu masalahnya, apakah
[buffer2] pergi sekarang atau saat\lsenjata ditembakkan, tidak ada

bedanya bagiku.

entries.original:
"And before you think you can escape
this, [player]\.

Be aware\.\CC0820 I know where your
mother lives.

I cannot guarantee her safety should
you attack me or flee\."
entries.translation_source: And before you think you can escape this, [player-name-1][game-token-2] Be aware[game-token-3][control-code-4] I know where your mother lives. I cannot guarantee her safety should you attack me or flee[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Dan sebelum kamu berpikir kamu bisa
melarikan diri dari ini, [player]\.\lSadarlah\.\CC0820 Aku tahu di mana ibumu

tinggal. Aku tidak bisa menjamin
keselamatannya jika kamu\lmenyerangku atau melarikan diri\.

entries.original:
"Good, so you will be cooperative.

Then this is goodbye, [player].
May we never meet again."
entries.translation_source: Good, so you will be cooperative. Then this is goodbye, [player-name-1]. May we never meet again.
entries.translated:
Bagus, jadi kamu akan kooperatif.
Kalau begitu ini selamat tinggal,\l[player]. Semoga kita tidak bertemu

lagi.

entries.original:
"PAYLOAD RECEIVED.

PROCESSING.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: PAYLOAD RECEIVED. PROCESSING.[control-code-1].[control-code-2].[control-code-3]
entries.translated: MUATAN DITERIMA. MEMPROSES.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830

entries.original:
"PROCESSING COMPLETE.

SENTIENT MATTER DETECTED.

COPYING.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: PROCESSING COMPLETE. SENTIENT MATTER DETECTED. COPYING.[control-code-1].[control-code-2].[control-code-3]
entries.translated:
PEMROSESAN SELESAI. MATERI SADAR
TERDETEKSI. MENYALIN.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830

entries.original:
"ENTRY H005 HAS BEEN COPIED
SUCCESSFULLY.

THE DATA HAS BEEN UPLOADED TO
THE MAINFRAME."
entries.translation_source: ENTRY H005 HAS BEEN COPIED SUCCESSFULLY. THE DATA HAS BEEN UPLOADED TO THE MAINFRAME.
entries.translated:
ENTRI H005 BERHASIL DISALIN. DATA
TERSEBUT TELAH DIUNGGAH KE\lMAINFRAME.

entries.original:
"I can’t believe my eyes\.

You\.\CC0818 you’re\.\CC0818 you’re my [buffer3]\.

[player]\.

No matter how old you get, I’ll
always recognize you!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t believe my eyes[game-token-1] You[game-token-2][control-code-3] you’re[game-token-4][control-code-5] you’re my [buffer3-6][game-token-7] [player-name-8][game-token-9] No matter how old you get, I’ll always recognize you!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak percaya mataku\. Kamu\.\CC0818 kamu
adalah\.\CC0818 kamu adalah [buffer3]\.\l[player]-ku\. Tidak peduli berapa

usiamu, aku akan selalu
mengenalimu!

entries.original: "Oh, they got to you too, huh?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, they got to you too, huh?
entries.translated: Oh, mereka juga sampai padamu, ya?

entries.original:
"Marlon, how do you know my
[buffer3]?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, how do you know my [buffer3-1]?
entries.translated:
Marlon, bagaimana kamu tahu
[buffer3] ku?

entries.original:
"We’ve run into each other a few
times now.

Your [buffer3] seems to have the
same sense of justice as you\.

Always running in blindly when
[buffer2]’s not wanted\."
entries.translation_source: We’ve run into each other a few times now. Your [buffer3-1] seems to have the same sense of justice as you[game-token-2] Always running in blindly when [buffer2-3]’s not wanted[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Kita sudah bertemu beberapa kali
sekarang. [buffer3] Anda tampaknya\lmemiliki rasa keadilan yang sama

dengan Anda\. Selalu bergegas masuk
tanpa pikir panjang saat [buffer2]\ltidak diinginkan\.

entries.original:
"Then, I guess you turned out just
as I hoped you would, [player].

I’m so proud, I’m at a loss
for words\."
entries.translation_source: Then, I guess you turned out just as I hoped you would, [player-name-1]. I’m so proud, I’m at a loss for words[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Nah, kurasa kau menjadi seperti
yang kuharapkan, [player]. Aku\lsangat bangga, aku kehilangan

kata-kata\.

entries.original: "Whoa, watch out!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa, watch out!
entries.translated: Wah, awas!

entries.original:
"You need to be mindful of your
surroundings in here, [player].

Items from many different Trainers
are constantly arriving, so you\lcan never know when one is going\lto come flying out of nowhere!"
entries.translation_source: You need to be mindful of your surroundings in here, [player-name-1]. Items from many different Trainers are constantly arriving, so you can never know when one is going to come flying out of nowhere!
entries.translated:
Kamu harus waspada terhadap
lingkungan sekitarmu di sini,\l[player]. Item dari banyak Pelatih

yang berbeda terus berdatangan,
jadi kamu tidak akan pernah tahu\lkapan salah satu akan terbang entah

dari mana!

entries.original:
"But for now, I think we’re in
the clear.

These platforms are usually safe
for us to stand on.

Not that they’re meant for us,
of course.

As I’m sure you guessed, this place
wasn’t designed for human life.

Sending people here is something
that shouldn’t even be possible\."
entries.translation_source: But for now, I think we’re in the clear. These platforms are usually safe for us to stand on. Not that they’re meant for us, of course. As I’m sure you guessed, this place wasn’t designed for human life. Sending people here is something that shouldn’t even be possible[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tapi untuk saat ini, kurasa kita
aman. Platform-platform ini\lbiasanya aman untuk kita pijak.

Bukan berarti platform itu memang
untuk kita, tentu saja. Seperti\lyang pasti sudah kamu duga, tempat

ini tidak dirancang untuk kehidupan
manusia. Mengirim orang ke sini\ladalah sesuatu yang seharusnya

bahkan tidak mungkin terjadi\..

entries.original:
"Oh, I forgot to ask.
How did you wind up in here, too?

And did Hoopa ever make contact
with you?

Marlon tells me it’s been 16 years
since I was trapped in here, so you\lmust have seen Hoopa by now.

\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I forgot to ask. How did you wind up in here, too? And did Hoopa ever make contact with you? Marlon tells me it’s been 16 years since I was trapped in here, so you must have seen Hoopa by now. [game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh, saya lupa bertanya. Bagaimana
kamu juga bisa berakhir di sini?\lDan apakah Hoopa pernah

menghubungimu? Marlon bilang sudah
16 tahun sejak saya terjebak di\lsini, jadi kamu pasti sudah melihat

Hoopa sekarang. \.

entries.original:
"Oh\.\CC0818 poor Hoopa\.

I never intended for that to
happen to it\.

I was trying to protect it when I
threw it in the ocean, but it seems\lit ended up in danger anyway\.

\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1][control-code-2] poor Hoopa[game-token-3] I never intended for that to happen to it[game-token-4] I was trying to protect it when I threw it in the ocean, but it seems it ended up in danger anyway[game-token-5] [game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Oh\.\CC0818 Hoopa yang malang\. Aku tidak
pernah berniat melakukan itu\lpadanya\. Aku berusaha melindunginya

saat melemparkannya ke laut, tapi
sepertinya ia malah berbahaya\. \.

entries.original:
"Marlon, from what I understand,
the Shadow Warrior project is\lstill ongoing\.?

16 years\.\CC0818 and you continued to
inflict such cruelty, on both\lpeople and Pokémon!?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, from what I understand, the Shadow Warrior project is still ongoing[game-token-1]? 16 years[game-token-2][control-code-3] and you continued to inflict such cruelty, on both people and Pokémon!?
entries.translated:
Marlon, setahuku, proyek Shadow
Warrior masih berlangsung\.? 16 tahun\.\CC0818\ldan kau terus melakukan kekejaman

seperti itu, baik pada manusia
maupun Pokémon!?

entries.original:
"We were desperate, Aros!

And there was no denying the
improvements with each experiment.

We were getting so, so close\."
entries.translation_source: We were desperate, Aros! And there was no denying the improvements with each experiment. We were getting so, so close[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kami putus asa, Aros! Dan tidak
dapat dipungkiri adanya peningkatan\ldari setiap percobaan. Kami sudah

sangat, sangat dekat\.

entries.original:
"I know your intentions were good,
Marlon.

But even the worst of men had good
intentions at one point.

And unfortunately, the harm you
inflicted outweighs the good you\lthought you would bring about with\lyour actions!

Why can’t you see that?"
entries.translation_source: I know your intentions were good, Marlon. But even the worst of men had good intentions at one point. And unfortunately, the harm you inflicted outweighs the good you thought you would bring about with your actions! Why can’t you see that?
entries.translated:
Saya tahu niatmu baik, Marlon.
Tetapi bahkan orang terburuk pun\lpernah memiliki niat baik pada

suatu titik. Dan sayangnya,
kerugian yang kamu timbulkan lebih\lbesar daripada kebaikan yang kamu

pikir akan kamu bawa dengan
tindakanmu! Kenapa kamu tidak bisa\lmelihat itu?

entries.original:
"Of course I’m aware of the harm
we caused!

Were it up to me, our research
would have been restricted to\lPokémon that wouldn’t have been\lhurt by the process.

But Fey\.\CC0818 she insisted we branch out,
use different species of Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: Of course I’m aware of the harm we caused! Were it up to me, our research would have been restricted to Pokémon that wouldn’t have been hurt by the process. But Fey[game-token-1][control-code-2] she insisted we branch out, use different species of Pokémon[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tentu saja saya sadar akan kerugian
yang kami sebabkan! Jika itu\lterserah saya, penelitian kami akan

dibatasi pada Pokémon yang tidak
akan terluka oleh proses tersebut.\lTapi Fey\.\CC0818 dia bersikeras kami

melakukan diversifikasi,
menggunakan spesies Pokémon yang\lberbeda\.

entries.original:
"That witch!

She’s the reason I’m even in here
at all!

I knew, from the moment she saw
Hoopa, that she had a growing\lobsession with it.

That’s why I cast Hoopa’s Poké Ball
out to sea\.\CC0818 trying to put it\lout of her reach.

When I met with her on the bridge
that day, she asked about Hoopa.

I tried to play it cool, saying I no
longer had it\.

But when she heard that, she took a
Cube from her pocket, and\.\CC0818 well\.

\.

Wait\.\CC0818 was it because I opposed the
Shadow Warrior Project?

After I discovered its existence,
I secretly began sabotaging your\lwork night after night\.

But no, that can’t be\.\CC0818 I
shouldn’t even be alive were that\lthe case\."
entries.translation_source: That witch! She’s the reason I’m even in here at all! I knew, from the moment she saw Hoopa, that she had a growing obsession with it. That’s why I cast Hoopa’s Poké Ball out to sea[game-token-1][control-code-2] trying to put it out of her reach. When I met with her on the bridge that day, she asked about Hoopa. I tried to play it cool, saying I no longer had it[game-token-3] But when she heard that, she took a Cube from her pocket, and[game-token-4][control-code-5] well[game-token-6] [game-token-7] Wait[game-token-8][control-code-9] was it because I opposed the Shadow Warrior Project? After I discovered its existence, I secretly began sabotaging your work night after night[game-token-10] But no, that can’t be[game-token-11][control-code-12] I shouldn’t even be alive were that the case[game-token-13]
entries.translated:
Penyihir itu! Dialah alasan aku
bisa berada di sini! Aku tahu,\lsejak dia melihat Hoopa, dia

memiliki obsesi yang semakin besar
terhadapnya. Itulah mengapa aku\lmelemparkan Poké Ball Hoopa ke laut\.\CC0818

berusaha menjauhkannya dari
jangkauannya. Saat aku bertemu\ldengannya di jembatan hari itu, dia

bertanya tentang Hoopa. Aku
berusaha bersikap tenang,\lmengatakan bahwa aku tidak lagi

memilikinya\. Tapi saat dia mendengar
itu, dia mengambil sebuah Kubus\ldari sakunya, dan\.\CC0818 yah\. \. Tunggu\.\CC0818

apakah itu karena aku menentang
Proyek Shadow Warrior? Setelah aku\lmengetahui keberadaannya, aku

diam-diam mulai menyabotase
pekerjaanmu malam demi malam\. Tapi\ltidak, itu tidak mungkin\.\CC0818 Aku

seharusnya tidak hidup jika itu
masalahnya\.

entries.original:
"Whatever her reasoning was, Aros,
she certainly didn’t tell us\lanything.

We weren’t even aware you were
alive at all."
entries.translation_source: Whatever her reasoning was, Aros, she certainly didn’t tell us anything. We weren’t even aware you were alive at all.
entries.translated:
Apapun alasannya, Aros, dia pasti
tidak memberi tahu kami apa pun.\lKami bahkan tidak tahu kamu masih

hidup sama sekali.

entries.original:
"If you can call this living.

We’re nothing but data right now,
so are we really alive?

How do we know we aren’t copies of
our real selves, and our physical\lbodies are gone forever\.?"
entries.translation_source: If you can call this living. We’re nothing but data right now, so are we really alive? How do we know we aren’t copies of our real selves, and our physical bodies are gone forever[game-token-1]?
entries.translated:
Jika kau bisa menyebut ini hidup.
Kami hanyalah data saat ini, jadi\lapakah kami benar-benar hidup?

Bagaimana kami tahu bahwa kami
bukan salinan dari diri kami yang\lsebenarnya, dan tubuh fisik kami

telah hilang selamanya\.?

entries.original: "What’s going on?"
entries.translation_source: What’s going on?
entries.translated: Ada apa?

entries.original:
"Oh, that happens every so often.

It means the Cube is about to
begin the sorting process.

Soon, we’ll be whisked away to
some other Cube sector.

You’ll get used to it eventually."
entries.translation_source: Oh, that happens every so often. It means the Cube is about to begin the sorting process. Soon, we’ll be whisked away to some other Cube sector. You’ll get used to it eventually.
entries.translated:
Oh, itu terjadi sesekali. Itu
berarti Kubus akan segera memulai\lproses penyortiran. Sebentar lagi,

kita akan dibawa ke sektor Kubus
lainnya. Kamu akan terbiasa pada\lakhirnya.

entries.original:
"Eventually\.?

Don’t tell me we’re trapped here!

Is there really no way out!?"
entries.translation_source: Eventually[game-token-1]? Don’t tell me we’re trapped here! Is there really no way out!?
entries.translated:
Akhirnya\.? Jangan bilang kita
terjebak di sini! Apa benar-benar\ltidak ada jalan keluar!?

entries.original:
"If there was, I’d have freed
myself ages ago, Marlon.

I’ve tried everything, so unless
you’ve thought of something I\lhaven’t, better get used to your\lnew digital life.

Sigh\.

It’s not all bad, though.

At least we don’t need to eat
or sleep!"
entries.translation_source: If there was, I’d have freed myself ages ago, Marlon. I’ve tried everything, so unless you’ve thought of something I haven’t, better get used to your new digital life. Sigh[game-token-1] It’s not all bad, though. At least we don’t need to eat or sleep!
entries.translated:
Kalau ada, aku sudah membebaskan
diriku sejak lama, Marlon. Aku\lsudah mencoba segalanya, jadi

kecuali kau sudah memikirkan
sesuatu yang belum aku pikirkan,\llebih baik biasakan diri dengan

kehidupan digital barumu. Helaan
napas\. Meskipun tidak semuanya\lburuk. Setidaknya kita tidak perlu

makan atau tidur!

entries.original:
"I really wish I could’ve gotten to
know you better, [player].

Maybe if we get lucky, we’ll wind
up together again someday\."
entries.translation_source: I really wish I could’ve gotten to know you better, [player-name-1]. Maybe if we get lucky, we’ll wind up together again someday[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku benar-benar berharap bisa
mengenalmu lebih baik, [player].\lMungkin jika kita beruntung, kita

akan bersama lagi suatu hari nanti\.

entries.original:
"It can’t be\.
Is that\.\CC0818 a Cube V3?

\.

It is!"
entries.translation_source: It can’t be[game-token-1] Is that[game-token-2][control-code-3] a Cube V3? [game-token-4] It is!
entries.translated:
Tidak mungkin\. Apa itu\.\CC0818 sebuah Cube
V3? \. Benar!

entries.original: "Marlon, do you have one, too?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, do you have one, too?
entries.translated:
Marlon, apakah kamu juga punya
satu?

entries.original:
"I do, yes.

But what does that have to
do with\.?"
entries.translation_source: I do, yes. But what does that have to do with[game-token-1]?
entries.translated:
Ya, aku punya. Tapi apa hubungannya
dengan\.?

entries.original:
"I think I know how to free you,
but only if I’m right about this\lplace being the third version\lcreated of Cube Space.

I’m pretty sure I am, though -
when I was first sent here,\lthe place was devoid of items.

The Cube V3 had only just been
revealed to the public, but no one\lhad access to it yet.

It didn’t take long to figure out
I’d been trapped in a more\ladvanced Cube Space.

I came up with a plan to free
myself, but my own Cube’s an\loutdated V2.

But as for you two\.\CC0818
I think this can work!"
entries.translation_source: I think I know how to free you, but only if I’m right about this place being the third version created of Cube Space. I’m pretty sure I am, though - when I was first sent here, the place was devoid of items. The Cube V3 had only just been revealed to the public, but no one had access to it yet. It didn’t take long to figure out I’d been trapped in a more advanced Cube Space. I came up with a plan to free myself, but my own Cube’s an outdated V2. But as for you two[game-token-1][control-code-2] I think this can work!
entries.translated:
Aku rasa aku tahu cara membebaskan
kalian, tapi hanya jika aku benar\ltentang tempat ini sebagai versi

ketiga dari Cube Space. Aku cukup
yakin sih - saat pertama kali\ldikirim ke sini, tempat itu kosong

dari item. Cube V3 baru saja
diperkenalkan ke publik, tapi belum\lada yang bisa mengaksesnya. Tidak

butuh waktu lama untuk menyadari
bahwa aku terjebak di Cube Space\lyang lebih canggih. Aku punya

rencana untuk membebaskan diri,
tapi Cube-ku sendiri adalah V2 yang\lusang. Tapi untuk kalian berdua\.\CC0818 aku

rasa ini bisa berhasil!

entries.original:
"What do we need to do, Aros?
Hurry, we can’t have much time left!"
entries.translation_source: What do we need to do, Aros? Hurry, we can’t have much time left!
entries.translated:
Apa yang harus kami lakukan, Aros?
Cepat, kita tidak punya banyak\lwaktu!

entries.original:
"Hand me your Cubes.

I’ll make the necessary modifications
for your escape.

If I’m correct, opening your Cubes
in here will cause a chain reaction,\lone that’ll forcibly eject you from\lCube Space."
entries.translation_source: Hand me your Cubes. I’ll make the necessary modifications for your escape. If I’m correct, opening your Cubes in here will cause a chain reaction, one that’ll forcibly eject you from Cube Space.
entries.translated:
Berikan Cube kalian padaku. Aku
akan melakukan modifikasi yang\ldiperlukan untuk pelarian kalian.

Jika aku benar, membuka Cube kalian
di sini akan menyebabkan reaksi\lberantai, yang akan memaksa kalian

keluar dari Cube Space.

entries.original:
"Are you sure about this, Aros?
Will this actually break us out?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure about this, Aros? Will this actually break us out?
entries.translated:
Apa kamu yakin dengan ini, Aros?
Apakah ini benar-benar akan\lmembebaskan kita?

entries.original:
"Either that, or your digital selves
will be destroyed forever.

No biggie.

Don’t worry - I rate your survival
odds as being higher than not."
entries.translation_source: Either that, or your digital selves will be destroyed forever. No biggie. Don’t worry - I rate your survival odds as being higher than not.
entries.translated:
Entah itu, atau diri digital kalian
akan dihancurkan selamanya. Santai\laja. Jangan khawatir - aku menilai

peluang bertahan hidup kalian lebih
tinggi daripada tidak.

entries.original: "Oh, THAT’S comforting\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, THAT’S comforting[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Oh, itu MENGHIBUR\.

entries.original:
"\.

If this works\.\CC0818 promise me something,
Marlon.

You’ll lay to rest the Pokémon that
you’ve turned into Shadow Warriors.

And you’ll end the Shadow Warrior
Project once and for all."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] If this works[game-token-2][control-code-3] promise me something, Marlon. You’ll lay to rest the Pokémon that you’ve turned into Shadow Warriors. And you’ll end the Shadow Warrior Project once and for all.
entries.translated:
\. Jika ini berhasil\.\CC0818 janjikan sesuatu
padaku, Marlon. Kau akan\lmengistirahatkan Pokémon yang telah

kau jadikan Shadow Warrior. Dan kau
akan mengakhiri Shadow Warrior\lProject untuk selamanya.

entries.original:
"\.\CC0840Alright.

You have my word.

I doubt we’ll be making any more
as it is\.

The fact I’m trapped here clearly
shows the Science Society has\lterminated our partnership.

But, what about you?
Are you not coming with us?"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1][control-code-2]Alright. You have my word. I doubt we’ll be making any more as it is[game-token-3] The fact I’m trapped here clearly shows the Science Society has terminated our partnership. But, what about you? Are you not coming with us?
entries.translated:
\.\CC0840Baiklah. Aku berjanji. Aku ragu
kita akan membuat lagi seperti ini\.\lFakta bahwa aku terjebak di sini

jelas menunjukkan Science Society
telah mengakhiri kemitraan kita.\lTapi, bagaimana denganmu? Apa kamu

tidak ikut dengan kami?

entries.original:
"I can’t\.

At least not without a Cube V3 of
my own.

In order for me to escape, someone
on the outside has to let me out."
entries.translation_source: I can’t[game-token-1] At least not without a Cube V3 of my own. In order for me to escape, someone on the outside has to let me out.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa\. Setidaknya tidak
tanpa Cube V3 milikku sendiri. Agar\laku bisa kabur, seseorang di luar

harus membebaskanku.

entries.original:
"And [player]\.
I wish we had more time to talk.

If only we were meeting under
better circumstances\."
entries.translation_source: And [player-name-1][game-token-2] I wish we had more time to talk. If only we were meeting under better circumstances[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Dan [player]\. Aku berharap kita
punya lebih banyak waktu untuk\lbicara. Seandainya kita bertemu

dalam keadaan yang lebih baik\.

entries.original:
"I’ll keep this brief - help Marlon
end the Shadow Warrior Project.

From what I remember, they’re highly
sensitive to light, so exposing them\lshould lay their souls to rest.

And above all else, save Hoopa.

The longer its power remains unbound,
the more it loses its sense of self.

Confine its power, and you can return
it to how it used to be."
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep this brief - help Marlon end the Shadow Warrior Project. From what I remember, they’re highly sensitive to light, so exposing them should lay their souls to rest. And above all else, save Hoopa. The longer its power remains unbound, the more it loses its sense of self. Confine its power, and you can return it to how it used to be.
entries.translated:
Aku akan singkat - bantu Marlon
mengakhiri Shadow Warrior Project.\lSeingatku, mereka sangat sensitif

terhadap cahaya, jadi mengekspos
mereka akan menenangkan jiwa\lmereka. Dan yang terpenting,

selamatkan Hoopa. Semakin lama
kekuatannya tidak terikat, semakin\lia kehilangan kesadaran dirinya.

Kurung kekuatannya, dan kau bisa
mengembalikannya seperti dulu.

entries.original:
"Alright, I’m done.

I’ve set your coordinates to
Cinder Volcano.

If you make it out, it shouldn’t
take long for you to reach the\lShadow Warriors.

And as thanks in advance, I took the
liberty of giving back what you\llost because of them, Marlon\."
entries.translation_source: Alright, I’m done. I’ve set your coordinates to Cinder Volcano. If you make it out, it shouldn’t take long for you to reach the Shadow Warriors. And as thanks in advance, I took the liberty of giving back what you lost because of them, Marlon[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Baiklah, selesai. Aku sudah
mengatur koordinat kalian ke Cinder\lVolcano. Jika kalian berhasil

keluar, tidak akan lama untuk
mencapai Shadow Warriors. Dan\lsebagai ucapan terima kasih

sebelumnya, aku mengambil kebebasan
untuk mengembalikan apa yang kau\lhilang karena mereka, Marlon\.

entries.original: "No\. that shouldn’t be possible\."
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] that shouldn’t be possible[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Tidak\. itu seharusnya tidak mungkin\.

entries.original:
"Never mind!

You’re running out of time!
You have to go, now!"
entries.translation_source: Never mind! You’re running out of time! You have to go, now!
entries.translated:
Lupakan! Waktu kalian habis! Kalian
harus pergi, sekarang!

entries.original:
"Aros\.\CC0818 I promise I’ll end this\.

And when I do, I swear I’ll return
for you.

I swear!"
entries.translation_source: Aros[game-token-1][control-code-2] I promise I’ll end this[game-token-3] And when I do, I swear I’ll return for you. I swear!
entries.translated:
Aros\.\CC0818 Aku berjanji akan mengakhiri
ini\. Dan saat itu terjadi, aku\lbersumpah akan kembali untukmu. Aku

bersumpah!

entries.original:
"Goodbye, Marlon, [player]\.

Don’t forget what you promised me!"
entries.translation_source: Goodbye, Marlon, [player-name-1][game-token-2] Don’t forget what you promised me!
entries.translated:
Selamat tinggal, Marlon, [player]\.
Jangan lupa apa yang kau janjikan\lpadaku!

entries.original:
"I don’t know who you are, but
you’re not getting past me, too!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t know who you are, but you’re not getting past me, too!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tahu siapa kamu, tapi kau
tidak akan melewatiku juga!

entries.original:
"\.[player]?

But\.\CC0818 but\.\CC0818 but you’re supposed to
be out of the picture!

How is this possible?

I need to warn the others!"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1][player-name-2]? But[game-token-3][control-code-4] but[game-token-5][control-code-6] but you’re supposed to be out of the picture! How is this possible? I need to warn the others!
entries.translated:
\.[player]? Tapi\.\CC0818 tapi\.\CC0818 tapi kamu
seharusnya sudah tidak ada!\lBagaimana ini mungkin? Aku harus

memperingatkan yang lain!

entries.original: "[red]Ughhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Ughhhhh[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [red]Ughhhhh\.

entries.original: "[red]Oh no no no no!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh no no no no!
entries.translated: [red]Oh tidak tidak tidak tidak!

entries.original: "[red]Véga, sir!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Véga, sir!
entries.translated: [red]Véga, Pak!

entries.original:
"Véga!

What’s the meaning of this?"
entries.translation_source: Véga! What’s the meaning of this?
entries.translated: Véga! Apa maksud dari ini?

entries.original:
"Marlon?

I was informed that you’d been
disposed of\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon? I was informed that you’d been disposed of[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Marlon? Saya diberitahu bahwa Anda
telah disingkirkan\.

entries.original:
"I don’t care what you were told!

The rest of the Shadow Warriors\.\CC0818
what have you done with them!?"
entries.translation_source: I don’t care what you were told! The rest of the Shadow Warriors[game-token-1][control-code-2] what have you done with them!?
entries.translated:
Aku tidak peduli apa yang
diberitakan padamu! Sisa dari\lShadow Warriors\.\CC0818 apa yang kau

lakukan pada mereka!?

entries.original:
"The Shadow Warriors?

Fey deemed this place unsafe for
them after the previous incident.

Most of them have already been
moved somewhere more secure."
entries.translation_source: The Shadow Warriors? Fey deemed this place unsafe for them after the previous incident. Most of them have already been moved somewhere more secure.
entries.translated:
Shadow Warriors? Fey menganggap
tempat ini tidak aman bagi mereka\lsetelah insiden sebelumnya.

Sebagian besar dari mereka sudah
dipindahkan ke tempat yang lebih\laman.

entries.original: "[red]Um\.\CC0818 sir\.?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Um[game-token-2][control-code-3] sir[game-token-4]?
entries.translated: [red]Um\.\CC0818 Pak\.?

entries.original:
"Tell me where they are, Véga!

Or so help me, I’ll turn you into
one of them myself!"
entries.translation_source: Tell me where they are, Véga! Or so help me, I’ll turn you into one of them myself!
entries.translated:
Katakan di mana mereka, Véga! Atau
sumpah, aku akan mengubahmu menjadi\lsalah satu dari mereka sendiri!

entries.original:
"Please. Do you really believe you
can still order me about?

I am Agent Véga of the
Science Society.

My loyalties are with Fey\.\CC0818
and you lost your authority over\lme when you broke your contract\lwith her.

Openly bringing Shadow Warriors out
into the public?

Trying to release a dark force known
for its destructive nature, without\lfirst trying to understand it?

The Rangers are already determined
to find something to catch us on,\lso we should consider ourselves\lfortunate that no one else\ldiscovered that we were creating\lliving weapons.

You must have had some idea of the
potential consequences, were Fey\lto ever find out, yes?

Especially now, when she is close to
achieving perfection\."
entries.translation_source: Please. Do you really believe you can still order me about? I am Agent Véga of the Science Society. My loyalties are with Fey[game-token-1][control-code-2] and you lost your authority over me when you broke your contract with her. Openly bringing Shadow Warriors out into the public? Trying to release a dark force known for its destructive nature, without first trying to understand it? The Rangers are already determined to find something to catch us on, so we should consider ourselves fortunate that no one else discovered that we were creating living weapons. You must have had some idea of the potential consequences, were Fey to ever find out, yes? Especially now, when she is close to achieving perfection[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tolong. Apakah kamu benar-benar
percaya kamu masih bisa\lmemerintahku? Aku Agen Véga dari

Science Society. Kesetiaanku kepada
Fey\.\CC0818 dan kamu kehilangan wewenangmu\latasku saat kamu melanggar

kontrakmu dengannya. Membawa Shadow
Warriors secara terbuka ke publik?\lMencoba melepaskan kekuatan gelap

yang dikenal karena sifat
destruktifnya, tanpa mencoba\lmemahaminya terlebih dahulu? Para

Rangers sudah bertekad untuk
menemukan sesuatu untuk menangkap\lkita, jadi kita harus menganggap

diri kita beruntung bahwa tidak ada
orang lain yang mengetahui bahwa\lkita menciptakan senjata hidup.

Kamu pasti punya gambaran tentang
konsekuensi potensial, jika Fey\lsuatu hari tahu, kan? Terutama

sekarang, saat dia dekat dengan
kesempurnaan\.

entries.original: "[red]Sir\.\CC0818 um\.\CC0818 excuse me, sir\.?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Sir[game-token-2][control-code-3] um[game-token-4][control-code-5] excuse me, sir[game-token-6]?
entries.translated: [red]Pak\.\CC0818 um\.\CC0818 permisi, Pak\.?

entries.original:
"We knew\.\CC0818 we knew she would
never approve.

But even then, we still had to try.

All we had to show was failure
after failure\.

Tell me, what would you have done,
Véga?"
entries.translation_source: We knew[game-token-1][control-code-2] we knew she would never approve. But even then, we still had to try. All we had to show was failure after failure[game-token-3] Tell me, what would you have done, Véga?
entries.translated:
Kami tahu\.\CC0818 kami tahu dia tidak akan
pernah menyetujui. Tetapi meskipun\lbegitu, kami tetap harus mencoba.

Yang bisa kami tunjukkan hanyalah
kegagalan demi kegagalan\. Katakan\lpadaku, apa yang akan kamu lakukan,

Véga?

entries.original:
"I would have continued waiting
patiently.

The last experiment alone should
have made it clear that practical\lapplication was well within reach.

Fey certainly has not given up\.

But then, that is how YOU should
have acted, according to YOUR\lwishes\."
entries.translation_source: I would have continued waiting patiently. The last experiment alone should have made it clear that practical application was well within reach. Fey certainly has not given up[game-token-1] But then, that is how YOU should have acted, according to YOUR wishes[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku akan terus menunggu dengan
sabar. Eksperimen terakhir saja\lseharusnya sudah memperjelas bahwa

aplikasi praktis sudah dalam
jangkauan. Fey jelas belum menyerah\.\lTapi kemudian, itulah cara

SEHARUSNYA kamu bertindak, sesuai
dengan KEINGINANMU\.

entries.original:
"What are you implying?

What do you know about what Fey
truly wants?"
entries.translation_source: What are you implying? What do you know about what Fey truly wants?
entries.translated:
Apa maksudmu? Apa yang kamu tahu
tentang apa yang sebenarnya\ldiinginkan Fey?

entries.original:
"Who knows\.

She won’t even tell me, and I’m her
right-hand man.

She’s always been the type to keep
her cards close to her chest\."
entries.translation_source: Who knows[game-token-1] She won’t even tell me, and I’m her right-hand man. She’s always been the type to keep her cards close to her chest[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Siapa tahu\. Dia bahkan tidak mau
memberitahuku, dan aku adalah\ltangan kanannya. Dia selalu tipe

yang menyimpan kartunya dekat di
dada\.

entries.original:
"Just to clear up any
misunderstandings\.

\.The Shadow Warriors, what do you
plan to do with them now?"
entries.translation_source: Just to clear up any misunderstandings[game-token-1] [game-token-2]The Shadow Warriors, what do you plan to do with them now?
entries.translated:
Hanya untuk meluruskan
kesalahpahaman\. \.The Shadow Warriors,\lapa yang kamu rencanakan untuk

dilakukan dengan mereka sekarang?

entries.original: "[red]Please don’t ignore me, sir\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Please don’t ignore me, sir[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [red]Tolong jangan abaikan aku, Pak\.

entries.original:
"Destroy them - the whole wretched
lot of them.

I’ve had time to reflect on what
we did to all those poor Pokémon\.

It was wrong - all of it!

None of them deserved to be
experimented on\.\CC0818 especially not in\lthat way!

I can’t change what we did, but I
can certainly end their pain now."
entries.translation_source: Destroy them - the whole wretched lot of them. I’ve had time to reflect on what we did to all those poor Pokémon[game-token-1] It was wrong - all of it! None of them deserved to be experimented on[game-token-2][control-code-3] especially not in that way! I can’t change what we did, but I can certainly end their pain now.
entries.translated:
Hancurkan mereka - seluruh kumpulan
celaka itu. Aku punya waktu untuk\lmerenungkan apa yang kita lakukan

pada semua Pokémon malang itu\. Itu
salah - semuanya! Tidak satu pun\ldari mereka pantas untuk

dieksperimen\.\CC0818 terutama tidak dengan
cara itu! Aku tidak bisa mengubah\lapa yang kita lakukan, tapi aku

pasti bisa mengakhiri penderitaan
mereka sekarang.

entries.original:
"And I cannot let you do that.

Aklove still has need of them,
and as per our contract, Fey is\lproviding him with both Grunts and\lShadow Warriors - all for his new\lorganization, the Light of Ruin.

But if you refuse to stand aside and
let us leave\."
entries.translation_source: And I cannot let you do that. Aklove still has need of them, and as per our contract, Fey is providing him with both Grunts and Shadow Warriors - all for his new organization, the Light of Ruin. But if you refuse to stand aside and let us leave[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dan aku tidak bisa membiarkanmu
melakukan itu. Aklove masih\lmembutuhkan mereka, dan sesuai

kontrak kita, Fey menyediakan dia
dengan Grunts dan Shadow Warriors -\lsemua untuk organisasi barunya,

Light of Ruin. Tapi jika kamu
menolak untuk menyingkir dan\lmembiarkan kami pergi\.

entries.original:
"One of you!

Help me get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: One of you! Help me get rid of him!
entries.translated:
Salah satu dari kalian! Bantu aku
menyingkirkannya!

entries.original: "I hope it was worth it, Marlon\."
entries.translation_source: I hope it was worth it, Marlon[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Aku harap itu sepadan, Marlon\.

entries.original: "[red]SIIIIIIIR!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]SIIIIIIIR!
entries.translated: [red]TUAAAAAN!

entries.original:
"[red]It’s [player], sir!

[buffer3]’s here too!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]It’s [player-name-2], sir! [buffer3-3]’s here too!
entries.translated:
[red]Ini [player], Tuan! [buffer3] juga
ada di sini!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0820 so much for the most secure
item storage in the world\."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1][control-code-2] so much for the most secure item storage in the world[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Huh\.\CC0820 begitulah penyimpanan item
paling aman di dunia\.

entries.original:
"You had one job\.\CC0818 keep out any
and all intruders!

But since you have so obviously
failed at that task, I suppose\lthat old adage must be true.

If you want anything done properly,
you must do it yourself."
entries.translation_source: You had one job[game-token-1][control-code-2] keep out any and all intruders! But since you have so obviously failed at that task, I suppose that old adage must be true. If you want anything done properly, you must do it yourself.
entries.translated:
Kamu punya satu tugas\.\CC0818 jaga agar
semua penyusup tidak masuk! Tapi\lkarena kamu jelas-jelas gagal dalam

tugas itu, kurasa pepatah lama itu
pasti benar. Jika kamu ingin\lsesuatu dilakukan dengan benar,

kamu harus melakukannya sendiri.

entries.original:
"[player]! So you survived the trip
back, too.

Quickly - we need to deal with Véga
and his cronies!

Your Pokémon can still fight, can’t
they? Great!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! So you survived the trip back, too. Quickly - we need to deal with Véga and his cronies! Your Pokémon can still fight, can’t they? Great!
entries.translated:
[player]! Jadi kau selamat dari
