perjalanan kembali juga. Cepat -\lkita harus menghadapi Véga dan

antek-anteknya! Pokémon-mu masih
bisa bertarung, kan? Hebat!

entries.original:
"There’s no time to back out of
this fight, [player]!

We need to work together to deal
with Véga and his cronies!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no time to back out of this fight, [player-name-1]! We need to work together to deal with Véga and his cronies!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada waktu untuk mundur dari
pertarungan ini, [player]! Kita\lharus bekerja sama untuk menghadapi

Véga dan antek-anteknya!

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 it is truly unfortunate that
you had to find out this way.

But I will not hesitate.

You are no longer a mere opponent\.\CC0818
you are an enemy!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] it is truly unfortunate that you had to find out this way. But I will not hesitate. You are no longer a mere opponent[game-token-4][control-code-5] you are an enemy!
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 sungguh disayangkan kau
harus mengetahuinya dengan cara\lini. Tapi aku tidak akan ragu. Kau

bukan lagi sekadar lawan\.\CC0818 kau adalah
musuh!

entries.original: "This useless grunt let me down\."
entries.translation_source: This useless grunt let me down[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"I doubt this would have gone much
better even with a useless grunt\."
entries.translation_source: I doubt this would have gone much better even with a useless grunt[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"All Grunts, retreat back to your
new base!

We’ve mostly finished what we
came for - there is no need to\lremain here!"
entries.translation_source: All Grunts, retreat back to your new base! We’ve mostly finished what we came for - there is no need to remain here!
entries.translated:
Semua Grunts, mundur kembali ke
markas baru kalian! Kami hampir\lselesai dengan apa yang kami

datangi - tidak perlu tetap di
sini!

entries.original:
"No you don’t!

You’re not getting away that easily!"
entries.translation_source: No you don’t! You’re not getting away that easily!
entries.translated:
Tidak, jangan! Kalian tidak akan
kabur semudah itu!

entries.original: "You can’t restrain me!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t restrain me!
entries.translated: Kau tidak bisa menahanku!

entries.original:
"There’s nowhere for you to run,
Véga!

Now, tell me where you’re keeping
the Shadow Warriors!"
entries.translation_source: There’s nowhere for you to run, Véga! Now, tell me where you’re keeping the Shadow Warriors!
entries.translated:
Tidak ada tempat untukmu lari,
Véga! Sekarang, katakan di mana kau\lmenyembunyikan Shadow Warriors!

entries.original:
"You think you have me cornered,
do you, Marlon?

Quite the opposite - it is you
who will soon be pinned down."
entries.translation_source: You think you have me cornered, do you, Marlon? Quite the opposite - it is you who will soon be pinned down.
entries.translated:
Kau pikir kau sudah menjebakku, ya,
Marlon? Justru sebaliknya - kau lah\lyang akan segera terpojok.

entries.original: "What’s that supposed to mean, Véga?"
entries.translation_source: What’s that supposed to mean, Véga?
entries.translated: Apa maksudnya itu, Véga?

entries.original:
"I’m sure you’re aware of the
incident that took place here, yes?"
entries.translation_source: I’m sure you’re aware of the incident that took place here, yes?
entries.translated:
Aku yakin kau tahu tentang insiden
yang terjadi di sini, kan?

entries.original: "Of course\.\CC0818 what’s your point?"
entries.translation_source: Of course[game-token-1][control-code-2] what’s your point?
entries.translated: Tentu saja\.\CC0818 apa maksudmu?

entries.original:
"The monster that appeared from
the lava\.\CC0818 those fools unfortunate\lenough to be present fought tooth\land nail to subdue it.

It only sleeps now, having been
overwhelmed by sheer numbers.

But supposing one had the means to
reawaken and control it\."
entries.translation_source: The monster that appeared from the lava[game-token-1][control-code-2] those fools unfortunate enough to be present fought tooth and nail to subdue it. It only sleeps now, having been overwhelmed by sheer numbers. But supposing one had the means to reawaken and control it[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Monster yang muncul dari lava\.\CC0818
orang-orang bodoh yang cukup sial\luntuk berada di sana bertarung

mati-matian untuk menaklukkannya.
Ia hanya tidur sekarang, setelah\ldikalahkan oleh jumlah yang luar

biasa. Tapi seandainya seseorang
memiliki cara untuk membangunkannya\lkembali dan mengendalikannya\.

entries.original: "No\.\CC0820 surely you’re not planning\.!?"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1][control-code-2] surely you’re not planning[game-token-3]!?
entries.translated: Tidak\.\CC0820 tentu kau tidak berencana\.!?

entries.original:
"Oh yes, Marlon.

Fey had Aklove pass me a certain
artifact, capable of controlling\lthe monster that slumbers beneath\lthe magma.

And now\."
entries.translation_source: Oh yes, Marlon. Fey had Aklove pass me a certain artifact, capable of controlling the monster that slumbers beneath the magma. And now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh ya, Marlon. Fey menyuruh Aklove
memberikan sebuah artefak tertentu\lpadaku, yang mampu mengendalikan

monster yang tertidur di bawah
magma. Dan sekarang\.

entries.original:
"Groudon!
Respond to my Red Orb!

Awaken, and revert to your
primordial state!"
entries.translation_source: Groudon! Respond to my Red Orb! Awaken, and revert to your primordial state!
entries.translated:
Groudon! Balaslah panggilan Red
Orb-ku! Bangunlah, dan kembalilah\lke wujud primordialmu!

entries.original:
"What now, Marlon?

You cannot keep holding me here -
the cave will soon collapse, and\lwe will both be trapped.

You cannot hope to find the Shadow
Warriors whilst buried under rubble."
entries.translation_source: What now, Marlon? You cannot keep holding me here - the cave will soon collapse, and we will both be trapped. You cannot hope to find the Shadow Warriors whilst buried under rubble.
entries.translated:
Ada apa lagi, Marlon? Kau tidak
bisa terus menahanku di sini - gua\lini akan segera runtuh, dan kita

berdua akan terjebak. Kau tidak
bisa berharap menemukan Shadow\lWarriors saat terkubur di bawah

puing.

entries.original:
"It’s simple.

If that happens, I’ll use Krookodile
to dig my way out.

Even if you must remain trapped,
Véga, I know Fey.

There are only so many places in
Borrius she’d consider secure\lenough to store the Shadow\lWarriors.

Once I rejoin Zeph in Frozen
Heights, we’ll scour every possible\llocation until we find them!"
entries.translation_source: It’s simple. If that happens, I’ll use Krookodile to dig my way out. Even if you must remain trapped, Véga, I know Fey. There are only so many places in Borrius she’d consider secure enough to store the Shadow Warriors. Once I rejoin Zeph in Frozen Heights, we’ll scour every possible location until we find them!
entries.translated:
Sederhana. Jika itu terjadi, aku
akan menggunakan Krookodile untuk\lmenggali jalan keluar. Bahkan jika

kau harus tetap terjebak, Véga, aku
kenal Fey. Hanya ada beberapa\ltempat di Borrius yang menurutnya

cukup aman untuk menyimpan Shadow
Warriors. Setelah aku bergabung\lkembali dengan Zeph di Frozen

Heights, kami akan menyisir setiap
lokasi yang memungkinkan sampai\lkami menemukan mereka!

entries.original:
"I thought you’d continue to be
stubborn, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: I thought you’d continue to be stubborn, Marlon.
entries.translated:
Kupikir kau akan terus keras
kepala, Marlon.

entries.original:
"Groudon!

The earth trembles with your
every step!

Now, subdue them!"
entries.translation_source: Groudon! The earth trembles with your every step! Now, subdue them!
entries.translated:
Groudon! Bumi gemetar dengan setiap
langkahmu! Sekarang, tundukkan\lmereka!

entries.original:
"Can’t keep your footing, Marlon?

Then, I shall take that as my cue
to leave."
entries.translation_source: Can’t keep your footing, Marlon? Then, I shall take that as my cue to leave.
entries.translated:
Tidak bisa menjaga keseimbangan,
Marlon? Kalau begitu, itu akan\lkuanggap sebagai isyarat untuk

pergi.

entries.original: "Curses\.\CC0818 he escaped\."
entries.translation_source: Curses[game-token-1][control-code-2] he escaped[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Sialan\.\CC0818 dia melarikan diri\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

You have to stop Groudon’s
rampage!

If not, the cave will collapse and
we’ll both be trapped here!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You have to stop Groudon’s rampage! If not, the cave will collapse and we’ll both be trapped here!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kau harus menghentikan
amukan Groudon! Jika tidak, gua ini\lakan runtuh dan kita berdua akan

terjebak di sini!

entries.original:
"Ngh\.\CC0818 [player], are you alright?

\.\CC0818No! We’ve been separated!"
entries.translation_source: Ngh[game-token-1][control-code-2] [player-name-3], are you alright? [game-token-4][control-code-5]No! We’ve been separated!
entries.translated:
Ngh\.\CC0818 [player], kau tidak apa-apa?
\.\CC0818Tidak! Kita terpisah!

entries.original:
"Wait, these Poké Balls on my side\.\CC0818
aren’t they [player]’s Pokémon?

They must have been dropped when
Groudon used that attack\.

What now\.\CC0818 my own Pokémon are too
badly hurt to take that thing on\.!"
entries.translation_source: Wait, these Poké Balls on my side[game-token-1][control-code-2] aren’t they [player-name-3]’s Pokémon? They must have been dropped when Groudon used that attack[game-token-4] What now[game-token-5][control-code-6] my own Pokémon are too badly hurt to take that thing on[game-token-7]!
entries.translated:
Tunggu, Poké Balls di sisiku\.\CC0818
bukankah itu Pokémon milik\l[player]? Pasti terjatuh saat

Groudon menggunakan serangan itu\.
Bagaimana ini\.\CC0818 Pokémon-ku sendiri\lterlalu terluka parah untuk

menghadapi makhluk itu\.!

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0818 [player]!

Let me use your Poké Balls!
I’ll command your Pokémon!

Just direct me on whether you want
to fight or switch!"
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] [player-name-3]! Let me use your Poké Balls! I’ll command your Pokémon! Just direct me on whether you want to fight or switch!
entries.translated:
Tunggu\.\CC0818 [player]! Biarkan aku
menggunakan Poké Ball-mu! Aku akan\lmemerintahkan Pokémon-mu! Arahkan

aku apakah kau ingin bertarung atau
ganti!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] sank into the lava and
fell into a deep slumber once more."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] sank into the lava and fell into a deep slumber once more.
entries.translated:
[black] [buffer1] tenggelam ke dalam lava
dan kembali tertidur lelap.

entries.original: "Phew\.\CC0818 we survived\.\CC0818 somehow\."
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1][control-code-2] we survived[game-token-3][control-code-4] somehow[game-token-5]
entries.translated: Fiuh\.\CC0818 kita selamat\.\CC0818 entah bagaimana\.

entries.original:
"Krookodile! Destroy the rocks!
Use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Krookodile! Destroy the rocks! Use Rock Smash!
entries.translated:
Krookodile! Hancurkan batu-batu
itu! Gunakan Rock Smash!

entries.original:
"Thank you for your help,
[player].

I honestly don’t know what I would
have done without you.

Here - I suppose you’ll want your
Pokémon back."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for your help, [player-name-1]. I honestly don’t know what I would have done without you. Here - I suppose you’ll want your Pokémon back.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih atas bantuanmu,
[player]. Sejujurnya aku tidak tahu\lapa yang akan kulakukan tanpamu.

Ini - kukira kau pasti ingin
Pokémon-mu kembali.

entries.original:
"How about you\.\CC0818 no, on second
thought, that’s not a good idea\."
entries.translation_source: How about you[game-token-1][control-code-2] no, on second thought, that’s not a good idea[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Bagaimana denganmu\.\CC0818 tidak, setelah
dipikir lagi, itu bukan ide yang\lbagus\.

entries.original:
"Look, I’m grateful for your help.

Truly, I am.

However, this next task\.\CC0818 is
something I need to handle alone.

Right now, I need to secure Zeph’s
aid in finding the Light of Ruin’s\lnew base.

If you followed me to our base in
[green]Frozen Heights[blue], Zeph would never\lagree to help.

So please, [player], for both our
sakes - stay away from our base."
entries.translation_source: Look, I’m grateful for your help. Truly, I am. However, this next task[game-token-1][control-code-2] is something I need to handle alone. Right now, I need to secure Zeph’s aid in finding the Light of Ruin’s new base. If you followed me to our base in [color-green-3]Frozen Heights[color-blue-4], Zeph would never agree to help. So please, [player-name-5], for both our sakes - stay away from our base.
entries.translated:
Dengar, aku bersyukur atas
bantuanmu. Sungguh. Namun, tugas\lberikutnya\.\CC0818 adalah sesuatu yang

harus kutangani sendiri. Saat ini,
aku perlu mendapatkan bantuan Zeph\luntuk menemukan markas baru Light

of Ruin. Jika kau mengikutiku ke
markas kami di [green]Frozen Heights[blue], Zeph\ltidak akan pernah setuju membantu.

Jadi, tolong, [player], demi kita
berdua - jauhi markas kami.

entries.original:
"It looks like someone left their
uniform on the floor.

Put it on?"
entries.translation_source: It looks like someone left their uniform on the floor. Put it on?
entries.translated:
Sepertinya seseorang meninggalkan
seragamnya di lantai. Pakai?

entries.original: "You put on the clothes."
entries.translation_source: You put on the clothes.
entries.translated: Kamu memakai pakaian itu.

entries.original:
"Your clothes are on the ground.
Put them on?"
entries.translation_source: Your clothes are on the ground. Put them on?
entries.translated: Pakaianmu ada di lantai. Pakai?

entries.original:
"Marlon’s Uniform is now available
in the Costume Box!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon’s Uniform is now available in the Costume Box!
entries.translated:
Seragam Marlon sekarang tersedia di
Kotak Kostum!

entries.original: "Aros"
entries.translation_source: Aros
entries.translated: Aros

entries.original:
"\.and so Fey ordered the grunts
to join Aklove’s \qoLight of Ruin\qc.

You understand now, Marlon?

Frankly, the fact any grunts and
scientists were allowed to remain\lis a miracle\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]and so Fey ordered the grunts to join Aklove’s [quote-open-2]Light of Ruin[quote-close-3]. You understand now, Marlon? Frankly, the fact any grunts and scientists were allowed to remain is a miracle[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
\.maka Fey memerintahkan para
prajurit untuk bergabung dengan\l\qoLight of Ruin\qc milik Aklove. Kamu

mengerti sekarang, Marlon? Terus
terang, fakta bahwa ada prajurit\ldan ilmuwan yang diizinkan tetap

tinggal adalah sebuah keajaiban\.

entries.original:
"I see\.\CC0818 I had no idea things had
gotten this bad\.

But I think I know how to make up
the difference.

And I know this may not sound like
the most agreeable idea, but\."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1][control-code-2] I had no idea things had gotten this bad[game-token-3] But I think I know how to make up the difference. And I know this may not sound like the most agreeable idea, but[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Begitu rupanya\.\CC0818 Aku tidak tahu
keadaan sudah separah ini\. Tapi aku\lrasa aku tahu cara menebusnya. Dan

aku tahu ini mungkin bukan ide yang
paling menyenangkan, tapi\.

entries.original:
"What the\.

That’s my uniform!

[player]\.\CC0818 is that you?"
entries.translation_source: What the[game-token-1] That’s my uniform! [player-name-2][game-token-3][control-code-4] is that you?
entries.translated:
Apa apaan\. Itu seragamku! [player]\.\CC0818
apa itu kamu?

entries.original:
"What!?
You\.\CC0820 you’re\.

No! It cannot possibly be you!

You’re\.\CC0818 you must be some
sort of spy!

Aklove\.\CC0818 how long must you
torment me\.?"
entries.translation_source: What!? You[game-token-1][control-code-2] you’re[game-token-3] No! It cannot possibly be you! You’re[game-token-4][control-code-5] you must be some sort of spy! Aklove[game-token-6][control-code-7] how long must you torment me[game-token-8]?
entries.translated:
Apa!? Kamu\.\CC0820 kamu\. Tidak! Tidak
mungkin ini kamu! Kamu\.\CC0818 pasti kamu\lsemacam mata-mata! Aklove\.\CC0818 berapa

lama lagi kau akan menyiksaku\.?

entries.original:
"You thought you could fool me
again, faker? Like he did?

Even though I see that you wear
[player]’s face under the mask\.

You are still a far cry from the
real deal!

Once I’ve sent you running back to
Aklove, deliver a message to him\lfor me!

Tell him\.\CC0820 that you’ll all suffer for
your irredeemable sins!"
entries.translation_source: You thought you could fool me again, faker? Like he did? Even though I see that you wear [player-name-1]’s face under the mask[game-token-2] You are still a far cry from the real deal! Once I’ve sent you running back to Aklove, deliver a message to him for me! Tell him[game-token-3][control-code-4] that you’ll all suffer for your irredeemable sins!
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir kamu bisa membodohiku
lagi, penipu? Seperti yang dia\llakukan? Meskipun aku melihat kamu

memakai wajah [player] di bawah
topeng\. Kamu masih jauh dari yang\lasli! Setelah aku mengirimmu

kembali ke Aklove, sampaikan pesan
untukku! Katakan padanya\.\CC0820 bahwa\lkalian semua akan menderita karena

dosa-dosa kalian yang tak
terampuni!

entries.original:
"This battle style\.\CC0818 this aura\.\CC0818
it cannot be\.\CC0818 are you really\l[player]\.!?

No, this can’t be true!"
entries.translation_source: This battle style[game-token-1][control-code-2] this aura[game-token-3][control-code-4] it cannot be[game-token-5][control-code-6] are you really [player-name-7][game-token-8]!? No, this can’t be true!
entries.translated:
Gaya bertarung ini\.\CC0818 aura ini\.\CC0818 tidak
mungkin\.\CC0818 apa kamu benar-benar\l[player]\.!? Tidak, ini tidak mungkin

benar!

entries.original:
"Zeph!
Enough!

We don’t have time for infighting
right now!

[player] isn’t the enemy - the
Light of Ruin is!

And you can either accept that fact,
or else I’ll be assuming command\lof what remains of the Shadows."
entries.translation_source: Zeph! Enough! We don’t have time for infighting right now! [player-name-1] isn’t the enemy - the Light of Ruin is! And you can either accept that fact, or else I’ll be assuming command of what remains of the Shadows.
entries.translated:
Zeph! Cukup! Kita tidak punya waktu
untuk bertengkar sekarang! [player]\lbukan musuh - Light of Ruin-lah

musuhnya! Dan kamu bisa menerima
fakta itu, atau aku akan mengambil\lalih komando sisa-sisa Shadows.

entries.original:
"Thank you.
Now then\.

What have you been planning, Zeph?

From what I gathered, we’ll be
staging an attack on the Light of\lRuin’s new base?"
entries.translation_source: Thank you. Now then[game-token-1] What have you been planning, Zeph? From what I gathered, we’ll be staging an attack on the Light of Ruin’s new base?
entries.translated:
Terima kasih. Sekarang\. Apa yang
sudah kamu rencanakan, Zeph? Dari\lyang aku kumpulkan, kita akan

melancarkan serangan ke markas baru
Light of Ruin?

entries.original:
"That’s right\.

I’m having our remaining scientists
locate their base.

Once they’ve managed to find it,
we’ll take the Light of Ruin by\lsurprise and destroy it.

With their main force left reeling,
we’ll steal back the Prison Bottle\land what remaining Shadow Warriors\lthey have left.

However, I’m still unsure as to how
long it will take to locate them\.

And unfortunately, we’re pressed for
time.

Right now, Aklove is with Fey as
she studies Hoopa.

When she finishes, Aklove intends to
turn its power on Borrius\.

If we can take out his base while
he’s gone, we can catch him off\lguard when he returns, and seal\lHoopa’s power away once again.

Without it, Aklove’s power will be
greatly diminished."
entries.translation_source: That’s right[game-token-1] I’m having our remaining scientists locate their base. Once they’ve managed to find it, we’ll take the Light of Ruin by surprise and destroy it. With their main force left reeling, we’ll steal back the Prison Bottle and what remaining Shadow Warriors they have left. However, I’m still unsure as to how long it will take to locate them[game-token-2] And unfortunately, we’re pressed for time. Right now, Aklove is with Fey as she studies Hoopa. When she finishes, Aklove intends to turn its power on Borrius[game-token-3] If we can take out his base while he’s gone, we can catch him off guard when he returns, and seal Hoopa’s power away once again. Without it, Aklove’s power will be greatly diminished.
entries.translated:
Benar\. Aku menyuruh ilmuwan kita
yang tersisa untuk mencari markas\lmereka. Setelah mereka berhasil

menemukannya, kita akan mengejutkan
Light of Ruin dan menghancurkannya.\lDengan kekuatan utama mereka yang

terpuruk, kita akan mencuri kembali
Prison Bottle dan sisa Shadow\lWarriors yang mereka miliki. Namun,

aku masih belum yakin berapa lama
waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk\lmenemukan mereka\. Dan sayangnya,

kita kekurangan waktu. Saat ini,
Aklove bersama Fey saat dia\lmempelajari Hoopa. Ketika dia

selesai, Aklove berniat untuk
mengarahkan kekuatannya ke Borrius\.\lJika kita bisa menghancurkan

markasnya saat dia pergi, kita bisa
mengejutkannya saat dia kembali,\ldan menyegel kekuatan Hoopa sekali

lagi. Tanpa itu, kekuatan Aklove
akan sangat berkurang.

entries.original:
"Roger that, Zeph.

And I take it you’re certain Fey
won’t retaliate against us if we\ltake action?"
entries.translation_source: Roger that, Zeph. And I take it you’re certain Fey won’t retaliate against us if we take action?
entries.translated:
Dimengerti, Zeph. Dan aku rasa kamu
yakin Fey tidak akan membalas\ldendam pada kita jika kita

bertindak?

entries.original:
"I’m certain, Marlon.

From talking with some of our
scientists, Fey could not care\lless about Aklove’s goals.

All she wants is to study that
Pokémon’s power.

She’ll give him her support, of
course, but for the most part,\lit is up to Aklove as to whether\lor not he succeeds.

Of course, we shouldn’t make light of
how dangerous he is alone\."
entries.translation_source: I’m certain, Marlon. From talking with some of our scientists, Fey could not care less about Aklove’s goals. All she wants is to study that Pokémon’s power. She’ll give him her support, of course, but for the most part, it is up to Aklove as to whether or not he succeeds. Of course, we shouldn’t make light of how dangerous he is alone[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku yakin, Marlon. Dari berbicara
dengan beberapa ilmuwan kita, Fey\ltidak peduli sama sekali dengan

tujuan Aklove. Yang dia inginkan
hanyalah mempelajari kekuatan\lPokémon itu. Dia pasti akan

memberinya dukungan, tapi sebagian
besar, terserah Aklove apakah dia\lberhasil atau tidak. Tentu saja,

kita tidak boleh meremehkan betapa
berbahayanya dia sendirian\.

entries.original:
"Then it seems to me that in order
for our plan to go off without a\lhitch, we’ll need all the manpower\lwe can muster.

So, I suggest we bring [player]
along, as well."
entries.translation_source: Then it seems to me that in order for our plan to go off without a hitch, we’ll need all the manpower we can muster. So, I suggest we bring [player-name-1] along, as well.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, menurutku agar
rencana kita berjalan lancar, kita\lakan membutuhkan semua tenaga yang

bisa kita kumpulkan. Jadi, aku
sarankan kita membawa [player]\ljuga.

entries.original:
"Marlon, I don’t understand\.

Why would you put so much faith
in [buffer1]?

[player] has only tried to interfere
with us before.

What makes you think [buffer2] would even
be willing to help us?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, I don’t understand[game-token-1] Why would you put so much faith in [buffer1-2]? [player-name-3] has only tried to interfere with us before. What makes you think [buffer2-4] would even be willing to help us?
entries.translated:
Marlon, aku tidak mengerti\. Kenapa
kamu menaruh kepercayaan sebanyak\litu pada [buffer1]? [player] hanya

pernah mencoba mengganggu kita
sebelumnya. Apa yang membuatmu\lberpikir [buffer2] akan bersedia

membantu kita?

entries.original:
"We were imprisoned together in the
Cube Space, Zeph.

And while we were there, we made a
promise to someone.

We promised we would destroy the
remaining Shadow Warriors and set\ltheir souls free.

And [player] knows that as long as
the Light of Ruin is holding onto\lthe Shadow Warriors, their souls\lwill remain trapped."
entries.translation_source: We were imprisoned together in the Cube Space, Zeph. And while we were there, we made a promise to someone. We promised we would destroy the remaining Shadow Warriors and set their souls free. And [player-name-1] knows that as long as the Light of Ruin is holding onto the Shadow Warriors, their souls will remain trapped.
entries.translated:
Kami dipenjara bersama di Cube
Space, Zeph. Dan saat itu, kami\lberjanji pada seseorang. Kami

berjanji akan menghancurkan sisa
Shadow Warriors dan membebaskan\ljiwa mereka. Dan [player] tahu

bahwa selama Light of Ruin memegang
Shadow Warriors, jiwa mereka akan\ltetap terperangkap.

entries.original:
"Are you saying that not only did
both of you survive a trip inside\lthe Cube, but someone else was\lthere, too?

Someone who knew about the existence
of the Shadow Warriors?"
entries.translation_source: Are you saying that not only did both of you survive a trip inside the Cube, but someone else was there, too? Someone who knew about the existence of the Shadow Warriors?
entries.translated:
Maksudmu, bukan hanya kalian berdua
selamat dari perjalanan di dalam\lCube, tapi ada orang lain juga di

sana? Seseorang yang tahu tentang
keberadaan Shadow Warriors?

entries.original:
"It was Aros, Zeph.

Fey imprisoned him in there sixteen
years ago.

And not only that, it turns out Aros
is [player]’s father, too."
entries.translation_source: It was Aros, Zeph. Fey imprisoned him in there sixteen years ago. And not only that, it turns out Aros is [player-name-1]’s father, too.
entries.translated:
Itu adalah Aros, Zeph. Fey
memenjarakannya di sana enam belas\ltahun lalu. Dan bukan hanya itu,

ternyata Aros juga adalah ayah
[player].

entries.original:
"Aros!? I see\.\CC0818 so that’s what became
of him\.

Well, I’m not surprised then.

He was always quick to identify bugs
in any system.

If anyone could figure out a way
out, no matter how flawed, it\lwould surely be him\."
entries.translation_source: Aros!? I see[game-token-1][control-code-2] so that’s what became of him[game-token-3] Well, I’m not surprised then. He was always quick to identify bugs in any system. If anyone could figure out a way out, no matter how flawed, it would surely be him[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Aros!? Begitu rupanya\.\CC0818 jadi itulah
yang terjadi padanya\. Yah, aku tidak\lterkejut. Dia selalu cepat

menemukan celah dalam sistem apa
pun. Jika ada yang bisa menemukan\ljalan keluar, betapapun cacatnya,

pasti dialah orangnya\.

entries.original:
"So, [player]\. would you be willing
to lend us your aid?

We intend to gather what resources
we can, and go for the Light of\lRuin directly.

\.

Yes, I’m aware - you and the
Shadows\.\CC0818 we haven’t always seen\leye-to-eye, have we?

Then, if I trusted you with our
most important secrets, would that\lbe enough?

In that case, let me explain what
our true purpose was\.

The true purpose of the Shadows\."
entries.translation_source: So, [player-name-1][game-token-2] would you be willing to lend us your aid? We intend to gather what resources we can, and go for the Light of Ruin directly. [game-token-3] Yes, I’m aware - you and the Shadows[game-token-4][control-code-5] we haven’t always seen eye-to-eye, have we? Then, if I trusted you with our most important secrets, would that be enough? In that case, let me explain what our true purpose was[game-token-6] The true purpose of the Shadows[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Jadi, [player]\. apakah kamu bersedia
membantu kami? Kami berniat\lmengumpulkan sumber daya yang ada,

dan langsung menyerang Light of
Ruin. \. Ya, aku sadar - kamu dan\lShadows\.\CC0818 kita tidak selalu

sepandangan, kan? Kalau begitu,
jika aku mempercayakanmu dengan\lrahasia terpenting kami, apakah itu

cukup? Dalam hal ini, biarkan aku
menjelaskan apa tujuan sebenarnya\lkami\. Tujuan sebenarnya dari Shadows\.

entries.original:
"It all began, seventeen years ago\.

Zeph’s son had just passed away.

As his old friends, we came to visit
him from our home region of Hoenn\."
entries.translation_source: It all began, seventeen years ago[game-token-1] Zeph’s son had just passed away. As his old friends, we came to visit him from our home region of Hoenn[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Semuanya dimulai, tujuh belas tahun
yang lalu\. Putra Zeph baru saja\lmeninggal. Sebagai teman lamanya,

kami datang mengunjunginya dari
daerah asal kami, Hoenn\.

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph\.\CC0818 how are you holding up?

I’m so sorry\.\CC0818 Marlon and I just
heard\.\CC0820 about your son\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Zeph[game-token-2][control-code-3] how are you holding up? I’m so sorry[game-token-4][control-code-5] Marlon and I just heard[game-token-6][control-code-7] about your son[game-token-8]
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph\.\CC0818 bagaimana kabarmu? Aku turut
berduka\.\CC0818 Marlon dan aku baru\lmendengar\.\CC0820 tentang putramu\.

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0818 Marlon\.\CC0818 thank you for
your condolences.

It’s good to see you again after all
these years\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory[game-token-1][control-code-2] Marlon[game-token-3][control-code-4] thank you for your condolences. It’s good to see you again after all these years[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0818 Marlon\.\CC0818 terima kasih atas
belasungkawanya. Senang bertemu\lkalian lagi setelah sekian lama\.

entries.original:
"I take it you travelled by boat to
get here?

How was the journey?"
entries.translation_source: I take it you travelled by boat to get here? How was the journey?
entries.translated:
Saya kira kalian naik kapal untuk
sampai ke sini? Bagaimana\lperjalanannya?

entries.original:
"[red]Very pleasant.

It took a few days to arrive here,
but the journey was lovely."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Very pleasant. It took a few days to arrive here, but the journey was lovely.
entries.translated:
[red]Sangat menyenangkan. Butuh beberapa
hari untuk sampai di sini, tapi\lperjalanannya indah.

entries.original:
"If I remember correctly, you
have a son, too\. right?"
entries.translation_source: If I remember correctly, you have a son, too[game-token-1] right?
entries.translated:
Kalau tidak salah ingat, Anda juga
punya seorang putra\. kan?

entries.original:
"We did\.

Unfortunately, he\.\CC0820 he succumbed to
illness much too young."
entries.translation_source: We did[game-token-1] Unfortunately, he[game-token-2][control-code-3] he succumbed to illness much too young.
entries.translated:
Ya\. Sayangnya, dia\.\CC0820 dia meninggal
karena penyakit di usia yang\lterlalu muda.

entries.original:
"You are knowledgable scientists\.\CC0818
have you ever thought about trying\lto bring him back?"
entries.translation_source: You are knowledgable scientists[game-token-1][control-code-2] have you ever thought about trying to bring him back?
entries.translated:
Kalian adalah ilmuwan yang
berpengetahuan\.\CC0818 pernahkah kalian\lberpikir untuk mencoba

menghidupkannya kembali?

entries.original:
"Of course\.

As scientists, we thought that if
anyone could find a way, it would\lbe us.

Sadly, there are no known methods
to truly revive the dead.

We had no choice but to try and
move on.

Then, a year ago, Ivory gave birth
to twins\.

It was one of the happiest moments
of our lives.

Of course we miss our first child,
but our new ones have done much\lto fill the voids in our hearts\."
entries.translation_source: Of course[game-token-1] As scientists, we thought that if anyone could find a way, it would be us. Sadly, there are no known methods to truly revive the dead. We had no choice but to try and move on. Then, a year ago, Ivory gave birth to twins[game-token-2] It was one of the happiest moments of our lives. Of course we miss our first child, but our new ones have done much to fill the voids in our hearts[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tentu saja\. Sebagai ilmuwan, kami
pikir jika ada yang bisa menemukan\lcara, itu adalah kami. Sayangnya,

tidak ada metode yang diketahui
untuk benar-benar menghidupkan\lorang mati. Kami tidak punya

pilihan selain mencoba melanjutkan
hidup. Kemudian, setahun yang lalu,\lIvory melahirkan anak kembar\. Itu

adalah salah satu momen paling
bahagia dalam hidup kami. Tentu\lsaja kami merindukan anak pertama

kami, tetapi anak-anak baru kami
telah banyak mengisi kekosongan di\lhati kami\.

entries.original:
"Is that so\.

Where are they now, if I may ask?"
entries.translation_source: Is that so[game-token-1] Where are they now, if I may ask?
entries.translated:
Benarkah\. Di mana mereka sekarang,
kalau boleh saya tanya?

entries.original:
"[red]Euler Log, a friend of ours, agreed
to babysit for the time being.

They’re with him now, back in
Frozen Heights."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Euler Log, a friend of ours, agreed to babysit for the time being. They’re with him now, back in Frozen Heights.
entries.translated:
[red]Euler Log, teman kami, setuju untuk
menjaga anak-anak untuk sementara.\lMereka bersamanya sekarang, kembali

di Frozen Heights.

entries.original:
"Frozen Heights\.\CC0820 a friend of mine
lives there as well.

He’s my old partner\.\CC0818 the one who
helped me found my own company\.

But around here, he’s simply known
as the \qoGuardian of Borrius\qc.

He’s even managed to befriend a
so-called \qomythical\qc Pokémon!

I think his wife recently gave
birth to their own child, actually\.

However, I don’t quite remember the
child’s name\."
entries.translation_source: Frozen Heights[game-token-1][control-code-2] a friend of mine lives there as well. He’s my old partner[game-token-3][control-code-4] the one who helped me found my own company[game-token-5] But around here, he’s simply known as the [quote-open-6]Guardian of Borrius[quote-close-7]. He’s even managed to befriend a so-called [quote-open-8]mythical[quote-close-9] Pokémon! I think his wife recently gave birth to their own child, actually[game-token-10] However, I don’t quite remember the child’s name[game-token-11]
entries.translated:
Frozen Heights\.\CC0820 seorang temanku
tinggal di sana juga. Dia adalah\lmitra lamaku\.\CC0818 yang membantuku

mendirikan perusahaanku sendiri\.
Tapi di sini, dia hanya dikenal\lsebagai \qoGuardian of Borrius\qc. Dia

bahkan berhasil berteman dengan apa
yang disebut \qomitos\qc Pokémon!\lKurasa istrinya baru saja

melahirkan anak mereka sendiri,
sebenarnya\. Namun, aku tidak begitu\lingat nama anak itu\.

entries.original:
"What about your new twins?
What are their names?"
entries.translation_source: What about your new twins? What are their names?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana dengan anak kembar
barumu? Siapa nama mereka?

entries.original:
"[red]Their names are [rival]
and Melony.

They’re the most beautiful children
in the world."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Their names are [text-token-rival-2] and Melony. They’re the most beautiful children in the world.
entries.translated:
[red]Nama mereka adalah [rival] dan
Melony. Mereka adalah anak-anak\ltercantik di dunia.

entries.original:
"Yes, that’s right\.\CC0818 Ivory and I are
[rival] and Melony’s parents.

[rival]\.\CC0818 ever since he arrived,
he’s been looking for us, hasn’t he?

I always regretted leaving them
both, but after spending so much\ltime away, I had really hoped they\lcould meet their old brother\.

Ah\.\CC0820 how stupid I was\."
entries.translation_source: Yes, that’s right[game-token-1][control-code-2] Ivory and I are [text-token-rival-3] and Melony’s parents. [text-token-rival-4][game-token-5][control-code-6] ever since he arrived, he’s been looking for us, hasn’t he? I always regretted leaving them both, but after spending so much time away, I had really hoped they could meet their old brother[game-token-7] Ah[game-token-8][control-code-9] how stupid I was[game-token-10]
entries.translated:
Ya, benar\.\CC0818 Ivory dan aku adalah
orang tua [rival] dan Melony.\l[rival]\.\CC0818 sejak dia tiba, dia telah

mencari kita, bukan? Aku selalu
menyesal meninggalkan mereka\lberdua, tetapi setelah begitu lama

pergi, aku sangat berharap mereka
bisa bertemu kakak laki-laki mereka\.\lAh\.\CC0820 betapa bodohnya aku\.

entries.original:
"Perhaps I should take it from
here\.

When I learned that we had both
experienced the pain of losing our\lown children, I made an offer.

Our combined scientific knowledge\.\CC0818
united together under one common\lgoal\.

I felt with that resolve, we could
achieve the impossible."
entries.translation_source: Perhaps I should take it from here[game-token-1] When I learned that we had both experienced the pain of losing our own children, I made an offer. Our combined scientific knowledge[game-token-2][control-code-3] united together under one common goal[game-token-4] I felt with that resolve, we could achieve the impossible.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku yang melanjutkannya
dari sini\. Ketika aku tahu bahwa\lkami berdua telah merasakan

sakitnya kehilangan anak sendiri,
aku membuat tawaran. Pengetahuan\lilmiah gabungan kami\.\CC0818 disatukan di

bawah satu tujuan bersama\. Aku
merasa dengan tekad itu, kami bisa\lmencapai hal yang mustahil.

entries.original:
"Of course, Marlon and Ivory were
most skeptical, but after many\lattempts, I convinced them."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Marlon and Ivory were most skeptical, but after many attempts, I convinced them.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Marlon dan Ivory sangat
skeptis, tetapi setelah banyak\lusaha, aku meyakinkan mereka.

entries.original:
"They agreed to return their children
to their home in Hoenn and then\lmove to Borrius without them.

With no distractions, I was certain
we would succeed."
entries.translation_source: They agreed to return their children to their home in Hoenn and then move to Borrius without them. With no distractions, I was certain we would succeed.
entries.translated:
Mereka setuju untuk mengembalikan
anak-anak mereka ke rumah mereka di\lHoenn dan kemudian pindah ke

Borrius tanpa mereka. Tanpa
gangguan, aku yakin kami akan\lberhasil.

entries.original:
"However, as we soon discovered, the
three of us could only do so much\lon our own.

And so, we partnered with an
independent organization, known as\l\qoThe Science Society\qc."
entries.translation_source: However, as we soon discovered, the three of us could only do so much on our own. And so, we partnered with an independent organization, known as [quote-open-1]The Science Society[quote-close-2].
entries.translated:
Namun, seperti yang segera kami
temukan, kami bertiga hanya bisa\lmelakukan banyak hal sendiri. Maka,

kami bermitra dengan organisasi
independen, yang dikenal sebagai\l\qoThe Science Society\qc.

entries.original:
"Together with their help, our
research suddenly gained speed.

However, this research required my
undivided attention.

And so, realizing that I simply could
not oversee so many projects at\lonce, I stepped down from my\lposition as CEO of Cube Corp."
entries.translation_source: Together with their help, our research suddenly gained speed. However, this research required my undivided attention. And so, realizing that I simply could not oversee so many projects at once, I stepped down from my position as CEO of Cube Corp.
entries.translated:
Dengan bantuan mereka, penelitian
kami tiba-tiba mendapatkan\lkecepatan. Namun, penelitian ini

membutuhkan perhatian penuhku.
Maka, menyadari bahwa aku tidak\lbisa mengawasi begitu banyak proyek

sekaligus, aku mundur dari posisiku
sebagai CEO Cube Corp.

entries.original:
"In my place, I left it to a young
woman\.\CC0818 Fey, the leader of the\lScience Society."
entries.translation_source: In my place, I left it to a young woman[game-token-1][control-code-2] Fey, the leader of the Science Society.
entries.translated:
Di tempatku, aku menyerahkannya
kepada seorang wanita muda\.\CC0818 Fey,\lpemimpin Science Society.

entries.original:
"Yes\.\CC0818 Zeph is the inventor of the
Super Cube.

The first Cube, meant for simple
storage, was a collaborative effort\lbetween him, your father and Fey.

It’s what allowed Cube Corp. to
take off, and become the major\linfluence in Borrius it is today."
entries.translation_source: Yes[game-token-1][control-code-2] Zeph is the inventor of the Super Cube. The first Cube, meant for simple storage, was a collaborative effort between him, your father and Fey. It’s what allowed Cube Corp. to take off, and become the major influence in Borrius it is today.
entries.translated:
Ya\.\CC0818 Zeph adalah penemu Super Cube.
Cube pertama, yang dimaksudkan\luntuk penyimpanan sederhana, adalah

hasil kerja sama antara dia,
ayahmu, dan Fey. Hal itulah yang\lmemungkinkan Cube Corp. lepas

landas, dan menjadi pengaruh besar
di Borrius seperti sekarang ini.

entries.original:
"And this is how she repays me,
after all this\.!

She practically stole Cube Corp.,
the company I founded with my\lown two hands\.

And she allows Aklove to steal my
Shadows from me, too\.!"
entries.translation_source: And this is how she repays me, after all this[game-token-1]! She practically stole Cube Corp., the company I founded with my own two hands[game-token-2] And she allows Aklove to steal my Shadows from me, too[game-token-3]!
entries.translated:
Dan beginilah caranya dia membalas
dendamku, setelah semua ini\.! Dia\lsecara praktis mencuri Cube Corp.,

perusahaan yang kudirikan dengan
tanganku sendiri\. Dan dia\lmengizinkan Aklove mencuri

Shadows-ku dariku juga\.!

entries.original:
"Phoo\.

I shouldn’t dwell on that now.

Anyway\.\CC0820 Fey was the one who gave
us the template for the project,\las you have likely guessed."
entries.translation_source: Phoo[game-token-1] I shouldn’t dwell on that now. Anyway[game-token-2][control-code-3] Fey was the one who gave us the template for the project, as you have likely guessed.
entries.translated:
Fuh\. Aku seharusnya tidak memikirkan
itu sekarang. Bagaimanapun\.\CC0820 Fey\ladalah orang yang memberi kami

template untuk proyek ini, seperti
yang mungkin sudah kau duga.

entries.original:
"Thus, before I stepped down as CEO,
I established a new branch at Cube\lCorp. entirely dedicated to the\lrevival efforts.

I called it the Shadow branch.
Or as you know it, the \qoShadows\qc.

To avoid tarnishing Cube Corp’s
reputation, I had to ensure our\lexperiments had no ties to the\lcompany whatsoever.

And with that out of the way, we
were able to experiment worry-free."
entries.translation_source: Thus, before I stepped down as CEO, I established a new branch at Cube Corp. entirely dedicated to the revival efforts. I called it the Shadow branch. Or as you know it, the [quote-open-1]Shadows[quote-close-2]. To avoid tarnishing Cube Corp’s reputation, I had to ensure our experiments had no ties to the company whatsoever. And with that out of the way, we were able to experiment worry-free.
entries.translated:
Oleh karena itu, sebelum aku turun
sebagai CEO, aku mendirikan cabang\lbaru di Cube Corp. yang seluruhnya

didedikasikan untuk upaya
kebangkitan. Aku menamakannya\lcabang Shadow. Atau seperti yang

kau ketahui, \qoShadows\qc. Untuk
menghindari mencoreng reputasi Cube\lCorp., aku harus memastikan

eksperimen kami tidak memiliki
hubungan dengan perusahaan sama\lsekali. Dan dengan hal itu

terselesaikan, kami dapat
bereksperimen tanpa khawatir.

entries.original: "Ivory, status report. "
entries.translation_source: Ivory, status report.
entries.translated: Ivory, laporan status.

entries.original:
"[red]We’re ready to begin the first trial,
Zeph.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]We’re ready to begin the first trial, Zeph.[color-blue-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Kami siap memulai percobaan
pertama, Zeph.[blue]

entries.original:
"Then let’s begin, shall we?

Everyone, take your positions."
entries.translation_source: Then let’s begin, shall we? Everyone, take your positions.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu mari kita mulai, ya?
Semuanya, ambil posisi kalian.

entries.original:
"Zeph, are you certain that this
will work?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph, are you certain that this will work?
entries.translated:
Zeph, apakah kau yakin ini akan
berhasil?

entries.original:
"Of course nothing is certain,
Marlon.

It is merely the first of many
prototypes.

I don’t expect perfect results on
the first try.

However, we can worry about the
finer points later.

For now\.\CC0818 let’s find out if this is
merely a hypothesis, or not."
entries.translation_source: Of course nothing is certain, Marlon. It is merely the first of many prototypes. I don’t expect perfect results on the first try. However, we can worry about the finer points later. For now[game-token-1][control-code-2] let’s find out if this is merely a hypothesis, or not.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja tidak ada yang pasti,
Marlon. Ini hanyalah yang pertama\ldari banyak prototipe. Aku tidak

mengharapkan hasil sempurna pada
percobaan pertama. Namun, kita bisa\lmengkhawatirkan detail yang lebih

spesifik nanti. Untuk saat ini\.\CC0818 mari
kita cari tahu apakah ini hanya\lhipotesis, atau bukan.

entries.original:
"To start with, I just place this
Pokémon here\."
entries.translation_source: To start with, I just place this Pokémon here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Untuk memulai, aku hanya
menempatkan Pokémon ini di sini\.

entries.original:
"Then, place the sample remains
next to it\."
entries.translation_source: Then, place the sample remains next to it[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kemudian, tempatkan sisa sampel di
sebelahnya\.

entries.original:
"And finally, turn on the molecular
fusion device!"
entries.translation_source: And finally, turn on the molecular fusion device!
entries.translated:
Dan akhirnya, aktifkan alat fusi
molekuler!

entries.original:
"Now, once this cloak is on to shield
it from the light, it should become\lmobile\."
entries.translation_source: Now, once this cloak is on to shield it from the light, it should become mobile[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sekarang, setelah jubah ini
terpasang untuk melindunginya dari\lcahaya, ia seharusnya menjadi dapat

bergerak\.

entries.original:
"It\.\CC0820 worked!

Now, let’s see if it can actually
move its body\."
entries.translation_source: It[game-token-1][control-code-2] worked! Now, let’s see if it can actually move its body[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Itu\.\CC0820 berhasil! Sekarang, mari kita
lihat apakah ia benar-benar bisa\lmenggerakkan tubuhnya\.

entries.original: "Whoa!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa!
entries.translated: Whoa!

entries.original:
"Quick, Marlon!

Hand me that control gauntlet!"
entries.translation_source: Quick, Marlon! Hand me that control gauntlet!
entries.translated:
Cepat, Marlon! Berikan aku sarung
tangan kendali itu!

entries.original:
"Stay, creature!

You must obey!"
entries.translation_source: Stay, creature! You must obey!
entries.translated: Diam, makhluk! Kau harus patuh!

entries.original: "Hmm\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Hmm\.

entries.original:
"I’ll admit this is not what I was
originally hoping for.

However, this certainly is a step in
the right direction.

Given time, we should\.\CC0820 we should be
able to bring them back\."
entries.translation_source: I’ll admit this is not what I was originally hoping for. However, this certainly is a step in the right direction. Given time, we should[game-token-1][control-code-2] we should be able to bring them back[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Aku akui ini bukan yang awalnya
kuharapkan. Namun, ini tentu adalah\llangkah ke arah yang benar. Dengan

waktu, kita seharusnya\.\CC0820 kita
seharusnya bisa membawa mereka\lkembali\.

entries.original:
"All things considered, though, the
first test went rather smoothly."
entries.translation_source: All things considered, though, the first test went rather smoothly.
entries.translated:
Meskipun demikian, ujian pertama
berjalan cukup lancar.

entries.original:
"Fey said we had to continue the
research, not to let this setback\ltrip us up.

Her words\.\CC0818 spurred on by her,
we continued to work on the\lShadow Warriors.

However, even with the control
gauntlet, some proved difficult\lto control.

One lashed out at my face, leaving
this scar you see today.

Another lashed out at Marlon,
severing his arm.

And yet, despite our injuries, we
pressed on\."
entries.translation_source: Fey said we had to continue the research, not to let this setback trip us up. Her words[game-token-1][control-code-2] spurred on by her, we continued to work on the Shadow Warriors. However, even with the control gauntlet, some proved difficult to control. One lashed out at my face, leaving this scar you see today. Another lashed out at Marlon, severing his arm. And yet, despite our injuries, we pressed on[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Fey berkata kami harus melanjutkan
penelitian, jangan sampai\lkemunduran ini menghalangi kami.

Kata-katanya\.\CC0818 didorong olehnya, kami
terus bekerja pada Shadow Warriors.\lNamun, bahkan dengan sarung tangan

kendali, beberapa terbukti sulit
dikendalikan. Satu menyerang\lwajahku, meninggalkan bekas luka

yang kau lihat sekarang. Lain
menyerang Marlon, memotong\llengannya. Namun, meskipun cedera

kami, kami terus maju\.

entries.original:
"Over the course of several years,
the Science Society helped us\lcapture more Pokémon, and combine\lthem with more test subjects.

Some were living - as per Fey’s
request - and others were not."
entries.translation_source: Over the course of several years, the Science Society helped us capture more Pokémon, and combine them with more test subjects. Some were living - as per Fey’s request - and others were not.
entries.translated:
Selama beberapa tahun, Science
Society membantu kami menangkap\llebih banyak Pokémon, dan

menggabungkannya dengan lebih
banyak subjek uji. Ada yang hidup -\lsesuai permintaan Fey - dan ada

yang tidak.

entries.original:
"That is not to say we turned anyone
against their will, of course.

All grunts that became Shadow
Warriors did so willingly for the\lchance to gain great power\.

But Fey\.\CC0818 she was like a demoness,
driving us to crueller and crueller\lextremes, in order to revive our\lchildren.

Of course, I suspect she had
absolutely no interest in them\lat all.

It was always the Shadow Warriors
she was invested in."
entries.translation_source: That is not to say we turned anyone against their will, of course. All grunts that became Shadow Warriors did so willingly for the chance to gain great power[game-token-1] But Fey[game-token-2][control-code-3] she was like a demoness, driving us to crueller and crueller extremes, in order to revive our children. Of course, I suspect she had absolutely no interest in them at all. It was always the Shadow Warriors she was invested in.
entries.translated:
Bukannya kami memaksa siapa pun
melawan kehendak mereka, tentu\lsaja. Semua grunt yang menjadi

Shadow Warriors melakukannya dengan
sukarela demi kesempatan\lmendapatkan kekuatan besar\. Tapi Fey\.\CC0818

dia seperti iblis wanita, mendorong
kami ke ekstrem yang semakin kejam,\luntuk menghidupkan kembali

anak-anak kami. Tentu saja, saya
curiga dia sama sekali tidak\ltertarik pada mereka. Selalu Shadow

Warriors yang dia investasikan.

entries.original:
"Eventually, we concluded we would
not be able to bring back our\lchildren using the Shadow Warriors.

Despite coming close with our last
trial, the cost to our children\lwould have been too great had\lwe continued in that same direction.

And so, we were forced to try a
new approach.

One that was extreme, yet plausible,
if recent events are anything to\lgo by\."
entries.translation_source: Eventually, we concluded we would not be able to bring back our children using the Shadow Warriors. Despite coming close with our last trial, the cost to our children would have been too great had we continued in that same direction. And so, we were forced to try a new approach. One that was extreme, yet plausible, if recent events are anything to go by[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, kami menyimpulkan bahwa
kami tidak akan bisa membawa\lkembali anak-anak kami menggunakan

Shadow Warriors. Meskipun hampir
berhasil dengan uji coba terakhir,\lbiaya bagi anak-anak kami akan

terlalu besar jika kami melanjutkan
ke arah yang sama. Jadi, kami\lterpaksa mencoba pendekatan baru.

Pendekatan yang ekstrem, namun
masuk akal, jika peristiwa\lbaru-baru ini bisa dijadikan acuan\.

entries.original:
"The plan was to bring the Ultimate
Weapon - the one mentioned in the\lold legends - here to Borrius.

But while that weapon may be
capable of mass destruction, it\lwas also the same device used to\lrestore the foreign king’s Pokémon.

And if the weapon could bring a
Pokémon back to life\.

\.it stands to reason it could
bring our children back as well\.

But how much of it was our idea\.?

And how much of it was Aklove’s
machinations\.?"
entries.translation_source: The plan was to bring the Ultimate Weapon - the one mentioned in the old legends - here to Borrius. But while that weapon may be capable of mass destruction, it was also the same device used to restore the foreign king’s Pokémon. And if the weapon could bring a Pokémon back to life[game-token-1] [game-token-2]it stands to reason it could bring our children back as well[game-token-3] But how much of it was our idea[game-token-4]? And how much of it was Aklove’s machinations[game-token-5]?
entries.translated:
Rencananya adalah membawa Senjata
Tertinggi - yang disebutkan dalam\llegenda kuno - ke sini ke Borrius.

Namun meskipun senjata itu mungkin
mampu menghancurkan massal, itu\ljuga perangkat yang sama yang

digunakan untuk memulihkan Pokémon
raja asing. Dan jika senjata itu\lbisa menghidupkan kembali seekor

Pokémon\. \.masuk akal jika bisa juga
membawa anak-anak kami kembali\. Tapi\lseberapa besar itu adalah ide kami\.?

Dan seberapa besar itu adalah
intrik Aklove\.?

entries.original:
"Yes\.\CC0818 under Zeph’s instructions, we
began researching the dark force\lof Borrius.

At the time, we hoped to use its
power to bring us the Ultimate\lWeapon.

Of course, we had no idea the dark
force was, in fact, Aros’s old\lpartner, Hoopa.

And from there\.\CC0818 you know the rest.

\. \. \. \.

Phew\.\CC0820 well, that was an explanation
and a half.

Take it all in, [player].

\.

Okay, now that you know what’s
really been going on, you should\lhave no hesitation about working\lwith us."
entries.translation_source: Yes[game-token-1][control-code-2] under Zeph’s instructions, we began researching the dark force of Borrius. At the time, we hoped to use its power to bring us the Ultimate Weapon. Of course, we had no idea the dark force was, in fact, Aros’s old partner, Hoopa. And from there[game-token-3][control-code-4] you know the rest. [game-token-5] [game-token-6] [game-token-7] [game-token-8] Phew[game-token-9][control-code-10] well, that was an explanation and a half. Take it all in, [player-name-11]. [game-token-12] Okay, now that you know what’s really been going on, you should have no hesitation about working with us.
entries.translated:
Ya\.\CC0818 di bawah instruksi Zeph, kami
mulai meneliti kekuatan gelap\lBorrius. Saat itu, kami berharap

menggunakan kekuatannya untuk
membawa Senjata Tertinggi kepada\lkami. Tentu saja, kami tidak tahu

bahwa kekuatan gelap itu sebenarnya
adalah mitra lama Aros, Hoopa. Dan\ldari sana\.\CC0818 kau tahu sisanya. \. \. \. \.

Fiuh\.\CC0820 nah, itu penjelasan yang
panjang. Hadapi semuanya, [player].\l\. Oke, sekarang setelah kau tahu apa

yang sebenarnya terjadi, kau
seharusnya tidak ragu untuk bekerja\lsama dengan kami.

entries.original:
"I should apologize, [player]\.

I believed you to be some sort of
spy, sent by Aklove.

If I’d known you were the real deal
all along, I would have reacted\lless\.\CC0818 violently."
entries.translation_source: I should apologize, [player-name-1][game-token-2] I believed you to be some sort of spy, sent by Aklove. If I’d known you were the real deal all along, I would have reacted less[game-token-3][control-code-4] violently.
entries.translated:
Aku harus meminta maaf, [player]\.
Aku mengira kau semacam mata-mata,\lyang dikirim oleh Aklove. Jika aku

tahu kau adalah yang asli sejak
awal, aku akan bereaksi kurang\.\CC0818\lkeras.

entries.original:
"Sir!

We’ve detected remnants of Hoopa’s
portal energy in Vivill Town!

It’s quite likely the Light of Ruin’s
base!"
entries.translation_source: Sir! We’ve detected remnants of Hoopa’s portal energy in Vivill Town! It’s quite likely the Light of Ruin’s base!
entries.translated:
Tuan! Kami mendeteksi sisa-sisa
energi portal Hoopa di Vivill Town!\lKemungkinan besar itu adalah markas

Light of Ruin!

entries.original:
"Vivill Town\.

So\.\CC0820 the old base used by the
Science Society, now serves as the\lLight of Ruin’s\.

I should have known\."
entries.translation_source: Vivill Town[game-token-1] So[game-token-2][control-code-3] the old base used by the Science Society, now serves as the Light of Ruin’s[game-token-4] I should have known[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Vivill Town\. Jadi\.\CC0820 markas lama yang
digunakan oleh Science Society,\lsekarang berfungsi sebagai Light of

Ruin{B4}s\. Seharusnya aku tahu\.

entries.original:
"Marlon\.\CC0818 we cannot remain here
any longer.

Now that Aklove is distracted,
we must strike quickly!

It’s time to rally our fighting
force and depart for Vivill Town.

Prepare the Shadow!
We move out at once!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon[game-token-1][control-code-2] we cannot remain here any longer. Now that Aklove is distracted, we must strike quickly! It’s time to rally our fighting force and depart for Vivill Town. Prepare the Shadow! We move out at once!
entries.translated:
Marlon\.\CC0818 kita tidak bisa tinggal di
sini lebih lama lagi. Sekarang\lAklove terganggu, kita harus

menyerang cepat! Saatnya
mengumpulkan pasukan tempur kita\ldan berangkat ke Vivill Town.

Siapkan Shadow! Kita bergerak
sekarang juga!

entries.original:
"Of course, Zeph.

I doubt we have much time until
Aklove returns."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Zeph. I doubt we have much time until Aklove returns.
entries.translated:
Tentu, Zeph. Aku ragu kita punya
banyak waktu sampai Aklove kembali.

entries.original:
"And [player]\.\CC0818 please, don’t tell
[rival] about Ivory and me.

At least\.\CC0818 not until the time is
truly right.

That we neglected our children
in favour of another\.\CC0818 the thought\lwould sicken him."
entries.translation_source: And [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] please, don’t tell [text-token-rival-4] about Ivory and me. At least[game-token-5][control-code-6] not until the time is truly right. That we neglected our children in favour of another[game-token-7][control-code-8] the thought would sicken him.
entries.translated:
Dan [player]\.\CC0818 tolong, jangan beri
tahu [rival] tentang Ivory dan\laku. Setidaknya\.\CC0818 tidak sampai

waktunya benar-benar tepat. Bahwa
kami mengabaikan anak-anak kami\ldemi yang lain\.\CC0818 pikiran itu akan

membuatnya muak.

entries.original:
"Oh, before I forget, keep the
outfit.

I think it looks rather good on
you.

Who knows\.\CC0818 it may come in handy
someday."
entries.translation_source: Oh, before I forget, keep the outfit. I think it looks rather good on you. Who knows[game-token-1][control-code-2] it may come in handy someday.
entries.translated:
Oh, sebelum aku lupa, simpan
pakaiannya. Menurutku itu terlihat\lcukup bagus di tubuhmu. Siapa tahu\.\CC0818

mungkin berguna suatu hari nanti.

entries.original:
"Have you the means to cross water -
the HM for Surf?

If you cannot use it, then you
should first obtain [green]Dehara City[blue]’s\lGym Badge, before you regroup\lwith us.

We must reach [green]Vivill Town[blue] as soon
as possible, so please hurry.

It’s [green]northeast[blue] of [green]Dehara City[blue],
when you are ready."
entries.translation_source: Have you the means to cross water - the HM for Surf? If you cannot use it, then you should first obtain [color-green-1]Dehara City[color-blue-2]’s Gym Badge, before you regroup with us. We must reach [color-green-3]Vivill Town[color-blue-4] as soon as possible, so please hurry. It’s [color-green-5]northeast[color-blue-6] of [color-green-7]Dehara City[color-blue-8], when you are ready.
entries.translated:
Apakah kau memiliki cara untuk
menyeberangi air - HM untuk\lSelancar? Jika tidak bisa

menggunakannya, maka kau harus
terlebih dahulu mendapatkan [green]Dehara\lCity[blue]{B4}s Gym Badge, sebelum bergabung

kembali dengan kami. Kita harus
mencapai [green]Vivill Town[blue] secepat\lmungkin, jadi tolong cepat.

Letaknya di [green]timur laut[blue] dari [green]Dehara
City[blue], saat kau siap.

entries.original: "daughter"
entries.translation_source: daughter
entries.translated: putri

entries.original:
"You’re seriously only leaving
Dehara now?

Man, you sure are slow!

Well, while you were loitering
around, I figured out how to get\lto the Ruins of Void.

Of course, by the time I got there,
it was too late to do anything\."
entries.translation_source: You’re seriously only leaving Dehara now? Man, you sure are slow! Well, while you were loitering around, I figured out how to get to the Ruins of Void. Of course, by the time I got there, it was too late to do anything[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kau benar-benar baru pergi dari
Dehara sekarang? Bung, kau\lbenar-benar lambat! Yah, saat kau

berkeliaran, aku sudah tahu cara
menuju Ruins of Void. Tentu saja,\lsaat aku sampai di sana, sudah

terlambat untuk melakukan apa pun\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
Just the [buffer1] I was looking for!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Just the [buffer1-2] I was looking for!
entries.translated:
[player]! Tepat [buffer1] yang aku
cari!

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0818 who the heck are you
supposed to be?"
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] who the heck are you supposed to be?
entries.translated: Tunggu\.\CC0818 siapa sebenarnya kau?

entries.original:
"[player], have you seen Jax?

Last I heard, he was planning to
travel to the Ruins of Void."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], have you seen Jax? Last I heard, he was planning to travel to the Ruins of Void.
entries.translated:
[player], apakah kau melihat Jax?
Terakhir kudengar, dia berencana\lpergi ke Ruins of Void.

entries.original:
"Whatever the Shadows were planning,
they’d already done it by the time\lI got there.

I saw signs of a battle, but nobody
was around\.\CC0818 and that includes\lanyone named Jax."
entries.translation_source: Whatever the Shadows were planning, they’d already done it by the time I got there. I saw signs of a battle, but nobody was around[game-token-1][control-code-2] and that includes anyone named Jax.
entries.translated:
Apapun yang direncanakan oleh
Shadows, mereka sudah melakukannya\lsaat aku tiba. Aku melihat

tanda-tanda pertempuran, tetapi
tidak ada seorang pun di sekitar\.\CC0818\ldan itu termasuk siapa pun yang

bernama Jax.

entries.original:
"[player], you were the last one to
see him!

What happened in there?

\.

Aklove?
I’ve never heard of him before\.

And it’s just as I feared - the dark
force has been released at last\.

\.

What!? Aros has been trapped
inside a Cube, you say?

Utter madness!

\.

Oh no\.

If I know Zeph, there’s only one
thing he could have possibly done\lwith Jax\.

\.

Oh?
You say Jax wasn’t with Zeph?

That gives me hope\.\CC0818 he must still
be out there\.

I’m surprised Zeph agreed to work
with you, but you know the saying\.

\qoThe enemy of my enemy is my
friend.\qc"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], you were the last one to see him! What happened in there? [game-token-2] Aklove? I’ve never heard of him before[game-token-3] And it’s just as I feared - the dark force has been released at last[game-token-4] [game-token-5] What!? Aros has been trapped inside a Cube, you say? Utter madness! [game-token-6] Oh no[game-token-7] If I know Zeph, there’s only one thing he could have possibly done with Jax[game-token-8] [game-token-9] Oh? You say Jax wasn’t with Zeph? That gives me hope[game-token-10][control-code-11] he must still be out there[game-token-12] I’m surprised Zeph agreed to work with you, but you know the saying[game-token-13] [quote-open-14]The enemy of my enemy is my friend.[quote-close-15]
entries.translated:
[player], kamu yang terakhir
melihatnya! Apa yang terjadi di\lsana? \. Aklove? Aku belum pernah

mendengarnya sebelumnya\. Dan seperti
yang aku khawatirkan - kekuatan\lgelap akhirnya terlepas\. \. Apa!? Aros

terperangkap di dalam Kubus,
katamu? Benar-benar gila! \. Oh tidak\.\lJika aku tahu Zeph, hanya ada satu

hal yang mungkin dia lakukan dengan
Jax\. \. Oh? Katamu Jax tidak bersama\lZeph? Itu memberiku harapan\.\CC0818 dia

pasti masih di luar sana\. Aku
terkejut Zeph setuju bekerja\ldenganmu, tapi kau tahu pepatahnya\.

\qoMusuh dari musuhku adalah
temanku.\qc

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 I don’t like the sound of
what you told me.

If this Aklove, the one who controls
Hoopa, is working with Fey, then\lthey pose an even larger threat\lthan I suspected.

And if the Light of Ruin is another
branch like the Shadows, then that\lmeans only one thing\.

A recruitment drive\.\CC0818 to find more
people to turn into those\labominations!

How Hoopa fits into things, however,
I have no idea\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] I don’t like the sound of what you told me. If this Aklove, the one who controls Hoopa, is working with Fey, then they pose an even larger threat than I suspected. And if the Light of Ruin is another branch like the Shadows, then that means only one thing[game-token-4] A recruitment drive[game-token-5][control-code-6] to find more people to turn into those abominations! How Hoopa fits into things, however, I have no idea[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 Aku tidak suka dengan apa
yang kau katakan padaku. Jika\lAklove ini, yang mengendalikan

Hoopa, bekerja sama dengan Fey,
maka mereka menjadi ancaman yang\llebih besar dari yang kuduga. Dan

jika Cahaya Kehancuran adalah
cabang lain seperti Bayangan, maka\litu berarti hanya satu hal\. Sebuah

kampanye perekrutan\.\CC0818 untuk mencari
lebih banyak orang yang diubah\lmenjadi kekejian itu! Namun,

bagaimana Hoopa cocok dalam semua
ini, aku tidak tahu\.

entries.original:
"If they have taken Jax\.\CC0818 no,
I’ll try to stay optimistic.

Jax is a resourceful boy\.

But lately, he seems to be
contacting me less and less\.\land with less pep, every time.

[player], head over to Vivill Town.

Stop the Light of Ruin, and try to
find Jax.

Whether he’s there of his own free
will or not, I suspect he will be\lwith them."
entries.translation_source: If they have taken Jax[game-token-1][control-code-2] no, I’ll try to stay optimistic. Jax is a resourceful boy[game-token-3] But lately, he seems to be contacting me less and less[game-token-4] and with less pep, every time. [player-name-5], head over to Vivill Town. Stop the Light of Ruin, and try to find Jax. Whether he’s there of his own free will or not, I suspect he will be with them.
entries.translated:
Jika mereka telah mengambil Jax\.\CC0818
tidak, aku akan berusaha tetap\loptimis. Jax adalah anak laki-laki

yang cerdik\. Tapi akhir-akhir ini,
dia sepertinya semakin jarang\lmenghubungiku\. dan dengan semangat

yang semakin berkurang, setiap
kali. [player], pergilah ke Vivill\lTown. Hentikan Cahaya Kehancuran,

dan coba temukan Jax. Apakah dia di
sana atas kemauannya sendiri atau\ltidak, aku curiga dia akan bersama

mereka.

entries.original:
"Okay, that’s it!
I’ve had it!

I kept my yap shut all this time,
but I’m not just gonna be ignored\lanymore!

Listen, old man\.\CC0818 I have no idea
who you are, or what’s happening\.

But if whatever is going on has to
do with the Shadows, then I want in!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, that’s it! I’ve had it! I kept my yap shut all this time, but I’m not just gonna be ignored anymore! Listen, old man[game-token-1][control-code-2] I have no idea who you are, or what’s happening[game-token-3] But if whatever is going on has to do with the Shadows, then I want in!
entries.translated:
Oke, itu saja! Aku sudah muak! Aku
diam saja selama ini, tapi aku\ltidak akan diabaikan lagi! Dengar,

pak tua\.\CC0818 Aku tidak tahu siapa kamu,
atau apa yang terjadi\. Tapi jika apa\lpun yang terjadi berhubungan dengan

Bayangan, maka aku ingin ikut!

entries.original:
"Oh! My apologies!
I didn’t mean to be rude.

Who might you be?"
entries.translation_source: Oh! My apologies! I didn’t mean to be rude. Who might you be?
entries.translated:
Oh! Maafkan saya! Saya tidak
bermaksud kasar. Siapa Anda?

entries.original:
"I’m mad as all else!

I don’t care about this Light of
Ruin or whatever\.

I came this close to finding the
Shadows and finding my parents,\land they got away from me again!

So if I hear they’re heading to
Vivill Town, then that’s where\lI’m going!"
entries.translation_source: I’m mad as all else! I don’t care about this Light of Ruin or whatever[game-token-1] I came this close to finding the Shadows and finding my parents, and they got away from me again! So if I hear they’re heading to Vivill Town, then that’s where I’m going!
entries.translated:
Aku sangat marah! Aku tidak peduli
dengan Light of Ruin atau apapun\litu\. Aku sudah sangat dekat untuk

menemukan Shadows dan menemukan
orang tuaku, dan mereka lolos lagi\ldariku! Jadi jika aku dengar mereka

menuju ke Vivill Town, maka ke
sanalah aku akan pergi!

entries.original:
"Please, I urge you to wait!

As of now, the Shadows are our
pawns to fix a greater problem!

At least hold off on your act of
vengeance until this ordeal is\lover, understood?"
entries.translation_source: Please, I urge you to wait! As of now, the Shadows are our pawns to fix a greater problem! At least hold off on your act of vengeance until this ordeal is over, understood?
entries.translated:
Tolong, saya mohon Anda menunggu!
Saat ini, Bayangan adalah bidak\lkita untuk memperbaiki masalah yang

lebih besar! Setidaknya tunda aksi
balas dendam Anda sampai cobaan ini\lselesai, mengerti?

entries.original:
"They’re YOUR pawns, old man.
They’re MY only lead to my parents.

I’m not stupid.
I know what’s at stake.

But the second this is all over,
I won’t hesitate to shake ’em down\lfor what I want to know."
entries.translation_source: They’re YOUR pawns, old man. They’re MY only lead to my parents. I’m not stupid. I know what’s at stake. But the second this is all over, I won’t hesitate to shake ’em down for what I want to know.
entries.translated:
Mereka adalah pion-pionmu, pak tua.
Mereka satu-satunya petunjukku\luntuk menemukan orang tuaku. Aku

tidak bodoh. Aku tahu apa yang
dipertaruhkan. Tapi begitu semua\lini selesai, aku tidak akan ragu

untuk memeras mereka demi apa yang
ingin aku ketahui.

entries.original:
"[player], since this is officially
your \qomission\qc, I’ll be waiting for\lyou in [green]Vivill Town[blue].

And for your sake, I’ll even
play nice with the Shadows until\lwe’re done.

Don’t be late, [player]."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], since this is officially your [quote-open-2]mission[quote-close-3], I’ll be waiting for you in [color-green-4]Vivill Town[color-blue-5]. And for your sake, I’ll even play nice with the Shadows until we’re done. Don’t be late, [player-name-6].
entries.translated:
[player], karena ini resmi menjadi
\qomisi\qcmu, aku akan menunggumu di\l[green]Vivill Town[blue]. Dan demi dirimu, aku

bahkan akan bersikap baik dengan
Shadow sampai selesai. Jangan\lterlambat, [player].

entries.original:
"That boy\.\CC0818 he’s got quite the mouth
to him\.

Well, I wish you luck in
Vivill Town, [player].

Let me know how it went, as soon
as you’ve returned."
entries.translation_source: That boy[game-token-1][control-code-2] he’s got quite the mouth to him[game-token-3] Well, I wish you luck in Vivill Town, [player-name-4]. Let me know how it went, as soon as you’ve returned.
entries.translated:
Anak laki-laki itu\.\CC0818 dia memang
banyak mulut\. Baiklah, aku berharap\lkamu beruntung di Kota Vivill,

[player]. Beri tahu aku bagaimana
hasilnya, segera setelah kamu\lkembali.

entries.original:
"Sheesh, about time you got here,
[player]."
entries.translation_source: Sheesh, about time you got here, [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Nah, akhirnya kamu sampai juga,
[player].

entries.original:
"Sorry\.\CC0818 I’m just a little on edge.

I’m getting close\.\CC0818 so close to
finding out what happened to\lmy parents\.

I guess it’s making me lose my cool
somehow."
entries.translation_source: Sorry[game-token-1][control-code-2] I’m just a little on edge. I’m getting close[game-token-3][control-code-4] so close to finding out what happened to my parents[game-token-5] I guess it’s making me lose my cool somehow.
entries.translated:
Maaf\.\CC0818 Aku hanya sedikit tegang. Aku
semakin dekat\.\CC0818 begitu dekat untuk\lmencari tahu apa yang terjadi pada

orang tuaku\. Kurasa ini entah
bagaimana membuatku kehilangan\lketenangan.

entries.original:
"While you were making your way
over, I tried scouting the area to\llook for the Shadows, but\. so far\lI’ve seen no sign of them."
entries.translation_source: While you were making your way over, I tried scouting the area to look for the Shadows, but[game-token-1] so far I’ve seen no sign of them.
entries.translated:
Sementara kamu dalam perjalanan ke
sini, saya mencoba mengintai area\luntuk mencari Bayangan, tetapi\.

sejauh ini saya belum melihat
tanda-tanda mereka.

entries.original:
"It’s weird\.\CC0818 it’s like the entire town
is deserted.

The only person I saw was this guy
with a weird symbol on his outfit,\lhanging around the warehouse,\lnorth of town.

Is that the base of these
\qoLight of Ruin\qc guys?"
entries.translation_source: It’s weird[game-token-1][control-code-2] it’s like the entire town is deserted. The only person I saw was this guy with a weird symbol on his outfit, hanging around the warehouse, north of town. Is that the base of these [quote-open-3]Light of Ruin[quote-close-4] guys?
entries.translated:
Ini aneh\.\CC0818 sepertinya seluruh kota
sepi. Satu-satunya orang yang\lkulihat adalah pria ini dengan

simbol aneh di pakaiannya,
berkeliaran di sekitar gudang, di\lutara kota. Apakah itu markas dari

orang-orang \qoLight of Ruin\qc ini?

entries.original:
"Well, only one way to find out.
I’m going on ahead.

If that is their base, then the
Shadows aren’t going to be far\lbehind."
entries.translation_source: Well, only one way to find out. I’m going on ahead. If that is their base, then the Shadows aren’t going to be far behind.
entries.translated:
Yah, hanya satu cara untuk
mengetahuinya. Aku akan pergi\lduluan. Jika itu adalah markas

mereka, maka Shadow tidak akan jauh
di belakang.

entries.original:
"You’re one of those Light of Ruin
thugs, aren’t you?

What’re you doing in this miserable
place, anyway?"
entries.translation_source: You’re one of those Light of Ruin thugs, aren’t you? What’re you doing in this miserable place, anyway?
entries.translated:
Kau salah satu dari para preman
Cahaya Kehancuran itu, kan? Apa\lyang kau lakukan di tempat sengsara

ini, sih?

entries.original:
"What I’m doing here isn’t any of
your business, kid.

You’ll leave if you know what’s
good for you."
entries.translation_source: What I’m doing here isn’t any of your business, kid. You’ll leave if you know what’s good for you.
entries.translated:
Apa yang kulakukan di sini bukan
urusanmu, nak. Kamu akan pergi\lkalau kamu tahu yang terbaik

untukmu.

entries.original:
"I think we’ve got the right place,
[player]!

He absolutely screams \qosuspicious\qc."
entries.translation_source: I think we’ve got the right place, [player-name-1]! He absolutely screams [quote-open-2]suspicious[quote-close-3].
entries.translated:
Kurasa kita sudah sampai di tempat
yang tepat, [player]! Dia\lbenar-benar berteriak

\qomencurigakan\qc.

entries.original:
"You’re not fooling anyone, pal.

We know this is your headquarters,
and we’re gonna be busting in\lwhether you like it or not!"
entries.translation_source: You’re not fooling anyone, pal. We know this is your headquarters, and we’re gonna be busting in whether you like it or not!
entries.translated:
Kau tidak menipu siapa pun, kawan.
Kami tahu ini markasmu, dan kami\lakan menerobos masuk, suka atau

tidak!

entries.original:
"CHZKKK\.

\.\CC0820Ma’am\.\CC0818 it looks like they came
after all.

But, I thought you said they would
have a small army with them\.

No, it’s just two Trainers\.

Understood.

No need for backup - I can deal
with them."
entries.translation_source: CHZKKK[game-token-1] [game-token-2][control-code-3]Ma’am[game-token-4][control-code-5] it looks like they came after all. But, I thought you said they would have a small army with them[game-token-6] No, it’s just two Trainers[game-token-7] Understood. No need for backup - I can deal with them.
entries.translated:
CHZKKK\. \.\CC0820Bu\.\CC0818 Tampaknya mereka datang
juga. Tapi, saya pikir Anda bilang\lmereka akan membawa pasukan kecil

bersama mereka\. Tidak, hanya dua
Pelatih\. Mengerti. Tidak perlu\lbantuan - saya bisa menangani

mereka.

entries.original:
"You made a huge mistake,
coming here alone."
entries.translation_source: You made a huge mistake, coming here alone.
entries.translated:
Kamu membuat kesalahan besar,
datang ke sini sendirian.

entries.original:
"You think we’re alone?
Keep dreaming.

When our backup arrives,
you’ll eat those words!"
entries.translation_source: You think we’re alone? Keep dreaming. When our backup arrives, you’ll eat those words!
entries.translated:
Kamu pikir kita sendirian? Teruslah
bermimpi. Saat bala bantuan kami\ltiba, kau akan menarik kembali

kata-katamu itu!

entries.original:
"Ha ha\.\CC0818 well, thank you for
confirming our suspicions\.

\.\CC0818not that any of it matters.

Do you think there’ll be a welcome
mat for you behind these doors?

I’ll spare you from guessing - it’s
our entire Light of Ruin branch!

There isn’t a force in Borrius large
enough to take us on!

You arrogant little fools have no
idea what you’ve stepped into!"
entries.translation_source: Ha ha[game-token-1][control-code-2] well, thank you for confirming our suspicions[game-token-3] [game-token-4][control-code-5]not that any of it matters. Do you think there’ll be a welcome mat for you behind these doors? I’ll spare you from guessing - it’s our entire Light of Ruin branch! There isn’t a force in Borrius large enough to take us on! You arrogant little fools have no idea what you’ve stepped into!
entries.translated:
Ha ha\.\CC0818 baik, terima kasih telah
mengonfirmasi kecurigaan kami\. \.\CC0818bukan\lberarti itu penting. Apakah kau

pikir akan ada keset sambutan
untukmu di balik pintu-pintu ini?\lAku akan menghemat tebakanmu - ini

seluruh cabang Light of Ruin kami!
Tidak ada kekuatan di Borrius yang\lcukup besar untuk melawan kami!

Kalian orang-orang bodoh yang
sombong tidak tahu apa yang telah\lkalian hadapi!

entries.original:
"Sorry, but nothing is gonna stop me
from getting what I want.
