Not you and not your entire branch!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry, but nothing is gonna stop me from getting what I want. Not you and not your entire branch!
entries.translated:
Maaf, tetapi tidak ada yang akan
menghentikanku untuk mendapatkan\lapa yang aku inginkan. Bukan kamu

dan bukan seluruh cabangmu!

entries.original: "Now’s my chance!"
entries.translation_source: Now’s my chance!
entries.translated: Sekarang kesempatanku!

entries.original:
"\.\CC0818What?

C’mon, he was being obnoxious.
He totally had it coming."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1][control-code-2]What? C’mon, he was being obnoxious. He totally had it coming.
entries.translated:
\.\CC0818Apa? Ayolah, dia itu menyebalkan.
Dia memang pantas mendapatkannya.

entries.original:
"Quick, let’s head inside while he’s
still unconcious."
entries.translation_source: Quick, let’s head inside while he’s still unconcious.
entries.translated:
Cepat, mari kita masuk ke dalam
sementara dia masih pingsan.

entries.original:
"Man, those Shadow guys sure know
how to make an entrance\."
entries.translation_source: Man, those Shadow guys sure know how to make an entrance[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Astaga, orang-orang Shadow itu
pasti tahu cara membuat pintu masuk\lyang spektakuler\.

entries.original:
"We don’t have much time, [player].

That grunt I knocked out could
wake up any minute now, so we\lreally need to get moving.

The only thing is\."
entries.translation_source: We don’t have much time, [player-name-1]. That grunt I knocked out could wake up any minute now, so we really need to get moving. The only thing is[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Kita tidak punya banyak waktu,
[player]. Anggota yang aku\lpingsankan itu bisa sadar kapan

saja sekarang, jadi kita
benar-benar harus segera bergerak.\lSatu-satunya hal adalah\.

entries.original:
"That door up ahead looks like our
only way through\.

And there’s probably plenty more
grunts on the other side.

So, do we sneak past ’em, or try to
fight our way through\.?"
entries.translation_source: That door up ahead looks like our only way through[game-token-1] And there’s probably plenty more grunts on the other side. So, do we sneak past ’em, or try to fight our way through[game-token-2]?
entries.translated:
Pintu di depan itu tampaknya
satu-satunya jalan kita untuk lewat\.\lDan mungkin masih banyak anak buah

lagi di sisi lain. Jadi, apakah
kita menyelinap melewati mereka,\latau mencoba bertarung melewati

mereka\.?

entries.original:
"What the\.\CC0820
How did a Shadow Warrior get here?"
entries.translation_source: What the[game-token-1][control-code-2] How did a Shadow Warrior get here?
entries.translated:
Apa\.\CC0820 Bagaimana seorang Prajurit
Bayangan bisa sampai di sini?

entries.original:
"We aren’t equipped to deal with
these anymore!

Let’s get out of here!"
entries.translation_source: We aren’t equipped to deal with these anymore! Let’s get out of here!
entries.translated:
Kami tidak lagi dilengkapi untuk
menangani ini! Ayo keluar dari\lsini!

entries.original: "Come on\.\CC0810 open up\.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: Come on[game-token-1][control-code-2] open up[game-token-3][control-code-4]
entries.translated: Ayo\.\CC0810 buka\.\CC0830

entries.original: "Got it! We’re safe now!\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: Got it! We’re safe now![control-code-1]
entries.translated: Baik! Kita aman sekarang!\CC0830

entries.original: "What the\.\CC0820 who’s this guy, anyway?"
entries.translation_source: What the[game-token-1][control-code-2] who’s this guy, anyway?
entries.translated: Apa sih\.\CC0820 siapa orang ini sih?

entries.original: "W-what? This isn’t a person at all!"
entries.translation_source: W-what? This isn’t a person at all!
entries.translated: A-apa? Ini sama sekali bukan orang!

entries.original:
"Hey, [player]!

This one of your Shadow buddies?
Call it off!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player-name-1]! This one of your Shadow buddies? Call it off!
entries.translated:
Hei, [player]! Ini salah satu teman
Shadow-mu? Hentikan!

entries.original:
"Geez\. that was close\.

What on earth was that thing,
anyway?

A few more seconds, and it could’ve
burnt us to a crisp!

\.

What’s that?

It’s called a Shadow Warrior?

That’s\.\CC0818 uh, a pretty unimaginative
name, honestly."
entries.translation_source: Geez[game-token-1] that was close[game-token-2] What on earth was that thing, anyway? A few more seconds, and it could’ve burnt us to a crisp! [game-token-3] What’s that? It’s called a Shadow Warrior? That’s[game-token-4][control-code-5] uh, a pretty unimaginative name, honestly.
entries.translated:
Astaga\. itu tadi nyaris\. Benda apa
itu tadi? Beberapa detik lagi, dan\lkita bisa hangus! \. Apa? Itu disebut

Shadow Warrior? Itu\.\CC0818 uh, nama yang
cukup tidak imajinatif, sejujurnya.

entries.original:
"But hey, at least it did us
a favour and cleared the path.

Let’s just hope there aren’t too many
more of them\."
entries.translation_source: But hey, at least it did us a favour and cleared the path. Let’s just hope there aren’t too many more of them[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tapi hei, setidaknya itu memberi
kita bantuan dan membersihkan\ljalan. Mari kita berharap saja

tidak ada terlalu banyak lagi dari
mereka\.

entries.original: "Stop\.\CC0820 stop\.\CC0820 right there![pause]"
entries.translation_source: Stop[game-token-1][control-code-2] stop[game-token-3][control-code-4] right there![text-token-pause-5]
entries.translated: Berhenti\.\CC0820 berhenti\.\CC0820 di sana![pause]

entries.original:
"I don’t care if you’ve already made
it inside\.

I can still drag you right back
out!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t care if you’ve already made it inside[game-token-1] I can still drag you right back out!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak peduli jika kamu sudah
masuk ke dalam\. Aku masih bisa\lmenyeretmu kembali keluar!

entries.original:
"CHZKKK\.

Hello\.\CC0818 can anyone hear me?

Darn!

That brat must have damaged my
communicator\."
entries.translation_source: CHZKKK[game-token-1] Hello[game-token-2][control-code-3] can anyone hear me? Darn! That brat must have damaged my communicator[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
CHZKKK\. Halo\.\CC0818 ada yang bisa
mendengarku? Sial! Anak nakal itu\lpasti telah merusak komunikatorku\.

entries.original:
"Fine - I’ll have to alert everyone
else in person!"
entries.translation_source: Fine - I’ll have to alert everyone else in person!
entries.translated:
Baiklah - Aku harus memberi tahu
semua orang secara langsung!

entries.original:
"And you call yourself a guard?

Attacking someone with a weakened
Pokémon is a sure way to lose!"
entries.translation_source: And you call yourself a guard? Attacking someone with a weakened Pokémon is a sure way to lose!
entries.translated:
Dan kau menyebut dirimu penjaga?
Menyerang seseorang dengan Pokémon\lyang lemah adalah cara pasti untuk

kalah!

entries.original:
"Why you\.

I’ll be back!

Once I get reinforcements, it’ll
be all over for you two!"
entries.translation_source: Why you[game-token-1] I’ll be back! Once I get reinforcements, it’ll be all over for you two!
entries.translated:
Kau\. Aku akan kembali! Begitu aku
mendapat bala bantuan, semuanya\lakan berakhir bagi kalian berdua!

entries.original:
"If that’s all the Light of Ruin
has, this’ll be a breeze!

So much for his \qobranch\qc of
grunts\.

I wonder where they are, anyway?"
entries.translation_source: If that’s all the Light of Ruin has, this’ll be a breeze! So much for his [quote-open-1]branch[quote-close-2] of grunts[game-token-3] I wonder where they are, anyway?
entries.translated:
Jika hanya itu yang dimiliki Light
of Ruin, ini akan mudah! Begitu\lsaja dengan \qocabang\qc pasukannya\. Aku

penasaran di mana mereka, sih?

entries.original: "The shaking is over\.\CC0820"
entries.translation_source: The shaking is over[game-token-1][control-code-2]
entries.translated: Gemetarnya sudah berakhir\.\CC0820

entries.original: "[red]Did they make it in?\CC0820"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Did they make it in?[control-code-2]
entries.translated: [red]Apakah mereka berhasil masuk?\CC0820

entries.original:
"Get ready everyone, they’re coming
down the stairs!\CC0820"
entries.translation_source: Get ready everyone, they’re coming down the stairs![control-code-1]
entries.translated:
Bersiap semuanya, mereka turun
tangga!\CC0820

entries.original:
"[red]Ahh!
They’re behind us!\CC0820"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Ahh! They’re behind us![control-code-2]
entries.translated: [red]Ahh! Mereka di belakang kita!\CC0820

entries.original: "[blue]Everybody run!\CC0810"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Everybody run![control-code-2]
entries.translated: [blue]Semua orang lari!\CC0810

entries.original:
"I guess it doesn’t really
matter.

One less hurdle for us!"
entries.translation_source: I guess it doesn’t really matter. One less hurdle for us!
entries.translated:
Kurasa itu tidak terlalu penting.
Satu rintangan berkurang bagi kita!

entries.original:
"Let’s find the Shadows so we can
end this thing.

The sooner we do that, the sooner I
can get what I want from them!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s find the Shadows so we can end this thing. The sooner we do that, the sooner I can get what I want from them!
entries.translated:
Ayo cari Shadows agar kita bisa
mengakhiri ini. Semakin cepat kita\llakukan itu, semakin cepat aku bisa

mendapatkan apa yang kuinginkan
dari mereka!

entries.original:
"What?
You want to help?

I need 6 letters to open this door.

I already have one of them, so I
just need [green]5[blue] more.

Do you know the other letters?"
entries.translation_source: What? You want to help? I need 6 letters to open this door. I already have one of them, so I just need [color-green-1]5[color-blue-2] more. Do you know the other letters?
entries.translated:
Apa? Kamu ingin membantu? Aku butuh
6 huruf untuk membuka pintu ini.\lAku sudah punya satu, jadi aku

hanya perlu [green]5[blue] lagi. Apakah kamu
tahu huruf lainnya?

entries.original:
"You’ve only learned [green][buffer1][blue] of the
letters so far.

Come back here once you’ve learned
all [green]5[blue]."
entries.translation_source: You’ve only learned [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] of the letters so far. Come back here once you’ve learned all [color-green-4]5[color-blue-5].
entries.translated:
Kamu baru belajar [green][buffer1][blue] huruf
sejauh ini. Kembalilah ke sini\lsetelah kamu belajar semua [green]5[blue].

entries.original:
"You haven’t learned any of the
other letters yet\.

Come back here once you’ve learned
all [green]5[blue]."
entries.translation_source: You haven’t learned any of the other letters yet[game-token-1] Come back here once you’ve learned all [color-green-2]5[color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Kamu belum belajar huruf lainnya
sama sekali\. Kembalilah ke sini\lsetelah kamu belajar semua [green]5[blue].

entries.original:
"Come back here once you’ve learned
all [green]5[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Come back here once you’ve learned all [color-green-1]5[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Kembalilah ke sini setelah kamu
belajar semua [green]5[blue].

entries.original: "Please enter the other [green]5[blue] letters."
entries.translation_source: Please enter the other [color-green-1]5[color-blue-2] letters.
entries.translated: Silakan masukkan [green]5[blue] huruf lainnya.

entries.original: "aklov"
entries.translation_source: aklov
entries.translated: aklov

entries.original:
"That doesn’t look like the correct
password\."
entries.translation_source: That doesn’t look like the correct password[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Itu tidak terlihat seperti kata
sandi yang benar\.

entries.original: "And the last letter is E\."
entries.translation_source: And the last letter is E[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Dan huruf terakhir adalah E\.

entries.original: "The door is open for you, Zeph."
entries.translation_source: The door is open for you, Zeph.
entries.translated: Pintu terbuka untukmu, Zeph.

entries.original:
"Good work, scientist.

I should have known that arrogant
fool would make the password his\lown name\."
entries.translation_source: Good work, scientist. I should have known that arrogant fool would make the password his own name[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, ilmuwan. Seharusnya
aku tahu bahwa si bodoh sombong itu\lakan membuat kata sandinya namanya

sendiri\.

entries.original:
"Marlon, has that boy returned with
the bottle yet?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, has that boy returned with the bottle yet?
entries.translated:
Marlon, apakah anak itu sudah
kembali dengan botolnya?

entries.original:
"No, he hasn’t.
He must still be searching for it."
entries.translation_source: No, he hasn’t. He must still be searching for it.
entries.translated:
Belum, dia belum kembali. Dia pasti
masih mencarinya.

entries.original:
"We’ll have to proceed without
him, then.

Aklove still appears to be with
Fey, so with luck, we won’t need\lthe bottle."
entries.translation_source: We’ll have to proceed without him, then. Aklove still appears to be with Fey, so with luck, we won’t need the bottle.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, kita harus
melanjutkan tanpa dia. Aklove masih\ltampak bersama Fey, jadi semoga

beruntung, kita tidak akan
membutuhkan botol itu.

entries.original:
"Ivory!

So my suspicions were correct -
you HAVE betrayed us."
entries.translation_source: Ivory! So my suspicions were correct - you HAVE betrayed us.
entries.translated:
Ivory! Jadi kecurigaanku benar -
kamu TELAH mengkhianati kami.

entries.original:
"[red]I betrayed you?
That’s simply untrue, Zeph.

My position\.\CC0818 my goals\.\CC0818 they haven’t
changed one bit.

It was you, who betrayed us\.\CC0818
when you refused to accept\lAklove as your replacement."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I betrayed you? That’s simply untrue, Zeph. My position[game-token-2][control-code-3] my goals[game-token-4][control-code-5] they haven’t changed one bit. It was you, who betrayed us[game-token-6][control-code-7] when you refused to accept Aklove as your replacement.
entries.translated:
[red]Aku mengkhianatimu? Itu tidak
benar, Zeph. Posisiku\.\CC0818 tujuanku\.\CC0818\ltidak berubah sedikit pun. Kamulah

yang mengkhianati kami\.\CC0818 ketika kamu
menolak menerima Aklove sebagai\lpenggantimu.

entries.original:
"[red]After Aklove took over the
leadership at the Ruins of Void, he\lgave me an offer I couldn’t refuse.

If I assist in his grand plan, then
he’ll grant me the power to finish\lwhat we started.

So don’t you see, Zeph?
This was the best course of action\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]After Aklove took over the leadership at the Ruins of Void, he gave me an offer I couldn’t refuse. If I assist in his grand plan, then he’ll grant me the power to finish what we started. So don’t you see, Zeph? This was the best course of action[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Setelah Aklove mengambil alih
kepemimpinan di Reruntuhan\lKehampaan, dia memberiku tawaran

yang tidak bisa kutolak. Jika aku
membantu rencana besarnya, maka dia\lakan memberiku kekuatan untuk

menyelesaikan apa yang kita mulai.
Jadi tidakkah kau lihat, Zeph? Ini\ladalah tindakan terbaik\.

entries.original:
"Grand plan?
You fool, Ivory!

He made it no secret to us that he
intends to destroy Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Grand plan? You fool, Ivory! He made it no secret to us that he intends to destroy Borrius!
entries.translated:
Rencana besar? Kau bodoh, Ivory!
Dia tidak merahasiakan dari kita\lbahwa dia berniat menghancurkan

Borrius!

entries.original: "[red]Grunts\.\CC0820 leave us, for now."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Grunts[game-token-2][control-code-3] leave us, for now.
entries.translated:
[red]Para prajurit\.\CC0820 tinggalkan kami,
untuk saat ini.

entries.original:
"[red]Perhaps that’s his aim\.\CC0818 but his
aim aligns with ours.

Like us, he intends to use Hoopa’s
power to bring the Ultimate Weapon\lto Borrius.

And then, using the Shadow Warriors
as fuel\.\CC0818 he’ll engage it."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Perhaps that’s his aim[game-token-2][control-code-3] but his aim aligns with ours. Like us, he intends to use Hoopa’s power to bring the Ultimate Weapon to Borrius. And then, using the Shadow Warriors as fuel[game-token-4][control-code-5] he’ll engage it.
entries.translated:
[red]Mungkin itulah tujuannya\.\CC0818 tapi
tujuannya sejalan dengan kita.\lSeperti kita, dia berniat

menggunakan kekuatan Hoopa untuk
membawa Senjata Tertinggi ke\lBorrius. Dan kemudian, menggunakan

Prajurit Bayangan sebagai bahan
bakar\.\CC0818 dia akan mengaktifkannya.

entries.original:
"[red]When the dust settles, I’ll be
granted use of the weapon to\lrestore my son\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]When the dust settles, I’ll be granted use of the weapon to restore my son[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Saat debu mereda, aku akan
diizinkan menggunakan senjata itu\luntuk memulihkan anakku\.

entries.original:
"What\.\CC0818 how can you do this?

What’s the point in helping him, when
it leaves us without a home to\lreturn to!?

It’ll destroy everything!

And that includes the children we
still have living here!"
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1][control-code-2] how can you do this? What’s the point in helping him, when it leaves us without a home to return to!? It’ll destroy everything! And that includes the children we still have living here!
entries.translated:
Apa\.\CC0818 bagaimana kau bisa melakukan
ini? Apa gunanya membantu dia, jika\litu membuat kita tanpa rumah untuk

kembali!? Itu akan menghancurkan
segalanya! Dan itu termasuk\lanak-anak yang masih tinggal di

sini!

entries.original:
"[red]Marlon\.\CC0818 of course I’ve prepared
for that inevitable outcome.

Aklove has agreed to safeguard our
children until this whole ordeal\lhas passed.

At the end of it all, yes, Borrius
may be gone\.

But, our entire family will be
reunited once again\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Marlon[game-token-2][control-code-3] of course I’ve prepared for that inevitable outcome. Aklove has agreed to safeguard our children until this whole ordeal has passed. At the end of it all, yes, Borrius may be gone[game-token-4] But, our entire family will be reunited once again[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
[red]Marlon\.\CC0818 tentu saja aku sudah bersiap
untuk hasil yang tak terelakkan\litu. Aklove setuju untuk melindungi

anak-anak kita sampai seluruh
cobaan ini berlalu. Pada akhirnya,\lya, Borrius mungkin akan lenyap\.

Tapi, seluruh keluarga kita akan
bersatu kembali\.

entries.original:
"Listen to yourself, Ivory!

You’re claiming our entire plan\.\CC0818 is
worth sacrificing an entire region!

It was always one thing to use the
lives of willing grunts to create\lthe Shadow Warriors\.

But these are countless innocent
lives you’d be wiping out!"
entries.translation_source: Listen to yourself, Ivory! You’re claiming our entire plan[game-token-1][control-code-2] is worth sacrificing an entire region! It was always one thing to use the lives of willing grunts to create the Shadow Warriors[game-token-3] But these are countless innocent lives you’d be wiping out!
entries.translated:
Dengar dirimu sendiri, Ivory! Kau
mengklaim seluruh rencana kita\.\CC0818\llayak untuk mengorbankan seluruh

wilayah! Selalu satu hal untuk
menggunakan nyawa prajurit yang\lrela untuk menciptakan Prajurit

Bayangan\. Tapi ini adalah nyawa tak
bersalah yang tak terhitung\ljumlahnya yang akan kau musnahkan!

entries.original:
"I agree with Marlon, Ivory.

I’ve crossed many lines, but this is
one I refuse to overstep\.

And I cannot allow you to do
the same.

Borrius is my home\.\CC0818 no, our home!

And that includes my own son\.\CC0818
he still needs a home to return to!

Shadow Warrior!
Seize her!

I’m sorry, but this is necessary,
Ivory\."
entries.translation_source: I agree with Marlon, Ivory. I’ve crossed many lines, but this is one I refuse to overstep[game-token-1] And I cannot allow you to do the same. Borrius is my home[game-token-2][control-code-3] no, our home! And that includes my own son[game-token-4][control-code-5] he still needs a home to return to! Shadow Warrior! Seize her! I’m sorry, but this is necessary, Ivory[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Aku setuju dengan Marlon, Ivory.
Aku sudah melewati banyak batas,\ltapi ini adalah satu yang aku tolak

untuk dilewati\. Dan aku tidak bisa
membiarkanmu melakukan hal yang\lsama. Borrius adalah rumahku\.\CC0818 tidak,

rumah kita! Dan itu termasuk anakku
sendiri\.\CC0818 dia masih butuh rumah untuk\lkembali! Prajurit Bayangan! Tangkap

dia! Maaf, tapi ini perlu, Ivory\.

entries.original:
"[red]What now, Marlon?

Are you really going to let Zeph
do this?

Will you truly allow him to sacrifice
everything we’ve worked so hard\lfor, all these years\.?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]What now, Marlon? Are you really going to let Zeph do this? Will you truly allow him to sacrifice everything we’ve worked so hard for, all these years[game-token-2]?
entries.translated:
[red]Sekarang bagaimana, Marlon? Apakah
kau benar-benar akan membiarkan\lZeph melakukan ini? Apakah kau

benar-benar akan mengizinkannya
mengorbankan semua yang telah kita\lkerjakan dengan susah payah selama

ini\.?

entries.original:
"Without a doubt in my mind, Ivory.

I have no hesitation, anymore.

You can ask a thousand times,
and I wouldn’t change my answer."
entries.translation_source: Without a doubt in my mind, Ivory. I have no hesitation, anymore. You can ask a thousand times, and I wouldn’t change my answer.
entries.translated:
Tanpa keraguan di pikiranku, Ivory.
Aku tidak ragu lagi. Kau bisa\lbertanya seribu kali, dan aku tidak

akan mengubah jawabanku.

entries.original:
"[red]Suit yourself.

Even if you lock me up, it will only
delay the inevitable.

Aklove will find the Ultimate
Weapon, and when he does\.

At last, he will keep his promise
to me\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Suit yourself. Even if you lock me up, it will only delay the inevitable. Aklove will find the Ultimate Weapon, and when he does[game-token-2] At last, he will keep his promise to me[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[red]Terserah kamu. Bahkan jika kau
mengunciku, itu hanya akan menunda\lhal yang tak terhindarkan. Aklove

akan menemukan Senjata Pamungkas,
dan ketika dia melakukannya\.\lAkhirnya, dia akan menepati

janjinya padaku\.

entries.original:
"Oh, we have no intention of holding
you for long.

We just need you out of the way
so we can disrupt your plans.

Once we discover where you’re
keeping the rest of the Shadow\lWarriors, Aklove’s big scheme will\lbe over.

You said it yourself, Ivory.

Without them, you have nothing to
power the weapon."
entries.translation_source: Oh, we have no intention of holding you for long. We just need you out of the way so we can disrupt your plans. Once we discover where you’re keeping the rest of the Shadow Warriors, Aklove’s big scheme will be over. You said it yourself, Ivory. Without them, you have nothing to power the weapon.
entries.translated:
Oh, kami tidak bermaksud menahanmu
lama. Kami hanya perlu kamu\lmenyingkir sehingga kami bisa

mengganggu rencana-rencanamu.
Setelah kami menemukan di mana kamu\lmenyimpan sisa Shadow Warriors,

rencana besar Aklove akan berakhir.
Kamu sendiri yang mengatakannya,\lIvory. Tanpa mereka, kamu tidak

punya apa-apa untuk menghidupkan
senjata.

entries.original: "[red]Right on cue\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Right on cue[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [red]Tepat pada waktunya\.

entries.original:
"No, no, no!
It’s too soon for him to return!"
entries.translation_source: No, no, no! It’s too soon for him to return!
entries.translated:
Tidak, tidak, tidak! Masih terlalu
cepat baginya untuk kembali!

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0818 why have I stopped receiving
the pertinent information needed to\llocate the Ultimate Weapon?"
entries.translation_source: Ivory[game-token-1][control-code-2] why have I stopped receiving the pertinent information needed to locate the Ultimate Weapon?
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0818 mengapa aku berhenti menerima
informasi yang relevan yang\ldiperlukan untuk menemukan Senjata

Tertinggi?

entries.original:
"[red]I apologize, Aklove.

The Shadows have proven more
troublesome than we anticipated.

Unfortunately, the Pokémon you
summoned to patrol the waters\lfailed to repel them.

The Shadows were able to bombard
the cliffside, shattering the wall\land flooding the Research Lab."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I apologize, Aklove. The Shadows have proven more troublesome than we anticipated. Unfortunately, the Pokémon you summoned to patrol the waters failed to repel them. The Shadows were able to bombard the cliffside, shattering the wall and flooding the Research Lab.
entries.translated:
[red]Saya minta maaf, Aklove. Shadows
telah terbukti lebih merepotkan\ldari yang kami perkirakan.

Sayangnya, Pokémon yang Anda
panggil untuk berpatroli di\lperairan gagal mengusir mereka.

Shadows mampu membombardir tebing,
menghancurkan dinding, dan\lmembanjiri Laboratorium Penelitian.

entries.original:
"WHAT!?

My data on the Ultimate Weapon has
been destroyed!?"
entries.translation_source: WHAT!? My data on the Ultimate Weapon has been destroyed!?
entries.translated:
APA!? Data saya tentang Senjata
Pamungkas telah dihancurkan!?

entries.original:
"[red]Most of it is too corrupted to be
recovered.

But we did learn something vital
before the attack.

The Ultimate Weapon is no longer in
your home region\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Most of it is too corrupted to be recovered. But we did learn something vital before the attack. The Ultimate Weapon is no longer in your home region[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Sebagian besar terlalu rusak untuk
dipulihkan. Tapi kami mempelajari\lsesuatu yang vital sebelum

serangan. Senjata Utama tidak lagi
berada di region asalmu\.

entries.original:
"Interesting\.\CC0818 we will discuss this
further, once I have dealt with\lthe intruders."
entries.translation_source: Interesting[game-token-1][control-code-2] we will discuss this further, once I have dealt with the intruders.
entries.translated:
Menarik\.\CC0818 kita akan membahas ini
lebih lanjut, setelah saya\lmenangani para penyusup.

entries.original:
"Zeph\.\CC0818 did you really think you would
be able to stop me?

What you have accomplished is no
more than an inconvenience.

No one will stop me, Zeph!
Not even you!

I WILL find the weapon!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph[game-token-1][control-code-2] did you really think you would be able to stop me? What you have accomplished is no more than an inconvenience. No one will stop me, Zeph! Not even you! I WILL find the weapon!
entries.translated:
Zeph\.\CC0818 Apakah kamu benar-benar
berpikir kamu bisa menghentikanku?\lApa yang telah kamu capai tidak

lebih dari sekadar gangguan. Tidak
ada yang akan menghentikanku, Zeph!\lBahkan kamu pun tidak! Aku AKAN

menemukan senjatanya!

entries.original:
"Alright, I held up my end of
the deal, you goon.

I’m pretty sure I found what you’re
looking for\.

But you’re not getting it just yet.

Tell me what I want to know,
and I’ll hand it over. Got it?"
entries.translation_source: Alright, I held up my end of the deal, you goon. I’m pretty sure I found what you’re looking for[game-token-1] But you’re not getting it just yet. Tell me what I want to know, and I’ll hand it over. Got it?
entries.translated:
Baiklah, aku menepati bagianku dari
perjanjian ini, kamu, dasar preman.\lAku cukup yakin aku menemukan apa

yang kamu cari\. Tapi kamu belum
mendapatkannya. Katakan padaku apa\lyang ingin aku ketahui, dan aku

akan menyerahkannya. Paham?

entries.original:
"I have no time for your games,
boy!

Give it to me!"
entries.translation_source: I have no time for your games, boy! Give it to me!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak punya waktu untuk
permainanmu, nak! Berikan padaku!

entries.original:
"No way, old man.

Tell me what you did to my parents,
and it’s all yours."
entries.translation_source: No way, old man. Tell me what you did to my parents, and it’s all yours.
entries.translated:
Tidak mungkin, pak tua. Katakan apa
yang kau lakukan pada orang tuaku,\ldan itu semua milikmu.

entries.original: "Now’s really not the time for\."
entries.translation_source: Now’s really not the time for[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sekarang benar-benar bukan waktunya
untuk\..

entries.original: "ENOUGH! Do you mind?"
entries.translation_source: ENOUGH! Do you mind?
entries.translated: CUKUP! Ada masalah?

entries.original:
"Oh, you must be the big-wig
everyone’s talking about.

Aklove, I’m guessing.

Shut your trap, pal.
I’m not here for you."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you must be the big-wig everyone’s talking about. Aklove, I’m guessing. Shut your trap, pal. I’m not here for you.
entries.translated:
Oh, pasti kamu adalah orang penting
yang dibicarakan semua orang.\lAklove, kukira. Tutup mulutmu,

sobat. Aku di sini bukan untukmu.

entries.original: "How dare you\."
entries.translation_source: How dare you[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Beraninya kau\.

entries.original:
"HOW DARE YOU!

I am a patient man, but I have no
tolerance for your disrespect,\lyou little brat!"
entries.translation_source: HOW DARE YOU! I am a patient man, but I have no tolerance for your disrespect, you little brat!
entries.translated:
BERANINYA KAMU! Aku pria yang
sabar, tapi aku tidak punya\ltoleransi terhadap

ketidakhormatanmu, dasar anak
nakal!

entries.original:
"Hoopa!
Send him to\."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Send him to[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Hoopa! Kirim dia ke\..

entries.original: "[red]Aklove, wait!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Aklove, wait!
entries.translated: [red]Aklove, tunggu!

entries.original:
"[red]Our deal\.\CC0820 don’t forget what you
promised me!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Our deal[game-token-2][control-code-3] don’t forget what you promised me!
entries.translated:
[red]Kesepakatan kita\.\CC0820 jangan lupa apa
yang kau janjikan padaku!

entries.original:
"Our deal\.?

Ha\.\CC0820 ha ha ha ha\.\CC0818 you mean to
tell me THIS is your son?"
entries.translation_source: Our deal[game-token-1]? Ha[game-token-2][control-code-3] ha ha ha ha[game-token-4][control-code-5] you mean to tell me THIS is your son?
entries.translated:
Kesepakatan kita\.? Ha\.\CC0820 ha ha ha ha\.\CC0818
maksudmu mengatakan padaku INI\lanakmu?

entries.original:
"Your son\.?

No\.\CC0820 no, it can’t be\.\CC0818 it has to be
a lie\.!

My parents\.\CC0820 they’d never do such
horrible things\.

They can’t be members of
the Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Your son[game-token-1]? No[game-token-2][control-code-3] no, it can’t be[game-token-4][control-code-5] it has to be a lie[game-token-6]! My parents[game-token-7][control-code-8] they’d never do such horrible things[game-token-9] They can’t be members of the Shadows!
entries.translated:
Anakmu\.? Tidak\.\CC0820 tidak, tidak mungkin\.\CC0818
pasti ini bohong\.! Orang tuaku\.\CC0820\lmereka tidak akan pernah melakukan

hal-hal mengerikan seperti itu\.
Mereka tidak mungkin anggota\lShadows!

entries.original: "Oh, this is just rich, Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, this is just rich, Ivory!
entries.translated: Oh, ini sungguh keterlaluan, Ivory!

entries.original:
"It is exactly as you heard, boy!

Your own parents are villains!"
entries.translation_source: It is exactly as you heard, boy! Your own parents are villains!
entries.translated:
Persis seperti yang kau dengar,
nak! Orang tuamu sendiri adalah\lpenjahat!

entries.original: "Aklove, that’s enough!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove, that’s enough!
entries.translated: Aklove, cukup!

entries.original:
"[rival], we wanted to come home\.

We really did\."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1], we wanted to come home[game-token-2] We really did[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[rival], kami ingin pulang\. Kami
sungguh ingin\.

entries.original:
"\qoJust one more day.\qc

That’s the lie we told ourselves,
over and over.

But after my injury\.\CC0818 I knew the only
way to justify it, was to come\lhome with your brother.

We had to keep going\.\CC0818 so our family
could be whole again\."
entries.translation_source: [quote-open-1]Just one more day.[quote-close-2] That’s the lie we told ourselves, over and over. But after my injury[game-token-3][control-code-4] I knew the only way to justify it, was to come home with your brother. We had to keep going[game-token-5][control-code-6] so our family could be whole again[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
\qoSatu hari lagi saja.\qc Itu bohong
yang kami katakan pada diri\lsendiri, berulang kali. Tapi

setelah cederaku\.\CC0818 aku tahu
satu-satunya cara untuk\lmembenarkannya, adalah pulang

dengan kakakmu. Kami harus terus
berjalan\.\CC0818 agar keluarga kami bisa\lutuh kembali\.

entries.original:
"What kind of stupid logic is that!?
My brother is dead and gone!

What about me?
What about Melony?

Did the lives we had to live matter
to you?

And even all those times I was so
close by\.

You never even reached out to
to say you were okay!"
entries.translation_source: What kind of stupid logic is that!? My brother is dead and gone! What about me? What about Melony? Did the lives we had to live matter to you? And even all those times I was so close by[game-token-1] You never even reached out to to say you were okay!
entries.translated:
Logika bodoh macam apa itu!?
Kakakku sudah mati dan pergi!\lBagaimana denganku? Bagaimana

dengan Melony? Apakah kehidupan
yang harus kami jalani berarti\lbagimu? Dan bahkan semua saat-saat

aku begitu dekat\. Kau bahkan tidak
pernah menghubungi untuk mengatakan\lkau baik-baik saja!

entries.original:
"ENOUGH!

Your incessant blathering is
beginning to irk me."
entries.translation_source: ENOUGH! Your incessant blathering is beginning to irk me.
entries.translated:
CUKUP! Omong kosongmu yang tak
henti-hentinya mulai menggangguku.

entries.original:
"Hoopa, you know what to do
with the boy."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, you know what to do with the boy.
entries.translated:
Hoopa, kau tahu apa yang harus
dilakukan dengan anak itu.

entries.original: "Him as well, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: Him as well, Hoopa.
entries.translated: Dia juga, Hoopa.

entries.original:
"As per your request, Ivory, they
have been sent to a safe location.

They will be out of harm’s way
during the coming ordeal."
entries.translation_source: As per your request, Ivory, they have been sent to a safe location. They will be out of harm’s way during the coming ordeal.
entries.translated:
Sesuai permintaanmu, Ivory, mereka
telah dikirim ke lokasi yang aman.\lMereka akan aman dari bahaya selama

cobaan yang akan datang.

entries.original:
"And where do you think you are
going, Zeph?"
entries.translation_source: And where do you think you are going, Zeph?
entries.translated:
Dan menurutmu kau mau ke mana,
Zeph?

entries.original:
"I know when to cut my losses.

With Marlon and that boy gone,
we’re outmatched."
entries.translation_source: I know when to cut my losses. With Marlon and that boy gone, we’re outmatched.
entries.translated:
Aku tahu kapan harus mengakui
kekalahan. Dengan Marlon dan anak\litu pergi, kita kalah jumlah.

entries.original:
"Hoopa, he wants to be rid of us,
so we ought to return in kind.

Send him to join that Houndoom
of his!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, he wants to be rid of us, so we ought to return in kind. Send him to join that Houndoom of his!
entries.translated:
Hoopa, dia ingin menyingkirkan
kita, jadi kita harus membalas\ldengan setimpal. Kirim dia untuk

bergabung dengan Houndoom miliknya!

entries.original:
"As for you, [player]\.

You have been a constant source of
trouble\.\CC0818 a real thorn in my side.

Hoopa’s Trainer\.\CC0818 and the one who
wishes to seize the title\.

I will crush you here, and in doing
so\.

I will prove Hoopa’s power belongs
only to me!"
entries.translation_source: As for you, [player-name-1][game-token-2] You have been a constant source of trouble[game-token-3][control-code-4] a real thorn in my side. Hoopa’s Trainer[game-token-5][control-code-6] and the one who wishes to seize the title[game-token-7] I will crush you here, and in doing so[game-token-8] I will prove Hoopa’s power belongs only to me!
entries.translated:
Sedangkan kamu, [player]\. Kamu telah
menjadi sumber masalah yang\lterus-menerus\.\CC0818 benar-benar duri di

sisiku. Pelatih Hoopa\.\CC0818 dan orang
yang ingin merebut gelar itu\. Aku\lakan menghancurkanmu di sini, dan

dengan melakukannya\. aku akan
membuktikan bahwa kekuatan Hoopa\lhanya milikku!

entries.original:
"Hoopa, you useless creature!

The only thing you are fit for
is scientific research!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, you useless creature! The only thing you are fit for is scientific research!
entries.translated:
Hoopa, makhluk tak berguna!
Satu-satunya hal yang kau cocok\ladalah penelitian ilmiah!

entries.original:
"[player]!

Your escape from the Cube was my
oversight!

I should have been more thorough
and followed my directions to the\lletter\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Your escape from the Cube was my oversight! I should have been more thorough and followed my directions to the letter[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[player]! Pelarianmu dari Kubus
adalah kelalaianku! Aku seharusnya\llebih teliti dan mengikuti

petunjukku dengan saksama\.

entries.original:
"But I guess it does not matter.
What is done is done.

And unfortunately, I am out of
Pokémon.

So, let us cut a deal.

I have something you may be
greatly invested in\.

Yes\.\CC0818 I am, of course, talking about
your friend - the boy with the\lgreen hat.

I expect you are wondering what
happened to him, are you not?"
entries.translation_source: But I guess it does not matter. What is done is done. And unfortunately, I am out of Pokémon. So, let us cut a deal. I have something you may be greatly invested in[game-token-1] Yes[game-token-2][control-code-3] I am, of course, talking about your friend - the boy with the green hat. I expect you are wondering what happened to him, are you not?
entries.translated:
Tapi kurasa itu tidak masalah. Apa
yang sudah terjadi biarlah terjadi.\lDan sayangnya, aku kehabisan

Pokémon. Jadi, mari kita buat
kesepakatan. Aku punya sesuatu yang\lmungkin sangat kau minati\. Ya\.\CC0818 Aku

tentu saja berbicara tentang
temanmu - anak laki-laki bertopi\lhijau itu. Aku kira kau penasaran

apa yang terjadi padanya, bukan?

entries.original:
"Oh yes\.\CC0818 I know exactly where
he is.

Would you like to meet him?"
entries.translation_source: Oh yes[game-token-1][control-code-2] I know exactly where he is. Would you like to meet him?
entries.translated:
Oh ya\.\CC0818 Aku tahu persis di mana dia.
Apakah kamu ingin bertemu\ldengannya?

entries.original: "Then, in that case\."
entries.translation_source: Then, in that case[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Kalau begitu, dalam hal ini\.

entries.original: "Hoopa, take this for your wounds."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, take this for your wounds.
entries.translated: Hoopa, ambil ini untuk lukamu.

entries.original: "Now, send [player] to join [buffer1] friend!"
entries.translation_source: Now, send [player-name-1] to join [buffer1-2] friend!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, kirim [player] untuk
bergabung dengan teman [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[player]! Is that really you?

I didn’t think I’d see a friendly
face in here.

I don’t know how long I’ve been
here, but it feels like forever\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Is that really you? I didn’t think I’d see a friendly face in here. I don’t know how long I’ve been here, but it feels like forever[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[player]! Apa itu benar-benar kamu?
Aku tidak mengira akan melihat\lwajah ramah di sini. Aku tidak tahu

sudah berapa lama aku di sini, tapi
rasanya seperti selamanya\.

entries.original:
"Huh? How did I get here?

I\.\CC0820 well, it’s\.

When you didn’t come back out of
the ruins, I ran inside to find you.

Next thing I knew, a portal opened
up under me, and I wound up here.

I can’t believe I could have been
so stupid\.

So stupid\.\CC0818 what’s Grampa been
training me for, if I mess up so\leasily when it matters most\.?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? How did I get here? I[game-token-1][control-code-2] well, it’s[game-token-3] When you didn’t come back out of the ruins, I ran inside to find you. Next thing I knew, a portal opened up under me, and I wound up here. I can’t believe I could have been so stupid[game-token-4] So stupid[game-token-5][control-code-6] what’s Grampa been training me for, if I mess up so easily when it matters most[game-token-7]?
entries.translated:
Hah? Bagaimana aku bisa sampai di
sini? Aku\.\CC0820 yah, ini\. Saat kamu tidak\lkembali dari reruntuhan, aku lari

ke dalam untuk mencarimu.
Tiba-tiba, sebuah portal terbuka di\lbawahku, dan aku berakhir di sini.

Aku tidak percaya aku bisa sebodoh
itu\. Bodoh sekali\.\CC0818 untuk apa Kakek\lmelatihku, jika aku begitu mudah

salah ketika itu paling penting\.?

entries.original:
"Hey\.\CC0818 tell me we won against
the Shadows, at least.

Did we save Articuno and Moltres?"
entries.translation_source: Hey[game-token-1][control-code-2] tell me we won against the Shadows, at least. Did we save Articuno and Moltres?
entries.translated:
Hei\.\CC0818 katakan padaku kita menang
melawan Shadow, setidaknya. Apakah\lkita menyelamatkan Articuno dan

Moltres?

entries.original:
"Ahh, who am I kidding?

If you’re stuck in here with me,
things obviously went south."
entries.translation_source: Ahh, who am I kidding? If you’re stuck in here with me, things obviously went south.
entries.translated:
Ahh, siapa yang aku bohongi? Jika
kamu terjebak di sini bersamaku,\lsemuanya jelas menjadi buruk.

entries.original:
"You know what?

You can fill me in on the details
once we find a way out.

For now, let’s just focus on getting
back home.

This place is really confusing, but
I’ve managed to figure out some of\lthe rules here."
entries.translation_source: You know what? You can fill me in on the details once we find a way out. For now, let’s just focus on getting back home. This place is really confusing, but I’ve managed to figure out some of the rules here.
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu? Kamu bisa memberitahuku
detailnya begitu kita menemukan\ljalan keluar. Untuk saat ini, mari

kita fokus untuk pulang ke rumah.
Tempat ini sangat membingungkan,\ltapi aku berhasil memahami beberapa

aturan di sini.

entries.original:
"These rock slabs\.

I’ve noticed they move when you
step on a certain spot."
entries.translation_source: These rock slabs[game-token-1] I’ve noticed they move when you step on a certain spot.
entries.translated:
Batu-batu ini\. Aku perhatikan mereka
bergerak saat kamu menginjak tempat\ltertentu.

entries.original: "Quick, follow me."
entries.translation_source: Quick, follow me.
entries.translated: Cepat, ikuti aku.

entries.original:
"The laws of our world clearly don’t
apply here, so stay sharp.

What you see might not always
be real\."
entries.translation_source: The laws of our world clearly don’t apply here, so stay sharp. What you see might not always be real[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Hukum dunia kita jelas tidak
berlaku di sini, jadi tetap\lwaspada. Apa yang kamu lihat

mungkin tidak selalu nyata\.

entries.original: "Now, do we go this way\.?"
entries.translation_source: Now, do we go this way[game-token-1]?
entries.translated:
Sekarang, apakah kita pergi ke
sini\.?

entries.original: "No, I think it was that way\."
entries.translation_source: No, I think it was that way[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Tidak, aku pikir itu ke sana\.

entries.original:
"Gah! Let’s just split up.

We’ll have better luck finding
the exit apart."
entries.translation_source: Gah! Let’s just split up. We’ll have better luck finding the exit apart.
entries.translated:
Gah! Mari kita berpisah saja. Kita
akan lebih beruntung menemukan\lpintu keluar secara terpisah.

entries.original:
"Let’s split up.

We’ll have better luck finding
the exit apart."
entries.translation_source: Let’s split up. We’ll have better luck finding the exit apart.
entries.translated:
Mari kita berpisah. Kita akan lebih
beruntung menemukan pintu keluar\lsecara terpisah.

entries.original:
"I’ve never been here before,
so this must be the right way!

Let’s continue on, [player]."
entries.translation_source: I’ve never been here before, so this must be the right way! Let’s continue on, [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Aku belum pernah ke sini
sebelumnya, jadi ini pasti jalan\lyang benar! Mari kita lanjutkan,

[player].

entries.original:
"This has to be it\.

I can feel it!"
entries.translation_source: This has to be it[game-token-1] I can feel it!
entries.translated:
Ini pasti dia\. Aku bisa
merasakannya!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.
Something feels off.

This platform seems different than
the other ones.

It didn’t move when I stepped on
the centre spot.

Could we have missed something?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] Something feels off. This platform seems different than the other ones. It didn’t move when I stepped on the centre spot. Could we have missed something?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Sesuatu terasa aneh. Platform
ini tampak berbeda dari yang lain.\lItu tidak bergerak saat aku

menginjak titik tengah. Mungkin
kita melewatkan sesuatu?

entries.original:
"I passed by plenty of boulders on
my way down here.

When I pushed one, another moved at
the same time!

But I noticed that not every
boulder I pushed moved another\.

Could those be the key to moving
this rock slab?"
entries.translation_source: I passed by plenty of boulders on my way down here. When I pushed one, another moved at the same time! But I noticed that not every boulder I pushed moved another[game-token-1] Could those be the key to moving this rock slab?
entries.translated:
Aku melewati banyak batu besar
dalam perjalananku ke sini. Saat\laku mendorong satu, yang lain

bergerak pada saat yang sama! Tapi
aku perhatikan bahwa tidak setiap\lbatu yang aku dorong memindahkan

yang lain\. Mungkin itu adalah kunci
untuk memindahkan lempengan batu\lini?

entries.original:
"This looks like\.\CC0818 the very bottom of
this world.

Well, if you can even call it that\.

But what now?
This place looks like a dead end."
entries.translation_source: This looks like[game-token-1][control-code-2] the very bottom of this world. Well, if you can even call it that[game-token-3] But what now? This place looks like a dead end.
entries.translated:
Ini tampaknya\.\CC0818 bagian paling bawah
dari dunia ini. Yah, jika kau bisa\lmenyebutnya seperti itu\. Tapi

sekarang bagaimana? Tempat ini
terlihat seperti jalan buntu.

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0820 I’m starting to remember now\.

Grampa Arthur told me stories about
a place like this\.

About a world where the laws of
nature have no bounds\.

About a world opposite ours\.

And if what Grampa told me is true,
then there’s only one thing that’s\lliving here\."
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] I’m starting to remember now[game-token-3] Grampa Arthur told me stories about a place like this[game-token-4] About a world where the laws of nature have no bounds[game-token-5] About a world opposite ours[game-token-6] And if what Grampa told me is true, then there’s only one thing that’s living here[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Tunggu\.\CC0820 Aku mulai ingat sekarang\.
Kakek Arthur bercerita tentang\ltempat seperti ini\. Tentang dunia di

mana hukum alam tidak terbatas\.
Tentang dunia yang berlawanan\ldengan kita\. Dan jika apa yang Kakek

katakan benar, maka hanya ada satu
hal yang hidup di sini\.

entries.original:
"That cry!
Did you hear that?

That must have been the Pokémon
Grampa Arthur was talking about!

If anything knows the way out of
here, it’d be that Pokémon!

Let’s go take a closer look!"
entries.translation_source: That cry! Did you hear that? That must have been the Pokémon Grampa Arthur was talking about! If anything knows the way out of here, it’d be that Pokémon! Let’s go take a closer look!
entries.translated:
Teriakan itu! Apakah kau dengar
itu? Itu pasti Pokémon yang\ldibicarakan Kakek Arthur! Jika ada

yang tahu jalan keluar dari sini,
Pokémon itulah! Ayo kita lihat\llebih dekat!

entries.original:
"[player], this is our chance!

I think that Pokémon is up ahead!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], this is our chance! I think that Pokémon is up ahead!
entries.translated:
[player], ini kesempatan kita! Aku
pikir Pokémon itu ada di depan!

entries.original:
"No\.\CC0820 this is a mistake.

What am I thinking?"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1][control-code-2] this is a mistake. What am I thinking?
entries.translated:
Tidak\.\CC0820 ini sebuah kesalahan. Apa
yang kupikirkan?

entries.original:
"If that Pokémon attacks us,
I’ll just get in the way.

But I still have items with me, so
let me heal your Pokémon first."
entries.translation_source: If that Pokémon attacks us, I’ll just get in the way. But I still have items with me, so let me heal your Pokémon first.
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon itu menyerang kita,
aku hanya akan menghalangi. Tapi\laku masih membawa item, jadi

biarkan aku menyembuhkan Pokémon-mu
dulu.

entries.original:
"Be careful, [player].

There’s no telling what that
Pokémon’s capable of."
entries.translation_source: Be careful, [player-name-1]. There’s no telling what that Pokémon’s capable of.
entries.translated:
Berhati-hatilah, [player]. Tidak
ada yang tahu apa kemampuan Pokémon\litu.

entries.original:
"Are you alright, [player]?

That Pokémon did a real number
on you\.

Here, let me heal your Pokémon
for you."
entries.translation_source: Are you alright, [player-name-1]? That Pokémon did a real number on you[game-token-2] Here, let me heal your Pokémon for you.
entries.translated:
Apakah kau baik-baik saja,
[player]? Pokémon itu benar-benar\lmenghajar kau\. Ini, biarkan aku

menyembuhkan Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"That power, that presence\.\CC0820 that was
definitely the ruler of this world!

There’s no doubt about it!
Look ahead!"
entries.translation_source: That power, that presence[game-token-1][control-code-2] that was definitely the ruler of this world! There’s no doubt about it! Look ahead!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan itu, kehadiran itu\.\CC0820 itu
pasti penguasa dunia ini! Tidak ada\lkeraguan tentang itu! Lihat ke

depan!

entries.original:
"Look at that\.\CC0818 it must have decided
to set us free.

That battle must have made a real
impression, somehow.

Now, I don’t know about you, but
I’ve definitely spent way too long\linside here.

I’m taking my chances on that
portal.

Let’s go home, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Look at that[game-token-1][control-code-2] it must have decided to set us free. That battle must have made a real impression, somehow. Now, I don’t know about you, but I’ve definitely spent way too long inside here. I’m taking my chances on that portal. Let’s go home, [player-name-3]!
entries.translated:
Lihat itu\.\CC0818 pasti dia memutuskan
untuk membebaskan kita. Pertarungan\litu pasti memberi kesan yang

mendalam, entah bagaimana.
Sekarang, aku tidak tahu tentangmu,\ltapi aku pasti sudah terlalu lama

di sini. Aku akan mengambil risiko
pada portal itu. Ayo pulang,\l[player]!

entries.original: "Wait\.\CC0820 isn’t this\.?"
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] isn’t this[game-token-3]?
entries.translated: Tunggu\.\CC0820 bukankah ini\.?

entries.original:
"It’s Rift Cave\.\CC0818 then that means\.!

We must be back in our world!

But, why\.?

\.

Ah, right. Rift Cave is also said to
disobey the laws of reality."
entries.translation_source: It’s Rift Cave[game-token-1][control-code-2] then that means[game-token-3]! We must be back in our world! But, why[game-token-4]? [game-token-5] Ah, right. Rift Cave is also said to disobey the laws of reality.
entries.translated:
Ini Gua Rift\.\CC0818 maka itu berarti\.! Kita
pasti sudah kembali ke dunia kita!\lTapi, kenapa\.? \. Ah, benar. Gua Rift

juga dikatakan melanggar hukum
realitas.

entries.original:
"Anyway, now that we made it,
let’s get back to it.

[player]\.\CC0818 what happened back at the
Ruins of Void?

\.

Aklove\.

Then that means we don’t have
a second to spare!"
entries.translation_source: Anyway, now that we made it, let’s get back to it. [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] what happened back at the Ruins of Void? [game-token-4] Aklove[game-token-5] Then that means we don’t have a second to spare!
entries.translated:
Bagaimanapun, sekarang kita
berhasil, mari kembali ke tujuan.\l[player]\.\CC0818 apa yang terjadi di

Reruntuhan Kekosongan? \. Aklove\. Maka
itu berarti kita tidak punya waktu\lsekejap pun!

entries.original: "No\. not this time\."
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] not this time[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Tidak\. bukan kali ini\.

entries.original:
"[player], being trapped in there
taught me a lot of things\.

But most importantly, it’s taught me
I’m nothing without my Pokémon.

I never want to find myself being
so useless to anyone again.

Meet me in Vivill Town.

I promise both my Pokémon and I
will be ready this time."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], being trapped in there taught me a lot of things[game-token-2] But most importantly, it’s taught me I’m nothing without my Pokémon. I never want to find myself being so useless to anyone again. Meet me in Vivill Town. I promise both my Pokémon and I will be ready this time.
entries.translated:
[player], terperangkap di sana
mengajarkanku banyak hal\. Tapi yang\lterpenting, itu mengajarkanku bahwa

aku bukan apa-apa tanpa Pokémon-ku.
Aku tidak ingin merasa tidak\lberguna bagi siapa pun lagi. Temui

aku di Vivill Town. Aku janji baik
Pokémon-ku dan aku akan siap kali\lini.

entries.original:
"[player]! You made it!

I picked up my grandfather on the
way here.

He said he wanted to speak to both
of us."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You made it! I picked up my grandfather on the way here. He said he wanted to speak to both of us.
entries.translated:
[player]! Kau berhasil! Aku
menjemput kakekku dalam perjalanan\lke sini. Dia bilang ingin berbicara

dengan kita berdua.

entries.original:
"Yes, [player], I’m relieved to
see both you and Jax are safe.

You two had me very worried!

While it may not have seemed very
long to you, much time has passed\lhere while you both were in the\lDistortion World."
entries.translation_source: Yes, [player-name-1], I’m relieved to see both you and Jax are safe. You two had me very worried! While it may not have seemed very long to you, much time has passed here while you both were in the Distortion World.
entries.translated:
Ya, [player], aku lega melihat
kalian berdua dan Jax selamat.\lKalian berdua membuatku sangat

khawatir! Meskipun mungkin tidak
terasa lama bagimu, banyak waktu\ltelah berlalu di sini saat kalian

berdua berada di Dunia Distorsi.

entries.original:
"That explains why I hadn’t been
there that long before [player]\lshowed up."
entries.translation_source: That explains why I hadn’t been there that long before [player-name-1] showed up.
entries.translated:
Itu menjelaskan kenapa aku tidak
terlalu lama di sana sebelum\l[player] muncul.

entries.original:
"And as I’m sure you’ve already
guessed, the Light of Ruin is\llong gone.

I witnessed them leave myself,
in fact.

I was keeping a close eye on your
status from Route 2, when I saw.

Hoopa appeared in front of this
warehouse with who I presume to\lbe the Light of Ruin’s leader.

When you didn’t emerge as well,
I feared the worst.

However, I was not given much time
to sail over and see for myself\lbefore their leader and all of his\lunderlings vanished!

Gone!

In the blink of an eye!

With Hoopa already under their
control, I’m at a loss for what\lthis Aklove character could\lbe planning next\."
entries.translation_source: And as I’m sure you’ve already guessed, the Light of Ruin is long gone. I witnessed them leave myself, in fact. I was keeping a close eye on your status from Route 2, when I saw. Hoopa appeared in front of this warehouse with who I presume to be the Light of Ruin’s leader. When you didn’t emerge as well, I feared the worst. However, I was not given much time to sail over and see for myself before their leader and all of his underlings vanished! Gone! In the blink of an eye! With Hoopa already under their control, I’m at a loss for what this Aklove character could be planning next[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dan seperti yang kuyakin sudah kau
duga, Cahaya Kehancuran sudah lama\lpergi. Aku menyaksikan mereka pergi

sendiri, faktanya. Aku mengawasi
statusmu dari Route 2, ketika aku\lmelihat. Hoopa muncul di depan

gudang ini dengan seseorang yang
kukira adalah pemimpin Cahaya\lKehancuran. Saat kau juga tidak

muncul, aku khawatir yang terburuk.
Namun, aku tidak punya banyak waktu\luntuk berlayar dan melihat sendiri

sebelum pemimpin mereka dan semua
bawahannya lenyap! Hilang! Dalam\lsekejap mata! Dengan Hoopa sudah di

bawah kendali mereka, aku bingung
apa yang direncanakan oleh karakter\lAklove ini selanjutnya\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

I’ve been looking everywhere
for you!

Aklove\.\CC0818 he’s\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I’ve been looking everywhere for you! Aklove[game-token-2][control-code-3] he’s[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku mencarimu ke
mana-mana! Aklove\.\CC0818 dia\.

entries.original:
"Young man, what do you know of
the Light of Ruin’s whereabouts?"
entries.translation_source: Young man, what do you know of the Light of Ruin’s whereabouts?
entries.translated:
Anak muda, apa yang kamu ketahui
tentang keberadaan Light of Ruin?

entries.original:
"More than you all, apparently.

When we confronted them, I was sent
to a holding cell in some building\lalong with\.

Along with my dad\.\CC0820 Marlon."
entries.translation_source: More than you all, apparently. When we confronted them, I was sent to a holding cell in some building along with[game-token-1] Along with my dad[game-token-2][control-code-3] Marlon.
entries.translated:
Lebih dari kalian semua, tampaknya.
Ketika kami menghadapi mereka, aku\ldikirim ke sel tahanan di suatu

gedung bersama\. Bersama ayahku\.\CC0820
Marlon.

entries.original: "Marlon is your father!?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon is your father!?
entries.translated: Marlon adalah ayahmu!?

entries.original:
"I don’t know what concern it is to
you, old man, but yeah.

We were locked up for a pretty
long time.

I wouldn’t say anything to him,
though.

I couldn’t.

But when they started moving us
somewhere, I took the opportunity\lto escape.

My dad wasn’t so lucky.

He got shuffled into this big
mountain covered in crystals."
entries.translation_source: I don’t know what concern it is to you, old man, but yeah. We were locked up for a pretty long time. I wouldn’t say anything to him, though. I couldn’t. But when they started moving us somewhere, I took the opportunity to escape. My dad wasn’t so lucky. He got shuffled into this big mountain covered in crystals.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tahu apa urusanmu dengan
ini, pak tua, tapi ya. Kami\ldikurung cukup lama. Aku tidak akan

mengatakan apa pun padanya,
meskipun. Aku tidak bisa. Tapi\lketika mereka mulai memindahkan

kami ke suatu tempat, aku mengambil
kesempatan untuk melarikan diri.\lAyahku tidak seberuntung itu. Dia

dibawa ke gunung besar yang
tertutup kristal.

entries.original:
"Crystal Peak\.

Could that be what they’re after?

No\.\CC0818 no\.\CC0818 there’s little
possibility they know it’s there\."
entries.translation_source: Crystal Peak[game-token-1] Could that be what they’re after? No[game-token-2][control-code-3] no[game-token-4][control-code-5] there’s little possibility they know it’s there[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Crystal Peak\. Mungkinkah itu yang
mereka cari? Tidak\.\CC0818 tidak\.\CC0818 kecil\lkemungkinan mereka tahu itu ada di

sana\.

entries.original:
"What?

What’s at Crystal Peak?"
entries.translation_source: What? What’s at Crystal Peak?
entries.translated: Apa? Ada apa di Crystal Peak?

entries.original:
"We have little time, Jax.

I’ll arrange passage for us to East
Borrius from Seaport City."
entries.translation_source: We have little time, Jax. I’ll arrange passage for us to East Borrius from Seaport City.
entries.translated:
Kita punya sedikit waktu, Jax. Aku
akan mengatur perjalanan untuk kita\lke East Borrius dari Seaport City.

entries.original:
"I don’t need passage!

Tell me what’s at Crystal Peak!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t need passage! Tell me what’s at Crystal Peak!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak butuh perjalanan! Katakan
apa yang ada di Crystal Peak!

entries.original:
"I could be wrong, of course, but
if Aklove’s goal is to cause mass\ldestruction, then he’ll be going\lafter something hidden atop the\lmountain."
entries.translation_source: I could be wrong, of course, but if Aklove’s goal is to cause mass destruction, then he’ll be going after something hidden atop the mountain.
entries.translated:
Aku bisa saja salah, tentu saja,
tapi jika tujuan Aklove adalah\lmenyebabkan kehancuran massal, maka

dia akan mencari sesuatu yang
tersembunyi di puncak gunung.

entries.original:
"What, like the weapon they keep
blabbing on about?"
entries.translation_source: What, like the weapon they keep blabbing on about?
entries.translated:
Apa, seperti senjata yang terus
mereka ocehkan?

entries.original: "So I’m correct, after all\."
entries.translation_source: So I’m correct, after all[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Jadi aku benar, ternyata\.

entries.original:
"I have kept this information secret
for many years\.

But I see no choice other than
to reveal it now.

The weapon Aklove has been
searching for\.

The weapon I presume Aklove hoped
Hoopa would bring him\.

It was already brought to Borrius
3000 years ago."
entries.translation_source: I have kept this information secret for many years[game-token-1] But I see no choice other than to reveal it now. The weapon Aklove has been searching for[game-token-2] The weapon I presume Aklove hoped Hoopa would bring him[game-token-3] It was already brought to Borrius 3000 years ago.
entries.translated:
Aku telah merahasiakan informasi
ini selama bertahun-tahun\. Tapi aku\ltidak punya pilihan selain

mengungkapkannya sekarang. Senjata
yang dicari Aklove\. Senjata yang\lkukira Aklove harapkan akan

dibawakan Hoopa untuknya\. Itu sudah
dibawa ke Borrius 3000 tahun yang\llalu.

entries.original:
"Young man, what do you plan to
do now?"
entries.translation_source: Young man, what do you plan to do now?
entries.translated: Anak muda, apa rencanamu sekarang?

entries.original:
"Well\.\CC0818 I haven’t really thought
about it.

I finally found what I was looking
for, and it was the last thing I\lcould’ve wanted\.

All I can say is if Aklove plans
to destroy Borrius with some\lweapon, he’s gotta go through\lme, first.

I haven’t decided if I want to be
with my parents, but if I do, I’d\lwant to be with them here.

I’ve really started to take a
liking to Borrius, you know?

And no one, and I mean NO ONE, will
ever take my parents from me again."
entries.translation_source: Well[game-token-1][control-code-2] I haven’t really thought about it. I finally found what I was looking for, and it was the last thing I could’ve wanted[game-token-3] All I can say is if Aklove plans to destroy Borrius with some weapon, he’s gotta go through me, first. I haven’t decided if I want to be with my parents, but if I do, I’d want to be with them here. I’ve really started to take a liking to Borrius, you know? And no one, and I mean NO ONE, will ever take my parents from me again.
entries.translated:
Yah\.\CC0818 Aku belum benar-benar
memikirkannya. Aku akhirnya\lmenemukan apa yang aku cari, dan

itu adalah hal terakhir yang
kuinginkan\. Yang bisa kukatakan\ladalah jika Aklove berencana

menghancurkan Borrius dengan suatu
senjata, dia harus melewati diriku\ldulu. Aku belum memutuskan apakah

aku ingin bersama orang tuaku, tapi
jika iya, aku ingin bersama mereka\ldi sini. Aku benar-benar mulai

menyukai Borrius, kamu tahu? Dan
tidak ada siapa pun, dan maksudku\lTIDAK ADA SEORANGPUN, yang akan

mengambil orang tuaku dariku lagi.

entries.original: "Toucannon! Let’s get a move on!"
entries.translation_source: Toucannon! Let’s get a move on!
entries.translated: Toucannon! Ayo kita berangkat!

entries.original: "Wait!"
entries.translation_source: Wait!
entries.translated: Tunggu!

entries.original:
"There’s no point in rushing in
there without a plan.

We need everyone ready.

We’re going to hit them with
everything we’ve got."
entries.translation_source: There’s no point in rushing in there without a plan. We need everyone ready. We’re going to hit them with everything we’ve got.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada gunanya bergegas ke sana
tanpa rencana. Kita perlu semua\lorang siap. Kita akan menyerang

mereka dengan segala yang kita
punya.

entries.original: "Yeah, yeah, I got that."
entries.translation_source: Yeah, yeah, I got that.
entries.translated: Ya, ya, aku mengerti.

entries.original:
"So [player], get to [green]Seaport City[blue]
ASAP!

If you can’t fly yet, the quickest
way there would be to earn the\l[green]Antisis City[blue] Gym Badge, and then\lhead east along [green]Route 17[blue].

While you’re making your way over,
Grampa Arthur and I will see what\lwe can come up with."
entries.translation_source: So [player-name-1], get to [color-green-2]Seaport City[color-blue-3] ASAP! If you can’t fly yet, the quickest way there would be to earn the [color-green-4]Antisis City[color-blue-5] Gym Badge, and then head east along [color-green-6]Route 17[color-blue-7]. While you’re making your way over, Grampa Arthur and I will see what we can come up with.
entries.translated:
Jadi [player], pergilah ke [green]Seaport
City[blue] secepat mungkin! Jika kamu\lbelum bisa terbang, cara tercepat

ke sana adalah mendapatkan [green]Antisis
City[blue] Gym Badge, lalu ke timur\lmenyusuri [green]Route 17[blue]. Selagi kamu

dalam perjalanan, Kakek Arthur dan
aku akan memikirkan sesuatu.

entries.original: "Alright, Grampa Arthur, you ready?"
entries.translation_source: Alright, Grampa Arthur, you ready?
entries.translated: Baiklah, Kakek Arthur, kamu siap?

entries.original:
"As ready as I’ll ever be!

This sure brings me back!"
entries.translation_source: As ready as I’ll ever be! This sure brings me back!
entries.translated:
Sesiap yang aku bisa! Ini
benar-benar mengingatkanku kembali!

entries.original: "Staraptor! Take us to [green]Seaport City[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! Take us to [color-green-1]Seaport City[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Staraptor! Bawa kami ke [green]Seaport
City[blue]!

entries.original: "Clerk"
entries.translation_source: Clerk
entries.translated: Pegawai

entries.original:
"What do you mean, the ship’s not
running?

We need to get to Polder Town
ASAP!

The fate of Borrius depends on it!"
entries.translation_source: What do you mean, the ship’s not running? We need to get to Polder Town ASAP! The fate of Borrius depends on it!
entries.translated:
Apa maksudmu, kapalnya tidak
beroperasi? Kita harus sampai ke\lPolder Town sesegera mungkin! Nasib

Borrius tergantung pada ini!

entries.original:
"Look, mate.

I told you already, I’m sorry, but
it can’t be helped.

The ship’s having engine troubles,
and there’s not a thing I can do.

But a friend of mine who owes me
a favor can take you to Polder\lTown, if it’s that urgent.

He can be found on the docks north
of here.

Show him one of these S.S. Tickets,
tell him I sent you, and he should\ltake you there."
entries.translation_source: Look, mate. I told you already, I’m sorry, but it can’t be helped. The ship’s having engine troubles, and there’s not a thing I can do. But a friend of mine who owes me a favor can take you to Polder Town, if it’s that urgent. He can be found on the docks north of here. Show him one of these S.S. Tickets, tell him I sent you, and he should take you there.
entries.translated:
Dengar, kawan. Sudah kubilang,
maaf, tapi tidak ada yang bisa\ldilakukan. Kapal ini mengalami

masalah mesin, dan tidak ada yang
bisa aku lakukan. Tapi seorang\ltemanku yang berutang budi padaku

bisa membawamu ke Polder Town, jika
itu sangat mendesak. Dia bisa\lditemukan di dermaga sebelah utara

sini. Tunjukkan padanya salah satu
Tiket S.S. ini, bilang aku yang\lmengutusmu, dan dia akan membawamu

ke sana.

entries.original:
"If that’ll get us there quickly,
let’s do that."
entries.translation_source: If that’ll get us there quickly, let’s do that.
entries.translated:
Kalau itu bisa membawa kita ke sana
dengan cepat, ayo lakukan itu.

entries.original:
"You got that, [player]?

Meet us at the boat on the docks
[green]north[blue] of here.

We’ll go on ahead and board without
you, so there’s no delay.

Oh, right - take this ticket so you
can get on the boat, too."
entries.translation_source: You got that, [player-name-1]? Meet us at the boat on the docks [color-green-2]north[color-blue-3] of here. We’ll go on ahead and board without you, so there’s no delay. Oh, right - take this ticket so you can get on the boat, too.
entries.translated:
Kamu mengerti, [player]? Temui kami
di kapal di dermaga [green]utara[blue] dari\lsini. Kami akan pergi duluan dan

naik kapal tanpa kamu, jadi tidak
ada penundaan. Oh, benar - ambil\ltiket ini agar kamu juga bisa naik

kapal.

entries.original: "We’ve made it\.\CC0818 it’s East Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: We’ve made it[game-token-1][control-code-2] it’s East Borrius!
entries.translated: Kita berhasil\.\CC0818 ini Borrius Timur!

entries.original: "Huh? Up there\.\CC0818 above Crystal Peak\.!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? Up there[game-token-1][control-code-2] above Crystal Peak[game-token-3]!
entries.translated:
Huh? Di atas sana\.\CC0818 di atas Crystal
Peak\.!

entries.original:
"Grampa Arthur, we need to head for
Crystal Peak.

That’s no ordinary storm brewing
above the mountain.

They must be getting the Ultimate
Weapon ready to destroy Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Grampa Arthur, we need to head for Crystal Peak. That’s no ordinary storm brewing above the mountain. They must be getting the Ultimate Weapon ready to destroy Borrius!
entries.translated:
Kakek Arthur, kita harus menuju ke
Crystal Peak. Itu bukan badai biasa\lyang berkumpul di atas gunung.

Mereka pasti sedang menyiapkan
Senjata Pamungkas untuk\lmenghancurkan Borrius!

entries.original:
"I concur, Jax.

Let’s make haste towards the
mountain.

We have to put an end to the Light
of Ruin’s schemes and save Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: I concur, Jax. Let’s make haste towards the mountain. We have to put an end to the Light of Ruin’s schemes and save Borrius!
entries.translated:
Saya setuju, Jax. Mari kita
bergegas menuju gunung. Kita harus\lmenghentikan skema Light of Ruin

dan menyelamatkan Borrius!

entries.original:
"Grampa and I will go on ahead to
the top of Crystal Peak, [player].

We can’t run in blind on this one,
so we’ll come up with a plan to\lstop their big scheme.

Follow us up as fast as you can,
okay?

In order to reach the top of
Crystal Peak, you’ll need the\lability to climb waterfalls\.

\.

Yeah\.\CC0818 that look on your face says
you know\.\CC0818 it’s the story of your\lentire Gym Challenge\.

That’s right\.\CC0818 you need [green]Polder Town[blue]’s
Gym Badge, and the HM for it.

But anyway, once you’ve done that,
make a beeline for [green]Crystal Peak[blue].

Got it?
See you there, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Grampa and I will go on ahead to the top of Crystal Peak, [player-name-1]. We can’t run in blind on this one, so we’ll come up with a plan to stop their big scheme. Follow us up as fast as you can, okay? In order to reach the top of Crystal Peak, you’ll need the ability to climb waterfalls[game-token-2] [game-token-3] Yeah[game-token-4][control-code-5] that look on your face says you know[game-token-6][control-code-7] it’s the story of your entire Gym Challenge[game-token-8] That’s right[game-token-9][control-code-10] you need [color-green-11]Polder Town[color-blue-12]’s Gym Badge, and the HM for it. But anyway, once you’ve done that, make a beeline for [color-green-13]Crystal Peak[color-blue-14]. Got it? See you there, [player-name-15].
entries.translated:
Kakek dan aku akan pergi duluan ke
puncak Crystal Peak, [player]. Kita\ltidak bisa menerobos secara buta

kali ini, jadi kita akan menyusun
rencana untuk menghentikan rencana\lbesar mereka. Ikuti kami secepat

mungkin, oke? Untuk mencapai puncak
Crystal Peak, kamu akan membutuhkan\lkemampuan untuk memanjat air terjun\.

\. Ya\.\CC0818 tatapan di wajahmu itu
mengatakan kamu tahu\.\CC0818 itu adalah\lcerita dari seluruh Tantangan

Gym-mu\. Benar\.\CC0818 kamu membutuhkan
[green]Polder Town[blue]{B4}s Lencana Gym, dan HM\luntuk itu. Tapi bagaimanapun,

setelah kamu melakukannya, langsung
menuju ke [green]Crystal Peak[blue]. Mengerti?\lSampai jumpa di sana, [player].

entries.original:
"[player]!
What took you so long?

That Jax guy and his grandpa ran
into me on my way up.

They told me to wait here for you,
saying it shouldn’t take too long\lfor you to join the fight.

Well, I figured I’d have an easier
time getting up the mountain with\lyou, anyway, so here I am.

The place is crawling with Light of
Ruin goons after all, so it’s not so\leasy to climb solo right now.

But before we go\.\CC0818 battle me.

Just a quick check to make sure
you’re ready.

I’ll know if you’re strong enough
to be my climbing buddy!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! What took you so long? That Jax guy and his grandpa ran into me on my way up. They told me to wait here for you, saying it shouldn’t take too long for you to join the fight. Well, I figured I’d have an easier time getting up the mountain with you, anyway, so here I am. The place is crawling with Light of Ruin goons after all, so it’s not so easy to climb solo right now. But before we go[game-token-2][control-code-3] battle me. Just a quick check to make sure you’re ready. I’ll know if you’re strong enough to be my climbing buddy!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kenapa lama sekali? Orang
bernama Jax itu dan kakeknya\lberpapasan denganku dalam

perjalananku ke atas. Mereka
menyuruhku menunggumu di sini,\lbilang bahwa seharusnya tidak butuh

waktu lama bagimu untuk ikut
bertarung. Yah, aku pikir akan\llebih mudah mendaki gunung

bersamamu, jadi di sinilah aku.
Tempat ini dipenuhi antek-antek\lCahaya Kehancuran, jadi tidak mudah

mendaki sendirian sekarang. Tapi
sebelum kita pergi\.\CC0818 bertarunglah\ldenganku. Hanya cek cepat untuk

memastikan kamu siap. Aku akan tahu
apakah kamu cukup kuat untuk\lmenjadi teman mendakiku!

entries.original:
"Man\. what was I even worried about?
Of course you’re ready!"
entries.translation_source: Man[game-token-1] what was I even worried about? Of course you’re ready!

entries.original:
"You might be ready to climb the
mountain, but I guess I’m not.

Let me grab some different Pokémon
from the PC real quick."
entries.translation_source: You might be ready to climb the mountain, but I guess I’m not. Let me grab some different Pokémon from the PC real quick.
entries.translated:
Kamu mungkin sudah siap mendaki
gunung, tapi kurasa aku belum.\lBiarkan aku mengambil beberapa

Pokémon lain dari PC sebentar.

entries.original: "Alright, I’m back."
entries.translation_source: Alright, I’m back.
entries.translated: Baiklah, aku kembali.

entries.original:
"Let’s make our way to the top as
quick as possible.

I’ll keep your Pokémon healed up
on the way."
entries.translation_source: Let’s make our way to the top as quick as possible. I’ll keep your Pokémon healed up on the way.
entries.translated:
Mari kita menuju puncak secepat
mungkin. Aku akan menyembuhkan\lPokémonmu di sepanjang jalan.

entries.original:
"You ready to keep going up the
mountain, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: You ready to keep going up the mountain, [player-name-1]?
entries.translated:
Kamu siap untuk terus naik gunung,
[player]?

entries.original:
"[black][player] decided to go with
[rival]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] decided to go with [text-token-rival-3]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] memutuskan untuk pergi
bersama [rival]!

entries.original:
"[black]While teamed up with [rival], the
[green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle.

[rival] is also capable of using
Surf and Rock Climb."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]While teamed up with [text-token-rival-2], the [color-green-3]first 3[color-black-4] viable Pokémon in your party will be selected for battle. [text-token-rival-5] is also capable of using Surf and Rock Climb.
entries.translated:
[black]Saat bekerjasama dengan [rival], [green]3
Pokémon pertama[black] yang layak di dalam\ltimmu akan dipilih untuk bertarung.

[rival] juga dapat menggunakan
Surf dan Rock Climb.

entries.original:
"Hurry up, [player].
There’s no time to waste!"
entries.translation_source: Hurry up, [player-name-1]. There’s no time to waste!
entries.translated:
Cepat, [player]. Tidak ada waktu
untuk disia-siakan!

entries.original:
"Let’s make our way to the top as
quick as possible.

Those Light of Ruin guys don’t
stand a chance against both of us!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s make our way to the top as quick as possible. Those Light of Ruin guys don’t stand a chance against both of us!
entries.translated:
Ayo kita menuju ke puncak secepat
mungkin. Orang-orang Light of Ruin\litu tidak akan sanggup melawan kita

berdua!

entries.original:
"Man\.\CC0818 Ivory is REALLY starting to
get on my nerves\.

I couldn’t wait to meet my parents
just a short while ago, but it’s\llike she doesn’t even care about\lme or my sister one bit!

What’s her problem?"
entries.translation_source: Man[game-token-1][control-code-2] Ivory is REALLY starting to get on my nerves[game-token-3] I couldn’t wait to meet my parents just a short while ago, but it’s like she doesn’t even care about me or my sister one bit! What’s her problem?
entries.translated:
Wah\.\CC0818 Ivory benar-benar mulai
membuatku kesal\. Aku tidak sabar\luntuk bertemu orang tuaku beberapa

waktu lalu, tapi sepertinya dia
tidak peduli sedikit pun padaku\latau adikku! Ada apa dengan dia?

entries.original:
"We’ve almost made it to the top,
[player]!

We just need to figure out a way to
get past those goons without being\lspotted by them.

If only we could somehow push
something in front of them to block\ltheir view\."
entries.translation_source: We’ve almost made it to the top, [player-name-1]! We just need to figure out a way to get past those goons without being spotted by them. If only we could somehow push something in front of them to block their view[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Kita hampir sampai di puncak,
[player]! Kita hanya perlu mencari\lcara untuk melewati para preman itu

tanpa terlihat oleh mereka. Andai
saja kita bisa mendorong sesuatu di\ldepan mereka untuk menghalangi

pandangan mereka\.

entries.original:
"This seems like the top of the
mountain, [player]!

Just a little more and we can stop
Aklove!"
entries.translation_source: This seems like the top of the mountain, [player-name-1]! Just a little more and we can stop Aklove!
entries.translated:
Ini tampaknya puncak gunung,
[player]! Sedikit lagi dan kita\lbisa menghentikan Aklove!

entries.original:
"Where are you going, [player]?

Do you need to head back to town to
