get supplies or something?"
entries.translation_source: Where are you going, [player-name-1]? Do you need to head back to town to get supplies or something?
entries.translated:
Mau ke mana, [player]? Apakah kamu
perlu kembali ke kota untuk\lmengambil persediaan atau sesuatu?

entries.original:
"Hurry back, [player].
There’s no time to waste!"
entries.translation_source: Hurry back, [player-name-1]. There’s no time to waste!
entries.translated:
Cepat kembali, [player]. Tidak ada
waktu untuk disia-siakan!

entries.original:
"Wha-? These Pokémon\.

That Aklove guy must have had Hoopa
set this trap to slow us down!

But we can’t stop moving now!

C’mon, [player]! Let’s blast through
these things and get to the summit!"
entries.translation_source: Wha-? These Pokémon[game-token-1] That Aklove guy must have had Hoopa set this trap to slow us down! But we can’t stop moving now! C’mon, [player-name-2]! Let’s blast through these things and get to the summit!
entries.translated:
Apa-? Pokémon ini\. Orang Aklove itu
pasti menyuruh Hoopa memasang\ljebakan ini untuk memperlambat

kita! Tapi kita tidak bisa berhenti
sekarang! Ayo, [player]! Hancurkan\lmakhluk-makhluk ini dan sampai ke

puncak!

entries.original:
"How’s that!
As if that was ever gonna stop us!"
entries.translation_source: How’s that! As if that was ever gonna stop us!
entries.translated:
Gimana rasanya! Seolah itu bisa
menghentikan kita!

entries.original:
"You! You’re still here!?

Why? Why would you ever do any
of this!?

There’s no point helping out that
Aklove goon!"
entries.translation_source: You! You’re still here!? Why? Why would you ever do any of this!? There’s no point helping out that Aklove goon!
entries.translated:
Kau! Kau masih di sini!? Kenapa?
Kenapa kau melakukan semua ini!?\lTidak ada gunanya membantu preman

Aklove itu!

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry, [rival]\.

I\.\CC0820 I can’t go back on our
deal now.

When the dust finally clears, you’ll
see that it was worth it\.

In the meantime, I\.\CC0820 I’m just
glad to know that you returned.

Stay here, where you’ll be safe from
the fallout."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’m sorry, [text-token-rival-2][game-token-3] I[game-token-4][control-code-5] I can’t go back on our deal now. When the dust finally clears, you’ll see that it was worth it[game-token-6] In the meantime, I[game-token-7][control-code-8] I’m just glad to know that you returned. Stay here, where you’ll be safe from the fallout.
entries.translated:
[red]Maaf, [rival]\. Aku\.\CC0820 Aku tidak bisa
mengingkari kesepakatan kita\lsekarang. Saat semuanya sudah

tenang, kau akan melihat bahwa ini
sepadan\. Sementara itu, aku\.\CC0820 Aku\lhanya senang mengetahui bahwa kau

kembali. Tetap di sini, di mana kau
akan aman dari dampaknya.

entries.original:
"I didn’t come back because I wanted
to be safe!

I came back to stop the destruction
you’re planning!

This whole time, I wanted you and
dad to come back, so we could be\la family again.

And now, as soon as I find you,
you think you can get away with\lsomething like this!?

No way!

You’ve already destroyed one home
when you left us.

I won’t let you destroy another!"
entries.translation_source: I didn’t come back because I wanted to be safe! I came back to stop the destruction you’re planning! This whole time, I wanted you and dad to come back, so we could be a family again. And now, as soon as I find you, you think you can get away with something like this!? No way! You’ve already destroyed one home when you left us. I won’t let you destroy another!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak kembali karena ingin
aman! Aku kembali untuk\lmenghentikan kehancuran yang kau

rencanakan! Selama ini, aku ingin
kau dan ayah kembali, agar kita\lbisa menjadi keluarga lagi. Dan

sekarang, begitu aku menemukanmu,
kau pikir kau bisa lolos dengan hal\lseperti ini!? Tidak mungkin! Kau

sudah menghancurkan satu rumah saat
kau meninggalkan kami. Aku tidak\lakan membiarkanmu menghancurkan

yang lain!

entries.original:
"[red]If it were up to me, we wouldn’t
be destroying anything, [rival].

But this is the only way\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]If it were up to me, we wouldn’t be destroying anything, [text-token-rival-2]. But this is the only way[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[red]Jika terserah padaku, kita tidak
akan menghancurkan apa pun,\l[rival]. Tapi ini satu-satunya

cara\.

entries.original:
"[red]Alakazam!
Immobilize him!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Alakazam! Immobilize him!
entries.translated: [red]Alakazam! Lumpuhkan dia!

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry, [rival]\.\CC0818 but this is for
your own good.

Stay here and out of harm’s way,
until we’re finished at the summit."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’m sorry, [text-token-rival-2][game-token-3][control-code-4] but this is for your own good. Stay here and out of harm’s way, until we’re finished at the summit.
entries.translated:
[red]Maaf, [rival]\.\CC0818 tapi ini demi
kebaikanmu sendiri. Tetap di sini\ldan jauh dari bahaya, sampai kami

selesai di puncak.

entries.original:
"[red]What about you, [player]?

I suppose it’s too much to hope
you’ll turn back?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]What about you, [player-name-2]? I suppose it’s too much to hope you’ll turn back?
entries.translated:
[red]Bagaimana denganmu, [player]?
Kurasa terlalu berharap kau akan\lmundur?

entries.original:
"Ngh\.\CC0818 [player]\.\CC0818 take\.\CC0818 my Pokémon\.

I can’t fight\.\CC0818 but\.\CC0818 they’ll back
you up\."
entries.translation_source: Ngh[game-token-1][control-code-2] [player-name-3][game-token-4][control-code-5] take[game-token-6][control-code-7] my Pokémon[game-token-8] I can’t fight[game-token-9][control-code-10] but[game-token-11][control-code-12] they’ll back you up[game-token-13]
entries.translated:
Ngh\.\CC0818 [player]\.\CC0818 ambillah\.\CC0818 Pokémon-ku\.
Aku tidak bisa bertarung\.\CC0818 tapi\.\CC0818\lmereka akan mendukungmu\.

entries.original:
"[black][rival] is lending you his
Toucannon, Vaporeon, and Mamoswine\lfor your fight with Ivory!

When the battle starts, they will
automatically join your team."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][text-token-rival-2] is lending you his Toucannon, Vaporeon, and Mamoswine for your fight with Ivory! When the battle starts, they will automatically join your team.
entries.translated:
[black][rival] meminjamkan Toucannon,
Vaporeon, dan Mamoswine miliknya\luntuk pertarunganmu melawan Ivory!

Saat pertarungan dimulai, mereka
akan otomatis bergabung dengan\ltimmu.

entries.original:
"[red]So, I suppose you’ll follow this
path no matter what\.

Very well, then\. I only need to
hold you off just long enough\.

Until Aklove is finished, you shall
not pass!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]So, I suppose you’ll follow this path no matter what[game-token-2] Very well, then[game-token-3] I only need to hold you off just long enough[game-token-4] Until Aklove is finished, you shall not pass!
entries.translated:
[red]Jadi, kurasa kau akan mengikuti
jalan ini apa pun yang terjadi\.\lBaiklah, kalau begitu\. Aku hanya

perlu menahanmu cukup lama\. Sampai
Aklove selesai, kau tidak akan\llewat!

entries.original:
"[red]As I thought\.\CC0818 this was all I could
do to stall you.

However, the preparations must be
almost complete by now.

All I can do is hope the remaining
Grunts above us can hold you off\lfor just long enough.

Farewell\.\CC0818 [player], [rival]."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]As I thought[game-token-2][control-code-3] this was all I could do to stall you. However, the preparations must be almost complete by now. All I can do is hope the remaining Grunts above us can hold you off for just long enough. Farewell[game-token-4][control-code-5] [player-name-6], [text-token-rival-7].
entries.translated:
[red]Seperti yang kuduga\.\CC0818 ini yang bisa
kulakukan untuk menahanmu. Namun,\lpersiapan pasti hampir selesai

sekarang. Yang bisa kulakukan
hanyalah berharap para Grunt yang\ltersisa di atas kita bisa menahanmu

cukup lama. Selamat tinggal\.\CC0818
[player], [rival].

entries.original:
"Alright, I’m good.

Let’s keep going, and finish this
once and for all!"
entries.translation_source: Alright, I’m good. Let’s keep going, and finish this once and for all!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, aku baik-baik saja. Ayo
terus maju, dan selesaikan ini\luntuk selamanya!

entries.original:
"Come on, Krookodile\.

Just pick up that boulder and move
it to the side."
entries.translation_source: Come on, Krookodile[game-token-1] Just pick up that boulder and move it to the side.
entries.translated:
Ayo, Krookodile\. Angkat saja batu
itu dan pindahkan ke samping.

entries.original:
"No, Krookodile!
You can’t push it!

There’s a rock in the way!

Argh\.\CC0818 if only one of my Pokémon
knew Dig\."
entries.translation_source: No, Krookodile! You can’t push it! There’s a rock in the way! Argh[game-token-1][control-code-2] if only one of my Pokémon knew Dig[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tidak, Krookodile! Kamu tidak bisa
mendorongnya! Ada batu di jalan!\lArgh\.\CC0818 seandainya saja salah satu

Pokémon-ku tahu Dig\.

entries.original: "Hey! I told you I’d come back!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! I told you I’d come back!
entries.translated: Hei! Aku bilang aku akan kembali!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]! Use [buffer2]!
Help him out of there!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! Use [buffer2-2]! Help him out of there!
entries.translated:
[buffer1]! Gunakan [buffer2]! Bantu
dia keluar dari sana!

entries.original:
"It’s good to see you again, [rival].

Have you given any thought on what
I told you, at all?"
entries.translation_source: It’s good to see you again, [text-token-rival-1]. Have you given any thought on what I told you, at all?
entries.translated:
Senang melihatmu lagi, [rival].
Sudahkah kamu memikirkan apa yang\laku katakan padamu?

entries.original:
"Yeah, and I believe you.

But that doesn’t mean I’ve forgiven
you for leaving us behind in Hoenn."
entries.translation_source: Yeah, and I believe you. But that doesn’t mean I’ve forgiven you for leaving us behind in Hoenn.
entries.translated:
Ya, dan aku percaya padamu. Tapi
itu tidak berarti aku sudah\lmemaafkanmu karena meninggalkan

kami di Hoenn.

entries.original:
"I can’t apologize enough for that,
[rival]\.

And I don’t expect you to ever
forgive us for what we did\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t apologize enough for that, [text-token-rival-1][game-token-2] And I don’t expect you to ever forgive us for what we did[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Saya tidak bisa cukup meminta maaf
untuk itu, [rival]\. Dan saya tidak\lmengharapkan kamu untuk memaafkan

kami atas apa yang kami lakukan\.

entries.original:
"Still\.\CC0820 I’m willing to give it
another shot.

At least you’re not trying to blow
everything up, like Ivory."
entries.translation_source: Still[game-token-1][control-code-2] I’m willing to give it another shot. At least you’re not trying to blow everything up, like Ivory.
entries.translated:
Tetap\.\CC0820 aku mau mencoba lagi.
Setidaknya kamu tidak mencoba\lmeledakkan semuanya, seperti Ivory.

entries.original:
"Ha ha\.\CC0818 appreciated, [rival],
despite the low-hanging fruit.

I swear I will do everything I can
to atone, for as long as I live.

And speaking of your mother, she
informed me that Aklove is almost\lready to fire the Ultimate Weapon.

Thankfully, we’re not too far from
the summit.

However, getting to the top is a bit
less simple\."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha[game-token-1][control-code-2] appreciated, [text-token-rival-3], despite the low-hanging fruit. I swear I will do everything I can to atone, for as long as I live. And speaking of your mother, she informed me that Aklove is almost ready to fire the Ultimate Weapon. Thankfully, we’re not too far from the summit. However, getting to the top is a bit less simple[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Ha ha\.\CC0818 dihargai, [rival], meskipun
itu buah yang mudah dipetik. Aku\lbersumpah akan melakukan semua yang

bisa kulakukan untuk menebus
kesalahan, selama aku hidup. Dan\lberbicara tentang ibumu, dia

memberitahuku bahwa Aklove hampir
siap untuk menembakkan Senjata\lPamungkas. Untungnya, kita tidak

terlalu jauh dari puncak. Namun,
mencapai puncak agak tidak\lsederhana\.

entries.original:
"Why? There can’t be any more than a
couple of goons left."
entries.translation_source: Why? There can’t be any more than a couple of goons left.
entries.translated:
Kenapa? Pasti tidak ada lebih dari
beberapa preman yang tersisa.

entries.original:
"Those grunts are exactly the
problem\.

I’m not sure how, but whenever
they locked eyes with me\.

\.my body froze up, and they just
threw me back in the cell.

Unless you can sneak past them
somehow\."
entries.translation_source: Those grunts are exactly the problem[game-token-1] I’m not sure how, but whenever they locked eyes with me[game-token-2] [game-token-3]my body froze up, and they just threw me back in the cell. Unless you can sneak past them somehow[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Para grunt itu memang masalahnya\.
Aku tidak yakin bagaimana, tapi\lsetiap kali mereka bertatapan

denganku\. \.tubuhku membeku, dan
mereka hanya melemparku kembali ke\lsel. Kecuali jika kamu bisa

menyelinap melewati mereka entah
bagaimana\.

entries.original:
"And we’ll find that \qosomehow\qc.

[player] and I got this far up on
our own, didn’t we?

Even if we can’t just fight our way
past, we’ll find an answer!"
entries.translation_source: And we’ll find that [quote-open-1]somehow[quote-close-2]. [player-name-3] and I got this far up on our own, didn’t we? Even if we can’t just fight our way past, we’ll find an answer!
entries.translated:
Dan kita akan menemukan bahwa
\qoentah bagaimana\qc. [player] dan aku\lberhasil sampai sejauh ini sendiri,

bukan? Meskipun kita tidak bisa
sekadar bertarung melewati, kita\lakan menemukan jawaban!

entries.original:
"Just be careful, [rival].

I’ll wait here with Melony until
you figure out a way past.

Oh, and give the item we asked
you to find in the warehouse to\l[player], will you?

It should help you deal with Aklove
if he tries anything at the summit."
entries.translation_source: Just be careful, [text-token-rival-1]. I’ll wait here with Melony until you figure out a way past. Oh, and give the item we asked you to find in the warehouse to [player-name-2], will you? It should help you deal with Aklove if he tries anything at the summit.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati saja, [rival]. Aku akan
menunggu di sini bersama Melony\lsampai kamu menemukan cara untuk

melewatinya. Oh, dan berikan barang
yang kami minta kamu cari di gudang\lkepada [player], ya? Itu seharusnya

membantumu menghadapi Aklove jika
dia mencoba melakukan sesuatu di\lpuncak.

entries.original:
"Here, [player].
You’ll need this."
entries.translation_source: Here, [player-name-1]. You’ll need this.
entries.translated:
Ini, [player]. Kamu akan
membutuhkan ini.

entries.original:
"Apparently, that’s the only thing
that can seal the dark force away\lagain, so don’t drop it.

Let’s go, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Apparently, that’s the only thing that can seal the dark force away again, so don’t drop it. Let’s go, [player-name-1]!
entries.translated:
Tampaknya, itu satu-satunya hal
yang dapat menyegel kekuatan gelap\litu lagi, jadi jangan jatuhkan.

Ayo, [player]!

entries.original:
"If you can find something to
obscure that grunt’s vision,\lthere’s a chance he won’t notice\lif you try to sneak past."
entries.translation_source: If you can find something to obscure that grunt’s vision, there’s a chance he won’t notice if you try to sneak past.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa menemukan sesuatu
untuk menghalangi pandangan preman\litu, ada kemungkinan dia tidak akan

menyadari jika kamu mencoba
menyelinap.

entries.original:
"This weird guy keeps trying to
convince me he’s my dad.

[rival] wasn’t happy about it,
but he still bought it.

I’m not falling for it, though!

Why would my dad just appear out
of the blue after 16 years?"
entries.translation_source: This weird guy keeps trying to convince me he’s my dad. [text-token-rival-1] wasn’t happy about it, but he still bought it. I’m not falling for it, though! Why would my dad just appear out of the blue after 16 years?
entries.translated:
Orang aneh ini terus berusaha
meyakinkan aku bahwa dia adalah\layahku. [rival] tidak senang

dengan itu, tapi dia tetap
mempercayainya. Tapi aku tidak akan\lpercaya begitu saja! Kenapa ayahku

tiba-tiba muncul begitu saja
setelah 16 tahun?

entries.original:
"That weird guy ran to the summit
to join the fight.

I really hope we make it out of
this in one piece\."
entries.translation_source: That weird guy ran to the summit to join the fight. I really hope we make it out of this in one piece[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Pria aneh itu berlari ke puncak
untuk bergabung dalam pertarungan.\lAku sangat berharap kita bisa

keluar dari ini dengan selamat\.

entries.original:
"\CC0600Psst\CC0601\.\CC0600

You two! Get over here!"
entries.translation_source: [control-code-1]Psst[control-code-2][game-token-3][control-code-4] You two! Get over here!
entries.translated: \CC0600Psst\CC0601\.\CC0600 Kalian berdua! Kemari!

entries.original:
"\CC0600There’s no sense rushing in and
getting captured!

Don’t worry, Grampa and I thought
of a plan.

Now listen up\CC0601\."
entries.translation_source: [control-code-1]There’s no sense rushing in and getting captured! Don’t worry, Grampa and I thought of a plan. Now listen up[control-code-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated:
\CC0600Tidak ada gunanya terburu-buru
masuk dan tertangkap! Jangan\lkhawatir, Kakek dan aku punya

rencana. Sekarang dengarkan\CC0601\.

entries.original:
"[red]All preparations have been
completed, Aklove.

The Shadow Warriors have been
successfully integrated into\lthe weapon.

Along with power absorbed from the
mountain, it’s now fully charged.

You may proceed with the activation
when ready."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]All preparations have been completed, Aklove. The Shadow Warriors have been successfully integrated into the weapon. Along with power absorbed from the mountain, it’s now fully charged. You may proceed with the activation when ready.
entries.translated:
[red]Semua persiapan telah selesai,
Aklove. Para Shadow Warriors telah\lberhasil diintegrasikan ke dalam

senjata. Bersama dengan kekuatan
yang diserap dari gunung, sekarang\lsudah terisi penuh. Anda dapat

melanjutkan aktivasi kapan pun
siap.

entries.original: "The Ultimate Weapon\."
entries.translation_source: The Ultimate Weapon[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Senjata Ultimate\.

entries.original:
"I still cannot believe it was hidden
in plain sight, all this time.

The crystal atop the mountain\.\CC0818
the Borrian insurgents must have\lbrought it here 3000 years ago\lusing Hoopa’s power.

The history books never mentioned
that little detail\.

To think that I wasted countless
hours searching for it!

But no matter - I have my chance to
activate it now."
entries.translation_source: I still cannot believe it was hidden in plain sight, all this time. The crystal atop the mountain[game-token-1][control-code-2] the Borrian insurgents must have brought it here 3000 years ago using Hoopa’s power. The history books never mentioned that little detail[game-token-3] To think that I wasted countless hours searching for it! But no matter - I have my chance to activate it now.
entries.translated:
Saya masih tidak percaya itu
tersembunyi di depan mata, selama\lini. Kristal di puncak gunung\.\CC0818 para

pemberontak Borrian pasti
membawanya ke sini 3000 tahun yang\llalu menggunakan kekuatan Hoopa.

Buku sejarah tidak pernah
menyebutkan detail kecil itu\.\lBayangkan saya membuang waktu

berjam-jam mencarinya! Tapi tidak
masalah - saya punya kesempatan\luntuk mengaktifkannya sekarang.

entries.original:
"All systems have been engaged.

And with the push of this button\."
entries.translation_source: All systems have been engaged. And with the push of this button[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Semua sistem telah diaktifkan. Dan
dengan menekan tombol ini\.

entries.original: "Gastrodon, now! Use Earth Power!"
entries.translation_source: Gastrodon, now! Use Earth Power!
entries.translated:
Gastrodon, sekarang! Gunakan Earth
Power!

entries.original:
"What!? You\.\CC0820 how can this be
possible!

It cannot be that\.\CC0818 Hoopa!"
entries.translation_source: What!? You[game-token-1][control-code-2] how can this be possible! It cannot be that[game-token-3][control-code-4] Hoopa!
entries.translated:
Apa!? Kamu\.\CC0820 bagaimana ini mungkin!
Tidak mungkin itu\.\CC0818 Hoopa!

entries.original:
"Yup. Guess the world you sent me
to wasn’t as deadly as you hoped!"
entries.translation_source: Yup. Guess the world you sent me to wasn’t as deadly as you hoped!
entries.translated:
Yup. Kira-kira dunia yang kau kirim
aku tidak seberbahaya yang kau\lharapkan!

entries.original:
"Hoopa! You useless Pokémon!

You could not even be rid of him
properly!?"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! You useless Pokémon! You could not even be rid of him properly!?
entries.translated:
Hoopa! Pokémon tidak berguna! Kamu
bahkan tidak bisa menyingkirkannya\ldengan benar!?

entries.original:
"Hold on\.

If you were not present for the
attack on our base, then it is\lclear you could not have escaped\lon your own\.

Then, there is nothing to stop me
from sending you right back!"
entries.translation_source: Hold on[game-token-1] If you were not present for the attack on our base, then it is clear you could not have escaped on your own[game-token-2] Then, there is nothing to stop me from sending you right back!
entries.translated:
Tunggu\. Jika kamu tidak hadir dalam
serangan ke markas kami, maka jelas\lkamu tidak bisa melarikan diri

sendiri\. Maka, tidak ada yang bisa
menghentikanku mengirimmu kembali!

entries.original: "Hoopa! Get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Get rid of him!
entries.translated: Hoopa! Singkirkan dia!

entries.original:
"Gastrodon! Keep me locked down with
your Sticky Hold!"
entries.translation_source: Gastrodon! Keep me locked down with your Sticky Hold!
entries.translated:
Gastrodon! Buat aku tetap terkunci
dengan Sticky Hold-mu!

entries.original:
"Tch\.\CC0818 have it your way.

I only need you incapacitated for
long enough.

Hoopa! Prepare to\."
entries.translation_source: Tch[game-token-1][control-code-2] have it your way. I only need you incapacitated for long enough. Hoopa! Prepare to[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tch\.\CC0818 terserah kamu. Aku hanya perlu
kamu lumpuh cukup lama. Hoopa!\lBersiaplah untuk\.

entries.original: "[player]! Now’s your chance!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Now’s your chance!
entries.translated: [player]! Sekarang kesempatanmu!

entries.original:
"Gah\.\CC0820 I should have known.

So it was you who aided the escape\.!"
entries.translation_source: Gah[game-token-1][control-code-2] I should have known. So it was you who aided the escape[game-token-3]!
entries.translated:
Gah\.\CC0820 Seharusnya aku tahu. Jadi kamu
yang membantu pelarian\.!

entries.original:
"Fine! Hoopa! You handle [player]!
I will deal with this other pest."
entries.translation_source: Fine! Hoopa! You handle [player-name-1]! I will deal with this other pest.
entries.translated:
Baik! Hoopa! Kamu urus [player]!
Aku akan berurusan dengan hama lain\lini.

entries.original:
"As for you, Ivory, activate the
weapon in my stead!"
entries.translation_source: As for you, Ivory, activate the weapon in my stead!
entries.translated:
Sedangkan kamu, Ivory, aktifkan
senjata itu sebagai gantiku!

entries.original:
"I don’t think so!
You’re not going anywhere, Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t think so! You’re not going anywhere, Ivory!
entries.translated:
Tidak mungkin! Kamu tidak akan
pergi ke mana pun, Ivory!

entries.original:
"You may have gotten the better of
me before, but this time, I’m taking\lyou down a peg!

I’m gonna stop you and save us all!"
entries.translation_source: You may have gotten the better of me before, but this time, I’m taking you down a peg! I’m gonna stop you and save us all!
entries.translated:
Kamu mungkin pernah mengalahkanku
sebelumnya, tapi kali ini, aku akan\lmerendahkanmu! Aku akan

menghentikanmu dan menyelamatkan
kita semua!

entries.original:
"Arrrrgh!

Why do all these annoyances keep
popping up out of the woodwork!?

\.

Fine, ’tis only a matter of time
now before you are all defeated.

I am a patient man\.

I have waited a year for this day,
so what is a few more moments?"
entries.translation_source: Arrrrgh! Why do all these annoyances keep popping up out of the woodwork!? [game-token-1] Fine, ’tis only a matter of time now before you are all defeated. I am a patient man[game-token-2] I have waited a year for this day, so what is a few more moments?
entries.translated:
Arrrrgh! Kenapa semua gangguan ini
terus muncul entah dari mana!? \.\lBaiklah, hanya masalah waktu

sebelum kalian semua dikalahkan.
Aku adalah orang yang sabar\. Aku\lsudah menunggu setahun untuk hari

ini, jadi apa artinya beberapa saat
lagi?

entries.original:
"Hold the line, Hoopa and Ivory!

Do not allow them near the weapon!

Once I’m done dealing with this
\qohero\qc, I’ll fire the Weapon\land be done with it."
entries.translation_source: Hold the line, Hoopa and Ivory! Do not allow them near the weapon! Once I’m done dealing with this [quote-open-1]hero[quote-close-2], I’ll fire the Weapon and be done with it.
entries.translated:
Tahan garis, Hoopa dan Ivory!
Jangan biarkan mereka mendekati\lsenjata! Setelah aku selesai

berurusan dengan \qopahlawan\qc ini,
aku akan menembakkan Senjata dan\lselesai.

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry\.\CC0820 Marlon\.\CC0830 [rival]\.\CC0830
This is the only way\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’m sorry[game-token-2][control-code-3] Marlon[game-token-4][control-code-5] [text-token-rival-6][game-token-7][control-code-8] This is the only way[game-token-9]
entries.translated:
[red]Maaf\.\CC0820 Marlon\.\CC0830 [rival]\.\CC0830 Ini
satu-satunya jalan\.

entries.original:
"[player]! Take down Hoopa, and turn
off that weapon!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Take down Hoopa, and turn off that weapon!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kalahkan Hoopa, dan
matikan senjata itu!

entries.original: "[black]Rayquaza flew away!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Rayquaza flew away!
entries.translated: [black]Rayquaza terbang menjauh!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0820 Hooooo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2][control-code-3] Hooooo!
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0820 Hooooo!

entries.original:
"[black]Hoopa summoned a mysterious power
and increased its size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Hoopa summoned a mysterious power and increased its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Hoopa memanggil kekuatan misterius
dan memperbesar ukurannya!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.

entries.original:
"Quick, [player]!
Seal its power while it’s weakened!"
entries.translation_source: Quick, [player-name-1]! Seal its power while it’s weakened!
entries.translated:
Cepat, [player]! Segel kekuatannya
selama masih lemah!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0820 pa?"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2][control-code-3] pa?
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0820 pa?

entries.original:
"You\.! You truly are the most
useless, pathetic Pokémon!

Too many times now have you failed
at the simplest tasks!"
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1]! You truly are the most useless, pathetic Pokémon! Too many times now have you failed at the simplest tasks!
entries.translated:
Kamu\.! Kamu benar-benar Pokémon yang
paling tidak berguna dan\lmenyedihkan! Sudah terlalu sering

kamu gagal dalam tugas-tugas paling
sederhana!

entries.original:
"Begone, Hoopa!
Leave my sight!

With your power sealed, I will just
have to\."
entries.translation_source: Begone, Hoopa! Leave my sight! With your power sealed, I will just have to[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Enyahlah, Hoopa! Pergi dari
pandanganku! Dengan kekuatanmu\ltersegel, aku harus\.

entries.original:
"Gotcha!

Not so tough without that Pokémon,
are you?"
entries.translation_source: Gotcha! Not so tough without that Pokémon, are you?
entries.translated:
Berhasil! Tidak begitu tangguh
tanpa Pokémon itu, kan?

entries.original: "Unhand me, you uncouth brute!"
entries.translation_source: Unhand me, you uncouth brute!
entries.translated: Lepaskan aku, kamu bruto kasar!

entries.original: "Not on your life, Aklove!"
entries.translation_source: Not on your life, Aklove!
entries.translated: Jangan mimpi, Aklove!

entries.original:
"[player]!
I got him! Now’s your chance!

Turn off the Ultimate Weapon!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I got him! Now’s your chance! Turn off the Ultimate Weapon!
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku menangkapnya!
Sekarang giliranmu! Matikan Senjata\lUtama!

entries.original:
"Out of my way!

The weapon must be activated,
no matter the cost!

But if you will not stand aside
and allow me to pass, then with\lor without Hoopa, I will bring you\lto your knees!"
entries.translation_source: Out of my way! The weapon must be activated, no matter the cost! But if you will not stand aside and allow me to pass, then with or without Hoopa, I will bring you to your knees!
entries.translated:
Minggir! Senjata itu harus
diaktifkan, berapa pun biayanya!\lTapi jika kamu tidak mau menyingkir

dan membiarkanku lewat, maka dengan
atau tanpa Hoopa, aku akan\lmembuatmu berlutut!

entries.original: "You take it from here, okay?"
entries.translation_source: You take it from here, okay?
entries.translated: Kamu lanjutkan dari sini, oke?

entries.original:
"[player]! You didn’t think I’d let you
handle this alone, right?

We fought our way up here together,
so let’s take him down together!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You didn’t think I’d let you handle this alone, right? We fought our way up here together, so let’s take him down together!
entries.translated:
[player]! Kamu pikir aku akan
membiarkanmu menangani ini\lsendirian? Kita berjuang sampai ke

sini bersama, jadi ayo kita
kalahkan dia bersama!

entries.original:
"No\.\CC0818 No\.\CC0818 No!

This cannot be happening!

THIS CANNOT BE HAPPENING!"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1][control-code-2] No[game-token-3][control-code-4] No! This cannot be happening! THIS CANNOT BE HAPPENING!
entries.translated:
Tidak\.\CC0818 Tidak\.\CC0818 Tidak! Ini tidak
mungkin terjadi! INI TIDAK MUNGKIN\lTERJADI!

entries.original:
"It’s over, Aklove.
Time to turn yourself in."
entries.translation_source: It’s over, Aklove. Time to turn yourself in.
entries.translated:
Sudah berakhir, Aklove. Saatnya
menyerahkan diri.

entries.original:
"I REFUSE!

NO! THIS IS NOT OVER!"
entries.translation_source: I REFUSE! NO! THIS IS NOT OVER!
entries.translated:
AKU MENOLAK! TIDAK! INI BELUM
BERAKHIR!

entries.original:
"What!? The Weapon\.\CC0818 it started up
somehow!"
entries.translation_source: What!? The Weapon[game-token-1][control-code-2] it started up somehow!
entries.translated:
Apa!? Senjata\.\CC0818 itu mulai menyala
entah bagaimana!

entries.original: "It’s not possible\."
entries.translation_source: It’s not possible[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Tidak mungkin\..

entries.original:
"Dresco Town\.\CC0820 my home\.\CC0820
No!"
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town[game-token-1][control-code-2] my home[game-token-3][control-code-4] No!
entries.translated: Dresco Town\.\CC0820 rumahku\.\CC0820 Tidak!

entries.original:
"Ha ha\.\CC0820 hahahahaha\.

Despite your interference, it appears
I have triumphed!

The 3000-year-old war\.\CC0818 has reached
its proper conclusion.

No longer will the great king have
to suffer for all eternity.

When he learns I have accomplished
what he failed to do, his Pokémon\lwill finally return to him\."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha[game-token-1][control-code-2] hahahahaha[game-token-3] Despite your interference, it appears I have triumphed! The 3000-year-old war[game-token-4][control-code-5] has reached its proper conclusion. No longer will the great king have to suffer for all eternity. When he learns I have accomplished what he failed to do, his Pokémon will finally return to him[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Ha ha\.\CC0820 hahahahaha\. Meskipun kamu
campur tangan, tampaknya aku telah\lmenang! Perang berusia 3000 tahun\.\CC0818

telah mencapai akhir yang
semestinya. Tidak lagi raja besar\lharus menderita untuk selamanya.

Ketika dia tahu aku berhasil
melakukan apa yang dia gagal\llakukan, Pokémon-nya akhirnya akan

kembali kepadanya\.

entries.original:
"No\.\CC0820 it cannot be\.

The colour of the cannon\.
it is all wrong!"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1][control-code-2] it cannot be[game-token-3] The colour of the cannon[game-token-4] it is all wrong!
entries.translated:
Tidak\.\CC0820 itu tidak mungkin\. Warna
meriam\. itu semua salah!

entries.original:
"Wha\.

How are you here!?"
entries.translation_source: Wha[game-token-1] How are you here!?
entries.translated: Apa\. Bagaimana kamu bisa di sini!?

entries.original:
"It’s simple, really.

That Hoopa of yours had sent
Houndoom to an empty cavern in\lCinder Volcano - a place that was\lof no danger to it at all.

You then sent me there as well.
Together, we managed to escape.

Once I was out, I made contact with
Fey and she had Agent Véga direct\lme here.

It seems she never fully intended
to allow you to rain destruction\."
entries.translation_source: It’s simple, really. That Hoopa of yours had sent Houndoom to an empty cavern in Cinder Volcano - a place that was of no danger to it at all. You then sent me there as well. Together, we managed to escape. Once I was out, I made contact with Fey and she had Agent Véga direct me here. It seems she never fully intended to allow you to rain destruction[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sederhana, sungguh. Hoopa milikmu
itu telah mengirim Houndoom ke\lsebuah gua kosong di Gunung Berapi

Cinder - tempat yang sama sekali
tidak berbahaya baginya. Kamu lalu\ljuga mengirimku ke sana.

Bersama-sama, kami berhasil
melarikan diri. Setelahku keluar,\laku menghubungi Fey dan dia

menyuruh Agen Véga mengarahkanku ke
sini. Sepertinya dia tidak pernah\lbenar-benar berniat membiarkanmu

mendatangkan kehancuran\..

entries.original:
"That deceitful wench!

I should have known she could
not be trusted\."
entries.translation_source: That deceitful wench! I should have known she could not be trusted[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Wanita licik itu! Aku seharusnya
tahu dia tidak bisa dipercaya\.

entries.original:
"Argh, forget her!

Just tell me, what have you done!?"
entries.translation_source: Argh, forget her! Just tell me, what have you done!?
entries.translated:
Argh, lupakan dia! Katakan saja,
apa yang sudah kau lakukan!?

entries.original:
"I modified the weapon’s settings
before firing it, boy.

I restored it to its original
purpose.

To give life, not take it."
entries.translation_source: I modified the weapon’s settings before firing it, boy. I restored it to its original purpose. To give life, not take it.
entries.translated:
Saya memodifikasi pengaturan
senjata sebelum menembakkannya,\lnak. Saya mengembalikannya ke

tujuan aslinya. Untuk memberi
kehidupan, bukan mengambilnya.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 you utter, utter fool!

We only extracted enough power from
the Shadow Warriors for a single\lblast before they all fell apart!"
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1][control-code-2] you utter, utter fool! We only extracted enough power from the Shadow Warriors for a single blast before they all fell apart!
entries.translated:
Kamu\.\CC0820 kamu bodoh, benar-benar bodoh!
Kami hanya mengambil cukup kekuatan\ldari Shadow Warriors untuk satu

ledakan sebelum mereka semua
hancur!

entries.original:
"[red]But\.\CC0820 you promised you would use
the weapon to restore my lost son!

Were you planning to betray me,
this entire time?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]But[game-token-2][control-code-3] you promised you would use the weapon to restore my lost son! Were you planning to betray me, this entire time?
entries.translated:
[red]Tetapi\.\CC0820 kamu berjanji akan
menggunakan senjata itu untuk\lmengembalikan anakku yang hilang!

Apakah kamu berencana
mengkhianatiku selama ini?

entries.original:
"Of course I was!

I had no intention of ever
helping you!

If all had gone according to plan,
I would have just left you as the\lscapegoat, and flown off!

Like so!"
entries.translation_source: Of course I was! I had no intention of ever helping you! If all had gone according to plan, I would have just left you as the scapegoat, and flown off! Like so!
entries.translated:
Tentu saja aku! Aku tidak pernah
berniat membantu kamu! Jika semua\lberjalan sesuai rencana, aku akan

meninggalkanmu sebagai kambing
hitam, dan terbang pergi! Seperti\litu!

entries.original:
"Staraptor! After him!
Let’s go!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! After him! Let’s go!
entries.translated: Staraptor! Kejar dia! Ayo!

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph\.\CC0820 my son’s remains\.\CC0820 I had
them with me\.

Why didn’t you\.\CC0820 why didn’t you
come for them!?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Zeph[game-token-2][control-code-3] my son’s remains[game-token-4][control-code-5] I had them with me[game-token-6] Why didn’t you[game-token-7][control-code-8] why didn’t you come for them!?
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph\.\CC0820 sisa-sisa putraku\.\CC0820 Aku
membawanya bersamaku\. Mengapa kamu\ltidak\.\CC0820 mengapa kamu tidak datang

untuk mereka!?

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0820 I’m sorry\.\CC0820 truly\.\CC0820 I\.\CC0820
I wish I could have\.

But there was only a sliver of time
available for me to slip in after\l[player] sealed Hoopa’s power.

And at that point\.\CC0818 I couldn’t take
the chance I’d be noticed!

I’m so sorry, Ivory."
entries.translation_source: Ivory[game-token-1][control-code-2] I’m sorry[game-token-3][control-code-4] truly[game-token-5][control-code-6] I[game-token-7][control-code-8] I wish I could have[game-token-9] But there was only a sliver of time available for me to slip in after [player-name-10] sealed Hoopa’s power. And at that point[game-token-11][control-code-12] I couldn’t take the chance I’d be noticed! I’m so sorry, Ivory.
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0820 Maaf\.\CC0820 sungguh\.\CC0820 Aku\.\CC0820 Aku berharap
bisa\. Tapi hanya ada sedikit waktu\lbagiku untuk menyelinap setelah

[player] menyegel kekuatan Hoopa.
Dan pada saat itu\.\CC0818 Aku tidak bisa\lmengambil risiko untuk diketahui!

Maaf sekali, Ivory.

entries.original:
"[red]Marlon\.\CC0820 [rival]\.\CC0820 all I ever wanted
was\.\CC0820 was\.

It was all for him\.\CC0820 always for him\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Marlon[game-token-2][control-code-3] [text-token-rival-4][game-token-5][control-code-6] all I ever wanted was[game-token-7][control-code-8] was[game-token-9] It was all for him[game-token-10][control-code-11] always for him[game-token-12]
entries.translated:
[red]Marlon\.\CC0820 [rival]\.\CC0820 semua yang
kuinginkan adalah\.\CC0820 adalah\. Itu semua\luntuknya\.\CC0820 selalu untuknya\.

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0820 you still don’t get it.

Yes, we lost one child, but we
gained two more.

After I met [rival]\.\CC0820 I’ve come to
understand what we’ve lost by\labandoning them all those years\lago.

But it’s not too late for us!

We can start again\.\CC0820 build a new
relationship with them!

We can never truly make up for all
the years we lost, but we can at\lleast start somewhere."
entries.translation_source: Ivory[game-token-1][control-code-2] you still don’t get it. Yes, we lost one child, but we gained two more. After I met [text-token-rival-3][game-token-4][control-code-5] I’ve come to understand what we’ve lost by abandoning them all those years ago. But it’s not too late for us! We can start again[game-token-6][control-code-7] build a new relationship with them! We can never truly make up for all the years we lost, but we can at least start somewhere.
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0820 kamu masih belum mengerti.
Ya, kami kehilangan satu anak,\ltetapi kami mendapatkan dua lagi.

Setelah aku bertemu [rival]\.\CC0820 aku
mulai memahami apa yang kami\lhilangkan dengan meninggalkan

mereka bertahun-tahun yang lalu.
Tapi belum terlambat bagi kita!\lKita bisa memulai lagi\.\CC0820 membangun

hubungan baru dengan mereka! Kita
tidak akan pernah bisa benar-benar\lmenebus semua tahun yang hilang,

tetapi setidaknya kita bisa memulai
dari suatu tempat.

entries.original:
"[red]I\.\CC0820 I need time to think - alone.

Don’t come looking for me."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I[game-token-2][control-code-3] I need time to think - alone. Don’t come looking for me.
entries.translated:
[red]Aku\.\CC0820 Aku butuh waktu untuk berpikir
- sendiri. Jangan cari aku.

entries.original: "Is\.\CC0818 is it over?"
entries.translation_source: Is[game-token-1][control-code-2] is it over?
entries.translated: Apakah\.\CC0818 apakah sudah selesai?

entries.original:
"Zeph, Marlon, you’re under arrest.

I should not need to spell out
your crimes.

You are both fully aware of what
you’ve done."
entries.translation_source: Zeph, Marlon, you’re under arrest. I should not need to spell out your crimes. You are both fully aware of what you’ve done.
entries.translated:
Zeph, Marlon, kalian ditangkap.
Saya seharusnya tidak perlu\lmenjelaskan kejahatan kalian.

Kalian berdua sangat sadar akan apa
yang telah kalian lakukan.

entries.original:
"Please, Arthur.

Take me in, but let Marlon be.

He’s suffered enough through
all this\."
entries.translation_source: Please, Arthur. Take me in, but let Marlon be. He’s suffered enough through all this[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tolong, Arthur. Terima aku, tapi
biarkan Marlon. Dia sudah cukup\lmenderita melalui semua ini\.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You were key in draining the power
supply of the Ultimate Weapon\.

I suppose we can work something
out.

Marlon is free to go for now.

As for you, please come with us.
We have a lot to discuss."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] You were key in draining the power supply of the Ultimate Weapon[game-token-2] I suppose we can work something out. Marlon is free to go for now. As for you, please come with us. We have a lot to discuss.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Anda adalah kunci dalam
menguras pasokan daya dari Senjata\lUtama\. Saya kira kita bisa menemukan

jalan keluar. Marlon bebas pergi
untuk saat ini. Sedangkan untukmu,\ltolong ikut kami. Kami memiliki

banyak hal untuk dibicarakan.

entries.original:
"Marlon, please, watch over my son
while I’m gone."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, please, watch over my son while I’m gone.
entries.translated:
Marlon, tolong, jagalah anakku
selama aku pergi.

entries.original:
"Of course, Zeph.

I’ll take him back to my home until
you’re released."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Zeph. I’ll take him back to my home until you’re released.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Zeph. Aku akan
membawanya kembali ke rumahku\lsampai kamu dibebaskan.

entries.original:
"Then, I guess this is it,
[player]?

No\.\CC0818 there’s one more thing I
need to do."
entries.translation_source: Then, I guess this is it, [player-name-1]? No[game-token-2][control-code-3] there’s one more thing I need to do.
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, kurasa ini dia,
[player]? Tidak\.\CC0818 ada satu hal lagi\lyang harus kulakukan.

entries.original:
"Listen up, old man!

I didn’t spend the last who knows
how many days searching for you\lonly to be happy when I found you!

I’m gonna show you what you’ve been
missing out on all these years!

I’m gonna show you how strong
I’ve become!"
entries.translation_source: Listen up, old man! I didn’t spend the last who knows how many days searching for you only to be happy when I found you! I’m gonna show you what you’ve been missing out on all these years! I’m gonna show you how strong I’ve become!
entries.translated:
Dengarkan, pak tua! Aku tidak
menghabiskan entah berapa hari\lterakhir ini mencarimu hanya untuk

bersenang-senang saat menemukanmu!
Aku akan menunjukkan padamu apa\lyang sudah kamu lewatkan selama

ini! Aku akan menunjukkan padamu
betapa kuatnya diriku sekarang!

entries.original:
"[rival], I already know you’re
strong\."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1], I already know you’re strong[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [rival], Aku sudah tahu kamu kuat\.

entries.original:
"No, no, no.
You don’t understand, old man.

Seeing me fight is one thing, but
you haven’t really experienced it."
entries.translation_source: No, no, no. You don’t understand, old man. Seeing me fight is one thing, but you haven’t really experienced it.
entries.translated:
Tidak, tidak, tidak. Kamu tidak
mengerti, pak tua. Melihatku\lbertarung adalah satu hal, tetapi

kamu belum benar-benar
mengalaminya.

entries.original:
"[player]!

For one last time, I want you to
fight by my side!

You’re gonna help me prove to him
how strong I am!

Beating him down alone isn’t enough,
I need to show him that I’m just\las strong, if not stronger than\lsomeone who could take down Hoopa!

And then he’ll really know how far
I’ve come!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! For one last time, I want you to fight by my side! You’re gonna help me prove to him how strong I am! Beating him down alone isn’t enough, I need to show him that I’m just as strong, if not stronger than someone who could take down Hoopa! And then he’ll really know how far I’ve come!
entries.translated:
[player]! Untuk terakhir kalinya,
aku ingin kau bertarung di sisiku!\lKau akan membantuku membuktikan

padanya betapa kuatnya aku!
Mengalahkannya sendirian saja tidak\lcukup, aku harus menunjukkan

padanya bahwa aku sama kuatnya,
jika tidak lebih kuat dari\lseseorang yang bisa mengalahkan

Hoopa! Dan kemudian dia akan
benar-benar tahu sejauh mana aku\ltelah berkembang!

entries.original:
"Let’s do this, old man!

I’ve been saving this one,
just for you!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s do this, old man! I’ve been saving this one, just for you!
entries.translated:
Ayo kita lakukan ini, pak tua! Aku
sudah menyimpan yang ini, khusus\luntukmu!

entries.original:
"Is that right\.\CC0820 but I still have
my pride as a Trainer, [rival].

I’m afraid I won’t just let you win
that easily!"
entries.translation_source: Is that right[game-token-1][control-code-2] but I still have my pride as a Trainer, [text-token-rival-3]. I’m afraid I won’t just let you win that easily!
entries.translated:
Begitu ya\.\CC0820 tapi aku masih memiliki
harga diriku sebagai Pelatih,\l[rival]. Maaf, aku tidak akan

membiarkanmu menang semudah itu!

entries.original:
"You know, [rival], I already knew
how far you’d come.

But your strength in battle isn’t how
I know that.

Your prideful, yet good heart was
what helped save us all from\ldisaster.

That’s what truly makes you a
strong Trainer.

I couldn’t be more proud of you."
entries.translation_source: You know, [text-token-rival-1], I already knew how far you’d come. But your strength in battle isn’t how I know that. Your prideful, yet good heart was what helped save us all from disaster. That’s what truly makes you a strong Trainer. I couldn’t be more proud of you.
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, [rival], aku sudah tahu
sejauh mana kau telah melangkah.\lNamun, itu bukan dari kekuatanmu

dalam bertarung yang membuatku
tahu. Hatimu yang bangga namun\lbaiklah yang membantu menyelamatkan

kita semua dari bencana. Itulah
yang benar-benar menjadikanmu\lseorang Pelatih yang kuat. Aku

tidak bisa lebih bangga padamu.

entries.original:
"Old man\.\CC0820 no\.\CC0820 Dad\.

Took you long enough\.\CC0818 to finally
say that\."
entries.translation_source: Old man[game-token-1][control-code-2] no[game-token-3][control-code-4] Dad[game-token-5] Took you long enough[game-token-6][control-code-7] to finally say that[game-token-8]
entries.translated:
Orang tua\.\CC0820 tidak\.\CC0820 Ayah\. Lama sekali
kau\.\CC0818 untuk akhirnya mengatakan itu\.

entries.original:
"[rival], let’s get Melony and go
home to Frozen Heights.

I want to get to know you both."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1], let’s get Melony and go home to Frozen Heights. I want to get to know you both.
entries.translated:
[rival], mari kita jemput Melony
dan pulang ke Frozen Heights. Aku\lingin mengenal kalian berdua.

entries.original: "What about\.\CC0820 you know\.\CC0820 her?"
entries.translation_source: What about[game-token-1][control-code-2] you know[game-token-3][control-code-4] her?
entries.translated: Bagaimana dengan\.\CC0820 kamu tahu\.\CC0820 dia?

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0820 needs time to herself.

She sacrificed so much, for nothing,
in the end.

I think she needs to process that.

When she’s ready, we can always
find her."
entries.translation_source: Ivory[game-token-1][control-code-2] needs time to herself. She sacrificed so much, for nothing, in the end. I think she needs to process that. When she’s ready, we can always find her.
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0820 butuh waktu untuk dirinya
sendiri. Dia mengorbankan begitu\lbanyak, untuk tidak ada hasilnya,

pada akhirnya. Saya pikir dia perlu
memproses itu. Saat dia siap, kita\lselalu bisa menemukannya.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player]\.\CC0818
I want you to have this.

I picked it up, back when we were
first trapped in the Shadows’ base."
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] I want you to have this. I picked it up, back when we were first trapped in the Shadows’ base.
entries.translated:
Hei, [player]\.\CC0818 Aku ingin kamu
memiliki ini. Aku mengambilnya,\ldulu saat kita pertama kali

terjebak di markas Bayangan.

entries.original:
"[player], it’s no secret that you got
as strong as I did\.\CC0818 no, maybe even\lstronger.

Man, you’ve sure come a long way
since we teamed up together back\lin the Shadows’ base.

Whether it was fate or Hoopa that
brought us together\.

I’m glad we got to be friends.

If you’re not busy with anything
else, why don’t you finish off the\lrest of the Gym Challenge?

The Champion’s seat in Borrius is
currently vacant\.

And I can’t think of anyone better
to have the title than you.

The final Gym is east of Magnolia
Town, in [green]Redwood Village[blue].

Good luck, [player].

I’ll come and congratulate you
once you become the Champ!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], it’s no secret that you got as strong as I did[game-token-2][control-code-3] no, maybe even stronger. Man, you’ve sure come a long way since we teamed up together back in the Shadows’ base. Whether it was fate or Hoopa that brought us together[game-token-4] I’m glad we got to be friends. If you’re not busy with anything else, why don’t you finish off the rest of the Gym Challenge? The Champion’s seat in Borrius is currently vacant[game-token-5] And I can’t think of anyone better to have the title than you. The final Gym is east of Magnolia Town, in [color-green-6]Redwood Village[color-blue-7]. Good luck, [player-name-8]. I’ll come and congratulate you once you become the Champ!
entries.translated:
[player], bukan rahasia lagi bahwa
kau menjadi sekuat diriku\.\CC0818 tidak,\lmungkin bahkan lebih kuat. Wah, kau

sudah jauh sejak kita bekerja sama
di markas Shadows. Entah itu takdir\latau Hoopa yang mempertemukan kita\.

aku senang kita bisa menjadi teman.
Jika kau tidak sibuk dengan hal\llain, kenapa tidak menyelesaikan

sisa tantangan Gym? Kursi Juara di
Borrius saat ini kosong\. Dan aku\ltidak bisa memikirkan orang yang

lebih pantas menyandang gelar itu
selain dirimu. Gym terakhir ada di\ltimur Magnolia Town, di [green]Redwood

Village[blue]. Semoga berhasil, [player].
Aku akan datang dan memberi selamat\lbegitu kau menjadi Juara!

entries.original:
"[player]!

Arthur just relayed the good news
to me!

Thank goodness you’re still in one
piece!

And of course, thank you!

You, Jax, [rival]\.\CC0818 you all gave
everything you had to save Borrius.

Of course, I’ve been told not all
has been resolved with this\l\qoAklove\qc, but that’s something you\lcan worry about later, I suppose.

For now, you just worry about that
empty seat, meant for the Champion!

So here, I think these may be
useful to you."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Arthur just relayed the good news to me! Thank goodness you’re still in one piece! And of course, thank you! You, Jax, [text-token-rival-2][game-token-3][control-code-4] you all gave everything you had to save Borrius. Of course, I’ve been told not all has been resolved with this [quote-open-5]Aklove[quote-close-6], but that’s something you can worry about later, I suppose. For now, you just worry about that empty seat, meant for the Champion! So here, I think these may be useful to you.
entries.translated:
[player]! Arthur baru saja
menyampaikan berita baik kepadaku!\lSyukurlah kamu masih utuh! Dan

tentu saja, terima kasih! Kamu,
Jax, [rival]\.\CC0818 kalian semua\lmemberikan segalanya yang kalian

miliki untuk menyelamatkan Borrius.
Tentu saja, saya sudah diberi tahu\lbahwa belum semuanya terselesaikan

dengan \qoAklove\qc ini, tapi itu
adalah sesuatu yang bisa kamu\lkhawatirkan nanti, kurasa. Untuk

saat ini, kamu hanya perlu khawatir
tentang kursi kosong yang\ldiperuntukkan bagi sang Juara! Jadi

ini, menurutku ini mungkin berguna
bagimu.

entries.original:
"I’ve heard there are Shard maniacs
around Borrius, who are also quite\lthe move masters.

They collect Shards, so if you think
they can teach your Pokémon any\luseful tricks for the Pokémon\lLeague, don’t hesitate to search\lthem out.

Well, I really should get back to
my research.

And in the meantime, I’ll see if
Arthur’s had any more luck finding\lthat escapee\.

Best of luck, [player]!
I hope you excel!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve heard there are Shard maniacs around Borrius, who are also quite the move masters. They collect Shards, so if you think they can teach your Pokémon any useful tricks for the Pokémon League, don’t hesitate to search them out. Well, I really should get back to my research. And in the meantime, I’ll see if Arthur’s had any more luck finding that escapee[game-token-1] Best of luck, [player-name-2]! I hope you excel!
entries.translated:
Saya dengar ada penggemar Shard di
sekitar Borrius, yang juga ahli\ldalam jurus. Mereka mengumpulkan

Shard, jadi jika kamu pikir mereka
bisa mengajari Pokémon-mu trik\lberguna untuk Pokémon League,

jangan ragu untuk mencari mereka.
Baiklah, aku harus kembali ke\lpenelitianku. Sementara itu, aku

akan lihat apakah Arthur mendapat
keberuntungan lebih dalam menemukan\lburonan itu\. Semoga beruntung,

[player]! Aku harap kamu berhasil!

entries.original: "Hold it!"
entries.translation_source: Hold it!
entries.translated: Tahan!

entries.original:
"Finally, I managed to catch up
with you, [player]!

I was feeling down after Aklove
got away from me, but catching up\lto you perked me right up again!

\.

Huh? Why am I here?

Well, funny story\.\CC0818 actually, it
was Grampa Arthur who used to be\lthe Champion of Borrius.

But ever since he retired, the
Champion’s title has been open\lfor the taking!

This whole time, Grampa Arthur
had been training me as his\lreplacement - by having me fight\lagainst threats to the region.

I’m sure that’s why Prof. Log had
you run these errands too\.

He and Grampa always did have a
bit of a rivalry, ha ha!

But now that a worthy challenger
has appeared, someone I respect,\lthis is going to be a fun battle!"
entries.translation_source: Finally, I managed to catch up with you, [player-name-1]! I was feeling down after Aklove got away from me, but catching up to you perked me right up again! [game-token-2] Huh? Why am I here? Well, funny story[game-token-3][control-code-4] actually, it was Grampa Arthur who used to be the Champion of Borrius. But ever since he retired, the Champion’s title has been open for the taking! This whole time, Grampa Arthur had been training me as his replacement - by having me fight against threats to the region. I’m sure that’s why Prof. Log had you run these errands too[game-token-5] He and Grampa always did have a bit of a rivalry, ha ha! But now that a worthy challenger has appeared, someone I respect, this is going to be a fun battle!
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, aku berhasil menyusulmu,
[player]! Aku merasa sedih setelah\lAklove lolos dariku, tapi

menyusulmu membuatku bersemangat
lagi! \. Hah? Kenapa aku di sini?\lYah, cerita lucunya\.\CC0818 sebenarnya,

Kakek Arthurlah yang dulu menjadi
Juara Borrius. Tapi sejak dia\lpensiun, gelar Juara menjadi

terbuka untuk diperebutkan! Selama
ini, Kakek Arthur melatihku sebagai\lpenggantinya - dengan membuatku

bertarung melawan ancaman-ancaman
di wilayah ini. Aku yakin itulah\lmengapa Prof. Log menyuruhmu

menjalankan tugas-tugas ini juga\.
Dia dan Kakek selalu bersaing, ha\lha! Tapi sekarang setelah penantang

yang layak muncul, seseorang yang
kuhormati, ini akan menjadi\lpertarungan yang menyenangkan!

entries.original:
"Now, it’s just you and me.

You ready?
Let’s go!"
entries.translation_source: Now, it’s just you and me. You ready? Let’s go!
entries.translated:
Sekarang, hanya kamu dan aku. Kamu
siap? Ayo!

entries.original:
"Come to think of it, we always
battled side-by-side, right?

So, I think that the best way to
battle for the Champion’s Seat is\lwith two Pokémon side-by-side!

That’s right! We’re making this a
Double Battle!

Are you ready? I put my best team
together just for this!

Here I come, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Come to think of it, we always battled side-by-side, right? So, I think that the best way to battle for the Champion’s Seat is with two Pokémon side-by-side! That’s right! We’re making this a Double Battle! Are you ready? I put my best team together just for this! Here I come, [player-name-1]!
entries.translated:
Kalau dipikir-pikir, kita selalu
bertarung berdampingan, kan? Jadi,\lmenurutku cara terbaik untuk

bertarung memperebutkan Kursi Juara
adalah dengan dua Pokémon secara\lberdampingan! Benar! Kita akan

menjadikan ini Pertarungan Ganda!
Apakah kamu siap? Aku sudah\lmenyusun tim terbaikku khusus untuk

ini! Aku datang, [player]!

entries.original:
"\.

\.so\.\CC0818 that’s that.

\.

I see. I guess that makes sense,
after all.

I always knew you were the stronger
Trainer out of the both of us, even\lafter I got a head-start over you\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] [game-token-2]so[game-token-3][control-code-4] that’s that. [game-token-5] I see. I guess that makes sense, after all. I always knew you were the stronger Trainer out of the both of us, even after I got a head-start over you[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
\. \.jadi\.\CC0818 begitulah. \. Oh, begitu. Aku
rasa itu masuk akal, setelah semua.\lAku selalu tahu kamu adalah Pelatih

yang lebih kuat di antara kita
berdua, bahkan setelah aku mendapat\lkeunggulan awal darimu\.

entries.original:
"You know, before we began our
fight, I kept thinking\.

\.about all the times I rushed in,
and then you helped bail me out.

Even at Crystal Peak, when I
thought I prepared my Pokémon\lwell enough, we wouldn’t have\lwon without you.

And even though we won, I got
complacent and Aklove got away.

That’s when I realized\.

Even if my Pokémon grow stronger,
what use is it if I don’t grow\lstronger with them?

I guess that’s the difference that
ended up deciding the winner.

So, I’m going to get stronger.

Not just my Pokémon.

Me.

And when I do, let’s do this again!

I’ll take your crown with my own
two hands!

But for now, let’s get you
officially recognized as Borrius’\lnew Champion!

Come on!
The register’s just up ahead.

Follow me!"
entries.translation_source: You know, before we began our fight, I kept thinking[game-token-1] [game-token-2]about all the times I rushed in, and then you helped bail me out. Even at Crystal Peak, when I thought I prepared my Pokémon well enough, we wouldn’t have won without you. And even though we won, I got complacent and Aklove got away. That’s when I realized[game-token-3] Even if my Pokémon grow stronger, what use is it if I don’t grow stronger with them? I guess that’s the difference that ended up deciding the winner. So, I’m going to get stronger. Not just my Pokémon. Me. And when I do, let’s do this again! I’ll take your crown with my own two hands! But for now, let’s get you officially recognized as Borrius’ new Champion! Come on! The register’s just up ahead. Follow me!
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, sebelum kita memulai
pertarungan, aku terus berpikir\.\l\.tentang semua saat aku bergegas,

dan kemudian kau membantu
menyelamatkanku. Bahkan di Puncak\lKristal, ketika kupikir aku sudah

mempersiapkan Pokémon-ku dengan
cukup baik, kami tidak akan menang\ltanpamu. Dan meskipun kami menang,

aku menjadi lengah dan Aklove
melarikan diri. Saat itulah aku\lmenyadari\. Bahkan jika Pokémon-ku

menjadi lebih kuat, apa gunanya
jika aku tidak ikut menjadi lebih\lkuat bersama mereka? Kurasa itulah

perbedaan yang akhirnya menentukan
pemenang. Jadi, aku akan menjadi\llebih kuat. Bukan hanya Pokémon-ku.

Aku. Dan saat itu terjadi, mari
kita lakukan ini lagi! Aku akan\lmengambil mahkotamu dengan kedua

tanganku sendiri! Tapi untuk saat
ini, mari kita buat kau diakui\lsecara resmi sebagai Juara baru

Borrius! Ayo! Daftarnya ada di
depan. Ikuti aku!

entries.original:
"This room is the Hall of Fame\.

It’s been a long time since I
last entered this room\.

Grampa Arthur brought me here
when I was younger, but I haven’t\lbeen since.

Anyway, [player]!
Welcome to the Hall of Fame!

This machine will make a permanent
record of your achievement.

Just place your Pokémon on it
and you’ll be good to go!

And once again, [player],
CONGRATULATIONS!"
entries.translation_source: This room is the Hall of Fame[game-token-1] It’s been a long time since I last entered this room[game-token-2] Grampa Arthur brought me here when I was younger, but I haven’t been since. Anyway, [player-name-3]! Welcome to the Hall of Fame! This machine will make a permanent record of your achievement. Just place your Pokémon on it and you’ll be good to go! And once again, [player-name-4], CONGRATULATIONS!
entries.translated:
Ruangan ini adalah Hall of Fame\.
Sudah lama sejak terakhir kali aku\lmemasuki ruangan ini\. Kakek Arthur

membawaku ke sini saat aku masih
kecil, tapi sejak itu aku tidak\lpernah ke sini lagi. Pokoknya,

[player]! Selamat datang di Hall of
Fame! Mesin ini akan membuat\lcatatan permanen atas pencapaianmu.

Letakkan Pokémon-mu di atasnya dan
semuanya akan beres! Dan sekali\llagi, [player], SELAMAT!

entries.original:
"Congratulations on completing the
main campaign of Pokémon Unbound!

In recognition of your achievement,
all Battle Difficulties have been\lunlocked!"
entries.translation_source: Congratulations on completing the main campaign of Pokémon Unbound! In recognition of your achievement, all Battle Difficulties have been unlocked!
entries.translated:
Selamat telah menyelesaikan
kampanye utama Pokémon Unbound!\lSebagai pengakuan atas

pencapaianmu, semua Kesulitan
Pertarungan telah dibuka!

entries.original:
"Additionally, a new outfit has been
added to the Costume Box!"
entries.translation_source: Additionally, a new outfit has been added to the Costume Box!
entries.translated:
Selain itu, sebuah kostum baru
telah ditambahkan ke Kotak Kostum!

entries.original:
"There’s plenty more to do now that
you’ve become Champion, so don’t go\laway just yet!

Keep enjoying Pokémon Unbound,
and thank you for playing!"
entries.translation_source: There’s plenty more to do now that you’ve become Champion, so don’t go away just yet! Keep enjoying Pokémon Unbound, and thank you for playing!
entries.translated:
Masih banyak lagi yang bisa
dilakukan setelah kamu menjadi\lJuara, jadi jangan pergi dulu!

Teruslah nikmati Pokémon Unbound,
dan terima kasih telah bermain!

entries.original:
"[player]!

Congratulations!

I told you I’d come by after you
became the Champion, didn’t I?

Well, here I am!

So, what are your plans now that
you’re the strongest Trainer in\lBorrius?

\.

You don’t have any, huh?

Well, I hear renovations on the
Battle Frontier have finally been\lcompleted.

My dad and I planned on heading
over soon to check it out."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Congratulations! I told you I’d come by after you became the Champion, didn’t I? Well, here I am! So, what are your plans now that you’re the strongest Trainer in Borrius? [game-token-2] You don’t have any, huh? Well, I hear renovations on the Battle Frontier have finally been completed. My dad and I planned on heading over soon to check it out.
entries.translated:
[player]! Selamat! Aku sudah bilang
akan datang setelah kamu menjadi\lJuara, kan? Nah, ini aku! Jadi, apa

rencanamu sekarang setelah kamu
menjadi Pelatih terkuat di Borrius?\l\. Kamu tidak punya rencana, ya? Nah,

aku dengar renovasi di Battle
Frontier akhirnya selesai. Ayahku\ldan aku berencana pergi ke sana

sebentar lagi untuk melihatnya.

entries.original:
"Yes, congratulations, [player]!

I was hoping I’d get the chance to
see you in person when you\lreturned home.

Are you surprised to see me back
in the old black and red?

That outfit I let you keep wasn’t
my only one, you know!

But even after all that happened,
I felt I needed to wear it again.

Ivory’s still missing, so I hope
that it will be easier to find her\lif I look just like her.

If you happen to hear anything,
[player], don’t hesitate to let\lme know.

And of course, don’t think I’ve
forgotten about your father.

I’ve been looking into freeing him
from the Cube, but so far, I\lhaven’t had much luck.

When I find something useful, I’ll
be sure to have a Mission for you."
entries.translation_source: Yes, congratulations, [player-name-1]! I was hoping I’d get the chance to see you in person when you returned home. Are you surprised to see me back in the old black and red? That outfit I let you keep wasn’t my only one, you know! But even after all that happened, I felt I needed to wear it again. Ivory’s still missing, so I hope that it will be easier to find her if I look just like her. If you happen to hear anything, [player-name-2], don’t hesitate to let me know. And of course, don’t think I’ve forgotten about your father. I’ve been looking into freeing him from the Cube, but so far, I haven’t had much luck. When I find something useful, I’ll be sure to have a Mission for you.
entries.translated:
Ya, selamat, [player]! Aku berharap
mendapatkan kesempatan bertemu\llangsung denganmu saat kau pulang

ke rumah. Apakah kau terkejut
melihatku kembali dengan pakaian\lhitam dan merah yang lama itu?

Pakaian yang kubiarkan kau simpan
itu bukan satu-satunya milikku, kau\ltahu! Tetapi meskipun semua yang

telah terjadi, aku merasa perlu
memakainya lagi. Ivory masih\lhilang, jadi aku berharap akan

lebih mudah menemukannya jika aku
terlihat persis seperti dia. Jika\lkau kebetulan mendengar sesuatu,

[player], jangan ragu untuk memberi
tahu aku. Dan tentu saja, jangan\lkira aku melupakan ayahmu. Aku

telah mencari cara untuk
membebaskannya dari Kubus, tetapi\lsejauh ini, aku belum banyak

beruntung. Saat aku menemukan
sesuatu yang berguna, aku pasti\lakan memberikan Misi untukmu.

entries.original:
"Anyway, we’re gonna go check out
the [green]Battle Frontier[blue].

It’s just [green]north[blue] of [green]Seaport City[blue],
and the best of best from all\laround the world are said to\lgather there.

Since it just reopened and all,
there’s sure to be swarms of\lTrainers itching for a fight!

My dad and I are gonna show them
how real Trainers battle!

See you later, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Anyway, we’re gonna go check out the [color-green-1]Battle Frontier[color-blue-2]. It’s just [color-green-3]north[color-blue-4] of [color-green-5]Seaport City[color-blue-6], and the best of best from all around the world are said to gather there. Since it just reopened and all, there’s sure to be swarms of Trainers itching for a fight! My dad and I are gonna show them how real Trainers battle! See you later, [player-name-7]!
entries.translated:
Anyway, kita akan pergi memeriksa
[green]Battle Frontier[blue]. Itu hanya [green]utara[blue]\ldari [green]Kota Pelabuhan[blue], dan yang

terbaik dari yang terbaik dari
seluruh dunia dikatakan berkumpul\ldi sana. Karena baru saja dibuka

kembali, pasti ada banyak Pelatih
yang ingin bertarung! Ayahku dan\laku akan menunjukkan pada mereka

bagaimana Pelatih sejati bertarung!
Sampai jumpa, [player]!

entries.original:
"[player], my [buffer1], a hearty
congratulations to you!

I heard the news!

To think, after all this time, I
have finally bested old Arthur!

Ho ho ho!

Erm\. excuse me.

Now, my [buffer1], the reason for
my visit.

I have yet another errand for
you to run!

You thought you were done with
those, didn’t you?

Ho ho ho!

Erm\. anyway, following your
defeat of Hoopa atop Crystal Peak,\lmysterious portals have begun\lappearing around Borrius.

When approached, powerful Pokémon
are said to leap forth.

As the Guardian of Borrius in both
name and standing, it is your\lresponsibility to take care of\lthese Pokémon.

I assume that in most cases, if you
capture the Pokémon, the portals\lwill disappear permanently.

Although, it is doubtful that they
will all stay gone forever\.

In any case!

Capture the Pokémon found in these
mysterious portals.

Some portals may only appear if you
bring specific Pokémon, but the\lPokémon in those portals must be\lcaptured regardless.

And if a portal refuses to disappear
permanently after catching the\lPokémon, simply registering it in\lyour Pokédex will be enough."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], my [buffer1-2], a hearty congratulations to you! I heard the news! To think, after all this time, I have finally bested old Arthur! Ho ho ho! Erm[game-token-3] excuse me. Now, my [buffer1-4], the reason for my visit. I have yet another errand for you to run! You thought you were done with those, didn’t you? Ho ho ho! Erm[game-token-5] anyway, following your defeat of Hoopa atop Crystal Peak, mysterious portals have begun appearing around Borrius. When approached, powerful Pokémon are said to leap forth. As the Guardian of Borrius in both name and standing, it is your responsibility to take care of these Pokémon. I assume that in most cases, if you capture the Pokémon, the portals will disappear permanently. Although, it is doubtful that they will all stay gone forever[game-token-6] In any case! Capture the Pokémon found in these mysterious portals. Some portals may only appear if you bring specific Pokémon, but the Pokémon in those portals must be captured regardless. And if a portal refuses to disappear permanently after catching the Pokémon, simply registering it in your Pokédex will be enough.
entries.translated:
[player], [buffer1] saya, selamat
yang sebesar-besarnya untukmu! Aku\lmendengar kabarnya! Bayangkan,

setelah sekian lama, akhirnya aku
berhasil mengalahkan Arthur tua! Ho\lho ho! Erm\. permisi. Sekarang,

[buffer1] saya, alasan kunjunganku.
Aku punya tugas lain untukmu! Kamu\lpikir kamu sudah selesai dengan

tugas-tugas itu, kan? Ho ho ho! Erm\.
bagaimanapun, setelah kekalahanmu\latas Hoopa di puncak Crystal Peak,

portal-portal misterius mulai
bermunculan di sekitar Borrius.\lSaat didekati, Pokémon kuat

dikatakan melompat keluar. Sebagai
Penjaga Borrius, baik dalam nama\lmaupun kenyataan, adalah tanggung

jawabmu untuk mengurus
Pokémon-Pokémon ini. Aku berasumsi\lbahwa dalam kebanyakan kasus, jika

kamu menangkap Pokémon tersebut,
portal-portal itu akan menghilang\lsecara permanen. Meskipun,

diragukan bahwa semuanya akan tetap
hilang selamanya\. Bagaimanapun!\lTangkap Pokémon yang ditemukan di

portal-portal misterius ini.
Beberapa portal mungkin hanya\lmuncul jika kamu membawa Pokémon

tertentu, tetapi Pokémon di
portal-portal itu harus ditangkap\lbagaimanapun juga. Dan jika sebuah

portal menolak untuk menghilang
secara permanen setelah menangkap\lPokémon, cukup mendaftarkannya di

Pokédex-mu sudah cukup.

entries.original:
"And with that, I’m off!

Do say hi to your mother for me,
will you, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: And with that, I’m off! Do say hi to your mother for me, will you, [player-name-1]?
entries.translated:
Baiklah, aku pergi! Tolong
sampaikan salamku pada ibumu, ya,\l[player]?

entries.original:
"So, you have come\.

Ha ha ha ha\. not that you had much
of a choice in the matter\."
entries.translation_source: So, you have come[game-token-1] Ha ha ha ha[game-token-2] not that you had much of a choice in the matter[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Jadi, kau datang\. Ha ha ha ha\. bukan
karena kau punya banyak pilihan\ldalam hal ini\.

entries.original:
"Aklove!

I came alone like you asked\.\CC0818 now
give back Grampa Arthur!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove! I came alone like you asked[game-token-1][control-code-2] now give back Grampa Arthur!
entries.translated:
Aklove! Aku datang sendiri seperti
yang kau minta\.\CC0818 sekarang kembalikan\lKakek Arthur!

entries.original:
"Oh! [player]!
He did this to you too!?

That sneak\.\CC0818 he’s in for it now!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! [player-name-1]! He did this to you too!? That sneak[game-token-2][control-code-3] he’s in for it now!
entries.translated:
Oh! [player]! Dia melakukan ini
padamu juga!? Itu pengkhianat\.\CC0818 dia\lakan mendapatkannya sekarang!

entries.original:
"Are you angry?
Does rage consume your soul?

That\.\CC0818 is exactly how I felt,
when you robbed me of everything\.

All I had worked so hard to achieve,
gone in the blink of an eye\.

I could have finally achieved what
I knew I was destined to do\.

Fey abandoned and betrayed me\.\CC0818
but there is still time!

I will start again!

I will start from scratch, without
having to rely on anyone\.

Like that fool Zeph!
Or that treasonous Fey!

They never came with you, but I can
still have my revenge on you both!"
entries.translation_source: Are you angry? Does rage consume your soul? That[game-token-1][control-code-2] is exactly how I felt, when you robbed me of everything[game-token-3] All I had worked so hard to achieve, gone in the blink of an eye[game-token-4] I could have finally achieved what I knew I was destined to do[game-token-5] Fey abandoned and betrayed me[game-token-6][control-code-7] but there is still time! I will start again! I will start from scratch, without having to rely on anyone[game-token-8] Like that fool Zeph! Or that treasonous Fey! They never came with you, but I can still have my revenge on you both!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu marah? Apakah amarah
menguasai jiwamu? Itu\.\CC0818 persis\lseperti yang kurasakan, ketika kau

merampas segalanya dariku\. Semua
yang telah kukerjakan dengan susah\lpayah, lenyap dalam sekejap mata\.

Aku bisa saja akhirnya mencapai apa
yang kutahu ditakdirkan untuk\lkulakukan\. Fey meninggalkan dan

mengkhianatiku\.\CC0818 tapi masih ada
waktu! Aku akan memulai lagi! Aku\lakan memulai dari awal, tanpa harus

bergantung pada siapa pun\. Seperti
si bodoh Zeph itu! Atau Fey yang\lberkhianat itu! Mereka tidak pernah

datang bersamamu, tapi aku masih
bisa membalas dendam pada kalian\lberdua!

entries.original:
"He’s insane\.\CC0818 he really thinks
he can try again\.

Careful, [player].
He’s still serious about this.

Team up with me, and let’s put this
guy and his plans down for good!

Time to end this once and for all!"
entries.translation_source: He’s insane[game-token-1][control-code-2] he really thinks he can try again[game-token-3] Careful, [player-name-4]. He’s still serious about this. Team up with me, and let’s put this guy and his plans down for good! Time to end this once and for all!
entries.translated:
Dia gila\.\CC0818 dia benar-benar berpikir
bisa mencoba lagi\. Hati-hati,\l[player]. Dia masih serius tentang

ini. Bergabunglah denganku, dan
mari kita hentikan orang ini\lbeserta rencananya untuk selamanya!

Saatnya mengakhiri ini sekali dan
untuk selamanya!

entries.original: "Why\. why couldn’t you just\.?"
entries.translation_source: Why[game-token-1] why couldn’t you just[game-token-2]?
entries.translated:
Mengapa\. mengapa kamu tidak bisa
saja\.?

entries.original:
"Why\.\CC0818 why must you rob me of
everything\.

My dreams\.\CC0818 my possessions\.\CC0818
my\.\CC0818 victory\."
entries.translation_source: Why[game-token-1][control-code-2] why must you rob me of everything[game-token-3] My dreams[game-token-4][control-code-5] my possessions[game-token-6][control-code-7] my[game-token-8][control-code-9] victory[game-token-10]
entries.translated:
Mengapa\.\CC0818 mengapa kau merampok
segalanya dariku\. Mimpiku\.\CC0818 hartaku\.\CC0818 ku\.\CC0818\lkemenangan\.

entries.original:
"It’s over, Aklove.
Your destructive plans end here.

Just tell me\.\CC0818 the destruction
of Borrius\.

What was it for!?
What was the point of any of it!?

All that destruction, all that loss
of life\.\CC0818 what would it have\lachieved!?"
entries.translation_source: It’s over, Aklove. Your destructive plans end here. Just tell me[game-token-1][control-code-2] the destruction of Borrius[game-token-3] What was it for!? What was the point of any of it!? All that destruction, all that loss of life[game-token-4][control-code-5] what would it have achieved!?
entries.translated:
Sudah berakhir, Aklove. Rencana
destruktifmu berakhir di sini.\lKatakan saja padaku\.\CC0818 kehancuran

Borrius\. Untuk apa itu semua!? Apa
gunanya semua itu!? Semua\lkehancuran itu, semua kehilangan

nyawa\.\CC0818 apa yang akan dicapainya!?

entries.original:
"Fine\.\CC0820 I will tell you\.

My ancestor, the one the legends
refer to as \qothe foreign king\qc\lfrom the Great War\.

Even now, 3000 years later, he still
walks the earth to this day.

Once I finished what he started\.\CC0818
once I had brought that war to its\lproper conclusion\.

Then he could rest in peace.

The subjugation of Borrius\.\CC0818 would
have finally seen his last wish\lfulfilled.

But now\.\CC0818 it is no longer possible\."
entries.translation_source: Fine[game-token-1][control-code-2] I will tell you[game-token-3] My ancestor, the one the legends refer to as [quote-open-4]the foreign king[quote-close-5] from the Great War[game-token-6] Even now, 3000 years later, he still walks the earth to this day. Once I finished what he started[game-token-7][control-code-8] once I had brought that war to its proper conclusion[game-token-9] Then he could rest in peace. The subjugation of Borrius[game-token-10][control-code-11] would have finally seen his last wish fulfilled. But now[game-token-12][control-code-13] it is no longer possible[game-token-14]
entries.translated:
Baik\.\CC0820 Aku akan memberitahumu\.
Leluhurku, yang oleh legenda\ldisebut sebagai \qoraja asing\qc dari

Perang Besar\. Bahkan sekarang, 3000
tahun kemudian, dia masih berjalan\ldi bumi hingga hari ini. Setelah

aku menyelesaikan apa yang dia
mulai\.\CC0818 setelah aku mengakhiri perang\litu dengan kesimpulan yang tepat\.

Maka dia bisa beristirahat dengan
damai. Penaklukan Borrius\.\CC0818 akhirnya\lakan melihat harapan terakhirnya

terpenuhi. Tapi sekarang\.\CC0818 itu tidak
lagi mungkin\.

entries.original: "That’s so pathetic."
entries.translation_source: That’s so pathetic.
entries.translated: Itu sangat menyedihkan.

entries.original: "W-what did you say!?"
entries.translation_source: W-what did you say!?
entries.translated: A-apa yang kamu katakan!?

entries.original:
