"Let’s say you’re right.

Let’s say the legend’s true and the
king’s still alive.

But 3000 years\.

Do you really think not a second
of that was spent on reflection?

On regret?

Isn’t it possible he no longer
wants war?

How would you know?

You just projected your desires
onto a myth and nearly destroyed\lour region because of it!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s say you’re right. Let’s say the legend’s true and the king’s still alive. But 3000 years[game-token-1] Do you really think not a second of that was spent on reflection? On regret? Isn’t it possible he no longer wants war? How would you know? You just projected your desires onto a myth and nearly destroyed our region because of it!
entries.translated:
Anggap saja kamu benar. Anggap saja
legenda itu benar dan raja masih\lhidup. Tapi 3000 tahun\. Apa kamu

benar-benar berpikir tidak ada satu
detik pun yang dihabiskan untuk\lperenungan? Penyesalan? Bukankah

mungkin dia tidak lagi menginginkan
perang? Bagaimana kamu tahu? Kamu\lhanya memproyeksikan keinginanmu

pada mitos dan hampir menghancurkan
wilayah kita karenanya!

entries.original: "Nngh\."
entries.translation_source: Nngh[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Nng\.

entries.original:
"Hmm? What are those sounds coming
from below?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm? What are those sounds coming from below?
entries.translated:
Hmm? Suara apa itu yang datang dari
bawah?

entries.original:
"So, this is where you took him,
Aklove!"
entries.translation_source: So, this is where you took him, Aklove!
entries.translated:
Jadi, ini tempat kamu membawanya,
Aklove!

entries.original: "Marlon! You’re here too?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon! You’re here too?
entries.translated: Marlon! Kamu juga di sini?

entries.original:
"That’s right\. that’s Zeph’s son back
there, isn’t it?

It was my responsiblity to watch
him, and I\.\CC0818 I shirked that\lresponsibility to spend time with my\lown son.

But that is a mistake I’ve come to
rectify."
entries.translation_source: That’s right[game-token-1] that’s Zeph’s son back there, isn’t it? It was my responsiblity to watch him, and I[game-token-2][control-code-3] I shirked that responsibility to spend time with my own son. But that is a mistake I’ve come to rectify.
entries.translated:
Benar\. itu putra Zeph di belakang
sana, bukan? Itu adalah tanggung\ljawabku untuk mengawasinya, dan aku\.\CC0818

aku mengabaikan tanggung jawab itu
untuk menghabiskan waktu dengan\lputraku sendiri. Tapi itu adalah

kesalahan yang aku perbaiki
sekarang.

entries.original:
"You know, you could have had your
revenge so easily.

[player]’s mother\.\CC0818 Jax’s grandfather\.\CC0818
Zeph’s son\.

You could have just ended them
once they were in your grasp.

Yet you couldn’t lose the desire to
lord over how superior you were,\land you left them alive, choosing\lto battle [player] and Jax instead.

It’s like I always suspected\.\CC0818
your own worst instincts would be\lwhy you’d never win!"
entries.translation_source: You know, you could have had your revenge so easily. [player-name-1]’s mother[game-token-2][control-code-3] Jax’s grandfather[game-token-4][control-code-5] Zeph’s son[game-token-6] You could have just ended them once they were in your grasp. Yet you couldn’t lose the desire to lord over how superior you were, and you left them alive, choosing to battle [player-name-7] and Jax instead. It’s like I always suspected[game-token-8][control-code-9] your own worst instincts would be why you’d never win!
entries.translated:
Kamu tahu, kamu bisa saja membalas
dendammu dengan mudah. Ibu [player]\.\CC0818\lkakek Jax\.\CC0818 putra Zeph\. Kamu bisa saja

mengakhiri mereka begitu mereka
dalam genggamanmu. Namun kamu tidak\lbisa kehilangan keinginan untuk

memamerkan betapa unggulnya dirimu,
dan kamu membiarkan mereka hidup,\lmemilih untuk bertarung melawan

[player] dan Jax. Seperti yang
selalu kuduga\.\CC0818 naluri terburukmu\lsendiri adalah alasan mengapa kamu

tidak akan pernah menang!

entries.original:
"Now Aklove, you’re going with these
officers.

It’s time to face the justice you’re
long overdue."
entries.translation_source: Now Aklove, you’re going with these officers. It’s time to face the justice you’re long overdue.
entries.translated:
Sekarang Aklove, kamu akan pergi
dengan petugas-petugas ini. Sudah\lwaktunya menghadapi keadilan yang

sudah lama tertunda untukmu.

entries.original:
"Let’s get you home, Zeph Jr.

Now that the bad man is behind bars,
your father will be released soon\."
entries.translation_source: Let’s get you home, Zeph Jr. Now that the bad man is behind bars, your father will be released soon[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mari kita antar kamu pulang, Zeph
Jr. Sekarang setelah penjahat itu\ldi balik jeruji besi, ayahmu akan

segera dibebaskan\.

entries.original:
"Grampa Arthur!
I was really worried about you!

Are you okay?
He didn’t hurt you, did he?"
entries.translation_source: Grampa Arthur! I was really worried about you! Are you okay? He didn’t hurt you, did he?
entries.translated:
Kakek Arthur! Aku sangat khawatir
padamu! Kamu baik-baik saja? Dia\ltidak menyakitimu, kan?

entries.original:
"Oh no, Jax, I’m perfectly alright,
as you can see.

As Marlon says, he mostly left us
alone.

It seems his only interest was in
drawing you here.

Just be thankful his ego outweighed
his common sense."
entries.translation_source: Oh no, Jax, I’m perfectly alright, as you can see. As Marlon says, he mostly left us alone. It seems his only interest was in drawing you here. Just be thankful his ego outweighed his common sense.
entries.translated:
Oh tidak, Jax, aku baik-baik saja,
seperti yang kamu lihat. Seperti\lyang dikatakan Marlon, dia

kebanyakan meninggalkan kita
sendirian. Sepertinya satu-satunya\lminatnya adalah untuk menarikmu ke

sini. Bersyukurlah bahwa egonya
lebih besar daripada akal sehatnya.

entries.original:
"Phew\. that’s a relief.

Let’s go home, Grampa."
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1] that’s a relief. Let’s go home, Grampa.
entries.translated:
Fiuh\. lega rasanya. Ayo pulang,
Kakek

entries.original:
"[player], we always seem to team up
under the worst circumstances, huh?

\.Either way, I’m glad we got to
fight together one last time.

You are the Champion, after all,
and there’s no other Trainer I’d\llike to fight alongside.

If you ever want to team up again,
I’ll be hanging around the Battle\lFrontier, so just give me a shout\lif you stop by!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], we always seem to team up under the worst circumstances, huh? [game-token-2]Either way, I’m glad we got to fight together one last time. You are the Champion, after all, and there’s no other Trainer I’d like to fight alongside. If you ever want to team up again, I’ll be hanging around the Battle Frontier, so just give me a shout if you stop by!
entries.translated:
[player], kita selalu terlihat
bekerja sama dalam keadaan\lterburuk, ya? \.Bagaimanapun, aku

senang kita bisa bertarung bersama
untuk terakhir kalinya. Lagipula,\lkamu adalah Juara, dan tidak ada

Pelatih lain yang ingin aku ajak
bertarung. Jika kamu ingin bekerja\lsama lagi, aku akan berada di

sekitar Battle Frontier, jadi
panggil saja aku jika kamu mampir!

entries.original:
"Let me explain how the Pokémon
Wireless Club works.

On this, the top floor, there are
two rooms.

It’s the Union Room.

You may link up with Trainers
around you who have also\lentered the Union Room using\lthe Wireless Adapter.

With them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.

Second, the room on the right is
the Direct Corner.

You may battle Pokémon with your
friends in this room, but trading is\lno longer available.

Please use Unbound Cloud if you
wish to trade Pokémon.

Sometimes, you may not be able to
find your friends in the Union Room\lor the Direct Corner.

In that case, please move closer
to your friends.

If the Wireless Adapter isn’t
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.

If that is the case, you must go
to the Direct Corner.

I hope you enjoy the Wireless
Communication System."
entries.translation_source: Let me explain how the Pokémon Wireless Club works. On this, the top floor, there are two rooms. First, the room on the left. It’s the Union Room. You may link up with Trainers around you who have also entered the Union Room using the Wireless Adapter. With them, you may do things like chat, battle, and trade. Second, the room on the right is the Direct Corner. You may battle Pokémon with your friends in this room, but trading is no longer available. Please use Unbound Cloud if you wish to trade Pokémon. Sometimes, you may not be able to find your friends in the Union Room or the Direct Corner. In that case, please move closer to your friends. If the Wireless Adapter isn’t connected, you may still link up using a GBA Game Link cable. If that is the case, you must go to the Direct Corner. I hope you enjoy the Wireless Communication System.

entries.original:
"Each member of the Elite Four likes
to set up certain conditions on the\lfield before battle.

First, there’s [green]Moleman[blue].

He likes to set up a vicious
Sandstorm, a kind of Sandstorm\lthat does more damage than a\lregular Sandstorm.

This kind of Sandstorm also boosts
Ground-type Pokémon’s Sp. Def,\land won’t go away if you try to\lget rid of it.

Next, there’s [green]Elias[blue].

When you fight him, all Ghost-type
Pokémon will take half damage\land be immune to entry hazards\lwhen they’re at full health.

Safeguard and Substitute will also
fail unless used by a Ghost-type.

Third, comes [green]Arabella[blue].

Her room is filled with a
Misty Terrain.

And not only that, but any Fairy-
types sent out will have their\llowest defensive stat boosted.

Lastly, comes [green]Penny[blue].

There’s a rainbow in her room that
raises the chance of secondary move\leffects used by Dragon-types.

Make sure you’re prepared for these
conditions before you fight them!"
entries.translation_source: Each member of the Elite Four likes to set up certain conditions on the field before battle. First, there’s [color-green-1]Moleman[color-blue-2]. He likes to set up a vicious Sandstorm, a kind of Sandstorm that does more damage than a regular Sandstorm. This kind of Sandstorm also boosts Ground-type Pokémon’s Sp. Def, and won’t go away if you try to get rid of it. Next, there’s [color-green-3]Elias[color-blue-4]. When you fight him, all Ghost-type Pokémon will take half damage and be immune to entry hazards when they’re at full health. Safeguard and Substitute will also fail unless used by a Ghost-type. Third, comes [color-green-5]Arabella[color-blue-6]. Her room is filled with a Misty Terrain. And not only that, but any Fairy- types sent out will have their lowest defensive stat boosted. Lastly, comes [color-green-7]Penny[color-blue-8]. There’s a rainbow in her room that raises the chance of secondary move effects used by Dragon-types. Make sure you’re prepared for these conditions before you fight them!

"The Elite Four are among the

Moleman uses [green]Ground[red]-types,
Elias uses [green]Ghost[red]-types,\lArabella uses [green]Fairy[red]-types,\land Penny uses [green]Dragon[red]-types.

They don’t have many shared
weaknesses, so prepare properly\lby bringing Pokémon that know a\lgood variety of moves."
entries.translation_source: The Elite Four are among the strongest Trainers in Borrius. Before fighting them, you should know what you’re up against. Moleman uses [color-green-1]Ground[color-red-2]-types, Elias uses [color-green-3]Ghost[color-red-4]-types, Arabella uses [color-green-5]Fairy[color-red-6]-types, and Penny uses [color-green-7]Dragon[color-red-8]-types. They don’t have many shared weaknesses, so prepare properly by bringing Pokémon that know a good variety of moves.
