menggunakan [green]Tanah[red]-tipe, Elias\lmenggunakan [green]Hantu[red]-tipe, Arabella

menggunakan [green]Peri[red]-tipe, dan Penny
menggunakan [green]Naga[red]-tipe. Mereka tidak\lmemiliki banyak kelemahan yang

sama, jadi persiapkan diri dengan
baik dengan membawa Pokémon yang\lmengetahui berbagai macam jurusan.

entries.original:
"Trainer!

Once you pass through the doorway
behind me, your Pokémon League\lchallenge will begin.

And once begun, there is no turning
back until you have cleared the\lchallenge.

Have you healed your Pokémon?

Have you purchased essential items?

If so, you may begin your challenge
whenever it most suits you.

Demonstrate the power that brought
you here and go for glory!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer! Once you pass through the doorway behind me, your Pokémon League challenge will begin. And once begun, there is no turning back until you have cleared the challenge. Have you healed your Pokémon? Have you purchased essential items? If so, you may begin your challenge whenever it most suits you. Demonstrate the power that brought you here and go for glory!
entries.translated:
Trainer! Begitu Anda melewati pintu
di belakangku, tantangan Liga\lPokémon Anda akan dimulai. Dan

setelah dimulai, tidak ada jalan
mundur hingga Anda berhasil\lmenyelesaikan tantangan tersebut.

Apakah Anda sudah memulihkan
Pokémon Anda? Apakah Anda sudah\lmembeli item penting? Jika sudah,

Anda boleh memulai tantangan kapan
pun Anda siap. Tunjukkan kekuatan\lyang membawamu ke sini dan raihlah

kejayaan!

entries.original:
"You will be facing the Elite Four
of the Pokémon League.

You may challenge them in any
order, but if you lose to any of\lthem, you will have to start your\lchallenge anew."
entries.translation_source: You will be facing the Elite Four of the Pokémon League. You may challenge them in any order, but if you lose to any of them, you will have to start your challenge anew.
entries.translated:
Kamu akan menghadapi Elite Four
dari Liga Pokémon. Kamu dapat\lmenantang mereka dalam urutan apa

pun, tetapi jika kamu kalah dari
salah satu dari mereka, kamu harus\lmemulai tantanganmu dari awal.

entries.original: "You Are My Only"
entries.translation_source: You Are My Only
entries.translated: Kamu Satu-satunya

entries.original:
"Bonds are powerful! Can you clear
the Pokémon League with only one
Pokémon, and prove your bond?"
entries.translation_source: Bonds are powerful! Can you clear the Pokémon League with only one Pokémon, and prove your bond?
entries.translated:
Ikatan itu kuat! Bisakah kamu
... hanya dengan satu Pokémon,
dan membuktikan ikatanmu?

entries.original:
"My only friend is my Pokémon.

I don’t need any more friends
than him.

The bond between a Trainer and
their best friend is unbreakable,\ldon’t you think?

A Trainer and their best friend
can beat any challenge!

Even the Pokémon League!

Do you think you can beat it with
only one Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: My only friend is my Pokémon. I don’t need any more friends than him. The bond between a Trainer and their best friend is unbreakable, don’t you think? A Trainer and their best friend can beat any challenge! Even the Pokémon League! Do you think you can beat it with only one Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Satu-satunya temanku adalah
Pokémonku. Aku tidak perlu teman\llain selain dia. Ikatan antara

seorang Pelatih dan sahabat
terbaiknya itu tak terputuskan,\lbukan? Seorang Pelatih dan sahabat

terbaiknya bisa mengalahkan
tantangan apa pun! Bahkan Liga\lPokémon! Apakah kamu pikir kamu

bisa mengalahkannya dengan hanya
satu Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Good luck, and never forget the
bond between you and your Pokémon\lfills you with strength!"
entries.translation_source: Good luck, and never forget the bond between you and your Pokémon fills you with strength!
entries.translated:
Semoga berhasil, dan jangan pernah
lupa bahwa ikatan antara kamu dan\lPokémon-mu memberimu kekuatan!

entries.original:
"I guess you’re one of those people
that needs more than one friend."
entries.translation_source: I guess you’re one of those people that needs more than one friend.
entries.translated:
Kukira kamu adalah salah satu dari
orang-orang yang membutuhkan lebih\ldari satu teman.

entries.original:
"You can do it!

All you need to do is beat the
Pokémon League with just one\lPokémon!"
entries.translation_source: You can do it! All you need to do is beat the Pokémon League with just one Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kamu pasti bisa! Yang perlu kamu
lakukan hanyalah mengalahkan Liga\lPokémon dengan hanya satu Pokémon!

entries.original:
"You did it!

I definitely never doubted you!

You’ve proven the bond with your
Pokémon is most important to you.

Well, take this, in case you want
an even stronger friend."
entries.translation_source: You did it! I definitely never doubted you! You’ve proven the bond with your Pokémon is most important to you. Well, take this, in case you want an even stronger friend.
entries.translated:
Kamu berhasil! Aku jelas tidak
pernah meragukanmu! Kamu telah\lmembuktikan bahwa ikatan dengan

Pokémon-mu adalah yang terpenting
bagimu. Nah, ambil ini, kalau kamu\lingin teman yang lebih kuat lagi.

entries.original:
"Never underestimate the power of
friendship!

It is definitely the most important
stat!"
entries.translation_source: Never underestimate the power of friendship! It is definitely the most important stat!
entries.translated:
Jangan pernah meremehkan kekuatan
persahabatan! Itu pasti adalah stat\lyang paling penting!

entries.original: "Moleman"
entries.translation_source: Moleman
entries.translated: Moleman

entries.original:
"Who dares enter the domain of the
Mole-Man?

Surface-dweller!

For years, my fellow mole-people
and I have lived below ground with\lonly Ground-type Pokémon and the\lEarth itself.

In that world without sunlight, we
tempered our spirits and grew\lstrong!

And yet, you try to establish
dominance over us, as your\lancestors did so many years ago!?

Very well! Learn of the wrath of
the mole-people and the very Earth!"
entries.translation_source: Who dares enter the domain of the Mole-Man? Surface-dweller! For years, my fellow mole-people and I have lived below ground with only Ground-type Pokémon and the Earth itself. In that world without sunlight, we tempered our spirits and grew strong! And yet, you try to establish dominance over us, as your ancestors did so many years ago!? Very well! Learn of the wrath of the mole-people and the very Earth!
entries.translated:
Siapa yang berani memasuki wilayah
Manusia Tikus Tanah? Penduduk\lpermukaan! Selama bertahun-tahun,

sesama manusia tikus tanah dan aku
telah hidup di bawah tanah hanya\ldengan Pokémon tipe Tanah dan Bumi

itu sendiri. Di dunia tanpa sinar
matahari itu, kami menguatkan\lsemangat kami dan menjadi kuat!

Namun, kamu mencoba untuk
mendominasi kami, seperti yang\ldilakukan nenek moyangmu

bertahun-tahun yang lalu!? Baiklah!
Rasakan murka manusia tikus tanah\ldan Bumi itu sendiri!

entries.original:
"I, the living embodiment of the
ground\. defeated by a surface-\ldweller?

But I, the Mole-man, will have my
revenge someday!

This I swear, on behalf of all
mole-people!"
entries.translation_source: I, the living embodiment of the ground[game-token-1] defeated by a surface- dweller? But I, the Mole-man, will have my revenge someday! This I swear, on behalf of all mole-people!
entries.translated:
Aku, perwujudan hidup dari tanah\.
dikalahkan oleh seorang penghuni\lpermukaan? Tapi aku, Manusia Tikus

Tanah, akan membalas dendam suatu
hari! Ini aku sumpah, atas nama\lsemua manusia tikus tanah!

entries.original:
"I cannot leave the clutches of this
so-called \qoElite Four\qc for now.

But when the time is right\. hmph.

Very well.

Test your mettle against the rest
of them.

Until we meet again\."
entries.translation_source: I cannot leave the clutches of this so-called [quote-open-1]Elite Four[quote-close-2] for now. But when the time is right[game-token-3] hmph. Very well. Test your mettle against the rest of them. Until we meet again[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa lepas dari
cengkeraman yang disebut \qoElite\lFour\qc ini untuk saat ini. Tapi saat

waktunya tepat\. hmph. Baiklah. Uji
kemampuanmu melawan yang lainnya.\lSampai kita bertemu lagi\.

entries.original:
"So, you have bested the greatest
of man and mole-man.

It is time for you to take the
throne of Champion.

Enter through the door in the
centre of the room outside.

Until the day we mole-people take
it for our own\."
entries.translation_source: So, you have bested the greatest of man and mole-man. It is time for you to take the throne of Champion. Enter through the door in the centre of the room outside. Until the day we mole-people take it for our own[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu telah mengalahkan
manusia dan manusia-tikus tanah\lterhebat. Sudah waktunya kamu

mengambil takhta Juara. Masuk
melalui pintu di tengah ruangan di\lluar. Sampai hari ketika kami

manusia-tikus tanah mengambilnya
untuk diri kami sendiri\.

entries.original:
"Surface-dweller!
You dare show yourself again?

I warn you, the mole-people do not
suffer an insult twice!

I have toiled underground,
reaffirming my connection\lto the Earth itself\.

All in preparation for this day!

And now, I shall exact my
vengeance on all surface-dwellers\.

Starting with you!"
entries.translation_source: Surface-dweller! You dare show yourself again? I warn you, the mole-people do not suffer an insult twice! I have toiled underground, reaffirming my connection to the Earth itself[game-token-1] All in preparation for this day! And now, I shall exact my vengeance on all surface-dwellers[game-token-2] Starting with you!
entries.translated:
Penghuni permukaan! Beraninya kau
muncul lagi? Aku peringatkan,\lmanusia-tikus tanah tidak

menoleransi penghinaan dua kali!
Aku telah bekerja keras di bawah\ltanah, memperkuat kembali

hubunganku dengan Bumi itu sendiri\.
Semua sebagai persiapan untuk hari\lini! Dan sekarang, aku akan

menuntut balas dendamku pada semua
penghuni permukaan\. Dimulai\ldenganmu!

entries.original:
"Gah\. so my revenge must be
postponed for another day\.

Leave. And do not return, for I
shall surely triumph next time!"
entries.translation_source: Gah[game-token-1] so my revenge must be postponed for another day[game-token-2] Leave. And do not return, for I shall surely triumph next time!
entries.translated:
Gah\. jadi balas dendamku harus
ditunda ke lain hari\. Pergi. Dan\ljangan kembali, karena aku pasti

akan menang lain kali!

entries.original:
"So, you have bested the greatest
of man and mole-man.

It is time for you to defend your
title of Champion.

Until the day we mole-people take
it for our own\."
entries.translation_source: So, you have bested the greatest of man and mole-man. It is time for you to defend your title of Champion. Until the day we mole-people take it for our own[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Jadi, kamu telah mengalahkan
manusia dan manusia-tikus tanah\lterhebat. Sudah waktunya kamu

mempertahankan gelar Juaramu.
Sampai hari ketika kami\lmanusia-tikus tanah mengambilnya

untuk diri kami sendiri\.

entries.original: "Elias"
entries.translation_source: Elias
entries.translated: Elias

entries.original:
"Howdy. I’m Elias.

Or rather, I’m the corpse formerly
known as Elias.

Guess being dead doesn’t get me
out of my duties as a member of\lthe Elite Four, huh?

Lousy economy\.

Yup. Served as a member for years
while I was alive.

Then those jerks dug up my body
after I croaked, and shoved a\lGhost Pokémon along with my spirit\lright back inside.

Oh, don’t get me wrong.

Still got my wits, and my Pokémon
haven’t gotten any less strong.

In fact, I think they might have
only gotten stronger, if anything\.

Sigh, I suppose we should battle
before this stupid flesh prison\lfalls apart."
entries.translation_source: Howdy. I’m Elias. Or rather, I’m the corpse formerly known as Elias. Guess being dead doesn’t get me out of my duties as a member of the Elite Four, huh? Lousy economy[game-token-1] Yup. Served as a member for years while I was alive. Then those jerks dug up my body after I croaked, and shoved a Ghost Pokémon along with my spirit right back inside. Oh, don’t get me wrong. Still got my wits, and my Pokémon haven’t gotten any less strong. In fact, I think they might have only gotten stronger, if anything[game-token-2] Sigh, I suppose we should battle before this stupid flesh prison falls apart.
entries.translated:
Halo. Aku Elias. Atau lebih
tepatnya, aku mayat yang dulu\ldikenal sebagai Elias. Sepertinya

mati tidak membebaskanku dari tugas
sebagai anggota Elite Four, ya?\lEkonomi yang buruk\. Yup. Bertugas

sebagai anggota selama
bertahun-tahun saat aku masih\lhidup. Lalu orang-orang brengsek

itu menggali tubuhku setelah aku
mati, dan memasukkan Pokémon Hantu\lbersama rohku kembali ke dalam. Oh,

jangan salah paham. Aku masih
waras, dan Pokémon-ku tidak menjadi\llemah. Bahkan, menurutku mereka

malah semakin kuat\. Huh, sepertinya
kita harus bertarung sebelum\lpenjara daging bodoh ini hancur.

entries.original:
"Well, can’t blame a loss on the
lousy job market, so I guess we’re\ldone here.

Go face the rest of the Elite Four.

And kid\. try not to let yourself
be dug up and experimented on\lafter you pass, okay?

Take it from me.
It’s really inconvenient."
entries.translation_source: Well, can’t blame a loss on the lousy job market, so I guess we’re done here. Go face the rest of the Elite Four. And kid[game-token-1] try not to let yourself be dug up and experimented on after you pass, okay? Take it from me. It’s really inconvenient.
entries.translated:
Yah, tidak bisa menyalahkan
kekalahan pada pasar kerja yang\lburuk, jadi kurasa kita selesai di

sini. Hadapi sisa anggota Elite
Four. Dan nak\. usahakan jangan\lsampai kamu digali dan dieksperimen

setelah kamu meninggal, oke?
Percayalah padaku. Itu sangat\lmerepotkan.

entries.original:
"Huh, would you look at that?

That’s all four of us down
for the count.

Take your rightful throne as
Champion.

It’s the centre door outside.
You can’t miss it."
entries.translation_source: Huh, would you look at that? That’s all four of us down for the count. Take your rightful throne as Champion. It’s the centre door outside. You can’t miss it.
entries.translated:
Hah, lihat itu? Kami berempat
semuanya kalah. Ambil takhta yang\lsah sebagai Juara. Itu pintu tengah

di luar. Kamu tidak akan
melewatkannya.

entries.original:
"Hey.
Surprised to see me again?

Don’t be.
I sorta knew this would happen.

They keep telling me that they’ll
find my replacement eventually,\lbut that day never comes\.

But you didn’t come here to listen
to dead air. Or a dead man.

Sigh\. Let’s just get this battle
over with."
entries.translation_source: Hey. Surprised to see me again? Don’t be. I sorta knew this would happen. They keep telling me that they’ll find my replacement eventually, but that day never comes[game-token-1] But you didn’t come here to listen to dead air. Or a dead man. Sigh[game-token-2] Let’s just get this battle over with.
entries.translated:
Hei. Terkejut melihatku lagi?
Jangan. Aku sudah agak tahu ini\lakan terjadi. Mereka terus bilang

akan mencari penggantiku suatu
hari, tapi hari itu tidak pernah\ltiba\. Tapi kau tidak datang ke sini

untuk mendengarkan suara hampa.
Atau orang mati. Huh\. Ayo selesaikan\lpertarungan ini.

entries.original:
"As much as I wanna pass on\.

I have a good mind to stick around
long enough to beat you first\.

\.I mean, whether it’s life or
death, I’m getting no respect as\lit is.

Anyway, move it.

There’s still some members of the
Elite Four to beat."
entries.translation_source: As much as I wanna pass on[game-token-1] I have a good mind to stick around long enough to beat you first[game-token-2] [game-token-3]I mean, whether it’s life or death, I’m getting no respect as it is. Anyway, move it. There’s still some members of the Elite Four to beat.
entries.translated:
Meskipun aku ingin mati\. aku punya
pikiran untuk bertahan cukup lama\luntuk mengalahkanmu dulu\. \.Maksudku,

baik hidup atau mati, aku tidak
mendapat rasa hormat. Pokoknya,\lminggir. Masih ada beberapa anggota

Elite Four yang harus dikalahkan.

entries.original:
"Huh, would you look at that?

That’s all four of us down
for the count.

Go defend your title of Champion."
entries.translation_source: Huh, would you look at that? That’s all four of us down for the count. Go defend your title of Champion.
entries.translated:
Hah, lihat itu? Kami berempat
semuanya kalah. Pergi pertahankan\lgelar Juaramu.

entries.original: "Arabella"
entries.translation_source: Arabella
entries.translated: Arabella

entries.original:
"Hi there, friend!

Oh no, I’m not a lost kid!

I’m the Fairy Princess Arabella!
I’m one of the Elite Four!

Daddy used to be a member, but
then he got fired.

So, I volunteered, and now I’m in
the Elite Four!

It’s great! I get given lots of
money to battle Trainers!

\.even if I have to share some
with Daddy.

And I get to invite people to my
tea parties when I win!

Okay, friend!

Let’s battle! I’m gonna show you
how a fairy princess does it!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, friend! Oh no, I’m not a lost kid! I’m the Fairy Princess Arabella! I’m one of the Elite Four! Daddy used to be a member, but then he got fired. So, I volunteered, and now I’m in the Elite Four! It’s great! I get given lots of money to battle Trainers! [game-token-1]even if I have to share some with Daddy. And I get to invite people to my tea parties when I win! Okay, friend! Let’s battle! I’m gonna show you how a fairy princess does it!
entries.translated:
Halo, teman! Oh tidak, aku bukan
anak hilang! Aku Putri Peri\lArabella! Aku salah satu Elite

Four! Ayah dulu anggota, tapi lalu
dipecat. Jadi, aku sukarela, dan\lsekarang aku di Elite Four! Ini

hebat! Aku diberi banyak uang untuk
bertarung melawan Pelatih! \.meskipun\laku harus berbagi dengan Ayah. Dan

aku bisa mengundang orang ke pesta
tehku saat menang! Oke, teman! Ayo\lbertarung! Aku akan menunjukkan

bagaimana putri peri melakukannya!

entries.original:
"When you’re done with the rest of
the Elite Four, will you still join\lone of my tea parties?

It’s going to be so much fun!

If not\. can I ask: do you know
what \qodeadbeat\qc means?

That’s what people call Daddy now."
entries.translation_source: When you’re done with the rest of the Elite Four, will you still join one of my tea parties? It’s going to be so much fun! If not[game-token-1] can I ask: do you know what [quote-open-2]deadbeat[quote-close-3] means? That’s what people call Daddy now.
entries.translated:
Saat kamu selesai dengan sisa Elite
Four, apakah kamu masih akan ikut\lsalah satu pesta tehku? Itu akan

sangat menyenangkan! Jika tidak\.
bolehkah aku bertanya: apakah kamu\ltahu apa arti \qopemalas\qc? Itu yang

orang-orang panggil Ayah sekarang.

entries.original:
"Wow. You beat all of us!
You’re really super strong!

There’s a big door in the centre
of the hall outside.

That’s where the Champion room is!
You should go and see it!"
entries.translation_source: Wow. You beat all of us! You’re really super strong! There’s a big door in the centre of the hall outside. That’s where the Champion room is! You should go and see it!
entries.translated:
Wow. Kamu mengalahkan kami semua!
Kamu benar-benar super kuat! Ada\lpintu besar di tengah aula di luar.

Itu tempat ruang Juara! Kamu harus
pergi dan lihat!

entries.original:
"Hi there, [player]!
Did you miss me?

I just finished a tea party with
my friends just now.

Sorry, you’ll have to wait for the
next one\.

Oh! You’re here for a battle
instead, aren’t you\.?

Yay! I wanna show you how much
stronger I got! Really!

Okay! For my fairy friends, and
for Daddy\.

Arabella the fairy princess!
Transform!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, [player-name-1]! Did you miss me? I just finished a tea party with my friends just now. Sorry, you’ll have to wait for the next one[game-token-2] Oh! You’re here for a battle instead, aren’t you[game-token-3]? Yay! I wanna show you how much stronger I got! Really! Okay! For my fairy friends, and for Daddy[game-token-4] Arabella the fairy princess! Transform!
entries.translated:
Halo, [player]! Apakah kamu
merindukanku? Aku baru saja selesai\lpesta teh dengan teman-temanku

tadi. Maaf, kamu harus menunggu
yang berikutnya\. Oh! Kamu di sini\luntuk bertarung, bukan\.? Yay! Aku

ingin menunjukkan betapa kuatnya
aku sekarang! Sungguh! Oke! Demi\lteman-teman peri, dan demi Ayah\.

Arabella putri peri!
Bertransformasi!

entries.original:
"Thanks for battling me again!

Daddy hardly battles anymore since
he quit.

But it’s okay!

I’ll keep working at the Elite Four
until Daddy gets a new job!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks for battling me again! Daddy hardly battles anymore since he quit. But it’s okay! I’ll keep working at the Elite Four until Daddy gets a new job!
entries.translated:
Terima kasih sudah bertarung
denganku lagi! Ayah jarang\lbertarung lagi sejak dia berhenti.

Tapi tidak apa-apa! Aku akan terus
bekerja di Elite Four sampai Ayah\lmendapat pekerjaan baru!

entries.original:
"Wow. You beat all of us!
You’re really super strong!

You should go defend your title of
Champion now!"
entries.translation_source: Wow. You beat all of us! You’re really super strong! You should go defend your title of Champion now!
entries.translated:
Wow. Kamu mengalahkan kami semua!
Kamu benar-benar super kuat! Kamu\lharus pergi mempertahankan gelar

Juaramu sekarang!

entries.original: "Penny"
entries.translation_source: Penny
entries.translated: Penny

entries.original:
"Hi, I’m Penny!

\.what?
This thing I’m wearing?

These aren’t clothes, they’re my
patented Goodra bottoms!

I’ve always been a huge fan of
Dragon-type Pokémon, so I love\llooking just like them!

There isn’t anything I don’t know
about them, and there isn’t a\lsingle piece of Dragon merchandise\lI haven’t bought!

Dragons are the best!

With their tails and their wings
and their FIRE BREATHING!

A filthy casual like you doesn’t
stand a chance against me!

I’ll prove it to you right now!

GRAWR!"
entries.translation_source: Hi, I’m Penny! [game-token-1]what? This thing I’m wearing? These aren’t clothes, they’re my patented Goodra bottoms! I’ve always been a huge fan of Dragon-type Pokémon, so I love looking just like them! There isn’t anything I don’t know about them, and there isn’t a single piece of Dragon merchandise I haven’t bought! Dragons are the best! With their tails and their wings and their FIRE BREATHING! A filthy casual like you doesn’t stand a chance against me! I’ll prove it to you right now! GRAWR!
entries.translated:
Hai, aku Penny! \.Apa? Benda yang aku
pakai ini? Ini bukan pakaian, ini\ladalah celana Goodra patenku! Aku

selalu menjadi penggemar berat
Pokémon tipe Naga, jadi aku suka\lterlihat persis seperti mereka!

Tidak ada satu pun yang tidak aku
ketahui tentang mereka, dan tidak\lada satu pun barang dagangan Naga

yang belum aku beli! Naga adalah
yang terbaik! Dengan ekor dan sayap\ldan NAPAS API mereka! Orang

amatiran seperti kamu tidak punya
kesempatan melawanku! Aku akan\lmembuktikannya padamu sekarang!

GRAWR!

entries.original:
"What!? But I had the best Pokémon
type in the world ever!

\.Aw, fine.
I guess that was pretty impressive.

Looks like my dragons and I still
need to get stronger."
entries.translation_source: What!? But I had the best Pokémon type in the world ever! [game-token-1]Aw, fine. I guess that was pretty impressive. Looks like my dragons and I still need to get stronger.
entries.translated:
Apa!? Tapi aku punya tipe Pokémon
terbaik di dunia! \.Ah, baiklah.\lKurasa itu cukup mengesankan.

Sepertinya aku dan naga-nagaku
masih perlu menjadi lebih kuat.

entries.original:
"You’re still not done yet, right?
Go battle the rest of the Elite Four!

Me? I’m gonna go pick up my
Haxorus edition Unova coffee mug\land mouse pad.

You should get it soon, it’s only
on sale for the next three days!"
entries.translation_source: You’re still not done yet, right? Go battle the rest of the Elite Four! Me? I’m gonna go pick up my Haxorus edition Unova coffee mug and mouse pad. You should get it soon, it’s only on sale for the next three days!
entries.translated:
Kamu masih belum selesai, kan?
Pergi bertarung dengan sisa Elite\lFour! Aku? Aku akan pergi mengambil

cangkir kopi dan mouse pad Unova
edisi Haxorusku. Kamu harus segera\lmendapatkannya, hanya diskon tiga

hari ke depan!

entries.original:
"Wowee!
Even I lost!

And now you get to be
Borrius’ Champion!

It’s time for you to take the
centre door right outside.

As for me, I’m heading off to
Dragon-con.

You want me to pick you up anything
while I’m there?

No? Ah, suit yourself.
More merch for me!"
entries.translation_source: Wowee! Even I lost! And now you get to be Borrius’ Champion! It’s time for you to take the centre door right outside. As for me, I’m heading off to Dragon-con. You want me to pick you up anything while I’m there? No? Ah, suit yourself. More merch for me!
entries.translated:
Wowee! Bahkan aku kalah! Dan
sekarang kamu menjadi Juara\lBorrius! Saatnya kamu mengambil

pintu tengah di luar. Untuk diriku,
aku akan pergi ke Dragon-con. Kamu\lingin aku membelikan sesuatu selama

di sana? Tidak? Ah, terserah. Lebih
banyak barang untukku!

entries.original:
"Oh hey, it’s you again!

I’ve been levelling up my Dragons
since we last battled!

And now, thanks to my harsh
training, non-stop studying of\lDragon’s Monthly, and a king’s\lransom of Dragon memorabilia\.

I’m the greatest expert on all
things Dragon you ever saw!

Dukes up! My Dragons and I are
itching to throw down!

GRAWR!"
entries.translation_source: Oh hey, it’s you again! I’ve been levelling up my Dragons since we last battled! And now, thanks to my harsh training, non-stop studying of Dragon’s Monthly, and a king’s ransom of Dragon memorabilia[game-token-1] I’m the greatest expert on all things Dragon you ever saw! Dukes up! My Dragons and I are itching to throw down! GRAWR!
entries.translated:
Oh hai, kamu lagi! Aku sudah
menaikkan level Naga-Nagaku sejak\lkita bertarung terakhir! Dan

sekarang, berkat latihanku yang
keras, belajar tanpa henti dari\lDragon{B4}s Monthly, dan sejumlah

besar memorabilia Naga\. Aku adalah
pakar terhebat dalam segala hal\ltentang Naga yang pernah kamu

lihat! Angkat tangan! Aku dan
Naga-Nagaku tidak sabar untuk\lbertarung! GRAWR!

entries.original:
"Nooo\. that magazine was a non-
cancellable subscription\. and\lI still couldn’t beat you\.

I’m picking up a Noivern tracksuit
to cheer myself up.

And no, you can’t have one.

The title of Borrius’ repeat
Champion is good enough, don’t\lyou think?

Now don’t lose to the others\.
until I beat you myself!"
entries.translation_source: Nooo[game-token-1] that magazine was a non- cancellable subscription[game-token-2] and I still couldn’t beat you[game-token-3] I’m picking up a Noivern tracksuit to cheer myself up. And no, you can’t have one. The title of Borrius’ repeat Champion is good enough, don’t you think? Now don’t lose to the others[game-token-4] until I beat you myself!
entries.translated:
Tidaaak\. majalah itu adalah
langganan yang tidak bisa\ldibatalkan\. dan aku tetap tidak bisa

mengalahkanmu\. Aku akan membeli
tracksuit Noivern untuk menghibur\ldiriku. Dan tidak, kamu tidak bisa

punya satu. Gelar Juara berulang
Borrius sudah cukup, menurutmu?\lSekarang jangan kalah dari yang

lain\. sampai aku mengalahkanmu
sendiri!

entries.original:
"Wowee!
Even I lost!

And now you get to defend your
title of Champion!

As for me, I’m heading off to
Dragon-con.

You want me to pick you up anything
while I’m there?

No? Ah, suit yourself.
More merch for me!"
entries.translation_source: Wowee! Even I lost! And now you get to defend your title of Champion! As for me, I’m heading off to Dragon-con. You want me to pick you up anything while I’m there? No? Ah, suit yourself. More merch for me!
entries.translated:
Wowee! Bahkan aku kalah! Dan
sekarang kamu bisa mempertahankan\lgelar Juaramu! Untuk diriku, aku

akan pergi ke Dragon-con. Kamu
ingin aku membelikan sesuatu selama\ldi sana? Tidak? Ah, terserah. Lebih

banyak barang untukku!

entries.original: "Solenk"
entries.translation_source: Solenk
entries.translated: Solenk

entries.original:
"[black]You defended your title!
Congratulations!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You defended your title! Congratulations!
entries.translated:
[black]Kamu mempertahankan gelarmu!
Selamat!

entries.original:
"Hey, [player]! I finally caught up
to you!

So funny story - I had to put my
Gym Challenge on the backburner,\lthanks to my dad\.

But now that we’re done catching
up, I clawed my way through the\lElite Four, just to see you.

So let’s get back to what’s really
important.

Me\.\CC0820 taking your Champion’s title!

I’ve put together the best of
the best in this lineup\.

And that includes a super rare
Pokémon I found at Cinder Volcano!

Ready, [player]?
Because you’re going down!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player-name-1]! I finally caught up to you! So funny story - I had to put my Gym Challenge on the backburner, thanks to my dad[game-token-2] But now that we’re done catching up, I clawed my way through the Elite Four, just to see you. So let’s get back to what’s really important. Me[game-token-3][control-code-4] taking your Champion’s title! I’ve put together the best of the best in this lineup[game-token-5] And that includes a super rare Pokémon I found at Cinder Volcano! Ready, [player-name-6]? Because you’re going down!
entries.translated:
Hei, [player]! Akhirnya aku bisa
mengejarmu! Jadi cerita lucu - aku\lharus menunda Tantangan Gym-ku,

karena ayahku\. Tapi sekarang setelah
kita selesai bertemu, aku berjuang\lmelewati Elite Four, hanya untuk

menemuimu. Jadi mari kita kembali
ke hal yang benar-benar penting.\lAku\.\CC0820 mengambil gelar Juaramu! Aku

telah menyusun yang terbaik dari
yang terbaik dalam lineup ini\. Dan\litu termasuk Pokémon langka super

yang aku temukan di Cinder Volcano!
Siap, [player]? Karena kamu akan\lkalah!

entries.original:
"[player]!

I can’t let you pass through there,
without another round with me!

After all, how can I show my face
to Dad if I can’t even beat one\lmeasly Trainer?

Let’s go! I’m taking your spot at the
top for sure!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I can’t let you pass through there, without another round with me! After all, how can I show my face to Dad if I can’t even beat one measly Trainer? Let’s go! I’m taking your spot at the top for sure!
entries.translated:
[player]! Aku tidak bisa
membiarkanmu lewat sana, tanpa satu\lronde lagi denganku! Lagipula,

bagaimana aku bisa menunjukkan
wajahku pada Ayah jika aku bahkan\ltidak bisa mengalahkan satu Pelatih

rendahan? Ayo pergi! Aku pasti
mengambil tempatmu di puncak!

entries.original:
"Wait one moment, [player]!

Are you surprised to see me out
here?

Well, I thought I heard a familiar
cry calling out to me\.

That was the moment when I
encountered Zapdos.

No, not the one from Thundercap Mt.\.\CC0818
the one Aklove used for the\lunbinding at the Ruins of Void.

I still don’t know why it came to me,
why it chose me as its Trainer\.

But I knew it was a sign - that I
had to find you and battle you\lonce again!

To be honest, defeating you is
[rival]’s goal, first and foremost\.

But I’m his father - I can’t sit
around and let my own skills\lstagnate, can I?

So, no matter how long a shot
this is, I’d like to try my hand\lat defeating you!"
entries.translation_source: Wait one moment, [player-name-1]! Are you surprised to see me out here? Well, I thought I heard a familiar cry calling out to me[game-token-2] That was the moment when I encountered Zapdos. No, not the one from Thundercap Mt.[game-token-3][control-code-4] the one Aklove used for the unbinding at the Ruins of Void. I still don’t know why it came to me, why it chose me as its Trainer[game-token-5] But I knew it was a sign - that I had to find you and battle you once again! To be honest, defeating you is [text-token-rival-6]’s goal, first and foremost[game-token-7] But I’m his father - I can’t sit around and let my own skills stagnate, can I? So, no matter how long a shot this is, I’d like to try my hand at defeating you!
entries.translated:
Tunggu sebentar, [player]! Apakah
kamu terkejut melihatku di sini?\lYah, aku pikir aku mendengar

teriakan yang familiar memanggilku\.
Saat itulah aku bertemu Zapdos.\lBukan, bukan yang dari Thundercap

Mt.\.\CC0818 yang digunakan Aklove untuk
pelepasan ikatan di Ruins of Void.\lAku masih tidak tahu mengapa ia

datang kepadaku, mengapa ia
memilihku sebagai Pelatihnya\. Tapi\laku tahu itu adalah tanda - bahwa

aku harus menemukanmu dan bertarung
denganmu lagi! Sejujurnya,\lmengalahkanmu adalah tujuan

[rival], pertama dan terutama\. Tapi
aku adalah ayahnya - aku tidak bisa\lduduk diam dan membiarkan

kemampuanku sendiri mandek, kan?
Jadi, tidak peduli seberapa\lsulitnya ini, aku ingin mencoba

mengalahkanmu!

entries.original:
"One moment, [player].

I’m afraid that [rival] and I have
a bit of a rivalry brewing at home\.

Who can be the first to claim your
title of Champion - myself, or\l[rival]?

And as a Trainer, I have my pride.

I can’t allow myself to lose to
[rival] that easily.

And so, I have to put everything I
have on the line to take you down!"
entries.translation_source: One moment, [player-name-1]. I’m afraid that [text-token-rival-2] and I have a bit of a rivalry brewing at home[game-token-3] Who can be the first to claim your title of Champion - myself, or [text-token-rival-4]? And as a Trainer, I have my pride. I can’t allow myself to lose to [text-token-rival-5] that easily. And so, I have to put everything I have on the line to take you down!
entries.translated:
Sebentar, [player]. Aku khawatir
bahwa [rival] dan aku memiliki\lsedikit persaingan yang berkembang

di rumah\. Siapa yang bisa menjadi
yang pertama mengklaim gelar\lJuaramu - aku, atau [rival]? Dan

sebagai Pelatih, aku memiliki harga
diriku. Aku tidak bisa membiarkan\ldiriku kalah dari [rival] semudah

itu. Jadi, aku harus mempertaruhkan
segalanya untuk menjatuhkanmu!

entries.original:
"There you are, [player].

I\.\CC0818 well, when I heard that you had
returned to the Pokémon League\.

I thought that this would be my
biggest chance to battle you again.

I don’t quite know why, myself.

Is it simply to try and impress
Marlon, or even [rival]?

Or does it stem from something
else entirely\.?

I actually don’t quite remember, and
yet, here I am.

But either way, you cannot refuse my
challenge, so get ready!"
entries.translation_source: There you are, [player-name-1]. I[game-token-2][control-code-3] well, when I heard that you had returned to the Pokémon League[game-token-4] I thought that this would be my biggest chance to battle you again. I don’t quite know why, myself. Is it simply to try and impress Marlon, or even [text-token-rival-5]? Or does it stem from something else entirely[game-token-6]? I actually don’t quite remember, and yet, here I am. But either way, you cannot refuse my challenge, so get ready!
entries.translated:
Itu dia, [player]. Aku\.\CC0818 yah, ketika
aku mendengar bahwa kamu telah\lkembali ke Liga Pokémon\. Aku pikir

ini akan menjadi kesempatan
terbesarku untuk bertarung denganmu\llagi. Aku sendiri tidak begitu tahu

mengapa. Apakah hanya untuk mencoba
dan mengesankan Marlon, atau bahkan\l[rival]? Atau apakah itu berasal

dari sesuatu yang lain sama sekali\.?
Sebenarnya aku tidak begitu ingat,\lnamun, aku di sini. Tapi

bagaimanapun, kamu tidak bisa
menolak tantanganku, jadi\lbersiaplah!

entries.original:
"Yes, [player] it’s me - I’ve returned
for another battle with you.

Something stirs within me\. almost like
I have to defeat you, no matter\lwhat it takes\.

Is this my pride as a Trainer?
Or maybe something else\.

Either way, I don’t think I’ll settle
down without one more try!"
entries.translation_source: Yes, [player-name-1] it’s me - I’ve returned for another battle with you. Something stirs within me[game-token-2] almost like I have to defeat you, no matter what it takes[game-token-3] Is this my pride as a Trainer? Or maybe something else[game-token-4] Either way, I don’t think I’ll settle down without one more try!
entries.translated:
Ya, [player] ini aku - aku kembali
untuk pertarungan lain denganmu.\lSesuatu bergolak di dalam diriku\.

hampir seperti aku harus
mengalahkanmu, apa pun yang terjadi\.\lApakah ini harga diriku sebagai

Pelatih? Atau mungkin sesuatu yang
lain\. Bagaimanapun, aku tidak akan\ltenang tanpa satu percobaan lagi!

entries.original:
"I’m afraid I cannot let you pass
through those doors so easily.

You see, my son was pestering me to
find you and record a victory.

And as his father, I ought to do my
very best for him!

Ah, but of course, I don’t expect
you to just hand me a victory out\lof pity.

Let me test myself against the true
strength of Borrius’s Champion!"
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid I cannot let you pass through those doors so easily. You see, my son was pestering me to find you and record a victory. And as his father, I ought to do my very best for him! Ah, but of course, I don’t expect you to just hand me a victory out of pity. Let me test myself against the true strength of Borrius’s Champion!
entries.translated:
Aku khawatir aku tidak bisa
membiarkanmu melewati pintu-pintu\litu dengan mudah. Begini, anakku

terus mendesakku untuk menemukanmu
dan mencatat kemenangan. Dan\lsebagai ayahnya, aku harus

melakukan yang terbaik untuknya!
Ah, tapi tentu saja, aku tidak\lmengharapkanmu memberiku kemenangan

karena kasihan. Biarkan aku menguji
diriku melawan kekuatan sejati dari\lJuara Borrius!

entries.original:
"[player]!
So you finally came back, huh?

Ever since I lost to you, I’ve been
thinking long and hard about what\lI’ve been lacking\.

And especially about my Grampa
Arthur’s legacy\.

But right now, this isn’t about
Grampa. Or even about me.

This is about knowing there’s a strong
Trainer in front of me, ripe to be\lchallenged!

And that’s what gets my heart
racing, no matter when or where!

It’s on, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! So you finally came back, huh? Ever since I lost to you, I’ve been thinking long and hard about what I’ve been lacking[game-token-2] And especially about my Grampa Arthur’s legacy[game-token-3] But right now, this isn’t about Grampa. Or even about me. This is about knowing there’s a strong Trainer in front of me, ripe to be challenged! And that’s what gets my heart racing, no matter when or where! It’s on, [player-name-4]!
entries.translated:
[player]! Jadi akhirnya kamu
kembali, ya? Sejak aku kalah\ldarimu, aku telah berpikir keras

tentang apa yang kurang dariku\. Dan
terutama tentang warisan Kakek\lArthur\. Tapi sekarang ini bukan

tentang Kakek. Atau bahkan
tentangku. Ini tentang mengetahui\lada Pelatih kuat di depanku, siap

untuk ditantang! Dan itulah yang
membuat jantungku berdebar, kapan\lpun dan di mana pun! Ayo, [player]!

entries.original:
"Back again, [player]?
Well, so am I.

No matter how often I lose,
I can’t help it!

Every battle, I get to measure just
how much of a gap I have to close\lto catch up to you!

So, let’s see the level of strength I
have to surpass, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Back again, [player-name-1]? Well, so am I. No matter how often I lose, I can’t help it! Every battle, I get to measure just how much of a gap I have to close to catch up to you! So, let’s see the level of strength I have to surpass, [player-name-2]!
entries.translated:
Kembali lagi, [player]? Yah, aku
juga. Tidak peduli seberapa sering\laku kalah, aku tidak bisa

menahannya! Setiap pertarungan, aku
bisa mengukur seberapa besar celah\lyang harus aku tutup untuk

mengejarmu! Jadi, mari kita lihat
tingkat kekuatan yang harus aku\llampaui, [player]!

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Remember me? It’s Milo!
From Thundercap Mt.!

I came all this way just to see
you again!

Say, let’s have a battle!

I bet it’ll be super fun with a
strong Trainer like you!"
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player-name-1]! Remember me? It’s Milo! From Thundercap Mt.! I came all this way just to see you again! Say, let’s have a battle! I bet it’ll be super fun with a strong Trainer like you!
entries.translated:
Hai, [player]! Ingat aku? Ini Milo!
Dari Thundercap Mt.! Aku datang\lsejauh ini hanya untuk menemuimu

lagi! Ayo, kita bertarung! Aku
yakin itu akan sangat menyenangkan\ldengan Pelatih kuat sepertimu!

entries.original:
"You’re still super strong,
[player]!

That was so much fun!
I’m glad I came all this way!"
entries.translation_source: You’re still super strong, [player-name-1]! That was so much fun! I’m glad I came all this way!
entries.translated:
Kamu masih sangat kuat, [player]!
Itu sangat menyenangkan! Aku senang\laku datang sejauh ini!

entries.original:
"Hey, Champion!

I made it through the Elite Four
just so I could battle with you!

Me and my shorts won’t lose this
fight!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Champion! I made it through the Elite Four just so I could battle with you! Me and my shorts won’t lose this fight!
entries.translated:
Hei, Juara! Aku berhasil melewati
Empat Elite hanya untuk bertarung\ldenganmu! Aku dan celana pendekku

tidak akan kalah dalam pertarungan
ini!

entries.original: "Shadow"
entries.translation_source: Shadow

entries.original: "Nostalgic"
entries.translation_source: Nostalgic

entries.original: "Machine"
entries.translation_source: Machine

entries.original: "Polder Town"
entries.translation_source: Polder Town
entries.translated: Polder Town

entries.original: "Polder Town D"
entries.translation_source: Polder Town D

entries.original: "Polder Town N"
entries.translation_source: Polder Town N

entries.original:
"Welcome to East Borrius!

Polder Town is a far cry from
any place in West Borrius, don’t\lyou think?

Like, I doubt West Borrians would
willingly live in a swamp."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to East Borrius! Polder Town is a far cry from any place in West Borrius, don’t you think? Like, I doubt West Borrians would willingly live in a swamp.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di Borrius Timur!
Polder Town sangat berbeda dari\ltempat mana pun di Borrius Barat,

bukan? Seperti, aku ragu penduduk
Borrius Barat mau tinggal di rawa.

entries.original:
"You might think the muddy ground
makes it hard to live here, but\lguess again!

The mud is actually very good for
the skin."
entries.translation_source: You might think the muddy ground makes it hard to live here, but guess again! The mud is actually very good for the skin.
entries.translated:
Kamu mungkin mengira tanah
berlumpur membuat sulit tinggal di\lsini, tapi coba tebak lagi! Lumpur

itu sebenarnya sangat baik untuk
kulit.

entries.original:
"Tessy’s Pokémon may not all look
like [green]Water[red]-type Pokémon, but I\lguarantee you, most will be when\lyou fight them!"
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s Pokémon may not all look like [color-green-1]Water[color-red-2]-type Pokémon, but I guarantee you, most will be when you fight them!
entries.translated:
Pokémon Tessy mungkin tidak
semuanya terlihat seperti Pokémon\ltipe [green]Air[red], tapi aku jamin, sebagian

besar akan menjadi tipe Air saat
kamu melawan mereka!

entries.original:
"Tessy’s so smart!

She figured out a way to make her
Pokémon the same type as their\lmoves!

I bet she learned how at the
[green]Battle Circus[red]."
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s so smart! She figured out a way to make her Pokémon the same type as their moves! I bet she learned how at the [color-green-1]Battle Circus[color-red-2].
entries.translated:
Tessy pintar sekali! Dia menemukan
cara untuk membuat Pokémon-nya\lmemiliki tipe yang sama dengan

jurus mereka! Aku yakin dia belajar
caranya di [green]Battle Circus[red].

entries.original:
"Today, we’re dancing for a reason.

When we fulfill our purpose, we’ll
disappear for a reason."
entries.translation_source: Today, we’re dancing for a reason. When we fulfill our purpose, we’ll disappear for a reason.
entries.translated:
Hari ini, kita menari karena suatu
alasan. Saat kita memenuhi tujuan\lkita, kita akan menghilang karena

suatu alasan.

entries.original:
"We dance to worship our goddess!
The one and only Meloetta!

Who needs Arceus?"
entries.translation_source: We dance to worship our goddess! The one and only Meloetta! Who needs Arceus?
entries.translated:
Kami menari untuk memuja dewi kami!
Satu-satunya Meloetta! Siapa yang\lbutuh Arceus?

entries.original:
"Legend has it that Meloetta will
appear if you dance hard enough.

We dance for the chance to one day
witness a true dancer."
entries.translation_source: Legend has it that Meloetta will appear if you dance hard enough. We dance for the chance to one day witness a true dancer.
entries.translated:
Legenda mengatakan bahwa Meloetta
akan muncul jika kamu menari cukup\lkeras. Kami menari untuk kesempatan

suatu hari menyaksikan penari
sejati.

entries.original:
"The night I see Meloetta is the
night I resume my normal life.

But until then\.
I dance!"
entries.translation_source: The night I see Meloetta is the night I resume my normal life. But until then[game-token-1] I dance!
entries.translated:
Malam saat aku melihat Meloetta
adalah malam saat aku melanjutkan\lhidup normalku. Tapi sampai saat

itu\. aku menari!

entries.original:
"Meloetta!
We love you!"
entries.translation_source: Meloetta! We love you!
entries.translated: Meloetta! Kami mencintaimu!

entries.original:
"[black]Meloetta is challenging you to a
dance off for the right to battle!

Do you accept the challenge?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Meloetta is challenging you to a dance off for the right to battle! Do you accept the challenge?
entries.translated:
[black]Meloetta menantangmu dalam adu
dansa untuk hak bertarung! Apakah\lkamu menerima tantangan?

entries.original:
"[black]During the course of the dance off,
keys will appear on the screen.

To win, press all corresponding
keys before they disappear."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]During the course of the dance off, keys will appear on the screen. To win, press all corresponding keys before they disappear.
entries.translated:
[black]Selama adu dansa berlangsung,
tombol akan muncul di layar. Untuk\lmenang, tekan semua tombol yang

sesuai sebelum tombol itu
menghilang.

entries.original:
"[black]Meloetta is pleased with your
performance.

It acknowledges your right to
battle it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Meloetta is pleased with your performance. It acknowledges your right to battle it!
entries.translated:
[black]Meloetta senang dengan
penampilanmu. Meloetta mengakui\lhakmu untuk bertarung dengannya!

entries.original:
"[black]Meloetta is displeased you could
not defeat it in a dance off."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Meloetta is displeased you could not defeat it in a dance off.
entries.translated:
[black]Meloetta tidak senang karena kamu
tidak bisa mengalahkannya dalam adu\ldansa.

entries.original: "Lalalala!"
entries.translation_source: Lalalala!
entries.translated: Lalalala!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] took off in the
moonlight."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] took off in the moonlight.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] pergi di bawah sinar
bulan.

entries.original:
"Will you come see Polder Town’s
famous Croagunk show?"
entries.translation_source: Will you come see Polder Town’s famous Croagunk show?
entries.translated:
Maukah kamu datang melihat
pertunjukan Croagunk terkenal di\lPolder Town?

entries.original:
"Okay!
I’m going to get all fired up!"
entries.translation_source: Okay! I’m going to get all fired up!
entries.translated: Oke! Aku akan bersemangat sekali!

entries.original:
"Ready all Croagunk!
Everyone, gather up!"
entries.translation_source: Ready all Croagunk! Everyone, gather up!
entries.translated:
Siapkan semua Croagunk! Semuanya,
berkumpul!

entries.original:
"The Croagunk that I will have you
follow today is\."
entries.translation_source: The Croagunk that I will have you follow today is[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Croagunk yang akan saya minta kamu
ikuti hari ini adalah\.

entries.original:
"This--the Croagunk with the
[buffer2]!

It’s holding a [buffer1]!
Ready, set, go!"
entries.translation_source: This--the Croagunk with the [buffer2-1]! It’s holding a [buffer1-2]! Ready, set, go!
entries.translated:
Ini--Croagunk dengan [buffer2]! Ia
memegang [buffer1]! Siap, siap,\lmulai!

entries.original:
"Okay! Find the Croagunk that
I asked you to follow!"
entries.translation_source: Okay! Find the Croagunk that I asked you to follow!
entries.translated:
Oke! Temukan Croagunk yang saya
minta kamu ikuti!

entries.original:
"[red]That Croagunk is holding a
[buffer1], right?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]That Croagunk is holding a [buffer1-2], right?
entries.translated:
[red]Croagunk itu memegang [buffer1],
kan?

entries.original:
"[red]You are\.
\.\ltotally correct!

Receive the prize, a [buffer1],
from that Croagunk!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]You are[game-token-2] [game-token-3] totally correct! Receive the prize, a [buffer1-4], from that Croagunk!
entries.translated:
[red]Kamu\. \. benar sekali! Terima
hadiahnya, [buffer1], dari Croagunk\litu!

entries.original:
"[red]You are\.
\.\linconceivably incorrect!

I’m sorry\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]You are[game-token-2] [game-token-3] inconceivably incorrect! I’m sorry[game-token-4]
entries.translated: [red]Kamu\. \. salah besar! Maaf\.

entries.original:
"[red]That marks the grand finale of our
Croagunk show!

Thank you, one and all!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]That marks the grand finale of our Croagunk show! Thank you, one and all!
entries.translated:
[red]Itulah akhir yang spektakuler dari
pertunjukan Croagunk kami! Terima\lkasih, satu dan semua!

entries.original:
"That’s too bad\.
I guarantee it’s great, though."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad[game-token-1] I guarantee it’s great, though.
entries.translated: Sayang sekali\. Saya jamin ini bagus.

entries.original:
"You want to see the Croagunk
again?

There are a lot of preparations
and such to make, so come back\ltomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: You want to see the Croagunk again? There are a lot of preparations and such to make, so come back tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Kamu ingin melihat Croagunk lagi?
Ada banyak persiapan dan\lsebagainya, jadi kembalilah besok!

entries.original: "[green]Croak\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Croak[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Croak\.

entries.original:
"Operating a ship every day can wear
you out! It’s not running today.

It leaves for Seaport City on
[green]Sundays[blue] and [green]Wednesdays[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Operating a ship every day can wear you out! It’s not running today. It leaves for Seaport City on [color-green-1]Sundays[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Wednesdays[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Mengoperasikan kapal setiap hari
bisa melelahkan! Hari ini tidak\lberoperasi. Kapal berangkat ke

Seaport City pada hari [green]Minggu[blue] dan
[green]Rabu[blue]!

entries.original:
"When it’s working, the S.S. Marine
sets sail to West Borrius on\lSundays and Wednesdays."
entries.translation_source: When it’s working, the S.S. Marine sets sail to West Borrius on Sundays and Wednesdays.
entries.translated:
Saat beroperasi, S.S. Marine
berlayar ke West Borrius pada hari\lMinggu dan Rabu.

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine sets sail to West
Borrius every [green]Sunday[blue] and [green]Wednesday[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine sets sail to West Borrius every [color-green-1]Sunday[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Wednesday[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
S.S. Marine berlayar ke West
Borrius setiap hari [green]Minggu[blue] dan\l[green]Rabu[blue].

entries.original: "Average Angler"
entries.translation_source: Average Angler
entries.translated: Pemancing Rata-rata

entries.original: "Great Piscator"
entries.translation_source: Great Piscator
entries.translated: Piscator Hebat

entries.original: "Fisher Master"
entries.translation_source: Fisher Master
entries.translated: Master Pemancing

entries.original:
"It’s time to whip out your Rod and
get fishing! Hook [buffer1] Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It’s time to whip out your Rod and get fishing! Hook [buffer1-1] Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Waktunya mengeluarkan Pancing
dan mulai memancing! Tangkap
[buffer1] Pokémon.

entries.original:
"It’s time to whip out the bait and
lure in some fish! Hook [buffer1] Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It’s time to whip out the bait and lure in some fish! Hook [buffer1-1] Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Waktunya mengeluarkan umpan
dan memikat ikan! Tangkap
[buffer1] Pokémon.

entries.original:
"It’s time to plant yourself firm
and look onward. Hook [buffer1] Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It’s time to plant yourself firm and look onward. Hook [buffer1-1] Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Waktunya bertahan dan melihat
ke depan. Tangkap [buffer1]
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Hey, Trainer!

Remember me?
I certainly remember you.

I’m the guy you met in Gurun Town!

My hope was to strike it big here
in East Borrius, but the only gig\lI could find involves fishing\.

Anyway, I was hired as a sporting
goods promoter by Cube Corp.

They wanted me to encourage
Trainers to fish more, and\lthereby promote their signature\lfishing rod band.

So, here’s my encouragement
to you!

If you fish for at least [green][buffer1][blue]
Pokémon using fishing rods you\lobtain yourself, you’ll be eligible\lfor a reward!

How does that sound?
Great, right?

Come back to me if you’ve fished at
least [green][buffer1][blue] times!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Trainer! Remember me? I certainly remember you. I’m the guy you met in Gurun Town! My hope was to strike it big here in East Borrius, but the only gig I could find involves fishing[game-token-1] Anyway, I was hired as a sporting goods promoter by Cube Corp. They wanted me to encourage Trainers to fish more, and thereby promote their signature fishing rod band. So, here’s my encouragement to you! If you fish for at least [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] Pokémon using fishing rods you obtain yourself, you’ll be eligible for a reward! How does that sound? Great, right? Come back to me if you’ve fished at least [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-blue-7] times!
entries.translated:
Hei, Pelatih! Ingat aku? Aku pasti
ingat kamu. Aku orang yang kamu\ltemui di Gurun Town! Harapanku

adalah sukses besar di East
Borrius, tapi satu-satunya\lpekerjaan yang bisa kudapatkan

adalah memancing\. Ngomong-ngomong,
aku dipekerjakan sebagai promotor\lperlengkapan olahraga oleh Cube

Corp. Mereka ingin aku mendorong
Pelatih untuk lebih banyak\lmemancing, dan dengan demikian

mempromosikan pita pancing andalan
mereka. Jadi, inilah doronganku\luntukmu! Jika kamu memancing

setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon
menggunakan pancing yang kamu\ldapatkan sendiri, kamu berhak

mendapatkan hadiah! Kedengarannya
bagaimana? Hebat, kan? Kembalilah\lpadaku jika kamu sudah memancing

setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] kali!

entries.original:
"After your great showing, I now
have another task for you.

Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even
further by fishing for Pokémon\lat least [green][buffer1][blue] times."
entries.translation_source: After your great showing, I now have another task for you. Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even further by fishing for Pokémon at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] times.
entries.translated:
Setelah penampilan hebatmu, aku
punya tugas lain untukmu.\lPromosikan pancing Cube Corp. lebih

jauh dengan memancing Pokémon
setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] kali.

entries.original:
"After your great showing, I now
have one last task for you.

Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even
further by fishing for Pokémon\lat least 50 more times, for a\lgrand total of [green][buffer1][blue] times!

This should be easy for a great
piscator such as yourself."
entries.translation_source: After your great showing, I now have one last task for you. Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even further by fishing for Pokémon at least 50 more times, for a grand total of [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] times! This should be easy for a great piscator such as yourself.
entries.translated:
Setelah penampilan hebatmu, aku
punya satu tugas terakhir untukmu.\lPromosikan pancing Cube Corp. lebih

jauh dengan memancing Pokémon
setidaknya 50 kali lagi, sehingga\ltotalnya menjadi [green][buffer1][blue] kali! Ini

pasti mudah bagi pemancing hebat
sepertimu.

entries.original:
"Great job, Trainer!

I’ve received word from Cube Corp.
that you’ve promoted their brand\la total of [green][buffer2][blue] times!

Here’s your reward!"
entries.translation_source: Great job, Trainer! I’ve received word from Cube Corp. that you’ve promoted their brand a total of [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] times! Here’s your reward!
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, Pelatih! Aku mendapat
kabar dari Cube Corp. bahwa kamu\ltelah mempromosikan merek mereka

sebanyak [green][buffer2][blue] kali! Ini
hadiahmu!

entries.original:
"Thanks to your fishing efforts,
I’ve been promoted!

I’m now the assistant to the
regional manager of Cube Corp.’s\lfishing branch!

Some day soon, I’ll be running
that joint!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks to your fishing efforts, I’ve been promoted! I’m now the assistant to the regional manager of Cube Corp.’s fishing branch! Some day soon, I’ll be running that joint!
entries.translated:
Berkat usaha memancingmu, aku
dipromosikan! Aku sekarang asisten\lmanajer regional cabang pancing

Cube Corp! Suatu hari nanti, aku
akan memimpin tempat itu!

entries.original:
"My sources at Cube Corp. tell me
that you’ve only fished for [green][buffer2][blue]\lPokémon so far.

You need to fish for at least [green][buffer1][blue]
if you want the reward."
entries.translation_source: My sources at Cube Corp. tell me that you’ve only fished for [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] Pokémon so far. You need to fish for at least [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] if you want the reward.
entries.translated:
Sumberku di Cube Corp. mengatakan
bahwa kamu hanya memancing [green][buffer2][blue]\lPokémon sejauh ini. Kamu perlu

memancing setidaknya [green][buffer1][blue] jika
kamu ingin hadiahnya.

entries.original:
"Or at least, I’d like to give you
one, but you have no space in your\lparty for it."
entries.translation_source: Or at least, I’d like to give you one, but you have no space in your party for it.
entries.translated:
Atau setidaknya, aku ingin
memberimu satu, tapi tidak ada\lruang di timmu untuk itu.

entries.original:
"A terrific Trainer!

Let me share a training tip with
you.

During a battle with a Trainer,
even if your Pokémon’s items are\ltaken away, don’t worry.

They will be returned to you
safely after the battle.

\.But disposable items seem
to disappear."
entries.translation_source: A terrific Trainer! Let me share a training tip with you. During a battle with a Trainer, even if your Pokémon’s items are taken away, don’t worry. They will be returned to you safely after the battle. [game-token-1]But disposable items seem to disappear.
entries.translated:
Pelatih yang hebat! Biarkan aku
berbagi tips latihan. Selama\lpertarungan dengan Pelatih,

meskipun item Pokémonmu diambil,
jangan khawatir. Mereka akan\ldikembalikan dengan aman setelah

pertarungan. \.Tapi item sekali pakai
sepertinya akan hilang.

entries.original:
"I caught my precious partner in
the [green]Safari Zone[blue].

It’s just to the [green]east[blue] of town."
entries.translation_source: I caught my precious partner in the [color-green-1]Safari Zone[color-blue-2]. It’s just to the [color-green-3]east[color-blue-4] of town.
entries.translated:
Aku menangkap partner berhargaku di
[green]Safari Zone[blue]. Letaknya di sebelah\l[green]timur[blue] kota.

entries.original:
"We can live unchanged,
because we keep changing.

I mean, Pokémon also evolve,
but their Natures stay the same.

At least they’re supposed to\."
entries.translation_source: We can live unchanged, because we keep changing. I mean, Pokémon also evolve, but their Natures stay the same. At least they’re supposed to[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kita bisa hidup tidak berubah,
karena kita terus berubah.\lMaksudku, Pokémon juga berevolusi,

tetapi Nature mereka tetap sama.
Setidaknya seharusnya begitu\.

entries.original:
"Only the lowest kind of employee
will tell you to not buy a\lparticular item.

Such as that woman stocking the
shelves, for instance.

She has no business sense.

I, on the other hand, will tell
you this.

Buy as many [green]Max Repels[blue] as you can!

They have the best value out of
all repellants!"
entries.translation_source: Only the lowest kind of employee will tell you to not buy a particular item. Such as that woman stocking the shelves, for instance. She has no business sense. I, on the other hand, will tell you this. Buy as many [color-green-1]Max Repels[color-blue-2] as you can! They have the best value out of all repellants!
entries.translated:
Hanya karyawan kelas bawah yang
akan memberitahumu untuk tidak\lmembeli barang tertentu. Seperti

wanita yang mengisi rak itu,
misalnya. Dia tidak punya naluri\lbisnis. Aku, di sisi lain, akan

memberitahumu ini. Belilah sebanyak
mungkin [green]Max Repel[blue]! Mereka memiliki\lnilai terbaik di antara semua

pengusir!

entries.original:
"Let me give you a Trainer’s tip:
don’t buy Ultra Balls.

They’re not worth your money.

Instead, try to buy specialty
Poké Balls such as the [green]Quick Ball[red]\lor [green]Net Ball[red].

They’re cheaper and they tend to
have a better chance at a capture.

Unfortunately none are available
here, but many other Marts in\lBorrius sell such Poké Balls."
entries.translation_source: Let me give you a Trainer’s tip: don’t buy Ultra Balls. They’re not worth your money. Instead, try to buy specialty Poké Balls such as the [color-green-1]Quick Ball[color-red-2] or [color-green-3]Net Ball[color-red-4]. They’re cheaper and they tend to have a better chance at a capture. Unfortunately none are available here, but many other Marts in Borrius sell such Poké Balls.
entries.translated:
Biarkan aku memberi tips Pelatih:
jangan beli Ultra Ball. Itu tidak\lsebanding dengan uangmu.

Sebaliknya, coba beli Poké Ball
khusus seperti [green]Quick Ball[red] atau [green]Net\lBall[red]. Mereka lebih murah dan

cenderung memiliki peluang lebih
baik untuk menangkap. Sayangnya\ltidak ada yang tersedia di sini,

tetapi banyak Mart lain di Borrius
yang menjual Poké Ball semacam itu.

entries.original:
"For a swamp, [green]Cootes Bog[blue]
surprisingly doesn’t have many\lBug-type Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: For a swamp, [color-green-1]Cootes Bog[color-blue-2] surprisingly doesn’t have many Bug-type Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Untuk sebuah rawa, [green]Cootes Bog[blue]
ternyata tidak memiliki banyak\lPokémon tipe Serangga.

entries.original:
"I am grateful that you came all
this way!

Are you a Trainer?

Ooh, you have a Pokédex!
It’s so marvelous!

I wonder if you’d please do me a
favour."
entries.translation_source: I am grateful that you came all this way! Are you a Trainer? Ooh, you have a Pokédex! It’s so marvelous! I wonder if you’d please do me a favour.
entries.translated:
Aku berterima kasih kamu datang
sejauh ini! Apakah kamu seorang\lPelatih? Ooh, kamu punya Pokédex!

Sungguh menakjubkan! Aku ingin tahu
apakah kamu sudi membantuku.

entries.original:
"Oh, Trainer. I’m so pleased that
you came all the way here!

I’m wondering if you would do me a
favour today, too."
entries.translation_source: Oh, Trainer. I’m so pleased that you came all the way here! I’m wondering if you would do me a favour today, too.
entries.translated:
Oh, Pelatih. Aku sangat senang kamu
datang sejauh ini! Aku ingin tahu\lapakah kamu mau membantuku hari ini

juga.

entries.original:
"I’m touched that you came here,
yet you are being so unkind."
entries.translation_source: I’m touched that you came here, yet you are being so unkind.
entries.translated:
Aku tersentuh kamu datang ke sini,
namun kamu bersikap tidak baik.

entries.original:
"To be clear, I would like to see a
Pokémon that knows [green][buffer1][red].

Thank you."
entries.translation_source: To be clear, I would like to see a Pokémon that knows [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]. Thank you.
entries.translated:
Untuk lebih jelasnya, aku ingin
melihat Pokémon yang tahu [green][buffer1][red].\lTerima kasih.

entries.original:
"Oh, my goodness. Your [buffer2]
can use [buffer1]!

You went to all the trouble of
teaching it to your Pokémon?

That’s so touching!

This is a small token of my
appreciation.

Please don’t hesitate to accept
this."
entries.translation_source: Oh, my goodness. Your [buffer2-1] can use [buffer1-2]! You went to all the trouble of teaching it to your Pokémon? That’s so touching! This is a small token of my appreciation. Please don’t hesitate to accept this.
entries.translated:
Ya ampun. [buffer2] kamu bisa
menggunakan [buffer1]! Kamu bersusah\lpayah mengajarkannya ke Pokémonmu?

Sungguh menyentuh! Ini adalah tanda
penghargaan kecil dariku. Tolong\ljangan ragu untuk menerimanya.

entries.original:
"I wonder what [buffer1] looks
like when it is actually used.

I’m sure you can use it skillfully!"
entries.translation_source: I wonder what [buffer1-1] looks like when it is actually used. I’m sure you can use it skillfully!
entries.translated:
Aku penasaran bagaimana [buffer1]
terlihat saat benar-benar\ldigunakan. Aku yakin kamu bisa

menggunakannya dengan terampil!

entries.original: "All the Right Moves"
entries.translation_source: All the Right Moves
entries.translated: Semua Jurusan yang Tepat

entries.original:
"There are 120 TMs in total.
Can you find them all?"
entries.translation_source: There are 120 TMs in total. Can you find them all?
entries.translated:
Total ada 120 TM. Bisakah kamu
menemukan semuanya?

entries.original:
"I’ll give you something great when
you collect a lot of [green]TMs[red]!

Do you think you can find them all?"
entries.translation_source: I’ll give you something great when you collect a lot of [color-green-1]TMs[color-red-2]! Do you think you can find them all?
entries.translated:
Aku akan memberimu sesuatu yang
hebat saat kamu mengumpulkan banyak\l[green]TM[red]! Apakah kamu pikir kamu bisa

menemukan semuanya?

entries.original:
"There are [green][buffer1][red] TMs in total, and
they can be found all around\lBorrius.

For example, some kind people will
give TMs.

So don’t be shy! Talk to everyone!"
entries.translation_source: There are [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] TMs in total, and they can be found all around Borrius. For example, some kind people will give TMs. So don’t be shy! Talk to everyone!
entries.translated:
Ada total [green][buffer1][red] TM, dan mereka
dapat ditemukan di seluruh Borrius.\lMisalnya, beberapa orang baik akan

memberikan TM. Jadi jangan malu!
Bicaralah dengan semua orang!

entries.original:
"Those TMs aren’t going to just
find themselves!"
entries.translation_source: Those TMs aren’t going to just find themselves!
entries.translated:
TM-TM itu tidak akan menemukan
dirinya sendiri!

entries.original:
"There are still more TMs!

[green][buffer3][red] more in total!

If you collect all of them, I’ll
give you a great gift!"
entries.translation_source: There are still more TMs! [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-red-3] more in total! If you collect all of them, I’ll give you a great gift!
entries.translated:
Masih ada TM lagi! [green][buffer3][red] lebih
banyak total! Jika kamu\lmengumpulkan semuanya, aku akan

memberimu hadiah yang hebat!

entries.original:
"Wow! Great job!
You’ve got great technical points!

I didn’t know all these moves were
TMs!

Thanks to you, I realized
the true depth of TMs.

You are a TM Master!

Thank you!
I was thrilled to see them!

As a reward, please accept this
as a gift!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Great job! You’ve got great technical points! I didn’t know all these moves were TMs! Thanks to you, I realized the true depth of TMs. You are a TM Master! Thank you! I was thrilled to see them! As a reward, please accept this as a gift!
entries.translated:
Wow! Kerja bagus! Kamu punya poin
teknis yang hebat! Aku tidak tahu\lsemua jurus ini adalah TM!

Berkatmu, aku menyadari kedalaman
sejati dari TM. Kamu adalah Master\lTM! Terima kasih! Aku sangat senang

melihatnya! Sebagai hadiah,
terimalah ini sebagai kado!

entries.original:
"Oh! You’re a TM Master!

Thank you for showing me
a lot of TMs.

Use lots of different moves, and
bring out your Pokémon’s power!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! You’re a TM Master! Thank you for showing me a lot of TMs. Use lots of different moves, and bring out your Pokémon’s power!
entries.translated:
Oh! Kamu adalah Master TM! Terima
kasih telah menunjukkan banyak TM\lpadaku. Gunakan banyak jurus

berbeda, dan keluarkan kekuatan
Pokémonmu!

entries.original:
"This TM was found in the outdoor
hedge maze."
entries.translation_source: This TM was found in the outdoor hedge maze.
entries.translated:
TM ini ditemukan di labirin pagar
luar ruangan.

entries.original:
"This TM was found on the snowy
cliffs after using Rock Climb."
entries.translation_source: This TM was found on the snowy cliffs after using Rock Climb.
entries.translated:
TM ini ditemukan di tebing bersalju
setelah menggunakan Rock Climb.

entries.original:
"This TM was found on B1F after
crossing the blue bridge."
entries.translation_source: This TM was found on B1F after crossing the blue bridge.
entries.translated:
TM ini ditemukan di B1F setelah
menyeberangi jembatan biru.

entries.original:
"This TM was purchased in the
marketplace."
entries.translation_source: This TM was purchased in the marketplace.
entries.translated: TM ini dibeli di pasar.

entries.original:

entries.original:
"This hole you see here is what’s
known as a Raid Den.

Powerful Pokémon inhabit these
dens, and once a day, you can fight\lfor a chance to capture one in\leach den found around Borrius!

These Pokémon are scary strong, so
it’s a good idea to pick the right\lpartner to fight alongside you.

When you start the battle, you’ll
notice that the Pokémon you’re\lfighting looks very big.

This is because of the phenomenon
known as [green]Dynamax[red].

It will stay this way throughout
the battle and can only be caught\lonce it is defeated and returned to\lnormal size."
entries.translation_source: This hole you see here is what’s known as a Raid Den. Powerful Pokémon inhabit these dens, and once a day, you can fight for a chance to capture one in each den found around Borrius! These Pokémon are scary strong, so it’s a good idea to pick the right partner to fight alongside you. When you start the battle, you’ll notice that the Pokémon you’re fighting looks very big. This is because of the phenomenon known as [color-green-1]Dynamax[color-red-2]. It will stay this way throughout the battle and can only be caught once it is defeated and returned to normal size.
entries.translated:
Lubang yang kamu lihat di sini
dikenal sebagai Sarang Raid.\lPokémon kuat menghuni sarang-sarang

ini, dan sekali sehari, kamu bisa
bertarung untuk mendapatkan\lkesempatan menangkap satu di setiap

sarang yang ditemukan di sekitar
Borrius! Pokémon-Pokémon ini sangat\lkuat, jadi sebaiknya pilih rekan

yang tepat untuk bertarung
bersamamu. Saat kamu memulai\lpertarungan, kamu akan melihat

bahwa Pokémon yang kamu lawan
terlihat sangat besar. Ini karena\lfenomena yang dikenal sebagai

[green]Dynamax[red]. Ia akan tetap seperti ini
sepanjang pertarungan dan hanya\lbisa ditangkap setelah dikalahkan

dan kembali ke ukuran normal.

entries.original:
"Dynamax is a unique phenomenon
that can only be used in special\lareas, like this one.

If you have mastered the power of
Mega Evolution, you’ll be able to\lDynamax your Pokémon as well.

Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax,
but if a Pokémon holds a Mega\lStone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be\lable to.

To Dynamax a Pokémon, press \btn04
when you see the red Dynamax\lsymbol appear.

If you choose to Dynamax your
Pokémon, the effect will last\lfor three turns.

During this time period, each of
your Pokémon’s moves will be\lpowered up into special variants\lknown as [green]Max Moves[red].

These Max Moves are much more
powerful than regular attacks,\lso make sure you use them to full\leffect while Dynamaxed!"
entries.translation_source: Dynamax is a unique phenomenon that can only be used in special areas, like this one. If you have mastered the power of Mega Evolution, you’ll be able to Dynamax your Pokémon as well. Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax, but if a Pokémon holds a Mega Stone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be able to. To Dynamax a Pokémon, press [button-icon-1] when you see the red Dynamax symbol appear. If you choose to Dynamax your Pokémon, the effect will last for three turns. During this time period, each of your Pokémon’s moves will be powered up into special variants known as [color-green-2]Max Moves[color-red-3]. These Max Moves are much more powerful than regular attacks, so make sure you use them to full effect while Dynamaxed!
entries.translated:
Dynamax adalah fenomena unik yang
hanya bisa digunakan di area\lkhusus, seperti ini. Jika kamu

sudah menguasai kekuatan Mega
Evolusi, kamu juga bisa melakukan\lDynamax pada Pokémonmu. Hampir

semua Pokémon bisa Dynamax, tetapi
jika Pokémon memegang Batu Mega\latau Kristal Z, ia tidak bisa.

Untuk melakukan Dynamax pada
Pokémon, tekan \btn04 saat kamu melihat\lsimbol Dynamax merah muncul. Jika

kamu memilih untuk melakukan
Dynamax pada Pokémonmu, efeknya\lakan bertahan selama tiga giliran.

Selama periode waktu ini, setiap
jurus Pokémonmu akan ditingkatkan\lmenjadi varian khusus yang dikenal

sebagai [green]Max Moves[red]. Max Moves ini
jauh lebih kuat daripada serangan\lbiasa, jadi pastikan kamu

menggunakannya secara maksimal saat
Dynamax!

entries.original:
"Sometimes when the Pokémon you’re
fighting is desperate, it’ll throw\lup shields to defend itself.

These shields will severely reduce
the damage you can inflict until\lthey’re destroyed.

Any attack will destroy at least
one shield, but if you use a move\llike [green]Brick Break[red], you can destroy\ltwo shields at a time!"
entries.translation_source: Sometimes when the Pokémon you’re fighting is desperate, it’ll throw up shields to defend itself. These shields will severely reduce the damage you can inflict until they’re destroyed. Any attack will destroy at least one shield, but if you use a move like [color-green-1]Brick Break[color-red-2], you can destroy two shields at a time!
entries.translated:
Terkadang saat Pokémon yang kamu
lawan dalam keadaan putus asa, ia\lakan mengeluarkan perisai untuk

melindungi diri. Perisai ini akan
sangat mengurangi kerusakan yang\lbisa kamu berikan sampai perisai

itu hancur. Serangan apa pun akan
menghancurkan setidaknya satu\lperisai, tetapi jika kamu

menggunakan jurus seperti [green]Pemecah
Batu Bata[red], kamu bisa menghancurkan\ldua perisai sekaligus!

entries.original: "Redwood Forest"
entries.translation_source: Redwood Forest
entries.translated: Hutan Redwood

entries.original:
"Dang it!

It won’t budge!

This Pokémon hasn’t moved in
weeks\.

Do you hear me Snorlax?
I need to see my boyfriend!

You can’t stop true love!"
entries.translation_source: Dang it! It won’t budge! This Pokémon hasn’t moved in weeks[game-token-1] Do you hear me Snorlax? I need to see my boyfriend! You can’t stop true love!
entries.translated:
Sial! Dia tidak mau bergerak!
Pokémon ini tidak bergerak selama\lberminggu-minggu\. Apakah kau

mendengarku Snorlax? Aku harus
bertemu pacarku! Kau tidak bisa\lmenghentikan cinta sejati!

entries.original:
"Infernape!
Wake it up with a Fire Punch!"
entries.translation_source: Infernape! Wake it up with a Fire Punch!
entries.translated:
Infernape! Bangunkan dia dengan
Fire Punch!

entries.original: "[green]Ooh ooh ahh!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Ooh ooh ahh!
entries.translated: [green]Ooh ooh ahh!

entries.original:
"I’m exhausted\.

I’ve tried everything I can think
of to move this Snorlax, but it\lwon’t budge a muscle.

I wanted to see my boyfriend, but
he broke up with me, so I don’t\lknow why I’m even still trying\."
entries.translation_source: I’m exhausted[game-token-1] I’ve tried everything I can think of to move this Snorlax, but it won’t budge a muscle. I wanted to see my boyfriend, but he broke up with me, so I don’t know why I’m even still trying[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku kelelahan\. Aku sudah mencoba
semua yang bisa kupikirkan untuk\lmenggerakkan Snorlax ini, tapi dia

tidak mau bergerak sedikit pun. Aku
ingin bertemu pacarku, tapi dia\lputus denganku, jadi aku tidak tahu

kenapa aku masih berusaha\.

entries.original:
"[green]Snorrrr!

[black]Snorlax is sleep eating!
Now’s your chance!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Snorrrr! [color-black-2]Snorlax is sleep eating! Now’s your chance!
entries.translated:
[green]Snorrrr! [black]Snorlax sedang makan
sambil tidur! Ini kesempatanmu!

entries.original:
"[black]Snorlax stubbornly refuses to
leave.

Looks like you’ll have to capture
it if you want to get rid of it."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Snorlax stubbornly refuses to leave. Looks like you’ll have to capture it if you want to get rid of it.
entries.translated:
[black]Snorlax dengan keras kepala menolak
pergi. Sepertinya kau harus\lmenangkapnya jika ingin

menyingkirkannya.

entries.original:
"Hey!

Have you seen a cute girl with
an Infernape?

\.

She went towards Redwood Village?

I’m coming girl!

Here, this is for your trouble.
I appreciate ya, Champ!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Have you seen a cute girl with an Infernape? [game-token-1] She went towards Redwood Village? I’m coming girl! Here, this is for your trouble. I appreciate ya, Champ!
entries.translated:
Hei! Apakah kau melihat gadis
cantik dengan Infernape? \. Dia pergi\lmenuju Redwood Village? Aku datang,

gadis! Ini, sebagai imbalan atas
bantuanmu. Aku menghargaimu, Juara!

entries.original: "[green]Growwwwf!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Growwwwf!
entries.translated: [green]Growwwwf!

entries.original: "[black]The suspicious person ran off!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The suspicious person ran off!
entries.translated: [black]Orang mencurigakan itu kabur!

entries.original: "[black]The suspicious cell ran off!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The suspicious cell ran off!
entries.translated: [black]Sel mencurigakan itu kabur!

entries.original: "[black]The suspicious tree ran off!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The suspicious tree ran off!
entries.translated: [black]Pohon mencurigakan itu kabur!

entries.original: "Numbskull"
entries.translation_source: Numbskull
entries.translated: Bodoh

entries.original:
"Are you dense? Smash Pokémon heads
against trees [buffer1] times!"
entries.translation_source: Are you dense? Smash Pokémon heads against trees [buffer1-1] times!
entries.translated:
Apa kau bodoh? Hantamkan
kepala Pokémon ke pohon
sebanyak [buffer1] kali!

entries.original:
"I hit me head on dem trees too
many times\.

Now, I speak ungood.

I hate da trees now that made me
dumb.

Me mad!

Me want revenge!

You do it for me?

Use [green]Headbutt[blue] to teach trees to be
good [green][buffer1][blue] times!"
entries.translation_source: I hit me head on dem trees too many times[game-token-1] Now, I speak ungood. I hate da trees now that made me dumb. Me mad! Me want revenge! You do it for me?
