Use [color-green-2]Headbutt[color-blue-3] to teach trees to be good [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] times!
entries.translated:
Aku kepalaku terbentur pohon
terlalu sering\. Sekarang, aku bicara\ltidak bagus. Aku benci pohon yang

bikin aku bodoh. Aku marah! Aku
ingin balas dendam! Kau lakukan\luntukku? Gunakan [green]Headbutt[blue] untuk

mengajari pohon menjadi baik
sebanyak [green][buffer1][blue] kali!

entries.original:
"Good, attack trees with Headbutt,
and dem who defend trees."
entries.translation_source: Good, attack trees with Headbutt, and dem who defend trees.
entries.translated:
Bagus, serang pohon dengan
Headbutt, dan mereka yang membela\lpohon.

entries.original: "Okee, me will hurt trees meself!"
entries.translation_source: Okee, me will hurt trees meself!
entries.translated:
Okee, aku akan menyakiti pohon
sendiri!

entries.original:
"More head bangin’!
[green][buffer3][blue] more time\\08!"
entries.translation_source: More head bangin’! [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3] more time[raw-escape-4]!
entries.translated:
Lebih banyak head bangin{B4}! [green][buffer3][blue]
kali lagi\\08!

entries.original:
"Good, now me can go back to bein’
the best Pokémon Neurosurgeon\lin world.

Take dis to help you for you
help me."
entries.translation_source: Good, now me can go back to bein’ the best Pokémon Neurosurgeon in world. Take dis to help you for you help me.
entries.translated:
Baik, sekarang aku bisa kembali
menjadi Ahli Bedah Saraf Pokémon\lterbaik di dunia. Ambil ini untuk

membantumu karena kamu telah
membantuku.

entries.original:
"Me be better soon.
Me brain not very broke."
entries.translation_source: Me be better soon. Me brain not very broke.
entries.translated:
Aku akan segera sembuh. Otakku
tidak terlalu rusak.

entries.original:
"Oh, perfect timing, Trainer!

I have just been filming my
latest movie in this forest.

The title of the movie is:
\qoKangaskhan v Kangaskhan:\lDawn of the Kangaskhan\qc

Unfortunately, the actor portraying
the main antagonist has fallen ill.

Would you be willing to take
his place?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, perfect timing, Trainer! I have just been filming my latest movie in this forest. The title of the movie is: [quote-open-1]Kangaskhan v Kangaskhan: Dawn of the Kangaskhan[quote-close-2] Unfortunately, the actor portraying the main antagonist has fallen ill. Would you be willing to take his place?
entries.translated:
Oh, waktu yang tepat, Pelatih! Aku
baru saja syuting film terbaruku di\lhutan ini. Judul filmnya adalah:

\qoKangaskhan v Kangaskhan: Dawn of
the Kangaskhan\qc Sayangnya, aktor\lyang memerankan antagonis utama

jatuh sakit. Apakah kamu bersedia
mengambil tempatnya?

entries.original:
"A shame\.
Truly, a shame\."
entries.translation_source: A shame[game-token-1] Truly, a shame[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali\. Sungguh, sayang
sekali\.

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

Once you have defeated all of the
Trainers in this forest, please\lbring [green]4[red] strong [green]Kangaskhan[red] for an\limportant fight scene in the movie.

It will be filmed in the likeness
of a [green]Double Battle[red].

They should ideally be levelled
[green]\Lv 70[red] or higher."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! Once you have defeated all of the Trainers in this forest, please bring [color-green-1]4[color-red-2] strong [color-green-3]Kangaskhan[color-red-4] for an important fight scene in the movie. It will be filmed in the likeness of a [color-green-5]Double Battle[color-red-6]. They should ideally be levelled [color-green-7][game-token-8] 70[color-red-9] or higher.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Setelah kamu
mengalahkan semua Pelatih di hutan\lini, tolong bawa [green]4[red] [green]Kangaskhan[red] yang

kuat untuk adegan pertarungan
penting dalam film. Ini akan\ldifilmkan seperti [green]Pertarungan

Ganda[red]. Mereka idealnya harus berada
di level [green]\Lv 70[red] atau lebih tinggi.

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

Please make sure your party
consists of only [green]4 Kangaskhan[red]\lbefore we can begin filming the\l[green]Double Battle[red].

They should ideally be levelled
[green]\Lv 70[red] or higher."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! Please make sure your party consists of only [color-green-1]4 Kangaskhan[color-red-2] before we can begin filming the [color-green-3]Double Battle[color-red-4]. They should ideally be levelled [color-green-5][game-token-6] 70[color-red-7] or higher.
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Pastikan timmu hanya
terdiri dari [green]4 Kangaskhan[red] sebelum\lkita bisa memulai syuting

[green]Pertarungan Ganda[red]. Mereka idealnya
harus berada di level [green]\Lv 70[red] atau\llebih tinggi.

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

Lights, camera, action!"
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! Lights, camera, action!
entries.translated: Luar biasa! Lampu, kamera, aksi!

entries.original:
"Wonderful work out there today.

For your performance, you have
earned one of these."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful work out there today. For your performance, you have earned one of these.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus di luar sana hari ini.
Untuk penampilanmu, kamu telah\lmendapatkan salah satu dari ini.

entries.original:
"Farewell, Trainer!

I look forward to seeing you at the
red carpet premiere!"
entries.translation_source: Farewell, Trainer! I look forward to seeing you at the red carpet premiere!
entries.translated:
Selamat tinggal, Pelatih! Aku tidak
sabar untuk melihatmu di pemutaran\lperdana karpet merah!

entries.original:
"[black]Huh?

The Cube received a notification!

It says that the movie received a
critic score of less than 30% on\lRotten Tamato Berries\.

Oh, well, didn’t hurt to help!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Huh? The Cube received a notification! It says that the movie received a critic score of less than 30% on Rotten Tamato Berries[game-token-2] Oh, well, didn’t hurt to help!
entries.translated:
[black]Hah? Cube menerima notifikasi!
Dikatakan bahwa film tersebut\lmendapat skor kritik kurang dari

30% di Rotten Tamato Berries\. Oh,
ya, tidak ada salahnya membantu!

entries.original: "[green]Krawwr!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Krawwr!
entries.translated: [green]Krawwr!

entries.original:
"Hey, Trainer!

You look almost as strong as you
are lost!

Beat me and I’ll tell you a secret!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Trainer! You look almost as strong as you are lost! Beat me and I’ll tell you a secret!
entries.translated:
Hei, Pelatih! Kamu terlihat hampir
sekuat kamu tersesat! Kalahkan aku\ldan aku akan memberitahumu sebuah

rahasia!

entries.original: "Wow! Okay! Okay!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Okay! Okay!
entries.translated: Wow! Oke! Oke!

entries.original:
"So I heard the woman over there
talking\.

Sometimes if you go backwards,
you go forwards!"
entries.translation_source: So I heard the woman over there talking[game-token-1] Sometimes if you go backwards, you go forwards!
entries.translated:
Jadi aku mendengar wanita di sana
berbicara\. Kadang jika kamu mundur,\lkamu maju!

entries.original:
"I noticed a peculiar Pokémon
earlier.

When I approached it, it changed its
appearance to match mine!

No\.\CC0818 it wasn’t a Ditto.

I could tell that much at least."
entries.translation_source: I noticed a peculiar Pokémon earlier. When I approached it, it changed its appearance to match mine! No[game-token-1][control-code-2] it wasn’t a Ditto. I could tell that much at least.
entries.translated:
Aku melihat seekor Pokémon aneh
tadi. Saat aku mendekatinya, ia\lmengubah penampilannya agar sesuai

dengan penampilanku! Tidak\.\CC0818 itu
bukan Ditto. Setidaknya aku bisa\ltahu sebanyak itu.

entries.original:
"This is Redwood Forest?

It’s so spooky in here, I figured
it must be Grim Woods!"
entries.translation_source: This is Redwood Forest? It’s so spooky in here, I figured it must be Grim Woods!
entries.translated:
Ini Hutan Redwood? Di sini sangat
menyeramkan, aku pikir pasti ini\lHutan Grim!

entries.original:
"If you have an [green]open space in your
party[blue] in addition to a spare [green]Poké\lBall[blue] when you evolve one of the\lNincada that swarm here, you’ll\lfind a new Pokémon on your team\lafter the evolution!

But the process requires a spare
[green]Poké Ball[blue] in your Cube, got that?

NOT a Great Ball or an Ultra Ball,
just a [green]Poké Ball[blue]."
entries.translation_source: If you have an [color-green-1]open space in your party[color-blue-2] in addition to a spare [color-green-3]Poké Ball[color-blue-4] when you evolve one of the Nincada that swarm here, you’ll find a new Pokémon on your team after the evolution! But the process requires a spare [color-green-5]Poké Ball[color-blue-6] in your Cube, got that? NOT a Great Ball or an Ultra Ball, just a [color-green-7]Poké Ball[color-blue-8].
entries.translated:
Jika kamu memiliki [green]ruang kosong di
timmu[blue] selain [green]Poké Ball[blue] cadangan\lsaat kamu mengevolusi salah satu

Nincada yang berkerumun di sini,
kamu akan menemukan Pokémon baru di\ltimmu setelah evolusi! Tapi

prosesnya membutuhkan [green]Poké Ball[blue]
cadangan di Cube-mu, mengerti?\lBUKAN Great Ball atau Ultra Ball,

hanya [green]Poké Ball[blue].

entries.original:
"[red]My ESP tells me that you’re close to
finding what you seek\.

But first, let’s battle!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]My ESP tells me that you’re close to finding what you seek[game-token-2] But first, let’s battle!
entries.translated:
[red]ESP-ku memberitahuku bahwa kamu
hampir menemukan apa yang kamu cari\.\lTapi pertama, ayo bertarung!

entries.original:
"Nothing could have prepared me
for that."
entries.translation_source: Nothing could have prepared me for that.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang bisa mempersiapkanku
untuk itu.

entries.original:
"[red]I can sense you’re looking for the
exit.

It’s just up ahead."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I can sense you’re looking for the exit. It’s just up ahead.
entries.translated:
[red]Aku bisa merasakan kamu mencari
pintu keluar. Itu ada di depan\lsana.

entries.original: "Redwood Village"
entries.translation_source: Redwood Village
entries.translated: Desa Redwood

entries.original: "Redwood Village D"
entries.translation_source: Redwood Village D

entries.original: "Redwood Village N"
entries.translation_source: Redwood Village N

entries.original: "Be gone, wandering spirits!"
entries.translation_source: Be gone, wandering spirits!
entries.translated: Enyahlah, roh-roh pengembara!

entries.original:
"The wandering spirits have been
cleansed from my soul\."
entries.translation_source: The wandering spirits have been cleansed from my soul[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Roh-roh pengembara telah
dibersihkan dari jiwaku\.

entries.original:
"Did you know that the trees in this
village actually produce red wood?

Bet you didn’t!

You must’ve thought that these
trees look like every other plain\lold forest tree.

Well, I’ll have you know that
although they may look like\lordinary forest trees, they’re\lactually very special!

Their red wood attracts many
different species of Pokémon.

Don’t believe me?

Have a Pokémon use the move
[green]Headbutt[red] on one, and see for\lyourself!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that the trees in this village actually produce red wood? Bet you didn’t! You must’ve thought that these trees look like every other plain old forest tree. Well, I’ll have you know that although they may look like ordinary forest trees, they’re actually very special! Their red wood attracts many different species of Pokémon. Don’t believe me? Have a Pokémon use the move [color-green-1]Headbutt[color-red-2] on one, and see for yourself!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa pohon-pohon di
desa ini sebenarnya menghasilkan\lkayu merah? Pasti kamu tidak tahu!

Kamu pasti mengira pohon-pohon ini
terlihat seperti pohon hutan biasa\llainnya. Nah, saya akan memberitahu

kamu bahwa meskipun mereka terlihat
seperti pohon hutan biasa, mereka\lsebenarnya sangat istimewa! Kayu

merah mereka menarik banyak spesies
Pokémon yang berbeda. Tidak\lpercaya? Suruhlah Pokémon

menggunakan jurus [green]Headbutt[red] pada
salah satunya, dan lihat sendiri!

entries.original:
"Out of all the Borrius Gyms,
Benjamin’s is always meant to be\lchallenged last.

Why?

Well, if you hadn’t explored the
rest of Borrius first, you wouldn’t\lbe able to solve his puzzle\."
entries.translation_source: Out of all the Borrius Gyms, Benjamin’s is always meant to be challenged last. Why? Well, if you hadn’t explored the rest of Borrius first, you wouldn’t be able to solve his puzzle[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dari semua Gym Borrius, Gym
Benjamin selalu dimaksudkan untuk\lditantang terakhir. Kenapa? Nah,

jika kamu belum menjelajahi seluruh
Borrius terlebih dahulu, kamu tidak\lakan bisa memecahkan teka-tekinya\.

entries.original:
"Now do you see?

Benjamin’s puzzle is based on the
caves you should have travelled\lthrough last!"
entries.translation_source: Now do you see? Benjamin’s puzzle is based on the caves you should have travelled through last!
entries.translated:
Sekarang kamu lihat? Teka-teki
Benjamin didasarkan pada gua-gua\lyang seharusnya kamu lalui terakhir

kali!

entries.original:
"Benjamin is our Gym Leader!

I want to be just like Benjamin
when I grow up!

And again when I grow down,
just like he does!"
entries.translation_source: Benjamin is our Gym Leader! I want to be just like Benjamin when I grow up! And again when I grow down, just like he does!
entries.translated:
Benjamin adalah Pemimpin Gym kami!
Aku ingin menjadi seperti Benjamin\lsaat aku besar nanti! Dan lagi saat

aku mengecil, seperti yang dia
lakukan!

entries.original:
"Our little town is protected by the
Forest Guardian.

However, the Forest Guardian has
not been seen in many years.

It is said that if you bring an old
friend of the Forest Guardian, it\lwill reveal itself once more."
entries.translation_source: Our little town is protected by the Forest Guardian. However, the Forest Guardian has not been seen in many years. It is said that if you bring an old friend of the Forest Guardian, it will reveal itself once more.
entries.translated:
Kota kecil kami dilindungi oleh
Penjaga Hutan. Namun, Penjaga Hutan\ltidak terlihat selama

bertahun-tahun. Konon jika kamu
membawa teman lama Penjaga Hutan,\lia akan muncul kembali.

entries.original:
"Astounding\.

The Forest Guardian has revealed
itself unto you.

It must have sensed an old friend
among the members of your party.

And not only that, it appears to
be challenging you to a battle.

You have my blessing to battle it
and capture it, if you so please."
entries.translation_source: Astounding[game-token-1] The Forest Guardian has revealed itself unto you. It must have sensed an old friend among the members of your party. And not only that, it appears to be challenging you to a battle. You have my blessing to battle it and capture it, if you so please.
entries.translated:
Menakjubkan\. Penjaga Hutan telah
menampakkan diri kepadamu. Ia pasti\lmerasakan teman lama di antara

anggota timmu. Dan bukan hanya itu,
ia tampaknya menantangmu untuk\lbertarung. Kamu mendapat restuku

untuk bertarung dan menangkapnya,
jika kamu mau.

entries.original:
"Congratulations on your capture of
the Forest Guardian.

Please watch over it and protect
it, as it protected and watched\lover us."
entries.translation_source: Congratulations on your capture of the Forest Guardian. Please watch over it and protect it, as it protected and watched over us.
entries.translated:
Selamat atas penangkapan Penjaga
Hutan. Tolong jaga dan lindungi\ldia, seperti dia melindungi dan

menjaga kami.

entries.original: "[green]Biiiiiiiiiiii!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Biiiiiiiiiiii!
entries.translated: [green]Biiiiiiiiiiii!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] wants to fight you again!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] wants to fight you again!
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] ingin bertarung denganmu
lagi!

entries.original: "Splishy Splash"
entries.translation_source: Splishy Splash
entries.translated: Splishy Splash

entries.original:
"They’re the most useless Pokémon!
Magikarp! Can you place 30 of them
in your current Box?"
entries.translation_source: They’re the most useless Pokémon! Magikarp! Can you place 30 of them in your current Box?
entries.translated:
Mereka adalah Pokémon yang
paling tidak ... menempatkan 30
ekor di dalam Kotakmu saat ini?

entries.original:
"Hey there, Pokémon Trainer.

I’m a member of the Hip Waders,
just like you!

And boy, do I have an assignment
for you.

You know the Pokémon [green]Magikarp[blue]?

\.

What am I even asking you, of
course you do!

Who doesn’t know of the famed
Pokémon?

I want you to place [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em in
a [green]single Box[blue].

When you’ve done that, I’ll take
’em off your hands for you, and\lgive you something even better in\lexchange.

As an esteemed member of the Hip
Waders, this should be a piece of\lcake for you!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, Pokémon Trainer. I’m a member of the Hip Waders, just like you! And boy, do I have an assignment for you. You know the Pokémon [color-green-1]Magikarp[color-blue-2]? [game-token-3] What am I even asking you, of course you do! Who doesn’t know of the famed Pokémon? I want you to place [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] of ’em in a [color-green-7]single Box[color-blue-8]. When you’ve done that, I’ll take ’em off your hands for you, and give you something even better in exchange. As an esteemed member of the Hip Waders, this should be a piece of cake for you!
entries.translated:
Hai, Pelatih Pokémon. Saya anggota
Hip Waders, sama seperti kamu! Dan\lwah, saya punya tugas untukmu. Kamu

tahu Pokémon [green]Magikarp[blue]? \. Untuk apa
saya bertanya, tentu kamu tahu!\lSiapa yang tidak kenal Pokémon

terkenal itu? Saya ingin kamu
menempatkan [green][buffer1][blue] ekor di dalam\l[green]satu Kotak[blue]. Setelah kamu

melakukannya, saya akan
mengambilnya darimu, dan memberimu\lsesuatu yang lebih baik sebagai

imbalannya. Sebagai anggota
terhormat Hip Waders, ini pasti\lmudah bagimu!

entries.original:
"Boy oh boy, Pokémon Trainer!

I can’t believe you actually
did it!

You actually got [buffer1] Magikarp in
one Box!

I mean, a task like that takes
serious dedication.

But after all, you are a member of
the Hip Waders.

So let me take them off your hands
for you.

And for an esteemed member such as
yourself, I want you to have this."
entries.translation_source: Boy oh boy, Pokémon Trainer! I can’t believe you actually did it! You actually got [buffer1-1] Magikarp in one Box! I mean, a task like that takes serious dedication. But after all, you are a member of the Hip Waders. So let me take them off your hands for you. And for an esteemed member such as yourself, I want you to have this.
entries.translated:
Wah, Pelatih Pokémon! Saya tidak
percaya kamu benar-benar\lmelakukannya! Kamu benar-benar

mendapatkan [buffer1] Magikarp dalam
satu Kotak! Maksud saya, tugas\lseperti itu membutuhkan dedikasi

serius. Tapi bagaimanapun juga,
kamu adalah anggota Hip Waders.\lJadi biarkan saya mengambilnya dari

tanganmu. Dan untuk anggota
terhormat sepertimu, saya ingin\lkamu menerima ini.

entries.original:
"Hey there, Pokémon Trainer.

I’m a member of the Hip Waders!

If you want to join our club, talk
to the club’s president back in\lSeaport City.

You know, that port city in
West Borrius?"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, Pokémon Trainer. I’m a member of the Hip Waders! If you want to join our club, talk to the club’s president back in Seaport City. You know, that port city in West Borrius?
entries.translated:
Hai, Pelatih Pokémon. Saya anggota
Hip Waders! Jika kamu ingin\lbergabung dengan klub kami,

bicaralah dengan presiden klub di
Seaport City. Kamu tahu, kota\lpelabuhan di West Borrius itu?

entries.original:
"Hey there, Pokémon Trainer.

As of this moment, your current
Box, \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc has [green][buffer3][blue] Magikarp\lin it.

Your goal is to get [green][buffer2][blue] of those
suckers in there.

Come back when you’ve done that."
entries.translation_source: Hey there, Pokémon Trainer. As of this moment, your current Box, [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4][quote-close-5] has [color-green-6][buffer3-7][color-blue-8] Magikarp in it. Your goal is to get [color-green-9][buffer2-10][color-blue-11] of those suckers in there. Come back when you’ve done that.
entries.translated:
Hai, Pelatih Pokémon. Saat ini,
Kotakmu saat ini, \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc berisi\l[green][buffer3][blue] Magikarp di dalamnya.

Tujuanmu adalah mendapatkan
[green][buffer2][blue] dari makhluk-makhluk itu\ldi sana. Kembalilah setelah kamu

melakukannya.

entries.original:
"Actually, make space in your party
first for it, Pokémon Trainer."
entries.translation_source: Actually, make space in your party first for it, Pokémon Trainer.
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, buat ruang di timmu
terlebih dahulu untuknya, Pelatih\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"Did you know?

Magikarp aren’t really the weakest
of Pokémon!

That esteemed title goes to
Wishiwashi’s solo form!

A fish that’s also useless until
it gets bigger!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know? Magikarp aren’t really the weakest of Pokémon! That esteemed title goes to Wishiwashi’s solo form! A fish that’s also useless until it gets bigger!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu? Magikarp sebenarnya
bukanlah Pokémon terlemah! Gelar\lterhormat itu milik bentuk solo

Wishiwashi! Seekor ikan yang juga
tidak berguna sampai ia menjadi\llebih besar!

entries.original:
"Oh, dear me.

My daughter left me with her infant
son, but I am much too busy today\lto look after him properly.

Would you care to tend to him
while I complete my work?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me. My daughter left me with her infant son, but I am much too busy today to look after him properly. Would you care to tend to him while I complete my work?
entries.translated:
Ya ampun. Putriku meninggalkanku
dengan putranya yang masih bayi,\ltapi aku terlalu sibuk hari ini

untuk menjaganya dengan baik.
Maukah kamu menjaganya sementara\laku menyelesaikan pekerjaanku?

entries.original:
"Splendid.

Please walk around with him until I
finish my work today."
entries.translation_source: Splendid. Please walk around with him until I finish my work today.
entries.translated:
Bagus sekali. Tolong
berjalan-jalanlah dengannya sampai\laku selesai bekerja hari ini.

entries.original:
"Ah, so you’ve returned with my
grandson.

I have finished my work for today,
so I am able to take care of him\lfor the remainder of the day.

Here is the payment for your
services."
entries.translation_source: Ah, so you’ve returned with my grandson. I have finished my work for today, so I am able to take care of him for the remainder of the day. Here is the payment for your services.
entries.translated:
Ah, jadi kamu kembali dengan
cucuku. Aku sudah selesai bekerja\lhari ini, jadi aku bisa menjaganya

untuk sisa hari ini. Ini bayaran
untuk jasamu.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received $[buffer1] from
the woman!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received $[buffer1-3] from the woman!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima $[buffer1] dari
wanita itu!

entries.original:
"Oh, dear me.

I have no choice but to continue to
neglect him today."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me. I have no choice but to continue to neglect him today.
entries.translated:
Ya ampun. Aku tidak punya pilihan
selain terus mengabaikannya hari\lini.

entries.original:
"Please walk around with my grandson
until I finish my work today."
entries.translation_source: Please walk around with my grandson until I finish my work today.
entries.translated:
Tolong berjalan-jalanlah dengan
cucuku sampai aku selesai bekerja\lhari ini.

entries.original:
"My daughter leaves her son with me
every day, so your services will be\lrequired again, tomorrow."
entries.translation_source: My daughter leaves her son with me every day, so your services will be required again, tomorrow.
entries.translated:
Putriku meninggalkan putranya
bersamaku setiap hari, jadi jasamu\lakan dibutuhkan lagi besok.

entries.original:
"My daughter leaves her son with me
every day while she goes to work.

I’m unable to give him my full
attention, so each day I try to\lhire a part-time babysitter.

Come back between [green]7 AM[red] and [green]7 PM[red],
and I will pay you to babysit."
entries.translation_source: My daughter leaves her son with me every day while she goes to work. I’m unable to give him my full attention, so each day I try to hire a part-time babysitter. Come back between [color-green-1]7 AM[color-red-2] and [color-green-3]7 PM[color-red-4], and I will pay you to babysit.
entries.translated:
Putriku meninggalkan putranya
bersamaku setiap hari saat dia\lpergi bekerja. Aku tidak bisa

memberikan perhatian penuh padanya,
jadi setiap hari aku mencoba\lmenyewa pengasuh paruh waktu.

Kembalilah antara [green]pukul 7 pagi[red] dan
[green]pukul 7 malam[red], dan aku akan\lmembayarmu untuk mengasuh.

entries.original: "[black]The baby is sleeping peacefully."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The baby is sleeping peacefully.
entries.translated: [black]Bayi itu tidur dengan tenang.

entries.original:
"[black]The baby started following behind
you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The baby started following behind you!
entries.translated:
[black]Bayi itu mulai mengikutimu dari
belakang!

entries.original:
"[black]Take the baby for a walk around
town until his grandmother has\lfinished her work."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Take the baby for a walk around town until his grandmother has finished her work.
entries.translated:
[black]Ajak bayi itu jalan-jalan keliling
kota sampai neneknya selesai\lbekerja.

entries.original:
"[black]The baby is bouncing around happily
in his stroller."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The baby is bouncing around happily in his stroller.
entries.translated:
[black]Bayi itu melompat-lompat dengan
gembira di kereta dorongnya.

entries.original:
"[black]Oh? There’s something in the
baby’s mouth.

Oh, no!
It’s a choking hazard!

Quick, get it out!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Oh? There’s something in the baby’s mouth. Oh, no! It’s a choking hazard! Quick, get it out!
entries.translated:
[black]Oh? Ada sesuatu di mulut bayi. Oh,
tidak! Itu bahaya tersedak! Cepat,\lkeluarkan!

entries.original:
"[black]The baby is looking at you
disapprovingly.

It doesn’t seem to want to go
this way."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The baby is looking at you disapprovingly. It doesn’t seem to want to go this way.
entries.translated:
[black]Bayi itu menatapmu dengan tidak
setuju. Sepertinya dia tidak mau\llewat sini.

entries.original:
"Hi, Trainer!

I’m training to open up my very
own Pokémon nursery.

I still have a ways to go, but I
can still offer you something good!

If you pay me $[green][buffer1][red], I can
significantly speed up the hatching\ltime of all the Eggs in your party!

What do you say?

Sounds like a pretty good deal,
am I right?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, Trainer! I’m training to open up my very own Pokémon nursery. I still have a ways to go, but I can still offer you something good! If you pay me $[color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3], I can significantly speed up the hatching time of all the Eggs in your party! What do you say? Sounds like a pretty good deal, am I right?
entries.translated:
Hai, Pelatih! Aku sedang berlatih
untuk membuka penitipan Pokémonku\lsendiri. Aku masih jauh dari

tujuan, tapi aku tetap bisa
menawarkan sesuatu yang bagus! Jika\lkamu membayarku $[green][buffer1][red], aku bisa

mempercepat waktu penetasan semua
Telur dalam timmu secara\lsignifikan! Bagaimana? Setuju?

Kedengarannya tawaran yang cukup
bagus, kan?

entries.original:
"Sweet!

Please pass me all the Eggs in
your party."
entries.translation_source: Sweet! Please pass me all the Eggs in your party.
entries.translated:
Mantap! Tolong berikan aku semua
Telur dalam timmu.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over all Eggs
on hand."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over all Eggs on hand.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan semua Telur
yang ada.

entries.original:
"All done!
Here are your Eggs.

I hope to see you again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: All done! Here are your Eggs. I hope to see you again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Ini Telur-telurmu. Semoga
bertemu lagi besok!

entries.original:
"It’s okay!

You’d prefer to wait until you have
more Eggs, am I right?"
entries.translation_source: It’s okay! You’d prefer to wait until you have more Eggs, am I right?
entries.translated:
Tidak apa-apa! Kamu lebih suka
menunggu sampai punya lebih banyak\lTelur, kan?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You didn’t realize how much this
cost before you spoke to me, am\lI right?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] You didn’t realize how much this cost before you spoke to me, am I right?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Kamu tidak menyadari berapa
biayanya sebelum berbicara\ldenganku, kan?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

Why would you want to spend money
when you have no Eggs?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] Why would you want to spend money when you have no Eggs?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Mengapa Anda ingin menghabiskan
uang ketika Anda tidak memiliki\lTelur?

entries.original:
"You’re going to be here again
tomorrow, am I right?

I’m looking forward to working with
your Eggs again!"
entries.translation_source: You’re going to be here again tomorrow, am I right? I’m looking forward to working with your Eggs again!
entries.translated:
Anda akan ada di sini lagi besok,
kan? Saya menantikan untuk bekerja\ldengan Telur Anda lagi!

entries.original:
"Ever come across an Egg you just
didn’t want?

Then have no fear!

I buy Eggs like those at $[green][buffer1][blue]
a pop.

Do you have any Eggs you want to
sell to me?"
entries.translation_source: Ever come across an Egg you just didn’t want? Then have no fear! I buy Eggs like those at $[color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] a pop. Do you have any Eggs you want to sell to me?
entries.translated:
Pernah menemukan Telur yang tidak
Anda inginkan? Jangan takut! Saya\lmembeli Telur seperti itu seharga

$[green][buffer1][blue] per buah. Apakah Anda
memiliki Telur yang ingin Anda jual\lkepada saya?

entries.original:
"Do you have any Eggs you want to
sell to me?"
entries.translation_source: Do you have any Eggs you want to sell to me?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda memiliki Telur yang
ingin Anda jual kepada saya?

entries.original:
"Which Egg do you want to sell
to me?"
entries.translation_source: Which Egg do you want to sell to me?
entries.translated:
Telur mana yang ingin Anda jual
kepada saya?

entries.original:
"Are you sure you want to sell me
this Egg?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure you want to sell me this Egg?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda yakin ingin menjual
Telur ini kepada saya?

entries.original:
"Are you sure you want to sell me
all of the Eggs in your party?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure you want to sell me all of the Eggs in your party?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda yakin ingin menjual
semua Telur di tim Anda kepada\lsaya?

entries.original:
"Are you sure you want to sell me
all of the Eggs in Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure you want to sell me all of the Eggs in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4][quote-close-5]?
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda yakin ingin menjual
semua Telur di Kotak \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc?

entries.original: "[black][player] sold the Egg for $[buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] sold the Egg for $[buffer1-3]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menjual Telur seharga
$[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] sold [buffer1] Egg[buffer3] in the party
for $[buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] sold [buffer1-3] Egg[buffer3-4] in the party for $[buffer2-5]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menjual [buffer1]
Telur[buffer3] di tim seharga\l$[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] sold [buffer1] Egg[buffer3] in the Box
for $[buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] sold [buffer1-3] Egg[buffer3-4] in the Box for $[buffer2-5]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menjual [buffer1]
Telur[buffer3] di Kotak seharga\l$[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Pleasure doing business with you!

Come see me again if you have more
Eggs to sell."
entries.translation_source: Pleasure doing business with you! Come see me again if you have more Eggs to sell.
entries.translated:
Senang bisa berbisnis dengan Anda!
Datang lagi jika Anda memiliki\llebih banyak Telur untuk dijual.

entries.original:
"Keep me in mind if you ever come
across an Egg you don’t want."
entries.translation_source: Keep me in mind if you ever come across an Egg you don’t want.
entries.translated:
Ingatlah saya jika Anda menemukan
Telur yang tidak Anda inginkan.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any Eggs in
your party\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any Eggs in your party[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Anda tidak memiliki Telur di tim
Anda\.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any Eggs in
Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any Eggs in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4][quote-close-5][game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Anda tidak memiliki Telur di Kotak
\qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\.

entries.original:
"I can’t buy that Pokémon from you.
It’s not in an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t buy that Pokémon from you. It’s not in an Egg!
entries.translated:
Saya tidak bisa membeli Pokémon itu
dari Anda. Itu bukan dalam Telur!

entries.original:
"Despite our town being known for
its export of Charcoal, I have yet\lto actually see a Pokémon hold\lthe item.

Can you help me by showing me a
Pokémon [green]holding[red] a [green]Charcoal[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Despite our town being known for its export of Charcoal, I have yet to actually see a Pokémon hold the item. Can you help me by showing me a Pokémon [color-green-1]holding[color-red-2] a [color-green-3]Charcoal[color-red-4]?
entries.translated:
Meskipun kota kami terkenal dengan
ekspor Arang, saya belum\lbenar-benar melihat Pokémon

memegang item itu. Bisakah Anda
membantu saya dengan menunjukkan\lPokémon [green]memegang[red] [green]Arang[red]?

entries.original:
"Huh, so that’s why I haven’t seen
it around here.

Charcoal is made out of black wood,
not red wood!

Okay, thank you!
You’ve made my day!

Now, let me show you something!"
entries.translation_source: Huh, so that’s why I haven’t seen it around here. Charcoal is made out of black wood, not red wood! Okay, thank you! You’ve made my day! Now, let me show you something!
entries.translated:
Huh, jadi itulah mengapa saya belum
melihatnya di sini. Arang terbuat\ldari kayu hitam, bukan kayu merah!

Oke, terima kasih! Anda membuat
hari saya! Sekarang, biarkan saya\lmenunjukkan sesuatu!

entries.original:
"Huh?

That’s an Egg."
entries.translation_source: Huh? That’s an Egg.
entries.translated: Huh? Itu adalah Telur.

entries.original:
"Huh?

That Pokémon’s not holding
a Charcoal."
entries.translation_source: Huh? That Pokémon’s not holding a Charcoal.
entries.translated:
Huh? Pokémon itu tidak memegang
Arang.

entries.original:
"Have a Pokémon hold the [green]Luck
Incense[red] like Charcoal, and it’ll\l[green]double[red] the amount of [green]prize money[red]\lreceived from battles!"
entries.translation_source: Have a Pokémon hold the [color-green-1]Luck Incense[color-red-2] like Charcoal, and it’ll [color-green-3]double[color-red-4] the amount of [color-green-5]prize money[color-red-6] received from battles!
entries.translated:
Suruh Pokémon memegang [green]Luck Incense[red]
seperti Charcoal, dan itu akan\l[green]melipatgandakan[red] jumlah [green]uang hadiah[red]

yang diterima dari pertarungan!

entries.original: "So you don’t know either\."
entries.translation_source: So you don’t know either[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Jadi kamu juga tidak tahu\.

entries.original:
"Benjamin is a master of [green]Bug[blue]-type
Pokémon!

And he’s a huge fan of battling
backwards, too!

Even his Gym puzzle is inspired by
his [green]backwards[blue] way of thinking.

What does this all mean?
You’ll see in due time\."
entries.translation_source: Benjamin is a master of [color-green-1]Bug[color-blue-2]-type Pokémon! And he’s a huge fan of battling backwards, too! Even his Gym puzzle is inspired by his [color-green-3]backwards[color-blue-4] way of thinking. What does this all mean? You’ll see in due time[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Benjamin adalah master Pokémon tipe
[green]Serangga[blue]! Dan dia juga penggemar\lberat bertarung secara terbalik!

Bahkan teka-teki Gym-nya
terinspirasi dari cara berpikirnya\lyang [green]terbalik[blue]. Apa artinya semua

ini? Akan terlihat pada waktunya\.

entries.original:
"Benjamin’s backwards way of
thinking has nothing on your way,\lit seems!"
entries.translation_source: Benjamin’s backwards way of thinking has nothing on your way, it seems!
entries.translated:
Cara berpikir terbalik Benjamin
tidak ada apa-apanya dengan caramu,\lsepertinya!

entries.original:
"I’ll trade you my super special
[green][buffer2][blue] if you can catch me a\l[green][buffer1][blue]!

I’ve been trying really hard to
find one, but it’s so difficult!

Do you have one to trade me?"
entries.translation_source: I’ll trade you my super special [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] if you can catch me a [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6]! I’ve been trying really hard to find one, but it’s so difficult! Do you have one to trade me?
entries.translated:
Aku akan menukarmu super spesialku
[green][buffer2][blue] jika kamu bisa\lmenangkapkan aku [green][buffer1][blue]! Aku

sudah berusaha keras mencari satu,
tapi sangat sulit! Apakah kamu\lpunya satu untuk ditukar denganku?

entries.original:
"But it’s been so hard for me to
find one\."
entries.translation_source: But it’s been so hard for me to find one[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tapi sangat sulit bagiku untuk
menemukannya\.

entries.original:
"Does that look a [buffer1] to you?
I asked for a [buffer1], not that."
entries.translation_source: Does that look a [buffer1-1] to you? I asked for a [buffer1-2], not that.
entries.translated:
Apakah itu terlihat seperti
[buffer1] bagimu? Aku meminta\l[buffer1], bukan itu.

entries.original:
"Alright!
I scored myself a great Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! I scored myself a great Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Baiklah! Aku mendapatkan Pokémon
yang hebat!

entries.original:
"Have you been playing with my old
[buffer2]?

I’ve been playing with the
[buffer1] you gave me.

I even evolved it!"
entries.translation_source: Have you been playing with my old [buffer2-1]? I’ve been playing with the [buffer1-2] you gave me. I even evolved it!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu telah bermain dengan
[buffer2] lamaku? Aku telah bermain\ldengan [buffer1] yang kamu berikan

padaku. Aku bahkan mengevolusinya!

entries.original:
"Use [green]Soak[blue] on a Pokémon you’re
fighting!

Then, throw a [green]Net Ball[blue] at it for
super easy catch!"
entries.translation_source: Use [color-green-1]Soak[color-blue-2] on a Pokémon you’re fighting! Then, throw a [color-green-3]Net Ball[color-blue-4] at it for super easy catch!
entries.translated:
Gunakan [green]Soak[blue] pada Pokémon yang kamu
lawan! Lalu, lempar [green]Net Ball[blue]\lpadanya untuk menangkap dengan

sangat mudah!

entries.original:
"BEGIN FROM
THE CENTRE.
CREATE WHAT
YOU SEEK."
entries.translation_source: BEGIN FROM THE CENTRE. CREATE WHAT YOU SEEK.
entries.translated:
MULAI DARI TENGAH. CIPTAKAN APA
YANG KAMU CARI.

entries.original: "There is a big hole in the wall."
entries.translation_source: There is a big hole in the wall.
entries.translated: Ada lubang besar di dinding.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the
power of rock started moving!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Pokémon statue that exudes the power of rock started moving!
entries.translated:
[black]Patung Pokémon yang memancarkan
kekuatan batu mulai bergerak!

entries.original: "[green]Zaza zari za\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Zaza zari za[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Zaza zari za\.

entries.original:
"CRACK THE
ICE. LEAVE
PURE WHAT
YOU SEEK."
entries.translation_source: CRACK THE ICE. LEAVE PURE WHAT YOU SEEK.
entries.translated:
PECAHKAN ES. TINGGALKAN MURNI APA
YANG KAMU CARI.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the
power of ice started moving!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Pokémon statue that exudes the power of ice started moving!
entries.translated:
[black]Patung Pokémon yang memancarkan
kekuatan es mulai bergerak!

entries.original: "[green]Jakiih!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Jakiih!
entries.translated: [green]Jakiih!

entries.original:
"NATURE MOLDS
TO OUR WILL.
TURN THE
CRYSTALS TO
WHAT YOU SEEK."
entries.translation_source: NATURE MOLDS TO OUR WILL. TURN THE CRYSTALS TO WHAT YOU SEEK.
entries.translated:
ALAM MEMBENTUK SESUAI KEHENDAK
KITA. UBAH KRISTAL MENJADI APA YANG\lKAMU CARI.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the
power of steel started moving!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Pokémon statue that exudes the power of steel started moving!
entries.translated:
[black]Patung Pokémon yang memancarkan
kekuatan baja mulai bergerak!

entries.original: "[green]Ji-ji-ze-ji-zoh\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Ji-ji-ze-ji-zoh[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Ji-ji-ze-ji-zoh\.

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] disappeared.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] menghilang.

entries.original: "Rift Cave"
entries.translation_source: Rift Cave
entries.translated: Rift Cave

entries.original:
"A mysterious cave said to have a
connection to the great beyond.
Those who wander about inside may
never find their way out."
entries.translation_source: A mysterious cave said to have a connection to the great beyond. Those who wander about inside may never find their way out.

entries.original: "Route 1"
entries.translation_source: Route 1
entries.translated: Rute 1

entries.original:
"[black]A large pile of snow is blocking
the road.

Better go another way for now."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]A large pile of snow is blocking the road. Better go another way for now.
entries.translated:
[black]Tumpukan salju besar menghalangi
jalan. Lebih baik lewat jalan lain\luntuk saat ini.

entries.original:
"Sorry, fella.

An avalanche caused some snow piles
to gather up on the road.

If you wanna go to Bellin, you’ll
have to take the ol’ mountain road\lfor now.

Here, come with me and I’ll show you
the way."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, fella. An avalanche caused some snow piles to gather up on the road. If you wanna go to Bellin, you’ll have to take the ol’ mountain road for now. Here, come with me and I’ll show you the way.
entries.translated:
Maaf, kawan. Longsoran salju
menyebabkan beberapa tumpukan salju\lmenumpuk di jalan. Jika kamu ingin

pergi ke Bellin, kamu harus lewat
jalan gunung yang lama untuk saat\lini. Ayo, ikut aku dan aku akan

menunjukkan jalannya.

entries.original:
"Some scary lookin’ fella came along
and melted the snow piles blockin’\lthe road.

I sure was happy and all, but
somethin’ seemed up with him.

If you care, I watched him head
[green]north of Frozen Heights[blue].

Wonder what he’s doin’ up there?"
entries.translation_source: Some scary lookin’ fella came along and melted the snow piles blockin’ the road. I sure was happy and all, but somethin’ seemed up with him. If you care, I watched him head [color-green-1]north of Frozen Heights[color-blue-2]. Wonder what he’s doin’ up there?
entries.translated:
Seseorang yang kelihatan menakutkan
datang dan melelehkan tumpukan\lsalju yang menghalangi jalan. Aku

pasti senang dan semuanya, tapi ada
yang aneh dengan dia. Jika kamu\lpeduli, aku melihat dia pergi ke

[green]utara Frozen Heights[blue]. Entah apa
yang dia lakukan di sana?

entries.original:
"Ah, you must be [player].

Prof. Log phoned ahead and told me
to guide you if you got lost.

Bellin Town is just over that way."
entries.translation_source: Ah, you must be [player-name-1]. Prof. Log phoned ahead and told me to guide you if you got lost. Bellin Town is just over that way.
entries.translated:
Ah, kamu pasti [player]. Prof. Log
menelepon sebelumnya dan menyuruhku\luntuk membimbingmu jika kamu

tersesat. Bellin Town ada di
sebelah sana.

entries.original:
"If you’d like me to show you how to
capture a Pokémon, prove you’re\lcapable by delivering [green]Prof. Log’s\lpackage[blue] to him."
entries.translation_source: If you’d like me to show you how to capture a Pokémon, prove you’re capable by delivering [color-green-1]Prof. Log’s package[color-blue-2] to him.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin aku menunjukkan
cara menangkap Pokémon, buktikan\lkamu mampu dengan mengantarkan

[green]paket Prof. Log[blue] kepadanya.

entries.original:
"Ah, from the Badge on your Trainer
Card, I see that you’ve become a\lrather skilled Trainer.

You’ve far surpassed the role of
Prof. Log’s errand [buffer1].

However, in my book, you’re never
too experienced to watch an expert\lcatch Pokémon!

So, what do you say?

I could show you a thing or two
about capturing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Ah, from the Badge on your Trainer Card, I see that you’ve become a rather skilled Trainer. You’ve far surpassed the role of Prof. Log’s errand [buffer1-1]. However, in my book, you’re never too experienced to watch an expert catch Pokémon! So, what do you say? I could show you a thing or two about capturing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ah, dari Lencana di Kartu
Pelatihmu, aku melihat kamu telah\lmenjadi Pelatih yang cukup

terampil. Kamu sudah jauh melampaui
peran sebagai kurir Prof. Log\l[buffer1]. Namun, menurutku, kamu

tidak akan pernah terlalu
berpengalaman untuk melihat seorang\lahli menangkap Pokémon! Jadi,

bagaimana? Aku bisa menunjukkan
beberapa hal tentang menangkap\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"I heard from Prof. Log that you did
well delivering his package to him.

And I even heard from him that he’s
sending you on more errands as a\lfully fledged Pokémon Trainer!

You know, I used to be something of
a Trainer myself, back in my day.

I could show you a thing or two
about capturing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I heard from Prof. Log that you did well delivering his package to him. And I even heard from him that he’s sending you on more errands as a fully fledged Pokémon Trainer! You know, I used to be something of a Trainer myself, back in my day. I could show you a thing or two about capturing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku dengar dari Prof. Log bahwa
kamu berhasil mengantarkan paketnya\lkepadanya. Dan aku bahkan dengar

darinya bahwa dia akan mengirimmu
untuk tugas-tugas lain sebagai\lPelatih Pokémon yang sepenuhnya!

Kamu tahu, dulu aku juga seorang
Pelatih, di zamanku. Aku bisa\lmenunjukkan beberapa hal tentang

menangkap Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Alrighty!
Here we go!"
entries.translation_source: Alrighty! Here we go!
entries.translated: Baiklah! Ayo kita mulai!

entries.original:
"Phew\.

That one was too close for
comfort\."
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1] That one was too close for comfort[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Fiuh\. Itu terlalu dekat untuk
kenyamanan\.

entries.original:
"As you witnessed, I successfully
captured that Pokémon by throwing\la [green]Poké Ball[blue].

However, this won’t always work.

Many times, Pokémon must be
weakened before you’ll be able\lto capture them."
entries.translation_source: As you witnessed, I successfully captured that Pokémon by throwing a [color-green-1]Poké Ball[color-blue-2]. However, this won’t always work. Many times, Pokémon must be weakened before you’ll be able to capture them.
entries.translated:
Seperti yang kamu saksikan, aku
berhasil menangkap Pokémon itu\ldengan melempar [green]Poké Ball[blue]. Namun,

ini tidak selalu berhasil.
Seringkali, Pokémon harus\ldilemahkan sebelum kamu bisa

menangkap mereka.

entries.original:
"And as my thanks for allowing me to
stretch my legs today, please take\lthis Poké Ball I acquired back in\lmy younger days."
entries.translation_source: And as my thanks for allowing me to stretch my legs today, please take this Poké Ball I acquired back in my younger days.
entries.translated:
Dan sebagai ucapan terima kasih
karena telah mengizinkanku\lmeregangkan kaki hari ini, silakan

ambil Poké Ball ini yang aku
dapatkan di masa mudaku.

entries.original:
"If you would ever like to see my
skills again, please, stop by."
entries.translation_source: If you would ever like to see my skills again, please, stop by.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin melihat kemampuanku
lagi, silakan mampir.

entries.original:
"If you ever would like to see me in
action, please, stop by."
entries.translation_source: If you ever would like to see me in action, please, stop by.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu ingin melihatku beraksi,
silakan mampir.

entries.original: "boy"
entries.translation_source: boy
entries.translated: laki-laki

entries.original: "Route 10"
entries.translation_source: Route 10
entries.translated: Rute 10

entries.original:
"Huah, fellow Trainer!

I am training my body and soul by
staring at this tree intently!

Take this so you can train too!"
entries.translation_source: Huah, fellow Trainer! I am training my body and soul by staring at this tree intently! Take this so you can train too!
entries.translated:
Huah, sesama Pelatih! Aku melatih
tubuh dan jiwaku dengan menatap\lpohon ini dengan saksama! Ambil ini

agar kamu bisa berlatih juga!

entries.original:
"Huah, fellow Trainer!

I can [green]upgrade[blue] the [green]Macho Brace[blue] to
make training more efficient!

Right now it is only a measly \Lv [buffer3],
but I can upgrade it to [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue] in\lexchange for [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Huah, fellow Trainer! I can [color-green-1]upgrade[color-blue-2] the [color-green-3]Macho Brace[color-blue-4] to make training more efficient! Right now it is only a measly [game-token-5] [buffer3-6], but I can upgrade it to [color-green-7][game-token-8] [buffer2-9][color-blue-10] in exchange for [color-green-11][buffer2-12] [buffer1-13]s[color-blue-14]!
entries.translated:
Huah, sesama Pelatih! Aku dapat
[green]meningkatkan[blue] [green]Macho Brace[blue] untuk\lmembuat latihan lebih efisien! Saat

ini hanya \Lv [buffer3] yang rendah,
tapi aku dapat meningkatkannya\lmenjadi [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue] dengan imbalan

[green][buffer2] [buffer1][blue]!

entries.original:
"Fine, settle for an inferior
product!"
entries.translation_source: Fine, settle for an inferior product!
entries.translated:
Baik, terimalah produk yang lebih
rendah!

entries.original:
"You do not have enough [buffer1]s
for me to upgrade your Macho Brace!"
entries.translation_source: You do not have enough [buffer1-1]s for me to upgrade your Macho Brace!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup [buffer1]
untukku meningkatkan Gelang\lMacho-mu!

entries.original:
"[black]The Macho Brace level has been
increased to \Lv [buffer2]!

Pokémon will now gain [green][buffer2]*[black] the
amount of Effort Values when held."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Macho Brace level has been increased to [game-token-2] [buffer2-3]! Pokémon will now gain [color-green-4][buffer2-5]*[color-black-6] the amount of Effort Values when held.
entries.translated:
[black]Level Gelang Macho telah
ditingkatkan menjadi \Lv [buffer2]!\lPokémon sekarang akan mendapatkan

[green][buffer2]*[black] jumlah Nilai Effort saat
dikenakan.

entries.original:
"Your Macho Brace is as powerful
as it can get!

In its current state, you will
receive [green][buffer1]*[blue] the amount of effort\lvalues when training with it!"
entries.translation_source: Your Macho Brace is as powerful as it can get! In its current state, you will receive [color-green-1][buffer1-2]*[color-blue-3] the amount of effort values when training with it!
entries.translated:
Gelang Macho-mu sudah sekuat
mungkin! Dalam keadaan saat ini,\lkamu akan menerima [green][buffer1]*[blue] jumlah

nilai effort saat berlatih
dengannya!

entries.original:
"The sea\.

Full of fury one moment, calm as a
Pokémon’s nature the next\."
entries.translation_source: The sea[game-token-1] Full of fury one moment, calm as a Pokémon’s nature the next[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Laut\. Penuh amarah sesaat, tenang
seperti sifat Pokémon selanjutnya\.

entries.original:
"Battle me.

Show me you too, can be as furious
as the sea."
entries.translation_source: Battle me. Show me you too, can be as furious as the sea.
entries.translated:
Bertarunglah denganku. Tunjukkan
padaku bahwa kamu juga bisa seganas\llaut.

entries.original:
"You have done well.
Take this item."
entries.translation_source: You have done well. Take this item.
entries.translated:
Kamu telah melakukannya dengan
baik. Ambil item ini.

entries.original:
"That [green]Medichamite[blue] is for Mega
Evolving the Pokémon, [green]Medicham[blue].

With the right Trainer, it too can
battle as furiously as the sea."
entries.translation_source: That [color-green-1]Medichamite[color-blue-2] is for Mega Evolving the Pokémon, [color-green-3]Medicham[color-blue-4]. With the right Trainer, it too can battle as furiously as the sea.
entries.translated:
Itu [green]Medichamit[blue] untuk Mega Evolusi
Pokémon, [green]Medicham[blue]. Dengan Pelatih\lyang tepat, ia juga bisa bertarung

seganas laut.

entries.original:
"If you can defeat all the Trainers
here and on the Auburn Waterway,\lI’d like to see your fury, too."
entries.translation_source: If you can defeat all the Trainers here and on the Auburn Waterway, I’d like to see your fury, too.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa mengalahkan semua
Pelatih di sini dan di Jalur Air\lAuburn, aku ingin melihat amarahmu

juga.

entries.original:
"Stop right there!

I want to paint this
perfect moment."
entries.translation_source: Stop right there! I want to paint this perfect moment.
entries.translated:
Berhenti di situ! Aku ingin melukis
momen sempurna ini.

entries.original:
"A young kid, dashing through
the rain\."
entries.translation_source: A young kid, dashing through the rain[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Seorang anak muda, berlari menembus
hujan\.

entries.original:
"I don’t think it’s such a good
idea to paint in the rain.

Everything I paint gets
washed away\."
entries.translation_source: I don’t think it’s such a good idea to paint in the rain. Everything I paint gets washed away[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku rasa bukan ide yang baik untuk
melukis di tengah hujan. Semua yang\lkulukis akan terhapus\.

entries.original:
"Only the uncool kids actually go
to school\."
entries.translation_source: Only the uncool kids actually go to school[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Hanya anak-anak yang tidak keren
yang benar-benar pergi ke sekolah\.

entries.original:
"That cave over there, what do you
suppose is in it?"
entries.translation_source: That cave over there, what do you suppose is in it?
entries.translated:
Gua di sana itu, menurutmu apa yang
ada di dalamnya?

entries.original:
"I bet scary strong Pokémon live
there!"
entries.translation_source: I bet scary strong Pokémon live there!
entries.translated:
Aku yakin Pokémon kuat yang
menakutkan tinggal di sana!

entries.original:
"Word around these parts is that the
cave is called the [green]Cave of Being[blue].

People say it bears a resemblance
to the lake caves of Sinnoh."
entries.translation_source: Word around these parts is that the cave is called the [color-green-1]Cave of Being[color-blue-2]. People say it bears a resemblance to the lake caves of Sinnoh.
entries.translated:
Kabar di sekitar sini mengatakan
bahwa gua itu disebut [green]Gua\lKeberadaan[blue]. Orang-orang bilang gua

itu mirip dengan gua danau di
Sinnoh.

entries.original:
"In other places like Fallshore
City, it only rains sometimes.

So why is it always raining on
Route 10?"
entries.translation_source: In other places like Fallshore City, it only rains sometimes. So why is it always raining on Route 10?
entries.translated:
Di tempat lain seperti Kota
Fallshore, hujan hanya\lkadang-kadang. Jadi mengapa di Rute

10 selalu hujan?

entries.original: "Route 11"
entries.translation_source: Route 11
entries.translated: Rute 11

entries.original: "Cliff Cave"
entries.translation_source: Cliff Cave
entries.translated: Gua Tebing

entries.original:
"Beyond the boundary of rocks lies
a vast ocean.

It’s somewhere in this ocean
wherein lies the peaceful\lAlola region.

The people there have a tradition
that each of their islands is\lprotected by a guardian deity.

Do you ever wonder what it would
be like if each of the islands that\lmake up Borrius had, too?

That thought may not cross your
mind, but it certainly does mine."
entries.translation_source: Beyond the boundary of rocks lies a vast ocean. It’s somewhere in this ocean wherein lies the peaceful Alola region. The people there have a tradition that each of their islands is protected by a guardian deity. Do you ever wonder what it would be like if each of the islands that make up Borrius had, too? That thought may not cross your mind, but it certainly does mine.
entries.translated:
Di balik batas bebatuan terbentang
lautan luas. Di suatu tempat di\llautan inilah terletak wilayah

Alola yang damai. Orang-orang di
sana memiliki tradisi bahwa setiap\lpulau mereka dilindungi oleh dewa

pelindung. Apakah kamu pernah
bertanya-tanya bagaimana rasanya\ljika setiap pulau yang membentuk

Borrius juga memilikinya? Pikiran
itu mungkin tidak terlintas di\lbenakmu, tetapi pasti terlintas di

benakku.

entries.original:
"That Pokémon in your party\.

It certainly bears resemblance to
the guardian deities of Alola\."
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon in your party[game-token-1] It certainly bears resemblance to the guardian deities of Alola[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Pokémon di timmu itu\. Itu pasti
mirip dengan Dewa Pelindung Alola\.

entries.original:
"Reports from the Alola region
indicate their guardian deities\lare still present, which must mean\lyours is not of this world.

Regardless, this item rightfully
belongs with it, not with me."
entries.translation_source: Reports from the Alola region indicate their guardian deities are still present, which must mean yours is not of this world. Regardless, this item rightfully belongs with it, not with me.
entries.translated:
Laporan dari wilayah Alola
menunjukkan bahwa Dewa Pelindung\lmereka masih ada, yang berarti

milikmu bukan dari dunia ini.
Bagaimanapun juga, item ini\lseharusnya menjadi miliknya, bukan

milikku.

entries.original:
"The [green]Tapunium Z[red] can power up any
of the Alolan guardian deities\l[green]Nature’s Madness[red], into a more\lpowerful, one-time use Z-Move."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Tapunium Z[color-red-2] can power up any of the Alolan guardian deities [color-green-3]Nature’s Madness[color-red-4], into a more powerful, one-time use Z-Move.
entries.translated:
[green]Tapunium Z[red] dapat meningkatkan
[green]Kegilaan Alam[red] dari Dewa Pelindung\lAlola mana pun, menjadi Z-Move yang

lebih kuat dan hanya bisa digunakan
sekali.

entries.original:
"Upon this rocky face I see, yet
another Trainer, yearning to be.

The very best, I say, the very
best.

Then, I shall put this Trainer to
the test!"
entries.translation_source: Upon this rocky face I see, yet another Trainer, yearning to be. The very best, I say, the very best. Then, I shall put this Trainer to the test!
entries.translated:
Di wajah berbatu ini kulihat,
seorang Pelatih lain, yang ingin\lmenjadi yang terbaik. Yang terbaik,

kataku, yang terbaik. Lalu, aku
akan menguji Pelatih ini!

entries.original:
"A glorious defeat for me, a
glorious defeat you see."
entries.translation_source: A glorious defeat for me, a glorious defeat you see.
entries.translated:
Kekalahan yang gemilang bagiku,
kekalahan yang gemilang kau lihat.

entries.original:
"And as this Trainer did pass the
test, I said to them, they are\lthe very best."
entries.translation_source: And as this Trainer did pass the test, I said to them, they are the very best.
entries.translated:
Dan saat Pelatih ini berhasil
melewati ujian, aku berkata kepada\lmereka, mereka adalah yang terbaik.

entries.original:
"An [green]Alakazite[blue] is full of might.

For [green]Alakazam[blue], it will shine
bright."
entries.translation_source: An [color-green-1]Alakazite[color-blue-2] is full of might. For [color-green-3]Alakazam[color-blue-4], it will shine bright.
entries.translated:
Sebuah [green]Alakazite[blue] penuh dengan
kekuatan. Untuk [green]Alakazam[blue], akan\lbersinar terang.

entries.original:
"Upon this rocky face I see, yet
another Trainer, yearning to be.

The very best, I say, the very
best.

But only one who has defeated all
of the Trainers on Route 11, can\lbe put to the test."
entries.translation_source: Upon this rocky face I see, yet another Trainer, yearning to be. The very best, I say, the very best. But only one who has defeated all of the Trainers on Route 11, can be put to the test.
entries.translated:
Di wajah berbatu ini kulihat,
seorang Pelatih lain, yang ingin\lmenjadi yang terbaik. Yang terbaik,

kataku, yang terbaik. Tapi hanya
yang telah mengalahkan semua\lPelatih di Route 11, yang dapat

diuji.

entries.original:
"We battle as one!
Us and nature!"
entries.translation_source: We battle as one! Us and nature!
entries.translated:
Kami bertarung sebagai satu! Kami
dan alam!

entries.original:
"Mother nature, where have we
gone wrong?"
entries.translation_source: Mother nature, where have we gone wrong?
entries.translated: Ibu Pertiwi, di mana kita salah?

entries.original:
"I work to protect the environment.
In turn, nature protects me!"
entries.translation_source: I work to protect the environment. In turn, nature protects me!
entries.translated:
Aku bekerja untuk melindungi
lingkungan. Sebagai balasannya,\lalam melindungiku!

entries.original:
"We battle as one!
Us and nature!

But only against Trainers that can
take us both at once!"
entries.translation_source: We battle as one! Us and nature! But only against Trainers that can take us both at once!
entries.translated:
Kami bertarung sebagai satu! Kami
dan alam! Tapi hanya melawan\lPelatih yang bisa menghadapi kami

berdua sekaligus!

entries.original:
"Together we’re strong!
Together with nature!"
entries.translation_source: Together we’re strong! Together with nature!
entries.translated:
Bersama kita kuat! Bersama dengan
alam!

entries.original: "But together\. we’re strong\.?"
entries.translation_source: But together[game-token-1] we’re strong[game-token-2]?
entries.translated: Tapi bersama\. kita kuat\.?

entries.original:
"The mountain here has a whole
network of caves running\lthrough it.

Together, we protect the Pokémon
of the cliff’s caves."
entries.translation_source: The mountain here has a whole network of caves running through it. Together, we protect the Pokémon of the cliff’s caves.
entries.translated:
Gunung di sini memiliki jaringan
gua yang luas di dalamnya. Bersama,\lkami melindungi Pokémon di gua-gua

tebing.

entries.original:
"Together we’re strong!
Together with nature!

But only against Trainers that can
take us both at once!"
entries.translation_source: Together we’re strong! Together with nature! But only against Trainers that can take us both at once!
entries.translated:
Bersama kita kuat! Bersama dengan
alam! Tapi hanya melawan Pelatih\lyang bisa menghadapi kami berdua

sekaligus!

entries.original:
"Pokémon from the sea have infested
this body of water!"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon from the sea have infested this body of water!
entries.translated:
Pokémon dari laut telah memenuhi
perairan ini!

entries.original: "How did they get up here?"
entries.translation_source: How did they get up here?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana mereka bisa sampai ke
sini?

entries.original:
"Tentacool don’t belong in ponds,
they belong in the sea!"
entries.translation_source: Tentacool don’t belong in ponds, they belong in the sea!
entries.translated:
Tentacool tidak seharusnya ada di
kolam, mereka seharusnya ada di\llaut!

entries.original:
"With a better rod, I could catch
better Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: With a better rod, I could catch better Pokémon[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dengan pancing yang lebih baik, aku
bisa menangkap Pokémon yang lebih\lbaik\.

entries.original:
"I love fishing, don’t get me wrong.

But it’d be best if I also had more
work."
entries.translation_source: I love fishing, don’t get me wrong. But it’d be best if I also had more work.
entries.translated:
Aku suka memancing, jangan salah
paham. Tapi akan lebih baik jika\laku juga punya lebih banyak

pekerjaan.

entries.original: "It’s not easy\."
entries.translation_source: It’s not easy[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ini tidak mudah\.

entries.original:
"It’s all right.
Losing doesn’t bug me anymore."
entries.translation_source: It’s all right. Losing doesn’t bug me anymore.
entries.translated:
Tidak apa-apa. Kalah tidak lagi
menggangguku.

entries.original:
"I guess you get to be good at
what you like.

Well, you beat me at Pokémon,
but you can’t top me at fishing."
entries.translation_source: I guess you get to be good at what you like. Well, you beat me at Pokémon, but you can’t top me at fishing.
entries.translated:
Kurasa kau bisa menjadi ahli dalam
hal yang kau sukai. Yah, kau\lmengalahkanku di Pokémon, tapi kau

tidak bisa mengalahkanku dalam
memancing.

entries.original: "It’s kind of chilly out here."
entries.translation_source: It’s kind of chilly out here.
entries.translated: Di sini agak dingin.

entries.original: "That warmed me right up!"
entries.translation_source: That warmed me right up!
entries.translated: Itu membuatku langsung hangat!

entries.original: "It’s always important to stay warm."
entries.translation_source: It’s always important to stay warm.
entries.translated: Penting untuk selalu tetap hangat.

entries.original:
"This place reminds me of the Cliff
Caves from the Johto region.

Huh? I could’ve thought of something
different?

Like what? Cliff Caves Remastered?
Original Recipe Cliff Caves?"
entries.translation_source: This place reminds me of the Cliff Caves from the Johto region. Huh? I could’ve thought of something different? Like what? Cliff Caves Remastered? Original Recipe Cliff Caves?
entries.translated:
Tempat ini mengingatkanku pada
Cliff Caves dari region Johto. Hah?\lAku bisa memikirkan sesuatu yang

berbeda? Seperti apa? Cliff Caves
Remastered? Cliff Caves Resep Asli?

entries.original: "I believe I can fly!"
entries.translation_source: I believe I can fly!
entries.translated: Aku percaya aku bisa terbang!

entries.original: "I believe I can touch the sky!"
entries.translation_source: I believe I can touch the sky!
entries.translated:
Aku percaya aku bisa menyentuh
langit!

entries.original:
"I like to pretend I can fly like
my birds.

Being grounded sucks."
entries.translation_source: I like to pretend I can fly like my birds. Being grounded sucks.
entries.translated:
Aku suka berpura-pura bisa terbang
seperti burung-burungku. Berada di\ldarat itu menyebalkan.

entries.original:
"Talonflame has a Hidden Ability
called [green]Gale Wings[blue].

It can use its Flying-type moves
faster!"
entries.translation_source: Talonflame has a Hidden Ability called [color-green-1]Gale Wings[color-blue-2]. It can use its Flying-type moves faster!
entries.translated:
Talonflame memiliki Ability
Tersembunyi bernama [green]Gale Wings[blue]. Ia\lbisa menggunakan gerakan tipe

Terbangnya lebih cepat!

entries.original: "Route 12"
entries.translation_source: Route 12
entries.translated: Rute 12

entries.original:
"Did you know that your [buffer1]
is able to power moves up\linto [green]Z-Moves[blue]?

Those are super powerful moves that
can only be used once per battle!

Just equip your Pokémon with a
[green]Z-Crystal[blue] matching one of its\lmove Types, and press \btn04 when\lselecting the move to unleash a\ldevastating attack!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that your [buffer1-1] is able to power moves up into [color-green-2]Z-Moves[color-blue-3]? Those are super powerful moves that can only be used once per battle! Just equip your Pokémon with a [color-green-4]Z-Crystal[color-blue-5] matching one of its move Types, and press [button-icon-6] when selecting the move to unleash a devastating attack!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa [buffer1] kamu
dapat meningkatkan kekuatan gerakan\lmenjadi [green]Z-Moves[blue]? Itu adalah gerakan

super kuat yang hanya bisa
digunakan sekali per pertempuran!\lCukup lengkapi Pokémon-mu dengan

[green]Z-Crystal[blue] yang sesuai dengan salah
satu Tipe gerakannya, dan tekan \btn04\lsaat memilih gerakan untuk

melancarkan serangan dahsyat!

entries.original:
"There’s a Pokémon in the bag!
Take it?"
entries.translation_source: There’s a Pokémon in the bag! Take it?
entries.translated: Ada Pokémon di dalam tas! Ambil?

entries.original:
"[player] found a [buffer1]!
It has a [green][buffer2][black] nature."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] found a [buffer1-2]! It has a [color-green-3][buffer2-4][color-black-5] nature.
entries.translated:
[player] menemukan [buffer1]! Ia
memiliki sifat [green][buffer2][black].

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough space for
this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough space for this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki cukup ruang
untuk Pokémon ini.

entries.original:
"There’s a Pokémon in the bag!

But it doesn’t seem like it wants
to come out right now\."
entries.translation_source: There’s a Pokémon in the bag! But it doesn’t seem like it wants to come out right now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ada Pokémon di dalam tas! Tapi
sepertinya ia tidak ingin keluar\lsekarang\.

entries.original: "Check ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Check ’em!
entries.translated: Periksa mereka!

entries.original:
"Did you enjoy checking out my
Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Did you enjoy checking out my Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu menikmati memeriksa
Pokémon-ku?

entries.original: "I love showing off my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I love showing off my Pokémon!
entries.translated: Aku suka memamerkan Pokémon-ku!

entries.original:
"This mountain pass has a very
unique layout.

You’re not going to find any other
route in Borrius with stairs built\linto the side of a mountain like\lthis one!"
entries.translation_source: This mountain pass has a very unique layout. You’re not going to find any other route in Borrius with stairs built into the side of a mountain like this one!
entries.translated:
Jalur gunung ini memiliki tata
letak yang sangat unik. Kamu tidak\lakan menemukan rute lain di Borrius

dengan tangga yang dibangun di sisi
gunung seperti ini!

entries.original: "Do you know where you’re going?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know where you’re going?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tahu ke mana kamu
pergi?

entries.original: "You must know."
entries.translation_source: You must know.
entries.translated: Kamu pasti tahu.

entries.original:
"To go between Tarmigan Town and
Dehara City, you must first go\ldown the mountain."
entries.translation_source: To go between Tarmigan Town and Dehara City, you must first go down the mountain.
entries.translated:
Untuk pergi antara Kota Tarmigan
dan Kota Dehara, kamu harus turun\lgunung terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"A beautiful Trainer can’t lose
her way!

It’s simply not possible!"
entries.translation_source: A beautiful Trainer can’t lose her way! It’s simply not possible!
entries.translated:
Seorang Trainer cantik tidak bisa
tersesat! Itu benar-benar tidak\lmungkin!

entries.original:
"My psychic powers foretell my
victory!"
entries.translation_source: My psychic powers foretell my victory!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan psikisku meramalkan
kemenanganku!

entries.original: "I\. I was wrong?"
entries.translation_source: I[game-token-1] I was wrong?
entries.translated: Aku\. Aku salah?

entries.original:
"I must hone my psychic senses
further.

Next time, I will not be wrong."
entries.translation_source: I must hone my psychic senses further. Next time, I will not be wrong.
entries.translated:
Aku harus mengasah indra psikisku
lebih jauh. Lain kali, aku tidak\lakan salah.

entries.original:
"The warmer the weather, the
stronger I get!"
entries.translation_source: The warmer the weather, the stronger I get!
entries.translated:
Semakin hangat cuacanya, semakin
kuat aku!

entries.original:
"The ocean off the coast is really
deep!"
entries.translation_source: The ocean off the coast is really deep!
entries.translated:
Lautan di lepas pantai sangat
dalam!

entries.original: "I’ll keep fishing."
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep fishing.
entries.translated: Aku akan terus memancing.

entries.original:
"I think some Pokémon can take
you underwater."
entries.translation_source: I think some Pokémon can take you underwater.
entries.translated:
Menurutku beberapa Pokémon bisa
membawamu ke bawah air.

entries.original:
"You can’t see from on land, but
the water here is very deep!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t see from on land, but the water here is very deep!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak bisa melihat dari darat,
tetapi air di sini sangat dalam!

entries.original: "Route 13"
entries.translation_source: Route 13
entries.translated: Rute 13

entries.original:
"[buffer1] soared upwards out
of sight."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] soared upwards out of sight.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] melesat ke atas hingga
tidak terlihat.

entries.original:
"With my fists, I am trying to
smash this rock that continuously\lreappears under my umbrella.

Aiyah!

But it is not working\."
entries.translation_source: With my fists, I am trying to smash this rock that continuously reappears under my umbrella. Aiyah! But it is not working[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dengan tinjuku, aku mencoba
menghancurkan batu ini yang terus\lmuncul kembali di bawah payungku.

Aiyah! Tapi itu tidak berhasil\.

entries.original:
"Aiyah! 
You smashed it!"
entries.translation_source: Aiyah! You smashed it!
entries.translated: Aiyah! Kamu menghancurkannya!

entries.original:
"They call me the Ocean Master.

Why?

Because I am the master of the
ocean.

I command the Pokémon of the sea,
and none can defeat me.

Allow me to show you."
entries.translation_source: They call me the Ocean Master. Why? Because I am the master of the ocean. I command the Pokémon of the sea, and none can defeat me. Allow me to show you.
entries.translated:
Mereka memanggilku Master Lautan.
Kenapa? Karena aku adalah master\llautan. Aku memerintah Pokémon

laut, dan tidak ada yang bisa
mengalahkanku. Izinkan aku\lmenunjukkan padamu.

entries.original:
"You are now the Ocean Master.
Congratulations."
entries.translation_source: You are now the Ocean Master. Congratulations.
entries.translated:
Kamu sekarang adalah Master Lautan.
Selamat.

entries.original:
"In truth, I was called the Ocean
Master because of my name.

It was a cruel joke my classmates
played on me.

I vowed revenge, so I became an
Ace Trainer.

That is all in the past now, so I
would like you to have this."
entries.translation_source: In truth, I was called the Ocean Master because of my name. It was a cruel joke my classmates played on me. I vowed revenge, so I became an Ace Trainer. That is all in the past now, so I would like you to have this.
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, aku dipanggil Master
Laut karena namaku. Itu adalah\llelucon kejam yang dilakukan

teman-teman sekelasku padaku. Aku
bersumpah akan membalas dendam,\ljadi aku menjadi Pelatih Ace. Itu

semua sudah berlalu sekarang, jadi
aku ingin kamu memiliki ini.

entries.original:
"Only the Ocean Master can tame a
Mega Gyarados.

As you are one, allow your [green]Gyarados[blue]
to hold the [green]Gyaradosite[blue].

It will make for an explosive
battle."
entries.translation_source: Only the Ocean Master can tame a Mega Gyarados. As you are one, allow your [color-green-1]Gyarados[color-blue-2] to hold the [color-green-3]Gyaradosite[color-blue-4]. It will make for an explosive battle.
entries.translated:
Hanya Master Laut yang bisa
menjinakkan Mega Gyarados. Karena\lkamu adalah salah satunya, biarkan

[green]Gyarados[blue] milikmu memegang
[green]Gyaradosite[blue]. Itu akan membuat\lpertarungan yang eksplosif.

entries.original:
"They call me the Ocean Master.

Why?

Because I am the master of the
ocean.

I command the Pokémon of the sea,
and none can defeat me.

Especially not someone who has not
even defeated all of the Trainers\lon Route 13 and Route 14."
entries.translation_source: They call me the Ocean Master. Why? Because I am the master of the ocean. I command the Pokémon of the sea, and none can defeat me. Especially not someone who has not even defeated all of the Trainers on Route 13 and Route 14.
entries.translated:
Mereka memanggilku Master Laut.
Kenapa? Karena aku adalah penguasa\llautan. Aku memerintah Pokémon

laut, dan tidak ada yang bisa
mengalahkanku. Terutama bukan\lseseorang yang bahkan belum

mengalahkan semua Pelatih di Rute
13 dan Rute 14.

entries.original:
"Wahahah! This dude’s going to catch
himself a big one!"
entries.translation_source: Wahahah! This dude’s going to catch himself a big one!
entries.translated:
Wahahah! Orang ini akan menangkap
yang besar!

entries.original: "This dude just lost one\."
entries.translation_source: This dude just lost one[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Orang ini baru saja kehilangan satu\.

entries.original:
"This dude thinks you’re a big one.
No, you’re a big-one-to-be!"
entries.translation_source: This dude thinks you’re a big one. No, you’re a big-one-to-be!
entries.translated:
Orang ini mengira kamu yang besar.
Tidak, kamu adalah calon yang\lbesar!

entries.original:
"Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll
hook a big one!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll hook a big one!
entries.translated:
Oh, tidak! Aku punya perasaan aku
akan memancing yang besar!

entries.original:
"I look at the sea to forget all
the bad things that happened."
entries.translation_source: I look at the sea to forget all the bad things that happened.
entries.translated:
Aku melihat laut untuk melupakan
semua hal buruk yang terjadi.

entries.original:
"Ooh!
Traumatic!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh! Traumatic!
entries.translated: Ooh! Traumatis!

entries.original:
"I’m looking at the sea to forget
the bad thing that happened!"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking at the sea to forget the bad thing that happened!
entries.translated:
Aku sedang melihat laut untuk
melupakan hal buruk yang terjadi!

entries.original:
"You can only Dive where the sea
is dark."
entries.translation_source: You can only Dive where the sea is dark.
entries.translated:
Kamu hanya bisa Menyelam di mana
lautnya gelap.

entries.original: "What’s beyond the horizon?"
entries.translation_source: What’s beyond the horizon?
entries.translated: Apa yang ada di balik cakrawala?

entries.original: "Glub!"
entries.translation_source: Glub!
