entries.translated: Glub!

entries.original:
"I see the Ruins of Void over
yonder!"
entries.translation_source: I see the Ruins of Void over yonder!
entries.translated: Aku melihat Ruins of Void di sana!

entries.original:
"I can beat even marine Pokémon
at swimming."
entries.translation_source: I can beat even marine Pokémon at swimming.
entries.translated:
Aku bisa mengalahkan bahkan Pokémon
laut dalam berenang.

entries.original:
"Swimming’s great!
Sunburns aren’t!"
entries.translation_source: Swimming’s great! Sunburns aren’t!
entries.translated:
Berenang itu hebat! Kulit terbakar
matahari tidak!

entries.original: "Shocker!"
entries.translation_source: Shocker!
entries.translated: Mengejutkan!

entries.original:
"My friend wanted to swim to
the Ruins of Void."
entries.translation_source: My friend wanted to swim to the Ruins of Void.
entries.translated:
Temanku ingin berenang ke Ruins of
Void.

entries.original:
"If I were to ride a Pokémon on
the sea, I’d like a Lapras.

Lapras is so big, I bet it
would keep me dry on water."
entries.translation_source: If I were to ride a Pokémon on the sea, I’d like a Lapras. Lapras is so big, I bet it would keep me dry on water.
entries.translated:
Jika aku bisa menunggangi Pokémon
di laut, aku ingin Lapras. Lapras\lsangat besar, aku yakin itu akan

membuatku tetap kering di air.

entries.original:
"Oh, I just love your ride!
Can I have it if I win?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I just love your ride! Can I have it if I win?
entries.translated:
Oh, aku suka kendaraanmu! Bisakah
aku memilikinya jika aku menang?

entries.original: "Oh! I lost!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! I lost!
entries.translated: Oh! Aku kalah!

entries.original:
"It’s still a long way to
the Ruins of Void.

I want to go back to Dresco Town."
entries.translation_source: It’s still a long way to the Ruins of Void. I want to go back to Dresco Town.
entries.translated:
Masih jauh menuju Ruins of Void.
Aku ingin kembali ke Dresco Town.

entries.original:
"Please don’t splash my face!
You’ll ruin the makeup."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t splash my face! You’ll ruin the makeup.
entries.translated:
Tolong jangan percikkan wajahku!
Riasanku akan rusak.

entries.original:
"Kurukkoo!
How do you like my birdcall?"
entries.translation_source: Kurukkoo! How do you like my birdcall?
entries.translated:
Kurukkoo! Bagaimana menurutmu suara
burungku?

entries.original: "I had to bug you!"
entries.translation_source: I had to bug you!
entries.translated: Aku harus mengganggumu!

entries.original:
"I collect sea Pokémon on weekends
because the sea is so close."
entries.translation_source: I collect sea Pokémon on weekends because the sea is so close.
entries.translated:
Aku mengoleksi Pokémon laut di
akhir pekan karena lautnya sangat\ldekat.

entries.original:
"You need sun to sunbathe!

I very well couldn’t do it on
Route 10!"
entries.translation_source: You need sun to sunbathe! I very well couldn’t do it on Route 10!
entries.translated:
Kau butuh sinar matahari untuk
berjemur! Tentu saja aku tidak bisa\lmelakukannya di Route 10!

entries.original:
"From out of the sand I leap! Hiyah!
I challenge thee!"
entries.translation_source: From out of the sand I leap! Hiyah! I challenge thee!
entries.translated:
Dari dalam pasir aku melompat!
Hiyah! Aku menantangmu!

entries.original: "With honour I admit defeat!"
entries.translation_source: With honour I admit defeat!
entries.translated:
Dengan hormat aku mengakui
kekalahan!

entries.original:
"I must refine the art of concealment.
I bid thee farewell."
entries.translation_source: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.
entries.translated:
Aku harus menyempurnakan seni
penyembunyian. Aku ucapkan selamat\ltinggal.

entries.original:
"This year, I’m going to finally
learn how to swim!"
entries.translation_source: This year, I’m going to finally learn how to swim!
entries.translated:
Tahun ini, aku akhirnya akan
belajar berenang!

entries.original:
"Yay, yay!
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Yay, yay! Pokémon!
entries.translated: Yay, yay! Pokémon!

entries.original: "What happens now?"
entries.translation_source: What happens now?
entries.translated: Apa yang terjadi sekarang?

entries.original:
"Did I just win?
Or did I lose?"
entries.translation_source: Did I just win? Or did I lose?
entries.translated:
Apakah aku baru saja menang? Atau
kalah?

entries.original: "Route 14"
entries.translation_source: Route 14
entries.translated: Route 14

entries.original:
"M-my legs! They cramped up!
Glub, glub\."
entries.translation_source: M-my legs! They cramped up! Glub, glub[game-token-1]
entries.translated: K-kakiku! Kram! Glub, glub\.

entries.original:
"The water is deep here.
There are many people swimming."
entries.translation_source: The water is deep here. There are many people swimming.
entries.translated:
Airnya dalam di sini. Ada banyak
orang berenang.

entries.original: "Splash!"
entries.translation_source: Splash!
entries.translated: Byur!

entries.original:
"I wish I could ride my Pokémon.
I bet you’re not tired."
entries.translation_source: I wish I could ride my Pokémon. I bet you’re not tired.
entries.translated:
Aku ingin bisa menunggangi
Pokémon-ku. Pasti kau tidak lelah.

entries.original: "Riding a Pokémon sure looks fun!"
entries.translation_source: Riding a Pokémon sure looks fun!
entries.translated:
Menunggangi Pokémon pasti terlihat
menyenangkan!

entries.original: "Check out my buff physique!"
entries.translation_source: Check out my buff physique!
entries.translated: Lihatlah fisik kekar saya!

entries.original: "Wimpy!"
entries.translation_source: Wimpy!
entries.translated: Lemah!

entries.original:
"I should’ve been buffing up my
Pokémon, not me!"
entries.translation_source: I should’ve been buffing up my Pokémon, not me!
entries.translated:
Seharusnya aku memperkuat
Pokémon-ku, bukan diriku sendiri!

entries.original:
"I’m beat! But, I still have the
bike race and marathon left!"
entries.translation_source: I’m beat! But, I still have the bike race and marathon left!
entries.translated:
Aku kelelahan! Tapi, aku masih
punya balapan sepeda dan maraton!

entries.original: "My boyfriend gave me big pearls."
entries.translation_source: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.
entries.translated: Pacarku memberiku mutiara besar.

entries.original:
"Oh, no!
My pearls were in them!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! My pearls were in them!
entries.translated:
Oh, tidak! Mutiara-mutiara itu ada
di dalamnya!

entries.original:
"Will my pearls grow bigger inside
Cloyster?"
entries.translation_source: Will my pearls grow bigger inside Cloyster?
entries.translated:
Akankah mutiara-mutiara saya tumbuh
lebih besar di dalam Cloyster?

entries.original:
"When I can’t be with my boyfriend,
I spend time with the Pokémon he\lgave me."
entries.translation_source: When I can’t be with my boyfriend, I spend time with the Pokémon he gave me.
entries.translated:
Saat aku tidak bisa bersama
pacarku, aku menghabiskan waktu\lbersama Pokémon yang dia berikan

kepadaku.

entries.original:
"If only there was someone to have a
picnic with\."
entries.translation_source: If only there was someone to have a picnic with[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Andai saja ada seseorang untuk
berpiknik bersama\.

entries.original:
"Wow!
Your Badges are too cool!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Your Badges are too cool!
entries.translated:
Wow! Lencana-lencana kamu terlalu
keren!

entries.original: "Not enough!"
entries.translation_source: Not enough!
entries.translated: Tidak cukup!

entries.original:
"You got those Badges from Gym
Leaders. I know!"
entries.translation_source: You got those Badges from Gym Leaders. I know!
entries.translated:
Kamu mendapatkan Lencana-lencana
itu dari Pemimpin Gym. Aku tahu!

entries.original: "What are you looking at?"
entries.translation_source: What are you looking at?
entries.translated: Apa yang kamu lihat?

entries.original: "I’m just relaxing here."
entries.translation_source: I’m just relaxing here.
entries.translated: Aku hanya bersantai di sini.

entries.original: "Even rough housers need a break."
entries.translation_source: Even rough housers need a break.
entries.translated:
Bahkan orang yang suka berkelahi
pun butuh istirahat.

entries.original:
"Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call
myself an Expert now, can I?"
entries.translation_source: Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call myself an Expert now, can I?
entries.translated:
Nah, nah, aku kalah. Aku tidak bisa
menyebut diriku seorang Ahli\lsekarang, kan?

entries.original:
"Whoops! Don’t tell me I snagged
a Surfing Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Whoops! Don’t tell me I snagged a Surfing Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Whoops! Jangan bilang aku memancing
Pokémon Berselancar?

entries.original: "I can’t keep up!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t keep up!
entries.translated: Aku tidak bisa mengikuti!

entries.original:
"It’d be a handful if I hooked
your tough Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: It’d be a handful if I hooked your tough Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Akan merepotkan jika aku memancing
Pokémon tangguhmu!

entries.original:
"Perhaps that reek is your sweaty
Pokémon’s body odor\."
entries.translation_source: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty Pokémon’s body odor[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mungkin bau itu adalah bau badan
Pokémonmu yang berkeringat\.

entries.original:
"We’re standing on top of the
KBT Expressway!"
entries.translation_source: We’re standing on top of the KBT Expressway!
entries.translated: Kami berdiri di atas Jalan Tol KBT!

entries.original:
"Can you feel the people moving
below us?"
entries.translation_source: Can you feel the people moving below us?
entries.translated:
Bisakah kamu merasakan orang-orang
yang bergerak di bawah kita?

entries.original:
"This section of the KBT Expressway
runs from Crater Town to Tehl Town."
entries.translation_source: This section of the KBT Expressway runs from Crater Town to Tehl Town.
entries.translated:
Bagian dari Jalan Tol KBT ini
membentang dari Crater Town ke Tehl\lTown.

entries.original:
"If 100 people as big as me stood
here, do you think the ground\lcould support the weight?"
entries.translation_source: If 100 people as big as me stood here, do you think the ground could support the weight?
entries.translated:
Jika 100 orang sebesar aku berdiri
di sini, apakah menurutmu tanah\lbisa menahan beratnya?

entries.original: "Route 15"
entries.translation_source: Route 15
entries.translated: Rute 15

entries.original:
"Are you crazy!?

Don’t you know it’s dangerous to
swim in a thunderstorm?

\.\CC0820Us?

We’re part Ground-type!
We can’t be shocked!"
entries.translation_source: Are you crazy!? Don’t you know it’s dangerous to swim in a thunderstorm? [game-token-1][control-code-2]Us? We’re part Ground-type! We can’t be shocked!
entries.translated:
Apa kamu gila!? Tidak tahukah kamu
bahwa berenang dalam badai petir\litu berbahaya? \.\CC0820Kami? Kami adalah

tipe Ground! Kami tidak bisa
tersengat!

entries.original:
"Oh, dear\.

You’d best be careful swimming in
this weather!

This is no natural thunderstorm,
you see.

Something ominous is causing
the downpour."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear[game-token-1] You’d best be careful swimming in this weather! This is no natural thunderstorm, you see. Something ominous is causing the downpour.
entries.translated:
Oh, sayang\. Sebaiknya kamu
berhati-hati berenang dalam cuaca\lini! Ini bukan badai petir alami,

lho. Sesuatu yang tidak
menyenangkan menyebabkan hujan\lderas.

entries.original:
"The strange thunderstorm from
before is over now!

Why did it suddenly end?"
entries.translation_source: The strange thunderstorm from before is over now! Why did it suddenly end?
entries.translated:
Badai petir aneh sebelumnya sudah
berakhir sekarang! Kenapa tiba-tiba\lberhenti?

entries.original: "It ended as suddenly as our battle!"
entries.translation_source: It ended as suddenly as our battle!
entries.translated:
Itu berakhir tiba-tiba seperti
pertarungan kita!

entries.original:
"What could have caused a
thunderstorm that powerful?

I know of the Ability [green]Drizzle[red], but
that was something else.

The rain was almost\.\CC0820 primordial\."
entries.translation_source: What could have caused a thunderstorm that powerful? I know of the Ability [color-green-1]Drizzle[color-red-2], but that was something else. The rain was almost[game-token-3][control-code-4] primordial[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Apa yang bisa menyebabkan badai
petir sekuat itu? Aku tahu tentang\lAbility [green]Drizzle[red], tapi itu lain.

Hujan itu hampir\.\CC0820 primordial\.

entries.original:
"Thunderstorms don’t actually have
an effect on fishing.

But [green]Sweet Scent[blue]\.

That can’t be used if the weather
isn’t clear."
entries.translation_source: Thunderstorms don’t actually have an effect on fishing. But [color-green-1]Sweet Scent[color-blue-2][game-token-3] That can’t be used if the weather isn’t clear.
entries.translated:
Badai petir sebenarnya tidak
berpengaruh pada memancing. Tapi\l[green]Sweet Scent[blue]\. Itu tidak bisa

digunakan jika cuaca tidak cerah.

entries.original: "Route 16"
entries.translation_source: Route 16
entries.translated: Rute 16

entries.original: "Route 16 - 17"
entries.translation_source: Route 16 - 17

entries.original: "[black]Something unseeable is in the way."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Something unseeable is in the way.
entries.translated:
[black]Sesuatu yang tidak terlihat
menghalangi jalan.

entries.original:
"Move, kid!

You’re blockin’ the road!"
entries.translation_source: Move, kid! You’re blockin’ the road!
entries.translated:
Minggir, nak! Kamu menghalangi
jalan!

entries.original:
"Huh?

There’s somethin’ in the way?

It better not be that pesky
Pokémon, again\."
entries.translation_source: Huh? There’s somethin’ in the way? It better not be that pesky Pokémon, again[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Hah? Ada sesuatu yang menghalangi?
Semoga bukan Pokémon menyebalkan\litu lagi\.

entries.original:
"Take this.

If my hunch is right, it’ll get rid
of whatever’s blockin’ the road."
entries.translation_source: Take this. If my hunch is right, it’ll get rid of whatever’s blockin’ the road.
entries.translated:
Ambil ini. Jika firasatku benar,
ini akan menyingkirkan apa pun yang\lmenghalangi jalan.

entries.original:
"If my hunch is right, that item
should show you exactly what’s\lblockin’ the road."
entries.translation_source: If my hunch is right, that item should show you exactly what’s blockin’ the road.
entries.translated:
Jika firasatku benar, item itu akan
menunjukkan padamu persis apa yang\lmenghalangi jalan.

entries.original:
"[black]Something unseeable is in the way.

Use the Devon Scope?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Something unseeable is in the way. Use the Devon Scope?
entries.translated:
[black]Sesuatu yang tidak terlihat
menghalangi jalan. Gunakan Devon\lScope?

entries.original: "[black][player] used the Devon Scope."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] used the Devon Scope.
entries.translated: [black][player] menggunakan Devon Scope.

entries.original:
"[black]An invisible Pokémon became
completely visible!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]An invisible Pokémon became completely visible!
entries.translated:
[black]Seekor Pokémon yang tidak terlihat
menjadi terlihat sepenuhnya!

entries.original: "[black]The startled Pokémon took off!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The startled Pokémon took off!
entries.translated: [black]Pokémon yang terkejut itu kabur!

entries.original:
"Hmph.

Seems like you’re a more
intimidatin’ Trainer than you let on\.

Say\. you should take on the Antisis
Gym with your Pokémon.

I hear the Gym Leader there has
been pretty bored lately."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. Seems like you’re a more intimidatin’ Trainer than you let on[game-token-1] Say[game-token-2] you should take on the Antisis Gym with your Pokémon. I hear the Gym Leader there has been pretty bored lately.
entries.translated:
Hmph. Sepertinya kamu adalah
Pelatih yang lebih mengintimidasi\ldaripada yang kamu perlihatkan\.

Katakan\. kamu harus menantang Gym
Antisis dengan Pokémon-mu. Kudengar\lPemimpin Gym di sana akhir-akhir

ini cukup bosan.

entries.original: "[black]The startled Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The startled Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated:
[black]Pokémon yang terkejut itu
menyerang!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] took off!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] took off!
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] kabur!

entries.original:
"Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun,
please shine down on me\."
entries.translation_source: Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun, please shine down on me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh Tuan Matahari, Matahari, Tuan
Matahari Emas, tolong sinari aku\.

entries.original:
"Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun,
has shone down on me\."
entries.translation_source: Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun, has shone down on me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh Tuan Matahari, Matahari, Tuan
Matahari Emas, telah menyinariku\.

entries.original:
"Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun,
it’s now time to leave\."
entries.translation_source: Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun, it’s now time to leave[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh Tuan Matahari, Matahari, Tuan
Matahari Emas, sekarang waktunya\lpergi\.

entries.original:
"I get my kicks by harassing people
with my stinking Pokémon.

They’re great for startling people.
And, they bite, too."
entries.translation_source: I get my kicks by harassing people with my stinking Pokémon. They’re great for startling people. And, they bite, too.
entries.translated:
Aku mendapatkan kesenangan dengan
mengganggu orang dengan Pokémon-ku\lyang bau. Mereka hebat untuk

mengejutkan orang. Dan, mereka juga
menggigit.

entries.original:
"Leaving so soon?

There’s an exit toll to pay!"
entries.translation_source: Leaving so soon? There’s an exit toll to pay!
entries.translated:
Pergi secepat ini? Ada biaya keluar
yang harus dibayar!

entries.original: "You took my money!"
entries.translation_source: You took my money!
entries.translated: Kamu mengambil uangku!

entries.original:
"Forget it!
I don’t need your money!"
entries.translation_source: Forget it! I don’t need your money!
entries.translated: Lupakan! Aku tidak butuh uangmu!

entries.original:
"If you don’t know how, I’m willing
to show you how to swim."
entries.translation_source: If you don’t know how, I’m willing to show you how to swim.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu tidak tahu caranya, aku
bersedia mengajarimu berenang.

entries.original:
"My favourite kind of guy is someone
that looks good out in the sea!"
entries.translation_source: My favourite kind of guy is someone that looks good out in the sea!
entries.translated:
Tipe pria favoritku adalah
seseorang yang terlihat keren di\llaut!

entries.original: "The tide is going out\."
entries.translation_source: The tide is going out[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Air laut sedang surut\.

entries.original:
"Don’t get me wrong, it’s not as if
I don’t like mountain men.

But, you know, my favourite kind of
guy looks great with Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t get me wrong, it’s not as if I don’t like mountain men. But, you know, my favourite kind of guy looks great with Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Jangan salah paham, bukannya aku
tidak suka pria gunung. Tapi,\ltahukah kamu, tipe pria favoritku

tampak hebat dengan Pokémon!

entries.original:
"The bad men in Antisis City like to
harass people who get too close\lthe city."
entries.translation_source: The bad men in Antisis City like to harass people who get too close the city.
entries.translated:
Orang-orang jahat di Kota Antisis
suka mengganggu orang yang terlalu\ldekat dengan kota.

entries.original:
"My dream’s a big one!

I want to battle every kind of
Pokémon from around the world!"
entries.translation_source: My dream’s a big one! I want to battle every kind of Pokémon from around the world!
entries.translated:
Mimpiku besar! Aku ingin bertarung
melawan semua jenis Pokémon dari\lseluruh dunia!

entries.original:
"I lost, but I am one step closer to
realizing my dream!"
entries.translation_source: I lost, but I am one step closer to realizing my dream!
entries.translated:
Aku kalah, tapi aku selangkah lebih
dekat untuk mewujudkan mimpiku!

entries.original:
"Listen, you! Whatever happens,
never lose sight of your dream!"
entries.translation_source: Listen, you! Whatever happens, never lose sight of your dream!
entries.translated:
Dengar, kamu! Apapun yang terjadi,
jangan pernah melupakan mimpimu!

entries.original:
"Oh right\.
I was fishing, wasn’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Oh right[game-token-1] I was fishing, wasn’t I?
entries.translated: Oh benar\. Aku sedang memancing, kan?

entries.original:
"I’d sensed the presence of a
Trainer for a while.

It was you!"
entries.translation_source: I’d sensed the presence of a Trainer for a while. It was you!
entries.translated:
Aku sudah merasakan kehadiran
seorang Pelatih sejak tadi.\lTernyata kamu!

entries.original:
"Defeating you will be no easy
matter."
entries.translation_source: Defeating you will be no easy matter.
entries.translated:
Mengalahkanmu bukanlah hal yang
mudah.

entries.original:
"Is it possible to become more
powerful by understanding Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Is it possible to become more powerful by understanding Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Apakah mungkin menjadi lebih kuat
dengan memahami Pokémon?

entries.original:
"My body isn’t naturally this good
looking!

My Pokémon and I exercise every
day to keep our bodies fit."
entries.translation_source: My body isn’t naturally this good looking! My Pokémon and I exercise every day to keep our bodies fit.
entries.translated:
Tubuhku tidak secara alami segagah
ini! Aku dan Pokémon-ku berolahraga\lsetiap hari untuk menjaga kebugaran

tubuh kami.

entries.original: "Look at these magnificent wings!"
entries.translation_source: Look at these magnificent wings!
entries.translated:
Lihatlah sayap-sayap yang megah
ini!

entries.original: "I’m going to peck you for that!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to peck you for that!
entries.translated: Aku akan mematukmu karena itu!

entries.original:
"Did you know that one of my bird
Pokémon can mimic speech?"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that one of my bird Pokémon can mimic speech?
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa salah satu
Pokémon burungku bisa menirukan\lucapan?

entries.original:
"I came here in hopes of bringing
new life into the area."
entries.translation_source: I came here in hopes of bringing new life into the area.
entries.translated:
Aku datang ke sini dengan harapan
membawa kehidupan baru ke area ini.

entries.original: "Route 17"
entries.translation_source: Route 17
entries.translated: Rute 17

entries.original:
"Oh, geez\.
Another Trainer\.

Well, here you go."
entries.translation_source: Oh, geez[game-token-1] Another Trainer[game-token-2] Well, here you go.
entries.translated:
Oh, astaga\. Pelatih lain\. Baiklah,
ini dia.

entries.original:
"I’ve been instructed by my
superiors to hand out that HM to\lany Trainers coming this way.

Until the bridge is fixed, you’ll
need to use that HM for [green]Rock Climb[blue]\lif you want to go to [green]Seaport City[blue].

Just face that rock wall over
there to use it."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been instructed by my superiors to hand out that HM to any Trainers coming this way. Until the bridge is fixed, you’ll need to use that HM for [color-green-1]Rock Climb[color-blue-2] if you want to go to [color-green-3]Seaport City[color-blue-4]. Just face that rock wall over there to use it.
entries.translated:
Aku diperintahkan oleh atasan untuk
membagikan HM itu kepada Pelatih\lyang datang ke sini. Sampai

jembatan diperbaiki, kamu harus
menggunakan HM itu untuk [green]Panjat\lTebing[blue] jika ingin pergi ke [green]Seaport

City[blue]. Hadapilah dinding batu di
sana untuk menggunakannya.

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid!

A fight between some Zangoose and
Seviper took out the bridge.

It’ll take some time before we get
it fixed.

You should talk to our boss about
finding an alternative way to\lSeaport City in the meantime."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid! A fight between some Zangoose and Seviper took out the bridge. It’ll take some time before we get it fixed. You should talk to our boss about finding an alternative way to Seaport City in the meantime.
entries.translated:
Maaf, nak! Pertarungan antara
Zangoose dan Seviper merusak\ljembatan. Butuh beberapa waktu

untuk memperbaikinya. Kamu harus
bicara dengan bos kami untuk\lmencari jalan alternatif menuju

Seaport City sementara ini.

entries.original: "It’s a seashell."
entries.translation_source: It’s a seashell.
entries.translated: Itu adalah kerang laut.

entries.original: "[green]Derrrr!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Derrrr!
entries.translated: [green]Derrrr!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] receded into the
sand."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] receded into the sand.
entries.translated: [buffer1] mundur ke dalam pasir.

entries.original:
"He ho!
You thaved me!

I wath looking for Berrieth on behalf
of Tropiuth Berrieth Inc., when all\lof a thudden theth boulderth fell\ldown around me!

But you rethcued me, tho now I can
go home for the day!

Becauth of your heroic efforth, I
want you to take thome Berrieth!"
entries.translation_source: He ho! You thaved me! I wath looking for Berrieth on behalf of Tropiuth Berrieth Inc., when all of a thudden theth boulderth fell down around me! But you rethcued me, tho now I can go home for the day! Becauth of your heroic efforth, I want you to take thome Berrieth!
entries.translated:
He ho! Kamu menyelamatkanku! Aku
sedang mencari Berrieth atas nama\lTropiuth Berrieth Inc., ketika

tiba-tiba batu-batu besar ini jatuh
di sekelilingku! Tapi kamu\lmenyelamatkanku, jadi sekarang aku

bisa pulang! Karena usahamu yang
heroik, aku ingin kamu mengambil\lbeberapa Berrieth!

entries.original:
"He ho!

I’ll be back tomorrow to look for
more Berrieth!"
entries.translation_source: He ho! I’ll be back tomorrow to look for more Berrieth!
entries.translated:
He ho! Aku akan kembali besok untuk
mencari lebih banyak Berrieth!

entries.original:
"I am an eloquent Bird Keeper.

I only partake in the finest of
aerial battles.

As such, I refuse to partake in
battles where Pokémon on the\lground are utilized.

Hearing that, would you care for a
[green]Sky Battle[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: I am an eloquent Bird Keeper. I only partake in the finest of aerial battles. As such, I refuse to partake in battles where Pokémon on the ground are utilized. Hearing that, would you care for a [color-green-1]Sky Battle[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Aku adalah Pemelihara Burung yang
fasih. Aku hanya berpartisipasi\ldalam pertarungan udara yang

terbaik. Oleh karena itu, aku
menolak untuk berpartisipasi dalam\lpertarungan yang menggunakan

Pokémon di darat. Mendengar itu,
apakah kamu tertarik untuk\l[green]Pertarungan Langit[blue]?

entries.original:
"Unfortunately for you, I also require
the defeat of all Trainers on this\lroute before I will battle you.

Please return once you have done so,
and then we can begin our eloquent\laerial battle!"
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately for you, I also require the defeat of all Trainers on this route before I will battle you. Please return once you have done so, and then we can begin our eloquent aerial battle!
entries.translated:
Sayangnya bagimu, aku juga
membutuhkan kekalahan semua Pelatih\ldi rute ini sebelum aku bertarung

denganmu. Silakan kembali setelah
kamu melakukannya, dan kita bisa\lmemulai pertarungan udara kita yang

fasih!

entries.original:
"Today appears to be my lucky day.
Let us battle!"
entries.translation_source: Today appears to be my lucky day. Let us battle!
entries.translated:
Hari ini tampaknya hari
keberuntunganku. Ayo bertarung!

entries.original:
"A shame.
That is indeed unfortunate."
entries.translation_source: A shame. That is indeed unfortunate.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali. Itu sungguh
disayangkan.

entries.original:
"You have no Pokémon I would be
willing to fight.

Only [green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon or
Pokémon with the [green]Levitate[blue] ability\lmay battle with my Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You have no Pokémon I would be willing to fight. Only [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-type Pokémon or Pokémon with the [color-green-3]Levitate[color-blue-4] ability may battle with my Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak memiliki Pokémon yang
mau aku lawan. Hanya Pokémon tipe\l[green]Terbang[blue] atau Pokémon dengan

kemampuan [green]Levitate[blue] yang boleh
bertarung dengan Pokémon-ku.

entries.original:
"Our aerial battle brought such joy
to my heart.

Please, take this Mega Stone for the
Pokémon [green]Pidgeot[blue] as a show of my\lgratitude!"
entries.translation_source: Our aerial battle brought such joy to my heart. Please, take this Mega Stone for the Pokémon [color-green-1]Pidgeot[color-blue-2] as a show of my gratitude!
entries.translated:
Pertarungan udara kita memberikan
kebahagiaan yang besar di hatiku.\lSilakan, ambil Mega Stone ini untuk

Pokémon [green]Pidgeot[blue] sebagai tanda
terima kasihku!

entries.original:
"Our aerial battle brought such joy
to my heart.

Please, take these Wings as a show
of my gratitude!"
entries.translation_source: Our aerial battle brought such joy to my heart. Please, take these Wings as a show of my gratitude!
entries.translated:
Pertarungan udara kita memberikan
kebahagiaan yang besar di hatiku.\lSilakan, ambil Sayap-Sayap ini

sebagai tanda terima kasihku!

entries.original:
"A shame.
You don’t have space for any wings."
entries.translation_source: A shame. You don’t have space for any wings.
entries.translated:
Sayang sekali. Kamu tidak punya
ruang untuk sayap apa pun.

entries.original:
"Our aerial battle filled me with
so much joy!

Let us do it again tomorrow."
entries.translation_source: Our aerial battle filled me with so much joy! Let us do it again tomorrow.
entries.translated:
Pertarungan udara kita membuatku
sangat bahagia! Ayo kita lakukan\llagi besok.

entries.original:
"I try not to leave the area so my
fishing chain will grow as long as\lpossible."
entries.translation_source: I try not to leave the area so my fishing chain will grow as long as possible.
entries.translated:
Aku berusaha tidak meninggalkan
area ini agar rantai pancingku\ltumbuh sepanjang mungkin.

entries.original:
"Most of my friends came to Seaport
City from far away regions."
entries.translation_source: Most of my friends came to Seaport City from far away regions.
entries.translated:
Sebagian besar temanku datang ke
Seaport City dari daerah yang jauh.

entries.original:
"But then most of my friends went
back to where they came from\."
entries.translation_source: But then most of my friends went back to where they came from[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tapi kemudian sebagian besar
temanku kembali ke tempat asal\lmereka\.

entries.original:
"Actually, that guy over there is my
only friend now\."
entries.translation_source: Actually, that guy over there is my only friend now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya, pria di sana itu
satu-satunya temanku sekarang\.

entries.original:
"I should go back home.

There was much more variety in
watery areas where I came from."
entries.translation_source: I should go back home. There was much more variety in watery areas where I came from.
entries.translated:
Aku harus pulang ke rumah. Ada
lebih banyak variasi di area\lperairan tempat aku berasal.

entries.original:
"Notice the cliffs here\.

This is the only place in Borrius
where they’re this vertical!"
entries.translation_source: Notice the cliffs here[game-token-1] This is the only place in Borrius where they’re this vertical!
entries.translated:
Perhatikan tebing di sini\. Ini
satu-satunya tempat di Borrius yang\lbegitu vertikal!

entries.original: "All the more fun to climb!"
entries.translation_source: All the more fun to climb!
entries.translated: Semakin menyenangkan untuk didaki!

entries.original:
"When I climb down the bluffs, I
find very interesting things hidden\lin the seashells on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: When I climb down the bluffs, I find very interesting things hidden in the seashells on the beach!
entries.translated:
Saat aku turun dari tebing, aku
menemukan hal-hal yang sangat\lmenarik tersembunyi di dalam

kerang-kerang di pantai!

entries.original:
"Finding rare Pokémon is much
easier if you have a DexNav.

As long as you’ve seen the
Pokémon, it’s very easy to\lencounter it again!"
entries.translation_source: Finding rare Pokémon is much easier if you have a DexNav. As long as you’ve seen the Pokémon, it’s very easy to encounter it again!
entries.translated:
Menemukan Pokémon langka jauh lebih
mudah jika kamu memiliki DexNav.\lSelama kamu sudah melihat Pokémon

tersebut, sangat mudah untuk
bertemu lagi!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon and I have been
running across Borrius.

We can take a kid Trainer like you!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon and I have been running across Borrius. We can take a kid Trainer like you!
entries.translated:
Aku dan Pokémon-ku telah berlari
melintasi Borrius. Kami bisa\lmengalahkan Trainer anak sepertimu!

entries.original:
"I guess we need to run less and
train more\."
entries.translation_source: I guess we need to run less and train more[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kami perlu lebih sedikit
berlari dan lebih banyak berlatih\.

entries.original:
"Huff\. Puff\.

Jogging and battling make a tiring
combo!"
entries.translation_source: Huff[game-token-1] Puff[game-token-2] Jogging and battling make a tiring combo!
entries.translated:
Huff\. Puff\. Joging dan bertarung
adalah kombinasi yang melelahkan!

entries.original:
"I trained my Zangoose and Seviper
to play together nicely!"
entries.translation_source: I trained my Zangoose and Seviper to play together nicely!
entries.translated:
Aku melatih Zangoose dan Seviper-ku
untuk bermain bersama dengan baik!

entries.original:
"Huh?
What’s that?

You say there are no Bug Pokémon
around here?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What’s that? You say there are no Bug Pokémon around here?
entries.translated:
Hah? Apa itu? Kamu bilang tidak ada
Pokémon Bug di sekitar sini?

entries.original:
"Huh?
What’s that?

Then where’d I get my Bug Pokémon
from?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What’s that? Then where’d I get my Bug Pokémon from?
entries.translated:
Hah? Apa itu? Lalu dari mana aku
mendapatkan Pokémon Seranggaku?

entries.original:
"I know there are bug Pokémon
around here!

There was one day I saw a huge
[green]swarm[blue] of them flying around!"
entries.translation_source: I know there are bug Pokémon around here! There was one day I saw a huge [color-green-1]swarm[color-blue-2] of them flying around!
entries.translated:
Aku tahu ada Pokémon Serangga di
sekitar sini! Suatu hari aku\lmelihat [green]kawanan[blue] besar mereka

terbang berputar-putar!

entries.original:
"One day, my babies will use a
powerful Return and beat you up\lfor what you did to them!"
entries.translation_source: One day, my babies will use a powerful Return and beat you up for what you did to them!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, bayiku akan menggunakan
Return yang kuat dan mengalahkanmu\lkarena apa yang kau lakukan pada

mereka!

entries.original: "Route 18"
entries.translation_source: Route 18
entries.translated: Route 18

entries.original:
"Let’s have a race!

Let’s see who can get to the
Pokémon League first!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s have a race! Let’s see who can get to the Pokémon League first!
entries.translated:
Ayo kita balapan! Mari kita lihat
siapa yang sampai ke Pokémon League\lterlebih dahulu!

entries.original:
"I’ve been swimming since I was a
wee tot, but nothing could have\lprepared me for this moment."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been swimming since I was a wee tot, but nothing could have prepared me for this moment.
entries.translated:
Aku sudah berenang sejak aku masih
kecil, tapi tidak ada yang bisa\lmempersiapkanku untuk momen ini.

entries.original: "It was the moment I met you!"
entries.translation_source: It was the moment I met you!
entries.translated:
Itu adalah saat aku bertemu
denganmu!

entries.original:
"Despite swimming since I was a wee
tot, I had never seen a Trainer\lriding on the back of a Pokémon\lbefore I battled you.

Which Pokémon is that you’re
Surfing on, anyway?

Is that a Wailmer?
It sure looks like one!"
entries.translation_source: Despite swimming since I was a wee tot, I had never seen a Trainer riding on the back of a Pokémon before I battled you. Which Pokémon is that you’re Surfing on, anyway? Is that a Wailmer? It sure looks like one!
entries.translated:
Meskipun sudah berenang sejak aku
masih kecil, aku belum pernah\lmelihat Pelatih naik di punggung

Pokémon sebelum aku bertarung
denganmu. Pokémon apa yang kau\lnaiki dengan Surf itu? Apakah itu

Wailmer? Memang terlihat seperti
itu!

entries.original:
"I keep my Poké Balls in the
pockets of my swim trunks.

\.

What?
Expecting a different answer?"
entries.translation_source: I keep my Poké Balls in the pockets of my swim trunks. [game-token-1] What? Expecting a different answer?
entries.translated:
Aku menyimpan Poké Ball-ku di saku
celana renangku. \. Apa? Mengharapkan\ljawaban yang berbeda?

entries.original:
"Only the best swimmers can swim all
the way to the Pokémon League!"
entries.translation_source: Only the best swimmers can swim all the way to the Pokémon League!
entries.translated:
Hanya perenang terbaik yang bisa
berenang sampai ke Pokémon League!

entries.original: "You’re cheating!"
entries.translation_source: You’re cheating!
entries.translated: Kau curang!

entries.original:
"It defeats the purpose of swimming
across a long watery stretch if\lyour Pokémon does it for you!"
entries.translation_source: It defeats the purpose of swimming across a long watery stretch if your Pokémon does it for you!
entries.translated:
Itu menghilangkan tujuan berenang
di perairan panjang jika Pokémonmu\lyang melakukannya untukmu!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon doesn’t know Sand-
Attack, but I can always help\lout using my psychic abilities!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon doesn’t know Sand- Attack, but I can always help out using my psychic abilities!
entries.translated:
Pokémonku tidak tahu Sand-Attack,
tapi aku selalu bisa membantu\lmenggunakan kemampuan psikisku!

entries.original:
"You see that man on the other
beach?

He’s my rival!"
entries.translation_source: You see that man on the other beach? He’s my rival!
entries.translated:
Kau lihat pria di pantai seberang
itu? Dia sainganku!

entries.original:
"We once fought together as the duo
named \qoThe Brain and the Brawn\qc."
entries.translation_source: We once fought together as the duo named [quote-open-1]The Brain and the Brawn[quote-close-2].
entries.translated:
Kami pernah bertarung bersama
sebagai duo yang bernama \qoOtak dan\lOtot\qc.

entries.original:
"Maybe someday I, the brawn, will
reunite with my old friend, the\lbrain."
entries.translation_source: Maybe someday I, the brawn, will reunite with my old friend, the brain.
entries.translated:
Mungkin suatu hari nanti aku, sang
otot, akan bersatu kembali dengan\lteman lamaku, sang otak.

entries.original:
"I trained with Tessy!

She taught me how to
climb Waterfalls!"
entries.translation_source: I trained with Tessy! She taught me how to climb Waterfalls!
entries.translated:
Aku berlatih dengan Tessy! Dia
mengajariku cara memanjat Air\lTerjun!

entries.original: "Those were the days\."
entries.translation_source: Those were the days[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Itulah masa-masa indah\.

entries.original:
"Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader
in East Borrius.

If you defeat her, your Pokémon
gain the skill to scale waterfalls."
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader in East Borrius. If you defeat her, your Pokémon gain the skill to scale waterfalls.
entries.translated:
Tessy adalah Pemimpin Gym tipe Air
di East Borrius. Jika kau\lmengalahkannya, Pokémonmu

mendapatkan kemampuan untuk
memanjat air terjun.

entries.original:
"Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader
in East Borrius.

If you defeat her, your Pokémon
gain the skill to scale waterfalls.

But you already knew that,
didn’t you?"
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader in East Borrius. If you defeat her, your Pokémon gain the skill to scale waterfalls. But you already knew that, didn’t you?
entries.translated:
Tessy adalah Pemimpin Gym tipe Air
di East Borrius. Jika kau\lmengalahkannya, Pokémonmu

mendapatkan kemampuan untuk
memanjat air terjun. Tapi kau sudah\ltahu itu, kan?

entries.original:
"It may not look it, but this spot
here is the best spot for fishing\lin all of Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: It may not look it, but this spot here is the best spot for fishing in all of Borrius!
entries.translated:
Mungkin tidak terlihat seperti itu,
tetapi tempat ini adalah tempat\lterbaik untuk memancing di seluruh

Borrius!

entries.original:
"Or at least, that’s what I tell
myself\."
entries.translation_source: Or at least, that’s what I tell myself[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Atau setidaknya, itulah yang
kukatakan pada diriku sendiri\.

entries.original:
"Both of my friends call me crazy
for standing all the way out here.

But what do they know?

They stare at each other outside
of Cinder Volcano all day\."
entries.translation_source: Both of my friends call me crazy for standing all the way out here. But what do they know? They stare at each other outside of Cinder Volcano all day[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kedua temanku menyebutku gila
karena berdiri di sini. Tapi apa\lyang mereka tahu? Mereka saling

menatap di luar Gunung Berapi
Cinder sepanjang hari\.

entries.original:
"Looks like I’ll need more than my
trusty Rod to become the Champion\lof Borrius\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like I’ll need more than my trusty Rod to become the Champion of Borrius[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku butuh lebih dari
Pancing andalanku untuk menjadi\lJuara Borrius\.

entries.original:
"Ptui!

Ugh, I hate sand, it’s coarse,
rough, and irritating.

And it gets everywhere!"
entries.translation_source: Ptui! Ugh, I hate sand, it’s coarse, rough, and irritating. And it gets everywhere!
entries.translated:
Ptui! Ugh, aku benci pasir, kasar,
kasar, dan menjengkelkan. Dan ada\ldi mana-mana!

entries.original: "Not like you, you’re soft\."
entries.translation_source: Not like you, you’re soft[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Tidak seperti dirimu, kamu lembut\.

entries.original:
"By hiding in sand all day, I’m
learning new techniques to defeat\lthe Elite Four!"
entries.translation_source: By hiding in sand all day, I’m learning new techniques to defeat the Elite Four!
entries.translated:
Dengan bersembunyi di pasir
sepanjang hari, aku mempelajari\lteknik baru untuk mengalahkan Elite

Four!

entries.original:
"Heading for Victory Road, eh?
Let me put a stop to those plans."
entries.translation_source: Heading for Victory Road, eh? Let me put a stop to those plans.
entries.translated:
Menuju ke Victory Road, ya? Biarkan
aku menghentikan rencana itu.

entries.original: "Hmph."
entries.translation_source: Hmph.
entries.translated: Hmph.

entries.original:
"Only I should be allowed to
challenge the Elite Four.

That’s right, me, and me alone!"
entries.translation_source: Only I should be allowed to challenge the Elite Four. That’s right, me, and me alone!
entries.translated:
Hanya aku yang boleh menantang
Elite Four. Betul, aku, dan hanya\laku!

entries.original:
"Victory Road is not for the faint
of heart.

Those who enter must overcome the
famed torturous\. ice puzzle\."
entries.translation_source: Victory Road is not for the faint of heart. Those who enter must overcome the famed torturous[game-token-1] ice puzzle[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Victory Road bukan untuk yang lemah
hati. Mereka yang masuk harus\lmengatasi menyiksa\. teka-teki es\.

entries.original:
"Like true royalty, you’ve done it!

You’ve defeated all of the Trainers
here on Route 18!

And as royalty, too, I’ve just got
to challenge you, myself!"
entries.translation_source: Like true royalty, you’ve done it! You’ve defeated all of the Trainers here on Route 18! And as royalty, too, I’ve just got to challenge you, myself!
entries.translated:
Seperti bangsawan sejati, kau
berhasil! Kau telah mengalahkan\lsemua Pelatih di sini di Rute 18!

Dan sebagai bangsawan juga, aku
harus menantangmu sendiri!

entries.original: "And the reward for your efforts is\."
entries.translation_source: And the reward for your efforts is[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Dan hadiah untuk usahamu adalah\.

entries.original:
"That is a Mega Stone for the
Pokémon known as [green]Sableye[red].

If you share a strong bond with
one, give it that, and your bond\lwill bounce back status attacks!"
entries.translation_source: That is a Mega Stone for the Pokémon known as [color-green-1]Sableye[color-red-2]. If you share a strong bond with one, give it that, and your bond will bounce back status attacks!
entries.translated:
Itu adalah Batu Mega untuk Pokémon
yang dikenal sebagai [green]Sableye[red]. Jika\lkamu memiliki ikatan kuat

dengannya, berikan itu, dan
ikatanmu akan memantulkan serangan\lstatus!

entries.original:
"I’m the queen of Route 18!

What does that mean?

Defeat all the Trainers on this
route to find out!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the queen of Route 18! What does that mean? Defeat all the Trainers on this route to find out!
entries.translated:
Aku ratu Rute 18! Apa artinya?
Kalahkan semua Pelatih di rute ini\luntuk mengetahuinya!

entries.original:
"This plateau marks the beginning of
the long climb up Victory Road to\lthe Pokémon League.

It is there where Trainers compete
against the Elite Four for a chance\lto become Borrius’ Champion.

Are you one of those Trainers?"
entries.translation_source: This plateau marks the beginning of the long climb up Victory Road to the Pokémon League. It is there where Trainers compete against the Elite Four for a chance to become Borrius’ Champion. Are you one of those Trainers?
entries.translated:
Dataran tinggi ini menandai awal
pendakian panjang menuju Victory\lRoad ke Liga Pokémon. Di sanalah

para Pelatih bertanding melawan
Elite Four untuk kesempatan menjadi\lJuara Borrius. Apakah kamu salah

satu dari Pelatih itu?

entries.original:
"Then my suspicions are confirmed\.

\.

Take these!"
entries.translation_source: Then my suspicions are confirmed[game-token-1] [game-token-2] Take these!
entries.translated:
Maka kecurigaanku terbukti\. \. Ambil
ini!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.
I am not usually wrong\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] I am not usually wrong[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Hmm\. Aku biasanya tidak salah\.

entries.original:
"The climb up to Victory Road is
long and arduous.

Those [green]Max Repels[blue] should keep the
wild Pokémon away while you climb."
entries.translation_source: The climb up to Victory Road is long and arduous. Those [color-green-1]Max Repels[color-blue-2] should keep the wild Pokémon away while you climb.
entries.translated:
Pendakian menuju Victory Road
panjang dan berat. [green]Max Repel[blue] itu\lakan menjauhkan Pokémon liar saat

kamu mendaki.

entries.original:
"Did ya know that money grows
on trees?"
entries.translation_source: Did ya know that money grows on trees?
entries.translated:
Apa kau tahu bahwa uang tumbuh di
pohon?

entries.original:
"Well, yer absolutely wrong!

I just picked this here money right
off this here tree!"
entries.translation_source: Well, yer absolutely wrong! I just picked this here money right off this here tree!
entries.translated:
Wah, kamu benar-benar salah! Aku
baru aja memetik uang ini langsung\ldari pohon ini!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received $[buffer1] from
the organic alchemist!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received $[buffer1-3] from the organic alchemist!
entries.translated:
[black][player] menerima $[buffer1] dari
alkemis organik!

entries.original:
"This here tree only grows money
once a day.

I know, inconvenient, amaright?"
entries.translation_source: This here tree only grows money once a day. I know, inconvenient, amaright?
entries.translated:
Pohon ini cuma menumbuhkan uang
sekali sehari. Aku tahu,\lmerepotkan, ya kan?

entries.original:
"Oh\.
Ya already knew\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] Ya already knew[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Ya, kamu sudah tahu\.

entries.original:
"Only those who have acquired all
eight of Borrius’ Gym Badges may\lpass through this point."
entries.translation_source: Only those who have acquired all eight of Borrius’ Gym Badges may pass through this point.
entries.translated:
Hanya mereka yang telah memperoleh
semua delapan Lencana Gym Borrius\lyang boleh melewati titik ini.

entries.original:
"\.

You may pass."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] You may pass.
entries.translated: \. Kamu boleh lewat.

entries.original:
"Past this point lies the entrance
to Victory Road.

It is the final hurdle Trainers
must overcome if they wish to\lchallenge the Elite Four for a\lchance to become Borrius’ Champion."
entries.translation_source: Past this point lies the entrance to Victory Road. It is the final hurdle Trainers must overcome if they wish to challenge the Elite Four for a chance to become Borrius’ Champion.
entries.translated:
Di luar titik ini terletak pintu
masuk ke Victory Road. Itu adalah\lrintangan terakhir yang harus

diatasi oleh Pelatih jika mereka
ingin menantang Elite Four untuk\lkesempatan menjadi Juara Borrius.

entries.original: "Hero of the Hall"
entries.translation_source: Hero of the Hall
entries.translated: Pahlawan Aula

entries.original:
"Become a grand Champion! Enter the
Hall of Fame with monotype teams."
entries.translation_source: Become a grand Champion! Enter the Hall of Fame with monotype teams.
entries.translated:
Jadilah Juara besar! Masuki
Hall of Fame dengan tim
monotype.

entries.original:
"Do you know about the
Hall of Fame?

It’s the place where you go if you
defeat the Pokémon League!

At one point, the old Champion,
Artie had been there so many times,\lhe decided to set a goal of going\lthere with every team consisting\lof a common type.

Sadly, he never did reach his goal,
and only ever entered with monotype\lteams for 17 out of the 18 types.

Maybe you want to take up the
challenge instead?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know about the Hall of Fame? It’s the place where you go if you defeat the Pokémon League! At one point, the old Champion, Artie had been there so many times, he decided to set a goal of going there with every team consisting of a common type. Sadly, he never did reach his goal, and only ever entered with monotype teams for 17 out of the 18 types. Maybe you want to take up the challenge instead?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu tahu tentang Hall of
Fame? Itu adalah tempat yang kamu\lkunjungi jika kamu mengalahkan

Pokémon League! Pada suatu waktu,
Juara lama, Artie sudah berada di\lsana berkali-kali, dia memutuskan

untuk menetapkan tujuan pergi ke
sana dengan setiap tim yang terdiri\ldari satu tipe. Sayangnya, dia

tidak pernah mencapai tujuannya,
dan hanya pernah masuk dengan tim\lmonotype untuk 17 dari 18 tipe.

Mungkin kamu ingin mengambil
tantangan itu sebagai gantinya?

entries.original:
"You’re taking up the challenge?
Sweet!

Bring on those victories!

There are [green]18[blue] types in total, and
you’ll need to enter the Hall of\lFame with teams for each one.

Oh, and keep this in mind: if you
Mega Evolve a Pokémon, both the\lbase species and Mega species will\lcount towards the team type.

So, let’s say you want to use a
Mega Gyarados.

In addition to a Water-type team,

A Youngster just isn’t the kind

You’ll be seeing me in the
Champion’s room someday!

I guarantee it!"

entries.translated:
Apa itu? Seorang Youngster bukanlah
tipe orang yang akan menantang\lPokémon League? Aku terima taruhan

itu! Suatu hari nanti kau akan
melihatku di ruang Champion! Aku\ljamin!

entries.original: "Route 2"
entries.translation_source: Route 2
entries.translated: Route 2

entries.original:
"You came down from the mountain?
You must be exhausted.

Let me take care of your Pokémon
for you."
entries.translation_source: You came down from the mountain? You must be exhausted. Let me take care of your Pokémon for you.
entries.translated:
Kau turun dari gunung? Kau pasti
kelelahan. Biarkan aku merawat\lPokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"If you’re in a hurry, the Psychic
over there can teleport you to\lDresco Town - the next town over.

Even if you decide to take him up
on his offer, it’s never a bad idea\lto be fully healed!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re in a hurry, the Psychic over there can teleport you to Dresco Town - the next town over. Even if you decide to take him up on his offer, it’s never a bad idea to be fully healed!
entries.translated:
Jika kau terburu-buru, Psychic di
sana bisa menteleportasimu ke\lDresco Town - kota berikutnya.

Bahkan jika kau memutuskan untuk
menerima tawarannya, tidak ada\lsalahnya untuk pulih sepenuhnya!

entries.original: "[green]Cleeeeewoo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Cleeeeewoo!
entries.translated: [green]Cleeeeewoo!

entries.original:
"Hey, kid!
Listen up.

The road up ahead is fraught with
Trainers wanting to battle.

Some people have even dubbed it
\qoChallenge Road\qc.

But hey, I understand if you don’t
want to battle them.

So, using my amazing psychic
powers, I can teleport you to the\lother side for free!

What do you say, are you in?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, kid! Listen up. The road up ahead is fraught with Trainers wanting to battle. Some people have even dubbed it [quote-open-1]Challenge Road[quote-close-2]. But hey, I understand if you don’t want to battle them. So, using my amazing psychic powers, I can teleport you to the other side for free! What do you say, are you in?
entries.translated:
Hei, nak! Dengarkan. Jalan di depan
penuh dengan Trainer yang ingin\lbertarung. Beberapa orang bahkan

menjulukinya \qoChallenge Road\qc. Tapi
hei, aku mengerti jika kau tidak\lingin bertarung dengan mereka.

Jadi, dengan kekuatan psikisku yang
luar biasa, aku bisa\lmenteleportasimu ke sisi lain

secara gratis! Bagaimana, kau mau?

entries.original:
"What do you say, should I teleport
you to Dresco Town?"
entries.translation_source: What do you say, should I teleport you to Dresco Town?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana menurutmu, haruskah aku
menteleportasimu ke Dresco Town?

entries.original:
"Here we go!

Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!"
entries.translation_source: Here we go! Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!
entries.translated:
Ayo kita mulai! Abra, Kadabra,
Reuniclus!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind let
me know."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind let me know.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berubah pikiran, beri
tahu aku.

entries.original:
"Listen, pal, you’re on Challenge
Road to train, yeah?"
entries.translation_source: Listen, pal, you’re on Challenge Road to train, yeah?
entries.translated:
Dengar, sobat, kamu di Challenge
Road untuk berlatih, kan?

entries.original: "Oh, my bad, just ignore me then."
entries.translation_source: Oh, my bad, just ignore me then.
entries.translated: Oh, salahku, abaikan saja aku.

entries.original:
"I thought so!

I can tell you’re a Trainer burning
with fiery passion.

Well, I have this Pokémon here.

It’d be perfect for a Trainer
like you.

Why don’t you defeat all of the
Trainers on Challenge Road and\lthen come back here?

I’ll give it to you then, so make
sure you have space in your party!"
entries.translation_source: I thought so! I can tell you’re a Trainer burning with fiery passion. Well, I have this Pokémon here. It’d be perfect for a Trainer like you. Why don’t you defeat all of the Trainers on Challenge Road and then come back here? I’ll give it to you then, so make sure you have space in your party!
entries.translated:
Aku pikir begitu! Aku bisa tahu
kamu adalah Pelatih yang\lbersemangat membara. Nah, aku punya

Pokémon ini di sini. Ini akan
sempurna untuk Pelatih sepertimu.\lBagaimana kalau kamu kalahkan semua

Pelatih di Challenge Road lalu
kembali ke sini? Aku akan\lmemberikannya padamu saat itu, jadi

pastikan kamu punya ruang di timmu!

entries.original:
"I thought so!

I can tell you’re a Trainer burning
with fiery passion.

Well, since you’ve defeated all of
the Trainers on this road, I’d say\lyou earned this Pokémon."

Aku pikir begitu! Aku bisa tahu
kamu adalah Pelatih yang\lbersemangat membara. Nah, karena

kamu telah mengalahkan semua
Pelatih di jalan ini, menurutku\lkamu pantas mendapatkan Pokémon

ini.

"But make space in your party for it
first, yeah?"

Tapi buat ruang di timmu untuknya
dulu, ya?

Jaga [buffer1] itu, ya? Jika kamu
merawatnya dengan baik, itu akan\lmenjaga semangat membaramu tetap

hidup, pasti!

before is doing great, yeah?"

entries.translated:
Oh, itu Pelatih yang bersemangat
membara! Aku yakin [buffer1] yang\lkuberikan sebelumnya baik-baik

saja, kan?

"[black]A mysterious ring is floating in

hole\.

deep in the hole?"

[black]Sebuah cincin misterius melayang di
udara. Sesuatu terlihat jauh di\ldalam lubang\. Apakah kamu ingin

lubang?

mana banyak Pelatih datang untuk\lberlatih.

"You’re taking up the challenge, eh?
I hope you healed up!"

entries.translated:
Kamu menerima tantangan ini, ya?
Semoga kamu sudah sembuh!

entries.original: "You’re decent."

That’s why it’s best to raise
Pokémon of different types."

Semua Pokémon memiliki kelemahan.
Bahkan yang terkuat sekalipun.\lItulah mengapa sebaiknya

membesarkan Pokémon dengan tipe
yang berbeda.

"Them [green]Yellow Poké Balls[blue] hold

[green]Poké Ball Kuning[blue] itu berisi barang
yang disebut Technical Machines. [green]TM[blue]\lini dapat digunakan untuk mengajari

Pokémonmu jurus sebanyak yang kamu
mau!

different categories?"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that moves can have different categories?
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu bahwa jurus bisa
memiliki kategori yang berbeda?

entries.original:
"These categories help determine
how your Pokémon uses its moves."
entries.translation_source: These categories help determine how your Pokémon uses its moves.
entries.translated:
Kategori-kategori ini membantu
menentukan bagaimana Pokémonmu\lmenggunakan jurusnya.

"A Pokémon’s moves can be physical
moves or special moves.

A high Attack stat makes physical
moves deal more damage, and a high\lSp. Atk stat makes special moves\ldeal more damage!"
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon’s moves can be physical moves or special moves. A high Attack stat makes physical moves deal more damage, and a high Sp. Atk stat makes special moves deal more damage!
entries.translated:
Jurus Pokémon bisa berupa jurus
fisik atau jurus spesial. Stat\lAttack yang tinggi membuat jurus

fisik memberikan lebih banyak
damage, dan stat Sp. Atk yang\ltinggi membuat jurus spesial

memberikan lebih banyak damage!

entries.original:
"Have you prepared your first two
Pokémon for this battle?"
entries.translation_source: Have you prepared your first two Pokémon for this battle?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu sudah menyiapkan dua
Pokémon pertamamu untuk pertempuran\lini?

entries.original:
"Drat!
Kelsey took up my second slot!"
entries.translation_source: Drat! Kelsey took up my second slot!
entries.translated: Drat! Kelsey mengisi slot keduaku!

"The Pokémon you send out in a
Double Battle will be the Pokémon\lin the top row of your Party List.

If one of those two Pokémon has
fainted, the second Pokémon to\lbe sent out will come from the\lsecond row and so on!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon you send out in a Double Battle will be the Pokémon in the top row of your Party List. If one of those two Pokémon has fainted, the second Pokémon to be sent out will come from the second row and so on!
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang kamu kirim dalam
Pertarungan Ganda adalah Pokémon di\lbaris teratas Daftar Tim-mu. Jika

salah satu dari dua Pokémon itu
pingsan, Pokémon kedua yang akan\ldikirim akan berasal dari baris

kedua, dan seterusnya!

entries.original:
"We’re a team!
We camp and battle together!

But we can’t battle you when you
only have one Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We’re a team! We camp and battle together! But we can’t battle you when you only have one Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kami satu tim! Kami berkemah dan
bertarung bersama! Tapi kami tidak\lbisa bertarung denganmu jika kamu

hanya memiliki satu Pokémon!

entries.original:
"We’re a team!
We battle and picnic together!"
entries.translation_source: We’re a team! We battle and picnic together!
entries.translated:
Kami satu tim! Kami bertarung dan
berpiknik bersama!

entries.original:
"As long as I lose with Chad, the
outcome doesn’t matter to me!"
entries.translation_source: As long as I lose with Chad, the outcome doesn’t matter to me!
entries.translated:
Selama aku kalah bersama Chad,
hasilnya tidak masalah bagiku!

entries.original:
"A Pokémon that’s [green]Paralyzed[red] is
slower and might not be able to\lattack."

entries.translated:
Pokémon yang [green]Lumpuh[red] akan lebih
lambat dan mungkin tidak bisa\lmenyerang.

entries.original:
"We’re a team!
We battle and picnic together!

But we can’t battle you when you
only have one Pokémon!"

entries.translated:
Kami satu tim! Kami bertarung dan
berpiknik bersama! Tapi kami tidak\lbisa bertarung denganmu jika kamu

hanya memiliki satu Pokémon!
