"Pokémon with the Ability [green]Keen Eye[red]
can’t have their accuracy lowered.

They also ignore all changes to an
opponent’s evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon with the Ability [color-green-1]Keen Eye[color-red-2] can’t have their accuracy lowered. They also ignore all changes to an opponent’s evasiveness.
entries.translated:
Pokémon dengan Ability [green]Mata Tajam[red]
tidak bisa diturunkan akurasinya.\lMereka juga mengabaikan semua

perubahan pada evasiveness lawan.

entries.original:
"How did this old Hiker get onto
this little piece of land?"
entries.translation_source: How did this old Hiker get onto this little piece of land?
entries.translated:
Bagaimana Pendaki tua ini bisa
sampai di sebidang tanah kecil ini?

entries.original: "I swam, of course!"
entries.translation_source: I swam, of course!
entries.translated: Aku berenang, tentu saja!

entries.original:
"In some other regions, you can
buy a Bicycle that lets you hop up\lledges or move across water.

Unfortunately, the best you can
hope for with Borrius Bikes is to\lspeed your way up slippery slopes."
entries.translation_source: In some other regions, you can buy a Bicycle that lets you hop up ledges or move across water. Unfortunately, the best you can hope for with Borrius Bikes is to speed your way up slippery slopes.
entries.translated:
Di beberapa wilayah lain, kamu bisa
membeli Sepeda yang memungkinkanmu\lmelompati tebing atau bergerak di

air. Sayangnya, yang terbaik yang
bisa kamu harapkan dari Sepeda\lBorrius adalah melaju cepat menaiki

lereng licin.

entries.original:
"We are the Crush Kin of Route 2!

We want to fight only the strongest
of Trainers!

If you defeat all of the Trainers
on Route 2 and Route 15, we will\lrecognize your strength, and then\lbattle you!"
entries.translation_source: We are the Crush Kin of Route 2! We want to fight only the strongest of Trainers! If you defeat all of the Trainers on Route 2 and Route 15, we will recognize your strength, and then battle you!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin dari Route 2!
Kami hanya ingin bertarung melawan\lPelatih terkuat! Jika kamu

mengalahkan semua Pelatih di Route
2 dan Route 15, kami akan mengakui\lkekuatanmu, lalu bertarung

denganmu!

entries.original:
"We are the Crush Kin of Route 2!

We want to fight only the strongest
of Trainers!

Show us what you’re made of!"
entries.translation_source: We are the Crush Kin of Route 2! We want to fight only the strongest of Trainers! Show us what you’re made of!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin dari Route 2!
Kami hanya ingin bertarung melawan\lPelatih terkuat! Tunjukkan apa yang

kau punya!

entries.original: "You have proven your strength!"
entries.translation_source: You have proven your strength!
entries.translated: Kau telah membuktikan kekuatanmu!

entries.original:
"The strongest of Trainers deserve
items like this!"
entries.translation_source: The strongest of Trainers deserve items like this!
entries.translated:
Pelatih terkuat layak mendapatkan
item seperti ini!

entries.original:
"That Mega Stone is for [green]Lopunny[blue]!

When it Mega Evolves, it embraces
its true nature and becomes part\lFighting-type!"
entries.translation_source: That Mega Stone is for [color-green-1]Lopunny[color-blue-2]! When it Mega Evolves, it embraces its true nature and becomes part Fighting-type!
entries.translated:
Batu Mega itu untuk [green]Lopunny[blue]! Saat
Mega Berevolusi, ia merangkul sifat\laslinya dan menjadi bagian tipe

Petarung!

entries.original:
"We are the Crush Kin of Route 2!

We want to fight only the strongest
of Trainers!

And the strongest of Trainers have
at least two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We are the Crush Kin of Route 2! We want to fight only the strongest of Trainers! And the strongest of Trainers have at least two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin dari Route 2!
Kami hanya ingin bertarung melawan\lPelatih terkuat! Dan Pelatih

terkuat memiliki setidaknya dua
Pokémon!

entries.original:
"We’re the Crush Kin that dominates
Route 2!

We only fight the best of Trainers!

If you can beat all of the Trainers
on Route 2 and Route 15, we’ll\lchallenge you!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Crush Kin that dominates Route 2! We only fight the best of Trainers! If you can beat all of the Trainers on Route 2 and Route 15, we’ll challenge you!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin yang
mendominasi Route 2! Kami hanya\lbertarung melawan yang terbaik dari

para Pelatih! Jika kamu bisa
mengalahkan semua Pelatih di Route\l2 dan Route 15, kami akan

menantangmu!

entries.original:
"We’re the Crush Kin that dominates
Route 2!

We only fight the best of Trainers!

Show us what you’re made of!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Crush Kin that dominates Route 2! We only fight the best of Trainers! Show us what you’re made of!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin yang
mendominasi Route 2! Kami hanya\lbertarung melawan yang terbaik dari

para Pelatih! Tunjukkan apa yang
kau punya!

entries.original: "You’ve shown that you’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve shown that you’re the best!
entries.translated:
Kau telah menunjukkan bahwa kaulah
yang terbaik!

entries.original:
"The best of Trainers deserve
items like this!"
entries.translation_source: The best of Trainers deserve items like this!
entries.translated:
Pelatih terbaik layak mendapatkan
item seperti ini!

entries.original:
"Give that Mega Stone to [green]Lopunny[red]!

If you Mega Evolve it, it’ll
embrace its true nature and\lFighting-type power!"
entries.translation_source: Give that Mega Stone to [color-green-1]Lopunny[color-red-2]! If you Mega Evolve it, it’ll embrace its true nature and Fighting-type power!
entries.translated:
Berikan Batu Mega itu kepada
[green]Lopunny[red]! Jika kamu Mega Evolusi, ia\lakan merangkul sifat aslinya dan

kekuatan tipe Petarung!

entries.original:
"We’re the Crush Kin that dominates
Route 2!

We only fight the best of Trainers!

And the best of Trainers have
at least two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Crush Kin that dominates Route 2! We only fight the best of Trainers! And the best of Trainers have at least two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Crush Kin yang
mendominasi Rute 2! Kami hanya\lbertarung melawan Pelatih terbaik!

Dan Pelatih terbaik memiliki
setidaknya dua Pokémon!

entries.original: "Route 3"
entries.translation_source: Route 3
entries.translated: Rute 3

entries.original:
"[black]The sand castle came alive
and attacked!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The sand castle came alive and attacked!
entries.translated:
[black]Kastil pasir itu hidup dan
menyerang!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] receded into
the sand."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] receded into the sand.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] mundur ke dalam pasir.

entries.original:
"Do you prefer to avoid Trainers by
cutting through the tall grass?

The fact that you battled me means
you don’t!"
entries.translation_source: Do you prefer to avoid Trainers by cutting through the tall grass? The fact that you battled me means you don’t!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu lebih suka menghindari
Pelatih dengan memotong rumput\ltinggi? Fakta bahwa kamu bertarung

denganku berarti kamu tidak!

entries.original:
"It’s time for a grassy battle on a
grassy island!"
entries.translation_source: It’s time for a grassy battle on a grassy island!
entries.translated:
Saatnya untuk pertarungan berumput
di pulau berumput!

entries.original: "A grassy defeat!"
entries.translation_source: A grassy defeat!
entries.translated: Kekalahan berumput!

entries.original:
"Please don’t Cut the grass on
this island.

If you do, it won’t be a grassy
island anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Please don’t Cut the grass on this island. If you do, it won’t be a grassy island anymore!
entries.translated:
Tolong jangan Potong rumput di
pulau ini. Jika kamu melakukannya,\lpulau ini tidak akan menjadi pulau

berumput lagi!

entries.original:
"I wish I could live just by
inhaling the fresh air.

It smells good, so it must be
tasty, too, right?"
entries.translation_source: I wish I could live just by inhaling the fresh air. It smells good, so it must be tasty, too, right?
entries.translated:
Aku berharap bisa hidup hanya
dengan menghirup udara segar.\lBaunya enak, jadi pasti enak juga,

kan?

entries.original: "I love running around on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: I love running around on the beach!
entries.translated: Aku suka berlarian di pantai!

entries.original: "Oh no, you beat me!"
entries.translation_source: Oh no, you beat me!
entries.translated: Oh tidak, kamu mengalahkanku!

entries.original:
"No matter how many times I lose,
nothing will stop me from running\laround on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how many times I lose, nothing will stop me from running around on the beach!
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli berapa kali aku kalah,
tidak ada yang akan menghentikanku\luntuk berlarian di pantai!

entries.original:
"Fishing by the coast whilst
reminiscing about my past is\lalways pleasurable."
entries.translation_source: Fishing by the coast whilst reminiscing about my past is always pleasurable.
entries.translated:
Memancing di tepi pantai sambil
mengenang masa laluku selalu\lmenyenangkan.

entries.original:
"Did I become a fisherman because I
am patient, or did fishing make\lme patient?

That is the question."
entries.translation_source: Did I become a fisherman because I am patient, or did fishing make me patient? That is the question.
entries.translated:
Apakah aku menjadi nelayan karena
aku sabar, atau memancing membuatku\lsabar? Itulah pertanyaannya.

entries.original:
"Battling with you was a true test
of patience!"
entries.translation_source: Battling with you was a true test of patience!
entries.translated:
Bertarung denganmu adalah ujian
kesabaran yang sesungguhnya!

entries.original: "Patience is a virtue not many have."
entries.translation_source: Patience is a virtue not many have.
entries.translated:
Kesabaran adalah kebajikan yang
tidak dimiliki banyak orang.

entries.original:
"If you hook the same Pokémon many
times in a row, odds are you’ll\lencounter one that looks different\lthan other Pokémon of its species."
entries.translation_source: If you hook the same Pokémon many times in a row, odds are you’ll encounter one that looks different than other Pokémon of its species.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu mengait Pokémon yang sama
berkali-kali berturut-turut,\lkemungkinan besar kamu akan

menemukan yang terlihat berbeda
dari Pokémon lain dari spesiesnya.

entries.original:
"Your lead Pokémon is a key
ingredient in fishing."
entries.translation_source: Your lead Pokémon is a key ingredient in fishing.
entries.translated:
Pokémon pemimpinmu adalah bahan
utama dalam memancing.

entries.original:
"My lead was great for fishing, but
not so much for battling!"
entries.translation_source: My lead was great for fishing, but not so much for battling!
entries.translated:
Pokémon pertama saya bagus untuk
memancing, tapi tidak terlalu bagus\luntuk bertarung!

entries.original:
"If your lead Pokémon has the
ability [green]Suction Cups[blue] or [green]Sticky\lHold[blue], it’ll be much easier for you\lto land a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: If your lead Pokémon has the ability [color-green-1]Suction Cups[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Sticky Hold[color-blue-4], it’ll be much easier for you to land a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Jika Pokémon pertama Anda memiliki
kemampuan [green]Cangkir Hisap[blue] atau\l[green]Cengkeraman Lengket[blue], akan lebih

mudah bagi Anda untuk menangkap
Pokémon.

entries.original: "Route 4"
entries.translation_source: Route 4
entries.translated: Rute 4

entries.original: "Route 4 - 5"
entries.translation_source: Route 4 - 5

entries.original:
"Go away, bozo.
Can’t you see we’re thinkin’ here?"
entries.translation_source: Go away, bozo. Can’t you see we’re thinkin’ here?
entries.translated:
Pergi, dasar bodoh. Tidak lihat
kami sedang berpikir?

entries.original:
"Go away, bozo.
Can’t you see we’re plottin’ here?"
entries.translation_source: Go away, bozo. Can’t you see we’re plottin’ here?
entries.translated:
Pergi, dasar bodoh. Tidak lihat
kami sedang merencanakan sesuatu?

entries.original: "Here, take some Potions."
entries.translation_source: Here, take some Potions.
entries.translated: Ini, ambil beberapa Potion.

entries.original:
"Cinder Volcano is dangerous, and
temperatures are extreme.

If you don’t have your Pokémon to
protect you, you could faint."
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano is dangerous, and temperatures are extreme. If you don’t have your Pokémon to protect you, you could faint.
entries.translated:
Gunung Api Cinder berbahaya, dan
suhunya ekstrem. Jika Anda tidak\lmemiliki Pokémon untuk melindungi

Anda, Anda bisa pingsan.

entries.original:
"Hi there, Trainer!

If you can beat me, I’ll heal your
Pokémon for free!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, Trainer! If you can beat me, I’ll heal your Pokémon for free!
entries.translated:
Halo, Pelatih! Jika Anda bisa
mengalahkan saya, saya akan\lmemulihkan Pokémon Anda secara

gratis!

entries.original: "Healing time!"
entries.translation_source: Healing time!
entries.translated: Waktu pemulihan!

entries.original: "Time to heal up!"
entries.translation_source: Time to heal up!
entries.translated: Saatnya memulihkan diri!

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated: Siap! Tetap aman di luar sana!

entries.original:
"That ledge will take you right back
to Dresco Town!

I’d think carefully about using it,
though.

Once you hop it, the only way back
here is through Grim Woods!"
entries.translation_source: That ledge will take you right back to Dresco Town! I’d think carefully about using it, though. Once you hop it, the only way back here is through Grim Woods!
entries.translated:
Tebing itu akan membawa Anda
kembali ke Dresco Town! Tapi\lpikirkan baik-baik sebelum

menggunakannya. Setelah Anda
melompat, satu-satunya jalan\lkembali ke sini adalah melalui Grim

Woods!

entries.original:
"\.

Go away."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] Go away.
entries.translated: \. Pergi.

entries.original: "[black]Ride on Lapras?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Ride on Lapras?
entries.translated: [black]Naik Lapras?

entries.original: "[green]Prassss!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Prassss!
entries.translated: [green]Prassss!

entries.original:
"Does battling this high up make
you feel\. elated?"
entries.translation_source: Does battling this high up make you feel[game-token-1] elated?
entries.translated:
Apakah bertarung di ketinggian ini
membuatmu merasa\. gembira?

entries.original:
"Maybe I’ve been spending too much
time in the Dresco Town Gym."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I’ve been spending too much time in the Dresco Town Gym.
entries.translated:
Mungkin saya sudah terlalu banyak
menghabiskan waktu di Dresco Town\lGym.

entries.original:
"Mirskle has had a huge impact on
the way I live my life.

Most people say he’s a bad
influence on children, but I\lcouldn’t be happier!"
entries.translation_source: Mirskle has had a huge impact on the way I live my life. Most people say he’s a bad influence on children, but I couldn’t be happier!
entries.translated:
Mirskle memiliki dampak besar pada
cara saya menjalani hidup.\lKebanyakan orang mengatakan dia

adalah pengaruh buruk bagi
anak-anak, tapi saya tidak bisa\llebih bahagia!

entries.original:
"I’ll catch something good
eventually.

You just go have fun."
entries.translation_source: I’ll catch something good eventually. You just go have fun.
entries.translated:
Saya akan menangkap sesuatu yang
bagus pada akhirnya. Kamu pergi\lbersenang-senang saja.

entries.original:
"You see that guy up there?
He’s been fishing there for days."
entries.translation_source: You see that guy up there? He’s been fishing there for days.
entries.translated:
Kamu lihat orang itu di atas? Dia
sudah memancing di sana selama\lberhari-hari.

entries.original:
"It looks like I lost.
I should catch a better haul."
entries.translation_source: It looks like I lost. I should catch a better haul.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku kalah. Aku harus
menangkap tangkapan yang lebih\lbaik.

entries.original:
"To be honest, I’ve been here for
days, too."
entries.translation_source: To be honest, I’ve been here for days, too.
entries.translated:
Sejujurnya, aku juga sudah di sini
selama berhari-hari.

entries.original: "Route 5"
entries.translation_source: Route 5
entries.translated: Rute 5

entries.original:
"Whew\. I better take a rest\.

Groan\.

That volcano takes a lot out
of you!

Let me heal your Pokémon so you
don’t get tired like me."
entries.translation_source: Whew[game-token-1] I better take a rest[game-token-2] Groan[game-token-3] That volcano takes a lot out of you! Let me heal your Pokémon so you don’t get tired like me.
entries.translated:
Whew\. Sebaiknya aku beristirahat\.
Aduh\. Gunung berapi itu sangat\lmelelahkan! Biarkan aku

menyembuhkan Pokémonmu agar kamu
tidak lelah sepertiku.

entries.original: "Take care of yourself."
entries.translation_source: Take care of yourself.
entries.translated: Jaga dirimu baik-baik.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer.

I moved here recently with my three
Pokémon from the Unova region.

I’ve been raising them on my own up
until this point, but lately,\lthey’ve been craving adventure.

I don’t really want to leave my
home, so I’ve been searching for\lsomeone to take them off my hands.

How would you like to take care of
one for me?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer. I moved here recently with my three Pokémon from the Unova region. I’ve been raising them on my own up until this point, but lately, they’ve been craving adventure. I don’t really want to leave my home, so I’ve been searching for someone to take them off my hands. How would you like to take care of one for me?
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, Pelatih Borrius. Aku baru
saja pindah ke sini bersama tiga\lPokémonku dari wilayah Unova. Aku

telah merawat mereka sendiri sampai
saat ini, tetapi akhir-akhir ini\lmereka mendambakan petualangan. Aku

tidak benar-benar ingin
meninggalkan rumahku, jadi aku\ltelah mencari seseorang untuk

mengambil alih mereka. Bagaimana
jika kamu merawat salah satunya\luntukku?

entries.original:
"Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer.

Which adventurous Pokémon will
you take now?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer. Which adventurous Pokémon will you take now?
entries.translated:
Oh, halo, Pelatih Borrius. Pokémon
petualang mana yang akan kamu ambil\lsekarang?

entries.original: "You’d like [buffer1][red]?"
entries.translation_source: You’d like [buffer1-1][color-red-2]?
entries.translated: Kamu ingin [buffer1][red]?

entries.original: "Which one will you take?"
entries.translation_source: Which one will you take?
entries.translated: Yang mana yang akan kamu ambil?

entries.original:
"Oh, okay then.

I guess I’ll have to keep searching
for a Trainer."
entries.translation_source: Oh, okay then. I guess I’ll have to keep searching for a Trainer.
entries.translated:
Oh, baiklah kalau begitu.
Sepertinya aku harus terus mencari\lPelatih.

entries.original:
"I have adventurous Pokémon to give
away, but you can’t do anything\lwith a full party of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I have adventurous Pokémon to give away, but you can’t do anything with a full party of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Aku punya Pokémon petualang untuk
diberikan, tetapi kamu tidak bisa\lmelakukan apa pun dengan tim

Pokémon yang penuh.

entries.original:
"When you have at least [green][buffer1] Badges[red],
come back so I can give you more!"
entries.translation_source: When you have at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2] Badges[color-red-3], come back so I can give you more!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu memiliki setidaknya
[green][buffer1] Lencana[red], kembalilah agar\laku bisa memberimu lebih banyak!

entries.original:
"Hello again!

How are my old friends doing?"
entries.translation_source: Hello again! How are my old friends doing?
entries.translated:
Halo lagi! Bagaimana kabar
teman-teman lamaku?

entries.original: "[green]Snivy"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Snivy

entries.original: "[lightgreen]Tepig"
entries.translation_source: [color-lightgreen-1]Tepig

entries.original: "[blue]Oshawott"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oshawott

entries.original: "Leg Day"
entries.translation_source: Leg Day
entries.translated: Hari Kaki

entries.original:
"It’s leg day! Walk [buffer1] steps to
work out those calves."
entries.translation_source: It’s leg day! Walk [buffer1-1] steps to work out those calves.
entries.translated:
Ini hari kaki! Jalan [buffer1]
langkah untuk melatih betis
itu.

entries.original:
"Today is leg day.

It’s the most important day of
the week.

Some people skip leg day, but those
people are wrong.

Walking is the best way to work
out your legs.

If you walk enough, I will give you
a reward in celebration of leg day."
entries.translation_source: Today is leg day. It’s the most important day of the week. Some people skip leg day, but those people are wrong. Walking is the best way to work out your legs. If you walk enough, I will give you a reward in celebration of leg day.
entries.translated:
Hari ini adalah hari kaki. Ini
adalah hari terpenting dalam\lseminggu. Beberapa orang melewatkan

hari kaki, tetapi orang-orang itu
salah. Berjalan adalah cara terbaik\luntuk melatih kakimu. Jika kamu

berjalan cukup, aku akan memberimu
hadiah sebagai perayaan hari kaki.

entries.original:
"Awesome!

Now walk at least [green][buffer1][blue] steps to
really work those calves."
entries.translation_source: Awesome! Now walk at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] steps to really work those calves.
entries.translated:
Hebat! Sekarang jalan setidaknya
[green][buffer1][blue] langkah untuk benar-benar\lmelatih betis itu.

entries.original:
"Okay, then go back to the gym and
lift some dumbbells, flabby calves!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, then go back to the gym and lift some dumbbells, flabby calves!
entries.translated:
Oke, kalau begitu kembali ke gym
dan angkat beberapa dumbel, betis\llembek!

entries.original:
"You still have [green][buffer3][blue] step\\08 to go
before reaching [green][buffer1][blue].

Come on now, feel the burn!"
entries.translation_source: You still have [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3] step[raw-escape-4] to go before reaching [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-blue-7]. Come on now, feel the burn!
entries.translated:
Kamu masih memiliki [green][buffer3][blue]
langkah\\08 lagi sebelum mencapai\l[green][buffer1][blue]. Ayo sekarang, rasakan

panasnya!

entries.original:
"Whoa, I’m sure your legs are tired
after that workout.

Here, take this small snack to heal
your muscles."
entries.translation_source: Whoa, I’m sure your legs are tired after that workout. Here, take this small snack to heal your muscles.
entries.translated:
Wah, aku yakin kakimu lelah setelah
latihan itu. Ini, ambil camilan\lkecil ini untuk memulihkan ototmu.

entries.original:
"Leg day should really be a
national holiday."
entries.translation_source: Leg day should really be a national holiday.
entries.translated:
Hari latihan kaki seharusnya
benar-benar menjadi hari libur\lnasional.

entries.original:
"Are we in a forest or on a route?
I can’t tell!"
entries.translation_source: Are we in a forest or on a route? I can’t tell!
entries.translated:
Apakah kita di hutan atau di rute?
Aku tidak tahu!

entries.original: "You tricked me!"
entries.translation_source: You tricked me!
entries.translated: Kau menipuku!

entries.original:
"There are too many trees for this
to be a route.

We must be in a forest!

It’s times like these I wish I had
a Town Map\."
entries.translation_source: There are too many trees for this to be a route. We must be in a forest! It’s times like these I wish I had a Town Map[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Terlalu banyak pohon untuk ini
menjadi rute. Kita pasti di hutan!\lSaat seperti ini aku berharap punya

Peta Kota\.

entries.original:
"Why does that guy keep looking
at me like that?"
entries.translation_source: Why does that guy keep looking at me like that?
entries.translated:
Kenapa pria itu terus menatapku
seperti itu?

entries.original:
"I just picked up my Pokémon from
the Day Care.

They’re raring to go!"
entries.translation_source: I just picked up my Pokémon from the Day Care. They’re raring to go!
entries.translated:
Aku baru saja menjemput Pokémon-ku
dari Day Care. Mereka sangat\lbersemangat!

entries.original:
"Raring to go\.
More like medium rare!"
entries.translation_source: Raring to go[game-token-1] More like medium rare!
entries.translated:
Bersemangat\. Lebih seperti setengah
matang!

entries.original:
"Pokémon left in the Day Care get
stronger as you travel."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon left in the Day Care get stronger as you travel.
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang ditinggalkan di Day
Care menjadi lebih kuat saat kamu\lbepergian.

entries.original:
"Keep an eye out for dark patches
between trees.

Those indicate that there is a
hidden pathway there."
entries.translation_source: Keep an eye out for dark patches between trees. Those indicate that there is a hidden pathway there.
entries.translated:
Perhatikan bercak gelap di antara
pepohonan. Itu menandakan ada jalan\ltersembunyi di sana.

entries.original:
"Sometimes my shorts cause chafing
while I run, but for the most part,\lthey’re delightfully comfy and\leasy to wear!"
entries.translation_source: Sometimes my shorts cause chafing while I run, but for the most part, they’re delightfully comfy and easy to wear!
entries.translated:
Kadang celana pendekku menyebabkan
lecet saat aku berlari, tetapi\lsebagian besar, celana itu sangat

nyaman dan mudah dipakai!

entries.original:
"Ow!
My legs are chafing!"
entries.translation_source: Ow! My legs are chafing!
entries.translated: Aduh! Kakiku lecet!

entries.original:
"Do you know about [green]Terrains[blue]?

For the most part, they’re special
battlefield effects that boost the\lpower of certain moves used by\lPokémon on the ground."
entries.translation_source: Do you know about [color-green-1]Terrains[color-blue-2]? For the most part, they’re special battlefield effects that boost the power of certain moves used by Pokémon on the ground.
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu tentang [green]Medan[blue]?
Sebagian besar, itu adalah efek\lmedan pertempuran khusus yang

meningkatkan kekuatan gerakan
tertentu yang digunakan oleh\lPokémon di tanah.

entries.original:
"Whenever I hear a Trainer run by,
I immediately look and catch them!

It’s those silent Trainers who walk
by that give me difficulty\."
entries.translation_source: Whenever I hear a Trainer run by, I immediately look and catch them! It’s those silent Trainers who walk by that give me difficulty[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Setiap kali aku mendengar seorang
Pelatih berlari lewat, aku segera\lmelihat dan menangkap mereka!

Pelatih yang diam-diam berjalan
lewat itulah yang menyulitkanku\.

entries.original:
"Is your nature a match for mine?

Let’s synchronize in a beautiful
battle to find out!"
entries.translation_source: Is your nature a match for mine? Let’s synchronize in a beautiful battle to find out!
entries.translated:
Apakah sifatmu cocok dengan
sifatku? Mari kita sinkronisasi\ldalam pertempuran yang indah untuk

mengetahuinya!

entries.original:
"Even though Kirlia had Synchronize,
turns out you’re not my type\."
entries.translation_source: Even though Kirlia had Synchronize, turns out you’re not my type[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Meskipun Kirlia memiliki
Sinkronisasi, ternyata kamu bukan\ltipeku\.

entries.original:
"When a Pokémon with [green]Synchronize[red]
leads the party, all Pokémon you\lfind will have the same [green]nature[red] as it!"
entries.translation_source: When a Pokémon with [color-green-1]Synchronize[color-red-2] leads the party, all Pokémon you find will have the same [color-green-3]nature[color-red-4] as it!
entries.translated:
Ketika Pokémon dengan [green]Sinkronisasi[red]
memimpin party, semua Pokémon yang\lkamu temukan akan memiliki [green]sifat[red]

yang sama dengannya!

entries.original:
"There is no room in my heart for
anything but my bugs.

Say, do you also notice a bug
hiding in that girl’s hair?"
entries.translation_source: There is no room in my heart for anything but my bugs. Say, do you also notice a bug hiding in that girl’s hair?
entries.translated:
Tidak ada ruang di hatiku untuk apa
pun selain seranggaku. Hei, apakah\lkamu juga melihat serangga

bersembunyi di rambut gadis itu?

entries.original: "Route 6"
entries.translation_source: Route 6
entries.translated: Rute 6

entries.original: "Route 6 - 7"
entries.translation_source: Route 6 - 7

entries.original:
"Two bridges\.

If you beat me, I’ll tell you which
one gets you to the next route!"
entries.translation_source: Two bridges[game-token-1] If you beat me, I’ll tell you which one gets you to the next route!
entries.translated:
Dua jembatan\. Jika kamu
mengalahkanku, aku akan memberitahu\ljembatan mana yang membawamu ke

rute berikutnya!

entries.original: "I guess I have to tell you now."
entries.translation_source: I guess I have to tell you now.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku harus memberitahumu
sekarang.

entries.original:
"The fact that you battled me means
you’re going the right way."
entries.translation_source: The fact that you battled me means you’re going the right way.
entries.translated:
Fakta bahwa kamu bertarung
melawanku berarti kamu berada di\ljalan yang benar.

entries.original:
"Unless you can Surf, going this
way just leads to a dead end."
entries.translation_source: Unless you can Surf, going this way just leads to a dead end.
entries.translated:
Kecuali kamu bisa menggunakan Surf,
jalan ini hanya akan menemui jalan\lbuntu.

entries.original:
"This is the only Route where a
Pokémon that appears at night\lwill also appear in the early\lmorning!"
entries.translation_source: This is the only Route where a Pokémon that appears at night will also appear in the early morning!
entries.translated:
Ini adalah satu-satunya Rute di
mana Pokémon yang muncul di malam\lhari juga akan muncul di pagi hari!

entries.original:
"If you wake up really early,
you’ll hear Kricketot cries!"
entries.translation_source: If you wake up really early, you’ll hear Kricketot cries!
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bangun pagi-pagi sekali,
kamu akan mendengar suara\lKricketot!

entries.original:
"Kricketot must stay awake longer
than other nocturnal Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Kricketot must stay awake longer than other nocturnal Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kricketot harus tetap terjaga lebih
lama dari Pokémon nokturnal\llainnya.

entries.original:
"Like bird Pokémon, bug Pokémon
generally change when the sun sets."
entries.translation_source: Like bird Pokémon, bug Pokémon generally change when the sun sets.
entries.translated:
Seperti Pokémon burung, Pokémon
serangga umumnya berubah saat\lmatahari terbenam.

entries.original:
"When Smeargle swarm, they swarm
on this very route!"
entries.translation_source: When Smeargle swarm, they swarm on this very route!
entries.translated:
Saat Smeargle mengerumuni, mereka
mengerumuni di rute ini juga!

entries.original:
"I may have caught Smeargle here,
but I taught it moves elsewhere!"
entries.translation_source: I may have caught Smeargle here, but I taught it moves elsewhere!
entries.translated:
Aku mungkin menangkap Smeargle di
sini, tapi aku mengajarinya jurus\ldi tempat lain!

entries.original:
"My Smeargle learned its moves from
the Pokémon atop Frost Mountain.

Except for Spore.

That it learned from a Shroomish
on Route 9."
entries.translation_source: My Smeargle learned its moves from the Pokémon atop Frost Mountain. Except for Spore. That it learned from a Shroomish on Route 9.
entries.translated:
Smeargle-ku belajar jurusnya dari
Pokémon di puncak Frost Mountain.\lKecuali Spore. Itu dia pelajari

dari Shroomish di Route 9.

entries.original:
"Before letting your Pokémon hold a
[green]Figy Berry[blue], make sure it doesn’t\lhave a conflicting [green]Nature[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Before letting your Pokémon hold a [color-green-1]Figy Berry[color-blue-2], make sure it doesn’t have a conflicting [color-green-3]Nature[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Sebelum membiarkan Pokémon-mu
memegang [green]Figy Berry[blue], pastikan ia\ltidak memiliki [green]Nature[blue] yang

bertentangan.

entries.original:
"We’re the Sun Trio!

Beat us three to win a fantastic
prize!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Sun Trio! Beat us three to win a fantastic prize!
entries.translated:
Kami adalah Sun Trio! Kalahkan kami
bertiga untuk memenangkan hadiah\lfantastis!

entries.original: "One down, two to go!"
entries.translation_source: One down, two to go!
entries.translated: Satu selesai, dua lagi!

entries.original:
"I’m the newest member of the
Sun Trio.

That’s why they have me stand
at the back."
entries.translation_source: I’m the newest member of the Sun Trio. That’s why they have me stand at the back.
entries.translated:
Aku anggota terbaru dari Sun Trio.
Itulah kenapa mereka menyuruhku\lberdiri di belakang.

entries.original:
"If the sun ever were to stop
shining, we’d all freeze solid!

But if it were to ever get any
hotter, we’d roast!

It’s amazing that the ball of fire
in the sky keeping us alive could\lalso end all life in an instant."
entries.translation_source: If the sun ever were to stop shining, we’d all freeze solid! But if it were to ever get any hotter, we’d roast! It’s amazing that the ball of fire in the sky keeping us alive could also end all life in an instant.
entries.translated:
Jika matahari berhenti bersinar,
kita semua akan membeku! Tapi jika\lsemakin panas, kita akan hangus!

Sungguh menakjubkan bahwa bola api
di langit yang menjaga kita tetap\lhidup juga bisa mengakhiri semua

kehidupan dalam sekejap.

entries.original:
"Beating those two members of the
Sun Trio is no easy feat!

\.Actually, I’m just kidding,
they’re both weak.

I’m weak too, and that’s what
makes us the Sun Trio!

But even though I’m weak, I’m not
just going to hand over the prize!

You also have to beat me, no matter
how weak I may be!

The third member of the Sun Trio\.
Coming at you!"
entries.translation_source: Beating those two members of the Sun Trio is no easy feat! [game-token-1]Actually, I’m just kidding, they’re both weak. I’m weak too, and that’s what makes us the Sun Trio! But even though I’m weak, I’m not just going to hand over the prize! You also have to beat me, no matter how weak I may be! The third member of the Sun Trio[game-token-2] Coming at you!
entries.translated:
Mengalahkan dua anggota Sun Trio
itu bukanlah prestasi mudah!\l\.Sebenarnya, aku hanya bercanda,

mereka berdua lemah. Aku juga
lemah, dan itulah yang membuat kami\lmenjadi Sun Trio! Tapi meskipun aku

lemah, aku tidak akan begitu saja
menyerahkan hadiahnya! Kamu juga\lharus mengalahkanku, tidak peduli

selemah apa pun aku! Anggota ketiga
Sun Trio\. Akan datang padamu!

entries.original:
"Even though I knew I’d lose going
into it, that’s what made it fun!"
entries.translation_source: Even though I knew I’d lose going into it, that’s what made it fun!
entries.translated:
Meskipun aku tahu aku akan kalah
saat melakukannya, itulah yang\lmembuatnya menyenangkan!

entries.original: "And for your prize, it’s a\."
entries.translation_source: And for your prize, it’s a[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Dan untuk hadiahmu, ini adalah\.

entries.original:
"We love the sun!

Day or night, our source of light
is always because of the sun!"
entries.translation_source: We love the sun! Day or night, our source of light is always because of the sun!
entries.translated:
Kami cinta matahari! Siang atau
malam, sumber cahaya kami selalu\lkarena matahari!

entries.original:
"Arright, boys!

I know times have been tough ever
since those Ferrothorns kicked us\lout of Antisis.

But soon we’re gonna head on over
to Route 10 and start fresh!

We’re gonna make it our new base,
and any Trainers wantin’ to pass\lthrough are gonna have to pay a\lpretty toll!

Hahaha!"
entries.translation_source: Arright, boys! I know times have been tough ever since those Ferrothorns kicked us out of Antisis. But soon we’re gonna head on over to Route 10 and start fresh! We’re gonna make it our new base, and any Trainers wantin’ to pass through are gonna have to pay a pretty toll! Hahaha!
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kawan-kawan! Aku tahu
masa-masa sulit sejak Ferrothorn\litu mengusir kita dari Antisis.

Tapi segera kita akan pergi ke
Route 10 dan memulai awal baru!\lKita akan menjadikannya markas baru

kita, dan Pelatih mana pun yang
ingin lewat harus membayar tol yang\lmahal! Hahaha!

entries.original: "Yeah, yeah!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, yeah!
entries.translated: Ya, ya!

entries.original:
"We’re gonna rough ’em up and steal
their cash!"
entries.translation_source: We’re gonna rough ’em up and steal their cash!
entries.translated:
Kita akan menghajar mereka dan
mencuri uang mereka!

entries.original:
"They’re all gonna cry for
their mommies!"
entries.translation_source: They’re all gonna cry for their mommies!
entries.translated:
Mereka semua akan menangis
memanggil mama mereka!

entries.original:
"Whad’ya want, bozo?

Can’t you see we’re discussin’
important things here?

Scram!"
entries.translation_source: Whad’ya want, bozo? Can’t you see we’re discussin’ important things here? Scram!
entries.translated:
Apa yang kau mau, bodoh? Tidak
lihat kami sedang membahas hal\lpenting? Pergi sana!

entries.original: "Route Gate"
entries.translation_source: Route Gate

entries.original:
"Heading south takes you towards
the Auburn Waterway, a route that\lconnects Route 6 to Route 10.

You’ll need [green]Surf[red] if you want to
get there, though."
entries.translation_source: Heading south takes you towards the Auburn Waterway, a route that connects Route 6 to Route 10. You’ll need [color-green-1]Surf[color-red-2] if you want to get there, though.
entries.translated:
Pergi ke selatan membawamu menuju
Auburn Waterway, sebuah rute yang\lmenghubungkan Route 6 ke Route 10.

Namun, kau perlu [green]Surf[red] jika ingin
sampai ke sana.

entries.original: "Route 7"
entries.translation_source: Route 7
entries.translated: Route 7

entries.original:
"Have you noticed that the Rattata
around here look different than the\lRattata found on Route 2?"
entries.translation_source: Have you noticed that the Rattata around here look different than the Rattata found on Route 2?
entries.translated:
Apakah kau perhatikan bahwa Rattata
di sini terlihat berbeda dari\lRattata yang ditemukan di Route 2?

entries.original:
"They’re so strange\.
I wonder why they look different?"
entries.translation_source: They’re so strange[game-token-1] I wonder why they look different?
entries.translated:
Mereka sangat aneh\. Aku ingin tahu
kenapa mereka terlihat berbeda?

entries.original:
"The strange Rattata only come out
at night, so I don’t blame you if\lyou haven’t noticed them."
entries.translation_source: The strange Rattata only come out at night, so I don’t blame you if you haven’t noticed them.
entries.translated:
Rattata aneh itu hanya keluar pada
malam hari, jadi aku tidak\lmenyalahkanmu jika kau belum

melihat mereka.

entries.original:
"When you cross the bridges, keep
an eye out on your right.

There’s a split path there that’ll
either take you back to Route 6 or\lto a house where a nice couple\lwill heal your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: When you cross the bridges, keep an eye out on your right. There’s a split path there that’ll either take you back to Route 6 or to a house where a nice couple will heal your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Saat menyeberangi jembatan,
perhatikan sisi kananmu. Ada jalur\lbercabang di sana yang akan

membawamu kembali ke Route 6 atau
ke sebuah rumah di mana pasangan\lbaik hati akan menyembuhkan

Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"Have you ever tried using a move
in a Double Battle that hits more\lthan one Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever tried using a move in a Double Battle that hits more than one Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Pernahkah kau mencoba menggunakan
jurus dalam Pertarungan Ganda yang\lmengenai lebih dari satu Pokémon?

entries.original: "I can tell you have!"
entries.translation_source: I can tell you have!
entries.translated: Aku bisa bilang kau pernah!

entries.original:
"When a Pokémon’s move can hit
more than one target in a Double\lBattle, it does less damage.

That’s something to keep in mind
when you’re fighting two on two!"
entries.translation_source: When a Pokémon’s move can hit more than one target in a Double Battle, it does less damage. That’s something to keep in mind when you’re fighting two on two!
entries.translated:
Saat jurus Pokémon bisa mengenai
lebih dari satu target dalam\lPertarungan Ganda, kerusakannya

berkurang. Itu patut diingat saat
kau bertarung dua lawan dua!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon has the ability [green]Static[red].

Pokémon that hit it with direct
contact might get Paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon has the ability [color-green-1]Static[color-red-2]. Pokémon that hit it with direct contact might get Paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Pokémon-ku memiliki kemampuan
[green]Static[red]. Pokémon yang mengenainya\ldengan kontak langsung mungkin

menjadi Lumpuh.

entries.original:
"[red]My Psychic power involves reading
your mind to mimic your strategy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]My Psychic power involves reading your mind to mimic your strategy!
entries.translated:
[red]Kekuatan Psikis-ku melibatkan
membaca pikiranmu untuk meniru\lstrategimu!

entries.original:
"I am not very good at it yet,
however."
entries.translation_source: I am not very good at it yet, however.
entries.translated:
Namun, aku belum terlalu mahir
dalam hal itu.

entries.original:
"[red]I often imagine there is a Trainer
somewhere who could imitate anyone\lwell enough to best them, even with\ltheir own Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I often imagine there is a Trainer somewhere who could imitate anyone well enough to best them, even with their own Pokémon!
entries.translated:
[red]Aku sering membayangkan ada seorang
Pelatih di suatu tempat yang bisa\lmeniru siapa pun dengan cukup baik

untuk mengalahkan mereka, bahkan
dengan Pokémon mereka sendiri!

entries.original:
"Hoo hoo\. sure is humid\. like
a sauna\."
entries.translation_source: Hoo hoo[game-token-1] sure is humid[game-token-2] like a sauna[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Hoo hoo\. pasti lembap\. seperti sauna\.

entries.original:
"Hey, kiddo, c’mere for a sec.

You’re slowly falling into a
deep sleep\.

You’re drifting off\.

\.

Drat! It’s not working!

I’ll have to take you out the
old fashioned way!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, kiddo, c’mere for a sec. You’re slowly falling into a deep sleep[game-token-1] You’re drifting off[game-token-2] [game-token-3] Drat! It’s not working! I’ll have to take you out the old fashioned way!
entries.translated:
Hei, nak, ke sini sebentar. Kau
perlahan jatuh ke dalam tidur\lnyenyak\. Kau mulai mengantuk\. \. Sial!

Tidak berhasil! Aku harus
mengalahkanmu dengan cara kuno!

entries.original:
"I couldn’t best your mind or your
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I couldn’t best your mind or your Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa mengalahkan
pikiranmu atau Pokémon-mu!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon likes to hypnotize
children and eat their dreams.

I hide behind this tree because
kids are easier to catch off guard\lwhen they’re startled.

And once off guard, it’s easier to
lull them into a deep sleep\."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon likes to hypnotize children and eat their dreams. I hide behind this tree because kids are easier to catch off guard when they’re startled. And once off guard, it’s easier to lull them into a deep sleep[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Pokémon-ku suka menghipnotis
anak-anak dan memakan mimpi mereka.\lAku bersembunyi di balik pohon ini

karena anak-anak lebih mudah
terkejut saat dikejutkan. Dan\lsetelah terkejut, lebih mudah

menidurkan mereka\.

entries.original:
"If I had a Pokémon with [green]Flame Body[blue]
or [green]Magma Armor[blue] in my party, my\lEggs would hatch much faster!"
entries.translation_source: If I had a Pokémon with [color-green-1]Flame Body[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Magma Armor[color-blue-4] in my party, my Eggs would hatch much faster!
entries.translated:
Jika aku memiliki Pokémon dengan
[green]Flame Body[blue] atau [green]Magma Armor[blue] di\ltimku, Telur-telurku akan menetas

jauh lebih cepat!

entries.original:
"All birds can fly!
Even the flightless ones!"
entries.translation_source: All birds can fly! Even the flightless ones!
entries.translated:
Semua burung bisa terbang! Bahkan
yang tidak bisa terbang sekalipun!

entries.original:
"See? If they couldn’t fly, then they
wouldn’t have crashed down so hard!"
entries.translation_source: See? If they couldn’t fly, then they wouldn’t have crashed down so hard!
entries.translated:
Lihat? Jika mereka tidak bisa
terbang, maka mereka tidak akan\ljatuh dengan keras!

entries.original:
"Doduo and Dodrio are supposed to be
flightless birds.

Yet those flightless birds can
still learn Fly!

How in the world is that even
possible?"
entries.translation_source: Doduo and Dodrio are supposed to be flightless birds. Yet those flightless birds can still learn Fly! How in the world is that even possible?
entries.translated:
Doduo dan Dodrio seharusnya adalah
burung yang tidak bisa terbang.\lNamun burung yang tidak bisa

terbang itu masih bisa belajar
Terbang! Bagaimana mungkin hal itu\lbisa terjadi?

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Dude!

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Dude! I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Aku adalah Bung Pemancing! Aku
sangat suka memancing! Aku tidak\ltahan jika tidak memancing.

Katakan, apakah kamu suka
memancing?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Aku suka gayamu. Kurasa kita
bisa berteman. Ambil ini dan\lpancinglah, teman muda!

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

From the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, my friend.
entries.translated:
Memancing adalah cara hidup! Ini
seperti puisi terbaik. Dari laut\lhingga sungai, pergilah dan

dapatkan yang besar, temanku.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
That’s so disappointing\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] That’s so disappointing[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Itu sangat mengecewakan\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, [player]!

How are the fish biting?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, [player-name-1]! How are the fish biting?
entries.translated:
Halo, [player]! Bagaimana hasil
memancingnya?

entries.original:
"Hi there, young traveller.
Your Pokémon look tired.

Let me heal them for you."
entries.translation_source: Hi there, young traveller. Your Pokémon look tired. Let me heal them for you.
entries.translated:
Hai, pengelana muda. Pokémonmu
terlihat lelah. Biarkan aku\lmenyembuhkan mereka untukmu.

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated:
Siap semua! Tetap aman di luar
sana!

entries.original:
"This area is sealed off to anyone
who isn’t a member of the Shadows.

Since you’re not one of us,
scram, kid!"
entries.translation_source: This area is sealed off to anyone who isn’t a member of the Shadows. Since you’re not one of us, scram, kid!
entries.translated:
Area ini ditutup untuk siapa pun
yang bukan anggota Shadows. Karena\lkamu bukan salah satu dari kami,

pergi, nak!

entries.original:
"What the\.

How’d you get onto Route 9?

However it was, you’re still not
getting through here."
entries.translation_source: What the[game-token-1] How’d you get onto Route 9? However it was, you’re still not getting through here.
entries.translated:
Apa\. Bagaimana kamu bisa sampai ke
Rute 9? Bagaimanapun caranya, kamu\ltetap tidak bisa lewat sini.

entries.original: "Route 8"
entries.translation_source: Route 8
entries.translated: Rute 8

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe in the blizzard!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe in the blizzard!
entries.translated:
Siap semua! Tetap aman di tengah
badai salju!

entries.original: "No Fall Damage"
entries.translation_source: No Fall Damage
entries.translated: Tidak Ada Kerusakan Jatuh

entries.original:
"Practice the secret martial art of
jumping safely [buffer1] times."
entries.translation_source: Practice the secret martial art of jumping safely [buffer1-1] times.
entries.translated:
Latihlah seni bela diri rahasia
melompat dengan aman sebanyak
[buffer1] kali.

entries.original:
"Ah, Trainer, did you know that
there is a secret martial art to\lavoid fall damage from moderate\lheights?

You just go to the edge of a ledge
or rock, jump, and land peacefully.

But this technique requires much
practice.

Are you ready to practice with
[green][buffer1][blue] jumps?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, Trainer, did you know that there is a secret martial art to avoid fall damage from moderate heights? You just go to the edge of a ledge or rock, jump, and land peacefully. But this technique requires much practice. Are you ready to practice with [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] jumps?
entries.translated:
Ah, Pelatih, tahukah kamu bahwa ada
seni bela diri rahasia untuk\lmenghindari kerusakan jatuh dari

ketinggian sedang? Kamu cukup pergi
ke tepi tebing atau batu, melompat,\ldan mendarat dengan damai. Tapi

teknik ini membutuhkan banyak
latihan. Apakah kamu siap berlatih\ldengan [green][buffer1][blue] lompatan?

entries.original:
"Before you start, you should do
some stretches.

And don’t be disappointed if you
take some fall damage on your\lfirst few tries.

It happens to the best jumpers."
entries.translation_source: Before you start, you should do some stretches. And don’t be disappointed if you take some fall damage on your first few tries. It happens to the best jumpers.
entries.translated:
Sebelum memulai, kamu harus
melakukan beberapa peregangan. Dan\ljangan kecewa jika kamu menerima

sedikit kerusakan jatuh pada
beberapa percobaan pertamamu. Itu\lterjadi pada pelompat terbaik

sekalipun.

entries.original:
"I hope one day you will want to
master this super secret skill."
entries.translation_source: I hope one day you will want to master this super secret skill.
entries.translated:
Aku harap suatu hari nanti kamu
ingin menguasai keterampilan super\lrahasia ini.

entries.original:
"You have only done [green][buffer2][blue] jump\\07 with
no fall damage.

You still need at least [green][buffer3][blue] more
to become a master."
entries.translation_source: You have only done [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] jump[raw-escape-4] with no fall damage. You still need at least [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] more to become a master.
entries.translated:
Kamu baru melakukan [green][buffer2][blue]
lompatan\\07 tanpa kerusakan jatuh.\lKamu masih perlu setidaknya

[green][buffer3][blue] lagi untuk menjadi master.

entries.original:
"Wow, you are now a master of
jumping off moderate heights\lwithout fall damage!

You’d be surprised how many
Trainers get slightly injured on\lthose things.

Anyway, here is some Protein for a
post-workout snack."
entries.translation_source: Wow, you are now a master of jumping off moderate heights without fall damage! You’d be surprised how many Trainers get slightly injured on those things. Anyway, here is some Protein for a post-workout snack.
entries.translated:
Wow, kamu sekarang menjadi master
melompat dari ketinggian sedang\ltanpa kerusakan jatuh! Kamu akan

terkejut berapa banyak Trainer yang
mengalami cedera ringan dari\lhal-hal itu. Ngomong-ngomong, ini

ada Protein untuk camilan
pasca-latihan.

entries.original:
"Jumping from moderate heights is
a skill.

Don’t let anyone tell you
otherwise."
entries.translation_source: Jumping from moderate heights is a skill. Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.
entries.translated:
Melompat dari ketinggian sedang
adalah suatu keterampilan. Jangan\lbiarkan siapa pun mengatakan

sebaliknya.

entries.original:
"If you’re going to get stronger,
I’ll get stronger too."
entries.translation_source: If you’re going to get stronger, I’ll get stronger too.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu akan menjadi lebih kuat,
aku juga akan menjadi lebih kuat.

entries.original:
"You’d best not send out any weak
Pokémon!

Your opponents are my partners
in life!"
entries.translation_source: You’d best not send out any weak Pokémon! Your opponents are my partners in life!
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya jangan kirim Pokémon
lemah! Lawanmu adalah pasanganku\ldalam hidup!

entries.original:
"Thank you my friends\. for all
your hard work."
entries.translation_source: Thank you my friends[game-token-1] for all your hard work.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih teman-temanku\. untuk
semua kerja keras kalian.

entries.original:
"No matter what, my Pokémon will
stick with me until the end!"
entries.translation_source: No matter what, my Pokémon will stick with me until the end!
entries.translated:
Apa pun yang terjadi, Pokémon-ku
akan tetap bersamaku sampai akhir!

entries.original:
"Even when I lose, I still get some
enjoyment out of it."
entries.translation_source: Even when I lose, I still get some enjoyment out of it.
entries.translated:
Bahkan saat aku kalah, aku masih
mendapatkan kesenangan darinya.

entries.original:
"I got used to this snowiness.
I sing while I climb now."
entries.translation_source: I got used to this snowiness. I sing while I climb now.
entries.translated:
Aku sudah terbiasa dengan salju
ini. Aku bernyanyi sambil mendaki\lsekarang.

entries.original:
"It’s still not easy to battle on
this snowy ground\."
entries.translation_source: It’s still not easy to battle on this snowy ground[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Masih tidak mudah untuk bertarung
di tanah bersalju ini\.

entries.original:
"If I had a Bike, it would be much
easier to climb.

But where can you even get a Bike
around here?"
entries.translation_source: If I had a Bike, it would be much easier to climb. But where can you even get a Bike around here?
entries.translated:
Jika aku punya Sepeda, akan lebih
mudah untuk mendaki. Tapi di mana\lkamu bisa mendapatkan Sepeda di

sekitar sini?

entries.original:
"If you run and run, you’ll become
one with the wind."
entries.translation_source: If you run and run, you’ll become one with the wind.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu berlari dan berlari, kamu
akan menyatu dengan angin.

entries.original:
"[red]Picnics are fun wherever you go,
just like Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Picnics are fun wherever you go, just like Pokémon!
entries.translated:
[red]Piknik menyenangkan di mana pun
kamu pergi, seperti Pokémon!

entries.original:
"I lost because the ground is
too snowy!"
entries.translation_source: I lost because the ground is too snowy!
entries.translated:
Aku kalah karena tanahnya terlalu
bersalju!

entries.original:
"[red]I’ll forget about losing and just
enjoy this snowy hike."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’ll forget about losing and just enjoy this snowy hike.
entries.translated:
[red]Aku akan melupakan kekalahan dan
menikmati pendakian bersalju ini.

entries.original:
"No one knows the mountains better
than me, I tells ya."
entries.translation_source: No one knows the mountains better than me, I tells ya.
entries.translated:
Tidak ada yang tahu gunung lebih
baik dariku, aku bilang.

entries.original:
"How many thousands of years have I
been out here\.

If only I could lose, my journey
would end\."
entries.translation_source: How many thousands of years have I been out here[game-token-1] If only I could lose, my journey would end[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Berapa ribu tahun aku sudah di sini\.
Andai saja aku bisa kalah,\lperjalananku akan berakhir\.

entries.original:
"Thank you\.

Thank you\.

Now my journey can come to an end\."
entries.translation_source: Thank you[game-token-1] Thank you[game-token-2] Now my journey can come to an end[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Terima kasih\. Terima kasih\. Sekarang
perjalananku bisa berakhir\.

entries.original:
"You have set me free\.

I am truly grateful from the bottom
of my heart\."
entries.translation_source: You have set me free[game-token-1] I am truly grateful from the bottom of my heart[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Kamu telah membebaskanku\. Aku
benar-benar bersyukur dari lubuk\lhati yang paling dalam\.

entries.original: "Route 9"
entries.translation_source: Route 9
entries.translated: Rute 9

entries.original: "Route 9 - 10"
entries.translation_source: Route 9 - 10

entries.original:
"I love my daughter very much.

I can’t stand not seeing her for
even a single day.

I would even commit terrible crimes
for my daughter’s sake!

That’s how much I love her."
entries.translation_source: I love my daughter very much. I can’t stand not seeing her for even a single day. I would even commit terrible crimes for my daughter’s sake! That’s how much I love her.
entries.translated:
Aku sangat mencintai putriku. Aku
tidak tahan tidak melihatnya meski\lsehari pun. Aku bahkan akan

melakukan kejahatan demi putriku!
Itulah betapa aku mencintainya.

entries.original:
"Borrius is doomed\.

But now that nothing is anchoring
us down, we’re catching the next\lboat to Hoenn!"
entries.translation_source: Borrius is doomed[game-token-1] But now that nothing is anchoring us down, we’re catching the next boat to Hoenn!
entries.translated:
Borrius telah hancur\. Tapi sekarang
karena tidak ada yang menahan kita,\lkita naik kapal berikutnya ke

Hoenn!

entries.original:
"You know, it might have been
just me\.

But I could swear Jax seemed a
little put-off by something.

And I don’t think it was just because
those thugs got away with the\lPrison Stone, either\."
entries.translation_source: You know, it might have been just me[game-token-1] But I could swear Jax seemed a little put-off by something. And I don’t think it was just because those thugs got away with the Prison Stone, either[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Kau tahu, mungkin hanya diriku\. Tapi
aku bersumpah Jax tampak sedikit\lterusik oleh sesuatu. Dan kurasa

itu bukan hanya karena para preman
itu lolos dengan Prison Stone, juga\lbukan\.

entries.original:
"[red]Those thugs just waltzed on in
here and ransacked our home!

They pinned us to the wall, and
we were forced to watch helplessly\lwhile they scoured our home for\lthe Prison Stone."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Those thugs just waltzed on in here and ransacked our home! They pinned us to the wall, and we were forced to watch helplessly while they scoured our home for the Prison Stone.
entries.translated:
[red]Para preman itu baru saja masuk ke
sini dan mengobrak-abrik rumah\lkami! Mereka menempelkan kami ke

dinding, dan kami terpaksa
menyaksikan tanpa daya sementara\lmereka menggeledah rumah kami untuk

mencari Prison Stone.

entries.original:
"Mystical chants, kwaah!

You want Pokémon learn [green]Hex[red], skree?
[green]1 Blue Shard[red] and [green]1 Red Shard[red] it be."
entries.translation_source: Mystical chants, kwaah! You want Pokémon learn [color-green-1]Hex[color-red-2], skree? [color-green-3]1 Blue Shard[color-red-4] and [color-green-5]1 Red Shard[color-red-6] it be.
entries.translated:
Mantra mistis, kwaah! Kamu ingin
Pokémon belajar [green]Hex[red], skree? [green]1 Blue\lShard[red] dan [green]1 Red Shard[red] biayanya.

entries.original: "Which Pokémon it be?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon it be?
entries.translated: Pokémon mana itu?

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over 1 Blue Shard
and 1 Red Shard."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over 1 Blue Shard and 1 Red Shard.
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan 1 Blue Shard
dan 1 Red Shard.

entries.original: "Hwa!"
entries.translation_source: Hwa!
entries.translated: Hwa!

entries.original:
"Huhu\. Graa\.
Not enough [buffer1]s\."
entries.translation_source: Huhu[game-token-1] Graa[game-token-2] Not enough [buffer1-3]s[game-token-4]
entries.translated: Huhu\. Graa\. Tidak cukup [buffer1]s\.

entries.original:
"Did you know humans have internal
clocks that tell them how many\ltimes they’ve been rained on?

Here, yours says\.

[buffer1]!

You’ve been rained on
[buffer1] times!

I personally have been rained on
16777215 times!

No one’ll ever be rained on more
than me!

NO ONE!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know humans have internal clocks that tell them how many times they’ve been rained on? Here, yours says[game-token-1] [buffer1-2]! You’ve been rained on [buffer1-3] times! I personally have been rained on 16777215 times! No one’ll ever be rained on more than me! NO ONE!
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu manusia memiliki jam
internal yang memberi tahu berapa\lkali mereka kehujanan? Ini, milikmu

mengatakan\. [buffer1]! Kamu telah
kehujanan sebanyak [buffer1] kali!\lSecara pribadi aku telah kehujanan

16777215 kali! Tidak ada yang akan
pernah kehujanan lebih dari aku!\lTIDAK ADA!

entries.original:
"Me?
No, I’m not a Trainer.

I just find fishing in the rain
a relaxing sport.

Say\.

Now that I’ve been staring at it
for a while, how do you suppose\lI could get to that island in the\lmiddle of the lake?

What, you don’t see it?

It’s right there, just look out
onto the lake!

You still don’t see it?

Sorry, I’m a Fisherman, not an
eye doctor.

You’re on your own here, pal."
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not a Trainer. I just find fishing in the rain a relaxing sport. Say[game-token-1] Now that I’ve been staring at it for a while, how do you suppose I could get to that island in the middle of the lake? What, you don’t see it? It’s right there, just look out onto the lake! You still don’t see it? Sorry, I’m a Fisherman, not an eye doctor. You’re on your own here, pal.
entries.translated:
Aku? Tidak, aku bukan seorang
Trainer. Aku hanya merasa memancing\ldi tengah hujan adalah olahraga

yang santai. Ngomong-ngomong\.
Setelah aku lama menatapnya,\lbagaimana menurutmu aku bisa sampai

ke pulau di tengah danau itu? Apa,
kamu tidak melihatnya? Itu di sana,\llihat saja ke danau! Kamu masih

tidak melihatnya? Maaf, aku seorang
Fisherman, bukan dokter mata. Urus\lsendiri, teman.

entries.original:
"Me?

No, I’m not a Trainer.

I just find fishing in the rain
a relaxing sport.

Say\.

Now that I’ve been staring at it
for a while, how do you suppose\lI could get to that island in the\lmiddle of the lake?

What do you mean you don’t
see it?

I saw you pick up the yellow Poké
Ball that was resting on it!

Are you trying to tell me you won’t
share your secret with me?

In that case, leave me to fish!"
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not a Trainer. I just find fishing in the rain a relaxing sport. Say[game-token-1] Now that I’ve been staring at it for a while, how do you suppose I could get to that island in the middle of the lake? What do you mean you don’t see it? I saw you pick up the yellow Poké Ball that was resting on it! Are you trying to tell me you won’t share your secret with me? In that case, leave me to fish!
entries.translated:
Aku? Tidak, aku bukan seorang
Trainer. Aku hanya merasa memancing\ldi tengah hujan adalah olahraga

yang santai. Ngomong-ngomong\.
Setelah aku lama menatapnya,\lbagaimana menurutmu aku bisa sampai

ke pulau di tengah danau itu? Apa
maksudmu kamu tidak melihatnya? Aku\lmelihat kamu mengambil Poké Ball

kuning yang ada di atasnya! Apakah
kamu bermaksud mengatakan bahwa\lkamu tidak akan berbagi rahasiamu

denganku? Kalau begitu, biarkan aku
memancing!

entries.original:
"Now that those strange people are
gone, we can finally camp again!"
entries.translation_source: Now that those strange people are gone, we can finally camp again!
entries.translated:
Sekarang setelah orang-orang aneh
itu pergi, kita akhirnya bisa\lberkemah lagi!

entries.original:
"I’m so happy!
I don’t even care if I lose!"
entries.translation_source: I’m so happy! I don’t even care if I lose!
entries.translated:
Aku sangat senang! Aku bahkan tidak
peduli jika aku kalah!

entries.original:
"Ahh\.
Camping out in the leaves is great!"
entries.translation_source: Ahh[game-token-1] Camping out in the leaves is great!
entries.translated:
Ahh\. Berkemah di dedaunan itu
menyenangkan!

entries.original:
"Who needs seasons when you have
areas like Route 9 that are\lperpetually stuck in one!"
entries.translation_source: Who needs seasons when you have areas like Route 9 that are perpetually stuck in one!
entries.translated:
Siapa yang butuh musim ketika ada
daerah seperti Route 9 yang\lterus-menerus terjebak dalam satu

musim!

entries.original:
"When those weird people showed up,
I wasn’t able to run anymore."
entries.translation_source: When those weird people showed up, I wasn’t able to run anymore.
entries.translated:
Ketika orang-orang aneh itu muncul,
aku tidak bisa berlari lagi.

entries.original: "Looks like I couldn’t outrun you!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like I couldn’t outrun you!
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku tidak bisa melarikan
diri darimu!

entries.original:
"It’s so freeing being able to run
again!  "
entries.translation_source: It’s so freeing being able to run again!
entries.translated:
Sangat membebaskan bisa berlari
lagi!

entries.original:
"My grandparents used to live in
Antisis City, so I know a thing\lor two about thugs.

But the thugs that were on this
route\.

Not even my grandparents had ever
seen anyone like them before!

I wonder who they were?"
entries.translation_source: My grandparents used to live in Antisis City, so I know a thing or two about thugs. But the thugs that were on this route[game-token-1] Not even my grandparents had ever seen anyone like them before! I wonder who they were?
entries.translated:
Kakek-nenekku dulu tinggal di
Antisis City, jadi aku tahu sedikit\ltentang preman. Tapi preman-preman

yang ada di rute ini\. Bahkan
kakek-nenekku belum pernah melihat\lorang seperti mereka sebelumnya!

Aku ingin tahu siapa mereka?

entries.original:
"I’m singin’ in the rain\.

Just singin’ in the rain\."
entries.translation_source: I’m singin’ in the rain[game-token-1] Just singin’ in the rain[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku bernyanyi di tengah hujan\. Hanya
bernyanyi di tengah hujan\.

entries.original:
"I’m dancing in the rain\.
And I’m happy again!"
entries.translation_source: I’m dancing in the rain[game-token-1] And I’m happy again!
entries.translated:
Aku menari di tengah hujan\. Dan aku
bahagia lagi!

entries.original:
"Life’s not all about waiting for
the storm to pass.

It’s about learning to dance in
the rain."
entries.translation_source: Life’s not all about waiting for the storm to pass. It’s about learning to dance in the rain.
entries.translated:
Hidup tidak hanya tentang menunggu
badai berlalu. Ini tentang belajar\lmenari di tengah hujan.

entries.original:
"In other regions, [green]Karrablast[blue] and
[green]Shelmet[blue] evolve when they’re traded\lwith each other.

But in Borrius, you just have to
use a [green]Link Stone[blue] on them!

The other one doesn’t even need
to be in the party!"
entries.translation_source: In other regions, [color-green-1]Karrablast[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Shelmet[color-blue-4] evolve when they’re traded with each other. But in Borrius, you just have to use a [color-green-5]Link Stone[color-blue-6] on them! The other one doesn’t even need to be in the party!
entries.translated:
Di wilayah lain, [green]Karrablast[blue] dan
[green]Shelmet[blue] berevolusi saat mereka\ldiperdagangkan satu sama lain.

Tetapi di Borrius, kamu hanya perlu
menggunakan [green]Link Stone[blue] pada mereka!\lYang satu bahkan tidak perlu ada di

party!

entries.original:
"When is the best time to train
a bird?

When it rains, of course!"
entries.translation_source: When is the best time to train a bird? When it rains, of course!
entries.translated:
Kapan waktu terbaik untuk melatih
seekor burung? Saat hujan, tentu\lsaja!

entries.original: "That’s why I’m training right now!"
entries.translation_source: That’s why I’m training right now!
entries.translated:
Itulah kenapa aku berlatih
sekarang!

entries.original:
"I only train my birds when
it rains.

And if they get zapped by lightning
while they’re flying\. that only\lmakes them stronger!"
entries.translation_source: I only train my birds when it rains. And if they get zapped by lightning while they’re flying[game-token-1] that only makes them stronger!
entries.translated:
Aku hanya melatih burung-burungku
saat hujan. Dan jika mereka\ltersambar petir saat terbang\. itu

hanya membuat mereka lebih kuat!

entries.original:
"No\. it couldn’t be\.
But it’s the only explanation!

Did you suddenly gain the ability to
walk through walls?"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] it couldn’t be[game-token-2] But it’s the only explanation! Did you suddenly gain the ability to walk through walls?
entries.translated:
Tidak\. tidak mungkin\. Tapi itu
satu-satunya penjelasan! Apakah\lkamu tiba-tiba mendapatkan

kemampuan menembus dinding?

entries.original:
"Well, sure, it’s a bit of a grind
dealing with those monsters all the\ltime, but hey, at least it’s better\lthan retail."
entries.translation_source: Well, sure, it’s a bit of a grind dealing with those monsters all the time, but hey, at least it’s better than retail.
entries.translated:
Yah, tentu, agak melelahkan
berurusan dengan monster-monster\litu sepanjang waktu, tapi hei,

setidaknya itu lebih baik daripada
pekerjaan ritel.

entries.original:
"I heard a guy with a green hat was
wandering around the route.

But who’d have guessed there’d be
two of you brats?"
entries.translation_source: I heard a guy with a green hat was wandering around the route. But who’d have guessed there’d be two of you brats?
entries.translated:
Aku dengar ada seorang pria bertopi
hijau berkeliaran di rute ini. Tapi\lsiapa sangka akan ada dua bocah

sepertimu?

entries.original:
"Gah! Didn’t your mother teach you
any manners, kid!?"
entries.translation_source: Gah! Didn’t your mother teach you any manners, kid!?
entries.translated:
Gah! Apakah ibumu tidak mengajarimu
sopan santun, nak!?

entries.original:
"Geez\.

Brats like you make me wonder why
anyone would even have ’em, least\lof all Zeph\."
entries.translation_source: Geez[game-token-1] Brats like you make me wonder why anyone would even have ’em, least of all Zeph[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ya ampun\. Bocah sepertimu membuatku
bertanya-tanya mengapa ada orang\lyang mau punya anak, apalagi Zeph\.

entries.original:
"Hey, I just follow orders.
They don’t tell me anything."
entries.translation_source: Hey, I just follow orders. They don’t tell me anything.
entries.translated:
Hei, aku hanya mengikuti perintah.
Mereka tidak memberitahuku apa pun.

entries.original:
"Gah\. That was painful\.

But I guess I’ll think of it as giving
Lady Ivory a chance to beat you\ldown herself!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Gah[game-token-1] That was painful[game-token-2] But I guess I’ll think of it as giving Lady Ivory a chance to beat you down herself! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Gah\. Itu menyakitkan\. Tapi kurasa aku
akan menganggapnya sebagai memberi\lLady Ivory kesempatan untuk

mengalahkanmu sendiri! Ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"I mean, it’s called \qothe dark
force\qc, so\.

Not exactly gonna use it for anything
other than to ruin someone’s day,\ldon’t you think?"
entries.translation_source: I mean, it’s called [quote-open-1]the dark force[quote-close-2], so[game-token-3] Not exactly gonna use it for anything other than to ruin someone’s day, don’t you think?
entries.translated:
Maksudku, itu disebut \qokekuatan
gelap\qc, jadi\. Tidak tepat akan\lmenggunakannya untuk hal lain

selain menghancurkan hari
seseorang, bukan?

entries.original:
"Prepare to face the wrath of
the Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Prepare to face the wrath of the Shadows!
entries.translated:
Bersiaplah menghadapi murka
Shadows!

entries.original:
"C’mon\. what kind of wrath was that,
anyway?"
entries.translation_source: C’mon[game-token-1] what kind of wrath was that, anyway?
entries.translated: Ayolah\. murka macam apa itu, sih?

entries.original:
"Ha! Not like you’ll ever beat all of
us, anyway!

We’ve got all the pull we need to
get back up, again and again!"
entries.translation_source: Ha! Not like you’ll ever beat all of us, anyway! We’ve got all the pull we need to get back up, again and again!
entries.translated:
Ha! Seolah kamu bisa mengalahkan
kami semua! Kami punya semua\lpengaruh yang kami butuhkan untuk

bangkit kembali, lagi dan lagi!

entries.original:
"Whatever. Don’t mind me.

I’ll just watch for anyone else out
here, in this miserable damp\lplace\. not that you’d care what\lsomeone from the Shadows thinks\."
entries.translation_source: Whatever. Don’t mind me. I’ll just watch for anyone else out here, in this miserable damp place[game-token-1] not that you’d care what someone from the Shadows thinks[game-token-2]
entries.translated:

entries.original:
"The Safari Game is an opportunity
for you to capture as many Pokémon\las you can.

To start off, you’re given special
Safari Balls.

While playing, the Pokémon you are
attempting to capture will appear\lin front of you.

Try your best to aim and hit it
with a Safari Ball.

If you manage to land a hit, and
the Pokémon stays in the Safari\lBall, it’s yours to keep!

Once you run out of Safari Balls or
choose to quit, the game is over."
entries.translation_source: The Safari Game is an opportunity for you to capture as many Pokémon as you can. To start off, you’re given special Safari Balls. While playing, the Pokémon you are attempting to capture will appear in front of you. Try your best to aim and hit it with a Safari Ball. If you manage to land a hit, and the Pokémon stays in the Safari Ball, it’s yours to keep! Once you run out of Safari Balls or choose to quit, the game is over.
entries.translated:
Safari Game adalah kesempatan
bagimu untuk menangkap sebanyak\lmungkin Pokémon. Untuk memulai,

kamu akan diberikan Safari Ball
khusus. Saat bermain, Pokémon yang\lkamu coba tangkap akan muncul di

hadapanmu. Cobalah sebaik mungkin
untuk membidik dan mengenai dengan\lSafari Ball. Jika kamu berhasil

mengenai, dan Pokémon tetap berada
di dalam Safari Ball, maka Pokémon\litu menjadi milikmu! Setelah kamu

kehabisan Safari Ball atau memilih
berhenti, permainan selesai.

entries.original:
"There are different difficulty modes
for the Safari Game.

The higher the difficulty mode, the
faster the Pokémon you are trying\lto capture will move around.

The higher difficulty modes are
still beneficial, however.

They offer the chance for you to
encounter much rarer Pokémon than\lthose that can be found in the\llower difficulty modes."
entries.translation_source: There are different difficulty modes for the Safari Game. The higher the difficulty mode, the faster the Pokémon you are trying to capture will move around. The higher difficulty modes are still beneficial, however. They offer the chance for you to encounter much rarer Pokémon than those that can be found in the lower difficulty modes.
entries.translated:

daripada yang dapat ditemukan di
mode kesulitan yang lebih rendah.

"In the Safari Game, Berries can be

Which Berry would you like to know
about?"
