entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine is currently having
engine trouble.

We are not currently boarding
passengers."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine is currently having engine trouble. We are not currently boarding passengers.
entries.translated:
S.S. Marine saat ini mengalami
masalah mesin. Kami saat ini tidak\lmenaikkan penumpang.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the S.S. Marine!

Your ticket is\. right there.
Do you want to board?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the S.S. Marine! Your ticket is[game-token-1] right there. Do you want to board?
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di S.S. Marine!
Tiket Anda\. di sana. Apakah Anda\lingin naik?

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine leaves once a day
for a voyage between Seaport City\land Polder Town.

When the whistle blows five times,
it means the ship has arrived at\lits destination.

On the ship, the passenger cabins
are full of Trainers who love to\lbattle.

Items can’t be used in battles
against those Trainers, but if you\ldefeat all of the Trainers on board\lbefore the ship reaches its final\ldestination, we’ll give you a prize."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine leaves once a day for a voyage between Seaport City and Polder Town. When the whistle blows five times, it means the ship has arrived at its destination. On the ship, the passenger cabins are full of Trainers who love to battle. Items can’t be used in battles against those Trainers, but if you defeat all of the Trainers on board before the ship reaches its final destination, we’ll give you a prize.
entries.translated:
S.S. Marine berlayar sekali sehari
untuk perjalanan antara Kota\lPelabuhan dan Kota Polder. Ketika

peluit berbunyi lima kali, itu
berarti kapal telah tiba di\ltujuannya. Di kapal, kabin

penumpang penuh dengan Pelatih yang
suka bertarung. Item tidak dapat\ldigunakan dalam pertempuran melawan

Pelatih itu, tetapi jika Anda
mengalahkan semua Pelatih di kapal\lsebelum kapal mencapai tujuan

akhirnya, kami akan memberi Anda
hadiah.

entries.original: "Please board the ship."
entries.translation_source: Please board the ship.
entries.translated: Silakan naik ke kapal.

entries.original:
"[blue]Congrats on beating all of the
Trainers on board!

Here’s what you get for winning."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Congrats on beating all of the Trainers on board! Here’s what you get for winning.
entries.translated:
[blue]Selamat telah mengalahkan semua
Pelatih di kapal! Inilah yang Anda\ldapatkan karena menang.

entries.original:
"Operating a ship every day can wear
you out! It’s not running today.

It leaves for Polder Town on
[green]Mondays[blue] and [green]Fridays[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Operating a ship every day can wear you out! It’s not running today. It leaves for Polder Town on [color-green-1]Mondays[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Fridays[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Mengoperasikan kapal setiap hari
bisa melelahkan! Hari ini tidak\lberoperasi. Kapal berangkat ke Kota

Polder pada hari [green]Senin[blue] dan [green]Jumat[blue]!

entries.original:
"Operating a ship more than once a
day can wear you out!

It already sailed today."
entries.translation_source: Operating a ship more than once a day can wear you out! It already sailed today.
entries.translated:
Mengoperasikan kapal lebih dari
sekali sehari bisa melelahkan!\lKapal sudah berlayar hari ini.

entries.original: "Board"
entries.translation_source: Board
entries.translated: Naik

entries.original:
"Okay!
You must be the last passenger."
entries.translation_source: Okay! You must be the last passenger.
entries.translated: Oke! Anda pasti penumpang terakhir.

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine usually sets sail
on Mondays and Fridays to East\lBorrius.

But right now I hear it’s having
engine trouble."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine usually sets sail on Mondays and Fridays to East Borrius. But right now I hear it’s having engine trouble.
entries.translated:
S.S. Marine biasanya berlayar pada
hari Senin dan Jumat ke Borrius\lTimur. Tapi saat ini saya dengar

ada masalah mesin.

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine sets sail to East
Borrius every [green]Monday[blue] and [green]Friday[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine sets sail to East Borrius every [color-green-1]Monday[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Friday[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
S.S. Marine berlayar ke Borrius
Timur setiap hari [green]Senin[blue] dan [green]Jumat[blue].

entries.original:
"What!?
Engine trouble!?

Sniff\. I just want to go back home
to Magnolia Town\."
entries.translation_source: What!? Engine trouble!? Sniff[game-token-1] I just want to go back home to Magnolia Town[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Apa!? Masalah mesin!? Sedih\. Saya
hanya ingin pulang ke Kota Magnolia\.

entries.original:
"I came from overseas to learn more
about the legendary Pokémon\lrumoured to live in the [green]Cave of\lBeing[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I came from overseas to learn more about the legendary Pokémon rumoured to live in the [color-green-1]Cave of Being[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Saya datang dari luar negeri untuk
mempelajari lebih lanjut tentang\lPokémon legendaris yang dikabarkan

tinggal di [green]Gua Keberadaan[blue].

entries.original:
"I have plans to explore the
[green]Tomb of Borrius[blue] while I am here.

I hear many riches await those who
are brave enough to descend into\lits depths."
entries.translation_source: I have plans to explore the [color-green-1]Tomb of Borrius[color-blue-2] while I am here. I hear many riches await those who are brave enough to descend into its depths.
entries.translated:
Saya berencana untuk menjelajahi
[green]Makam Borrius[blue] selama saya di sini.\lSaya dengar banyak kekayaan menanti

mereka yang cukup berani untuk
turun ke kedalamannya.

entries.original:
"Psst\.

Listen up, Sparky.
I’ve got a sweet deal fo’ you.

In my hand is a ticket to a
special place.

Folks know it as [green]Glimmer Isle[blue].

I can sell it to ya, but it’s
gonna cost ya $[green]999999999[blue].

Whatcha say, Sparky?

You in on the deal of a lifetime?"
entries.translation_source: Psst[game-token-1] Listen up, Sparky. I’ve got a sweet deal fo’ you. In my hand is a ticket to a special place. Folks know it as [color-green-2]Glimmer Isle[color-blue-3]. I can sell it to ya, but it’s gonna cost ya $[color-green-4]999999999[color-blue-5]. Whatcha say, Sparky? You in on the deal of a lifetime?
entries.translated:
Psst\. Dengar, Sparky. Saya punya
tawaran menarik untukmu. Di tangan\lsaya ada tiket ke tempat spesial.

Orang-orang mengenalnya sebagai
[green]Pulau Gemerlap[blue]. Saya bisa\lmenjualnya padamu, tapi harganya

$[green]999999999[blue]. Bagaimana, Sparky? Kamu
ikut dalam penawaran seumur hidup?

entries.original:
"Come on, Sparky.
Don’t be pulling my leg.

I see you don’t have enough cash."
entries.translation_source: Come on, Sparky. Don’t be pulling my leg. I see you don’t have enough cash.
entries.translated:
Ayolah, Sparky. Jangan bercanda.
Saya lihat kamu tidak punya cukup\luang.

entries.original: "See you around, Sparky\."
entries.translation_source: See you around, Sparky[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sampai jumpa lagi, Sparky\.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

To weather, or not to weather\.
What does this truly mean?

Only the weather will tell!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! To weather, or not to weather[game-token-1] What does this truly mean? Only the weather will tell!
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Cuaca, atau bukan
cuaca\. Apa artinya sebenarnya? Hanya\lcuaca yang akan memberi tahu!

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!
You found all us clowns!

To think, someone has found all of
us\. you must truly be a master\lof weather!

For that, you have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! You found all us clowns! To think, someone has found all of us[game-token-1] you must truly be a master of weather! For that, you have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Kamu menemukan
kami semua badut! Bayangkan,\lseseorang telah menemukan kita

semua\. kamu pasti benar-benar ahli
cuaca! Untuk itu, kamu mendapat\lrasa terima kasihku.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

That [green]Castform[blue] is a rare Pokémon
indeed!

And like you, it is both master of
weather and friendship!

’Til your travels bringeth us
together again, I bid you adieu."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! That [color-green-1]Castform[color-blue-2] is a rare Pokémon indeed! And like you, it is both master of weather and friendship! ’Til your travels bringeth us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! [green]Castform[blue] itu
adalah Pokémon langka! Dan\lsepertimu, ia adalah ahli cuaca dan

persahabatan! Sampai perjalananmu
mempertemukan kita lagi, aku\lucapkan selamat tinggal.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

But first, make space in your
party."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! But first, make space in your party.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Tapi pertama,
kosongkan slot di timmu.

entries.original:
"Good day.

Welcome to the Camomons Battle
House.

In this house, all Pokémon become
the same types as their first two\lmoves.

Feel free to battle any of the
Trainers here as many times as\lyou wish.

If you need an explanation of the
battle type here, please come and\lspeak with me."
entries.translation_source: Good day. Welcome to the Camomons Battle House. In this house, all Pokémon become the same types as their first two moves. Feel free to battle any of the Trainers here as many times as you wish. If you need an explanation of the battle type here, please come and speak with me.
entries.translated:
Selamat siang. Selamat datang di
Camomons Battle House. Di rumah\lini, semua Pokémon menjadi tipe

yang sama dengan dua jurus pertama
mereka. Silakan bertarung dengan\lPelatih mana pun di sini sebanyak

yang kamu mau. Jika kamu perlu
penjelasan tentang tipe pertarungan\ldi sini, silakan datang dan bicara

denganku.

entries.original:
"Battles here are fought utilizing
the [green]Camomons[red] battle format.

In a Camomons battle, all Pokémon
become the same types as their\lfirst two moves.

For instance, if a Pokémon’s first
two moves are Ember and Water Gun,\lthen it will become a Fire- and\lWater-type."
entries.translation_source: Battles here are fought utilizing the [color-green-1]Camomons[color-red-2] battle format. In a Camomons battle, all Pokémon become the same types as their first two moves. For instance, if a Pokémon’s first two moves are Ember and Water Gun, then it will become a Fire- and Water-type.
entries.translated:
Pertarungan di sini dilakukan
menggunakan format pertarungan\l[green]Camomons[red]. Dalam pertarungan

Camomons, semua Pokémon menjadi
tipe yang sama dengan dua jurus\lpertama mereka. Misalnya, jika dua

jurus pertama Pokémon adalah Ember
dan Water Gun, maka ia akan menjadi\ltipe Api dan Air.

entries.original:
"Woah! You spotted me behind this
tree! Impressive!"
entries.translation_source: Woah! You spotted me behind this tree! Impressive!
entries.translated:
Woah! Kamu melihatku di balik pohon
ini! Hebat!

entries.original:
"What!?
This isn’t a good hiding place?"
entries.translation_source: What!? This isn’t a good hiding place?
entries.translated:
Apa!? Ini bukan tempat
persembunyian yang bagus?

entries.original:
"Listen, listen! Can you tell me
what kind of Pokémon you have?"
entries.translation_source: Listen, listen! Can you tell me what kind of Pokémon you have?
entries.translated:
Dengar, dengar! Bisakah kamu
memberitahuku jenis Pokémon apa\lyang kamu miliki?

entries.original:
"You’re so tough.
I’m stunned\."
entries.translation_source: You’re so tough. I’m stunned[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Kamu sangat tangguh. Aku terpana\.

entries.original:
"The [green]Timer Ball[red] may not be useful at
the start of battle, but it’s\lgreat for long, drawn out battles\lwith legendary Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Timer Ball[color-red-2] may not be useful at the start of battle, but it’s great for long, drawn out battles with legendary Pokémon.
entries.translated:
[green]Timer Ball[red] mungkin tidak berguna di
awal pertarungan, tapi bagus untuk\lpertarungan panjang dengan Pokémon

legendaris.

entries.original:
"Forget Timer Balls, the [green]Heavy Ball[blue]
is the ideal Ball for capturing\llegendary Pokémon!

Many of them are super heavy, and
the Heavy Ball winds up having a\lbetter chance to capture any of\lthem than a maxed Timer Ball.

Don’t believe me?

Just set your [green]Last Used Ball[blue] to
[green]Always Best Ball[blue] in the [green]Options\lMenu[blue] and see for yourself!

You can buy Heavy Balls out in the
[green]marketplace[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Forget Timer Balls, the [color-green-1]Heavy Ball[color-blue-2] is the ideal Ball for capturing legendary Pokémon! Many of them are super heavy, and the Heavy Ball winds up having a better chance to capture any of them than a maxed Timer Ball. Don’t believe me? Just set your [color-green-3]Last Used Ball[color-blue-4] to [color-green-5]Always Best Ball[color-blue-6] in the [color-green-7]Options Menu[color-blue-8] and see for yourself! You can buy Heavy Balls out in the [color-green-9]marketplace[color-blue-10].
entries.translated:
Lupakan Timer Ball, [green]Heavy Ball[blue]
adalah Ball yang ideal untuk\lmenangkap Pokémon legendaris!

Banyak dari mereka sangat berat,
dan Heavy Ball memiliki peluang\llebih baik untuk menangkapnya

dibandingkan Timer Ball maksimal.
Tidak percaya? Cukup atur [green]Last Used\lBall[blue] menjadi [green]Always Best Ball[blue] di

[green]Options Menu[blue] dan lihat sendiri!
Kamu bisa membeli Heavy Ball di\l[green]pasar[blue].

entries.original:
"Battling in the [green]Camomons
Battle House[blue] is a great way to\ltrain your Pokémon quickly.

But don’t forget to set the order
of your Pokémon’s moves before\lbattling there!"
entries.translation_source: Battling in the [color-green-1]Camomons Battle House[color-blue-2] is a great way to train your Pokémon quickly. But don’t forget to set the order of your Pokémon’s moves before battling there!
entries.translated:
Bertarung di [green]Camomons Battle House[blue]
adalah cara yang bagus untuk\lmelatih Pokémon-mu dengan cepat.

Tapi jangan lupa untuk mengatur
urutan jurus Pokémon-mu sebelum\lbertarung di sana!

entries.original:
"I hear one of the vendors in the
market sells special Poké Balls\limported all the way from Johto!"
entries.translation_source: I hear one of the vendors in the market sells special Poké Balls imported all the way from Johto!
entries.translated:
Kudengar salah satu penjual di
pasar menjual Poké Ball khusus yang\ldiimpor langsung dari Johto!

entries.original:
"Some days I can hear a sad cry
reverberating across the crates."
entries.translation_source: Some days I can hear a sad cry reverberating across the crates.
entries.translated:
Beberapa hari aku bisa mendengar
tangisan sedih yang bergema di\lpeti-peti.

entries.original:
"Do you hear that?

I’ve been hearing that Pokémon’s
cry all day.

It sounds very sad and lonely,
don’t you think?"
entries.translation_source: Do you hear that? I’ve been hearing that Pokémon’s cry all day. It sounds very sad and lonely, don’t you think?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu mendengarnya? Aku sudah
mendengar tangisan Pokémon itu\lsepanjang hari. Kedengarannya

sangat sedih dan kesepian,
menurutmu?

entries.original: "[green]Kyu! Kyu!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Kyu! Kyu!
entries.translated: [green]Kyu! Kyu!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] ran off into the
warehouse."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] ran off into the warehouse.
entries.translated: [buffer1] lari ke gudang.

entries.original: "Shadow Base"
entries.translation_source: Shadow Base
entries.translated: Shadow Base

entries.original: "Emotional"
entries.translation_source: Emotional

entries.original:
"A mysterious hideout built into
the side of a mountain.
Who does it belong to?"
entries.translation_source: A mysterious hideout built into the side of a mountain. Who does it belong to?

entries.original:
"The door requires a Key Card with
Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened."
entries.translation_source: The door requires a Key Card with Clearance Level: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3], to be opened.
entries.translated:
Pintu ini memerlukan Kartu Kunci
dengan Level Akses: [green][buffer1][black], untuk\ldibuka.

entries.original:
"The door requires a Key Card with
Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened.

Open it?"
entries.translation_source: The door requires a Key Card with Clearance Level: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3], to be opened. Open it?
entries.translated:
Pintu ini memerlukan Kartu Kunci
dengan Level Akses: [green][buffer1][black], untuk\ldibuka. Buka?

entries.original:
"Bingo!
The Key Card opened the door!"
entries.translation_source: Bingo! The Key Card opened the door!
entries.translated: Bingo! Kartu Kunci membuka pintu!

entries.original: "The door is open\."
entries.translation_source: The door is open[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Pintu terbuka\.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] seems lonely.
Accept it onto your team?"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] seems lonely. Accept it onto your team?
entries.translated:
[buffer1] tampak kesepian. Terima ke
dalam timmu?

entries.original: "The [buffer1] is sad."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] is sad.
entries.translated: [buffer1] sedih.

entries.original:
"Huh?

It looks like [green][buffer1][black] wants to
come out of its Poké Ball and walk\laround with you!

Let [green][buffer1][black] out?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? It looks like [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3] wants to come out of its Poké Ball and walk around with you! Let [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-black-6] out?
entries.translated:
Hah? Sepertinya [green][buffer1][black] ingin
keluar dari Poké Ball-nya dan\lberjalan-jalan bersamamu! Keluarkan

[green][buffer1][black]?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] started walking behind
you!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] started walking behind you!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] mulai berjalan di
belakangmu!

entries.original:
"[buffer1] will return to its
Poké Ball if you leave the room."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] will return to its Poké Ball if you leave the room.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] akan kembali ke Poké
Ball-nya jika kamu meninggalkan\lruangan.

entries.original:
"[buffer1] is happily following
behind you."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] is happily following behind you.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] dengan senang mengikutimu
dari belakang.

entries.original:
"Oh? It looks like [buffer1] wants
you to have something it found."
entries.translation_source: Oh? It looks like [buffer1-1] wants you to have something it found.
entries.translated:
Oh? Sepertinya [buffer1] ingin kamu
memiliki sesuatu yang ditemukannya.

entries.original:
"That guy\. he just came out of
nowhere\."
entries.translation_source: That guy[game-token-1] he just came out of nowhere[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Orang itu\. dia muncul entah dari
mana\.

entries.original: "Wiped out in an instant\."
entries.translation_source: Wiped out in an instant[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Lenyap dalam sekejap\.

entries.original:
"This guy with red hair just came
out of nowhere and knocked out all\lof my Pokémon before I even had a\lchance to react!

Now I can’t even stop you
from escaping\."
entries.translation_source: This guy with red hair just came out of nowhere and knocked out all of my Pokémon before I even had a chance to react! Now I can’t even stop you from escaping[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Orang berambut merah ini muncul
entah dari mana dan mengalahkan\lsemua Pokémonku sebelum aku sempat

bereaksi! Sekarang aku bahkan tidak
bisa menghentikanmu melarikan diri\.

entries.original:
"The door appears to have been
blown apart."
entries.translation_source: The door appears to have been blown apart.
entries.translated:
Pintu ini tampaknya telah
diledakkan.

entries.original:
"Oh, sir!

Some guy with red hair blasted his
way in here!

I tried to stop him, but he just
shoved me aside."
entries.translation_source: Oh, sir! Some guy with red hair blasted his way in here! I tried to stop him, but he just shoved me aside.
entries.translated:
Oh, Tuan! Seseorang berambut merah
menerobos masuk ke sini! Aku\lmencoba menghentikannya, tapi dia

hanya mendorongku ke samping.

entries.original: "Which floor would you like, sir?"
entries.translation_source: Which floor would you like, sir?
entries.translated:
Lantai berapa yang Anda inginkan,
Tuan?

entries.original: "Which floor do you want?"
entries.translation_source: Which floor do you want?
entries.translated: Lantai berapa yang kamu mau?

entries.original: "You’re already on this floor\."
entries.translation_source: You’re already on this floor[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Kamu sudah di lantai ini\.

entries.translation_source: 1F
entries.translated: 1F

entries.original: "B1F"
entries.translation_source: B1F
entries.translated: B1F

entries.original: "B2F"
entries.translation_source: B2F
entries.translated: B2F

entries.original: "B3F"
entries.translation_source: B3F
entries.translated: B3F

entries.original:
"Marlon, sir!

I know what it looks like, but I
promise, I’m not slacking off!

Zeph told me to watch the news and
keep an eye out for anyone who\llooks like they might belong to\lthe Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, sir! I know what it looks like, but I promise, I’m not slacking off! Zeph told me to watch the news and keep an eye out for anyone who looks like they might belong to the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Marlon, Pak! Saya tahu ini
kelihatannya seperti saya\lbermalas-malasan, tapi saya janji,

saya tidak bermalas-malasan! Zeph
menyuruh saya untuk menonton berita\ldan mengawasi siapa pun yang

mungkin berasal dari Light of Ruin.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry about the huge mess in
the base, sir.

When most of the grunts left to
join the Light of Ruin, they just\ldropped all of their things on\lthe floor.

I’m sure some of them even left
their [green]clearance cards[red] behind\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry about the huge mess in the base, sir. When most of the grunts left to join the Light of Ruin, they just dropped all of their things on the floor. I’m sure some of them even left their [color-green-1]clearance cards[color-red-2] behind[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Maaf atas kekacauan besar di
markas, Pak. Saat sebagian besar\langgota bawahan pergi bergabung

dengan Light of Ruin, mereka
menjatuhkan semua barang mereka di\llantai. Saya yakin beberapa dari

mereka bahkan meninggalkan [green]kartu
izin[red] mereka\.

entries.original:
"Marlon, sir!

I heard rumours that you joined
the Light of Ruin, too.

I’m glad you’re still here.

Maybe now that you’re back, someone
will finally be able to keep Zeph\lfrom doing anything too rash\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, sir! I heard rumours that you joined the Light of Ruin, too. I’m glad you’re still here. Maybe now that you’re back, someone will finally be able to keep Zeph from doing anything too rash[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Marlon, Pak! Saya dengar rumor
bahwa Anda juga bergabung dengan\lLight of Ruin. Saya senang Anda

masih di sini. Mungkin sekarang
Anda kembali, seseorang akhirnya\lbisa menghentikan Zeph dari

melakukan sesuatu yang terlalu
gegabah\.

entries.original:
"The base has been so quiet ever
since most of the grunts were\lordered to join the Light of Ruin.

To be honest, sir, I was ordered to
go, too, but I refused.

I didn’t join this organization
because I wanted money.

I joined because I believed in what
Zeph was trying to achieve\."
entries.translation_source: The base has been so quiet ever since most of the grunts were ordered to join the Light of Ruin. To be honest, sir, I was ordered to go, too, but I refused. I didn’t join this organization because I wanted money. I joined because I believed in what Zeph was trying to achieve[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Markas menjadi sangat sepi sejak
sebagian besar anggota bawahan\ldiperintahkan untuk bergabung

dengan Light of Ruin. Sejujurnya,
Pak, saya juga diperintahkan untuk\lpergi, tapi saya menolak. Saya

tidak bergabung dengan organisasi
ini karena ingin uang. Saya\lbergabung karena saya percaya pada

apa yang Zeph coba capai\.

entries.original:
"With most of the other grunts gone,
our manpower has become very\llimited.

So, it is essential that each of us
become as strong as possible.

Would you allow me the privilege of
battling with you, sir?"
entries.translation_source: With most of the other grunts gone, our manpower has become very limited. So, it is essential that each of us become as strong as possible. Would you allow me the privilege of battling with you, sir?
entries.translated:
Dengan sebagian besar anggota
bawahan lainnya pergi, tenaga kerja\lkita menjadi sangat terbatas. Jadi,

sangat penting bagi kita
masing-masing untuk menjadi sekuat\lmungkin. Apakah Anda mengizinkan

saya hak istimewa untuk bertarung
dengan Anda, Pak?

entries.original:
"Thank you for battling with me,
sir.

Now, we’re both more prepared for
the inevitable confrontation with\lthe Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for battling with me, sir. Now, we’re both more prepared for the inevitable confrontation with the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih telah bertarung dengan
saya, Pak. Sekarang, kita berdua\llebih siap untuk konfrontasi yang

tak terhindarkan dengan Light of
Ruin.

entries.original:
"Of course, sir.

I wouldn’t expect you to waste your
time on a grunt such as myself."
entries.translation_source: Of course, sir. I wouldn’t expect you to waste your time on a grunt such as myself.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Pak. Saya tidak akan
mengharapkan Anda membuang waktu\luntuk seorang bawahan seperti saya.

entries.original:
"An obnoxiously loud episode of a
Unova Pokémon Musical is on.

Watch for too long and it might
fry your brain."
entries.translation_source: An obnoxiously loud episode of a Unova Pokémon Musical is on. Watch for too long and it might fry your brain.
entries.translated:
Episode Pokemon Musical Unova yang
sangat berisik sedang diputar.\lTerlalu lama menontonnya bisa

membuat otakmu digoreng.

entries.original:
"Sir!

Zeph has ordered me to stop anyone
without the proper clearance from\lentering the lab.

However, I’m sure it’s fine if I
allow you in."
entries.translation_source: Sir! Zeph has ordered me to stop anyone without the proper clearance from entering the lab. However, I’m sure it’s fine if I allow you in.
entries.translated:
Pak! Zeph telah memerintahkan saya
untuk menghentikan siapa pun yang\ltidak memiliki izin yang tepat

untuk memasuki laboratorium. Namun,
saya yakin tidak apa-apa jika saya\lmengizinkan Anda masuk.

entries.original:
"Please feel free to enter the
lab, sir."
entries.translation_source: Please feel free to enter the lab, sir.
entries.translated: Silakan masuk ke laboratorium, Pak.

entries.original:
"I’m using a complicated algorithm
to determine the approximate\llocation of the Light of Ruin HQ.

Once I have the results, Zeph plans
on using the information to take\lhis revenge on the Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: I’m using a complicated algorithm to determine the approximate location of the Light of Ruin HQ. Once I have the results, Zeph plans on using the information to take his revenge on the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Saya menggunakan algoritma rumit
untuk menentukan perkiraan lokasi\lmarkas Light of Ruin. Begitu saya

mendapatkan hasilnya, Zeph
berencana menggunakan informasi itu\luntuk membalas dendam pada Light of

Ruin.

entries.original:
"Oh, Marlon, sir!

I spent some time back at HQ with
the Science Society, and learned\labout a new way to make our\lPokémon stronger in battles!

Would you like to see it?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, Marlon, sir! I spent some time back at HQ with the Science Society, and learned about a new way to make our Pokémon stronger in battles! Would you like to see it?
entries.translated:
Oh, Marlon, Pak! Saya menghabiskan
waktu di markas bersama Science\lSociety, dan belajar tentang cara

baru untuk membuat Pokemon kita
lebih kuat dalam pertempuran!\lApakah Anda ingin melihatnya?

entries.original:
"For spending your valuable time
battling me, I’d like to thank you\lby healing your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: For spending your valuable time battling me, I’d like to thank you by healing your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sebagai ucapan terima kasih karena
telah meluangkan waktu berharga\lAnda untuk bertarung dengan saya,

saya ingin berterima kasih dengan
menyembuhkan Pokemon Anda.

entries.original:
"Of course, sir.

I’m sure you have much more
important business to attend to."
entries.translation_source: Of course, sir. I’m sure you have much more important business to attend to.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, Pak. Saya yakin Anda
memiliki urusan yang jauh lebih\lpenting untuk diurus.

entries.original:
"Great care is being taken in
synthesizing this next batch of\lShadow Warriors.

These Shadow Warriors will be the
strongest we’ve ever created!

They’ll be invincible!

And the Light of Ruin will stand no
chance against them!"
entries.translation_source: Great care is being taken in synthesizing this next batch of Shadow Warriors. These Shadow Warriors will be the strongest we’ve ever created! They’ll be invincible! And the Light of Ruin will stand no chance against them!
entries.translated:
Perhatian besar diberikan dalam
mensintesis kumpulan Shadow\lWarriors berikutnya. Shadow

Warriors ini akan menjadi yang
terkuat yang pernah kita ciptakan!\lMereka akan kebal! Dan Light of

Ruin tidak akan punya peluang
melawan mereka!

entries.original:
"They wanted us to go back to HQ
and stop making Shadow Warriors.

STOP MAKING SHADOW WARRIORS!?

ARE YOU KIDDING ME!?

Creating Shadow Warriors is all I
live for!

I’m fortunate that Zeph still had a
use for more and allowed me to\lcontinue synthesizing them."
entries.translation_source: They wanted us to go back to HQ and stop making Shadow Warriors. STOP MAKING SHADOW WARRIORS!? ARE YOU KIDDING ME!? Creating Shadow Warriors is all I live for! I’m fortunate that Zeph still had a use for more and allowed me to continue synthesizing them.
entries.translated:
Mereka ingin kita kembali ke markas
dan berhenti membuat Shadow\lWarriors. BERHENTI MEMBUAT SHADOW

WARRIORS!? APA KAMU BERCANDA!?
Menciptakan Shadow Warriors adalah\lsemua yang saya jalani! Saya

beruntung bahwa Zeph masih
membutuhkan lebih banyak dan\lmengizinkan saya untuk terus

mensintesis mereka.

entries.original:
"Something grotesque is being
synthesized in the tube."
entries.translation_source: Something grotesque is being synthesized in the tube.
entries.translated:
Sesuatu yang mengerikan sedang
disintesis di dalam tabung.

entries.original: "The tube is empty."
entries.translation_source: The tube is empty.
entries.translated: Tabungnya kosong.

entries.original: "The cage is empty."
entries.translation_source: The cage is empty.
entries.translated: Kandang itu kosong.

entries.original:
"Someone has been experimenting
today\."
entries.translation_source: Someone has been experimenting today[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Seseorang telah bereksperimen hari
ini\.

entries.original:
"Ah, [player]\. it is good of you to
visit us.

I have been trying to live a more
honourable life since I was\lreleased from prison.

I owe my son, of course, every
effort to make sure this second\lchance does not go to waste.

Having toiled for years to see him
return to me, I plan to let the\lyounger generation guide the future\lfrom now on.

As for me, my only desire is to spend
what time I have with Zeph Jr.

Ah, yes\. would you care to spar with
me, if you have time?

My son seems to have grown rather
fond of Pokémon battles, after all."
entries.translation_source: Ah, [player-name-1][game-token-2] it is good of you to visit us. I have been trying to live a more honourable life since I was released from prison. I owe my son, of course, every effort to make sure this second chance does not go to waste. Having toiled for years to see him return to me, I plan to let the younger generation guide the future from now on. As for me, my only desire is to spend what time I have with Zeph Jr. Ah, yes[game-token-3] would you care to spar with me, if you have time? My son seems to have grown rather fond of Pokémon battles, after all.
entries.translated:
Ah, [player]\. baik kamu mengunjungi
kami. Saya telah berusaha menjalani\lhidup yang lebih terhormat sejak

dibebaskan dari penjara. Tentu
saja, saya berhutang budi pada anak\lsaya, setiap usaha untuk memastikan

kesempatan kedua ini tidak sia-sia.
Setelah bekerja keras selama\lbertahun-tahun untuk melihatnya

kembali kepada saya, saya berencana
untuk membiarkan generasi muda\lmemandu masa depan mulai sekarang.

Adapun saya, satu-satunya keinginan
saya adalah menghabiskan waktu yang\lsaya miliki bersama Zeph Jr. Ah, ya\.

maukah kamu bertanding denganku,
jika kamu punya waktu? Anak saya\ltampaknya sudah sangat menyukai

pertarungan Pokémon, bagaimanapun
juga.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes\. would you care to spar with
me, if you have time?

My son seems to have grown rather
fond of Pokémon battles, after all."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes[game-token-1] would you care to spar with me, if you have time? My son seems to have grown rather fond of Pokémon battles, after all.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya\. apakah Anda bersedia
bertarung dengan saya, jika Anda\lpunya waktu? Anak saya tampaknya

menjadi sangat menyukai pertarungan
Pokémon, lagipula.

entries.original:
"I see\. yes, I suppose there’s not
much reason for us to be at each\lother’s throats\.

Peace may have returned to us, but
it needn’t be anything more than a\lfriendly competition.

If you change your mind, I would be
willing to take you on, anytime."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] yes, I suppose there’s not much reason for us to be at each other’s throats[game-token-2] Peace may have returned to us, but it needn’t be anything more than a friendly competition. If you change your mind, I would be willing to take you on, anytime.
entries.translated:
Saya mengerti\. ya, saya kira tidak
ada banyak alasan bagi kita untuk\lsaling bermusuhan\. Perdamaian

mungkin telah kembali kepada kita,
tetapi itu tidak perlu lebih dari\lsekadar persaingan yang bersahabat.

Jika Anda berubah pikiran, saya
akan bersedia menerima tantangan\lAnda, kapan saja.

entries.original:
"Finally, a chance presents itself, to
fight with a clear conscience\.

Well, [player], don’t expect me to
hold back.

I have to put on a good showing for
my son, after all!"
entries.translation_source: Finally, a chance presents itself, to fight with a clear conscience[game-token-1] Well, [player-name-2], don’t expect me to hold back. I have to put on a good showing for my son, after all!
entries.translated:
Akhirnya, ada kesempatan untuk
bertarung dengan hati nurani yang\lbersih\. Nah, [player], jangan harap

aku akan menahan diri. Lagipula,
aku harus tampil baik untuk anakku!

entries.original:
"I don’t think I’ve felt so satisfied
after a loss, in a good long time.

I should really thank you,
[player].

Your actions not only brought my son
back to me\.

But I should also be grateful you
took time from your busy life to\lkeep him amused.

Please, accept this gift from me."
entries.translation_source: I don’t think I’ve felt so satisfied after a loss, in a good long time. I should really thank you, [player-name-1]. Your actions not only brought my son back to me[game-token-2] But I should also be grateful you took time from your busy life to keep him amused. Please, accept this gift from me.
entries.translated:
Kurasa aku belum pernah merasa
begitu puas setelah kekalahan,\lsudah lama sekali. Aku benar-benar

harus berterima kasih padamu,
[player]. Tindakanmu tidak hanya\lmembawa anakku kembali kepadaku\.

Tetapi aku juga harus bersyukur
karena kamu meluangkan waktu dari\lkesibukanmu untuk menghiburnya.

Tolong, terimalah hadiah ini
dariku.

entries.original:
"The Z-Crystal is for the Pokémon
[green]Decidueye[blue].

If it knows [green][buffer1][blue], it can power
it up into a devastating Z-Move."
entries.translation_source: The Z-Crystal is for the Pokémon [color-green-1]Decidueye[color-blue-2]. If it knows [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-blue-5], it can power it up into a devastating Z-Move.
entries.translated:
Batu Z adalah untuk Pokémon
[green]Decidueye[blue]. Jika ia tahu [green][buffer1][blue],\lia dapat menguatkannya menjadi

Jurus Z yang dahsyat.

entries.original:
"Thank you again for that battle.

Even if I lost again, as long as it
makes my son happy, then that’s all\lthat really matters to me.

Feel free to come another day if you
wish to spar again, sometime."
entries.translation_source: Thank you again for that battle. Even if I lost again, as long as it makes my son happy, then that’s all that really matters to me. Feel free to come another day if you wish to spar again, sometime.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih lagi untuk pertarungan
itu. Meskipun aku kalah lagi,\lselama itu membuat anakku bahagia,

maka itulah yang benar-benar
penting bagiku. Jangan ragu untuk\ldatang lagi di lain hari jika kamu

ingin bertanding lagi, suatu saat
nanti.

entries.original:
"Whoa!

You’re the Trainer that helped my
daddy bring me back from the dark\lplace!

You’re so cool!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa! You’re the Trainer that helped my daddy bring me back from the dark place! You’re so cool!
entries.translated:
Wah! Kamu adalah Pelatih yang
membantu ayahku membawaku kembali\ldari tempat gelap! Kamu keren

sekali!

entries.original:
"Whoa!

Your battle with my daddy was so
fun to watch.

I wanna be a Pokémon Trainer when
I grow up, too!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa! Your battle with my daddy was so fun to watch. I wanna be a Pokémon Trainer when I grow up, too!
entries.translated:
Wah! Pertarunganmu dengan ayahku
sangat menyenangkan untuk ditonton.\lAku juga ingin menjadi Pelatih

Pokémon saat aku besar nanti!

entries.original:
"Frozen Heights

An island town on a frozen lake."
entries.translation_source: Frozen Heights An island town on a frozen lake.
entries.translated:
Frozen Heights Sebuah kota pulau di
danau beku.

entries.original: "Log Pokémon Research Lab"
entries.translation_source: Log Pokémon Research Lab
entries.translated: Log Laboratorium Riset Pokémon

entries.original: "[player]’s Residence"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]’s Residence
entries.translated: Kediaman [player]

entries.original: "[rival]’s Residence"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]’s Residence
entries.translated: Rumah [rival]

entries.original:
"It’s a list of things [rival]
is planning to do.

Better get going!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a list of things [text-token-rival-1] is planning to do. Better get going!
entries.translated:
Ini adalah daftar hal yang [rival]
rencanakan untuk dilakukan. Lebih\lbaik berangkat sekarang!

"Route 1
\qoSnowy Mountain Pass\qc

\au Frozen Heights
\ad Bellin Town, Icicle Cave"
entries.translation_source: Route 1 [quote-open-1]Snowy Mountain Pass[quote-close-2] [game-token-3] Frozen Heights [game-token-4] Bellin Town, Icicle Cave
entries.translated:
Rute 1 \qoJalur Gunung Salju\qc \au
Ketinggian Beku \ad Kota Bellin, Gua\lEs

entries.original:
"Route 1
\qoSnowy Mountain Pass\qc

\au Frozen Heights
\ad Bellin Town\l\al Icicle Cave"
entries.translation_source: Route 1 [quote-open-1]Snowy Mountain Pass[quote-close-2] [game-token-3] Frozen Heights [game-token-4] Bellin Town [game-token-5] Icicle Cave
entries.translated:
Rute 1 \qoJalur Gunung Bersalju\qc \au
Dataran Tinggi Beku \ad Kota Bellin \al\lGua Es

entries.original:
"Bellin Town

A quiet town nestled deep in the
mountains."
entries.translation_source: Bellin Town A quiet town nestled deep in the mountains.
entries.translated:
Bellin Town, sebuah kota tenang
yang terletak jauh di dalam\lpegunungan.

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Ice-type Pokémon, Articuno.

It says here that Articuno was once
used to reinforce a seal on a great\ldarkness, but now it likes to\ltravel between Frost Mountain\land Frozen Heights."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Ice-type Pokémon, Articuno. It says here that Articuno was once used to reinforce a seal on a great darkness, but now it likes to travel between Frost Mountain and Frozen Heights.
entries.translated:
Ini adalah patung Pokémon
Legendaris tipe Es, Articuno. Di\lsini tertulis bahwa Articuno

dulunya digunakan untuk memperkuat
segel pada kegelapan besar, tetapi\lsekarang ia suka bepergian antara

Gunung Frost dan Frozen Heights.

entries.original:
"Icicle Cave
Passage"
entries.translation_source: Icicle Cave Passage
entries.translated: Jalur Gua Icicle

entries.original:
"Route 2
\qoOcean Lane\qc

\al Dresco Town
\ar Icicle Cave, Route 15"
entries.translation_source: Route 2 [quote-open-1]Ocean Lane[quote-close-2] [game-token-3] Dresco Town [game-token-4] Icicle Cave, Route 15
entries.translated:
Rute 2 \qoOcean Lane\qc \al Dresco Town \ar
Icicle Cave, Rute 15

entries.original:
"Dresco Town

The archipelago of the Borrius
Region."
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town The archipelago of the Borrius Region.
entries.translated:
Dresco Town Kepulauan dari Wilayah
Borrius.

entries.original:
"Dresco Town Pokémon Gym
Leader: Mirskle\lThe Mellow Master of Flowers"
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town Pokémon Gym Leader: Mirskle The Mellow Master of Flowers
entries.translated:
Dresco Town Pemimpin Gym Pokémon:
Mirskle Sang Master Bunga yang\lLembut

entries.original:
"Trainer House

Battle to your heart’s content!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer House Battle to your heart’s content!
entries.translated: Rumah Trainer Bertarung sepuasnya!

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Fire-type Pokémon, Moltres.

It says here that Moltres was once
used to reinforce a seal on a great\ldarkness, but now it resides in\lCinder Volcano."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Fire-type Pokémon, Moltres. It says here that Moltres was once used to reinforce a seal on a great darkness, but now it resides in Cinder Volcano.

kota? Warga didorong untuk
meninggalkan rumah mereka dan\lmemulihkan Kota Antisis ke

kejayaannya dahulu.

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

Don’t walk away from these signs
until you’ve read them completely!

Every single one contains important
information that will help you out\lduring your adventure.

Skipping text on these signs will
likely cost you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Trainer Tips! Don’t walk away from these signs until you’ve read them completely! Every single one contains important information that will help you out during your adventure. Skipping text on these signs will likely cost you!
entries.translated:
[black]Tips Pelatih! Jangan menjauh dari
papan-papan ini sampai kamu\lmembacanya semua! Setiap papan

berisi informasi penting yang akan
membantumu selama petualangan.\lMelewatkan teks di papan-papan ini

kemungkinan akan merugikanmu!

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

Hold \btn01 to change the default
movement speed!

Press \btn02 to toggle auto-run!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Trainer Tips! Hold [button-icon-2] to change the default movement speed! Press [button-icon-3] to toggle auto-run!
entries.translated:
[black]Tips Pelatih! Tahan \btn01 untuk
mengubah kecepatan gerak default!\lTekan \btn02 untuk mengalihkan

lari-otomatis!

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

Open the [green]Options[black] Menu to enable
Save Prompts and Quick HMs!

If [green]Save Prompts[black] are turned on, you
will be asked if you’d like to save\lbefore or after important events!

If [green]Quick HMs[black] are turned on, Field
Moves can be used without needing\lconfirmation each use!

Additionally, \btn02 and \btn03 can be used
to scroll between pages of options!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Trainer Tips! Open the [color-green-2]Options[color-black-3] Menu to enable Save Prompts and Quick HMs! If [color-green-4]Save Prompts[color-black-5] are turned on, you will be asked if you’d like to save before or after important events! If [color-green-6]Quick HMs[color-black-7] are turned on, Field Moves can be used without needing confirmation each use! Additionally, [button-icon-8] and [button-icon-9] can be used to scroll between pages of options!
entries.translated:
[black]Tips Pelatih! Buka Menu [green]Options[black]
untuk mengaktifkan Save Prompts dan\lQuick HMs! Jika [green]Save Prompts[black]

diaktifkan, kamu akan ditanya
apakah ingin menyimpan sebelum atau\lsesudah peristiwa penting! Jika

[green]Quick HMs[black] diaktifkan, Gerakan
Lapangan dapat digunakan tanpa\lperlu konfirmasi setiap kali!

Selain itu, \btn02 dan \btn03 dapat digunakan
untuk menggulir antar halaman opsi!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Pokémon can gain Exp. Points by
battling other Pokémon.

Exp. Points help them grow
stronger.

And your Pokémon will still get
Exp. Points even if you catch a\lPokémon you are battling against!

But keep in mind, if your Pokémon
level up too much, other Trainers\lwill get stronger as well.

In order to prevent issues from
arising due to overleveling such\las increased difficulty, a hard\llevel cap may be enabled from the\l[green]Options Menu[black] by setting [green]Exp. Gain[black]\lto [green]Capped Exp. Share[black]."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Pokémon can gain Exp. Points by battling other Pokémon. Exp. Points help them grow stronger. And your Pokémon will still get Exp. Points even if you catch a Pokémon you are battling against! But keep in mind, if your Pokémon level up too much, other Trainers will get stronger as well. In order to prevent issues from arising due to overleveling such as increased difficulty, a hard level cap may be enabled from the [color-green-1]Options Menu[color-black-2] by setting [color-green-3]Exp. Gain[color-black-4] to [color-green-5]Capped Exp. Share[color-black-6].
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Pokémon dapat
memperoleh Poin Exp. dengan\lbertarung melawan Pokémon lain.

Poin Exp. membantu mereka menjadi
lebih kuat. Dan Pokémon-mu akan\ltetap mendapatkan Poin Exp. bahkan

jika kamu menangkap Pokémon yang
sedang kamu lawan! Namun perlu\ldiingat, jika Pokémon-mu naik level

terlalu banyak, Pelatih lain juga
akan menjadi lebih kuat. Untuk\lmencegah masalah yang timbul akibat

level berlebih seperti peningkatan
kesulitan, batas level keras dapat\ldiaktifkan dari [green]Menu Options[black] dengan

mengatur [green]Perolehan Exp.[black] menjadi
[green]Capped Exp. Share[black].

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

If you talk to this Chansey, your
Pokémon will be fully healed!

Whenever you lose a battle, you’ll
be returned to this point as well!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! If you talk to this Chansey, your Pokémon will be fully healed! Whenever you lose a battle, you’ll be returned to this point as well!
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Jika kamu berbicara
dengan Chansey ini, Pokémon-mu akan\lsembuh total! Setiap kali kamu

kalah dalam pertarungan, kamu akan
dikembalikan ke titik ini juga!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Any Pokémon that participates in
battle receives full Exp. Points.

If the [green]Exp. Share[black] is enabled in
the [green]Options[black] Menu, any Pokémon\lthat didn’t participate will still\lreceive a portion of the Exp.\lPoints earned in battle."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Any Pokémon that participates in battle receives full Exp. Points. If the [color-green-1]Exp. Share[color-black-2] is enabled in the [color-green-3]Options[color-black-4] Menu, any Pokémon that didn’t participate will still receive a portion of the Exp. Points earned in battle.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Pokémon apa pun yang
berpartisipasi dalam pertarungan\lmenerima Poin Exp. penuh. Jika [green]Exp.

Share[black] diaktifkan di Menu [green]Options[black],
Pokémon yang tidak berpartisipasi\lakan tetap menerima sebagian dari

Poin Exp. yang diperoleh dalam
pertarungan.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

When selecting an attack in battle,
certain symbols may appear.

This is based on the move’s
effectiveness against the target.

A green [green]\au[black] indicates that the move
is super effective.

A yellow [orange]\ad[black] indicates the move is
not very effective.

A red [lightgreen]*[black] indicates that the move
doesn’t affect the target at all.

And a \+ symbol indicates the move
has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! When selecting an attack in battle, certain symbols may appear. This is based on the move’s effectiveness against the target. A green [color-green-1][game-token-2][color-black-3] indicates that the move is super effective. A yellow [color-orange-4][game-token-5][color-black-6] indicates the move is not very effective. A red [color-lightgreen-7]*[color-black-8] indicates that the move doesn’t affect the target at all. And a [game-token-9] symbol indicates the move has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Saat memilih serangan
dalam pertarungan, simbol tertentu\lmungkin muncul. Ini didasarkan pada

efektivitas gerakan terhadap
target. [green]\au[black] hijau menunjukkan bahwa\lgerakan tersebut sangat efektif. [orange]\ad[black]

kuning menunjukkan gerakan tersebut
tidak terlalu efektif. [lightgreen]*[black] merah\lmenunjukkan bahwa gerakan tersebut

tidak berpengaruh sama sekali pada
target. Dan simbol \+ menunjukkan\lbahwa gerakan tersebut memiliki

Bonus Serangan Tipe Sama.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

The [green]Item Restrictions[black] option lets
you choose how many items you can\luse in battle!

If you choose [green]No Items[black], then no
Trainers will be able to use any\leither!

At minimum, [green]4 Items Only[black] must be
set for [green]Expert[black], and [green]No Items[black] must\lbe set for [green]Insane[black].

If you’re feeling extra ambitious,
setting it to [green]Enemy Trainer Only[black]\lwill allow your opponents to use\litems while preventing you!

This last choice works for any
difficulty."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! The [color-green-1]Item Restrictions[color-black-2] option lets you choose how many items you can use in battle! If you choose [color-green-3]No Items[color-black-4], then no Trainers will be able to use any either! At minimum, [color-green-5]4 Items Only[color-black-6] must be set for [color-green-7]Expert[color-black-8], and [color-green-9]No Items[color-black-10] must be set for [color-green-11]Insane[color-black-12]. If you’re feeling extra ambitious, setting it to [color-green-13]Enemy Trainer Only[color-black-14] will allow your opponents to use items while preventing you! This last choice works for any difficulty.
entries.translated:
Tips Pelatih! Opsi [green]Pembatasan Item[black]
memungkinkan Anda memilih berapa\lbanyak item yang dapat digunakan

dalam pertempuran! Jika Anda
memilih [green]Tanpa Item[black], maka tidak ada\lPelatih yang dapat menggunakan item

juga! Setidaknya, [green]Hanya 4 Item[black]
harus diatur untuk [green]Expert[black], dan\l[green]Tanpa Item[black] harus diatur untuk

[green]Insane[black]. Jika Anda merasa sangat
ambisius, mengaturnya ke [green]Hanya\lPelatih Lawan[black] akan memungkinkan

lawan Anda menggunakan item
sementara mencegah Anda! Pilihan\lterakhir ini berfungsi untuk

tingkat kesulitan apa pun.
