entries.original: "Tarmigan Town"
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town
entries.translated: Kota Tarmigan

entries.original: "Tarmigan Town D"
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town D

entries.original: "Tarmigan Town N"
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town N

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is located on the
\qoThundercap Highland\qc.

But if you came to see the
lightning storms, you’re out\lof luck.

Those only happen to the east of
here, by Epidimy Town."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is located on the [quote-open-1]Thundercap Highland[quote-close-2]. But if you came to see the lightning storms, you’re out of luck. Those only happen to the east of here, by Epidimy Town.
entries.translated:
Kota Tarmigan terletak di
\qoThundercap Highland\qc. Tapi jika\lkamu datang untuk melihat badai

petir, kamu kurang beruntung. Itu
hanya terjadi di sebelah timur\lsini, dekat Kota Epidimy.

entries.original:
"I work at the facility over here
called the Dream Research Lab.

We do exactly as it sounds, we
research dreams.

My line of work is related to
harvesting a special kind of\lmist from the Pokémon Musharna.

Unfortunately, it isn’t going
so well.

So far, I’ve only managed to get
one capsule’s worth of mist.

Since a single capsule is useless
to me, you can have it."
entries.translation_source: I work at the facility over here called the Dream Research Lab. We do exactly as it sounds, we research dreams. My line of work is related to harvesting a special kind of mist from the Pokémon Musharna. Unfortunately, it isn’t going so well. So far, I’ve only managed to get one capsule’s worth of mist. Since a single capsule is useless to me, you can have it.
entries.translated:
Aku bekerja di fasilitas di sini
yang disebut Dream Research Lab.\lKami melakukan persis seperti

namanya, kami meneliti mimpi.
Pekerjaanku terkait dengan memanen\lsejenis kabut khusus dari Pokémon

Musharna. Sayangnya, tidak berjalan
dengan baik. Sejauh ini, aku hanya\lberhasil mendapatkan satu kapsul

kabut. Karena satu kapsul tidak
berguna bagiku, kau boleh\lmemilikinya.

entries.original:
"The [green]Dream Mist[blue] can be used to give
a Pokémon its Hidden Ability.

There is no going back once this
change is made.

I’d give you more if I could, but
our Musharna doesn’t seem to be\lproducing much anymore.

If you can find your own Musharna
to fight, it may release some Dream\lMist if you can defeat it."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Dream Mist[color-blue-2] can be used to give a Pokémon its Hidden Ability. There is no going back once this change is made. I’d give you more if I could, but our Musharna doesn’t seem to be producing much anymore. If you can find your own Musharna to fight, it may release some Dream Mist if you can defeat it.
entries.translated:
The [green]Dream Mist[blue] dapat digunakan
untuk memberikan Pokémon Kemampuan\lTersembunyi. Tidak ada jalan

kembali setelah perubahan ini
dilakukan. Aku akan memberimu lebih\ljika bisa, tapi Musharna kami

sepertinya tidak banyak memproduksi
lagi. Jika kamu bisa menemukan\lMusharnamu sendiri untuk bertarung,

ia mungkin melepaskan sedikit Dream
Mist jika kamu bisa mengalahkannya.

entries.original:
"Ever since ancient times, the
mythical Pokémon Darkrai has\lhaunted this town.

If you look hard enough, you can
even see the spirits of the poor\lsouls haunted by Darkrai.

Be wary, child!
Don’t fall into the dark void!"
entries.translation_source: Ever since ancient times, the mythical Pokémon Darkrai has haunted this town. If you look hard enough, you can even see the spirits of the poor souls haunted by Darkrai. Be wary, child! Don’t fall into the dark void!
entries.translated:
Sejak zaman kuno, Pokémon mitos
Darkrai telah menghantui kota ini.\lJika kamu cukup jeli, kamu bahkan

bisa melihat roh dari jiwa-jiwa
malang yang dihantui Darkrai.\lBerhati-hatilah, anak muda! Jangan

jatuh ke dalam kehampaan gelap!

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is so secluded in
the mountains; it doesn’t have its\lown entrance to the [green]KBT Expressway[red]!

If you wanna go down the mountain,
you’ll have to walk or ask the\lteleporter to send you down."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is so secluded in the mountains; it doesn’t have its own entrance to the [color-green-1]KBT Expressway[color-red-2]! If you wanna go down the mountain, you’ll have to walk or ask the teleporter to send you down.
entries.translated:
Kota Tarmigan sangat terpencil di
pegunungan; kota ini tidak memiliki\lpintu masuk sendiri ke [green]KBT

Expressway[red]! Jika kamu ingin turun
gunung, kamu harus berjalan kaki\latau meminta teleporter untuk

mengirimmu turun.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, a very thorough cleaning
of the mansion is being undertaken\lat the moment.

If you wish to challenge the
Successor, please come back later."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, a very thorough cleaning of the mansion is being undertaken at the moment. If you wish to challenge the Successor, please come back later.
entries.translated:
Maaf, sedang dilakukan pembersihan
menyeluruh di mansion saat ini.\lJika Anda ingin menantang Penerus,

silakan kembali lagi nanti.

entries.original:
"My family has owned Tarmigan
Mansion for generations.

In fact, my ancestors were
responsible for the formation of\lTarmigan Town itself!

As such, I like to sit out here and
watch the town every now and then.

Don’t just sit around like me,
youngster.

Carpe diem, child!
Seize the day!"
entries.translation_source: My family has owned Tarmigan Mansion for generations. In fact, my ancestors were responsible for the formation of Tarmigan Town itself! As such, I like to sit out here and watch the town every now and then. Don’t just sit around like me, youngster. Carpe diem, child! Seize the day!
entries.translated:
Keluarga saya telah memiliki
Tarmigan Mansion selama beberapa\lgenerasi. Bahkan, nenek moyang saya

bertanggung jawab atas pembentukan
Kota Tarmigan sendiri! Oleh karena\litu, saya suka duduk di sini dan

mengamati kota sesekali. Jangan
hanya duduk seperti saya, anak\lmuda. Carpe diem, anak! Ambil

kesempatan!

entries.original:
"[black]The little girl vanished.

Was she even there to begin with?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little girl vanished. Was she even there to begin with?
entries.translated:
[black]Gadis kecil itu menghilang. Apakah
dia benar-benar ada di sana sejak\lawal?

entries.original:
"Did you come up here to obtain the
power of [green]Mega Evolution[blue] from\l[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]?

Most people who come here are
usually after it.

This town doesn’t have much to
offer otherwise, other than the\lhorrific nightmares, of course."
entries.translation_source: Did you come up here to obtain the power of [color-green-1]Mega Evolution[color-blue-2] from [color-green-3]Tarmigan Mansion[color-blue-4]? Most people who come here are usually after it. This town doesn’t have much to offer otherwise, other than the horrific nightmares, of course.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu datang ke sini untuk
mendapatkan kekuatan [green]Mega Evolusi[blue]\ldari [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]? Kebanyakan

orang yang datang ke sini biasanya
mencarinya. Kota ini tidak punya\lbanyak hal lain untuk ditawarkan,

selain mimpi buruk yang mengerikan,
tentu saja.

entries.original:
"So you got what you came for, eh?

Now that the power of Mega
Evolution is yours, what’s next?

Z-Moves?

I hear they like to use those a
lot in East Borrius.

But why wait until you get there?

Your [buffer1] can easily
activate Z-Moves as well!

So what are you waiting for?

Start collecting Z-Crystals
already!"
entries.translation_source: So you got what you came for, eh? Now that the power of Mega Evolution is yours, what’s next? Z-Moves? I hear they like to use those a lot in East Borrius. But why wait until you get there? Your [buffer1-1] can easily activate Z-Moves as well! So what are you waiting for? Start collecting Z-Crystals already!
entries.translated:
Jadi kamu mendapatkan apa yang kamu
cari, ya? Sekarang setelah kekuatan\lMega Evolusi menjadi milikmu, apa

selanjutnya? Gerakan Z? Kudengar
mereka suka menggunakannya di\lBorrius Timur. Tapi kenapa harus

menunggu sampai di sana? [buffer1]mu
juga bisa dengan mudah mengaktifkan\lGerakan Z! Jadi tunggu apa lagi?

Mulailah mengumpulkan Kristal Z
sekarang!

entries.original:
"You’ll never be able to beat my
super, rare, awesome, Sandslash!

I got it all the way up in this
hidden section of Icicle Cave!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll never be able to beat my super, rare, awesome, Sandslash! I got it all the way up in this hidden section of Icicle Cave!
entries.translated:
Kamu tidak akan pernah bisa
mengalahkan Sandslash-ku yang\lsuper, langka, dan keren! Aku

mendapatkannya di bagian
tersembunyi Gua Es ini!

entries.original:
"Oh yeah?

Well, my Miltank is super powerful,
too!

I got it in the Magnolia Fields!
You’re going down!"
entries.translation_source: Oh yeah? Well, my Miltank is super powerful, too! I got it in the Magnolia Fields! You’re going down!
entries.translated:
Oh ya? Nah, Miltank-ku juga sangat
kuat! Aku mendapatkannya di Ladang\lMagnolia! Kamu akan kalah!

entries.original:
"There’s been this locked house
near [green]Tarmigan Mansion[red] for a\lreally long time.

I think it was once a small inn
for visitors of this town.

But it closed down after the
guests started suffering from\lhorrendous nightmares."
entries.translation_source: There’s been this locked house near [color-green-1]Tarmigan Mansion[color-red-2] for a really long time. I think it was once a small inn for visitors of this town. But it closed down after the guests started suffering from horrendous nightmares.
entries.translated:
Sudah lama ada rumah terkunci di
dekat [green]Tarmigan Mansion[red]. Kurasa dulu\litu adalah penginapan kecil untuk

pengunjung kota ini. Tapi tutup
setelah para tamu mulai menderita\lmimpi buruk yang mengerikan.

entries.original:
"There’s been this locked house
near Tarmigan Mansion for a\lreally long time.

But for some reason it’s open now\."
entries.translation_source: There’s been this locked house near Tarmigan Mansion for a really long time. But for some reason it’s open now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sudah lama ada rumah terkunci di
dekat Tarmigan Mansion. Tapi entah\lkenapa sekarang terbuka\.

entries.original:
"Hi!
Do you have a [green][buffer1][blue]?

Want to trade it for my
[green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Do you have a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]? Want to trade it for my [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]?
entries.translated:
Hai! Apakah kamu punya [green][buffer1][blue]?
Mau menukarnya dengan [green][buffer2][blue]\lmilikku?

entries.original:
"Sister, I’ve been rejected, yet
again."
entries.translation_source: Sister, I’ve been rejected, yet again.
entries.translated: Kakak, aku ditolak lagi.

entries.original:
"You should have just said no.

That’s very much not a [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: You should have just said no. That’s very much not a [buffer1-1].
entries.translated:
Kamu seharusnya bilang tidak saja.
Itu jelas bukan [buffer1].

entries.original:
"Thanks! Anyone ever tell you that
you’re a real pal?"
entries.translation_source: Thanks! Anyone ever tell you that you’re a real pal?
entries.translated:
Terima kasih! Ada yang pernah
bilang kamu benar-benar teman?

entries.original:
"How is my old [buffer2]?
My [buffer1] is doing great!

I’ve been feeding it lots and lots
of sweet Berries."
entries.translation_source: How is my old [buffer2-1]? My [buffer1-2] is doing great! I’ve been feeding it lots and lots of sweet Berries.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana [buffer2] lamaku?
[buffer1]ku baik-baik saja! Aku\lmemberinya banyak Beri manis.

entries.original:
"Listen up, youngster.

That swindler over there is
constantly extorting [green]Red Shards[blue]\lfrom youngsters, like yourself.

Here, I stole a couple from his
collection for you to enjoy."
entries.translation_source: Listen up, youngster. That swindler over there is constantly extorting [color-green-1]Red Shards[color-blue-2] from youngsters, like yourself. Here, I stole a couple from his collection for you to enjoy.
entries.translated:
Dengar, anak muda. Penipu di sana
terus-menerus memeras [green]Serpihan\lMerah[blue] dari anak muda sepertimu.

Ini, aku mencuri beberapa dari
koleksinya untukmu.

entries.original:
"I hold by the principle that it is
permitted to steal from thieves."
entries.translation_source: I hold by the principle that it is permitted to steal from thieves.
entries.translated:
Saya berpegang pada prinsip bahwa
diperbolehkan mencuri dari pencuri.

entries.original:
"Those are some hot hands ya got
there, fella!

You wannem to burn up with
fiery power?

I can teach your Pokémon [green]Fire
Punch[blue] for just [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Those are some hot hands ya got there, fella! You wannem to burn up with fiery power? I can teach your Pokémon [color-green-1]Fire Punch[color-blue-2] for just [color-green-3][buffer2-4] [buffer1-5]s[color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Tanganmu panas sekali, kawan! Kamu
mau tanganmu terbakar dengan\lkekuatan api? Aku bisa mengajari

Pokémon-mu [green]Pukulan Api[blue] hanya dengan
[green][buffer2] [buffer1][blue]!

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon is raring to fire up
their hands with [green]Fire Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is raring to fire up their hands with [color-green-1]Fire Punch[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Pokémon mana yang siap untuk
membakar tangannya dengan [green]Pukulan\lApi[blue]?

entries.original: "Fire power!"
entries.translation_source: Fire power!
entries.translated: Kekuatan api!

entries.original:
"Fizzle\.
You don’t have enough [green][buffer1]s[blue].

I can’t burn up those hands
for nothing\."
entries.translation_source: Fizzle[game-token-1] You don’t have enough [color-green-2][buffer1-3]s[color-blue-4]. I can’t burn up those hands for nothing[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Gagal\. Kamu tidak punya cukup
[green][buffer1][blue]. Aku tidak bisa membakar\ltangan itu tanpa imbalan\.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over
[buffer2] [buffer1][buffer3]."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over [buffer2-3] [buffer1-4][buffer3-5].
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer2]
[buffer1][buffer3].

entries.original:
"[blue]\.Welcome\.

\.
\.Kekeke\.

We’ve had a reservation for you.
We’ve held it for a long time\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][game-token-2]Welcome[game-token-3] [game-token-4] [game-token-5]Kekeke[game-token-6] We’ve had a reservation for you. We’ve held it for a long time[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
[blue]\.Selamat datang\. \. \.Kekeke\. Kami sudah
memiliki reservasi untukmu. Kami\ltelah menahannya untuk waktu yang

lama\.

entries.original:
"[player] lay down on the bed as if
bidden there."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] lay down on the bed as if bidden there.
entries.translated:
[player] berbaring di tempat tidur
seolah disuruh ke sana.

entries.original: "[player] awakened!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] awakened!
entries.translated: [player] terbangun!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon walking around this
lab all assist in the research.

They’re all special Pokémon known
for their connection to dreams."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon walking around this lab all assist in the research. They’re all special Pokémon known for their connection to dreams.
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon yang berjalan di
sekitar lab ini membantu dalam\lpenelitian. Mereka semua adalah

Pokémon spesial yang dikenal karena
hubungannya dengan mimpi.

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s the Champion!

We’re developing a special Poké
Ball, here at the Dream Research\lLab, and we’d be honoured if you’d\ltest it out for us!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s the Champion! We’re developing a special Poké Ball, here at the Dream Research Lab, and we’d be honoured if you’d test it out for us!
entries.translated:
Oh, ini sang Juara! Kami sedang
mengembangkan Poké Ball khusus di\lLaboratorium Penelitian Mimpi, dan

kami akan merasa terhormat jika
Anda mau mencobanya untuk kami!

entries.original:
"Those are [green]Dream Balls[blue].

They’re better for capturing
Pokémon that are [green]asleep[blue].

Any Pokémon caught with them will
also have its [green]Hidden Ability[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Those are [color-green-1]Dream Balls[color-blue-2]. They’re better for capturing Pokémon that are [color-green-3]asleep[color-blue-4]. Any Pokémon caught with them will also have its [color-green-5]Hidden Ability[color-blue-6].
entries.translated:
Itu adalah [green]Bola Mimpi[blue]. Mereka lebih
baik untuk menangkap Pokémon yang\l[green]tertidur[blue]. Semua Pokémon yang

ditangkap dengan mereka juga akan
memiliki [green]Kemampuan Tersembunyi[blue].

entries.original:
"In the Unova region, a scientist
named Fennel created a device that\lallows people to enter the dreams\lof their Pokémon.

We’re working on our own version of
the device for humans.

The goal is to allow people to go
back and relive their worst\lnightmare."
entries.translation_source: In the Unova region, a scientist named Fennel created a device that allows people to enter the dreams of their Pokémon. We’re working on our own version of the device for humans. The goal is to allow people to go back and relive their worst nightmare.
entries.translated:
Di wilayah Unova, seorang ilmuwan
bernama Fennel menciptakan\lperangkat yang memungkinkan orang

memasuki mimpi Pokémon mereka. Kami
sedang mengerjakan versi perangkat\lkami sendiri untuk manusia.

Tujuannya adalah untuk memungkinkan
orang kembali dan mengalami kembali\lmimpi buruk terburuk mereka.

entries.original:
"I’ve done it!

I’ve managed to create a device
capable of sending people back\linto their worst nightmare!

And I can tell\.

You were sent to a nightmarish
world of nothingness, where you\lencountered illusions of your\lfriends and family, yes?

And then you fought a giant Pokémon
that loved plunging your Pokémon\linto a deep sleep, over and again,\lyes?

\.It’s all in your eyes.

My machine can use that trauma
to send you there again!

\.Why would you want to go
back there?

Well, they say that confronting
your worst nightmare a second\ltime can show you a path to the\lheavens itself!

However, you will needs relics
connected to the heavens for this\lto work.

I believe people can dig such
relics up with the ADM\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve done it! I’ve managed to create a device capable of sending people back into their worst nightmare! And I can tell[game-token-1] You were sent to a nightmarish world of nothingness, where you encountered illusions of your friends and family, yes? And then you fought a giant Pokémon that loved plunging your Pokémon into a deep sleep, over and again, yes? [game-token-2]It’s all in your eyes. My machine can use that trauma to send you there again! [game-token-3]Why would you want to go back there? Well, they say that confronting your worst nightmare a second time can show you a path to the heavens itself! However, you will needs relics connected to the heavens for this to work. I believe people can dig such relics up with the ADM[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Aku berhasil! Aku berhasil
menciptakan alat yang bisa mengirim\lorang kembali ke mimpi buruk

terburuk mereka! Dan aku bisa tahu\.
Kamu dikirim ke dunia kekosongan\lyang penuh mimpi buruk, di mana

kamu bertemu ilusi dari teman dan
keluargamu, ya? Lalu kamu bertarung\lmelawan Pokémon raksasa yang suka

membuat Pokémon-mu tertidur lelap,
berulang kali, ya? \.Semua itu ada di\lmatamu. Mesinku bisa menggunakan

trauma itu untuk mengirimmu ke sana
lagi! \.Kenapa kamu ingin kembali ke\lsana? Yah, kata mereka, menghadapi

mimpi buruk terburukmu untuk kedua
kalinya bisa menunjukkan jalan\lmenuju surga itu sendiri! Namun,

kamu akan membutuhkan relik yang
terhubung dengan surga agar ini\lberhasil. Aku percaya orang bisa

menggali relik semacam itu dengan
ADM\.

entries.original:
"Huh?

It seems my machine is reacting to
those Plates in your Cube!

Would you like me to activate my
machine and send you back into\lyour worst nightmare?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? It seems my machine is reacting to those Plates in your Cube! Would you like me to activate my machine and send you back into your worst nightmare?
entries.translated:
Hah? Sepertinya mesinku bereaksi
terhadap Plat-Plat di Kubusmu!\lApakah kamu ingin aku mengaktifkan

mesinku dan mengirimmu kembali ke
mimpi buruk terburukmu?

entries.original:
"It seems my machine is reacting to
those Plates in your Cube!

Would you like me to activate my
machine and send you back into\lyour worst nightmare?"
entries.translation_source: It seems my machine is reacting to those Plates in your Cube! Would you like me to activate my machine and send you back into your worst nightmare?
entries.translated:
Sepertinya mesinku bereaksi
terhadap Piring-piring itu di\lKubusmu! Apakah kamu ingin aku

mengaktifkan mesinku dan mengirimmu
kembali ke dalam mimpi buruk\lterburukmu?

entries.original:
"B-but science!

Think of all the possibilities!"
entries.translation_source: B-but science! Think of all the possibilities!
entries.translated:
T-tapi sains! Pikirkan semua
kemungkinan!

entries.original:
"Okay, let me just flip this switch,
and\."
entries.translation_source: Okay, let me just flip this switch, and[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Baiklah, biar saya balikkan saklar
ini, dan\.

entries.original:
"The machine has been activated!

You’ll be entering a dream-like
state, any moment now.

I’ll try to hijack someone found
in your memory so I can keep tabs\lon you while you’re under.

Just come find me whenever you’re
ready to leave."
entries.translation_source: The machine has been activated! You’ll be entering a dream-like state, any moment now. I’ll try to hijack someone found in your memory so I can keep tabs on you while you’re under. Just come find me whenever you’re ready to leave.
entries.translated:
Mesin telah diaktifkan! Kamu akan
memasuki keadaan seperti mimpi,\lsebentar lagi. Aku akan mencoba

membajak seseorang yang ditemukan
dalam ingatanmu agar aku bisa\lmemantau kamu selagi kamu

terpengaruh. Temui saja aku kapan
pun kamu siap untuk pergi.

entries.original:
"Are you ready to wake up and return
to Tarmigan Town?"
entries.translation_source: Are you ready to wake up and return to Tarmigan Town?
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu siap untuk bangun dan
kembali ke Tarmigan Town?

entries.original:
"I’ll be using this body to keep
tabs on you.

Speak to it when you’re ready
to leave."
entries.translation_source: I’ll be using this body to keep tabs on you. Speak to it when you’re ready to leave.
entries.translated:
Aku akan menggunakan tubuh ini
untuk mengawasimu. Bicaralah\lpadanya saat kamu siap pergi.

entries.original:
"Did you enjoy reliving your
worst nightmare?

As long as you bring those Plates,
I can send you there, again!"
entries.translation_source: Did you enjoy reliving your worst nightmare? As long as you bring those Plates, I can send you there, again!
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu menikmati mengalami
kembali mimpi buruk terburukmu?\lSelama kamu membawa Piring-piring

itu, aku bisa mengirimmu ke sana,
lagi!

entries.original:
"Huh?

My machine isn’t reacting to your
Cube anymore.

Did you take those Plates out
of it?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? My machine isn’t reacting to your Cube anymore. Did you take those Plates out of it?
entries.translated:
Huh? Mesin saya tidak bereaksi
terhadap Cube kamu lagi. Apakah\lkamu mengambil Lempengan-lempengan

itu darinya?

entries.original:
"All of the Pokémon found in this
laboratory eat dreams.

They do this using the unique
[green]Dream Eater[red] move.

Your Pokémon are capable of
learning it, too!"
entries.translation_source: All of the Pokémon found in this laboratory eat dreams. They do this using the unique [color-green-1]Dream Eater[color-red-2] move. Your Pokémon are capable of learning it, too!
entries.translated:
Semua Pokémon yang ditemukan di
laboratorium ini memakan mimpi.\lMereka melakukannya menggunakan

jurus unik [green]Dream Eater[red]. Pokémon-mu
juga bisa mempelajarinya!

entries.original:
"[green]Dream Eater[red] allows you to do damage
and restore HP at the same time!

But it only works if the target
is sleeping\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Dream Eater[color-red-2] allows you to do damage and restore HP at the same time! But it only works if the target is sleeping[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[green]Dream Eater[red] memungkinkan Anda untuk
memberikan damage dan memulihkan HP\lpada saat yang sama! Tapi hanya

berfungsi jika target sedang tidur\.

entries.original: "[green]Naaa!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Naaa!
entries.translated: [green]Naaa!

entries.original: "[green]Mmm\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Mmm[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Mmm\.

entries.original: "[green]Gar!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gar!
entries.translated: [green]Gar!

entries.original: "[green]Hyyyyyyyyypno\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hyyyyyyyyypno[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Hyyyyyyyyypno\.

entries.original: "Tarmigan Mansion"
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Mansion
entries.translated: Tarmigan Mansion

entries.original:
"An ancient mansion present in
Tarmigan Town since its founding.
Defeat the master of the mansion to
obtain the power of Mega Evolution!"
entries.translation_source: An ancient mansion present in Tarmigan Town since its founding. Defeat the master of the mansion to obtain the power of Mega Evolution!

entries.original:
"Somewhere in this house resides
Successor Maxima.

If you find her, she’ll give you
something special."
entries.translation_source: Somewhere in this house resides Successor Maxima. If you find her, she’ll give you something special.
entries.translated:
Di suatu tempat di rumah ini
tinggal Successor Maxima. Jika kamu\lmenemukannya, dia akan memberikan

sesuatu yang istimewa kepadamu.

entries.original:
"A switch is hidden in one of the
statues in the mansion.

If you manage to find it, it will
open up a new passageway."
entries.translation_source: A switch is hidden in one of the statues in the mansion. If you manage to find it, it will open up a new passageway.
entries.translated:
Sebuah sakelar tersembunyi di salah
satu patung di mansion. Jika kamu\lberhasil menemukannya, itu akan

membuka jalan baru.

entries.original:
"There are plenty of different
healing methods available to you\lin the mansion.

It’s honestly a little redundant\."
entries.translation_source: There are plenty of different healing methods available to you in the mansion. It’s honestly a little redundant[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ada banyak metode penyembuhan yang
berbeda tersedia untukmu di\lmansion. Sejujurnya itu agak

berlebihan\.

entries.original:
"As chefs, it is our sworn duty to
prepare the finest quality food for\lthe master of this mansion.

That being Successor Maxima,
of course."
entries.translation_source: As chefs, it is our sworn duty to prepare the finest quality food for the master of this mansion. That being Successor Maxima, of course.
entries.translated:
Sebagai koki, adalah tugas suci
kami untuk menyiapkan makanan\ldengan kualitas terbaik untuk tuan

dari rumah besar ini. Tentu saja,
yaitu Penerus Maxima.

entries.original:
"Some Berries like the [green]Occa Berry[blue]
and [green]Passho Berry[blue] reduce the amount\lof damage Pokémon receive from\l[green]super-effective[blue] moves.

Like all Berries, they’re [green]one-time
use[blue] only in regular battles.

But I hear stronger Pokémon in
[green]Hidden Grottos[blue] tend to drop them\lfrequently after battles\."
entries.translation_source: Some Berries like the [color-green-1]Occa Berry[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Passho Berry[color-blue-4] reduce the amount of damage Pokémon receive from [color-green-5]super-effective[color-blue-6] moves. Like all Berries, they’re [color-green-7]one-time use[color-blue-8] only in regular battles. But I hear stronger Pokémon in [color-green-9]Hidden Grottos[color-blue-10] tend to drop them frequently after battles[game-token-11]
entries.translated:
Beberapa Berry seperti [green]Occa Berry[blue]
dan [green]Passho Berry[blue] mengurangi jumlah\lkerusakan yang diterima Pokémon

dari [green]serangan super efektif[blue].
Seperti semua Berry, mereka [green]sekali\lpakai[blue] hanya dalam pertempuran

biasa. Tapi saya dengar Pokémon
yang lebih kuat di [green]Hidden Grottos[blue]\lcenderung menjatuhkannya sering

setelah pertempuran\.

entries.original:
"There are some Berries like the
[green]Kee Berry[blue] and [green]Maranga Berry[blue] that\lare really hard to come by.

Whenever our master ingredient
gatherer happens to come across\lone, we make sure to cook it\linto a delectable meal."
entries.translation_source: There are some Berries like the [color-green-1]Kee Berry[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Maranga Berry[color-blue-4] that are really hard to come by. Whenever our master ingredient gatherer happens to come across one, we make sure to cook it into a delectable meal.
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Berry seperti [green]Kee
Berry[blue] dan [green]Maranga Berry[blue] yang sangat\lsulit didapatkan. Kapan pun

pengumpul bahan utama kami
kebetulan menemukan salah satunya,\lkami pastikan untuk memasaknya

menjadi hidangan yang lezat.

entries.original:
"Berries like the [green]Liechi Berry[blue] and
[green]Salac Berry[blue] are only eaten by\lPokémon in a [green]pinch[blue]!

What’s a pinch?

That’s simple!

A [green]pinch[blue] is whenever the health bar
shows [lightgreen]red[blue].

But for Pokémon with the ability
[green]Gluttony[blue], a pinch is whenever the\lhealth bar shows [orange]yellow[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Berries like the [color-green-1]Liechi Berry[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Salac Berry[color-blue-4] are only eaten by Pokémon in a [color-green-5]pinch[color-blue-6]! What’s a pinch? That’s simple! A [color-green-7]pinch[color-blue-8] is whenever the health bar shows [color-lightgreen-9]red[color-blue-10]. But for Pokémon with the ability [color-green-11]Gluttony[color-blue-12], a pinch is whenever the health bar shows [color-orange-13]yellow[color-blue-14].
entries.translated:
Beri seperti [green]Beri Liechi[blue] dan [green]Beri
Salak[blue] hanya dimakan oleh Pokémon\ldalam keadaan [green]genting[blue]! Apa itu

keadaan genting? Sederhana! Keadaan
[green]genting[blue] adalah saat bilah kesehatan\lmenunjukkan warna [lightgreen]merah[blue]. Tapi untuk

Pokémon dengan kemampuan [green]Kerakusan[blue],
keadaan genting adalah saat bilah\lkesehatan menunjukkan warna [orange]kuning[blue].

entries.original:
"I got stuck on dishes duty\.
What a drag\.

Everyone else gets to cook and
talk about Berries\."
entries.translation_source: I got stuck on dishes duty[game-token-1] What a drag[game-token-2] Everyone else gets to cook and talk about Berries[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Aku terjebak tugas cuci piring\.
Menyebalkan sekali\. Yang lain semua\lbisa memasak dan berbicara tentang

Beri\.

entries.original:
"Here, enjoy these fresh handpicked
ingredients from the garden."
entries.translation_source: Here, enjoy these fresh handpicked ingredients from the garden.
entries.translated:
Ini, nikmatilah bahan-bahan segar
yang dipetik langsung dari kebun.

entries.original:
"I’m responsible for gathering the
daily ingredients."
entries.translation_source: I’m responsible for gathering the daily ingredients.
entries.translated:
Saya bertanggung jawab untuk
mengumpulkan bahan-bahan harian.

entries.original: "Maxima"
entries.translation_source: Maxima
entries.translated: Maxima

entries.original:
"There’s a switch somewhere that
opens up a path to Maxima."
entries.translation_source: There’s a switch somewhere that opens up a path to Maxima.
entries.translated:
Ada saklar di suatu tempat yang
membuka jalan menuju Maxima.

entries.original:
"I probably won’t get anywhere if I
keep standing here."
entries.translation_source: I probably won’t get anywhere if I keep standing here.
entries.translated:
Aku mungkin tidak akan ke mana-mana
jika terus berdiri di sini.

entries.original:
"I need to grow even stronger to
surpass the others."
entries.translation_source: I need to grow even stronger to surpass the others.
entries.translated:
Aku harus menjadi lebih kuat lagi
untuk melampaui yang lain.

entries.original: "Welcome to the top floor, kid."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the top floor, kid.
entries.translated:
Selamat datang di lantai teratas,
nak.

entries.original: "You’re not even close to the end."
entries.translation_source: You’re not even close to the end.
entries.translated: Kamu bahkan belum mendekati akhir.

entries.original:
"I’d say this point in the challenge
is around the mid-point."
entries.translation_source: I’d say this point in the challenge is around the mid-point.
entries.translated:
Menurutku, titik dalam tantangan
ini adalah sekitar pertengahan.

entries.original:
"A statue with a switch?
Never heard of it."
entries.translation_source: A statue with a switch? Never heard of it.
entries.translated:
Patung dengan sakelar? Belum pernah
dengar.

entries.original: "Super-de-duper-de-doo!"
entries.translation_source: Super-de-duper-de-doo!
entries.translated: Super-de-duper-de-doo!

entries.original:
"Unlike the other experts, I’m still
young and free!"
entries.translation_source: Unlike the other experts, I’m still young and free!
entries.translated:
Tidak seperti para ahli lainnya,
aku masih muda dan bebas!

entries.original: "Dragons can Mega Evolve, too!"
entries.translation_source: Dragons can Mega Evolve, too!
entries.translated: Naga juga bisa Mega Evolve!

entries.original: "Not just yet, though!"
entries.translation_source: Not just yet, though!
entries.translated: Tapi belum sekarang!

entries.original:
"One day, my dragons will soar high
in their Mega Evolved forms!"
entries.translation_source: One day, my dragons will soar high in their Mega Evolved forms!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, naga-nagaku akan
terbang tinggi dalam bentuk Mega\lEvolved mereka!

entries.original:
"If you can fight your way through
this mansion, you can learn the\lsacred art of Mega Evolution."
entries.translation_source: If you can fight your way through this mansion, you can learn the sacred art of Mega Evolution.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa bertarung melewati
rumah besar ini, kamu bisa belajar\lseni suci Mega Evolution.

entries.original:
"You’d better hope you have enough
healing items."
entries.translation_source: You’d better hope you have enough healing items.
entries.translated:
Kamu sebaiknya berharap memiliki
cukup item penyembuh.

entries.original: "The end is nigh."
entries.translation_source: The end is nigh.
entries.translated: Akhir sudah dekat.

entries.original:
"Child, where do you think
you’re going?"
entries.translation_source: Child, where do you think you’re going?
entries.translated:
Anak kecil, ke mana kamu pikir kamu
pergi?

entries.original:
"To obtain the power of
Mega Evolution?"
entries.translation_source: To obtain the power of Mega Evolution?
entries.translated:
Untuk mendapatkan kekuatan Mega
Evolution?

entries.original:
"Remember this: power corrupts, and
absolute power corrupts absolutely.

The same can be said about
Mega Evolution.

Be careful."
entries.translation_source: Remember this: power corrupts, and absolute power corrupts absolutely. The same can be said about Mega Evolution. Be careful.
entries.translated:
Ingat ini: kekuasaan korup, dan
kekuasaan mutlak korup mutlak. Hal\lyang sama bisa dikatakan tentang

Mega Evolution. Hati-hati.

entries.original:
"Whenever you’re ready to face
Maxima, just walk off the ledge.

Don’t worry, it won’t hurt."
entries.translation_source: Whenever you’re ready to face Maxima, just walk off the ledge. Don’t worry, it won’t hurt.
entries.translated:
Kapan pun kamu siap menghadapi
Maxima, langsung saja berjalan dari\ltepian. Jangan khawatir, tidak akan

sakit.

entries.original:
"Hello there, Trainer.

I am the Mansion’s Successor,
Maxima.

If you’re here, then I should
congratulate you for navigating\lyour way to me.

I presume, like many others, you
have come here seeking the power\lof [green]Mega Evolution[red]?

\.

As I thought.

However, it is one thing to \qowant\qc.
It is quite another to \qodeserve\qc.

You see, Mega Evolution is only
possible when both Trainer and\lPokémon share a deep bond.

Yet, there are those who visit me,
focused only on what perceived\lpower can be achieved with\lMega Evolution.

And the bonds that make Mega
Evolution possible\.\CC0818 are not always\lbonds of friendship and love.

So, if I am to pass on such a
technique to someone, it must be\lsomeone of both skill, and a\lnatural love for Pokémon.

This shall be my final test."
entries.translation_source: Hello there, Trainer. I am the Mansion’s Successor, Maxima. If you’re here, then I should congratulate you for navigating your way to me. I presume, like many others, you have come here seeking the power of [color-green-1]Mega Evolution[color-red-2]? [game-token-3] As I thought. However, it is one thing to [quote-open-4]want[quote-close-5]. It is quite another to [quote-open-6]deserve[quote-close-7]. You see, Mega Evolution is only possible when both Trainer and Pokémon share a deep bond. Yet, there are those who visit me, focused only on what perceived power can be achieved with Mega Evolution. And the bonds that make Mega Evolution possible[game-token-8][control-code-9] are not always bonds of friendship and love. So, if I am to pass on such a technique to someone, it must be someone of both skill, and a natural love for Pokémon. This shall be my final test.
entries.translated:
Halo, Trainer. Aku adalah Penerus
Mansion, Maxima. Jika kamu di sini,\lmaka aku harus mengucapkan selamat

karena berhasil menemukan jalanku.
Aku menduga, seperti banyak\llainnya, kamu datang ke sini

mencari kekuatan [green]Mega Evolution[red]? \.
Seperti yang kuduga. Namun, satu\lhal adalah \qomenginginkan\qc. Hal lain

adalah \qopantas\qc. Kamu lihat, Mega
Evolution hanya mungkin terjadi\lketika Trainer dan Pokémon berbagi

ikatan yang dalam. Namun, ada yang
datang kepadaku, hanya fokus pada\lkekuatan yang dirasakan dapat

dicapai dengan Mega Evolution. Dan
ikatan yang membuat Mega Evolution\lmungkin\.\CC0818 tidak selalu ikatan

persahabatan dan cinta. Jadi, jika
aku harus mewariskan teknik seperti\litu kepada seseorang, itu harus

seseorang yang memiliki
keterampilan dan cinta alami\lterhadap Pokémon. Ini akan menjadi

ujian terakhirku.

entries.original:
"Triumph over me, and show me you are
worthy of wielding my greatest gift!"
entries.translation_source: Triumph over me, and show me you are worthy of wielding my greatest gift!
entries.translated:
Kalahkan aku, dan tunjukkan bahwa
kamu layak menggunakan hadiah\lterbesarku!

entries.original:
"How amazing\.\CC0818 truly, you have shown
that you can be trusted to use\lthis power, responsibly and without\lreckless abandon.

I bestow upon you, then, your very
own Mega Keystone.

Yet before I do\.\CC0818 I’d like you to
choose a suitable vessel for it.

Fu fu fu\.\CC0818 not to worry.
They are functionally identical.

Just\.\CC0818 choose the one that
suits you best."
entries.translation_source: How amazing[game-token-1][control-code-2] truly, you have shown that you can be trusted to use this power, responsibly and without reckless abandon. I bestow upon you, then, your very own Mega Keystone. Yet before I do[game-token-3][control-code-4] I’d like you to choose a suitable vessel for it. Fu fu fu[game-token-5][control-code-6] not to worry. They are functionally identical. Just[game-token-7][control-code-8] choose the one that suits you best.
entries.translated:
Sungguh menakjubkan\.\CC0818 sungguh, kamu
telah menunjukkan bahwa kamu bisa\ldipercaya untuk menggunakan

kekuatan ini, dengan bertanggung
jawab dan tanpa gegabah. Maka, aku\lberikan kepadamu, Mega Keystone

milikmu sendiri. Namun sebelum aku
melakukannya\.\CC0818 aku ingin kamu memilih\lwadah yang cocok untuknya. Fu fu fu\.\CC0818

jangan khawatir. Mereka secara
fungsional identik. Hanya\.\CC0818 pilih\lyang paling cocok untukmu.

entries.original:
"Just\.\CC0818 choose the one that
suits you best."
entries.translation_source: Just[game-token-1][control-code-2] choose the one that suits you best.
entries.translated:
Hanya\.\CC0818 pilih yang paling cocok
untukmu.

entries.original:
"You would like the
[green][buffer1][red]?"
entries.translation_source: You would like the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]?
entries.translated: Kamu menginginkan [green][buffer1][red]?

entries.original:
"I see.

Yes, I think you do carry that
[buffer1] very well, myself.

Anyway, you now have the power to
[green]Mega Evolve[red] your Pokémon.

For a Pokémon to be capable of
Mega Evolving in battle, it must\lbe holding its unique [green]Mega Stone[red].

You should see if that Pokémon can
Mega Evolve by the [green]Mega Symbol[red] in\lthe battle menu.

Should it appear, press \btn04
before you select your next\lattack.

Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve
and become more powerful.

Keep in mind, however, you can
only Mega Evolve a Pokémon [green]once[red]\lper battle, and it wears off if the\lbattle ends, or the Mega Evolved\lPokémon faints.

Now, take that power\.\CC0818 and use it
for the good of humanity.

I shall be counting on you to change
the world\.\CC0818 and make a real impact\."
entries.translation_source: I see. Yes, I think you do carry that [buffer1-1] very well, myself. Anyway, you now have the power to [color-green-2]Mega Evolve[color-red-3] your Pokémon. For a Pokémon to be capable of Mega Evolving in battle, it must be holding its unique [color-green-4]Mega Stone[color-red-5]. You should see if that Pokémon can Mega Evolve by the [color-green-6]Mega Symbol[color-red-7] in the battle menu. Should it appear, press [button-icon-8] before you select your next attack. Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve and become more powerful. Keep in mind, however, you can only Mega Evolve a Pokémon [color-green-9]once[color-red-10] per battle, and it wears off if the battle ends, or the Mega Evolved Pokémon faints. Now, take that power[game-token-11][control-code-12] and use it for the good of humanity. I shall be counting on you to change the world[game-token-13][control-code-14] and make a real impact[game-token-15]
entries.translated:
Aku lihat. Ya, kurasa kau memang
membawa [buffer1] itu dengan sangat\lbaik. Ngomong-ngomong, sekarang kau

memiliki kekuatan untuk [green]Mega Evolve[red]
Pokémon-mu. Agar Pokémon dapat Mega\lEvolve dalam pertempuran, ia harus

memegang [green]Mega Stone[red] yang unik. Kau
bisa melihat apakah Pokémon itu\lbisa Mega Evolve dari [green]Simbol Mega[red]

di menu pertempuran. Jika muncul,
tekan \btn04 sebelum memilih serangan\lberikutnya. Pokémonmu akan Mega

Evolve dan menjadi lebih kuat.
Namun perlu diingat, kau hanya bisa\lMega Evolve Pokémon [green]sekali[red] per

pertempuran, dan efeknya hilang
jika pertempuran berakhir atau\lPokémon yang Mega Evolve pingsan.

Sekarang, ambillah kekuatan itu\.\CC0818 dan
gunakan untuk kebaikan umat\lmanusia. Aku akan mengandalkanmu

untuk mengubah dunia\.\CC0818 dan membuat
dampak nyata\.

entries.original:
"For a Pokémon to be capable of
Mega Evolving in battle, it must\lbe holding its unique [green]Mega Stone[red].

You should see if that Pokémon can
Mega Evolve by the [green]Mega Symbol[red] in\lthe battle menu.

Should it appear, press \btn04

Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve

Keep in mind, however, you can

entries.translation_source: For a Pokémon to be capable of Mega Evolving in battle, it must be holding its unique [color-green-1]Mega Stone[color-red-2]. I shall be counting on you to change the world[game-token-10][control-code-11] and make a real impact[game-token-12]
entries.translated:
Agar Pokémon dapat Mega Evolve
dalam pertempuran, ia harus\lmemegang [green]Mega Stone[red] yang unik. Kau

bisa melihat apakah Pokémon itu
bisa Mega Evolve dari [green]Simbol Mega[red]\ldi menu pertempuran. Jika muncul,

tekan \btn04 sebelum memilih serangan
berikutnya. Pokémonmu akan Mega\lEvolve dan menjadi lebih kuat.

Namun perlu diingat, kau hanya bisa
Mega Evolve Pokémon [green]sekali[red] per\lpertempuran, dan efeknya hilang

jika pertempuran berakhir atau
Pokémon yang Mega Evolve pingsan.\lSekarang, ambillah kekuatan itu\.\CC0818 dan

gunakan untuk kebaikan umat
manusia. Aku akan mengandalkanmu\luntuk mengubah dunia\.\CC0818 dan membuat

dampak nyata\.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes. Of course.
It almost slipped my mind.

Take this Mega Stone, the same one
I use - for the Pokémon Altaria."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes. Of course. It almost slipped my mind. Take this Mega Stone, the same one I use - for the Pokémon Altaria.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya. Tentu saja. Hampir saja
terlupakan. Ambil Mega Stone ini,\lyang sama dengan yang aku gunakan -

untuk Pokémon Altaria.

entries.original: "Mega Ring"
entries.translation_source: Mega Ring
entries.translated: Mega Ring

entries.original: "Mega Bracelet"
entries.translation_source: Mega Bracelet
entries.translated: Mega Bracelet

entries.original: "Mega Cuff"
entries.translation_source: Mega Cuff
entries.translated: Mega Cuff

entries.original: "Mega Charm"
entries.translation_source: Mega Charm
entries.translated: Mega Charm

entries.original: "It’s an ordinary statue."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ordinary statue.
entries.translated: Ini patung biasa.

entries.original:
"A secret switch!

Press it?"
entries.translation_source: A secret switch! Press it?
entries.translated: Saklar rahasia! Tekan?

entries.original: "Who wouldn’t?"
entries.translation_source: Who wouldn’t?
entries.translated: Siapa yang tidak?

entries.original: "Not quite yet!"
entries.translation_source: Not quite yet!
entries.translated: Belum sekarang!

entries.original:
"Mega Evolution was first discovered
in the Kalos Region by the renowned\lProfessor Sycamore.

Thanks to his research, Pokémon
are now able to Mega Evolve\lduring battle.

However, a large part of Mega
Evolution still remains a mystery."
entries.translation_source: Mega Evolution was first discovered in the Kalos Region by the renowned Professor Sycamore. Thanks to his research, Pokémon are now able to Mega Evolve during battle. However, a large part of Mega Evolution still remains a mystery.
entries.translated:
Mega Evolusi pertama kali ditemukan
di Region Kalos oleh Profesor\lSycamore yang terkenal. Berkat

penelitiannya, Pokémon kini dapat
Mega Evolve selama pertempuran.\lNamun, sebagian besar Mega Evolusi

masih menjadi misteri.

entries.original:
"It’s a book on Mega Evolution
by Prof. Log!

It says Pokémon that Mega Evolve
during battle are granted higher\lstats for the rest of the battle.

The remainder of the book is empty.
Prof. Log only researches stats."
entries.translation_source: It’s a book on Mega Evolution by Prof. Log! It says Pokémon that Mega Evolve during battle are granted higher stats for the rest of the battle. The remainder of the book is empty. Prof. Log only researches stats.
entries.translated:
Ini buku tentang Mega Evolusi oleh
Prof. Log! Dikatakan bahwa Pokémon\lyang Mega Evolve selama pertempuran

mendapatkan statistik yang lebih
tinggi selama sisa pertempuran.\lSisa buku kosong. Prof. Log hanya

meneliti statistik.

entries.original:
"The town has had a problem with
nightmares for the longest time.

I wish somebody would do something
about it already\."
entries.translation_source: The town has had a problem with nightmares for the longest time. I wish somebody would do something about it already[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kota ini sudah lama bermasalah
dengan mimpi buruk. Aku berharap\lseseorang sudah melakukan sesuatu

tentang itu\.

entries.original:
"Is it true?

Has Tarmigan’s nightmare
really ended?

I’m ecstatic!
This is amazing!

I can finally sleep well again
at night!"
entries.translation_source: Is it true? Has Tarmigan’s nightmare really ended? I’m ecstatic! This is amazing! I can finally sleep well again at night!
entries.translated:
Benarkah? Apakah mimpi buruk
Tarmigan benar-benar berakhir? Aku\lsangat senang! Ini luar biasa! Aku

akhirnya bisa tidur nyenyak lagi di
malam hari!

entries.original:
"Do you need a way back down
the mountain?

My Abra and I will be more than
happy to teleport you down.

What do you say?
Do you want to be teleported?"
entries.translation_source: Do you need a way back down the mountain? My Abra and I will be more than happy to teleport you down. What do you say? Do you want to be teleported?
entries.translated:
Apakah kau butuh cara untuk turun
gunung? Aku dan Abra-ku akan dengan\lsenang hati menteleportasimu turun.

Bagaimana? Apakah kau ingin
diteleportasi?

entries.original:
"Okay, then!

Abra, use Teleport!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, then! Abra, use Teleport!
entries.translated: Baiklah! Abra, gunakan Teleport!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind,
come back.

We’ll be sitting here."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind, come back. We’ll be sitting here.
entries.translated:
Jika kau berubah pikiran, kembali
saja. Kami akan duduk di sini.

entries.original: "[green]Braaaaa!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Braaaaa!
entries.translated: [green]Braaaaa!

entries.original:
"Items like [green]Mega Stones[red] and
[green]Z-Crystals[red] can’t be purchased.

The only way you can get them is by
finding them lying around, or by\lreceiving them as gifts."
entries.translation_source: Items like [color-green-1]Mega Stones[color-red-2] and [color-green-3]Z-Crystals[color-red-4] can’t be purchased. The only way you can get them is by finding them lying around, or by receiving them as gifts.
entries.translated:
Item seperti [green]Mega Stones[red] dan
[green]Z-Crystals[red] tidak dapat dibeli.\lSatu-satunya cara mendapatkannya

adalah dengan menemukannya
berserakan, atau menerimanya\lsebagai hadiah.

entries.original:
"If only there were some way to give
a Pokémon a stat boost at the\lbeginning of battle without needing\lto use an item\.

I’m sure someone out there is
trying to figure that out.

Perhaps someone from the renowned
Science Society?"
entries.translation_source: If only there were some way to give a Pokémon a stat boost at the beginning of battle without needing to use an item[game-token-1] I’m sure someone out there is trying to figure that out. Perhaps someone from the renowned Science Society?
entries.translated:
Andai saja ada cara untuk
memberikan boost stat pada Pokémon\ldi awal pertempuran tanpa perlu

menggunakan item\. Aku yakin
seseorang di luar sana sedang\lmencoba mencari tahu. Mungkin

seseorang dari Science Society yang
terkenal?

entries.original: "Tehl Town"
entries.translation_source: Tehl Town
entries.translated: Tehl Town

entries.original: "Tehl Town D"
entries.translation_source: Tehl Town D

entries.original: "Tehl Town N"
entries.translation_source: Tehl Town N

entries.original:
"[green]Route 10 [blue]has a cave that resembles
the [green]Lake Caves [blue]of [green]Sinnoh[blue].

I’ve never been in it myself, but
I’ve heard things\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Route 10 [color-blue-2]has a cave that resembles the [color-green-3]Lake Caves [color-blue-4]of [color-green-5]Sinnoh[color-blue-6]. I’ve never been in it myself, but I’ve heard things[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
[green]Route 10 [blue]memiliki gua yang mirip
dengan [green]Lake Caves [blue]di [green]Sinnoh[blue]. Aku\lsendiri belum pernah masuk, tapi

aku mendengar hal-hal\.

entries.original:
"One day, I’m gunna put Tehl Town
on t’ map.

If yeh ever see me statues aroun’
Borrius, yeh’ll know they’re good.

But I promise yeh, I’ll build t’
biggest, bestest one right here!"
entries.translation_source: One day, I’m gunna put Tehl Town on t’ map. If yeh ever see me statues aroun’ Borrius, yeh’ll know they’re good. But I promise yeh, I’ll build t’ biggest, bestest one right here!
entries.translated:
Suatu hari, aku akan menempatkan
Tehl Town di peta. Jika kamu pernah\lmelihat patung-patungku di sekitar

Borrius, kamu akan tahu itu bagus.
Tapi aku janji, aku akan membangun\lyang terbesar dan terbaik di sini!

entries.original:
"I swear\.

Those weird guys have been blocking
off [green]Route 9[blue] for days\.

I wonder what they’re up to?"
entries.translation_source: I swear[game-token-1] Those weird guys have been blocking off [color-green-2]Route 9[color-blue-3] for days[game-token-4] I wonder what they’re up to?
entries.translated:
Aku bersumpah\. Orang-orang aneh itu
sudah memblokir [green]Route 9[blue] selama\lberhari-hari\. Aku penasaran apa yang

mereka rencanakan?

entries.original: "Here, take these!"
entries.translation_source: Here, take these!
entries.translated: Ini, ambil ini!

entries.original:
"One of Professor Log’s Aides who
lives in Tehl Town will give you\la gift if you’ve captured\lenough Pokémon.

I hope those help you fill up
your Pokédex!"
entries.translation_source: One of Professor Log’s Aides who lives in Tehl Town will give you a gift if you’ve captured enough Pokémon. I hope those help you fill up your Pokédex!
entries.translated:
Salah satu Asisten Profesor Log
yang tinggal di Tehl Town akan\lmemberimu hadiah jika kamu sudah

menangkap cukup Pokémon. Semoga itu
membantu mengisi Pokédex-mu!

entries.original: "Statue of Regi"
entries.translation_source: Statue of Regi
entries.translated: Statue of Regi

entries.original:
"A man needs inspiration for his
final statue! Bring him the Pokémon
that sleeps under Bellin Town."
entries.translation_source: A man needs inspiration for his final statue! Bring him the Pokémon that sleeps under Bellin Town.
entries.translated:
Seorang ... patung terakhirnya!
Bawakan dia Pokémon yang tidur
di bawah Bellin Town.

entries.original:
"’Scuse me, yeh couldn’ spare a
moment, could yeh?

Listen\. I was one o’ the best
statue builder’s ’n Borrius.

But lately, m’ skills got stagnant
- the ol’ muse dried up ’n all.

Thing is, aye\. heard stories
’bout an ancient king - a king\lstrong enough t’ tow countries\lw’ ropes.

Eons an’ eons old, it is.

Would yeh believe me if I said I
found it?

Under m’ home in Bellin.
Right there?

Would bring the big lump here
m’self, but it won’ budge.

No idea how t’ wake it up, either.

But, eh\. yeh look handy - couldn’
bring it here, could yeh?"
entries.translation_source: ’Scuse me, yeh couldn’ spare a moment, could yeh? Listen[game-token-1] I was one o’ the best statue builder’s ’n Borrius. But lately, m’ skills got stagnant - the ol’ muse dried up ’n all. Thing is, aye[game-token-2] heard stories ’bout an ancient king - a king strong enough t’ tow countries w’ ropes. Eons an’ eons old, it is. Would yeh believe me if I said I found it? Under m’ home in Bellin. Right there? Would bring the big lump here m’self, but it won’ budge. No idea how t’ wake it up, either. But, eh[game-token-3] yeh look handy - couldn’ bring it here, could yeh?
entries.translated:
Permisi, kau punya waktu sebentar,
ya? Dengar\. Aku dulu salah satu\lpembangun patung terbaik di

Borrius. Tapi akhir-akhir ini,
kemampuanku mandek - inspirasi\llamaku habis. Masalahnya, ya\. aku

dengar cerita tentang seorang raja
kuno - raja yang cukup kuat untuk\lmenarik negara dengan tali. Sudah

berabad-abad usianya. Kau percaya
kalau aku bilang aku menemukannya?\lDi bawah rumahku di Bellin. Di

sana? Aku akan bawa gumpalan besar
itu sendiri, tapi dia tidak mau\lbergerak. Tidak tahu cara

membangunkannya juga. Tapi, eh\. kau
terlihat cakap - tidak bisa\lmembawanya ke sini, ya?

entries.original:
"Ne’er mind, then.

Didn’ expect yeh t’ know how,
anyway."
entries.translation_source: Ne’er mind, then. Didn’ expect yeh t’ know how, anyway.
entries.translated:
Tidak apa-apa. Lagipula aku tidak
menyangka kau tahu caranya.

entries.original:
"A’righ, yer a real champ.

So, yeh ever been into the bottom
o’ Bellin Town?

Yeh’ll see it there.

As I said, it jus’ sits there. It
don’ move, don’ attack, nuthin’.

Real myst’ry.

Sorry I can’ help yeh figurin’ out
how t’ get it movin’, but if yeh\lmanage, bring it here."
entries.translation_source: A’righ, yer a real champ. So, yeh ever been into the bottom o’ Bellin Town? Yeh’ll see it there. As I said, it jus’ sits there. It don’ move, don’ attack, nuthin’. Real myst’ry. Sorry I can’ help yeh figurin’ out how t’ get it movin’, but if yeh manage, bring it here.
entries.translated:
Baiklah, kau juara sejati. Jadi,
kau pernah ke ujung Bellin Town?\lKau akan melihatnya di sana.

Seperti yang kukatakan, ia hanya
duduk di sana. Tidak bergerak,\ltidak menyerang, tidak apa-apa.

Misteri sungguhan. Maaf aku tidak
bisa membantu mencari cara untuk\lmembuatnya bergerak, tapi jika kau

berhasil, bawa ke sini.

entries.original:
"That’s\.

Yeh did it! The livin’ statue\.
yeh really got it t’ move!

Awright, jus’ hold it nice an’
still - I’ll get t’ old hammer\land chisel out\."
entries.translation_source: That’s[game-token-1] Yeh did it! The livin’ statue[game-token-2] yeh really got it t’ move! Awright, jus’ hold it nice an’ still - I’ll get t’ old hammer and chisel out[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Itu\. Kau berhasil! Patung hidup itu\.
kau benar-benar membuatnya\lbergerak! Baiklah, diamkan saja -

aku akan mengambil palu dan pahat
tua\.

entries.original:
"Whew\. well, that’s some o’ t’
best work I ever done."
entries.translation_source: Whew[game-token-1] well, that’s some o’ t’ best work I ever done.
entries.translated:
Wah\. yah, itu salah satu karya
terbaik yang pernah kulakukan.

entries.original:
"An’ w’ that\. I think it’s ’bout
time I pack it in.

Nuthin’ toppin’ this, I tell
yeh that.

Thank yeh kindly, [buffer1].
As a token o’ gratitude\.

Well, on t’ side,
I’m a pretty good blacksmith.

Was jus’ thinkin’ ’bout takin’ it
up as a proper job, actually\. not\lmuch call fer this statue business\lanymore.

Tell yeh what, yeh can be me first
customer! How ’bout it?

Now what could I do fer yeh?
Let’s see\.

Yeh got any o’ them Amulet Coins?

Jus’ as thanks, I’ll give it a
free upgrade."
entries.translation_source: An’ w’ that[game-token-1] I think it’s ’bout time I pack it in. Nuthin’ toppin’ this, I tell yeh that. Thank yeh kindly, [buffer1-2]. As a token o’ gratitude[game-token-3] Well, on t’ side, I’m a pretty good blacksmith. Was jus’ thinkin’ ’bout takin’ it up as a proper job, actually[game-token-4] not much call fer this statue business anymore. Tell yeh what, yeh can be me first customer! How ’bout it? Now what could I do fer yeh? Let’s see[game-token-5] Yeh got any o’ them Amulet Coins? Jus’ as thanks, I’ll give it a free upgrade.
entries.translated:
Dan dengan itu\. kurasa sudah
waktunya aku berhenti. Tidak ada\lyang bisa mengalahkan ini, aku

katakan padamu. Terima kasih
banyak, [buffer1]. Sebagai tanda\lterima kasih\. Yah, di samping itu,

aku pandai pandai besi. Tadinya aku
berpikir untuk menjadikannya\lpekerjaan tetap, sebenarnya\. tidak

banyak permintaan untuk bisnis
patung ini lagi. Begini saja, kau\lbisa jadi pelanggan pertamaku!

Bagaimana? Sekarang apa yang bisa
kulakukan untukmu? Mari lihat\. Kau\lpunya Amulet Coin? Sebagai ucapan

terima kasih, akan ku-upgrade
gratis.

entries.original:
"Yeh got any o’ them Amulet Coins?

Jus’ as thanks, I’ll give it a
free upgrade."
entries.translation_source: Yeh got any o’ them Amulet Coins? Jus’ as thanks, I’ll give it a free upgrade.
entries.translated:
Kau punya Amulet Coin? Sebagai
ucapan terima kasih, akan\lku-upgrade gratis.

entries.original:
"Don’ have nuthin’ like that?

Well, yeh go get one first, and
stuff it into yer fancy Cube thing.

Then come talk t’ me."
entries.translation_source: Don’ have nuthin’ like that? Well, yeh go get one first, and stuff it into yer fancy Cube thing. Then come talk t’ me.
entries.translated:
Tidak punya apa-apa seperti itu?
Baiklah, kau ambil dulu, dan\lmasukkan ke dalam Cube mewahmu itu.

Lalu datang bicara padaku.

entries.original:
"[black]The Amulet Coin level has been
increased to \Lv [buffer2]!

[green][buffer2]*[black] the amount of prize money will
be earned when brought into battle."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Amulet Coin level has been increased to [game-token-2] [buffer2-3]! [color-green-4][buffer2-5]*[color-black-6] the amount of prize money will be earned when brought into battle.
entries.translated:
[black]Level Amulet Coin telah
ditingkatkan menjadi \Lv [buffer2]!\l[green][buffer2]*[black] jumlah uang hadiah akan

diperoleh saat dibawa ke
pertempuran.

entries.original:
"[black]The Amulet Coin level has already
been maxed out!

Instead\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Amulet Coin level has already been maxed out! Instead[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[black]Level Amulet Coin sudah maksimal!
Sebagai gantinya\.

entries.original:
"So, d’yeh like it?

Now when a Pokémon holdin’ tha’
gets sent out, yeh’ll get more\lcash than before!

’Course, it’s possible t’ get it
t’ give yeh more, but it’s not\lall tha’ cheap.

If yeh can get [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue], I
can give it ’nuther upgrade, alrigh’?"
entries.translation_source: So, d’yeh like it? Now when a Pokémon holdin’ tha’ gets sent out, yeh’ll get more cash than before! ’Course, it’s possible t’ get it t’ give yeh more, but it’s not all tha’ cheap. If yeh can get [color-green-1][buffer2-2] [buffer1-3]s[color-blue-4], I can give it ’nuther upgrade, alrigh’?
entries.translated:
Jadi, kau suka? Sekarang saat
Pokémon yang memegangnya dikirim,\lkau akan mendapatkan lebih banyak

uang daripada sebelumnya! Tentu
saja, mungkin bisa membuatnya\lmemberi lebih banyak, tapi tidak

murah. Jika kau bisa mendapatkan
[green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue], aku bisa\lmemberinya upgrade lagi, oke?

entries.original:
"’Ello, again!
Yer Amulet Coin’s \Lv [buffer3].

If it’s an upgrade yeh wan’,
I’m gunna need [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: ’Ello, again! Yer Amulet Coin’s [game-token-1] [buffer3-2]. If it’s an upgrade yeh wan’, I’m gunna need [color-green-3][buffer2-4] [buffer1-5]s[color-blue-6].
entries.translated:
Halo, lagi! Amulet Coin-mu \Lv
[buffer3]. Jika kamu mau upgrade,\laku butuh [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue].

entries.original:
"Not today?
Awrigh’.

Bring ’em later if yeh go changin’
yer mind."
entries.translation_source: Not today? Awrigh’. Bring ’em later if yeh go changin’ yer mind.
entries.translated:
Tidak hari ini? Baiklah. Bawa
mereka nanti jika kamu berubah\lpikiran.

entries.original:
"Think yer a bit short on
[buffer1]s.

Go get some more, then talk t’
me again."
entries.translation_source: Think yer a bit short on [buffer1-1]s. Go get some more, then talk t’ me again.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya kamu kekurangan
[buffer1]s. Ambil lagi, lalu bicara\llagi denganku.

entries.original:
"How’s tha’ Amulet Coin treatin’
yeh?

Highest level I could make it, so
I’m hopin’ it’s doin’ yeh good."
entries.translation_source: How’s tha’ Amulet Coin treatin’ yeh? Highest level I could make it, so I’m hopin’ it’s doin’ yeh good.
entries.translated:
Bagaimana Amulet Coin
memperlakukanmu? Level tertinggi\lyang bisa kubuat, jadi kuharap itu

berguna untukmu.

entries.original: "lass"
entries.translation_source: lass
entries.translated: Gadis

entries.original:
"My mother suffers from horrible
separation anxiety.

So much so, that when I moved away,
she forced me to install a path\lbetween our houses.

You’re welcome to use it, if
you’d like.

My mother lives on [green]Route 9[red]."
entries.translation_source: My mother suffers from horrible separation anxiety. So much so, that when I moved away, she forced me to install a path between our houses. You’re welcome to use it, if you’d like. My mother lives on [color-green-1]Route 9[color-red-2].
entries.translated:
Ibuku menderita kecemasan
perpisahan yang parah. Sedemikian\lparahnya, sehingga ketika aku

pindah, dia memaksaku untuk
memasang jalur di antara rumah\lkami. Kamu dipersilakan

menggunakannya, jika kamu mau.
Ibuku tinggal di [green]Route 9[red].

entries.original:
"Despite it being private property,
some people have decided to camp\lout in our underground passageway,\land hold a contest daily.

I’m pretty sure it’s rigged though,
since I’ve never heard of anyone\lwithout a super fast [green]Motorbike[blue]\lcompleting it."
entries.translation_source: Despite it being private property, some people have decided to camp out in our underground passageway, and hold a contest daily. I’m pretty sure it’s rigged though, since I’ve never heard of anyone without a super fast [color-green-1]Motorbike[color-blue-2] completing it.
entries.translated:
Meskipun itu properti pribadi,
beberapa orang memutuskan untuk\lberkemah di lorong bawah tanah

kami, dan mengadakan kontes setiap
hari. Tapi aku yakin itu curang,\lkarena aku belum pernah mendengar

ada orang yang tanpa [green]Motorbike[blue]
super cepat menyelesaikannya.

entries.original:
"Yo, yo!
I am the official [green]Name Rater[blue]!

Want me to rate the nicknames of
your Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Yo, yo! I am the official [color-green-1]Name Rater[color-blue-2]! Want me to rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Yo, yo! Aku adalah [green]Name Rater[blue]
resmi! Kamu ingin aku menilai nama\lpanggilan Pokémon-mu?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon’s nickname should
I see?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon’s nickname should I see?
entries.translated:
Nama panggilan Pokémon mana yang
harus kulihat?

entries.original:
"[buffer1], is it?
That is a gucci nickname!

But, would you like me to give it
a swag name?

How about it?"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1], is it? That is a gucci nickname! But, would you like me to give it a swag name? How about it?
entries.translated:
[buffer1], ya? Itu nama panggilan
yang gucci! Tapi, apakah kamu ingin\laku memberinya nama yang swag?

Bagaimana?

entries.original:
"Really?
That’s an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: Really? That’s an Egg!
entries.translated: Sungguh? Itu Telur!

entries.original:
"Uh huh.
Come back again."
entries.translation_source: Uh huh. Come back again.
entries.translated: Uh huh. Kembali lagi.

entries.original:
"Cool. Then, what should the new
nickname be?"
entries.translation_source: Cool. Then, what should the new nickname be?
entries.translated:
Keren. Lalu, nama panggilan baru
apa yang seharusnya?

entries.original:
"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

It looks the same as before, but
still feels ten times cooler!

You’re so lucky!"
entries.translation_source: Done! From now on, this Pokémon will be called [buffer1-1]! It looks the same as before, but still feels ten times cooler! You’re so lucky!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Mulai sekarang, Pokémon
ini akan dipanggil [buffer1]!\lTampilannya sama seperti

sebelumnya, tapi tetap terasa
sepuluh kali lebih keren! Kamu\lsangat beruntung!

entries.original:
"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

It’s a way better name than before!
You’re so swag!"
entries.translation_source: Done! From now on, this Pokémon will be called [buffer1-1]! It’s a way better name than before! You’re so swag!
entries.translated:
Selesai! Mulai sekarang, Pokémon
ini akan dipanggil [buffer1]! Itu\lnama yang jauh lebih baik dari

sebelumnya! Kamu sangat swag!

entries.original:
"Hi! 
I’m one of Prof. Log’s Aides.

If your Pokédex has complete data
on [green][buffer1][red] species, I’m supposed to\lgive you a reward.

So, [player], let me ask you.

Have you gathered data on at least[green]
[buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! I’m one of Prof. Log’s Aides. If your Pokédex has complete data on [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] species, I’m supposed to give you a reward. So, [player-name-4], let me ask you. Have you gathered data on at least[color-green-5] [buffer1-6][color-red-7] kinds of Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Hai! Aku salah satu Asisten Prof.
Log. Jika Pokédex-mu memiliki data\llengkap tentang spesies [green][buffer1][red],

aku seharusnya memberimu hadiah.
Jadi, [player], biarkan aku\lbertanya. Apakah kamu telah

mengumpulkan data setidaknya[green]
[buffer1][red] jenis Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Great! You have caught [green][buffer3][red]
kinds of Pokémon!

Congratulations!
Here you go!"
entries.translation_source: Great! You have caught [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-red-3] kinds of Pokémon! Congratulations! Here you go!
entries.translated:
Hebat! Kamu telah menangkap
[green][buffer3][red] jenis Pokémon! Selamat!\lIni dia!

entries.original:
"Use the [green]Dowsing Machine[red] to detect
any hidden items close to you.

When you use it, keep a close eye
on the top left corner of your\lscreen.

If there is a hidden item close by,
the little symbol there will point\lin the direction of the item.

If there is no item close by,
you’ll see a small white circle."
entries.translation_source: Use the [color-green-1]Dowsing Machine[color-red-2] to detect any hidden items close to you. When you use it, keep a close eye on the top left corner of your screen. If there is a hidden item close by, the little symbol there will point in the direction of the item. If there is no item close by, you’ll see a small white circle.
entries.translated:
Gunakan [green]Dowsing Machine[red] untuk
mendeteksi item tersembunyi di\ldekatmu. Saat menggunakannya,

perhatikan sudut kiri atas layarmu.
Jika ada item tersembunyi di\ldekatnya, simbol kecil di sana akan

menunjuk ke arah item tersebut.
Jika tidak ada item di dekatnya,\lkamu akan melihat lingkaran putih

kecil.

entries.original:
"\.Oh. I see.

When you get [green][buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon,
come back."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]Oh. I see. When you get [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4] kinds of Pokémon, come back.
entries.translated:
\.Oh. Begitu. Saat kamu mendapatkan
[green][buffer1][red] jenis Pokémon, kembalilah.

entries.original:
"Let’s see\.

Uh-oh! You have caught only
[green][buffer3][red] kinds of Pokémon!

You need [green][buffer1][red] kinds.

Did you get the [green]DexNav[red] from [green]Nat Log[red]
in [green]Blizzard City[red]?

It’s a very handy tool for finding
new species of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Let’s see[game-token-1] Uh-oh! You have caught only [color-green-2][buffer3-3][color-red-4] kinds of Pokémon! You need [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-red-7] kinds. Did you get the [color-green-8]DexNav[color-red-9] from [color-green-10]Nat Log[color-red-11] in [color-green-12]Blizzard City[color-red-13]? It’s a very handy tool for finding new species of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Coba lihat\. Uh-oh! Kamu hanya
menangkap [green][buffer3][red] jenis Pokémon!\lKamu perlu [green][buffer1][red] jenis. Apakah

kamu mendapatkan [green]DexNav[red] dari [green]Nat
Log[red] di [green]Blizzard City[red]? Itu alat yang\lsangat berguna untuk menemukan

spesies baru Pokémon.
