"Help a researcher study seasonal
form changes around Borrius by
bringing him various Sawsbuck."
entries.translation_source: Help a researcher study seasonal form changes around Borrius by bringing him various Sawsbuck.
entries.translated:
Bantu seorang peneliti
mempelajari perubahan bentuk
musiman ... berbagai Sawsbuck.

entries.original:
"Help a researcher study seasonal
form changes by bringing him a
Sawsbuck in its Spring form."
entries.translation_source: Help a researcher study seasonal form changes by bringing him a Sawsbuck in its Spring form.
entries.translated:
Bantu seorang peneliti mempelajari
perubahan bentuk musiman dengan\lmembawakannya Sawsbuck dalam bentuk

Musim Semi.

entries.original:
"Help a researcher study seasonal
form changes by bringing him a
Sawsbuck in its Summer form."
entries.translation_source: Help a researcher study seasonal form changes by bringing him a Sawsbuck in its Summer form.
entries.translated:
Bantu seorang peneliti mempelajari
perubahan bentuk musiman dengan\lmembawakannya Sawsbuck dalam bentuk

Musim Panas.

entries.original:
"Help a researcher study seasonal
form changes by bringing him a
Sawsbuck in its Autumn form."
entries.translation_source: Help a researcher study seasonal form changes by bringing him a Sawsbuck in its Autumn form.
entries.translated:
Bantu seorang peneliti mempelajari
perubahan bentuk musiman dengan\lmembawakannya Sawsbuck dalam bentuk

Musim Gugur.

entries.original:
"Help a researcher study seasonal
form changes by bringing him a
Sawsbuck in its Winter form."
entries.translation_source: Help a researcher study seasonal form changes by bringing him a Sawsbuck in its Winter form.
entries.translated:
Bantu seorang peneliti mempelajari
perubahan bentuk musiman dengan\lmembawakannya Sawsbuck dalam bentuk

Musim Dingin.

entries.original:
"Greetings, [player].

I am a researcher studying seasonal
form changes of Pokémon.

Since the seasons do not change in
Borrius, I am very interested in\llearning how certain Pokémon\lchange form in this region.

Would you like to help me with
my research?"
entries.translation_source: Greetings, [player-name-1]. I am a researcher studying seasonal form changes of Pokémon. Since the seasons do not change in Borrius, I am very interested in learning how certain Pokémon change form in this region. Would you like to help me with my research?
entries.translated:
Salam, [player]. Saya adalah
seorang peneliti yang mempelajari\lperubahan bentuk musiman Pokémon.

Karena musim tidak berubah di
Borrius, saya sangat tertarik untuk\lmempelajari bagaimana Pokémon

tertentu berubah bentuk di wilayah
ini. Apakah Anda ingin membantu\lsaya dalam penelitian saya?

entries.original:
"Splendid!

I am currently researching the
Pokémon known as [green][buffer1][blue].

To start off the research, I would
like to study a [green][buffer1][blue] in\lits [green][buffer2][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Splendid! I am currently researching the Pokémon known as [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. To start off the research, I would like to study a [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] in its [color-green-7][buffer2-8][color-blue-9] form.
entries.translated:
Bagus sekali! Saat ini saya sedang
meneliti Pokémon yang dikenal\lsebagai [green][buffer1][blue]. Untuk memulai

penelitian, saya ingin mempelajari
seekor [green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk\l[green][buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"No?

If you change your mind, your help
would still be invaluable."
entries.translation_source: No? If you change your mind, your help would still be invaluable.
entries.translated:
Tidak? Jika Anda berubah pikiran,
bantuan Anda akan tetap sangat\lberharga.

entries.original:
"Have you brought me a [green][buffer1][blue] in
its [green][buffer2][blue] form to study?

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Have you brought me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in its [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] form to study? *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Apakah Anda membawakan saya seekor
[green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue]\luntuk dipelajari? *Frisk* *Frisk*

entries.original:
"Ah, it does not appear you have
brought one.

I would like to see a [green][buffer1][blue] in
its [green][buffer2][blue] form, please."
entries.translation_source: Ah, it does not appear you have brought one. I would like to see a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in its [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] form, please.
entries.translated:
Ah, sepertinya Anda belum membawa
satu. Saya ingin melihat seekor\l[green][buffer1][blue] dalam bentuk [green][buffer2][blue],

tolong.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, you have.

Please wait a moment while I
study it."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, you have. Please wait a moment while I study it.
entries.translated:
Ah, ya, Anda membawanya. Mohon
tunggu sebentar sementara saya\lmempelajarinya.

entries.original:
"Interesting\.

I have added invaluable data
to my research.

Next, I would like to see a [green][buffer1][blue]
in its [green][buffer3][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Interesting[game-token-1] I have added invaluable data to my research. Next, I would like to see a [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] in its [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] form.
entries.translated:
Menarik\. Saya telah menambahkan data
yang sangat berharga ke penelitian\lsaya. Selanjutnya, saya ingin

melihat seekor [green][buffer1][blue] dalam
bentuk [green][buffer3][blue].

entries.original:
"Interesting\.

It appears that for some reason the
Pokémon appearing in the area are\lnot what they are supposed to be\.

Was this your doing?

\.

In that case, this is more than
sufficient!

Who needs Deerling?

This phenomenon is far better for
me to study!"
entries.translation_source: Interesting[game-token-1] It appears that for some reason the Pokémon appearing in the area are not what they are supposed to be[game-token-2] Was this your doing? [game-token-3] In that case, this is more than sufficient! Who needs Deerling? This phenomenon is far better for me to study!
entries.translated:
Menarik\. Tampaknya untuk beberapa
alasan, Pokémon yang muncul di area\lini bukanlah yang seharusnya\. Apakah

ini perbuatan Anda? \. Kalau begitu,
ini lebih dari cukup! Siapa yang\lbutuh Deerling? Fenomena ini jauh

lebih baik untuk saya pelajari!

entries.original:
"Thank you so much!

You’ve been a great asset to my
research!

So, although Borrius’s climate
remains stable, Deerling and\lSawsbuck have different forms,\ldepending on their environment,\lrather than season\.

Ah yes, your reward."
entries.translation_source: Thank you so much! You’ve been a great asset to my research! So, although Borrius’s climate remains stable, Deerling and Sawsbuck have different forms, depending on their environment, rather than season[game-token-1] Ah yes, your reward.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih banyak! Anda telah
menjadi aset besar bagi penelitian\lsaya! Jadi, meskipun iklim Borrius

tetap stabil, Deerling dan Sawsbuck
memiliki bentuk yang berbeda,\ltergantung pada lingkungan mereka,

bukan musim\. Ah ya, hadiah Anda.

entries.original:
"As my way of thanks, how about I
do something\.\CC0818 beneficial, for your\lPokémon?

You see, I have a device that can
change the [green]Nature[blue] of a Pokémon -\lchange how it grows.

I can perform the procedure on
your Pokémon, for free, just this\lone time.

Just be aware\.\CC0818 your Pokémon may not
enjoy it very much, and will come\lto hate you afterwards\."
entries.translation_source: As my way of thanks, how about I do something[game-token-1][control-code-2] beneficial, for your Pokémon? You see, I have a device that can change the [color-green-3]Nature[color-blue-4] of a Pokémon - change how it grows. I can perform the procedure on your Pokémon, for free, just this one time. Just be aware[game-token-5][control-code-6] your Pokémon may not enjoy it very much, and will come to hate you afterwards[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Sebagai ucapan terima kasih,
bagaimana jika saya melakukan\lsesuatu\.\CC0818 yang bermanfaat, untuk

Pokémon Anda? Anda lihat, saya
memiliki perangkat yang dapat\lmengubah [green]Nature[blue] dari seekor Pokémon

- mengubah cara ia tumbuh. Saya
dapat melakukan prosedur ini pada\lPokémon Anda, secara gratis, hanya

satu kali ini saja. Harap diingat\.\CC0818
Pokémon Anda mungkin tidak terlalu\lmenikmatinya, dan akan membenci

Anda setelahnya\.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon’s Nature should
I change?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon’s Nature should I change?
entries.translated:
Nature Pokémon mana yang harus saya
ubah?

entries.original:
"Which Nature should I give
[buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Nature should I give [buffer1-1]?
entries.translated:
Nature mana yang harus saya berikan
kepada [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Should I give [green][buffer1][blue]
the [green][buffer2][blue] Nature?"
entries.translation_source: Should I give [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] the [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] Nature?
entries.translated:
Haruskah saya memberikan [green][buffer1][blue]
Nature [green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"Then, hold still, [buffer1]\.

It’s just a simple procedure\.
You won’t remember a thing\."
entries.translation_source: Then, hold still, [buffer1-1][game-token-2] It’s just a simple procedure[game-token-3] You won’t remember a thing[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Kalau begitu, diamlah, [buffer1]\. Ini
hanya prosedur sederhana\. Anda tidak\lakan ingat apa pun\.

entries.original:
"Ah, we’ve finished.

I’ve restructured your [buffer1]’s
heart to the more optimal Nature.

Now it’s as if it’s an entirely
different Pokémon!

And fortunately, it seems to
remember nothing about what just\lhappened.

Thank you again for your
assistance!

And although I cannot continuously
afford to change Natures for you,\lif you are able to foot the bill,\lI will happy to change more."
entries.translation_source: Ah, we’ve finished. I’ve restructured your [buffer1-1]’s heart to the more optimal Nature. Now it’s as if it’s an entirely different Pokémon! And fortunately, it seems to remember nothing about what just happened. Thank you again for your assistance! And although I cannot continuously afford to change Natures for you, if you are able to foot the bill, I will happy to change more.
entries.translated:
Ah, kita selesai. Aku telah
merestrukturisasi hati [buffer1] ke\lNature yang lebih optimal. Sekarang

seolah-olah itu adalah Pokémon yang
sama sekali berbeda! Dan untungnya,\lsepertinya ia tidak ingat apa pun

tentang apa yang baru saja terjadi.
Terima kasih lagi atas bantuanmu!\lDan meskipun aku tidak bisa

terus-menerus mengganti Nature
untukmu, jika kamu bisa membayar\lbiayanya, aku akan dengan senang

hati mengganti lebih banyak.

entries.original:
"Of course, I can wait while you
decide on a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Of course, I can wait while you decide on a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Tentu saja, aku bisa menunggu
sementara kamu memutuskan Pokémon.

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][blue] already has that
Nature\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] already has that Nature[game-token-4]
entries.translated: [green][buffer1][blue] sudah memiliki Nature itu\.

entries.original: "I cannot change an Egg’s Nature."
entries.translation_source: I cannot change an Egg’s Nature.
entries.translated:
Aku tidak bisa mengubah Nature
Telur.

entries.original:
"Have you come for more Nature
changes?

Well\. as long as you can foot the
bill of $[green]50000[blue], I can do another."
entries.translation_source: Have you come for more Nature changes? Well[game-token-1] as long as you can foot the bill of $[color-green-2]50000[color-blue-3], I can do another.
entries.translated:
Apakah kamu datang untuk perubahan
Nature lagi? Baiklah\. selama kamu\lbisa membayar biaya $[green]50000[blue], aku

bisa melakukan yang lain.

entries.original:
"For $[green]50000[blue], should I give
[green][buffer1][blue] the [green][buffer2][blue] Nature?"
entries.translation_source: For $[color-green-1]50000[color-blue-2], should I give [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-blue-5] the [color-green-6][buffer2-7][color-blue-8] Nature?
entries.translated:
Dengan $[green]50000[blue], haruskah aku
memberikan [green][buffer1][blue] Nature\l[green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"Ah, we’ve finished.

I’ve restructured your [buffer1]’s
heart to the more optimal Nature.

And fortunately, it seems to
remember nothing about what just\lhappened.

And now, the payment, if you would."
entries.translation_source: Ah, we’ve finished. I’ve restructured your [buffer1-1]’s heart to the more optimal Nature. And fortunately, it seems to remember nothing about what just happened. And now, the payment, if you would.
entries.translated:
Ah, kita selesai. Aku telah
merestrukturisasi hati [buffer1] ke\lNature yang lebih optimal. Dan

untungnya, sepertinya ia tidak
ingat apa pun tentang yang baru\lsaja terjadi. Dan sekarang,

pembayarannya, jika kamu mau.

entries.original:
"If you are able to foot the bill
again, I will be happy to change\lmore."
entries.translation_source: If you are able to foot the bill again, I will be happy to change more.
entries.translated:
Jika kamu bisa membayar biayanya
lagi, aku akan dengan senang hati\lmengganti lebih banyak.

entries.original:
"I am afraid neither you or I are
able to afford a Nature change."
entries.translation_source: I am afraid neither you or I are able to afford a Nature change.
entries.translated:
Aku khawatir baik kamu maupun aku
tidak mampu membayar perubahan\lNature.

Sampai baru-baru ini, kota ini
cukup tenang. Yaitu, sampai\lorang-orang itu muncul dan mulai

membanjiri Route 9.

"This town is fairly quiet.

Not many are incentivized to hang
around in a small forest town."
entries.translation_source: This town is fairly quiet. Not many are incentivized to hang around in a small forest town.
entries.translated:
Kota ini cukup tenang. Tidak banyak
yang termotivasi untuk berkeliaran\ldi kota kecil di hutan.

"I’m looking for Battle Items like
[green]X-Attack[blue] and [green]X-Speed[blue].

battle by [green]2[blue] whole stat stages.

Contrary!

can’t seem to find any here\."

They raise a Pokémon’s stats in battle by [color-green-5]2[color-blue-6] whole stat stages. And they ignore abilities like Contrary! But no matter how hard I look, I can’t seem to find any here[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Aku mencari Item Pertempuran
seperti [green]X-Attack[blue] dan [green]X-Speed[blue].\lMereka meningkatkan stat Pokémon

dalam pertempuran sebanyak [green]2[blue]
seluruh tahap stat. Dan mereka\lmengabaikan kemampuan seperti

Contrary! Tapi sekeras apa pun aku
mencari, sepertinya aku tidak bisa\lmenemukannya di sini\.

entries.original:
"You should stock up on [green]Revives[red]!

They heal a fainted Pokémon back
to half health!"
entries.translation_source: You should stock up on [color-green-1]Revives[color-red-2]! They heal a fainted Pokémon back to half health!
entries.translated:
Kamu harus menimbun [green]Revives[red]! Mereka
menyembuhkan Pokémon yang pingsan\lkembali ke setengah kesehatan!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!

Please, enjoy this gift!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! Please, enjoy this gift!
entries.translated:
Hei, di sana! Silakan, nikmati
hadiah ini!

"There are a few Pokémon in this
area that only evolve via a\l[green]Water Stone[blue]."
entries.translation_source: There are a few Pokémon in this area that only evolve via a [color-green-1]Water Stone[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Ada beberapa Pokémon di area ini
yang hanya berevolusi melalui [green]Water\lStone[blue].

entries.original: "Thundercap Mt."
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt.
entries.translated: Gunung Thundercap

entries.original: "Thundercap Mt. A"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. A

entries.original: "Thundercap Mt. B"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. B

"A mountain known for its frequent
lightning storms.
Legends say a powerful Pokémon
roosts at the summit."
entries.translation_source: A mountain known for its frequent lightning storms. Legends say a powerful Pokémon roosts at the summit.

entries.original:
"The path up this mountain is
exhausting, isn’t it?

Let me heal you up so you can
continue on, worry free!"
entries.translation_source: The path up this mountain is exhausting, isn’t it? Let me heal you up so you can continue on, worry free!
entries.translated:
Jalan menuju gunung ini melelahkan,
bukan? Biarkan aku menyembuhkanmu\lsehingga kamu bisa melanjutkan

perjalanan, tanpa khawatir!

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated:
Semua siap! Jaga dirimu di luar
sana!

entries.original:
"The power of evolution\.
It compels me to give this to you!"
entries.translation_source: The power of evolution[game-token-1] It compels me to give this to you!
entries.translated:
Kekuatan evolusi\. Memaksaku untuk
memberikan ini padamu!

entries.original:
"I may feel compelled to give you
something tomorrow, as well."
entries.translation_source: I may feel compelled to give you something tomorrow, as well.
entries.translated:
Aku mungkin merasa terdorong untuk
memberikan sesuatu padamu besok\ljuga.

entries.translation_source: The Wayward Kid
entries.translated: Anak yang Tersesat

entries.translation_source: Milo
entries.translated: Milo

"A little boy has lost his way in
Thundercap Mt. 4F! Team up with
him, and guide him to the exit."
entries.translation_source: A little boy has lost his way in Thundercap Mt. 4F! Team up with him, and guide him to the exit.
entries.translated:
Seorang anak kecil tersesat di
Thundercap Mt. ... dan bimbing
dia menuju pintu keluar.

entries.original:
"I’m Milo\.

I was catching Pokémon, and then
I got lost\.

I’m so scared\.

Please!
Please take me to the exit!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Milo[game-token-1] I was catching Pokémon, and then I got lost[game-token-2] I’m so scared[game-token-3] Please! Please take me to the exit!
entries.translated:
Aku Milo\. Aku sedang menangkap
Pokémon, lalu aku tersesat\. Aku\lsangat takut\. Tolong! Tolong bawa

aku ke pintu keluar!

entries.original:
"Oh\.
I’m so scared\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] I’m so scared[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Aku sangat takut\.

entries.original: "[black][player] decided to go with Milo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] decided to go with Milo!
entries.translated:
[black][player] memutuskan untuk pergi
bersama Milo!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy
all the time!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy all the time!
entries.translated:
Aku akan menjaga Pokémonmu tetap
sehat setiap saat!

entries.original:
"I like useful moves like Growl and
Tail Whip.

Those are my favourites."
entries.translation_source: I like useful moves like Growl and Tail Whip. Those are my favourites.
entries.translated:
Aku suka jurus berguna seperti
Raungan dan Ekorguncang. Itu\lfavoritku.

entries.original:
"The mountain\.
It’s so easy to get confused.

Do you know where we are?"
entries.translation_source: The mountain[game-token-1] It’s so easy to get confused. Do you know where we are?
entries.translated:
Gunung ini\. Sangat mudah untuk
bingung. Apakah kamu tahu di mana\lkita?

entries.original:
"[player], did you get to be
so good because you’re always\lwith your Pokémon?

Yes! That has to be it!
Milo will try like you!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], did you get to be so good because you’re always with your Pokémon? Yes! That has to be it! Milo will try like you!
entries.translated:
[player], apakah kamu menjadi
begitu hebat karena kamu selalu\lbersama Pokémon-mu? Ya! Pasti itu!

Milo akan berusaha sepertimu!

entries.original:
"[black]While teamed up with Milo, the
[green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]While teamed up with Milo, the [color-green-2]first 3[color-black-3] viable Pokémon in your party will be selected for battle.
entries.translated:
[black]Saat bekerja sama dengan Milo, [green]3
Pokémon pertama[black] yang layak di timmu\lakan dipilih untuk bertarung.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh! There’s the ladder!

I want to get tougher so I
won’t be such a scaredy-cat.

[player], bye-bye!
Thank you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh! There’s the ladder! I want to get tougher so I won’t be such a scaredy-cat. [player-name-2], bye-bye! Thank you!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh! Itu tangganya! Aku ingin
menjadi lebih kuat agar tidak\lmenjadi penakut. [player], bye-bye!

Terima kasih!

entries.original:
"It appears Milo has left
something behind\."
entries.translation_source: It appears Milo has left something behind[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Tampaknya Milo meninggalkan sesuatu\.

entries.original: "[green]Gyaoo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gyaoo!
entries.translated: [green]Gyaoo!

entries.original: "Sankren thoron!"
entries.translation_source: Sankren thoron!
entries.translated: Sankren thoron!

entries.original:
"I was standing outside, by Antisis
City, when I saw it\.

A yellow Pokémon I’d never seen
before, standing on a ledge,\lstaring down at me.

All my friends didn’t believe me
when I told them, so I came here\lto take a picture of it.

And I’m pretty sure if I dig
straight through this wall, I’ll\lreach that ledge where I saw\lthe Pokémon.

The only thing is, I don’t know how
long it’ll take to break through.

If only I had some sort of machine
that could do the digging for me\."
entries.translation_source: I was standing outside, by Antisis City, when I saw it[game-token-1] A yellow Pokémon I’d never seen before, standing on a ledge, staring down at me. All my friends didn’t believe me when I told them, so I came here to take a picture of it. And I’m pretty sure if I dig straight through this wall, I’ll reach that ledge where I saw the Pokémon. The only thing is, I don’t know how long it’ll take to break through. If only I had some sort of machine that could do the digging for me[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku berdiri di luar, dekat Antisis
City, ketika aku melihatnya\. Seekor\lPokémon kuning yang belum pernah

kulihat sebelumnya, berdiri di
tepian, menatapku. Semua temanku\ltidak percaya ketika aku ceritakan,

jadi aku datang ke sini untuk
memotretnya. Dan aku cukup yakin\ljika aku menggali langsung menembus

dinding ini, aku akan mencapai
tepian tempat aku melihat Pokémon\litu. Hanya saja, aku tidak tahu

berapa lama waktu yang dibutuhkan
untuk menembusnya. Seandainya aku\lpunya mesin yang bisa menggali

untukku\.

entries.original:
"That digging machine in your Cube\.

It’s just what I need to dig
through the wall!

Please, let me borrow it for a sec."
entries.translation_source: That digging machine in your Cube[game-token-1] It’s just what I need to dig through the wall! Please, let me borrow it for a sec.
entries.translated:
Mesin penggali di Cube-mu\. Itu yang
kubutuhkan untuk menggali menembus\ldinding! Tolong, pinjamkan

sebentar.

entries.original: "Alright, just gimme a sec\."
entries.translation_source: Alright, just gimme a sec[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Baiklah, tunggu sebentar\.

entries.original:
"I did it!
I broke through the wall!

I knew there was a ledge on the
other side!

Now, if you’ll excuse me for just a
sec\."
entries.translation_source: I did it! I broke through the wall! I knew there was a ledge on the other side! Now, if you’ll excuse me for just a sec[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku berhasil! Aku menerobos tembok!
Aku tahu ada tebing di sisi lain!\lSekarang, permisi sebentar\.

entries.original:
"Well, that yellow Pokémon is
there, just as I thought.

I took the picture I wanted, and
now that I’ve done that, I’ll let\lyou go right ahead and capture it.

Thanks again for your help!"
entries.translation_source: Well, that yellow Pokémon is there, just as I thought. I took the picture I wanted, and now that I’ve done that, I’ll let you go right ahead and capture it. Thanks again for your help!
entries.translated:
Yah, Pokémon kuning itu ada di
sana, seperti yang kuduga. Aku\lsudah mengambil foto yang

kuinginkan, dan sekarang setelah
itu, aku akan membiarkanmu\lmenangkapnya. Terima kasih lagi

atas bantuanmu!

entries.original:
"But how will I break through the
wall without it?"
entries.translation_source: But how will I break through the wall without it?
entries.translated:
Tapi bagaimana aku bisa menerobos
tembok tanpanya?

entries.original: "[green]Raaaaaa!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Raaaaaa!
entries.translated: [green]Raaaaaa!

"[buffer1] disappeared into
the mountain range."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] disappeared into the mountain range.

[buffer1] menghilang ke dalam
barisan pegunungan.

[black]Barang itu tersegel di balik
penghalang listrik.

"The electric barrier blocks you
from passing through."
entries.translation_source: The electric barrier blocks you from passing through.

Penghalang listrik menghalangimu
untuk lewat.

"The electric barrier has
been disengaged."

Penghalang listrik telah
dinonaktifkan.

entries.translated:
TEKANAN DI TEMPAT LAIN ADALAH
KUNCI.

Ini adalah batu tantangan. Suruh
[buffer1] menghancurkan batu itu?

"[buffer1] tried to smash the

entries.translated:
[buffer1] mencoba menghancurkan batu
tantangan. Sepotong batu itu patah!

entries.original: "It’s a challenge rock."
entries.translation_source: It’s a challenge rock.
entries.translated: Ini adalah batu tantangan.

entries.original:
"For many years I have isolated
myself in this cave.

After all this time, I am now the
most powerful Trainer here.

Can you even hope to take the title
from me?"
entries.translation_source: For many years I have isolated myself in this cave. After all this time, I am now the most powerful Trainer here. Can you even hope to take the title from me?
entries.translated:
Selama bertahun-tahun aku
mengasingkan diri di gua ini. Set\lsekian lama, aku kini menjadi

Pelatih terkuat di sini. Bisakah
kau berharap untuk merebut gelar\litu dariku?

entries.original:
"What’s done is done.

I will never get those years of my
life back.

All I can hope to do now is move
forward.

I won’t be needing this anymore."
entries.translation_source: What’s done is done. I will never get those years of my life back. All I can hope to do now is move forward. I won’t be needing this anymore.
entries.translated:
Apa yang terjadi sudah terjadi. Aku
tidak akan pernah bisa mendapatkan\lkembali tahun-tahun hidupku itu.

Yang bisa kuharapkan sekarang
hanyalah melangkah maju. Aku sudah\ltidak membutuhkan ini lagi.

"That’s a Mega Stone for the
Pokémon [green]Ampharos[blue].

Only the strongest Trainers can
hope to use it well.

Farewell, Trainer."

Itu adalah Batu Mega untuk Pokémon
[green]Ampharos[blue]. Hanya Pelatih terkuat\lyang bisa berharap untuk

menggunakannya dengan baik. Selamat
tinggal, Pelatih.

"For many years I have isolated
myself in this cave.

After all this time, I am now the
most powerful Trainer here.

If you wish to challenge me for
this title, defeat all of the other\lTrainers first."
entries.translation_source: For many years I have isolated myself in this cave. After all this time, I am now the most powerful Trainer here. If you wish to challenge me for this title, defeat all of the other Trainers first.
entries.translated:
Selama bertahun-tahun aku
mengasingkan diri di gua ini. Set\lsekian lama, aku kini menjadi

Pelatih terkuat di sini. Jika kau
ingin menantangku untuk gelar ini,\lkalahkan semua Pelatih lain

terlebih dahulu.

entries.original:
"Zzzz\.

[black]She appears to have fallen asleep
at her post.

Better go a different way."
entries.translation_source: Zzzz[game-token-1] [color-black-2]She appears to have fallen asleep at her post. Better go a different way.
entries.translated:
Zzzz\. [black]Dia tampaknya tertidur di
posnya. Lebih baik pergi lewat\ljalan lain.

entries.original:
"No matter how fast you run, there
are plenty of us to slow you down!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how fast you run, there are plenty of us to slow you down!
entries.translated:
Tidak peduli seberapa cepat kau
lari, ada banyak dari kami untuk\lmemperlambatmu!

entries.original:
"Why are we after Zapdos?

\.

Beats me.
I just get paid to follow orders."
entries.translation_source: Why are we after Zapdos? [game-token-1] Beats me. I just get paid to follow orders.
entries.translated:
Kenapa kita mengejar Zapdos? \.
Entahlah. Aku dibayar untuk\lmengikuti perintah.

entries.original:
"This room\. It’s so hard to
navigate through it\."
entries.translation_source: This room[game-token-1] It’s so hard to navigate through it[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ruangan ini\. Sangat sulit untuk
menavigasinya\.

entries.original:
"Seriously, this room is the reason it
took us so long to reach the peak\."
entries.translation_source: Seriously, this room is the reason it took us so long to reach the peak[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Serius, ruangan ini yang
menyebabkan kami butuh waktu lama\luntuk mencapai puncak\.

entries.original:
"Well, if I can’t slow you down, at
least this room will."
entries.translation_source: Well, if I can’t slow you down, at least this room will.
entries.translated:
Yah, jika aku tidak bisa
memperlambatmu, setidaknya ruangan\lini akan melakukannya.

entries.original:
"I hope none of the other grunts
fell off the mountain\."
entries.translation_source: I hope none of the other grunts fell off the mountain[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku harap tidak ada anak buah lain
yang jatuh dari gunung\.

entries.original:
"You’d better hurry it up, kid.

Because if those tremors mean what I
think they mean\."
entries.translation_source: You’d better hurry it up, kid. Because if those tremors mean what I think they mean[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sebaiknya kau cepat, nak. Karena
jika getaran-getaran itu artinya\lseperti yang kukira\.

entries.original:
"I can only imagine what the
higher-ups will do to him\.

\.

Wait, I failed too, didn’t I?

Ack! I’m sorry, Marlon, sir!

Don’t put me on Shadow Warrior
feeding duty! Please!"
entries.translation_source: I can only imagine what the higher-ups will do to him[game-token-1] [game-token-2] Wait, I failed too, didn’t I? Ack! I’m sorry, Marlon, sir! Don’t put me on Shadow Warrior feeding duty! Please!
entries.translated:
Aku hanya bisa membayangkan apa
yang akan dilakukan atasan padanya\. \.\lTunggu, aku juga gagal, kan? Aduh!

Maaf, Tuan Marlon! Jangan tugaskan
aku memberi makan Shadow Warrior!\lKumohon!

entries.original:
"The mountain’s got a pretty neat
view, don’t ya think?

Just a shame about the Pokémon
living here.

But that’s why we dealt with ’em!"
entries.translation_source: The mountain’s got a pretty neat view, don’t ya think? Just a shame about the Pokémon living here. But that’s why we dealt with ’em!
entries.translated:
Gunung ini punya pemandangan yang
cukup keren, bukan? Sayangnya\ltentang Pokémon yang tinggal di

sini. Tapi itulah kenapa kami
menangani mereka!

entries.original:
"Despite my rage, I’m still just a
Rattata in a cage\."
entries.translation_source: Despite my rage, I’m still just a Rattata in a cage[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Meskipun amarahku, aku tetap hanya
seekor Rattata di dalam sangkar\.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon living here were getting
in the way, so we rounded ’em up\lan locked ’em in an electric cage.

How can you unlock it?

Hah! Like I’ll ever tell you!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon living here were getting in the way, so we rounded ’em up an locked ’em in an electric cage. How can you unlock it? Hah! Like I’ll ever tell you!
entries.translated:
Pokémon yang tinggal di sini
menghalangi, jadi kami mengumpulkan\lmereka dan mengunci mereka di dalam

sangkar listrik. Bagaimana cara
membukanya? Hah! Seolah aku akan\lmemberitahumu!

entries.original:
"Even if you keep going, I’ll never
tell you which of the Grunts has\lthe key to release the Pokémon!

\.Oh, shoot. I just blabbed about
the key\."
entries.translation_source: Even if you keep going, I’ll never tell you which of the Grunts has the key to release the Pokémon! [game-token-1]Oh, shoot. I just blabbed about the key[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Bahkan jika kau terus maju, aku
tidak akan pernah memberitahumu\lanak buah mana yang memiliki kunci

untuk melepaskan Pokémon! \.Oh, sial.
Aku baru saja membocorkan soal\lkunci\.

entries.original:
"The stairs have been destroyed, so
nothing can interrupt Marlon while\lhe prepares to capture Zapdos."
entries.translation_source: The stairs have been destroyed, so nothing can interrupt Marlon while he prepares to capture Zapdos.
entries.translated:
Tangga-tangganya telah dihancurkan,
jadi tidak ada yang bisa mengganggu\lMarlon saat dia bersiap menangkap

Zapdos.

entries.original:
"

It’s nothing like Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: It’s nothing like Antisis City.

entries.original:
"Maybe I should go back to
Antisis City.

I’m out of my depth in here."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should go back to Antisis City. I’m out of my depth in here.
entries.translated:
Mungkin aku harus kembali ke
Antisis City. Aku tidak sanggup di\lsini.

entries.original:
"Did you know?

The Dehara City Gym Leader
trains here regularly."
entries.translation_source: Did you know? The Dehara City Gym Leader trains here regularly.
entries.translated:
Tahukah kamu? Pemimpin Gym Dehara
City berlatih di sini secara rutin.

entries.original:
"Wow, you’re strong!
Do you train here too?"
entries.translation_source: Wow, you’re strong! Do you train here too?
entries.translated:
Wow, kau kuat! Apakah kau juga
berlatih di sini?

entries.original:
"I guess I need to train more to
match that Gym Leader."
entries.translation_source: I guess I need to train more to match that Gym Leader.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya aku perlu berlatih lebih
keras untuk menyamai Pemimpin Gym\litu.

entries.original:
"My top speed went down when I got
trapped in that electric web!"
entries.translation_source: My top speed went down when I got trapped in that electric web!
entries.translated:
Kecepatan tertinggiku menurun saat
aku terjebak di jaring listrik itu!

entries.original:
"Hahhh!
I have no need for HM slaves!

I will keep smashing rocks with
my bare hands!"
entries.translation_source: Hahhh! I have no need for HM slaves! I will keep smashing rocks with my bare hands!
entries.translated:
Hahhh! Aku tidak butuh budak HM!
Aku akan terus menghancurkan batu\ldengan tangan kosong!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon evolved from the energy
in this cave!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon evolved from the energy in this cave!
entries.translated:
Pokémonku berevolusi dari energi di
gua ini!

entries.original:
"When I was your age, most of the
paths here didn’t exist.

I dug through the cave with my
trusty Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: When I was your age, most of the paths here didn’t exist. I dug through the cave with my trusty Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Saat seusiamu, sebagian besar jalur
di sini belum ada. Aku menggali gua\lini dengan Pokémon andalanku.

entries.original:
"When I was your age, we respected
our elders.

We didn’t mercilessly beat them."
entries.translation_source: When I was your age, we respected our elders. We didn’t mercilessly beat them.
entries.translated:
Saat seusiamu, kami menghormati
orang yang lebih tua. Kami tidak\lmengalahkan mereka tanpa ampun.

entries.original:
"Youngsters like you\.
No respect for their elders."
entries.translation_source: Youngsters like you[game-token-1] No respect for their elders.
entries.translated:
Anak-anak sepertimu\. Tidak hormat
pada orang yang lebih tua.

entries.original:
"Your skill makes my rubber gear
seem useless.

Maybe I should invest in a more
expensive brand."
entries.translation_source: Your skill makes my rubber gear seem useless. Maybe I should invest in a more expensive brand.
entries.translated:
Kemampuanmu membuat peralatan
karetku terlihat tidak berguna.\lMungkin aku harus berinvestasi pada

merek yang lebih mahal.

entries.original:
"It appears I need to spend more
time honing my clairvoyance."
entries.translation_source: It appears I need to spend more time honing my clairvoyance.
entries.translated:
Tampaknya aku perlu menghabiskan
lebih banyak waktu untuk mengasah\lkewaskitaanku.

entries.original:
"Even though I lost, I’m still
very happy!

The cavern is glowing with the
fires of passion!"
entries.translation_source: Even though I lost, I’m still very happy! The cavern is glowing with the fires of passion!
entries.translated:
Meskipun aku kalah, aku masih
sangat bahagia! Guanya bersinar\ldengan api gairah!

entries.original:
"Ho ho ho!
Gee golly, it’s a mountain!"
entries.translation_source: Ho ho ho! Gee golly, it’s a mountain!
entries.translated: Ho ho ho! Astaga, itu gunung!

entries.original:
"What a fun battle!

You got my blood flowing during my
long climb."
entries.translation_source: What a fun battle! You got my blood flowing during my long climb.
entries.translated:
Pertarungan yang menyenangkan! Kamu
membuat darahku mengalir selama\lpendakian panjangku.

entries.original:
"Be careful when climbing the rock
walls, the fall can be treacherous."
entries.translation_source: Be careful when climbing the rock walls, the fall can be treacherous.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati saat memanjat dinding
batu, jatuhnya bisa berbahaya.

entries.original: "and Surf!"
entries.translation_source: and Surf!

entries.original:
"In order to disengage the electric
barrier in this room, you should\lstart with the boulders on the\lright side of this room.

You’ll need Surf to get over there,
though."
entries.translation_source: In order to disengage the electric barrier in this room, you should start with the boulders on the right side of this room. You’ll need Surf to get over there, though.
entries.translated:
Untuk menonaktifkan penghalang
listrik di ruangan ini, kamu harus\lmulai dengan batu-batu besar di

sisi kanan ruangan ini. Namun, kamu
akan membutuhkan Surf untuk sampai\lke sana.

entries.original:
"Surprisingly, you can’t catch any
[green]Voltorb[blue] here.

They’re only found daily in one of
the Gyms."
entries.translation_source: Surprisingly, you can’t catch any [color-green-1]Voltorb[color-blue-2] here. They’re only found daily in one of the Gyms.
entries.translated:
Anehnya, kamu tidak bisa menangkap
[green]Voltorb[blue] di sini. Mereka hanya\lditemukan setiap hari di salah satu

Gym.

entries.original:
"Now I can’t get back up the ladder,
no matter how hard I try."
entries.translation_source: Now I can’t get back up the ladder, no matter how hard I try.
entries.translated:
Sekarang aku tidak bisa naik
kembali ke tangga, tidak peduli\lseberapa keras aku berusaha.

entries.original:
"Have your Pokémon been acting
funny lately?"
entries.translation_source: Have your Pokémon been acting funny lately?
entries.translated:
Apakah Pokémon-mu bertingkah aneh
akhir-akhir ini?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.
Clearly not\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] Clearly not[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Hmm\. Jelas tidak\.

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn my Electric-types
were acting funny until they were\lknocked out\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn my Electric-types were acting funny until they were knocked out[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku bisa bersumpah tipe Listrikku
bertingkah aneh sampai mereka KO\.

entries.original:
"People assume just because I’m a
Super Nerd, I’m required to do\lnerdy things.

I can study rocks if I want to!

Nobody can tell me who I have
to be!"
entries.translation_source: People assume just because I’m a Super Nerd, I’m required to do nerdy things. I can study rocks if I want to! Nobody can tell me who I have to be!
entries.translated:
Orang-orang menganggap hanya karena
aku seorang Super Nerd, aku harus\lmelakukan hal-hal kutu buku. Aku

bisa mempelajari batu jika aku mau!
Tidak ada yang bisa memberitahuku\lsiapa aku harus menjadi!

entries.original:
"Me? No, I’m not lost.
I live here!"
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not lost. I live here!
entries.translated:
Aku? Tidak, aku tidak tersesat. Aku
tinggal di sini!

entries.original:
"I hear there’s a Pokémon that has
mushrooms growing on its back.

Not around here, though.
I wonder if they taste any good?"
entries.translation_source: I hear there’s a Pokémon that has mushrooms growing on its back. Not around here, though. I wonder if they taste any good?
entries.translated:
Kudengar ada Pokémon yang memiliki
jamur tumbuh di punggungnya. Tapi\ltidak di sekitar sini. Aku

penasaran apakah mereka enak?

entries.original:
"Huh? Are you lost too?
No? It doesn’t matter.

Let’s have a quick Pokémon
battle!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? Are you lost too? No? It doesn’t matter. Let’s have a quick Pokémon battle!
entries.translated:
Hah? Apakah kamu juga tersesat?
Tidak? Tidak masalah. Ayo bertarung\lPokémon cepat!

entries.original:
"Lost?

There’s nothing lost about this kid!"
entries.translation_source: Lost? There’s nothing lost about this kid!
entries.translated:
Tersesat? Tidak ada yang tersesat
dari anak ini!

entries.original:
"I got separated from my friends\.

I’ve got my Pokémon with me so
I’m okay, but\."
entries.translation_source: I got separated from my friends[game-token-1] I’ve got my Pokémon with me so I’m okay, but[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aku terpisah dari teman-temanku\. Aku
membawa Pokémon bersamaku jadi aku\lbaik-baik saja, tapi\.

entries.original:
" You’re lost, aren’t you?
I’ll guide you if you can beat me."
entries.translation_source: You’re lost, aren’t you? I’ll guide you if you can beat me.

entries.original:
"I’m not lost, I tell you!
I’m camping! That’s my story!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not lost, I tell you! I’m camping! That’s my story!
entries.translated:
Aku tidak tersesat, kataku! Aku
berkemah! Itu ceritaku!

entries.original: "a start, right?"
entries.translation_source: a start, right?

entries.original:
"I just wanted to have a picnic in
Thundercap Mt.

I didn’t think I would get lost
in a place like this\."
entries.translation_source: I just wanted to have a picnic in Thundercap Mt. I didn’t think I would get lost in a place like this[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku hanya ingin piknik di Gunung
Thundercap. Aku tidak berpikir akan\ltersesat di tempat seperti ini\.

entries.original:
"Why have a picnic here?
I don’t know.

There’s no deep meaning to it."
entries.translation_source: Why have a picnic here? I don’t know. There’s no deep meaning to it.
entries.translated:
Kenapa piknik di sini? Entahlah.
Tidak ada makna mendalam tentang\litu.

entries.original:
"Did you come to play, too?
Wanna play battle with me?"
entries.translation_source: Did you come to play, too? Wanna play battle with me?
entries.translated:
Kamu juga datang untuk bermain? Mau
bertarung denganku?

entries.original: "You were just toying with me!"
entries.translation_source: You were just toying with me!
entries.translated: Kamu hanya mempermainkanku!

entries.original:
"I’m playing hide-and-seek here.
I like some underground tag, too."
entries.translation_source: I’m playing hide-and-seek here. I like some underground tag, too.
entries.translated:
Aku bermain petak umpet di sini.
Aku juga suka bermain kejar-kejaran\lbawah tanah.

entries.original: " to take care of you!"
entries.translation_source: to take care of you!

entries.original:
"Speaking of crying, I’m positive I
heard before\."
entries.translation_source: Speaking of crying, I’m positive I heard before[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Bicara soal menangis, aku yakin
pernah mendengarnya sebelumnya\.

entries.original:
"Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy
Town and terrorize ’em for fun.

But then that white-haired Gym
Leader always chases me away.

I hope I give him such a headache\."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy Town and terrorize ’em for fun. But then that white-haired Gym Leader always chases me away. I hope I give him such a headache[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kadang aku berjalan ke Kota Epidimy
dan meneror mereka untuk\lbersenang-senang. Tapi kemudian

Pemimpin Gym berambut putih itu
selalu mengusirku. Kuharap aku\lmembuatnya pusing sekali\.

entries.original:
"I trained like a madman, and my
Pokémon trained even more!"
entries.translation_source: I trained like a madman, and my Pokémon trained even more!
entries.translated:
Aku berlatih seperti orang gila,
dan Pokémon-ku berlatih lebih keras\llagi!

entries.original:
"Yeah, yeah!
Even though I lost, I’m energetic!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, yeah! Even though I lost, I’m energetic!
entries.translated:
Ya, ya! Meskipun aku kalah, aku
tetap bersemangat!

entries.original:
"For someone as mad as you, your
training has clearly paid off!

And madness born from a drive for
strength must be rewarded!

Trainer!

Have you any of those [green]Power Items[blue]?

They may not look it, but my hands
are both for crafting and punching!

So, allow me to improve all of your
Power Items so they may strengthen\lyour Pokémon even quicker!

All I need are stars - [green][buffer1]s[blue]
to be exact!

You can collect one [buffer1] per
day by smashing the [green]Challenge Rock[blue].

This imposing rock, right here.

Bring a [green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon and
smash your way through!"
entries.translation_source: For someone as mad as you, your training has clearly paid off! And madness born from a drive for strength must be rewarded! Trainer! Have you any of those [color-green-1]Power Items[color-blue-2]? They may not look it, but my hands are both for crafting and punching! So, allow me to improve all of your Power Items so they may strengthen your Pokémon even quicker! All I need are stars - [color-green-3][buffer1-4]s[color-blue-5] to be exact! You can collect one [buffer1-6] per day by smashing the [color-green-7]Challenge Rock[color-blue-8]. This imposing rock, right here. Bring a [color-green-9]Fighting[color-blue-10]-type Pokémon and smash your way through!
entries.translated:
Untuk seseorang yang segila dirimu,
latihanmu jelas membuahkan hasil!\lDan kegilaan yang lahir dari

dorongan untuk kekuatan harus
dihargai! Trainer! Apakah kamu\lpunya [green]Power Items[blue] itu? Meskipun

tidak terlihat, tanganku bisa untuk
membuat dan memukul! Jadi, izinkan\laku meningkatkan semua Power

Items-mu agar mereka bisa
memperkuat Pokémon-mu lebih cepat!\lYang aku butuhkan hanyalah bintang

- tepatnya [green][buffer1]s[blue]! Kamu bisa
mengumpulkan satu [buffer1] per hari\ldengan menghancurkan [green]Challenge

Rock[blue]. Batu besar ini, di sini.
Bawalah Pokémon tipe [green]Fighting[blue] dan\lhancurkan jalanmu!

entries.original:
"Greetings, mad one among madmen!

If you wish, pay me [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue]
and I will upgrade all of your\l[green]Power Items[blue] to [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Greetings, mad one among madmen! If you wish, pay me [color-green-1][buffer3-2] [buffer1-3][color-blue-4] and I will upgrade all of your [color-green-5]Power Items[color-blue-6] to [color-green-7][game-token-8] [buffer2-9][color-blue-10]!
entries.translated:
Salam, yang gila di antara para
orang gila! Jika kamu mau, bayar\laku [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue] dan aku akan

meningkatkan semua [green]Power Items[blue]
milikmu menjadi [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over
[buffer2] [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over [buffer2-3] [buffer1-4].
entries.translated:
[black][player] menyerahkan [buffer2]
[buffer1].

entries.original:
"[black]The Power Item level has been
increased to \Lv [buffer2]!

Pokémon will now gain an additional
[green]\\0C[black] Effort Values when one is held."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Power Item level has been increased to [game-token-2] [buffer2-3]! Pokémon will now gain an additional [color-green-4][raw-escape-5][color-black-6] Effort Values when one is held.
entries.translated:
[black]Level Power Item telah ditingkatkan
menjadi \Lv [buffer2]! Pokémon\lsekarang akan mendapatkan tambahan

[green]\\0C[black] Effort Values saat salah satu
item tersebut dikenakan.

entries.original:
"Gather the stars around Borrius
and come again!"
entries.translation_source: Gather the stars around Borrius and come again!
entries.translated:
Kumpulkan bintang-bintang di
sekitar Borrius dan datang lagi!

entries.original:
"Alas, you lack the [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue]
to upgrade your Power Items.

Obtain more stars to your name
and come again!"
entries.translation_source: Alas, you lack the [color-green-1][buffer3-2] [buffer1-3][color-blue-4] to upgrade your Power Items. Obtain more stars to your name and come again!
entries.translated:
Sayangnya, kamu kekurangan [green][buffer3]
[buffer1][blue] untuk meningkatkan Power\lItems-mu. Dapatkan lebih banyak

bintang atas namamu dan datang
lagi!

entries.original:
"With your Power Items at their max
level, your Pokémon will gain an\ladditional [green]\\0C[blue] Effort Values when\lone is held!

Tell me that’s not mad, mad one
among madmen!"
entries.translation_source: With your Power Items at their max level, your Pokémon will gain an additional [color-green-1][raw-escape-2][color-blue-3] Effort Values when one is held! Tell me that’s not mad, mad one among madmen!
entries.translated:
Dengan Power Items-mu pada level
maksimal, Pokémon-mu akan\lmendapatkan tambahan [green]\\0C[blue] Effort

Values saat salah satu item
tersebut dikenakan! Katakan itu\ltidak gila, wahai yang gila di

antara para orang gila!

entries.original: "\btn0CMove \btn00Grab \btn01Quit"
entries.translation_source: [button-icon-1]Move [button-icon-2]Grab [button-icon-3]Quit

entries.original: "\btn0CMove \btn00Drop \btn01Cancel"
entries.translation_source: [button-icon-1]Move [button-icon-2]Drop [button-icon-3]Cancel

entries.original: "\btn0CMove \btn00Slide \btn01Quit"
entries.translation_source: [button-icon-1]Move [button-icon-2]Slide [button-icon-3]Quit

entries.original:
"This image must be recreated
to proceed![pause]"
entries.translation_source: This image must be recreated to proceed![text-token-pause-1]

entries.original: "Give up solving the puzzle?"
entries.translation_source: Give up solving the puzzle?

entries.original: "Tomb of Borrius"
entries.translation_source: Tomb of Borrius
entries.translated: Makam Borrius

entries.original:
"An ancient tomb said to be the
resting place of King Borrius III.
Immense wealth is said to wait for
anyone who can reach the burial
chamber."
entries.translation_source: An ancient tomb said to be the resting place of King Borrius III. Immense wealth is said to wait for anyone who can reach the burial chamber.

entries.original: "Tomb Raider"
entries.translation_source: Tomb Raider
entries.translated: Pemburu Makam

entries.original:
"A hole has opened up into the
depths of a tomb! Explore it and
solve its mysteries."
entries.translation_source: A hole has opened up into the depths of a tomb! Explore it and solve its mysteries.
entries.translated:
Sebuah lubang telah terbuka ke
... kedalaman makam! Jelajahi
dan pecahkan misterinya.

entries.original: "Fred"
entries.translation_source: Fred
entries.translated: Fred

entries.original:
"This piece goes here\.

And that piece goes there\."
entries.translation_source: This piece goes here[game-token-1] And that piece goes there[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Potongan ini ditempatkan di sini\.
Dan potongan itu ditempatkan di\lsana\.

entries.original:
"Oh, a Trainer!

The name’s Fred.

My colleagues and I have been here
for weeks trying to learn more\labout this ancient tomb.

Unfortunately, this puzzle here has
us stumped.

If you think you’ll have a better
chance at solving it than we did,\lthen be my guest."
entries.translation_source: Oh, a Trainer! The name’s Fred. My colleagues and I have been here for weeks trying to learn more about this ancient tomb. Unfortunately, this puzzle here has us stumped. If you think you’ll have a better chance at solving it than we did, then be my guest.
entries.translated:
Oh, seorang Pelatih! Namaku Fred.
Aku dan rekan-rekanku sudah berada\ldi sini selama berminggu-minggu

mencoba mempelajari lebih lanjut
tentang makam kuno ini. Sayangnya,\lteka-teki di sini membuat kami

kebingungan. Jika kau pikir kau
punya kesempatan lebih baik untuk\lmenyelesaikannya daripada kami,

silakan.

entries.original:
"This puzzle here has had us stumped
for weeks!

It’s simply too hard to complete\."
entries.translation_source: This puzzle here has had us stumped for weeks! It’s simply too hard to complete[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Teka-teki ini telah membuat kami
bingung selama berminggu-minggu!\lIni terlalu sulit untuk

diselesaikan\.

entries.original:
"Come on, Fred!
You can do it!

\.Wait, what are you doing!?

That piece doesn’t go there!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, Fred! You can do it! [game-token-1]Wait, what are you doing!? That piece doesn’t go there!
entries.translated:
Ayo, Fred! Kamu bisa melakukannya!
\.Tunggu, apa yang kamu lakukan!?\lPotongan itu tidak seharusnya di

sana.

entries.original:
"This tomb was designed by the
ancient people of Borrius to keep\lout intruders like us.

The puzzle on this floor must only
be the first in a series of traps\lbefore the burial chamber\."
entries.translation_source: This tomb was designed by the ancient people of Borrius to keep out intruders like us. The puzzle on this floor must only be the first in a series of traps before the burial chamber[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Makam ini dirancang oleh orang kuno
Borrius untuk mencegah penyusup\lseperti kita. Teka-teki di lantai

ini pasti hanya yang pertama dari
serangkaian jebakan sebelum ruang\lpemakaman\..

entries.original:
"This tomb was designed by the
ancient people of Borrius to keep\lout intruders like us.

The puzzle on this floor must only
be the first in a series of traps\lbefore the burial chamber\.

Best of luck down there."
entries.translation_source: This tomb was designed by the ancient people of Borrius to keep out intruders like us. The puzzle on this floor must only be the first in a series of traps before the burial chamber[game-token-1] Best of luck down there.
entries.translated:
Makam ini dirancang oleh orang kuno
Borrius untuk menghalau penyusup\lseperti kita. Teka-teki di lantai

ini pastilah hanya yang pertama
dari rangkaian jebakan sebelum\lruang pemakaman\. Semoga beruntung di

sana.

entries.original:
"This door is the passageway to the
burial chamber!

I can feel it in my bones!"
entries.translation_source: This door is the passageway to the burial chamber! I can feel it in my bones!
entries.translated:
Pintu ini adalah jalan menuju ruang
pemakaman! Aku bisa merasakannya di\ltulang-tulangku!

entries.original:
"This door is the passageway to the
burial chamber!

I can feel it in my bones!

Maybe something you’ll discover
down below will provide the key\lto unlocking it\."
entries.translation_source: This door is the passageway to the burial chamber! I can feel it in my bones! Maybe something you’ll discover down below will provide the key to unlocking it[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Pintu ini adalah lorong menuju
ruang pemakaman! Aku bisa\lmerasakannya di tulangku! Mungkin

sesuatu yang akan kamu temukan di
bawah akan memberikan kunci untuk\lmembukanya\.

entries.original:
"Hey, kid!

You okay down there?

That looked like a nasty fall!

\.

\.I’m sure you’ll shrug it off!

Hang on\.
Let me throw down a ladder."
entries.translation_source: Hey, kid! You okay down there? That looked like a nasty fall! [game-token-1] [game-token-2]I’m sure you’ll shrug it off! Hang on[game-token-3] Let me throw down a ladder.
entries.translated:
Hei, Nak! Kamu baik-baik saja di
sana? Itu kelihatannya jatuh yang\lparah! \. \.Aku yakin kamu akan

mengatasinya! Tunggu\. Biarkan aku
menurunkan tangga.

entries.original:
"Wow, kid, looks like you found a
way into the tomb!

I’m impressed!

Not even the greatest minds in the
Archeology Society could crack\lthat puzzle!

You’re a natural archeologist, kid!

In fact, why don’t you take the
lead on exploring this place?

They say great riches are waiting
for anyone who can find the burial\lchamber.

A whiz like you should have no
problem finding it."
entries.translation_source: Wow, kid, looks like you found a way into the tomb! I’m impressed! Not even the greatest minds in the Archeology Society could crack that puzzle! You’re a natural archeologist, kid! In fact, why don’t you take the lead on exploring this place? They say great riches are waiting for anyone who can find the burial chamber. A whiz like you should have no problem finding it.
entries.translated:
Wow, nak, sepertinya kamu menemukan
jalan masuk ke makam! Aku terkesan!\lBahkan para pemikir terhebat di

Perkumpulan Arkeologi pun tidak
bisa memecahkan teka-teki itu! Kamu\ladalah arkeolog alami, nak!

Sebenarnya, kenapa kamu tidak
memimpin dalam menjelajahi tempat\lini? Mereka bilang kekayaan besar

menanti siapa pun yang bisa
menemukan ruang pemakaman. Seorang\ljenius sepertimu seharusnya tidak

masalah menemukannya.

entries.original:
"Keep your eye out for hidden
treasure as you explore the tomb.

I doubt the ancient civilization
left much treasure just lying\laround\."
entries.translation_source: Keep your eye out for hidden treasure as you explore the tomb. I doubt the ancient civilization left much treasure just lying around[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Perhatikan harta karun tersembunyi
saat menjelajahi makam. Saya ragu\lperadaban kuno meninggalkan banyak

harta karun begitu saja\.

entries.original: "[green]Booooooooo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Booooooooo!
entries.translated: [green]Huuuuuuuuu!

entries.original:
"\.A volcano\.?

How in the world did they get a
volcano in this tomb\.?

\.Oh, well.
No point in dwelling on it.

It looks like we’re too high up to
ride on a Pokémon across the lava,\lso you just keep finding us a way\lthrough the tomb."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]A volcano[game-token-2]? How in the world did they get a volcano in this tomb[game-token-3]? [game-token-4]Oh, well. No point in dwelling on it. It looks like we’re too high up to ride on a Pokémon across the lava, so you just keep finding us a way through the tomb.
entries.translated:
\.Gunung berapi\.? Bagaimana mungkin
mereka bisa membawa gunung berapi\lke dalam makam ini\.? \.Oh, sudahlah.

Tidak ada gunanya memikirkannya.
Sepertinya kita terlalu tinggi\luntuk menunggangi Pokémon melintasi

lava, jadi kamu terus saja mencari
jalan bagi kita melewati makam ini.

entries.original:
"Be careful when hopping on those
rocks!

One wrong step and you’ll fall to
a fiery doom\.

So stay safe, and keep an eye out
for any hidden switches that might\llead us to the next floor."
entries.translation_source: Be careful when hopping on those rocks! One wrong step and you’ll fall to a fiery doom[game-token-1] So stay safe, and keep an eye out for any hidden switches that might lead us to the next floor.
entries.translated:
Hati-hati saat melompat di atas
batu-batu itu! Satu langkah salah\ldan kamu akan jatuh ke kematian

yang membara\. Jadi tetap aman, dan
perhatikan saklar-saklar\ltersembunyi yang mungkin membawa

kita ke lantai berikutnya.

entries.original: "The rock reacted to your touch!"
entries.translation_source: The rock reacted to your touch!
entries.translated:
Batu itu bereaksi terhadap
sentuhanmu!

entries.original:
"Ohhh\. Trainer\.
I don’t feel so good\.

The Dusknoir must be messing with
the space in our dimension\.

The more I move, the fuzzier
it gets\.

So be careful\.
And don’t let them spot youuuu\."
entries.translation_source: Ohhh[game-token-1] Trainer[game-token-2] I don’t feel so good[game-token-3] The Dusknoir must be messing with the space in our dimension[game-token-4] The more I move, the fuzzier it gets[game-token-5] So be careful[game-token-6] And don’t let them spot youuuu[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Ohhh\. Pelatih\. Aku merasa tidak enak\.
Dusknoir pasti mengacaukan ruang di\ldimensi kita\. Semakin aku bergerak,

semakin kabur\. Jadi hati-hati\. Dan
jangan biarkan mereka melihatmuuu\.

entries.original:
"The Dusknoir must be messing with
the space in our dimension\.

Be careful\.
And don’t let them spot youuuu\."
entries.translation_source: The Dusknoir must be messing with the space in our dimension[game-token-1] Be careful[game-token-2] And don’t let them spot youuuu[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Dusknoir pasti sedang mengacaukan
ruang di dimensi kita\. Hati-hati\. Dan\ljangan biarkan mereka melihatmuuuu\.

entries.original:
"Phew\.

Am I ever glad I got through that
in one piece!"
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1] Am I ever glad I got through that in one piece!
entries.translated:
Fiuh\. Aku sangat lega bisa melewati
itu dengan selamat!

entries.original:
"Uh oh.

Looks like one wrong step on this
floor and you’ll plummet back down\lto the floor below.

But there has to be some way to get
across the floor, right?

Maybe if you can reach a certain
speed?"
entries.translation_source: Uh oh. Looks like one wrong step on this floor and you’ll plummet back down to the floor below. But there has to be some way to get across the floor, right? Maybe if you can reach a certain speed?
entries.translated:
Uh oh. Sepertinya satu langkah yang
salah di lantai ini dan kamu akan\ljatuh kembali ke lantai di

bawahnya. Tapi pasti ada cara untuk
menyeberangi lantai ini, kan?\lMungkin jika kamu bisa mencapai

kecepatan tertentu?

entries.original:
"I’d wager that if you can find a
way to move quickly across the\lfloor, you’ll be able to avoid\lfalling through the holes."
entries.translation_source: I’d wager that if you can find a way to move quickly across the floor, you’ll be able to avoid falling through the holes.
entries.translated:
Saya yakin jika kamu bisa menemukan
cara untuk bergerak cepat di\llantai, kamu akan bisa menghindari

jatuh ke dalam lubang-lubang.

entries.original:
"This is it\.
The burial chamber!

And look!

That must be where the ancient king
of Borrius is buried.

Now that we’ve made it, let’s
gather up as much treasure as we\lcan, then get out of here.

And just in case there are still
traps waiting to be sprung, let me\luse the last of my healing items on\lyour Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: This is it[game-token-1] The burial chamber! And look! That must be where the ancient king of Borrius is buried. Now that we’ve made it, let’s gather up as much treasure as we can, then get out of here. And just in case there are still traps waiting to be sprung, let me use the last of my healing items on your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ini dia\. Ruang pemakaman! Lihat! Itu
pasti tempat raja kuno Borrius\ldimakamkan. Sekarang kita sudah

sampai, mari kita kumpulkan
sebanyak mungkin harta karun, lalu\lkeluar dari sini. Dan untuk

berjaga-jaga jika masih ada jebakan
yang menunggu untuk dipicu, biarkan\laku menggunakan item penyembuh

terakhirku pada Pokémon-mu.

entries.original:
"Gather up as much treasure as
you can.

When you’ve done that, I’d wager
there’s even more hiding inside\lthat coffin\."
entries.translation_source: Gather up as much treasure as you can. When you’ve done that, I’d wager there’s even more hiding inside that coffin[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Kumpulkan sebanyak mungkin harta
karun. Setelah itu, aku yakin masih\lada lebih banyak lagi yang

tersembunyi di dalam peti mati itu\.

entries.original: "The coffin feels cold to the touch\."
entries.translation_source: The coffin feels cold to the touch[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Peti mati itu terasa dingin saat
disentuh\.

entries.original:
"[red]WARNING! WARNING! WARNING!

INTRUDER DETECTED!

THE AUTOMATED DEFENSE SYSTEM HAS
BEEN ENGAGED!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]WARNING! WARNING! WARNING! INTRUDER DETECTED! THE AUTOMATED DEFENSE SYSTEM HAS BEEN ENGAGED!
entries.translated:
[red]PERINGATAN! PERINGATAN! PERINGATAN!
PENYUSUP TERDETEKSI! SISTEM\lPERTAHANAN OTOMATIS TELAH

DIAKTIFKAN!

entries.original:
"I knew there’d be some other trap!

I was smart to keep my distance
from this coffin until now.

It’s a good thing I let you take
the lead on the exploration!"
entries.translation_source: I knew there’d be some other trap! I was smart to keep my distance from this coffin until now. It’s a good thing I let you take the lead on the exploration!
entries.translated:
Aku tahu pasti ada jebakan lain!
Aku pintar menjaga jarak dari peti\lmati ini sampai sekarang. Untung

aku membiarkanmu memimpin
eksplorasi!

entries.original:
"It seems your fight with that
ancient Pokémon unlocked the\lseal on the door.

Looks like my colleague was right
about that door leading to the\lburial chamber, after all.

Well, I’d best report back to the
Archeology Society with the\ltreasure and knowledge I gathered.

But before I go, I picked this up
while we were making our way\lthrough the tomb.

At first glance, I thought it was
ancient treasure, but it’s just one\lof those Z-Crystals all the kids\lare into these days.

Here, you can have it."
entries.translation_source: It seems your fight with that ancient Pokémon unlocked the seal on the door. Looks like my colleague was right about that door leading to the burial chamber, after all. Well, I’d best report back to the Archeology Society with the treasure and knowledge I gathered. But before I go, I picked this up while we were making our way through the tomb. At first glance, I thought it was ancient treasure, but it’s just one of those Z-Crystals all the kids are into these days. Here, you can have it.
entries.translated:
Sepertinya pertarunganmu dengan
Pokémon kuno itu membuka segel di\lpintu. Ternyata rekan saya benar

tentang pintu itu yang mengarah ke
ruang pemakaman. Baiklah, sebaiknya\lsaya melapor kembali ke Perkumpulan

Arkeologi dengan harta karun dan
pengetahuan yang saya kumpulkan.\lTapi sebelum pergi, saya mengambil

ini saat kami melewati makam.
Sekilas, saya kira itu harta karun\lkuno, tapi ternyata hanya salah

satu Z-Crystal yang disukai
anak-anak sekarang. Ini, kamu boleh\lmemilikinya.

entries.original:
"Something pinged in the wall!
[buffer1] confirmed!"
entries.translation_source: Something pinged in the wall! [buffer1-1] confirmed!

entries.original:
"Okay, listen up, kiddo!

You’ll be digging with my very own
sledgehammer and pickax!

Press \btn00, and you’ll be able to dig
out all sorts of stuff!

If at any point you want to change
tools, just press \btn02 or \btn03!

I’m sure you can dig some treasure
out before the wall comes down.

You can do it!
Good luck!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, listen up, kiddo! You’ll be digging with my very own sledgehammer and pickax! Press [button-icon-1], and you’ll be able to dig out all sorts of stuff! If at any point you want to change tools, just press [button-icon-2] or [button-icon-3]! I’m sure you can dig some treasure out before the wall comes down. You can do it! Good luck!

entries.original:
"\.

Oh? There’s a note taped inside
the ADM.

\qoDigging for Treasure!\qc

The ADM comes equipped with its
very own sledgehammer and pickax!

Press \btn00, and ye’ll be able to dig
out all sorts of stuff!

If at any point ye want to change
tools, just press \btn02 or \btn03!

I’m sure ye can dig them out
before the wall comes tumblin’\ldown!

Ye can do it!
Good luck!"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] Oh? There’s a note taped inside the ADM. [quote-open-2]Digging for Treasure![quote-close-3] The ADM comes equipped with its very own sledgehammer and pickax! Press [button-icon-4], and ye’ll be able to dig out all sorts of stuff! If at any point ye want to change tools, just press [button-icon-5] or [button-icon-6]! I’m sure ye can dig them out before the wall comes tumblin’ down! Ye can do it! Good luck!

entries.translation_source: The wall collapsed!

entries.translation_source: Underground Pass

entries.original:
"A tunnel connecting Tehl Town to
Route 9.
Enthusiasts have set up a daily
challenge here."
entries.translation_source: A tunnel connecting Tehl Town to Route 9. Enthusiasts have set up a daily challenge here.

entries.original:
"Will you be the latest entrant
in our daily challenge?

Get to the other end of the tunnel
in less than 15 seconds to win a\lfantastic prize!"
entries.translation_source: Will you be the latest entrant in our daily challenge? Get to the other end of the tunnel in less than 15 seconds to win a fantastic prize!
entries.translated:
Maukah kamu menjadi peserta terbaru
dalam tantangan harian kami? Capai\lujung lain terowongan dalam waktu

kurang dari 15 detik untuk
memenangkan hadiah fantastis!

entries.original:
"Back for another attempt at our
daily challenge?"
entries.translation_source: Back for another attempt at our daily challenge?
entries.translated:
Kembali untuk mencoba lagi
tantangan harian kami?

entries.original: "Can’t hack it, eh?"
entries.translation_source: Can’t hack it, eh?
entries.translated: Tidak bisa mengatasinya, ya?

entries.original:
"The rules are simple.

To win a prize, talk to my brother
at the other end of the tunnel in\l[green]less than 15 seconds[blue] from when I\lsay go.

If you make it there in [green]10 seconds
or less[blue], you’ll win a big prize!

We’ll let you know when time is up."
entries.translation_source: The rules are simple. To win a prize, talk to my brother at the other end of the tunnel in [color-green-1]less than 15 seconds[color-blue-2] from when I say go. If you make it there in [color-green-3]10 seconds or less[color-blue-4], you’ll win a big prize! We’ll let you know when time is up.
entries.translated:
Aturannya sederhana. Untuk
memenangkan hadiah, bicaralah\ldengan saudara laki-lakiku di ujung

lain terowongan dalam [green]kurang dari
15 detik[blue] dari saat aku bilang\lmulai. Jika kamu sampai di sana

dalam [green]10 detik atau kurang[blue], kamu
akan memenangkan hadiah besar! Kami\lakan memberitahumu saat waktu

habis.

entries.original:
"On your marks\.
Get set\.

GO! GO! GO!"
entries.translation_source: On your marks[game-token-1] Get set[game-token-2] GO! GO! GO!
entries.translated: Siap\. Siap\. MULAI! MULAI! MULAI!

entries.original:
"What are you waiting for?
GO, GO, GO!"
entries.translation_source: What are you waiting for? GO, GO, GO!
entries.translated:
Apa yang kamu tunggu? MULAI, MULAI,
MULAI!
