"CONGRATULATIONS!

You made it to me in [buffer1]
seconds!

Would you like to claim your prize
now, or hold off and try again in\l10 seconds or less to win an even\lbigger prize?"
entries.translation_source: CONGRATULATIONS! You made it to me in [buffer1-1] seconds! Would you like to claim your prize now, or hold off and try again in 10 seconds or less to win an even bigger prize?
entries.translated:
SELAMAT! Kamu sampai kepadaku dalam
[buffer1] detik! Apakah kamu ingin\lmengambil hadiahmu sekarang, atau

menunda dan mencoba lagi dalam
waktu 10 detik atau kurang untuk\lmemenangkan hadiah yang lebih

besar?

entries.original: "Here’s your prize!"
entries.translation_source: Here’s your prize!
entries.translated: Ini hadiahmu!

entries.original:
"CONGRATULATIONS!

You made it to me in [buffer1]
seconds!

Extraordinary!

Here’s your prize!"
entries.translation_source: CONGRATULATIONS! You made it to me in [buffer1-1] seconds! Extraordinary! Here’s your prize!
entries.translated:
SELAMAT! Kamu sampai kepadaku dalam
[buffer1] detik! Luar biasa! Ini\lhadiahmu!

entries.original:
"CONGRATULATIONS!

You made it to me in [buffer1]
seconds!

Extraordinary!

I didn’t even think that was
possible!

Here’s your prize!"
entries.translation_source: CONGRATULATIONS! You made it to me in [buffer1-1] seconds! Extraordinary! I didn’t even think that was possible! Here’s your prize!
entries.translated:
SELAMAT! Kamu sampai kepadaku dalam
[buffer1] detik! Luar biasa! Aku\lbahkan tidak berpikir itu mungkin!

Ini hadiahmu!

entries.original:
"Speak to my brother or me whenever
you’re ready to try again."
entries.translation_source: Speak to my brother or me whenever you’re ready to try again.
entries.translated:
Bicaralah dengan saudara
laki-lakiku atau aku kapan pun kamu\lsiap untuk mencoba lagi.

entries.original:
"[blue]Time’s up!

Sorry, fella, but you didn’t
make it!

Better luck next time!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Time’s up! Sorry, fella, but you didn’t make it! Better luck next time!
entries.translated:
[blue]Waktu habis! Maaf, kawan, tapi kamu
tidak berhasil! Semoga beruntung\llain kali!

entries.original:
"Come back tomorrow for another
chance to win a fantastic prize!"
entries.translation_source: Come back tomorrow for another chance to win a fantastic prize!
entries.translated:
Kembalilah besok untuk kesempatan
lain memenangkan hadiah fantastis!

entries.original: "Claim Prize"
entries.translation_source: Claim Prize
entries.translated: Klaim Hadiah

entries.original: "Try Again"
entries.translation_source: Try Again
entries.translated: Coba Lagi

entries.original: "Dowsing Wizard"
entries.translation_source: Dowsing Wizard
entries.translated: Penyihir Pendeteksi

entries.original:
"Scavenge the region and find at
least [buffer1] hidden items."
entries.translation_source: Scavenge the region and find at least [buffer1-1] hidden items.
entries.translated:
Jelajahi wilayah dan temukan
setidaknya [buffer1] barang
tersembunyi.

entries.original:
"You can find so much cool stuff in
the most random of places.

Take this Great Ball I found in my
neighbour’s mailbox, for example\.

Or even this half-eaten hot dog I
found in my garbage can.

You want to find some hidden items,
and then compare?"
entries.translation_source: You can find so much cool stuff in the most random of places. Take this Great Ball I found in my neighbour’s mailbox, for example[game-token-1] Or even this half-eaten hot dog I found in my garbage can. You want to find some hidden items, and then compare?
entries.translated:
Kamu bisa menemukan banyak barang
keren di tempat yang paling acak.\lAmbil contoh Bola Hebat ini yang

kutemukan di kotak surat tetanggaku\.
Atau bahkan hot dog setengah\ldimakan ini yang kutemukan di

tempat sampahku. Kamu ingin mencari
beberapa barang tersembunyi, lalu\lbandingkan?

entries.original:
"Awesome!

Once you find [green][buffer1][blue] discarded items,
come back and we’ll compare.

I bet you can’t find anything as
sweet as my haul here!"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! Once you find [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] discarded items, come back and we’ll compare. I bet you can’t find anything as sweet as my haul here!
entries.translated:
Luar biasa! Setelah kamu menemukan
[green][buffer1][blue] barang buangan, kembalilah\ldan kita bandingkan. Aku yakin kamu

tidak akan menemukan barang sekeren
koleksiku di sini!

entries.original:
"That’s cool, I’ll find other people
to compare with."
entries.translation_source: That’s cool, I’ll find other people to compare with.
entries.translated:
Itu keren, aku akan mencari orang
lain untuk dibandingkan.

entries.original:
"So far you’ve found [green][buffer2][blue] hidden
item\\07.

I think you can find some more
in this tunnel.

Come back when you’ve found [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: So far you’ve found [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] hidden item[raw-escape-4]. I think you can find some more in this tunnel. Come back when you’ve found [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-blue-7].
entries.translated:
Sejauh ini kamu telah menemukan
[green][buffer2][blue] barang tersembunyi\\07. Aku\lpikir kamu bisa menemukan lebih

banyak di terowongan ini.
Kembalilah saat kamu telah\lmenemukan [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Okay, let’s see what you got\.

Wow!

Where did you find this mint
condition barbecue chip shaped\llike a Ditto?

Or that limited edition Nanab
Berry peel - that’s vintage!

Hold on, I’ll trade you for ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, let’s see what you got[game-token-1] Wow! Where did you find this mint condition barbecue chip shaped like a Ditto? Or that limited edition Nanab Berry peel - that’s vintage! Hold on, I’ll trade you for ’em!

entries.original:
"Remember to check between couch
cushions for secret treasures."
entries.translation_source: Remember to check between couch cushions for secret treasures.

entries.original:
"[black]Toxapex pumped itself full of
poisonous fluids to increase\lits size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Toxapex pumped itself full of poisonous fluids to increase its size!

entries.original: "[black]Toxapex receded into the sand."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Toxapex receded into the sand.
entries.translated: [black]Toxapex mundur ke dalam pasir.

entries.original:
"DEFEATING
THE TOXAPEX
IS THE KEY."
entries.translation_source: DEFEATING THE TOXAPEX IS THE KEY.
entries.translated: MENGALAHKAN TOXAPEX ADALAH KUNCI.

entries.original: "[black][player] found a rare Egg!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] found a rare Egg!
entries.translated: [black][player] menemukan Telur langka!

entries.original: "The Sharpedo is angry!"
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo is angry!
entries.translated: Sharpedo marah!

entries.original: "The Sharpedo are angry!"
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo are angry!
entries.translated: Sharpedo marah!

entries.original: "The Sharpedo attacked!"
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo attacked!
entries.translated: Sharpedo menyerang!

entries.original:
"The Sharpedo is eyeing you
curiously."
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo is eyeing you curiously.

entries.original: "Valley Cave"
entries.translation_source: Valley Cave
entries.translated: Gua Lembah

entries.original:
"A seemingly plain tunnel that
connects Crater Town to Route 6.
The ocean has recently started
flooding in."
entries.translation_source: A seemingly plain tunnel that connects Crater Town to Route 6. The ocean has recently started flooding in.

entries.original:
"The inscription on the tablet
appears to have eroded away."
entries.translation_source: The inscription on the tablet appears to have eroded away.
entries.translated:
Prasasti pada tablet tampaknya
telah terkikis.

entries.original:
"There appears to be an ancient
button embedded in the rock!

Press it?"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be an ancient button embedded in the rock! Press it?
entries.translated:
Tampaknya ada tombol kuno yang
tertanam di batu! Tekan?

entries.original: "Nothing happened\."
entries.translation_source: Nothing happened[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"A life of gambling is a life of
no regrets."
entries.translation_source: A life of gambling is a life of no regrets.
entries.translated:
Hidup berjudi adalah hidup tanpa
penyesalan.

entries.original:
"I train myself every day by running
barefoot across these stones."
entries.translation_source: I train myself every day by running barefoot across these stones.
entries.translated:
Aku melatih diriku setiap hari
dengan berlari tanpa alas kaki di\latas batu-batu ini.

entries.original:
"Rare herbs grow in this cave.
It is my job to protect them."
entries.translation_source: Rare herbs grow in this cave. It is my job to protect them.

entries.original: "My job is important."
entries.translation_source: My job is important.
entries.translated: Tugasku penting.

entries.original:
"If a Pokémon eats one of the
rare herbs that grow here, its\laffection for you will decrease."
entries.translation_source: If a Pokémon eats one of the rare herbs that grow here, its affection for you will decrease.

entries.original:
"Long ago, there was a readable
inscription on the tablet below.

However, it appears it has long
since eroded away.

From what I remember, I believe it
said something along the lines of:

PRESSING THE SWITCH WITH INSECT
IS THE KEY.

What ever could that mean?"
entries.translation_source: Long ago, there was a readable inscription on the tablet below. However, it appears it has long since eroded away. From what I remember, I believe it said something along the lines of: PRESSING THE SWITCH WITH INSECT IS THE KEY. What ever could that mean?
entries.translated:
Dahulu kala, ada prasasti yang bisa
dibaca di tablet di bawah. Namun,\ltampaknya prasasti itu sudah lama

terkikis. Dari yang kuingat, aku
yakin isinya kira-kira: MENGGUNAKAN\lSAKELAR DENGAN SERANGGA ADALAH

KUNCI. Apa maksudnya?

entries.original:
"It seems that the long-standing
tablet has finally been destroyed.

Were you responsible for removing
that piece of history?"
entries.translation_source: It seems that the long-standing tablet has finally been destroyed. Were you responsible for removing that piece of history?

entries.original: "Victory Road"
entries.translation_source: Victory Road
entries.translated: Victory Road

entries.original:
"The last and toughest of trials
leading up to the Pokémon League.
Trainers seeking to become the best
arrive here after enduring a long
and grueling journey."
entries.translation_source: The last and toughest of trials leading up to the Pokémon League. Trainers seeking to become the best arrive here after enduring a long and grueling journey.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Welcome, Trainer.

This final area of Victory Road is
known as the \qotorture chamber\qc.

All that remains between here and
the Pokémon League is this one\licy area.

But hey, I get it.

Not everyone wants to spend their
time sliding around looking for\lthe exit.

So, let’s cut a deal.

If you pay me $[green]200000[blue], I’ll send
you to the other side.

You won’t even have to get your
feet wet.

What do you say?
It’s only a measly $[green]200000[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh[game-token-1] Welcome, Trainer. This final area of Victory Road is known as the [quote-open-2]torture chamber[quote-close-3]. All that remains between here and the Pokémon League is this one icy area. But hey, I get it. Not everyone wants to spend their time sliding around looking for the exit. So, let’s cut a deal. If you pay me $[color-green-4]200000[color-blue-5], I’ll send you to the other side. You won’t even have to get your feet wet. What do you say? It’s only a measly $[color-green-6]200000[color-blue-7][game-token-8]

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Welcome, Trainer.

This final area of Victory Road is
known as the \qotorture chamber\qc.

All that remains between here and
the Pokémon League is this one\licy area.

But hey, I get it.

Not everyone wants to spend their
time sliding around looking for\lthe exit.

So, let’s cut a deal.

If you pay me $[green]45000[blue], I’ll send
you to the other side.

You won’t even have to get your
feet wet.

What do you say?
It’s only a measly $[green]45000[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh[game-token-1] Welcome, Trainer. This final area of Victory Road is known as the [quote-open-2]torture chamber[quote-close-3]. All that remains between here and the Pokémon League is this one icy area. But hey, I get it. Not everyone wants to spend their time sliding around looking for the exit. So, let’s cut a deal. If you pay me $[color-green-4]45000[color-blue-5], I’ll send you to the other side. You won’t even have to get your feet wet. What do you say? It’s only a measly $[color-green-6]45000[color-blue-7][game-token-8]

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Pleasure doing business with you,
Trainer\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh[game-token-1] Pleasure doing business with you, Trainer[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, heh\. Senang berbisnis
denganmu, Trainer\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Good luck on the ice, Trainer\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh[game-token-1] Good luck on the ice, Trainer[game-token-2]

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, huh?

You don’t have enough coin to
employ my services\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, huh? You don’t have enough coin to employ my services[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

If you’ve made it this far, Insane
Trainer, then you can make it a\llittle farther on your own.

Just slide onto the ice and dive
deep into insanity\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh[game-token-1] If you’ve made it this far, Insane Trainer, then you can make it a little farther on your own. Just slide onto the ice and dive deep into insanity[game-token-2]

entries.original:
"It’s an ingenious design, really.

To test Trainers’ strength, the
designers of Victory Road set up\la puzzle that must be solved in\lorder to progress any further.

That way, those lacking conviction
are forced to turn back."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ingenious design, really. To test Trainers’ strength, the designers of Victory Road set up a puzzle that must be solved in order to progress any further. That way, those lacking conviction are forced to turn back.
entries.translated:
Ini desain yang cerdik, sungguh.
Untuk menguji kekuatan Trainer,\lpara perancang Victory Road membuat

teka-teki yang harus dipecahkan
untuk melanjutkan. Dengan begitu,\lmereka yang kurang keyakinan

terpaksa kembali.

entries.original:
"Life is all about overcoming
hurdles!

Could you be a hurdle for me?"
entries.translation_source: Life is all about overcoming hurdles! Could you be a hurdle for me?

entries.original:
"I couldn’t overcome the hurdle you
presented to me\."
entries.translation_source: I couldn’t overcome the hurdle you presented to me[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"If you can’t overcome a hurdle, you
can always just go around it.

Keep going, and you’ll find the
greatest hurdle for Trainers:\lthe Pokémon League."
entries.translation_source: If you can’t overcome a hurdle, you can always just go around it. Keep going, and you’ll find the greatest hurdle for Trainers: the Pokémon League.

entries.original:
"There actually wasn’t any need to
prove how strong we are.

I already know how capable my
Pokémon and I are!"
entries.translation_source: There actually wasn’t any need to prove how strong we are. I already know how capable my Pokémon and I are!
entries.translated:
Sebenarnya tidak perlu membuktikan
seberapa kuat kami. Aku sudah tahu\lseberapa mampu aku dan Pokémon-ku!

entries.original:
"You know what I think?

All people know what they can do
alone, but\.

There are a lot of things you can
only do with Pokémon, too!"
entries.translation_source: You know what I think? All people know what they can do alone, but[game-token-1] There are a lot of things you can only do with Pokémon, too!

entries.original:
"Do you aim to be the very best?

The very best Trainers know how to
use their Pokémon’s muscles to\lmove boulders around!"
entries.translation_source: Do you aim to be the very best? The very best Trainers know how to use their Pokémon’s muscles to move boulders around!

entries.original:
"I see no end to the endless battles
in front of me.

Even if you defeat me, which you
won’t, I’ll never stop!"
entries.translation_source: I see no end to the endless battles in front of me. Even if you defeat me, which you won’t, I’ll never stop!

entries.original:
"Well, that didn’t go the way I
wanted it to!"
entries.translation_source: Well, that didn’t go the way I wanted it to!

entries.original:
"How do you stop me from fighting
you?

Push that boulder onto the pressure
plate, and I will no longer have a\lreason to fight."
entries.translation_source: How do you stop me from fighting you? Push that boulder onto the pressure plate, and I will no longer have a reason to fight.

entries.original:
"The puzzle in this room isn’t part
of the Victory Road puzzle.

It has been around for much, much
longer.

Who could have set it up, I wonder?"
entries.translation_source: The puzzle in this room isn’t part of the Victory Road puzzle. It has been around for much, much longer. Who could have set it up, I wonder?

entries.original:
"I’d love to brag about my Pokémon,
but nature’s calling!"
entries.translation_source: I’d love to brag about my Pokémon, but nature’s calling!

entries.original:
"Two Tamers\.

One of Dragons, and the other
of\.

Wait\.

What exactly do I tame, again?"
entries.translation_source: Two Tamers[game-token-1] One of Dragons, and the other of[game-token-2] Wait[game-token-3] What exactly do I tame, again?

entries.original:
"If I knew what I tamed, we wouldn’t
have lost."
entries.translation_source: If I knew what I tamed, we wouldn’t have lost.

entries.original:
"I teamed up with this Dragon Tamer
to help gain clarity into what\lexactly I tame."
entries.translation_source: I teamed up with this Dragon Tamer to help gain clarity into what exactly I tame.

entries.original:
"Two Tamers\.

If you want to battle us, you’ll
need more Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Two Tamers[game-token-1] If you want to battle us, you’ll need more Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Druddigon is the Cave Pokémon!

I caught mine right here in the
caves of Victory Road!"
entries.translation_source: Druddigon is the Cave Pokémon! I caught mine right here in the caves of Victory Road!
entries.translated:
Druddigon adalah Pokémon Gua! Aku
menangkap milikku di sini, di\lgua-gua Victory Road!

entries.original:
"No!
My Cave Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: No! My Cave Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Gabite is also known as the Cave
Pokémon, but unlike Gabite,\lDruddigon is a pure Dragon-type."
entries.translation_source: Gabite is also known as the Cave Pokémon, but unlike Gabite, Druddigon is a pure Dragon-type.

entries.original:
"Bring more Pokémon if you want to
fight my wonderful Cave Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Bring more Pokémon if you want to fight my wonderful Cave Pokémon!

entries.original:
"My cousin and I came out here
because I accidentally burned all\lof his bugs."
entries.translation_source: My cousin and I came out here because I accidentally burned all of his bugs.

entries.original: "Don’t worry, his bugs are fine."
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry, his bugs are fine.

entries.original:
"I convinced my cousin that the
best Bug-type could be found in\lthis area of Victory Road.

I didn’t realize the only Bug-type
around here is Durant."
entries.translation_source: I convinced my cousin that the best Bug-type could be found in this area of Victory Road. I didn’t realize the only Bug-type around here is Durant.

entries.original:
"I brought my cousin here to look
for Bug-type Pokémon.

Maybe if you had more Pokémon, we
would take a break and battle you."
entries.translation_source: I brought my cousin here to look for Bug-type Pokémon. Maybe if you had more Pokémon, we would take a break and battle you.

entries.original:
"Why is the only Bug-type Pokémon
here Durant?

My cousin promised me there were
great Bug-type Pokémon here!"
entries.translation_source: Why is the only Bug-type Pokémon here Durant? My cousin promised me there were great Bug-type Pokémon here!

entries.original:
"Cousin!

Your Heatmor’s trying to eat my
Durant again!"
entries.translation_source: Cousin! Your Heatmor’s trying to eat my Durant again!
entries.translated:
Sepupu! Heatmor-mu mencoba memakan
Durant-ku lagi!

entries.original:
"My cousin’s Heatmor is always
trying to eat the Durant I caught."
entries.translation_source: My cousin’s Heatmor is always trying to eat the Durant I caught.
entries.translated:
Heatmor sepupuku selalu mencoba
memakan Durant yang kutangkap.

entries.original:
"We’re out here looking for bugs.
But all I can find is Durant!

If you had more Pokémon, I’d fight
you to express my frustration."
entries.translation_source: We’re out here looking for bugs. But all I can find is Durant! If you had more Pokémon, I’d fight you to express my frustration.

entries.original:
"Have a little taste of our
mother-daughter fighting style!"
entries.translation_source: Have a little taste of our mother-daughter fighting style!
entries.translated:
Cicipilah sedikit gaya bertarung
ibu-anak kami!

entries.original:
"Our mother-daughter combination has
seen better fights."
entries.translation_source: Our mother-daughter combination has seen better fights.

entries.original:
"My daughter looks up to Arabella
of the Elite Four.

Ever since she could speak, all she
could talk about was Arabella."
entries.translation_source: My daughter looks up to Arabella of the Elite Four. Ever since she could speak, all she could talk about was Arabella.
entries.translated:
Putriku mengagumi Arabella dari
Elite Four. Sejak bisa bicara, yang\ldibicarakannya hanya Arabella.

entries.original:
"If you want to see some beautiful
mother-daughter power, bring more\lPokémon to battle with."
entries.translation_source: If you want to see some beautiful mother-daughter power, bring more Pokémon to battle with.

entries.original:
"Me and Mommy are super strong
when we fight together!"
entries.translation_source: Me and Mommy are super strong when we fight together!
entries.translated:
Aku dan Ibu sangat kuat saat
bertarung bersama!

entries.original: "Me and Mommy\. we lost?"
entries.translation_source: Me and Mommy[game-token-1] we lost?

entries.original:
"I wanna be just like Arabella!

Super adorable and super powerful!"
entries.translation_source: I wanna be just like Arabella! Super adorable and super powerful!
entries.translated:
Aku ingin menjadi seperti Arabella!
Sangat imut dan sangat kuat!

entries.original:
"I wanna be just like Arabella!
She fights with two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I wanna be just like Arabella! She fights with two Pokémon!

entries.original:
"I am a Pokémon Ranger!

If the hedges are in danger\.
Let me see your Pokémon in battle!"
entries.translation_source: I am a Pokémon Ranger! If the hedges are in danger[game-token-1] Let me see your Pokémon in battle!

entries.original:
"Your strength is fathomless!
I am deeply impressed."
entries.translation_source: Your strength is fathomless! I am deeply impressed.
entries.translated:
Kekuatanmu tak terduga! Aku sangat
terkesan.

entries.original:
"I aim to be the best Pokémon
Ranger in the world!

But my first step is to take care
of these hedges."
entries.translation_source: I aim to be the best Pokémon Ranger in the world! But my first step is to take care of these hedges.

entries.original:
"It’s not enough for me just to be
together with Pokémon!

I want to win!

But I do know that some people feel
at ease just by being with their\lPokémon."
entries.translation_source: It’s not enough for me just to be together with Pokémon! I want to win! But I do know that some people feel at ease just by being with their Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Tidak cukup bagiku hanya bersama
Pokémon! Aku ingin menang! Tapi aku\ltahu bahwa sebagian orang merasa

tenang hanya dengan bersama Pokémon
mereka.

entries.original:
"My Pokémon was once injured badly
in a fight.

I’m just so grateful that we’re
still together after all that."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon was once injured badly in a fight. I’m just so grateful that we’re still together after all that.

entries.original:
"You are the wind.

A supple and comforting wind
blowing through Victory Road!"
entries.translation_source: You are the wind. A supple and comforting wind blowing through Victory Road!

entries.original:
"A heated battle is good, but get
too hot and you might end up\lgetting burned!"
entries.translation_source: A heated battle is good, but get too hot and you might end up getting burned!

entries.original:
"Amazing\.
I think I got a bit singed."
entries.translation_source: Amazing[game-token-1] I think I got a bit singed.

entries.original:
"Burning competitiveness and cool

"I assume you’re trying to reach our
Admin in the Command Centre?

I can’t help much with that, but I
can at least let you know that one\lof the letters of the Command\lCentre’s password is [green]O[red].

please feel free to ask."
entries.translation_source: I assume you’re trying to reach our Admin in the Command Centre? I can’t help much with that, but I can at least let you know that one of the letters of the Command Centre’s password is [color-green-1]O[color-red-2]. If you need anything else from me, please feel free to ask.

please feel free to ask."

silakan tanya.

entries.translation_source: Did your Pokémon get hurt? Please, lie down on one of these beds so I can heal them.

entries.translation_source: Oh, did you forget which letter I gave you? One of the letters of the Command Centre’s password is [color-green-1]O[color-red-2].

entries.original:
"The base is split into eight
different sections.

The main areas are the Power Grid,
Break Room, Cafeteria, Rest Room,\land Research Lab.

Other smaller areas include the
storage areas, the living spaces,\land the Command Centre.

The living spaces and the Command
Centre can only be accessed via\lthe Research Lab.

But with the Research Lab now
underwater, the living spaces, as\lwell as some storage areas have\lbeen completely cut off.

However, for some reason, the
Command Centre is still accessible."
entries.translation_source: The base is split into eight different sections. The main areas are the Power Grid, Break Room, Cafeteria, Rest Room, and Research Lab. Other smaller areas include the storage areas, the living spaces, and the Command Centre. The living spaces and the Command Centre can only be accessed via the Research Lab. But with the Research Lab now underwater, the living spaces, as well as some storage areas have been completely cut off. However, for some reason, the Command Centre is still accessible.

entries.translation_source: Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos that appears when the ecosystem is in danger. Why it’s appearing here and now is a mystery to us. We’re trying to find the answer to this, but we need someone to go and collect all of the individual [quote-open-1]cells[quote-close-2] and [quote-open-3]cores[quote-close-4] of Zygarde.

entries.original:
"The Battle Circus is a facility for
Single, Double, and Multi Battle\lchallenges.

Once begun, your challenge lasts
until you defeat the Circus\lRingmaster, or you choose to rest.

In Single Battle format, you have a
choice of entering with three or\lsix Pokémon.

In Double Battle format, you have a
choice of entering with four or six\lPokémon.

The battles are held in the main
arena.

Before each battle, the Ringmaster
will activate a random effect for\lthe duration of the battle.

This effect is permanent and cannot
be removed or overridden.

These effects may also increase in
intensity and begin to stack the\lhigher your streak becomes.

For every Trainer you defeat, you
will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]).

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be\lrecorded for when you wish to\lcontinue.

If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

Please be aware of that!"
entries.translation_source: The Battle Circus is a facility for Single, Double, and Multi Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Circus Ringmaster, or you choose to rest. In Single Battle format, you have a choice of entering with three or six Pokémon. In Double Battle format, you have a choice of entering with four or six Pokémon. The battles are held in the main arena. Before each battle, the Ringmaster will activate a random effect for the duration of the battle. This effect is permanent and cannot be removed or overridden. These effects may also increase in intensity and begin to stack the higher your streak becomes. If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Please be aware of that!

"The Battle Sands is a facility for

Oh, I forgot to mention that one
Pokémon on each side of the field\lwill gain a random stat boost at\lthe beginning of the battle.

Keep that in mind when choosing
your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The Battle Sands is a facility for Single and Double Battles. In Single Battles, two Pokémon must be entered. In Double Battles, three Pokémon must be entered. Here’s the catch for this facility: you’re not actually battling. Pokémon you enter in this facility will be taken by a volunteer and used to fight for you. You’ll be given the choice of whether you want your Pokémon to attack or switch out, but the final decision will be up to the Trainer controlling your Pokémon. As this Trainer wins battles, [color-green-1]Battle Points[color-blue-2] ([color-green-3]BP[color-blue-4]) will be acrued. You may choose to stop the battles at any point, but know that once you do, that’s it for the streak. Whether the Trainer loses a battle or you decide to retire, you will receive the BP acrued as winnings. Additionally, leaving at any point without saving will cause any BP acrued to be lost. Just be aware of that. Oh, I forgot to mention that one Pokémon on each side of the field will gain a random stat boost at the beginning of the battle. Keep that in mind when choosing your Pokémon.

entries.original:
"The Battle Tower is a facility for

Once begun, your challenge lasts
until you defeat the Tower Tycoon,\lor you choose to rest.

In Single Battle format, you have a
choice of entering with three or\lsix Pokémon.

In Double Battle format, you have a
choice of entering with four or\lsix Pokémon.

The battles are held in Battle
Rooms of which there are many in\lthe tower.

Trainers await your challenge.

will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]).

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be\lrecorded for when you wish to\lcontinue.

If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

Please be aware of that!"
entries.translation_source: The Battle Tower is a facility for Single, Double, Multi, and Metronome Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Tower Tycoon, or you choose to rest. In Single Battle format, you have a choice of entering with three or six Pokémon. In Double Battle format, you have a choice of entering with four or six Pokémon. The battles are held in Battle Rooms of which there are many in the tower. In each of the Battle Rooms, Trainers await your challenge. For every Trainer you defeat, you will earn [color-green-1]Battle Points[color-blue-2] ([color-green-3]BP[color-blue-4]). If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Please be aware of that!

"The Battle Tower is a facility for

entries.translation_source: The Battle Tower is a facility for Single, Double, Multi, and Metronome Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Tower Tycoon, or you choose to rest. The Battle Tower’s Multi Battle Rooms are for Multi Battles with a partner. To enter, join another Trainer and compete with two or three Pokémon each. Inside the tower is a room named the Battle Salon where you can meet other Trainers. There, you can find a Trainer to act as your partner in the Multi Battles. You can also partner up with a friend using a Link Cable. Once you have partnered up, you will be shown to a battle room. In the Multi Battle Room, tag teams await your challenge. If you manage to defeat each team, you will earn [color-green-1]Battle Points[color-red-2] ([color-green-3]BP[color-red-4]). If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Also, if you are in a tag team with a friend, you may not interrupt your challenge. Please be aware of that!

entries.original:
"The Battle Frontier has four
facilities dedicated to battling.

At the Battle Tower, the objective
is to beat many Trainers in a row.

At the Battle Sands, other Trainers
battle with your Pokémon.

At the Battle Circus, random
effects are present every battle.

And finally, at the Battle Mine,
you must use a team of six Pokémon\lthat can handle many different\lbattle formats."
entries.translation_source: The Battle Frontier has four facilities dedicated to battling. At the Battle Tower, the objective is to beat many Trainers in a row. At the Battle Sands, other Trainers battle with your Pokémon. At the Battle Circus, random effects are present every battle. And finally, at the Battle Mine, you must use a team of six Pokémon that can handle many different battle formats.

entries.original:
"The battles at the four Battle
Frontier facilities are held under\lspecial rules.

First and foremost, no Exp. Points
can be earned.

Consequently, the Pokémon battling
here will not level up.

When choosing a level to battle at,
all Pokémon on your team will be\ladjusted to that level for the\lduration of the battles."
entries.translation_source: The battles at the four Battle Frontier facilities are held under special rules. First and foremost, no Exp. Points can be earned. Consequently, the Pokémon battling here will not level up. When choosing a level to battle at, all Pokémon on your team will be adjusted to that level for the duration of the battles.

entries.original:
"Battle Points are usually referred
to as BP.

BP are points that are used only in
the Battle Frontier.

BP are awarded for meeting certain
performance goals at the various\lBattle Frontier facilities.

BP can be exchanged for prizes at
Exchange Service Corners."
entries.translation_source: Battle Points are usually referred to as BP. BP are points that are used only in the Battle Frontier. BP are awarded for meeting certain performance goals at the various Battle Frontier facilities. BP can be exchanged for prizes at Exchange Service Corners.
entries.translated:
Battle Points biasanya disebut
sebagai BP. BP adalah poin yang\lhanya digunakan di Battle Frontier.

BP diberikan untuk mencapai target
performa tertentu di berbagai\lfasilitas Battle Frontier. BP dapat

ditukar dengan hadiah di Pojok
Layanan Tukar.

entries.original:
"Exchange Service Corners can be
found in booths dotted around the\lBattle Frontier, or in the Battle\lTower itself.

There, you may exchange your BP for
a wide variety of services and\lprizes.

Please do visit them!"
entries.translation_source: Exchange Service Corners can be found in booths dotted around the Battle Frontier, or in the Battle Tower itself. There, you may exchange your BP for a wide variety of services and prizes. Please do visit them!

entries.original:
"[green]Mega Evolution[black] is a temporary
evolution that can be initiated in\lbattle if a Pokémon is holding a\l[green]Mega Stone[black] for their species.

To activate Mega Evolution, press
\btn04 while selecting an attack\lto use.

Only one Pokémon per team can Mega
Evolve, and after the battle is\lover, Mega Pokémon return to their\loriginal forms."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Mega Evolution[color-black-2] is a temporary evolution that can be initiated in battle if a Pokémon is holding a [color-green-3]Mega Stone[color-black-4] for their species. To activate Mega Evolution, press [button-icon-5] while selecting an attack to use. Only one Pokémon per team can Mega Evolve, and after the battle is over, Mega Pokémon return to their original forms.

entries.original:
"A [green]Z-Move[black] is a special type of move
in which a Trainer and their\lPokémon’s wishes combine to\lunleash a very powerful attack\lonce per battle.

If one of these moves are
available, it can be activated by\lpressing \btn04 and then \btn00 while\lselecting an attack to use.

In order for a Pokémon to use a
Z-Move, it must hold a special type\lof item called a [green]Z-Crystal[black].

Most Z-Crystals correspond to a
certain type of move, but some are\lalso species specific."
entries.translation_source: A [color-green-1]Z-Move[color-black-2] is a special type of move in which a Trainer and their Pokémon’s wishes combine to unleash a very powerful attack once per battle. If one of these moves are available, it can be activated by pressing [button-icon-3] and then [button-icon-4] while selecting an attack to use. In order for a Pokémon to use a Z-Move, it must hold a special type of item called a [color-green-5]Z-Crystal[color-black-6]. Most Z-Crystals correspond to a certain type of move, but some are also species specific.

entries.original:
"[green]Dynamax[black] is a temporary
transformation where a Pokémon\ldistorts space to change its size.

When a Pokémon Dynamaxes, for
three turns its HP is increased and\lall of its moves are powered up\linto special [green]Max Moves[black].

Each Max Move has a unique effect,
that varies based on the type of\lthe original move.

If a Pokémon has the Gigantamax
Factor, it can undergo Gigantamax.

This is a special kind of Dynamax
that results in a different\lappearance to its regular form, in\laddition to being larger.

Each Gigantamax Pokémon has an
exclusive Max Move known as a\lG-Max Move.

To activate Dynamax, press
\btn04 while selecting an attack\lto use."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Dynamax[color-black-2] is a temporary transformation where a Pokémon distorts space to change its size. When a Pokémon Dynamaxes, for three turns its HP is increased and all of its moves are powered up into special [color-green-3]Max Moves[color-black-4]. Each Max Move has a unique effect, that varies based on the type of the original move. If a Pokémon has the Gigantamax Factor, it can undergo Gigantamax. This is a special kind of Dynamax that results in a different appearance to its regular form, in addition to being larger. Each Gigantamax Pokémon has an exclusive Max Move known as a G-Max Move. To activate Dynamax, press [button-icon-5] while selecting an attack to use.

entries.original:
"When selecting an attack in battle,
certain symbols may appear.

This is based on the move’s
effectiveness against the target.

A green [green]\au[black] indicates that the move
is super effective.

A yellow [orange]\ad[black] indicates the move is
not very effective.

A red [lightgreen]*[black] indicates that the move
doesn’t affect the target at all.

And a \+ symbol indicates the move
has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus."
entries.translation_source: When selecting an attack in battle, certain symbols may appear. This is based on the move’s effectiveness against the target. A green [color-green-1][game-token-2][color-black-3] indicates that the move is super effective. A yellow [color-orange-4][game-token-5][color-black-6] indicates the move is not very effective. A red [color-lightgreen-7]*[color-black-8] indicates that the move doesn’t affect the target at all. And a [game-token-9] symbol indicates the move has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus.

entries.original:
"Of all the battles I’ve taken part
in, one stands out above the rest.

The day was sweltering, the
pressure intense.

My opponent had just sent out her
Rotom-Fan holding an Air Balloon.

Up until that point I had barely
been holding on, but upon seeing\lthat redundant freak of nature,\lI couldn’t take it anymore.

I fainted in disbelief and lost
the battle.

Never underestimate the power of
a [green]Rotom-Fan[red] holding an [green]Air Balloon[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Of all the battles I’ve taken part in, one stands out above the rest. The day was sweltering, the pressure intense. My opponent had just sent out her Rotom-Fan holding an Air Balloon. Up until that point I had barely been holding on, but upon seeing that redundant freak of nature, I couldn’t take it anymore. I fainted in disbelief and lost the battle. Never underestimate the power of a [color-green-1]Rotom-Fan[color-red-2] holding an [color-green-3]Air Balloon[color-red-4]!

entries.original:
"If you’re fighting a random battle
with a team of 3 or 4 Pokémon,\lyou’ll be given a choice of which\lrandom Pokémon you want to fight\lwith before each battle.

And if you win a battle, you’ll be
able to pick from a mix of your\land your opponent’s previous teams!

This’ll only last each 10 battles,
however.

After that point you’ll be offered
a brand new random team.

Oh, and you should keep in mind
that you’ll always be offered a\lteam choice before random Multi\lbattles, since you’ll never be able\lto pick a full team of 6."
entries.translation_source: If you’re fighting a random battle with a team of 3 or 4 Pokémon, you’ll be given a choice of which random Pokémon you want to fight with before each battle. And if you win a battle, you’ll be able to pick from a mix of your and your opponent’s previous teams! This’ll only last each 10 battles, however. After that point you’ll be offered a brand new random team. Oh, and you should keep in mind that you’ll always be offered a team choice before random Multi battles, since you’ll never be able to pick a full team of 6.

entries.original:
"Take a look, at the Science
Society’s latest breakthrough\.\l[green]Nature changing[red]!

They called us mad, said we were
\qoharming Pokémon\qc\.

Fools! Fools, I say, deserving to
rot at the bottom of the earth!

Ahem\. anyway\.

Were you, perchance, looking to have
a Pokémon’s [green]Nature[red] changed?

It will cost you [green][buffer1][red] BP.
You currently have [green][buffer2][red] BP."
entries.translation_source: Take a look, at the Science Society’s latest breakthrough[game-token-1] [color-green-2]Nature changing[color-red-3]! They called us mad, said we were [quote-open-4]harming Pokémon[quote-close-5][game-token-6] Fools! Fools, I say, deserving to rot at the bottom of the earth! Ahem[game-token-7] anyway[game-token-8] Were you, perchance, looking to have a Pokémon’s [color-green-9]Nature[color-red-10] changed? It will cost you [color-green-11][buffer1-12][color-red-13] BP. You currently have [color-green-14][buffer2-15][color-red-16] BP.
entries.translated:
Lihatlah, terobosan terbaru Science
Society\. [green]Pengubah Sifat[red]! Mereka\lmenyebut kami gila, bilang kami

\qomenyakiti Pokémon\qc\. Bodoh! Bodoh,
kataku, pantas membusuk di dasar\lbumi! Ehem\. ngomong-ngomong\. Apakah

Anda, kebetulan, ingin mengubah
[green]Sifat[red] Pokémon? Biayanya [green][buffer1][red]\lBP. Anda saat ini memiliki [green][buffer2][red]

BP.

entries.original:
"The Antisis Gym is a unique battle
facility only for Single Battle\lchallenges.

Once begun, your challenge lasts
until you choose to rest.

To begin your challenge, you must
enter with three Pokémon.

Each Pokémon will be set to Level
50 for the challenge.

Duplicate species or items may not
be used.

Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax,
Focus Sashes, exploding moves,\lDestiny Bond, and Perish Song may\lnot be used.

Regigigas with the Ability Stall in
addition to Pokémon banned in the\l[green]Standard[blue] tier may not be used."
entries.translation_source: The Antisis Gym is a unique battle facility only for Single Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you choose to rest. To begin your challenge, you must enter with three Pokémon. Each Pokémon will be set to Level 50 for the challenge. Duplicate species or items may not be used. Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax, Focus Sashes, exploding moves, Destiny Bond, and Perish Song may not be used. Regigigas with the Ability Stall in addition to Pokémon banned in the [color-green-1]Standard[color-blue-2] tier may not be used.

entries.original:
"Before each battle, your opponent’s
team will be revealed to you.

Additionally, in each battle, a
certain move type may not be used.

This will be revealed as well.

Regarding moves that change types,
the type they change into is taken\linto account.

It is at that point you must choose
a single Pokémon to fight against\lone of theirs.

For every Trainer you defeat, you
will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]).

However, do note that since this
battle facility is not part of the\lBattle Frontier, you will not earn\lany prints for your Frontier Card.

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be\lrecorded for when you wish to\lcontinue.

If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

Please be aware of that!"
entries.translation_source: Before each battle, your opponent’s team will be revealed to you. Additionally, in each battle, a certain move type may not be used. This will be revealed as well. Regarding moves that change types, the type they change into is taken into account. It is at that point you must choose a single Pokémon to fight against one of theirs. For every Trainer you defeat, you will earn [color-green-1]Battle Points[color-blue-2] ([color-green-3]BP[color-blue-4]). However, do note that since this battle facility is not part of the Battle Frontier, you will not earn any prints for your Frontier Card. If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Please be aware of that!

seorang anak keluar dari batas\lkota. Tolong, teruslah mencari dia!

"Sniff\.

My mommy left me out here
all alone\.

I don’t think she cares about
me anymore\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] My mommy left me out here all alone[game-token-2] I don’t think she cares about me anymore[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Hiks\. Mamaku meninggalkanku di sini
sendirian\. Aku rasa dia tidak peduli\llagi padaku\.

entries.original:
"What’s that?

Did you say my mommy sent you to
find me?

Sniff\.

Maybe she really does care
about me\."
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Did you say my mommy sent you to find me? Sniff[game-token-1] Maybe she really does care about me[game-token-2]

entries.original:
"Okay\.

Please take me back to my mommy."
entries.translation_source: Okay[game-token-1] Please take me back to my mommy.

entries.original:
"[black]The little girl appears to have
been blown away."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little girl appears to have been blown away.
entries.translated:
[black]Gadis kecil itu tampaknya telah
tertiup angin.

entries.original:
"Waaaah!

This big wind blew me all the way
out here!

Lemme hold onto you so I don’t blow
away again!"
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! This big wind blew me all the way out here! Lemme hold onto you so I don’t blow away again!

entries.original:
"Waaaah!

That big wind blew me away again!

I’m scared now\.
I wanna go home\."
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! That big wind blew me away again! I’m scared now[game-token-1] I wanna go home[game-token-2]

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

I hate the wind\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] I hate the wind[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Hiks\. Aku benci angin\.

entries.original:
"Huh?

I’m not being blown away anymore\.

Yay!

It’s over!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? I’m not being blown away anymore[game-token-1] Yay! It’s over!
entries.translated:
Hah? Aku tidak terbawa lagi\. Yay!
Sudah selesai!

entries.original: "I’m\. so\. dizzy\."
entries.translation_source: I’m[game-token-1] so[game-token-2] dizzy[game-token-3]

entries.original:
"Mommy!
You found me!

I missed you so much!
I was so scared\.

This big bad wind kept blowing me
all over!

But I’m okay now, thanks to
this person!"
entries.translation_source: Mommy! You found me! I missed you so much! I was so scared[game-token-1] This big bad wind kept blowing me all over! But I’m okay now, thanks to this person!

entries.original:
"I wanna go home now, Mommy.
I’m really dizzy\."
entries.translation_source: I wanna go home now, Mommy. I’m really dizzy[game-token-1]

entries.original: "Mommy, wait!"
entries.translation_source: Mommy, wait!

entries.original:
"We forgot to give a gift to the
[buffer1] who helped me!"
entries.translation_source: We forgot to give a gift to the [buffer1-1] who helped me!

entries.original: "[black][player] received $4000!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received $4000!
entries.translated: [black][player] menerima $4000!

entries.original:
"Mommy\.

What happened to you\.?"
entries.translation_source: Mommy[game-token-1] What happened to you[game-token-2]?

entries.original: "Bad Babysitter"
entries.translation_source: Bad Babysitter
entries.translated: Pengasuh yang Buruk

entries.original:
"A young boy in a Pikachu costume
has run away from home to Route 8!
Find him, and bring him home safely."
entries.translation_source: A young boy in a Pikachu costume has run away from home to Route 8! Find him, and bring him home safely.
entries.translated:
Seorang ... lari dari rumah ke
Rute 8! Temukan dia, dan bawa
dia pulang dengan selamat.

entries.original:
"My brother!

Please, help me!

I was babysitting him when he ran
away down the mountain!

Please, help me find him!"
entries.translation_source: My brother! Please, help me! I was babysitting him when he ran away down the mountain! Please, help me find him!

entries.original:
"I can’t thank you enough!

My brother’s small, so there’s no
way he could have gone far.

My bet is he’s somewhere on
[green]Route 8[red] right about now.

And last I saw, he was wearing his
favourite [green]Pikachu costume[red]."
entries.translation_source: I can’t thank you enough! My brother’s small, so there’s no way he could have gone far. My bet is he’s somewhere on [color-green-1]Route 8[color-red-2] right about now. And last I saw, he was wearing his favourite [color-green-3]Pikachu costume[color-red-4].

entries.original: "My parents are going to kill me!"
entries.translation_source: My parents are going to kill me!
entries.translated: Orang tuaku akan membunuhku!

entries.original:
"My brother told me all about his
journey back up here!

You’re amazing!"
entries.translation_source: My brother told me all about his journey back up here! You’re amazing!

entries.original:
"That TM is my thanks for your help!
It contains [green]Return[red]!

It’s a move that gets stronger the
more your Pokémon likes you.

It’s the perfect TM for such a nice
person like you!"
entries.translation_source: That TM is my thanks for your help! It contains [color-green-1]Return[color-red-2]! It’s a move that gets stronger the more your Pokémon likes you. It’s the perfect TM for such a nice person like you!

entries.original:
"It’s the amazing person who saved
my brother!

Thank you again!"
entries.translation_source: It’s the amazing person who saved my brother! Thank you again!

entries.original: "Willy"
entries.translation_source: Willy
entries.translated: Willy

entries.original:
"Ahhh!
Please don’t eat me!"
entries.translation_source: Ahhh! Please don’t eat me!
entries.translated: Ahhh! Tolong jangan makan aku!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

You’re not a Pokémon.

I thought a Pokémon was going
to eat me."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] You’re not a Pokémon. I thought a Pokémon was going to eat me.
entries.translated:
Sniff\. Kamu bukan Pokémon. Aku pikir
seekor Pokémon akan memakanku.

entries.original:
"I want to go home.

I ran away from my mean sister, but
I really miss her now\."
entries.translation_source: I want to go home. I ran away from my mean sister, but I really miss her now[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Please, take me back up to
[green]Blizzard City[blue].

I’ll follow you there."
entries.translation_source: Please, take me back up to [color-green-1]Blizzard City[color-blue-2]. I’ll follow you there.
entries.translated:
Tolong, bawa aku kembali ke
[green]Blizzard City[blue]. Aku akan mengikutimu\lke sana.

entries.original: "[black][player] decided to go with Willy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] decided to go with Willy!

entries.original:
"[black]While teamed up with Willy, the
[green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]While teamed up with Willy, the [color-green-2]first 3[color-black-3] viable Pokémon in your party will be selected for battle.

entries.original:
"[blue]Sniff\.

I don’t think this is the right way
home\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Sniff[game-token-2] I don’t think this is the right way home[game-token-3]

entries.original:
"[blue]Sniff\.

I know the way home from here.

I had fun walking with you!
You’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Sniff[game-token-2] I know the way home from here. I had fun walking with you! You’re the best!

entries.original:
"It’s you!
The big Trainer who saved me!

You’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you! The big Trainer who saved me! You’re the best!

entries.original: "The Black Emboar"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar
entries.translated: Si Emboar Hitam

entries.original:
"Rescue a man’s brother from the
clutches of the \qoBlack Emboar\qc in
the KBT Expressway."
entries.translation_source: Rescue a man’s brother from the clutches of the [quote-open-1]Black Emboar[quote-close-2] in the KBT Expressway.
entries.translated:
Selamatkan saudara ... seorang
pria dari cengkeraman \qoBlack
Emboar\qc di KBT Expressway.

entries.original: "Brother"
entries.translation_source: Brother
entries.translated: Kakak

entries.original: "James"
entries.translation_source: James
entries.translated: James

entries.original: "Black Emboar Boss"
entries.translation_source: Black Emboar Boss
entries.translated: Boss Emboar Hitam

entries.original:
"Hey, Trainer.

\.

What? You want me to say something
interesting?

Fine, then\.

Lately, I’ve been having trouble
with my brother.

He’s gotten himself in deep with
this gang calling themselves\lthe \qoBlack Emboar\qc.

I don’t really know what it’s all
about, but I’m really worried\lfor his safety.

I haven’t spoken with him in days,
so I’m afraid something bad has\lhappened to him.

\.

What’s that?

You’d be willing to check up on
him for me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Trainer. [game-token-1] What? You want me to say something interesting? Fine, then[game-token-2] Lately, I’ve been having trouble with my brother. He’s gotten himself in deep with this gang calling themselves the [quote-open-3]Black Emboar[quote-close-4]. I don’t really know what it’s all about, but I’m really worried for his safety. I haven’t spoken with him in days, so I’m afraid something bad has happened to him. [game-token-5] What’s that? You’d be willing to check up on him for me?

entries.original:
"You’re the one who barged into my
home and asked."
entries.translation_source: You’re the one who barged into my home and asked.

entries.original:
"Thank you!

You can probably find my brother
in the northern KBT Expressway.

I’d go myself, but I’m too weak of
a Trainer.

They say these Black Emboar are
insanely vicious."
entries.translation_source: Thank you! You can probably find my brother in the northern KBT Expressway. I’d go myself, but I’m too weak of a Trainer. They say these Black Emboar are insanely vicious.

entries.original:
"If you ever see my brother again,
please let him know that I’m still\lworried about him."
entries.translation_source: If you ever see my brother again, please let him know that I’m still worried about him.

entries.original:
"What do you think you’re
up to, brat?

This is the Black Emboar’s
ultimate paradise\.

A little pest like you has no
business here\.

It couldn’t be that you think you
can stand up to me, the head of\lthe Black Emboar?"
entries.translation_source: What do you think you’re up to, brat? This is the Black Emboar’s ultimate paradise[game-token-1] A little pest like you has no business here[game-token-2] It couldn’t be that you think you can stand up to me, the head of the Black Emboar?
entries.translated:
Apa yang kau lakukan, bocah? Ini
adalah surga utama Black Emboar\.\lHama kecil sepertimu tidak punya

urusan di sini\. Jangan-jangan kau
pikir kau bisa melawanku, kepala\lBlack Emboar?

entries.original:
"That all you got?

Nah, you got one option
left--get lost!

This is our place, the
Black Emboar.

We got no place else to go, and we
don’t want nobody gettin’ in our way."
entries.translation_source: That all you got? Nah, you got one option left--get lost! This is our place, the Black Emboar. We got no place else to go, and we don’t want nobody gettin’ in our way.

entries.original:
"Gwa ha ha ha! Bring it!
You’ve got your share of guts, kid!

I’ll show you what the guy who
holds the Black Emboar together\lcan really do!"
entries.translation_source: Gwa ha ha ha! Bring it! You’ve got your share of guts, kid! I’ll show you what the guy who holds the Black Emboar together can really do!
entries.translated:
Gwa ha ha ha! Ayo lawan! Kamu punya
nyali, bocah! Aku akan tunjukkan\lapa yang bisa dilakukan oleh orang

yang menyatukan Black Emboar!

entries.original:
"You ain’t half bad, kid\.
I like ya.

Get a loaf of this\.

From now on, our team’s name is
gonna be the Black [player]!

Yeah! We’re takin’ on your
rough and tough name!

It’s a wilder name for a
wilder team!

The Black [player]!
Gwa ha ha ha! That’s awesome!"
entries.translation_source: You ain’t half bad, kid[game-token-1] I like ya. Get a loaf of this[game-token-2] From now on, our team’s name is gonna be the Black [player-name-3]! Yeah! We’re takin’ on your rough and tough name! It’s a wilder name for a wilder team! The Black [player-name-4]! Gwa ha ha ha! That’s awesome!

entries.original:
"What, you want somethin’ else, kid?

\.

My bro?

Geez, that punk never quits.

Alright, as a favour to you for
beatin’ me, I’ll go with you."
entries.translation_source: What, you want somethin’ else, kid? [game-token-1] My bro? Geez, that punk never quits. Alright, as a favour to you for beatin’ me, I’ll go with you.

entries.original:
"I’ve told you time and time again,
bro, quit tryin’ to mess with\lthe Black Emboar!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve told you time and time again, bro, quit tryin’ to mess with the Black Emboar!

entries.original:
"I can’t, James.
You’re my brother.

You mean everything to me.

And I can’t let you go down this
path any longer!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t, James. You’re my brother. You mean everything to me. And I can’t let you go down this path any longer!

entries.original:
"You claim you care about me, but
you really ain’t got no guts, bro.

You keep sendin’ these Trainers to
harass me ’cause you’re too scared\lto get your own hands dirty."
entries.translation_source: You claim you care about me, but you really ain’t got no guts, bro. You keep sendin’ these Trainers to harass me ’cause you’re too scared to get your own hands dirty.

entries.original: "This kid, [player]’s got guts!"
entries.translation_source: This kid, [player-name-1]’s got guts!

entries.original:
"Let me tell ya!

No one has ever wrecked me as good
as [buffer2] did!

I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar
to the Black [player], after [buffer1]!

So it’s time for a fresh start.

The Black [player] and I are movin’
to Antisis City!

I hear the old gang that used to
run that joint got ran outta town.

Terror Granbull, somethin’
or other\.

Now that city is ripe for the
pickin’ by the Black [player]!

Gwa ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Let me tell ya! No one has ever wrecked me as good as [buffer2-1] did! I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar to the Black [player-name-2], after [buffer1-3]! So it’s time for a fresh start. The Black [player-name-4] and I are movin’ to Antisis City! I hear the old gang that used to run that joint got ran outta town. Terror Granbull, somethin’ or other[game-token-5] Now that city is ripe for the pickin’ by the Black [player-name-6]! Gwa ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"But James, you can’t just
leave me all alone!"
entries.translation_source: But James, you can’t just leave me all alone!

entries.original:
"I thought about makin’ you one of
us too, but I can’t have someone\lwho’s so weak in my squad!

Instead, I’ve decided to let [player]
join our ranks."
entries.translation_source: I thought about makin’ you one of us too, but I can’t have someone who’s so weak in my squad! Instead, I’ve decided to let [player-name-1] join our ranks.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Black [player], kid!

All members gotta have a Bike,
so take this."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Black [player-name-1], kid! All members gotta have a Bike, so take this.

entries.original:
"That’s a powerful Motorbike all
members of the Black [player] own!

You can press \btn02 to activate the
turbo boost, or you can take it\leasy and pedal.

Look us up if you ever come
by Antisis City.

We’ll welcome you with open arms."
entries.translation_source: That’s a powerful Motorbike all members of the Black [player-name-1] own! You can press [button-icon-2] to activate the turbo boost, or you can take it easy and pedal. Look us up if you ever come by Antisis City. We’ll welcome you with open arms.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Black [player], kid!

Look us up if you ever come
by Antisis City.

We’ll welcome you with open arms."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Black [player-name-1], kid! Look us up if you ever come by Antisis City. We’ll welcome you with open arms.

entries.original:
"Sorry you got caught up in
all of that.

I may have lied when I told you I
hadn’t heard from my brother.

In truth, I knew he was the leader
of the Black Emboar.

I just thought you wouldn’t have
wanted to help if you knew you’d\lbe going up against their leader.

But now he’s gone for good, and
I’m left all alone\.

I feel so sheepish about this\.

Anyway, thank you for helping me.

Please take this TM for your time."
entries.translation_source: Sorry you got caught up in all of that. I may have lied when I told you I hadn’t heard from my brother. In truth, I knew he was the leader of the Black Emboar. I just thought you wouldn’t have wanted to help if you knew you’d be going up against their leader. But now he’s gone for good, and I’m left all alone[game-token-1] I feel so sheepish about this[game-token-2] Anyway, thank you for helping me. Please take this TM for your time.

entries.original:
"Hey!
Yeah, you, the little brat there!

Get over here!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Yeah, you, the little brat there! Get over here!
entries.translated:
Hei! Ya, kamu, bocah nakal di sana!
Kemarilah!

entries.original:
"Hey!
Who said ya can pass through here?

This place belongs to us, the
Black Emboar!

It’s like our Gym, kid!

So scram! Toddle off home to your
ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This place belongs to us, the Black Emboar! It’s like our Gym, kid! So scram! Toddle off home to your ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!
entries.translated:
Hei! Siapa bilang kau boleh lewat
sini? Tempat ini milik kami, Black\lEmboar! Ini seperti Gym kami, nak!

Jadi pergilah! Pulanglah ke ibumu,
bocah sok suci!

entries.original:
"Ha! Fine!

Brats like you with a future
so bright\.

Just go on back home, and be nice
to your parents.

Don’t forget your baby bottle!"
entries.translation_source: Ha! Fine! Brats like you with a future so bright[game-token-1] Just go on back home, and be nice to your parents. Don’t forget your baby bottle!

entries.original:
"What didja say, ya little creep?

I’ll teach ya to take the Black
Emboar seriously!

I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon
right down to the ground!

With relish!"
entries.translation_source: What didja say, ya little creep? I’ll teach ya to take the Black Emboar seriously! I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon right down to the ground! With relish!

entries.original:
"Don’t get all high and mighty
because you beat me!

If you really want to pick a fight
with the Black Emboar, go duke\lit out with our leader!

He’s somewhere in this tunnel!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t get all high and mighty because you beat me! If you really want to pick a fight with the Black Emboar, go duke it out with our leader! He’s somewhere in this tunnel!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass
through here?

This is Black Emboar territory!

Go back to where you came from!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This is Black Emboar territory! Go back to where you came from!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hei! Siapa bilang kau boleh lewat
sini? Ini wilayah Black Emboar!\lKembalilah ke asalmu!

entries.original: "Get lost, punk."
entries.translation_source: Get lost, punk.
entries.translated: Pergi, bocah.

entries.original: "We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!

entries.original:
"The Black Emboar won’t fall
so easily!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar won’t fall so easily!

entries.original:
"Hey, hey, kid!
It’s dangerous!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, hey, kid! It’s dangerous!
entries.translated: Hei, hei, nak! Itu berbahaya!

entries.original:
"The Black Emboar!
Never stop, and never look back!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar! Never stop, and never look back!

entries.original:
"Whad’ya want kid?

We’re busy!"
entries.translation_source: Whad’ya want kid? We’re busy!
entries.translated: Ada apa, nak? Kami sibuk!

entries.original:
"[player]!

You made it!
Welcome to the Black [player] HQ!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You made it! Welcome to the Black [player-name-2] HQ!

entries.original:
"It don’t look like much right now,
but I’m tellin’ you, once we take\lout those Black Ferrothorns, we’ll\lfix the place right up.

Of course, we’d be happy if you
stuck around and helped us deal\lwith those losers.

I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof
strategy for our attack, so in the\lmeantime, why don’t you help your\lfellow Black [player] out?"
entries.translation_source: It don’t look like much right now, but I’m tellin’ you, once we take out those Black Ferrothorns, we’ll fix the place right up. Of course, we’d be happy if you stuck around and helped us deal with those losers. I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof strategy for our attack, so in the meantime, why don’t you help your fellow Black [player-name-1] out?

entries.original:
"You’re just in time, [player].

We figured out how we’re gonna take
down those Black Ferrothorns.

We’re gonna pull a gutsy move and
attack from the sewers.

Gwa ha ha ha!

Those arrogant loaves of meat won’t
know what hit em’!"
entries.translation_source: You’re just in time, [player-name-1]. We figured out how we’re gonna take down those Black Ferrothorns. We’re gonna pull a gutsy move and attack from the sewers. Gwa ha ha ha! Those arrogant loaves of meat won’t know what hit em’!

entries.original:
"Boys! Mount your bikes!
We’re goin’ to the sewers!"
entries.translation_source: Boys! Mount your bikes! We’re goin’ to the sewers!

entries.original:
"I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof
strategy for our attack against the\lBlack Ferrothorns.

In the meantime, why don’t you
help your fellow Black [player]\lout?"
entries.translation_source: I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof strategy for our attack against the Black Ferrothorns. In the meantime, why don’t you help your fellow Black [player-name-1] out?
entries.translated:
Aku sibuk menyusun strategi yang
sempurna untuk serangan kita\lterhadap Black Ferrothorn.

Sementara itu, kenapa kau tidak
membantu sesama Black [player]?

entries.original:
"Before we moved in, this base
belonged to the old gang that used\lto run Antisis City.

After the Black Ferrothorn kicked
’em out, they left this base\lripe for the takin’.

We fixed it up real nice since we
got here, and we even replaced the\lplugged up hole to the sewers with\lactual stairs!"
entries.translation_source: Before we moved in, this base belonged to the old gang that used to run Antisis City. After the Black Ferrothorn kicked ’em out, they left this base ripe for the takin’. We fixed it up real nice since we got here, and we even replaced the plugged up hole to the sewers with actual stairs!
entries.translated:
Sebelum kami pindah, markas ini
milik geng lama yang dulu menguasai\lAntisis City. Setelah Black

Ferrothorn mengusir mereka, mereka
meninggalkan markas ini siap\ldiambil. Kami memperbaikinya sejak

tiba di sini, dan kami bahkan
mengganti lubang tersumbat ke\lselokan dengan tangga sungguhan!

entries.original:
"We’re comin’ up with a strategy to
take down the Black Ferrothorn."
entries.translation_source: We’re comin’ up with a strategy to take down the Black Ferrothorn.
entries.translated:
Kami sedang menyusun strategi untuk
mengalahkan Black Ferrothorn.

entries.original:
"When we get rid of those Black
Ferrothorns, I’m gonna take one of\ltheir couches for myself.

I bet they have a boatload in that
fancy base of theirs!"
entries.translation_source: When we get rid of those Black Ferrothorns, I’m gonna take one of their couches for myself. I bet they have a boatload in that fancy base of theirs!

entries.original: "Flushed Away"
entries.translation_source: Flushed Away
entries.translated: Terhanyut

entries.original:
"Someone’s havin’ toilet troubles!
Help your fellow Black [player] by
retrievin’ his socks from the sewer."
entries.translation_source: Someone’s havin’ toilet troubles! Help your fellow Black [player-name-1] by retrievin’ his socks from the sewer.
entries.translated:
Seseorang mengalami masalah
toilet! Bantu sesamamu, Black
[player], dengan ... selokan.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], buddy, how’s
it hangin’?

Listen, [player], the other day
I\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 accidentally flushed my\lfavourite pair of socks down the\ldrain.

Come ’ere and ’elp me, why doncha?

Listen ’ere, pal.

Those Black Ferrothorns, see, they

They gots all the connections in

they’re gettin’ their goods from.

Ya see, there’s this scientist -
she lives not too far from ’ere.

She’s been gettin’ them all the
latest in enhancers the Science\lSociety ’as been puttin’ out on\lthe black market.

I’m too chicken to take ’er on
alone, but with you\.

That’d be a whole ’nother story,
ya ’ear?

So whaddya say, you in, my [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! My [buffer1-2]! Come ’ere and ’elp me, why doncha? Listen ’ere, pal. Those Black Ferrothorns, see, they gots all this good stuff. They gots all the connections in high places to get their Pokémon pumped up big an’ strong. If we’re gonna take ’em out, we’re gonna need to cut off their supply, ya ’ear? Good news is, I know where exactly they’re gettin’ their goods from. Ya see, there’s this scientist - she lives not too far from ’ere. She’s been gettin’ them all the latest in enhancers the Science Society ’as been puttin’ out on the black market. "Sweet, my [buffer1]!

We’re gonna gets our Pokémon

entries.translation_source: Sweet, my [buffer1-1]! We’re gonna gets our Pokémon pumped up all big and strong, ya ’ear? Let’s do this thing! That scientist lives in the ’ouse right next to the Pokémon Center. I’ll go on ahead and meet you there, my [buffer1-2]!

Manis, [buffer1] saya! Kita akan
membuat Pokémon kita besar dan\lkuat, kamu dengar? Ayo lakukan ini!

Ilmuwan itu tinggal di rumah tepat
di sebelah Pokémon Center. Aku akan\lpergi duluan dan menemuimu di sana,

[buffer1] saya!

entries.original:
"’ey! My [buffer1]!

Thanks to your ’elp, we’ve now
got a great way to pump up our\lPokémon before we fight them\lBlack Ferrothorns!

That Pokémon I nabbed from that
scientist was what she was usin’\lto create the serum that them\lBlack Ferrothorns ’ave been usin’,\lya ’ear?

No idea ’ow she was doin’ it,
though.

It must’ve been some weird power
of alchemy.

That don’t really matter, though,
since James knows ’ow to do it for\lus, too, ya ’ear?

Oh, yeah, I almost forgot, my [buffer1].
James wanted you to ’ave this."
entries.translation_source: ’ey! My [buffer1-1]! Thanks to your ’elp, we’ve now got a great way to pump up our Pokémon before we fight them Black Ferrothorns! That Pokémon I nabbed from that scientist was what she was usin’ to create the serum that them Black Ferrothorns ’ave been usin’, ya ’ear? No idea ’ow she was doin’ it, though. entries.translated:
Hei! [buffer1] saya! Berkat
bantuanmu, kita sekarang punya cara\lhebat untuk menguatkan Pokémon kita

sebelum melawan para Black
Ferrothorn! Pokémon yang aku ambil\ldari ilmuwan itu adalah yang dia

gunakan untuk membuat serum yang
dipakai para Black Ferrothorn, kamu\ldengar? Tidak tahu bagaimana dia

tahu cara melakukannya untuk kita,
kamu dengar? Oh, ya, hampir lupa,\l[buffer1] saya. James ingin kamu

memiliki ini.

entries.original:
"That cry\.

I’ve heard it somewhere before\.

You must be one of those rare Ice-

Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped

Now that I mention it, I haven’t
seen them around in a while\."
entries.translation_source: That cry[game-token-1] I’ve heard it somewhere before[game-token-2] Ah! You must be one of those rare Ice- type Sandslash that live up here! Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped coming to feed you? Now that I mention it, I haven’t seen them around in a while[game-token-3]

entries.original:
"Then I was right.

You’ve been hungry because your
food supply stopped coming.

Let me make you a deal then,
Sandslash.

If you become my Pokémon and help
me make an income through battling,\lI will support you, your friends,\land your family through the money\lwe make.

Does that work for you?"
entries.translation_source: Then I was right. You’ve been hungry because your food supply stopped coming. Let me make you a deal then, Sandslash. If you become my Pokémon and help me make an income through battling, I will support you, your friends, and your family through the money we make. Does that work for you?

entries.original:
"[red]Those three are Uxie, Mesprit,
and Azelf.

They’re thought to be the Pokémon
that gave us knowledge, emotion,\land willpower.

Still, I wonder where those three
went\.

Hey, assistant!

Look all over the Borrius region,
and try to find them!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Those three are Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf. They’re thought to be the Pokémon that gave us knowledge, emotion, and willpower. Still, I wonder where those three went[game-token-2] Hey, assistant! Look all over the Borrius region, and try to find them!

entries.original:
"I wonder where those three
Pokémon flew off to?

Uxie is a Pokémon that symbolizes
knowledge\.

If you mention a place in Borrius
where knowledge is gathered, the\lfirst thing that comes to mind is\lthe [green]Dream Research Lab[red]\.

Mesprit is a Pokémon that presides
over emotion, right?

Maybe someplace where you [green]heard[red]
something that stirred your\lemotions?

And Azelf is willpower\.

The desire to [green]see something
through[red]\.

What place could represent that?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder where those three Pokémon flew off to? Uxie is a Pokémon that symbolizes knowledge[game-token-1] If you mention a place in Borrius where knowledge is gathered, the first thing that comes to mind is the [color-green-2]Dream Research Lab[color-red-3][game-token-4] Mesprit is a Pokémon that presides over emotion, right? Maybe someplace where you [color-green-5]heard[color-red-6] something that stirred your emotions? And Azelf is willpower[game-token-7] The desire to [color-green-8]see something through[color-red-9][game-token-10] What place could represent that?

entries.original:
"I have this feeling that you caught
the three Pokémon that flew off.

Can you bring them here for me
to see?"
entries.translation_source: I have this feeling that you caught the three Pokémon that flew off. Can you bring them here for me to see?

entries.original:
"Good work on the capture of the
three Pokémon, assistant.

Now, do you feel it?

The space\.
It feels full again\."
entries.translation_source: Good work on the capture of the three Pokémon, assistant. Now, do you feel it? The space[game-token-1] It feels full again[game-token-2]

entries.original:
"Astounding!
Simply astounding!

It appears your three Pokémon have
allowed Dialga, the master of time\lto begin crossing over into our\ldimension!

It is well known that these
Pokémon share a unique bond, but\lI did not expect this to happen!

Although, take note that Dialga
lacks a reflection.

That must mean it is waiting for
you to capture it before it can\lcompletely enter our dimension.

My colleagues at the Science
Society will be most pleased with\lmy findings\.

And as a reward for your assistance,
please take this rare orb that\lseems to resonate with Dialga."
entries.translation_source: Astounding! Simply astounding! It appears your three Pokémon have allowed Dialga, the master of time to begin crossing over into our dimension! It is well known that these Pokémon share a unique bond, but I did not expect this to happen! Although, take note that Dialga lacks a reflection. That must mean it is waiting for you to capture it before it can completely enter our dimension. My colleagues at the Science Society will be most pleased with my findings[game-token-1] And as a reward for your assistance, please take this rare orb that seems to resonate with Dialga.

entries.original:
"Our Miltank are our pride and joy!

It’d be an awful shame if something
happened to them.

There’d go our livelihood!"
