entries.original:
"Oh, dear me!

The Miltank, our pride and joy\.
They’ve been stolen!

Some thugs callin’ themselves the
\qoTerror Granbull\qc or somethin’ or\lother came and nabbed our Miltank!

How are we gonna survive without
’em?

\.

That’s it!

You’re Borrius’ new Champion,
aren’t you?

Won’t you help us get our Miltank
back?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me! The Miltank, our pride and joy[game-token-1] They’ve been stolen! Some thugs callin’ themselves the [quote-open-2]Terror Granbull[quote-close-3] or somethin’ or other came and nabbed our Miltank! How are we gonna survive without ’em? [game-token-4] That’s it! You’re Borrius’ new Champion, aren’t you? Won’t you help us get our Miltank back?

entries.original:
"Thanks, hon, you’re a real
life saver.

Those thugs can’t have gotten far.

I’d wager they’re in the [green]Magnolia
Fields[red] as we speak."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, hon, you’re a real life saver. Those thugs can’t have gotten far. I’d wager they’re in the [color-green-1]Magnolia Fields[color-red-2] as we speak.

entries.original:
"Our Miltank ain’t the brightest
of cattle.

If you approach any in the [green]Magnolia
Fields[red], they’ll prolly run away\lfrom you until they hit a wall.

If you can get ’em to run back to
town, then we’ll take it from there."
entries.translation_source: Our Miltank ain’t the brightest of cattle. If you approach any in the [color-green-1]Magnolia Fields[color-red-2], they’ll prolly run away from you until they hit a wall. If you can get ’em to run back to town, then we’ll take it from there.

entries.original:
"Some of our pride and joy, the
Miltank have returned to the farm!

But there are still some out in the
[green]Magnolia Fields[red], I reckon."
entries.translation_source: Some of our pride and joy, the Miltank have returned to the farm! But there are still some out in the [color-green-1]Magnolia Fields[color-red-2], I reckon.

entries.original:
"Oh, dear me!

If the Champion can’t help me,
then who can?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me! If the Champion can’t help me, then who can?

entries.original:
"Our pride and joy, the Miltank
have returned to the farm!

I can’t thank you enough for
this, hon.

You gotta take this year’s supply
of Moomoo Milk as my thanks."
entries.translation_source: Our pride and joy, the Miltank have returned to the farm! I can’t thank you enough for this, hon. You gotta take this year’s supply of Moomoo Milk as my thanks.

livelihood back.

And business ain’t never been

entries.translation_source: Miltank
entries.translated: Miltank

"Arright, boys!

You all messed up big time in
Cootes Bog, but this here is our\lbig score!

Hahaha!

These Miltank are gonna make us
rich!

We’re gonna milk ’em dry for
everything they have!"
entries.translation_source: Arright, boys! You all messed up big time in Cootes Bog, but this here is our big score! Hahaha! These Miltank are gonna make us rich! We’re gonna milk ’em dry for everything they have!

Give milk!"

entries.original: "[green]Mooooo\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Mooooo[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Mooooo\.

entries.original:
"I know you stupid cows produce over
five gallons of milk a day, so come\lon, fork it over!"
entries.translation_source: I know you stupid cows produce over five gallons of milk a day, so come on, fork it over!

entries.original:
"This just ain’t workin’ like I’d
hoped, boys.

Any of you got any bright ideas?"
entries.translation_source: This just ain’t workin’ like I’d hoped, boys. Any of you got any bright ideas?

entries.original:
"Get back here you stupid cows!
I wasn’t done milkin’ ya!"
entries.translation_source: Get back here you stupid cows! I wasn’t done milkin’ ya!

entries.original:
"Huh?

It’s some punk kid!

Let’s rough [buffer2] up and snatch\."
entries.translation_source: Huh? It’s some punk kid! Let’s rough [buffer2-1] up and snatch[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Huh? Itu anak punk! Ayo kita
kerjain [buffer2] dan rampas\.

entries.original:
"Hold up, boys!
That kid looks awfully familiar\.

Wait, I know you\.\CC0820 you’re that little
punk who got all up in our business\lback at Route 10!

And from what I heard, you went
and messed with my boys back in\lCootes Bog too, didn’t ya?

And here ya are again.

Seriously, what’s the deal with
ya, punk!?

Boys! Watch yourself around
that punk kid!

Don’t underestimate [buffer2], or your
butts’ll be handed to ya faster\lthan you can say \qoGranbull\qc!"
entries.translation_source: Hold up, boys! That kid looks awfully familiar[game-token-1] Wait, I know you[game-token-2][control-code-3] you’re that little punk who got all up in our business back at Route 10! And from what I heard, you went and messed with my boys back in Cootes Bog too, didn’t ya? And here ya are again. Seriously, what’s the deal with ya, punk!? Boys! Watch yourself around that punk kid! Don’t underestimate [buffer2-4], or your butts’ll be handed to ya faster than you can say [quote-open-5]Granbull[quote-close-6]!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry about a thing, Boss!

I’m gonna beat [buffer1] so hard, [buffer2]’s
gonna cry for [buffer3] momma!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry about a thing, Boss! I’m gonna beat [buffer1-1] so hard, [buffer2-2]’s gonna cry for [buffer3-3] momma!

entries.original:
"You dumbo!

You can’t use your Granbull like
that!

Move over, and lemme show you how
to really use Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: You dumbo! You can’t use your Granbull like that! Move over, and lemme show you how to really use Granbull!

entries.original:
"Gah! Ya stupid ding dongs!

I told ya NOT to underestimate
[buffer1]!

But what didja go ahead and do?
You underestimated [buffer1]!

Seriously, of all the goons, why’d
I get stuck with the dumbest ones?

I could throw schmuck after schmuck
at this kid, but I’m pretty sure\leven a thousand wouldn’t make a\ldifference!

Does that mean the Terror Granbull’s
stuck bein’ the losers forever\.?"
entries.translation_source: Gah! Ya stupid ding dongs! I told ya NOT to underestimate [buffer1-1]! But what didja go ahead and do? You underestimated [buffer1-2]! Seriously, of all the goons, why’d I get stuck with the dumbest ones? I could throw schmuck after schmuck at this kid, but I’m pretty sure even a thousand wouldn’t make a difference! Does that mean the Terror Granbull’s stuck bein’ the losers forever[game-token-3]?

entries.original:
"It doesn’t have to be that way,
Gruff."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t have to be that way, Gruff.
entries.translated: Tidak harus seperti itu, Gruff.

entries.original: "And who do ya think you are?"
entries.translation_source: And who do ya think you are?
entries.translated: Dan kamu pikir kamu siapa?

entries.original:
"The name’s James.

I used to be in charge of the
roughest and toughest gang around,\lthe Black [player]!

But those Black Ferrothorns did the
same thing they did to you, to us.

They kicked us right outta
Antisis City!

Me and the Black [player] were
lost until the Boss found us.

She gave us a new purpose.

We’re now proudly known as the
Black Horizon.

You and your boys should join us,
Gruff.

We got enough goons now to take
down an entire army!

The Black Ferrothorn don’t stand
a chance anymore!"
entries.translation_source: The name’s James. I used to be in charge of the roughest and toughest gang around, the Black [player-name-1]! But those Black Ferrothorns did the same thing they did to you, to us. They kicked us right outta Antisis City! Me and the Black [player-name-2] were lost until the Boss found us. She gave us a new purpose. We’re now proudly known as the Black Horizon. You and your boys should join us, Gruff. We got enough goons now to take down an entire army! The Black Ferrothorn don’t stand a chance anymore!

entries.original:
"The Black Horizon, huh?

I kinda like the sound of that\.

But say we join up with you chumps,
what happens to our Granbull?

None of us could imagine our lives
without ’em."
entries.translation_source: The Black Horizon, huh? I kinda like the sound of that[game-token-1] But say we join up with you chumps, what happens to our Granbull? None of us could imagine our lives without ’em.

entries.original:
"The Boss isn’t too big on forcin’
everyone to use the same kind of\lPokémon.

So you can keep ’em."
entries.translation_source: The Boss isn’t too big on forcin’ everyone to use the same kind of Pokémon. So you can keep ’em.

entries.original: "Then we’re sold."
entries.translation_source: Then we’re sold.

entries.original:
"Come on, boys!
We’re goin’ to the Black Horizon!

Those Black Ferrothorns are gonna
feel terror that not even the\lTerror Granbull alone could whip up!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, boys! We’re goin’ to the Black Horizon! Those Black Ferrothorns are gonna feel terror that not even the Terror Granbull alone could whip up!

entries.original:
"It’s been a minute, [player].

How’ve ya been without the Black
[player] keepin’ ya on the\lstraight and narrow?

\.

So you became Champion, huh?

I always knew I had the eye for
great talent!

You sure got your share of guts,
kid.

It’s a shame the Boss doesn’t want
you joinin’ the Black Horizon.

Something about having \qospecial
plans\qc for you.

Anyway, [player], keep on bein’
the gutsiest Trainer I know!"
entries.translation_source: It’s been a minute, [player-name-1]. How’ve ya been without the Black [player-name-2] keepin’ ya on the straight and narrow? [game-token-3] So you became Champion, huh? I always knew I had the eye for great talent! You sure got your share of guts, kid. It’s a shame the Boss doesn’t want you joinin’ the Black Horizon. Something about having [quote-open-4]special plans[quote-close-5] for you. Anyway, [player-name-6], keep on bein’ the gutsiest Trainer I know!

"Hello, child.

In my later years of life, I
managed to gamble away all of my\lmoney and belongings.

As such, every night, rain or
shine, I sleep on a bench.

It would be nice to have a place to
call home once again\.

Say\.

You seem full of spunk.

Would you like to find me a home?
It looks great on a résumé."
entries.translation_source: Hello, child. In my later years of life, I managed to gamble away all of my money and belongings. As such, every night, rain or shine, I sleep on a bench. It would be nice to have a place to call home once again[game-token-1] Say[game-token-2] You seem full of spunk. Would you like to find me a home? It looks great on a résumé.

entries.original:
"You are a blessed child.

I shall await your return."
entries.translation_source: You are a blessed child. I shall await your return.

entries.original:
"Clearly, I misjudged you.

No caring child would turn down
such a request from an old man."
entries.translation_source: Clearly, I misjudged you. No caring child would turn down such a request from an old man.

entries.original:
"Where should you look for a home?

Anywhere will do, as long as
it is indoors."
entries.translation_source: Where should you look for a home? Anywhere will do, as long as it is indoors.

entries.original:
"That look on your face\.

You’ve found a home, haven’t you?

Where is it located?

Seaport City?

I’ll head there right away.

Meet me there to make sure I get
settled in alright."
entries.translation_source: That look on your face[game-token-1] You’ve found a home, haven’t you? Where is it located? Seaport City? I’ll head there right away. Meet me there to make sure I get settled in alright.

entries.original:
"Hello again, child.

I have settled in quite nicely,
thanks to your efforts.

Please, I want you to take this
rare crystal as my thanks."
entries.translation_source: Hello again, child. I have settled in quite nicely, thanks to your efforts. Please, I want you to take this rare crystal as my thanks.

entries.original:
"Hello again, child.

You are very kind coming to visit
this kindly old man."
entries.translation_source: Hello again, child. You are very kind coming to visit this kindly old man.

entries.original:
"I own many residences in Seaport
City.

My Skitty and I are known around
here as the king and queen of real\lestate!"
entries.translation_source: I own many residences in Seaport City. My Skitty and I are known around here as the king and queen of real estate!

entries.original:
"What’s that, young [buffer1]?

You’re looking for a place to put
up a kindly older gentleman?

Unfortunately, I am not in the mood
to discuss business at the present\lmoment.

You see\. my dear real estate queen
ran away from me!

We had a horrible fight, and she
just took off to the streets!

Oh\. what am I to do\.?
I cannot think without her!"
entries.translation_source: What’s that, young [buffer1-1]? You’re looking for a place to put up a kindly older gentleman? Unfortunately, I am not in the mood to discuss business at the present moment. You see[game-token-2] my dear real estate queen ran away from me! We had a horrible fight, and she just took off to the streets! Oh[game-token-3] what am I to do[game-token-4]? I cannot think without her!
entries.translated:
Apa itu, anak muda [buffer1]? Kau
mencari tempat untuk menampung\lseorang pria tua yang baik hati?

Sayangnya, aku tidak sedang ingin
membicarakan bisnis saat ini. Kau\llihat\. ratu properti sayangku lari

dariku! Kami bertengkar hebat, dan
dia langsung pergi ke jalanan! Oh\.\lapa yang harus aku lakukan\.? Aku

tidak bisa berpikir tanpanya!

entries.original:
"Aha! An idea has firmly taken
root in my cranium!

Would you allow me to accompany you
in an attempt to locate my queen?

Knowing her, there is little chance
she ran far."
entries.translation_source: Aha! An idea has firmly taken root in my cranium! Would you allow me to accompany you in an attempt to locate my queen? Knowing her, there is little chance she ran far.
entries.translated:
Aha! Sebuah ide telah tertanam kuat
di kepalaku! Maukah kamu\lmengizinkanku menemanimu dalam

upaya menemukan ratuku? Mengenal
dia, kecil kemungkinan dia lari\ljauh.

entries.original:
"Splendid!
Let us begin our search.

She must be somewhere in Seaport
City.

She’s small and pink\. you can’t
miss her!"
entries.translation_source: Splendid! Let us begin our search. She must be somewhere in Seaport City. She’s small and pink[game-token-1] you can’t miss her!

entries.original:
"Well, then.

I have no further business to
discuss with you.

Hrmph."
entries.translation_source: Well, then. I have no further business to discuss with you. Hrmph.

entries.original:
"My queen must be somewhere in
Seaport City.

If you see something small and
pink\. well\. that’s my queen!"
entries.translation_source: My queen must be somewhere in Seaport City. If you see something small and pink[game-token-1] well[game-token-2] that’s my queen!

entries.original:
"A job well done, young [buffer1].

Now, let us return to my place of
residence so I may confer upon you\la handsome reward."
entries.translation_source: A job well done, young [buffer1-1]. Now, let us return to my place of residence so I may confer upon you a handsome reward.

entries.original:
"Ohhhh\.
You found me\.

Those ruffians, no, those hooligans
just abducted us out of nowhere!

And now I have no idea where we
are\.

My queen and I are so scared\.

Let’s go home\.
But truly this time\."
entries.translation_source: Ohhhh[game-token-1] You found me[game-token-2] Those ruffians, no, those hooligans just abducted us out of nowhere! And now I have no idea where we are[game-token-3] My queen and I are so scared[game-token-4] Let’s go home[game-token-5] But truly this time[game-token-6]

entries.original:
"Please take my queen and me home
safely\."
entries.translation_source: Please take my queen and me home safely[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Ah, yes.

I believe you mentioned something
earlier about needing a home for\lan older gentleman?

In that case, to thank you, feel
free to let him know he may move\lin upstairs, free of charge."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes. I believe you mentioned something earlier about needing a home for an older gentleman? In that case, to thank you, feel free to let him know he may move in upstairs, free of charge.

entries.original:
"Feel free to let your friend know
he may move in upstairs, free of\lcharge."
entries.translation_source: Feel free to let your friend know he may move in upstairs, free of charge.

entries.original:
"The fellow who moved in at your
request is quite the likable\ltenant.

He causes no disturbances
whatsoever, and has even agreed to\lkeep an eye on my queen whenever I\lgo away!

What a gentleman!"
entries.translation_source: The fellow who moved in at your request is quite the likable tenant. He causes no disturbances whatsoever, and has even agreed to keep an eye on my queen whenever I go away! What a gentleman!

entries.original:
"I do not believe my queen would
have wandered in that direction.

Let us try searching somewhere
else."
entries.translation_source: I do not believe my queen would have wandered in that direction. Let us try searching somewhere else.
entries.translated:
Saya tidak percaya ratu saya akan
berkelana ke arah itu. Mari kita\lcoba mencari di tempat lain.

entries.original:
"[blue]Heh, heh, heh\.
Seems we’ve found quite a catch!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Heh, heh, heh[game-token-2] Seems we’ve found quite a catch!

entries.original:
"[blue]Come on, man\.
Hurry up and catch it already!

A Skitty like that’ll go for big
bucks on the Black Market!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Come on, man[game-token-2] Hurry up and catch it already! A Skitty like that’ll go for big bucks on the Black Market!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ayolah, bung\. Cepat tangkap dia!
Skitty seperti itu akan laku mahal\ldi Pasar Gelap!

entries.original:
"[blue]Nooooooooo!
You ruffians! Leave my queen alone!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Nooooooooo! You ruffians! Leave my queen alone!

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh? Wazzat you kid?

You think you can interfere with
our business?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Huh? Wazzat you kid? You think you can interfere with our business?
entries.translated:
[blue]Huh? Ada apa, nak? Kau pikir bisa
ikut campur urusan kami?

entries.original:
"[blue]Somebody ought to teach a kid
like you to mind your manners!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Somebody ought to teach a kid like you to mind your manners!

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry,
I’m sorry!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry!
entries.translated: Maaf, maaf, maaf, maaf!

entries.original:
"Wait\.
That shout didn’t come from you\."
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1] That shout didn’t come from you[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Wait\. Teriakan itu bukan darimu\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Bullo, you oaf!
Quit messing around!

Just lemee ’em take out for you."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Bullo, you oaf! Quit messing around! Just lemee ’em take out for you.

entries.original:
"[blue]We ain’t gonna let you get away
with this, fat man!

Just you wait\. you and your Skitty
will regret this!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]We ain’t gonna let you get away with this, fat man! Just you wait[game-token-2] you and your Skitty will regret this!

entries.original:
"[blue]There, there, Queenie\.
It’s okay now\.

Those bad men are gone\.
I’m sorry we fought earlier\.

Kingy promises to be better to you
from now on\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]There, there, Queenie[game-token-2] It’s okay now[game-token-3] Those bad men are gone[game-token-4] I’m sorry we fought earlier[game-token-5] Kingy promises to be better to you from now on[game-token-6]

entries.original:
"[blue]Thank you for your assistance in
locating my queen!

I’ll be willing to talk business
with you once I arrive home safely."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Thank you for your assistance in locating my queen! I’ll be willing to talk business with you once I arrive home safely.

entries.original:
"It appears we have returned home
without further incident.

Now, let us\."
entries.translation_source: It appears we have returned home without further incident. Now, let us[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"[blue]Serves you and him right.

If you ever wanna see that snobby
man again, come alone to the\l[green]western warehouse[blue].

And don’t bring any Pokémon that
aren’t [green]Ice[blue]- or [green]Fairy[blue]-types!

We’re gonna teach you a lesson you
won’t forget!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Serves you and him right. If you ever wanna see that snobby man again, come alone to the [color-green-2]western warehouse[color-blue-3]. And don’t bring any Pokémon that aren’t [color-green-4]Ice[color-blue-5]- or [color-green-6]Fairy[color-blue-7]-types! We’re gonna teach you a lesson you won’t forget!

entries.original:
"That is not the way to my home.
Let us go in a different direction."
entries.translation_source: That is not the way to my home. Let us go in a different direction.
entries.translated:
Itu bukan jalan menuju rumahku. Ayo
pergi ke arah yang berbeda.

entries.original:
"You decided to take me up on my
offer, huh?

Did you come with only Ice- and
Fairy-types like I said?

\."
entries.translation_source: You decided to take me up on my offer, huh? Did you come with only Ice- and Fairy-types like I said? [game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Looks like you did.
Alright, then.

You can head down the stairs behind
me to try to rescue the fat man.

Good luck.
You’re going to need it\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you did. Alright, then. You can head down the stairs behind me to try to rescue the fat man. Good luck. You’re going to need it[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Done already?
This is no joke, kid.

That fat man is gonna stay down
there until someone rescues him."
entries.translation_source: Done already? This is no joke, kid. That fat man is gonna stay down there until someone rescues him.

entries.original:
"You think this is a joke, kid?

I said only bring [green]Ice[blue]- and [green]Fairy[blue]-
types!

If you wanna rescue the fat man,
you’ll need to do as I say."
entries.translation_source: You think this is a joke, kid? I said only bring [color-green-1]Ice[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Fairy[color-blue-4]- types! If you wanna rescue the fat man, you’ll need to do as I say.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hmph.

I thought the limitations placed on
you would mean the fat man would\lstay our prisoner forever.

Guess we have no choice, then.

Time for you to face our new
and improved teams!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hmph. I thought the limitations placed on you would mean the fat man would stay our prisoner forever. Guess we have no choice, then. Time for you to face our new and improved teams!

entries.original:
"Gah\.

I knew nabbin’ that Skitty was a
bad idea."
entries.translation_source: Gah[game-token-1] I knew nabbin’ that Skitty was a bad idea.

entries.original:
"Bullo, you oaf!
Quit messing around!

Just let my team handle it."
entries.translation_source: Bullo, you oaf! Quit messing around! Just let my team handle it.

entries.original:
"I give, kid.
You win again.

But the fat man sure learned his
lesson for mouthing off.

And as long as being at a
disadvantage was difficult for\lyou, you did too\."
entries.translation_source: I give, kid. You win again. But the fat man sure learned his lesson for mouthing off. And as long as being at a disadvantage was difficult for you, you did too[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Ah\.
My queen and I have returned home.

And this time, there does not appear
to be a hooligan in sight!

Thank you very much, young [buffer1].

Please meet me inside to discuss
your reward."
entries.translation_source: Ah[game-token-1] My queen and I have returned home. And this time, there does not appear to be a hooligan in sight! Thank you very much, young [buffer1-2]. Please meet me inside to discuss your reward.
entries.translated:
Ah\. Aku dan ratuku telah kembali ke
rumah. Dan kali ini, sepertinya\ltidak ada preman di sekitar! Terima

kasih banyak, [buffer1] muda.
Silakan temui aku di dalam untuk\lmembahas hadiahmu.

entries.original:
"Swizer called us in to help teach
you a lesson.

Don’t think you’ll get away with
messing with us!"
entries.translation_source: Swizer called us in to help teach you a lesson. Don’t think you’ll get away with messing with us!

entries.original: "There’s still more to come!"
entries.translation_source: There’s still more to come!

entries.original:
"Swizer’s prepared for this!
You won’t outsmart him!"
entries.translation_source: Swizer’s prepared for this! You won’t outsmart him!

entries.original:
"The Seaport Burglar Society controls
crime in Seaport City."
entries.translation_source: The Seaport Burglar Society controls crime in Seaport City.

entries.original:
"One of these days the Seaport
Burglar Society will be known to all!"
entries.translation_source: One of these days the Seaport Burglar Society will be known to all!

entries.original:
"Our leader is El-Scamo!

He likes to scam people!"
entries.translation_source: Our leader is El-Scamo! He likes to scam people!

entries.original: "El-Scamo is gonna be upset!"
entries.translation_source: El-Scamo is gonna be upset!
entries.translated: El-Scamo akan kesal!

entries.original:
"El-Scamo is a master thief.

No one knows what he truly looks
like!"
entries.translation_source: El-Scamo is a master thief. No one knows what he truly looks like!

entries.original:
"We’ll slow you down!
The Black Ferrothorn rule!"
entries.translation_source: We’ll slow you down! The Black Ferrothorn rule!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
We’ll rule the Seaport underworld!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! We’ll rule the Seaport underworld!

entries.original:
"We control crime here, now!
Us, the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: We control crime here, now! Us, the Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"Barbs rules the Black Ferrothorn
with an iron fist!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs rules the Black Ferrothorn with an iron fist!
entries.translated:
Barbs memimpin Black Ferrothorn
dengan tangan besi!

entries.original: "Island Saviour"
entries.translation_source: Island Saviour
entries.translated: Penyelamat Pulau

entries.original:
"A Hiker needs your help getting off
an island! Bring a Pokémon with
Dig to help him escape."
entries.translation_source: A Hiker needs your help getting off an island! Bring a Pokémon with Dig to help him escape.
entries.translated:
Seorang Pendaki membutuhkan
bantuanmu untuk keluar dari
sebuah ... membantunya kabur.

entries.original:
"Hoo boy, Trainer!

I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m
wondering if you can help me out.

I got to this island by digging
up from a hidden tunnel, but my\lGraveler forgot Dig when it\llearned a new move.

Now I’m stuck here with no way off
this island.

Can you help me get back home?"
entries.translation_source: Hoo boy, Trainer! I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m wondering if you can help me out. I got to this island by digging up from a hidden tunnel, but my Graveler forgot Dig when it learned a new move. Now I’m stuck here with no way off this island. Can you help me get back home?

entries.original:
"Awesome!

All you need is a Pokémon that
knows [green]Dig[blue].

Do you have one with you?"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! All you need is a Pokémon that knows [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]. Do you have one with you?

entries.original:
"Amazing!

The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re
ready to go into the tunnel.

There is no going back until you
reach the other exit."
entries.translation_source: Amazing! The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re ready to go into the tunnel. There is no going back until you reach the other exit.

entries.original:
"I’m going to challenge you to a
battle before we go.

I need to be sure you’re strong
enough to survive down there."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to challenge you to a battle before we go. I need to be sure you’re strong enough to survive down there.
entries.translated:
Aku akan menantangmu bertarung
sebelum kita pergi. Aku harus yakin\lkamu cukup kuat untuk bertahan di

sana.

entries.original: "I think you’re ready!"
entries.translation_source: I think you’re ready!

entries.original:
"Alrighty, let’s go!
Use Dig!"
entries.translation_source: Alrighty, let’s go! Use Dig!

entries.original:
"What are you getting at?
None of your Pokémon know [green]Dig[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: What are you getting at? None of your Pokémon know [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Apa maksudmu? Tidak ada Pokémon-mu
yang tahu [green]Menggali[blue]!

entries.original:
"No?

Well I hope the rising tide won’t
drown me\."
entries.translation_source: No? Well I hope the rising tide won’t drown me[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"No?

[green]Sandshrew[blue] and [green]Sandslash[blue] in the
[green]Great Desert[blue] usually know Dig."
entries.translation_source: No? [color-green-1]Sandshrew[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Sandslash[color-blue-4] in the [color-green-5]Great Desert[color-blue-6] usually know Dig.
entries.translated:
Tidak? [green]Sandshrew[blue] dan [green]Sandslash[blue] di
[green]Gurun Besar[blue] biasanya tahu Dig.

entries.original:
"It’s just a tunnel, what’s there
to be scared about?"
entries.translation_source: It’s just a tunnel, what’s there to be scared about?
entries.translated:
Ini hanya terowongan, apa yang
perlu ditakuti?

entries.original:
"Well, we’re here!
The Lost Tunnel\.

It’s rather dank in here\.
It’s also really dark.

I don’t think even a Pokémon could
light it up.

Well, we’d better get going!

There’s a ladder up, somewhere
around here."
entries.translation_source: Well, we’re here! The Lost Tunnel[game-token-1] It’s rather dank in here[game-token-2] It’s also really dark. I don’t think even a Pokémon could light it up. Well, we’d better get going! There’s a ladder up, somewhere around here.

entries.original:
"I’m sure there is a ladder
somewhere around here\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sure there is a ladder somewhere around here[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Whew, I’m lost already!

I hope you know where you’re
going."
entries.translation_source: Whew, I’m lost already! I hope you know where you’re going.

entries.original:
"Have I ever mentioned how much I
hate Diglett?"
entries.translation_source: Have I ever mentioned how much I hate Diglett?

entries.original:
"What was that!?

Oh\. just a shadow\."
entries.translation_source: What was that!? Oh[game-token-1] just a shadow[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Apa itu tadi!? Oh\. hanya bayangan\.

entries.original:
"You’re surprisingly brave for a
young Trainer, you know?"
entries.translation_source: You’re surprisingly brave for a young Trainer, you know?

entries.original:
"What?
An earthquake? Now?"
entries.translation_source: What? An earthquake? Now?
entries.translated: Apa? Gempa? Sekarang?

entries.original:
"Wow, you wiped the floor with
that Diglett!

Have you ever wondered what a
Diglett’s feet look like?"
entries.translation_source: Wow, you wiped the floor with that Diglett! Have you ever wondered what a Diglett’s feet look like?

entries.original:
"Again?
I hope no rocks fall on me\."
entries.translation_source: Again? I hope no rocks fall on me[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"That was a tough Golem!

I wonder if it would get along
with my Graveler\."
entries.translation_source: That was a tough Golem! I wonder if it would get along with my Graveler[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"A third time?
This can’t be a coincidence!"
entries.translation_source: A third time? This can’t be a coincidence!
entries.translated:
Ketiga kalinya? Ini pasti bukan
kebetulan!

entries.original:
"Phew, that was a tough battle!
I’m tired just from watching!

But now that you took out that
Dugtrio, the tremors should stop."
entries.translation_source: Phew, that was a tough battle! I’m tired just from watching! But now that you took out that Dugtrio, the tremors should stop.

entries.original:
"There’s the ladder!

I thought we would be stuck here
forever\.

Let’s get out of here."
entries.translation_source: There’s the ladder! I thought we would be stuck here forever[game-token-1] Let’s get out of here.

entries.original:
"What? A dead end!

I’m sure there’s a way out of
here\."
entries.translation_source: What? A dead end! I’m sure there’s a way out of here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Apa? Jalan buntu! Aku yakin ada
jalan keluar dari sini\.

entries.original: "Let me see\."
entries.translation_source: Let me see[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Aha! Found it!

A weak spot in the wall, right
here."
entries.translation_source: Aha! Found it! A weak spot in the wall, right here.
entries.translated:
Aha! Ketemu! Titik lemah di
dinding, tepat di sini.

entries.original: "Graveler, use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Graveler, use Rock Smash!

entries.original: "[green]Rarrrarrr!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Rarrrarrr!
entries.translated: [green]Rarrrarrr!

entries.original:
"Thanks for all your help!
Here, take this TM.

I forgot I had it this whole time."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for all your help! Here, take this TM. I forgot I had it this whole time.
entries.translated:
Terima kasih atas semua bantuanmu!
Ini, ambil TM ini. Aku lupa aku\lmemilikinya selama ini.

entries.original:
"TM28 contains [green]Dig[blue].

We should have just used it right
away, eh?"
entries.translation_source: TM28 contains [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]. We should have just used it right away, eh?
entries.translated:
TM28 berisi [green]Gali[blue]. Lebih baik kita
langsung menggunakannya, ya?

entries.original: "Nine Tails of Snow"
entries.translation_source: Nine Tails of Snow
entries.translated: Sembilan Ekor Salju

entries.original:
"An idol can’t perform without her
precious Pokémon! Track down the
burglar that stole her Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: An idol can’t perform without her precious Pokémon! Track down the burglar that stole her Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Seorang idola tidak bisa tampil
tanpa Pokémon kesayangannya!
Lacak ... mencuri Pokémon-nya.

entries.original: "Burglar"
entries.translation_source: Burglar
entries.translated: Pencuri

entries.original:
"Whatever will I do\.

My beloved baby was taken from me
by some\. some\. crook!

How can I perform on stage
without her?

Please, help me get my baby back!"
entries.translation_source: Whatever will I do[game-token-1] My beloved baby was taken from me by some[game-token-2] some[game-token-3] crook! How can I perform on stage without her? Please, help me get my baby back!

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you!

Thank you, thank you!

I know that my baby was taken by a
man dressed in gray.

But that’s all I know\.
I wish I knew where he went\."

salah. Kalau begitu, ambillah ini.

Granbull Teror menyebabkan
keributan! Bergabunglah dengan
... dan memulihkan ketertiban.

"[player], come here, darlin’.
I need your help with a problem.

Ya see, some goons are causin’
quite a ruckus, right here in\lCootes Bog.

And my Swampert, who is the
protector of this here bog, is as\lgone as a vegan at a hog fry!

Swampert is supposed to keep the
delicate balance of this unique\lecosytem, but without it, there’s\lnothin’ settlin’ down these goons!

I need to stop their shenanigans
and find my Swampert, so balance\lcan be restored to the swamp.

But, you see, I can’t take out all
these goons alone.

So, what do ya say, down for an
adventure with ol’ Tessy?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], come here, darlin’. I need your help with a problem. Ya see, some goons are causin’ quite a ruckus, right here in Cootes Bog. And my Swampert, who is the protector of this here bog, is as gone as a vegan at a hog fry! Swampert is supposed to keep the delicate balance of this unique ecosytem, but without it, there’s nothin’ settlin’ down these goons! I need to stop their shenanigans and find my Swampert, so balance can be restored to the swamp. But, you see, I can’t take out all these goons alone. So, what do ya say, down for an adventure with ol’ Tessy?

up, too."

[green]first 3[black] Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle."

"Well, gosh darn’ it!

swamp, so when it’s here, all the\lother Pokémon fall in line.

Let’s find out what happened to
’ol Swampert!"

ya can.

entries.translated:
[red]Segera temui aku begitu kamu bisa.

ol’ critters before they cause\lanymore trouble in the bog!"

"[red]Looks like they’re comin’ straight
for us!

This about to get as hot as a
fryin’ pan in a July sun!"

"[red]Wowy, we did it!

Both these Pokémon aren’t goin’ to
be much trouble from here on out."

ini tidak akan banyak merepotkan\lmulai sekarang.

"[blue]Haha, you’ve fallen right into
our trap!

Thanks to this gizmo the Science
Society let us test out for ’em,\lwe’ll be able to turn this Pokémon\linto an unstoppable force!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Haha, you’ve fallen right into our trap! Thanks to this gizmo the Science Society let us test out for ’em, we’ll be able to turn this Pokémon into an unstoppable force!

entries.original:
"[red]Uh oh!

That goon there just injected that
Feraligatr with that science-y\llookin’ thing.

And now Feraligatr’s gettin’
bigger, an’ bigger, an’ bigger!

Looks like we’re goin’ to need to
settle it down again."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Uh oh! That goon there just injected that Feraligatr with that science-y lookin’ thing. And now Feraligatr’s gettin’ bigger, an’ bigger, an’ bigger! Looks like we’re goin’ to need to settle it down again.

[red]Uh oh! Preman itu baru saja
menyuntikkan benda yang terlihat\lilmiah itu ke Feraligatr itu. Dan

sekarang Feraligatr semakin besar,
dan besar, dan besar! Sepertinya\lkita harus menenangkannya lagi.

"[blue]Once these two finish gettin’
quashed by our ultimate Feraligatr,\lno one’ll be able to stand in our\lway as we claim a new home for\lus Terror Granbull!

We’re gonna march unopposed into
Polder Town and make it the seat\lof our new enterprise!

Who needs Antisis City?

Gruff’ll be so proud of all
us Terror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Once these two finish gettin’ quashed by our ultimate Feraligatr, no one’ll be able to stand in our way as we claim a new home for us Terror Granbull! We’re gonna march unopposed into Polder Town and make it the seat of our new enterprise! Who needs Antisis City? Gruff’ll be so proud of all us Terror Granbull!

entries.original: "[green]Gaaaaatoooor\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gaaaaatoooor[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Gaaaaatoooor\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Grrr\.
Arr\.

You may have defeated Feraligatr,
but without Swampert, the swamp is\lstill in chaos.

More contenders will arise, and
we’ll take the strong ones for\lourselves.

Soon we’ll be able to call Polder
Town our home, and there’s nothin’\lyou’ll be able to do to stop us!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Grrr[game-token-2] Arr[game-token-3] You may have defeated Feraligatr, but without Swampert, the swamp is still in chaos. More contenders will arise, and we’ll take the strong ones for ourselves. Soon we’ll be able to call Polder Town our home, and there’s nothin’ you’ll be able to do to stop us!

entries.original:
"[blue]Ahhh!
Swampert escaped!

I knew we shouldn’t have bought
those discount Poké-restraints!

Scatter, boys!

SCATTER!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ahhh! Swampert escaped! I knew we shouldn’t have bought those discount Poké-restraints! Scatter, boys! SCATTER!

"[red]Ah, Swampert, dear, it’s nice to
have ya back.

I hope them Terror Granbull didn’t
hurt ya too badly.

\.

Yes, I know those hoodlums need to
be punished, but I need ya to\lstay here in the bog so ya can\lrestore the balance.

Don’t ya worry, I’ll keep a
closer eye on the swamp from\lnow on.

If those hoodlums set one foot in
here, I’ll let ’em have it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Ah, Swampert, dear, it’s nice to have ya back. I hope them Terror Granbull didn’t hurt ya too badly. [game-token-2] Yes, I know those hoodlums need to be punished, but I need ya to stay here in the bog so ya can restore the balance. Don’t ya worry, I’ll keep a closer eye on the swamp from now on. If those hoodlums set one foot in here, I’ll let ’em have it!

"[red]Thank you, [player], for your help
in fixin’ the swamp and beatin’\lthose nasty varmints.

I am truly indebted to ya.

Here’s a little parcel of my
gratitude for ya service."

obliged to ya."

the strongest!"

not lick it\.

entries.original:
"[black]Dynamax is a unique phenomenon that
a Pokémon can only undergo in\lspecial areas, such as Hidden\lGrottos.

Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax,
but if a Pokémon holds a Mega\lStone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be\lable to.

To Dynamax a Pokémon, press \btn04
when you see the red Dynamax\lsymbol appear.

If you choose to Dynamax your
Pokémon, the effect will last\lfor three turns.

During this time period, each of
your Pokémon’s moves will be\lpowered up into special variants\lknown as [green]Max Moves[black].

These Max Moves are much more
powerful than regular attacks."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Dynamax is a unique phenomenon that a Pokémon can only undergo in special areas, such as Hidden Grottos. Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax, but if a Pokémon holds a Mega Stone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be able to. To Dynamax a Pokémon, press [button-icon-2] when you see the red Dynamax symbol appear. If you choose to Dynamax your Pokémon, the effect will last for three turns. During this time period, each of your Pokémon’s moves will be powered up into special variants known as [color-green-3]Max Moves[color-black-4]. These Max Moves are much more powerful than regular attacks.

entries.translation_source: The Swords of Justice of the Unova region have appeared! Why would they be here? The great Portal Boom, that’s why! Will you capture them and show them to me?

"The Swords of Justice are waiting
for a Trainer like the Champion\lto come and find them!

If you don’t find them soon,
someone else just might!"
entries.translation_source: The Swords of Justice are waiting for a Trainer like the Champion to come and find them! If you don’t find them soon, someone else just might!

entries.original:
"Ahaha, I knew I could count
on you!

Word has it the Pokémon have been
spotted around [green]Victory Road[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Ahaha, I knew I could count on you! Word has it the Pokémon have been spotted around [color-green-1]Victory Road[color-blue-2].

"Capture the Swords of Justice and
bring them here!

Word has it they’ve been spotted
around [green]Victory Road[blue].

They’re quite apprehensive of
humans, so they may only feel\lsecure when they’re together.

If you accidentally defeat one,
don’t worry!

Like most legendary Pokémon, they

Like most legendary Pokémon, they will reappear if you enter the Hall of Fame again.

You have done well capturing the
Swords of Justice.

Now, follow me and bring them to
[green]Route 17[blue].

I have a suspicion about them\."
entries.translation_source: Trainer! You have done well capturing the Swords of Justice. Now, follow me and bring them to [color-green-1]Route 17[color-blue-2]. I have a suspicion about them[game-token-3]

entries.original:
"Trainer!

Bring the Swords of Justice you
captured earlier.

I have a suspicion about this
rock face\."
entries.translation_source: Trainer! Bring the Swords of Justice you captured earlier. I have a suspicion about this rock face[game-token-1]

entries.original:
"Trainer!

I believe this rock face before me
is somehow linked to the Swords of\lJustice.

Please allow them out of their
Poké Balls, so we can see if they\lreact to the wall."
entries.translation_source: Trainer! I believe this rock face before me is somehow linked to the Swords of Justice. Please allow them out of their Poké Balls, so we can see if they react to the wall.

"[black]Your Pokémon are shaking in their
Poké Balls!"

Ball mereka!

entries.original:
"Ahaha!
My suspicions were confirmed!

Despite the Swords of Justice not
originating in Borrius, they still\lbear a strong connection with\lwhatever is hiding behind this\lrock face.

If I am correct, you’ll need these
in your fight against it."
entries.translation_source: Ahaha! My suspicions were confirmed! Despite the Swords of Justice not originating in Borrius, they still bear a strong connection with whatever is hiding behind this rock face. If I am correct, you’ll need these in your fight against it.

entries.original:
"May the swords be with you, young
Trainer."
entries.translation_source: May the swords be with you, young Trainer.

entries.original:
"[black]Keldeo boosted its aura and
increased its size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Keldeo boosted its aura and increased its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Keldeo meningkatkan aura dan
ukurannya!

entries.original: "The Terror Granbull"
entries.translation_source: The Terror Granbull
entries.translated: The Terror Granbull

"The Terror Granbull are causing
havoc on Route 10! Assist the local
authorities in rounding them up."
entries.translation_source: The Terror Granbull are causing havoc on Route 10! Assist the local authorities in rounding them up.
entries.translated:
Para Terror Granbull
menyebabkan kekacauan di Route
10! Bantu otoritas ... mereka.

to the Auburn Waterway! Help the
local authorities arrest 5 of them."

"The Terror Granbull have run away
to the Auburn Waterway! Help the
local authorities arrest 4 of them."

entries.original: "Hello, good citizen!"
entries.translation_source: Hello, good citizen!
entries.translated: Halo, warga yang baik!

entries.original:
"Oh, I remember you!

You’re that [buffer1] who assisted us in
the Dresco Town Gym!

For that, you can have these
five Revives."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I remember you! You’re that [buffer1-1] who assisted us in the Dresco Town Gym! For that, you can have these five Revives.

entries.original:
"Say, would you like to help out by
assisting the police again?"
entries.translation_source: Say, would you like to help out by assisting the police again?
entries.translated:
Ngomong-ngomong, apakah kamu mau
membantu polisi lagi?

entries.original:
"Ah\. those Badges mean that you’re
probably strong enough\.

Would you be willing to lend a
hand to the local police force?"
entries.translation_source: Ah[game-token-1] those Badges mean that you’re probably strong enough[game-token-2] Would you be willing to lend a hand to the local police force?
entries.translated:
Ah\. lencana-lencana itu berarti kamu
mungkin cukup kuat\. Apakah kamu\lbersedia membantu kepolisian

setempat?

entries.original:
"Ah, good, good.

Then, as you know, Borrius’ crime
problem mostly relates to the\lgangs that were confined together\lin [green]Antisis City[blue].

Recently, however, the gang that
used to dominate the most\lterritories there, the so-called\l\qoTerror Granbull\qc, vacated their\lold base.

On top of that, there’s been reports
that several members of the gang\lhave been congregating and causing\ltrouble in various locations.

With our police force spread so thin,
we need a strong Trainer such as\lyourself to help in rounding up\lthose goons."
entries.translation_source: Ah, good, good. Then, as you know, Borrius’ crime problem mostly relates to the gangs that were confined together in [color-green-1]Antisis City[color-blue-2]. Recently, however, the gang that used to dominate the most territories there, the so-called [quote-open-3]Terror Granbull[quote-close-4], vacated their old base. On top of that, there’s been reports that several members of the gang have been congregating and causing trouble in various locations. With our police force spread so thin, we need a strong Trainer such as yourself to help in rounding up those goons.

entries.original:
"Ah, thank you for your assistance.

When you are prepared, meet me on
the east side of [green]Route 10[blue], just up\lthe first set of stairs you see.

I recommend making sure your
Pokémon are healed up."
entries.translation_source: Ah, thank you for your assistance. When you are prepared, meet me on the east side of [color-green-1]Route 10[color-blue-2], just up the first set of stairs you see. I recommend making sure your Pokémon are healed up.

entries.original:
"Our forces will be spread thin for
the foreseeable future.

If you would like to lend a hand,
it will always be appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Our forces will be spread thin for the foreseeable future. If you would like to lend a hand, it will always be appreciated.
entries.translated:
Pasukan kami akan tersebar tipis
dalam waktu dekat. Jika kamu ingin\lmembantu, itu akan selalu dihargai.

entries.original:
"Huh?
It’s some punk kid!

Man, who just walks up to a big gang
of people without protection, huh?

Let’s rough [buffer2] up and snatch
all [buffer1] cash!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? It’s some punk kid! Man, who just walks up to a big gang of people without protection, huh? Let’s rough [buffer2-1] up and snatch all [buffer1-2] cash!

entries.original:
"That’s right! There’s no one to blame
but yourself, punk!"
entries.translation_source: That’s right! There’s no one to blame but yourself, punk!

entries.original:
"Didn’t your mommy ever tell you not
to follow strangers anywhere?

Well, we’re about to show ya why\.
the hard way!

So c’mon then - lemme hear ya
squeal, ya brat!

Beg for mercy from the
[green]Terror Granbull[green]!"
entries.translation_source: Didn’t your mommy ever tell you not to follow strangers anywhere? Well, we’re about to show ya why[game-token-1] the hard way! So c’mon then - lemme hear ya squeal, ya brat! Beg for mercy from the [color-green-2]Terror Granbull[color-green-3]!

entries.original:
"Hold it right there!

I’m arresting you, in the name of
the Fallshore City Police!"
entries.translation_source: Hold it right there! I’m arresting you, in the name of the Fallshore City Police!
entries.translated:
Berhenti di situ! Aku menangkapmu,
atas nama Kepolisian Kota\lFallshore!

entries.original:
"Uh oh - it’s the cops!

Scatter, boys!"
entries.translation_source: Uh oh - it’s the cops! Scatter, boys!

entries.original:
"What!? Get back here, you cowardly
wusses!

You outnumber these jokers, easily!

Gah\. just you wait - you’ll be sorry
you ever got in our way!"
entries.translation_source: What!? Get back here, you cowardly wusses! You outnumber these jokers, easily! Gah[game-token-1] just you wait - you’ll be sorry you ever got in our way!

entries.original:
"Darn\. they got away\.

Still, all this water means that
there aren’t too many places to\lescape from us.

They can’t have gone that far.
Let’s split up and look for them."
entries.translation_source: Darn[game-token-1] they got away[game-token-2] Still, all this water means that there aren’t too many places to escape from us. They can’t have gone that far. Let’s split up and look for them.

entries.original:
"And that’s you finished, I’m afraid!
You’re under arrest!

Now don’t cause any trouble, and
just come along quietly."
entries.translation_source: And that’s you finished, I’m afraid! You’re under arrest! Now don’t cause any trouble, and just come along quietly.
entries.translated:
Dan kamu sudah selesai, aku
khawatir! Kamu ditahan! Sekarang\ljangan buat masalah, dan ikut saja

dengan tenang.

entries.original:
"Good work, [player].

Thanks to your efforts, there’s one
less criminal on the loose.

Only [buffer1] are left now.

Keep searching, while I take this man
down to the station."
entries.translation_source: Good work, [player-name-1]. Thanks to your efforts, there’s one less criminal on the loose. Only [buffer1-2] are left now. Keep searching, while I take this man down to the station.
entries.translated:
Kerja bagus, [player]. Berkat
usahamu, satu penjahat berkurang.\lHanya [buffer1] yang tersisa

sekarang. Teruslah mencari,
sementara aku membawa orang ini ke\lkantor polisi.

entries.original:
"Great job, [player]!
That should be most of them now!

Only their leader remains at large,
so\.

Let’s regroup on [green]Route 10[blue] by the
stairs to determine his location."
entries.translation_source: Great job, [player-name-1]! That should be most of them now! Only their leader remains at large, so[game-token-2] Let’s regroup on [color-green-3]Route 10[color-blue-4] by the stairs to determine his location.

entries.original:
"It’s you - you’re the little brat
from earlier!

You thought you were so tough with
that cop backin’ you up?

Without him, you’re just some
pathetic wimp!

And pathetic wimps ain’t good for
anythin’ but crying!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you - you’re the little brat from earlier! You thought you were so tough with that cop backin’ you up? Without him, you’re just some pathetic wimp! And pathetic wimps ain’t good for anythin’ but crying!

entries.original:
"Ngh\. so the kid’s decided to play
detective, huh?

Fine! I’ll teach you no second-rate
brat can just go mess with the\lTerror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: Ngh[game-token-1] so the kid’s decided to play detective, huh? Fine! I’ll teach you no second-rate brat can just go mess with the Terror Granbull!

entries.original:
"Gah! How’d this little snot find me
hiding here!?

Grr\. well then, I guess you don’t
leave me any choice!

I’m gonna teach a punk like you a
lesson in pain!"
entries.translation_source: Gah! How’d this little snot find me hiding here!? Grr[game-token-1] well then, I guess you don’t leave me any choice! I’m gonna teach a punk like you a lesson in pain!

entries.original:
"Tch\. so this punk kid found me\.

Fine! Taste the terrible terror of
the Terror Granbull!

\.

That sounded way better in my head\."
entries.translation_source: Tch[game-token-1] so this punk kid found me[game-token-2] Fine! Taste the terrible terror of the Terror Granbull! [game-token-3] That sounded way better in my head[game-token-4]

entries.original:
"There you are, [player].

I must commend you on your valiant
efforts in rounding up those four\lcowardly goons.

As for the leader of the pack,
however, who remains at large\.

I haven’t seen him.

Has he returned to Antisis City,
perhaps?"
entries.translation_source: There you are, [player-name-1]. I must commend you on your valiant efforts in rounding up those four cowardly goons. As for the leader of the pack, however, who remains at large[game-token-2] I haven’t seen him. Has he returned to Antisis City, perhaps?
entries.translated:
Nah, kamu di sini, [player]. Aku
harus memuji usahamu yang berani\ldalam menangkap empat penjahat

pengecut itu. Sedangkan untuk
pemimpin kelompoknya, yang masih\lburon\. Aku belum melihatnya. Mungkin

dia sudah kembali ke Antisis City?

entries.original:
"Hahahaha! As if I would!

The mighty Gruff, leader of the
Terror Granbull, doesn’t just let a\lchance to beat down a do-gooder\lslip on by!"
entries.translation_source: Hahahaha! As if I would! The mighty Gruff, leader of the Terror Granbull, doesn’t just let a chance to beat down a do-gooder slip on by!

entries.original:
"Stop right there, criminal scum!

I’m taking you in for the various
felonies and disturbances you’ve\lcaused across Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Stop right there, criminal scum! I’m taking you in for the various felonies and disturbances you’ve caused across Borrius!

entries.original:
"Hah! I’d love to see ya try!

As for you, kid\. \CC0818 sure, you didn’t
do too bad, beatin’ my goons the\lway ya did\.

But those cowards fled from an
easy beatin’ - it was no surprise\lya won over those saps.

But you’re gonna find I ain’t such
an easy target, capice?

I’ll be a real man, and see just
how good ya really are.

Get ready, ya wannabe hero, ’cos
Gruff only knows how to play rough!"
entries.translation_source: Hah! I’d love to see ya try! As for you, kid[game-token-1] [control-code-2] sure, you didn’t do too bad, beatin’ my goons the way ya did[game-token-3] But those cowards fled from an easy beatin’ - it was no surprise ya won over those saps. But you’re gonna find I ain’t such an easy target, capice? I’ll be a real man, and see just how good ya really are. Get ready, ya wannabe hero, ’cos Gruff only knows how to play rough!

entries.original:
"Heh\. awright, I get it - ya got me,
fair and square!

But don’t go thinkin’ that I’m turning
myself in, ya hear?

I’m hoppin’ on a boat to East
Borrius, and me and the boys’ll\lmake a fresh start there!

Smell ya later, copper!

And next time, remember to
confiscate my bike!"
entries.translation_source: Heh[game-token-1] awright, I get it - ya got me, fair and square! But don’t go thinkin’ that I’m turning myself in, ya hear? I’m hoppin’ on a boat to East Borrius, and me and the boys’ll make a fresh start there! Smell ya later, copper! And next time, remember to confiscate my bike!

entries.original:
"Gah\.! I can’t believe it never
occurred to me to do that\.

Sigh\. but still, that was fine work
there, [player].

I’ll radio my colleagues in Seaport
City, to intercept him at the port.

There’s nothing more we can do here,
so for now, please take this.

Consider it a reward for doing your
bit to help the community."
entries.translation_source: Gah[game-token-1]! I can’t believe it never occurred to me to do that[game-token-2] Sigh[game-token-3] but still, that was fine work there, [player-name-4]. I’ll radio my colleagues in Seaport City, to intercept him at the port. There’s nothing more we can do here, so for now, please take this. Consider it a reward for doing your bit to help the community.

entries.original:
"Maybe another time\.

I could ask for your help in
solving another case.

Until then, stay safe, and stay
vigilant."
entries.translation_source: Maybe another time[game-token-1] I could ask for your help in solving another case. Until then, stay safe, and stay vigilant.

entries.translated: Terlalu Banyak TV

"Watching too much TV is bad for
your brain! Help cure children who
have had their brains fried by TV."

entries.translated:
Menonton TV terlalu banyak
buruk untuk ... anak-anak yang
otaknya telah rusak karena TV.

"Find a scientist who studies brain
activity to help wake a little girl
up from her coma."
entries.translation_source: Find a scientist who studies brain activity to help wake a little girl up from her coma.

entries.original:
"Find children in Borrius watching

"Find children in Borrius watching
TV and scan their brains.
Remaining: 3"

"Find children in Borrius watching
TV and scan their brains.
Remaining: 2"

TV and scan their brains.
Remaining: 1"

Dream Research lab with the data
gathered from the TV children."
entries.translation_source: Report back to the scientist at the Dream Research lab with the data gathered from the TV children.

entries.original:
"This boy was found watching TV in
the southwest house.
His eyes were glued to the TV."
entries.translation_source: This boy was found watching TV in the southwest house. His eyes were glued to the TV.

entries.original:
"This girl was found watching TV in
the Swarm family house.
Her brain seemed normal."
entries.translation_source: This girl was found watching TV in the Swarm family house. Her brain seemed normal.

entries.original:
"This boy was found watching TV in
the northeast house.
His brain seemed fried."

"This girl was found watching TV in
the house north of the market.
Her brain seemed gelatinous."
entries.translation_source: This girl was found watching TV in the house north of the market. Her brain seemed gelatinous.
entries.translated:
Gadis ini ditemukan menonton TV di
rumah di utara pasar. Otaknya\lsepertinya seperti agar-agar.

entries.translated: [black]Misi Selesai: [green][buffer1]

entries.original:
"My\.\CC0820 my daughter\.

She’s fallen into a deep coma\.

It’s because she\.\CC0820 she watched
too much television!

If only there were someone out
there who could help her\.

You seem like a well-traveled
Trainer.

Perhaps you know someone who
could help?"
entries.translation_source: My[game-token-1][control-code-2] my daughter[game-token-3] She’s fallen into a deep coma[game-token-4] It’s because she[game-token-5][control-code-6] she watched too much television! If only there were someone out there who could help her[game-token-7] You seem like a well-traveled Trainer. Perhaps you know someone who could help?

entries.original:
"I knew I was right to ask you!
Oh, thank you!

Please find someone to restore my
daughter’s consciousness.

Perhaps a scientist of some sort?

I’m sure there’s some institute out
there that researches the brain\."
entries.translation_source: I knew I was right to ask you! Oh, thank you! Please find someone to restore my daughter’s consciousness. Perhaps a scientist of some sort? I’m sure there’s some institute out there that researches the brain[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Aku tahu aku benar untuk bertanya
padamu! Oh, terima kasih! Tolong\lcari seseorang untuk memulihkan

kesadaran putriku. Mungkin seorang
ilmuwan? Aku yakin ada institut di\lluar sana yang meneliti otak\.

entries.original:
"If not you, this Trainer I
don’t even know, then who?"
entries.translation_source: If not you, this Trainer I don’t even know, then who?

entries.original:
"Ah, Trainer, it’s you again!

The scientist you sent was able to
heal my daughter!

My gratitude knows no bounds.

This mischievous Pokémon emerged
from my daughter during the\lhealing process.

I want you to have it."
entries.translation_source: Ah, Trainer, it’s you again! The scientist you sent was able to heal my daughter! My gratitude knows no bounds. This mischievous Pokémon emerged from my daughter during the healing process. I want you to have it.
entries.translated:
Ah, Pelatih, kamu lagi! Ilmuwan
yang kamu kirim berhasil\lmenyembuhkan putriku! Rasa terima

kasihku tak terbatas. Pokémon nakal
ini muncul dari putriku selama\lproses penyembuhan. Aku ingin kamu

memilikinya.

entries.original:
"But first you’ll need to make space
in your party for it."
entries.translation_source: But first you’ll need to make space in your party for it.

entries.original:
"Because of you, not only is my
daughter back to normal, but she\ldoesn’t even remember the concept\lof a television!

It’s truly a miracle."
entries.translation_source: Because of you, not only is my daughter back to normal, but she doesn’t even remember the concept of a television! It’s truly a miracle.
entries.translated:
Karena dirimu, bukan hanya putriku
kembali normal, tetapi dia bahkan\ltidak ingat konsep televisi!

Benar-benar sebuah keajaiban.

entries.original:
"[black]She’s in a dream-like state.

This is what happens when you
watch too much TV."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]She’s in a dream-like state. This is what happens when you watch too much TV.

entries.original:
"Thank you for helping me get
better, Trainer!

I heard I was sick, but my Daddy
won’t tell me why."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for helping me get better, Trainer! I heard I was sick, but my Daddy won’t tell me why.

entries.original:
"Here at the Dream Research Lab,
we study the dreams of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Here at the Dream Research Lab, we study the dreams of Pokémon.

entries.original:
"What did you say?

A child in Polder Town has fallen
into a coma due to watching too\lmuch television?

Then it must be worse than I
feared\.

I’ve been getting reports from all
across the region of children\lunable to divert their attention\lfrom that horrendous device.

In order to help this child, I must
have data on all of the children\lin Borrius locked into this\l\qotelevision\qc frenzy.

Trainer!

It’s up to you to get this data
for me.

By my count, there are [buffer1] children
total.

My scans indicate there are two in
snowy areas, one in a city on the\lcoast, and another in a somber and\lsad town.

You’ve found one, so that just
leaves [green][buffer2][blue] more.

When you encounter another, scan
them with your Super Cube and\lsend me the data."
entries.translation_source: What did you say? A child in Polder Town has fallen into a coma due to watching too much television? Then it must be worse than I feared[game-token-1] I’ve been getting reports from all across the region of children unable to divert their attention from that horrendous device. In order to help this child, I must have data on all of the children in Borrius locked into this [quote-open-2]television[quote-close-3] frenzy. Trainer! It’s up to you to get this data for me. By my count, there are [buffer1-4] children total. My scans indicate there are two in snowy areas, one in a city on the coast, and another in a somber and sad town. You’ve found one, so that just leaves [color-green-5][buffer2-6][color-blue-7] more. When you encounter another, scan them with your Super Cube and send me the data.
